ust ekranda boyle gorunur.

renginin

bir dokunus yeter.

original:

about in her letter?
translation:
<T>Az once olanlar... Bayan Ledore'un mektubunda
bahsettigi turden bir olay
miydi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>I imagine so, yes. It sounds as though
tonight's spectacle was but one of many.
translation:
<T>Sanirim oyle, evet. Gorunuse gore
bu geceki gosteri, yasananlarin
sadece biriydi.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Emmy, were you able to find out anything
that may help us?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Emmy, bize yardimci olabilecek
herhangi bir sey ogrenebildin mi?

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M6/1/5>As a matter of fact, yes! It seems our
Masked Gentleman first turned up here
about a month ago.
translation:
<T><M6/1/5>Aslinda evet! Gorunuse gore Maskeli Bey
ilk kez burada
bir ay kadar once ortaya cikmis.

original:
<T>He's been performing his miracles left, right
and centre. It has the whole city in a frenzy.<M1/1/1/45>
translation:
<T>Mucizelerini her yerde sergiliyor. Bu da
butun sehri cilgina cevirdi.<M1/1/1/45>

original:
<T>Why would he do something like this? These
innocent people only wanted to watch the
parade!
translation:
<T>Neden boyle bir sey yapsin ki? Bu
masum insanlar sadece gecit torenini
izlemek istiyordu!

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>It's worrying to see this troublemaker able to
act in impunity for so long. Presumably the
police are struggling with the case.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Bu bas belasinin bu kadar uzun sure
cezasiz hareket edebilmesi endise verici.
Anlasilan polis bu vakayla bogusuyor.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Seems so. They are trying to catch the
culprit, but they can't do much without any
leads on his identity.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Oyle gorunuyor. Sucluyu yakalamaya
calisiyorlar ama kimligine dair hicbir ipucu
olmadan pek bir sey yapamiyorlar.

original:
<T><M4/1/3>And given that they don't know how he does
these miracles, I'd say it's pretty hard for
them to pin down suspects.
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Ustelik bu mucizeleri nasil yaptigini
bilmedikleri icin, suphelileri
belirlemeleri oldukca zor.

original:
<T>I see. <W><M2/2/1/45>Well, there's no time like the present.
Let's start by investigating the immediate
area.
translation:
<T>Anliyorum. <W><M2/2/1/45>Oyleyse vakit kaybetmeyelim.
Once yakin
cevreyi arastirarak baslayalim.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T>Well, I think we've pretty much gathered that
they're solid stone. <W>Is there really nothing
we can do to help them?
translation:
<T>Sanirim artik onlarin tamamen
tas kesildigini anladik. <W>Onlara yardim etmek icin
gercekten yapabilecegimiz hicbir sey yok mu?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>If we'd been standing here earlier, we might
have ended up the same way!
translation:
<T>Eger az once burada duruyor olsaydik,
sonumuz da boyle olabilirdi!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>And we still might! <W>Right, I'll just snap a few
photos. You never know when they'll come
in handy!<M7/1/2/45>
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Hala olabilir! <W>Tamam, birkac fotograf cekeyim.
Ne zaman ise yarayacaklari
belli olmaz!<M7/1/2/45>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>We'd best be on our guard. If the other
miracles are anything like tonight's, we must
be prepared for any eventuality.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Tetikte olsak iyi olur. Diger mucizeler de
bu geceki gibiyse, her turlu
ihtimale hazirlikli olmaliyiz.

original: <T><M3/1/3/15>I'll be careful, Professor!
translation: <T><M3/1/3/15>Dikkatli olacagim, Profesor!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh, Professor! There's someone coming our
way. <M3/2/1>Let's ask him if he knows anything!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ah, Profesor! Birisi bize dogru geliyor.
<M3/2/1>Bir sey bilip bilmedigini soralim!

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T><M4/1/1>We meet again, my friends! It must be the
fated reunion of kindred spirits, no? <W>How
thrilling the carnival is tonight!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Yeniden karsilastik, dostlarim! Bu, kaderin
yoldas ruhlari bulusturmasi olmali, degil mi? <W>Bu geceki
karnaval ne kadar da heyecan verici!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>If I'm not mistaken, you are...
translation: <T>Yanilmiyorsam siz...

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Mistaken? Absolutely not! Indeed, it is I who
was mistaken, <M1/1/1>to suppose for a moment that
we would not meet again!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Yanilmak mi? Kesinlikle hayir! Aslinda yanilan
benmisim; <M1/1/1>bir an icin bile
bir daha karsilasmayacagimizi sanmakla!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I am here simply to enjoy the sights and
sounds that only a tourist may see and hear!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Buraya yalnizca bir turistin gorebilecegi ve
duyabilecegi manzaralarin ve seslerin tadini cikarmaya geldim!

original:
<T>I will have none of this turning to stone
business. Where is the elegance? <M3/2/1/45>You would
sooner catch me in a waxworks!
translation:
<T>Bu tas kesilme isinden hic hoslanmiyorum.
Zarafet nerede? <M3/2/1/45>Beni ancak
bir balmumu muzesinde yakalarsiniz!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But pleasantries aside, I come to you now
for a reason!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama nezaketi bir kenara birakacak olursak, size simdi
bir nedenle geldim!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M2/2/2>Umm, what sort of reason?
translation: <T><M2/2/2>Sey... Ne gibi bir neden?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>I have prepared a wooden crate - a box,
say. <M1/1/1/45>I would like you to try to find it.
Go on, slide your stylus around.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Bir tahta sandik hazirladim-yani bir kutu.
<M1/1/1/45>Onu bulmaya calismanizi istiyorum.
Haydi, kaleminizi etrafta gezdirin.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>I can't see any wooden boxes anywhere!
Are you sure there's one around here?
translation:
<T>Hicbir yerde tahta kutu goremiyorum!
Emin misiniz, burada bir tane var mi?

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T>Ha ha ha! Not so hasty, little man! It takes
but a few helpings of patience and a full
course of imagination.
translation:
<T>Ha ha ha! O kadar acele etme, kucuk adam! Birkac porsiyon
sabir ve tam bir
yemeklik hayal gucu gerekir.

original:
<T>How can you hope to find the box if you do
not think outside it?
translation:
<T>Kutunun disini dusunmezsen
kutuyu nasil bulmayi umabilirsin?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Ah, pardon me, Aldus, I haven't quite
caught the gist of your explanation. Could
you clarify a little?
translation:
<T>Ah, affedin Aldus, anlattiginizin ozunu tam
kavrayamadim. Biraz daha
aciklayabilir misiniz?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I am so very glad you asked, my fair
gentleman friend! This is where we must use
the ancient art...<W30>of zooming!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Sormana cok sevindim, zarif
dostum! Iste burada kadim sanati...
<W30>yakinlastirmayi kullanmaliyiz!

original: <T><M2/2/4>Zooming? You want us to move faster?
translation: <T><M2/2/4>Yakinlastirma mi? Daha hizli hareket etmemizi mi istiyorsunuz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Aha, slow down there! No, you must I-spy
with your magnifying glass and watch for
a reaction, blue as the azure sky!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aha, yavasla! Hayir, buyutecinle etrafa bakmali ve
gokyuzu kadar masmavi bir
tepkiye goz kulak olmalisin!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Behold! If the magnifying glass turns blue,
you have found a zoom point! Now then...
<W>Focus! <W>Magnify! <W>ZOOM!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Goruyor musun! Buyutec maviye donerse,
bir yakinlastirma noktasi buldun demektir! Simdi...
<W>Odaklan! <W>Buyut! <W>YAKINLASTIR!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>When you find a zoom point, <M3/2/1>just touch the
Touch Screen as you would with any point
of interest. <W><M1/1/1>Do not be shy!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bir yakinlastirma noktasi buldugunda, <M3/2/1>sadece
ilginc herhangi bir noktada yaptigin gibi
Dokunmatik Ekran'a dokun. <W><M1/1/1>Cekinme!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M5/1/5/15>Oh! So it was hidden back here!
translation: <T><M5/1/5/15>Oh! Demek burada sakliymis!

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>What magnificent magnification! <W>With such
a skill in your repertoire, the needle lies in
plain sight and not in the haystack!<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Ne muhtesem bir yakinlastirma! <W>Boylesi
bir beceri repertuvarinizdayken, igne
samanlikta degil, acikca goz onundedir!<M1/1/1>

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M6/2/5>We'll bear this technique in mind. Thank
you, Aldus!
translation:
<T><M6/2/5>Bu teknigi aklimizda tutacagiz. Tesekkur
ederiz, Aldus!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>As ever, the pleasure was mine. Now, touch
the box before you! You have been itching
for this moment, I can tell!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Her zamanki gibi zevk bana aitti. Simdi, dokun
karsindaki kutuya! Bu an icin sabirsizlandigini
hissedebiliyorum!

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T>Voila, your hint coin! How radiantly she
shines! <M2/1/1>On those puzzles which have you
stumped, she is your fairest friend.
translation:
<T>Voila, ipucu paraniz! Ne kadar da parlak
isildiyor! <M2/1/1>Sizi zorlayan bilmecelerde
en sadik dostunuz odur.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But you should not waste these willy-nilly,
oh no. Hint coins are not numerous like
grains of sand, <M4/1/1>but prized like pearls!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama bunlari oyle rastgele harcamamalisiniz,
oh hayir. Ipucu paralari kum taneleri kadar
cok degildir; <M4/1/1>inciler gibi kiymetlidir!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>They are hidden all over the city, so peel
your eyes and <M3/2/1/10>look around, <W60><M3/1/1/10>look out, <W60>look
about! <W>And sometimes, <M3/2/1/10>zoom!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sehrin her yerine saklanmislardir, bu yuzden gozlerinizi
dort acin ve <M3/2/1/10>etrafa bakin, <W60><M3/1/1/10>dikkat edin, <W60>goz
gezdirin! <W>Ve bazen de, <M3/2/1/10>yakinlastirin!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>And now, my friends, I have taught you
everything I know. Go out, out into the
great wide world, and zoom!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ve simdi, dostlarim, bildigim her seyi size
ogrettim. Haydi, gidin, o
engin dunyaya acilin ve yakinlastirin!

original:
<T>Oh, I almost forgot! When you no longer
want to see the world in glorious detail,
touch <CR>Zoom Out</CR> to return to normal!
translation:
<T>Ah, neredeyse unutuyordum! Dunyayi artik
bu muhtesem ayrintida gormek istemezseniz,
normal hale donmek icin <CR>Zoom Out</CR> secenegine dokunun!

original: <T><M2/1/1>And with that, I bid you adieu.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ve bununla birlikte, size veda ediyorum.

original: <T>Until we meet again!
translation: <T>Yeniden gorusene kadar!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M2/2/1/45>He never wastes any time, does he?
translation: <T><M2/2/1/45>Hic vakit kaybetmiyor, degil mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Well now, back to the investigation. Perhaps
this zoom function will come in handy later
on.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Peki, simdi arastirmaya donelim. Belki
bu yakinlastirma islevi ileride
isimize yarar.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>Professor, do you think <M5/1/1/30>that tent over there
was set up for the carnival? It's huge!
translation:
<T>Profesor, sizce <M5/1/1/30>su cadir
karnaval icin mi kurulmus? Kocaman!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>I'd say so, yes. What with all the flags and
illuminations, it certainly looks as a carnival
marquee should.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Evet, oyle diyebilirim. Bayraklar ve
isiklandirmalarla birlikte, tam da bir karnaval
cadirina benziyor.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M5/2/1>This street is so festive! I wonder if it's like
this every day?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Bu sokak ne kadar da senlikli! Acaba her gun
boyle mi?

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Can we see it a bit closer up, Professor?
Just for a second?
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Biraz daha yakindan bakabilir miyiz, Profesor?
Sadece bir saniye?

original:
<T><M9/1/1/45>Of course. But let's not get ahead of
ourselves, Luke. We need to establish how
we will move around the city.
translation:
<T><M9/1/1/45>Elbette. Ama acele etmeyelim,
Luke. Sehirde nasil
dolasacagimizi belirlememiz gerekiyor.

original: <T><M3/1/1/15>Oh, of course!
translation: <T><M3/1/1/15>Ah, tabii ki!

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>While investigating, you should see the
<CR>Back to Map</CR> icon on the Touch Screen.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Arastirma yaparken Dokunmatik Ekran'da
<CR>Back to Map</CR> simgesini gormelisiniz.

original:
<T>Touch that icon to switch from Investigation
Mode to Movement Mode.
translation:
<T>O simgeye dokunarak Arastirma Modu'ndan
Hareket Modu'na gecebilirsiniz.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>We can move to any place marked with an
orange icon. Just touch an icon to move to
that location.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Turuncu bir simgeyle isaretlenmis her yere
gidebiliriz. Bir konuma gitmek icin
sadece simgeye dokunun.

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>I hope that was clear enough.
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Umarim yeterince aciklayici olmustur.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Touch...the orange icons?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Turuncu... simgelere mi dokunacagiz?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Basically, to move from one location to the
next, all we need to do is touch an orange
icon on the map. Right, Professor?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Yani bir konumdan digerine gecmek icin
tek yapmamiz gereken haritadaki turuncu
simgeye dokunmak. Degil mi, Profesor?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/30>You've hit the nail on the head, Emmy.
Now let's head to the marquee. It's as good
a place as any to start our investigation!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/30>Tam isabet, Emmy.
Simdi cadira gidelim. Arastirmamiza baslamak icin
en az digerleri kadar iyi bir yer!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I've been wondering, Professor. How are we
going to keep track of our investigations
with so much going on?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Merak ediyordum, Profesor. Bunca sey olurken
arastirmalarimizi nasil
takip edecegiz?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>You ask a pertinent question, Luke. Allow
me to explain.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Yerinde bir soru sordun, Luke.
Izin ver de aciklayayim.

original:
<T>Start by touching the trunk icon on the
Touch Screen.
translation:
<T>Once Dokunmatik Ekran'daki sandik simgesine
dokun.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Here we have the Save option. Touch this
option to save your progress throughout
the adventure.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Burada Kaydet secenegi var. Macera boyunca
ilerlemeni kaydetmek icin bu
secenege dokun.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>This is the Puzzle Index. This option allows
you to review puzzles you've found during
the adventure.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Bu, Bulmaca Dizini. Bu secenek, macera sirasinda
buldugun bilmeceleri
gozden gecirmeni saglar.

original:
<T>In order to have another go at an unsolved
puzzle, however, you'll need to return to
its location.
translation:
<T>Cozulmemis bir bilmeceyi yeniden denemek icin
ise, bulundugu
konuma geri donmen gerekir.

original:
<T>You'll find the location of the puzzle listed
in the Puzzle Index, so don't worry about
having to search for it.
translation:
<T>Bilmece konumu Bulmaca Dizini'nde listelenir,
bu yuzden onu aramak zorunda
kalacagin icin endiselenme.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>These are the Mysteries and Journal
options. Touch them to review the events
and developments of the story.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Bunlar Gizemler ve Gunluk secenekleri.
Hikayedeki olaylari ve gelismeleri
gozden gecirmek icin onlara dokun.

original:
<T>Lastly, this is the Episodes option. Touch
this option to view additional parts of the
story.
translation:
<T>Son olarak, bu Bolumler secenegi. Hikayenin
ek kisimlarini gormek icin
bu secenege dokun.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Be sure to check often in case you have
new episodes to view.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Goruntuleyebilecegin yeni bolumler
olabilir diye sik sik kontrol et.

original: [WI-FI PUZZLE PROFILE TUTORIAL]
translation: [WI-FI BULMACA PROFILI EGITIMI]

original: <T><M3/1/1>I feel like I know it all now!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Simdi her seyi biliyor gibiyim!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M4/2/6/15>You're still just an apprentice, Luke. <W>Save
the smugness until you know the trunk like
the back of your hand.
translation:
<T><M4/2/6/15>Sen hala sadece bir ciraksin, Luke. <W>Kibirini,
sandigi avucunun ici gibi bilene
kadar sakla.

original: <T><M1/2/2/45>But I did memorise it all...
translation: <T><M1/2/2/45>Ama hepsini ezberledim...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Now, now, you two. Just put the trunk to
use and you'll be familiar with it in no time.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hadi, hadi, siz ikiniz. Sandigi kullanin da
kisa surede alisacaksiniz.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>It's the giant clown balloon we saw earlier.
I wonder how they got this enormous thing
up into the air?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Az once gordugumuz dev palyaco balonu.
Bu koca seyi havaya
nasil kaldirdilar acaba?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/2>However they did it, it's not likely to be
floating again any time soon.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Nasil yaptilarsa yaptilar ama,
yakinda tekrar havalanacak gibi degil.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Hmm, it must have been damaged in all
the commotion.
translation:
<T>Hmm, kargasa sirasinda
hasar gormus olmali.

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Shh! Do you hear that? It's almost like...<W> Is
somebody crying?
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Sss! Duyuyor musun? Sanki...<W>
birisi agliyor mu?

original:
<T><M3/2/5/15>I hear it too! It's coming from that clown!
<W><M3/2/2>What if the clown...<W> What if it's alive?!
translation:
<T><M3/2/5/15>Ben de duyuyorum! O palyacodan geliyor!
<W><M3/2/2>Ya palyaco...<W> Ya yasiyorsa?!

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Let's have a closer look at our sniffling
entertainer, shall we?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Hickiran
eglendiricimize biraz daha yakindan bakalim, olur mu?

original:
<T><M4/2/2>Do you think that the crying clown could be
part of the curse, too?
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Sence aglayan palyaco da
lanetin bir parcasi olabilir mi?

original:
<T>It's possible. Let's give the whole thing
a thorough check once more.
translation:
<T>Mumkun. Her seyi bir kez daha
enine boyuna kontrol edelim.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T>Professor, we can't just ignore somebody in
tears!
translation:
<T>Profesor, gozyaslari icindeki birini
oylece gormezden gelemeyiz!

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original: <T><M3/1/4>Hello? Who's this?
translation: <T><M3/1/4>Alo? Kimsiniz?

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
<T><M2/1/2>So it was this little girl who was crying.
I didn't really think it was the clown...
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Aglayan su kucuk kizmis.
Gercekten palyaco oldugunu sanmamistim...

original: マカロン
translation: マカロン

original: <T>Sniff, sniff. Ohhh, Maaaammy! Sob...
translation: <T>Hick, hick. Ooo, Aaaaanneee! Hick...

original:
<T><M5/2/3>She doesn't look injured, thank goodness.
<W>There, there, dear, don't cry. What's your
name?
translation:
<T><M5/2/3>Neyse ki yarali gorunmuyor.
<W>Tamam, tamam canim, aglama. Adin
ne?

original:
<T><M4/3/1>H-huh? Me...<W15>sniff...<W15>name? But...but...<W>
Sniff...sniffle...<M4/1/1>
translation:
<T><M4/3/1>H-hi? Ben...<W15>hick...<W15>adim mi? Ama...ama...<W>
Hick...hingir...<M4/1/1>

original:
<T><M2/2/3/45>We can't help you unless you stop crying.
Come now, tell us what's wrong.
translation:
<T><M2/2/3/45>Aglamayi birakmadikca sana yardim edemeyiz.
Haydi, bize ne oldugunu soyle.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>She must be lost. <M3/1/2>I know how that feels all
too well.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Kaybolmus olmali. <M3/1/2>Bu duyguyu cok iyi
biliyorum.

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T>I believe you're right, Luke. She seems to
have lost her mother. We must do our best
to reunite them.
translation:
<T>Sanirim haklisin, Luke. Annesini
kaybetmis gibi gorunuyor. Onlari tekrar
kavusturmak icin elimizden geleni yapmaliyiz.

original: <T><M2/1/3>Leave it to me, Professor!
translation: <T><M2/1/3>Bana birakin, Profesor!

original: <T>Sniff...<W>sob... Aw, wey aye...
translation: <T>Hick...<W>hing... Aaa, of ya...

original: <T>Ohhhhh... Sniff...<W30>sob...<W30>whimper...
translation: <T>Oooofff... Hick...<W30>hing...<W30>inle...

original:
<T><M1/2/2>This won't do. I'll never be able to call
myself a gentleman if I don't solve this
problem!
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Boyle olmaz. Bu problemi cozmezsem
kendime asla centilmen diyemem!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I have to do something to help this little
girl!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bu kucuk kiza yardim etmek icin bir sey
yapmaliyim!

original: <T>Sniff...
translation: <T>Hick...

original: <T><M1/2/1>Ahhh, Mammy! There ya are!
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Ahh, Anne! Iste buradasin!

original: タニア
translation: タニア

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Bonnie! Eeee, thank heavens! I was worried
sick, like! <W><M1/2/1/45>Thank you sooo much, pet!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Bonnie! Aaa, sukurler olsun! Meraktan
hasta olacaktim, vallahi! <W><M1/2/1/45>Cok ama cok tesekkur ederim, canim!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Don't mention it. Just doing my duty as
a gentleman in training!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Lafi bile olmaz. Ben sadece centilmen adayi
olarak gorevimi yapiyorum!

original: <T>Tee hee hee! Cheers, mistah! Buh-bye!
translation: <T>Hihihi! Sag ol, bayim! Bay-bay!

original: <T><M2/1/1>All's well that ends well, right, Professor?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Sonu iyi biten her sey iyidir, degil mi Profesor?

original:
<T><M2/2/3/45>She called you {''}mister{''}, Luke! Don't you
feel all grown-up now?
translation:
<T><M2/2/3/45>Sana {''}bay{''} dedi, Luke! Simdi kendini
daha buyumus hissetmiyor musun?

original: <T>A job well done, Luke. I'm proud of you.
translation: <T>Iyi is cikardin, Luke. Seninle gurur duyuyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Oh, it was nothing! I am the esteemed
Professor Layton's apprentice, after all!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Ah, bir sey degil! Sonucta ben saygideger
Profesor Layton'in ciragiyim!

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Now then, back to the case. I believe
Angela's house is quite a bit further on.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Simdi, tekrar olaya donelim. Sanirim
Angela'nin evi epeyce daha ileride.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M5/1/1/15>Look, a policeman!
translation: <T><M5/1/1/15>Bak, bir polis!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Perhaps he hurried here to collect a few
testimonies. Let's see what he has to say.
translation:
<T>Belki de buraya birkac
taniklik toplamak icin acele etmistir. Ne diyecegine bakalim.

original: ポリス
translation: ポリス

original:
<T>Well, they said this hoo-dee-doo miracle
man was supposed to be around here, but
I don't see him anywhere, do you?
translation:
<T>Sey, su maskaralik mucize adamin buralarda
olmasi gerekiyormus ama ben ortalikta
goremiyorum. Siz goruyor musunuz?

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T>I'm afraid that the Masked Gentleman has
long since fled the scene of the crime,
Constable.
translation:
<T>Korkarim Maskeli Beyefendi suc mahallinden
coktan kacti,
Memur.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Mm. I knew I shouldn't have finished my
sprouts. Full belly, empty cell.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Himm. O filizleri bitirmemeliydim, biliyordum.
Dolu karin, bos hucre.

original:
<T>Us d'Orian police are on the beat 24/7, but
the Gentleman is still miles ahead of us.
<W><M3/1/1/45>He's some kind of supervillain!
translation:
<T>Biz d'Orian polisleri 7/24 devriyedeyiz ama
O Beyefendi hala bizden kilometrelerce onde.
<W><M3/1/1/45>Resmen bir super kotu!

original:
<T>We've even had to cordon off the gallery
now thanks to all his funny business. <M2/1/1/45>Is
nowhere sacred?
translation:
<T>Yaptigi sacmaliklar yuzunden galeriyi bile
kordon altina almak zorunda kaldik. <M2/1/1/45>Hicbir yer kutsal degil mi?

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
<T><M3/1/1>You're talking about the case of the living
paintings, right?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Canli tablolar vakasindan bahsediyorsunuz,
degil mi?

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Living paintings? I wasn't aware of such
a case.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Canli tablolar mi? Boyle bir vakadan haberim
yoktu.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Sorry, Professor, I forgot to mention that.
I heard about it while I was off investigating
on my own.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Affedersiniz Profesor, soylemeyi unuttum.
Kendi basima arastirma yaparken duydum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>It was a right shock, I can tell you. How
would you feel if you saw a painting <M3/1/1/45>pop out
of its frame and start wandering around?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Inanin, tam bir soktu. Bir tablo <M3/1/1/45>cercevesinden firlayip
etrafta dolasmaya baslasa siz ne hissederdiniz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>We seized the lot of 'em as evidence. Even
if you could get in now, there wouldn't be
anything to see.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Hepsine delil olarak el koyduk. Simdi iceri
girebilseniz bile gorulecek bir sey kalmadi.

original:
<T><M3/1/3/45>Well, I think that's a fairly good reason to
close the gallery off!
translation:
<T><M3/1/3/45>Bence bu galeriyi kapatmak icin gayet iyi bir
sebep!

original:
<T>I just feel sorry for all those tourists. <M2/1/1/45>The
gallery's usually at the top of their list of
things to do.
translation:
<T>Su turistlere aciyorum sadece. <M2/1/1/45>Galeri genelde yapilacaklar listesinin en
basinda olur.

original:
<T><M4/1/3/45>An art gallery located in the heart of the
desert? It's a dream destination for tourists!
translation:
<T><M4/1/3/45>Colun ortasinda bir sanat galerisi mi? Turistler
icin ruya gibi bir yer!

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>It is rather easy to forget that outside this
city lies nothing but arid sand.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Bu sehrin disinda kupkuru kumdan baska bir
sey olmadigini unutmak oldukca kolay.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Tell me about it. Don't see who'd go out of
their way to cause trouble here. Of all the
places in the world to pick!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Hic sormayin. Buraya gelip de sorun cikaracak
kimseyi anlamiyorum. Dunyada bunca yer varken!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Indeed. <W>So, we now know that at least two
incidents are linked to this masked man. <M5/2/1/45>And
supposedly, to the mask...
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Gercekten. <W>Demek ki en az iki olay bu maskeli
adamla baglantili. <M5/2/1/45>Ve sozde maskeyle de...

original:
<T>We need more information, Professor. Let's
press on to the Ledores' house. <W><M3/2/1/45>I think we
need to turn right here.
translation:
<T>Daha fazla bilgiye ihtiyacimiz var, Profesor. Ledore'larin
evine dogru devam edelim. <W><M3/2/1/45>Sanirim burada saga donmeliyiz.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Glad you didn't end up a statue. We'll take
it from here, so don't worry your fine selves.<M4/1/1/45>
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Heykele donusmemene sevindim. Buradan sonrasi bizde,
o yuzden kendini yorma merak etme.<M4/1/1/45>

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Good luck to you, Constable! I'd be scared
to touch those statues. Imagine if you
chipped off a toe!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Size iyi sanslar, Memur! O heykellere dokunmaya
korkarim. Ya bir parmak ucu koparsa!

original: コマーニ無
translation: コマーニ無

original:
<T>Sticking up posters for the fair. With a bit of
tape here and a bit of glue there. Sticking
up, sticking up, away we go...
translation:
<T>Senlik icin afis asiyorum. Biraz
bant buraya, biraz yapistirici suraya. Asiyorum,
asiyorum, hadi bakalim...

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original: <T>Um, excuse me...
translation: <T>Sey, affedersiniz...

original:
<T>Sticking up posters, round the clock. Wall
by wall and block by- <W30><M2/2/1/15>YIIIIKES!<W30> Is...<W30> Is this
what they call a stick-up?!
translation:
<T>Afis asiyorum, gunun her saati. Duvar
duvar, sokak so- <W30><M2/2/1/15>IMDAAAT!<W30> Bu...<W30> Bu da
soygun dedikleri sey mi?!

original:
<T><M4/1/3>Oh, no, I'm so sorry. I really didn't mean to
scare you.
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Ah, hayir, cok ozur dilerim. Gercekten seni
korkutmak istemedim.

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ah, you had that situation with the balloons
earlier. It's good to see you safe and
sound.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ah, az once balonlarla ilgili o olay vardi.
Seni sag salim gormek guzel.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Ohh, the darlings from the plaza! How are
you? I'm just putting these posters up for
the ringmaster and...<W><M2/2/1> Oh dear!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ahh, meydandaki tatlilar! Nasilsiniz?
Ben sadece sirk muduru icin bu afisleri
asiyordum ve...<W><M2/2/1> Aman!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>I must have got such a fright that I mixed up
the posters. How can I tell which is which
now?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Oyle korktum ki afisleri birbirine karistirmisim.
Simdi hangisi hangisi nasil anlayacagim?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It never rains but it pours! I'm afraid this is
your fault, so you'll have to help me out
again!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bir musibet bin nasihat! Korkarim bu senin
yuzunden oldu, o yuzden bana yine yardim
etmek zorundasin!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Y-you're not going to take responsibility for
your actions? You'd really leave me high
and dry?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Y-yaptiklarinin sorumlulugunu almayacak
misin? Beni gercekten ortada mi
birakacaksin?

original:
<T>Oh please, do something about these
posters!
translation: <T>Ne olur, su afislere bir care bulun!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Fabulous, fabulous! After seeing how you
solved that with such finesse, I'm inspired
to do my best work now!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Harika, harika! Onu ne kadar ustaca
cozdugunu gorunce ben de en iyi isimi
yapmak icin ilham aldim!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Do stop by the circus when you get the
chance! We've even got wild beasts jumping
through flaming hoops!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Firsat bulunca mutlaka sirke ugrayin! Alevli
halkalardan atlayan vahsi hayvanlarimiz bile
var!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Flaming hoops? Now that sounds like my
idea of fun!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Alevli halkalar mi? Iste buna eglence derim!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Forget the Masked Gentleman and his silly
miracles! The Stellar Circus is still the most
spectacular show in town!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Maskeli Beyefendi'yi ve sacma mucizelerini
unutun! Stellar Sirki hala sehrin en
gorkemli gosterisi!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Erm, we can't exactly turn people to
stone...but we really are worth seeing!
Oh, please say you'll visit!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sey, insanlari tasa ceviremeyiz elbette...
ama bizi gormeye gercekten deger!
Ah, lutfen geleceginizi soyleyin!

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original: <T><M3/1/1>It sounds like a lot of fun! I want to go!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Cok eglenceli geliyor! Gitmek istiyorum!

original:
<T><M5/2/1>I do too, Luke. But the investigation takes
priority. We can do all those things later,
all right?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Ben de istiyorum, Luke. Ama sorusturma
oncelikli. Bunlari sonra yapariz,
tamam mi?

original: <T><M1/2/2/45>All right...

<T><M2/2/1>Why must that Masked Gentleman keep
popping up all over the place? I leap every
time I see a leaf!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bu Maskeli Beyefendi neden her yerde
karsima cikip duruyor? Bir yaprak gorsem
zipliyorum!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T>After we pass through this alley, we should
be able to see the Ledore estate.
translation:
<T>Bu araliktan gecince, Ledore malikanesini
gorebilmeliyiz.

original:
<T><M5/2/2/45>Well, what are we waiting for? Come on,
slowcoaches!
translation:
<T><M5/2/2/45>E peki, neyi bekliyoruz? Haydi,
yavaslar!

original: ヤッタイ
translation: Yattai

original:
<T>You there, with the hat! Rule number one in
these parts: don't leave Knick-Knack Alley
without a knick-knack!
translation:
<T>Hey sen, sapkali! Bu civarda birinci kural:
Knick-Knack Sokagi'ndan
bir ivir zivir almadan cikilmaz!

original: ヤッタイ
translation: ヤッタイ

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Step right up, step right up! Our toys are
cheap and our smiles are free! How may
Jean-Paul be of service to you?<M2/2/1>
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Buyurun, buyurun! Oyuncaklarimiz
ucuz, gulumsememiz bedava! Jean-Paul size
nasil yardimci olabilir?<M2/2/1>

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original: <T><M2/1/1>Cor! Look at all the toys!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Vay canina! Su oyuncaklarin hepsine bak!

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Let's have a look... <W>Ooh, there are a fair
few, aren't there? <W>How would you like
the triceratops?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Bir bakalim... <W>Oooh, epey
varmis, degil mi? <W>Triseratops'u ister
misin?

original: <T><M4/1/2>Umm, it's nice...<W30>but I prefer the little bear.
translation: <T><M4/1/2>Sey, guzel...<W30>ama ben kucuk ayicigi tercih ederim.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Oh, that's right, you have an eye for cute
things! Well then, what about the robot?
<W30>Excuse me, sir...
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Aa dogru ya, sevimli seylerden anlarsin!
O zaman robot nasil?
<W30>Affedersiniz, efendim...

original:
<T><M3/3/2>My eyes! <W>My eyes have been dazzled by
the splendour of your light!
translation:
<T><M3/3/2>Gozlerim! <W>Gozlerim, isiginizin
ihtisamiyla kamasti!

original:
<T><M4/1/4>Is...is something the matter? <W>Should we call
an ambulance?
translation:
<T><M4/1/4>B...bir sorun mu var? <W>Ambulans
cagiralim mi?

original:
<T><M1/3/1/45>Splendid creature, you are a radiant goddess
sent to walk upon this earth!
translation:
<T><M1/3/1/45>Muhtesem varlik, bu dunyada yurumek uzere
gonderilmis piril piril bir tanricasin!

original: <T><M1/1/1>I'm sorry?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Pardon?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>O Venus! O Aphrodite! Allow me to present
you with this humble robot puzzle!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Ah Venus! Ah Afrodit! Bu mutevazi robot
bulmacasini size sunmama izin verin!

original:
<T>How could I have believed my puzzle worthy
of your glory? Will you ever forgive this
wretched fool?
translation:
<T>Bulmacamin gorkeminize layik olduguna
nasil inanabildim? Bu
sefil budalayi affedecek misiniz?

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Erm, I think you'd better solve his puzzle,
Emmy.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Sey, bence onun bulmacasini cozsen iyi olur,
Emmy.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Oh, how I bathe in your indomitable spirit!
Come, fair lady, conquer my robot puzzle!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Ah, yenilmez ruhunda nasil da yikaniyorum!
Gel, guzel hanimefendi, robot bulmacami alt et!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Exquisite beyond compare! Beauty and
brains in equal measure, so befitting of an
angel in human guise!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Esi benzeri yok! Guzellik ve
zeka esit olcude; insan kiligindaki bir
melege yakisir!

original:
<T><M2/3/2/45>You shall not spend a single penny here.
<M2/2/1>Oblige your unworthy servant by taking this
robot for free!
translation:
<T><M2/3/2/45>Burada tek kurus bile harcamayacaksiniz.
<M2/2/1>Degersiz hizmetkarinizi kirmayin da bu
robotu ucretsiz alin!

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>And let me tell you, this brave little toy
embodies the very spirit of adventure!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Ve sunu da soyleyeyim, bu cesur kucuk oyuncak
macera ruhunun ta kendisini temsil ediyor!

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Please, take it as a token of my...most
fervent affection.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Lutfen, onu benim... en
atesli sevgimin bir nisanesi olarak kabul edin.

original:
<T><M5/2/4>What, really? Are you sure, sir? <W>Well, if you
insist...
translation:
<T><M5/2/4>Ne, gercekten mi? Emin misiniz, efendim? <W>Eee, eger
israr ediyorsaniz...

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>The toy stall owner Jean-Paul has given you
a toy robot!
translation:
<T>Oyuncak tezgahi sahibi Jean-Paul sana
bir oyuncak robot verdi!

original:
<T>The Toy Robot minigame has been added to
the trunk.
translation:
<T>Oyuncak Robot mini oyunu
valize eklendi.

original:
<T>Can you dodge the tricks and traps littered
throughout each maze and come out
triumphant? Only time will tell!
translation:
<T>Her labirente serpistirilmis hile ve tuzaklardan
kacip galip cikabilecek misin?
Bunu ancak zaman gosterecek!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Ah, your celestial duties beckon! I can see it
in your eyes!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Ah, goksel gorevlerin seni cagiriyor! Bunu
gozlerinde goruyorum!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Erm, yes. I'm afraid we're in a hurry today,
so we don't have time to stop and chat.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Sey, evet. Ne yazik ki bugun acelemiz var,
sohbet etmek icin duracak vaktimiz yok.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>I understand. Well, whenever you pass by
these parts, be sure to give me a call...<W><M4/2/1>
for I am a prisoner of your love.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Anliyorum. Ne zaman bu taraflardan gecersen
mutlaka beni ara...<W><M4/2/1>
cunku ben senin askinin tutsagiyim.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Oh, you have returned, goddess who has
stolen my heart! Is this a dream? Is this
a waking dream, so brief and transient?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ah, geri dondun, kalbimi
calan tanrica! Bu bir ruya mi? Bu
kisacik ve gecici bir uyanik ruya mi?

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
<T><M6/2/5/45>That's so strange! We only went down one
street and it's as if we're in another city!
translation:
<T><M6/2/5/45>Ne kadar tuhaf! Sadece bir
sokak indik ve sanki baska bir sehre gelmis gibiyiz!

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>This is the residential area. The Ledore
estate is just around the corner.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Burasi yerlesim bolgesi. Ledore
malikanesi hemen kosede.

original:
<T><M2/2/2/45>It's really dark. Even darker than Misthallery
is at night!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2/45>Burasi cok karanlik. Misthallery'nin
gecesinden bile daha karanlik!

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T>No doubt the city's residents enjoy a dimly
lit environment in contrast to the glare and
bustle of the city centre.
translation:
<T>Sehrin merkezindeki parlaklik ve
kalabaligin aksine, burada yasayanlar
los bir ortami tercih ediyor olmali.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>In town it seemed as if the night was just
beginning. I wonder when all those people
actually sleep?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Sehirde gece yeni basliyormus gibi
gorunuyordu. Onca insan
acaba ne zaman uyuyor?

original:
<T><M2/2/3/45>Pff, you're good at puzzles, Luke. Take
a guess.
translation:
<T><M2/2/3/45>Poh, sen bulmacalarda iyisin, Luke. Bir
tahminde bulun.

original: フランキ
translation: フランキ

original:
<T>Oi, oi, who are you lot? Another bunch of
gawpers 'eading up for a butcher's at the
Ledore place, I'll bet.
translation:
<T>Hey, hey, siz de kimsiniz? Bahse girerim
Ledore'lara, o kasabin yanina bakmaya giden
bir grup meraklisiniz.

original:
<T>In fact, no. We have received a personal
letter of invitation. I'd much appreciate it
if you could let us pass.
translation:
<T>Aslinda hayir. Bize kisisel bir
davet mektubu geldi. Gecmemize izin
verirseniz sevinirim.

original:
<T>Not so fast, Sonny Jim. If you AIN'T just
going for a look, that's even more
suspicious.
translation:
<T>O kadar hizli degil, delikanli. Eger SADECE
bakmaya gitmiyorsan, bu daha da
supheli.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>How am I to know you ain't that miracle
mincemeat fella?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Senin o mucize kiymasi
herif olmadigini nereden bileyim?

original:
<T>Think I could just let you waltz in
unannounced? <M2/1/1>Not on your nelly, mate!
translation:
<T>Habersizce iceri suzulup
girecegini mi saniyorsun? <M2/1/1>Hadi oradan, dostum!

original: ナルキス
translation: ナルキス

original:
<T>Now, now, what's the matter here? I would
hazard to say you are on the verge of an
altercation.
translation:
<T>Hay hay, burada mesele nedir? Gorunuse
bakilirsa kavga
cikaracak gibisiniz.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Before we get into a terrible scuffle, might
I suggest a more refined way of settling the
matter at hand?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Korkunc bir arbedeye donusmeden once,
su meseleyi daha zarif bir yolla
cozmeyi onerebilir miyim?

original:
<T>Behold the exquisite method I propose!
Many great minds have toiled, but only I
have ever devised a solution so placatory!
translation:
<T>Iste size onerdigim zarif yontem!
Nice buyuk zekalar ugrasti ama ancak ben
bu kadar uzlastirici bir cozum bulabildim!

original: <T>Hmph, go on then.
translation: <T>Hih, hadi bakalim.

original: <T>What is it that you have in mind?
translation: <T>Aklinda ne var?

original: <T>Aha aha, it's quite simple, really.
translation: <T>Aha aha, aslinda oldukca basit.

original:
<T>Hidden under one of these fine silver
tumblers is a ball. All you need to do is
point to the correct one.
translation:
<T>Bu sik gumus
bardaklarin birinin altinda bir top var. Tek yapman
dogru olani isaret etmek.

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Intriguing, but this isn't exactly my cup of
tea. I much prefer games that require a
quick mind rather than a quick eye.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Ilginc, ama pek bana gore degil.
Ben hizli gozden ziyade
hizli zihin gerektiren oyunlari tercih ederim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Don't worry, Professor! Let me handle this
one!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Merak etmeyin, Profesor! Bunu ben
hallederim!

original:
<T>Peh! What's the point in playing if I'm only
up against some sprog?
translation:
<T>Peh! Karsimda sadece bir
velet varken oynamanin ne anlami var?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Settle down, my good man. Any opponent
is a worthy opponent in a battle of wits.
Now, let us begin.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Sakin ol, dostum. Zeka savasinda her rakip
degerli bir rakiptir.
Simdi baslayalim.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Keep your eyes on the tumbler and on my
most refined and dextrous movements!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Gozlerini bardaga ve benim
son derece zarif ve cevik hareketlerime dik!

original: <T>Right then. I know which one I'm choosing.
translation: <T>Peki o zaman. Hangisini sececegimi biliyorum.

original: <T>Your turn, runt.
translation: <T>Sira sende, ufaklik.

original: <T>Umm...
translation: <T>Sey...

original: <T>It's this one!
translation: <T>Bu!

original: <T>Wh-what? I was sure that was the right one!
translation: <T>N-ne? Onun dogru oldugundan emindim!

original:
<T>Hah, going to blub like a little baby, are
you?
translation:
<T>Ha! Kucuk bir bebek gibi
aglayacak misin yani?

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>What a dreadful shame. Still, isn't it better
to walk away empty-handed than with...
<W15>nothing?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Ne buyuk bir utanc. Yine de,
eli bos gitmek, yaninda...
<W15>hicbir sey olmadan gitmekten daha iyi degil mi?

original: <T><M3/1/2>Wait! We're not finished yet. I'm up next!
translation: <T><M3/1/2>Bekle! Daha bitmedi. Siradaki benim!

original:
<T>So the lady wants a go too? Heh heh, right
you are, love.
translation:
<T>Hanimefendi de denemek mi istiyor? Heh heh, pekala,
askim.

original:
<T>Hmph, if you're all done with the
condescension, can we move on to the
part where I beat you?
translation:
<T>Hih, kucumsemeyi bitirdiysen
benim seni yendigim
kisma gecebilir miyiz?

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Aha aha, let's get to it then, shall we?
Remember not to take your eyes off my
flawless arts.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Aha aha, o halde baslayalim, olur mu?
Gozlerini benim
kusursuz hunerlerimden ayirma.

original: <T>Me first! Hrm...yeah, it's that one!
translation: <T>Once ben! Himm... evet, o!

original:
<T>Are you positive about that? <W>I've honed
my concentration to pinpoint precision,
you know!
translation:
<T>Buna emin misin? <W>Bilirsin,
odaklanmami igne ucu hassasiyetine kadar
gelistirdim!

original: <T>That's the one! I'm absolutely sure!
translation: <T>O! Kesinlikle eminim!

original: <T><M4/1/3>What?! Oh, come on, this game is rigged!
translation: <T><M4/1/3>Ne?! Hadi ama, bu oyun hileli!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>You 'aving a laugh? You've got to be a
proper sore loser to try and pin the blame
on someone else!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Dalga mi geciyorsun? Sucu baskasina
atmaya calismak icin tam bir
kotu kaybeden olmak lazim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>I'm feeling generous today, though, so
mister fancy-pants can have a go too if he
wants.<M1/1/1/45>
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Bugun comertligim uzerimde; o yuzden
sik bey de isterse bir deneme yapabilir.<M1/1/1/45>

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Well...yes, I think I will. <W>Now that I've seen
through your little trick, I have no reason to
object.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Sey... evet, yapacagim. <W>Kucuk numarani
gordukten sonra
itiraz etmek icin bir nedenim yok.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I'm sorry? Trick? <W>I am but a helpful
passer-by facilitating a peaceful agreement
between two parties.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Pardon? Numara mi? <W>Ben sadece iki taraf
arasinda bariscil bir anlasmaya aracilik eden
yardimsever bir yolcuyum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Pack it in, Narc-<W15> I mean, uh, facilitator
bloke. <M2/1/1>Let's just show them how it's done!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Kes sesini, Nars-<W15> yani, sey, arabulucu
efendi. <M2/1/1>Hadi onlara bunun nasil yapildigini gosterelim!

original: <T>As you wish. Now, watch carefully.
translation: <T>Nasil istersen. Simdi dikkatle izle.

original: <T><M1/1/1>You done? Then I'm going to say...
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Bitti mi? O zaman ben de soyle diyecegim...

original:
<T>One moment! If it's all the same to you,
I'd like to be the first to choose.
translation:
<T>Bir dakika! Senin icin sakincasi yoksa,
ilk secen ben olmak istiyorum.

original: <T>U-<W>uhh...
translation: <T>S-<W>sey...

original:
<T>I presume you don't object if I pick first
again?
translation:
<T>Tekrar ilk ben secersem itiraz etmiyorsun,
degil mi?

original: <T>Err...right...
translation: <T>Ee... peki...

original: <T>This is my choice.
translation: <T>Secimim bu.

original: <T>Mmm, this one.
translation: <T>Hmm, su.

original:
<T>Okay, and now to reveal where our ball
has been hiding.
translation:
<T>Tamam, simdi de topumuzun
nereye saklandigini gorelim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Heh, serves you right! You ain't getting
through here in a million years!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Heh, iyi oldu! Milyon yil gecse de
buradan gecemezsin!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>The game was played in all fairness. <M3/2/1>Terribly
bad luck. <W>Or...are you still a glutton for
punishment?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Oyun tamamen adildi. <M3/2/1>Ne fena
sans. <W>Yoksa... hala cezaya
doymuyor musun?

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>That match was simply to check your
<CR>fingerwork</C>. I will not lose the next one.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>O mac sadece
<CR>fingerwork</C> kontrolu icindi. Bir sonrakini kaybetmeyecegim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Peh! You're all talk! He's never getting the
hang of this.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Peh! Hep konusuyorsun! Bunun
puf noktasini asla kapamayacak.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Perhaps it would be best if we leave it at
this, sir.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Belki de burada
biraksak daha iyi olur, efendim.

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>I've examined your <CR>fingerwork</C>, and I believe
that is where your trick lies. Once more, if
you would be so kind.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Senin <CR>fingerwork</C>'unu inceledim ve
hilelerinin orada yattigina inaniyorum. Bir kez daha,
lutfen.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Now where could it be? I know it's hard
to drag your gaze away from my elegant
fingers.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Simdi nerede olabilir? Zarif
parmaklarimdan gozunu
ayirmak zor, biliyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Where is it hiding? Try not to be distracted
by my dextrous digits!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Nerede saklaniyor? Cevik
parmaklarim seni
oyalamasin!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Which cup is it under? I do apologise if
you were hypnotised by my nimble
fingers.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hangi bardagin altinda? Cevik
parmaklarim seni
hipnotize ettiyse kusura bakma.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Pick a cup, any cup. It's only natural to
be mesmerised by my beautifully slender
hands.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bir bardak sec, herhangi birini. Ince ve
guzel ellerime
buyulenmen gayet dogal.

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Perhaps you'll kindly allow us to pass now?
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Simdi gecmemize izin verir misin?

original: <T><M2/1/1>Peh! This wasn't the plan, Narcisse!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Peh! Bu planin parcasi degildi, Narcisse!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Do not.<W15> Even.<W15> Speak to me.<W15> My beautiful
game, ruined.<W> Losers should be neither
seen nor heard.<W> OUT of my sight.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sakin.<W15> Ha.<W15> Benimle konusma.<W15> Guzel
oyunumu mahvettin.<W> Kaybedenler ne
gorulmeli ne de duyulmali.<W> GOZUMDEN KAYBOL.

original: <T>Uh...<W>er, but you...
translation: <T>Sey...<W> ama sen...

original:
<T>Ugh, whatever. Like I need your help
anyways! I'm my own man!
translation:
<T>Of, her neyse. Zaten yardimina
ihtiyacim yok! Ben kendi basimin caresine bakarim!

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>A laughable man. You, however, gave an
admirable performance. I have to say, I'm
very much impressed.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Gulunc bir adam. Ama sen
takdire sayan bir performans sergiledin. Dogrusu,
cok etkilendim.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Now, it is time for me to make my dashing
and graceful exit. <W>Until next time!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Simdi benim de gosterisli ve
zarif bir cikis yapma vaktim. <W>Bir dahaki sefere!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>You did it, Professor! Were they cheating,
after all?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Basardiniz, Profesor! Demek ki
gercekten hile yapiyorlarmis, oyle mi?

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>Ha ha. You didn't see the trick?
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Ha ha. Numaranin ne oldugunu gormedin mi?

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Bragging was his undoing. You see, he
always had one finger pointing towards
the tumbler that contained the ball.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Ovunmesi onu ele verdi. Goruyorsun ya,
her zaman bir parmagi, topun oldugu
bardagi isaret ediyordu.

original:
<T><M4/1/4>Ah, you're right! <M1/1/3/45>Grr, I knew the game was
rigged!
translation:
<T><M4/1/4>Ah, haklisiniz! <M1/1/3/45>Grr, oyunun
hileli oldugunu biliyordum!

original:
<T><M2/2/5>Still, I don't understand what the point of all
that was.
translation:
<T><M2/2/5>Yine de butun bunlarin amacini
anlamadim.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>I suppose you get all sorts here. I mean, in
the City of Miracles.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Sanirim burada her tur insan var. Yani,
Mucizeler Sehri'nde.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>I doubt they are truly acquaintances of
Angela's. Hmm, it's very odd indeed.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Angela'nin gercekten tanidiklari olduklarini
sanmiyorum. Hmm, cok tuhaf.

original: <T><M2/1/2/45>Maybe it was just some bizarre festival act.
translation: <T><M2/1/2/45>Belki de sadece tuhaf bir festival gosterisiydi.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Let's worry about this later. I'm starving!
The sooner we visit Mrs Ledore, the sooner
we can eat!
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Simdi bunu dert etmeyelim. Acliktan oluyorum!
Bayan Ledore'a ne kadar cabuk gidersek, o kadar cabuk
yemek yeriz!

original:
When it's your turn,
slide the stylus on
the Touch Screen to
choose a tumbler.
Touch the screen to
confirm your choice.
translation:
Sira sana geldiginde,
Touch Screen uzerinde
kalemi kaydirarak
bir bardak sec.
Secimini onaylamak icin
ekana dokun.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T>Well, looks as though we're finally here!
translation: <T>Eh, sonunda buraya varmisiz!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>This is the first time I've seen Angela in
18 years. I'm a little nervous, truth be told.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Angela'yi
18 yildir ilk kez gorecegim. Dogrusu biraz gerginim.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/2>I can't even imagine how long 18 years
must feel!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>18 yilin ne kadar uzun
hissettirdigini hayal bile edemiyorum!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/2/1>What a magnificent garden! And look, they
even have balconies!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ne muhtesem bir bahce! Bak, hatta
balkonlari bile var!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: あれは…
translation: O da...

original: シャロア…
translation: Angela...

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original: はっ、エルシャール…？
translation: Ha, Hershel...?

original: よくきてくれたわ、エルシャール
translation: Iyi ki geldin, Hershel.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>It's good to see you again too, Angela.
translation: <T>Seni tekrar gormek guzel, Angela.

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original: <T>I'm very glad you came.
translation: <T>Geldigine cok sevindim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Of course. I came as soon as I received
your letter.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Elbette. Mektubunu alir almaz
hemen geldim.

original: <T><M8/1/1>I knew you wouldn't ignore our troubles.
translation: <T><M8/1/1>Sikintilarimizi gormezden gelmeyecegini biliyordum.

original:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Especially not with the Mask of Chaos
involved.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Hele ki isin icinde Kaos Maskesi
varken hic.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Oh, but where are my manners? Allow me to
show you inside.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Ah, ama nerede benim gorgum? Izin ver de
seni iceri buyur edeyim.

original:
<T>We can talk more inside. Please, make
yourself at home in the lounge.
translation:
<T>Iceride daha rahat konusuruz. Lutfen,
salonda kendini evinde gibi hisset.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Let's not keep Angela waiting. We should go
inside.
translation:
<T>Angela'yi bekletmeyelim. Iceri
girmeliyiz.

original: シャロア
translation: シャロア

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Well, Professor Layton, I'm disappointed in
you! The Hershel I know would never neglect
to introduce his friends.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Pekala, Profesor Layton, senden hayal kirikligina ugradim!
Bildigim Hershel, arkadaslarini tanistirmayi asla ihmal
etmezdi.

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original: <T><M2/1/1>Oh, of course. My apologies. This is-
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ah, tabii. Affedersiniz. Bu-

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original: <T><M5/2/1>Emmy Altava, the professor's assistant.
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Profesorun asistani Emmy Altava.

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
<T><M3/1/1>And I'm his apprentice, Luke! It's very nice
to meet you, Mrs Ledore.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ben de ciragi Luke! Sizinle tanismak
cok guzel, Bayan Ledore.

original:
<T>The pleasure's all mine. Please, call me
Angela. My husband, Henry, isn't here just
now. He has meetings until late.
translation:
<T>Asil memnuniyet bana ait. Lutfen bana
Angela deyin. Esim Henry su an burada degil.
Gece gec saatlere kadar toplantisi var.

original:
<T>Ah, Henry! How is he? I can hardly believe
that the two of you are married now.
Extraordinary how time flies.
translation:
<T>Ah, Henry! Nasil? Ikinizin artik evli
olduguna inanamiyorum.
Zaman ne cabuk geciyor.

original:
<T><M7/1/1/45>It passes in the blink of an eye...but it still
feels like an eternity.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Goz acip kapayincaya kadar geciyor...
ama yine de bir sonsuzluk gibi
geliyor.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Angela, I'm sorry to broach the topic so
soon, but I'm anxious to discuss your letter.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Angela, konuya bu kadar
erken girdigim icin uzgunum ama mektubunu
konusmak icin sabirsizlaniyorum.

original:
<T>Could you tell me more about the unusual
happenings in this city?
translation:
<T>Bu sehirdeki sira disi
olaylar hakkinda biraz daha anlatir misin?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It...it all started about a month ago. That
was when the Masked Gentleman first
appeared.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>S-sey... Her sey yaklasik bir ay once basladi.
Maskeli Bey ilk kez
o zaman ortaya cikti.

original:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Since then, we've had people turning into
horses, people stepping out of paintings...
It's absolute chaos.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/45>O zamandan beri insanlar
data donusuyor, tablolarin icinden cikanlar oluyor...
Tam bir kaos.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>We were present earlier this evening when
a similar event took place: several people
apparently turned to stone.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Bu aksam daha once benzer bir olaya
sahit olduk: birkac kisi
sozde tasa donustu.

original:
<T><M8/1/1>Another of his dreadful acts? He calls them
miracles, you know.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Onun korkunc islerinden biri daha mi? Onlara
'mucize' diyor, bilirsin.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Well, whatever we saw tonight, it certainly
was extraordinary, I'll give him that.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Her ne gorduysek, kesinlikle
olaganustuydu; hakkini vermek lazim.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I was petrified when all those people turned
to stone! <W>Oh wait, <W30>no, I don't mean...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>O insanlar tasa donunce ben de
korkudan donup kaldim! <W>Bir dakika, <W30>hayir, onu demek istemedim...

original:
<T>Everyone says he's unleashing the power of
the Mask of Chaos to destroy our city.
translation:
<T>Herkes, sehrimizi yok etmek icin
Kaos Maskesi'nin gucunu serbest biraktigini soyluyor.

original:
<T><M7/1/1/55>This city is packed full of tourists and
travellers. We still haven't been able to
identify all the victims.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/55>Bu sehir turist ve
gezginlerle dolup tasiyor. Hala tum
kurbanlari tespit edemedik.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Even Henry is afraid of what horrible
nightmare might occur next.<W> <M4/1/1/45>He fears for his
own safety and the city's future.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Henry bile sirada ne korkunc
kabusun yasanacagindan korkuyor.<W> <M4/1/1/45>Kendi guvenliginden
de sehrin geleceginden endise ediyor.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Just a moment, Angela. How is it possible
that this Masked Gentleman could possess
the Mask of Chaos?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Bir dakika, Angela. Bu Maskeli Bey'in
Kaos Maskesi'ne nasil
sahip olmasi mumkun?

original:
<T>I was sure the mask was lost forever.<W30>
I saw it...<W30><M8/2/1/45>along with...
translation:
<T>Maskenin sonsuza dek kayboldugundan emindim.<W30>
Onu gordum...<W30><M8/2/1/45>hem de...

original:
<T><M3/2/5>Wait a second! Professor, you've actually
seen the Mask of Chaos?
translation:
<T><M3/2/5>Bir dakika! Profesor, Kaos Maskesi'ni
gercekten gordunuz mu?

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Yes...<W> A friend of mine - my best friend,
in fact - discovered it back in our school
days.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Evet...<W> Bir arkadasim-hatta en iyi arkadasim-
okul gunlerimizde
onu bulmustu.

original: <T><M3/1/2/45>What?! You never mentioned this before!
translation: <T><M3/1/2/45>Ne?! Bunu daha once hic soylemediniz!

original:
<T><M7/1/1>So you haven't told them? <W>About the mask?
<W>About Randall?
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Demek onlara anlatmadin? <W>Maske hakkinda?
<W>Randall hakkinda?
<T><M3/2/1/45>Anlatmadim...

original:
<T>Randall? He was your friend? The one who
found the mask?
translation:
<T>Randall mi? Arkadasin miydi? Maskeyi
bulan o muydu?

original:
<T>Yes, Randall Ascot, he discovered it. <W><M8/2/1/45>And
I... <W>It was my fault that he...
translation:
<T>Evet, Randall Ascot buldu. <W><M8/2/1/45>Ve
ben... <W>Onun basina gelenler benim hatamdi...

original:
<T><M8/1/1>After the accident, Henry led several search
parties down into the ruins.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Kazadan sonra Henry birkac arama
ekibini harabelere indirdi.

original: <T>He never found Randall.
translation: <T>Randall'i hic bulamadi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>But he did find the ancient treasure hidden
down there. <W>And the mask.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Ama oraya saklanmis
kadim hazineyi buldu. <W>Ve maskeyi.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>He found it?!
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Onu buldu mu?!

original: <T><M7/1/1>Yes. Everything that Randall sought.
translation: <T><M7/1/1>Evet. Randall'in aradigi her seyi.

original:
<T>Henry brought the mask back here. He said
he had stumbled upon it in one of the
passages.
translation:
<T>Henry maskeyi buraya getirdi. Bir
gecitte rastladigini
soyledi.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/60>If he found the mask, then what of Randall?
Surely they would have been together?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/60>Madem maskeyi buldu, Randall'a ne oldu?
Kesin birlikte olmaliydilar.

original: <T><M8/1/1>No, Hershel. I'm sorry.
translation: <T><M8/1/1>Hayir, Hershel. Uzgunum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Henry has never stopped searching, though.
He refuses to accept Randall's death.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama Henry aramayi hic birakmadi.
Randall'in olumunu kabullenmiyor.

original:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Apart from his work, it's really the only
thing he thinks about.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Isinin disinda, gercekten dusundugu
tek sey bu.

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>I can't say that I blame him. I want to
believe it too...<W30>that Randall isn't really
gone...
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Onu suclayamam. Ben de
inanmak istiyorum...<W30> Randall'in gercekten
gitmedigine...

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>Isn't that pendant...?
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Su kolye... degil mi?

original:
<T>Oh, you remember this? It's aged quite a bit
now, much as we have.
translation:
<T>Aa, bunu hatirladin mi? Bizim gibi
o da epey eskidi.
<T><M4/2/1/45>Angela, ben-

original:
<T><M6/1/1>Hershel, I've wanted to apologise for our
last conversation for so very long. I'm so
sorry I didn't contact you sooner.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Hershel, son konusmamiz icin
uzun zamandir ozur dilemek istiyordum. Cok
uzgunum; daha once sana ulasamadim.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>I knew it wasn't your fault. I just couldn't
bear losing him.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Bunun senin sucun olmadigini biliyordum. Sadece
onu kaybetmeye dayanamadim.

original:
<T>I want to say it was because I was young,
but that's no excuse. <W>I...<W30>I think I just needed
someone to blame. I'm sorry.
translation:
<T>Gencligim yuzundendi demek isterim,
ama bu bahane degil. <W>Ben...<W30>sanirim sadece
suclayacak birine ihtiyacim vardi. Ozur dilerim.

original:
<T><M8/1/1/45>Randall was your best friend. You were in
just as much pain as I was.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1/45>Randall en iyi arkadasindi. Sen de
benim kadar aci cekiyordun.

original:
<T><M8/2/1/60>I never held it against you, Angela. You had
every right to blame me. <W>I wasn't able to
save him.
translation:
<T><M8/2/1/60>Sana hic kin tutmadim, Angela. Beni
suclamakta hakliydin. <W>Onu
kurtaramadim.

original: <T>It haunts me to this day.
translation: <T>Bu hala pesimi birakmiyor.

original: <T><M7/1/1/45>I'm so sorry, Hershel.
translation: <T><M7/1/1/45>Cok uzgunum, Hershel.

original:
<T>Henry insisted we keep the mask here, to
remind us of Randall. <W>And I have my
pendant...
translation:
<T>Henry, Randall'i hatirlamak icin maskeyi
burada tutmamizda israr etti. <W>Ben de
kolyemi...

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>You kept it here? <W>Then how did the Masked
Gentleman come by it?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Burada mi tuttunuz? <W>O halde Maskeli
Bey onu nasil ele gecirdi?

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>It was stolen from us. One month ago.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Bizden calindi. Bir ay once.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/60>At the very time the Masked Gentleman
first appeared?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Maskeli Bey'in ilk ortaya
ciktigi zamanda mi?

original: <T><M7/1/1/45>More or less, yes.
translation: <T><M7/1/1/45>Asagi yukari, evet.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Once we catch this villain, I want the mask
back. For Randall...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bu kotu adami yakaladigimizda maskeyi
geri istiyorum. Randall icin...

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>I promise we'll do all we can.<W> Could you
show me where you kept the mask?
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Elimizden geleni yapacagimiza soz veriyorum.<W> Maskeyi
nerede tuttugunuzu gosterebilir misiniz?

original:
<T><M8/1/1/20>Oh! Well, we kept it in Henry's study...<W>but
he isn't here...
translation:
<T><M8/1/1/20>Ah! Sey, onu Henry'nin calisma odasinda...<W> ama
kendisi burada degil...

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Angela, I understand. A gentleman's study
is his private domain. I shouldn't wish to
enter without Henry present.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Angela, anliyorum. Bir beyefendinin calisma odasi
ozel alanidir. Henry yokken
iceri girmek istemem.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>In any case, it's rather late. I was hoping to
look over the scene of tonight's incident
once more before we retire for the evening.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Her halukarda, epey gec oldu. Geceyi
bitirmeden once bu aksamki olayin
meydanini bir kez daha gormek istiyordum.

original: <T>Shall we call on you both tomorrow?
translation: <T>Yarin ikinizi de ziyaret edelim mi?

original: <T><M7/2/2/45>Yes, that sounds like the best idea.
translation: <T><M7/2/2/45>Evet, en iyisi bu.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>I've booked a couple of rooms for you at
the Camel's Hump hotel.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Senin icin Camel's Hump otelinde
birkac oda ayirttim.

original:
<T><M1/2/2/45>It's a little bit of a walk, but I think you'll
find it quite to your liking.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2/45>Biraz yurumek gerekecek ama
begeneceginizi dusunuyorum.

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>Much appreciated, Angela.
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Cok tesekkurler, Angela.

original:
<T>Just take the road running north-west from
the gallery plaza and continue up past all
the shops. You can't miss it.
translation:
<T>Galeri meydanindan kuzeybatiya giden
yolu takip et ve tum dukkanlarin
yanindan gecip devam et. Kacirman mumkun degil.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Really, this is more than we could have
expected. Thank you again. We'll see you
tomorrow.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Gercekten, bu bekledigimizden de fazlasi.
Tekrar tesekkurler. Yarin
gorusuruz.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I can't wait to get to the hotel! <M1/1/2>I think
I could eat a horse! And I'm so tired my
eyes are falling out!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Otele gitmek icin sabirsizlaniyorum! <M1/1/2>Sanirim
dev bir ati bile yiyebilirim! Ve o kadar yorgunum ki
gozlerim kapaniyor!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/1/1>We'll go very soon, Luke, I promise. There's
just one more thing I'd like to check...<W30>if
your stomach approves.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Cok yakinda gidecegiz, Luke, soz. Sadece
kontrol etmek istedigim bir sey daha var...<W30>tabii
miden onaylarsa.

original:
<T><M3/2/5>Oh...<W> <M3/1/3>Erm, of course, Professor! I'll feed my
hunger for information instead.
translation:
<T><M3/2/5>Ah...<W> <M3/1/3>Sey, elbette Profesor! Acligimi
bu kez bilgiyle doyururum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Then let's revisit Celebration Boulevard. We
may be able to find some new clues if it's
quietened down.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>O halde Senlik Bulvari'na geri donelim.
Ortalik sakinlestiyse, yeni ipuclari
bulabiliriz.<M1/1/1>

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M3/2/2>The professor has spoken!
translation: <T><M3/2/2>Profesor konustu!

original: ヌーデン
translation: ヌーデン

original: <T>Oh, I do beg your pardon.
translation: <T>Ah, affedersiniz.

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T>On the contrary, I should be the one
apologising.
translation:
<T>Hayir, asil ozur dilemesi gereken
benim.

original:
<T>No, really, sir, it was I who-<W30> I beg your
pardon, but are you perchance Professor
Layton?
translation:
<T>Hayir, efendim, asil ben-<W30> Affedersiniz,
acaba siz Profesor
Layton misiniz?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>I am. You have me at a disadvantage,
Mr...?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Evet. Siz beni taniyorsunuz ama ben sizi
taniyamadim,
Bay...?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh, how terrible of me! Allow me to
introduce myself. My name is Mordaunt,
personal assistant to Mr Ledore.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah, ne kadar kabayim! Izin verin kendimi
tanitayim. Adim Mordaunt,
Bay Ledore'un kisisel asistaniyim.

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original: <T><M2/2/1>How do you know about the professor?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Profesoru nereden taniyorsunuz?

original:
<T>Mrs Ledore told us some days ago to
expect your arrival. When I saw you just
now, I merely wondered...
translation:
<T>Bayan Ledore birkac gun once gelisinizi
beklememizi soyledi. Az once sizi gorunce
sadece merak ettim...

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>It's a pleasure to meet you, Mr Mordaunt.
Please allow me to introduce my
companions, Emmy Altava and Luke Triton.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Tanistigimiza memnun oldum, Bay Mordaunt.
Izin verirseniz, yoldaslarimi tanitayim:
Emmy Altava ve Luke Triton.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>I do not wish to be presumptuous, but I take
it that you are leaving?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Haddimi asmak istemem ama
gidiyor musunuz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Again, you are correct, Mr Mordaunt. We're
retiring for the night. I gather Henry won't be
home for some time.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Yine haklisiniz, Bay Mordaunt. Bu gece
istirahate cekiliyoruz. Anladigim kadariyla Henry
bir sure eve gelmeyecek.

original:
<T>I see, I see! Yes, Mr Ledore is rushed off his
feet with all the chaos. It's a miracle he can
run on so little sleep - excuse the pun.
translation:
<T>Anliyorum, anliyorum! Evet, Bay Ledore bu
kaos yuzunden basini kasiyacak vakit bulamiyor.
Bu kadar az uykuyla idare etmesi bir mucize-
kelime oyununu mazur gorun.

original:
<T>I shall inform Mr Ledore that you were here.
Please forgive him for being unable to
welcome you himself.
translation:
<T>Bay Ledore'a geldiginizi bildirecegim.
Sizi bizzat karsilayamadigi icin lutfen onu
bagislayin.

original:
<T>Well, I believe I should be taking my leave.
Do be careful. The streets near here are in
a terrible shambles.
translation:
<T>Ben de artik musaadenizi isteyeyim.
Dikkatli olun. Buralardaki sokaklar
berbat halde.

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>Likewise, Mr Mordaunt.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Size de, Bay Mordaunt.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Mr Ledore must be a very busy man to need
an assistant. Almost as busy as you,
Professor!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bay Ledore'un bir asistana ihtiyac duyacak kadar
mesgul olmasi gerek. Neredeyse sizin kadar,
Profesor!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>This place may be called the City of
Miracles, but I'm quite sure most of its
prosperity was born of hard work.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Burasina Mucizeler Sehri denebilir ama
refahinin cogunun siki calismadan
dogduguna eminim.

original:
<T>Now, let's head back to Celebration
Boulevard. Perhaps our work on the case
will relieve Henry's burden.
translation:
<T>Simdi, Kutlama Bulvari'na geri donelim.
Belki davayla ilgili calismalarimiz
Henry'nin yukunu hafifletir.

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T>Those footsteps! Why, I would recognise
that firm, resolute sound anywhere! I need
not see to identify a gentleman.
translation:
<T>Su ayak sesleri! O kararli, saglam sesi
her yerde tanirim! Bir beyefendiyi tanimak icin
gormeme bile gerek yok.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I am hidden very sneakily behind the fa{,c}ade
before you. Find me! Show me a zoom to
be proud of!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Karsindaki fa{,c}ade'in arkasina cok sinsi
bir sekilde saklandim. Beni bul! Ovunecegim bir yakinlastirma
goster bana!

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T>What is this, with the going away? Oh,
I see. You are being shy! Nonsense,
nonsense! Be not too shy to magnify!
translation:
<T>Bu gidis de ne boyle? Ah,
anladim. Utaniyorsun! Sacmalik,
sacmalik! Yakinlastirmaya cekinme!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Be brave! Seek out the place where I am
hidden and zoom! Make visible my humble
visage!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Cesur ol! Saklandigim yeri bul
ve yakinlastir! Mutevazi
cehremi gorunur kil!

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T>Oh, I am uncovered! I am undone!<W> Like
a tea cosy over my heart, it warms me to
see you grow!
translation:
<T>Ah, aciga ciktim! Mahvoldum!<W> Tipki
kalbimin ustundeki bir cay demligi ortusu gibi, seni buyurken gormek icimi
isitiyor!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>What is the matter, my gentlemanly friends?
I would not hinder you. Now hurry, and
converse with me.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ne oldu, beyefendi dostlarim?
Size engel olmak istemem. Haydi cabuk, ve
benimle konusun.

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh, bravo! It takes great skill and art to
detect a hidden man with such ease. Hurrah!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ah, bravo! Boyle kolaylikla sakli bir adami
bulmak buyuk ustalik ve sanat ister. Yasasin!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Was there something you wanted from us?
translation: <T>Bizden istedigin bir sey mi vardi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You are right! There is something I would
very much like to tell you about. It comes
from<M2/1/1> the fruitful grapevine.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Haklisiniz! Size bahsetmek
cok istedigim bir sey var. Bu bilgi
dedikodu agindan<M2/1/1> geliyor.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Ha ha ha! Now focus your little magnifying
glass on the metal box and <M2/1/1>examine it
closely!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ha ha ha! Simdi kucuk buyutecinizi
metal kutuya dogrultun ve <M2/1/1>onu inceleyin
dikkatlice!

original:
<T>What's wrong, my spirited friends? Was my
metal box not to your liking?<W> Come, now.
Check it!
translation:
<T>Ne oldu, coskulu dostlarim? Benim
metal kutum hosunuza gitmedi mi?<W> Haydi ama.
Bir bakin!

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T><M2/1/1>This, my friends, is a collection item! And
one that will serve you so fashionably well!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu, dostlarim, bir koleksiyon parcasi! Hem de
size oyle sik bir sekilde hizmet edecek ki!

original:
<T>Throughout the city, you may find scrap and
treasure, rubbish and rarities, rubble and
ransom...
translation:
<T>Sehrin dort bir yaninda hurda ve hazine,
cop ve nadideler, moloz ve
ganimet bulabilirsiniz...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But whatever these things may be, it is you,
my friends, who have the power to transform
them into a collection!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama bunlar her ne olursa olsun, dostlarim,
onlari bir koleksiyona donusturme gucu
sizdedir!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Soon your hoard will grow until it is grand
enough to impress even the most seasoned
collectors!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Yakinda birikiminiz, en tecrubeli
koleksiyonculari bile etkileyecek kadar
buyuyecek!

original:
<T>Such items are scattered near and far, hither
and thither, <M3/2/1/20>so do not miss a trick!
translation:
<T>Boyle esyalar yakinlarda da uzaklarda da, oraya
buraya sacilmistir; <M3/2/1/20>bu yuzden firsat kacirmayin!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>I see! I must admit hunting for artefacts is
rather a hobby of mine.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Anliyorum! Itiraf etmeliyim, eser avlamak
benim de epey bir hobimdir.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Words spoken from the heart, good sir!
Please, let me reward you!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Yurekten gelen sozler, efendim!
Lutfen, sizi odullendirmeme izin verin!

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Remember where our destinies crossed at
Celebration Boulevard? <W>Check the wooden
box there again!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Kaderlerimizin Senlik Bulvari'nda kesistigi yeri
hatirliyor musun? <W>Oradaki tahta
kutuyu yeniden kontrol et!

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>I think it is time to take my leave, no? Enjoy
your salubrious collection selection, my
friends!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Sanirim artik musaade isteme vaktim geldi, degil mi? Tadini cikarin
bu nefis koleksiyon seciminizin,
dostlarim!

original: <T>And goodbye!
translation: <T>Hosca kalin!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M2/2/3/45>Do you think that man will ever stop
shooting off after he's done talking?
translation:
<T><M2/2/3/45>Sence o adam, konusmasini bitirdikten sonra
bir gun kacip gitmeyi birakacak mi?

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>Eternally eccentric Aldus has given you a
box to store the items you collect.
translation:
<T>Daima tuhaf Aldus size topladiginiz esyalari
saklayacaginiz bir kutu verdi.

original:
<T>The Collection Box has been added to the
trunk.
translation:
<T>Koleksiyon Kutusu sandiga
eklendi.

original:
<T>Use this box to store all the rare and
fascinating items that you come across on
your travels.
translation:
<T>Seyahatlerinizde karsiniza cikan tum nadir ve
ilgi cekici esyalari saklamak icin
bu kutuyu kullanin.

original:
<T>These items are purely for enjoyment and
have no bearing on the case. A full
collection is its own reward!
translation:
<T>Bu esyalar sadece keyif icindir ve
vaka uzerinde hicbir etkisi yoktur.
Tam bir koleksiyon zaten basli basina bir oduldur!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Well, that gives us one more thing to do on
our travels. For now, we should continue
back to Celebration Boulevard.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Pekala, bu da seyahatlerimizde yapacak bir sey daha demek.
Simdilik Senlik Bulvari'na
geri donmeliyiz.

original: コッペリア
translation: コッペリア

original:
<T>Hullo! Here for the show, are you? <W30>I do a
performance in the marquee just there! Got
me name on the sign and everything.
translation:
<T>Selam! Gosteri icin mi geldiniz? <W30>Surada, cadirda
sahne aliyorum! Tabelada adim bile yaziyor.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>They've had to cancel it today, though. Half
our props got ruined in the panic. Proper
wrecked, they were.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ama bugun iptal etmek zorunda kaldik.
Panikte dekorlarimizin yarisi mahvoldu. Resmen
paramparca oldular.

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T><M1/1/1>That is incredibly unfortunate. I'm sorry to
hear it.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Bu gercekten talihsiz. Duyduguma uzuldum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I took a gander at the people who turned
to stone meself, but it got me wondering:
what's the bloomin' point?!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ben de tasa donen insanlara bir baktim ama
sunu merak ettim:
Bunun ne anlami var ki?!

original:
<T>D'you think he's got something against the
circus? Or maybe he just hates fun? Urrgh,
that's an 'orrible thought.
translation:
<T>Acaba sirke mi takmis? Yoksa eglenceden mi
nefret ediyor? Off,
bu korkunc bir dusunce.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>But there's no use getting down in the
dumps when we've got smiles to put on
faces, you know?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ama suratlara gulumseme konduracakken
moral bozmanin alemi yok, degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Here, why don't youse try a puzzle? Oh,
go on! It'll make you dead 'appy!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bakin, bir bilmece denemek istemez misiniz?
Hadi ama! Sizi cok mutlu eder!

original:
<T>Oh, maybe now's not the best time. Busy
stuff to be getting on with. Well, how 'bout
you come back later if you get the chance?
translation:
<T>Ah, belki simdi pek uygun zaman degil.
Yapacak isleriniz vardir. Sey, firsat bulursaniz
sonra tekrar gelin, olur mu?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Oh, hullo there, look who's back! Did you
want another look at that puzzle, then?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Aa, selam! Bakin kim gelmis! Su bilmeceye
bir daha mi bakmak istediniz?

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Hurrah, you got it right! Oh, well done!
You're a proper clever lot, aren't you?
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Yasasin, dogru bildiniz! Aferin!
Ne kadar da zekiymissiniz, ha?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Ever since our troupe got here, these mental
miracles have kept 'appening. It's driving me
a bit batty!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Toplulugumuz buraya geldiginden beri bu
zihinsel mucizeler durmadan oluyor.
Insani biraz cildirtiyor!

original:
<T>I just 'ope the police don't go calling it
{''}magic{''}. Cause let's be honest - it's not.
translation:
<T>Umarim polis buna
{''}sihir{''} demez. Durust olalim-degil cunku.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Magic tricks aren't something you do to 'urt
people. They're meant to entertain.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Sihir numaralari insanlara zarar vermek icin
yapilmaz. Eglendirmek icindir.

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original: <T><M3/1/1>Absolutely!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Kesinlikle!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>The sooner they catch that Gentleman
bloke, the better, I say! Maybe then we can
all enjoy a bit of R&R, eh?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>O Beyefendi herifi ne kadar cabuk yakalarlarsa
o kadar iyi! Belki o zaman hepimiz biraz
R&R yapariz, ha?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>There's a whole load of entertainment in
Monte d'Or. Not just the casinos and the
parade, but stuff for the kiddies, too.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Monte d'Or'da bir suru eglence var.
Sadece kumarhaneler ve gecit toreni degil,
cocuklar icin de bir seyler var.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Well, the panic seems to have died down
now.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Eh, panik biraz yatismis gibi gorunuyor
simdi.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Hmm... The petrified victims have all been
removed, but I hope we may find other
clues.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Hmm... Tas kesilen kurbanlarin hepsi
