goturulmus, ama baska
ipuclari bulmayi umuyorum.

original:
<T>It's been long enough for those that fled the
scene to return. It's possible that an
eyewitness was among them.
translation:
<T>Olay yerinden kacanlarin geri donmesi icin
yeterince zaman gecti. Aralarinda bir
gorgu tanigi olabilir.

original: ポリス
translation: ポリス

original: <T><M3/1/1/15>Oi, you three! For the love of... Stop!
translation: <T><M3/1/1/15>Hey, siz ucu! Allah askina... Durun!

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original: <T><M1/2/2>Oh, um...sorry.
translation: <T><M1/2/2>Ah, sey... ozur dilerim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Phew, that was a close shave. I thought we
were about to lose our one precious lead for
this case!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Of, ucuz atlattik. Bu dava icin sahip oldugumuz
o tek degerli ipucunu kaybedecegiz sandim!

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original: <T>You mean you've found something?
translation: <T>Yani bir sey mi buldunuz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Oh, yes. See them horse tracks? We
estimate about three of them, galloping
away from the carnival.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Ah, evet. Su at izlerini goruyor musunuz?
Yaklasik uc at varmis; panayirdan
dort nala uzaklasmislar.

original:
<T>We reckon they were left by our culprits.
Otherwise, <M3/1/1>why would they be so clear
among these thousands of footprints?
translation:
<T>Bunlarin suclulara ait oldugunu dusunuyoruz.
Yoksa <M3/1/1>bu binlerce ayak izi arasinda
nasil bu kadar belirgin olurlardi?

original:
<T>What's more, they're going the very same
direction that our mystery man left in.
Veeeery suspicious, if you ask me.
translation:
<T>Ustelik, su esrarengiz adamin gittigi yonun
tam aynisina gidiyorlar.
Bana sorarsaniz coook supheli.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Er, yes... <W>Have you thought of asking some
witnesses, though?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Ee, evet... <W>Peki hic taniklara sormayi
dusundunuz mu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Course we have, we're the police!<W> And we'll
grill those witnesses good and proper...<W>just
as soon as we find some.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Tabii ki dusunduk, biz polisiz!<W> Taniklari
guzelce sorguya cekecegiz...<W>tabii once bir tane
bulursak.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>It's difficult, you know, with Monte d'Or
being a tourist city. Half our witnesses will
probably be on the first train home.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Zor tabii; Monte d'Or bir turizm sehri.
Taniklarin yarisi muhtemelen ilk trenle
eve donmus olacaktir.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>We've seized all the statues in the area, but
as for the identity of that man...<M2/1/1/45>we haven't
got the first idea.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bolgedeki tum heykellere el koyduk ama
su adamin kimligi konusunda...<M2/1/1/45>en ufak bir fikrimiz
yok.

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>I realised most of the people here were
tourists when I was asking around. No one
seemed to know the Ledores.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Etrafta sorarken buradakilerin cogunun
turist oldugunu fark ettim. Kimse Ledore'lari
taniyor gibi degildi.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Nah, only the residents know about Mr and
Mrs Ledore - or about anything, really.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yok, Bay ve Bayan Ledore'u sadece
yerliler bilir-zaten burada olup bitenleri de
onlar bilir.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I heard there's a boutique owner who knows
everything that goes on in town, though.
<W><M2/1/1>Now, what's the place called again...?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama sehirde olan biten her seyi bilen bir
butik sahibi varmis diye duydum.
<W><M2/1/1>Simdi, dukkanin adi neydi...?

original:
<T>Sorry, it's completely slipped my mind. <W><M2/1/1/45>But
it's somewhere in the shopping district,
that's for sure.
translation:
<T>Pardon, aklimdan tamamen uctu. <W><M2/1/1/45>Ama
alisveris bolgesinde bir yerde, o kesin.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Head up to the gallery plaza and take a left.
You might have to just try the shops one
by one.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Galeri meydanina cikin ve sola donun.
Dukkanlari belki tek tek denemeniz
gerekecek.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Thank you. We'll have a look around for
this boutique you mentioned.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Tesekkur ederim. Bahsettiginiz bu butigi
aramaya koyulacagiz.

original:
<T>Would be nice if we could cordon off the
street. Have a bit of peace while we worked.
translation:
<T>Keske sokagi kordon altina alabilsek.
Calisirken biraz huzurumuz olurdu.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But no, we can't disturb the tourist traffic,
can we?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama yok, turist trafigini rahatsiz edemeyiz,
degil mi?

original: セレナ
translation: Serena

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Wasn't today's carnival the most
wonderfabulant thing ever? People turning
to stalagminium and everything!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bugunku karnaval, simdiye kadarki en
harika-muhtesem sey degil miydi? Insanlarin
stalagminyuma donusmesi falan!

original: <T>The Masked Dandleman is amazible!
translation: <T>Maskeli Dandleman acayipmuthis!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>I'm afraid what you're referring to was no
show.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Korkarim bahsettiginiz sey bir
gosteri degildi.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Not a show? That's imposterous!<W> How did
he turn people into stone, then?! Fizzle me
this!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Gosteri degil mi? Bu dupeduz sahte-hata!<W> O zaman
insanlari nasil tasa cevirdi?! Hadi
bunu cizirdatip acikla!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M5/1/1>I don't know. His performance wouldn't be
as impressive if we could explain it, would
it?
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Bilmiyorum. Aciklayabilseydik,
bu kadar etkileyici olmazdi,
olmaz mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I suppo<W20>oo<W20>oo<W20>ose so.<W> Actually, I saw
a looky-spooking stranger loutering about.
Do you think it was him?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ga<W20>li<W20>ba<W20> oyle.<W> Aslinda, etrafta
tuhafta-korkutucu bir yabancinin dolandigini gordum.
Sence o muydu?

original:
<T>His face was hidden under a mistevious
mask. This puzzle's mistevious, too!
translation:
<T>Yuzu muzip-sisli bir
maskenin altina saklanmisti. Bu bilmece de muzip-sisli!

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Why won't you solve my wonderfabulant
puzzle?! You know, you're just as bad as
the Masked Dandleman!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Neden harika-muhtesem bilmecemi
cozmuyorsun?! Biliyor musun, sen de en az
Maskeli Dandleman kadar kotusun!

original:
<T>Ahh! The top-hatted dandleman's back for
revenge!
translation:
<T>Ahh! Silindir sapkali dandleman intikam icin
geri dondu!

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Wonderfabulant! Any dandleman who can do
that is bound to catch that criminal
thread-handed!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Harika-muhtesem! Bunu yapabilen her dandleman
o sucluyu
iplik-eliyle yakalar!

original:
<T>But all I know about the culprit was that he
hid his face behind an amazibly mistevious
mask!
translation:
<T>Ama suclu hakkinda bildigim tek sey,
yuzunu sasirtici-muzip bir
maskenin arkasina sakladigi!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That's not much to go on! It all happened
in the middle of a parade!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu pek bir seye yaramaz! Her sey bir gecit
toreninin ortasinda oldu!

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Very true. Many of the attendees and
performers were wearing masks.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Dogru. Seyircilerin ve
sanatcilarin cogu maske takiyordu.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Aww, don't be such a spoilsnail. You've
got to think positive!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ahh, oyle bir keyif-bozsalyangoz olma. Pozitif
dusunmelisin!

original:
<T>There's a costume boutique in the shopping
district. Maybe the Masked Dandleman
bought his outfit there.
translation:
<T>Alisveris bolgesinde bir kostum butigi var.
Belki Maskeli Dandleman
kiyafetini oradan almistir.

original:
<T>You might even finish up your case in one
fowl scoop!
translation:
<T>Davani bir
kus-sipsak hamlede bile bitirebilirsin!

original:
<T>I give the Masked Dandleman's show ten
out of ten for his imposterous miracles and
mistevious charm!
translation:
<T>Maskeli Dandleman'in gosterisine, sahte-harika mucizeleri ve
muzip-sisli cazibesi icin
on uzerinden on veriyorum!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M5/1/1>We need to take a left to reach the
shopping district.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Alisveris bolgesine ulasmak icin sola
sapmaliyiz.

original: ニルス
translation: Nils

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Hey. You hear about the parade getting hit?
Real shame.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Hey. Gecit torenine saldirildigini duydun mu?
Yazik gercekten.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Too bad the police couldn't stop the bloke.
Always a step behind, y'know.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Polisin herifi durduramamasi kotu oldu.
Hep bir adim gerideler, bilirsin.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Bet the costume shop lady knows more than
the entire force combined.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Iddiaya varim, o kostum dukkanindaki kadin,
tum teskilattan daha cok sey biliyordur.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Might I ask where this costume shop is?
translation: <T>Bu kostum dukkaninin nerede oldugunu sorabilir miyim?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Right there. Got plenty of carnival stuff for
hire. Why? You changing your costume?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Surada. Kiralik bir suru karnaval esyasi var.
Neden? Kostum mu degistiriyorsun?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Er... Something like that. Many thanks for
your assistance, sir.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Sey... Ona benzer. Yardiminiz icin cok
tesekkur ederim, efendim.

original:
<T><M2/3/1>Sure. No need to be so formal. The name's
Nils. <W>Seriously, people still act like that
nowadays?
translation:
<T><M2/3/1>Tabii. Bu kadar resmi olmana gerek yok. Adim
Nils. <W>Cidden, insanlar hala boyle mi davraniyor
simdi?

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>That must be the boutique the policeman
mentioned earlier!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bu, polisin az once bahsettigi
butik olmali!

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>What a...vivid selection they have. Well,
let's go inside.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Ne... canli bir seckileri var. Peki,
iceri girelim.

original:
<T><M2/3/1>Whatever you need for a costume, you'll
find it in that lady's shop. Masks, face
paint, props, accessories. <W>Hats, too.
translation:
<T><M2/3/1>Kostum icin neye ihtiyacin varsa o kadinin dukkaninda
bulursun. Maskeler, yuz
boyasi, aksesuarlar, esyalar. <W>Sapkalar da.

original: ラプンシュカ
translation: ラプンシュカ

original: <T><M1/2/1>Hello there! Come in, come in.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Merhaba! Buyurun, buyurun.

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T>Good evening, madam. May I ask if you are
the owner of this establishment?
translation:
<T>Iyi aksamlar, hanimefendi. Bu dukkanin
sahibi siz misiniz?

original:
<T>Shush! Not a word more. I know exactly
what you're looking for.
translation:
<T>Ssst! Bir kelime daha etme. Tam olarak
ne aradigini biliyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Hold on, I have just the thing...<W> There!
<M1/2/1>A dashing harlequin outfit for a fine
gentleman!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Dur, tam aradigin sey var...<W> Iste!
<M1/2/1>Sik bir beyefendi icin yakisikli
bir harlequin kostumu!

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ah, actually...<W> We were hoping you could
give us some information on the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ah, aslinda...<W> Maskeli Bey hakkinda
bize biraz bilgi verebilir
diye umuyorduk.

original:
<T><M1/1/3>Oh, you're that kind of customer? Why
didn't you say so?<W> All right. <M1/2/1>If you solve
this puzzle, I'll tell you what I know.
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Ha, sen o tur musterilerdensin? Neden
bastan soylemedin?<W> Pekala. <M1/2/1>Bu bulmacayi
cozersen bildiklerimi anlatirim.

original:
<T>For shame. A gentleman like you, unable to
solve a puzzle like this? What's the world
coming to?
translation:
<T>Yaziklar olsun. Senin gibi bir beyefendi
boyle bir bulmacayi cozemiyor mu? Dunya
ne hale geldi?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>You're not getting a shred of info out of me
unless you can solve this puzzle.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bu bulmacayi cozemezsen benden
zerre bilgi alamazsin.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Aren't we a clever clogs? <W>All right, what do
you want to know?
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Ne kadar da kurnazmisiz? <W>Pekala, ne
bilmek istiyorsun?

original:
<T>What do you know about the Masked
Gentleman?
translation:
<T>Maskeli Bey hakkinda
ne biliyorsun?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Not a great deal, actually. He turned up
about a month ago - no one knows from
where.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aslinda pek bir sey degil. Yaklasik bir ay
once ortaya cikti-nereden geldigini
kimse bilmiyor.

original:
<T>Started whipping up a storm in town, turning
tourists into horses and such. He's
obviously seeking attention.
translation:
<T>Sehirde ortaligi karistirmaya basladi;
turistleri ata falan ceviriyor. Belli ki
ilgi pesinde.

original:
<T>How he performs these tricks? Well...<W>
Nobody knows. Some say it's magic.
translation:
<T>Bu numaralari nasil yapiyor? Sey...<W>
Kimse bilmiyor. Bazilari bunun buyu
oldugunu soyluyor.

original:
<T>And that's all I know.<W> But if you're doing an
investigation, I do have something that may
sharpen your reasoning skills.
translation:
<T>Bildigim bu kadar.<W> Ama bir sorusturma
yapiyorsaniz, akil yurutme becerilerinizi
keskinlestirecek bir seyim var.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Who knows? It might even help your fashion
sense, young man.
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Kim bilir? Belki giyim
tarzina bile katkisi olur, delikanli.

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original: <T><M3/3/1>What is it?
translation: <T><M3/3/1>Nedir o?

original:
<T>It's called the One-Stop Shop. Just a little
puzzle game I made on a quiet day.
translation:
<T>Adi One-Stop Shop. Sakin bir gunde
yaptigim kucuk bir bulmaca oyunu.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>It's easy once you get the hang of it. Just
have a play around. You might learn
something about shopkeeping too!
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Puf noktasini kapinca kolay. Biraz
kurcala, dene. Belki dukkan isletmek hakkinda
da bir seyler ogrenirsin!

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Wow, this looks like a lot of fun! Thank you
very much!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Vay, bu cok eglenceli gorunuyor! Cok
tesekkur ederim!

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>Ludmilla has given you her handcrafted toy
shop: the One-Stop Shop!
translation:
<T>Ludmilla sana el yapimi
oyuncak dukkani One-Stop Shop'u verdi!

original:
<T>The Shop minigame has been added to the
trunk.
translation:
<T>Dukkan mini oyunu
valize eklendi.

original:
<T>Appeal to your customers' shopping impulse
to sell every item in your inventory!
translation:
<T>Musterilerinin alisveris durtusune hitap ederek
envanterindeki her urunu sat!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Give it a try! There are all sorts of things to
sell.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bir dene! Satacak
her turden sey var.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>If you manage to sell every item in every
aisle, come back and see me.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Her reyondaki tum
urunleri satmayi basarirsan, geri gel de beni gor.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>I'll have a little something specially prepared
for you. <W>Don't forget!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Senin icin ozel olarak
kucuk bir sey hazirlayacagim. <W>Unutma!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Okay! I'll come and visit when I've finished
them all.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Tamam! Hepsini
bitirince ugrayacagim.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Now, I made that toy myself, so don't go
dropping it in a puddle or anything!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>O oyuncagi ben yaptim, o yuzden
gidip de su birikintisine dusurme falan!

original: <T><M3/1/1>Of course! I'll take good care of it!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Elbette! Ona iyi
bakacagim!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Well, it seems that we've gathered all the
information we can. Let's head to the hotel.
translation:
<T>Gorunuse gore elde edebilecegimiz tum
bilgileri topladik. Hadi otele gidelim.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I believe all we have to do is keep going up
this street, and it's just round the corner.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Sanirim tek yapmamiz gereken bu
caddeden yukari devam etmek; hemen koseyi donunce.

original: ジャグラー
translation: ジャグラー

original:
<T>La dee da, de dum, de doo.<W> De dum de
doo, diddly dum dee doo, dee dum...
translation:
<T>La dee da, de dum, de doo.<W> De dum de
doo, diddly dum dee doo, dee dum...

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original: <T><M5/1/1>Look, Professor. A clown!
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Bakin, Profesor. Bir palyaco!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/80>Ahh, let me guess. First time in Monte d'Or,
right? <W>Hullo! I'm Juggles, your friendly
neighbourhood clown. And you are...?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/80>Ahh, tahmin edeyim. Monte d'Or'a ilk kez
geliyorsunuz, degil mi? <W>Merhaba! Ben Juggles, mahallenizin
sevimli palyacosu. Peki ya siz...?

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hershel Layton. I teach archaeology at
Gressenheller University.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hershel Layton. Gressenheller Universitesi'nde
arkeoloji dersleri veriyorum.

original: <T><M2/1/1>And he's a famous puzzle solver, too!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Hem o meshur bir bilmece cozucudur!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh, that's just lovely! And that hat looks
superb on you, I must say.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ah, ne hos! Sunu da soylemeliyim ki o sapka
size harika yakismis.

original:
<T>Speaking of hats, I'm sure I have a puzzle
stashed somewhere in mine...<W> Aha! Here
you go. My gift to you!
translation:
<T>Sapkalardan bahsetmisken, benimkinin icinde de
bir bilmece sakli olmali...<W> Aha! Buyurun.
Size hediyem!

original:
<T><M2/3/1>Oh. <W30>Um. <W30>I take it you didn't like that one,
then.
translation: <T><M2/3/1>Ah. <W30>Sey. <W30>Demek ki onu pek begenmediniz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Please, could you not, maybe...just take my
puzzle anyway? It's nothing special, really...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Lutfen, sey... bilmeceyi yine de alir misiniz?
Pek ozel bir sey degil aslinda...

original:
<T>Wow! Smashing! Your young friend wasn't
joking, was he?<W> Hey, here's a bit of local
knowledge for you.
translation:
<T>Vay! Harika! Genc arkadasin saka yapmiyormus,
degil mi?<W> Hey, size biraz yerel bilgi vereyim.

original:
<T>See that big stone slab? That's our famous
monument. The whole history of Monte d'Or
is written on it! <W30>Fab spot for photos, too!
translation:
<T>Su buyuk tas levhayi goruyor musunuz?
Bizim meshur anitimizdir. Monte d'Or'un tum
tarihi uzerinde yazili! <W30>Fotograf icin de sahane bir yer!

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Ah yes, it's mentioned in the guidebook. It
says it commemorates the city's founding.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Ah evet, rehber kitapta bahsediliyor.
Sehrin kurulusunu anmak icin dikildigi yaziyor.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/20>That's the one! And there are plenty more
tourist sights on offer here!<W> Speaking of
which, did you enjoy the parade?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/20>Aynen o! Burada daha pek cok turistik yer var!<W> Bu arada,
gecit toreni hosunuza gitti mi?

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Yes, we did. We had quite an exhausting
time, in fact. We're about to retire to bed.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Evet, gitti. Aslinda epey yorulduk.
Simdi yatmaya cekilecegiz.

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Oh.<W> Oh!<W> Well! If you're looking for hotels,
look no more! Closest to here is the
Camel's Hump. Brilliant service.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Ah.<W> Ah!<W> Sey! Otel ariyorsaniz, daha fazla aramayin!
Buraya en yakin yer Camel's Hump.
Hizmeti mukemmel.

original:
<T>Just head down this road on the left here
and it'll be on your right. You'll be there
in no time.
translation:
<T>Su soldaki yoldan asagi inin, saginizda kalir.
Hemen varirsiniz.

original:
<T>We're not too far from there either. Oh, by
{''}we{''} I mean {''}the Stellar Circus{''}. We're a
travelling troupe, you see.
translation:
<T>Biz de oradan cok uzakta degiliz. Hani
{''}biz{''} derken {''}Stellar Sirki{''}ni kastediyorum.
Gezgin bir topluluguz, bilirsiniz.

original:
<T>Pop over and see us if you get the chance.
We're not moving any time soon!
translation:
<T>Firsat bulursaniz ugrayip bizi izleyin.
Yakin zamanda bir yere gitmiyoruz!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You ever have dreams where you go to
school wearing normal-sized shoes?<W>
Terrifying.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hic ruyanda okula normal boy ayakkabilarla
gittigini gordun mu?<W>
Dehset verici.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M6/1/1>Just look at this place!
translation: <T><M6/1/1>Suraya bir bakin!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Well, Professor, it looks like Mrs Ledore is
putting us up in style!
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Profesor, gorunuse gore Bayan Ledore bizi
oldukca sik bir yerde agirliyor!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Ha ha. I don't think I've ever stayed in
quite such...exotic accommodation before.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Ha ha. Sanirim daha once hic
boylesine... egzotik bir yerde kalmadim.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I suppose a city that lives on tourism must
have its fair share of fancy hotels.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Turizmle yasayan bir sehrin,
bolca gosterisli oteli olmali.

original:
<T><M7/1/1>I can smell the roast lamb from out here!
Oh, let's go in, Professor!
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Kuzu kizartmasinin kokusu buradan bile geliyor!
Hadi iceri girelim, Profesor!

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>All right then, let's...<W> What's going on here?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Pekala, hadi...<W> Burada neler oluyor?

original: ダンチョー
translation: ダンチョー

original:
<T><M3/1/2>All right, I've had it up to here! I don't know
why I wasted my time over you... Good for
nothing balls of fluff!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Tamam, artik yeter! Sizinle
niye ugrastim ki... Hicbir ise yaramaz
tuy yumagi herifler!

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original: <T>Aww, look how cute these bunnies are!
translation: <T>Aaa, su tavsanlar ne kadar sevimli!

original:
<T><M1/1/3>Cute? You find these snivelling little furballs
cute?! Ha! <M2/1/3>I've never seen an animal more
pathetic than these two!
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Sevimli mi? Su sizlanan kucuk tuy
yumaklarini sevimli mi buluyorsun?! Ha! <M2/1/3>Bu ikisinden daha acinasi hayvan
hic gormedim!

original:
<T><M3/1/3>I've a mind to cast these rabbits out of the
troupe for good!
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>Bu tavsanlari
topluluktan temelli kovasim var!

original: <T><M1/2/3>Cast them out?!<W> Why would you do that?
translation: <T><M1/2/3>Kovmak mi?!<W> Bunu neden yapasiniz ki?

original:
<T><M3/1/3>Simple - if these old rabbits can't learn new
tricks, they're no good in my circus! They're
an utter waste of time and resources.
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>Basit-bu yasli tavsanlar yeni
numaralar ogrenemiyorsa sirkimde ise yaramazlar!
Zaman ve kaynak israfindan baska bir sey degiller.

original:
<T>But that's horrid... <W><M4/1/3>I know! What if I took
one and taught him some tricks for you?
translation:
<T>Ama bu korkunc... <W><M4/1/3>Buldum! Ya birini alip
ona sizin icin birkac numara ogretirsem?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You?<W> A mere child thinks he can train one
of these stagnant, hopeless beasts where I,
the ringmaster, have failed?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sen mi?<W> Siradan bir cocuk, benim,
sirk mudurunun bile basaramadigi su durgun, umutsuz
hayvanlardan birini egitebilecegini mi saniyor?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I'm not a mere child! I can understand what
they're saying!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ben siradan bir cocuk degilim! Onlarin ne
dedigini anlayabiliyorum!

original:
<T>They say they don't want to leave all their
friends in the circus. <W>They say they'll work
very hard from now on!
translation:
<T>Sirkten butun arkadaslarini
birakip gitmek istemediklerini soyluyorlar. <W>Onlar bundan sonra
cok siki calisacaklarini soyluyorlar!

original:
<T>And they say they're sorry... <W>Don't they?<W>
Yes, they do. <M4/1/2>Please give them another
chance!
translation:
<T>Bir de ozur dilediklerini soyluyorlar... <W>Degil mi?<W>
Evet, oyle. <M4/1/2>Lutfen onlara bir
sans daha verin!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmm... Well, the rabbit show is a circus
favourite. If it can still be salvaged...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmm... Tavsan gosterisi
sirkimizin gozdesi. Eger hala kurtarilabilecekse...

original:
<T>Fine. Take one of these floppy critters and
get it to master the dramatic arts. If you
can manage that, they can both stay.
translation:
<T>Peki. Su sarkik kulakli yaratiklardan birini al
da sahne sanatlarinda ustalastir. Eger bunu
basarirsan ikisi de kalabilir.

original: <T><M1/1/3>You've got one week!
translation: <T><M1/1/3>Bir haftan var!

original:
<T><M3/1/3>But if its acting is wishy-washy or it starts
nibbling on the set mid-show, they're both
out, out, out! Got it?
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>Ama oyunculugu yavan olursa ya da
gosteri sirasinda dekoru kemirmeye baslarsa, ikisi de
gider, gider, gider! Anladin mi?

original:
<T><M5/1/3>Yes, sir! Don't worry. I'll train your rabbit to
become a splendid actor!
translation:
<T><M5/1/3>Evet, efendim! Merak etmeyin. Tavsaninizi
muhtesem bir oyuncu olmasi icin egitecegim!

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>You received an adorable rabbit from the
ringmaster of the Stellar Circus!
translation:
<T>Stellar Sirki'nin
sirk mudurunden sevimli bir tavsan aldin!

original:
<T>The Rabbit Show minigame has been added
to the trunk.
translation:
<T>Tavsan Gosterisi mini oyunu
valize eklendi.

original:
<T>Befriend your rabbit and teach it some new
tricks to perform in the rabbit show.
translation:
<T>Tavsaninla arkadas ol ve tavsan gosterisinde sergilemesi icin
yeni numaralar ogret.

original: <T>Hmph. I see you've gone for the brown one.
translation: <T>Hih. Kahverengi olani secmissin.

original: 茶ウサルーク
translation: 茶ウサルーク

original: <T>Yes. I'm naming him <N/1>!
translation: <T>Evet. Adini <N/1> koyuyorum!

original:
<T>Well then, it's all yours. If it's really got
what it takes, we'll gladly take it back into
the circus. And the other one, too.
translation:
<T>Oyleyse, artik senin. Eger gercekten
icinde o potansiyel varsa, onu memnuniyetle
yeniden sirke aliriz. Otekini de.

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T><M2/1/1>A sweet little fellow, isn't he? Just remember
to bring him back to the circus once you've
trained him up.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Tatli kucuk bir sey, degil mi? Sadece
onu egittikten sonra sirke geri getirmeyi
unutma.

original:
<T>Of course! I'm going to turn
<N/1> into a great actor!
translation:
<T>Elbette! 
<N/1>'i harika bir oyuncuya
donusturecegim!

original: ウサギ
translation: Tavsan

original: <T><SEQ{''}brown{''}>Snuff, snuff!
translation: <T><SEQ{''}brown{''}>Snif, snif!

original: <T>What's wrong, <N/1>?
translation: <T>Ne oldu, <N/1>?

original:
<T>Is <N/1> trying to tell us
something?
translation:
<T><N/1> bize
bir sey mi anlatmaya calisiyor?

original: <T><SEQ{''}brown{''}>Snuff!
translation: <T><SEQ{''}brown{''}>Snif!

original:
<T><M1/1/1><N/1> says he won't let us
down!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1><N/1>, bizi
yari yolda birakmayacagini soyluyor!

original:
<T>Aww, don't worry your fuzzy head. We'll get
you back into the circus!
translation:
<T>Aaa, o tuylu kafani dert etme. Seni
yeniden sirke sokacagiz!

original: <T>Now, perhaps we should go into the hotel.
translation: <T>Simdi, belki de otele girmeliyiz.

original: <T>Hmph. I see you've gone for the white one.
translation: <T>Hih. Beyaz olani secmissin.

original: 白ウサルーク
translation: 白ウサルーク

original: <T><SEQ{''}white{''}>Snuff, snuff!
translation: <T><SEQ{''}white{''}>Snif, snif!

original: <T><SEQ{''}white{''}>Snuff!
translation: <T><SEQ{''}white{''}>Snif!

original:
<T><M1/1/3>As my dear mama always used to say, {''}If
the rabbit can't learn, the rabbit can't earn!{''}
<M3/1/3>Good luck, boy!
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Sevgili annem hep derdi ki, {''}Tavsan
ogrenemezse, tavsan kazanamaz!{''}
<M3/1/3>Bol sans, oglum!

original: ユーミン
translation: Yuming

original:
<T>I'm Yuming - lovely to meet you. I just
wanted to share with someone how pleased
I am with this hotel!
translation:
<T>Ben Yuming - tanistigimiza sevindim. Sadece
bu otelden ne kadar memnun oldugumu biriyle
paylasmak istedim!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Isn't it marvellous? The service is great and
it's a stone's throw from the high street and
all its shops!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Harika degil mi? Hizmet muthis ve
ana caddeye ve tum magazalara
tas atimi mesafede!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>The only qualm I have with it is the name.
I mean, come on, the Camel's Hump hotel?
It's not very appealing, is it?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Tek sikayetim adi. Yani, hadi ama, Deve Kamburu Oteli mi?
Pek de cekici degil,
oyle degil mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Actually, miss, I'm rather fond of the name.
translation: <T>Aslinda hanimefendi, ben bu adi oldukca seviyorum.

original:
<T><M1/2/3>Really? Well, to each their own!<W> Though
I have heard this establishment has <M1/2/1>nothing
on Monte d'Or's top hotel.
translation:
<T><M1/2/3>Gercekten mi? Eh, zevkler ve renkler!<W> Ama
bu yerin <M1/2/1>hicbir
sekilde Monte d'Or'un en iyi oteline yaklasamadigini duydum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You should definitely take the time to see it
while you're here.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Buradayken onu gormeye kesinlikle
zaman ayirmalisin.

original: <T><M3/1/1>We may just do that, if we have time.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Vaktimiz olursa, yapabiliriz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I'm not sure how long I should stay here this
time. A week might be good. Yes.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bu sefer burada ne kadar kalmaliyim emin degilim.
Bir hafta iyi olabilir. Evet.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Let's enquire at the front desk. With any
luck, they're already expecting us.
translation:
<T>Resepsiyona soralim. Sansimiz
yaver giderse bizi coktan bekliyorlardir.

original: バスカル
translation: バスカル

original:
<T>Welcome, welcome! Do you have a
reservation?
translation:
<T>Hos geldiniz, hos geldiniz! Rezervasyonunuz
var mi?

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T>Yes, I believe so. Is there anything reserved
for one Hershel Layton?
translation:
<T>Evet, sanirim var. Hershel Layton adina
ayrilmis bir sey var mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ah, yes. Mrs Ledore informed us of your
arrival. We would like to welcome you as her
special guests.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ah, evet. Bayan Ledore gelisinizden bizi
haberdar etti. Sizi onun ozel misafirleri olarak
agirlamak isteriz.

original:
<T>One moment, please, while I find your
keys...
translation: <T>Anahtarlarinizi bulurken bir saniye lutfen...

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Do you suppose this place is owned by
the Ledores?
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Sizce burasi Ledore'lara mi ait?

original:
<T>It's quite likely. Everything in this hotel is in
its own neat little place. That's very like
Henry.
translation:
<T>Buyuk ihtimalle. Bu otelde her sey kendi
duzenli yerinde. Bu, Henry'e cok benziyor.

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Professor, how well do you know
Mr Ledore? What's he like?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Profesor, Bay Ledore'u ne kadar iyi
taniyorsunuz? Nasil biridir?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I remember him as a thoughtful boy, very
quiet and hard-working.<W> I never really talked
to him, though.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Onu dusunceli bir cocuk olarak hatirliyorum;
cok sessiz ve caliskandi.<W> Ama onunla pek
konusmuslugum yok.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/60>We both lived in the same village, but he
was just a friend of a friend. I never got to
know him very well.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/60>Ikimiz de ayni koyde yasardik ama o sadece
bir arkadasin arkadasiydi. Onu pek iyi
taniyamadim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>But you knew Angela quite well, didn't you,
Professor?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ama Angela'yi oldukca iyi taniyordunuz,
degil mi Profesor?

original:
<T>I'm so sorry to keep you waiting. If you
could just sign here and here...
translation:
<T>Sizi beklettigim icin cok ozur dilerim. Suraya
ve suraya imza atarsaniz...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Perfect! I have a couple of lovely rooms for
you. Here are your keys. And here is your
complimentary puzzle.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Mukemmel! Sizin icin iki guzel odam var.
Anahtarlariniz burada. Ve iste ucretsiz
bilmeceniz.

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Oh! What excellent service!
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Ah! Ne harika hizmet!

original:
<T><M3/2/2>I'm terribly sorry that the puzzle was not to
your liking, sir. Let me take that away for
you.
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Bilmecenin hosunuza gitmemesine cok uzuldum
efendim. Izin verin onu sizden alayim.

original:
<T>Here is your proof of reservation and, of
course, your complimentary puzzle, should
you wish to undertake it again.
translation:
<T>Iste rezervasyon belgeniz ve elbette,
tekrar denemek isterseniz ucretsiz bilmeceniz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Excellent work, sir. You are in room 502,
and the young lady is upstairs in 602. Do
tell me if there's anything you need.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Harika is, efendim. Siz 502 numarali odadasiniz,
genc hanim ise ust katta 602'de. Bir seye
ihtiyaciniz olursa lutfen soyleyin.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Thank you very much indeed.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Cok tesekkur ederim.

original:
<T><M4/2/3>I wonder if he just dishes out the same
puzzle to everyone who stays here...
translation:
<T><M4/2/3>Acaba burada kalan herkese ayni bilmeceyi mi
veriyor...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We are proud to offer convenient access
to the city centre and all the tourist
attractions here.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sehir merkezine ve tum turistik yerlere
kolay erisim sunmaktan gurur duyuyoruz.

original:
<T>You can drop in here to freshen up at any
time of day.
translation: <T>Gunun her saatinde ugrayip tazelenebilirsiniz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Hmm... That shack looks awfully familiar.
translation: <T>Hmm... Su kulube fazlasiyla tanidik geliyor.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/2>Yes...I know what you mean!
translation: <T><M3/1/2>Evet...Ne demek istedigini anliyorum!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M4/2/3>Ah, so it wasn't just d{'e}j{`a} vu? This is going
to bother me all day, now!
translation:
<T><M4/2/3>Ah, yani sadece d{'e}j{'a} vu degildi? Bu
artik butun gun aklimi kurcalayacak!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>It looks rather out of place in this hotel.
I wonder if it's a feature?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Bu otelde biraz yersiz duruyor.
Acaba bilerek mi yapilmis?

original:
<T>That shack is rather large for a conversation
piece. I wonder if anyone actually uses it...
translation:
<T>Su kulube, sohbet konusu olacak kadar
buyuk. Acaba gercekten kullanan var mi...

original: ユーミン
translation: Yumin

original:
<T>Excuse me, the gentleman in the hat? Could
you please come here for a moment?
translation:
<T>Affedersiniz, sapkali beyefendi? Bir
dakikaligina buraya gelir misiniz?

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
<T>Now this is fancy! It's on a whole different
level from Misthallery, isn't it?
translation:
<T>Vay canina, burasi cok sik! Misthallery'den
bambaska bir seviye, degil mi?

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
<T><M4/1/1>This bed is so soft! I could fall asleep on it
right now.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bu yatak cok yumusak! Su anda ustunde
uyuyakalabilirim.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>We've barely arrived and I'm already
exhausted. I don't know if I can keep up
with this city.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Daha yeni geldik ve ben simdiden
yoruldum. Bu sehre ayak uydurabilir miyim
bilmiyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Come on, Luke! We've only just started our
investigation. Don't tell me you're burnt out
after one little miracle.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Hadi ama, Luke! Daha sorusturmaya yeni
basladik. Bir kucuk mucizeyle tukendigini
soyleme sakin.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>No... But what if the mask really does have
magical powers, as the Masked Gentleman
said? What do we do then?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Hayir... Ama ya maske gercekten de Maskeli
Beyefendi'nin dedigi gibi sihirli guclere
sahipse? O zaman ne yapariz?

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>We can't say for certain one way or the
other. Let's not jump to any conclusions.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Kesin olarak ne oyle ne boyle diyebiliriz.
Hemen sonuca atlamayalim.

original:
<T>But Mr Ledore was powerful enough to build
a city after finding the mask. Perhaps it also
has the power to turn people to stone...
translation:
<T>Ama Bay Ledore, maskeyi bulduktan sonra bir
sehir kuracak kadar guclendi. Belki de insanlari
tasa cevirme gucu de vardir...

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>Surely not. Those are two different things.
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Sanmiyorum. Bunlar iki farkli sey.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But it must have some sort of power, right?
Why else would someone steal it?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama bir tur gucu olmali, degil mi?
Yoksa biri neden calsin?

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Perhaps, Luke. But I rather think that
there is something more to this Masked
Gentleman case.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Belki, Luke. Ama bence bu Maskeli
Beyefendi vakasinda bundan daha fazlasi var.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>I doubt that we're even dealing with the true
Mask of Chaos. <W>After all, I saw that mask
fall into a chasm years ago.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Zaten gercek Kaos Maskesi'yle ugrastigimizdan
bile supheliyim. <W>Sonucta o maskenin yillar once
bir ucuruma dustugunu gordum.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Oh. I hadn't even thought of that.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Ah. Bunu hic dusunmemistim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I've been wanting to ask you, Professor.
What was Randall like? You and Angela
seemed to know him very well.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Size sormak istiyordum, Profesor.
Randall nasil biriydi? Siz ve Angela onu
cok iyi taniyor gibiydiniz.

original: <T><M3/2/1>Yes, please tell us!
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Evet, lutfen anlatin!

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>About...Randall?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Randall hakkinda... mi?

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Absolutely! This mystery could have
something to do with your past. You never
know!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Kesinlikle! Bu gizem gecmisinizle ilgili
olabilir. Belli mi olur!

original: <T><M1/1/3/45>It might be important! Please, Professor?
translation: <T><M1/1/3/45>Onemli olabilir! Lutfen, Profesor?

original: <T>I suppose...<W>you may be right. <W><M3/2/1/45>Very well.
translation: <T>Sanirim...<W>hakli olabilirsiniz. <W><M3/2/1/45>Peki.

original: <T>It would be about 18 years ago.
translation: <T>Yaklasik 18 yil onceydi.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Randall, Angela, Henry and I all used to live
in a small place called Stansbury, just
beyond the desert.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Randall, Angela, Henry ve ben, colun hemen
otesindeki Stansbury adli kucuk bir yerde
yasardik.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>It was a quiet little village, the kind where
everybody knows everyone else.<W> Randall
was my best friend.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Herkesin herkesi tanidigi turden sakin,
kucuk bir koydu.<W> Randall en iyi arkadasimdi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>He'd tell me about all his hobbies, drag me
along on all his adventures. If not for him,
I wouldn't even be an archaeologist.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Bana tum hobilerinden bahseder, beni her
maceralarina suruklerdi. O olmasaydi,
ben arkeolog bile olmazdim.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>It's true. Although I study it fervently today,
I had little interest in the field of
archaeology back then.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Dogru. Bugun tutkuyla calissam da,
o zamanlar arkeoloji alanina pek ilgim
yoktu.

original:
<T><M3/2/5>What?! I can't imagine you like that,
Professor!
translation:
<T><M3/2/5>Ne?! Sizi oyle hayal edemiyorum,
Profesor!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<V0010>That night we just listened to the professor.
It broke my heart to hear him recount how
he had lost his best friend.</V>
translation:
<V0010>O gece sadece profesoru dinledik.
En yakin arkadasini nasil kaybettigini anlatisini
duymak kalbimi parcaladi.</V>

original:
<V0020>But hidden in his story was a clue that
would prove essential to solving the
case of the Masked Gentleman.</V>
translation:
<V0020>Ama hikayesinin icinde gizli bir ipucu vardi;
bu ipucu, Maskeli Beyefendi
vakasini cozmek icin hayati olacakti.</V>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<V0010><T>The first I heard of the Mask of Chaos...
It must have been about 18 years ago.</V>
translation:
<V0010><T>Kaos Maskesi'ni ilk kez duydugumda...
Sanirim yaklasik 18 yil onceydi.</V>

original: ヤングヤングランド
translation: Young Young Land

original:
エルシャール、俺の勝ちだ。
今日はたっぷりと話に付き合ってもらうぞ。
translation:
Hershel, ben kazandim.
Bugun benimle uzun uzun sohbet edeceksin.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
…ランド、悪いけど、
僕は考古学には興味がないんだ…。
translation:
...Randall, kusura bakma ama,
arkeolojiyle ilgilenmiyorum...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
まあ、そう言うなって。
親友には理解してもらいたいんだよ。
translation:
Ama oyle deme.
En iyi dostumun beni anlamasini isterim.

original: 遺跡探検だって？
translation: Harabe kesfi mi?

original:
ああ。絶対に君も気にいるさ。
君に考古学のすばらしさを伝えたいんだ。
translation:
Evet. Eminim sen de bayilacaksin.
Sana arkeolojinin ne kadar harika oldugunu gostermek istiyorum.

original:
考古学には無限の可能性がある。
考古学を学べば、人類のルーツですらも
わかるかもしれない。
translation:
Arkeolojinin sonsuz bir potansiyeli var.
Arkeolojiyi ogrenirsek, insanligin kokenlerini bile
kesfedebiliriz.

original: こんなにすばらしい学問は他にはない！
translation: Boylesine harika bir bilim dali baska yok!

original: だからって、ランド…。
translation: Yine de, Randall...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<V0010><T>This time will be different, Hershel. <L1.65>You
won't regret it. I swear!</V>
translation:
<V0010><T>Bu sefer farkli olacak, Hershel. <L1.65>Pisman
olmayacaksin. Yemin ederim!</V>

original: <V0020><T><M4/1/1>I've got a good feeling about this!</V>
translation: <V0020><T><M4/1/1>Bu konuda icimde iyi bir his var!</V>

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<V0030><T><M3/2/1>I've heard that one before, Randall. <L2.0>I don't
have time to go on another one of these
silly expeditions of yours.</V>
translation:
<V0030><T><M3/2/1>Bunu daha once de duydum, Randall. <L2.0>Benim
bu sacma seferlerinden bir yenisine
vakit ayiracak zamanim yok.</V>

original:
<V0040><T><M2/1/1>I'm telling you this is different, Hershel! <L2.25>It
isn't some silly adventure! <L4.4>I think I might be
on to something big this time!</V>
translation:
<V0040><T><M2/1/1>Sana soyluyorum, bu sefer farkli, Hershel! <L2.25>Bu
oyle sacma bir macera degil! <L4.4>Bu sefer
cok buyuk bir seyin pesinde olabilirim!</V>

original: <V0050><T>Oh, really? <L1.65>Do tell.</V>
translation: <V0050><T>Oyle mi? <L1.65>Anlat bakalim.</V>

original:
<V0060><T><M4/2/1>Something priceless! <L1.7>Something
indescribable! <L3.5>Something beyond your
wildest dreams, Hershel!</V>
translation:
<V0060><T><M4/2/1>Paha bicilemez bir sey! <L1.7>Tarifsiz bir
sey! <L3.5>En cilgin hayallerinin bile
otesinde bir sey, Hershel!</V>

original: コリー
translation: Collins

original:
<V0070><T>All right, class. You've proven your legs
work. <L2.65>Now please exercise your backsides
and be seated.</V>
translation:
<V0070><T>Peki, sinif. Bacaklarinizin calistigini
kanitladiniz. <L2.65>Simdi lutfen popolarinizi da
calistirin ve oturun.</V>

original:
<V0080><T>Just meet me tonight. <L1.55>Soon our names will
be in all the papers. <L4.0>You'll be the famous
scholar Hershel Layton!</V>
translation:
<V0080><T>Bu gece benimle bulus yeter. <L1.55>Yakinda adimiz
her gazetede olacak. <L4.0>Sen unlu bilgin
Hershel Layton olacaksin!</V>

original: コリー
translation: Collins

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Now that you're all seated, kindly open your
books to page 13.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Herkes yerine oturduguna gore, lutfen
kitaplarinizi 13. sayfadan acin.

original:
<T>Today we'll be talking about Donald
Rutledge and his groundbreaking work,
{''}Ancient Histories{''}.
translation:
<T>Bugun Donald
Rutledge ve cigir acan eseri,
{''}Ancient Histories{''} hakkinda konusacagiz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Now, Rutledge investigated a number of
noteworthy archaeological sites, looking for
similarities between them.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Simdi, Rutledge bir dizi
dikkate deger arkeolojik alani inceleyerek
aralarindaki benzerlikleri aradi.

original:
<T>He identified the linking factor, the common
denominator, the universal, ubiquitous
name: {''}Azran{''}.
translation:
<T>Baglanti unsurunu, ortak
paydayi, her yerde rastlanan evrensel
adi belirledi: {''}Azran{''}.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Years later, we've barely scratched the
surface of all there is to know about the
Azran civilisation and their time.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Yillar sonra bile, Azran uygarligi ve
onlarin donemi hakkinda bilinebileceklerin
sadece yuzeyini kaziyabildik.

original:
<T>But the discovery of the Azran was a huge
breakthrough for archaeology, initiating
unprecedented research in the field.
translation:
<T>Yine de Azran'in kesfi, arkeoloji icin buyuk bir
atilimdi ve alanda
esi benzeri gorulmemis arastirmalari baslatti.

original:
<T>We have here some incomplete records of
an excavation from the boom period. <M2/1/1>Let's
see... Layton, can you help fill in the gaps?
translation:
<T>Burada, o donemin kazilarindan
kalma bazi eksik kayitlar var. <M2/1/1>Hadi
bakalim... Layton, bosluklari doldurmama yardim eder misin?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M4/1/1>Of course, sir.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Elbette, efendim.

original:
<T>This isn't like you, Layton. Daydreaming,
were we?
translation:
<T>Bu sana gore degil, Layton. Hayal
kuruyordun, degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Now have another look and try to get it right
this time.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Simdi bir kez daha bak ve bu sefer dogru
yapmaya calis.

original: [Not used]
translation: [Kullanilmiyor]

original: コリー
translation: Collins

original: <T><M1/2/1>Hmph. Yes, quite. Good work, Layton.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Hih. Evet, elbette. Iyi is, Layton.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Thank you, sir.
translation: <T>Tesekkur ederim, efendim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Right then. Let's move on to page 14.<W>
Rutledge's most famous discovery was the
ancient stone circle of Pleynoth.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Peki o halde. 14. sayfaya gecelim.<W>
Rutledge'in en unlu kesfi,
Pleynoth'un antik tas cemberiydi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Early theories held that Pleynoth was a
primitive holy site, but the finding of some
intricate artefacts disproved that.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ilk teoriler Pleynoth'un ilkel bir kutsal alan
oldugunu one suruyordu, ancak bazi
karmasik eserlerin bulunmasi bunu curuttu.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>These artefacts were the basis for a
fascinating comparative study by the
palaeontologist Doris Pompitous.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bu eserler, paleontolog Doris Pompitous'un
yuruttugu buyuleyici bir karsilastirmali
calismanin temelini olusturdu.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Based on a wide range of evidence from
different fields, Pompitous came up with
radically new ideas about this civilisation.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Farkli alanlardan gelen genis bir kanit
yelpazesine dayanarak Pompitous, bu
medeniyet hakkinda kokten yeni fikirler ortaya atti.

original:
<T>She theorised that they were scientifically
advanced and had a language as evolved as
our own.
translation:
<T>Onlarin bilimsel olarak ileri duzeyde
oldugunu ve bizimki kadar gelismis bir dile
sahip olduklarini one surdu.

original:
<T>Furthermore, through extensive fossil
analysis, she proved that Earth once had
a completely different ecosystem.
translation:
<T>Ayrica kapsamli fosil analizleriyle, Dunya'nin
bir zamanlar tamamen farkli bir ekosisteme
sahip oldugunu kanitladi.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Now then, here is a problem related to
fossils. Would anyone like to give it a shot?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Peki, simdi fosillerle ilgili bir problem var.
Denemek isteyen var mi?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T><M2/2/1>Sir! Let me do it! Let me!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Efendim! Ben yapayim! Ben!

original: <T><M2/1/1>Ascot? All right, then.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ascot mu? Peki oyleyse.

original:
<T>If you find this sort of thing difficult, Ascot,
I'd advise you to think before you speak
next time.
translation:
<T>Boyle seyleri zor buluyorsan, Ascot,
bir dahaki sefer konusmadan once dusunmeni
tavsiye ederim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmph. Well, I suppose you'd better try
again.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Hih. Pekala, sanirim tekrar denemelisin.

original: [Not used]
translation: [Kullanilmiyor]

original: コリー
translation: Collins

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Well demonstrated. I see you've done your
homework on this topic.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Guzelce gosterdin. Bu konuda odevini
yaptigini goruyorum.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T><M4/2/1>What? This is basic stuff, sir!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Ne? Bu en temel seyler, efendim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmph. Next page. This will be in your test
next week, so make sure you take notes.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hih. Sonraki sayfa. Bu, gelecek haftaki
sinavinizda olacak; not aldiginizdan emin olun.

original:
<T>Our forefathers built many ancient edifices
here in England, of which we've found but
the merest handful.
translation:
<T>Atalarimiz burada, Ingiltere'de pek cok antik
yapi insa etti; fakat biz bunlarin ancak
cok kucuk bir kismini bulabildik.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Most of them were undoubtedly lost in the
passage of history, but their legacy remains
in various forms.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Cogu suphesiz tarihin akisi icinde kayboldu,
amma miraslari cesitli bicimlerde
yasamaya devam ediyor.

original: <T>Sir! Sir!
translation: <T>Efendim! Efendim!

original:
<T>You have a question, Ascot? Go on, then,
out with it.
translation: <T>Bir sorun mu var, Ascot? Hadi, soyle bakalim.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Sir, have you heard of the Mask of Chaos?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Efendim, Kaos Maskesi'ni duydunuz mu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Are you being impudent, Ascot? Of course
I've heard of it.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Saygisizlik mi ediyorsun, Ascot? Elbette
duydum.

original:
<T>The Mask of Chaos is a mythical treasure
documented by Donald Rutledge.
translation:
<T>Kaos Maskesi, Donald Rutledge tarafindan
belgelenmis efsanevi bir hazinedir.

original: <T><M3/2/1>What's your opinion, sir? Does it exist?
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Siz ne dusunuyorsunuz, efendim? Gercekten var mi?

original:
<T>I find it hard to believe that such a legendary
object could lie undiscovered for so long.
translation:
<T>Boylesine efsanevi bir nesnenin bu kadar
uzun sure kesfedilmeden kalabilecegine
inanmakta zorlaniyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>If I thought such things could still be found,
I would not be teaching at this school, but
out digging for treasure!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Eger boyle seylerin hala bulunabilecegine
inansaydim, bu okulda ders vermez; disarida
hazine kazardim!

original:
<T>Even if its existence could be proven, it
would be quite impossible to find, and you
know it.
translation:
<T>Var oldugu kanitlansa bile, onu bulmak
tamamen imkansiz olurdu; sen de bunu
biliyorsun.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>So I'd appreciate it if you'd stop wasting
lesson time with irrelevant questions, Ascot.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu yuzden ders vaktini alakasiz sorularla
harcamayi birakmani rica ederim, Ascot.

original: <T><M1/2/4>Right. Sorry, sir.
translation: <T><M1/2/4>Peki. Ozur dilerim, efendim.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><K>...</K><W30>Randall apologising? That's a first!
translation: <T><K>...</K><W30>Randall ozur diliyor mu? Ilk kez goruyorum!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmph. Since you're so keen, Ascot, you
can solve the next problem too.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hih. Madem bu kadar heveslisin, Ascot,
sonraki problemi de sen cozebilirsin.

original: <T><M2/1/3>Gah! How come I'm struggling with this?!
translation: <T><M2/1/3>Ah! Bununla nasil boyle zorlaniyorum?!

original: <T><M4/2/1>This time, I'll definitely get it!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Bu sefer kesin yapacagim!

original: コリー
translation: Collins

original:
<T>All right, students, that's it for today. You
may tidy up your desks and go.
translation:
<T>Peki, ogrenciler, bugunluk bu kadar. Masalarinizi
toparlayip gidebilirsiniz.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Wow, today's class just flew by. Old Collins
may be grumpy, but his lessons are
blooming fantastic.
translation:
<T>Vay canina, bugunku ders hemen bitti. Ihtiyar Collins
huysuz olabilir ama dersleri
gercekten muthis.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>What got into you today, pestering him
about that mask? Is this to do with your
treasure-hunting expedition?
translation:
<T>Bugun sana ne oldu da o maskeyi sorup durarak
onu darladin? Bu, senin
hazine avi seferinle mi ilgili?

original:
<T><M4/4/3>Oho, so you want to know now, do you?
<W>You do. Don't deny it, Hersh.
translation:
<T><M4/4/3>Oho, simdi ogrenmek mi istiyorsun?
<W>Istiyorsun. Inkar etme, Hersh.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Hey, no need to be smug. I just wondered
why you'd be daft enough to wind up old
Crotchety Collins.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Hey, boburlenmene gerek yok. Sadece merak ettim;
neden huysuz ihtiyar
Collins'i kizdiracak kadar aptalca davrandin?

original:
<T><M1/4/4>Hmm... Well, I suppose if you come over to
my house later, I could tell you about it.
translation:
<T><M1/4/4>Hmm... Sey, sanirim sonra
benim eve gelirsen sana anlatabilirim.

original:
<T>I mean, if you really want to know, I can't
really hide it from you, can I?
translation:
<T>Yani, gercekten bilmek istiyorsan, senden
saklayamam, degil mi?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Randall, old chum, sometimes I think you
live on a different planet.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Randall, eski dostum, bazen sanki
baska bir gezegende yasiyorsun.

original: <T><M2/4/3>Hah, I wish!
translation: <T><M2/4/3>Hah, keske!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T><M2/2/1>Mr Collins!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Bay Collins!

original: コリー
translation: Collins

original: <T>Hm? What is it?
translation: <T>Hm? Ne var?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Sir, do you really, honestly believe the Mask
of Chaos is gone forever?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Efendim, Kaos Maskesi'nin gercekten,
sonsuzca yok olduguna samimiyetle inaniyor musunuz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Tsk. Not again, Ascot. I thought that
discussion was over.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Tsk. Yine mi, Ascot? O konuyu
kapattigimizi sanmistim.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>But, sir, I just have to know. What makes
you think the mask was lost?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ama efendim, mutlaka bilmeliyim. Maskenin
kayboldugunu dusunmenize ne sebep oluyor?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Think about it. It belongs to a time and
culture that are known only from myths and
hearsay.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bir dusun. Sadece efsaneler ve soylentilerden
bildigimiz bir doneme ve
kulture ait.

original:
<T>Consequently, any clues that might hint as
to its whereabouts are, ultimately, pure
speculation. And so they shall remain.
translation:
<T>Dolayisiyla, yerini ima edebilecek her turlu
ipucu nihayetinde
salt bir varsayimdir. Ve oyle de kalacaktir.

original:
<T>You know, it's a shame you don't put as
much thought into topics that don't disrupt
the class.
translation:
<T>Biliyor musun, dersi aksatmayan konulara da
bu kadar dusunce
ayirmaman gercekten yazik.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>But, sir, you're an expert in the field! I was
sure if anyone knew something about the
mask it would be you!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ama efendim, siz bu alanda uzmansiniz! Maskeyle
ilgili bir sey bilen varsa,
o da sizsiniz diye emindim!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Ascot, I am delighted by your keen interest
in archaeology, but please, save the flattery
for your fan club.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ascot, arkeolojiye olan derin ilgin beni memnun ediyor,
ama lutfen, yagciligi
hayran kulubun icin sakla.

original:
<T>As it happens, Donald Rutledge isn't the
only scholar to write about the Mask of
Chaos.
translation:
<T>Gerci Donald Rutledge, Kaos Maskesi hakkinda
yazan tek akademisyen degil.

original:
<T>That said, nobody has been able to say
what significance the mask really had, other
than as a carnival accessory.
translation:
<T>Yine de kimse, maskenin bir karnaval aksesuari
olmaktan baska
gercekte ne anlam tasidigini soyleyemedi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Regardless, any archaeologist with sense
will tell you that the mask was lost aeons
ago, if it ever existed.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Her halukarda, akli basinda herhangi bir
arkeolog, maskenin, eger gercekten var olduysa,
caglar once kayboldugunu soyler.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>So what would happen if, say, I found it
tomorrow?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Peki diyelim ki onu yarin bulsaydim,
ne olurdu?

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Ha! You'd become a legend in the world
of archaeology, just as Rutledge was. But
the odds are...<W15>infinitesimal.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Ha! Rutledge gibi, arkeoloji dunyasinda bir efsane
olurdun. Ama ihtimal...<W15>yok denecek kadar az.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Look, Ascot, if you're that keen, you should
stick to what you love. Just keep your
questions for after class.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bak, Ascot, bu kadar hevesliysen sevdigin
seye bagli kal. Sorularini da
ders sonrasina birak.

original: <T><M1/1/4>I will. And I'm really sorry, sir.
translation: <T><M1/1/4>Oyle yapacagim. Gercekten ozur dilerim, efendim.

original: <T><M1/2/2>All right, all right. Go off home, then.
translation: <T><M1/2/2>Tamam, tamam. O halde evine git.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Goodbye, sir!
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Hosca kalin, efendim!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You go straight home, you hear? I don't
want to have to tell your parents you got
lost looking for a mythical artefact.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Dogruca eve gidiyorsun, anlasildi mi? Ailene
efsanevi bir eser ararken kayboldugunu
soylemek zorunda kalmak istemiyorum.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>Greetings, Dalston.
translation: <T>Selam, Dalston.

original: ヤングダルストン
translation: Genc Dalston

original:
<T>Eh up, it's Bratscot and Layton. What
rubbish are you two ninnies going on about
today?
translation:
<T>Eee, bak sen... Bratscot ve Layton. Siz iki
budala bugun yine ne sacmaliyorsunuz
bakalim?

original:
<T><M4/2/1>It's not rubbish! Even you have to see that
archaeology is fun. Or are you too cool for
fun?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Sacmalik degil! Sen bile
arkeolojinin eglenceli oldugunu gormelisin. Yoksa
eglenmek sana mi yakismiyor?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>What's the point in fun if it's not going to
earn you any cash?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Para kazandirmayacaksa eglencenin
ne anlami var?

original:
<T>I'm setting up my own hotel business, and
I'm going to make an even bigger fortune
than my old man.
translation:
<T>Kendi otel isimi kuruyorum ve
babamdan bile daha buyuk bir servet
yapacagim.

original:
<T>I bet the only reason you like all that ancient
history guff is 'cause it'll get you out of this
hole, right?
translation:
<T>Bahse girerim o eski tarih zirvalarini sevmenin
tek sebebi, seni bu
batakliktan kurtaracak olmasi, degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I happen to like this village. I'll only be
leaving to get a degree in archaeology, and
there's nowhere better than Gressenheller!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ben bu koyu seviyorum. Sadece
arkeoloji diplomasi almak icin ayrilacagim ve
Gressenheller'den daha iyi bir yer yok!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Good. While you're off mincing around in
London, I'll be building my hotel empire.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Iyi. Sen Londra'da dolanip dururken
ben de otel imparatorlugumu kuruyor olacagim.

original:
<T><M1/2/3>Not a problem, Dalston. I'll just use your
hotel as a base of operations for my
fact-finding expeditions!
translation:
<T><M1/2/3>Sorun degil, Dalston. Otelini
arastirma seferlerim icin bir
operasyon ussu olarak kullanirim!

original:
<T>Faugh! I don't know how you lot stay sane.
All I ever hear from your mouth is that tripe
about archaeology!
translation:
<T>Ogh! Siz nasil akli basinda kaliyorsunuz, bilmiyorum.
Agzinizdan cikan tek sey
arkeolojiyle ilgili o zirvalar!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Hah, I think it's your sanity that's in
question, Dalston. Watch you don't lose
your mind in that big, empty noggin, eh?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Hah, bence sorgulanmasi gereken senin aklin,
Dalston. O kocaman, bombos kafanda
aklini kaybetme de, ha?

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original: マリー、当番忘れているんじゃなーい？
translation: Marie, nobetini unutmadin degil mi?

original: マリー
translation: Marie

original: あ、いけない
translation: Ah, kotu oldu!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: あ、ランド！放課後の練習はしないの？
translation: Ah, Randall! Okuldan sonra antrenman yapmayacak misin?

original:
ああ。今日はエルシャール・レイトンと
約束があってな。
translation:
Evet. Bugun Hershel Layton'la
sozlesmistim.

original:
ランド、エルシャール、ちょっと待ってて！
今、降りてくから。
translation:
Randall, Hershel, biraz bekleyin!
Hemen asagi iniyorum.

original: シャロアは今日も元気だな…。
translation: Angela bugun de cok enerjik...

original:
ああ、明るくて健康的、
それが彼女の魅力さ。
translation:
Evet, neseli ve capcanli;
iste onu cekici yapan da bu.

original: やあ、シャロア。
translation: Selam, Angela.

original:
ごきげんよう、エルシャール。
それで、今日は何をするつもり？
translation:
Merhaba, Hershel.
Peki, bugun ne yapmayi dusunuyorsun?

original:
考古学の勉強会さ。
あ、シャロア、君からも頼んでくれよ。
translation:
Arkeoloji calisma toplantisi.
Ah Angela, sen de rica et lutfen.

original:
エルシャールが考古学という
崇高な学問から逃げ腰なんだよ。
translation:
Hershel, arkeoloji gibi
soylu bir bilimden kacmaya calisiyor.

original:
また考古学の話か。
二人とも好きだよね。
translation:
Yine arkeoloji mi?
Ikiniz de bunu seviyorsunuz, degil mi?

original: いや、僕は…
translation: Hayir, ben...

original:
いいか、ふたりとも。
今夜、君たちには
とっておきの代物を見せてやる。
translation:
Iyi dinleyin, ikiniz de.
Bu gece size
ozel bir sey gosterecegim.

original:
とっておきの？
それはなんだい？
translation:
Ozel bir sey mi?
Neymis o?

original: 奇跡の仮面さ…。
translation: Mucize Maskesi...

original:
また、それか。
そんなつくり話をしてまで、
僕を考古学に引き込みたいのかい？
translation:
Yine mi o.
Beni arkeolojiye cekmek icin
boyle uydurma hikayeler mi anlatacaksin?

original:
う、信じないのか。まあいい。
今日の勝負は俺が勝っただろ。
translation:
Hih, inanmiyor musun. Neyse.
Bugunku iddiayi ben kazandim, degil mi?

original:
とにかく、今夜は俺の話に
とことん付き合ってもらうぞ。
translation:
Her neyse, bu gece benim sozlerime
sonuna kadar katlanacaksiniz.

original:
じゃあ夜の八時にな。
シャロアもいっしょだ。
ふたりとも待ってるからな。
translation:
O zaman aksam sekizde.
Angela da bizimle olacak.
Ikinizi de bekliyor olacagim.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Typical Randall. He never gives up!
translation: <T>Randall iste. Asla pes etmez!

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>I might be able to get some reading in
before going round to his, though...
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Yine de onun evine gitmeden once
biraz okuyabilirim...

original: コリー
translation: Cory

original:
<T>Hello, Layton. Was there something you
wanted to ask me about?
translation:
<T>Merhaba, Layton. Bana sormak istedigin
bir sey mi vardi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>If not, don't you think you should be at
home doing your homework?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Eger yoksa, sence de evde olup
odevini yapman gerekmiyor mu?

original: ヤングダルストン
translation: Genc Dalston

original:
<T>Oi, Layton! I hear a kitten's been running
around in school. Don't suppose you've
seen it, have you?
translation:
<T>Hey, Layton! Okulda bir yavru kedinin
kosturup durdugunu duydum. Onu
gormus olamazsin, degil mi?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>A kitten? No, I haven't seen it. <W>Why, is it
yours?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Yavru kedi mi? Hayir, gormedim. <W>Neden,
senin mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>What? Mine?! Hah, no. D'you think I'm
worried about it or something?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ne? Benim mi?! Hah, hayir. Onun icin
endiselendigimi falan mi saniyorsun?

original:
<T><M3/1/2>It's just... What a silly animal for getting
lost in a school!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Sadece... Bir okulda kaybolacak kadar
sacma bir hayvan!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>That Randall has got far too good at fencing
lately.
translation:
<T>Randall son zamanlarda eskrimde fazlasiyla
iyi oldu.

original: <T><M4/1/1>I'm not going to let him win the next bout!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bir sonraki karsilasmayi kazanmasina izin
vermeyecegim!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Hello, Ma, I'm home!
translation: <T>Merhaba anne, geldim!

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original:
<T>Oh, Hershel, dear. Would you come over
here for a second? Ohhh dear, oh dear,
oh dear...
translation:
<T>Ah, Hershel canim. Bir saniye buraya
gelir misin? Ahh canim, canim,
canim...

original: <T><M4/2/1>Of course. <W>Um, is something the matter?
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Elbette. <W>Sey, bir sorun mu var?

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original:
<T>Thank goodness you're home, Hershel.
Your father's in trouble!
translation:
<T>Iyi ki eve geldin, Hershel.
Babanin basi dertte!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>In trouble...? What do you mean, Ma?
What's happened?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Dertte mi...? Ne demek istiyorsun, anne?
Ne oldu?

original:
<T><M1/1/3>It's awful! Some strange men in black
suits came to the door around midday,
demanding to see you.
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Cok kotu! Ogle vakti siyah
takim elbiseli bazi tuhaf adamlar kapiya
geldi ve seni gormekte israr etti.

original:
<T>Your father said they were old acquaintances
of his and just went off with them! And he's
been gone ever since!
translation:
<T>Baban onlarin eski tanidiklari oldugunu
soyledi ve onlarla birlikte gitti! O zamandan
beri de ortalikta yok!

original:
<T><M2/1/3>That was hours ago. Where on earth can
he be? <W>Oh, I knew those men looked
suspicious.
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Bu saatler onceydi. Nerede olabilir ki?
<W>Ah, o adamlarin
supheli gorundugunu biliyordum.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Calm down, Ma. I'm sure he's fine. Do you
want me to go out and look for him?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Sakin ol, anne. Eminim iyidir. Disari cikip onu
aramami ister misin?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Oh, Hershel, would you? I'll stay here in
case he comes home.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ah, Hershel, yapar misin? O gelir diye ben
burada kalirim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>All right, then. I'll be back soon, so don't
worry, okay?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Peki o zaman. Yakinda donerim, o yuzden
endiselenme, tamam mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/3>Thank you, Hershel. And do be careful! If
anything happens, just cry out for help as
loud as you can.<W> I'll keep an ear out.
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Tesekkur ederim, Hershel. Ve dikkatli ol! Bir
sey olursa, olabildigince yuksek sesle yardim
iste.<W> Ben de kulak kabartirim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>I'll be fine, Ma. Nothing will happen to me.
I'll find Pa and bring him back.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Iyi olacagim, anne. Bana hicbir sey olmaz.
Babami bulup geri getirecegim.

original:
<T><M1/2/3>Any luck finding your father yet? There's
been no sign of him here. Where can he
be?
translation:
<T><M1/2/3>Babani bulabildin mi? Burada ondan
eser yok. Nerede olabilir
ki?

original: <T>I'll find him, Ma. Don't worry.
translation: <T>Onu bulacagim, anne. Merak etme.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Ma is calling me into the kitchen. I'd better
go and see what she wants.
translation:
<T>Annem beni mutfaga cagiriyor. Gidip
ne istedigine bakmaliyim.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>This is Pa we're talking about, so he's
probably on Pebble Lane, chatting to
someone.
translation:
<T>Bahsettigimiz kisi babam, o yuzden
muhtemelen Pebble Lane'de biriyle
sohbet ediyordur.

original: グロリア
translation: Gloria

original:
<T>Hello, Hershel, lad. What's the time?
Shouldn't you be off home?
translation:
<T>Merhaba Hershel evlat. Saat kac oldu?
Eve gitmen gerekmiyor mu?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>I'm looking for Pa, actually. Apparently he
went out with a group of strange men. Have
you seen him?
translation:
<T>Aslinda babami ariyorum. Gorunuse gore
bir grup tuhaf adamla disari cikmis. Onu
gordun mu?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Roland? Sorry, haven't seen him all day.
Don't tell me Lucille is having you run
around after him again, is she?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Roland mi? Uzgunum, butun gun gormedim.
Yoksa Lucille yine seni onu arayip durman icin
kosturuyor mu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It's always like this. Your pa goes missing
for two seconds, and she works herself into
a tizz and sends out the cavalry.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hep boyledir. Baban iki saniyeligine ortadan
kaybolsa, o hemen telasa kapilir
da herkesi seferber eder.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>But since you're here, Hershel, maybe you
can help me with something. Don't worry,
it won't take long.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Ama madem buradasin, Hershel, belki bana bir
seyde yardim edersin. Merak etme,
uzun surmez.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>These two ladybirds settled on a corncob
earlier and they've been crawling about like
crazy. I think they're lost...
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Su iki ugur bocegi biraz once bir misir kocanina
kondu ve delice dolasip duruyorlar.
Sanirim kayboldular...

original:
<T>I'm sorry to keep you from your errand,
Hershel.
translation:
<T>Seni isinden alikoydugum icin kusura bakma,
Hershel.

original:
<T>Do you think you can help me with these
ladybirds?
translation:
<T>Bu ugur bocekleri konusunda bana yardim
edebilir misin?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Ooh, marvellous. Thank you, Hershel.
You're a good lad.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ah, harika. Tesekkur ederim, Hershel.
Iyi bir cocuksun.

original:
<T>If I see Roland, I'll be sure to say you're
looking for him. Be careful not to trip while
you're running around!
translation:
<T>Roland'i gorursem, onu aradigini soyleyecegim.
Kostururken takilip
dusmemeye dikkat et!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Ha ha, it's okay, Gloria. It's not dark yet,
and I've tied my shoelaces, so I should be
fine. Thanks, though.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Ha ha, sorun degil, Gloria. Daha kararmadi,
bagciklarimi da bagladim, o yuzden
iyiyim. Yine de tesekkurler.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Ah, I suppose you're too big for me to tell
you that now...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ah, sanirim artik bunu soylemeyecek kadar
buyudun...

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Right, Pa, where are you? You must be
somewhere in the market...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Peki baba, neredesin? Pazarda bir yerde
olmalisin...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hello again, Hershel. Still no sign of Roland,
I'm afraid.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Yine merhaba, Hershel. Maalesef hala Roland'dan
haber yok.

original:
<T>Oh. Well, would you tell him Ma's looking
for him if he comes past?
translation:
<T>Ah. Peki, ugrarsa annemin onu aradigini
soyler misin?

original: <T><M3/1/1>Yes, of course. Good luck!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Elbette. Iyi sanslar!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Where IS Pa? I can't see him anywhere...
<W><M1/2/1>Oh.
translation:
<T>Babam NEREDE? Hicbir yerde goremiyorum...
<W><M1/2/1>Ah.

original: ヤングヘンリー
translation: Genc Henry

original: <T>Good evening.
translation: <T>Iyi aksamlar.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Er, hello, Henry. Are you out shopping?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Ee, merhaba Henry. Alisverise mi ciktin?

original:
<T>Yes. I've been sent to purchase the week's
groceries for the household.
translation:
<T>Evet. Evin haftalik
erzak alisverisini yapmak icin gonderildim.

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>I see. That's a bit rough on you, isn't it?
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Anliyorum. Bu senin icin biraz zor degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It's just part of my duties. And may I ask
where you are bound?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu sadece gorevlerimin bir parcasi. Peki
nereye gidiyorsun, sorabilir miyim?

original:
<T>Oh, I'm looking for my father. <W><M1/1/1/45>You haven't
seen him, have you, Henry?
translation:
<T>Ah, babami ariyorum. <W><M1/1/1/45>Onu
hic gormedin, degil mi Henry?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>No, I'm afraid I haven't. I'm very sorry
I can't help you.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hayir, maalesef gormedim. Yardim edemedigim icin
cok uzgunum.

original: <T><M1/2/1>That's all right.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Sorun degil.
<T><K>Sey...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Er... <W>Right...<W> I suppose I'd better go on
looking, then.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ee... <W>Tamam...<W> Sanirim ben de
aramaya devam etsem iyi olacak.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Yes. I wish you luck.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Evet. Sana iyi sanslar.

original: ライオネル
translation: Lionel

original: <T>'Ullo, 'Ershel. You look well today.
translation: <T>Selam, 'Ershel. Bugun iyi gorunuyorsun.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Good evening, Lionel.
translation: <T>Iyi aksamlar, Lionel.

original:
<T>You know, I just saw that beanpole 'Enry,
from the Ascot 'ouse. They certainly make
that boy pull 'is weight!
translation:
<T>Biliyor musun, Ascot 'evinden o sirik gibi 'Enry'yi
az once gordum. Oglana
ciddi ciddi is yaptiriyorlar!

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Speaking of pulling weights, I got some
bricks for me mum's garden wall, but I can't
work out how much they weigh...
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Madem agirliklardan bahsediyoruz, annemin bahce duvari icin
birkac tugla aldim ama
ne kadar geldiklerini hesaplayamiyorum...

original: <T><M1/1/2>Won't you 'elp me work it out?
translation: <T><M1/1/2>Hesaplamama yardim eder misin?

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Can you work out which of these bricks are
the 'eavy ones?
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Bu tuglalardan hangilerinin
agir olanlar oldugunu bulabilir misin?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Ohh... That's right clever, that is. You 'ave
my thanks, lad.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ooh... Bu gercekten zekice. Tesekkurler,
evlat.

original:
<T>Happy to help. I'll be on my way, then.
Good luck with the wall.
translation:
<T>Yardim edebildiysem ne mutlu. O zaman ben kacayim.
Duvar icin kolay gelsin.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Toodle-oo!
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Hosca kal!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>The days are just getting shorter and
shorter, and all that work still to do in
me mum's garden...
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Gunler giderek kisaliyor da kisaliyor, bir de
annemin bahcesinde yapilacak
onca is var...

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>What could have happened to Pa?
translation: <T>Babamin basina ne gelmis olabilir?

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>He doesn't usually stay out this late...
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Normalde bu kadar gec disarida kalmaz...

original: ダンフィン
translation: Dunfin

original:
<T>Ahoy there, Hershel. Where are you off to in
such a hurry?
translation:
<T>Hey ahoy, Hershel. Bu telasla nereye
gidiyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Hello, Uncle Doug. Have you seen Pa
anywhere?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Merhaba Doug Amca. Babami bir yerde
gordun mu?

original: <T><M2/1/1>Roland? Can't say I have, no...
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Roland mi? Hayir, gormedim...

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Ahem, Hershel, my boy. How would you like
to give your Uncle Doug a hand with
a puzzle?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Ohom, Hershel evlat. Doug Amca'na bir
bulmacada el uzatmak ister misin?

original: <T><M2/1/2>Don't let your old uncle down, boy!
translation: <T><M2/1/2>Yasli amcani hayal kirikligina ugratma, evlat!

original: <T><M2/1/2>I just can't work it out at all...
translation: <T><M2/1/2>Bir turlu cozemedim...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Marvellous, my boy. You truly are your
father's son. <W>What did you say you were
up to, again?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Harika, evladim. Gercekten de babanin
oglusun. <W>Ne yapiyordun demistin,
tekrar?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Pa left the house in a hurry earlier. Ma is
worried and sent me out to look for him.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Babam biraz once aceleyle evden cikti. Annem
endiselendi ve beni onu aramaya gonderdi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh tosh, Lucille's always such a worryguts.
But if I see Roland, I'll give him the word.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hadi canim, Lucille hep boyle endise eder.
Roland'i gorursem ona haber veririm.

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Thank you, Uncle Doug.
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Tesekkur ederim, Doug Amca.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Well, Pa's not in town, so I suppose he
must have gone on towards the woods.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Demek babam kasabada degil; o halde
orman tarafina gitmis olmali.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>It's not like Roland to be wandering around
so late. Unheard of at dinner time, ha!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Roland'in bu kadar gec saatlerde dolasmasi
ona gore degil. Aksam yemegi vaktinde hic
duyan olmamistir, ha!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Pa! There you are!
translation: <T>Baba! Iste buradasin!

original: ローラン
translation: Roland

original: <T>Hershel, what's the matter with you?
translation: <T>Hershel, neyin var?

original:
<T><M6/2/3/45>You went off with a group of strangers and
didn't come back all day. Ma's going spare!
translation:
<T><M6/2/3/45>Bir grup yabanciyla gidip butun gun geri
donmedin. Annem deliye dondu!

original:
<T><M3/1/1/60>Oh, your mother is just a fusspot. I told her
they were old friends of mine.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/60>Ah, annen biraz telaslidir. Ona onlarin eski
dostlarim oldugunu soyledim.

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>She didn't seem to think they looked like
friends. And she also said they were looking
for me...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Onlar arkadas gibi gorunmuyormus dedi.
Ayrica beni aradiklarini da soyledi...

original:
<T><M2/1/2>What a pair of nervous Nellies you both are!
I'm right here, safe and sound.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Ikiniz de ne kadar telaslisiniz!
Ben buradayim iste, sapasaglam.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>As for those men, I know them from years
ago. They'd seen you as a baby and were
curious to see how you'd grown up, is all.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>O adamlara gelince, onlari yillar oncesinden
taniyorum. Seni bebekken gormuslerdi ve
nasil buyudugunu merak ettiler, hepsi bu.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Hmm, all right. <W>But what were you doing
all the way out here in the woods?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Hmm, peki. <W>Ama ormanin bu kadar icine
neden geldiniz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>They wanted to visit the Norwell wall, so
I offered to show them the way. It's quite
hard to find for tourists.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Norwell Duvari'ni gormek istediler, ben de
yolu gostereyim dedim. Turistler icin
bulmasi oldukca zor.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Tourists? We haven't been getting many of
those lately.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Turistler mi? Son zamanlarda pek
gelmiyorlar.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/60>Not these days, no, but back when the wall
was excavated, Stansbury was all over the
news. The tourists streamed in.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/60>Su siralar degil, ama duvar kazildiginda
Stansbury haberlerdeydi. Turistler
akin akin gelirdi.

original:
<T>They flocked in all year round, day and
night, just to see the Norwell wall...
translation:
<T>Norwell Duvari'ni gormek icin butun yil,
gece gunduz akin ederlerdi...

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>This must have been years before we moved
here. I can't imagine Stansbury as a tourist
spot.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Bu, buraya tasinmadan yillar once olmali.
Stansbury'yi bir turistik yer olarak
hayal edemiyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/60>There was a sudden surge of interest in
archaeology in this little town. All sorts of
scholars and researchers started moving in.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/60>Bu kucuk kasabada arkeolojiye ilgi birden
artti. Her turden
akademisyen ve arastirmaci buraya tasinmaya basladi.

original:
<T>People who sought to decipher the wall, to
crack its secrets, to gain knowledge of
unknown civilisations!
translation:
<T>Duvari cozmek, sirlarini aciga cikarmak ve
bilinmeyen medeniyetler hakkinda
bilgi edinmek isteyen insanlar!

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Ugh, Pa, you're starting to sound just like
Randall.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Off, baba, Randall gibi konusmaya
basliyorsun.

original:
<T><M3/4/1>Ho ho ho! You must have a glorious time
with your friend Randall, then.
translation:
<T><M3/4/1>Ho ho ho! O zaman arkadasin Randall'la
harika vakit geciriyorsundur.

original:
<T><M2/3/1>Anyhow, let's go home. Best not keep your
mother waiting any longer or she'll be
having kittens.
translation:
<T><M2/3/1>Her neyse, hadi eve gidelim. Anneni daha
fazla bekletmeyelim; yoksa
kuplere biner.
