original: <T><M1/1/1>Yes, let's. I'm starving!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Evet, gidelim. Acliktan oluyorum!

original: ダンフィン
translation: Dunfin

original:
<T>Ah, Roland! I just saw your boy, and he was
running around looking for- <W15>Oh, here's the
lad. He found you then.
translation:
<T>Ah, Roland! Az once oglunu gordum, seni
ariyordu- <W15>Oh, iste cocuk burada.
Demek seni bulmus.

original: ローラン
translation: Roland

original:
<T>Yes, I was just showing some friends
around. Thanks for the message, though.
translation:
<T>Evet, sadece birkac arkadasi gezdiriyordum.
Yine de haber verdigin icin sag ol.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Maybe you should tell your missus next time
you go gallivanting off. Lucky that Hershel
here is an expert retriever. Woof woof.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Bir dahaki sefere boyle gezmeye cikinca
hanimina da haber versen iyi olur. Neyse ki
Hershel burada usta bir retriever. Hav hav.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M4/1/1>Thanks, Uncle {''}Dog{''}.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Tesekkurler, {''}Dog{''} Amca.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Lucille is such a worrier and yet you're
such an easy-going chap, Roland. They
do say opposites attract...
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Lucille cok endiseli biri, ama sen de
o kadar rahat bir adamsin ki, Roland.
Zit kutuplar birbirini ceker derler...

original: グロリア
translation: Gloria

original:
<T>Hey, Roland! I'm glad to see you haven't
been kidnapped by strange men after all.
translation:
<T>Hey, Roland! Sonunda seni tuhaf adamlar
kacirmamis, buna sevindim.

original: ローラン
translation: Roland

original:
<T><M3/1/1/60>Kidnapped? What are you on about? Don't
tell me you were worried.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/60>Kacirilmak mi? Neden bahsediyorsun?
Yoksa endiselendin mi?

original:
<T><M3/2/2>No, I know Lucille and her flights of fancy.
She'll be glad to have you back, though.
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Hayir, Lucille'in hayal gucunu bilirim.
Yine de geri dondugune sevinecek.

original:
<T>Honestly, I've never met anyone who could
brew a storm in a teacup like Lucille.
translation:
<T>Acikcasi, Lucille gibi bir fincanda firtina
koparabilen kimseyle hic tanismadim.

original:
<T>Ho ho! Well, I suppose I don't make things
easy for her...
translation:
<T>Ho ho! Eh, sanirim ben de isleri onun icin
kolaylastirmiyorum...

original: ローラン
translation: Roland

original:
<T>What's the matter, Hershel? Have you left
something at school?
translation:
<T>Ne oldu, Hershel? Okulda bir sey mi
unuttun?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>No, no, it's nothing. Let's go home.
translation: <T>Hayir, hayir, bir sey yok. Eve gidelim.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Ma? <W>Ma! I found Pa.
translation: <T>Anne? <W>Anne! Babayi buldum.

original: ローラン
translation: Roland

original:
<T><M3/1/1/60>Now, Lucille dear, didn't I tell you those
people were friends of mine and not to
worry?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/60>Lucille canim, sana o insanlarin benim
dostlarim oldugunu ve endiselenmemen
gerektigini soylememis miydim?

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original:
<T><M2/2/3>Well, I didn't know you'd be gone all day,
now, did I? I don't mean to fret, but if you
just disappear like that-
translation:
<T><M2/2/3>Ee, butun gun yok olacagini nereden
bilecektim ki? Endiselenmek istemem ama
tam boyle ortadan kaybolursan-

original:
<T>Um, Ma, I'll be in my room, okay? Call me
when dinner's ready!
translation:
<T>Sey, anne, odama cikiyorum, olur mu?
Aksam yemegi hazir olunca beni cagir!

original: ローラン
translation: Roland

original:
<T>Where do you think you're going, son?
Dinner's nearly ready. Why don't you wait
in your room?
translation:
<T>Nereye gidiyorsun saniyorsun, oglum?
Aksam yemegi neredeyse hazir. Odanda
beklesene?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Whew! Parents. <W>Hmm, I wonder how long
dinner will be... What shall I do till then?
translation:
<T>Of! Anne babalar. <W>Hmm, aksam yemegi ne
kadar surecek acaba... O zamana kadar ne yapsam?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>It's nice to be in my own room again. I can
finally read that book.
translation:
<T>Yine kendi odamda olmak ne guzel. Sonunda
o kitabi okuyabilecegim.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>But then I'd have to stop mid-chapter or
something. I hate having to stop. <W>But what
else could I do?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Ama o zaman bolumun ortasinda falan durmak zorunda kalirim.
Durmaktan nefret ederim. <W>Ama baska
ne yapabilirim ki?

original: <T>Hum, hum-tee-tum...
translation: <T>Him him, tidi tim...

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Hmm, Randall seemed really keyed up
today. More so than usual.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Hmm, Randall bugun cok gergin gorunuyordu.
Her zamankinden de fazla.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>I'm used to his crazy treasure hunt talk, but
he's never been so cocksure before. Maybe
he's really found something.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Onun cilgin hazine avi laflarina alisigim ama
hic bu kadar kendinden emin olmamisti. Belki de
gercekten bir sey bulmustur.

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Come to think of it, weren't he and Dalston
arguing over some old, indecipherable map
the other day?
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Dusununce, gecen gun o ve Dalston
eski, okunaksiz bir harita yuzunden
tartismiyorlar miydi?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Wow, I'm actually feeling quite curious.
Randall must be getting through to me...
<W>Worrying thought.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Vay, gercekten merak etmeye basladim.
Randall galiba bana da bulasiyor...
<W>Endise verici bir dusunce.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/60>Still, imagine if we really did discover an
ancient artefact. That would be terrific!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/60>Yine de, gercekten kadim bir eser buldugumuzu
dusunsene. Harika olurdu!

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original: <T>Hershel? Hersheeeeel? Dinner's ready!
translation: <T>Hershel? Hersheeeeel? Aksam yemegi hazir!

original: <T><M1/2/1>What, already? That was quick.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Ne, simdiden mi? Cok cabuk oldu.

original: ローラン
translation: Roland

original:
<T>Mmm, all that sightseeing has given me
quite an appetite. I wonder what's for
dinner...
translation:
<T>Mmm, onca gezinti epey istahimi acti.
Acaba aksam yemeginde
ne var...

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original:
<T>Your father can set the table tonight. You go
upstairs and have a rest, dear. I'll call you
when dinner's ready.
translation:
<T>Baban bu aksam masayi kurabilir. Sen
yukari cikip dinlen, canim. Aksam yemegi
hazir olunca seni cagiririm.

original: ローラン
translation: Laurent

original:
<T>How was school, son? Anything exciting
happen?
translation:
<T>Okul nasildi, oglum? Heyecanli
bir sey oldu mu?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Not really. Just the usual.<W> Well, now you
mention it, <M4/2/1/45>I lost a fencing bout to Randall.
translation:
<T>Pek degil. Her zamanki gibi.<W> Simdi
soyleyince, <M4/2/1/45>Randall'a bir eskrim macini kaybettim.

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original:
<T><M2/2/1>What's the score now, then? Have they
decided which one of you will be going to
the next tournament?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Peki skor simdi kac oldu? Bir sonraki
turnuvaya ikinizden hangisinin
gidecegine karar verdiler mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>I'm not about to let Randall beat me, Ma.
I just need a bit more time to practise.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Randall'in beni yenmesine izin vermem, anne.
Sadece biraz daha antrenman yapmam gerek.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>That's the spirit. How about some pudding
to strengthen you up, then?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Aferin. O zaman guclenmen icin
biraz puding ister misin?

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>Oh. No, thanks, Ma.
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Ah. Hayir, tesekkurler anne.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/60>You sure, son? There might not be any left
after I've been at it...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/60>Emin misin, oglum? Ben isimi bitirdikten sonra
hic kalmayabilir...

original:
<T><M5/1/1>No, no. I told Randall I'd meet him after
dinner. Is that okay?
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Yok, yok. Randall'a yemekten sonra
bulusacagimizi soyledim. Uygun mu?

original: <T><M1/1/3>Now? Isn't it a bit late to be going out?
translation: <T><M1/1/3>Simdi mi? Disari cikmak icin biraz gec degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Don't worry, Ma. We're just going to sit
around in Randall's room and talk.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Merak etme anne. Sadece Randall'in odasinda
oturup konusacagiz.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Hmm. Don't stay out too late, will you?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Hmm. Cok gece kalma, olur mu?

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>I won't. Thanks, Ma. See you later!
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Kalmam. Tesekkurler anne. Sonra gorusuruz!

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original: <T>Hello, dear. Weren't you going out?
translation: <T>Merhaba canim. Disari cikmiyor muydun?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>I am, but I just realised I left something
behind.
translation:
<T>Cikiyorum ama bir seyi
unuttugumu fark ettim.

original:
<T><M2/1/3>Really, you'd forget your hair if it wasn't
gelled on.
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Cidden, sacin joleyle yapisik olmasa
onu bile unutursun.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>But since you're here... Would you have
a look at this apron for me?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ama madem buradasin... Su onluge
bir bakar misin?

original:
<T>Hmm. Maybe I should just let you go on to
your friend's.
translation:
<T>Hmm. Belki de seni
arkadasina gondermeliyim.

original:
<T>Have a good look at the pattern on this
apron.
translation:
<T>Su onlugun
desenine iyice bak.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Quick as always. All right, off you go, dear.
Have fun!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Her zamanki gibi hizlisin. Peki, hadi git canim.
Iyi eglenceler!

original: <T><M2/1/1>Thanks, Ma. Bye!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Tesekkurler anne. Hosca kal!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You will be careful walking home in the dark,
won't you, Hershel? You never know what
might happen.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Karanlikta eve donerken dikkatli olursun,
degil mi Hershel? Ne
olacagi hic belli olmaz.

original: ローラン
translation: Laurent

original:
<T>So you're off to Randall's again, are you?
I hope the Ascots don't mind you turning up
at all hours.
translation:
<T>Yine Randall'a gidiyorsun demek?
Umarim Ascot'lar her saatte
kapilarina dayanmandan rahatsiz olmuyordur.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Er...it's okay, Pa. Really.
translation: <T>Ee... sorun yok baba. Gercekten.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hmph. <W>Well now, didn't you say your friend
Randall has a penchant for puzzles? Maybe
he'd like this one.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hih. <W>Sey, arkadasin Randall'in
bulmacalara meraki var dememis miydin? Belki
bunu sever.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Hmph. You'll have to solve this puzzle
before you can challenge Randall with it,
you know!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Hih. Randall'a bunu sorabilmen icin
once bu bulmacayi
kendin cozmen gerekir, biliyorsun!

original:
<T>Want to try this puzzle again, Hershel? I bet
Randall would get a real kick out of it if you
showed him it later on.
translation:
<T>Bu bulmacayi tekrar denemek ister misin, Hershel? Bahse
girerim, sonra ona gosterirsen Randall bundan
acayip keyif alir.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Pa, I told you, I don't even like puzzles that
much...
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Baba, soyledim ya, bulmacalari
o kadar da sevmiyorum...

original:
<T><M3/1/3>Oh, hogwash. You like puzzles all right.
You're my son.
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>Hadi canim. Bulmacalari gayet de seviyorsun.
Sen benim oglumsun.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Old Ascot is not a bad chap, but he's a real
stick-in-the-mud. He should give that boy of
his more encouragement.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ihtiyar Ascot kotu biri degil ama tam bir
tutucu. Oglunu
daha cok cesaretlendirmeli.

original: ダンフィン
translation: Dunfin

original:
<T>Hershel, boy! What are you doing out at this
time?
translation:
<T>Hershel, evlat! Bu saatte
disarida ne isin var?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Hello, Uncle Doug. I'm just going round to
Randall's house.
translation:
<T>Merhaba, Doug Amca. Sadece
Randall'in evine gidiyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh? And what is the young sir plotting this
time? You keep an eye on him, won't you?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Oyle mi? Genc bey bu sefer ne planliyor?
Ona goz kulak ol, olur mu?

original:
<T><M2/2/2>If anything happens to that boy, his father
will have the whole county up in arms.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>O cocuga bir sey olursa, babasi
butun bolgeyi ayaga kaldirir.

original:
<T><M5/1/1>It's all right, Uncle Doug. We're only going
to chat.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Sorun yok, Doug Amca. Sadece
sohbet edecegiz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>That didn't stop Mr Ascot sending you home
last time. Try not to antagonise the man,
Hershel.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Gecen sefer Bay Ascot seni eve gondermisti.
Adami kizdirmamaya calis,
Hershel.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>He won't even know I'm there. See you
tomorrow!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Orada oldugumu bile bilmeyecek. Yarin
gorusuruz!

original:
<T>I'd tell you not to be out of doors so late,
my boy, but ahh, that fresh night air does
you the world of good!
translation:
<T>Bu kadar gec saatlerde disarida olma derdim,
evlat, ama ahh, su taze gece havasi
insana cok iyi geliyor!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>I spend enough time at school during the
day. I should just go straight to Randall's
house.
translation:
<T>Gunduzleri okulda zaten yeterince zaman
geciriyorum. Dogruca Randall'in evine
gitmeliyim.

original: コリー
translation: Collins

original: <T>Layton, is that you?
translation: <T>Layton, o sen misin?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Good evening, Mr Collins.
translation: <T>Iyi aksamlar, Bay Collins.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>What are you doing lurking around the
school gate at this hour? Have you finished
the short essay I gave you?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu saatte okul kapisinin etrafinda ne
aylaklik ediyorsun? Sana verdigim
kisa kompozisyonu bitirdin mi?

original: <T><M4/1/1>Erm, pretty much.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Sey... asagi yukari.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmph. You'll no doubt find this puzzle
a piece of cake then.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hih. O zaman bu bulmacayi
cocuk oyuncagi bulursun elbette.

original:
<T>Disappointing, Layton. Sloppy research
yields sloppy results.
translation:
<T>Hayal kirikligisin, Layton. Ozene bezene
arastirmazsan sonuclar da ozensiz olur.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>If you did your essay properly, you shouldn't
have any trouble answering this.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Eger kompozisyonunu duzgun yaptiysan,
bunu cevaplamakta zorlanmamalisin.

original:
<T>Hmph. You have done your homework after
all.
translation:
<T>Hih. Demek odevini
sonunda yapmissin.

original: <T>Yes, sir.
translation: <T>Evet, efendim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Well, don't stay out too late. We don't want
your mother to start worrying.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Peki, cok gece kalma. Annenin
meraklanmasini istemeyiz.

original: <T>I won't, sir.
translation: <T>Kalmam, efendim.

original:
<T>You can be on your way, Layton. I won't
have students loitering around here at night.
translation:
<T>Gidebilirsin, Layton. Geceleri burada
oyalanan ogrenciler istemiyorum.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Hang on, Randall's house is not that way.
He'll get all worked up if I'm late, so I'd
better not make any detours.
translation:
<T>Bir dakika, Randall'in evi o tarafta degil.
Gec kalirsam cok telaslanir, o yuzden
sapma yapmasam iyi olur.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>All those questions about...what was it?
The Mask of Chaos? What soft-boiled
scheme has he cooked up this time?
translation:
<T>Su sorularin hepsi... neydi o?
Kaos Maskesi mi? Bu sefer ne yarim yamalak
plan uydurdu acaba?

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Hm? <W>What's Dalston doing out here at this
hour?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Hm? <W>Dalston bu saatte burada ne
ariyor?

original: ヤングダルストン
translation: Genc Dalston

original: <T>Oi, Layton. Bit late for a stroll.
translation: <T>Hey, Layton. Yuruyus icin biraz gec degil mi?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>I could say the same to you, Dalston. Do
your parents even know you're out?
translation:
<T>Aynisini sana da soyleyebilirim, Dalston. Ailen
senin disarida oldugunu biliyor mu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Maybe, maybe not. Who cares? I go where
I like, when I like.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Belki biliyorlardir, belki de hayir. Kimin umurunda?
Istedigim yere, istedigim zaman giderim.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Hey, I just saw Angela go by. You lot aren't
having another of your little archaeology
parties, are you?
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Hey, az once Angela'yi gecerken gordum. Siz de
yine o kucuk arkeoloji
toplantilarinizdan birini yapmiyorsunuz, degil mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/2/45>I really don't know what Angela sees in that
posh brat. His parents aren't even as rich
as mine.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2/45>Angela'nin o simarik, gorgusuz zuppede ne
buldugunu anlamiyorum. Ailesi benimkiler
kadar bile zengin degil.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>And what about you, Layton? Aren't you
tired of playing along with all Bratscot's
potty ideas?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Peki ya sen, Layton? Bratscot'un su sacma
fikirlerine ayak uydurmaktan
yorulmadin mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>I might not care about the archaeology, but
I do enjoy listening to Randall in full rant.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Arkeoloji umurumda olmayabilir ama Randall'i
cosmusken dinlemekten zevk aliyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>He's good at talking, that's for sure. Never
shuts up. <W>But aren't we getting a bit old for
kiddie adventures?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Konusmayi iyi bilir, orasi kesin. Hic
susmaz. <W>Ama cocuk maceralari icin biraz
yaslanmadik mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>They aren't kiddie adventures, Dalston.
Anyway, we're only 17.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Bunlar cocuk maceralari degil, Dalston.
Hem daha 17 yasindayiz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We're already 17, you mean. Thought you'd
have grown out of puzzles and riddles by
now. Like this one. How easy is this?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Yani artik 17'yiz. Bulmacalari ve bilmeceleri
coktan birakmis olacagini sanirdim.
Mesela sunun gibi. Ne kadar kolay, degil mi?

original:
<T>Hah! Looks like I overestimated you,
Layton. You can't even work out this and
it's a doddle!
translation:
<T>Hah! Galiba seni fazla gozumde buyutmusum,
Layton. Bunu bile cozemiyorsun;
cocuk oyuncagi!

original:
<T>You want another go? I thought you were
more into tea than teasers.
translation:
<T>Bir daha mi denemek istiyorsun? Senin
bulmacadan cok caya merakli oldugunu sanirdim.

original:
<T>Pff, I think Ascot's infected you with his
Puzzilitis. You pretend not to care, but you
enjoy it really. You and Angela.
translation:
<T>Pff, sanirim Ascot seni Bulmaca Hastaligi'yla
bulastirmis. Umursamiyormus gibi yapiyorsun
ama aslinda hosuna gidiyor. Senin de, Angela'nin da.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I can't afford to get wrapped up in your
little games, not if I want to become a
successful hotel magnate.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Basarili bir otel patronu olmak istiyorsam,
sizin kucuk oyunlariniza
dalanamam.

original:
<T>By the way, I saw that errand boy from the
Ascot house carrying two huge shopping
bags earlier.
translation:
<T>Bu arada, az once Ascotlarin evindeki o
kosusturmaci cocugu iki kocaman alisveris
cantasi tasirken gordum.

original:
<T><M3/1/2/45>Now there's a busy bee, and he's no older
than us. You'd never catch me being bossed
around like that.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2/45>Iste caliskan bir ari; hem de bizden buyuk degil.
Beni asla oyle emir altinda
kosturamazsin.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Well, you're not Henry. As long as he's
happy with it...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>E, sen Henry degilsin. O memnunsa
bana ne...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Yeah? Aren't you just the same, though,
letting his lordship Count Bratula lead you
around by the nose?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Oyle mi? Ama sen de ayni degil misin,
Simarik Kont Bratula Hazretleri'nin seni
burnundan suruklemesine izin veriyorsun?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>You sound awfully sour, Dalston. If you want
to join us, you should just say.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Cok huysuz konusuyorsun, Dalston. Bize
katilmak istiyorsan, sadece soyle yeter.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Anyway, I really should go. See you
tomorrow!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Her neyse, gitmem gerek. Yarin gorusuruz!

original: <T>Aren't you going over to the Ascot place?
translation: <T>Ascotlarin evine gitmiyor musun?

original:
<T>Yes, but what about you? Are you heading
home soon?
translation:
<T>Evet, ama ya sen? Yakinda
eve mi gidiyorsun?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I'm enjoying the evening air. Don't worry
your pretty head about it.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Aksam havasinin tadini cikariyorum. Sen
kafana takma.

original: ヤングダルストン
translation: Genc Dalston

original:
<T>Oi, Layton! Are you blanking me? Or can
you just not see through that mass of hair?
translation:
<T>Hey, Layton! Beni mi gormezden geliyorsun?
Yoksa su sac yiginindan bir sey goremiyor musun?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: やあ、シャロア
translation: Merhaba, Sharoa.

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Sharoa

original: エルシャール…ちょうどよかったわね。
translation: Hershel... Tam zamaninda geldin.

original: ああ。
translation: Evet.

original:
エルシャール、ごめんね。
ランドに付き合わせて。
translation:
Hershel, kusura bakma.
Seni Randall'a bulastirdim.

original:
いや、平気さ。彼の強引なところも含めて
僕もランドのことが好きだからね。
translation:
Yok, sorun degil. Onun biraz zorlayici yanlariyla birlikte
ben de Randall'i seviyorum.

original: そうね、そこがランドの魅力よね。
translation: Evet, iste Randall'in cazibesi de bu.

original:
無鉄砲な彼だけど、あなたがついていれば、
なんとなく大丈夫な感じがするの。
安心っていうか…
translation:
O cok gozu kara ama sen yaninda olunca,
nedense her sey yolunda gidecekmis gibi geliyor.
Icim rahatliyor, yani...

original:
いや、僕よりもずっとランドは
しっかりしているさ
translation:
Hayir, Randall benden cok daha
dengeli biridir.

original:
そう、そんな風にいつも
一歩下がったところから見守ってくれる。
それがあなたよね。エルシャール
あ、いや（照れ）
translation: Sey... (utanir)

original: これからもランドを見守ってあげて、エルシャール
translation: Bundan sonra da Randall'a goz kulak ol, Hershel.

original: ああ、もちろん
translation: Evet, elbette.

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Sharoa

original:
<T><M4/1/1>What are you doing? Aren't we going
straight to Randall's?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ne yapiyorsun? Dogruca Randall'a
gitmiyor muyuz?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Oh. Yes, of course.
translation: <T>Ah. Evet, tabii ki.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Right, let's sneak in the usual way...
translation: <T>Tamam, her zamanki gibi gizlice girelim...

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Sharoa

original: <T><M2/2/1/45>Yes, I think that would be best.
translation: <T><M2/2/1/45>Evet, bence en iyisi bu olur.

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Sharoa

original:
<T>Hershel, no! If we go in through the front
door, Mr Ascot might see us!
translation:
<T>Hershel, hayir! On kapidan girersek
Bay Ascot bizi gorebilir!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Mmm. Last time he caught us here, he
wasn't too pleased, was he?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Mmm. Gecen sefer bizi burada yakaladiginda
pek memnun olmamisti, degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/2>I don't want to think about it. Let's go in
through the window.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Dusunmek bile istemiyorum. Pencereden
girelim.

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Sharoa

original:
<T>This ivy on the wall is really the VIP entrance
to Randy's room, isn't it?
translation:
<T>Su duvardaki sarmasik, gercekten de Randy'nin
odasina VIP girisi, degil mi?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ha. I reckon I can count on one hand the
number of times I've been in through the
front door.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ha. On kapidan kac kez girdigimi
tek elimle sayabilirim.

original:
<T><M2/1/2/45>Randy's father isn't that bad, you know.
He's just very, very strict.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2/45>Randy'nin babasi o kadar da kotu degil.
Sadece cok, cok kati.

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Randall hasn't opened the window yet, has
he? We'll have to send the signal.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Randall henuz pencereyi acmadi, degil mi?
Sinyali gondermemiz gerekecek.

original:
<T><M1/2/2/60>Yep. Would you care to do the honours,
Hershel?
translation:
<T><M1/2/2/60>Evet. Bu isi sen yapmak ister misin,
Hershel?

original:
<T>What's the problem? Are you giving up for
tonight?
translation: <T>Sorun ne? Bu gece vazgeciyor musun?

original:
<T>We have to send the signal so that Randy
opens his window and we can climb in.
translation:
<T>Sinyali gondermeliyiz ki Randy penceresini
acsin ve iceri tirmanabilelim.

original: <T>Great! That should do it.
translation: <T>Harika! Bu is gorur.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Oof! Hey, Randall.
translation: <T>Off! Hey, Randall.

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Sharoa

original: <T>Hello! We're not late, are we?
translation: <T>Merhaba! Gec kalmadik, degil mi?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>I've been waiting ages! <W>Hershel, did you
have to protect my Angie from terrible
dangers on the way?
translation:
<T>Asirlardir bekliyorum! <W>Hershel, yolda
benim Angie'yi korkunc
tehlikelerden koruman mi gerekti?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>I am bound to say that the lady did not
require my aid, though I would've been
glad to provide it, had the need arisen.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Sunu soylemeliyim ki hanimefendinin
yardimima ihtiyaci yoktu; ama gerek
olsaydi seve seve yardim ederdim.

original:
<T><M3/4/3/45>Ha ha ha! Oh, come off it. What a
gentleman, eh, Angie?
translation:
<T><M3/4/3/45>Ha ha ha! Hadi ama. Ne
centilmen, degil mi Angie?

original:
<T>So, what is this thing you were going to tell
us all about?
translation:
<T>Peki, bize anlatacagini soyledigin
sey neydi?

original: <T><M2/2/2>Yes, don't you have something to show us?
translation: <T><M2/2/2>Evet, bize gosterecegin bir sey yok mu?

original: <T><M1/4/3/45>Patience, patience, my friends!
translation: <T><M1/4/3/45>Sabir, sabir, dostlarim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Rand

original: <T>まずはこれを[見/み]てくれ。
translation: <T>Once suna bir [見/み] bak.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>これは？
translation: <T>Bu da ne?

original: <T>『[奇跡/きせき]の[仮面/かめん]』だよ。
translation: <T>Bu, [[奇跡/きせき]の[仮面/かめん]].

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1>The...the Mask of Chaos? You mean the
real Mask of Chaos?!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Su... su Kaos Maskesi mi? Yani gercek
Kaos Maskesi mi?!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T><M4/4/2>The one and only!
translation: <T><M4/4/2>Tek ve biricik!

original:
<T>The artefact Donald Rutledge wrote of in his
{''}Ancient Histories{''}. I've found it at last!
translation:
<T>Donald Rutledge'in
{''}Ancient Histories{''} adli eserinde soz ettigi eser. Sonunda onu buldum!

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original: <T><M2/1/2/45>That's...a fake, right? <W>It must be.
translation: <T><M2/1/2/45>Bu... sahtedir, degil mi? <W>Oyle olmak zorunda.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Absolutely not. This is the genuine article.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Kesinlikle hayir. Bu, gercek olanin ta kendisi.

original:
<T>According to Rutledge, the myth goes that
{''}he who holds the Mask of Chaos may have
anything he desires{''}!
translation:
<T>Rutledge'a gore efsane soyle der:
{''}Kaos Maskesi'ni elinde tutan kisi,
diledigi her seye sahip olabilir{''}!

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>That's...incredible. But it sounds a bit, you
know, ominous.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Bu... inanilmaz. Ama biraz, bilirsin,
tehditkar geliyor.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Ha, it's just a legend, Hershel. You
shouldn't believe everything you read.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Ha, bu sadece bir efsane, Hershel.
Okudugun her seye inanmamalisin.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Still, when I examined the mask, I made an
unexpected discovery.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Yine de maskeyi inceledigimde
beklenmedik bir kesif yaptim.

original: <T><M1/1/1/60>Something Rutledge didn't mention?
translation: <T><M1/1/1/60>Rutledge'in bahsetmedigi bir sey mi?

original:
<T><M2/4/3/45>Exactly. <W>The mask does indeed possess an
extraordinary power.
translation:
<T><M2/4/3/45>Aynen oyle. <W>Maske gercekten de
olaganustu bir guce sahip.

original:
<T>It holds the key to unimaginable fortune and
glory.
translation:
<T>Akil almaz bir servet ve sohretin
anahtarini tasiyor.

original:
<T><M4/2/2>That is to say, if I can crack the puzzle of
the mask, it will lead me to the lost treasure
of an ancient civilisation!
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Yani, maskenin bulmacasini cozebilirsem,
bu beni kadim bir medeniyetin kayip
hazinesine goturecek!

original:
<T><M4/2/3>Well, what do you say? Doesn't it fill you
with a thirst for adventure?
translation:
<T><M4/2/3>Ee, ne dersin? Icini macera
ozlemiyle doldurmuyor mu?

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Er,<W30> no.<W30> To begin with, we don't even know
if that really is the Mask of Chaos. <W>Where
did you get it from?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Sey,<W30> hayir.<W30> Oncelikle bunun gercekten
Kaos Maskesi olup olmadigini bile bilmiyoruz. <W>Onu
nereden buldun?

original:
<T><M1/4/2/45>Heh heh. Excellent question, my dear
Hershel!
translation:
<T><M1/4/2/45>Heh heh. Mukemmel bir soru, sevgili
Hershel!

original:
<T><M2/4/2/45>It wasn't easy! I had to crack a devilish
puzzle to get my hands on the mask.
translation:
<T><M2/4/2/45>Kolay olmadi! Maskeye ulasmak icin
seytani bir bulmacayi cozmem gerekti.

original: <T><M4/2/1/60>A puzzle? What puzzle?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/60>Bir bulmaca mi? Hangi bulmaca?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Rand

original: これだよ。
translation: Iste bu.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: …これは！？
translation: ...Bu ne!?

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Sharoa

original: 何なの？
translation: Nedir bu?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<V0010><T>We made the trip to Monte d'Or to
investigate the Mask of Chaos.</V>
translation:
<V0010><T>Kaos Maskesi'ni arastirmak icin
Monte d'Or'a yolculuk yaptik.</V>

original:
<V0020><T>There, we witnessed a terrifying sight -
civilians petrified before our very eyes!</V>
translation:
<V0020><T>Orada dehset verici bir manzaraya tanik olduk -
siviller gozlerimizin onunde tasa dondu!</V>

original:
<V0030><T>We met Angela Ledore, an old friend
of the professor's. We also learnt of a
tragic event in Professor Layton's past.</V>
translation:
<V0030><T>Angela Ledore'la tanistik; profesorun eski bir dostu.
Ayrica Profesor Layton'in gecmisindeki
trajik bir olayi ogrendik.</V>

original:
<V0040><T>I didn't get much sleep that night...
but the sunrise was quite beautiful.</V>
translation:
<V0040><T>O gece pek uyuyamadim...
ama gun dogumu oldukca guzeldi.</V>

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: ふうぁあ…あれ…
translation: Huuuaa... sey...

original: レミ

<T><M5/2/1/45>Well, looks like somebody needs more
sleep! <W>Don't worry. You stay here while the
professor and I investigate, okay?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Eh, biri biraz daha
uykuya ihtiyac duyuyor gibi! <W>Merak etme. Profesorle ben arastirirken
sen burada kal, olur mu?

original: ルーク

<T><M1/2/4>Nnngh... <W60><M1/2/5>What? You're going to leave me
behind?! No! <M1/3/5><W75><M3/1/3>Oh, nice try, Emmy! I may be
half-asleep, but you can't trick me!
translation:
<T><M1/2/4>Nnngh... <W60><M1/2/5>Ne? Beni geride mi
birakacaksiniz?! Hayir! <M1/3/5><W75><M3/1/3>Ah, guzel deneme, Emmy! Belki de
yari uykuluyum ama beni kandiramazsin!

original:
<T><M4/2/6>Half-asleep? So, you admit it, then - you
could do with a bit more sleep! Sure you
don't want to stay here and take a nap?
translation:
<T><M4/2/6>Yari uykulu mu? O halde kabul ediyorsun -
biraz daha uykuya ihtiyacin var! Burada
kalip biraz kestirmek istemedigine emin misin?

original: <T><M1/2/2>Huh?<W> No, I'm okay. I can investigate too.
translation: <T><M1/2/2>Ha?<W> Hayir, ben iyiyim. Ben de arastirabilirim.

original: レイトン

<T><M2/1/1/45>Come now, you two.<W> Before we set out, let
us go through yesterday's events.<M1/1/1/60>
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Haydi, siz ikiniz.<W> Yola cikmadan once dunku olaylari gozden
gecirelim.<M1/1/1/60>

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Okay! Well, we arrived here in Monte d'Or
after we got that letter from Mrs Ledore.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Tamam! Sey, Bayan Ledore'dan o mektubu aldiktan sonra Monte d'Or'a
geldik.

original:
<T><M6/2/5>When we went to see her, she told us that a
shady character calling himself the Masked
Gentleman is stirring up trouble in the city.<M6/2/1>
translation:
<T><M6/2/5>Onu gormeye gittigimizde, kendine Maskeli
Beyefendi diyen supheli birinin sehirde ortaligi karistirdigini
soyledi.<M6/2/1>

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We even got to see one of his {''}miracles{''}
last night for ourselves! The professor and I
saw him turn people into stone!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Dun gece onun {''}miracles{''}larindan birine bizzat
tanik olduk! Profesorle ben, insanlarin tasa donusmesini gorduk!

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>The whole city is on edge. If the Masked
Gentleman isn't caught soon, we don't
know what might happen.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Tum sehir diken ustunde. Maskeli
Beyefendi yakalanmazsa, ne olacagini
bilemiyoruz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Indeed. It is our mission to apprehend the
Masked Gentleman and restore peace to
Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Kesinlikle. Maskeli Beyefendi'yi yakalayip Monte d'Or'a yeniden huzur
getirmek bizim gorevimiz.

original:
<T>But in order to do so, we must first find out
who is behind that mask.<M4/1/1/60>
translation:
<T>Ama bunu yapabilmemiz icin once o maskenin ardindaki kisinin kim
oldugunu ogrenmeliyiz.<M4/1/1/60>

original:
<T><M3/1/1>From what I gather, the police are still
fumbling for a lead.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Anladigim kadariyla polis hala bir ipucu bulmakta zorlaniyor.

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>With so little to go on, it'd be best to get
the full story from Mr Ledore himself.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Elimizde bu kadar az sey varken, en iyisi hikayenin tamamini bizzat
Bay Ledore'dan dinlemek.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>An excellent proposition. I was thinking this
might be a good time to pay Henry a visit.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Harika bir oneri. Henry'yi ziyaret etmek icin tam zamani olabilecegini
dusunuyordum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>So we're going to the Ledores'?<W> Maybe we
can also check the place where they kept
the mask, then!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yani Ledore'lara gidiyoruz?<W> O zaman maskeyi sakladiklari yeri de kontrol
edebiliriz!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Professor, isn't that...?<W30> No.<W> But then who
could it be?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Profesor, bu... o degil mi...?<W30> Hayir.<W> O zaman kim
olabilir?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>A friend of yours, Emmy?
translation: <T>Emmy, senin bir arkadasin mi?

original:
<T><M4/1/3>No, no. But I could swear I've seen her
before somewhere...
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Hayir, hayir. Ama onu daha once bir yerde
gordugume yemin edebilirim...

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Do you mind if we have a word with her,
Professor?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Onunla bir konussak sakincasi var mi,
Profesor?

original: ナゾーバ

<T><M3/2/1>Ehee hee! How befitting the carnival is of
a beauty such as myself. At last I shall have
a chance to shine!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ehee hee! Karnaval, benim gibi
bir guzellige ne kadar da yakisiyor. Nihayet
parlayacak bir sansim olacak!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But you, travellers, I sense that you are
overwhelmed by the glitz of the city and in
need of guidance from your puzzle queen!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama siz, yolcular, sehrin isiltisi karsisinda
bunalmis gibisiniz ve bilmece kralicenizden
bir rehberlige ihtiyaciniz var!

original: レミ

<T><M2/2/2/45>I recognise that voice! And that fashion
sense.<W> Aren't you Granny-
translation: <T><M2/2/2/45>O sesi taniyorum! Ve su giyim tarzini da.<W> Sen nene-

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Silence! The beautiful and clairvoyant
Elizabeth has spoken!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sessizlik! Guzel ve kahin
Elizabeth konustu!

original: レイトン

<T><M5/2/1/45>Clairvoyant? Is that so?<W> Did I hear you say
you are a puzzle queen?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Kahin mi? Oyle mi?<W> Bilmece kralicesi oldugunuzu soylediginizi mi
duydum?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Ehee hee! Why, yes. I am the ruler of
puzzles!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ehee hee! Elbette, evet. Ben
bilmecelerin hukumdariyim!

original:
<T>And you'll find my puzzling subjects roaming
all over this land! Fun, frustrating, finicky,
they're out there, everywhere you look!
translation:
<T>Ve bilmece tebaami bu diyarda
dort bir yanda dolasirken bulacaksiniz! Eglenceli, sinir bozucu, nazli,
her yerde... Nereye baksaniz!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But sometimes a puzzle might stump us and
we put it off until later. Other times we miss
puzzles completely!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama bazen bir bilmece bizi zorlar ve
onu daha sonraya birakiriz. Bazen de
bilmeceleri tamamen kaciririz!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>And that is where I come in. I gather those
poor, neglected puzzles and keep them safe
and warm, as a good queen should!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Iste o zaman ben devreye girerim. O zavalli,
ihmal edilmis bilmeceleri toplar ve iyi bir kralice gibi
onlari guvende, sicacik tutarim!

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>In other words, if we let any puzzles slip by,
we just have to come and see you?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Yani baska bir deyisle, bir bilmeceyi kacirirsak,
gelelim sizi gorelim, yeter mi?

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>That sounds very convenient.
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Bu oldukca kullanisli gorunuyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Isn't it just? After all, I am your puzzle
queen, Elizabeth the-
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Oyle degil mi? Sonucta ben sizin bilmece
kralicenizim, Elizabeth, yani-

original: ルーク
<T><M3/1/1>Beautiful and clairvoyant!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Guzel ve kahin!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Ehee hee! You're catching on, boy! <W><M2/2/1>Just
stop by my sha-<W30> That is, my palace,<W30>
whenever you're itching for a puzzle or five.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ehee hee! Anlamaya basladin, oglan! <W><M2/2/1>Su
kulubeme-<W30> Yani, sarayima,<W30>
canin bir bilmece ya da bes tane cektiginde ugrayin.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Whenever you're itching for a puzzle or five,
just pop round and consult Elizabeth!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Canin bir bilmece ya da bes tane cektiginde,
hemen ugrayin ve Elizabeth'e danisin!

original: バスカル

<T>Good morning to you, Professor. I trust you
slept well?
translation:
<T>Gunaydin, Profesor. Umarim
iyi uyumussunuzdur?

original: レイトン

<T>Very well indeed, thank you. The room is
very comfortable.
translation:
<T>Cok iyi, tesekkur ederim. Oda
oldukca rahat.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I am glad to hear that. We pride ourselves
on being one of the finest hotels in this city.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bunu duyduguma sevindim. Bu sehirdeki
en iyi otellerden biri olmakla gurur duyuyoruz.

original:
<T>We strive for excellence. I do think we may
one day achieve it.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Mukemmellik icin cabaliyoruz. Bir gun
bunu basaracagimiza inaniyorum.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M4/1/1>With so many splendid hotels in Monte d'Or,
I imagine competition must be fierce.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Monte d'Or'da bu kadar gorkemli otel varken,
rekabetin cok cetin oldugunu tahmin ediyorum.

original:
<T>It is, yes. But our priority here at the
Camel's Hump remains the same: providing
the very best service for our guests.
translation:
<T>Evet, oyle. Ama burada
Camel's Hump'taki onceligimiz hep ayni:
misafirlerimize en iyi hizmeti sunmak.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Your satisfaction is of the utmost importance
to us, so please do ask should you require
anything.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Memnuniyetiniz bizim icin her seyden onemli,
bu yuzden bir seye ihtiyaciniz olursa
lutfen cekinmeden soyleyin.

original: <T><M2/1/1/30>Thank you. We'll keep that in mind.
translation: <T><M2/1/1/30>Tesekkur ederim. Aklimizda tutacagiz.

original:
<T>We're very fortunate to be situated where we
are, but we're always looking for new ways
to improve our service.
translation:
<T>Bulundugumuz konum nedeniyle cok sansliyiz,
ama hizmetimizi gelistirmek icin
her zaman yeni yollar ariyoruz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>An excellent work ethic. I'll be sure to
recommend you in future.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Harika bir calisma anlayisi. Sizi
ileride mutlaka tavsiye edecegim.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M5/2/1>The streets are still packed, but compared to
last night it feels quite peaceful!
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Sokaklar hala tiklim tiklim ama
dun geceye kiyasla oldukca sakin!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>The carnival-goers must be exhausted from
all the thrills.
translation:
<T>Karnavaldakiler tum o heyecandan
yorulmus olmali.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>Do you think there will be another parade
tonight, Professor?
translation:
<T>Sizce bu gece bir gecit toreni daha
olur mu, Profesor?

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>From what I've heard, there is a parade
every evening. But try to remember, Luke,
that we are not here for the festivities.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Duyduguma gore her aksam bir gecit toreni
oluyor. Ama unutma, Luke,
biz burada eglence icin degiliz.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Should we continue gathering information
from witnesses?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Taniklardan bilgi toplamaya
devam edelim mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Certainly. I was thinking we could talk to the
locals while we make our way to the Ledore
residence. <W><M3/2/1/45>Hmm?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Elbette. Ledore
malikanesine dogru giderken yerlilerle konusabiliriz.
<W><M3/2/1/45>Himm?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Professor, look! <W><M5/2/1>It's that little girl who was
lost. She's crying again!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Profesor, bakin! <W><M5/2/1>Kaybolan o kucuk kiz.
Yine agliyor!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M5/2/1>You wouldn't ignore a stray kitten, would
you, Professor?! Let's help her!
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Basibos bir yavru kediyi gormezden gelmezsiniz,
degil mi, Profesor?! Ona yardim edelim!

original: マカロン
translation: Makaron

original:
<T>Waaaah! I...<W>I was only talkin' to the clown
for a, sniff...<W>a sec, like, and then me
mam...<W>me mam disappeared!
translation:
<T>Vaaaah! Ben...<W>Ben sadece palyacoyla
bir, hick...<W>bir saniyeligine konusuyordum da, sonra
annem...<W>annem kayboldu!

original: <T>Wh-where'd she gan? Waaaaaah!
translation: <T>Ne-nereye gitti? Vaaaaaah!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/1/2>You lost your mum again? Umm...<W>
Professor?
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Anneni yine mi kaybettin? Hmm...<W>
Profesor?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>We should try not to stray too far from our
investigation, but it is a gentleman's duty to
aid those in need.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Sorusturmamizdan cok fazla
uzaklasmamaya calismaliyiz, ama ihtiyaci olana
yardim etmek bir beyefendinin gorevidir.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I knew you'd say that. All right! Let's find
this girl's mum!<M1/1/1/45>
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bunu diyecegini biliyordum. Pekala! Hadi
bu kizin annesini bulalim!<M1/1/1/45>

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Can you remember where you last saw your
mother, little one?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Anneni en son nerede gordugunu
hatirliyor musun, kucuk?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>I think... <W>I think it was near that huuuge tent,
where the water gans whoosh, whoosh!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Sanirim... <W>O kocaman cadirin yanindaydi,
sularin vuus vuus yaptigi yerde!

original:
<T><M4/1/3>That's got to be Celebration Boulevard.
Let's go!
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Bu kesinlikle Kutlama Bulvari olmali.
Hadi gidelim!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Hold on. Is that...<W15>Gloria?
translation: <T>Bir dakika. O da...<W15>Gloria mi?

original: マカロン
translation: Makaron

original: <T>Howay, mistah! I want me mam! Let's go!
translation: <T>Hadi, amca! Annemi istiyorum! Gidelim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Please excuse me for just a moment.
There's someone I'd like to talk to. I'll be
right back.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Bir an icin lutfen beni mazur gorun.
Konusmak istedigim biri var. Hemen
donecegim.

original: グロリア
<T>Hello there. Do I...know you?
translation: <T>Merhaba. Ben sizi... taniyor muyum?

original: レイトン
<T><M3/2/1>Gloria? I thought it was you!
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Gloria? Sen oldugunu dusunmustum!

original:
<T>Oh, of course! It's young Hershel! Last time
I saw you, you were just a lad! And you had
rather more hair.
translation:
<T>Ah, tabii ya! Genc Hershel! Son gorusumuzde
sen daha bir delikanliydin! Bir de
saclarin epey daha fazlaydi.

original: レミ
<T><M5/2/1>A friend of yours, Professor?
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Bir arkadasiniz mi, Profesor?

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Yes, from long ago. This is Gloria.<W> What
brings you here? Are you on holiday?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Evet, eski bir dost. Bu Gloria.<W> Sizi
buraya getiren nedir? Tatilde misiniz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh goodness, no! I moved here to Monte
d'Or...<W>five years ago, now?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aman Tanrim, hayir! Monte
d'Or'a tasindim...<W>bes yil oldu galiba?

original:
<T>There's only a handful of people left in
Stansbury, Hershel. It's a sad, desolate
place these days.
translation:
<T>Stansbury'de sadece birkac kisi kaldi,
Hershel. Simdilerde huzunlu, issiz bir
yer.

original:
<T>But look at you with your lovely wife and
children! To think you didn't invite your dear
auntie to the wedding!
translation:
<T>Ama sen de ne guzel esin ve
cocuklarinla buradasin! Dusun ki sevgili halani
dugune davet etmemissin!

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Oh, no, it's not what it looks like at all. This
is my assistant, Emmy, and Luke here is the
son of a good friend.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Ah, hayir, gorundugu gibi degil. Bu
benim asistanim Emmy; Luke ise
iyi bir arkadasimin oglu.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Emmy Altava. It's nice to meet you, Gloria.
<W>And this little girl can't find her mother, so
we're helping her look.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Emmy Altava. Tanistigimiza memnun oldum, Gloria.
<W>Ve bu kucuk kiz annesini bulamiyor; biz de
aramasina yardim ediyoruz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>That's nice, dear.<W> You know, Hershel, it
wouldn't have hurt to come and visit now
and then. Too late now, though.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ne hos, canim.<W> Bilirsin Hershel,
ara sira gelip ziyaret etsen fena olmazdi.
Ama artik cok gec tabii.

original:
<T>I never thought I'd say this, but I miss
Stansbury. The peace and quiet, the
green...even the creepy-crawlies!
translation:
<T>Bunu soyleyecegimi hic dusunmezdim ama
Stansbury'yi ozluyorum. Huzuru, sessizligi,
yesili... hatta surungen bocekleri bile!

original:
<T>Monte d'Or is just hectic these days. Some
rowdy character in a mask calling himself
the Masked Gentleman or what have you.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or ise bu aralar tam bir kesmekes.
Maskeli Beyefendi falan diye kendine isim takan,
maskeli bir serseri var.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>He's been going after tourists too! You've
got to keep an eye out wherever you go. I
don't know. Be careful, won't you, Hershel?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Turistlerin pesine de dusuyormus!
Nereye gidersen git gozunu dort acmalisin.
Bilmem... Dikkatli ol, olur mu Hershel?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Of course I will, Gloria. <W>Well, it has been
lovely to see you again, but we really must
be getting on.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Elbette olurum, Gloria. <W>Seni yeniden gormek
cok guzeldi ama gercekten artik
yola koyulmamiz gerekiyor.

original:
<T>Stansbury is just a shadow of its former self
now. It was never the same, not after what
happened to poor Randall.
translation:
<T>Stansbury artik eski halinin bir golgesi
simdi. Zavalli Randall'a olanlardan sonra
hicbir sey eskisi gibi olmadi.

original: <T><M1/2/1>I'm sorry to hear it...
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Bunu duymak uzucu...

original: マカロン
translation: Makaron

original:
<T>Hee hee, that old man looks propah funny!
His tooth is sparkly as owt!
translation:
<T>Hee hee, su ihtiyar pek komik gorunuyor!
Disi de isil isil parliyor!

original: パンチョン

<T>Out of my way! Don't you know who I am?
I'm Waltham of Waltham and Co.!
translation:
<T>Cekil yolumdan! Benim kim oldugumu bilmiyor musun?
Waltham and Co.'dan Waltham'im!

original: ルーク
<T>Waltham of Waltham?
translation: <T>Waltham and Co.'dan Waltham mi?

original: マカロン
<T>Hiya!
translation: <T>Selam!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh! What charming little...<W>ragamuffins.
Hrmph. Since you're blocking my path, I
assume there's something you want.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh! Ne sevimli kucuk...<W>veletler.
Hrmph. Yolumu kestiginize gore,
sanirim benden bir sey istiyorsunuz.

original:
<T>We're lookin' for Mammy! Have ya seen
her, mistah?
translation:
<T>Mammy'yi ariyoruz! Onu gordun mu
bayim?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Well, how would I know? I've never met
your, er...<W15>{''}mammy{''}.<W> Dear, oh dear. What
am I supposed to do with you two?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ben nereden bileyim? Hic tanismadim
senin, sey...<W15>{''}mammy{''}.<W> Ah, ah. Peki ben
sizinle ne yapacagim simdi?

original:
<T><M3/1/3>Wait! I'm not lost! I'm just helping her find
Mammy- <W30>I mean, her mother!
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>Dur! Kaybolmadim! Sadece ona
Mammy'yi- <W30>yani annesini bulmasinda yardim ediyorum!

original:
<T>Aha! Splendid, then.<W> <M2/1/1>Now I think of it, I did
see a woman rushing towards Celebration
Boulevard...
translation:
<T>Aha! Harika o zaman.<W> <M2/1/1>Simdi dusundum de,
Az once Kutlama Bulvari'na dogru
kosarak giden bir kadin gordum...

original:
<T>White trousers and wavy, red hair. Seemed
to be looking for someone - maybe you?<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Beyaz pantolonlu, dalgali kizil sacliydi. Birini
ariyor gibiydi - belki de sizi?<M1/1/1>

original: <T><M4/1/1>Ah! That's got to be her! <W><M1/1/1>Thank you, sir!
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Ah! Kesin o olmali! <W><M1/1/1>Tesekkur ederim, efendim!

original: <T>Cheers, mistah! Buh-bye!
translation: <T>Sag ol, bayim! Gule gule!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hrmph! Don't mention it. Time is money, but
I've got that coming out of my ears!<W> So to
speak.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hrmph! Lafi bile olmaz. Zaman paradir ama
bende ondan kulagimdan tasacak kadar var!<W> Tabiri
caizse.

original:
<T>How troublesome it would be to lose a child
in this crowd...
translation:
<T>Bu kalabalikta bir cocugu kaybetmek
ne kadar da dert olurdu...

original: フランキ

<T>Ain't Mrs Ledore a proper beauty? They say
her and her hubby ain't on the best of
terms. Maybe now's my chance, eh?
translation:
<T>Bayan Ledore tam bir guzel degil mi? Derler ki
onunla kocasi pek iyi gecinmiyormus.
Belki de simdi benim sansim, ha?

original: ルーク
<T><M3/1/1>Are you talking about Angela?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Angela'dan mi bahsediyorsun?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That's Mrs Ledore to you, scruff! Who said
you could use her first name, eh?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Senin icin o Bayan Ledore, serseri! Adiyla hitap edebilecegini kim soyledi,
ha?

original: レミ

<T><M5/1/1>What was that about the Ledores not getting
on?
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Ledore'larin pek anlasamadigina dair ne dedin?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Heh, it's obvious, innit? He gets home late
every night. Who can say where he is all
day? Not his wife, anyway.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Heh, belli degil mi? Her gece gec geliyor
eve. Gun boyu nerede oldugunu kim bilebilir?
Karisi zaten hic bilmez.

original: <T><M2/2/1>What do you mean?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Ne demek istiyorsun?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Obviously he's busy with all this miracle
business. Being the city's founder probably
comes with its fair share of duties too.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Belli ki su mucize
isleriyle mesgul. Sehrin kurucusu olmak da
bir suru sorumluluk getiriyordur.

original:
<T>Don't open your gob when you ain't got
a clue what you're on about, love.
translation:
<T>Ne dedigini bilmiyorsan
agzini acma, canim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You're one of them tomboys, ain't you?
Can't stand 'em.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sen su erkek fatmalardan birisin, degil mi?
Hic haz etmem.

original:
<T>A woman who ain't brainy ain't worth my
time, that's what I say. Bet you can't even
solve this puzzle.
translation:
<T>Zeki olmayan kadina zaman ayirmam,
ben oyle derim. Bahse girerim su bilmeciyi bile
cozemezsin.

original:
<T>Told ya. Come back when you're a bit more
ladylike! Ah ha ha!
translation:
<T>Demistim. Biraz daha
hanimefendi olunca gel! Ah ha ha!

original:
<T><M2/1/7>My...<W> It's a wonder Mrs Ledore hasn't fallen
for your charms.
translation:
<T><M2/1/7>Vay...<W> Bayan Ledore cazibene kanmamis,
sasilir dogrusu.

original:
<T>Come back to solve my puzzle, 'ave you,
princess?
translation:
<T>Bilmecemi cozmeye mi geldin,
prenses?

original:
<T>See? I told-<W> Wait! You solved it?!<W> I've been
trying to work that out for weeks!
translation:
<T>Gordun mu? Demis-<W> Dur! Cozdun mu?!<W> Ben de
haftalardir onunla ugrasiyordum!

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Maybe if you spent less time being insulting
to strangers, you'd solve a puzzle or two.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Yabancilara hakaret etmeye daha az vakit ayirsan,
belki bir-iki bilmece cozerdin.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Eh heh heh! A brainy tomboy with a big gob!
You'll never be no Angela Ledore, but I like
your style.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Eh heh heh! Koca agizli, zeki bir erkek fatma!
Asla Angela Ledore olamazsin ama
tarzini sevdim.

original:
<T>Old Ledore's out the house for so long, you
never know what he's up to. Not that I'm
keeping track or nothing...
translation:
<T>Ihtiyar Ledore o kadar uzun sure evden uzak kaliyor ki
neyin pesinde oldugunu bilemezsin. Yani ben
takip ediyormusum gibi degil tabii...

original: ラプンシュカ

<T>Well, look who's back! How are you liking
Monte d'Or?
translation:
<T>Bakin kim geri donmus! Monte d'Or'u
nasil buluyorsunuz?

original: レイトン

<T>Our investigation is proceeding quite
smoothly. Thanks for your help, madam.
translation:
<T>Sorusturmamiz oldukca
sorunsuz ilerliyor. Yardiminiz icin tesekkurler, hanimefendi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Well, you're bound to be doing better than
the police. They can't see the forest for
the trees.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Suphesiz polisten daha iyi gidiyorsunuz.
Onlar agaclardan
ormani goremiyor.

original:
<T>This is the thing, see. You've got a fresh
perspective as tourists. You might be able
to pick up on clues they missed.
translation:
<T>Soyle ki. Turist oldugunuz icin
taze bir bakis aciniz var. Onlarin kacirdigi
ipuclarini yakalayabilirsiniz.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/30>A fresh perspective as tourists... <W>You mean
by solving puzzles and gathering hint coins?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/30>Turist olarak taze bir bakis... <W>Yani
bulmacalari cozmek ve ipucu parasi toplamak mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Heavens, no. I mean do what normal
tourists do: have fun! Mingle in the crowd,
go to the races, play at the funfair!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aman hayir. Normal turistlerin yaptigi gibi
yapin: eglenin! Kalabaliga karisin,
yarislara gidin, lunaparkta oynayin!

original: ルーク

<T><M3/2/5>Can we really do all that and still keep
investigating?
translation:
<T><M3/2/5>Bunlarin hepsini yapip yine de
sorusturmaya devam edebilir miyiz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>The Masked Gentleman is targeting the
masses, so your best bet is to seek out
the popular attractions.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Maskeli Bey kalabaligi hedef aliyor,
bu yuzden en iyisi
populer yerlerin pesine dusmek.

original: <T><M2/2/5>That makes sense...<W15>I think.
translation: <T><M2/2/5>Mantikli...<W15>sanirim.

original:
<T>Go and explore the city, visit the popular
spots! It's as good a plan as any to find
clues on your case.
translation:
<T>Gidin, sehri kesfedin; populer
yerleri ziyaret edin! Davanizla ilgili
ipuclari bulmak icin en az digerleri kadar iyi bir plan.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>And when it's all over, you can relax and
just enjoy yourselves.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ve her sey bittiginde
rahatlar, sadece keyfinize bakarsiniz.

original: セレナ

<T>The Masked Dandleman is the talk of the
town! Have you seen what he can do? It's
amazible!
translation:
<T>Maskeli Dandleman sehrin dilinde!
Neler yapabildigini gordunuz mu? Tam bir
amazible!

original:
<T>I hope I get to meet him. I took the bus all
the way from Ipsthorpe just to see one of
his miracles with my own eyes.
translation:
<T>Onunla tanismayi umuyorum. Ipsthorpe'tan otobusle
ta buralara, mucizelerinden birini kendi gozlerimle gormek icin
geldim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Bet you'd like to meet him too, right? He's
so wonderfabulant! Look, I've even made a
spectificent puzzle for him!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sen de onunla tanismak istersin, degil mi? O
cok wonderfabulant! Bak, onun icin
spectificent bir bilmece bile yaptim!

original: <T>You can't solve it? Imposterous!
translation: <T>Cozemiyor musun? Imposterous!

original:
<T>Solve my puzzle and you'll be just as
amazible as the Masked Dandleman!
translation:
<T>Bilmecemi cozersen
Maskeli Dandleman kadar amazible olursun!

original:
<T>Wonderfabulant! How did you manage that?
You must be really intelligible!
translation:
<T>Wonderfabulant! Bunu nasil basardin?
Gercekten cok intelligible olmalisin!

original: レミ

<T><M3/1/1>So, er, Serena. You're hoping to see the
Masked Gentleman, right? Aren't you afraid
after what he did yesterday?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yani, ee, Serena. Maskeli Beyefendi'yi gormek istiyorsun,
oyle mi? Dun yaptiklarindan sonra korkmuyor musun?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>What do you mean? I'd love a statue of
myself, even if I have to be terrified to
stalagminium for it!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ne demek istiyorsun? Kendi heykelime bayilirim;
bunun icin korkudan stalagminiuma donusmem gerekse bile!

original:
<T>Wherever there's a miracle, you can
guaranfirm I'll be at the front of the queue
to see it.
translation:
<T>Nerede bir mucize varsa,
guaranfirm ederim ki gormek icin siranin en onunde
ben olurum.

original:
<T><M5/1/3>You do know it's not really a show, don't
you? He's dangerous.
translation:
<T><M5/1/3>Bunun aslinda bir gosteri olmadigini biliyorsun,
degil mi? O tehlikeli.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Oh yes, absotively. The Masked Dandleman
is real. That's what makes him so
thrillerating!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ah evet, absotively. Maskeli Dandleman
gercek. Onu bu kadar
thrillerating yapan da bu!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Serena, meeting the Masked Gentleman is
no more {''}thrillerating{''} than losing your life
savings in a casino.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Serena, Maskeli Beyefendi ile karsilasmak
kumarhanede tum birikimini kaybetmekten daha
{''}thrillerating{''} degil.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>What do you mean? Have you seen the
Masked Dandleman in a casino?! Well,
I know where I'll be going tonight!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ne demek istiyorsun? Maskeli
Dandleman'i kumarhanede mi gordun?!
O zaman bu gece nereye gidecegimi biliyorum!

original:
<T>At night, there are spardiant, brinkling lights
everywhere! Makes me feel like a star, like a
famous celery!
translation:
<T>Geceleri her yerde spardiant, brinkling isiklar
var! Kendimi bir yildiz gibi, unlu bir
kereviz gibi hissediyorum!

original: ユーミン

<T>Hey, it's you again, with the top hat! You
look quite the gentleman, I must say.
translation:
<T>Hey, yine siz! O silindir sapkali! Dogrusu
tam bir beyefendiye benziyorsunuz.

original: レイトン

<T><M3/1/1>Why, thank you, miss. I strive to be one in
actuality, not merely in dress.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Naziksiniz bayan. Sadece kiyafetimle degil,
gercekte de oyle olmaya calisirim.

original:
<T>I've heard you gentlemanly types just love
a bit of mystery. Is that true? May I test
you?
translation:
<T>Duyduguma gore siz beyefendi tipleri
biraz gizemi cok seversiniz. Dogru mu? Sizi
test edebilir miyim?

original: <T>Oh, perhaps I was mistaken. Never mind.
translation: <T>Ah, belki de yanilmisim. Bos verin.

original: <T>You do like puzzles, don't you?
translation: <T>Bulmacalari seviyorsunuz, degil mi?

original:
<T>Just as I thought! Gentlemen and puzzles go
together like Brie and grapes.
translation:
<T>Tahmin ettigim gibi! Beyefendilerle bulmacalar
Brie peyniriyle uzum gibi yakisir.

original:
<T>So, the latest incident has thrust us into the
realms of mythology now? Does our masked
man have snakes for hair, by any chance?
translation:
<T>Demek son olay bizi mitolojinin
diyarina da surukledi ha? Maskeli adamin
saclari yilanlardan mi olusuyor yoksa?

original:
<T>He claimed to be performing some sort of
miracle. <W><M4/1/1>But I for one do not believe in
spontaneous petrification.
translation:
<T>Bir tur mucize gerceklestirdigini
iddia etti. <W><M4/1/1>Ama ben kendiliginden
tas kesilmeye inanmiyorum.

original:
<T>Well, that's for the police to find out, really,
isn't it?
translation:
<T>Eh, bunu aslinda polisin
cozmesi gerek, degil mi?

original:
<T>On the other hand, you do seem to know
what you're doing, which is more than we
can say for the local constabulary.
translation:
<T>Ote yandan, ne yaptiginizi biliyor
gibisiniz; yerel polis icin
bunu soyleyemeyiz.

original:
<T>All right. I trust you'll be able to catch the
Masked Gentleman before the entire city
gets turned to stone?
translation:
<T>Peki. Tum sehir tasa donmeden once
Maskeli Bey'i yakalayabileceginize
inaniyorum, degil mi?

original: <T><M2/1/1>Well, I intend to do the best I can.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Elimden gelenin en iyisini yapmaya niyetliyim.

original: <T>Excellent! I'll let you get to it then.
translation: <T>Mukemmel! O zaman sizi isinize birakayim.

original:
<T>You must tell me where you picked up your
hat. It just suits you so well.
translation:
<T>Sapkanizi nereden aldiginizi mutlaka soyleyin.
Size cok yakismis.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>We have to find your mummy before we do
anything else. Mr Waltham said she might be
on Celebration Boulevard!
translation:
<T>Baska bir sey yapmadan once anneni bulmaliyiz.
Bay Waltham onun Kutlama Bulvari'nda
olabilecegini soyledi!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>The gallery isn't open to the public yet. No
doubt the police are still at work in there.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Galeri henuz halka acik degil. Polis
muhtemelen hala iceride calisiyordur.

original: マカロン
translation: Makaron

original:
<T>Me mam was upset 'cause we didn't get to
see all the nice stuff in there.
translation:
<T>Annem, icerideki guzel seylerin
hepsini goremedigimiz icin uzgundu.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T>I can't imagine they'll have it closed for
much longer.
translation:
<T>Bu kadar uzun sure kapali
tutacaklarini sanmiyorum.

original:
<T>Maybe it'll be open tomorrah?<W> Orrr...the day
aftah tomorrah?
translation:
<T>Belki yarin acilir?<W> Ya daaa...yarindan
sonraki gun?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>It depends on what the police find,
I suppose. Let's try again later.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Sanirim polisin ne bulacagina
bagli. Daha sonra tekrar deneyelim.

original: ヌーデン

<T>Ah, we meet again, Professor Layton! What
are the chances?
translation:
<T>Ah, yine karsilastik, Profesor Layton! Ne
buyuk tesaduf!

original: レイトン

<T>Hello there, Mr Mordaunt. Out running
errands, are you?
translation:
<T>Merhaba, Bay Mordaunt. Disarida
islerinizi mi hallediyorsunuz?

original:
<T>Something like that. I've just been to
examine the scene of last night's incident.
translation:
<T>Onun gibi bir sey. Az once
dunku gecenin olay yerini incelemeye gittim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But to be frank, I've turned up nothing at
all! I don't seem to have much talent for
detective work... Was it really magic?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama durust olayim, hicbir sey bulamadim!
Dedektiflik isinde pek yetenegim yok
galiba... Gercekten sihir miydi?

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>We can't entirely rule out that possibility,
but it's far more likely that some sort of
trick was involved.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Bu ihtimali tamamen goz ardi edemeyiz,
ama buyuk ihtimalle bir tur
hile soz konusuydu.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>So it seems, so it seems! By the way, I see
your party has gained a member since last
night.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Oyle gorunuyor, oyle gorunuyor! Bu arada,
ekibinizin dun geceden beri
bir uye kazandigini goruyorum.

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Ah yes, this would be...
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Ah evet, bu da...

original: マカロン

<T>Bonnie! I'm lost!<W> Well, me mam's lost.
We're tryin' to find her!
translation:
<T>Bonnie! Kayboldum!<W> Yani annem kayboldu.
Onu bulmaya calisiyoruz!

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>You wouldn't happen to have seen a
red-haired woman dressed in purple in
the vicinity, would you?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Bu civarda mor giyinmis
kizil sacli bir kadin
gormus olamaz misiniz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Funny you should ask, really! I saw precisely
such a woman on Celebration Boulevard
just now.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ne tesaduf ki soruyorsunuz! Az once
Kutlama Bulvari'nda tam da
oyle bir kadin gordum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>She was asking around after a child too.
I don't expect that's a coincidence!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>O da bir cocugu sorup duruyordu.
Bunun tesaduf oldugunu sanmiyorum!

original:
<T>Cheers, mistah knobbly heed! You'd make a
propah good detective, like!
translation:
<T>Sag ol, yumrulu kafali bayim! Sen
harbi iyi bir dedektif olursun!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh! My first solved case! Well, I hope you
find your mother soon. Ta-ta!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh! Ilk cozdugum vaka! Umarim
annenizi yakinda bulursunuz. Hosca kalin!

original: <T>Buh-bye!
translation: <T>Gule gule!

original: コッペリア

<T><M1/2/1>Hullo! Isn't today just luverly? It's so
peaceful compared to yesterday! And
hey - we've got a full 'ouse again!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Selam! Bugun ne kadar da guzel, degil mi?
Dune gore cok daha sakin! Hem
bak - mekan yine tiklim tiklim!

original: レイトン

<T>Things have certainly calmed down. It never
ceases to amaze me how quickly people will
adapt.
translation:
<T>Ortalik kesinlikle sakinlesti. Insanlarin ne kadar cabuk uyum sagladigina
her seferinde sasiriyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh, it's always like this. <W>The masked geezer
kicks up a right fuss, then the next day it's
like nothing ever 'appened.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah, hep boyle olur. <W>Maskeli herif
bir kiyamet koparir, ertesi gun de
sanki hicbir sey olmamis gibi olur.

original:
<T>I do worry, though. Like, what if one day
something really terrible 'appens and we
can't go back to normal?
translation:
<T>Yine de endiseleniyorum. Ya bir gun
gercekten korkunc bir sey olur da
normale donemeyebilirsek?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/30>I intend to catch the Masked Gentleman
before it comes to that.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/30>Buna gelmeden Maskeli Beyefendi'yi
yakalamayi dusunuyorum.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>'Ang on, I didn't mean to set the tone so
grim...<W> 'Ere's an idea. A puzzle to brighten
the mood!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Dur bi'... Havayi bu kadar
kasvetli yapmak istemedim...<W> Bir fikrim var. Morali yukseltecek
bir bilmece!

original:
<T>Oops. Well, I just 'ad to try something
before we all ended up like a bunch of
moody Mandies.
translation:
<T>Hoppala. Neyse, bir sey denemem gerekiyordu,
yoksa hepimiz surat asan bir
topluga donecektik.

original:
<T>Oh, that puzzle! It'll cheer you up right as
rain.
translation:
<T>Ah, o bilmece! Neseni
sip diye yerine getirir.

original:
<T>I'm trying, really I am. But I can't stop
thinking that the future's all doom and
gloom.
translation:
<T>Deniyorum, gercekten. Ama gelecegin hep felaket ve
karanlik olacagini dusunmeden edemiyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh yeah, a little bird told me that some of
the city bigwigs went and had a gander at
the scene of the trouble.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ha evet, kucuk bir kus bana sehirdeki bazi
buyuklerin gidip olay yerini soyle bir inceledigini
soyledi.

original: <T><M2/2/1/30><K>Hmm... </K>Was Mr Ledore among them?
translation: <T><M2/2/1/30><K>Hmm... </K>Bay Ledore da onlarin arasinda miydi?

original:
<T>Yeah, I think so. They were all trying to
pretend like everything's fine, but they
looked pretty uptight to me.
translation:
<T>Evet, sanirim. Her sey yolundaymis gibi davranmaya
calisiyorlardi ama bana
bayagi gergin gorunduler.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>They were 'aving a bit of a barney at one
point. Trying to pin the blame on each
other, sounded like.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bir ara epey tartisiyorlardi.
Sucu birbirlerinin ustune yikmaya
calisiyor gibiydiler.

original: <T><M5/2/1/30>Oh? Are they not on good terms, then?
translation: <T><M5/2/1/30>Oyle mi? Demek aralari iyi degil?

original:
<T>You could say that. Anyway, I don't care
whose fault it is as long as they catch the
Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Oyle denebilir. Neyse, kimin sucu oldugu umurumda degil;
yeter ki Maskeli Beyefendi'yi yakalasinlar.

original:
<T>Everyone ran off quick as you like when the
incident 'appened, but now it's as peaceful
as peaceful can be.
translation:
<T>Olay oldugunda herkes isik hiziyla kacisti ama simdi ortalik
olabildigince sakin.

original: ポリス

<T>All right, son. You're going to have to move
a few steps to the left. We had a little
happening here last night.
translation:
<T>Peki, evlat. Birkac adim sola gecmen gerekecek.
Dun gece burada kucuk bir olay
yasandi.

original: ルーク

<T><M4/2/5>You can't have been investigating the whole
night, surely?!
translation:
<T><M4/2/5>Butun gece boyunca sorusturma yapmis olamazsiniz,
degil mi?!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Eh? What are you on about?<W> Oh, are you
mixing me up with one of my fellow
officers? We're not all the same person.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ha? Neden bahsediyorsun?<W> Yoksa beni
meslektaslarimdan biriyle mi karistirdin?
Hepimiz ayni kisi degiliz.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>What? But you look just like... You've even
got the same nose!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Ne? Ama tipki...
Hatta burnunuz bile ayni!

original: レイトン

<T>Luke, leave the officer to his work.<W> Though,
the resemblance is uncanny...
translation:
<T>Luke, memuru isine birak.<W> Gerci,
benzerlik gercekten urkutucu...

original:
<T>On the outside, maybe. You can't tell from
my face, but I'm the most disciplined officer
on the force. I train the hardest!
translation:
<T>Disaridan oyle gorunebilir. Yuzumden anlayamazsiniz ama
teskilattaki en disiplinli memur benim.
En cok ben calisirim!

original:
<T>I train harder than anyone else on the force.
In fact, I'm training my neck muscles right
now.
translation:
<T>Teskilatta herkesten daha cok calisirim.
Hatta su anda boyun kaslarimi calistiriyorum.

original:
<T>Give this some thought. Otherwise you'll
never be able to see past our uniforms and
tell us apart.
translation:
<T>Biraz dusunun de, aksi halde
uniformalarimizin otesini goremez ve
bizi ayirt edemezsiniz.

original:
<T>Impressive. From the way you solved that
puzzle, I take it you're not here for pleasure,
then?
translation:
<T>Etkileyici. O bilmeceyi cozusunden anladigim kadariyla,
buraya eglenmeye gelmemissiniz,
oyle mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Maybe you know something concerning last
night's incident, hm?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Dun geceki olayla ilgili bir sey biliyor olabilir misiniz,
hm?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/30>Well, we were at the scene, but I doubt we
can tell you anything you don't already
know about the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/30>Biz olay yerindeydik ama Maskeli Beyefendi hakkinda
sizin zaten bildiklerinizden farkli bir sey soyleyebilecegimizi
sanmiyorum.

original:
<T>The carnival was in full swing. What kind of
villain pulls tricks in a street full of
defenceless civilians?
translation:
<T>Karnaval tum hiziyla suruyordu. Savunmasiz sivillerle dolu bir sokakta
hangi tur kotu adam numara yapar ki?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Because of him and his shenanigans, I've
been late home every single night. Wife's
worried sick about me.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Onun yuzunden ve yaptigi sacmaliklar yuzunden,
her gece eve gec kaliyorum. Esim
benim icin endiseden kahroluyor.

original:
<T>We were supposed to be out enjoying the
celebrations, too.
translation: <T>Bizim de disarida olup kutlamalarin tadini cikarmamiz gerekiyordu.

original:
<T>Ahh, and I was really looking forward to
having some candyfloss...
translation: <T>Ahh, bir de pamuk seker yemeyi dort gozle bekliyordum...

original: <T><M3/2/2>Sounds like you need a rest!
translation: <T><M3/2/2>Dinlenmeye ihtiyaciniz var gibi!

original:
<T><M5/2/1>I've heard there have been very few leads
as of yet.
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Su ana kadar cok az ipucu bulundugunu duydum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>They've organised a special task force, but
no one knows who's in charge of what at
the moment.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ozel bir gorev gucu kurdular ama
su an kimin neyden sorumlu oldugunu
kimse bilmiyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Well, if we find anything useful, we'll be sure
to inform the police.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Eger ise yarar bir sey bulursak, mutlaka
polise bildiririz.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Much appreciated. The sooner I can sink my
teeth into a toffee apple, the better.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Cok makbule gecer. Ne kadar cabuk elma sekere
disimi gecirebilirsem, o kadar iyi.

original:
<T>It's hopeless investigating the area with all
these people milling about.
translation: <T>Bunca insan etrafta dolanirken bolgeyi arastirmak imkansiz.

original:
<T>I really wish I could ignore that smell of
chocolate roasted peanuts too...
translation: <T>Keske cikolatali kavrulmus fistik kokusunu da gormezden gelebilsem...

original: ヤッタイ

<T>Step right up! Jean-Paul's toys are the best
in town! You want it? We've got it!
translation:
<T>Yaklasin! Jean-Paul'un oyuncaklari
sehirdeki en iyisi! Istiyorsaniz bizde var!

original:
<T>Bears, dinosaurs, rabbits, piggies! Cars,
and tractors and thingamajiggies!
translation:
<T>Ayilar, dinozorlar, tavsanlar, domuzcuklar! Arabalar,
traktorler ve daha neler neler!

original: レイトン
<T><M3/1/1>Hello, Jean-Paul.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Merhaba, Jean-Paul.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Ah, aren't you Emmy's friend? How are
you enjoying Monte d'Or?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ah, sen Emmy'nin arkadasi degil misin? Monte d'Or'u
nasil buluyorsunuz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Very well, thank you. And Luke is taking
good care of the robot you gave us.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Cok iyi, tesekkur ederim. Luke da bize verdiginiz
robota cok iyi bakiyor.

original:
<T>Glad to hear it! I can't really give you
another toy, but how about a puzzle
instead?
translation:
<T>Bunu duyduguma sevindim! Size
bir oyuncak daha veremem ama
onun yerine bir bulmaca ne dersiniz?

original:
<T>I thought you'd be a puzzle lover, but
maybe you're just a different sort from
Emmy.
translation:
<T>Bulmaca sever sanmistim ama
belki de Emmy'den
farkli bir tarziniz vardir.

original: <T>I knew you'd come back!
translation: <T>Geri doneceginizi biliyordum!

original:
<T>Hah! I knew you'd like that. I've got goodies
for everyone, even those who are too old
for toys.
translation:
<T>Hah! Begeneceginizi biliyordum. Herkes icin
hediyelerim var; oyuncak icin
yasi gecmis olanlar bile.

original: <T><M2/1/1>That was a fine puzzle. Thank you.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Guzel bir bulmacaydi. Tesekkur ederim.

original: ルーク

<T><M2/1/4>Hey, Professor, did you notice that
Jean-Paul doesn't talk the same way to us
as he does to Emmy?
translation:
<T><M2/1/4>Hey, Profesor, fark ettiniz mi,
Jean-Paul bize Emmy'ye konustugu
gibi konusmuyor.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Yes, Luke, I did. But let's not mention that
to Emmy, shall we? We wouldn't want to
embarrass her.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Evet Luke, fark ettim. Ama bunu
Emmy'ye soylemeyelim, olur mu? Onu
utandirmak istemeyiz.

original:
<T>Step right up! Don't be shy! Jean-Paul's
toys don't bite! <W30>At least most of them don't.
translation:
<T>Yaklasin! Cekinmeyin! Jean-Paul'un
oyuncaklari isirmaz! <W30>En azindan cogu isirmaz.

original: タニア

<T>Eee... Where'd that bairn get off to this
time?
translation: <T>Eee... Bu sefer o velet nereye kacti acaba?

original: <T>I look away for one second...
translation: <T>Bir saniye gozumu ayiriyorum...

original: マカロン
<T>Mammy!
translation: <T>Annecigim!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Aw, wey aye! Bonnie! Where've ya been?
Didn't I tell ya to stay close?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ah, hadi canim! Bonnie! Neredeydin?
Yakinimda kalmani soylemedim mi?

original:
<T>I was talkin' to the clown and, then, when
I turned round, I couldn't see ya! We looked
al' ower for ya, Mammy!
translation:
<T>Palyacoyla konusuyordum da, sonra donunce
seni goremedim! Seni her yerde aradik,
anne!

original: レイトン

<T>Ah yes, we bumped into your daughter again
a little way back...
translation:
<T>Ah evet, az once kizinizla yine karsilastik...
soyle biraz ileride...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Eee, thank you soooo much, pet. I'm really
sorry for botherin' ya again. She can be a
reet pain sometimes.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Eee, cooook tesekkur ederim, canim. Gercekten
yine sizi rahatsiz ettigim icin uzgunum. Bazen
tam bir bas belasi olabiliyor.

original: <T>Cheers, mistah!
translation: <T>Sag olun, beyim!

original: レミ

<T>That Bonnie seems to be quite the little
explorer! Maybe she'll grow up to be an
archaeologist.
translation:
<T>Bonnie tam bir kucuk
kasif gibi gorunuyor! Belki buyuyunce
arkeolog olur.

original: ルーク

<T><M2/1/1>I once lost my parents in the middle of
London when I was, um...younger. I know
how it feels!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ben de bir zamanlar, sey... daha kucukken
Londra'nin ortasinda ailemi kaybetmistim. Nasil bir sey oldugunu
biliyorum!

original:
<T><M4/2/3>Oh, yes? Weren't you in London just the
other week?
translation:
<T><M4/2/3>Oyle mi? Daha gecen hafta Londra'da
degil miydin?

original:
<T><M2/1/4>That's different! Anyway, I decided to go
and have a look at one of the maps in the
street, and there they were!
translation:
<T><M2/1/4>O baska! Neyse, sokaktaki haritalardan birine bakmaya karar verdim,
bir de ne goreyim, oradaydilar!

original:
<T><M7/1/1>Now that we've solved this little case, let's
hurry on to the Ledores'.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Bu kucuk vakayi da cozdugumuze gore,
hadi Ledore'lara acele edelim.

original:
<T>Thank you sooo much for findin' me little
Bonnie again.
translation:
<T>Kucuk Bonnie'mi yine
buldugunuz icin cooook tesekkur ederim.

original:
<T>Aye! Cheers, mistah! And to the mistah in
the blue hat 'n' all!
translation:
<T>Evet! Sag olun, beyim! Mavi sapkali beyefendiye de
hepinize de!

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original:
<T>Hershel! It's good to see you again. I'm
sorry, but Henry had to go out rather
suddenly.
translation:
<T>Hershel! Seni yeniden gormek guzel. Uzgunum
ama Henry oldukca ani bir sekilde disari
cikmak zorunda kaldi.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>He asked me to show you into his study,
though. Please, spend as long as you like.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Ama sizi calisma odasina almami istedi.
Lutfen istediginiz kadar kalin.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Thank you, Angela.<W> Is everything all right?
translation: <T>Tesekkurler, Angela.<W> Her sey yolunda mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Oh yes, just some business in town, I
expect.<W> Shall we, Hershel? Henry's study
is this way.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Oh evet, sanirim sehirde biraz isi var,
oyle.<W> Gidelim mi, Hershel? Henry'nin calisma odasi
bu tarafta.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Of course. Please convey my thanks to
Henry. I'm sorry to have missed him today.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Elbette. Lutfen Henry'ye tesekkurlerimi
ilet. Bugun onu kacirdigim icin uzgunum.

original:
<T><M8/1/1>I know, and I'm sorry too. It's just that
things have been a bit hectic for Henry since
the Masked Gentleman appeared.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Biliyorum, ben de uzgunum. Sadece,
Maskeli Beyefendi ortaya ciktigindan beri
Henry icin isler biraz karisik.

original:
<T>Between dealing with the police and trying
to appease the business owners, he hasn't
had a moment to himself.
translation:
<T>Polisle ugrasmak ve
esnafi yatistirmaya calismak arasinda,
kendine ayiracak bir ani bile olmadi.
