original: <T>Henry's study is this way.
translation: <T>Henry'nin calisma odasi bu tarafta.

original: レミ

<T><M3/2/1>Oh my, what a beautiful study! Rows of
books and not a speck of dust!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Aman Tanrim, ne guzel bir calisma odasi! Sira sira
kitaplar ve zerre kadar toz yok!

original: シャロア

<T><M7/2/2>Yes. Henry is rather<W10>.<W10>.<W10>.<W30>fastidious about
cleaning. It's what he does to relax.
translation:
<T><M7/2/2>Evet. Henry temizlik konusunda oldukca<W10>.<W10>.<W10>.<W30>titizdir.
Bu onun rahatlama sekli.

original: <T><M5/1/1>...<W>That's a very industrious way to relax.
translation: <T><M5/1/1>...<W>Bu, rahatlamak icin epey uretken bir yol.

original: レイトン

<T>This is quite a large home to maintain. Do
you have any help?
translation:
<T>Burasi bakimi icin oldukca buyuk bir ev. Size
yardim eden biri var mi?

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Oh, Henry does most of the work. <W>Whenever
he gets anxious, well...<W>he likes to be
productive.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Oh, islerin cogunu Henry yapar. <W>Ne zaman
endiselense, sey...<W>uretken olmayi
sever.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>He must have a lot of anxiety in his life. <W>Is it
true that he built Monte d'Or from nothing?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hayatinda epey endise olmali. <W>Monte d'Or'u
yoktan var ettigi dogru mu?

original:
<T><M7/1/1>Oh yes. Henry is quite remarkable like that.
Always has been, especially since Randall...
Ah...
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Ah evet. Henry bu konuda gercekten olaganustudur.
Hep oyleydi, ozellikle de Randall'dan beri...
Ah...

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Please excuse me. Feel free to examine the
study as much as you like. I'll be here if you
have any questions.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Lutfen beni mazur gorun. Istediginiz kadar
calisma odasini inceleyin. Sorunuz olursa
buradayim.

original: シャロア
translation: Saroa

original:
<T>Have you already finished with your
investigation, Hershel?
translation:
<T>Arastirmani simdiden bitirdin mi,
Hershel?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Not quite. Please allow us a little more time.
translation: <T>Henuz degil. Lutfen bize biraz daha zaman taniyin.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M2/2/1>The desk looks untouched.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Masa hic dokunulmamis gibi gorunuyor.

original: シャロア
translation: Saroa

original:
<T>I used to see Henry sitting at that desk for
hours. <W>Though, not in recent days.
translation:
<T>Henry'yi o masada
saatlerce otururken gorurdum. <W>Ama son gunlerde degil.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>So Henry would spend a lot of time working
in here?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Demek Henry burada uzun sure
calisirdi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Sometimes working. Other times he'd just be
poring over that mask. That awful mask.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bazen calisirdi. Bazense sadece
o maskeye dalip giderdi. Su korkunc maske.

original:
<T><M7/1/1>I wish Randall had never found that cursed
mask. That thing tore us apart! You, me,
Randall...
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Keske Randall o lanetli
maskeyi hic bulmasaydi. O sey bizi parcaladi! Sen, ben,
Randall...

original:
<T><M8/1/1/45>But now it seems the mask has brought us
together again. Funny, isn't it?
translation:
<T><M8/1/1/45>Ama simdi maske sanki bizi
yeniden bir araya getirdi. Komik degil mi?

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>A mask that can bring both joy and sorrow...
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Hem sevinc hem keder getirebilen bir maske...

original:
<T>It acted as a catalyst both for Randall's
misfortune and Henry's success.
translation:
<T>Randall'in
talihsizligi ve Henry'nin basarisi icin bir katalizor oldu.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Is it true that Monte d'Or would not exist
today had Henry not found the mask and
the treasure?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Henry maskeyi ve
hazineyi bulmasaydi, Monte d'Or bugun
var olmazdi, degil mi?

original: <T><M1/1/1>Yes... You could say that.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Evet... Oyle denebilir.

original:
<T>Henry used his newfound fortune to open
a small inn out here in the middle of the
desert.
translation:
<T>Henry yeni buldugu servetle
colun ortasinda, burada
kucuk bir han acti.

original:
<T><M7/1/1>It was a modest place to begin with, but it
didn't stay that way for long...
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Basta mutevazi bir yerdi ama
uzun sure oyle kalmadi...

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>People streamed in: explorers, entrepreneurs
and soon tourists... The inn had to be
extended, then remodelled.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Insanlar akin etti: kasifler, girisimciler
ve kisa sure sonra turistler... Hani
buyutmek, sonra da yenilemek zorunda kaldik.

original:
<T>Henry's little hotel project became an
astonishing success.
translation:
<T>Henry'nin kucuk otel projesi
sasirtici bir basariya donustu.

original:
<T><M8/1/1>And the rest is history. Monte d'Or
flourished and became what it is today.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Gerisi malum. Monte d'Or
serpilip buyudu ve bugun oldugu hale geldi.

original:
<T><M3/2/5>I still find it amazing that this city was just
one little hotel 18 years ago...
translation:
<T><M3/2/5>Bu sehrin 18 yil once
sadece kucuk bir otel olmasina hala sasiriyorum...

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Henry credits the existence of Monte d'Or to
the Mask of Chaos.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Henry, Monte d'Or'un varligini
Kaos Maskesi'ne bagliyor.

original:
<T><M7/1/1>That mask has changed so many lives, in so
many ways.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>O maske, pek cok hayati, pek
cok yonden degistirdi.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Say, Mrs Le- <W30>Angela? Does the Mask of
Chaos really have magical powers?
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Sey, Bayan Le- <W30>Angela? Kaos Maskesi'nin
gercekten buyulu gucleri var mi?

original:
<T><M8/1/1>The person who stole it certainly seems to
think so.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Onu calan kisi kesinlikle
oyle dusunuyor gibi gorunuyor.

original:
<T>Yes, I'm very interested in the culprit's
motives.
translation:
<T>Evet, suclunun
niyetleriyle cok ilgileniyorum.

original:
<T>I have a feeling everything will fall into place
once we unmask our thief.
translation:
<T>Hirsizin maskesini dusurdugumuzde
her seyin yerine oturacagini hissediyorum.

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Who is the Masked Gentleman and what
does he want?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Maskeli Beyefendi kim ve
ne istiyor?

original: <T><M1/1/1>Do you have any theories, Hershel?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Hershel, bir teorin var mi?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Well, I'd hazard that the Masked Gentleman
is most likely someone living here in town.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Sey, Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
muhtemelen kasabada yasayan biri oldugunu dusunuyorum.

original:
<T>He could be an ordinary citizen, hidden
behind the fa{,c}ade of an ordinary existence.
translation:
<T>Siradan bir hayatin fa{,c}ade'i arkasina
saklanan siradan bir vatandas olabilir.

original: <T><M8/1/1>You think so?
translation: <T><M8/1/1>Oyle mi dusunuyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Angela, let me ask you something. Who in
Monte d'Or would benefit from the recent
turmoil?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Angela, sana bir sey sorayim. Kim
Monte d'Or'da son
kargasadan fayda saglar?

original:
<T><M7/1/1>Who? Why, I can't think of anyone here
who would benefit from this madness.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Kim mi? Sey, bu delilikten
fayda saglayacak kimse gelmiyor aklima.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Do you know of anyone with a grudge
against Henry? Anyone you've had financial
disputes with in the past?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Henry'ye kin besleyen birini biliyor musun?
Gecmiste mali
anlasmazlik yasadigin biri?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>The only person I can think of who has
a grudge against Henry is, <W30>well, <W30>Dalston.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Henry'ye kin besledigini dusundugum tek kisi
<W30>sey, <W30>Dalston.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Dalston?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Dalston?

original: <T><M2/2/1>Alphonse Dalston, you mean?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Alphonse Dalston'dan mi bahsediyorsun?

original: <T><M1/2/1>That name sounds familiar...
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Bu isim tanidik geliyor...

original:
<T><M4/2/2>Yes, Hershel, the very same.<W> Dalston was
a friend of ours in Stansbury, Luke.
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Evet, Hershel, ta kendisi.<W> Dalston,
Stansbury'de bizim bir arkadasimizdi, Luke.

original:
<T><M8/1/1>Between them, Dalston and Henry own most
of the businesses in town. They've been
rivals for years.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Dalston ve Henry, kasabadaki isletmelerin coguna
birlikte sahip. Yillardir
rakipler.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I believe they may have had altercations
over the property lines of one or two hotels.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sanirim bir iki otelin arsa sinirlari
uzerinden tartismis olabilirler.

original:
<T><M7/1/1>It wouldn't surprise me if Dalston set out to
sabotage Henry. You know how he is,
Hershel.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Dalston'in Henry'yi
sabotaj etmeye kalkmasina sasirmam. Onun nasil biri oldugunu bilirsin,
Hershel.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Yes, I do. But it doesn't seem like him to
stage such a theatrical display...
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Evet, bilirim. Ama boyle tiyatral bir gosteri
duzenlemek ona pek benzemez...

original:
<T><M8/1/1>Well, there is also the fact that Dalston has
been receiving advance warnings from the
Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Ayrica Dalston'in
Maskeli Beyefendi'den
onceden uyarilar aldigi da var.

original:
<T>And he's the only person in Monte d'Or
besides Henry to have received them.
translation:
<T>Ve onlari alan, Henry'nin disinda
Monte d'Or'daki tek kisi o.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I'd hate to cast aspersions, but isn't it odd
that Dalston has such a link to the Masked
Gentleman?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Suclamak istemem ama
Dalston'in Maskeli
Beyefendi'yle boyle bir bagi olmasi tuhaf degil mi?

original: <T><M3/2/5>That is suspicious, isn't it, Professor?
translation: <T><M3/2/5>Supheli, degil mi Profesor?

original:
<T>It is rather odd.<W> I think it definitely warrants
some investigation.
translation:
<T>Oldukca tuhaf.<W> Kesinlikle
arastirmayi hak ediyor.

original: <T><M4/1/3>Let's go and talk to him, Professor!
translation: <T><M4/1/3>Gidip onunla konusalim, Profesor!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>If you want to see Dalston, his house is just
west of your hotel.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Dalston'i gormek istiyorsan, evi
otelinin hemen batisinda.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Angela, has anyone else been in here
besides you and Henry?
translation:
<T>Angela, buraya
sen ve Henry disinda baska biri girdi mi?

original: シャロア
translation: Saroa

original:
<T><M7/1/1>Normally this is Henry's private space. <W>But
sometimes when he has visitors, he brings
them in here.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Burasi normalde Henry'nin ozel alanidir. <W>Ama
bazen misafirleri oldugunda onlari
buraya getirir.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>Isn't the parlour more comfortable?
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Salon daha rahat degil mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Oh yes. The study is only for important
guests...<W>or when he doesn't want me to
overhear.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Elbette. Calisma odasi yalnizca onemli
misafirler icindir...<W>ya da benim
duymami istemedigi zamanlarda.

original:
<T>So no one is ever in this room without Henry
being here as well, correct?
translation:
<T>Yani Henry de burada olmadan bu odada
kimse bulunmaz, dogru mu?

original:
<T><M8/1/1>Yes. I don't think a guest could have stolen
it. Not that we've had many of late.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Evet. Bir misafirin onu calmis olabilecegini
sanmiyorum. Zaten son zamanlarda pek misafirimiz de yok.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We keep the doors locked at all times, so
whoever stole the mask must have come in
through a window.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Kapilari her zaman kilitli tutariz, bu yuzden
maskeyi calan her kimse iceri
pencereden girmis olmali.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>You'd have to be pretty nimble to get
through a window. That would fit the
Masked Gentleman's style.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Pencereden girebilmek icin oldukca cevik
olmak gerekir. Bu, Mucize Beyefendi'nin
tarzina uyuyor.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Yes. I wonder what kind of person would
take the mask...
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Evet. Acaba maskeyi nasil biri
almis olabilir...

original:
<T><M7/1/1>Strange though it may be, Hershel, it seems
that the mask has brought us together
again.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Ne kadar garip olsa da, Hershel, maske sanki
bizi yeniden bir araya getirdi
bir kez daha.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Was the mask locked away in this chest?
translation: <T>Maske bu sandigin icinde kilitli miydi?

original: シャロア
translation: Saroa

original: <T><M8/1/1>No, it was hanging on the wall here.
translation: <T><M8/1/1>Hayir, surada duvarda asiliydi.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/1/1>You had a priceless artefact and you just
left it hanging on the wall?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Paha bicilmez bir eseriniz vardi ve siz onu
oylece duvarda asili mi biraktiniz?

original:
<T><M7/1/1>Why not? This is our home.<W> Henry thought
displaying the mask brought good luck to
Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Neden olmasin? Burasi bizim evimiz.<W> Henry,
maskeyi sergilemenin Monte d'Or'a iyi sans getirdigini
dusunurdu.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>I see. Where were you and Henry when
the mask was stolen?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Anladim. Maske calindiginda sen ve Henry
neredeydiniz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I think we were both at home, but neither of
us saw or heard anything.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sanirim ikimiz de evdeydik ama hicbirimiz
bir sey gormedik ya da duymadik.

original:
<T><M7/1/1/45>And soon after that, the Masked Gentleman
started playing his tricks in town.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Ve kisa sure sonra Mucize Beyefendi
kasabada oyunlarina basladi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Do you have any idea why he would want to
bring harm to the town?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Kasabaya zarar vermek istemesinin sebebine
dair bir fikrin var mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>It could be a disgruntled gambler, someone
who lost some property...or maybe someone
with a personal grudge.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Hosnutsuz bir kumarbaz olabilir, mulk kaybeden
biri... ya da belki de
kisisel kini olan biri.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>It's hard to imagine anyone taking umbrage
with someone as unassuming as Henry,
though. It would have to be about money.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Henry kadar gosterissiz birine birinin
alinmasini hayal etmek zor. Yine de
mesele para olmali.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Whatever the reason, it can't possibly justify
throwing the whole city into chaos!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Sebebi ne olursa olsun, tum sehri kaosa
suruklemeyi asla hakli cikaramaz!

original: <T><M4/2/6>Money can make people do crazy things.
translation: <T><M4/2/6>Para insanlara cilginca seyler yaptirabilir.

original: <T><M3/2/2>But...things this crazy? <W>I don't understand...
translation: <T><M3/2/2>Ama... bu kadar cilginca mi? <W>Anlamiyorum...

<T>I haven't quite worked out how Dalston
and the Masked Gentleman are linked.
translation:
<T>Dalston ile Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
nasil baglantili oldugunu tam cozemedim.

original: ニルス
<T>Hey. How's it going?
translation: <T>Hey. Nasil gidiyor?

original: レイトン
<T><M1/2/1>Very well, thank you. How are you?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Cok iyi, tesekkur ederim. Siz nasilsiniz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Just thinking about stuff. <W>Don't believe in
lively, carefree Monte d'Or. Big power
struggle going on underneath.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Soyle seyler dusunuyorum. <W>Su canli, tasasiz
Monte d'Or masalina inanma. Altta buyuk bir guc
mucadelesi donuyor.

original: <T>Indeed. Do you know any details, then?
translation: <T>Gercekten mi. O halde ayrinti biliyor musunuz?

original:
<T>Possibly. Nothing's free in this world. Except
wishes. Solve this puzzle first. Then we'll
see.
translation:
<T>Belki. Bu dunyada hicbir sey bedava degil. Dilekler
haric. Once su bilmecemi coz. Sonra
bakariz.

original:
<T>You not going to solve this? Hey, no skin
off my back.
translation: <T>Cozmeyecek misin? Hey, bana uyar.

original: <T>Want my info? Solve my puzzle. Simple.
translation: <T>Bilgimi mi istiyorsun? Bilmecemi coz. Basit.

original:
<T>All right then. You solved my puzzle. I'll
spill the beans.
translation: <T>Pekala. Bilmecemi cozdun. Anlatiyorum.

original:
<T>Right, know the Ledores? Heard they built
this town years ago using the booty from
a treasure hunt.
translation:
<T>Tamam, Ledore'lari biliyor musun? Yillar once bir hazine avindan gelen ganimetle
bu kasabayi kurduklarini duydum.

original:
<T>Then you've got Dalston. Built a number of
hotels here over the years. Doing pretty
well.
translation:
<T>Bir de Dalston var. Yillar icinde burada bir suru
otel yapti. Isi de hayli
iyi.

original:
<T>Now some weirdo comes in doing miracles.
All seem to target the Ledore properties.
Catch my drift?
translation:
<T>Simdi de bir tuhaf herif cikip mucizeler yapiyor.
Hepsi de Ledore mulklerini hedef aliyor.
Nereye varmak istedigimi anladin mi?

original:
<T><M5/2/1>If the Ledores lose their business, Dalston
is the first to benefit. Is that what you
mean?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Ledore'lar islerini kaybederse, Dalston
ilk kazanan olur. Bunu mu
demek istiyorsunuz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Spot on! You're sharp, you are. Think about
who's profiting from the chaos, and you'll
find the mastermind.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Aynen oyle! Keskin zekalisin.
Kargasadan kimin kar ettigine bak, arkasindaki beyni
bulursun.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>In other words, you think Alphonse Dalston
is the Masked Gentleman?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Yani Alphonse Dalston'in
Maskeli Beyefendi oldugunu mu dusunuyorsunuz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Maybe. Maybe not. Only the Masked
Gentleman knows. Talk to Dalston, though.
Couldn't hurt.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Belki. Belki de degil. Bunu sadece Maskeli
Beyefendi bilir. Yine de Dalston'la konus.
Zarari olmaz.

original:
<T>Power struggles are bad news. Even the
winners end up losing.
translation:
<T>Guc mucadeleleri hayra alamet degildir. Hatta
kazananlar bile sonunda kaybeder.

original: ハインリヒ
translation: Heinrich

original:
<T>Argh! <W>Never bet on black. NEVER BET ON
BLACK! When will I learn?<W> Looks like beans
on toast all week again...
translation:
<T>Ahh! <W>Siyaha asla bahis yapma. SIYAHA ASLA
BAHIS YAPMA! Ne zaman ogrenecegim?<W> Gorunuse gore butun hafta
fasulye-tost yiyecegim yine...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Excuse me, sir. We are seeking information
on the Masked Gentleman. Could we speak
to you for a moment?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Affedersiniz efendim. Mucize Beyefendi
hakkinda bilgi ariyoruz. Bizimle bir an
konusabilir misiniz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Look, mate, if I knew anything about the
Masked Gentleman, I'd be down at the city
hall collecting my reward.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bak dostum, Mucize Beyefendi hakkinda
bir sey bilseydim simdi belediyede
odulumu aliyor olurdum.

original:
<T>But if I were to bet on it, I'd say he's some
poor blighter who's just down on his luck.
He's not a villain!
translation:
<T>Ama bahis oynasam, derdim ki o sadece
sansi yaver gitmeyen zavalli bir adamdir.
O bir kotu adam degil!

original: <T><M1/2/1>Really?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Gercekten mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Picture this: ordinary bloke gets fleeced in
a casino. He loses everything, because it's
all fixed! It's not his fault!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sunu dusun: siradan bir adam kumarhanede
dolandiriliyor. Cunku her sey
ayarli! Her seyini kaybediyor. Sucu onun degil!

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Are we...still talking about the Masked
Gentleman here?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Biz... hala Mucize
Beyefendi'yi mi konusuyoruz?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Hang on. Do you really think someone
would start turning people to stone just
because he lost a few bets?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bir dakika. Birinin sadece birkac bahis
kaybetti diye insanlari tasa cevirmeye
baslayacagini gercekten mi dusunuyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>It's just a theory, okay? It just doesn't make
any sense that horses would be so... <W>Ah,
forget it.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sadece bir teori, tamam mi? Atlarin bu kadar...
olmasi hic mantikli gelmiyor... <W>Ah,
neyse bos ver.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Wait. What about horses?
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Dur. Atlar ne alaka?

original:
<T>You want to know, do you? Sorry, mate,
nothing's free in this world. You'll have to
solve this puzzle for me first.
translation:
<T>Bilmek istiyorsun ha? Kusura bakma dostum,
bu dunyada bedava hicbir sey yok. Once
su bulmacayi benim icin cozmen gerekecek.

original: <T>Want to try again later? Fine by me.
translation: <T>Sonra tekrar denemek ister misin? Bana uyar.

original: <T>Try it again! I bet you can't do it.
translation: <T>Bir daha dene! Bahse girerim yapamazsin.

original:
<T>First I lose this week's wages, and now I've
got to give up my only useful piece of info
about those stupid miracles...
translation:
<T>Once bu haftaki ucretimi kaybettim, simdi de
su aptal mucizeler hakkinda sahip oldugum
yegane ise yarar bilgiden vazgecmem gerekecek...

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Please, sir. What were you saying about
horses? And how did that relate to the
Masked Gentleman?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Lutfen efendim. Atlar hakkinda ne
diyordunuz? Bunun Mucize
Beyefendi'yle ne ilgisi var?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>All I heard is that around the time he first
turned up, you could make some serious
money selling horses.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Duydugum tek sey, ilk ortaya ciktigi siralarda
at satarak ciddi para
kazanilabildigiydi.

original:
<T>That's all I know. Now if you'll excuse me,
I'm off to check the park benches for loose
change.
translation:
<T>Bildigim bu kadar. Simdi musaadenizle,
park banklarinda bozuk para
aramaya gidiyorum.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Hmm... Why would he think that his
information was valuable? Was he betting
on horse races, as well?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hmm... Bilgisinin neden degerli oldugunu
neden dusundu ki? O da at yarislarina
bahis mi yapiyordu?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/30>Perhaps it has something to do with the
incident in which the Masked Gentleman
turned people into horses.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/30>Belki de Mucize Beyefendi'nin
insanlari ata cevirdigi
olayla ilgilidir.

original:
<T><M3/2/6>Oh, that's right. That was donkey's years
ago...
translation:
<T><M3/2/6>Ah, dogru ya. O, esek yillar
onceydi...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Never bet on red, either. NEVER BET ON
RED! When will I learn?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Kirmiziya da asla bahis yapma. KIRMIZIYA ASLA
BAHIS YAPMA! Ne zaman ogrenecegim?

original:
<T>I had a really nice suit earlier, but I lost it at
the roulette table.<M1/1/1><W> Maybe I should go and try
to win it back again.
translation:
<T>Az once cok sik bir takimim vardi ama onu
rulet masasinda kaybettim.<M1/1/1><W> Belki gidip
yeniden kazanmaya calismaliyim.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Somehow, I don't think going back is a very
good idea...
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Nedense geri donmenin pek iyi bir fikir
oldugunu sanmiyorum...

original:
<T><M4/1/3>You know, there is more to life than making
money.
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Biliyor musun, hayatta para kazanmaktan
daha fazlasi var.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Yeah, in Humbert's case, there's losing it as
well!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Evet, Humbert'in durumunda onu kaybetmek de
var!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>We should find Dalston's home to the west
of here.
translation:
<T>Dalston'in evini buranin batisinda
bulmaliyiz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Aha! This must be the circus. We met the
ringmaster outside our hotel, didn't we?
translation:
<T>Aha! Bu sirk olmali. Otelimizin
disinda sirk muduruyle karsilasmistik, degil mi?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/1>Can we go inside?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Iceri girebilir miyiz?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M5/2/2>Luke, we're not here to have fun! We're in
the middle of our investigation!
translation:
<T><M5/2/2>Luke, eglenmeye gelmedik! Biz
sorusturmanin ortasindayiz!

original: <T><M1/2/2>I-I know that!
translation: <T><M1/2/2>B-Biliyorum!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>This part of town has quite a different feel
to it, doesn't it, Professor?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Sehrin bu kisminin havasi
epey farkli, degil mi Profesor?

original:
<T>Yes. We're on the edge of the desert here.
You can even see part of an old ruin over
there.
translation:
<T>Evet. Burada colun kiyisindayiz.
Surada eski bir harabenin
bir kismini bile gorebilirsin.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Really? Wow.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Gercekten mi? Vay canina.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yes, this entire region of the desert is
dotted with extremely ancient ruins.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet, colun bu bolgesinin tamami
son derece eski harabelerle dolu.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But we are getting distracted. Let's proceed
to Dalston's house.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama dikkatimizi dagitiyoruz. Dalston'in
evine gidelim.

original: パック

<T>Hey, have you been to the circus yet? They
have a tiger. How cool is that?
translation:
<T>Hey, sirke gittin mi hic? Bir kaplanlari var.
Ne kadar havali, degil mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>And they have a magic show. It's way better
than that silly Masked Gentleman's tricks!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Bir de sihir gosterisi var. O aptal Maskeli Beyefendi'nin numaralarindan cok daha iyi!

original: レイトン

<T>So you think the Masked Gentleman does
tricks?
translation:
<T>Yani Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
numara yaptigini mi dusunuyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Of course. There's no such thing as magic,
mister. It's all tricks, no doubt about it.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Tabii ki. Sihir diye bir sey yok,
beyefendi. Hepsi numara, suphe yok.

original: レミ

<T><M5/2/1>Well, there might be more to it than that.
The world is full of mysterious things.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Belki de is bundan daha fazlasidir.
Dunya gizemli seylerle dolu.

original:
<T>Hah! I learnt that there are no puzzles in the
world that can't be solved!
translation:
<T>Hah! Dunyada cozulemeyecek hicbir bilmece
olmadigini ogrendim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It's true. A nice man at our hotel told me
so. <W>Here, I can show you. Have a go at this
one.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Dogru. Oteldeki iyi bir adam soyledi.
<W>Bak, gosterebilirim. Sunu bir dene.

original:
<T>Okay, well... Maybe some puzzles don't
have a solution.
translation:
<T>Peki, sey... Belki de bazi bilmecelerin
cozumu yoktur.

original: <T>Hi again! Want to solve this puzzle?
translation: <T>Yine merhaba! Bu bilmeciyi cozmek ister misin?

original:
<T>Every puzzle can be solved. And every
magic trick can be explained!
translation:
<T>Her bilmece cozulebilir. Ve her
sihir numarasi da aciklanabilir!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But the man from the hotel also said that
the Masked Gentleman's miracles were real!
I don't understand...
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama oteldeki adam da
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin mucizelerinin gercek oldugunu soyledi!
Anlamiyorum...

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Every puzzle may have a solution, but some
of those solutions have to be puzzled out,
I suppose.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Her bilmecenin bir cozumu olabilir, ama sanirim bazi
cozumleri bulmak icin epey kafa yormak gerekir,
diye dusunuyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Wha...? <W>I'm confused. Grown-ups talk about
such difficult stuff sometimes.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ne...? <W>Kafam karisti. Buyukler bazen
cok zor seylerden konusuyor.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>Ha ha, don't worry. I'm sure you'll turn into
a fine puzzle solver when you're older.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Ha ha, merak etme. Buyuyunce
cok iyi bir bilmece cozucu olacagina eminim.

original:
<T>Sometimes I can't understand anything
grown-ups say. It's so confusing.
translation:
<T>Bazen buyuklerin soyledigi hicbir seyi anlayamiyorum.
Cok kafa karistirici.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: うあっ！番犬
translation: Aa! Bekci kopegi!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: まずいな…
translation: Kotu oldu...

original: 私にまかせてください…
translation: Bana birakin...

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original: 何を騒いでいる、おまえたち！
translation: Ne yaygara kopariyorsunuz, siz!

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original:
<T>Oi! Hershel Layton? Is that you?<W> I haven't
seen you in years!
translation:
<T>Hey! Hershel Layton? O sen misin?<W> Seni
yillardir gormedim!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Hello, Dalston. It has been some time. You
look well.
translation:
<T>Merhaba, Dalston. Uzun zaman oldu.
Iyi gorunuyorsun.

original:
<T>What are you doing in Monte d'Or? Don't
tell me you've moved here, too!
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'da ne yapiyorsun? Sakin
sen de buraya tasindim deme!

original:
<T><M6/1/1>No, I am here on business.<W> So you left
Stansbury, I see.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Hayir, is icin buradayim.<W> Demek
Stansbury'den ayrildin.

original:
<T>Everyone left! Stansbury turned into a ghost
town after that mess with the Ascot family.
translation:
<T>Herkes gitti! Ascot ailesiyle yasanan o karmasadan sonra
Stansbury bir hayalet kasabaya dondu.

original:
<T>Ghost towns don't attract many tourists and
empty hotels don't make any money.
translation:
<T>Hayalet kasabalar cok turist cekmez ve
bos oteller para kazandirmaz.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Ah yes, you always did mean to build your
own hotels, didn't you? It seems you've
done quite well for yourself here.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Ah evet, sen de hep kendi otellerini kurmak
isterdin, degil mi? Gorunen o ki burada
kendine epey iyi bir hayat kurmussun.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Enough small talk, Layton. What's your
business here?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Yeter bu kadar laf, Layton. Buradaki
isin ne?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>I'm investigating the recent events
surrounding the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Maskeli Beyefendi'yle ilgili son olaylari
arastiriyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Who put you up to this? Angela?<W> Oh, let me
guess, I'm a suspect now, right? Well,
that's a load of rubbish.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Seni buna kim kiskirtti? Angela mi?<W> Ah, dur tahmin edeyim,
simdi ben supheli oldum, oyle mi? Hadi canim,
bu sacmalik.

original:
<T>What do I have to gain from that maniac
terrorising the town? This chaos is bad for
business - everyone's business!
translation:
<T>O manyagin kasabayi
deset sacmasi bana ne kazandirir ki? Bu kaos
islere zarar veriyor - herkesin isine!

original:
<T><M5/2/1/60>I have heard that there is something of
a prolonged power struggle going on in
Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Monte d'Or'da
yillardir suren bir guc mucadelesi oldugunu
duydum.

original:
<T>If one wanted to hurt an opponent, one
might be willing to make a sacrifice or two,
no? <W>Hypothetically speaking.
translation:
<T>Birisi rakibine zarar vermek isterse,
bir iki fedakarlik yapmaya da razi olabilir,
oyle degil mi? <W>Tabii varsayimsal olarak.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Why does the Masked Gentleman send
a warning of his plans specifically to you
and Henry?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Maskeli Beyefendi neden planlarina dair
uyariyi ozellikle sana
ve Henry'ye gonderiyor?

original:
<T>There must be plenty of other business
owners in town who would be glad of the
information.
translation:
<T>Kasabada bu
bilgiye sevinecek daha pek cok isletme
sahibi olmali.

original:
<T><M6/2/1>It certainly looks as though there is some
connection between you and the Masked
Gentleman, Dalston.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Seninle Maskeli
Beyefendi arasinda bir baglanti varmis gibi
gorunuyor, Dalston.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Har har har! Na{:i}ve as ever, Layton. If
anyone is connected to that creep, it's
Angela.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ha ha ha! Her zamanki gibi Na{:i}ve'sin, Layton. Eger
o herifle baglantili biri varsa, o da
Angela'dir.

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>I beg your pardon?
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Affedersin?

original:
<T>You weren't the only one Angela blamed for
Randall's...<W>untimely end.
translation:
<T>Angela'nin Randall'in...<W>zamansiz
olumu icin sucladigi tek kisi sen degildin.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Henry encouraged Randall to go on that
expedition and convinced Angela to let him.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Henry, Randall'i o
seferine gitmeye tesvik etti ve Angela'yi da ona izin vermeye ikna etti.

original:
<T>Years later, Angela and Henry are married.
You know the saying {''}Keep your friends
close and your enemies closer{''}?
translation:
<T>Yillar sonra Angela ile Henry evlendi.
Su deyisi bilirsin {''}Dostlarini yakin tut,
dusmanlarini daha da yakin{''}, degil mi?

original:
<T><M8/2/1/45>Angela holding a grudge against Henry?
After all these years?<W> Come now, Dalston.
That seems highly unlikely.
translation:
<T><M8/2/1/45>Angela'nin Henry'ye kin tutmasi mi?
Bunca yil sonra mi?<W> Hadi ama, Dalston.
Bu pek olasi gorunmuyor.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Angela changed after Randall's death, you
know that. She got uptight and sulky.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Angela, Randall'in olumunden sonra degisti,
biliyorsun. Gergin ve somurtkan oldu.

original:
<T>Maybe she buried her resentment deep down
and she's been plotting revenge all this
time.
translation:
<T>Belki ofkesini derinlere gomdu ve
bunca zamandir intikam
planliyor.

original:
<T>Think about it: Angela never forgave you for
Randall's death. Practically drove you out of
Stansbury, didn't she?
translation:
<T>Dusunsene: Angela seni
Randall'in olumu icin hic affetmedi. Neredeyse seni
Stansbury'den kovdu, degil mi?

original: <T>I...<W>wouldn't say that.
translation: <T>Ben...<W> oyle demezdim.

original:
<T>Open your eyes, Layton. Henry loved Angela
and he couldn't stand seeing her with
Randall.
translation:
<T>Gozunu ac, Layton. Henry Angela'yi seviyordu
da onu Randall'la gormeye
dayanamiyordu.

original:
<T>That's why he sent Randall out on that
expedition into the ruins! Henry knew how
dangerous it was!
translation:
<T>Bu yuzden Randall'i o
kalintilara sefer icin gonderdi! Henry bunun ne kadar
tehlikeli oldugunu biliyordu!

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>That's ridiculous, Dalston.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Bu sacmalik, Dalston.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Oh, is it?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Oyle mi?

original:
<T>Then how come Henry kept everything
Randall discovered about Norwell to
himself?
translation:
<T>O zaman Henry, Randall'in Norwell hakkinda kesfettigi her seyi
neden
kendine sakladi?

original:
<T>So he could find the treasure that should've
been Randall's and take it for his own!
translation:
<T>Boylece Randall'in hakki olan hazineyi
bulup kendine alabilsin diye!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Angela wasn't going to let Henry get away
with that! This whole Masked Gentleman
fiasco is her doing!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Angela, Henry'nin bununla pacayi kurtarmasina izin vermezdi!
Bu Maskeli Beyefendi
rezaletinin hepsi onun isi!

original:
<T>With one stroke, Angela can ruin Henry, get
the treasure and exact her revenge! It's
genius!
translation:
<T>Tek hamlede Angela Henry'yi mahvedebilir,
hazineyi alabilir ve intikamini da alabilir! Bu
deha isi!

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>That's quite the tale, Dalston. But without
proof, that's all it is.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Dalston, guzel hikaye. Ama
kanit olmadan hepsi bu kadar: bir hikaye.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I hope I'm there when the penny finally
drops, Layton.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Jeton nihayet dustugunde
orada olmayi umuyorum, Layton.

original:
<T>This isn't a city of miracles.<W> It's a city of
betrayals.
translation:
<T>Burasi mucizeler sehri degil.<W> Burasi
ihanetler sehri.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M4/1/1>A city of betrayals... Wow, that's-
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Ihanetler sehri... Vay canina, bu-

original: <T>See? Even a child can see it.
translation: <T>Goruyor musun? Bir cocuk bile bunu goruyor.
<T><M1/3/4>Hayir! Ben-

original: <T><M5/2/1>It's all right, Luke.
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Sorun degil, Luke.

original:
<T><M3/2/3>Professor, I think we've heard enough. Let's
go now.
translation:
<T><M3/2/3>Profesor, bence yeterince duyduk. Hadi
gidelim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Oho! This boy has a mind of his own!<W> Well,
if you won't talk to me, at least go and see
the mayor.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Oho! Bu cocugun kendi akli var!<W> Peki,
benimle konusmayacaksan en azindan gidip
belediye baskaniyla gorus.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>The mayor, you say?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Belediye baskani mi dedin?

original:
<T>I've heard he's put together a special task
force to root out that masked lunatic.
translation:
<T>Duyduguma gore o maskeli manyagi ortaya cikarmak icin
ozel bir gorev gucu kurmus.

original:
<T>If you're serious about finding the truth,
you'll want to have a chat with them.
translation:
<T>Gercegi bulma konusunda ciddisen,
onlarla konusmak istersin.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M3/1/1>Actually...Dalston has a point there.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Aslinda... Dalston'in dediginde bir pay var.

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>Indeed. Let's head to the city hall, then.
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Dogru. O halde belediyeye gidelim.

original: ゴンゾ
translation: Gonzo

original: <T>Mr Dalston! Another letter!
translation: <T>Bay Dalston! Yine bir mektup!

original:
<T>Two, actually! One for you, and the other
is for someone called Mr Layton. <W30>Does
anyone know who Mr Layton is?!
translation:
<T>Aslinda iki tane! Biri size, digeri de Bay Layton adinda
birine. <W30>Bay Layton'in kim oldugunu
bilen var mi?!

original: <T>That...would be me.
translation: <T>O... ben oluyorum.

original:
<T>There. A warning from the Masked
Gentleman. While I stood before you.
translation:
<T>Iste. Maskeli
Beyefendi'den bir uyari. Senin karsinda dururken bile.

original: <T><M1/2/5>How did anyone know we were here?
translation: <T><M1/2/5>Burada oldugumuzu nasil bildiler?

original: <T><M5/1/1>Professor, we're being watched.
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Profesor, izleniyoruz.

original: <T><M5/2/1>I think you're right, Emmy.
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Sanirim haklisin, Emmy.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Look, that place is going to be teeming with
tourists tonight.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bak, bu gece orasi turistlerle
dolup tasacak.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>We still have time before sundown. We need
to inform the mayor.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Gun batmadan once hala vaktimiz var. Belediye baskanini
bilgilendirmeliyiz.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Right, Professor!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Tamam, Profesor!
<T><M4/2/1/45>Haydi gidelim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>The mayor should be at the city hall. It's
just beyond the Ledore place.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Belediye baskani belediye binasinda olmali. Ledore yerinin
hemen ilerisinde.

original:
<T>He's probably busy planning with the special
task force. He's called in reinforcements
from London, too.
translation:
<T>Muhtemelen ozel gorev gucuyle
plan yapiyordur. Londra'dan da
takviye cagirmis.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Maybe they're busy analysing the suspicious
evidence against me as we speak!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Belki de su anda bana karsi olan supheli delilleri
inceliyorlardir!

original: <T><M1/2/3>Maybe so. Hmph!
translation: <T><M1/2/3>Olabilir. Hih!

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Come now, Luke. Let's head to the city
hall. Thank you, Dalston. This was very...<W>
informative.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Hadi ama, Luke. Belediye
binasina gidelim. Tesekkurler, Dalston. Bu gercekten...<W>
aydinlaticiydi.

original: <T>I've got a bad feeling about all this.
translation: <T>Tum bunlar hakkinda icime kotu bir his doguyor.

original: 手紙
translation: Mektup

original: <T>Greetings, my friends.
translation: <T>Selamlar, dostlarim.

original:
<T>I trust you enjoyed last night's
festivities. I certainly did.
It was so refreshing!

You see, people who are made
of stone cannot cheat or lie.

In fact, they cannot do anything
unpleasant. They just stand
there in dignified silence.
translation:
<T>Umarim dun geceki
senliklerin tadini cikarmissinizdir. Ben kesinlikle cikardim.
Ne kadar ferahlaticiydi!

Goruyorsunuz, tastan
olan insanlar hile yapamaz ya da yalan soyleyemez.

Aslinda, hos olmayan hicbir sey
yapamazlar. Sadece
oracikta vakur bir sessizlik icinde dururlar.

original:
<T>To rob a person of their power to do
evil is quite miraculous, don't you
think? Almost as miraculous as
my follow-up tonight.

<T>I will be performing in the Gallery
Plaza and I assure you it will be
a most enlightening experience.
I hope you will attend.
translation:
<T>Bir insanin kotuluk yapma gucunu
elinden almak oldukca mucizevi, degil
mi? Neredeyse
bu aksamki devam gosterim kadar mucizevi.

<T>Bu aksam Galeri
Meydani'nda sahne alacagim ve bunun
son derece aydinlatici bir deneyim olacagini
garanti ederim. Umarim gelirsiniz.

original:
<T>Until then, I, the Masked
Gentleman, bid you adieu.
translation:
<T>O zamana dek ben, Maskeli
Beyefendi, sizlere veda ediyorum.

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original:
<T>I hope you weren't thinking of harassing my
dog. Poor beast was only doing what he
does best!
translation:
<T>Umarim kopegimi rahatsiz etmeyi
dusunmuyordunuz. Zavalli hayvan sadece en iyi
bildigi seyi yapiyordu!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I'll have no funny business on my property.
Understood, Layton?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Arazimde saklabanlik istemem.
Anlasildi mi, Layton?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>The city hall is just up ahead.
translation: <T>Belediye binasi hemen ileride.

original: ジャグラー

<T>La dee da... <W>Hm? What's the matter? Oh,
I know. You think the city hall is too serious
for clowns, don't you?
translation:
<T>La dee da... <W>Hm? Ne oldu? Oh,
biliyorum. Belediye binasini palyacolar icin
fazla ciddi buluyorsunuz, degil mi?

original:
<T>Well, it so happens I keep the officers
motivated with a little routine of mine
whenever they pass by. Watch this. <W>Ahem.
translation:
<T>Sans eseri, memurlar her gectiklerinde
kucuk bir rutinimle onlari motive ederim.
Izleyin bakin. <W>Ohom.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Move your hands in the air, we're solving
miracles today!<W> We'll find that gentleman
and we'll make him pay!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ellerinizi havaya kaldirin, bugun mucizeleri
cozuyoruz!<W> O beyefendiyi bulacagiz
ve bedelini odetecegiz!

original: レイトン
<T><M5/2/1>That is quite a rousing chant, I must say.
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Dogrusu oldukca costurucu bir tezahurat.

original: レミ

<T><M3/2/2>Ooh, keep going! I can feel my adrenaline
pumping!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Ooo, devam et! Adrenalinimin
yukseldigini hissediyorum!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/80>Look out, Masked Gentleman! My chanting
will be the end of you!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/80>Dikkat et, Maskeli Bey! Tezahuratim
senin sonun olacak!

original: <T><M5/2/1>At least you're staying positive!
translation: <T><M5/2/1>En azindan pozitif kaliyorsunuz!

original: <T><M2/1/1>Yes, it's good to see that.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Evet, bunu gormek guzel.

original:
<T>It would be a crime to keep my powers of
motivation to myself.
translation:
<T>Motivasyon gucumu
kendime saklamak gunah olurdu.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1>This must be the city hall. What a grand
building!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Burasi belediye binasi olmali. Ne gorkemli
bir bina!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Let's go in and find the mayor and his task
force, Professor!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Iceri girip belediye baskanini ve ekibini
bulalim, Profesor!

original: ルーク

<T>Wow! Why didn't we have a big city hall like
this back in Misthallery?
translation:
<T>Vay canina! Misthallery'de neden boyle
kocaman bir belediye binasi yoktu?

original: レイトン

<T>Monte d'Or continues to impress.<W> There are
a great deal of police officers here. Is this
where they are stationed?
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or etkileyiciligini surduruyor.<W> Burada
bir suru polis var. Hepsi
burada mi konuslanmis?

original: レミ

<T><M6/2/5>I don't think so. I heard the main police
station is somewhere outside town.<M6/2/1>
translation:
<T><M6/2/5>Sanmiyorum. Ana karakolun
sehrin disinda bir yerde oldugunu duydum.<M6/2/1>

original:
<T><M6/2/5>But look how many there are! Their entire
force must be here.
translation:
<T><M6/2/5>Ama bak, ne kadar coklar! Tum
kuvvetleri burada olmali.

original:
<T><M6/2/5>It seems the Masked Gentleman is receiving
quite a bit of attention.<M1/2/1>
translation:
<T><M6/2/5>Gorunuse gore Maskeli Bey
epey ilgi topluyor.<M1/2/1>

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Yes, they have certainly upped the ante. We
didn't see this many officers the night of the
petrification incident.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Evet, kesinlikle isi buyutmusler. Taslasma
olayinin oldugu gece bu kadar
memur gormemistik.

original:
<T>Which could also mean they were not
prepared. Perhaps the Masked Gentleman
doesn't always send out a warning...
translation:
<T>Bu da hazirliksiz olduklari
anlamina gelebilir. Belki Maskeli Bey
her zaman onceden uyari gondermiyordur...

original:
<T><M3/2/3>But...but that's not fair! Striking when the
town is helpless! What about all the
innocent people he's hurting?
translation:
<T><M3/2/3>Ama... ama bu haksizlik! Sehir caresizken
vurmak! Peki ya onun incittigi tum
masum insanlar?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That's the right attitude, Luke! Let's solve
this case swiftly, before anyone else suffers.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Iste dogru tutum bu, Luke! Baska kimse
zarar gormeden bu davayi hizla cozelim.

original: ポリス
<T>Can I help you at all, sir?
translation: <T>Size yardimci olabilir miyim, efendim?

original: レイトン

<T>We'd like to see the mayor. We've heard
that he has assembled a task force to
investigate the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Belediye baskaniyla gorusmek istiyoruz. Maskeli
Bey'i arastirmak icin bir ozel ekip
kurdugunu duyduk.

original:
<T>Civilians need the mayor's permission to talk
to the task force.<W> To get that permission,
you need to see the mayor.
translation:
<T>Sivillerin ozel ekiple konusmasi icin belediye
baskaninin izni gerekir.<W> Bu izni almak
icin de belediye baskanini gormeniz gerek.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Which is what you just asked for. <W15>Ahem. <W15>I'll,
er...<W15>see if I can find him.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Az once istediginiz de buydu. <W15>Ohom. <W15>Ben,
sey...<W15>gidip
onu bulabilir miyim bakayim.

original: ルーク

<T><M2/1/1>Wow! We're actually going to meet the
mayor of Monte d'Or!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Vay canina! Gercekten Monte d'Or'un
belediye baskaniyla tanisacagiz!

original: レミ

<T><M4/2/1>I wonder what kind of man he is... Managing
a city this size must be a big responsibility.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Nasil bir adam acaba... Bu buyuklukte
bir sehri yonetmek buyuk sorumluluk olmali.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>I wonder if I could do it... Maybe I'll be
a mayor when I grow up! How does
Mayor Luke Triton sound?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Ben yapabilir miyim acaba... Buyuyunce
belediye baskani olurum belki! Peki ya
Belediye Baskani Luke Triton nasil kulaga geliyor?

original:
<T><M5/1/1>That doesn't have such a bad ring to it.
Just as long as you give us the royal
treatment when we come and visit!
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>O kadar da kotu kulaga gelmiyor.
Yeter ki ziyaret etmeye geldigimizde
bize krallara layik davran!

original: ミカ

<T><M3/1/1>Stamp and file, stamp and file... The
paperwork has gone through the roof since
the Masked Gentleman turned up.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Damgala ve dosyala, damgala ve dosyala...
Maskeli Beyefendi ortaya ciktigindan beri
evrak isi tavan yapti.

original:
<T>All these boys in blue milling around and
they still can't catch their mark. <W>Imagine if
I was that bad at my job.
translation:
<T>Bunca mavi uniformali ortalikta dolasiyor da
hala hedeflerini yakalayamiyorlar. <W>Bir de
ben isimde bu kadar kotu olsaydim dusun.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>How do they expect to solve crime when
they can't even solve this puzzle?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Su bilmeciyi bile cozemiyorlarken
sucu nasil cozecekler?

original:
<T>Well, you're just a civilian, so it doesn't
mean anything if you can't solve it.
translation:
<T>Eh, sen sadece bir sivilsin;
cozememen bir sey ifade etmez.

original:
<T>The police expect to solve crime, and yet
they can't even solve this puzzle? Pfff...
translation:
<T>Polis sucu cozmeyi bekliyor, ama
su bilmeciyi bile cozemiyor mu? Pfff...

original:
<T>There. An ordinary citizen has solved a
puzzle that stumped the police. No wonder
this case is going nowhere.
translation:
<T>Al iste. Siradan bir vatandas
polisi zorlayan bir bilmeciyi cozdu. Sasmamali
bu dava ilerlemiyor.

original: レイトン

<T><M1/2/1>Well, it isn't an easy case. The Masked
Gentleman is a strange and highly
unpredictable adversary.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bu kolay bir vaka degil. Maskeli
Beyefendi tuhaf ve son derece
ongorulemez bir rakip.

original: レミ

<T><M3/1/1>And the crowds work as his shield. The
police can't use aggressive methods to take
him down without putting civilians in danger.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Kalabaliklar da onun kalkani oluyor. Polis
sivilleri tehlikeye atmadan onu etkisiz hale getirmek icin sert yontemlere
basvuramiyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I've heard the excuses more times than you
can imagine. Tell me, why are those
paintings not back at the gallery?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu bahaneleri hayal edemeyecegin kadar cok
duydum. Soyle bakalim, o
tablolar neden hala galeride degil?

original:
<T>And why are those people who got turned
into horses still out there somewhere
munching hay?
translation:
<T>Ve ata donusturulen o insanlar neden hala bir yerlerde
ot yiyip duruyor?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Whatever. The task force is in the meeting
room at the back. If you have the mayor's
permission, go on in.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Neyse. Gorev gucu arkadaki toplanti
odasindadir. Belediye baskaninin
izni varsa, iceri gir.

original:
<T><M2/1/3>Wow, she's lost all faith in the police,
hasn't she?
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Vay canina, polise olan tum guvenini kaybetmis,
degil mi?

original:
<T><M5/2/1>The local people are feeling rather let down.
The incidents started over a month ago, so
you can't blame them.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Halk kendini epey yuzustu birakilmis hissediyor.
Olaylar bir aydan fazla once basladi;
onlari suclayamazsin.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>I really hope we can catch the Masked
Gentleman before his next trick.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Umarim bir sonraki numarasindan once Maskeli
Beyefendi'yi yakalayabiliriz.

original:
<T>All these slackers do is stand around
drinking bad coffee and blathering about
how tough the case is.
translation:
<T>Bu aylaklarin yaptigi tek sey, ortalikta dikilmek,
kotu kahve icmek ve davanin ne kadar zor oldugundan
gevelemek.

original: オルトビルセン

<T>Rhys Williams, mayor of Monte d'Or. It's my
great pleasure to welcome you all to our
fair city!
translation:
<T>Ben Monte d'Or'un belediye baskani Rhys Williams. Sizi
guzel sehrimize
karsilamaktan buyuk mutluluk duyuyorum!

original: レイトン

<T><M3/1/1/45>Thank you. My name is Hershel Layton. I'm
a friend of Angela Ledore's.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Tesekkur ederim. Benim adim Hershel Layton.
Angela Ledore'nin bir arkadasiyim.

original: レミ

<T><M5/2/1>Emmy Altava. Pleased to meet you,
Mr Mayor.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Emmy Altava. Tanistigimiza memnun oldum,
Sayin Belediye Baskani.

original: ルーク
<T><M3/1/1>I'm Luke Triton, the professor's apprentice!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Ben Luke Triton, profesorun ciragiyim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>My friends and I are investigating the
Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Arkadaslarimla birlikte
Maskeli Bey'i arastiriyoruz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>We'd like your permission to contact the
special task force and offer our assistance.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ozel ekiple iletisime gecip
yardim teklif edebilmemiz icin izninizi istiyoruz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Investigating? Fancy that! Well, we need all
the help we can get. Let's see, now. What's
your puzzle solving record so far?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Arastirma mi? Bak sen! Eh, elimizden
geldigince yardima ihtiyacimiz var. Bakalim...
Simdiye kadar kac bulmaca cozdunuz?

original: <T>Hmm... <W>I see.
translation: <T>Hmm... <W>Anliyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I'm sorry, but every officer on the task force
has solved at least 25 puzzles. That's the
standard we agreed upon.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Uzgunum ama ozel ekipteki her memur
en az 25 bulmaca cozmus. Bu,
uzerinde anlastigimiz standart.

original:
<T><M8/2/1/45>Ah, it appears we haven't solved quite
enough puzzles yet. We'll have to come
back later.
translation:
<T><M8/2/1/45>Ah, gorunuse gore henuz yeterince
bulmaca cozmemisiz. Daha sonra
geri gelmemiz gerekecek.

original:
<T>I'm sorry, but if you want to join the task
force, you need to have solved at least 25
puzzles.
translation:
<T>Uzgunum ama ekibe katilmak istiyorsaniz
en az 25
bulmaca cozmus olmalisiniz.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>In that case, we'll have to come back
later.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>O halde daha sonra
geri gelmemiz gerekecek.

original: オルトビルセン

<T>Rhys Williams, mayor of Monte d'Or. It's my
great pleasure to welcome you all to our
fair city!
translation:
<T>Rhys Williams, Monte d'Or belediye baskani. Guzel sehrimize hepiniz
hos geldiniz!

original: レイトン

<T><M3/1/1/45>Thank you. My name is Hershel Layton. I'm
a friend of Angela Ledore's.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Tesekkur ederim. Benim adim Hershel Layton. Ben
Angela Ledore'un bir dostuyum.

original: レミ

<T><M5/2/1>Emmy Altava. Pleased to meet you,
Mr Mayor.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Emmy Altava. Tanistigimiza memnun oldum,
Sayin Belediye Baskani.

original: ルーク
<T><M3/1/1>I'm Luke Triton, the professor's apprentice!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Ben Luke Triton, profesorun ciragiyim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>My friends and I are investigating the
Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Arkadaslarim ve ben Maskeli Beyefendi'yi
arastiriyoruz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>We'd like your permission to contact the
special task force and offer our assistance.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ozel gorev gucuyle iletisime gecip
yardim teklif etmek icin izninizi istiyoruz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Investigating? Fancy that! Well, we need all
the help we can get.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Arastirmak mi? Vay canina! Eh, elimizden gelen her yardima ihtiyacimiz var.

original:
<T>Let's see, now. What's your puzzle solving
record so far? You'd really need to have
solved at least 25...
translation:
<T>Bakayim... Simdiye kadar bilmece cozme
karneniz nasil? Gercekten en az 25 tane
cozmus olmaniz gerekir...

original:
<T>Have you solved 25 puzzles yet? That's the
standard we set for the officers working in
the task force, see.
translation:
<T>25 bilmece cozdunuz mu? Bu,
gorev gucunde calisan memurlar icin
belirledigimiz standart, bakin.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Aha! You have! You are amply qualified.
Welcome to our task force.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aha! Cozmussunuz! Fazlasiyla uygunsunuz.
Gorev gucumuze hos geldiniz.

original:
<T>To be honest, our investigation has been
a bit...bumpy.
translation:
<T>Durust olmak gerekirse, sorusturmamiz
biraz... puruzlu ilerliyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>The detectives from London and our chief of
police aren't getting along at all.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Londra'dan gelen dedektiflerle baskomiserimiz
hic anlasamiyor.

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>I'm sorry to hear it.
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Bunu duymak uzucu.

original:
<T>I requested assistance from London, see.
I've forgotten their names, but they seem
a sharp lot.
translation:
<T>Londra'dan yardim istedim.
Isimlerini unuttum ama
epey keskin bir ekip gibiler.

original:
<T>Ah yes, our strategy meeting is about to
begin, I think.
translation: <T>Ah evet, sanirim strateji toplantimiz baslamak uzere.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Please go on in and join the meeting.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Lutfen iceri buyurun ve toplantiya katilin.

original:
<T>If you could defuse the situation, I would be
incredibly grateful.
translation:
<T>Ortamdaki gerginligi yatistirabilirseniz cok
minnettar olurum.

original:
<T><M4/1/3>Detectives from London, eh? I wonder who
that could be...
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Londra'dan dedektifler, ha? Kim olabilir
acaba...

original:
<T>They're all in the briefing room back there.
I'm counting on you!
translation:
<T>Hepsi suradaki brifing odasinda.
Size guveniyorum!

original: <T><M3/1/1>Thank you, Mr Mayor.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Tesekkur ederim, Sayin Belediye Baskani.

original:
<T>The meeting is back there in the briefing
room. Good luck!
translation:
<T>Toplanti arkadaki brifing
odasinda. Bol sans!

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Argh! The task force strategy meeting is
about to start and my partner still isn't back.
translation:
<T>Ahh! Gorev gucu strateji toplantisi
baslamak uzere ve ortagim hala donmedi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I don't know why he bothers. Gathering
evidence at the scene is one giant waste of
time!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Neden ugrastigini anlamiyorum. Olay yerinde
kanit toplamak koca bir
zaman kaybi!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Does this concern the petrification incident?
translation: <T>Bu, taslasma olayiyla mi ilgili?

original:
<T>Yeah. But it's too late now! Whatever
evidence might have been there has been
compromised by the crowds.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Evet. Ama artik cok gec! Orada olabilecek
her turlu kanit kalabalik tarafindan
bozuldu.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T>That know-it-all from London and the chief
are at each other's throats all day, and the
other bloke is just a meathead.
translation:
<T>Londra'dan gelen o ukala her seyi bilenle sef
butun gun birbirlerinin bogazinda, oteki
adam da tam bir kaz kafali.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/2>A meathead? What's a meathead?
translation: <T><M3/1/2>Kaz kafali mi? Kaz kafali ne demek?

original: <T>The chief's words, boy. Not mine.
translation: <T>Sefin sozleri, evlat. Benim degil.

original:
<T>My partner had better be back soon. I can't
stay awake through this whole meeting on
my own!
translation:
<T>Ortagim en kisa surede donse iyi olur. Bu
toplantinin tamaminda tek basima
uyanik kalamam!

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<V0010><T>おおっ！レミにレイトンじゃないか！
それに、チビも！</V>
translation:
<V0010><T>Ooo! Remi ile Layton degil misiniz!
Bir de ufaklik var!</V>

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<V0010><T><M3/2/3>Little chap? <L1.8>I'm not a child! <L3.2>I'm Luke Triton,
apprentice to Professor Layton!</V>
translation:
<V0010><T><M3/2/3>Kucuk cocuk mu? <L1.8>Ben cocuk degilim! <L3.2>Ben Luke Triton'um,
Profesor Layton'in ciragi!</V>

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<V0020><T>Ah, of course...Inspector Grosky. <L2.65>We should
have known it was you.</V>
translation:
<V0020><T>Ah, tabii ki...Mufettis Grosky. <L2.65>Sen oldugunu
bilmeliydik.</V>

original:
<V0030><T><M5/1/3>How did you get in here with all the
competent police officers?</V>
translation:
<V0030><T><M5/1/3>Bunca yetenekli polis varken buraya nasil
girebildin?</V>

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<V0040><T><M2/1/1>Emmy! How rude! <L1.9>If you're not careful, you
might end up hurting my feelings.</V>
translation:
<V0040><T><M2/1/1>Emmy! Ne kabalik! <L1.9>Dikkat etmezsen
duygularimi incitebilirsin.</V>

original:
<V0050><T>Guess I'll have to turn to my arrest record
at Scotland Yard to cheer me up! <M2/2/1>Ah ha
ha ha!</V><M2/1/1>
translation:
<V0050><T>Sanirim moralimi duzeltmek icin Scotland Yard'daki
tutuklama sicilime bakmam gerekecek! <M2/2/1>Ha ha
ha ha!</V><M2/1/1>

original:
<V0060><T><M2/1/6>And how many of those arrests came with
the professor's help? <L3.05>About half?</V>
translation:
<V0060><T><M2/1/6>Peki o tutuklamalarin kacinda profesorun
yardimi vardi? <L3.05>Yarisi kadar mi?</V>

original:
<V0070><T><M1/1/1/60>Ah ha ha ha! Yeah, I suppose that sounds
about right. <L4.7>Good to see you too, Emmy!</V>
translation:
<V0070><T><M1/1/1/60>Ha ha ha ha! Evet, kulaga
dogru geliyor. <L4.7>Seni gormek de guzel, Emmy!</V>

original: ブルーマイル
translation: Bloom

original: <V0080><T><M3/1/1>Professor Layton, I presume?</V>
translation: <V0080><T><M3/1/1>Profesor Layton, sanirim?</V>

original:
<V0090><T><M1/1/1>Detective Inspector Leonard Bloom. Senior
detective at Scotland Yard.</V>
translation:
<V0090><T><M1/1/1>Dedektif Mufettis Leonard Bloom. Scotland Yard'in
kidemli dedektifiyim.</V>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<V0100><T><M3/1/1/45>That's quite the title. <L1.9>Hershel Layton. How
do you do?</V>
translation:
<V0100><T><M3/1/1/45>Ne unvan ama. <L1.9>Hershel Layton. Memnun
doldum.</V>

original:
<V0110><T><M2/1/1>Wow, this must be a really big case to call
in Scotland Yard's finest!</V>
translation:
<V0110><T><M2/1/1>Vay canina, Scotland Yard'in en iyilerini
cagirttiklarina gore bu cok buyuk bir dava olmali!</V>
<V0120><T><M5/1/3>Sanirim oyle.</V>

original:
<V0130><T><M4/2/1/45>I wonder how the local police feel about
bringing in external help.</V>
translation:
<V0130><T><M4/2/1/45>Yerel polisin disaridan yardim getirilmesine
ne diyecegini merak ediyorum.</V>

original: シバロフ
translation: Sibarov

original:
<V0140><T>How did all these people get into my briefing
room? <L3.1>Who are these civilians?! <L4.6>Where's
my tea?!</V>
translation:
<V0140><T>Bu kadar insan brifing
odama nasil girdi? <L3.1>Bu siviller de kim?! <L4.6>Nerede
cayim?!</V>

original:
<V0150><T><M3/1/1>Chief Inspector Sheffield, may I introduce
Professor Hershel Layton.</V>
translation:
<V0150><T><M3/1/1>Basmufettis Sheffield, size Profesor
Hershel Layton'i takdim edeyim.</V>

original:
<V0160><T><M3/1/1>Scotland Yard has solved many difficult
cases with his assistance.</V>
translation:
<V0160><T><M3/1/1>Scotland Yard onun yardimiyla bircok zor
vakayi cozdu.</V>

original:
<V0170><T><M1/1/1>I assure you, any help he can offer will be
invaluable to us.</V>
translation:
<V0170><T><M1/1/1>Emin olun, sunabilecegi her turlu yardim
bizim icin paha bicilmez olacaktir.</V>

original:
<V0180><T><M1/1/1>All right then. <L1.6>Just make sure he doesn't get
in the way.</V>
translation:
<V0180><T><M1/1/1>Peki o zaman. <L1.6>Sadece araya
girmediginden emin olun.</V>

original:
<V0190><T>Now, <L0.7>if we're done with the pleasantries, <L2.6>I'd
like to get on with solving this case!</V>
translation:
<V0190><T>Simdi, <L0.7>nezaket fasli bittiyse, <L2.6>bu davayi
cozmeye gecmek istiyorum!</V>

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T>How long is this meeting going to last?
Maybe we should plan a small exercise
routine so we don't get stiff.
translation:
<T>Bu toplanti daha ne kadar surecek?
Belki tutulup kalmamak icin kucuk bir
esneme rutini planlamaliyiz.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/1/3>It's our brain we're meant to be exercising,
Inspector.
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>Calistirmamiz gereken beynimiz,
Mufettis.

original: ブルーマイル
translation: Bloom

original:
<T>When you're ready to start, talk to Chief
Inspector Sheffield and take your seat.
translation:
<T>Baslamaya hazir oldugunuzda Basmufettis
Sheffield'la konusup yerinize gecin.

original: シバロフ
translation: Sibarov

original:
<T>Right, are we ready to get this meeting
started? Not got any other business, have
you? 'Cause this is gonna take a while.
translation:
<T>Peki, bu toplantiyi
baslatmaya hazir miyiz? Baska isiniz yok,
degil mi? Cunku bu biraz surecek.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Good. Then park yourself in a seat and let's
get this over with.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Guzel. O zaman bir yere otur ve
sunu bitirelim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hurry up and finish whatever it is you still
have to do, then.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>O halde, yapman gereken her neyse
cabucak bitir.

original: <T>Start the meeting?
translation: <T>Toplanti baslasin mi?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>Professor, where are you going? The
meeting isn't over yet!
translation:
<T>Profesor, nereye gidiyorsunuz?
Toplanti daha bitmedi!

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T>That's Layton for you! Reckon you can
explain the next miracle too?
translation:
<T>Iste Layton boyle biridir! Bir sonraki mucizeyi de
aciklayabilecegini mi saniyorsun?

original: ブルーマイル
translation: Bloom

original:
<T>It's good to have your help on this case,
Professor. Your insight may bring us a great
deal closer to catching our villain.
translation:
<T>Bu davada yardiminizin olmasi iyi, Profesor.
Sezgileriniz bizi sucluyu yakalamaya
cok daha yaklastirabilir.

original:
<T>We won't resume the meeting without you.
Just talk to the Chief Inspector whenever
you're ready.
translation:
<T>Siz olmadan toplantiya devam etmeyecegiz.
Hazir oldugunuzda Basmufettisle
konusmaniz yeterli.

original: シバロフ
translation: Sibarov

original:
ではさっさと対策会議を始めるぞ。
全員席に着け。
translation:
O halde vakit kaybetmeden onlem toplantisini baslatiyoruz.
Herkes yerine otursun.

original: ブルーマイルくん、頼む。
translation: Bloom, senden rica ediyorum.

original: ブルーマイル
translation: Bloom

original:
では、『奇跡の紳士』事件についての
捜査会議を始める
translation:
O halde,?Maskeli Beyefendi? olayiyla ilgili
sorusturma toplantisini baslatiyoruz.

original:
今回の事件のカギは『奇跡の紳士』を[名乗/なの]る
犯人が町で引き起こしている奇怪な事件の
トリックを解明することにある。
translation:
Bu olayin anahtari, kendini?Maskeli Beyefendi?[??/??]diye
tanitan suclunun sehirde yol actigi tuhaf olaylarin
numarasini cozmekte yatiyor.

original:
まずは、『奇跡の紳士』がこれまで
起こした事件の詳細を説明しよう
translation:
Once,?Maskeli Beyefendi?nin simdiye kadar
yol actigi olaylarin ayrintilarini aciklayalim.

original: では、まず最初の事件だが…
translation: Peki, once ilk olaya gelelim...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: ふむふむ…
translation: Himm himm...

original: ブルーマイル
translation: Bloom

original:
<T>By demystifying the Masked Gentleman's
crimes, we aim to learn his methods and use
that knowledge to track him down.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin suclarinin gizemini cozerek,
yontemlerini ogrenmeyi ve bu bilgiyle
izini surup onu yakalamayi amacliyoruz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>We have a special guest here. His skills of
observation are unparalleled in this room.
Professor Layton, if you would.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Burada ozel bir konugumuz var. Bu odada
hic kimse onun kadar keskin gozlem yapamaz.
Profesor Layton, buyurun.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Ah, er...of course. Where would you like to
start?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Ah, sey... elbette. Nereden
baslamak istersiniz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Let's start with the most straightforward
case: the people who turned into horses.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>En acik vakayla baslayalim:
ata donusen insanlar.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Ah yes. I haven't been able to gather
much evidence on that case. However,
I understand that there were witnesses?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Ah evet. O vakayla ilgili
pek fazla kanit toplayamadim. Ancak,
olay yerinde taniklar vardi, degil mi?

original:
<T>Indeed. Perhaps we should fill you in on
what we know.
translation:
<T>Evet. Bildiklerimizi sana
anlatalim.

original: <T>Thank you. That would be very helpful.
translation: <T>Tesekkur ederim. Cok yardimci olur.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Well, naturally we have the statements taken
from witnesses at the scene. Let's start with
those.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Elbette olay yerindeki taniklardan alinan
ifadeler var. Once
onlarla baslayalim.

original: <T>Please go ahead, Detective Bloom.
translation: <T>Buyurun, Dedektif Bloom.

original:
<T>I will now summarise the witness statements
and present some relevant evidence. Please
pay close attention.
translation:
<T>Simdi tanik ifadelerini ozetleyip
ilgili bazi kanitlari sunacagim. Lutfen
dikkatle dinleyin.

original:
<T>The incident occurred at night. The
carnival's main attraction, the nightly
parade, was in full swing.
translation:
<T>Olay gece meydana geldi. Karnavalin ana
cazibesi olan gece
yuruyusu tum hiziyla suruyordu.

original:
<T>As the parade approached a bend in
the road near the shopping district,
the Masked Gentleman appeared.
translation:
<T>Yuruyus, alisveris bolgesi yakininda
yoldaki bir viraja yaklasirken,
Maskeli Beyefendi ortaya cikti.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Presumably the area was full of tourists.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Muhtemelen bolge turistlerle doluydu.

original:
<T>Yes, just as the Masked Gentleman had
planned.
translation:
<T>Evet, Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
planladigi gibi.

original:
<T>A flash lit up the sky, and the crowd
looked up to see the Gentleman stood
high above them on a ledge.
translation:
<T>Bir parilti gokyuzunu aydinlatti ve kalabalik
basini kaldirdiginda Beyefendi'nin
onlarin uzerinde bir cikintida durdugunu gordu.

original:
<T>According to our reports, he snapped
his fingers and the light intensified,
blinding the onlookers.
translation:
<T>Raporlarimiza gore parmaklarini siklatti
ve isik siddetlendi,
izleyenleri kor etti.

original:
<T>When the bright light subsided, it
appeared that some of the people had
been turned into horses.
translation:
<T>Parlak isik sonunce,
insanlarin bir kisminin
ata donusmus oldugu goruldu.

original:
<T>At any rate, those people vanished,
leaving behind only a few personal
effects.
translation:
<T>Her halukarda o insanlar kayboldu,
geride yalnizca birkac kisisel
esya birakarak.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Detective Bloom, do you have a theory as
to what really happened that night?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Dedektif Bloom, o gece gercekten
ne olduguna dair bir teorin var mi?

original: <T><M3/1/1>Yes, I do.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Evet, var.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>I see. Please allow me to confirm a couple
of points before we continue.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Anladim. Devam etmeden once
birkac noktayi netlestirmeme izin verin.

original:
<T>Does the parade start at the same time
every evening?
translation:
<T>Yuruyus her aksam ayni saatte mi
basliyor?

original:
<T>In a manner of speaking, I suppose. It
always starts just after sunset.
translation:
<T>Sayilir. Her zaman
gun batimindan hemen sonra baslar.

original:
<T>Were you able to confirm the identities of
the people who were supposedly turned
into horses?
translation:
<T>Sozde ata donusen
kisilerin kimliklerini
dogrulayabildiniz mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>No. Oddly enough, none of their belongings
contained any IDs and no missing person
reports have been filed.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hayir. Garip bir sekilde esyalarinin hicbirinde
kimlik yoktu ve kayip kisi
basvurusu da yapilmadi.

original: <T><M5/1/1/45>I see. Thank you, Detective.
translation: <T><M5/1/1/45>Anliyorum. Tesekkurler, Dedektif.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Looking at the information at hand, I believe
the truth is clear.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Elimizdeki bilgilere bakinca,
gercegin acik oldugunu dusunuyorum.

original:
<T>The Masked Gentleman obviously tricked
witnesses into believing some people had
been turned into horses.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi belli ki taniklari,
bazi insanlarin ata
donustugune inandirdi.

original:
<T>There was one essential atmospheric
element to his charade.
translation:
<T>Onun bu numarasinda hayati bir atmosferik
detay vardi.

original: 設問
translation: Soru

original:
What was the key element necessary for
the Masked Gentleman's trick to work?
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin numarasinin ise yaramasi icin gerekli
kilit unsur neydi?

original: 回答
translation: Cevap

original: The colours in the parade.
translation: Yuruyusteki renkler.

original: The weather.
translation: Hava durumu.

original: The time of day.
translation: Gunun saati.

original:
<T>The Masked Gentleman used the vivid
colours of the parade as a distraction.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi, yuruyusun canli
renklerini dikkat dagitmak icin kullandi.

original:
<T><K>Hmm...</K><W> I suppose that's possible, but
I don't think that many witnesses would be
fooled so easily.
translation:
<T><K>Hmm...</K><W> Bu mumkun olabilir ama
bu kadar cok tanigin
bu kadar kolay kandirilacagini sanmiyorum.

original:
<T>The tourists were distracted by the
unseasonable weather, and missed the trick.
translation:
<T>Turistler mevsime uymayan havayla
dikkatleri dagilip numarayi kacirdi.

original:
<T>It was a clear night, Professor. There was
nothing remarkable or distracting about it at
all.
translation:
<T>Gece acikti, Profesor. Dikkat dagitacak ya da
olaganustu bir sey
hic yoktu.

original:
<T>It was already dark at the start of the
parade, so it would be easy to miss things
even before the blinding light.
translation:
<T>Yuruyusun basinda zaten
karanlikti, bu yuzden bazi seyleri
kor edici isik ortaya cikmadan once bile kacirmak kolaydi.

original: <T>My thoughts exactly, Professor.
translation: <T>Ben de aynen boyle dusunuyorum, Profesor.

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>And of course, it's much easier to trick the
eyes with bright lights when it's dark all
around.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Ve elbette, etraf karanlikken parlak isiklarla
gozleri kandirmak
cok daha kolaydir.

original:
<T>Several witnesses claimed they actually saw
tourists transform into horses. I, however,
do not believe in magic.
translation:
<T>Bazi taniklar turistlerin gercekten
data donustugunu gorduklerini soyledi. Ben ise,
buyuye inanmiyorum.

original:
Why couldn't the witnesses have
seen the tourists transform?
translation:
Taniklar turistlerin
ata donustugunu neden gorememis olabilir?

original: Their eyes were closed.
translation: Gozleri kapaliydi.

original: There were no tourists.
translation: Orada turist yoktu.

original: The witnesses ran away.
translation: Taniklar kacti.

original:
<T>When the horses appeared, the people's
eyes must have been closed.
translation:
<T>Atlar ortaya ciktiginda insanlarin
gozleri kapali olmaliydi.

original:
<T>Right. At night, their eyes would have been
extremely sensitive to bright light. They
couldn't have seen anything.
translation:
<T>Dogru. Gece vakti gozleri parlak isiga
son derece hassas olurdu. Hicbir sey
goremezlerdi.

original:
<T>Perhaps there were no tourists in the first
place and they were just an illusion.
translation:
<T>Belki de en basta turist yoktu
da hepsi bir yanilsamaydi.

original:
<T>There's nothing in the reports to suggest
that.<W> Come on, Professor. Think!
translation:
<T>Raporlarda bunu dusundurecek
hicbir sey yok.<W> Hadi ama, Profesor. Dusun!

original:
<T>Most of the witnesses would have
instinctively run away.
translation:
<T>Taniklarin cogu icgudusel olarak
kacmis olmali.

original:
<T>Perhaps, but none of the witnesses reported
fleeing the scene.
translation:
<T>Olabilir ama hicbir tanik olay yerinden
kactigini bildirmedi.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>In other words, the Masked Gentleman
temporarily blinded onlookers to cover up
the trick.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Yani Maskeli Beyefendi
numarayi gizlemek icin izleyenleri
gecici olarak kor etti.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Our so-called tourists swiftly left, and horses
were set loose in the street. <M3/2/1>Which leaves
just one thing left to explain.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sozde turistler hizla uzaklasti ve atlar
sokaga salindi. <M3/2/1>Geriye
aciklanmasi gereken tek bir sey kaldi.

original: Where were the horses hidden?
translation: Atlar nerede saklanmisti?

original: In the sewers.
translation: Kanalizasyonda.

original: In the art gallery.
translation: Sanat galerisinde.

original: In the alleys nearby.
translation: Yakindaki arka sokaklarda.

original:
<T>The horses must have jumped out of the
manholes on the street.
translation:
<T>Atlar sokaktaki
rogar kapaklarindan firlamis olmali.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Honestly, Professor? Even in Monte d'Or,
the manholes aren't wide enough to let a
horse through.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Cidden mi, Profesor? Monte d'Or'da bile
rogarlar bir
ati gecirecek kadar genis degil.

original:
<T>Well, the art gallery could accommodate
dozens of horses, and it's not far from the
scene...
translation:
<T>Sanat galerisi onlarca ati
barindirabilir ve olay yerine de
uzak sayilmaz...

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Still, it would have taken far too long to lead
a group of horses through the gallery doors
and down the street.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yine de galerinin kapilarindan bir grup ati
cikarip
sokaga indirmek cok uzun surerdi.

original:
<T>The small, dark alleys giving on to the high
street - one could hide horses in those and
release them all at once.
translation:
<T>Ana caddeye acilan kucuk, karanlik arka
sokaklar... Atlari oralara saklayip
hepsini bir anda salabilirsin.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>It would seem you have it all worked out,
Professor. Would you care to elaborate for
everybody?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Gorunen o ki her seyi cozmussunuz,
Profesor. Herkes icin
biraz acar misiniz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Certainly. First, it seems that the key to this
miracle is in its location.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Elbette. Once, bu mucizenin anahtarinin
bulundugu yer oldugu anlasiliyor.

original:
<T>The shopping district is full of little
alleys, and that particular area is
isolated by a bend in the road.
translation:
<T>Alisveris bolgesi kucuk
arka sokaklarla dolu ve o bolge,
yoldaki bir virajla izole edilmis.

original:
<T>Just before the incident, everyone was
absorbed in the parade. No one paid
attention to the dark alleys.
translation:
<T>Olaydan hemen once herkes yuruyuse
kaptirmisti. Kimse
karanlik arka sokaklara dikkat etmedi.

original:
<T>A bright light appeared suddenly,
blinding the crowd, and horses were
released from the alleys.
translation:
<T>Aniden parlak bir isik belirdi,
kalabaligi kor etti ve atlar
arka sokaklardan salindi.

original:
<T>At the same time, people disguised as
tourists dropped some props and went
to hide in the alleys.
translation:
<T>Ayni anda turist kiligina giren insanlar
bazi aksesuarlari birakip
arka sokaklarda saklandi.

original:
<T>By the time the witnesses could see
clearly again, all they beheld were
the horses.
translation:
<T>Taniklar yeniden net gorebildiginde,
gordukleri tek sey
atlar oldu.

original:
<T>Precisely. But there's no evidence that the
Masked Gentleman had accomplices planted
among the tourists.
translation:
<T>Aynen oyle. Ama Maskeli Beyefendi'nin turistlerin arasina
yardakcilar yerlestirdigine dair
kanit yok.

original:
<T>True. But isn't it suspicious that the
belongings found at the scene contained
no forms of identification?
translation:
<T>Dogru. Ama olay yerinde bulunan esyalarin
hicbirinde
kimlik olmamasi supheli degil mi?

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Besides, if these people had been genuine
tourists, their families would surely have
reported them missing.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Ustelik bu insanlar gercekten turist olsaydi,
aileleri mutlaka
kayip basvurusu yapardi.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Very good, Professor. That was my
conclusion, as well.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Cok iyi, Profesor. Ben de
ayni sonuca varmistim.

original: シバロフ
translation: Sibarov

original:
<T>What?! So the Masked Gentleman's miracle
was just a simple trick?
translation:
<T>Ne?! Yani Maskeli Beyefendi'nin mucizesi
sadece basit bir numara miydi?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Yes, Chief Inspector. Smoke and mirrors, so
to speak. Only in this case, it was bright
lights and dark alleys.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Evet, Basmufettis. Tabiri caizse goz boyama.
Sadece bu kez,
parlak isiklar ve karanlik arka sokaklar vardi.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Bah! <W>All right, men, let's have a breather.
Layton, come and see me again when
you're ready to go on.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hah! <W>Pekala cocuklar, biraz mola verelim.
Layton, devam etmeye hazir oldugunda
yine gel.

original: シバロフ
translation: Sibarov

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>All right, time to move on to the next
miracle. Let's see what you make of this
one, Layton.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Pekala, siradaki
mucizeye gecme zamani. Bakalim buna ne diyeceksin,
Layton.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M1/1/1>I will do what I can. What do you know?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Elimden geleni yaparim. Ne biliyoruz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Not a lot. The short of it is some characters
popped out of paintings at the art gallery
and ran riot in town.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Pek bir sey degil. Kisacasi sanat galerisindeki
resimlerden bazi karakterler firladi ve
kasabada ortaligi birbirine katti.

original:
