<T><M5/2/1/45>Characters from paintings ran riot, you say?
What did they do, exactly?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Resimlerden cikan karakterler ortaligi karistirdi, oyle mi?
Tam olarak ne yaptilar?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>The witnesses reported people dressed
in strange clothes charging around and
breaking things.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Taniklar, tuhaf kiyafetli insanlarin
etrafta kosturup
bir seyleri kirdiklarini soyledi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>But when the sun went down, they
disappeared just as quickly as they
appeared.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Ama gunes battiginda
ortaya ciktiklari kadar cabuk
kayboldular.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Did anyone actually see these people
step out of the paintings?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bu insanlarin
resimlerden ciktigini goren oldu mu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>No. The gallery had already closed by
then.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Hayir. Galeri o zamana kadar
kapanmisti.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>In that case, why did anyone suppose
that they came out of the paintings?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>O halde insanlar neden
resimlerden ciktiklarini dusundu?

original:
<T>Well...<W>apparently, they looked just like
some characters in famous paintings,
down to the finest detail.
translation:
<T>Sey...<W>gorunuse gore unlu tablolardaki
bazi karakterlere, en ince ayrintisina kadar
benziyorlardi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>And when we checked the gallery, we
saw that the paintings were...<W>empty.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Ve galeriyi kontrol ettigimizde,
tablolarin...<W>bos oldugunu gorduk.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Empty? Do you mean...
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Bos mu? Yani...

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>The characters in those paintings were
gone, vanished. Only thing left was the
background.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>O tablolardaki karakterler
gitmisti, yok olmustu. Geriye sadece
arka plan kalmisti.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>You saw this yourself? Interesting...
<W>The key to this trick must lie in the
paintings themselves.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bunu bizzat gordun mu? Ilginc...
<W>Bu numaranin anahtari
bizzat tablolarda olmali.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>That's what I thought, but we've
thrown our best experts at these
paintings and haven't found a thing!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Ben de oyle dusundum ama
en iyi uzmanlarimizi bu
tablolara verdik, hicbir sey bulamadik!

original:
<T><M3/2/1/60>I see. Please allow me to ask a few more
questions, then.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/60>Anladim. O halde birkac soru daha
sormama izin verin.

original: 設問
translation: Soru

original:
Were the paintings from which
the people disappeared...
translation:
Insanlarin kayboldugu
tablolar...

original: 回答
translation: Cevap

original: ...particularly valuable?
translation: ...ozellikle degerli miydi?

original: ...from a common source?
translation: ...ayni kaynaktan mi geliyordu?

original: ...cursed?
translation: ...lanetli miydi?

original: <T><M6/2/1>Were these paintings particularly valuable?
translation: <T><M6/2/1>Bu tablolar ozellikle degerli miydi?

original:
<T>No, they were replicas of famous paintings.
Portraits. They couldn't have been worth
much.
translation:
<T>Hayir, unlu tablolarin replikalariydi.
Portrelerdi. Pek
degerli olamazlardi.

original:
<T><M6/2/1>Did the paintings come from a common
source?
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Tablolar ayni
kaynaktan mi geliyordu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>As a matter of fact, they did. According to
the curator, they were all donated earlier
that day.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Aslinda evet. Kuratore gore
o gunun daha erken saatlerinde
hepsi bagislanmis.

original:
<T>It was a collection of replicas and the donor
wanted to remain anonymous.
translation:
<T>Bir replikalar koleksiyonuydu ve bagisci
anonim kalmak istedi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>All the paintings we're investigating came
from that collection.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Inceledigimiz tum tablolar
bu koleksiyondandi.

original: <T><M6/2/1>Were these paintings cursed?
translation: <T><M6/2/1>Bu tablolar lanetli miydi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>What's that? Cursed?<W> I didn't think you were
one for all that superstitious mumbo jumbo,
Layton.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Ne? Lanetli mi?<W> Senin boyle batil inanc sacmaliklarina
inanacagini sanmazdim,
Layton.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/60>That can't be a coincidence. Whoever
donated these paintings was an accomplice.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Bu tesaduf olamaz. Bu tablolari bagislayan kisi
bir yardakciydi.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/30>Agreed. We looked into it, but nobody has
a clue who this mysterious donor is.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/30>Katiliyorum. Arastirdik ama kimse bu gizemli bagiscinin
kim oldugunu bilmiyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>We questioned the whole staff of the gallery,
but they all came out clean as a whistle.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Galerinin tum personelini sorguladik
ama hepsi tertemiz cikti.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>What a huge blooming waste of time all that
was.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hepsi koskoca bir zaman
kaybiydi.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Hmm. I think we must understand how
the illusion was created in order to find
the truth.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Hmm. Gercegi bulmak icin
bu illuzyonun nasil yaratildigini
anlamaliyiz.

original: Were these paintings...
translation: Bu tablolar...

original: ...oddly shaped?
translation: ...tuhaf sekilli miydi?

original: ...strangely packaged?
translation: ...garip sekilde paketlenmis miydi?

original: ...unusually framed?
translation: ...alisilmadik cercevelenmis miydi?

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Were these paintings of unusual shape or
size?
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Bu tablolarin sekli ya da
boyutu alisilmadik miydi?

original:
<T>Hmm. They were a variety of sizes - some
small, some large, but they were all,<W30> you
know...<W30>painting-shaped.
translation:
<T>Hmm. Cesit cesit boyuttaydilar; kimi
kucuk, kimi buyuktu ama hepsi,<W30> hani
bilirsin...<W30>tablo seklindeydi.

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Were the paintings packaged in any
particular way?
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Tablolar herhangi
ozel bir sekilde paketlenmis miydi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Hmm. The curator did say that the paintings
were vacuum-sealed. He said this was
usually reserved for rare items.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Hmm. Kurator tablolarin
vakumla muhurlendigini soyledi. Bunun
normalde nadir esyalar icin yapildigini da ekledi.

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Were the frames of the paintings unusual in
any way? Were there any thick enough to
hide, say, a person?
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Cerceveler herhangi bir acidan
alisilmadik miydi? Ornegin bir
insani saklayacak kadar kalin olan var miydi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>No, and no. We examined all the frames
closely and even took some apart, but they
were completely ordinary.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Hayir, hayir. Tum cerceveleri
yakindan inceledik, hatta bazilarini soktuk ama
tamamen siradandi.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Interesting. I believe the airtight packaging
is relevant here.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ilginc. Bu hava gecirmez paketlemenin
burada onemli oldugunu dusunuyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>The portraits were sealed when they arrived,
and the frames came in thick, metal cases.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Portreler geldiginde muhurluydu
ve cerceveler kalin metal kutulardaydi.

original:
<T>The gallery staff were pretty surprised that
replicas were given such secure packaging.
We didn't really think much of it.
translation:
<T>Galeri personeli replikalarin boyle saglam paketlenmesine
oldukca sasirdi.
Biz ise pek ustunde durmadik.

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Indeed.<W> Still, in order for my theory to be
correct, the donation must have included
specific display instructions.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Elbette.<W> Yine de teorimin dogru olabilmesi icin
bagisin
ozel sergileme talimatlari icermesi gerekir.

original: Did the display instructions specify...
translation: Sergileme talimatlari sunu belirtiyor muydu...

original: ...when to display them?
translation: ...ne zaman sergileneceklerini?

original: ...where to display them?
translation: ...nerede sergileneceklerini?

original: ...how to arrange them?
translation: ...nasil duzenleneceklerini?

original:
<T><M6/2/1>Were there specific instructions about the
exact time to display the paintings?
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Tablolarin tam
hangi saatte sergilenecegine dair ozel talimatlar var miydi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Yes, actually, there were! How'd you know,
Layton?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Evet, vardi! Nereden bildin,
Layton?

original:
<T><M6/2/1>Did the instructions give a particular location
where the paintings should be displayed?
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Talimatlarda tablolarin sergilenecegi
belirli bir yer belirtilmis miydi?

original:
<T>Hmm... No, doesn't look like it. There's
nothing in the report, anyhow.
translation:
<T>Hmm... Hayir, oyle gorunmuyor. Zaten raporda da
hicbir sey yok.

original:
<T><M6/2/1>Did the donor give any instructions on what
arrangement or order to put the paintings
in?
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Bagisci, tablolarin hangi
sirayla ya da nasil duzenlenmesi gerektigine dair
talimat verdi mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>No, nothing like that. As far as I know, the
gallery arranged them as they saw fit.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Hayir, oyle bir sey yok. Bildigim kadariyla galeri
digi gibi duzenlemis.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>The crates arrived in the morning, but the
instructions from the donor said to display
them precisely at noon.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Sandiklar sabah geldi ama bagiscinin talimati
tam oglen
sergilenmelerini soyluyordu.

original: <T><M3/1/1>And therein lies the trick.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Iste numara da burada.

original: The illusion was created by...
translation: Illuzyon sununla yaratildi...

original: ...frames hiding the people.
translation: ...cercevelerde insanlarin saklanmasiyla.

original: ...hallucinogenic gas.
translation: ...halusinojen gazla.

original: ...vanishing paint.
translation: ...kaybolan boyayla.

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>There were people hidden inside the frames
the entire time.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Insanlar tum sure boyunca
cercevelerin icinde sakliydi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Come off it, Layton! There's no way the
frames were thick enough to hold a person.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Hadi canim, Layton! Cercevelerin bir insani
saklayacak kadar kalin olmasi imkansiz.

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>There was hallucinogenic gas inside the
paintings, which was released when the
paintings were displayed.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Tablolarin icinde halusinojen bir gaz vardi;
tablolar sergilendiginde
bu gaz salindi.

original:
<T>Really, Layton? You think all the witnesses
were just hallucinating?
translation:
<T>Cidden mi, Layton? Tum taniklarin
halusinasyon gordugunu mu saniyorsun?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>So the buildings in town, they vandalised
themselves, did they?<M2/1/1/45> No, Layton, we need
a more solid idea than that to work from.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yani kasabadaki binalar kendilerini mi tahrip etti,
oyle mi?<M2/1/1/45> Hayir, Layton, bundan daha saglam
bir fikre ihtiyacimiz var.

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>The portraits were treated with a special
paint that slowly disappears when exposed
to air.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Portrelere, havayla temas ettiginde
yavasca kaybolan
ozel bir boya uygulanmisti.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Does such a thing even exist?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Boyle bir sey gercekten var mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>We have all observed how sunlight causes
a painting to fade, yes?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Gunes isiginin bir resmi
soldurdugunu hepimiz gozlemledik, degil mi?

original:
<T><M6/2/1>In a similar way, it's possible to create
chemically reactive paint that turns
transparent when exposed to air.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Benzer sekilde, havayla temas ettiginde
seffaflasan
kimyasal olarak tepkimeye giren bir boya uretmek mumkundur.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Of course! With paint like that, you could
make anything disappear from a painting.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Elbette! Boyle bir boyayla
bir resimdeki her seyi yok edebilirsin.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/60>Correct. Naturally, it would take some time
for the paint to turn transparent, so the
timing must be precise.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/60>Dogru. Elbette boyanin seffaflasmasi zaman alir,
o yuzden
zamanlama kesin olmali.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/60>The seals were removed so that the paint
disappearing would coincide with the
appearance of the rioters.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Muhurler, boyanin kaybolmasinin
yikim yapanlarin ortaya cikisiyla
eszamanli olmasi icin kaldirildi.

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>The Masked Gentleman had these rioters
dress up exactly like the individuals in the
portraits.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Maskeli Beyefendi bu yikimcilari
portrelerdeki kisilerle birebir ayni
giydirdi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmph. This is either genius or utter
hogwash.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hih. Bu ya deha isi ya da
tam bir sacmalik.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>I like this theory of yours, Layton, but we
have no evidence to back it up.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Bu teorini sevdim, Layton, ama
bunu destekleyecek kanitimiz yok.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Well, I doubt such paint would just disappear
without a trace.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Yine de boyle bir boyanin iz birakmadan
kaybolacagini sanmiyorum.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>If you examine the canvas for chemical
substances, you'll find residual outlines
where the paint turned transparent.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Tuvali kimyasal maddeler icin incelersen,
boyanin seffaflastigi yerlerde
kalan izleri bulursun.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>I'll order the analysis. <W>Excellent work!
I underestimated you, Layton.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Analizi emredecegim. <W>Mukemmel is!
Seni hafife almisim, Layton.

original: ブルーマイル
translation: Bloom

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Another one down. Good work, Professor.
Let's have a break.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Birini daha cozduk. Iyi is, Profesor.
Biraz ara verelim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>I order the breaks around here, Bloom! <W>All
right, everyone, off you go. Layton, let me
know when you're ready to go on.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Burada molalara ben karar veririm, Bloom! <W>Pekala,
herkes dagilsin. Layton, devam etmeye hazir oldugunda
haber ver.

original: シバロフ
translation: Sibarov

original:
<T>Right, you lot. Let's get on with it. <M3/1/1>Inspector
Grosky, you're up next.
translation:
<T>Pekala siz. Ise koyulalim. <M3/1/1>Mufettis
Grosky, siradaki sensin.

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T>All right, Layton. Here's another of the
crook's miracles for you to ponder. <M3/2/2>Even
you'll find this one hard to explain!<M3/1/2>
translation:
<T>Pekala Layton. Iste uzerinde dusunecegin
sahtekarin bir baska mucizesi. <M3/2/2>Bunu
sen bile aciklamakta zorlanacaksin!<M3/1/2>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>We'll see. If it's anything like the first two,
it's not a miracle at all.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Gorecegiz. Ilk ikisi gibiyse,
hic de mucize degildir.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>The other two didn't involve people being
engulfed in flames!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Diger ikisinde insanlar
alevler icinde kalmiyordu!

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>True. Tell me more about it.
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Dogru. Bana biraz daha anlat.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Certainly. I have the report right here. <W>The
incident took place last Sunday.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Elbette. Rapor burada. <W>Olay
gecen pazar yasandi.

original:
<T>That morning, 13 citizens received an
ominous letter.
translation:
<T>O sabah 13 vatandas
ugursuz bir mektup aldi.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Naturally, it was from our dastardly
villain, the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Elbette gonderen, o alcak
dusmanimiz Maskeli Beyefendi'ydi.

original: 奇跡の紳士
translation: Mucize Beyefendi

original:
<T>Esteemed citizen, I cordially
invite you to a special afternoon
showing of my latest miracle.
translation:
<T>Degerli vatandas, en yeni mucizemin
ozel bir ogleden sonra
gosterimine sizi ictenlikle davet ediyorum.

original:
Come to the gallery plaza at 1 pm
sharp. I must insist you attend - unless
you wish to forfeit your life, that is.
translation:
Saat tam 13:00'te galeri meydanina
gelin. Katilmanizda israr ediyorum - tabii
hayatinizdan vazgecmek istemiyorsaniz.

original:
<T>He also advertised the event in the
papers: {''}Miracle en Rouge - a modern
piece by the Masked Gentleman{''}.
translation:
<T>Etkinligi gazetelerde de duyurdu:
{''}Miracle en Rouge - Maskeli Beyefendi'den modern bir
eser{''}.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>That's a bold move. I suppose the
townspeople came?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Cesur bir hamle. Demek
kasabalilar geldi?

original:
<T>Townspeople and tourists alike! The
crowd was enormous, apparently!
translation:
<T>Kasabalilar da turistler de! Kalabalik
devasa buyuklukteymis!

original:
<T>Citizens of Monte d'Or, welcome!
I am the Masked Gentleman,
your host for today's event.

Also with us this afternoon are
13 very special guests, here
at my personal behest.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or vatandaslari, hos geldiniz!
Ben Maskeli Beyefendi,
bugunku etkinliginizin ev sahibiyim.

Bu ogleden sonra ayrica
benim ozel davetimle burada bulunan
13 cok ozel konugumuz var.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>The crook's voice could be heard, but
there was no sign of him, only an odd
tent in the plaza centre.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sahtekarin sesi duyuluyordu ama
meydandaki tuhaf bir cadir disinda
ondan eser yoktu.

original:
<T>Then, just before 1 pm, the canvas fell
to reveal a stage with the 13 invitees
standing on it.
translation:
<T>Tam saat 13:00'ten hemen once branda
dustu ve 13 davetlinin
uzerinde durdugu bir sahne ortaya cikti.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Hmm... How far were the audience from
this stage?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Hmm... Seyirci bu
sahneden ne kadar uzaktaydi?

original:
<T>Well, they can't have been close, or a
lot of them would have been hurt. <W>You
see, when the clock struck one, <W30>BOOM!
translation:
<T>Yakin olamazlardi, yoksa
cogu yaralanirdi. <W>Cunku
saat tam biri vurunca, <W30>BOM!

original:
<T>The 13 people on stage all burst into
flames!
translation:
<T>Sahnedeki 13 kisinin hepsi
alev aldi!

original:
<T>According to reports, the flames grew
to an inferno, then, poof! Gone. <W>Along
with the people on stage.
translation:
<T>Raporlara gore alevler
bir cehenneme donustu, sonra puf! Yok oldu. <W>Sahnedeki
insanlarla birlikte.

original: <T>The people on stage disappeared?
translation: <T>Sahnedeki insanlar kayboldu mu?

original:
<T>Correct! As far as I can see, the only
explanation is that they burnt to ash
and blew away!
translation:
<T>Dogru! Bildigim kadariyla tek
aciklama, kul olup
ucup gitmeleri!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>That's not a miracle, that's a public
execution.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bu mucize degil, halka acik bir
infaz.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Except it wasn't.<W> They were all found at
their homes later on, with not so much as
a scratch!<M3/1/2>
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Ama oyle olmadi.<W> Hepsi daha sonra
kendi evlerinde bulundu; ustlerinde
cizik bile yoktu!<M3/1/2>

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Impossible, yes.<W> The victims were just as
confused as us. They went to the plaza, and
that's all they remember.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Imkansiz, evet.<W> Magdurlar da bizim kadar
saskindi. Meydana gittiler ve
hatirladiklari tek sey bu.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Did you check the stage? Perhaps there was
space to hide underneath.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Sahneyi kontrol ettiniz mi? Belki
altinda saklanacak bir yer vardi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It wouldn't have been much of a hiding
place. The entire stage was consumed by
the fire.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Pek saklanilacak bir yer degildi.
Tum sahne
alevler tarafindan yutuldu.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I'm wracking my brain, but it would be easier
to bench-press a lorry!<M1/1/1/45>
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Kafami patlatiyorum ama
kamyon kaldirmak daha kolay!<M1/1/1/45>

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Hm. Are the investigating officers present?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Hmm. Sorusturmayi yuruten memurlar burada mi?

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Uh, yessir! I took statements from the
witnesses and interrogated all 13 individuals
involved, sir.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>E-evet efendim! Taniklardan
ifadeleri aldim ve olaya karisan 13 kisinin
hepsini sorguladim, efendim.

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Splendid. If you don't mind, I'd like to ask
you a few questions.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Harika. Sakincasi yoksa sana
birkac soru sormak istiyorum.

original: 設問
translation: Soru

original:
The Masked Gentleman hand-picked
his victims. Were they...
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi kurbanlarini tek tek
secti. Onlar...

original: 回答
translation: Cevap

original: ...his accomplices?
translation: ...onun yardakcilari miydi?

original: ...friends with each other?
translation: ...birbirleriyle arkadas miydi?

original: ...magicians?
translation: ...sihirbaz miydi?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Is it possible that these invitees were
actually the Masked Gentleman's
accomplices?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Bu davetlilerin aslinda
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
yardakcilari olmasi mumkun mu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>We suspected that at first, sir, so we
checked them out thoroughly. They're all
law-abiding locals.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Basta biz de oyle suphelendik efendim, o yuzden
didik didik inceledik. Hepsi
kanunlara uyan yerli halk.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Were the invitees friends, by any chance?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Davetliler tesadufen arkadas miydi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>No, sir. Not exactly...<W>but there was
something.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Hayir efendim. Tam olarak degil...<W>ama
bir sey vardi.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Were the invitees magicians?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Davetliler sihirbaz miydi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Uh...sir?<W> I don't know. I didn't ask if they
were magicians. Should I have?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Sey... efendim?<W> Bilmiyorum. Sihirbaz olup olmadiklarini
sormadim. Sormam mi gerekiyordu?

original: <T><M1/2/1/45>Go on, please.
translation: <T><M1/2/1/45>Devam et, lutfen.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Well, it turns out the 13 invitees are all
members of the same squash club.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Meger bu 13 davetlinin hepsi
ayni squash kulubunun uyesiymis.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Really?! That's news to me!<W> Tell me more
about this club!<M1/1/2>
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Gercekten mi?! Bu benim icin yeni!<W> Bana biraz daha
bu kulupten bahset!<M1/1/2>

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Not much to tell, sir. It's a popular club.
I concluded that the whole thing was just
a coincidence.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Pek anlatacak bir sey yok efendim. Populer bir kulup.
Ben de bunun
sadece bir tesaduf oldugu sonucuna vardim.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>A coincidence, eh? What do you think,
Layton?<M2/1/2>
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Tesaduf ha? Ne diyorsun,
Layton?<M2/1/2>

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I think the young officer may have found
a lead. Now, I have another question.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Genc memur bir iz bulmus
olabilir. Simdi baska bir sorum var.

original: Did any of the witnesses see...
translation: Taniklardan herhangi biri sunu gordu mu...

original: ...the victims go on stage?
translation: ...kurbanlarin sahneye ciktigini?

original: ...the Masked Gentleman?
translation: ...Maskeli Beyefendi'yi?

original: ...any of the 13 hide?
translation: ...13 kisiden birinin saklandigini?

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Did anyone see the 13 people take the
stage?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>13 kisinin sahneye
ciktigini goren oldu mu?

original:
<T>No, sir. No one was seen entering the tent
or leaving it.
translation:
<T>Hayir efendim. Kimse cadira
ne giren ne cikan gordu.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Did any of the witnesses see the Masked
Gentleman in the plaza?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Taniklardan biri meydanda
Maskeli Beyefendi'yi gordu mu?

original:
<T>We asked everyone and nobody saw him.
They only heard his voice.
translation:
<T>Herkese sorduk, kimse onu gormemis.
Sadece sesini duymuslar.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Did any of the witnesses see the 13
individuals hide when the fire started?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ates baslayinca 13
kisinin saklandigini goren oldu mu?

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Nobody reported seeing anyone hide.
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Kimse birinin saklandigini gordugunu bildirmedi.

original:
<T>Anyway, sir, like the inspector said, the
stage burnt to a crisp. There was nowhere
they could have gone.
translation:
<T>Neyse efendim, mufettisin dedigi gibi
sahne komur gibi oldu. Gidebilecekleri
hicbir yer yoktu.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/60>So, the invitees all got on stage without
anyone seeing them.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Yani davetliler sahneye
kimse gormeden cikti.

original: <T><M2/1/2/45>In the middle of the day, no less!
translation: <T><M2/1/2/45>Ustelik gun ortasinda!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Indeed. <W>Hm, I think this detail might be the
key to solving the puzzle.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aynen. <W>Hmm, bu ayrintinin
bulmacayi cozmenin anahtari olabilecegini dusunuyorum.

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>A final question, if I may. Could you tell me
about the clothes the 13 wore on stage?
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Son bir soru, izninle. Sahnedeki 13 kisinin
ne giydigini soyleyebilir misin?

original: <T>Of course, sir! Ask me anything!
translation: <T>Elbette efendim! Ne isterseniz sorun!

original: Were they wearing...
translation: Sunu mu giyiyorlardi...

original: ...extravagant clothing?
translation: ...abartili kiyafetler?

original: ...nothing?
translation: ...hicbir sey?

original: ...other clothes later on?
translation: ...sonradan baska kiyafetler mi?

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Were the people on stage wearing gaudy or
fancy clothing?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Sahnedekiler gosterisli ya da
sik kiyafetler mi giyiyordu?

original:
<T>Hmm, they were a bit of a mix, really. They
would have passed unnoticed in the crowd,
at any rate.
translation:
<T>Hmm, aslinda biraz karisikti. Yine de
kalabalikta fark edilmeden
karisabilirlerdi.

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>Were the invitees in fact wearing nothing?
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Davetliler gercekten hicbir sey giymiyor muydu?

original:
<T>Sir? If you're asking if they were naked, the
answer is no. <W>I think that would've been
mentioned.
translation:
<T>Efendim? Eger ciplak olup olmadiklarini soruyorsaniz,
cevap hayir. <W>Bence bu
zaten mutlaka belirtilirdi.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Were the invitees' clothes different from
what they were wearing when found later
on?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Davetlilerin kiyafetleri,
daha sonra bulunduklarinda giydiklerinden
farkli miydi?

original: <T><M1/1/1>Ummm... <W>I don't know, sir. Is it important?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Himm... <W>Bilmiyorum efendim. Onemli mi?

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>It may be. Could you check for me?
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Olabilir. Benim icin kontrol eder misin?

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Of course, sir. I'll have a quick look through
the photos.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Elbette efendim. Fotograflara
hemen bir goz atayim.

original: <T><M3/2/1>What are you thinking, Layton?<M1/1/1/45>
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Ne dusunuyorsun, Layton?<M1/1/1/45>

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>We might be on to something here.
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Burada bir sey yakalamis olabiliriz.

original: <T><M4/1/1>How did you guess, sir?!
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Nasil tahmin ettiniz efendim?!

original: <T>All their outfits changed!
translation: <T>Hepsinin kiyafeti degismis!

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>I checked the photos from the incident. The
invitees were all wearing something else
when we found them later on.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Olayin fotograflarina baktim.
Davetliler daha sonra buldugumuzda
baska bir sey giymisti.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>What's that got to do- <W><M3/2/1/45>Oh...<W> OH! I think I've
got it! <W>ANOTHER WIN FOR THE YARD!<M1/1/1/45>
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bunun ne alakasi- <W><M3/2/1/45>Aa...<W> AH! Sanirim
buldum! <W>KARAKOL ICIN YINE BIR ZAFER!<M1/1/1/45>

original: <T>Don't hurt me, Inspector!<W> What is it?
translation: <T>Bana vurmayin Mufettis!<W> Ne oldu?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>The victims' clothes burnt up on stage and
they all ran home naked!<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Kurbanlarin kiyafetleri sahnede yandi ve
hepsi ciplak halde evlerine kostular!<M1/1/1>

original: <T><K>Hmm.
translation: <T><K>Hmm.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Well, I don't hear anyone else speaking up.<W>
Stop that smirking, Layton! What is it? Out
with it!<M2/1/1>
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Pekala, baska konusan yok anlasilan.<W>
Siritmayi kes, Layton! Nedir bu? Soyle
bakayim!<M2/1/1>

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>I don't believe any of our 13 victims ever
left their homes.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>13 kurbanimizin hicbirinin
hic evinden ciktigina inanmiyorum.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Nonsense, Layton! Hundreds of people saw
them on that stage!<M2/1/2>
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Sacmalik, Layton! Yuzlerce kisi
onlari o sahnede gordu!<M2/1/2>

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>Allow me to explain.
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Aciklamama izin verin.

original:
<T>We know that the Masked Gentleman sent
instructions to 13 people, asking them to
come to the plaza.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin 13 kisiye
meydana gelmelerini isteyen
talimatlar gonderdigini biliyoruz.

original: <T>That's right.
translation: <T>Dogru.

original:
<T>But the whole town was sure to attend
thanks to the newspaper advert. Our villain
already had his pick of victims.
translation:
<T>Gazete ilani sayesinde tum kasabanin
gelecegi kesindi. Dusmanimiz
zaten kurbanlarini secmisti.

original: <T>I believe the 13 each received two letters.
translation: <T>Bence bu 13 kisi ikiser mektup aldi.

original:
<T><M5/1/1/60>The first letter was to be shown to the police
and the second held the true instructions.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/60>Ilk mektup polise gosterilecekti
ikincisi ise asil talimatlari iceriyordu.

original:
<T>These so-called special guests were not
summoned to the plaza at all. They were
ordered to stay away. Threatened, even.
translation:
<T>Sozde ozel konuklar aslinda
meydana hic cagrilmadi. Uzak durmalari
emredildi. Hatta tehdit edildiler.

original: <T><M3/2/2>But they were on that stage!<M3/1/2>
translation: <T><M3/2/2>Ama o sahnedeydiler!<M3/1/2>

original:
<T><M2/1/1>No, it merely looked as though they were.
Those {''}people{''} on stage were really just
expertly crafted mannequins.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hayir, sadece oyleymis gibi gorunuyordu.
Sahnedeki o {''}insanlar{''} aslinda
ustalikla yapilmis mankenlerdi.

original: <T>And the clothing?
translation: <T>Peki ya kiyafetler?

original:
<T>Ah yes, the dolls even wore clothing that
belonged to those they resembled, clothing
that was stolen in advance.
translation:
<T>Ah evet, kuklalar hatta benzedikleri kisilere
ait kiyafetleri giyiyordu; bu kiyafetler
en onceden calinmisti.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Ah! From the squash club! Some of them
did say they'd been victims of theft recently.
Hang on a moment, sir!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ah! Squash kulubunden! Bazilari yakin zamanda
hirsizliga ugradiklarini soylemisti.
Bir dakika efendim!

original:
<T><M6/2/1>While the 13 were safely at home, the
Masked Gentleman burned their likenesses
before the horrified crowd.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>13 kisi evinde guvendeyken,
Maskeli Beyefendi onlarin suretlerini
korkmus kalabaligin onunde yakti.

original:
<T>The onlookers were already convinced he
could perform miracles, so all it took was
some rudimentary pyrotechnics.
translation:
<T>Izleyenler onun mucize yapabildigine zaten
inanmisti, bu yuzden gereken tek sey
basit bir piroteknik gosterisiydi.

original: <T><M2/1/2/45>That's preposterous!
translation: <T><M2/1/2/45>Bu sacmaligin daniskasi!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Professor Layton, sir, you're right! I found
a second letter in one of the unsorted
evidence bags!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Profesor Layton efendim, hakliymissiniz! Tasnif edilmemis
kanit torbalarindan birinde
ikinci bir mektup buldum!

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>And there we have it.
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Iste bu kadar.

original: ブルーマイル
<T><M2/1/1>Very impressive, Professor.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Cok etkileyici, Profesor.

original:
<T>We're still investigating the petrification
incident, but once we have more to go on,
I'd appreciate your input.
translation:
<T>Taslasma olayini hala arastiriyoruz,
ama elimizde daha fazla bilgi oldugunda
goruslerinizi almak isterim.

original:
<T>Who knows? Now that we're on to the
Masked Gentleman's methods, perhaps
we can solve this one ourselves.
translation:
<T>Kim bilir? Maskeli Bey'in yontemlerini
artik anladigimiza gore
belki bunu kendimiz cozebiliriz.

original: レイトン
<T>I have faith in your team, Detective.
translation: <T>Ekibinize guveniyorum, Dedektif.

original: シバロフ

<T>We won't be beaten by this little toad and
his fancy circus tricks.
translation:
<T>Bu kucuk kurbaga ve
suslu sirk numaralarina yenilmeyecegiz.

original: グロスキー
<T>I knew they were tricks all along!
translation: <T>En basindan beri numara olduklarini biliyordum!

original:
<T>Now, I've got a crook to catch! I'll run
a thousand miles if I have to!
translation:
<T>Simdi gidip bir sucluyu yakalamam lazim! Gerekirse
bin mil kosarim!

original: <T><M1/1/2>FOR THE YARD!
translation: <T><M1/1/2>YARD ICIN!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Er, Inspector...? <W>Hmm, I think we'll be
leaving too.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Sey, Mufettis...? <W>Hmm, sanirim biz de
gidiyoruz.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Thanks again for your help, Professor.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Yardiminiz icin tekrar tesekkurler, Profesor.

original:
<T>Inspector Grosky and I will continue our
investigation of the petrification incident.
<W>Once he's calmed down, that is.
translation:
<T>Mufettis Grosky ile taslasma olayini
arastirmaya devam edecegiz.
<W>Tabii sakinlesince.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>We'll contact you just as soon as we've
finished.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Isimiz biter bitmez
sizinle iletisime gececegiz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I look forward to it. We'll follow our own
leads in the meantime.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sabirsizlikla bekliyorum. Bu arada biz de
kendi izlerimizin pesinden gidecegiz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Well then, meeting over. Back to the
investigation!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Peki o halde, toplanti bitti. Sorusturmaya
geri donun!

original: シバロフ

<T>Enough about accomplices! I'm telling you,
he's our man. Now, get me my evidence!
NOW!
translation:
<T>Yeter su suc ortagi muhabbeti! Size soyluyorum,
adamimiz o. Simdi kanitlarimi getirin!
HEMEN!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Ahh, Layton, good timing. We're on the
verge of a breakthrough here.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ahh, Layton, tam zamaninda geldin. Burada
bir atilimin esigindeyiz.

original:
<T>A few more pieces of evidence and we're
bringing our suspect in for questioning.
translation:
<T>Birkac kanit daha ve
supheliyi sorguya alacagiz.

original:
<T>Even if he tries to run, he won't get far.
There are ways to track a person's
movements.
translation:
<T>Kacmaya calissa bile fazla uzaklasamaz.
Birinin hareketlerini
takip etmenin yollari vardir.

original:
<T>Here, have a look at this. It's one of the
exercises we use to develop our men's
tracking skills.
translation:
<T>Al, suna bir bak. Bu, adamlarimizin
takip becerilerini gelistirmek icin
kullandigimiz alistirmalardan biri.

original:
<T>You solved all those cases, but you can't
solve this puzzle?
translation:
<T>Bunca davayi cozdun de
bu bulmacayi cozemiyor musun?

original:
<T>Work out where someone's been and it's
easier to work out where they're going!
translation:
<T>Birinin nerede oldugunu cikarirsan
nereye gittigini bulmak daha kolay olur!

original: <T>I knew you'd get it.
translation: <T>Anlayacagini biliyordum.

original:
<T>Our suspect is currently under close
surveillance. He won't be going anywhere.
translation:
<T>Suphelimiz su an yakindan
gozetim altinda. Bir yere gidemez.

original: レイトン
<T>Well, this sounds promising, Chief Inspector.
translation: <T>Bu umut verici gorunuyor, Basmufettis.

original:
<T>Thank you. Just protecting our city, as we
always have. <W>We don't need a fancy
Scotland Yard pen-pusher to help us.
translation:
<T>Tesekkurler. Her zaman yaptigimiz gibi
sehrimizi koruyoruz. <W>Bize yardim edecek
suslu bir Scotland Yard burokratina ihtiyacimiz yok.

original:
<T>Of course, but I'm sure Bloom doesn't wish
to step on your toes. He wants to catch the
criminal, like you.
translation:
<T>Elbette ama Bloom'un ayaklariniza basmak
istedigini sanmiyorum. O da sizin gibi
sucluyu yakalamak istiyor.

original:
<T>I know, I know. <W>It's just that these London
police always meddle and try to do things
their way.
translation:
<T>Biliyorum, biliyorum. <W>Ne var ki bu Londra
polisleri hep ise karisir ve
her seyi kendi yontemleriyle yapmaya calisir.

original:
<T>So remember, if you find anything, come to
me. I'm in charge here, not him.
translation:
<T>O yuzden unutma, bir sey bulursan
bana gel. Burada ben yetkiliyim, o degil.

original:
<T>As soon as we tie up a few loose ends,
we'll nail our suspect and bring him in!
translation:
<T>Birkac ucu daha baglar baglamaz
supheliyi yakalayip iceri alacagiz!

original: ブルーマイル

<T>Professor, with your reputation for cracking
cases, I must say I'm looking forward to
seeing the fruits of your investigation.
translation:
<T>Profesor, vakalari cozme konusundaki ununuzle,
sorusturmanizin meyvelerini gormeyi sabirsizlikla
bekliyorum.

original: レイトン

<T>Once we have something of note to report,
Detective, we will be sure to inform you.
translation:
<T>Kayda deger bir sey raporlayacak olursak,
Dedektif, sizi mutlaka bilgilendirecegiz.

original:
<T>And regarding your own investigation, have
you any inclination as to the identity of our
villain?
translation:
<T>Peki kendi sorusturmanizla ilgili olarak,
kotu adamimizin kimligi hakkinda bir kanaatiniz
var mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I suspect that the Masked Gentleman is
a tourist. In fact, I have my team scouring
hotel records as we speak.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
bir turist oldugundan supheleniyorum. Hatta ekibim su anda
otel kayitlarini didik didik ediyor.

original:
<T>It's slow work, though. There are hundreds
of tourists who have been in Monte d'Or for
over a month.
translation:
<T>Ama isler yavas ilerliyor. Monte d'Or'da
bir aydan uzun suredir bulunan
yuzlerce turist var.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>I imagine it's hard to gather many concrete
details regarding the culprit.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Suclu hakkinda somut
ayrintilar toplamak zor olmali.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Yes, especially given this town's situation.
The carnival certainly isn't helping.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Evet, ozellikle de kasabanin bu halinde.
Karnaval hic yardimci olmuyor.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Indeed, with so many either wearing a mask
or a costume, almost anyone could be
a suspect.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Dogrusu, bu kadar cok insan maske
ya da kostum takarken, neredeyse herkes
supheli olabilir.

original:
<T>What's more, Sheffield tiptoes around the
public. He's focused on shielding them
rather than catching the culprit!
translation:
<T>Ustelik Sheffield halkin etrafinda
parmak ucunda dolasiyor. Sucluyu yakalamaktan cok
onlari korumaya odaklanmis!

original:
<T>Doesn't he see that the best way to protect
the townspeople is to arrest the Masked
Gentleman?
translation:
<T>Kasabalilari korumanin en iyi yolunun Maskeli
Beyefendi'yi tutuklamak oldugunu
gormuyor mu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I'm sorry, I've got a mountain of profiles to
go through. I should get back to it.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Kusura bakmayin, gozden gecirmem gereken bir dag gibi dosya var.
Isimin basina donmeliyim.

original: レミ

<T><M2/1/3>Bloom and Sheffield don't seem to see eye
to eye, do they?
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Bloom ile Sheffield pek anlasamiyor gibi,
degil mi?

original:
<T>You might want to keep an eye on the local
hotel magnate Alphonse Dalston. Sheffield
suspects him.
translation:
<T>Yerel otel patronu Alphonse Dalston'a goz kulak olmak isteyebilirsiniz. Sheffield
ondan supheleniyor.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>He's too busy mollycoddling the locals
to do anything about it, though. If you find
anything, come to me.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ama o, yerlileri kollayip simartmakla
oyle mesgul ki bir sey yapamiyor. Bir sey bulursaniz
bana gelin.

original: オルトビルセン

<T>Layton, I just heard the news. Stupendous!
Absolutely incredible!
translation:
<T>Layton, az once haberi duydum. Muhtesem!
Kesinlikle inanilmaz!

original: レイトン
<T><M3/1/1/45>It was nothing, Mr Mayor.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Bir sey degil, Sayin Belediye Baskani.

original:
<T>None of that now. The officers told me how
you helped decipher these miracles we've
been plagued with.
translation:
<T>Oyle deme simdi. Memurlar bana, basimiza
bela olan bu mucizeleri cozmemize
nasil yardim ettigini anlatti.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We'll be able to reopen the gallery. <W>The
curator will be thrilled!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Galeriyi yeniden acabilecegiz. <W>Kurator
cok sevinecek!

original:
<T>He says some new pieces have already been
donated. I'll personally see to it that they're
checked for vanishing paint.
translation:
<T>Bazi yeni eserlerin simdiden bagislandigini soyluyor.
Kaybolan boya var mi diye
bizzat kontrol ettirecegim.

original: レミ

<T><M3/2/1>Great, Professor! We can investigate the
gallery ourselves now!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Harika, Profesor! Artik galeriyi
kendimiz de arastirabiliriz!

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Let's make it our next stop. We may find
some valuable clues. <W>And there are one or
two fine sculptures I'd like to see.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Bir sonraki duragimiz orasi olsun. Orada
degerli ipuclari bulabiliriz. <W>Hem gormek
istedigim bir iki guzel heykel de var.

original: ルーク

<T><M3/1/3>Hmm, I like paintings better. But I like clues
best of all!
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>Hmm, ben resimleri daha cok severim. Ama
en cok da ipuclarini severim!

original:
<T>I've notified the gallery staff that they can
reopen. Thanks again!
translation:
<T>Galeri personeline yeniden acabileceklerini
bildirdim. Tekrar tesekkurler!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Erm, Professor, that lady over there... Don't
we know her?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sey, Profesor, suradaki hanim... Onu
tanimiyor muyuz?

original: ハンナ
translation: Hannah

original:
<T>Ohhhh, Grosky! How well the neon lights of
Monte d'Or emphasise your resolute jaw!
translation:
<T>Ahhh, Grosky! Monte d'Or'un neon isiklari
kararli ceneni ne de guzel vurguluyor!

original:
<T>And the way the desert sun brings the flush
of sweat to your bare arms... Mmmm, it's
almost too much to bear.
translation:
<T>Ve col gunesinin ciplak kollarina terin kizilligini
yansitma sekli... Mmmm, bu
neredeyse dayanilmaz.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Oh, sorry. Didn't see you there! I'm
Hannah, president and sole member of the
Clampettes. Would you like to join?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ah, pardon. Seni orada gormemisim! Ben
Hannah, Clampettes'in baskani ve tek
uyesiyim. Katilmak ister misin?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Hello, Hannah. I thought I might see you
sooner or later.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Merhaba Hannah. Seni er ya da gec
gorecegimi dusunmustum.

original:
<T>Where Clamp goes, I will always follow. I've
barely seen him, though. He's been busy
with police work the whole time.
translation:
<T>Clamp nereye giderse ben de onu izlerim.
Ama onu pek goremedim. Butun bu sure
polis isleriyle mesguldu.

original:
<T><M4/2/3>Sorry you had to come all the way from
London for nothing.
translation:
<T><M4/2/3>Londra'dan bunca yolu bosuna geldigin
icin uzgunum.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Nothing? It's my duty and pleasure to
chronicle Grosky's every move. He's a
legend, simply unbelievable.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bosuna mi? Grosky'nin her hareketini
kayit altina almak benim gorevim ve zevkim.
O bir efsane, inanilmaz!

original: <T><M2/2/3>That's one way to describe him.
translation: <T><M2/2/3>Onu boyle tanimlamak da bir yol.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Hannah, have you by chance {''}chronicled{''}
the inspector while he investigated any of
the supposed miracles?
translation:
<T>Hannah, tesadufen {''}chronicled{''}
mufettis bu sozde mucizelerden herhangi birini
arastirirken onu kayda aldin mi?

original:
<T>Of course! <W>I've been on his trail ever since
he left London! He's been scouring the
whole city for clues.
translation:
<T>Elbette! <W>Londra'dan ayrildigindan beri
pesindeyim! Butun sehri ipuclari icin
didik didik ediyor.

original:
<T>And I was actually there last night when
those people got turned to stone. I nearly
got trampled! And where was my hero?!
translation:
<T>Ve dun gece o insanlar tasa cevrildiginde
ben de oradaydim. Neredeyse eziliyordum!
Peki benim kahramanim neredeydi?!

original:
<T><M3/3/4>Why, he was too busy chasing down the
villain to think of me, but how could I dislike
that fiery, unbridled passion?<M1/2/1>
translation:
<T><M3/3/4>Cunku kotu adami kovalamakla o kadar
mesguldu ki beni dusunemedi; ama ben
o atesli, dizginlenemez tutkuya nasil kizabilirim?<M1/2/1>

original:
<T><M1/2/3>Well, I suppose it's good that he's always
eager to track down injustice.
translation:
<T><M1/2/3>Eh, sanirim haksizligin pesine dusmeye her
zaman hevesli olmasi iyi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Isn't it? Speaking of tracking, I happened
to overhear a couple of officers talking
about a curious set of carriage tracks.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Oyle degil mi? Iz surmek demisken, iki
memurun garip bir araba izi takimindan
bahsettigini duydum.

original:
<T>Next time I see Grosky, I'm going to tell him
about the tracks. He works so hard, he may
not have heard about them yet!
translation:
<T>Grosky'yi bir dahaki gordugumde ona bu
izlerden bahsedecegim. O kadar cok calisiyor ki
henuz duymamis olabilir!

original:
<T>On a different note, I found this photo while
I was out documenting Grosky's movements.
translation:
<T>Baska bir konu: Grosky'nin hareketlerini
belgelerken bu fotografi buldum.

original: <T>I think there's some sort of puzzle in it!
translation: <T>Bence icinde bir tur bulmaca var!

original:
<T>That's okay, I wasn't sure either. At least
I can be sure about Grosky!
translation:
<T>Sorun degil, ben de emin degildim. En azindan
Grosky konusunda emin olabilirim!

original:
<T>Try out this puzzle before I show it to
Clamp!
translation:
<T>Bunu Clamp'e gostermeden once bu
bulmacayi dene!

original: <T>If only life were as simple as a puzzle...
translation: <T>Keske hayat bir bulmaca kadar basit olsa...

original:
<T><M1/3/1>What am I doing? I don't have time to mope
around! I'm president of the Clampettes
after all!
translation:
<T><M1/3/1>Ne yapiyorum ben? Kara kara dusunmeye
vaktim yok! Sonucta Clampettes'in baskani
benim!

original:
<T>I take my presidential duties seriously. If
Grosky is turned to stone, I'll just have to
store him in the living room.
translation:
<T>Baskanlik gorevlerimi ciddiye alirim. Eger
Grosky tasa cevrilirse, onu
salonda saklamak zorunda kalacagim.

original: ポリス

<T>Oi! Stop right there! Just what do you lot
think you're doing, loitering around the city
hall?
translation:
<T>Hey! Oldugunuz yerde durun! Siz ne
yaptiginizi saniyorsunuz, belediye binasinin
etrafinda avare avare dolasarak?

original: レイトン

<T>I think there's been a misunderstanding. We
are assisting the police with the Masked
Gentleman investigation.
translation:
<T>Sanirim bir yanlis anlasilma var. Biz
Maskeli Bey sorusturmasinda
polise yardim ediyoruz.

original:
<T>A likely story. You some sort of private
detective? You should have no trouble
solving this puzzle, then!
translation:
<T>Iyi hikaye. Ozel dedektif falan misiniz?
O zaman bu bulmacayi
cozmekte zorlanmazsiniz!

original:
<T>Just as I thought. I should bring you in under
suspicion of...<W>being suspicious.
translation:
<T>Tahmin ettigim gibi. Sizi
...supheli...<W>olmak suphesiyle iceri almaliyim.

original:
<T>Still loitering, eh? I'll be keeping a close
eye on you until you solve this puzzle.
translation:
<T>Hala oyalaniyorsunuz ha? Bu bulmacayi
cozene kadar sizi yakindan izleyecegim.

original:
<T>Hmm... Everything seems to be in order.
I suppose.
translation:
<T>Hmm... Her sey yolunda
gibi. Sanirim.

original: <T>Try to look less suspicious next time.
translation: <T>Bir dahaki sefere daha az supheli gorunmeye calisin.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Yes, well. I think we'll be on our way.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Evet, sey... Sanirim yolumuza gidelim.

original:
<T>Yes, move along, will you? I can't do my
job properly here with you tourists hanging
around.
translation:
<T>Evet, hadi ilerleyin olur mu? Siz turistler
burada oyalanirken isimi
duzgun yapamiyorum.

original:
<T>I've got my eye on you. And your suspicious
top hat.
translation:
<T>Gozum uzerinizde. Ve o supheli
silindir sapkanizda.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M5/2/1>Here we are! The gallery's open.
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Iste geldik! Galeri acik.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M2/1/1>Just like the mayor said.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Belediye baskaninin dedigi gibi.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M2/1/1>Let's go inside and have a look.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Iceri girip bir bakalim.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Ah, this is a fine gallery.
translation: <T>Ah, ne guzel bir galeri.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M5/2/1>Fine? It's magnificent!
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Guzel mi? Muhtesem!

original: オージー

<T>I cannot tell you how satisfying it is to share
our gift of fine art with the people again.
translation: <T>Guzel sanat armaganimizi yeniden insanlarla paylasmanin ne kadar tatmin edici oldugunu anlatamam.

original:
<T>I'm told we have you to thank for our grand
reopening. It's a great pleasure to meet you.
My name is Beaufort.
translation:
<T>Gorkemli yeniden acilisimiz icin size tesekkur etmemiz gerektigi soylendi. Sizinle tanismak buyuk bir mutluluk.
Benim adim Beaufort.

original: レイトン

<T><M1/2/1>Hershel Layton. I gather you are the curator
here. Would you mind if I asked you about
the recent miracle?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Hershel Layton. Galiba buranin kuratorusunuz.
Son mucize hakkinda size birkac soru sormamin sakincasi var mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Not at all, but I'm afraid you may be
disappointed. I didn't see anyone or
anything suspicious.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Elbette, ama hayal kirikligina ugrayabilirsiniz.
Kimseyi ya da
supheli bir seyi gormedim.

original:
<T>We'll be inspecting anonymous donations
much more carefully from now on, though.
translation:
<T>Yine de bundan sonra anonim bagislari
cok daha dikkatli inceleyecegiz.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>I don't imagine the Masked Gentleman will
be making any more donations here.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin buraya bir daha bagis yapacagini
sanmiyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I certainly hope not. <W>However, I rather
enjoyed the puzzle he included with the
paintings. Care to try?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Umarim yapmaz. <W>Yine de tablolarin arasina ilistirdigi bilmeceden oldukca keyif aldim.
Denemek ister misiniz?

original:
<T>Not to your taste, is it? Well, I stand by my
opinion - it's a nifty little thing.
translation: <T>Pek zevkinize uygun degil galiba. Neyse, ben fikrimin arkasindayim - sirin bir sey.

original:
<T>You've changed your mind? I knew you'd
come around.
translation: <T>Fikrinizi mi degistirdiniz? Doner dolasir geleceginizi biliyordum.

original:
<T>Oh, that was magnificent. It's no wonder
Detective Bloom speaks so highly of you.
translation: <T>Ah, muhtesemdi. Dedektif Bloom'un sizden bu kadar ovguyle soz etmesine sasmamali.

original:
<T>Reopening the gallery would not have been
possible without your help. Or Mr Ledore's,
for that matter.
translation: <T>Galeriyi yeniden acmak sizin yardiminiz olmadan mumkun olmazdi. Hatta Bay Ledore'un yardimi da olmasa.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Oh? Henry helped you?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Oyle mi? Henry size yardim etti mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yes, that's right. He kindly donated a
selection of pieces to replace those the
police confiscated.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet, dogru. Polislerin el koyduklarinin yerine gecsin diye nazikce bir
secki bagisladi.

original:
<T>So many, in fact, that we're even having to
store some on the top floor for now.
translation:
<T>O kadar cok ki, simdilik bir kismini ust katta
depolamak zorunda kaldik.

original:
<T>Exquisite sculptures, masterful watercolours,
it's quite a collection.
translation:
<T>Nefis heykeller, ustalikla yapilmis suluboyalar,
epey etkileyici bir koleksiyon.

original: ルーク

<T><M3/1/1>That sounds very generous! <W>But I suppose
it's easy when you're the wealthiest man in
town.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu cok comertce! <W>Ama tabii
sehrin en zengin adami olunca kolaydir.

original: <T>Indeed.
translation: <T>Dogru.

original:
<T>You know, I'm not much for small talk. If
you really want information, you should pay
a visit to the costume boutique.
translation:
<T>Bilirsiniz, pek laf olsun diye konusmayi sevmem. Gercekten bilgi istiyorsaniz
kostum butigine bir ugrayin.

original:
<T>The owner's lived here a long time and she
knows everything about everyone.
translation:
<T>Sahibi uzun zamandir burada yasiyor ve
herkes hakkinda her seyi bilir.

original: <T>He must be talking about Ludmilla.
translation: <T>Ludmilla'dan bahsediyor olmali.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Yes, it might be a good idea for us to speak
to her again.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Evet, onunla yeniden konusmamiz
iyi bir fikir olabilir.

original:
<T>My art critic friends gorge themselves on
caviar, but is there really anything better
than a gooey slice of pizza?
translation:
<T>Sanat elestirmeni arkadaslarim havyara gomulur, ama uzayip giden,
sulu bir pizza diliminden daha iyisi var mi gercekten?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It tastes even - munch - better when you're
surrounded by priceless - scoff, scoff -
works of art.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Etrafiniz paha bicilmez - scoff, scoff -
sanat eserleriyle cevriliyken, tadi daha da - munch -
guzel oluyor.

original: ラプンシュカ
translation: Rapunska

original:
<T>Hello there! Finally decided to choose a
costume, then?
translation:
<T>Merhaba! Sonunda bir
kostum secmeye karar verdin mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Not this time, I'm afraid. We were hoping
you could tell us a little more about
Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Bu sefer degil, maalesef. Monte d'Or hakkinda
bize biraz daha
anlatmanizi umuyorduk.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>The investigation's going slowly, is it? No
wonder you've come back to see me, then.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sorusturma yavas gidiyor, oyle mi? O halde
bana geri gelmenize sasmamali.

original:
<T>Getting solid information in Monte d'Or is
like gathering sand with a sieve.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'da saglam bilgi edinmek
elekle kum toplamaya benzer.

original:
<T>There are plenty of tourists coming and
going, but it's hard to find people who
really know the town.
translation:
<T>Gelen giden bir suru turist var, ama
kasabayi gercekten bilen
insanlari bulmak zor.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Yes, we've noticed that many of the people
we've talked to are somewhat uninformed.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Evet, konustugumuz kisilerin cogunun
biraz bilgisiz oldugunu fark ettik.

original: <T>See, I knew you were observant!
translation: <T>Gordun mu, gozlemci oldugunu biliyordum!

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Madam, I have a question about the local
police force.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Hanimefendi, yerel
polis teskilati hakkinda bir sorum var.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Not so fast. Do you think information grows
on trees? You're going to have to solve this
puzzle first.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>O kadar hizli degil. Bilginin agaclarda
bittigini mi saniyorsun? Once bu
bulmacayi cozmelisin.

original:
<T>No solution, no information. I'm sorry to
drive such a hard bargain, but I'm trying to
run a business here.
translation:
<T>Cozum yok, bilgi yok. Bu kadar siki pazarlik
ettigim icin kusura bakma ama burada
bir is yurutuyorum.

original:
<T>If you want more information, you'll have to
solve this puzzle first.
translation:
<T>Daha fazla bilgi istiyorsan once
bu bulmacayi cozmelisin.

original:
<T>Now then, you were going to tell us about
the local police force.
translation:
<T>Peki, yerel polis teskilati hakkinda
bize anlatacaktin.

original:
<T>Very well. <W>The people of Monte d'Or are
reluctant to rely on the local police.
translation:
<T>Pekala. <W>Monte d'Or halki
yerel polise bel baglamakta isteksiz.

original:
<T>It's not that our officers are untrustworthy,
they're just...well, inexperienced, shall we
say?
translation:
<T>Memurlarimizin guvenilmez olmasindan degil,
sadece... sey, deneyimsizler,
diyelim?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>And do you know anyone with a grudge
against the Ledores or Dalston?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Ledore'lara ya da Dalston'a kin besleyen
birini biliyor musun?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Well, I imagine there are hundreds who are
none too pleased about losing all their
savings in the casinos.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sey, kumarhanelerde tum birikimini
kaybeden yuzlerce kisi
pek memnun degildir herhalde.

original:
<T>But whoever's pulling off these flashy stunts
doesn't seem short of cash.
translation:
<T>Ama bu gosterisli numaralari
yapan kisi nakit sikintisi
cekiyor gibi gorunmuyor.

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>That's a good point.
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Bu iyi bir nokta.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Of course. Tell you what, though. That
circus out by Dalston's place must have
cash to spare.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Elbette. Ama sunu soyleyeyim: Dalston'in
oradaki sirkinde mutlaka
harcayacak para vardir.

original:
<T>They rented a stack of costumes from me
about a month ago. Covered my overheads
for the quarter.
translation:
<T>Yaklasik bir ay once benden bir yigin
kostum kiraladilar. Bu, bu ceyrekteki
giderlerimi karsiladi.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Don't circus performers usually have their
own costumes?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sirk sanatcilarinin genelde kendi
kostumleri olmaz mi?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/2/2>Oh! Maybe the circus group is performing
the miracles!
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Ah! Belki de mucizeleri yapan
sirk grubudur!

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>It's possible. In any case, we should see
what we can find out at the circus tent.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Olabilir. Her halukarda sirk cadirinda
neler ogrenebilecegimize bakmaliyiz.

original:
<T>Professor, you have a brilliant mind and the
poise of a gymnast, but your dress sense
leaves a lot to be desired.
translation:
<T>Profesor, muhtesem bir zekan ve
gimnastikci gibi bir durusun var ama giyim
zevkin pek ic acici degil.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>If you ever want a makeover, just say the
word.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bir gun imaj tazelemek istersen, sadece
soylemen yeter.

original: トリッキー

<T>What d'ya think of the Camel's Hump?
Pretty impressive, ain't it? <W>I'm Yukkles, by
the way.
translation:
<T>Camel's Hump hakkinda ne dusunuyorsun?
Epey etkileyici, degil mi? <W>Bu arada
ben Yukkles.

original: レイトン

<T>Ah yes, we met during the incident at the
parade. I'm glad to see you're well.
translation:
<T>Ah evet, gecit torenindeki olay sirasinda tanismistik.
Iyi oldugunuzu gormek guzel.

original:
<T>Oh! It's you! You know, I thought I'd be
turned to stone for sure. I guess I was just
lucky.
translation:
<T>Oh! Sizsiniz! Biliyor musunuz, kesin
tasa donecegim sanmistim. Sanirim
sansliymisim.

original: <T>So...what brings you up here today?
translation: <T>Peki... sizi bugun buraya getiren ne?

original:
<T>Our tent's set up west of here, but I'm on
a break.
translation:
<T>Cadirimiz buranin batisinda ama
ben moladayim.

original:
<T>I did my back in climbing out of the clown
car. I've just come up here to try solving
my puzzle with a bit of peace.
translation:
<T>Palyaco arabasindan cikarken belimi incittim.
Biraz huzur icinde
bulmacami cozmeye calismak icin buraya geldim.

original:
<T>It's not done a blind bit of good, though.
Hey, how'd you feel about helping an old
clown out?
translation:
<T>Ama zerre faydasi olmadi.
Hey, yasli bir
palyacoya yardim etmeye ne dersin?

original: <T>I'm never gonna solve this one, am I?
translation: <T>Bunu asla cozemeyecegim, degil mi?

original:
<T>I just need to calm the old noggin and work
through this puzzle a step at a time. <W>Or how
about you do it for me?
translation:
<T>Su kafayi bir sakinlestirip bu bulmacayi
adim adim cozmem lazim. <W>Ya da
benim yerime sen yapsan?

original:
<T>Thanks for the distraction, mate. For
a second there I almost forgot about my
crippling back pain.
translation:
<T>Dikkatimi dagittigin icin sag ol, dostum. Bir an
belimi kivrandiran agriyi
neredeyse unuttum.

original:
<T>Listen, I should be getting back now. You
should stop by the circus some time. It'd
cheer our tiger up buckets.
translation:
<T>Bak, artik donmem gerek. Bir ara sirke
ugra. Kaplanimizin
keyfini yerine getirir, hem de cok.

original:
<T>Bah. I guess I should get back to work. If
the ringmaster catches me here, I'll be on
tiger-bathing duty for a week.
translation:
<T>Bah. Sanirim ise donmeliyim. Sef beni
burada yakalarsa
bir hafta kaplan yikama nobetine kalirim.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I haven't been to a circus for ages.
Let's go!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Uzun zamandir sirke gitmemistim.
Hadi gidelim!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M2/1/7>We didn't come here to clown around,
Luke.
translation:
<T><M2/1/7>Buraya soytarilik yapmaya gelmedik,
Luke.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>But I suppose we have to go where the
investigation- <W30>Oooh! What a ferocious tiger!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ama sanirim sorusturma nereye
giderse oraya gitmeliyiz- <W30>Ooo! Ne vahsi bir kaplan!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Now I'm curious! <M3/2/2>Come on, you two! Let's
go!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Simdi merak ettim! <M3/2/2>Hadi siz ikiniz! Haydi
gidelim!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M3/2/4>Emmy! <M5/2/3>That's not setting a good example!
translation: <T><M3/2/4>Emmy! <M5/2/3>Bu iyi bir ornek olmuyor!

original: ダンチョー
translation: Sirk Muduru

original:
<T>Ladies and gentlemen, children of all ages!
Welcome to the Stellar Circus!
translation:
<T>Hanimefendiler ve beyefendiler, her yastan cocuklar!
Stellar Sirki'ne hos geldiniz!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hello, Ringmaster. The rabbit you gave us is
doing well.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Merhaba, Sirk Muduru. Verdiginiz tavsan
gayet iyi.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Oh, that creature. I forgot about that.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ah, o yaratik. Onu unutmustum.

original:
<T>And that's 'cause business is booming!
Mr Dalston hired us about a month ago, and
we've been sold out every night.
translation:
<T>Ve bunun nedeni islerimizin patlamasi!
Bay Dalston yaklasik bir ay once bizi tuttu ve
her gece biletler tukendi.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Even as we speak, our star performer is out
before a packed crowd.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Su anda bile yildiz sanatcimiz
tiklim tiklim bir kalabaligin onunde sahnede.

original:
<T>I really can't thank Mr Dalston enough for
his investment. He even offered us this
prime location!
translation:
<T>Bay Dalston'a yatirimi icin ne kadar tesekkur
etsem az. Hatta bize bu
harika yeri bile ayarladi!

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Ringmaster, I'm told that you recently
rented a large quantity of costumes from
a local boutique.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Sirk Muduru, yakin zamanda
yerel bir butikten cok sayida kostum
kiraladiginiz soyleniyor.

original:
<T>Looking around your establishment, it's
clear you already have more than enough.
<W>Why did you need to hire more?
translation:
<T>Isletmenize soyle bir bakinca
zaten fazlasiyla kostumunuz oldugu
<W>anlasiliyor. Neden daha fazlasini kiraladiniz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hey! Underneath the face paint and the
coloured wigs, circus performers are real
people with real needs.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hey! Yuz boyasinin ve
renkli peruklarin altinda, sirk sanatcilari
gercek ihtiyaclari olan gercek insanlardir.

original:
<T>They wanted to enjoy the carnival with the
rest of the city, but I didn't want them
ruining their work uniforms.
translation:
<T>Sehrin geri kalaniyla karnavalin tadini
cikarmak istediler ama ben is kiyafetlerini
mahvetmelerini istemedim.

original:
<T>So I hired them a bunch of the carnival
costumes the locals and tourists usually
wear. Is that a problem?
translation:
<T>Bu yuzden yerel halkin ve turistlerin
genelde giydigi bir suru karnaval
kostumu kiraladim. Bu bir sorun mu?

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>No, of course not. That was kind of you.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Hayir, elbette degil. Cok naziksiniz.

original:
<T>Hmph, I like to think so. I also like to think
that I'm smart enough to solve puzzles, but
I'm stumped by this one. Can you help?
translation:
<T>Hih, oyle oldugunu dusunmek isterim. Ben de
bulmaca cozebilecek kadar zeki oldugumu
dusunurum ama bunda tikandim. Yardim eder misin?

original: <T>Stumped you too, did it?
translation: <T>Seni de mi tikadi, ha?

original:
<T>Until this puzzle is solved, I won't be able to
concentrate on anything else.
translation:
<T>Bu bulmaca cozulene kadar baska hicbir seye
odaklanamayacagim.

original:
<T>I'm impressed. With wit like yours, you'd
make a fine clown. Or perhaps an animal
trainer.
translation:
<T>Etkilendim. Senin gibi bir zekayla
iyi bir palyaco olurdun. Ya da belki bir hayvan
terbiyecisi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Speaking of which, you should meet our
resident tiger, the ferocious and fearsome
Hannibal!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu arada, yerlesik kaplanimiz,
vahsi ve korkutucu
Hannibal'la tanismalisiniz!

original:
<T>Mr Dalston visits him quite often. His
enclosure is right over there if you want to
see him.
translation:
<T>Bay Dalston onu oldukca sik ziyaret eder.
Kafesi surada; isterseniz
onu gorebilirsiniz.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>A white tiger... <W><M5/1/1>Do you think you could talk
to him, Luke?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Beyaz bir kaplan... <W><M5/1/1>Sence onunla
konusabilir misin, Luke?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/1>I don't know...but I'd love to try!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Bilmiyorum... ama denemeyi cok isterim!

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Thank you, Ringmaster. We'd be delighted
to talk to Hannibal for a moment.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Tesekkurler, Sirk Muduru. Hannibal'la bir an
konusmaktan memnun oluruz.

original:
<T>Uh, talk? <W>With the tiger? <W>Well, it's no skin
off my nose.
translation:
<T>Sey, konusmak mi? <W>Kaplanla mi? <W>Peki, bana ne,
benim icin fark etmez.

original:
<T>Careful now! He's not {''}the ferocious and
fearsome Hannibal{''} for nothing.
translation:
<T>Dikkatli olun! O bosuna {''}the ferocious and
fearsome Hannibal{''} degil.

original:
<T>Have fun {''}talking{''} to Hannibal. <W>Ahhaw
guhhaw guhhaw! This city is full of
characters.
translation:
<T>Hannibal'la {''}talking{''} ederken iyi eglenceler. <W>Ahhaw
guhhaw guhhaw! Bu sehir tam bir
karakterler gecidi.

original: ダンチョー
translation: Sirk Muduru

original:
<T>Hannibal has worked with the finest trainers
in the world.<W> Don't try to pet him, though.
He'll bite your hand off!
translation:
<T>Hannibal dunyanin en iyi terbiyecileriyle calisti.
<W> Ama sakin onu sevmeye kalkma.
Elini koparir!

original: ダンチョー
translation: Sirk Muduru

original: <T>I thought you wanted to {''}talk{''} to the tiger.
translation: <T>Kaplanla {''}talk{''} etmek istedigini sanmistim.

original: チルチル
translation: Hannibal

original: <T>Grrrrowl-gaarrrrowl. GRRRRAAAR!
translation: <T>Grrrrowl-gaarrrrowl. GRRRRAAAR!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>Oh my! He's certainly talkative.
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Vay canina! Gercekten de konuskan.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>According to the ringmaster, he's quite
fearsome.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Sirk mudurune gore oldukca
korkutucuymus.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/1>And ferocious! <W>Let me see if he can
understand me!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ve vahsi! <W>Bakalim beni
anlayabilecek mi!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M4/2/1>I still think it's odd that you can talk to
animals, Luke. But since it's aiding our
investigation, I'll keep my mouth shut.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Luke, hayvanlarla konusabilmen hala bana
tuhaf geliyor. Ama sorusturmamiza yardimci
oldugu icin sesimi cikarmayacagim.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Erm, thanks...I suppose. <W>I hope he's not too
ferocious.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Ee, tesekkurler... sanirim. <W>Umarim cok da
vahsi degildir.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Don't worry. Just think of him as a giant
house cat. With bigger teeth.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Merak etme. Onu dev bir
ev kedisi gibi dusun. Daha buyuk disleri var.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Well, here goes nothing. <W><M1/1/3>Hello, Hannibal!
We're here to solve the puzzle of the
Masked Gentleman! Would you-
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Peki, hadi bakalim. <W><M1/1/3>Merhaba, Hannibal!
Mucize Beyefendi'nin bulmacasini
cozmeye geldik! Sen de-

original: <T>Gaaarr, grrrr-garr...<W>GRRROWR grawr.
translation: <T>Gaaarr, grrrr-garr...<W>GRRROWR grawr.

original: <T><M4/1/1>Oh, really?
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Oyle mi?

original: <T>Grrrawr...
translation: <T>Grrrawr...
<T><M2/2/1>...<W>Anladim.

original: <T><M5/2/3>What is it, Luke? What did he say?
translation: <T><M5/2/3>Luke, ne oldu? Ne dedi?

original:
<T><M1/1/4>He says he's got his own puzzle that needs
solving, ha ha!
translation:
<T><M1/1/4>Kendi cozulmesi gereken bir bulmacasi
oldugunu soyluyor, ha ha!

original: <T>Grrrowl.
translation: <T>Grrrowl.

original: <T>GRRRRRRRAWR!
translation: <T>GRRRRRRRAWR!

original: <T>Garr-garrraw?
translation: <T>Garr-garrraw?

original: <T>Grrrar-grrraw. Purrrrrr...
translation: <T>Grrrar-grrraw. Purrrrrr...

original: <T>Grrrrr garrawr. Gr-grrrrowl, graaawr!
translation: <T>Grrrrr garrawr. Gr-grrrrowl, graaawr!

original: <T>Wow!
translation: <T>Vay!

original: <T>What is it?! Don't just say wow!
translation: <T>Ne var?! Oylece "vay" deyip durma!

original: <T><M2/1/1>Hannibal is friends with Mr Dalston!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Hannibal, Bay Dalston'la arkadas!

original:
<T>And he's not ferocious or fearsome at all.
He's just a cub.
translation:
<T>Ve hic de vahsi ya da korkutucu degil.
Sadece bir yavru.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>He says Mr Dalston brings him treats and
scratches him behind the ears.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bay Dalston ona oduller getirdigini ve
kulaklarinin arkasini kasidigini soyluyor.

original:
<T>He also said that last night after the circus
finished, Mr Dalston brought him a treat and
played with him.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>O da dun gece sirk bittikten sonra
Bay Dalston'in ona bir odul getirip
onunla oynadigini soyledi.<M1/1/1>

original: <T><M3/2/4>Wow. Who would have guessed?
translation: <T><M3/2/4>Vay. Kim tahmin ederdi?

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>He rarely shows it, but Dalston has always
loved animals.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Pek belli etmez ama Dalston her zaman
hayvanlari sevmistir.

original: <T><M2/2/1>So, if the circus had a show last night...
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Yani, sirk dun gece gosteri yaptiysa...

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>The circus members couldn't have been
helping the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Sirk uyeleri Mucize Beyefendi'ye
yardim ediyor olamaz.

original:
<T>As for Dalston... Well, I doubt he'd want to
upstage the circus he himself hired.
translation:
<T>Dalston'a gelince... Sey, kendi tuttugu sirkin
onune gecmek isteyecegini sanmiyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>And anyway, Professor, if he was with
Hannibal, he can't be the culprit, can he?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hem de Profesor, eger Hannibal'laydiysa
suclu o olamaz, degil mi?

original: <T><M2/2/1>Not according to our evidence so far.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Su ana kadarki kanitlara gore, hayir.

original: <T><M2/2/1>So we're back to square one.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Yani basa donduk.

original: <T>Grrrawr?
translation: <T>Grrrawr?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>My, it's already getting late.
translation: <T>Aman, saat epey gec olmus.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Professor, the Masked Gentleman's warning
said that his next miracle would happen
tonight!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Profesor, Maskeli Beyefendi'nin uyarisinda
bir sonraki mucizesinin bu gece
olacagi yaziyordu!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M3/1/1>We'd better hurry to the gallery plaza!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Galeri meydanina acele etsek iyi olur!

original: コマーニ無

<T>Stellar Circus! Come one, come all to the
Stellar Circus!
translation:
<T>Stellar Sirki! Buyurun, buyurun, herkes
Stellar Sirki'ne!

original:
<T>Oh, my favourite visitors! Would you like
a flyer? And while you're at it, want to see
my bear sticker collection?
translation:
<T>Ah, en sevdigim ziyaretcilerim! Bir brosur ister misiniz?
Hem hazir buradayken, ayicik cikartma koleksiyonumu gormek ister misiniz?

original:
<T>I just finished arranging them on my break,
there. Look how sweet they are, with their
little hats and-<W30><M1/2/1> Eeek! <W>Where's the last one?
translation:
<T>Az once molamda onlari dizmeyi bitirdim,
iste. Su tatliliklarina bakin, kucuk sapkalariyla ve-<W30><M1/2/1> Aaa! <W>Sonuncusu nerede?

original:
<T>Ay ay ay! If I don't find which sticker should
go there, I'm going to be too flustered to
work! And then I'll be in deep trouble!
translation:
<T>Ay ay ay! Oraya hangi cikartmanin
gelmesi gerektigini bulamazsam, o kadar paniklerim ki
calisamam! O zaman da basim fena derde girer!

original:
<T>I need to get back to handing out these
flyers but knowing that one of my stickers
is missing, I just can't!
translation:
<T>Bu brosurleri dagitmaya geri donmem lazim ama cikartmalarimdan birinin
eksik oldugunu bilince yapamiyorum!

original: <T>Phew! You really saved my bacon!
translation: <T>Oh be! Gercekten beni kurtardiniz!

original: ルーク

<T>Putting up posters, handing out flyers -
sounds like hard work.
translation:
<T>Afis asmak, brosur dagitmak -
kulaga zor is gibi geliyor.

original:
<T>Oh, it's very demanding! But how else can
I tell people about the circus?<W> Oo, actually!
I've just had a fantastic idea!
translation:
<T>Ah, cok yorucu! Ama sirki insanlara baska nasil duyurabilirim ki?<W> Aa, durun!
Az once harika bir fikir geldi aklima!

original:
<T>If I could fly like the Masked Gentleman,
I could hand out flyers from the sky. I'd be
the first ever flying flyerer!
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi gibi ucabilseydim,
brosurleri gokten dagitabilirdim. Dunyanin
ilk ucan brosurcusu olurdum!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Imagine the crowds I'd bring in. The tent
would be chock-a-block!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bir dusunun, ne kalabalik toplardim. Cadir
tiklim tiklim olurdu!

original:
<T>It would be like a dream. I'd be happy as
a lark! <W>Oh, it's too much to think about!
translation: <T>Ruya gibi olurdu. Kuslar kadar mutlu olurdum! <W>Ah, dusunmesi bile fazla!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>That's...<W>an interesting plan. But how are you
going to fly?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu...<W>ilginc bir plan. Ama nasil
ucacaksiniz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Well, I haven't got that far yet, but if you
run into the Masked Gentleman can you ask
him about it for me?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sey, henuz o kadarini dusunmedim ama Maskeli Beyefendi'yle karsilasirsaniz,
benim icin ona sorar misiniz?

original: レイトン

<T><M4/2/1>That seems like an unnecessarily dangerous
way to hand out flyers. I recommend sticking
to the ground.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Bu, brosur dagitmanin gereksiz yere tehlikeli bir yolu gibi.
Yerde kalmanizi tavsiye ederim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Yeah, I just remembered that I'm terrified of
heights, anyway.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Evet, zaten
yukseklikten odum koptugunu simdi hatirladim.

original:
<T>Mind you, I'm always terrified at ground
level too.
translation: <T>Gerci yerdeyken de her zaman korkuyorum ya.

original: ポリス

<T>Professor, you should get a move on. The
Masked Gentleman is due to show any
moment now!
translation:
<T>Profesor, acele etmelisiniz. Maskeli Bey
her an
ortaya cikabilir!

original: レイトン
<T><M1/2/1>Yes, we're on our way to the plaza now.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Evet, simdi meydana gidiyoruz.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>If the chief inspector has tightened security,
the Masked Gentleman may find his
movements severely hampered.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Basmufettis guvenligi sikilastirdiysa
Maskeli Bey'in hareketleri
ciddi sekilde kisitlanabilir.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hampered is the word, all right. The chief's
identified the culprit. We're bringing him in
tonight.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Aynen oyle, kisitlandi. Sef sucluyu
tespit etti. Bu gece
onu iceri aliyoruz.

original: <T><M2/2/1>The culprit? You know who he is?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Suclu mu? Kim oldugunu biliyor musunuz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I don't know the details, sorry. But the task
force is mobilising in the plaza as we speak.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Detaylari bilmiyorum, kusura bakmayin. Ama ozel ekip
su anda meydanda toplaniyor.

original: <T><M4/2/1>I have a bad feeling about this.
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Bu isten kotu bir his aliyorum.

original:
<T>I've been posted here, so I'll have to miss
all the action. <W>Typical.
translation:
<T>Buraya gorevlendirildim, o yuzden
tum aksiyonu kaciracagim. <W>Her zamanki gibi.

original:
<T>You should hurry to the gallery plaza if you
don't want to miss it yourself.
translation:
<T>Siz de kacirmak istemiyorsaniz
galeri meydanina acele edin.

original: バスカル
translation: Pascal

original:
<T>Welcome back, Professor. <W>Haven't you
heard? The Masked Gentleman is due to
make an appearance in the plaza.
translation:
<T>Tekrar hos geldiniz, Profesor. <W>Duydunuz mu?
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin birazdan
meydanda ortaya cikmasi bekleniyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Funny how fast rumours spread, isn't it? <W>So,
sir, have you any interest in attending?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Soylentilerin ne kadar hizli yayildigi komik, degil mi? <W>Peki,
efendim, izlemek ister misiniz?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Yes, we're actually on our way to the plaza
right now.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Evet, aslinda su anda meydana
gidiyoruz.

original:
<T>If only I weren't on duty, I'd be inclined to
join you. The previous miracles were most
extraordinary.
translation:
<T>Keske gorevde olmasaydim da size
katilabilseydim. Onceki mucizeler
son derece olaganustuydu.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Oh well, I shall marvel over the miracle of
perfectly shined silverware instead. Good
evening to you, sir.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Eh, ben de bunun yerine kusursuz parlatilmis
catal bicagin mucizesine hayran kalirim. Iyi
aksamlar, efendim.

original:
<T>The miracle is due to begin! I should hurry if
I were you!
translation:
<T>Mucize birazdan baslayacak! Ben olsam
acele ederdim!

original: <T>Enjoy your evening, Professor.
translation: <T>Iyi aksamlar, Profesor.

original: グロリア
translation: Gloria

original:
<T>Hershel, lad, it's terrible! That nasty Masked
Gentleman is going to appear again tonight!
translation:
<T>Hershel evladim, felaket! O hain Maskeli
Beyefendi bu gece yine ortaya cikacak!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Don't worry, Gloria. Just be sure to stay
away from the gallery plaza.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Merak etme, Gloria. Sadece Galeri
Meydani'ndan uzak dur.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh, it's past my bedtime anyway. Are you
going, then?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ah, zaten benim yatma saatim gecti. Peki,
sen gidiyor musun?

original: <T><M3/2/1>Yes, I must continue my investigation.
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Evet, sorusturmama devam etmeliyim.

original:
<T>Look at you, all grown-up! Well, I won't
stop you from going, but do be careful.
translation:
<T>Sana bak, buyumus de adam olmus! Eh, gitmene
engel olmam ama dikkatli ol.

original:
