<T><M2/1/1>If Lucille knew you were heading straight
into danger, she'd have a fit.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Lucille dogruca tehlikeye gittigini
bilse kiyameti koparirdi.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Of course, Gloria. I'll be careful.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Elbette, Gloria. Dikkatli olacagim.

original:
<T>Monte d'Or has always been rowdy, but with
all this Masked Gentleman business, it's
become downright dangerous!
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or her zaman hareketliydi ama
bu Maskeli Beyefendi meselesiyle
tam anlamiyla tehlikeli oldu!

original:
<T>We'll all sleep easier once this miracle mess
is behind us.
translation:
<T>Bu mucize karmasasi
bitince hepimiz daha rahat uyuyacagiz.

original: ナルキス

<T>Aha aha! Behold the play of these neon
lights upon my elegant form. See how they
emphasise its perfection!
translation:
<T>Aha aha! Bu neon isiklarin
zarif bedenim uzerindeki oyununa bakin.
Nasil da kusursuzlugunu vurguluyorlar!

original: レイトン
<T><M1/2/1>I'm sorry...<W> What was that?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Affedersiniz...<W> Ne demistiniz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Don't you appreciate fine art when you see
it? Just look at my flawless nose, my
glorious chin...my, aha, effortless smirk!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Guzel sanati gorunce takdir etmiyor musunuz?
Kusursuz burnuma, muhtesem
ceneme bakin... ve iste, aha, zahmetsiz gulumsememe!

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Hm, now that you mention it, your face
does remind me of a puzzle.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Hm, simdi soyleyince, yuzunuz
gercekten de bir bulmacayi andiriyor.

original: レミ

<T><M3/1/2>Careful, Professor! Not everything is a
puzzle!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Dikkatli olun, Profesor! Her sey
bulmaca degil!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Oh...<W15>I'm sorry. <W15>I could have sworn there was
a puzzle here. <W>My mistake.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Oh...<W15>Uzgunum. <W15>Burada bir bulmaca olduguna
yemin edebilirdim. <W>Benim hatam.

original: <T><M5/2/1>Let's just move on.
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Hadi devam edelim.

original:
<T>I feel I ought to apologise to the rest of the
world for my devastating beauty.
translation:
<T>Kalan herkesten, bu buyuleyici
guzelligim icin ozur dilemem gerektigini hissediyorum.

original: <T><M2/1/1>It's not my fault I was born symmetrical!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Simetrik dogmak benim sucum degil!

original: ラプンシュカ
<T><M1/2/1>Just can't stay away, can you, now?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Demek kendinizi uzak tutamiyorsunuz, oyle mi?

original: レイトン
<T><M3/1/1>Well, you've been very helpful thus far.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Simdiye kadar cok yardimci oldunuz.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Oh? That was nothing. Look, I picked out
a new outfit for you while you were gone.
Let's start with that hideous hat.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Oh? O bir sey degildi. Bak, yoklugunda
sana yeni bir kiyafet sectim.
Su korkunc sapkayla baslayalim.

original: <T><M1/2/1>I beg your pardon, madam. I must decline.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Affedersiniz hanimefendi. Reddetmek zorundayim.

original:
<T>Hmph. Very well, then. I know better than to
try to convince you gentleman types.
translation:
<T>Hmph. Pekala. Sizin gibi beyefendi tiplerini
ikna etmeye calismamak gerektigini biliyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Anyway, here's an interesting titbit for you:
we've got a pair of tourists slinging false
accusations and extorting money.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Neyse, size ilginc bir bilgi: Iki turist
asilsiz suclamalar savurup
para sizdiriyormus.

original:
<T>I'm telling you, these two are trouble. Don't
go getting yourselves tangled up in their
schemes.
translation:
<T>Size soyluyorum, bu ikisi bela. Sakin
kendinizi onlarin
duzenlerine kaptirmayin.

original: <T><M5/1/1>Thank you. We'll keep that in mind.
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Tesekkur ederim. Aklimizda tutacagiz.

original:
<T>Monte d'Or attracts all sorts. You'd be
amazed by the stories I've heard.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or her tur insani ceker. Duydugum
hikayelere sasirirdiniz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But this business with the Masked
Gentleman is definitely the weirdest thing
I've ever witnessed.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama Maskeli
Bey'le ilgili bu is kesinlikle
simdiye kadar gordugum en tuhaf sey.

original: ゴンゾ
translation: Gonzo

original:
<T>I'm so very sorry, sir. Mr Dalston has just
left to go to the plaza.
translation:
<T>Cok uzgunum efendim. Bay Dalston az once
meydana gitmek uzere ayrildi.

original:
<T>I'd hate for you to come all the way out to
Ch{^a}teau Dalston for nothing, so here,
please take this puzzle.
translation:
<T>Ch{^a}teau Dalston'a kadar bosuna
gelmis olmanizi istemem, buyurun,
lutfen su bulmacayi alin.

original:
<T>I'm sorry you don't like my puzzle. It's one
of Mr Dalston's favourites.
translation:
<T>Bulmacami begenmediginiz icin uzgunum. Bu,
Bay Dalston'in en sevdiklerinden biridir.

original:
<T>You've come all this way. I must insist you
allow me to entertain you with a puzzle.
translation:
<T>Bunca yolu geldiniz. Sizi bir bulmacayla
eglendirmeme izin vermeniz icin israr etmeliyim.

original:
<T>Well done, sir. <W>I suppose you should be
making your way to the gallery plaza now?
translation:
<T>Aferin efendim. <W>Sanirim simdi Galeri Meydani'na
dogru yola koyulmalisiniz, degil mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M2/1/1>My thoughts exactly.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Aynen oyle dusunuyorum.

original:
<T>If you see Mr Dalston, will you try to keep
him out of trouble? I'd hate for him to
become a victim of a miracle.
translation:
<T>Bay Dalston'i gorurseniz, onu beladan uzak
tutmaya calisir misiniz? Bir mucizenin
kurbani olmasini istemem.

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Ah ha! What's that, Masked Gentleman?
You want me to read you your rights? How
about a couple of lefts? WA-POW!<M3/1/2>
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Aha! Ne var, Maskeli Beyefendi?
Haklarini mi okuyayim istiyorsun? Sana
birkac sol cakayim mi? WA-POW!<M3/1/2>

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M5/1/4>Hard at work, Inspector?
translation: <T><M5/1/4>Siki calisiyorsunuz, Mufettis?

original:
<T><M1/1/2/45>Aughh! <W>Ah, Emmy, it's you. <W>If you're looking
for Bloom, he's off arguing with Sheffield.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2/45>Ahh! <W>Ah, Emmy, sensin. <W>Eger Bloom'u
ariyorsan, Sheffield'la tartismaya gitti.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Things aren't going smoothly?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Isler yolunda gitmiyor mu?

original:
<T><M2/1/2/45>These desert dodos don't know the first
thing about police work! We should be
evacuating everyone from the plaza.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2/45>Su col kazlari polislikten zerre anlamiyor!
Herkesi
meydandan tahliye etmeliyiz.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>It doesn't matter, though. I'm going to
arrest the crook the minute he shows up.<M3/1/1>
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ama fark etmez. Gorundugu anda
onu tutuklayacagim.<M3/1/1>

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>I look forward to it.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Sabirsizlikla bekliyorum.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>I'll get you this time, or my name isn't
Clamp Grosky!<M3/1/2/15>
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Bu sefer yakalayacagim seni, yoksa adim
Clamp Grosky degil!<M3/1/2/15>

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M5/1/1>Look, Professor! There's Angela.
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Bakin, Profesor! Angela orada.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Angela, I didn't expect to see you here.
translation: <T>Angela, seni burada gormeyi beklemiyordum.

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original:
<T><M7/1/1>I had to come, Hershel. I'm worried about
the town.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Gelmek zorundaydim, Hershel. Sehir icin
endiseleniyorum.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>But it's dangerous here. The Masked
Gentleman could appear any minute now.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ama burasi tehlikeli. Maskeli
Beyefendi her an ortaya cikabilir.

original: <T><M4/1/1>Yes, we received a letter, too.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Evet, biz de bir mektup aldik.

original:
<T><M8/1/1>It said that Henry and I had to come tonight.
So you see, we have no choice.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Henry'yle bu gece gelmemiz gerektigini
yaziyordu. Yani goruyorsun, baska caremiz yok.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But why are all these tourists here? Don't
they realise they're in danger?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama bu turistlerin hepsi neden burada? Tehlikede
olduklarinin farkinda degiller mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Unfortunately, curiosity tends to be stronger
than fear.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Ne yazik ki merak cogu zaman
korkudan daha baskin gelir.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M2/2/1>I wonder what's going to happen...
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Acaba ne olacak...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: あ、先生！あれを！！
translation: Aa, Profesor! Suna bakin!!

original: 空中を
translation: Havada

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: 歩いているの！？
translation: Yuruyor mu!?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: そんな馬鹿な…
translation: Olmaz oyle sey...

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original: どういうことだ！
translation: Bu da ne demek!

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original: これが奇跡…
translation: Iste mucize...

original: 奇跡の紳士
translation: Maskeli Beyefendi

original:
はっははは…！諸君、
今夜もまた私のショーをごらんに入れよう。
今日は空中浮遊ショーだ！
translation:
Ha ha ha...! Bayanlar baylar,
bu gece de sizlere gosterimi sunacagim.
Bugun havada suzulme gosterisi!

original: 奇跡の紳士
translation: Mucize Beyefendi

original:
<V0010><T><M2/1/1>I hope you've enjoyed tonight's miracle.
<L2.85>I strive to please.</V>
translation:
<V0010><T><M2/1/1>Umarim bu geceki mucizeyi begenmissinizdir.
<L2.85>Memnun etmeye calisirim.</V>

original:
<V0020><T>Monte d'Or is not long for this world. <L3.0>Those
who prosper by the mask must also wither
by it.</V>
translation:
<V0020><T>Monte d'Or'un bu dunyada fazla zamani kalmadi. <L3.0>Maskeyle
yukselenler, onunla da solup
gidecek.</V>

original:
<V0030><T><M3/1/1>I do hope you'll be at my next show
tomorrow. <L2.8>Stop by Tingly Town...<L4.7>if you have
the time.</V>
translation:
<V0030><T><M3/1/1>Umarim bir sonraki gosterimde olursunuz
yarin. <L2.8>Tingly Town'a ugrayin...<L4.7>eger
vaktiniz olursa.</V>

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<V0010><T><M3/1/1>Tingly Town? <L1.45>That's the amusement park
here, right?</V>
translation:
<V0010><T><M3/1/1>Tingly Town? <L1.45>Burasi buradaki lunapark,
degil mi?</V>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<V0020><T><M4/2/1/45>I believe so. <L1.3>And with that, we have advance
warning of the Masked Gentleman's next
move.</V>
translation:
<V0020><T><M4/2/1/45>Sanirim oyle. <L1.3>Ve boylece Mucize Beyefendi'nin bir sonraki
hamlesine dair
onceden uyarimiz var.</V>

original: 奇跡の紳士
translation: Mucize Beyefendi

original:
<V0030><T>Ah! <L0.8>And look, <L2.0>it's the beautiful wife of
the richest man in town! <L5.85>Say hello to
Mrs Angela Ledore!</V>
translation:
<V0030><T>Ah! <L0.8>Ve bakin, <L2.0>kasabanin en zengin adaminin guzel
esi! <L5.85>Bayan Angela Ledore'a
merhaba deyin!</V>

original:
<V0040><T><M2/1/1>Mrs Ledore, please grace us with your
presence tomorrow. <L4.6>I suppose you can
bring Mr Ledore if you must.</V>
translation:
<V0040><T><M2/1/1>Bayan Ledore, lutfen yarin bizi
sereflendirin. <L4.6>Mecbur kalirsaniz
Bay Ledore'u da getirebilirsiniz.</V>

original: シャロア
translation: Saroa

original: <V0050><T><M8/1/1>How does he know me?</V>
translation: <V0050><T><M8/1/1>Beni nereden taniyor?</V>

original:
<V0060><T><M4/1/1/30>Oh, and don't forget to tell the tourists that
the town is cursed. <L5.1><M1/1/1>Sorry I didn't mention
that earlier.</V>
translation:
<V0060><T><M4/1/1/30>Ah, ayrica turistlere kasabanin lanetli
oldugunu soylemeyi unutmayin. <L5.1><M1/1/1>Bunu az once soylemeyi unuttum,
kusura bakmayin.</V>

original:
<V0070><T>Those who stay jeopardise their lives. <L3.2>But
those who leave risk missing the greatest
show ever!</V>
translation:
<V0070><T>Burada kalanlar hayatlarini tehlikeye atar. <L3.2>Ama
ayrilanlar simdiye kadarki en buyuk
gosteriyi kacirma riskini alir!</V>

original:
<V0080><T>My curse can be lifted if someone brings
forth something to oppose my power...
<L5.8>Perhaps another mask?</V>
translation:
<V0080><T>Lanetim, birisi gucume karsi koyacak bir sey
getirirse kaldirilabilir...
<L5.8>Belki baska bir maske?</V>

original:
<V0090><T>But the Mask of Order is another tale of
woe, isn't it?</V>
translation:
<V0090><T>Ama Duzen Maskesi baska bir
aci hikayesi, degil mi?</V>

original: <V0100><T><M3/1/1>Until we meet again!</V>
translation: <V0100><T><M3/1/1>Yeniden gorusene dek!</V>

original: <V0110><T><M7/1/1>The Mask of Order...?</V>
translation: <V0110><T><M7/1/1>Duzen Maskesi...?</V>

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <V0140><T><M3/2/1>The Mask of Order? What's that?</V>
translation: <V0140><T><M3/2/1>Duzen Maskesi mi? O da ne?</V>

original:
<V0150><T><M7/1/1>Is it some sort of complement to the Mask
of Chaos?</V>
translation:
<V0150><T><M7/1/1>Kaos Maskesi'nin bir tur tamamlayicisi
mi?</V>

original: <V0160><T>Could that mean...?</V>
translation: <V0160><T>Bu su anlama mi geliyor...?</V>

original:
<V0170><T><M4/2/1>So, <L0.65>if we can get that mask, <L2.30>then we can
stop the Masked Gentleman!</V>
translation:
<V0170><T><M4/2/1>Yani, <L0.65>o maskeyi alabilirsek, <L2.30>o zaman
Mucize Beyefendi'yi durdurabiliriz!</V>

original:
<V0180><T><M2/1/1/45>Well, that's not going to be an easy task.
<L2.4>The existence of the mask has never been
verified.</V>
translation:
<V0180><T><M2/1/1/45>Eh, bu kolay bir is olmayacak.
<L2.4>Maskenin varligi hicbir zaman
dogrulanmadi.</V>

original:
<V0190><T><M4/1/1>Is this true, Hershel? <L1.65>Can this other mask
stop this madness?</V>
translation:
<V0190><T><M4/1/1>Dogru mu bu, Hershel? <L1.65>Bu diger maske
bu deliligi durdurabilir mi?</V>

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original: <V0210><T>Well? <L0.65>What do you think, Layton?</V>
translation: <V0210><T>Peki? <L0.65>Ne dusunuyorsun, Layton?</V>

original: シバロフ
translation: Sibarov

original:
アルフォード・ダルストン、[今回/こんかい]の[街/まち]での
事件の容疑がきさまにかかっている。
署まで同行願おう
translation:
Alford Dalston, [??/????]ki [?/??]deki
olayla ilgili supheler senin uzerine.
Karakola kadar bizimle gel.

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original: な、なんだと！？私に！
translation: N-Ne dedin!? Bana mi!

original: ヘンリー！
translation: Henry!

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original:
ヘンリー！おまえだな！
こんな手紙で呼び出して私をはめた上に、
警察に何を吹き込んだ！
translation:
Henry! Demek sendin!
Beni boyle bir mektupla cagirip tuzaga dusurdun,
bir de polise ne soyledin!

original:
私は、この街を汚す者はゆるしてはおけん…
ただそれだけだ
translation:
Bu sehri kirletenleri affedemem...
Hepsi bu.

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T>I'm not letting that masked miscreant get
away. <W>FOR THE YARD!
translation:
<T>O maskeli haydudun kacmasina izin vermeyecegim.
<W>YARD ICIN!

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Guv, that Masked Gentleman fella is gettin'
away! Shouldn't we go after him?
translation:
<T>Sefim, su Mucize Beyefendi herif kaciyor!
Pesinden gitmemiz gerekmez mi?

original: シバロフ
translation: Sibarov

original:
<T>Hmph, Grosky can handle it. If that
cane-twirling felon escapes, we still have
the real mastermind cornered.
translation:
<T>Hih, Grosky halleder. Eger o
baston ceviren suclu kacarsa bile, hala
asil elebasini koseye sikistirmis durumdayiz.

original: <T><M4/1/1>Right, Guv!
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Emredersiniz, sefim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Now then... <W>Dalston, enough playing
around! I know you're behind all of this.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Simdi... <W>Dalston, oyun yeter!
Butun bunlarin arkasinda senin oldugunu biliyorum.

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original: <T><M3/1/1>Codswallop!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Zirva!

original: <T>Layton, back me up here!<M1/1/1>
translation: <T>Layton, beni destekle!<M1/1/1>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Chief Inspector, if I may? <W>The evidence we
have at this point suggests that-
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Basmufettis, musaadenizle? <W>Su ana kadar elimizdeki
kanitlar sunu gosteriyor ki-

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Enough, Layton! You're too close to this.
It's clouding your judgement.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yeter, Layton! Bu isin cok icindesin.
Bu da muhakemeni bulandiriyor.

original:
<T>The truth is that Dalston is in love with
Mrs Ledore. Has been for years. That's why
he's trying to bring Henry down.
translation:
<T>Gercek su ki Dalston Bayan Ledore'a asik.
Yillardir. Bu yuzden
Henry'yi cokertmeye calisiyor.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Chief Inspector, that's absurd!
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Basmufettis, bu sacmalik!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Dalston, if you've any respect for this town,
you'll come with us voluntarily. Don't make
me force you.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Dalston, bu kasabaya biraz saygin varsa,
bizimle gonullu gelirsin. Beni seni zorla
almaya mecbur birakma.

original: <T>Fine, I'll go. I have nothing to hide.
translation: <T>Peki, geliyorum. Saklayacak bir seyim yok.

original: <T><M2/1/1>We'll see about that.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Bunu gorecegiz.

original:
<T>Hold on. I want to say something to Henry.
Will you grant me that at least?
translation:
<T>Durun. Henry'ye bir sey soylemek istiyorum.
Bari buna izin verin.

original: <T>Fine, but make it quick.
translation: <T>Peki, ama cabuk ol.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Henry...<W> You set me up.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Henry...<W> Beni tuzaga dusurdun.

original:
<T>You won't be satisfied until you've ruined
everyone's lives, will you?
translation:
<T>Herkesin hayatini mahvetmeden tatmin olmayacaksin,
degil mi?

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original:
<T>You sent Randall into those ruins 18 years
ago. And what? Now I'm the one in your
way?
translation:
<T>Randall'i 18 yil once o harabelere sen gonderdin.
Ve sonra ne oldu? Simdi de ben mi
onundeki engelim?

original: <T>Accidents can be so convenient, eh?
translation: <T>Kazalar ne kadar da kullanisli olabiliyor, ha?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>With Randall out of the picture, you took all
the treasure for yourself.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Randall ortadan kalkinca, tum hazineyi
kendine aldin.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>And as if you hadn't destroyed enough lives
already, you forced Angela to marry you.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ve sanki yeterince hayat yikmamissin gibi,
Angela'yi seninle evlenmeye zorladin.

original:
<T>Do you really think she loves you? After
everything you've done?
translation:
<T>Gercekten onu sevdigini mi dusunuyorsun?
Yaptigin onca seyden sonra?

original:
<T>Angela may be your wife, but I know that not
a day goes by that she doesn't blame you
for Randall's death.
translation:
<T>Angela senin karin olabilir ama biliyorum ki
Randall'in olumunden dolayi seni
suclamadigi tek bir gun bile gecmiyor.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>You stole the treasure. <W>You stole Angela.
<W>You stole Randall's entire life!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hazineyi caldin. <W>Angela'yi caldin.
<W>Randall'in tum hayatini caldin!

original: <T><M2/1/1>You're wrong!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Yaniliyorsun!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Am I? Angela knows I'm right! Go on, ask
her! Ask her who's behind the Masked
Gentleman!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Oyle mi? Angela benim hakli oldugumu biliyor! Hadi, git
ona sor! Mucize
Beyefendi'nin arkasinda kimin oldugunu sor!

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Your own wife is sabotaging your City of
Miracles! And she's doing it right under your
nose.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Kendi karin Mucizeler Sehrini sabote ediyor!
Ve bunu burnunun
dibinde yapiyor.

original: <T>Enough, Dalston! We're leaving.
translation: <T>Yeter, Dalston! Gidiyoruz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I'll prove my innocence, Henry! And as soon
as I get out, you'll pay for this.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Masumiyetimi kanitlayacagim, Henry! Ve cikar cikmaz
bunun hesabini odeyeceksin.

original: シャロア
translation: Saroa
<T><M4/1/1>Henry, ben...

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>I know, Angela.<W> Let's just go home.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Biliyorum, Angela.<W> Hadi eve gidelim.

original: <T>Yes. <W>Yes, of course.
translation: <T>Evet. <W>Evet, elbette.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>I'm sure that Dalston is innocent. I hope
Detective Bloom has some insight.
translation:
<T>Dalston'in masum olduguna eminim. Umarim
Dedektif Bloom'un bir fikri vardir.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Phew! Now all this Masked Gentleman
hullabaloo is over, I might see about getting
that day off!
translation:
<T>Oh be! Su Maskeli Beyefendi
yaygarasi da bittigine gore, o izin gununu
almaya bakacagim!

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Mr Dalston orchestrated the whole blooming
thing! I'd never have guessed that!
translation:
<T>Bay Dalston butun bu Bloom isini
duzenlemis! Bunu asla tahmin etmezdim!

original: ブルーマイル

<T>Professor, I have to say you look troubled.
Is something on your mind?
translation:
<T>Profesor, dogrusu kaygili gorunuyorsunuz.
Aklinizi kurcalayan bir sey mi var?

original: レイトン

<T><M2/2/1/45>Yes, indeed. Alphonse Dalston is an
innocent man.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Evet, gercekten. Alphonse Dalston
masum bir adam.

original: ルーク
<T><M3/2/3>And we have a witness that can prove it!
translation: <T><M3/2/3>Ve bunu kanitlayabilecek bir tanigimiz var!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>A witness, you say? <W>Well, can you bring
them here?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Tanik mi dediniz? <W>Peki onu
buraya getirebilir misiniz?

original: <T><M2/2/2/45>Erm... Not really...
translation: <T><M2/2/2/45>Sey... Pek sayilmaz...

original:
<T><M6/2/1>Doing so would prove difficult. <W>But
witnesses aside, the evidence alone will
confirm Dalston's innocence.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Bunu yapmak zor olur. <W>Ama
taniklari bir kenara birakirsak, kanitlarin
kendisi Dalston'in masumiyetini kanitlar.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Sorry to burst your bubble, Professor, but
I doubt Sheffield is going to be interested
in what you have to say right now.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hevesinizi kirmak istemem, Profesor, ama
Sheffield'in su anda
soyleyeceklerinize ilgi duyacagini sanmiyorum.

original:
<T>However, consider this: if Dalston really is
innocent, the true perpetrator is still out
there.
translation:
<T>Ama sunu dusunun: Dalston gercekten
masumsa, asil fail
hala disarida.

original:
<T>So if another miracle happens while Dalston
is behind bars, we'll know we've got the
wrong man.
translation:
<T>Yani Dalston parmakliklar ardindayken
baska bir mucize olursa,
yanlis adami yakaladigimizi anlariz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Anyway, Dalston's interrogation is tomorrow.
I urge you to get some sleep and join us
then. Good night.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Her neyse, Dalston'in sorgusu yarin.
Biraz uyuyup o zaman
bize katilmanizi oneririm. Iyi geceler.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>It seems we don't have much choice. Let's
retire to the hotel for the night.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Pek fazla secenegimiz yok gibi. Gelin
bu gece icin otele cekilelim.

original: <T><M1/2/2>Poor Mr Dalston...
translation: <T><M1/2/2>Zavalli Bay Dalston...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>Professor, will you continue your story? We
might be able to learn something about the
mask.
translation:
<T>Profesor, hikayenize devam eder misiniz? Biz
maskeyle ilgili
bir seyler ogrenebiliriz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Very well. Where were we? <W>Ah, yes... There
was a puzzle contained within the scrawl of
symbols Randall showed us.
translation:
<T>Pekala. Nerede kalmistik? <W>Ah, evet... Randall'in
bize gosterdigi sembol karalamalarinin
icinde bir bulmaca vardi.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>To Randall, it was just the first step on his
road to renown. Yet following that road was
to change our lives forever...
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Randall icin bu, un yolundaki
sadece ilk adimdi. Ama o yolu takip etmek
hayatlarimizi sonsuza dek degistirecekti...

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Wha-?
translation: <T>Ne-?

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original: <T>What is that?!
translation: <T>Bu da ne?!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M4/2/2>That, my friends, is the hidden message of
Norwell!<M4/6/2>
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Iste dostlarim, Norwell'in gizli mesaji
bu!<M4/6/2>

original:
<T><M4/2/1>That?<W> That's the hidden message? What are
you talking about?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Bu mu?<W> Gizli mesaj bu mu? Ne
anlatiyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Now, now, keep your hair on and allow me
to elaborate.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Sakin, sakin. Ofkeni kontrol et de
izah edeyim.

original:
<T><M1/4/3>I have at long last cracked the riddle
concealed in the Norwell wall.
translation:
<T><M1/4/3>Sonunda Norwell duvarinda gizlenen
bilmeceyi cozdum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You solved the riddle that no one else ever
managed to solve? Really, Randy?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Kimsenin cozemedigi bilmeceyi
sen mi cozdun? Gercekten mi, Randy?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>I'm sorry I didn't tell you sooner, Angie.
I just wanted to see the look on your face
as I unveiled everything all at once!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Uzgunum, Angie, sana daha once soylemedim.
Her seyi bir anda aciklayinca yuzundeki
ifadeyi gormek istedim!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Norwell was a hot topic when it was first
discovered, but since then it's become
a mere tourist attraction.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Norwell ilk kesfedildiginde gundemdeydi,
amma o zamandan beri yalnizca
bir turist atraksiyonu oldu.

original:
<T>Stansbury could have just faded into
obscurity without anyone noticing. But not
now, not with this!
translation:
<T>Stansbury kimse fark etmeden
yavasca unutulup gidebilirdi. Ama
artik degil, bununla asla!

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>You mean, because you've deciphered this
message?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Yani, bu mesaji cozdugun icin mi
diyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Hold on, hold on. A discovery as great as
this deserves a far more elaborate
introduction.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Dur, dur. Boyle buyuk bir kesif
cok daha gorkemli bir
sunumu hak eder.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Norwell is a giant and ancient wall, and it's
sitting right here on our doorstep, just on
the outskirts of Stansbury.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Norwell devasa ve kadim bir duvar; tam
kapimizin onunde, Stansbury'nin
hemen dis tarafinda duruyor.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It was found about 30 years ago while they
were clearing the forest to make room for
new houses.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yaklasik 30 yil once, yeni evlere yer acmak
icin ormani temizlerlerken
bulundu.

original:
<T>When it was first announced, all sorts of
experts flooded in to try to decipher the
ancient script on the wall.
translation:
<T>Ilk duyuruldugunda, duvardaki kadim
yaziyi cozmeye calisan her turden
uzman buraya akin etti.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But the thing is, nobody succeeded! Not
one of them worked it out. They tried and
failed, and then everyone forgot.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama isin asli, kimse basaramadi! Hicbiri
cozemedi. Denediler, basaramadilar
ve sonra herkes unuttu.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Why does such a massive wall stand there?
What message does it hold? Nobody
knew...<W>until now!<M1/6/2>
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Boylesine dev bir duvar neden orada duruyor?
Ne mesaji sakliyor? Kimse
bilmiyordu...<W>ta ki simdiye kadar!<M1/6/2>

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>Because you've solved it?
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Cunku sen mi cozdun?

original: <T><M4/1/1>How on earth...?<W> What does it say, then?<M1/1/1>
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Nasil yani...?<W> Peki ne yaziyor?<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M4/2/2>That is something I'd like to explain at the
site itself. Come with me, my friends, to the
Norwell wall!
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Bunu en iyisi yerinde aciklayayim.
Benimle gelin, dostlarim, su
Norwell duvarina!

original: <T><M1/2/1>Wait, what? <W>You want to go there now?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Dur, ne? <W>Oraya simdi mi gitmek istiyorsun?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Shhh! Keep it down, Hersh! Let's just slip
out quickly.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ssst! Sesini kis, Hersh! Hadi hemen
sessizce sivisalim.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randy

original:
<T>Hey, are you bonkers? We can't go out
through the front door. We'll get caught!
translation:
<T>Hey, kafayi mi yedin? On kapidan
cikamayiz. Yakalaniriz!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>We have to be really quiet. If my father
catches us, we're toast!
translation:
<T>Cok sessiz olmaliyiz. Babam
bizi yakalarsa mahvoluruz!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Yes, we all know the routine by now.
Angela, are you all right going down by
yourself?
translation:
<T>Evet, artik hepimiz bu rutini biliyoruz.
Angela, tek basina asagi inmende
sakinca yok degil mi?

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Hah, I do this almost every day. See you at
the bottom!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hah, bunu neredeyse her gun yapiyorum. En altta
gorusuruz!

original: <T><M2/1/1>All right. Here we go, then.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Peki. O halde basliyoruz.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Phew...<W> We're out! And my father is none
the wiser.
translation:
<T>Oh be...<W> Disari ciktik! Hem babamin da
haberi yok.

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Norwell is in the woods, isn't it? Won't it be
really dark once we get past Oldmarket? We
should take torches.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Norwell ormanin icinde, degil mi? Oldmarket'i gecince
cok karanlik olmaz mi? Yanimiza
mesaleler almaliyiz.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Oh, we'll be fine. The stars are out, and
we're not going deep into the forest.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ah, sorun olmaz. Yildizlar gorunuyor ve
ormanin derinlerine inmeyecegiz.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M1/2/1>If you say so...
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Sen oyle diyorsan...

original: <T><M4/2/2>Come on, then! To Norwell!
translation: <T><M4/2/2>Hadi o zaman! Norwell'e!

original: ヤングダルストン
translation: Genc Dalston

original:
<T>Eh up, where are you three slinking off to in
the dark, then?
translation:
<T>Ee, siz ucu karanlikta nereye sinsice gidiyorsunuz
bakalim?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Why, we're going on a pioneering expedition
of great significance to the future of
archaeology. Want to come?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Biz de arkeolojinin gelecegi icin buyuk onem tasiyan
oncu bir kesif seferine gidiyoruz. Sen de gelmek ister misin?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Pff! I'd have loved to...if you'd asked me
ten years ago! You lot have fun on your
little adventure.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Pff! Cok isterdim... eger bunu bana
on yil once sorsaydiniz! Siz keyfinize bakin
su kucuk maceranizda.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>How dull. And just as I was about to reveal
my brilliant deductions, too!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ne sikici. Tam da parlak cikarimlarimi aciklamak
uzereydim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Enjoy being a smart alec while you can,
Ascot. We'll soon find out which of us can
actually make something of his life.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sen akillilik taslamaya devam et, Ascot.
Yakinda hangimizin hayatinda gercekten
bir sey basardigini goruruz.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>I already have made something of my life.
You might get your name on some hotel, but
I'll be in the history books!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Ben hayatimla zaten bir sey yaptim.
Sen belki adini bir otele verdirirsin ama
ben tarih kitaplarinda olacagim!

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original:
<T><M4/1/2>Oh, give it a rest, you two! <W>I'm sorry,
Dalston. Please don't mind Randall. We
were just going, anyway.
translation:
<T><M4/1/2>Off, kesin artik siz ikiniz! <W>Uzgunum,
Dalston. Lutfen Randall'i takma. Biz de
zaten gidiyorduk.

original:
<T>You lot are a real bunch of kids. How long
are you going to play at all this {''}best friends
forever{''} rubbish?
translation:
<T>Siz gercekten tam bir cocuk surususunuz. Ne kadar daha
bu {''}best friends
forever{''} sacmaligini oynayacaksiniz?

original:
<T><M2/4/3>Pff. Sour grapes, Dalston? <W30>Forget hotels,
you could make a fortune brewing your own
vinegar.
translation:
<T><M2/4/3>Pff. Kiskanclik mi bu, Dalston? <W30>Otelleri bos ver,
kendi sirkeni yaparak servet kazanabilirsin.

original: グロリア
translation: Gloria

original:
<T>Well now, should you three really be
wandering around at this time of night?
translation:
<T>Peki bakalim, siz ucu gercekten bu saatte
disarida dolasmali misiniz?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Good evening, ma'am. Are you also out
enjoying a lovely night-time stroll?
translation:
<T>Iyi aksamlar, hanimefendi. Siz de
guzel bir gece yuruyusunun tadini mi cikariyorsunuz?

original:
<T><M2/1/2>I was just taking some of our sweetcorn to
the neighbours. Sadly, the creepy-crawlies
seem to love it too.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Komsulara biraz seker misirimizdan
goturuyordum. Ne yazik ki bocekler de
bunu cok seviyor gibi.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Look, they've chewed holes all the way
through this cob!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Bak, bu kocanin her yerini kemirip
delik desik etmisler!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>The little beasties have made a real mess,
haven't they?
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Kucuk hasereler ortaligi fena dagitmis,
degil mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Look at the holes in this corncob. It's worse
than Swiss cheese!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Su misir kocanindaki deliklere bak! Isvicre peynirinden bile
daha kotu!

original:
<T>It's warm now, but the nights have started to
get chilly. Don't stay out too late, children.
translation:
<T>Simdi sicak ama geceler
serinlemeye basladi. Cok gec kalmayin, cocuklar.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>No, no, we won't.
translation: <T>Hayir, hayir, kalmayiz.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Aphids I'm used to, but why are there so
many ladybirds in the maize this year?
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Yaprak bitlerine alisigim ama neden bu yil
misirin icinde bu kadar cok ugur bocegi var?

original: ライオネル
translation: Lionel

original:
<T><M1/3/1>'Ullo? Is that young Master Randall? What
would your father say if he found you out
'ere at this time?
translation:
<T><M1/3/1>'Alo? Genc Usta Randall mi o? Seni
bu saatte burada gorse baban ne
derdi?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Oh, we'll be heading home soon, Lionel,
don't worry! I just thought I'd come by and
say hello.
translation:
<T>Ah, yakinda eve donuyoruz, Lionel,
merak etme! Sadece ugrayip
selam vermek istedim.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Aw, bless. You did, did you? Well, since
you're 'ere, 'ow about a good puzzle, eh?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Aman ne hos. Oyle mi yaptin? Madem
buradasin, iyi bir bilmeceye ne dersin?

original:
<T>It's never too 'ard for you, Master Randall!
It's not, is it?!
translation:
<T>Senin icin asla cok zor olmaz, Usta Randall!
Degil mi, olmaz mi?!

original:
<T>I've got a great little puzzle 'ere. Care to
solve it?
translation:
<T>Burada harika kucuk bir bilmece var. Cozmek
ister misin?

original: <T>It's a good 'un, isn't it?
translation: <T>Guzel, degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Ha ha, not bad! A tad easy, perhaps.<W> Well,
we should be going now. Would you excuse
us?<M1/2/1>
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ha ha, fena degil! Belki biraz kolaydi.<W> Sey,
artik gitmemiz gerek. Bize musaade
eder misin?<M1/2/1>

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Ooh, yes. I 'ope 'Ershel 'ere doesn't get
into trouble for keeping the little lady
and the young squire out so late.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Ah, evet. Umarim Hershel burada
kucuk hanimi ve genc efendiyi bu kadar gec
disarida tuttugu icin basini derde sokmaz.

original:
<T><M1/4/3>Um, in point of fact, Lionel, my father
doesn't know we're out. We, er, climbed out
of the window. You won't tell him, will you?
translation:
<T><M1/4/3>Sey, aslinda Lionel, babam disarida
oldugumuzu bilmiyor. Biz, ee, pencereden
ciktik. Ona soylemezsin, degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Come off it. 'Ow often do you think your
dad comes to 'ave a chat with the likes of
me? <W>Just be careful, all right?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hadi canim. Sence baban benim gibilerle
sohbet etmeye kac kez gelir ki?
Ben mi? <W>Siz sadece dikkatli olun, tamam mi?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>We will. Thank you, Lionel.
translation: <T>Olacagiz. Tesekkurler, Lionel.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>What's this? You already said 'ello once.
I 'ope you're not after another puzzle,
'cause I've got nothing left!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bu da ne? Zaten bir kere selam verdin.
Umarim baska bir bilmece istemiyorsundur,
cunku elimde hic kalmadi!

original: <T><M3/2/1>Not even a quick anagram, Lionel?
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Hizli bir anagram bile yok mu, Lionel?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Honestly, Master Randall. You kids should
go on 'ome and stop badgering the
grown-ups.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Cidden, Usta Randall. Siz cocuklar eve
gidin de buyukleri rahat birakin.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randy

original:
<T>Hey, we're going to the Norwell wall, not to
school! Wake up, Hersh!
translation:
<T>Hey, okula degil, Norwell surlarina
gidiyoruz! Uyan, Hersh!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randy

original:
<T>What are we doing here, Hersh? Can't we
get a move on and go to Norwell?
translation:
<T>Burada ne yapiyoruz, Hersh? Hadi
hareket edip Norwell'e gidelim!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M6/2/3>Oh, er... Sorry. I just walked home without
thinking.
translation:
<T><M6/2/3>Sey... Pardon. Dusunmeden eve
dogru yurumusum.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Good evening, Mrs Layton. I hope we're not
intruding.
translation:
<T>Iyi aksamlar, Bayan Layton. Rahatsiz
etmiyoruzdur umarim.

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Oh, no. It's always lovely to see you,
Randall. And you too, Angela, dear. Do
make yourselves comfortable.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Olur mu hic. Seni gormek her zaman guzel,
Randall. Sen de Angela, canim. Lutfen
rahatiniza bakin.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>If Hershel had told me you were coming, I'd
have had a pot of tea ready, but...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hershel geleceginizi soyleseydi bir demlik
cay hazirlardim ama...

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Please don't worry, Mrs Layton. We'll be off
again in a minute.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Lutfen endiselenmeyin, Bayan Layton. Birazdan
yine cikacagiz.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Well, can I fetch you a glass of cordial or
a biscuit? Or...<W30>I know! How about a quick
puzzle while you wait?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Peki, size bir bardak serbet ya da
bir biskuvi getireyim mi? Ya da...<W30>Buldum! Hizli bir
bilmece, beklerken ne dersiniz?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Ah well, never mind. Do come back and try
again sometime!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Eh, bos ver. Bir ara yine gel de
tekrar dene!

original:
<T>Would you like to have another go at my
puzzle?
translation:
<T>Bilmeceyi bir kez daha denemek
ister misin?

original:
<T><M2/4/3>Wow, Mrs Layton. Do you always come up
with puzzles on the spot when you have
unexpected guests?<M1/4/3>
translation:
<T><M2/4/3>Vay canina, Bayan Layton. Beklenmedik
misafirler gelince hep aninda bilmece
uydurur musunuz?<M1/4/3>

original:
<T><M2/2/3>I'm sorry, it wasn't much. If I had a bit more
time, I could offer you a much better one.
And a slice of cake.
translation:
<T><M2/2/3>Uzgunum, pek bir sey degildi. Biraz daha
zamanim olsaydi size cok daha iyisini
ve bir dilim kek sunardim.

original:
<T><M4/1/3>Don't say that, Mrs Layton. You'll never get
rid of him! It really is quite late...
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Oyle demeyin, Bayan Layton. Ondan asla
kurtulamazsiniz! Gercekten cok gec oldu...

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Don't worry, dear. It's always nice to have
Hershel's friends round.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Merak etme, canim. Hershel'in arkadaslarinin
ugramasi her zaman guzeldir.

original:
<T>You won't stay out too late, will you?
I wouldn't want your parents to worry.
translation:
<T>Cok gece kalmazsiniz, degil mi?
Ailenizin endiselenmesini istemem.

original: ローラン
translation: Roland

original: <T>Ho ho, Randall and Angela, is it?
translation: <T>Ho ho, Randall ve Angela, oyle mi?

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original: <T>Hello, Mr Layton.
translation: <T>Merhaba, Bay Layton.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I thought Hershel was going to spend the
evening at your house, Randall. He didn't
say he was bringing you here.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hershel'in bu aksami senin evinde gecirecegini
saniyordum, Randall. Sizi buraya
goturecegini soylememisti.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Oh, no, it wasn't planned. We were just
in town and we decided to drop in for
a minute.
translation:
<T>Yok yok, planli degildi. Sadece sehirdeydik
ve bir dakikaligina ugrayalim
dedik.

original:
<T><M3/3/1>I see. Well, it's kind of you to come in and
say hello.
translation:
<T><M3/3/1>Anladim. Yine de ugrayip
selam vermeniz cok nazik.

original:
<T><M3/4/1>Hershel's tired of my puzzles, but maybe
I can persuade you to try out this old teaser
of mine?
translation:
<T><M3/4/1>Hershel benim bilmecelerimden sikildi, ama
belki sizi su eski bilmecemi
denemeye ikna edebilirim?

original: <T><M1/3/1>Don't worry, lad. A good effort!
translation: <T><M1/3/1>Dert etme evlat. Iyi denemeydi!

original: <T><M1/3/1>How about this puzzle, then?
translation: <T><M1/3/1>O halde su bilmeceye ne dersin?

original:
<T><M2/4/1>Good work, lad! Well, thank you for
humouring me. It's nice to have a receptive
audience for once.
translation:
<T><M2/4/1>Aferin evlat! Eh, beni kirmadigin icin tesekkurler.
Bir kez olsun hevesli bir
dinleyici bulmak guzel.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I wish my father were more like you. He
doesn't understand the fun of solving
puzzles, cracking codes, finding things!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Keske babam da sizin gibi olsa. Bilmece cozmenin,
sifre kirmanin, bir seyler bulmanin
ne kadar eglenceli oldugunu anlamiyor!

original:
<T><M3/1/4>I don't think he even knows what fun is. All
he ever talks about is the value of hard
work...
translation:
<T><M3/1/4>Eglencenin ne oldugunu bile bildigini sanmiyorum.
Surekli konustugu tek sey calismanin
onemi...

original:
<T><M1/3/1>Heh heh. That's just his way of caring for
you. He wants to pass on the important
lessons in life.
translation:
<T><M1/3/1>Heh heh. Bu, sana deger verdiginin bir yolu.
Hayattaki onemli dersleri
aktarmak istiyor.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Hmm, maybe...
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Hmm, belki...

original:
<T>Aren't you youngsters going out? If you
hang about much longer, it'll be far too late.
translation:
<T>Siz gencler disari cikmiyor musunuz? Boyle
oyalanirsaniz cok gec olacak.

original: ダンフィン
translation: Dunfin

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Ahoy there! What are the dauntless trio
doing out at this time? You're not up to
any mischief, are you?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ahooy! Bu korkusuz uclu bu saatte
disarida ne yapiyor? Bir haylazlik
pesinde degilsiniz ya?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/2/1>We're out on a short expedition to satisfy
our intellectual appetite, if that's what you
mean.<M1/2/1>
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Eger kastiniz buysa, zihinsel istahimizi
doyurmak icin kisa bir kesfe ciktik
diyelim.<M1/2/1>

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Well, how would you like to feed your grey
matter with this?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Peki, beyin hucrelerinizi bununla
beslemek ister misiniz?

original:
<T>Oho! Can you satiate your hunger for
knowledge without solving my puzzle?
translation:
<T>Oho! Benim bilmecemi cozmeden bilgi
acliginizi doyurabilir misiniz?

original:
<T>How about this puzzle as an intellectual
appetiser?
translation:
<T>Zihinsel bir atistirmalik olarak su
bilmeceye ne dersiniz?

original:
<T>Young people are so clever these days.<W> So,
tell me. What are you creeping around like
mice for?
translation:
<T>Gencler bugunlerde cok zeki.<W> Simdi,
soyleyin bakalim. Neden fare gibi
sinsice dolasiyorsunuz?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Creeping? Why do you say that? We were
just strolling along.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Sinsice mi? Neden oyle diyorsunuz? Biz
sadece yuruyorduk.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Hah! You can't fool me.<W> Ah, of course.
You're going off exploring without your
father's permission, aren't you?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hah! Beni kandiramazsiniz.<W> Ha, tabii.
Babanizdan izin almadan kesfe
cikiyorsunuz, degil mi?

original:
<T><M4/2/2>Well... <W>Technically...yes. Please don't tell
him. He'd just worry if he knew.
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Sey... <W>Teknik olarak...evet. Lutfen ona soyleme.
Bilseydi sadece endiselenirdi.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>You two might be used to getting the odd
bump or bruise on your expeditions, but if
that young lady comes to any harm-
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ikiniz kesiflerinizde ufak tefek carpma
morluklara aliskin olabilirsiniz, ama o
genc hanimefendiye bir sey olursa-

original:
<T>You mean Angela? Oh, she'll be fine.
Anyway, she has both Hershel and me
to look after her.
translation:
<T>Angela mi? Ah, ona bir sey olmaz.
Zaten onu hem Hershel hem de ben
koruyacagiz.

original: <T><M2/1/1>That's what I'm worried about.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ben de ondan endise ediyorum.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Here we are! Within this forest lies the
object of today's enterprise: the ancient
Norwell wall!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Iste buradayiz! Bu ormanin icinde bugunku gorevimizin
hedefi yatiyor: kadim
Norwell suru!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Yes, yes, we know. We live here too,
remember?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Evet, evet, biliyoruz. Biz de burada yasiyoruz,
unuttun mu?

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original:
<T>Good grief! Spare us the melodrama, Randy.
Everyone in Stansbury knows that.
translation:
<T>Aman Tanrim! Bizi bu melodramdan kurtar, Randy.
Stansbury'de herkes bunu biliyor.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Cripes, you two. You have no soul. <W><M4/2/2>You
have to build the mood on these trips!
Motivate the troops, so to speak.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Vay canina, siz ikiniz. Hic ruhunuz yok. <W><M4/2/2>Bu
gezilerde havayi kurmak gerek!
Bir nevi ekibi motive etmek, yani.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Now, let's proceed. With enthusiasm,
please!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Simdi ilerleyelim. Coskuyla,
lutfen!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Ack, we're out of luck. The gate's locked.
translation: <T>Tuh, sansimiz yok. Kapi kilitli.

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That's probably to keep out shady types like
Randy. What are we going to do?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu muhtemelen Randy gibi
supheli tipleri disarida tutmak icindir. Ne yapacagiz?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T><M1/2/2>Worry not, my friends!
translation: <T><M1/2/2>Endiselenmeyin, dostlarim!

original:
<T><M3/2/2>You have only to look closely to see that
this gate is locked by a puzzle. Solve it and
you're through!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Dikkatle bakmaniz yeter; bu kapinin bir bulmacayla
kilitli oldugunu goreceksiniz. Cozun ve
iceri gecin!

original:
<T>How about having a quick break before we
tackle the gate puzzle again? We should
have brought a snack, really.
translation:
<T>Kapi bulmacasini tekrar denemeden once kisa bir mola versek?
Aslinda yanimiza atistirmalik getirmeliydik.

original:
<T>Right, this should be no trouble for the
modest genius who cracked the puzzle of
Norwell!
translation:
<T>Tamam, Norwell bulmacasini cozen
mutevazi dahi icin bu cocuk oyuncagi olmali!

original: <T><M4/4/3>Yes! We're in!
translation: <T><M4/4/3>Evet! Iceri girdik!

original: <T><M4/2/1>Terrific, Randy! You really did it!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Harika, Randy! Gercekten basardin!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I must say I'm impressed. You have
a natural talent for lock picking.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Etkilendigimi soylemeliyim. Kilit acma konusunda
dogustan yetenegin var.

original:
<T><M1/1/4>Hang on a sec. You're making me sound
like a common thief now!
translation:
<T><M1/1/4>Bir dakika! Beni simdi
dupeduz hirsiz gibi gosteriyorsun!

original: <T><M2/2/2>Hee hee hee. Come on, let's go!
translation: <T><M2/2/2>Hihihihi. Hadi, gidelim!

original: [Not used]
translation: [Kullanilmiyor]

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>The Norwell wall is just up this path.
translation: <T>Norwell suru su patikanin hemen ilerisinde.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>It is a bit dark, isn't it?
translation: <T>Biraz karanlik, degil mi?

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Randy, do you really think it's a good idea
to be going into the forest at this time?
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Randy, bu saatte
ormana girmek gercekten iyi bir fikir mi sence?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>It'll be fine. We can just follow the path for
the tourists. See, there's even a helpful sign
there!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Sorun olmaz. Turistler icin olan patikayi takip ederiz. Bak,
surada hatta yardimsever bir tabela bile var!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Mmm, that sign looks as if it's seen better
days...
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Mmm, o tabela daha iyi gunler
gormus gibi...

original:
<T>We're not really going to leave that broken
sign as it is, are we? Come on, I'm sure we
can mend it!
translation:
<T>O kirik tabelayi oylece
birakmayacagiz, degil mi? Hadi, eminim
tamir edebiliriz!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Golly, you weren't kidding! This sign is in a
really sorry state.
translation:
<T>Vay canina, saka yapmiyormussun! Bu tabela
gercekten berbat durumda.

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original:
<T><M2/1/2>I'd be amazed if tourists could find the place
at all!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Turistlerin burayi hic bulabilmesine
sasiririm!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Let's try to fix the sign for the next lot that
come by. <W>Hmm, how does this go, then?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Bir dahaki gelenler icin tabelayi duzeltmeye calisalim. <W>Hmm,
bu nasil oluyordu acaba?

original:
<T>We can't leave the sign like this. People will
get lost...
translation:
<T>Tabelayi boyle birakamayiz. Insanlar
kaybolur...

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Let's put our heads together and have
another go at fixing this sign.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Kafalarimizi birlestirip
su tabelayi tamir etmeyi bir daha deneyelim.

original: <T>And...there we go!
translation: <T>Ve... oldu!

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>I wonder why it was on the ground like that,
though. It didn't look so old that it would
fall apart spontaneously.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Yine de neden yerdeydi acaba.
O kadar eski gorunmuyordu; kendi kendine
parcalanacak gibi degildi.

original:
<T><M1/2/4>Well, erm...<W>I might have brushed past it last
time I was here...
translation:
<T><M1/2/4>Sey, yani...<W>En son burada oldugumda yanindan
gecerken biraz surtmus olabilirim...

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Honestly, Randy! Couldn't you have put it
back together at the time?
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Gercekten ama, Randy! O zaman
hemen yerine takamaz miydin?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randy

original: <T><M1/1/3>Wait... What's that?
translation: <T><M1/1/3>Dur... Bu da ne?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M2/2/1>Hold on! Where are you going?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Bir dakika! Nereye gidiyorsun?

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Sarloa

original: <T><M1/1/3>Randy, it's dark! Watch you don't trip!
translation: <T><M1/1/3>Randy, hava karanlik! Sakin takilip dusme!

original: <T><M2/2/1>I'm over here! Come and see!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Ben buradayim! Gel de bak!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Just look at the ground. There are footprints
everywhere!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Yere bir bak. Her yerde ayak izleri
var!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Whoa, I can't even make out how many sets
there are!
translation:
<T>Vay! Kac takim iz oldugunu bile
secemiyorum!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>We should stay on our toes. Whoever these
tracks belong to might be up to no good.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Tetikte olmaliyiz. Bu izler kime aitse
kotu bir seyler planliyor olabilir.

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Stop trying to make it sound sinister, Randy.
Surely they were just made by a group of
tourists.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Bunu urkutucu gostermeyi birak, Randy.
Bunlar kesin bir turist grubunun
izleridir.

original:
<T><M4/4/3>Maybe. <W30>Or maybe not! On one of my other
great expeditions, I remember seeing some
mysterious footprints by a bridge.
translation:
<T><M4/4/3>Belki. <W30>Ya da belki degil! Baska bir buyuk
kesfimde, bir koprunun yaninda bazi
gizemli ayak izleri gormustum.

original:
<T>You should always stop to find out how
many potential villainous foes you're dealing
with. Hersh, work out how I did it back then!
translation:
<T>Karsinda kac potansiyel kotu adam
oldugunu anlamak icin her zaman durup
bakmalisin. Hersh, o zaman nasil yaptigimi bul!

original:
<T>Ugh, I don't know. Do we really have to
look at this now?
translation:
<T>Ah, bilmiyorum. Gercekten simdi mi
buna bakmak zorundayiz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>If you're really not going to let us go on
until I work it out, I suppose I'll have to give
it some more thought.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bunu cozmeden ilerlememize gercekten
izin vermeyeceksen, sanirim biraz daha
dusunmem gerekecek.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>See, you may feign disinterest, but you're
actually pretty decent at solving puzzles.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Gordun mu, ilgisiz gibi davraniyorsun ama
aslinda bilmece cozmede oldukca iyisin.

original: <T><M1/1/1>I'm not really... It was just luck.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>O kadar da degil... Sans eseriydi.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>I'm sorry, Hershel. I'm afraid Randy has
puzzles on the brain.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Uzgunum, Hershel. Randy'nin akli
bilmecelerden baska bir sey dusunmuyor.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>What's wrong with that? The world is full of
puzzles just asking to be solved! <W><M2/2/1>And the
next one: the Norwell wall!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Bunun nesi kotu? Dunya cozulmek icin
bekleyen bilmecelerle dolu! <W><M2/2/1>Ve
siradaki: Norwell duvari!

original: イエット・デストリー…
translation: Yett Destry…

original: ついたな
translation: Yakaladim seni.

original: 本当にこのナゾを…？
translation: Gercekten bu bulmacayi…?

original:
俺は、イエット・デストリーの文字群が、
ある場所を指し示す内容であることに
気づいたんだ。よく見てみろ…エルシャール。
translation:
Yett Destry'nin harf dizisinin bir yeri isaret ettigini
fark ettim. Iyi bak… Hershel.

original: …ある場所？
translation: …Bir yer mi?

original:
エルシャール、ここまで言えば、
君にもわかるはずだよ。解いてみてくれ
translation:
Hershel, buraya kadar soylediysem
sen de anlamis olmalisin. Cozmeyi dene.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randy

original:
<T>Where are you going? You need to have
a closer look at the wall!
translation:
<T>Nereye gidiyorsun? Duvara
daha yakindan bakman gerek!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Randall, if you're right about this, it's
a radical step forward for archaeology.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Randall, bunda hakliysan bu
arkeoloji icin radikal bir ilerleme olur.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M1/2/1>And yet the pattern's pretty obvious once
you spot it! <W><M3/2/1>Oh, now I think of it, maybe it's
easier if you look at this.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ama bir kez fark edince desen cok
acik! <W><M3/2/1>Dusununce, belki de suna bakarsan
daha kolay olur.

original: <T><M1/2/1>What is it?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Bu nedir?

original:
<T>It's a transcription of one section of the
symbols.
translation:
<T>Sembollerin bir bolumunun
kopyasi.

original:
<T>Look closely, Hersh. Where have you seen
a pattern like that recently?<M1/6/2>
translation:
<T>Dikkatle bak, Hersh. Son zamanlarda
buna benzer bir deseni nerede gordun?<M1/6/2>

original:
<T>I've seen something like this before?
Hmm...
translation:
<T>Buna benzer bir seyi daha once mi gordum?
Hmm...

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Oh, the fossil Mr Collins had us reconstruct!
That's what you're talking about, isn't it?
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Ah, Bay Collins'in bize yeniden yaptirdigi
fosil! Ondan bahsediyorsun, degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Precisely! It's the same basic principle: cut
your model into squares and muddle them
up. Bingo, you have a puzzle!<M1/2/1>
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Aynen oyle! Temel ilke ayni: modeli karelere
bol ve parcalari karistir.
Iste, ortaya bir bilmece cikar!<M1/2/1>

original:
<T><M3/2/1>It's so simple that none of the experts even
thought to try!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>O kadar basit ki uzmanlarin hicbiri
denemeyi bile dusunmemis!

original: <T><M2/1/1>Incredible...<W> That's incredible, Randall.<M1/1/1>
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Inanilmaz...<W> Bu inanilmaz, Randall.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M4/2/1>You haven't seen anything yet. Just wait
until you solve the puzzle!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Daha hicbir sey gormedin. Bilmeceyi
cozene kadar bekle!

original: <T><M3/2/1>Why, what's going to happen?
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Ne olacak ki?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Now, now. You'll see when you've cracked
it!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Dur bakalim. Cozunce
goreceksin!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>What makes you think I can solve a puzzle
that stumped the top archaeologists?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>En iyi arkeologlarin cozemedigi bir bilmeceyi
benim cozebilecegimi nereden cikariyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Well, if you really think I can work this out,
Randall, I guess I can give it another go.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Madem gercekten bunu cozebilecegimi
dusunuyorsun, Randall, sanirim bir kez daha denerim.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Excellent, Hersh! You're not my best friend
for nothing!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Harika, Hersh! Bosuna en iyi arkadasim
degilsin!

original:
<T>The point is that this whole wall is one giant
map, pointing to a particular spot!<M1/2/1>
translation:
<T>Mesele su ki bu duvarin tamami devasa bir
harita; belirli bir noktayi isaret ediyor!<M1/2/1>

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Really? It doesn't look detailed enough to
be useful as a map.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Gercekten mi? Bir harita olarak ise yarayacak
kadar ayrintili gorunmuyor.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Don't you see? <W>The map underneath the
star chart exactly matches the terrain
beyond the hills.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Gormuyor musun? <W>Yildiz haritasinin altindaki
harita, tepelerin otesindeki araziyle
tam olarak ortusuyor.

original:
<T><M4/2/2>I followed this map over the hills, all the way
to its destination, and dug.
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Bu haritayi tepelerin uzerinden takip ettim,
hedefine kadar gittim ve kazdim.

original:
<T><M2/4/3>And that, my fellow adventurers, is where
I found the mask!
translation:
<T><M2/4/3>Ve iste, sevgili maceraci dostlarim, maskeyi
orada buldum!

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original:
<T><M2/1/3>You dug it up? Does that mean you went off
to some remote place on your own, Randy?
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Kazip cikardin mi? Yani tek basina issiz bir
yere mi gittin, Randy?

original:
<T>You promised you wouldn't do anything
dangerous!
translation:
<T>Tehlikeli bir sey yapmayacagina
soz vermistin!

original: <T><M6/2/1>Don't be cross, Angie. Have a look at this.
translation: <T><M6/2/1>Kizma, Angie. Suna bir bak.

original: <T><M1/2/1>What is it?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Bu nedir?

original:
<T>I copied this page out of Rutledge's
{''}Ancient Histories{''}.
translation:
<T>Bu sayfayi Rutledge'in
{''}Ancient Histories{''} kitabindan kopyaladim.

original:
<T><M6/4/3>Look, the symbol on the mask is exactly the
same as in the book. This has to be it, the
Mask of Chaos!
translation:
<T><M6/4/3>Bak, maskenin uzerindeki sembol kitaptakiyle
tipatip ayni. Bu kesinlikle o olmali:
Kaos Maskesi!

original:
<T><M6/4/1>It's a shame I couldn't find its twin, the
other mask that Rutledge wrote about, but...
translation:
<T><M6/4/1>Yazik ki Rutledge'in soz ettigi ikizini,
diger maskeyi bulamadim ama...

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Are you sure you're not getting carried
away? The symbol could just be
a coincidence...
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Abarttigindan emin misin? Sembol
sadece
bir tesaduf olabilir...

original:
<T><M6/2/2>Perhaps, but that's not all! The box holding
the mask also contained a stone tablet.<M6/6/2>
translation:
<T><M6/2/2>Belki, ama hepsi bu degil! Maskeyi tasiyan
kutu ayrica bir tas tablet de iceriyordu.<M6/6/2>

original:
<T><M6/2/2>And that tablet offered its own amazing
revelation.<M6/6/2>
translation:
<T><M6/2/2>Ve o tablet, kendi basina inanilmaz bir
sir daha ortaya koydu.<M6/6/2>

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Yet another revelation? This is getting a bit
much...
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Bir vahiy daha mi? Bu biraz
asiri olmaya basladi...

original: <T><M1/1/1/60>Yes, indeed.
translation: <T><M1/1/1/60>Evet, aynen oyle.

original:
<T><M6/2/1>Honestly, this is the best part. The mask is
much more than a priceless artefact. It's
also a key!
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Asil en iyi kismi bu. Maske paha bicilmez bir
eserden cok daha fazlasi. O ayni zamanda
bir anahtar!

original:
<T><M6/4/3>It's the key that will guide us to the treasure
of the ancients!
translation:
<T><M6/4/3>Bizi kadimlerin hazinesine goturecek
anahtar bu!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>What, that again? You really believe this
incredible treasure trove has just been lying
around for centuries?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Yine mi o? Gercekten bu inanilmaz hazine
ambarinin yuzyillardir oylece
durduguna inaniyor musun?

original:
<T><M6/2/1>Oh, absolutely! Having studied the mask,
I'm quite convinced.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Kesinlikle! Maskeyi inceledikten sonra
buna fazlasiyla ikna oldum.

original:
<T>This artefact belongs to a civilisation far, far
more ancient than anything in recorded
history.
translation:
<T>Bu eser, kayitli tarihteki her seyden cok daha
ama cok daha kadim bir uygarliga
ait.

original:
<T><M6/4/1>Not only that, but I believe these people
possessed knowledge and technology far
greater than our own.
translation:
<T><M6/4/1>Ustelik bu insanlarin bizden cok daha ileri
bilgi ve teknolojiye sahip olduguna
inaniyorum.

original:
<T><M6/4/3>The treasure we're looking for is not just
some precious trinket. It's the legacy of
an entire civilisation!
translation:
<T><M6/4/3>Aradigimiz hazine yalnizca degerli bir sus
esyasi degil. Bu, butun bir uygarligin
mirasi!

original: <T>Here, look at this.
translation: <T>Al, suna bak.

original:
<T><M6/2/1>This is the secret cipher that was written
on the tablet. The cipher I've cracked.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Bu, tabletin uzerine yazilmis gizli sifre.
Cozdugum sifre.

original:
<T>The ancient people used it to leave
messages for posterity.
translation:
<T>Kadim insanlar bunu gelecek nesillere
mesaj birakmak icin kullanirdi.

original:
<T><M6/2/2>If you know the cipher, it's clear that these
engravings on the inside of the mask are
also a map!
translation:
<T><M6/2/2>Sifreyi bilirsen, maskenin icindeki bu
islemelerin de
bir harita oldugu acik!

original:
<T>And where does it lead? <W>A legendary place
that has ever eluded explorers and
archaeologists - fabled Akbadain!<M6/6/2>
translation:
<T>Peki nereye goturuyor? <W>Kasiflerin ve
arkeologlarin bir turlu
ulasamadigi efsanevi Akbadain!<M6/6/2>

original: <T><M1/1/1/60>Akbadain?
translation: <T><M1/1/1/60>Akbadain?

original:
<T><M6/4/3>We have to go, Hershel! You have to come
with me to Akbadain!
translation:
<T><M6/4/3>Gitmeliyiz, Hershel! Akbadain'e benimle
gelmek zorundasin!

original:
<T><M4/1/3>No! You can't! It's too dangerous! I won't
let you go, Randy.
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Hayir! Yapamazsin! Cok tehlikeli! Gitmene
izin vermeyecegim, Randy.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>Oh, you won't let me?<W30> Just how do you
plan to stop me?<W30> I still have free will,
don't I?
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Oyle mi, izin vermeyeceksin?<W30> Peki beni
nasil durdurmayi planliyorsun?<W30> Sonucta
kendi iradem var, degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/3>Randy, you complete...<W15>clod!<W30> You are so
self-centred! Sometimes I don't even...
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Randy, sen tam bir...<W15>odunsun!<W30> Sen cok
bencilsin! Bazen ben bile...

original: <T><M1/1/3>I've had enough!
translation: <T><M1/1/3>Yeter artik!

original: <T><M2/3/2>Hey! What are you doing?!
translation: <T><M2/3/2>Hey! Ne yapiyorsun?!

original: <T>Oh, cripes! She's run off with the mask!
translation: <T>Ah, kahretsin! Maske ile kacti!

original:
<T><M4/3/2>Dash it all! She doesn't appreciate how
valuable that thing is. Come on, Hershel,
we have to find her!
translation:
<T><M4/3/2>Lanet olsun! O seyin ne kadar
degerli oldugunu anlamiyor. Hadi, Hershel,
onu bulmamiz gerek!

original: <T>Er, all right.
translation: <T>Sey... Peki.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randy

original: <T>Angelaaaaa! Where are you?
translation: <T>Angelaaaaa! Neredesin?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>I can't see her anywhere.
translation: <T>Onu hicbir yerde goremiyorum.

original: <T><M2/3/2>Argh! We'll just have to keep looking.
translation: <T><M2/3/2>Ahh! Aramaya devam etmeliyiz.

original: ライオネル
translation: Lionel

original: <T>'Ullo, lads. What's the 'urry?
translation: <T>Selam gencler. Ne bu telas?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T><M2/1/1>Lionel! Have you seen Angela go by?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Lionel! Angela'nin gectigini gordun mu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Angela? Yes, I saw her running down Pebble
Lane, as it 'appens.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Angela mi? Evet, tam da onu Pebble
Lane'den asagi kosarken gordum.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>She looked all bent out of shape too. What
did you boys say to make a young lady such
as 'erself cry? Did you-
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>O da bayagi perisan gorunuyordu. Siz cocuklar ne
dediniz de boyle bir hanimefendiyi
aglattiniz? Yoksa-

original: <T><M3/1/1>Sorry, Lionel. We're in a bit of a hurry.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Kusura bakma, Lionel. Biraz acelemiz var.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Yes, well, you'd better get on after 'er and
apologise, 'adn't you?
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Evet, oyleyse pesinden gidip
ondan ozur dilemeniz daha iyi, degil mi?

original:
<T>Angela was heading down Pebble Lane.
Aren't you going after 'er?
translation:
<T>Angela Pebble Lane'den asagi gidiyordu.
Pesinden gitmeyecek misiniz?

original: ヤングダルストン
translation: Genc Dalston

original:
<T>Oi, I just saw Angela belting it through here,
bawling her eyes out. That better not have
been your fault.
translation:
<T>Hey, az once Angela'nin buradan
hungur hungur aglayarak kosup gectigini gordum. Bunun
sizin yuzunuzden olmamasi iyi olur.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Not at all! <W>Well, in a manner of speaking.
Where did she go?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hic de degil! <W>Yani, bir bakima.
Nereye gitti?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Good grief. Towards your house. She had
some...thing in her hand, too.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aman Tanrim. Evine dogru. Elinde de
bir...sey vardi.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Fab. Thanks, Dalston.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Harika. Sag ol, Dalston.

original:
<T>Shouldn't you be going after Angela? She
looked pretty torn up.
translation:
<T>Angela'nin pesinden gitmeniz gerekmiyor mu? Cok
kotu gorunuyordu.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>If I was upset with you, I'd hide in the
school.
translation:
<T>Size kizmis olsaydim, okula
saklanirdim.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Do you really think...? Surely not... And
there's no way in. The doors are locked.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Gercekten mi saniyorsun...? Yok canim... Hem
iceri girmenin yolu yok. Kapilar kilitli.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Ha ha, I wasn't being serious.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Ha ha, ciddi degildim.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Hersh, you're not helping!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Hersh, hic yardimci olmuyorsun!

original:
<T>Look, she can't be in there. It's all locked
up. Let's go and look elsewhere.
translation:
<T>Bak, orada olamaz. Her yer kilitli.
Hadi baska yerde arayalim.

original: ダンフィン
translation: Dunfin

original:
<T>Are you boys looking for Angela? I saw her
fly past just now. <W>Not literally, of course.
translation:
<T>Angela'yi mi ariyorsunuz cocuklar? Az once yanimdan
yildirim gibi gecti. <W>Tabii kelimenin tam anlamiyla ucmadi.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Aha! She must have gone down Pebble
Lane, then!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Aha! O halde Pebble
Lane'e inmis olmali!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Oh! You don't suppose she's gone to
Memory Knoll, do you?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ah! Sence de
Memory Knoll'a gitmis olmasin?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>How did I know it would all end in tears?<W>
Well, go on then. Go and find her!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bunun gozyasiyla bitecegini nasil bildim?<W>
Hadi bakalim. Git de onu bul!

original:
<T>I've seen my share of foolhardy adventures
and more than my fair share of nasty
scrapes.
translation:
<T>Gozu kara maceralarin da, fena belalarin da
payima duseni gordum.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Enjoy it while you can, boys. That's all I can
say. It's all rules and responsibility once you
get to my age.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Keyfini cikarin cocuklar, elinizden geldigince. Soyleyecegim
tek sey bu. Benim yasima gelince her sey
kural ve sorumluluktan ibaret oluyor.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randy

original:
<T>Angela's not going to be at your house, you
wally. <W><M2/1/1>Or do you need your mummy all of
a sudden?
translation:
<T>Angela senin evinde olmayacak, sen
salak. <W><M2/1/1>Yoksa birdenbire annen
mi lazim oldu?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M5/2/1>I just... <W>Never mind. Let's go on looking.
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Ben sadece... <W>Bos ver. Aramaya devam edelim.

original:
<T>What the heck, Hersh? We're looking for
Angela, remember?
translation:
<T>Ne oluyor, Hersh? Angela'yi
ariyoruz, unuttun mu?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
シャロア、やっぱりここにいたのか。
奇跡の仮面を返してくれ！
translation:
Angela, demek hala buradasin.
Mucize Maskesini geri ver!

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original: ランド
translation: Randall

original:
どうしたんだよ、シャロア。
言ってるだろ？何も心配ないって
translation:
Ne oldu, Angela?
Soyluyorum ya, endiselenecek bir sey yok.

original:
兄さんだってそう言ったわ。
そう言って帰っては来なかった
translation:
Agabeyim de aynisini soyledi.
Oyle dedi ve bir daha geri donmedi.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<V0010><T>I know I said I wouldn't do anything
dangerous, <L2.8>but...<L3.5>I need that mask, Angela.</V>
translation:
<V0010><T>Tehlikeli bir sey yapmayacagima
soz verdigimi biliyorum, <L2.8>ama...<L3.5>O maskeye ihtiyacim var, Angela.</V>

original:
<V0020><T>I'm sorry about what happened to your
brother, <L2.6>but I'm not him.<M3/1/4></V>
translation:
<V0020><T>Kardesine olanlar icin uzgunum,
<L2.6>ama ben o degilim.<M3/1/4></V>

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <V0030><T>Randall, can we just drop this for now?</V>
translation: <V0030><T>Randall, simdilik bunu kapatsak olmaz mi?</V>

original:
<V0040><T><M1/1/1>No, Hershel, we can't! <L2.0><M2/1/1>Look, Angela, <L3.25>I know
this is hard for you, <L5.05>but please-<M1/1/1></V>
translation:
<V0040><T><M1/1/1>Hayir, Hershel, olmaz! <L2.0><M2/1/1>Bak, Angela, <L3.25>Biliyorum
bu senin icin zor, <L5.05>ama lutfen-<M1/1/1></V>

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Angela

original:
<V0050><T><M4/1/2>Please what?! <L1.4>Please let you go and
endanger yourself while I just sit here and
wait for you to never come back?!</V>
translation:
<V0050><T><M4/1/2>Lutfen ne?! <L1.4>Seni birakip gitmene ve
kendini tehlikeye atmana izin vereyim de ben burada oturup
bir daha donmemeni mi bekleyeyim?!</V>

original:
<V0060><T><M4/1/1>I will come back. <L1.3>I promise. <L2.75>I have to do
this, Angela.</V>
translation:
<V0060><T><M4/1/1>Geri donecegim. <L1.3>Soz veriyorum. <L2.75>Bunu yapmak
zorundayim, Angela.</V>

original:
<V0070><T><M4/1/2>I can't just live in my father's shadow my
entire life. <L3.4>I need this, <L4.95>and I need your help
to do it.</V>
translation:
<V0070><T><M4/1/2>Hayatim boyunca babamin golgesinde
yasayamam. <L3.4>Buna ihtiyacim var, <L4.95>ve bunu yapmak icin
yardimina ihtiyacim var.</V>

original:
<V0100><T><M2/1/2>Oh, Henry! <L1.25>You startled me. <L2.7>I didn't know
you were there.</V>
translation:
<V0100><T><M2/1/2>Ah, Henry! <L1.25>Beni korkuttun. <L2.7>Orada oldugunu
bilmiyordum.</V>

original: ヤングヘンリー
translation: Genc Henry

original:
<V0110><T><M2/1/1>You needn't worry, Miss Angela. <L2.05>Master
Randall said this would be his last
expedition. <L5.2>Isn't that right?</V>
translation:
<V0110><T><M2/1/1>Endiselenmenize gerek yok, Bayan Angela. <L2.05>Usta
Randall bunun son kesfi olacagini soyledi.
<L5.2>Oyle degil mi?</V>

original: <V0130><T><M4/1/1>Did you really say that, Randall?</V>
translation: <V0130><T><M4/1/2>Bunu gercekten soyledin mi, Randall?</V>

original:
<V0150><T><M1/1/1>This will be my last, and greatest, trip into
the ruins. <L3.75>Angela, <L4.55>please.</V>
translation:
<V0150><T><M1/1/1>Bu, harabelere yapacagim son ve en buyuk
yolculuk olacak. <L3.75>Angela, <L4.55>lutfen.</V>

original:
<V0160><T><M2/2/2>All right. <L1.35>As long as you promise not to do
anything dangerous...<L4.65>or stupid.</V>
translation:
<V0160><T><M2/2/2>Pekala. <L1.35>Tehlikeli bir sey yapmamaya soz verdigin
surece...<L4.65>ya da aptalca bir sey.</V>

original:
<V0170><T><M4/2/1/60>Nothing dangerous! <L1.7>And Hershel here will
make sure I don't do anything stupid!</V>
translation:
<V0170><T><M4/2/1/60>Tehlikeli hicbir sey yok! <L1.7>Ve Hershel burada
aptalca bir sey yapmamami saglayacak!</V>

original:
<V0180><T><M1/1/2/30>I...<L1.3>I need to go home. <L2.95>I'm exhausted.
<L4.9><M4/1/2>Please, <L5.9>be careful.</V>
translation:
<V0180><T><M1/1/2/30>Ben...<L1.3>Eve gitmem gerek. <L2.95>Cok yorgunum.
<L4.9><M4/1/2>Lutfen, <L5.9>dikkatli ol.</V>

original:
<V0200><T><M3/2/1>Henry, would you mind escorting Angela
home?</V>
translation:
<V0200><T><M3/2/1>Henry, Angela'yi eve kadar
goturur musun?</V>

original: <V0210><T>Not at all.</V>
translation: <V0210><T>Elbette.</V>

original:
<V0220><T><M4/2/1>So, Hershel, <L1.1>we're going to unearth the
most important archaeological find in
history! <L4.8>Aren't you excited?!</V>
translation:
<V0220><T><M4/2/1>Yani, Hershel, <L1.1>tarihin en onemli
arkeolojik kesfini
gun yuzune cikaracagiz! <L4.8>Heyecanli degil misin?!</V>

original:
<V0230><T>Let's go back to my place and make sure
we have enough supplies.<M4/6/2></V>
translation:
<V0230><T>Evime donelim de yeterince
erzakimiz var mi bakalim.<M4/6/2></V>

original:
<V0240><T><M3/2/1/45>All right. <L1.65>I do hope you intend to keep your
promise, Randall.</V>
translation:
<V0240><T><M3/2/1/45>Pekala. <L1.65>Umarim sozunu tutmayi
dusunuyorsundur, Randall.</V>

original: ヤングヘンリー
translation: Genc Henry

original: [Not used]
translation: [Kullanilmiyor]

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randy

original:
<T>What's the matter, Hersh? Do you need to
fetch something from home?
translation:
<T>Ne oldu, Hersh? Evden bir sey
almaya mi gidiyorsun?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>No, nothing. Let's go back to yours.
translation: <T>Hayir, bir sey yok. Seninkine geri donelim.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Hersh, what's wrong with you? You know we
can't use the front door! Why do you think
we climbed out the window?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hersh, senin derdin ne? On kapiyi kullanamayacagimizi biliyorsun!
Pencereden tirmanip cikmamizin sebebini saniyorsun?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Ha ha. I'm just pulling your leg.
translation: <T>Ha ha. Sadece seninle dalga geciyorum.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Ugh, for crying out loud...
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Off, Allah askina...

original:
<T>Seriously, my father will go berserk if he
finds out I left the house. Come on, through
the window!
translation:
<T>Cidden, babam evden ciktigimi
ogrenirse kiyameti koparir. Hadi, pencereden
gecelim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Water, food... <W>Torch, compass... <W>I think
that's everything. Are you ready, Hersh?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Su, yiyecek... <W>Mesale, pusula... <W>Sanirim
hepsi bu. Hazir misin, Hersh?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Ha ha, I've been ready for ages, Randall.
translation: <T>Ha ha, ben coktan hazirim, Randall.

original: ヤングヘンリー
translation: Genc Henry

original: <T><M4/2/1>Master Randall, I've brought some tea.
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Usta Randall, biraz cay getirdim.

original:
<T><M2/4/1>Thank you, Henry. <W>By the way...I'm grateful
for what you did earlier.
translation:
<T><M2/4/1>Tesekkurler, Henry. <W>Bu arada... az once yaptigin
sey icin minnettarim.

original:
<T>It was nothing. I'm glad I could be of
assistance.
translation:
<T>Bir sey degil. Yardimim dokunduysa
ne mutlu.

original:
<T>You've worked so long and so hard to fulfil
this dream, I felt I had to do something...
translation:
<T>Bu hayali gerceklestirmek icin o kadar uzun
ve o kadar cok calistin ki bir sey yapmaliydim...

original: <T><M1/2/1>Thank you, Henry. I mean it.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Tesekkur ederim, Henry. Ciddiyim.

original: <T>It was no trouble, truly.
translation: <T>Hic zahmet degil, gercekten.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Hersh, did I tell you that Henry's been
helping me with my research?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Hersh, Henry'nin arastirmalarimda bana
yardim ettigini sana soyledim mi?

original: <T>I'd never have got this far without his help.
translation: <T>Onun yardimi olmasaydi bu kadar ilerleyemezdim.

original: <T>Is that right?
translation: <T>Oyle mi?

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>So, Henry, are you coming with us to
explore the ruins?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Peki Henry, harabeleri kesfetmeye bizimle
gelmiyor musun?

original:
<T><M4/2/2>Unfortunately, no. I must remain here to
perform my household duties.
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Maalesef hayir. Ev islerimi
yapmak icin burada kalmaliyim.

original:
<T><M3/4/1>You must know how busy Henry is. My
father is a demanding man, and he's taken
a liking to Henry.
translation:
<T><M3/4/1>Henry'nin ne kadar mesgul oldugunu bilirsin. Babam
cok talepkar bir adam ve Henry'ye
bir yakinlik duydu.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>If Henry were to go with us, my father would
uncover the whole plan straight away and
stop us.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Henry bizimle gelirse babam tum plani hemen
ortaya cikarir ve
bizi durdurur.

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>Ah, I hadn't thought of that.
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Ah, bunu dusunmemistim.

original:
<T><M4/4/3>So, it looks as if we're all set. You should
probably go home and get some sleep,
Hershel.
translation:
<T><M4/4/3>Evet, her sey hazir gorunuyor. Muhtemelen
sen eve gidip biraz uyumalisin,
Hershel.

original:
<T>Tomorrow, we set out to conquer the
Akbadain ruins! This could be the biggest
find of the century, my friend!
translation:
<T>Yarin Akbadain harabelerini fethetmek icin
yola cikiyoruz! Bu yuzyilin en buyuk
kesfi olabilir, dostum!

original: <T><M3/1/3>That would be something...
translation: <T><M3/1/3>Bu harika olurdu...

original:
<T>If I had stopped Randall that night,
he might still be with us now.
translation:
<T>O gece Randall'i durdursaydim,
simdi hala bizimle olabilirdi.

original: <T>If only we had listened to Angela...
translation: <T>Keske Angela'yi dinleseydik...

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<V0010><T>After finding the truth behind the
Masked Gentleman's past {''}miracles{''},
we went to the gallery plaza.
translation:
<V0010><T>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin gecmisteki
{''}miracles{''}inin ardindaki gercegi ogrendikten sonra,
galeri meydanina gittik.

original:
<V0020><T>There we witnessed innocent
bystanders being lifted into the
air before they disappeared.
translation:
<V0020><T>Orada masum
seyircilerin havaya kaldirilip
kaybolduklarina tanik olduk.

original:
<V0030><T>Within minutes, the police arrested
Alphonse Dalston on suspicion of
aiding the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<V0030><T>Dakikalar icinde polis
