Alphonse Dalston'i, Maskeli Beyefendi'ye
yardim ettigi suphesiyle tutukladi.

original:
<V0040><T>Could it be that he was the mastermind
behind this series of incidents?
translation:
<V0040><T>Bu olaylar dizisinin arkasindaki beyin
o olabilir miydi?

original:
<V0050><T>As dawn broke on our third day in
Monte d'Or, I wondered: had we
come any closer to the truth?
translation:
<V0050><T>Monte d'Or'daki ucuncu gunumuzde
safak sokerken sunu dusundum:
Gercege biraz daha yaklasmis miydik?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Good morning, Luke. Did you sleep well?
We'll be setting out shortly to begin today's
investigations.
translation:
<T>Gunaydin, Luke. Iyi uyudun mu?
Bugunku sorusturmalarimiza baslamak icin
az sonra yola cikacagiz.

original: <T><M1/2/4/90>Muh...? O-okay, I'm awake...
translation: <T><M1/2/4/90>Ha...? T-tamam, uyandim...

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Morning, sleepy head! Did you have a good
lie-in? You were out for the count, so
I helped myself to your breakfast.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Gunaydin, uykucu! Iyi bir
uyku cektin mi? Bayilmis gibiydin, bu yuzden
kahvaltini ben yedim.

original: <T><M1/2/2>What?! How could you?!
translation: <T><M1/2/2>Ne?! Nasil yaparsin?!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Ho ho, Emmy was just teasing, Luke. Now,
before we head out, let's summarise our
plans for today.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ho ho, Emmy sadece saka yapiyordu, Luke. Simdi,
yola cikmadan once bugunku
planlarimizi ozetleyelim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Uh, right! Today's miracle is supposed to
take place in Tingly Town.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sey, evet! Bugunku mucize
Tingly Town'da gerceklesecekmis.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Tingly Town... Let's hope it lives up to its
name. It sounds so exciting!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Tingly Town... Adinin hakkini verir umarim.
Kulaga cok heyecan verici geliyor!

original:
<T><M1/2/2>No, it doesn't! <W><M1/2/3>I mean...people might be in
danger! It's not appropriate to be excited!
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Hayir, gelmiyor! <W><M1/2/3>Yani... insanlar tehlikede olabilir!
Heyecanlanmak uygun degil!

original:
<T><M4/2/6><K>Hmm... </K>Very responsible of you, Luke...<W>
Wait, don't tell me you're afraid?
translation:
<T><M4/2/6><K>Hmm... </K>Cok sorumluca, Luke...<W>
Dur, yoksa korkuyor musun?

original:
<T><M1/2/2>A-afraid? N-not at all! <W><M3/1/1/45>I'm sure today's the
day we'll catch the Masked Gentleman and
foil his plans!
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>K-korkmak mi? H-hayir, asla! <W><M3/1/1/45>Eminim bugun
Maskeli Beyefendi'yi yakalayacagimiz ve
planlarini bozacagimiz gun!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That's the spirit, Luke. We must clear up
this issue with Dalston, as well.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Iste bu, Luke. Dalston'la ilgili
bu meseleyi de acikliga kavusturmaliyiz.

original:
<T>I am certain of his innocence. Let's head to
the city hall first and hear what the police
have to say.
translation:
<T>Onun masum oldugundan eminim. Once
belediyeye gidip polisin
ne dedigini dinleyelim.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>The city hall is north of the Ledores'
mansion, isn't it? Let's get a move on!
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Belediye Ledore'larin konaginin
kuzeyinde, degil mi? Haydi hareket edelim!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>One can hardly head out to investigate
without closing one's bag, can one?
translation:
<T>Cantani kapatmadan arastirmaya
cikmak pek mumkun degil, degil mi?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: [Not used]
translation: [Kullanilmiyor]

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: バスカル
translation: Pascal

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Good morning! I trust that your repose was
comfortable?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Gunaydin! Istirahatinizin
rahat gectigini umarim?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Very comfortable, thank you.
translation: <T>Cok rahatti, tesekkur ederim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Such a splendid day! What with the Masked
Gentleman's capture, <M2/1/1>the town finally has
cause for celebration again.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ne muhtesem bir gun! Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
yakalanmasiyla, <M2/1/1>sehir sonunda
yeniden kutlama icin bir neden buldu.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>With any luck, you should now be able to
enjoy at your leisure all that Monte d'Or has
to offer.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sansiniz yaver giderse artik Monte d'Or'un
sundugu her seyin tadini gonlunuzce
cikarabilirsiniz.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Thank you kindly.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Nazik sozleriniz icin tesekkur ederim.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Take care, sir.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Kendinize iyi bakin, efendim.

original: ジャグラー
translation: Jonglor

original:
<T>Gyuh huh huh huh huh! Hullo, hullo, hullo!
Say hello to...<W>guess who?<W> No takers?<W> It's
me, Juggles the clown!
translation:
<T>Gyuh huh huh huh huh! Merhaba, merhaba, merhaba!
Tanisin bakalim...<W>tahmin edin kim?<W> Bilen yok mu?<W> Bu
benim, palyaco Juggles!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hello, Juggles. What are you up to? Wait,
don't tell me...<W>juggling!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Merhaba, Juggles. Ne yapiyorsun? Dur,
soyleme...<W>jonglorluk!

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Ha ha, good guess! Since the Masked
Gentleman's been caught, I'll be the best
show in town! I need to practise!
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Ha ha, iyi tahmin! Maskeli
Bey yakalandigina gore kasabanin en iyi
sovu ben olacagim! Pratik yapmam lazim!

original: <T><M3/2/5>People are saying he's been caught?
translation: <T><M3/2/5>Insanlar yakalandigini mi soyluyor?

original:
<T><M7/1/90>Just something I heard on the grapevine,
really. But pretty reliable sources, they were!
Pret-ty reliable.
translation:
<T><M7/1/90>Sadece kulaktan kulaga duydugum bir sey,
aslinda. Ama oldukca guvenilir kaynaklardi!
Pek gu-venilir.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Well, they haven't caught the real criminal.
He's still at large.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Ama gercek sucluyu yakalamadilar.
O hala disarida.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>What? Oh, don't be a spoilsport. You're
pulling my leg. Really? No...<W> Really?<W> Really,
huh?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ne? Hadi ama, hevesimi kacirma. Dalga
geciyorsun. Cidden mi? Hayir...<W> Cidden mi?<W> Cidden,
hi?

original:
<T>What makes you so sure about yourself then,
eh? <M2/1/1>Are you detectives? Investigators?
<W>SPIES?
translation:
<T>Peki bu kadar kendinden emin olmani saglayan ne,
hi? <M2/1/1>Siz dedektif misiniz? Arastirmaci?
<W>CASUSLAR?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hey, can you catch him then? If you do,
I'll sneak you into the funfair. How would
you like that?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hey, o zaman onu yakalayabilir misiniz? Yakalarsaniz,
sizi lunaparka gizlice sokarim. Buna
ne dersiniz?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>The old constables have it tough, always in
uniform during the festival. How can I
brighten their day a little?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Yasli polislerin isi zor, festival boyunca hep
uniforma icindeler. Gunlerini biraz nasil
neselendirebilirim?

original: ダンチョー
translation: Sirk Muduru

original:
<T>Another sell-out crowd! I should be thrilled,
<M2/1/2>but I can't help but worry about Mr Dalston,
our sponsor.
translation:
<T>Yine kapali gise! Sevincten ucmam gerek,
<M2/1/2>ama sponsorumuz Bay Dalston icin
endiselenmeden edemiyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Without his generosity, our little troupe
would never have got off the ground. And
now they say he'll go to jail!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Onun comertligi olmasaydi kucuk kumpanyamiz
asla yola cikamazdi. Ve simdi de
hapse girecegini soyluyorlar!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>I assure you that Alphonse Dalston is
innocent. The police will soon realise their
error.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Size temin ederim ki Alphonse Dalston
masum. Polis yakinda
hatasini anlayacak.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Innocent?! But that's even sadder! <M3/1/2>Arrested
for a crime he didn't commit!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Masum mu?! Bu daha da uzucu! <M3/1/2>Islemedigi
bir suc yuzunden tutuklandi!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Hmph. Funny, the things life springs on you.
That's why you've got to have contingency
plans.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Hih. Hayat insana ne surprizler yapiyor.
Iste bu yuzden her zaman bir
yedek planin olmali.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>We need enough paying customers to stay
in business without a sponsor. <M3/1/3>EVERYBODY!
EMERGENCY MEETING!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Sponsorsuz da ayakta kalmak icin
yeterince biletli musteri bulmaliyiz. <M3/1/3>HERKES!
ACIL TOPLANTI!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>They'd better catch the real criminal soon.
<M2/1/3>Nervous people don't buy tickets.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Gercek sucluyu bir an once yakalasinlar.
<M2/1/3>Gergin insanlar bilet almaz.

original:
<T><M3/1/3>If Mr Dalston isn't freed, perhaps Mr Ledore
would consider sponsoring us...
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>Bay Dalston serbest kalmazsa, belki Bay Ledore
bize sponsor olmayi dusunebilir...

original: チルチル
translation: Chilchil

original: <T><M2/2/1/45>Grrrrrowr...
translation: <T><M2/2/1/45>Grrrrrowr...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Poor Hannibal looks terribly depressed. No
wonder, being cooped up in this enclosure
all the time...
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Zavalli Hannibal cok uzgun gorunuyor. Tabii
sasmamali, hep bu kafesin icinde
tikili kaliyor...

original: <T><M1/1/1>Grr, grrrrawr grrrowl. Grrrowrrr...
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Grr, grrrrawr grrrowl. Grrrowrrr...

original:
<T><M2/2/2>He misses Mr Dalston! He says Mr Dalston
talks to him a lot...even though he can't
understand Hannibal at all.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Bay Dalston'i ozluyor! Bay Dalston'in
onunla cok konustugunu soyluyor... oysa
Hannibal'i hic anlayamiyor.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Then we have to crack this case quickly! We
can't be having poor Hannibal feeling all
alone, can we?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>O zaman bu isi cabucak cozmeliyiz! Zavalli
Hannibal'in kendini yapayalniz hissetmesine
izin veremeyiz, degil mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>You're right! Don't worry. We'll get to the
bottom of this!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Haklisin! Merak etme. Bunun
aslini ortaya cikaracagiz!

original: <T><M1/2/1>Grrrawr.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Grrrawr.

original: <T><M3/2/5>Oh, he says he's got a puzzle for us.<M1/2/5/60>
translation: <T><M3/2/5>Aa, bize bir bulmaca sordugunu soyluyor.<M1/2/5/60>

original: <T><M1/1/1>Grrrraaawrrr!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Grrrraaawrrr!

original: <T>We'll come back to solve it later!
translation: <T>Sonra cozmek icin geri gelecegiz!

original: <T>Grrrrroowwr. Grrrowr!
translation: <T>Grrrrroowwr. Grrrowr!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I'll come back soon. And Mr Dalston will be
back before you know it!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yakinda yine gelecegim. Ve Bay Dalston
goz acip kapayincaya kadar geri donecek!

original: <T><M2/2/1>Grrr...rrr...rrr...
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Grrr...rrr...rrr...

original: <T>He looks sleepy. Let's leave him in peace.
translation: <T>Uykusu gelmis gibi. Hadi onu rahat birakalim.

original: ゴンゾ
translation: Gonzo

original:
<T>Oh, Mr Dalston... What has become of
you?
translation:
<T>Ah, Bay Dalston... Sana
ne oldu?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Hello, I don't believe we've been formally
introduced.
translation:
<T>Merhaba, sanirim resmen
tanistirilmadik.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Gonzales. I am the steward of Ch{^a}teau
Dalston.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Gonzales. Ch{^a}teau
Dalston'in kahyasiyim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Last night, I'd cooked the dinner, swept the
floors and was just sitting down for a rest,
when suddenly I got a call.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Dun gece yemegi pisirdim, yerleri supurdum ve
dinlenmek icin yeni oturmustum ki,
birden bir telefon geldi.

original:
<T>{''}Mr Dalston has been arrested,{''} they said.
That was last night and I've heard nothing
else since!
translation:
<T>{''}Bay Dalston tutuklandi,{''} dediler.
Dun geceydi bu ve o zamandan beri
baska hicbir sey duymadim!

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>I believe Dalston is being questioned by the
police as we speak.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Sanirim Dalston su anda
polis tarafindan sorgulaniyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But he's done nothing! Why would anyone
suspect Mr Dalston?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama o hicbir sey yapmadi! Neden biri
Bay Dalston'dan suphelensin ki?

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>I urge you not to worry too much, Gonzales.
The enquiry will be over soon enough.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Cok fazla endiselenmemenizi oneririm, Gonzales.
Sorusturma yakinda bitecektir.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Yes, I should head back and dust the
window sills again. He is a fussy man...
<W>But he is a good man!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Evet, geri donup pencere
pervazlarini yine toz almaliyim. Cok titiz bir adam...
<W>Ama iyi bir adam!

original:
<T><M6/1/1>Let's head to the city hall. We still need to
speak to Dalston and Detective Bloom.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Belediyeye gidelim. Dalston ve Dedektif Bloom'la
hala konusmamiz gerekiyor.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/3>Right you are, Professor! Let's go!
translation: <T><M3/1/3>Haklisiniz, Profesor! Haydi gidelim!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Mr Dalston is innocent, of course. Quite
innocent, I'm sure...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bay Dalston elbette sucsuz. Hem de
kesinlikle sucsuz, eminim...

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Morning! Oh, it's you lot again! We met the
other night. You know, the <M4/1/2>night of that
statues incident.
translation:
<T>Gunaydin! Aa, yine siz! Gecen
gece tanismistik. Hani su <M4/1/2>heykel
olayi gecesi.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Oh...<W30>oh, erm, yes. You're...<W30>that one. <W30>Good
morning to you too, Constable.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ah...<W30> ee, evet. Siz...<W30> o kisisiniz. <W30>Sana da
Gunaydin, Memur.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We're still gathering evidence, but now that
the mastermind's in custody, I'll be looking
forward to some time off!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hala delil topluyoruz ama
beyin artik gozetim altinda olunca,
biraz izin yapmayi dort gozle bekliyorum!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>What can I say? I found those suspicious
wheel marks. Bound to be important
evidence in the trial.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ne diyeyim? O supheli
tekerlek izlerini ben buldum. Davada
onemli bir delil olacagi kesin.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>And the mastermind you refer to would
be...?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Bahsettiginiz beyin
kim oluyor...?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Alphonse Dalston. Who'd you think I
meant? Don't you read the papers?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Alphonse Dalston. Kimi
kastettigimi sandin? Gazete okumuyor musun?

original:
<T>Why'd he go and do that in a town he's got
wrapped round his little finger? Tourists hate
being turned to stone.
translation:
<T>Parmaginda oynattigi bu kasabada gidip
bunu neden yapti ki? Turistler
tasa donusmekten hic hoslanmaz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>My partner got himself hurt in the stampede
when that clown balloon fell down. <M2/1/1>I was
visiting him just earlier.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ortagim izdihamda yaralandi
su palyaco balonu dusunce. <M2/1/1>Az once
onu ziyarete gitmistim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I'm gutted I wasn't there to help him.
He'll be limping for a month and it's all
the Masked Gentleman's fault!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Orada olup yardim edemedigime cok icerledim.
Bir ay topallayacak ve bunun hepsi
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin sucu!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I hope they put that bloke away for a long,
long time.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Umarim o herifi cok,
cok uzun sure iceri tikarlar.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>The guv says if he cooperates, that'll be the
end of this nonsense.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Amir diyor ki isbirligi yaparsa, bu
sacmalik burada biter.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>If he's right and we put this nutter away fast,
maybe me and the wife can enjoy a bit of
the festival before it ends.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hakliysa ve bu manyagi hizlica iceri tikarsak,
ben de karimla biraz
festivalin tadini cikarabiliriz bitmeden.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Is Mr Dalston being questioned now?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Bay Dalston su an sorgulaniyor mu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Yeah, if you head down to the city hall, you
should be able to hear his sob story.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Evet, belediyeye inersen
onun acikli hikayesini duyabilirsin.

original: <T><M3/1/1>That's very helpful. Thank you for your time.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Bu cok yardimci oldu. Zamaniniz icin tesekkurler.

original:
<T>Listen, if you find any clues, don't try to be
a hero. <M/4/2/1>Just inform the police.
translation:
<T>Dinle, bir ipucu bulursan kahramanlik
yapmaya kalkma. <M/4/2/1>Sadece polise
haber ver.

original: ニルス
translation: Nils

original:
<T>Heard Alphonse Dalston got arrested.
Performing miracles without a licence, they
say. Always thought he was sketchy.
translation:
<T>Alphonse Dalston'in tutuklandigini duydum.
Ruhsatsiz mucizeler yapiyormus, diye
soyluyorlar. Hep supheli biri oldugunu dusunmustum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But...doesn't quite add up. Hotel magnate
like him. Everyone leaves town, he goes
broke.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama... pek akla yatmiyor. Onun gibi bir otel
patronu. Herkes kasabadan gidince, adam
batiyor.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Yes, I'd considered that as well. There is
much about the Masked Gentleman that is
still a mystery to me.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Evet, bunu ben de dusunmustum. Fakat
Maskeli Beyefendi hakkinda hala bilmedigim
cok sey var.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Well, Professor, you did say that the
Gentleman is probably wealthy, right?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Sey, Profesor, Beyefendi'nin muhtemelen
zengin oldugunu soylemistiniz, degil mi?

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Yes, but I feel certain that our culprit is not
Alphonse Dalston.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Evet, ama suclumuzun Alphonse Dalston
olmadigindan eminim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Don't look to the police to figure that out
on their own.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Polisin bunu kendi basina cozecegini
sanma.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Their detectives? Not a smart bunch.
Couldn't even crack this puzzle.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Dedektifleri mi? Pek zeki bir topluluk degil.
Bu bulmacayi bile cozemiyorlar.

original: <T><M2/1/1>What? Can't solve it either?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ne? Sen de mi cozemiyorsun?

original: <T><M2/2/1>Eh, you might be able to handle it.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Eh, belki sen halledebilirsin.

original:
<T><M2/3/1>Oh, you're a clever one. Thought you might
be the type.
translation:
<T><M2/3/1>Oh, sen zekisin. Oyle biri olabilecegini
dusunmustum.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Nils, you seem pretty well informed about all
this police business. How do you know so
much?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Nils, su polis isleri hakkinda epey bilgili
gorunuyorsun. Nasil bu kadar cok sey
biliyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Local police. Bunch of loudmouths. Not
the first investigation they've botched.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Yerel polis. Bir suru cenesi dusuk tip. Bu,
berbat ettikleri ilk sorusturma degil.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Even thought about lending them a hand,
since this Masked Gentleman guy's such
a dangerous loon.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hatta bu Maskeli Beyefendi denen herif
boyle tehlikeli bir deli oldugundan,
onlara yardim etmeyi bile dusundum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Anyone causing wanton destruction like
that? Guaranteed to be one selfish
individual.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Boyle akla zarar bir yikim cikaran biri mi?
Kesinlikle bencil
biridir.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Guy claims he can do anything! Think how
many problems he could actually solve.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Her seyi yapabilecegini iddia ediyor! Dusunsene,
aslinda kac sorunu cozebilirdi.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>All that potential for good. But, no.
Essentially, he's engaging in magical
vandalism. No better than a thug.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Iyilik icin onca potansiyel var. Ama yok.
Aslinda yaptigi sey buyulu
vandalizm. Bir serseriden farki yok.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Those are harsh words. <W>Though, I can't
entirely disagree with you.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Bu agir sozler. <W>Ama sana
tamamen karsi da gelemem.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>No matter. Fuzz caught him, right? <M2/3/1>Got
someone to shoulder the blame, at least.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Her neyse. Polis onu yakaladi, degil mi? <M2/3/1>En azindan
sucu ustlenecek birini buldular.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Wouldn't be surprised if it turns out they've
arrested the wrong man. Not with this police
department.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Yanlis adami tutukladiklari ortaya cikarsa
sasirmam. Bu polis
teskilatiyla olmaz mi.

original: ラプンシュカ
translation: Rapunska

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Welcome! Are you finally here to let me
dress you up nicely?
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Hos geldiniz! Sonunda
sizi guzelce giydirmeme izin vermeye mi geldiniz?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I'm afraid the answer is still {''}no{''}. But I do
appreciate your gracious offer, madam.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Korkarim cevap hala {''}no{''}. Ama nazik teklifinizi
takdir ediyorum, hanimefendi.

original:
<T><M2/1/3>A shame. <M2/2/1>Don't think you can waltz out of
here without solving a puzzle, though!
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Yazik. <M2/2/1>Ama buradan
bir bilmece cozmeden salina salina cikabilecegini sanma!

original:
<T><M1/1/3>Really? I hadn't pegged you as such a
defeatist.
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Gercekten mi? Seni boyle bir
pesimist sanmazdim.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Solving puzzles is a good way for the mind
to relax.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Bulmaca cozmek zihnin
rahatlamasi icin iyi bir yoldur.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>So, that erudite air isn't just an act. <M1/2/3>Still,
a pity about the clothes...
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Demek o bilgin havasi sadece numara degil. <M1/2/3>Yine de,
su kiyafetler icin yazik...

original:
<T><M7/1/1>Er, leaving that aside for the moment, did
you hear about the arrest that was made last
night?
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Ee, simdilik bunu bir kenara birakalim, dun gece
yapilan tutuklamayi
duydun mu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh, you mean Alphonse Dalston? That
really doesn't sit well with me.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah, Alphonse Dalston'dan mi bahsediyorsun? Bu
hic icime sinmiyor.

original:
<T>I can't imagine what sort of evidence the
police think they have against Alphonse.
translation:
<T>Polisin Alphonse'a karsi nasil bir delile
sahip oldugunu hayal bile edemiyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>All right, he's not very good with people.
A bit rough around the edges, maybe.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Tamam, insanlarla arasi pek iyi degil.
Biraz kaba saba olabilir.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But his own businesses are suffering too.
Isn't it obvious that he's not their man?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama kendi isleri de zarar goruyor.
Onlarin aradigi adam olmadigi belli degil mi?

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I also believe the police are wasting their
time interrogating Dalston.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ben de polisin Dalston'i sorgulayarak
zaman kaybettigini dusunuyorum.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>And that may be exactly what the real
criminal is going for.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ve bu, gercek
suclunun tam da istedigi sey olabilir.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>You mean that while everyone is focusing
on Dalston, the real culprit is preparing
another crime?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Yani herkes Dalston'a odaklanirken,
gercek suclu
baska bir suc icin hazirlaniyor mu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Exactly. It just seems as if the police are
a little overeager to call this case closed.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aynen oyle. Polis bu davayi kapatmaya
biraz fazla hevesli gibi gorunuyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I'm not pointing any fingers, but the
Gentleman is still at large. That chief
inspector will see soon enough.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Kimseyi suclamiyorum ama
Beyefendi hala disarida. O basmufettis
yakinda anlayacak.

original: ハンナ
translation: Hannah

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Supposedly the villain's been caught, but
I don't believe the local police could do it,
not without dear Grosky!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Sozde kotu adam yakalanmis, ama
yerel polisin bunu yapabildigine inanmiyorum,
sevgili Grosky olmadan asla!

original: <T><M2/1/2>It doesn't make any sense at all.
translation: <T><M2/1/2>Hicbir anlami yok.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M5/2/1>What do you mean?
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Ne demek istiyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/1/3>After the statues fiasco, I pursued the
Masked Gentleman over rooftops. I lost him,
but he was flying towards a specific place.
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Heykel olayindan sonra Maskeli
Bey'i catilarda kovaladim. Onu kaybettim,
ama belli bir yere dogru gidiyordu.

original:
<T>He didn't go towards Mr Dalston's house or
any of his hotels. <M1/1/2>Perhaps he was heading
for some sort of secret hideaway.
translation:
<T>Bay Dalston'in evine ya da
otellerinden herhangi birine gitmedi. <M1/1/2>Belki de
bir tur gizli siginaga gidiyordu.

original:
<T><M2/2/3>That hadn't occurred to me. We also chased
him, but we lost sight of him.
translation:
<T><M2/2/3>Bu aklima gelmemisti. Biz de onu kovaladik,
ama gozden kaybettik.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Hannah, thank you for sharing your account
with us.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hannah, anlattiklarin icin
tesekkur ederiz.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Yes, thank you. You may well have had
a hand in solving this case.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Evet, tesekkurler. Bu davayi cozmemize
gercekten katkin olmus olabilir.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>I will do anything for my gallant inspector,
even if it means cornering the real Masked
Gentleman and arresting him myself!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Yigit mufettisim icin her seyi yaparim,
gercek Maskeli Bey'i koseye sikistirip
onu bizzat tutuklamam gerekse bile!

original:
<T><M1/1/3>The local police may think they've got their
man, but something about Mr Dalston's
arrest just doesn't add up.
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Yerel polis adamini yakaladigini saniyor
olabilir ama Bay Dalston'in
tutuklanmasiyla ilgili bir seyler tutmuyor.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/5>Is it just me, Professor, or does it smell
a bit...pongy in here?<M1/2/5/90>
translation:
<T><M2/2/5>Bana mi oyle geliyor Profesor, yoksa burasi
biraz...kokusmus mu?<M1/2/5/90>

original: オージー
translation: Ozzie

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Oh! You caught me red-handed there, boy.
You're smelling my lunch: a graciously
gooey slice of Gorgonzola!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Ah! Beni sucustu yakaladin, evlat.
Kokladigin ogle yemegim: comertce
akiskan bir Gorgonzola dilimi!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1>You eat your lunch here in the gallery? <W>Isn't
that...<W15>bad for the paintings?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Ogle yemegini burada, galeride mi yiyorsun? <W>Bu
resimler icin...<W15>kotu degil mi?

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Hardly. I merely create an artistic experience
for the nose as well as the eyes.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Hic de degil. Sadece gozlere oldugu kadar
buruna da sanatsal bir deneyim yaratiyorum.

original:
<T>If you're unconvinced about the unparalleled
magnificence of pizza, may I suggest you
partake in this puzzle?
translation:
<T>Pizzanin esi benzeri olmayan
muhtesemligine ikna olmadiysan, bu bulmacaya
katilmani oneririm.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hmph. Well, I suppose you're one of those
naysayers. But each to their own!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hih. Demek sen o
inkarcilardansin. Ama herkesin zevki kendine!

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Mmmm, fresh pizza bubbling over with
cheese. The taste permeates the palate...
and you can never go back.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Mmmm, peynirle
tasip kabaran taze pizza. Tadi damaga isler...
ve bir daha vazgecemezsin.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>This puzzle demonstrates a situation we
have all experienced at one time or another.
Life truly does imitate art.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Bu bulmaca, hepimizin
bir zamanlar yasadigi bir durumu gosteriyor.
Hayat gercekten sanati taklit eder.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Maybe it would be for the best if the police
confiscated ALL the paintings.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Belki de en iyisi polis
BUTUN tablolari musadere etse.

original:
<T><M7/1/1>Indeed. Even great art can suffer at the
mercy of lingering odours like these.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Kesinlikle. Buyuk sanat bile
boyle kalici kokularin insafina kalinca zarar gorebilir.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Look, the gallery is quiet now because
we've just reopened. It has nothing to do
with the cheese, I assure you.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bak, galeri simdi sakin cunku
az once yeniden actik. Peynirle
ilgisi yok, emin ol.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>In fact, I've been thinking about serving
pizza to our patrons. Post-minimalist
pepperoni should be quite delectable.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aslinda, musterilerimize
pizza servis etmeyi dusunuyorum. Post-minimalist
pepperoni oldukca leziz olmali.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>With the Masked Gentleman safely behind
bars, we're sure to get more visitors.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Maskeli Beyefendi guvenle
parmakliklar ardindayken daha cok ziyaretci gelecektir.

original: コッペリア
translation: Coppelia

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Heya! I just 'eard the news about our
Gentleman getting arrested! But, really?
Mr Dalston?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Selam! Bizim
Bey'in tutuklandigi haberini duydum! Ama gercekten mi?
Bay Dalston mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That don't make any sense. I mean, I just
saw him yesterday at the circus and he were
'aving the time of 'is life!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hic mantikli degil. Yani onu daha dun
sirkte gordum ve
hayatinin en guzel zamanini geciriyordu!

original:
<T>On the other 'and, I s'pose it could all be
some weird stunt to build buzz or summat...
What do you guys think?<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Ote yandan, belki de ortaligi
karistirmak icin yapilan tuhaf bir reklam numarasidir...
Siz ne dusunuyorsunuz?<M1/1/1>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We believe Dalston is not the real criminal
here. The tiger in the circus tent vouched
for his innocence.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Dalston'in gercek suclu
olmadigina inaniyoruz. Sirk cadirindaki kaplan
onun masumiyetine kefil oldu.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>You what? Well, that's, um...<W>news to me.
I didn't know Hannibal-<W> So you think our
<M3/1/1>Gentleman's still out and about?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Ne dedin? Sey, bu benim icin...<W>yeni.
Hannibal'i bilmiyordum-<W> Yani sizce bizim
<M3/1/1>Bey hala ortalikta mi?

original:
<T>I just hope the mystery gets solved before
the festival's over!
translation:
<T>Umarim bu gizem festival
bitmeden cozulur!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Leave it to us! We're certain to catch the
real criminal!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bize birakin! Gercek sucluyu
kesin yakalayacagiz!

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Ey, I like that confidence. All right! When
you do catch him, give him a right good
slap for me, would you?
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Hey, bu ozguveni sevdim. Tamam! Onu
yakalayinca benim icin
guzelce bir tokat patlatin, olur mu?

original:
<T>And let me know if you get any good tips
from the elephants, yer?
translation:
<T>Fillerden iyi bir ipucu
alirsaniz bana da haber verin, tamam mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That warning about tonight... It's gonna be
at the funfair, in't it? You just be careful,
a'right?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu geceyle ilgili uyari...
lunaparkta olacak, degil mi? Dikkatli olun,
tamam mi?

original: <T><M3/1/1>We will. Thank you.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Olacagiz. Tesekkurler.

original: パック
translation: Puck

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Ahem.<W30> La la-laa! Do you guys know about
the funfair we have? It's HEAPS of fun!
Hee hee hee!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Oho.<W30> La la-laa! Bizdeki
lunaparki biliyor musunuz? ASIRI eglenceli!
Hih hih hih!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/1/1>You're talking about Tingly Town, right?
Have you heard what's supposed to happen
there tonight?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Tingly Town'dan bahsediyorsun, degil mi?
Bu gece orada ne olmasi gerektigini
duydun mu?

original:
<T><M3/3/1>Yup, the Masked Gentleman's going to turn
up for another miracle! It'll be the best
thing ever!
translation:
<T><M3/3/1>Evet, Maskeli Beyefendi yine bir mucize icin
ortaya cikacak! Bu, simdiye kadarki en
harika sey olacak!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Oh no! If lots of people turn up to see the
miracle, there's going to be a real panic
when things go wrong!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Hayir! Bir suru kisi mucizeyi gormeye gelirse,
isler ters gidince
ortam tam bir panige doner!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>What if a roller coaster flies off into the
sky?! Or the horses on the merry-go-round
go running wild?!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ya hiz treni gokyuzune firlarsa?! Ya
atlikarincadaki atlar
cilginca kosup durursa?!

original:
<T><M2/1/3>Or what if a Ferris wheel goes rolling after
people?!
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Ya bir donme dolap insanlarin pesinden
yuvarlanirsa?!

original: <T><M3/1/2>Rolling after people? Now that's just silly.
translation: <T><M3/1/2>Insanlarin pesinden yuvarlanmak mi? Bu da cok sacma.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Actually...<W15>that sounds pretty scary. Perhaps
I'll stay away from there today.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aslinda...<W15>kulaga bayagi korkunc geliyor. Belki
bugun oradan uzak dururum.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>La la-laa! Merry-go-horses running stray.
I think I'd better staaaaay awaaaaay.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>La la-laa! Atlikarinca atlari kacip gidiyor.
Bence en iyisi uuuuzaaaak duuurayim.

original: ヤッタイ
translation: Jean-Paul

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Step right up, step right up! I've got toys up
to my ears but I'm still all ears for you!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Yaklasin, yaklasin! Oyuncaklar kulaklarima
kadar ama sizi dinlemek icin hala kulaklarim acik!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Whew! Business is so good, it's been hard
to keep up.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Vay canina! Isler o kadar iyi ki
yetismek zor oluyor.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>The children of Monte d'Or are very lucky to
have such exquisite toys.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'un cocuklari boyle nefis
oyuncaklara sahip olduklari icin cok sansli.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Much appreciated! Yes, many of the officers
are buying toys for their children now their
extra shifts are over.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Cok naziksiniz! Evet, ek mesaileri bittigi icin
pek cok polis memuru simdi cocuklarina
oyuncak aliyor.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M4/1/3>Well, that seems a bit premature considering
the case hasn't been solved yet.
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Dava henuz cozulmemisken bu biraz
erken degil mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Oh, apple of my eye! Forgive me! My
selection may be better than ever, but I can
conceive of no gift to parallel your beauty!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Ah, gozumun bebegi! Affet beni! Seckim hic
olmadigi kadar iyi olabilir ama guzelliginle
boy olcusecek bir hediye dusunemiyorum!

original:
<T><M5/1/4>Yes, all right, nice to see you too,
Jean-Paul.<W> Hmm? Professor, what is it?
translation:
<T><M5/1/4>Evet, tamam, seni de gormek guzel,
Jean-Paul.<W> Himm? Profesor, ne oldu?

original:
<T><M4/2/1>That the police are no longer working extra
shifts shows that they're sure they have
their man.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Polisin artik ek mesai yapmamasi,
adamlarini yakaladiklarindan emin
olduklarini gosteriyor.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>If they're completely convinced that Dalston
is the real criminal, we're just going to have
to prove them wrong.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Dalston'in gercek suclu olduguna tamamen
ikna oldularsa, biz de
yanildiklarini kanitlamaliyiz.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>That silken hair, those hypnotic eyes. And
that...<W15>flavescent jacket! Every aspect of you
is perfection!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>O ipeksi saclar, o hipnotize eden gozler. Ve
su...<W15>sarimsi ceket! Senin her halin
mukemmellik!

original: グロリア
translation: Gloria

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Hershel, lad! Did you hear that the police
made an arrest?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hershel, evlat! Polisin
birini tutukladigini duydun mu?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Yes. They're questioning Dalston right now.
translation: <T>Evet. Su anda Dalston'i sorguluyorlar.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>I don't believe it for a minute! I've known
that boy most of his life and he wouldn't
hurt a fly!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Inanmiyorum! O cocugu
omrumun cogunda tanirim ve
sinege bile zarar vermez!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>I'm completely on your side, Gloria.
Unfortunately, the police seem quite
convinced.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Tamamen seninleyim, Gloria.
Ne yazik ki polis
buna oldukca emin gorunuyor.

original:
<T>Oh they are, are they? Well I'm going down
to that city hall right this instant to give
those twits a piece of my mind!
translation:
<T>Oyle miymis? O zaman hemen simdi
belediyeye gidip
o ahmaklarin agzina lafimi verecegim!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Calm down, Gloria, please. My friends and
I are gathering evidence that should clear
Dalston's name.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Sakin ol, Gloria, lutfen. Ben ve
arkadaslarim Dalston'in adini
temize cikaracak delil topluyoruz.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Calm down, you say? The only thing that
might stop my blood boiling is <M1/1/1>working on
a puzzle!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Sakin ol diyorsun ha? Kanimin
durulmasinin tek yolu <M1/1/1>bir bulmaca
cozmek olabilir!

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Eat your greens and finish your puzzles!
I know your parents raised you better than
that!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Yesilliklerini ye ve bulmacalarini bitir!
Anne baban seni bundan daha iyi
yetistirdi, biliyorum!

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Whatever else might be said about them, the
Dalstons did not raise a criminal. They
raised a shrewd businessman!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Onlar hakkinda ne denirse densin,
Dalstonlar bir suclu yetistirmedi. Onlar
kurnaz bir is adami yetistirdi!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>All right, that let off some steam. But still,
I feel sorry for Alphonse, the poor dear!<M1/1/2>
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Tamam, bu biraz icimi rahatlatti. Ama yine de,
Zavalli Alphonse'a aciyorum, canim!<M1/1/2>

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Some evidence at the scene appears to
point to Dalston, but he isn't the culprit -
I'm certain of it.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Olay yerindeki bazi deliller
Dalston'i isaret ediyor, ama o degil -
bundan eminim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Of course he's not. You're such a sensible
lad, Hershel.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Elbette degil. Sen ne kadar
mantikli bir evlatsin, Hershel.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Well, if the police won't do their job, we'll
just have to take care of it ourselves. I'll
keep an eye out for the real criminal!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Eger polis isini yapmiyorsa,
biz kendimiz halletmek zorundayiz. Ben
asil sucluyu gozumden kacirmayacagim!

original:
<T><M3/1/2>It's a pity that Alphonse looks so rugged.
That child's always been misunderstood.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Alphonse'un bu kadar sert gorunmesi yazik.
O cocuk hep yanlis anlasilmistir.

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original:
<T><M8/1/1>Hershel! The police have told us they won't
be releasing Dalston any time soon! Henry
and I can finally breathe a sigh of relief.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Hershel! Polis bize Dalston'i
yakinda serbest birakmayacaklarini soyledi! Henry
ve ben sonunda rahat bir nefes alabiliriz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Angela, Dalston is innocent.
translation: <T>Angela, Dalston sucsuz.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>What? Don't be silly.<W> You know as well as I
that Dalston wanted to ruin Henry and take
over the town!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ne? Sacmalama.<W> Dalston'in Henry'i mahvetmek ve
kasabayi ele gecirmek istedigini sen de benim kadar
iyi biliyorsun!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>I'm surprised you would make such a claim
without having any evidence to support your
accusation, Angela. That isn't like you.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Suclamani destekleyecek hicbir kanit olmadan
boyle bir iddiada bulunmana sasirdim,
Angela. Bu sana yakismiyor.

original:
<T><M7/1/1>I...<W> You're right, of course. I'm sorry. I'm
just very protective of Henry.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Ben...<W> Elbette haklisin. Ozur dilerim.
Sadece Henry'i cok koruyorum.

original:
<T>I understand that. Right now, I am trying to
prove that Dalston is innocent.
translation:
<T>Bunu anliyorum. Su anda
Dalston'in sucsuz oldugunu kanitlamaya calisiyorum.

original:
<T><M7/1/1>But if the real criminal is still at large, then
there could be another incident tonight!
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Ama gercek suclu hala disaridaysa,
bu gece bir olay daha olabilir!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We must do something before more fall
victim to this madman!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Daha fazla kisi bu delinin
kurbani olmadan bir sey yapmaliyiz!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>We're going now to speak to the police.
They need to realise the mistake they have
made.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Simdi polisle konusmaya gidiyoruz.
Yaptiklari hatayi
fark etmeleri gerekiyor.

original:
<T><M8/1/1>I'll try talking to Henry as well. He may be
able to use his influence to help.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Ben de Henry ile konusmayi deneyecegim. Belki
nufuzunu kullanip yardimci olabilir.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>If only Dalston hadn't acted so suspiciously,
we could have avoided this mess.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Dalston bu kadar supheli davranmasaydi,
bu karmasadan kacinabilirdik.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original: <T><M4/1/1>Hello again, Professor Layton.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Tekrar merhaba, Profesor Layton.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Before you go in, I'm to tell you that the
questioning of the suspect in the Masked
Gentleman case is underway.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Iceri girmeden once sunu soylemem gerekiyor:
Maskeli Beyefendi davasindaki suphelinin
sorgusu baslamis durumda.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>And that suspect would be Alphonse
Dalston, correct?
translation:
<T>Ve o supheli Alphonse
Dalston, dogru mu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Spot on, sir. Chief Inspector Sheffield and
Detective Bloom are grilling him as we
speak.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aynen oyle, efendim. Basmufettis Sheffield ve
Dedektif Bloom su anda
onu sikistiriyor.

original: <T><M3/1/1>You've been cleared, so please go on in.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Izniniz cikti, buyurun iceri gecin.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Chief Inspector Sheffield and Detective
Bloom are questioning the suspect. They're
in the briefing room at the back.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Basmufettis Sheffield ve Dedektif
Bloom supheliyi sorguluyor. Arka
taraftaki brifing odasindalar.

original: オルトビルセン
translation: Orville Bensen

original:
<T>Hello, Layton! Well! Who'd have thought the
mastermind would be one of our most
upright citizens? Funny old world.
translation:
<T>Merhaba, Layton! Vay! Kimin aklina gelirdi,
plani kuran kisinin en
durust vatandaslarimizdan biri olacagina? Tuhaf dunya.

original:
<T>It's beyond me, really it is. But at least we'll
have some peace again in our City of
Miracles.
translation:
<T>Aklim almiyor dogrusu. Ama en azindan
Mucizeler Sehrimizde yeniden
huzur olacak.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Of course, we do appreciate all the help
you've given us in the investigation. Tidy
work. First-rate!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Elbette, sorusturmada bize verdiginiz tum
yardim icin minnettariz. Tertemiz
is. Birinci sinif!

original:
<T><M3/1/2>I'm supposed to be cleaning up here, but
I can't get this puzzle out of my head. Give
us a hand, would you?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Burayi temizlemem gerekiyor ama
su bulmacayi aklimdan cikaramiyorum. Bir
el atar misiniz?

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Oh drat! I thought you'd have that one
solved in a jiffy!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Ah kahretsin! Onu hemen
cozeceginizi sanmistim!

original:
<T><M3/1/2>I just can't concentrate on getting the
clean-up organised until I find a solution to
this puzzle. This might take a while...
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Bu bulmacaya bir cozum bulana kadar
temizligi organize etmeye
odaklanamiyorum. Bu biraz surebilir...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Ha ha, there! I knew a sharp fellow like you
would have no trouble with my little chess
problem!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ha ha, iste! Senin gibi zeki birinin
benim kucuk satranc
problemimde zorlanmayacagini biliyordum!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Have you heard anything about the
investigation from the chief inspector?
translation:
<T>Basmufettisten sorusturmayla ilgili
bir sey duydunuz mu?

original:
<T>All I heard was that Dalston's our man and
we'll find out the whys and wherefores when
he's questioned.
translation:
<T>Duydugum tek sey, Dalston'in adamimiz oldugu ve
nedenlerini, neler oldugunu
sorgulaninca ogrenecegimiz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I'm sure Sheffield would be pleased to have
your keen insight on board during the
interrogation.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sheffield, sorgu sirasinda
keskin sezgilerinizin katkisindan
memnun olurdu eminim.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Thank you, Mr Mayor.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Tesekkur ederim, Bay Belediye Baskani.

original:
<T>Whew! With the criminal caught, fingers
crossed we won't be knee-deep in
paperwork and red tape any more!
translation:
<T>Oh! Suclu yakalandiysa, umarim
artik diz boyu
evrak ve burokrasi icinde kalmayiz!

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hrmph... I haven't been able to wring a
confession out of this Dalston chap... Are
you sure he's our man?!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hih... Su Dalston denen heriften
itiraf koparamadim... Emin misiniz
adamimiz o mu?!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Alphonse Dalston is innocent, Inspector.
The Masked Gentleman will appear tonight,
just as he said he would.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Alphonse Dalston masum, Mufettis.
Maskeli Beyefendi bu gece,
dedigi gibi ortaya cikacak.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/2/1>That's right! Mr Dalston's got too much
invested in Monte d'Or. It doesn't make
sense!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Aynen! Bay Dalston Monte d'Or'a
cok fazla yatirim yapti. Hic
mantikli degil!

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Tingly Town is the next target. Unless
something is done to prevent it, there will
be another incident tonight.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Siradaki hedef Tingly Town. Bunu
onlemek icin bir sey yapilmazsa,
bu gece yine bir olay olacak.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Not on my watch!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ben gorevdeyken asla!

original: <T>We need to talk to the chief inspector.
translation: <T>Basmufettisle konusmamiz gerekiyor.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>He believes he has the culprit and has
already put the patrol officers back on their
regular schedule.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Sucluyu yakaladigini dusunuyor ve
devriye memurlarini simdiden
normal duzenlerine dondurdu.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Then hurry along to the briefing room!
They're about to start!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>O halde brifing odasina cabuk gidin!
Baslamak uzereler!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>So you say Dalston's innocent, eh? <W30>Ha!
That explains why he was so adamant, even
after I gave him a good tickling!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Yani Dalston masum diyorsun, ha? <W30>Ha!
Demek bu yuzden bu kadar inatciydi,
ona guzelce gidiklama yaptiktan sonra bile!

original: ミカ
translation: Mika

original:
<T>I heard they made an arrest, but then I
remembered it was our police force...<M3/2/1>so
they're bound to have fouled it up.
translation:
<T>Birini tutukladiklarini duydum ama sonra
bizim polis teskilati oldugunu hatirladim...<M3/2/1>yani
kesin bir yerlerde batirmislardir.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M3/2/2>Oh, come on. Are they really that bad?
translation: <T><M3/2/2>Hadi ama. Gercekten o kadar mi kotuler?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Let's just say that this wouldn't be the first
false arrest in Monte d'Or. It wouldn't even
be the 50th.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Soyle diyeyim: Monte d'Or'da bu
ilk yanlis tutuklama olmaz. Hatta
elliincisi bile olmayabilir.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Last time they got their man, this tile pattern
was still in style.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>En son dogru adami yakaladiklarinda, bu karo
desenleri hala modaydi.

original: <T><M2/1/2>Pfff... What time is it? Can I go home yet?
translation: <T><M2/1/2>Poff... Saat kac oldu? Eve gidebilir miyim artik?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>The pattern might not be in style any more,
but I do like the colour scheme.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Desen artik moda olmayabilir
ama renk uyumunu seviyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hey, you solved it. But as I was saying,
seems like the police are a bit too quick to
make an arrest and call it a day.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hey, cozdun. Ama dedigim gibi,
gorunen o ki polis biraz fazla hizli
birini tutuklayip gunu kapatiyor.

original:
<T>So Dalston was at the scene of the crime.
Well, there's a surprise. So was everyone
else! <M3/2/2>It could've been anyone!
translation:
<T>Dalston suc mahallindeymis.
Vay, ne surpriz. Herkes
oradaydi zaten! <M3/2/2>Her kim olabilir!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>True... We were there as well. It would have
been easy to disappear into the crowd.
translation:
<T>Dogru... Biz de oradaydik. Kalabaliga
karisip kaybolmak kolay olurdu.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>If just being there counts as evidence, you
could arrest half the city!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sirf orada olmak kanit sayiliyorsa,
sehrin yarisini tutuklayabilirsiniz!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>I don't have nearly enough help here at the
city hall. How am I supposed to get home
and redecorate my living room?
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Belediyede yeterince yardimim yok.
Eve gidip
salonumu nasil yeniden dekore edecegim?

original: ブルーマイル
translation: Blue Mile

original:
<T>Professor Layton, glad you could make it.
We were about to continue the interrogation.
translation:
<T>Profesor Layton, geldiginize sevindik.
Sorguya devam etmek uzereydik.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>May we sit in?
translation: <T>Yaninizda oturabilir miyiz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Please do. The more sets of eyes we have
on our suspect, the better our chances of
catching him out if he's hiding something.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Elbette. Suphelimizi ne kadar cok gozle
izlersek, bir sey sakliyorsa onu aciga
cikarmamiz o kadar kolay olur.

original: シバロフ
translation: Sibarov

original:
<T>All right, Dalston, let's make this quick:
<M2/1/1>why'd you do it?
translation:
<T>Pekala, Dalston, uzatmayalim:
<M2/1/1>neden yaptin?

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original:
<T>For crying out loud, it's not me! Shouldn't
you be out looking for clues or something
instead of harassing me?
translation:
<T>Allah askina, ben degilim! Siz de
beni taciz etmek yerine disari cikip
ipucu falan arasaniza!

original:
<T>The old {''}I'm innocent{''} routine, eh? Well,
tough guy, we know you used a horse-drawn
cart in the statues trick.
translation:
<T>{''}Masumum{''} numarasi yani? Peki.
Sert cocuk, heykel numarasinda atli bir
araba kullandigini biliyoruz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>A racing chariot, to be precise. We found
tracks all over the scene.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Daha dogrusu bir yaris arabasi. Olay
yerinin her tarafinda izler bulduk.

original:
<T>So what was it for? Your getaway? Your
accomplices? What was it?
translation:
<T>Peki ne icindi? Kacisin icin mi? Yoksa
suc ortaklarin icin mi? Ne icindi?

original:
<T>Tell us what you did and who helped, and
<M2/1/1>the judge might go easy on you.
translation:
<T>Ne yaptigini ve kimlerin yardim ettigini soyle,
<M2/1/1>hakim belki sana daha hafif davranir.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I don't know what you're talking about!
I didn't do anything!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ne dediginizden haberim yok!
Ben hicbir sey yapmadim!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Cut the act, Dalston! You've got a chariot
and we found tracks from a chariot plastered
all over the scene!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Kes rol yapmayi, Dalston! Bir araban var
ve olay yerinin her yerinde araba izleri
bulduk!

original:
<T>I have a chariot, but it's not the only chariot
in town. Maybe you should talk to the man
who runs the racecourse.
translation:
<T>Bir arabam var ama sehirdeki tek araba bu
degil. Belki de hipodromu isleten adamla
konusmalisin.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>What would I gain by scaring people from
the town anyway? I depend on tourists!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Zaten insanlari sehirden kacirmak bana ne
kazandirir? Ben turistlere bagliyim!

original:
<T>All right, Dalston. We can do it the hard
way.
translation:
<T>Pekala, Dalston. O zaman zor yoldan
gideriz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We've already spoken to the manager of the
racecourse, and he said he hasn't noticed
any of the chariots going missing.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hipodrom muduruyle konustuk bile; bize
hicbir arabanin kayboldugunu fark etmedigini
soyledi.

original:
<T>Those things aren't cheap. And let me tell
you, there's no one else in Monte d'Or who
owns a private chariot.
translation:
<T>O seyler ucuz degil. Ustelik sana soyleyeyim,
Monte d'Or'da ozel arabasi olan baska
kimse yok.

original:
<T>We've also got your motive: jealousy!
Mrs Ledore rejected your proposal, so you
want revenge on Mr Ledore.
translation:
<T>Motivin de var: kiskanclik!
Bayan Ledore teklifini reddetti, sen de
Bay Ledore'dan intikam istiyorsun.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>You couldn't accept that a former butler got
rich and married your woman. Mr Ledore
told us all about it.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Eski bir usagin zengin olup sevdigin kadinla
evlenmesini kabullenemedin. Bay Ledore
bize her seyi anlatti.

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Ledore said that? Rotten little...
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Ledore bunu mu dedi? Serefsiz kucuk...

original:
<T>Detective Bloom, can we really say with
such certainty that the tracks incriminate
Dalston?
translation:
<T>Dedektif Bloom, gercekten bu izlerin
Dalston'i sucladigini bu kadar kesin
soyleyebilir miyiz?

original:
<T>Well, the fact remains that they belonged to
a chariot, and the chariot was used to
deposit some deceptively lifelike statues.
translation:
<T>Gercek su ki izler bir arabaya ait ve o araba,
aldatici derecede canli gorunen heykelleri
birakmak icin kullanilmis.

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>No doubt the trick relied upon crowd
mentality. People quickly turned hysterical.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Suphesiz numara kalabalik psikolojisine
dayaniyordu. Insanlar hemen histeriye kapildi.

original:
<T>If one person were, say, to feign illness,
a crowd would form. This would keep the
audience concerned and distracted.
translation:
<T>Diyelim ki biri hastalanmis gibi yapsa,
hemen bir kalabalik toplanir. Bu da
izleyiciyi endiseli ve dikkati dagilmis tutar.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Exactly. And during this time, other
accomplices could do as they wish, such as
wheeling in statues on a cart.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aynen. Bu sirada diger suc ortaklari da
istedikleri gibi hareket edip ornegin
heykelleri bir arabayla iceri sokabilir.

original:
<T>With the statues in place, these accomplices
could easily start screaming that the people
had been turned to stone.
translation:
<T>Heykeller yerlestirilince, bu ortaklar
insanlarin tasa donustugunu soyleyip
kolayca bagirmaya baslayabilir.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Which would trigger panic. The worried
crowd promptly forgets about the first
afflicted individual and tries to flee.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Bu da panigi tetikler. Endiseli kalabalik
ilk 'hasta' kisiyi hemen unutur ve
kacmaya calisir.

original:
<T>And as they flee, they no doubt see several
of these statues, which intensifies their
fear.
translation:
<T>Kacarken de elbette bu heykellerden
birkacini gorurler; bu da korkularini
daha da artirir.

original: <T><M3/1/1>I couldn't have said it better, Professor.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Daha iyi anlatilamazdi, Profesor.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Professor, I'm confused. We didn't see any
chariots there that night.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Profesor, kafam karisti. O gece orada hic
araba gormedik.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>How could anyone hide those statues in
front of all those witnesses?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bunca tanigin onunde o heykelleri nasil
gizleyebilirdi ki?

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>We were missing the wood for the trees.
There was only one hiding place large
enough and we were all looking at it.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Agaci gorup ormani kaciriyorduk.
Yeterince buyuk tek bir saklanma yeri vardi
ve hepimiz ona bakiyorduk.

original: <T>Where was that?
translation: <T>Neresiymis o?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Everything was hidden inside the giant clown
balloon.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Her sey dev palyaco balonunun icinde
sakliydi.

original: <T><M1/2/5>What? How?!
translation: <T><M1/2/5>Ne? Nasil?!

original:
<T><M6/1/1>Our minds have a way of establishing an
object's presence once we see it. We didn't
watch the balloon the whole time.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Zihnimiz bir nesneyi gordugunde onun
orada oldugunu varsayar. Balonu tum sure
izlemedik.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>But we saw the balloon floating. How could
the statues have been inside?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ama balonun uctugunu gorduk. Heykeller
nasil icinde olabilirdi?

original:
<T>The balloons attached to it must have been
filled with buoyant gas. I recall the clown
came down when they burst.
translation:
<T>Ona bagli balonlar kaldirici gazla doluydu.
Patlayinca palyaconun asagi indigini
hatirliyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Only an extremely sturdy vehicle could have
been used to transport those statues.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>O heykelleri tasimak icin ancak son derece
saglam bir arac kullanilabilirdi.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>And Dalston is the chief suspect behind
these acts because of his wealth?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ve Dalston, zenginligi yuzunden bu
olaylarin bas suphelisi mi?

original:
<T>Correct. None of these stunts would come
cheap. Buying props and paying so many
accomplices would require a lot of cash.
translation:
<T>Dogru. Bu numaralarin hicbiri ucuza gelmez.
Dekor almak ve bu kadar suc ortagina para
odemek cok para ister.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>He's got the means and the motive. I think
he's our man.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hem imkani var hem de motivi. Bence
aradigimiz adam o.

original:
<T>I doubt we'll see another appearance from
the Masked Gentleman as long as we have
Dalston in custody.
translation:
<T>Dalston gozaltindayken
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin yeniden ortaya
cikacagini sanmiyorum.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>I...<W30>cannot be so sanguine.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Ben...<W30>o kadar da iyimser olamiyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I'm sorry to hear that, Professor, but from
where I'm standing, it looks as though we
can just about close this case.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bunu duymak uzucu, Profesor, ama benim
gordugum kadariyla bu davayi artik
tamamen kapatabiliriz.

original: <T>And if the Gentleman does appear?
translation: <T>Ya Beyefendi yine ortaya cikarsa?

original:
<T>Well, then we'll have to rethink things. <W>If he
does appear, I may approach him directly
about this Mask of Order.
translation:
<T>O zaman her seyi yeniden dusunmemiz gerekir. <W>Eger
ortaya cikarsa, bu Duzen Maskesi hakkinda
yanina dogrudan gidebilirim.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Interesting. <W>In the meantime, there are a few
things I'd like to look into.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Ilginc. <W>Bu arada, bakmak istedigim birkac
sey var.

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>I'm curious about these chariots. A quick
once-over of the racecourse might shed
some light on our mystery.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Bu arabalar merakimi cekti. Hipodroma
hizli bir goz atmak gizemimize biraz
isik tutabilir.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>By all means. Let me know if you find any
more evidence pertaining to Mr Dalston.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Elbette. Bay Dalston'la ilgili baska bir
kanit bulursaniz haber verin.

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original:
<T><M3/1/2>What is it, Layton? Don't tell me it's your
turn to play the bad cop now?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Ne var, Layton? Simdi de
kotu polis rolunu sen mi oynayacaksin?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Not at all, Dalston. I'm quite certain that
you're innocent.
translation:
<T>Hic de degil, Dalston. Sucsuz
oldugundan oldukca eminim.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Convincing the police, however, is another
matter entirely.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Ama polisi ikna etmek
bambaska bir mesele.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That's the funny thing about making up your
mind: you stop listening to everything else.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Fikrini bir kere verince isin komigi su:
diger her seyi dinlemeyi birakirsin.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Hey, you're an archaeology buff, right?
See, I've been working on this puzzle while
I'm stuck here.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hey, sen arkeoloji meraklisisin, degil mi?
Bak, burada sikisip kaldim ya,
bu bulmaca uzerinde calisiyordum.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>I'm not saying anything else until my lawyer
gets here.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Avukatim gelene kadar
baska bir sey soylemiyorum.

original: <T><M3/1/2>Are you going to solve it or not?
translation: <T><M3/1/2>Cozecek misin, cozmeyecek misin?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Doesn't matter if you believe me or not -
they're not releasing me any time soon.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bana inanip inanmaman onemli degil -
beni yakin zamanda serbest birakmayacaklar.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I still plan to prove your innocence, Dalston.
I just need more evidence.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Yine de masumiyetini kanitlamayi planliyorum, Dalston.
Sadece daha fazla kanita ihtiyacim var.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>In fact, I'm going to look for that now. Can
you hold on for a while longer?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hatta simdi onu arayacagim. Bir sure daha
dayanabilir misin?

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Hah! Look around. Does it look like I've got
much choice?
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Hah! Etrafina bak. Sence
cok secenegim var mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/4>This case is paper thin. I'll sue them into
the ground when I get out!
translation:
<T><M3/1/4>Bu dava kagit kadar ince. Cikinca onlari
mahkemede yerin dibine sokacagim!

original: シバロフ
translation: Sheffield

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Dalston's keeping quiet, but I'm going to
keep pressing him as long as it takes until
he spills the beans!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Dalston susuyor ama ben,
agzindan baklayi cikarana kadar
ustune gitmeye devam edecegim!

original:
<T>Even if he doesn't confess, holding him
here at least keeps these underhanded
miracles from happening.
translation:
<T>Itiraf etmese bile onu burada tutmak,
en azindan bu sinsi
mucizelerin gerceklesmesini engeller.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1>With all due respect, Chief Inspector, have
you considered the off chance that Dalston
may not be the culprit?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Saygimla, Basmufettis, Dalston'in
suclu olmama ihtimalini
hic dusundunuz mu?

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Don't be ridiculous! Who else could have
done it?! The tooth fairy?!
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Sacmalamayin! Baska kim yapmis olabilir?!
Dis perisi mi?!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>No. The guilty party is someone with too
much time and money on his hands. That's
our man and no mistake.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hayir. Suclu, elinde fazla
zamani ve parasi olan biri. O
bizim adamimiz, baska ihtimal yok.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You watch. As long as Dalston's under lock
and key, there won't be so much as a peep
from that masked ninny.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Goreceksiniz. Dalston kilit altindayken,
o maskeli budaladan
tek bir cit bile cikmayacak.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I hope you soon come to realise the great
risks of your {''}guilty until proven innocent{''}
policy, Chief Inspector.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Umarim yakinda,
{''}guilty until proven innocent{''} politikanizin buyuk
risklerini fark edersiniz, Basmufettis.

original: <T><M2/1/1>No one terrorises this city on my watch.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ben gorevdeyken kimse bu sehre teror estiremez.

original: ブルーマイル
translation: Bloom

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Just so you know, the fact that I'm still
investigating doesn't mean I've changed
my mind about Dalston.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bil diye soyluyorum, hala sorusturuyor olmam
Dalston hakkindaki fikrimi degistirdigim
anlamina gelmiyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Right now, my job is to find and identify the
victims of last night's miracle. <W><M3/1/1>Assuming
they are indeed {''}victims{''}.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Su an gorevim, dun geceki mucizenin
kurbanlarini bulup kimliklerini tespit etmek. <W><M3/1/1>Tabii
gercekten {''}victims{''} iseler.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I see. I trust you won't object if I continue
investigating the case?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Anliyorum. Davayi arastirmaya devam edersem
itiraz etmeyeceksiniz, degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Go ahead. Sheffield might sing to a different
tune, but he's busy with the questioning.
<M3/1/1>Best of luck, Professor.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Devam et. Sheffield belki baska turlu dusunur,
amahala sorguyla mesgul.
<M3/1/1>Bol sans, Profesor.

original:
<T>I'll look into the whereabouts of last night's
{''}victims{''}. <M3/1/1>Please continue your own
investigation.
translation:
<T>Dun geceki
{''}victims{''}in nerede oldugunu arastiracagim. <M3/1/1>Siz de
kendi sorusturmaniza devam edin.

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T>Dalston still not off the hook, then?<W> Gah...<W30>
Looks like we've got a lot more work to do,
then.
translation:
<T>Demek Dalston hala yakayi siyiramadi, ha?<W> Off...<W30>
Gorunuse gore yapacak daha cok isimiz var,
oyleyse.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>We'll need more evidence to convince the
chief inspector. Let's see if we can track
down the chariot that was used.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Basmufettisi ikna etmek icin daha fazla
kanita ihtiyacimiz var. Kullanilan arabayi
bulup bulamayacagimiza bakalim.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Mr Dalston mentioned a racecourse, and the
chief inspector said he'd already checked
with the manager and nothing was missing.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bay Dalston bir hipodromdan bahsetti; basmufettis de
mudurle konusup kontrol ettigini ve
hicbir seyin eksik olmadigini soyledi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>It's still worth investigating, at any rate.
Perhaps they overlooked something.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Yine de arastirmaya deger.
Belki bir seyi gozden kacirmislardir.

original:
<T>You never know what you may find unless
you try.
translation:
<T>Denemeden ne bulabileceginizi
bilemezsiniz.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I saw the racecourse on a map back at the
hotel. It's just north of here.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Oteldeki haritada hipodromu gordum.
Buradan hemen kuzeyde.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Well then, what are we waiting for?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Oyleyse neyi bekliyoruz?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M6/1/1>Whoa! The racecourse is huge!
translation: <T><M6/1/1>Vay canina! Hipodrom kocaman!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>You can practically smell all that wagered
money in the air!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Neredeyse havadaki tum o bahis
parasinin kokusunu alabiliyorsun!

original: セレナ
translation: Serena

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Thrillerating casinos during the day, the
drama of a mistevious, magical dandleman
by night - this city has it all!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Gunduzleri gerilim-sahane kumarhaneler,
geceleri yaramaz, buyulu bir Dandleman'in
drami - bu sehirde her sey var!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I've only been here a few days, and what an
extravonanza it's been!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Sadece birkac gundur buradayim ve ne
eglence-sahane gunlerdi!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Didn't you hear? The police have a suspect
now. Don't you think there might not be any
more Masked Dandle- <W30>I mean, Gentleman?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Duymadin mi? Polis artik bir supheli buldu.
Sence artik Maskeli Dandle- <W30>yani, Bey
olmayabilir mi?

original:
<T>Don't be such a spoilsnail. That was just
Act One! <M3/2/1>The Dandleman's still out there.
I'm on tenderhawks in precipitation!
translation:
<T>Oyle heveskiran bir salyangoz olma. Bu sadece
Birinci Perdeydi! <M3/2/1>Dandleman hala disarida.
Heyecandan yerimde duramiyorum!

original: <T><M1/2/5>Gosh, you're looking forward to a crime?
translation: <T><M1/2/5>Aman Tanrim, bir suc olmasini mi dort gozle bekliyorsun?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Absotively! Life's short! Enjoy everything it
throws at you!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Kesinlikle! Hayat kisa! Karsina ne cikarirsa
tadini cikar!

original:
<T><M2/2/2>I don't know if I feel comfortable enjoying
something that scares other people...
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Baskalarini korkutan bir seyin
keyfini cikarmak bana dogru gelmiyor...

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Your loss! The way I see it, the more you
like, the more this amazible town can offer!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Sen bilirsin! Bana gore ne kadar cok seyi
seversen, bu hayret-otesi kasaba sana o kadar cok sey sunar!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Well, I'm glad you're having such a lovely
time, miss.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Pekala, boyle guzel vakit gecirmenize sevindim,
hanimefendi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>There's just one thing draining my parade...
Trying to decide what to do next!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sadece bir sey keyfimi kaciriyor...
Sirada ne yapacagima karar vermek!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Monte d'Or's the most wonderfabulant place
in the whole wide whirligig!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Monte d'Or, koca dunyadaki en harika-
muhtesem yer!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: わあ、すごい[盛/も]りあがりですね！
translation: Vay, ortam ne kadar da [盛/も] hareketli!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: みんなお金が掛かっているから真剣なのよ
translation: Herkesin parasi isin icinde, o yuzden ciddiler.

original: 観客
translation: Seyirci

original: くそーっ！
translation: Kahretsin!

original: あれ…
translation: Ha?..

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: 彼は、負けてしまったようだね
translation: Gorunuse gore kaybetmis.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It looks as if some of the carts are in use
right now, Professor.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Gorunuse gore bazi arabalar su anda
kullanimda, Profesor.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M5/2/3>Well, if that's the case, we could always
check the shed where they're stored, right?
translation:
<T><M5/2/3>Oyleyse, depoda tutulduklari kulubeyi
kontrol edebiliriz, degil mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Yes, but first we ought to find the person in
charge here. Perhaps that fellow over there?
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Evet, ama once buradaki sorumluyu
bulmaliyiz. Belki de su taraftaki adamdir?

original: グスタフ
translation: Gustav

original:
<T>Good day to you, my good sir. I'm Gustav,
the manager of this racecourse. How may
I help you?
translation:
<T>Iyi gunler, efendim. Ben Gustav,
bu yaris pistinin muduruyum. Size nasil
yardim edebilirim?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>My name is Hershel Layton and I'm
investigating the Masked Gentleman at the
request of Mrs Ledore.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Benim adim Hershel Layton ve
Bayan Ledore'un istegi uzerine Maskeli
Beyefendi'yi sorusturuyorum.

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Could I ask you some questions?
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Size birkac soru sorabilir miyim?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Only too happy to help, sir. Though I do
have one condition: <M3/1/1>you shall have to solve
a puzzle I've recently perfected.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Memnuniyetle yardimci olurum, efendim. Ancak
bir sartim var: <M3/1/1>yakin zamanda hazirladigim
bir bulmacayi cozmeniz gerekecek.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I'm afraid I won't be answering any
questions until you solve my puzzle. Failing
is a pet hate of mine.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Korkarim bulmacami cozmeden
sorularinizi yanitlamam. Basarisizlik
benim en sevmedigim seydir.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Forgive me, but I can't possibly confide in
you unless this puzzle is wrapped up.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Affedin ama bu bulmaca halledilmeden
size asla guvenip bir sey soyleyemem.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Outstanding work! Now, what questions did
you have?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Harika is! Simdi, hangi sorulari
soracaktiniz?

original:
<T>Do you recall anything unusual happening
shortly before the petrification incident?
translation:
<T>Taslasma olayindan kisa sure once
olagandisi bir sey oldu mu, hatirliyor musunuz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Anything unusual? No, I'm afraid it's been
rather routine around here for a while now.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Olagandisi bir sey mi? Hayir, korkarim burada
bir suredir her sey oldukca rutin.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Were any of the carts removed from the
track in the last few days?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Son birkac gunde pistten
herhangi bir araba kaldirildi mi?

original: <T><M2/1/1>I don't believe so...
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Sanmiyorum...

original:
<T>Though, to be honest, I have enough duties
here that I wouldn't necessarily know those
details.
translation:
<T>Ama durust olmak gerekirse, burada o kadar
cok isim var ki bu tur
ayrintilari mutlaka bilecek durumda degilim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But if one was removed, we'll have a record
of it somewhere.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Yine de biri kaldirildiysa,
bunun bir yerde kaydi vardir.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>We'd like to take a look at one. Are all of
the chariots being raced now?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Bir tanesine bakmak istiyoruz. Su anda
butun savas arabalari yarisiyor mu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>No, I believe we still have a few sitting at
the back of the shed.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hayir, sanirim birkac tanesi hala
barakanin arka tarafinda duruyor.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>They're just over there. Please, don't mind
the smell.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Surada duruyorlar. Lutfen,
kokuyu dert etmeyin.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Feel free to examine the whole grounds.
Please, take your time.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Tum alani incelemekten cekinmeyin.
Lutfen, acele etmeyin.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/1/2>He says that, but then why does he keep
watching us like a hawk?
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Boyle diyor ama o zaman neden
bizi sahin gibi izliyor?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>These must be the racing chariots that the
chief inspector mentioned.
translation:
<T>Bunlar basmufettisin bahsettigi
yaris savas arabalari olmali.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M5/2/1>I can see why the criminal would choose a
racing chariot over a regular cart. These
look sturdy, good for lugging heavy items.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Suclunun neden
normal bir araba yerine yaris savas arabasi sectigini anliyorum. Bunlar
saglam gorunuyor, agir seyleri tasimaya uygun.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You could transport quite a bit in one of
these, Professor!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bunlardan biriyle epey
sey tasiyabilirsiniz, Profesor!

original: <T><M6/1/1/45>Let's take a closer look at this one.
translation: <T><M6/1/1/45>Suna daha yakindan bakalim.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Hmm. It is fairly bulky. It would be difficult
to remove from the grounds without being
noticed.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Hmm. Oldukca iri. Bunu
fark edilmeden araziden cikarmak
zor olurdu.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Could the criminal maybe have ridden one
out of here?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Suclu acaba birine
binip buradan cikmis olabilir mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Unlikely. Riding it would have left tracks,
and there don't appear to be any leading
off the site.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Pek olasi degil. Uzerine binmek iz birakirdi
ve buradan disari
giden herhangi bir iz gorunmuyor.

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>And you'd need a horse, for starters!
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Hem baslamak icin bir ata ihtiyaciniz olurdu!

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>Wait... What's this?
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Dur... Bu da ne?

original: <T><M1/2/1>What is it, Professor?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Ne oldu, Profesor?

original: <T><M2/2/1/45>Both of you, take a close look at this.
translation: <T><M2/2/1/45>Ikiniz de buna yakindan bakin.

original:
<T>These bolts can be pulled out to take this
chariot apart.
translation:
<T>Bu civatalar cekilerek bu
savas arabasi sokulebilir.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>No doubt these chariots are much easier to
transport when disassembled.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Suphesiz bu savas arabalari sokuldugunde
tasinmasi cok daha kolay.

original:
<T>One could transport the pieces and then
reassemble the cart whenever it needed to
be used.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Parcalari tasiyip sonra gerektiginde
arabayi yeniden
birlestirebilirlerdi.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M3/2/1>So that's how our criminal slipped out
without leaving a trail...
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Demek suclu boyle
iz birakmadan sivismis...

original:
<T><M2/2/1>But how did they do it in the first place?
Surely someone here would see if you were
taking apart the chariots.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ama bunu en basta nasil yaptilar?
Burada birinin savas arabalarini
soktugunu goren olurdu.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Very astute, Luke. Let's ask Gustav a few
more questions.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Cok keskin, Luke. Gustav'a birkac
soru daha soralim.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Well, our criminal's a bold one, I'll give him
that. Who steals a chariot?
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Eh, suclumuz cesur biri,
ona hakkini vermek lazim. Kim savas arabasi calar ki?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Either someone determined, or someone
desperate. Let's see if Gustav can shed
some light on the matter.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ya kararli biri ya da
caresiz biri. Gustav bu konuda
bize biraz isik tutabilir mi bakalim.

original: グスタフ
translation: Gustav

original:
<T>Back so soon? Weren't you wanting to
have a look at the chariots?
translation:
<T>Bu kadar cabuk mu dondunuz? Arabalari
incelemek istemiyor muydunuz?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Gustav, is there ever reason to remove
a chariot from the racecourse?
translation:
<T>Gustav, bir savas arabasini yaris pistinden
cikarmanin bir nedeni olur mu?

original: グスタフ
translation: Gustav

original:
<T><M2/1/1><K>Hmmm...</K><W30> Well, occasionally they need
maintenance or repair, but that's the only
reason for them to leave the grounds.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1><K>Hmmm...</K><W30> Sey, bazen bakim ya da tamir gerekir
ama araziden ayrilmalarinin tek
sebebi budur.

original:
<T>We number each one, and any repair or
maintenance orders are signed by the
owner, Mr Ledore.
translation:
<T>Her birini numaralandiririz ve tum tamir ya da
bakim formlari sahibi Bay Ledore tarafindan
imzalanir.

original:
<T>Would you like to see our maintenance
records?
translation:
<T>Bakim
kayitlarimizi gormek ister misiniz?

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>If it's not too much trouble.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Eger zahmet olmazsa.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Certainly.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Elbette.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Interesting.
<T>You've found something?
translation: <T>Bir sey mi buldunuz?

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>One of the racing chariots was out for
maintenance during the statues incident.
It was returned yesterday.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Yaris arabalarindan biri heykeller olayi
sirasinda bakim icin disaridaydi.
Dun geri getirildi.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Surely you're not suggesting a connection
between this cart and the nefarious Masked
Gentleman?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bu arabanin hain Maskeli
Beyefendi'yle baglantili oldugunu
oneriyor olamazsiniz ya?

original:
<T>Simply one of several possibilities. It's
certainly nothing to worry about. <W>Hmm...
Henry signed the repair order...
translation:
<T>Sadece olasiliklardan biri. Elbette
endiselenecek bir sey yok. <W>Hmm...
Tamir formunu Henry imzalamis...

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Y-<W20>yes, but that's standard procedure. No
chariot can be removed from the premises
without Mr Ledore's approval.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>E-<W20>evet, ama bu standart prosedur. Bay
Ledore'un onayi olmadan hicbir savas arabasi
tesisten cikarilamaz.

original:
<T>Regrettably, you missed the opportunity to
speak to Mr Ledore by mere minutes.
translation:
<T>Ne yazik ki Bay Ledore'la konusma
firsatini sadece birkac dakika ile kacirdiniz.

original: <T><M5/2/1/60>Henry was here?
