translation: <T><M5/2/1/60>Henry burada miydi?

original:
<T>Yes, I believe he had just come from the
scene of last night's, er, incident.
translation:
<T>Evet, sanirim dun geceki, sey,
olayin yasandigi yerden yeni gelmisti.

original:
<T>I understand some black cloth was found in
the gallery plaza.
translation:
<T>Anladigim kadariyla galeri meydaninda
bir miktar siyah kumas bulunmus.

original:
<T>Apparently, Mr Ledore's donations to the
gallery were wrapped in the same kind of
cloth. He spoke to the curator about it.
translation:
<T>Anlasilan, Bay Ledore'un galeriye bagislari
ayni tur kumasa sariliymis.
Bu konuyu kuratorle konustu.

original:
<T>Black cloth? Interesting. Thank you, Gustav,
you've been most helpful.
translation:
<T>Siyah kumas mi? Ilginc. Tesekkurler Gustav,
cok yardimci oldun.

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>I believe our next stop should be the Ledore
residence.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Sanirim bir sonraki duragimiz Ledore
malikanesi olmali.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/1/1>That's right. We still haven't had the chance
to speak at length with Mr Ledore.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Dogru. Bay Ledore'la hala uzun uzun
konusma firsati bulamadik.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T>Isn't he bound to be busy, Professor?
translation: <T>Muhtemelen mesgul olmayacak mi, Profesor?

original:
<T><M1/2/1/90>Most likely, but I believe he'll make time for
us. We are investigating on his wife's
behalf, after all.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/90>Buyuk ihtimalle, ama bize zaman ayiracagina
inaniyorum. Sonucta karisi adina
sorusturuyoruz.

original:
<T>At this time of day, you'll probably find
Mr Ledore at home. Good luck.
translation:
<T>Gunun bu saatinde Bay Ledore'u muhtemelen
evde bulursunuz. Iyi sanslar.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M4/1/1>So a chariot was out for repair during the
time the miracle took place. That can't be
a coincidence!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Demek mucize sirasinda bir araba tamire
cikarilmis. Bu
tesaduf olamaz!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/2/1>But you never know, Emmy! We have to
consider all the possibilities!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Ama bilemezsin, Emmy! Tum
ihtimalleri dusunmeliyiz!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Very true, Luke. We can't confirm anything
as fact without decisive evidence.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Cok dogru, Luke. Kesin kanit olmadan
hicbir seyi gercek diye dogrulayamayiz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But our visit to the racecourse was still
rather fruitful. If nothing else, we now know
how the levitation miracle worked.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Yine de hipodrom ziyareti oldukca verimliydi.
En azindan artik
havalanma mucizesinin nasil isledigini biliyoruz.

original: <T>Er, we do?
translation: <T>Ee, biliyor muyuz?

original:
<T>Don't you mean the petrification miracle,
Professor?
translation:
<T>Profesor,
taslasma mucizesini demek istemediniz mi?

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>No, definitely levitation. I'll explain later.
For now, we need to go to the Ledore
mansion and talk to Henry.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Hayir, kesinlikle havalanma. Sonra aciklarim.
Simdilik Ledore
konagina gidip Henry'yle konusmamiz gerek.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Right! I hope Mr Ledore has time to see us.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Evet! Umarim Bay Ledore bizi gormeye vakit bulur.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Yes. I very much hope so as well...
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Evet. Ben de oyle umuyorum...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Angela, we were hoping to speak to Henry.
Is he here now?
translation:
<T>Angela, Henry ile konusmak istiyorduk.
Su an burada mi?

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original:
<T><M7/1/1/45>As a matter of fact, he arrived just
a moment ago.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Aslina bakarsan, az
once geldi.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Could you wait in the parlour? I'll call him
for you.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Salonda bekleyebilir misiniz? Onu sizin icin
cagiracagim.

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>Thank you.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Tesekkur ederim.

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <T>To what do I owe the honour of this visit?
translation: <T>Bu ziyaretin serefini neye borcluyum?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>I was hoping you could answer some
questions. <W>You own the Monte d'Or
racecourse, correct?
translation:
<T>Bazi sorulari yanitlayabileceginizi umuyordum.
<W>Monte d'Or hipodromunun sahibi sizsiniz,
dogru mu?

original: <T>Yes. Why?
translation: <T>Evet. Neden?

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/1/1>There's evidence to suggest one of your
racing chariots was used in the petrification
incident the other day.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Gecen gunku tasa donusme olayinda yaris
arabalarinizdan birinin kullanildigina dair
kanit var.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Absurd. Those chariots cannot be taken out
of the stadium without my written
permission.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Sacmalik. O arabalar benim yazili
iznim olmadan stadyumdan
cikarilamaz.

original:
<T>Each one has a serial number that is logged
if it is ever removed.
translation:
<T>Her birinin bir seri numarasi var; disari
cikarilirsa kayda gecer.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Correct. The converse is also true, however:
a chariot may be removed given that you
have granted permission.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Dogru. Ancak tersi de gecerli:
izninizi verdiginiz takdirde bir araba
cikarilabilir.

original: <T><M1/1/1/60>What are you implying, Layton?
translation: <T><M1/1/1/60>Ne ima ediyorsun, Layton?

original: <T><M5/1/1>Seems pretty clear to me, Mr Ledore.
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Bana oldukca acik gorunuyor, Bay Ledore.

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Simply that your log shows that one of the
chariots was out the night of the statues
incident...<W30>with your approval.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Sadece kayitlariniz, heykel olayinin oldugu
gece arabalardan birinin disarida oldugunu
gosteriyor...<W30>ustelik izninizle.

original:
<T>The chariot was removed for repairs and
returned to the racecourse yesterday.
translation:
<T>Araba tamir icin cikarildi ve dun hipodroma
geri getirildi.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Tracks from those chariots match a set of
tracks found at the scene of the crime.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Bu arabalara ait izler, suc mahallinde
bulunan izlerle eslesiyor.

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>Well...<W>that's unsettling.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Sey...<W>bu rahatsiz edici.

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>There's more. There are grounds to believe
that you were involved in the levitation stunt
that occurred last night, as well.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Daha fazlasi var. Dun geceki havalanma
numarasina da karistiginiza dair
gerekceler var.

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Layton, you can't be serious.
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Layton, ciddi olamazsin.

original:
<T>I understand that after the incident with the
paintings, you donated a number of works to
the gallery.
translation:
<T>Resimler olayi sonrasi,
galeriye bir dizi eser
bagisladiginizi anliyorum.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>When the Masked Gentleman appeared to
be walking on air, I believe he used a wire
stretched across the plaza.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Maskeli Beyefendi havada yurur gibi
gorundugunde, meydanin uzerinden gerilmis
bir tel kullandigini dusunuyorum.

original:
<T><M6/2/1>Those donations were rather hefty parcels,
were they not? <W>Their weight was used to
secure the wire.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>O bagislar epey agir paketlerdi,
degil mi? <W>Agirliklari teli sabitlemek icin
kullanildi.

original:
<T><K><M3/1/1>This is a ridiculously far-fetched notion,
Layton.
translation:
<T><K><M3/1/1>Bu son derece ucuk bir dusunce,
Layton.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>You had all those heavy donations stored
on the top floor so that they could be
used to keep the wire taut, correct?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Butun o agir bagislari, teli gergin tutmakta
kullanilmalari icin en ust katta sakladiniz,
dogru mu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Pure conjecture, but if you must,
continue.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sadece varsayim ama madem oyle,
devam et.

original:
<T>I understand you've already heard about
the black cloth found near the gallery.
translation:
<T>Galerinin yakininda bulunan siyah kumasi
zaten duydugunuzu anliyorum.

original:
<T>The Masked Gentleman used devices to
lift his accomplices into the air and the
black cloth to conceal them.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi, suc ortaklarini havaya
kaldirmak icin duzenekler ve onlari gizlemek
icin siyah kumasi kullandi.

original:
<T>Observers, blinded by neon lights
against the night sky, believed the
accomplices had simply vanished.
translation:
<T>Gece gogune karsi neon isiklar yuzunden
gozu kamasan izleyiciler, suc ortaklarinin
bir anda kayboldugunu sandi.

original:
<T>But, Professor, is anyone really capable
of performing such an elaborate stunt?
translation:
<T>Ama Profesor, biri gercekten bu kadar
karmasik bir numarayi yapabilir mi?

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Yes. However, such events would require
quite a bit of financing.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Evet. Ancak boyle isler epey bir finansman
gerektirir.

original:
<T>Henry, unsurprisingly, you and Dalston top
a very short list of suspects with the means
at their disposal.
translation:
<T>Henry, sasirtici olmayan sekilde, imkani olan
cok kisa bir supheli listesinin basinda sen ve
Dalston varsiniz.

original:
<T>While I obviously can't prevent you from
suspecting me, I do believe you're forgetting
something important.
translation:
<T>Elbette benden suphelenmeni engelleyemem
ama onemli bir seyi unuttugunu
dusunuyorum.

original:
<T>No one's fortune is more tied to this city
than mine. If it collapses, I am ruined.
translation:
<T>Bu sehre benden daha bagli bir servet yok.
Sehir cokerse ben de biterim.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>So I've heard. However, the more the
Masked Gentleman appears, the busier
Monte d'Or seems to become.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Bunu duydum. Ancak Maskeli Beyefendi ne
kadar cok ortaya cikarsa, Monte d'Or o kadar
canlaniyor gibi gorunuyor.

original:
<T>Without fail, the Masked Gentleman's acts
have all taken place in large crowds near
major tourist attractions.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin eylemleri, istisnasiz
buyuk turistik yerlerin yakinindaki kalabaliklar
arasinda gerceklesti.

original:
<T>One would expect a city experiencing such
chaos to gain a reputation for lawlessness
and criminal activity.
translation:
<T>Boyle bir kaos yasayan bir sehrin
kanunsuzluk ve sucla anilir
olmasini beklersin.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Instead, the rumours seem to focus on the
mysterious, charismatic gentleman who
performs miracles...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Oysa soylentiler, mucizeler gerceklestiren
gizemli ve karizmatik beyefendiye
yogunlasiyor...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I think anyone hearing such stories would be
curious enough to pay Monte d'Or a visit.
It'd pique my interest, all right!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Boyle hikayeleri duyan herkes Monte d'Or'u
ziyaret edecek kadar meraklanir.
Benim de ilgimi cekerdi dogrusu!

original:
<T>Precisely. To the average onlooker, the
Masked Gentleman's miracles look like
a particularly grand performance.
translation:
<T>Kesinlikle. Ortalama bir seyirciye gore
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin mucizeleri, oldukca
gosterisli bir gosteri gibi duruyor.

original:
<T>And as I'm sure you're aware, the number of
spectators increases with each subsequent
miracle.
translation:
<T>Ve eminim biliyorsunuzdur; her yeni
mucizeyle seyirci
sayisi artiyor.

original:
<T>Layton, am I hearing you correctly? Are you
insinuating that I hired the Masked
Gentleman to boost tourism?
translation:
<T>Layton, dogru mu duyuyorum? Turizmi artirmak
icin Maskeli Beyefendi'yi benim tuttugumu mu
ima ediyorsun?

original: <T><M6/2/1/45>It seems a possibility, yes.
translation: <T><M6/2/1/45>Bir ihtimal gibi gorunuyor, evet.

original:
<T>My wife apparently trusts you enough to
have summoned you here.
translation:
<T>Esim anlasilan sana bu kadar guvenmis ki
seni buraya cagirmis.

original:
<T>But 18 years ago, you left Randall for dead
and ran off to London. I don't trust you.
translation:
<T>Ama 18 yil once Randall'i olume terk edip
Londra'ya kactin. Sana guvenmiyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You betrayed the memory of your friend.
Now you have the nerve to make these
ludicrous accusations in my own home?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Dostunun anisina ihanet ettin.
Simdi de kendi evimde bu sacma
suclamalari yapmaya curet mi ediyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>I explored every inch of that ancient
deathtrap with nothing but Randall's notes
as a guide. Out of loyalty to him.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>O eski olum kapaninin her karisini, yalnizca
Randall'in notlarini rehber ederek arastirdim.
Ona sadakatimden.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You have no right to be here. You dishonour
his name.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Burada olmaya hakkin yok. Onun adini
lekeliyorsun.

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>Henry, let me explain-
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Henry, aciklamama izin ver-

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Leave, Layton. There is nothing more to
discuss.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Git, Layton. Konusacak baska bir sey
yok.

original: <T><K>...</K><W>Very well. We will leave.
translation: <T><K>...</K><W>Pekala. Gidiyoruz.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>But please hear me out about one thing. It
concerns the future of your city.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ama lutfen bir konuda beni dinleyin.
Bu, sehrinizin gelecegiyle ilgili.

original:
<T>Alphonse Dalston is not the criminal, and
it's more than likely the Masked Gentleman
will appear again tonight.
translation:
<T>Alphonse Dalston suclu degil ve Maskeli
Beyefendi'nin bu gece yeniden ortaya cikmasi
cok muhtemel.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>If you are telling the truth, then I hope to
see you tonight, as well. If so, perhaps we
can unravel this together.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Eger dogru soyluyorsan, o halde bu gece seni
de gormeyi umarim. Oyleyse belki bunu birlikte
cozebiliriz.

original: <T>I have nothing more to say to you.
translation: <T>Sana soyleyecek baska sozum yok.

original: <T>Angela, please escort our guests out.
translation: <T>Angela, lutfen misafirlerimizi disari kadar ugurla.

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original: <T><M7/1/1>Of...<W15>of course, Henry.
translation: <T><M7/1/1>El...<W15>elbette, Henry.

original: <T>We have nothing more to discuss.
translation: <T>Konusacak baska bir sey yok.

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original: <T><M4/1/1>Hershel, I'll see you out.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Hershel, seni disariya kadar gecireyim.

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original: <V0010><T><M7/1/1>I'm sorry, Hershel.</V>
translation: <V0010><T><M7/1/1>Uzgunum, Hershel.</V>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<V0020><T>It is I who should apologise. <L1.9>I've obviously
upset your husband.</V>
translation:
<V0020><T>Asil ozur dilemesi gereken benim. <L1.9>Belli ki
esinizi uzdum.</V>

original:
<V0030/200><T><M2/2/1/45>No, don't worry about Henry. <L1.9>He gets
emotional sometimes. <L4.4>Especially concerning
Randall.</V>
translation:
<V0030/200><T><M2/2/1/45>Hayir, Henry icin endiselenmeyin. <L1.9>Bazen
duygusallasir. <L4.4>Ozellikle
Randall soz konusu olunca.</V>

original:
<V0040><T><M5/2/1>Understood. <L1.2>But I also have the feeling that
Henry is hiding something. </V>
translation:
<V0040><T><M5/2/1>Anladim. <L1.2>Ama yine de
Henry'nin bir sey sakladigi hissine kapiliyorum. </V>

original:
<V0050><T><M8/1/1/45>Oh, I doubt that. <L1.25>Henry is an open book. <L2.9>He
always has been.</V>
translation:
<V0050><T><M8/1/1/45>Ah, sanmiyorum. <L1.25>Henry acik bir kitaptir. <L2.9>Hep
oyle olmustur.</V>

original:
<V0060><T><M4/2/1/45>I'm not so certain you know him as well as
you pretend to...</V>
translation:
<V0060><T><M4/2/1/45>Onu, iddia ettiginiz kadar iyi
tanidiginizdan pek emin degilim...</V>

original:
<V0070><T><M7/1/1>I beg your pardon? <L1.5>What do you mean by
that, Hershel?</V>
translation:
<V0070><T><M7/1/1>Affedersiniz? <L1.5>Bununla
ne demek istiyorsunuz, Hershel?</V>

original:
<V0080><T><M6/2/1/45>Ah...<L0.9>I intended no offence, Angela. <L3.65>All will
become clear in time. <L5.75>We will soon get to
the bottom of things.</V>
translation:
<V0080><T><M6/2/1/45>Ah...<L0.9>Kotu niyetim yoktu, Angela. <L3.65>Her sey
zamani gelince acikliga kavusacak. <L5.75>Yakinda
isin aslini ogrenecegiz.</V>

original: <V0090><T><M7/1/1/45>Yes, well... <L2.45>Thank you, Hershel.</V>
translation: <V0090><T><M7/1/1/45>Evet, sey... <L2.45>Tesekkur ederim, Hershel.</V>

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original:
<T><M7/1/1>Actually, Hershel...there is one secret that
I suspect Henry has been keeping...
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Aslinda, Hershel... Henry'nin sakladigini
dusundugum bir sir var...

original:
<T><M8/1/1>I think he may have found the Mask of Order
while he was searching for Randall.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Bence Randall'i ararken Duzen Maskesi'ni
bulmus olabilir.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M4/2/1>Is that so?
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Oyle mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>He hasn't said anything about it, but he
must have found it. He found the Azran
treasure, after all.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bundan hic soz etmedi ama mutlaka
bulmustur. Sonucta Azran
hazinelerini de buldu.

original:
<T><M8/1/1>I don't know why he would still be hiding it.
If that's the only thing that can stop the
Masked Gentleman...
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Neden hala sakladigini bilmiyorum.
Eger Maskeli Beyefendi'yi durdurabilecek
tek sey buysa...

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Yes. Our answer here may lie in finding the
Mask of Order. We'll continue our
investigation.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Evet. Cevabimiz Duzen Maskesi'ni
bulmakta yatiyor olabilir. Arastirmamiza
devam edecegiz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Thank you, Hershel. Please let me know at
once if you find anything pertaining to the
mask.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Tesekkur ederim, Hershel. Maskeyle ilgili
bir sey bulursaniz lutfen
hemen haber verin.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I fear the Masked Gentleman's next
appearance. I know he'll only bring more
trouble to our city...
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin bir sonraki
ortaya cikisindan korkuyorum. Sehrimize
daha fazla beladan baska bir sey getirmeyecek...

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Professor Layton! I've been looking all over
the place for you!
translation:
<T>Profesor Layton! Sizi her yerde
ariyordum!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>What can I do for you, Constable?
translation: <T>Sizin icin ne yapabilirim, memur?

original:
<T>Would you be so kind as to accompany me
to Celebration Boulevard? It's about the
Masked Gentleman case.
translation:
<T>Benimle Celebration Bulvari'na
gelir misiniz? Maskeli Beyefendi
davasiyla ilgili.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>The Masked Gentleman? What is it?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Maskeli Beyefendi mi? Ne olmus?

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T>Has he appeared again?
translation: <T>Yine mi ortaya cikti?

original:
<T>All I know is that my partner wants to talk to
you. He was one of the officers on duty
during the statues incident.
translation:
<T>Bildigim tek sey ortagimin sizinle konusmak
istemesi. Heykeller olayi sirasinda gorevde
olan memurlardan biriydi.

original:
<T><M4/1/2>This case seems to be growing more
complicated by the second.
translation:
<T><M4/1/2>Bu dava her saniye daha da
karmasiklasiyor.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Indeed. And this officer is on Celebration
Boulevard, you say?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Gercekten de. Ve bu memur
Celebration Bulvari'nda, oyle mi?

original:
<T>That's right, but I'll take you to him. A lot of
tourists seem to have trouble telling us
apart. Must be the uniforms.
translation:
<T>Dogru, ama sizi ona goturecegim. Bircok
turist bizi ayirt etmekte zorlaniyor.
Herhalde uniformalardandir.

original: <T><M2/1/4>Must be.
translation: <T><M2/1/4>Oyle olmali.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Who'd have thought it? Showing the great
Professor Layton around the City of
Miracles!<W> Ahem. This way, please.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Kim derdi! Buyuk
Profesor Layton'a Mucizeler Sehri'ni
gezdiriyorum!<W> Oho. Buyurun, bu taraftan.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Um, not that way, Professor. Celebration
Boulevard, the big avenue to the south?
You know, where the statues were?
translation:
<T>Ee, o taraftan degil, Profesor. Kutlama
Bulvari, guneydeki buyuk cadde?
Hani su heykellerin oldugu yer?

original: <T>Let's hurry. My partner is waiting.
translation: <T>Hadi acele edelim. Ortagim bekliyor.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Wait. I'd recognise that smell anywhere...<W>
A citizen in distress!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Dur. O kokuyu her yerde tanirim...<W>
Sikintida bir vatandas!

original: モミノキー
translation: Mominoki

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Ha ha...<W>harrumph! City's too big... Cannae
find a thing...
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ha ha...<W>hihim! Sehir cok buyuk... Hicbir
sey bulamiyorum...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Pardon me, sir. I'm Professor Hershel
Layton. Might I be of some service?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Affedersiniz efendim. Ben Profesor Hershel
Layton. Yardimci olabilir miyim?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Eh? <W>Aye, cheers, that'd be braw! Ah jist got
here, and the place has me fair stumped.
The name's Tannenbaum, by the way.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ha? <W>Evet, sag ol, harika olur! Daha yeni
geldim ve burasi beni fena halde afallatti.
Bu arada adim Tannenbaum.

original: <T><M5/1/1/45>What seems to be the trouble?
translation: <T><M5/1/1/45>Sorun nedir?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Well, for one thing, this confounded map
doesnae make an ounce of sense...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Oncelikle, su lanet olasi harita
zerre kadar anlamli degil...

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Ach, that's nae use at all. How am Ah
supposed to get tae Tingly Town with a map
like this?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ah, bunun hic faydasi yok. Boyle bir haritayla
Tingly Town'a nasil
gidecegim ki?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Ach, it's nae use. Ah cannae work it out,
Professor!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ah, olmuyor. Cozemiyorum,
Profesor!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Aha...<W>harrumph! That'll do jist nicely. Ah'm
fair chuffed with this, let me tell you.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aha...<W>hihim! Bu isimi pek guzel gorur. Soyleyeyim,
bundan bayagi memnun kaldim.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Wow! THE Professor Layton in action!
<M4/1/1>You really are as good as they say!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Vay! Profesor Layton is basinda!
<M4/1/1>Gercekten de dedikleri kadar iyisiniz!

original:
<T>You're lucky we came along, sir. The
professor here is probably the world's
greatest authority on puzzle-solving!
translation:
<T>Iyi ki karsiniza ciktik efendim. Buradaki
profesor, muhtemelen bulmaca cozme
konusunda dunyanin en buyuk otoritesidir!

original:
<T>Oh aye? Wonder how you'd do against the
lad who was staying at ma house. He was
puzzle bonkers, too.
translation:
<T>Oyle mi? Peki ya evimde kalan su delikanliya
karsi nasil yapardiniz acaba. O da
bulmacaya kafayi takmisti.

original:
<T>Ah treated that lad like ma ain son, but he
went and left without a word a few months
back. Ah couldnae believe it!
translation:
<T>O delikanliya oz oglum gibi davrandim ama
birkac ay once tek kelime etmeden
cekip gitti. Inanamadim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>In fact, Ah came here hoping to find him.
Off tae a bad start, aren't Ah? Getting
masel' lost and all.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aslinda onu bulmak umuduyla buraya geldim.
Kotu basladim, degil mi? Kaybolup
duruyorum iste.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Don't blame yourself, sir. Everyone finds
Monte d'Or bewildering at first. You'll find
your feet in no time.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Kendinizi suclamayin efendim. Herkes Monte
d'Or'u ilk basta sasirtici bulur. Cok gecmeden
alisirsiniz.

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>I wish you the best of luck in your search.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Arayisinizda size bol sans dilerim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>That's affy kind of ye, and thanks for
helping me out with the map. Ah'll jist be
going on my way then. Cheers!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Cok naziksiniz ve haritayla ilgili yardiminiz
icin tesekkurler. O halde ben yoluma
gideyim. Sag olun!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Never too busy to help a passer-by with his
troubles. You're a very kind man, Professor.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Yoldan gecen birine derdinde yardim etmek
icin asla cok mesgul degiliz. Cok nazik bir insansiniz, Profesor.

original:
<T>At this rate, you'll have the mystery of the
Masked Gentleman solved before you can
say {''}Bob's your uncle{''}!
translation:
<T>Bu gidisle, Maskeli Beyefendi gizemini
{''}iste bu kadar{''} demeye
firsat bulamadan cozmus olacaksiniz!

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Ha ha. I will do my utmost to justify your
faith in my abilities, Constable.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Ha ha. Yeteneklerime olan inancinizi bosa
cikarmamak icin elimden geleni yapacagim, Memur.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Professor, that tree-like gentleman over
there may be in need of some help.
translation:
<T>Profesor, suradaki agac gibi beyefendi
yardima ihtiyac duyuyor olabilir.

original: <T>He looks a bit...well, stumped.
translation: <T>Biraz... hani... kutuk gibi kalmis.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Aha! That's my partner there. I'm not sure
what he wanted to tell you, but let's find
out!
translation:
<T>Aha! Orada ortagim var. Sana
ne soylemek istedigini bilmiyorum ama
hadi ogrenelim!

original: <T>Hey! I brought the professor!
translation: <T>Hey! Profesoru getirdim!

original: ポリス②
translation: Polis②

original:
<T>Oh, marvellous! You know, I've been hoping
for a chance to talk to you for ages,
Professor!
translation:
<T>Oh, harika! Bilirsin, uzun zamandir
seninle konusma firsati
bekliyordum, Profesor!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Does it concern the Masked Gentleman?
translation: <T>Konu Maskeli Beyefendi mi?

original: <T><M2/2/1>Yes! I'll never forget that night!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Evet! O geceyi asla unutmayacagim!

original:
<T>Seeing our heroes on horseback in hot
pursuit of the dastardly villain... It moved
me, sir. Plain moved me!
translation:
<T>At sirtinda kahramanlarimizi
alcak kotu adamin pesinde gorunce... Cok
duygulandim, efendim. Hem de cok!

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Heroes on horseback... Are you talking
about us?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>At sirtinda kahramanlar... Bizden mi
bahsediyorsun?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Yes indeed, sir! It was a sight for sore eyes,
so it was! The boys were all so impressed.
Weren't they?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Elbette, efendim! Gozlere senlik bir
manzaraydi! Cocuklar cok etkilendi.
Degil mi?

original: <T>Impressed... Mmm.
translation: <T>Etkilenmis... Himm.

original:
<T>I've got to tell you, Professor - meeting you
in the flesh after that night is an absolute
honour!
translation:
<T>Size soylemeliyim, Profesor - o geceden sonra
sizi bizzat gormek buyuk bir
onur!

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>You flatter me, Constable.
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Beni simartiyorsunuz, Memur.

original:
<T>If you want to do any more horse riding
while you're in town, just let me know. I'll
make a course for you!
translation:
<T>Kasabadayken biraz daha ata binmek
isterseniz soyleyin yeter. Size
bir parkur hazirlarim!

original:
<T>I...I see. <W><M1/1/1>Well, I suppose I might enjoy
a little canter. If I have a spare moment
during the investigation, that is.
translation:
<T>Anli...anliyorum. <W><M1/1/1>Sanirim biraz
dortnala gitmek hosuma gidebilir. Bos vaktim olursa
sorusturma sirasinda tabii.

original:
<T>Excellent! I'll start working on an obstacle
course right away! Now where can I get
some swinging axes, I wonder?
translation:
<T>Mukemmel! Hemen bir engelli
parkur uzerinde calismaya baslarim! Simdi
sallanan baltalari nereden bulsam acaba?

original:
<T><M4/1/1><W30>I'll do my utmost to make sure the course
is worthy of your abilities, sir!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1><W30>Parkurun
yeteneklerinize layik oldugundan emin olmak icin elimden geleni yapacagim, efendim!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T>Constable, I couldn't help but notice...<W>that
had nothing to do with the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Memur, fark etmeden edemedim...<W>bu
Maskeli
Beyefendi'yle hic ilgili degildi.

original:
<T>Ah, my apologies. But look on the bright
side - you'll end up with a supply of carrots
to last you a lifetime!
translation:
<T>Ah, ozur dilerim. Ama iyi
tarafindan bakin - omur boyu
yetecek kadar havuc stogunuz olacak!

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Hmm, that's funny. He said he'd be waiting
right here.
translation:
<T>Hmm, bu tuhaf. Tam burada
bekleyecegini soylemisti.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T>I don't see any other officers here at all...
translation: <T>Burada baska hicbir polis memuru da yok...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Let's look around a little before we give up
entirely.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Tamamen vazgecmeden once biraz
etrafa bakalim.

original:
<T>Sorry, Professor. I could swear he said he'd
be waiting on Celebration Boulevard...
translation:
<T>Uzgunum, Profesor. Yemin edebilirim ki
Kutlama Bulvari'nda bekleyecegini soylemisti...

original:
<T>Let's take him at his word and keep
looking.
translation:
<T>Sozunu esas alip aramaya
devam edelim.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T>What's that? I think someone's running this
way.
translation:
<T>Ne o? Sanirim biri bu
tarafa kosuyor.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Wouldn't recommend that, running in the
street. Especially not with scissors.
translation:
<T>Sokakta kosmani pek
onermem. Hele elinde makas varken.

original: セレナ
translation: Serena

original:
<T>Did you hear?! Something AMAZIBLE is
going on at the Scorpion Casino! I bet it's
the Masked Dandleman's dandiwork!
translation:
<T>Duydun mu?! Akrep Kumarhanesi'nde inanilmaz
bir sey oluyormus! Eminim
Maskeli Dandleman'in isi!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>No time to spim-spam! If I miss this miracle,
who knows when there'll be another one?!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Spim-spam'a vakit yok! Bu mucizeyi kacirirsam,
kim bilir bir sonraki ne zaman olur?!

original:
<T>What do you think, Professor? Is the
Masked Gentleman at that casino?
translation:
<T>Ne dusunuyorsunuz, Profesor? Maskeli
Bey o kumarhanede mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>That's not where the last warning said he
would be, but anything is possible,
I suppose.
translation:
<T>Son uyarida bulunacagi yer orasi degildi
ama her sey mumkun,
sanirim.

original:
<T>Well, I'm still on duty, so I'll have to go and
see what the fuss is about. <W>I shall head to
the casino.
translation:
<T>Ben hala gorevdeyim, gidip
bu yaygara neymis bakmam gerekecek. <W>Kumarhaneye
gidiyorum.

original:
<T>Oh, and your lad wouldn't be allowed in
there normally, but if you plan on going,
I'll tell them to make an exception.
translation:
<T>Bir de, normalde oglanin oraya girmesine
izin vermezler ama gitmeyi dusunuyorsaniz,
onlara istisna yapmalarini soylerim.

original: <T>It's been an honour, Professor.
translation: <T>Sizinle tanismak bir onurdu, Profesor.
<T><M4/1/1><W30>Hanimefendi.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>Going by the map, to get to the casino we
need to head through the shopping district
and Chance Avenue. <W><M3/2/3>We should go too!
translation:
<T>Haritaya gore kumarhaneye gitmek icin
alisveris bolgesinden
ve Chance Avenue'den gecmemiz gerekiyor. <W><M3/2/3>Biz de gidelim!

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T>Surprise, surprise...<W>and the surprises do not
cease!<W> <M1/1/1>Our breadcrumbed trails of destiny
cross before us once again!
translation:
<T>Surpriz, surpriz...<W>ve surprizler hic
bitmiyor!<W> <M1/1/1>Kaderin ekmek kirintilariyla
isaretlenmis yollari bir kez daha kesisiyor!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>Nice to see you again, Aldus.
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Seni tekrar gormek guzel, Aldus.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M5/2/3/45>Um, good evening.
translation: <T><M5/2/3/45>Sey, iyi aksamlar.

original:
<T>Good evening? Ah, yes, the evening has
fallen, and lamentably,<M4/1/1> so have my spirits.
translation:
<T>Iyi aksamlar mi? Ah, evet, aksam coktu
ve ne yazik ki,<M4/1/1> keyfim de coktu.

original:
<T>But that air of tears no longer veils my eyes
now that we meet! <M3/2/1>New warmth courses
through me and soothes my heart.<W> <M2/1/1>Huzzah!
translation:
<T>Fakat artik bulustugumuz icin gozlerimi
yas perdesi ortmuyor! <M3/2/1>Icimden yeni bir
sicaklik geciyor, kalbimi yatistiriyor.<W> <M2/1/1>Yasasin!

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Then I'm glad we could be of help.
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>O halde yardimci olabildigimize sevindim.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>But you must not leave without my gracious
gift! I forged this puzzle over a hundred
nights. <W><M4/1/1>Please take it!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ama comert hediyemi almadan gidemezsin!
Bu bulmacayi yuz geceden fazla bir surede
yogurdum. <W><M4/1/1>Lutfen al!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>My apologies! You were obviously
unprepared for a puzzle at this moment.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ozur dilerim! Belli ki su anda bir bulmaca
icin hazir degildin.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You shall defeat this challenge mightily.
I await your next attempt with glistening
eyes.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bu meydan okumayi gorkemle yeneceksin.
Bir sonraki denemeni piril piril
gozlerle bekliyorum.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I knew in my heart that you would return to
brighten my night.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Gecemi aydinlatmak icin geri donecegini
kalbimden biliyordum.

original:
<T>Try to solve this puzzle which took a myriad
of nights for me to think into this world.
translation:
<T>Bu dunyaya getirmek icin sayisiz gece
harcadigim bu bulmacayi cozmeye calis.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>This is the Layton I expect. He of the
intellect that slices through a puzzle like
a <M3/2/1>hot chainsaw through butter.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bekledigim Layton bu. Bulmacayi
tereyagini <M3/2/1>sicak bir motorlu testereyle keser gibi
kesen bir zeka.

original: <T><M5/1/1/45>You're too kind, Aldus.
translation: <T><M5/1/1/45>Cok naziksin, Aldus.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah! Your humility is endearing, but, with me,
unnecessary. I know the reasoning, the wit,
the wisdom swirling inside your chapeau.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah! Alcakgonullulugun sevimli ama benim
yanimda gereksiz. Sapkanin icinde donen
mantigi, zekayi, bilgeligi biliyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You have brightened my evening, and I am
certain you will brighten many more!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aksamimi aydinlattin ve eminim daha
nicelerini de aydinlatacaksin!

original: <T>Until we meet again!
translation: <T>Yeniden gorusene dek!

original:
<T><M2/1/6/45>I was going to say something, but...<W30>nothing
actually seems sufficient.
translation:
<T><M2/1/6/45>Bir sey soyleyecektim ama...<W30>hicbir sey
aslinda yeterli gelmiyor.

original:
<T>Ah, my friends, this text should not be seen
with the eyes! If it is so, a grievous error
is being suffered!
translation:
<T>Ah, dostlarim, bu metin gozlerle gorulmemeli!
Eger goruluyorsa, vahim bir
hata yapiliyor demektir!

original: ヤッタイ
translation: Jean-Paul

original:
<T>Ah, the beauty of fair Emmy! Brighter than
neon in the night sky, you twinkle like an
exquisite gem.
translation:
<T>Ah, guzel Emmy'nin zarafeti! Gece
gogundeki neondan daha parlak, seckin
bir mucevher gibi parildiyorsun.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Hello to you, too, Jean-Paul. <W>Erm, I don't
suppose you noticed anything strange
before yesterday's incident, did you?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Sana da merhaba, Jean-Paul. <W>Sey, dunku
olaydan once garip
bir sey fark etmedin, degil mi?

original:
<T>Strange? <W>That depends... Do the strange
stirrings in my heart whenever you pass by
count?
translation:
<T>Garip mi? <W>O degisir... Yanindan gecerken
kalbimde beliren garip kipirtilar
sayilir mi?

original:
<T><M3/2/3>I was thinking more along the lines of
something concerning the Masked
Gentleman. We're looking for clues.
translation:
<T><M3/2/3>Ben daha cok Maskeli
Beyefendiyle ilgili bir seyi
kastetmistim. Ipucu ariyoruz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Th-the Masked Gentleman?!<W> <M1/3/1>Um, no.
I didn't see anything.<W> But I wish I did, if only
to help you, my jewel.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>M-Maskeli Beyefendi mi?!<W> <M1/3/1>Sey, hayir.
Hicbir sey gormedim.<W> Ama keske gorseydim, sirf
sana yardim edebilmek icin, mucevherim.

original:
<T>Oh, well. <M4/2/1>If you hear anything, be sure to let
us know, all right?
translation:
<T>Peki. <M4/2/1>Bir sey duyarsan
mutlaka haber ver, tamam mi?

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Oh, any excuse to talk to a goddess so
wholly divine!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ah, boylesine ilahi
bir tanricayla konusmak icin her bahane!

original:
<T>If only I'd been the first to put on a mask...
Then I would spend day and night performing
miracles just for you.
translation:
<T>Keske maskeyi ilk takan ben olsaydim...
O zaman sirf senin icin gece gunduz
mucizeler gerceklestirirdim.

original: ニルス
translation: Nils

original: <T>Still on the case, eh?
translation: <T>Hala davanin pesindesin, ha?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Sure it's not a waste of time? The police
say they've already solved everything. Case
closed, right?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bosuna zaman harcadigindan emin misin? Polis
her seyi cozduklerini soyluyor. Dava
kapandi, degil mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>While I do respect the police for their
diligent efforts, I strongly believe that this
time, they're quite off the mark.
translation:
<T>Polisin gayretli cabasina saygi duysam da,
bu sefer
hedefi epey sasirdiklarina inaniyorum.

original:
<T>Ah. <W>Honestly, wouldn't be surprised if the
Gentleman did turn up again. <W>Even with
Dalston under lock and key.
translation:
<T>Ha. <W>Acikcasi Beyefendi
yeniden ortaya cikarsa sasirmam. <W>Dalston
kilit altindayken bile.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>The police don't change their minds easily.
We'll need another solid blast of criminal
theatre for that.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Polis kolay kolay fikrini degistirmez.
Bunun icin saglam bir
suc tiyatrosu daha gerekir.

original:
<T>Pretty curious now. Will the Gentleman turn
up? It'll almost be a shame if he doesn't.
translation:
<T>Simdi merak ettim. Beyefendi
gelir mi? Gelmezse neredeyse yazik olacak.

original: コッペリア
translation: Coppelia

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Have you been to the funfair? The d'Orians
are all dead proud of it!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Lunaparka gittin mi? d'Orianlar onunla
cok gurur duyuyor!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M4/1/1>You mean Tingly Town, right?
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Tingly Town'u diyorsun, degil mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>That's the one! And according to local
legend, some of them rides are supposed to
have magic powers!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aynen o! Ve yerel efsaneye gore bazi
oyuncaklarin
sihirli gucleri varmis!

original: <T><M1/2/5>Really?! Like what?
translation: <T><M1/2/5>Gercekten mi?! Ne gibi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Well, it's said that if a couple rides the
Ferris wheel, they'll be married!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sey, deniyor ki bir cift
Donme Dolap'a binerse evlenirmis!

original:
<T>It's a fab park and they're always addin' new
things to see and do... Spread them
rumours, by the way!
translation:
<T>Harika bir yer ve surekli gorulecek,
yapilacak yeni seyler ekliyorlar... Bu arada
bu soylentileri de yayiver!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M4/2/1>How charming!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Ne hos!

original:
<T><M2/1/3>That doesn't sound like magic to me. I want
a ride that will give me the power to solve
any puzzle immediately!
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Bana sihir gibi gelmedi. Bana
her bulmacayi aninda cozme gucu verecek
bir oyuncak lazim!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Luke! Now what would be the fun of that?
The satisfaction of a puzzle is in doing it
yourself!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Luke! Bunun neresi eglenceli olurdu?
Bulmacanin tatmini onu
kendin yapmandadir!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hmm, I suppose so. All right, maybe that
wouldn't be such a good idea.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hmm, sanirim oyle. Tamam, belki de
bu pek iyi bir fikir degildir.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Well, whether you believe the legends or
not, you should still check out Tingly Town,
'cause it's a ton of fun!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Efsanelere inan ya da inanma,
yine de Tingly Town'a ugramalisin,
cunku cok eglenceli!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I only ever get to go to the funfair to reel in
customers, so make sure you have loads of
fun for me, a'right?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ben lunaparka ancak musteri
cekmek icin gidebiliyorum, o yuzden benim yerime
bol bol eglen, tamam mi?

original: パック
translation: Puck

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Wheee! No one can resist a good festival!
Yip-yip-yippee!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Vuhuu! Kimse iyi bir festivale karsi koyamaz!
Yip-yip-yippee!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>I heartily agree, but should someone your
age be here without your parents?
translation:
<T>Kesinlikle katiliyorum ama
senin yasindaki biri ailesiz burada olmali mi?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Nu-uh, I'm a big boy now.<W> Don't take me at
face value.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Hayir-hayir, artik kocaman bir cocugum.<W> Gorunusume
aldanma.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I own this little stall here. And because I say
so, you're not allowed to leave without
buying something!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bu kucuk tezgah benim. Ve ben oyle dedigim icin,
bir sey satin almadan
gidemezsiniz!

original:
<T>I don't believe we have any such obligation.
But you do have an impressive variety here,
I must say.
translation:
<T>Boyle bir zorunlulugumuz oldugunu sanmiyorum.
Ama itiraf etmeliyim, burada etkileyici bir cesit var,
dogrusu.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Thanks, I think... Well, can I at least show
you a project that one of my customers is
working on?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Sanirim tesekkurler... Sey, en azindan
musterilerimden birinin uzerinde calistigi
bir seyi size gosterebilir miyim?

original: <T>Try again! Try again!
translation: <T>Tekrar dene! Tekrar dene!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>La la, la la-lahhh. A story told in colour, tint
and hue will speak a thousand words to
youuuuuu.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>La la, la la-lahhh. Renklerle, tonlarla anlatilan
bir hikaye sana bin kelime
soylerrrr.

original: <T><M3/3/1>Good eye! I can't wait to tell my customer!
translation: <T><M3/3/1>Iyi goz! Musterime soylemek icin sabirsizlaniyorum!

original:
<T><M2/3/1>Now your time with me is done. Get out
there and have some fun!
translation:
<T><M2/3/1>Benimle gecireceginiz zaman bitti. Cikin
ve biraz eglenin!

original:
<T><M3/3/1>Looking young is great! I get spoilt like
you wouldn't believe!
translation:
<T><M3/3/1>Genc gorunmek harika! Inanamazsin ama
simartiliyorum!

original: コマーニ無
translation: Bungle

original:
<T>Come one, come all! Come see the
amazing, the sublime, Stellar Circus!
translation:
<T>Haydi gelin! Haydi hepiniz! Gelin gorun:
muhtesem, essiz Stellar Sirki!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/1>Good to see you untangled there, Bungle.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Seni boyle cozulmus gormek guzel, Bungle.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Oh, isn't it just?! I'm a bungle of joy to be
moving my arms again. Walking is nice, too.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Oyle degil mi?! Kollarimi yeniden oynatabildigim
icin sevincten bungle oldum. Yurumek de guzel.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I've finished putting up all my posters, so
now I'm passing out flyers. A fool's work is
never done!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Tum afislerimi asmayi bitirdim, simdi de
brosur dagitiyorum. Bir aptalin isi
hic bitmez!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Don't say that! A lot of people are having
fun thanks to your work. You should be
proud!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Oyle deme! Bircok insan senin sayende
egleniyor. Gurur
duymalisin!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Aw, you're such a darling to say that! I'm
just trying to do my part.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ah, bunu soylemen ne tatli! Ben sadece
uzerime duseni yapiyorum.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>All these flyers blowing through the air... It's
a bit like jumbo confetti.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Su havada ucusan brosurler... Kocaman
konfetilere benziyor biraz.

original: <T><M3/2/1>I hope the police don't think I'm littering...
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Umarim polis bunu cop atmak sanmaz...

original: ジャグラー
translation: Jonglor

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Evening, evening!<W> Did I wish you a good
evening?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Iyi aksamlar, iyi aksamlar!<W> Size iyi
aksamlar diledim mi?

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M5/2/1>You did, and the same to you!
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Evet, diledin; sana da!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Thanks! I just love all these colours.<W> As my
old nan used to say, you can never have
too many iridescent light bulbs!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Tesekkurler! Bu renklerin hepsine bayiliyorum.<W> Benim
yasli ninem derdi ki, asla
yeterince isil isil ampul olmaz!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/2/2>We don't have time to admire the sights.
We're here on official investigative business!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Manzaraya hayran kalacak vaktimiz yok.
Resmi bir sorusturma icin buradayiz!

original:
<T><M1/2/3>Detective Triton has spoken! We'll entrust
you with enough fun for the three of us,
Juggles.
translation:
<T><M1/2/3>Dedektif Triton konustu! Ucumuz adina
yeterince eglenceyi sana emanet ediyoruz,
Juggles.

original:
<T><M2/2/1/80>Oh!<W> Oh, I see. That's noble. Very noble.
Your parents must be proud.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/80>Oh!<W> Anliyorum. Ne kadar asil. Cok asil.
Anne baban seninle gurur duymali.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>All right, I accept. But it can be hard work,
fun.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Peki, kabul. Ama eglence
zor is olabilir.

original:
<T>Er, look, I know you're busy, but this'll only
take a minute of your time. Spare a look at
this puzzle, would you?
translation:
<T>Sey, bak, mesgul oldugunu biliyorum ama bu sadece
bir dakikani alir. Su bulmacaya
bir goz atar misin?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/20>I should prescribe you a nice relaxing break
so you've got more time for puzzles.
Clown's orders.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/20>Sana soyle guzel, rahatlatici bir mola
yazmaliyim ki bulmacalara daha cok vaktin olsun.
Palyaconun emri.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Just one quick puzzle, that's all I'm asking.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Sadece hizli bir bulmaca, istedigim bu kadar.

original: <T>How was that? Do you feel relaxed?
translation: <T>Nasil oldu? Rahatladin mi?

original: <T>I actually do! Thanks, Juggles!
translation: <T>Gercekten rahatladim! Tesekkurler, Juggles!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It's amazing what a puzzle can do for you.
Half the time people don't stop to think, let
alone laugh!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bir bulmacanin sana neler yapabildigine sasirirsin.
Insanlar cogu zaman durup dusunmez bile,
gulmeyi hic saymiyorum!

original:
<T><M5/1/1>I'll let you get on now. Good luck solving
your case!
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Simdi seni rahat birakayim. Davani cozmede
bol sans!

original:
<T>Come and see me when you're done. I'll put
a little giggle in your gait!
translation:
<T>Isin bitince gelip beni gor. Yuruyusune
kucuk bir kikirdama katayim!

original: バスカル
translation: Pascal

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Welcome back, Professor Layton. I trust you
have been sufficiently impressed at the
sights of our magnificent city?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Tekrar hos geldiniz, Profesor Layton. Umarim
muhtesem sehrimizin
manzaralarindan yeterince etkilenmissinizdir?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I'm afraid I spent the whole day
investigating, so I have yet to properly
appreciate Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Maalesef tum gunu
arastirma yaparak gecirdim, bu yuzden
Monte d'Or'un tadini henuz cikaramadim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I'm certain you'll have that chance in due
time. In the meantime, could I ask you for
a small favour?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Eminim zamani gelince o firsati bulacaksiniz.
Bu arada sizden kucuk
bir ricam olabilir mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>It seems our porters are having trouble
keeping up with the luggage for all of our
guests...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Gorunuse gore hamallarimiz
tum misafirlerimizin bagajina yetismekte
zorlaniyor...

original:
<T><M1/2/2>With so many guests, it's imperative that our
staff carry their luggage as efficiently as
possible.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Bu kadar cok misafir varken, personelimizin
bagajlari olabildigince
verimli tasimasi sart.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>The busy season is quite hard on our staff's
backs, I'm afraid.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Yogun sezon personelimizin
belini epey zorluyor, maalesef.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We're lucky that the incidents haven't hurt
our business, but I imagine some of the staff
wish for a slowdown.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Olaylarin isimize zarar vermemesi sans, ama
bazi personelin
islerin biraz yavaslamasini diledigini tahmin ediyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Well, I'm certain that you'll solve the case
soon and hopefully get to sample the sights
of our lovely city.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Eminim davayi yakinda cozeceksiniz ve umarim
guzel sehrimizin
manzaralarinin tadina da bakarsiniz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Our hotel facilities are open 24 hours for
your convenience, so please feel free to
make full use of them.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Otel olanaklarimiz rahatiniz icin 24 saat
aciktir, lutfen
dilediginiz gibi faydalanin.

original: ゴンゾ
translation: Gonzo

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It's only been a day since Mr Dalston was
arrested, and I'm already lost.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bay Dalston tutuklanali
sadece bir gun oldu ama simdiden kendimi kaybolmus hissediyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I wanted to testify on his behalf, but the
police said I must wait for the trial.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Onun lehine ifade vermek istedim ama
polis yargilamayi beklemem gerektigini soyledi.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Then I come home to find a hooligan has
smashed one of our windows!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sonra eve geliyorum ve bir serseri
pencerelerimizden birini kirmis!

original:
<T>And Mr Dalston is very particular about
repairs. It reminds me of when I was young
and...
translation:
<T>Ve Bay Dalston tamir islerine cok
titizdir. Bu bana gencken
ve...

original: <T>Oh, sorry, I got a bit nostalgic there.
translation: <T>Ah, ozur dilerim, biraz nostaljiye kapildim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmmm... I'm still thinking about when I was
young and I broke that window...
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmmm... Hala gencken o pencereyi
kirdigim zamani dusunuyorum...

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Yes! Maybe I could do the same for this
window. Then I can relax and wait for
Mr Dalston's return.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Evet! Belki bu pencere icin de
aynisini yapabilirim. O zaman rahatlayip
Bay Dalston'in donusunu beklerim.

original: <T>...If his innocence is proven, of course.
translation: <T>...Tabii masum oldugu kanitlanirsa.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>I assure you that we're doing everything in
our power to find the real criminal.
translation:
<T>Size temin ederim ki elimizden gelen her seyi
asil sucluyu bulmak icin
yapiyoruz.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>You don't happen to have any information
that might help our investigation, do you?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Sorusturmamiza yardimci olacak
bir bilginiz yok mu acaba?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I wish I did. I know very little of Mr Dalston's
daily comings and goings.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Keske olsaydi. Bay Dalston'in gunluk
gidis gelisleri hakkinda pek az sey bilirim.

original:
<T>I knew he received advance warning from
the Masked Gentleman, though.
translation:
<T>Yine de Maskeli Beyefendi'den onceden
uyari aldigini biliyordum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I think it's far more likely that Mr Ledore is
responsible for all this.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bence tum bunlardan cok daha muhtemel
sorumlu Bay Ledore.

original:
<T>And Mr Dalston... I know he may not be
the most popular in town, but please believe
me when I say he is a good man.
translation:
<T>Ve Bay Dalston... Kasabada
pek sevilmedigini biliyorum ama lutfen
iyi bir adam oldugunu soyledigimde bana inanin.

original: <T><M4/2/1>How did you and Dalston first meet?
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Siz Dalston'la ilk nasil tanistiniz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Ah, well, I needed a job, you see, and
Mr Dalston hired me. During my years here,
he has always treated me with dignity.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ah, sey, bir ise ihtiyacim vardi ve
Bay Dalston beni ise aldi. Buradaki yillarim boyunca,
her zaman bana saygiyla davrandi.

original:
<T>I shudder to think what I will do if he goes to
prison for this nasty business...
translation:
<T>Bu kotu is yuzunden
hapse girerse ne yapacagimi dusunmek bile urkutuyor...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Thank you for believing in my employer's
innocence.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Isverenimin masumiyetine
inandiginiz icin tesekkur ederim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Please make certain the police restore
Mr Dalston's good name.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Lutfen polisin
Bay Dalston'in itibarini geri vermesini saglayin.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>If we head up through the arcade, we should
reach the casino.
translation:
<T>Pasajdan yukari cikarsak kumarhaneye
ulasiriz.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/2/1>It looks lively, doesn't it? <W><M3/1/1>Come on!
What are we waiting for?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ne kadar canli, degil mi? <W><M3/1/1>Hadi!
Ne duruyoruz?

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Professor, do you see that nervous-looking
man over there?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Profesor, suradaki tedirgin gorunen
adami goruyor musunuz?

original: <T><M4/2/1>Yes. Something is going on there.
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Evet. Orada bir seyler donuyor.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T>Professor, this man comes across as a little,
um...<W30>{''}lost{''}, doesn't he? <W><M4/1/1>Let's see what we
can do.
translation:
<T>Profesor, bu adam biraz,
sey...<W30>{''}lost{''} gorunmuyor mu? <W><M4/1/1>Bakalim ne
yapabiliriz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Agreed, Emmy.
translation: <T>Katiliyorum, Emmy.

original: マーフィー
translation: Murphy

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Oh dear me... How could this happen? What
if I'm given the boot?!<W> Speaking of which,
are my shoes untied?<M2/3/2>
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Aman Tanrim... Bu nasil oldu? Ya beni
kovarlarsa?!<W> Bu arada,
ayakkabi baglarim acik mi?<M2/3/2>

original:
<T><M4/1/2>No, <W30><M4/2/1/15>I'm wearing loafers. <W30>Good. Wait... <M4/1/2/15><W>No,
still loafers. <W30><M4/2/2>Good.
translation:
<T><M4/1/2>Hayir, <W30><M4/2/1/15>mokasen giyiyorum. <W30>Iyi. Dur... <M4/1/2/15><W>Hayir,
hala mokasen. <W30><M4/2/2>Iyi.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M3/2/6/45>Maybe we should just move on, Professor.<M4/2/6/45>
translation: <T><M3/2/6/45>Belki de yolumuza devam etsek, Profesor.<M4/2/6/45>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M5/1/1/45>Now, Emmy, it can't hurt to ask...
translation: <T><M5/1/1/45>Emmy, sormanin zarari olmaz...

original:
<T><M2/2/1>How-de-do! I'm afraid I'm in rather a tight
spot at the moment. Now, far be it to push
my troubles onto you, but...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Merhaba! Su an biraz sikisik bir
durumdayim. Elbette derdimi size
yikmak istemem ama...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You know I'm the accountant, don't you?<W30>
No?<W30> Well, I'm Murphy, bookkeeper for both
Mr Dalston and the Ledores.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Muhasebeci oldugumu biliyorsunuzdur, degil mi?<W30>
Hayir mi?<W30> Peki, ben Murphy; hem
Bay Dalston'in hem de Ledore'larin muhasebesini tutarim.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Wait, I'm getting ahead of myself - first,
a little background on Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Durun, biraz ileri gittim - once,
Monte d'Or hakkinda biraz arka plan.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>The city was founded by Henry Ledore, but
a big part of its expansion came from
competing with Alphonse Dalston.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Sehri Henry Ledore kurdu, ama buyumesinin
buyuk kismi Alphonse Dalston'la olan
rekabetten geldi.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Here's the good part: getting arrested is not
good for business, you see, and Mr Dalston
has taken quite a hit!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Iyi kismi su: tutuklanmak islere iyi gelmez,
biliyorsunuz; Bay Dalston da epey darbe aldi!

original:
<T><M3/1/1/60>That's quite the information you've given
us, Murphy. <W60><M1/1/1/45>So Dalston's business interests
are at risk?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/60>Bize epey bilgi verdin
Murphy. <W60><M1/1/1/45>Yani Dalston'in ticari cikarlari
tehlikede mi?

original:
<T><M4/2/2>Ah, excuse me! I forget you don't have
numbers in your blood. Let me show you
an example of domestic business, then.
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Ah, affedersiniz! Kaninizda sayilar yok
diye unutuyorum. O halde size yerel
islerden bir ornek gostereyim.

original:
<T><M4/2/2>Think of it like an accountancy exam, save
the numbers.
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Bunu, sayilar haric bir muhasebe sinavi
gibi dusunun.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Usually, I pose this question with only the
bare minimum of information. <M2/2/1>But this isn't
a real exam, so I'll let you off.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Normalde bu soruyu yalnizca en az
bilgiyle sorarim. <M2/2/1>Ama bu gercek bir sinav degil,
o yuzden sizi bagislayacagim.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>So now you understand the complex,
beautiful web of our local economy.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Simdi yerel ekonomimizin karmasik,
guzel agini anladiniz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>As you must know, Mr Ledore founded this
town in the middle of the desert.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bildiginiz gibi, Bay Ledore bu sehri colun
ortasinda kurdu.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>This spot we stand on used to be an oasis.
The origins of the city, right under our feet!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Uzerinde durdugumuz yer eskiden bir vahadi.
Sehrin kokeni, tam ayaklarimizin altinda!

original: <T><M1/1/1>It feels quite central to the whole city.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Tum sehrin tam merkezi gibi geliyor.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Not to rush you, Murphy...<W>but how about
getting to the point?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Acele ettirmek istemem, Murphy...<W>ama
asil meseleye gelecek misin?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Quite, quite! To cut a long story short -
ohh, I love my job. Accountancy, books,
the lot. Fascinating work. Anyway...
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Elbette, elbette! Uzun lafin kisasi-
ohh, isimi seviyorum. Muhasebe, defterler,
her sey. Buyuleyici is. Neyse...

original:
<T><M1/1/2>When Mr Dalston was arrested, his situation
took a nosedive. More than a nosedive,
really. A whole facedive.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Bay Dalston tutuklaninca durumu cakildi.
Hem de oyle bir cakilma ki...
gercekten yuzustu yere kapaklandi.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>And without healthy competition from
Mr Dalston, Mr Ledore can just sit back and
rake in the profits!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Ve Bay Dalston'dan saglikli bir rekabet olmayinca,
Bay Ledore arkasina yaslanip
kari cebe indirebilir!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>What we're dealing with here isn't social or
physical damage, it's economic. And that's
the worst of all damages!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Burada soz konusu olan sosyal ya da fiziksel
zarar degil; ekonomik zarar. Ve bu,
en kotusu!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>But doesn't Mr Ledore's business also
suffer if the tourists are all frightened away?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ama turistler korkup kacarsa Bay Ledore'un isi
de zarar gormez mi?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Ah! That would be true, if that were true!
You see, everyone seems to be flocking to
see these miracles!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ah! Oyle olsaydi dogru olurdu!
Goruyorsunuz ya, herkes bu mucizeleri gormek icin
akin akin geliyor!

original:
<T><M4/2/2>In fact, in the last month, Mr Ledore's
overall net profits were up, let's see...<W>
Adjust the tax allowance...<W> Carry the five...
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Hatta gecen ay Bay Ledore'un toplam net kari
artti, bir bakayim...<W>
Vergi muafiyetini ayarla...<W> Besi elde tasi...

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Isn't that information confidential?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Bu bilgi gizli degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Oh no. Oh no!<W> I've done it again! YES! It's
confidential. But, wait, did I actually say
anything?
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Ah hayir. Ah hayir!<W> Yine yaptim! EVET! Bu
bilgi gizli. Ama dur, gercekten bir sey
soyledim mi?

original:
<T><M4/2/2>Let's just pretend that you never heard that
last part... <W30>In fact, there never was a last
part. <W30>Which may actually be true.
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Sunu hic duymamis gibi yapalim;
son kismi... <W30>Hatta son kisim diye bir sey
hic olmadi. <W30>Bu da gercekten dogru olabilir.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>So, in conclusion, what you're trying to say
is that Dalston's arrest has led to great
profits for Henry Ledore.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Yani ozetle demek istedigin,
Dalston'in tutuklanmasinin Henry Ledore'a
buyuk kar getirdigi.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Exactly so. Was I clear enough? In fact,
was I vague enough? I don't want to lose
my licence, you see...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Tam olarak oyle. Yeterince acik miydim?
Hatta yeterince muglak miydim? Goruyorsunuz ya,
ruhsatimi kaybetmek istemiyorum...

original:
<T><M2/1/3/45>Professor, it seems that Mr Ledore has both
the motive and the means.
translation:
<T><M2/1/3/45>Profesor, gorunen o ki Bay Ledore'un hem
motivasyonu hem de imkani var.

original: <T><M4/2/1/60>It certainly appears that way.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/60>Kesinlikle oyle gorunuyor.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Adjusted profits, year-on-year, minus
shareholder dividends, it's just... It's just
mind-blowing! Financially speaking.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Duzeltilmis karlar, yillik karsilastirma, eksi
hissedar temettuleri... Bu... bu inanilmaz!
Mali acidan konusuyorum.

original:
<T><M3/2/3>Well, as long as someone's happy working
out all that gibberish!
translation:
<T><M3/2/3>Eh, biri butun o sacmaligi hesaplamaktan
mutluysa sorun yok!

original: パンチョン
translation: Waltham

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Hmm...the neon is a bit loud, but it does go
well with the gold... <W>HUMBUG! Everything
goes well with gold!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Hmm... neon biraz fazla parlak ama altinla
iyi gidiyor... <W>SACMALIK! Altinla her sey
iyi gider!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I would say artificial light matches your
particular...charms, Mr Waltham.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Yapay isigin sizin
kendinize ozgu... cazibenize yakistigini soyleyebilirim, Bay Waltham.

original: <T><M3/1/1>An excellent observation, dear girl!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Mukemmel bir gozlem, genc hanim!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>And may I also compliment you on your
ability to maintain your senses in the face of
my glittering wealth?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ve goz kamastiran zenginligimin karsisinda
aklinizi basinizda tutabilme
becerinizi de ovebilir miyim?

original: <T><M5/2/3>I would...<W>prefer it if you didn't.
translation: <T><M5/2/3>Yapmasaniz...<W>tercih ederim.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/2>Yeah, it's not that hard...
translation: <T><M3/1/2>Evet, o kadar zor degil...

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Pshaw! Still, can't expect everyone to
appreciate the finer things. I doubt you can
even grasp these rules...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Peh! Yine de herkesten ince zevkleri
takdir etmesini bekleyemem. Su kurallari bile
kavrayabileceginizden supheliyim...

original:
<T><M3/1/2>I knew it! Not even interested in bettering
yourselves through sport!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Biliyordum! Sporla kendinizi gelistirmek bile
ilginizi cekmiyor!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You wouldn't be able to comprehend the
subtle intricacies of such a refined sport.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Boylesine rafine bir sporun
ince ayrintilarini anlayamazsiniz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I must say that I'm impressed such
lower-class rabble could reason out the
basics of such a refined sport.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Dogrusu, boyle
alt siniftan bir guruhun boylesine rafine bir sporun
temellerini cikarabilmesine sasirdim.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Um, not that it matters...but my family is
actually rather wealthy.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Sey, pek onemi yok ama... ailem
aslinda oldukca zengindir.

original:
<T><M3/2/7>Mr Waltham, money isn't everything. Maybe
some day you'll realise that.
translation:
<T><M3/2/7>Bay Waltham, para her sey degildir. Belki
bir gun bunu anlarsiniz.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Spoken like someone who earns an hourly
wage.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Saatlik ucretle calisan birinin
agzindan cikacak soz iste.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Yes, some neon to brighten up my brilliant
aura wouldn't go amiss. And just a touch of
xenon, too.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Evet, parlak aurami aydinlatacak biraz neon
fena olmaz. Bir de
azicik ksenon.

original: ハインリヒ
translation: Heinrich

original:
<T><M4/1/2>Augh! I didn't set aside any money for the
trip back home!
translation:
<T><M4/1/2>Ahh! Eve donus yolculugu icin hic para
ayirmamisim!

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Well, it could be worse. The bloke next to
me left with a small fortune.<W> Too bad he'd
arrived with a large one!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Sey, daha kotu olabilirdi. Yanimdaki herif
kucuk bir servetle cikti.<W> Yazik ki
buyuk bir servetle gelmisti!

original:
<T><M3/1/2>He wasn't happy. Having a real go at the
manager, he was.<W> Bellowing like some sort
of big water buffalo.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Memnun degildi. Mudure fena yukleniyordu.<W> Koca bir
su mandasi gibi boguruyordu.

original:
<T>You can stamp and snort all you want, but
no one'll listen if you've got no chips. Take
it from me.
translation:
<T>Istedigin kadar tepinip homurdan ama
cipsin yoksa kimse seni dinlemez. Benden
soylemesi.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>I wonder if this is what we heard about, the
disturbance at the casino?
translation:
<T>Acaba duydugumuz sey bu mu,
kumarhanedeki olay?

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/2>It doesn't sound as if it's related to the
Masked Gentleman. Do you still want to
look into it, Professor?
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Maskeli Bey'le ilgili gibi gorunmuyor.
Yine de
bakmak istiyor musunuz, Profesor?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Finding peaceful solutions to potentially
violent situations is the duty of every
gentleman.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Siddete donusebilecek durumlarda bariscil
cozumler bulmak
her beyefendinin gorevidir.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Well, if you want to get to the casino, just
keep on straight from here.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Kumarhaneye gitmek istiyorsaniz buradan
dumduz devam edin.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Once you get to the end of the avenue, you
can't miss it, mate. Just follow the trail of
broken dreams.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bulvarin sonuna gelince
kacirman imkansiz, dostum. Kirik
hayaller izini takip et.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Thank you for your time.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Zamaninizi ayirdiginiz icin tesekkurler.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Any idea how I can scrape together some
money for a ticket home? <M1/2/1>Preferably without
selling body parts.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Eve bilet parasi icin nasil
biraz para toparlayabilirim? <M1/2/1>Tercihen
vucut parcalari satmadan.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>This looks like the place! <M3/1/1>Let's go in and
see if we can help!
translation:
<T>Burasi dogru yer gibi! <M3/1/1>Iceri girip
yardim edebilir miyiz bakalim!

original: フランキ
translation: Frankie

original:
<T>So lemme get this straight. You're saying
I'm the one who lost, fair and square?
translation:
<T>Yani dogru mu anliyorum? Diyorsun ki
adaletli bir sekilde kaybeden benmisim?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh, I see. I'm the villain now, am I? That's
a laugh! The only crook in here's that shady
dealer of yours!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ha, anladim. Simdi kotu adam ben oldum,
oyle mi? Guldurmeyin! Buradaki tek uckagitci,
su supheli saticiniz!

original: ギラン
translation: Giran

original:
<T>We all have our off days, sir. I'll have to ask
you to leave now. Tomorrow is another day.
translation:
<T>Herkesin kotu gunu olur efendim. Simdi sizden
ayrilmanizi rica edecegim. Yarin yeni bir gun.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>That's it! Let's see how calm you feel after
I break your smarmy sunglasses!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yeter artik! O siritkan gunes gozluklerini
kirdiktan sonra bakalim ne kadar sakin kalacaksin!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>A moment, gentlemen! Let's all settle down
and discuss this rationally.
translation:
<T>Bir dakika, beyler! Sakinleselim ve bunu
mantik cercevesinde konusalim.

original: ナルキス
translation: Narcisse

original: <T>Relax, citizen. It's all under control.
translation: <T>Sakin olun, vatandas. Her sey kontrol altinda.

original: <T><M3/2/1>Why, hello there.
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Ah, merhaba.

original: [Not used]
translation: [Kullanilmadi]

original:
<T><M1/1/1>While I simply cannot bear the sight of
violence, I understand that there will always
be conflict in the world.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Siddet goruntusune tahammul edemesem de,
dunyada her zaman catisma olacagini
anliyorum.

original:
<T>Which is why I suggest we resolve this in the
most beautiful form of contest known to
humankind: the puzzle battle.
translation:
<T>Bu yuzden, bunu insanligin bildigi en guzel
musabaka bicimiyle cozmeyi oneriyorum:
bulmaca duellosu.

original: <T><M1/2/1/45>I'm listening.
translation: <T><M1/2/1/45>Dinliyorum.

original: <T>Go on, then.
translation: <T>Devam et o zaman.

original:
<T>But mark my words, mister fancy-pants, you
ain't got no chance of beating me this time.
translation:
<T>Ama iyi dinle, suslu puslu bey, bu sefer
beni yenme sansin yok.

original:
<T>I'm sure you're correct. And while I dislike
confrontations, I find the notion of a puzzle
battle quite intriguing. <W>Please, go ahead.
translation:
<T>Haklisiniz, eminim. Her ne kadar
catismalardan hoslanmasam da, bulmaca
duellosu fikrini oldukca ilginc buluyorum. <W>Lutfen, buyurun.

original: <T>Eh heh heh, good stuff.
translation: <T>Eh heh heh, guzel.

original: <T>Come on, Narc, we ain't got all day.
translation: <T>Hadi Narc, butun gunumuz yok.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Now now, patience is a virtue.<W> Gentlemen,
this is a casino, and in a casino, you battle
with chips.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Sss, sabir erdemdir.<W> Beyler,
burasi bir kumarhane; kumarhanede
fislerle kapisirsiniz.

original:
<T>Now, at a glance, these chips may look
randomly placed, but behold! Each column
deliciously adds up to 15.
translation:
<T>Ilk bakista bu fisler rastgele dizilmis gibi
gorunebilir ama bakin! Her sutun nefis
bir sekilde 15 ediyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh, but what a dreadful state of affairs! <W>The
rows are bereft of that same exquisite
symmetry!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah, ama ne korkunc bir durum! <W>Cunku
satirlar o ayni zarif
simetriden yoksun!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>We must help these poor, disordered rows,
mustn't we?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bu zavalli, duzensiz satirlara yardim
etmeliyiz, degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>So I ask you this: rearrange the chips so
that the columns and rows all add up to the
same number, beautifully balanced.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>O halde sorum su: fisleri oyle yeniden dizin ki
sutunlarin ve satirlarin toplami ayni sayiya
ciksin; kusursuz bir dengeyle.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Got that, 'ave you? Move the chips around
so each row and each column add up to
the same number. Child's play, innit?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Anladin mi? Fisleri oyle oynat ki her satir ve
her sutun ayni sayiyi versin.
Cocuk oyuncagi, degil mi?

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Yes, I think I understand.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Evet, sanirim anladim.

original:
<T>Whoever can do so in the fewest moves
will of course be the victor.
translation:
<T>Elbette bunu en az hamlede yapan
kazanan olur.

original: <T>Just tell me when you're ready to answer.
translation: <T>Cevap vermeye hazir olunca soylemen yeter.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Got it!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Anladim!

original: <T><M1/1/1>Oh no you don't! I've got it!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Yoo, o kadar da degil! Ben yaptim!

original:
<T>That was fast, Frankie. Let's see your
solution!
translation:
<T>Hizliydin, Frankie. Cozumunu
gorelim!

original: <T>That's right! Watch and learn!
translation: <T>Aynen oyle! Izle ve ogren!

original: <T>Ain't that a picture!
translation: <T>Goruyor musun su ise!

original: <T>You do appear to have solved it.
translation: <T>Gercekten de cozmus gorunuyorsun.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>A moment while I check!<W> Yes, indeed. Every
row and column add up to 15!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bir dakika kontrol edeyim!<W> Evet, gercekten. Her
satir ve sutun 15 ediyor!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Bravo! And I imagine the gentleman here will
now humbly acknowledge his defeat?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bravo! Ve sanirim beyefendi simdi
mutevazica yenilgiyi kabul edecek?

original:
<T><M5/2/1/60>It's true that the conditions of the puzzle
have been fulfilled, but-
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Bulmacanin sartlari saglandi, dogru,
ama-

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>Yeah, they 'ave. So what's your problem?
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Evet, saglandi. Ee, derdin ne?

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Simply this: I believe there is a more...
elegant solution.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Sadece su: Bence daha...
zarif bir cozum var.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Whatever do you mean, sir? All the rows
and columns are complete. If you're trying
to save face, I must say I'm disappointed.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ne demek istiyorsunuz efendim? Satirlar ve
sutunlar tamam. Eger yuz kurtarmaya
calisiyorsaniz, hayal kirikligina ugradim.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Luke, what does this puzzle remind you of?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Luke, bu bulmaca sana neyi hatirlatiyor?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M4/1/1>It looks a lot like a magic square puzzle!
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Sihirli kare bulmacasina cok benziyor!

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Exactly. Except that, the way it is now, the
solution is incomplete.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Aynen. Ama su haliyle
cozum eksik.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Right you are, Professor! The rows and
columns are fine, but the diagonals need to
add up to 15 as well!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Dogru, Profesor! Satirlar ve sutunlar iyi ama
diagonallerin toplami da
15 olmali!

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Oi, Narc! Don't listen to 'em! They ain't
worth it! I just moved them chips exactly like
you-
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Hey, Narc! Bunlari dinleme! Degmez!
Ben o fisleri aynen senin dedigin gibi
oynattim, sen-

original:
<T><M2/1/1>HA HA HA HA, Frankie! Your asinine
comments are delightful, but please! There
is no doubt about your victory.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>HA HA HA HA, Frankie! Aptalca
yorumlarin cok eglenceli, ama lutfen!
Zaferinden hic suphe yok.

original:
<T>Yet I concede, if this gentleman can show
me a perfect solution...<W>then you are utterly
disqualified.
translation:
<T>Yine de kabul ediyorum; bu beyefendi bana
mukemmel bir cozum gosterebilirse...<W>o zaman
tamamen diskalifiye olursun.

original: <T><M2/2/1/45>Well then, allow me to demonstrate.
translation: <T><M2/2/1/45>Oyleyse, musaadenizle gostereyim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Wait! He has to do it in less moves than
me or it don't count!<M1/1/1/45>
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Dur! Benden daha az hamlede yapmali,
yoksa sayilmaz!<M1/1/1/45>

original:
<T><M4/1/1/55>Understood. I shall complete a magic square
by touching only two chips.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/55>Anlasildi. Yalnizca iki fise dokunarak
sihirli kareyi tamamlayacagim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>I don't believe that's possible. But please,
by all means, <M3/1/1>prove me wrong!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Bunun mumkun olduguna inanmiyorum. Ama
lutfen, <M3/1/1>beni haksiz cikarin!

original:
<T>Just give it a rest and call me the winner,
eh?
translation: <T>Uzatma da kazananin ben oldugumu soyle, ha?

original:
<T><K><M4/1/1/45>(Hmm, I said I could do this by <CR>touching
only two chips</C>, but <CR>how I use those chips is
key here</C>.)</K>
translation:
<T><K><M4/1/1/45>(Hmm, bunu <CR>sadece iki fise
dokunarak</C>, ama <CR>bu fisleri nasil kullandigim
burada kilit</C>.)</K>

original:
<T>Look, give up now and you can at least
walk away with your dignity, yeah? You'll
never pull this off in two moves!
translation:
<T>Bak, simdi vazgecersen en azindan
onurunla cekip gidersin, ha? Bunu iki hamlede
asla basaramazsin!

original:
<T><K>(For a magic square, <CR>the 5 needs to be in
the centre</C>.<M4/1/1/45> Aha! And I could <CR>use one chip to
push another</C>...)</K>
translation:
<T><K>(Sihirli karede <CR>5'in ortada
olmasi gerekir</C>.<M4/1/1/45> Aha! Ve <CR>bir fisi digerini
itmek icin kullanabilirim</C>...)</K>

original:
<T>Determination is an admirable quality... <W>But
it can't solve all problems...
translation:
<T>Azim takdire sayan bir ozelliktir... <W>Ama
her sorunu cozemez...

original:
<T><K>(I can <CR>use a chip to push other chips</C>. I'll
use the 7 to push the 5 downwards and
then the 4 to shift the right column up...)</K>
translation:
<T><K>(Bir fisi <CR>diger fisleri itmek icin kullanabilirim</C>. Ben de
7'yi kullanip 5'i asagi itecek ve
sonra 4'le sag sutunu yukari kaydiracagim...)</K>

original: <T><M2/1/1>How'd you know to do that?!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Bunu yapacagini nereden bildin?!

original:
<T>I have to hand it to you. The thought of
pushing chips with other chips would not
have occurred to me. Most inspired!
translation:
<T>Hakkini vermeliyim. Fisleri baska fislerle
itmek aklima gelmezdi.
Cok zekice!

original:
<T>You're very kind. You'll see that the rows,
columns and diagonals all add up to 15
now.
translation:
<T>Cok naziksiniz. Goruyorsunuz; satirlar,
sutunlar ve kosegenler artik 15 ediyor
hepsi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>A completed magic square has a certain
beauty, don't you think?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Tamamlanmis bir sihirli karenin kendine has
bir guzelligi var, sizce de oyle degil mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I...I...<W>I must agree. I have no choice but to
declare victory for the gentleman!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ben... ben...<W>katilmak zorundayim. Beyefendinin
zaferini ilan etmekten baska carem yok!

original: <T><M1/1/1>Oh, come on, Narc! I had it!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Hadi ama, Narc! Ben yapmistim!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Now, Frankie, try to be a good sport, would
you? I think it's best you left now.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Frankie, centilmen olmayi denesen? Bence
simdi gitmen en iyisi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh...<W> Peh! Fine, I'll go. But this ain't over,
not by a long shot.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh...<W> Tuh! Peki, gidiyorum. Ama bu is bitmedi,
daha cok var!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That was some skilful arbitration, sir. I'd
hate to add a one-man casino riot to
Mr Ledore's growing list of worries.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu cok ustaca bir arabuluculuktu efendim. Bay
Ledore'un kabaran dert listesine bir de tek kisilik
kumarhane isyani eklemek istemezdim.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>My pleasure. It was worth it just to see such
a flawlessly elegant solution laid out before
me.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Memnuniyetle. Boylesine kusursuz ve zarif bir
cozumun onumde sergilenmesini gormek bile buna
degerdi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>My thanks to you as well, sir. I feel I owe
you some sort of reward. <W>The name's Drake,
by the way. I'm the manager here.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Size de tesekkur ederim efendim. Size bir cesit
odul borcluymusum gibi hissediyorum. <W>Bu arada
adim Drake. Buradaki mudur benim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Professor Hershel Layton. <W30>And there is no
need for a reward. I'm simply relieved that
we could resolve the situation peacefully.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Profesor Hershel Layton. <W30>Ve odule gerek
yok. Bu durumu bariscil sekilde cozebildigimize
sevindim.

original:
<T>I, on the other hand, would be more than
willing to accept a reward for my skilled
arbitration...
translation:
<T>Ben ise, bu ustaca
arabuluculugum karsiliginda bir odul
kabul etmeye fazlasiyla gonulluyum...

original: <T><M1/1/1>.<W10>.<W10>.<W>Narcisse, is it?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>.<W10>.<W10>.<W>Narcisse, oyle mi?

original: <T><M3/1/1>Drop in and see us again sometime.
