translation: <T><M3/1/1>Yine ugrayin, bir ara gorusuruz.

original: <T><M1/1/1>I certainly shall! <W>Don't forget me!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Elbette! <W>Beni unutmayin!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T>That all kind of felt like one big sham.
translation: <T>Tum bunlar koca bir numara gibi geldi.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>No matter. Let's pick up the investigation
where we left off.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Bos ver. Sorusturmaya kaldigimiz yerden
devam edelim.

original:
Switch chips by
sliding one onto
another. Try
moving chips in
unexpected ways
as well.
translation:
Fisleri, birini
digerinin uzerine
kaydirarak degistir.
Fisleri beklenmedik
sekillerde de
hareket ettirmeyi dene.

original:
Remember you can only touch two
chips. Try to make rows, columns
and diagonals add up to 15.
translation:
Yalnizca iki fise dokunabilecegini
unutma. Satirlarin, sutunlarin
ve kosegenlerin toplami 15 olmali.

original:
Rows, columns and diagonals should
all add up to 15. Remember that you
can only <CR>touch</C> two chips.
translation:
Satirlarin, sutunlarin ve kosegenlerin
hepsi 15 etmeli. Unutma, yalnizca iki fise
<CR>dokunabilirsin</C>.

original: ギラン
translation: Giran

original:
<T>My apologies for all the fuss before,
Professor.
translation:
<T>Az onceki karmasa icin
ozur dilerim, Profesor.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Not to worry! I trust everything is running
smoothly now?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Onemli degil! Her sey simdi
sorunsuz yuruyor mu?

original: <T><M2/1/1>Smooth as silk, thank you.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ipek gibi, tesekkur ederim.

original:
<T>Naturally, we do get our share of...upset
patrons. Casino security is usually quick to
respond.
translation:
<T>Elbette... sorun cikaran
musterilerimiz de oluyor. Casino guvenligi genelde
hizla mudahale eder.

original:
<T>I'm glad we didn't have to escalate the
situation to Mr Ledore.
translation: <T>Durumu Bay Ledore'a tasimak zorunda kalmamamiza sevindim.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Oh? Is Henry involved in the day-to-day
matters here?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Oyle mi? Henry burada gunluk
islerle ilgileniyor mu?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>He is. And that tireless devotion to the
smallest detail is why I respect him.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Evet. En kucuk ayrintiya bile
bitmek bilmeyen bagliligi ona saygi duymamin nedeni.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>If you don't mind, I'd rather this not get
back to Mr Ledore.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Mumkunse bunun
Bay Ledore'a gitmemesini tercih ederim.

original: <T><M1/1/1>You have my word.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Soz veriyorum.

original:
<T>Perfect! Also, I understand that you are
very fond of puzzles. Would you accept
one as a reward for earlier?
translation:
<T>Harika! Ayrica bulmacalara
cok duskun oldugunuzu duydum. Az onceki icin
odul olarak bir tane kabul eder misiniz?

original:
<T>It's modelled on a slot machine we have
here at the casino, but the similarities
end there.
translation:
<T>Buradaki kumarhanede bulunan bir slot
makinesine gore tasarlandi ama benzerlikler
orada biter.

original:
<T>You can see that it's not a proper slot
machine: it doesn't accept any money and
the sequence involves a logical pattern.
translation:
<T>Gordugunuz gibi bu gercek bir slot
makinesi degil: para kabul etmez ve
dizilim mantiksal bir oruntu izler.

original:
<T>We built this slot machine as an amusement
for those who don't, or can no longer,
gamble.
translation:
<T>Bu slot makinesini, kumar oynamayan ya da
artik oynayamayanlar icin
bir eglence olarak yaptik.

original:
<T>I hope we were able to whet your intellectual
appetite.
translation:
<T>Umarim zihinsel istahinizi
kabartabilmisizdir.

original:
<T>Indeed, very interesting. I don't believe I've
encountered a puzzle quite like that before.
translation: <T>Evet, oldukca ilginc. Daha once boyle bir bulmacayla karsilastigimi sanmiyorum.

original:
<T>I'm sure you must be busy with your
investigation, but do take the time to drop
by us again while you're here.
translation:
<T>Muhtemelen sorusturmanizla mesgulsunuz, ama
buradayken tekrar ugramaya
vakit ayirin.

original:
<T>Perhaps we can arrange for you and your
friends to see a show.
translation:
<T>Belki siz ve arkadaslariniz icin
bir gosteri ayarlayabiliriz.

original:
<T>I understand the stakes are high in Monte
d'Or tonight, but do pay us a visit after your
investigation is over, Professor.
translation:
<T>Bu gece Monte
d'Or'da bahislerin yuksek oldugunu biliyorum, ama sorusturmaniz
bittiginde bize ugrayin, Profesor.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Dear me, I'd completely lost track of time.
Let's make our way to Tingly Town as
quickly as possible!
translation:
<T>Aman, zamanin nasil gectigini fark etmemisim.
Tingly Town'a mumkun oldugunca
cabuk gidelim!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Yes, let's. Tingly Town is at the north end of
the city, if I recall.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Evet, gidelim. Yanlis hatirlamiyorsam Tingly Town
sehrin kuzey ucunda.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T>Finally! To the funfair!
translation: <T>Sonunda! Lunaparka!

original: セレナ
translation: Serena

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Nooo! I was expecting a show by the
Masked Dandleman and all I got was a man
with silly hair making a kerfussle.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Hayiiir! Maskeli Dandleman'den bir gosteri
bekliyordum, elimde kalan ise sacma sacli
bir adamin ortaligi karistirmasi oldu.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>If you're going to perturb the peace, go all
the way! Don't make me rush to the casino
just for a mashy tantrum!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Huzuru bozacaksan tam boz! Sirf
civik bir ofke nobeti icin beni
kumarhaneye kosturma!

original:
<T>There's meant to be another miracle tonight
at Tingly Town, but it'll just be a manatee
show for the kids, won't it?
translation:
<T>Bu gece Tingly Town'da bir mucize daha
olacakmis ama sonucta cocuklara
bir deniz inegi gosterisi olacak, degil mi?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Why? Because funfairs are for the whole
family?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Neden? Lunaparklar tum
aile icin diye mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Absotively! See, as one of the Masked
Dandleman's original fans, I'm more
dissecting than your average waylooker.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Kesinlikleee! Bak, Maskeli
Dandleman'in ilk hayranlarindan biri olarak, ben
ortalama bir seyirciden daha titizim.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Well...as long as there's something to put
you off going to Tingly Town tonight, I won't
argue with you.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Sey... Bu gece Tingly Town'a gitmeni
engelleyecek bir sey oldugu surece
seninle tartismam.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>No juventine stuff for me tonight! I'll just
enjoy the mood of the casino instead!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu gece benden genc isi bir sey bekleme!
Ben de kumarhanenin havasinin tadini cikaririm!

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original: <T>We meet again, Professor! Fancy that, eh?
translation: <T>Yine karsilastik, Profesor! Ne tesaduf, ha?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Er, hello.<W> Yes, I seem to recall...
translation: <T>Ee, merhaba.<W> Evet, hatirliyorum sanirim...

original:
<T><M4/1/1/30>Heh heh. <W>I'm the officer who escorted you
to Celebration Boulevard earlier.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/30>Heh heh. <W>Az once sizi
Celebration Bulvari'na goturen polisim ben.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Remember? And then we heard there was
some sort of ruckus at the casino so I came
rushing over here...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hatirladiniz mi? Sonra kumarhanede
bir olay ciktigini duyduk, ben de
kosa kosa buraya geldim...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But I can't find any sign of the Masked
Gentleman anywhere.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama Maskeli
Bey'in izine hicbir yerde rastlayamiyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>As it happens, the casino uproar had
nothing to do with the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aslina bakarsaniz, kumarhanedeki olayin
Maskeli Bey'le ilgisi yoktu.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Is that right? Maybe he won't appear tonight
then. Which pretty much proves that Dalston
is guilty, doesn't it?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Oyle mi? O zaman belki bu gece
ortaya cikmaz. Bu da Dalston'in
suclu oldugunu kanitliyor sayilir, degil mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>That's what all my fellow officers are
saying, anyway.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Zaten diger polis arkadaslarimin
dedigi de bu.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>I respectfully disagree. I haven't given up on
Dalston yet.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Saygiyla katilmiyorum. Dalston'dan
henuz vazgecmedim.

original:
<T>Well, you may yet be right, Professor. <M3/1/1>One
way or the other, we'll get our man.
translation:
<T>Belki de hakli cikarsiniz, Profesor. <M3/1/1>Oyle ya da boyle,
adamimizi yakalayacagiz.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>The first suspect never counts. <M4/1/1/30>We always
need a few tries before we nail it.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ilk supheli asla sayilmaz. <M4/1/1/30>Onu cakmadan once
her zaman birkac deneme gerekir.

original: トリッキー
translation: Tricky

original:
<T>Welcome to Tingly Town, the fantasy factory
for all five senses! <W>Or whatever the sign says
today...
translation:
<T>Tum bes duyunuz icin fantezi fabrikasi Tingly Town'a
hos geldiniz! <W>Ya da tabelada bugun
ne yaziyorsa...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/1/5>I know you! You're the clown we bumped
into after the statues incident.
translation:
<T><M4/1/5>Seni taniyorum! Heykeller olayindan sonra
carptigimiz palyacoydun.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yeah, I'm Yukkles. And I hear the Masked
Gentleman's planning another caper here
tonight. Oh, goodie.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet, ben Yukkles. Ve Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
bu gece burada bir numara daha planladigini
duydum. Oh, ne guzel.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I still have nightmares about the night with
the statues. I dream that they're running
after me. Very slowly!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Heykellerin oldugu geceyle ilgili hala kabus
goruyorum. Ruyamda pesimden
kosuyorlar. Cok yavas!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>You saw the statues miracle up close, didn't
you?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Heykellerin mucizesini yakindan gordun,
degil mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Pardon me, ah...Yukkles, but we were
hoping to stop the Masked Gentleman
before he strikes again.
translation:
<T>Affedersin, sey...Yukkles, ama Maskeli
Beyefendi'yi yeniden vurmasina
firsat vermeden durdurmak istiyoruz.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Oh, the horrors! Isn't it just-<W> Wait. <W>You'll
catch that menace? And put an end to my
nightmares?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ah, dehset! Oyle degil mi-<W> Dur. <W>Onu
yaklayacaksiniz? O belayi? Ve kabuslarima
son mu vereceksiniz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But you can't let your guard down!<W> .<W10>.<W10>.All
right, how's this: I'll let you in, but only if
you've solved at least 50 puzzles.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama gardini dusuremezsin!<W> .<W10>.<W10>.Peki,
soyle yapalim: Seni iceri alirim, ama
yalnizca en az 50 bulmaca cozduysen.

original:
<T>So, how many puzzles have you three
cracked up to this point?
translation:
<T>Peki, siz ucunuz simdiye kadar kac bulmaca
cozdunuz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Nah, sorry. I'm not keen on letting the
underqualified investigate. You'll need more
puzzles under your belt.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Yok, kusura bakma. Yetersizlerin arastirma
yapmasina pek sicak bakmiyorum. Daha
fazla bulmaca cozmus olmaniz gerek.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>So you can't come into the park and we're
all doomed to live out our lives in a soul-
shattering fearscape! Ahhhh!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Yani parka giremiyorsunuz ve hepimiz
hayatimizi ruh-
parcalayici bir korku diyarinda gecirmeye mahkumuz! Aaaah!

original:
<T><M2/2/2>What shall we do if we can't even get into
the funfair, Professor?
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Eger lunaparka bile giremiyorsak ne
yapacagiz, Profesor?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Clearly we need to solve more puzzles. It's
amazing how many people are willing to
acquiesce to our requests that way.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Belli ki daha fazla bulmaca cozmemiz gerek.
Bu sekilde kac kisinin isteklerimizi
kabul etmeye razi olduguna sasiriyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You're back! The fear almost overcame me
while you were gone.<W> The fear and the
candyfloss.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Geri dondunuz! Siz yokken korku neredeyse
beni ele geciriyordu.<W> Korku ve
pamuk seker.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Tell a poor clown what he wants to hear!
Have you solved at least 50 puzzles yet?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Zavalli bir palyacoya duymak istedigini soyle!
En az 50 bulmaca cozdunuz mu?

original:
<T>What?! No! How'd you expect to save
anyone from a masked supervillain with that
kind of experience? <M4/1/1>Out!
translation:
<T>Ne?! Hayir! Boyle bir tecrubeyle maskeli bir
super kotu adamdan kimi kurtarmayi
bekliyorsunuz? <M4/1/1>Disari!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Let's come back after we've solved
50 puzzles.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>50 bulmaca cozdukten sonra
geri gelelim.

original: トリッキー
translation: Tricky

original:
<T>Welcome to Tingly Town, the fantasy factory
for all five senses! <W>Or whatever the sign says
today...
translation:
<T>Tum bes duyunuz icin fantezi fabrikasi Tingly Town'a
hos geldiniz! <W>Ya da tabelada bugun
ne yaziyorsa...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/1/5>I know you! You're the clown we bumped
into after the statues incident.
translation:
<T><M4/1/5>Seni taniyorum! Heykeller olayindan sonra
carptigimiz palyacoydun.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yeah, I'm Yukkles. And I hear the Masked
Gentleman's planning another caper here
tonight. Oh goodie.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet, ben Yukkles. Ve Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
bu gece burada bir numara daha planladigini
duydum. Oh, ne guzel.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I still have nightmares about the night with
the statues. I dream that they're running
after me. Very slowly!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Heykellerin oldugu geceyle ilgili hala kabus
goruyorum. Ruyamda pesimden
kosuyorlar. Cok yavas!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>You saw the statues miracle up close, didn't
you?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Heykellerin mucizesini yakindan gordun,
degil mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Pardon me, ah...Yukkles, but we were
hoping to stop the Masked Gentleman
before he strikes again.
translation:
<T>Affedersin, sey...Yukkles, ama Maskeli
Beyefendi'yi yeniden vurmasina
firsat vermeden durdurmak istiyoruz.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Oh, the horrors! Isn't it just-<W> Wait. <W>You'll
catch that menace? And put an end to my
nightmares?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ah, dehset! Oyle degil mi-<W> Dur. <W>Onu
yaklayacaksiniz? O belayi? Ve kabuslarima
son mu vereceksiniz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But you can't let your guard down!<W> ...<W>All
right, how's this: I'll let you in, but only if
you've solved at least 50 puzzles.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama gardini dusuremezsin!<W> ...<W>Peki,
soyle yapalim: Seni iceri alirim, ama
yalnizca en az 50 bulmaca cozduysen.

original:
<T>So, how many puzzles have you three
cracked up to this point?
translation:
<T>Peki, siz ucunuz simdiye kadar kac bulmaca
cozdunuz?

original:
<T>You're back! The fear almost overcame me
while you were gone.<W> The fear and the
candyfloss.
translation:
<T>Geri dondunuz! Siz yokken korku neredeyse
beni ele geciriyordu.<W> Korku ve
pamuk seker.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Tell a poor clown what he wants to hear!
Have you solved at least 50 puzzles yet?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Zavalli bir palyacoya duymak istedigini soyle!
En az 50 bulmaca cozdunuz mu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Great! You've proved you use your heads
for more than just wearing hats! I feel a
whole lot better about letting you in now.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Harika! Kafanizi sadece sapka takmak icin
kullanmadiginizi kanitladiniz! Sizi iceri
almaya artik cok daha icim rahat.

original:
<T>Here, take these passes - you can get in for
free all week with them. Enjoy your time...
and end this reign of terror!
translation:
<T>Al, su gecis kartlarini al - onlarla tum hafta
ucretsiz girebilirsin. Iyi eglenceler...
ve su teror saltanatini bitirin!

original:
<T>Best of luck, but err, just in case you fail,
I'll be running away for the night.
translation:
<T>Bol sans, ama sey, ya basarisiz olursaniz
diye ben gece boyunca kaciyor olacagim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Wait, run? <W>No. I'll take the Monte d'Or tram.
Gets to the racecourse in no time. <W>You can
buy a ticket from that machine over there.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Dur, kacmak mi? <W>Yok. Monte d'Or tramvayina
binecegim. Yaris pistine hemen varir. <W>Bileti
suradaki makineden alabilirsiniz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Enjoy! Oh and...watch out for owls, too.
Clever blighters. Always hooting when you
least expect it...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Tadini cikarin! Ah bir de... baykuslara da
dikkat edin. Zeki seytanlar. En beklemediginiz
anda hep otup dururlar...

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>He's a strange one.
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Tuhaf biri.

original: <T><M2/1/1>I suppose it's part of a clown's trade.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Sanirim palyaco mesleginin bir parcasi.

original: わぁ、[楽/たの]しそう！
translation: Vay, [楽/たの]li gorunuyor！

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Show me where that masked rapscallion is!
I'm ready to have at him!<M3/1/1>
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Su maskeli haylazin nerede oldugunu gosterin!
Uzerine atilmaya hazirim!<M3/1/1>

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T>We only just arrived ourselves, Inspector.
translation: <T>Biz de daha yeni geldik, Mufettis.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>I don't see any other police officers in the
vicinity. Is anybody else coming?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Yakinda baska polis memuru goremiyorum.
Baska kimse geliyor mu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Well, Sheffield's convinced that Dalston's
his man. He gave half the lads the night off.
The rest are patrolling the city centre.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Sheffield Dalston'in adami olduguna
ikna. Cocuklarin yarisina geceyi izin verdi.
Geri kalani sehir merkezinde devriye geziyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/6/45>Sheffield may claim to protect the city but
his overconfidence is really putting people
in danger.
translation:
<T><M2/1/6/45>Sheffield sehri korudugunu iddia edebilir ama
bu asiri ozguveni insanlari
tehlikeye atiyor.

original:
<T><M4/1/3>But, with or without support from the police,
we have to start our search. Right,
Professor?
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Ama polis destegi olsun olmasin,
aramaya baslamaliyiz. Degil mi,
Profesor?

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Yes. We need to track down the Masked
Gentleman before he's able to act.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Evet. Maskeli
Beyefendi harekete gecmeden onu bulmaliyiz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I, naturally, have already found the first
clue! <W>On my way in, I spotted a poster that
read, {''}A new spin on the miraculous.{''}
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ben tabii ki ilk
ipucunu coktan buldum! <W>Iceri girerken bir afis gordum;
uzerinde {''}A new spin on the miraculous.{''} yaziyordu.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>That certainly sounds like our theatrical
friend.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Bu kesinlikle su tiyatrocu
arkadasimiza benziyor.

original: <T><M1/1/1>But what does it mean, Layton?!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Ama ne demek istiyor, Layton?!

original: <T><M5/2/1/60>I'll need to think about that.
translation: <T><M5/2/1/60>Bunun uzerinde dusunmem gerekecek.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>There's no time, man! You sit here and
think. I'm going to charge around until
I knock him over! <W30>FOR THE YARD!<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Zaman yok, adamim! Sen burada
oturup dusun. Ben etrafta kosturup
onu devirecegim! <W30>FOR THE YARD!<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Now that Inspector Grosky is...occupied,
let's consider this clue: {''}A new spin on the
miraculous.{''}
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Mufettis Grosky... mesgulken,
su ipucunu dusunelim: {''}A new spin on the
miraculous.{''}

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>There's no shortage of things that spin here.
I see the Ferris wheel, the merry-go-round,
the teacups...
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Burada donen seylerin
sonu yok. Donme dolabi, atlikarincayi,
fincanlari...

original:
<T><M3/1/1>And don't forget the roller coaster! Those
wheels spin rather fast.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bir de hiz trenini unutma! O
tekerlekler epey hizli donuyor.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/1>Which should we investigate first?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Hangisini once arastirmaliyiz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Seeing as you're so excited, I think it's fair
we let you decide, Luke.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Bu kadar heyecanli olduguna gore,
secimi sana birakalim, Luke.

original: マカロン
translation: Macaron

original: <T>Waaah! Mammy, where are ya?
translation: <T>Aaaah! Anne, neredesin?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M2/2/2>You're lost...again?
translation: <T><M2/2/2>Yine mi... kayboldun?

original:
<T>Nnn...<W>nnn...<W>nar, me mam is! She said-<W30> she
said I could gan on the rollah coastah, but
when I got off, she was gone!
translation:
<T>Nnn...<W>nnn...<W>annem nerede iste! Dedi ki-<W30> dedi ki
hiz trenine binebilirsin, ama
inince yoktu!

original: <T>WAAAAAUUUUGGGGGGHHHHHH!
translation: <T>WAAAAAUUUUGGGGGGHHHHHH!

original: <T><M3/1/2>Please don't cry. We'll find her for you.
translation: <T><M3/1/2>Lutfen aglama. Onu bulacagiz.

original:
<T>I'm not cryin', man! I'm...I'm frustrated!
Me mam needs to learn to stop gannin' off
on her-<W30> on her own!
translation:
<T>Aglamiyorum, abi! Ben...ben sinirliyim!
Annem kendi basina
kacip gitmeyi-<W30> birakmayi ogrenmeli!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Well, let's just...<W> Hmm, did your mother give
you some instructions in case you...<W30>I mean,<W30>
in case SHE got lost again?
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Sey, hadi...<W> Hmm, annen sana, sen...<W30>yani,<W30>
onun yine kaybolmasi durumunda ne yapacagini soyledi mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Umm...<W30>aye. She said I should gan to the
pumpkin spinnahs...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hmm...<W30>evet. Balkabagi donduruculerine
gitmemi soyledi...

original:
<T>Here, what do ya think I should gan on
next? The merry-go-round or the rollah
coastah again?
translation:
<T>Peki, sence sonra neye binmeliyim?
Atlikarincaya mi yoksa hiz trenine
bir daha mi?

original:
<T><M4/1/2>I really think you should head over to the
pumpkin spinners now. Your mum might be
waiting for you!
translation:
<T><M4/1/2>Bence simdi Balkabagi Donduruculeri'ne
gitmelisin. Annen
orada seni bekliyor olabilir!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Wey...<W30>aye, but, like, the pumpkin spinnahs
aren't gannin' anywhere...
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sey...<W30>evet ama, balkabagi donduruculer
hicbir yere gitmiyor ki...

original: タニア
translation: Tania

original:
<T>Eee... That daughtah of mine is lost again!
I told her to wait by the pumpkin spinnahs
if we got separated.
translation:
<T>Ahh... Kizim yine kayboldu!
Ayrilirsak balkabagi
donme oyuncaklarinin yaninda bekle demistim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>She's a bright lass, like, but she gets
distracted by pretty much anythin' -
balloons, clowns, mud...
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Zeki bir kizdir ama neredeyse her seye
dikkati dagilir -
balonlar, palyacolar, camur...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M3/2/1>Well, if there's anything I can do to help...
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Eger yardim edebilecegim bir sey varsa...

original:
<T>Eee, no, pet, I couldn't bother ya with this
again. She'll turn up in a bit. She always
does.
translation:
<T>Yok, canim, seni yine bununla yormayayim.
Birazdan cikar ortaya.
Hep cikar zaten.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I suppose if the Masked Gentleman is meant
to show up tonight, I should probably gan
find her and make sure she's okay.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Maskeli Beyefendi bu gece gelecekse,
gidip kizimi bulsam
iyi olacak; iyi oldugundan emin olayim.

original:
<T>Knowin' Bonnie, she'll probably see him and
run aftah him to his secret supervillain lair.
Maybe he'd fancy havin' an apprentice...
translation:
<T>Bonnie'yi bilirim; onu gorur gormez
gizli super kotu yuvasina kadar pesinden
kosar. Belki de cirak ister...

original: <T>Bonnie should be here soon...
translation: <T>Bonnie yakinda burada olur...

original: モミノキー
translation: Tannenbaum

original:
<T>Ha <W20>ha...<W>harrumph! It's affy bright...and loud.
And would ye believe it, it even reeks of
pongy feet!
translation:
<T>Ha <W20>ha...<W>ohhom! Cok parlak... hem de gurultulu.
Bir de inanir misiniz, resmen
kokmus ayak kokuyor!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Euch, Ah'm sweltering inside ma ain beard.
It could do with a wee trim, but this toon
doesnae seem to have a decent barber.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Uff, kendi sakalimin icinde kavruluyorum.
Biraz kisaltmak gerek ama bu kasabada
adam gibi bir berber yok galiba.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Aha! I believe we've found our next miracle:
the astounding length of Mr Tannenbaum's
beard!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Aha! Sanirim siradaki mucizeyi bulduk:
Bay Tannenbaum'un sakalinin
inanilmaz uzunlugu!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Emmy! That's rude!<W> The man just grew it
out.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Emmy! Bu kabalik!<W> Adam sadece uzatmis
iste.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Ug, will the pair of ye wheesht! Ma heid is
splitting me! <W>Ahhhh, that's better, a wee bit
of peace afore all the miracle malarkey.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Off, ikiniz de susar misiniz! Basim
catliyor! <W>Ahhhh, iste daha iyi, su mucize
zirvaligindan once biraz huzur.

original:
<T>Actually, do ye ken if it's still happening?
Ah cannae make heid nor tail of all the
rumours.
translation:
<T>Aslinda hala olacak mi, biliyor musunuz?
Su dedikodulardan
hicbir sey anlayamiyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Never you mind aboot ma beard. Ah'm off
once this miracle kerfuffle's oot the way
anyway.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sakalimi bos verin. Bu mucize karmasasi
biter bitmez
zaten gidiyorum.

original: ハンナ
translation: Hannah

original:
<T><M3/3/3>For my darling Grosky, I'd run through fire,
swim an ocean, or even spend the day at
the fair!
translation:
<T><M3/3/3>Sevgili Grosky'm icin atesin icinden kosarim,
bir okyanusu yuzerim, hatta butun gunu
lunaparkta bile geciririm!

original:
<T><M3/3/4>With any luck, this evening will start on the
Ferris wheel and end with a smooch!
translation:
<T><M3/3/4>Sansim yaver giderse bu aksam
Donme Dolap'ta baslayip bir opucukle bitecek!

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Oh, don't mind me! Just daydreaming again,
you know!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Ah, beni bos ver! Yine hayal kuruyorum iste,
bilirsin!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>I heard that the Masked Gentleman would be
here, so I knew Clamp would be, too. But
I've lost him in the crowd...
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Maskeli Bey burada olacakmis, o yuzden Clamp'in de
burada olacagini biliyordum. Ama
kalabalikta onu kaybettim...

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M2/1/4>Hannah, you need to develop other
interests. <W>Maybe knitting? <W20>Photography?
<W20>Papier m{^a}ch{'e} modelling? <W30>ANYTHING.
translation:
<T><M2/1/4>Hannah, baska
ilgi alanlari edinmelisin. <W>Belki orgu? <W20>Fotografcilik?
<W20>Papier m{^a}ch{'e} modelleme? <W30>HER NEYSE.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You're right! <M3/1/4>I could knit Clamp dolls, collect
snapshots and...<W>oooh...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Haklisin! <M3/1/4>Clamp bebekleri orebilir, fotograf
biriktirip...<W>oooh...

original:
<T><M1/1/3>I'm surprised there aren't more police here.
That younger detective must have gone to
check out the hotel.
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Burada daha fazla polis olmamasina sasirdim.
Su genc dedektif
oteli kontrol etmeye gitmis olmali.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Really? Which hotel was that?
translation: <T>Gercekten mi? Hangi oteldi o?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I'm not sure. They said something about
a meeting and an inn. <W><M3/1/2>Clamp stayed behind,
though, so we'll be perfectly safe!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Emin degilim. Bir seyler soylediler,
bir toplanti ve bir han hakkinda. <W><M3/1/2>Ama Clamp geride kaldi,
o yuzden tamamen guvendeyiz!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I must gather clues for my steadfast hero!
Any excuse to talk to him will bring me
one step closer to my dream!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Kararli kahramanim icin ipuclari toplamaliyim!
Onunla konusmak icin her bahane
beni hayalime bir adim daha yaklastirir!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Well, nothing seems to be out of the
ordinary with the merry-go-round.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Eh, atlikarincada olagan disi
bir sey gorunmuyor.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>{''}A new spin on the miraculous{''}...
translation: <T>{''}A new spin on the miraculous{''}...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T>Professor, look! A poster!
translation: <T>Profesor, bakin! Bir afis!

original:
<T>Oh? Well spotted, Luke. It appears to be
a puzzle.
translation:
<T>Oh? Iyi fark ettin, Luke. Bir
bulmaca gibi gorunuyor.

original:
<T>It could be a trap set by the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Bu Maskeli
Beyefendi'nin kurdugu bir tuzak olabilir.

original:
<T>I imagine we'll work out what our villain is
up to if we solve this puzzle...
translation:
<T>Bu bulmacayi cozersek
kotu adamin neyin pesinde oldugunu anlariz...

original: <T>Hmm...
translation: <T>Hmm...

original: <T>What is it, Professor?
translation: <T>Ne oldu, Profesor?

original:
<T>The puzzle is based around merry-go-round
horses. I wonder if he's trying to lead us to
look more closely at them.
translation:
<T>Bulmaca atlikarinca
atlari uzerine kurulu. Acaba bizi
onlara daha yakindan bakmaya mi yonlendiriyor.

original: <T><M3/2/1>Leave it to me. I'll have a look!
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Bana birakin. Bir bakayim!

original: <T><M3/2/1>Thank you, Emmy.
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Tesekkurler, Emmy.

original:
<T>Do you think that puzzle is really the work of
the Masked Gentleman?
translation:
<T>Sence o bulmaca gercekten
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin isi mi?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Well, he certainly is meticulous with his
presentation.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Eh, sunumunda kesinlikle
titiz.

original: <T>I wonder what will happen tonight...
translation: <T>Bu gece ne olacak acaba...

original:
<T><M22/1/2>Professor, I found this underneath one of
the horses!
translation:
<T><M22/1/2>Profesor, bunu atlardan birinin
altinda buldum!

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>Fascinating...
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Buyuleyici...

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Is that...<W> It's got a picture of the Mask of
Chaos on it!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bu da...<W> Uzerinde
Kaos Maskesi'nin resmi var!

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Clearly a calling card. I wonder if the
Masked Gentleman left any more around?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Belli ki bir imza. Acaba
Maskeli Beyefendi etrafa baska da birakti mi?

original: <T>Unnecessary
translation: <T>Gereksiz

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>The roller coaster seems to be just the same
as when we went on it earlier.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Hiz treni, az once bindigimiz zamankiyle
ayni gorunuyor.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M3/2/1>Perhaps you should have another go on it?
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Belki bir kez daha binmelisin?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M1/2/2>No! I mean... I don't think that's necessary.
translation: <T><M1/2/2>Hayir! Yani... Bence buna gerek yok.

original: <T><M2/2/6/45>You're not scared, are you, Luke?
translation: <T><M2/2/6/45>Korkmadin ya, Luke?

original:
<T><M3/2/3>N-not at all! It's just that we should be
looking for clues from the Masked
Gentleman, not going on rides!
translation:
<T><M3/2/3>H-hayir, hic! Sadece
Maskeli Beyefendi'den ipuclari
aramaliyiz, oyuncaklara binmemeliyiz!

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Come to think of it, something did catch
my attention while I was watching you go
round earlier...
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Dusununce, biraz once seni donerken izlerken
dikkatimi ceken
bir sey olmustu...

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Really? I don't remember anything out of
the ordinary.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Gercekten mi? Olagan disi hicbir sey
hatirlamiyorum.

original: <T><M3/1/2>That panel over there! Didn't you see it?
translation: <T><M3/1/2>Suradaki panel! Gormedin mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/5>I never even noticed! I had my mind on
other things... Could it be a message from
the Masked Gentleman?
translation:
<T><M2/2/5>Hic fark etmemisim! Aklim
baska seylerdeydi... Maskeli Beyefendi'den
bir mesaj olabilir mi?

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>It may well be. Let's have a closer look.
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Olabilir. Daha yakindan bakalim.

original: <T><M5/2/1>I don't see it. What is he trying to indicate?
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Goremiyorum. Ne anlatmaya calisiyor?

original:
<T><M5/2/1>We must find out what the Masked
Gentleman was trying to tell us.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin bize ne anlatmaya
calistigini bulmaliyiz.

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>So what does the missing arrow mean?
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Peki eksik ok ne anlama geliyor?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>I imagine it means we should look in that
direction. Perhaps under the roller coaster
track?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Sanirim o yone bakmamiz gerektigini
anlatiyor. Belki hiz treninin
raylarinin altinda?

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>Okay, I'll go and have a look.
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Tamam, gidip bakayim.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Gosh, Professor, the Masked Gentleman is
really cunning! Imagine planting clues in
a ride...
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Vay canina Profesor, Maskeli Beyefendi gercekten
kurnaz! Bir oyuncagin icine
ipuclari yerlestirmek...

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>He does seem to relish leading us on his
little treasure hunt...
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Bizi kucuk hazine avinda pesinden suruklemekten
zevk aliyor gibi...

original: <T><M22/1/2>Professor! Luke! Look what I've found!
translation: <T><M22/1/2>Profesor! Luke! Bakin ne buldum!

original:
<T><M5/2/1>The Mask of Chaos... <M2/2/1/45>There's no doubt it's
a message, but this card doesn't tell us
very much on its own.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Kaos Maskesi... <M2/2/1/45>Kesinlikle
bir mesaj, ama bu kart tek basina bize
pek bir sey soylemiyor.

original: [Not used]
translation: [Kullanilmiyor]

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/1>There's the teacup ride... It's kind of a
spooky version, isn't it?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Surada fincan treni var... Biraz
urpertici bir versiyon, degil mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Indeed. Far less inviting than your everyday
giant teacups.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Kesinlikle. Siradan
dev fincanlardan cok daha az davetkar.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Still, it does set a pleasantly spine-tingling
tone for the ride.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Yine de gezinti icin hos bir
urperti veren bir hava yaratiyor.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hmmm. There's something funny about
those teacups - and it's nothing to do with
them looking like pumpkins.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hmmm. Su fincanlarda
komik bir sey var - ve bunun
kabak gibi gorunmeleriyle ilgisi yok.

original:
<T>There's definitely something odd here, but
I can't quite work it out...
translation:
<T>Burada kesinlikle tuhaf bir sey var ama
bir turlu cozemiyorum...

original:
<T>All right, let's have another look at these
pumpkin teacups.
translation:
<T>Pekala, su
kabak fincanlara bir daha bakalim.

original:
<T>Hmm. I believe something may be hidden in
that pumpkin, there.
translation:
<T>Hmm. Sanirim surada,
o kabagin icinde bir sey gizli.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Layton's apprentice to the rescue! I'll go
and investigate, Professor!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Layton'in ciragi imdada! Gidip
inceleyecegim, Profesor!

original:
<T><M2/2/3/45>I suppose investigating a teacup ride
shouldn't be too dangerous.
translation:
<T><M2/2/3/45>Sanirim fincan trenini incelemek
cok tehlikeli olmamali.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Ha ha. No, I think he's quite safe.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Ha ha. Hayir, bence gayet guvende.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Professor, do you have any idea what the
Masked Gentleman is planning tonight?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Profesor, Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
bu gece ne planladigina dair bir fikriniz var mi?

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Difficult to say. The fact that he chose such
a crowded venue is worrying, though.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Soylemesi zor. Bu kadar
kalabalik bir yeri secmesi endise verici.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Sooner or later, somebody is going to get
badly hurt!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Er ya da gec biri
fena halde yaralanacak!

original:
<T><M22/1/1>Professor, Emmy! I found this card stuck
underneath a seat in the teacup!
translation:
<T><M22/1/1>Profesor, Emmy! Bu karti fincanin
altindaki bir koltuga yapismis buldum!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Good work, Luke. <W>Hey, it's the Mask of
Chaos!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Aferin, Luke. <W>Hey, bu
Kaos Maskesi!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>It's a message from the Masked Gentleman.
But what could it mean, I wonder?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Maskeli Beyefendi'nden bir mesaj.
Ama ne anlama geliyor acaba?

original: <T>Unnecessary
translation: <T>Gereksiz

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>This huge Ferris wheel is perhaps one of the
more obvious {''}spins{''} at the fairground.
translation:
<T>Bu dev donme dolap, lunaparktaki
en belirgin {''}spins{''}lerden biri olabilir.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>It's moving a little oddly, isn't it?
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Biraz garip hareket ediyor, degil mi?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>You're right, Emmy! It looks as if it's coming
to a stop, bumpily. I wonder if it's broken?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Haklisin, Emmy! Sanki
duracak gibi, sarsilarak ilerliyor. Acaba bozuldu mu?

original:
<T>If we don't repair this control panel, the
visitors will get stuck at the top.
translation:
<T>Bu kontrol panelini tamir etmezsek,
ziyaretciler en tepede mahsur kalacak.

original: <T>You're right. We can't give up!
translation: <T>Haklisin. Pes edemeyiz!

original: <T>We'd better repair that control panel.
translation: <T>O kontrol panelini tamir etsek iyi olur.

original:
<T>The Ferris wheel is running normally again.
I wonder where the ride operator is,
though...
translation:
<T>Donme dolap tekrar normal calisiyor.
Ama operator nerede,
acaba...

original:
<T><M7/2/3/45>Professor, there's a card stuck to the side
here! It's got a picture of the Mask of
Chaos on it!
translation:
<T><M7/2/3/45>Profesor, kenara yapismis bir kart var
burada! Uzerinde Kaos Maskesi'nin bir
resmi var!

original:
<T><M3/1/2/45>I knew it! Grrr! Who does he think he is,
endangering those innocent Ferris wheel
riders?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2/45>Biliyordum! Grrr! Kendini kim saniyor,
o masum donme dolap
binicilerini tehlikeye atarak?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>It's obviously a token left by the Masked
Gentleman, but it tells us little on its own.
Presumably it's just a part of his message.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Belli ki Maskeli Beyefendi'nin biraktigi bir
iz, ama tek basina bize pek bir sey soylemiyor.
Muhtemelen mesajinin sadece bir parcasi.

original: [Not used]
translation: [Kullanilmiyor]

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/1/1>So, that's our fourth card... <W>Hey, Professor!
I think we have the whole set now! Look!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Demek dorduncu kartimiz da bu... <W>Hey, Profesor!
Sanirim artik setin tamami bizde! Bakin!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Hmm... Yes, they form a map of sorts.
I believe the Masked Gentleman wants us to
go to that tower on top of the hill.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Hmm... Evet, bir cesit harita olusturuyorlar.
Sanirim Maskeli Beyefendi, su tepenin
ustundeki kuleye gitmemizi istiyor.

original: <T>On top of the hill...<W> <M5/5/3/15>I see it!<W>
translation: <T>Tepenin ustunde...<W> <M5/5/3/15>Gordum!<W>

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T>According to the guidebook, that's Tingly
Tower. It's the control room.
translation:
<T>Rehber kitaba gore orasi Tingly
Kulesi. Kontrol odasi.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Is that where the Masked Gentleman plans
to perform his miracle?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Maskeli Beyefendi mucizesini
orada mi gerceklestirmeyi planliyor?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>It certainly has a commanding view of the
entire park...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Tum parki goren hakim bir
manzarasi var...

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <T>Layton! A moment, if you please!
translation: <T>Layton! Bir dakika, lutfen!

original: シャロア
translation: Charoix

original: <T>Hello, Hershel.
translation: <T>Merhaba, Hershel.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Henry, Angela! You came after all!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Henry, Angela! Sonunda geldiniz!

original:
<T><M8/1/1>Hershel, I asked for your help, and you
deserve our trust. <W>Henry has something to
say.
translation:
<T><M8/1/1>Hershel, senden yardim istedim ve
guvenimizi hak ediyorsun. <W>Henry'nin
soyleyecek bir seyi var.

original: <T>I apologise for my behaviour earlier.
translation: <T>Daha onceki davranisim icin ozur dilerim.

original:
<T>My responsibility is to my city. <W><M2/1/1>I will do
whatever it takes to help you apprehend the
Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Sorumlulugum sehrime. <W><M2/1/1>Sizi Maskeli
Beyefendi'yi yakalamada desteklemek icin
ne gerekiyorsa yapacagim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Thank you both. With your help and
knowledge of the city, I'm sure we will track
him down.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ikinize de tesekkurler. Yardiminiz ve
sehri bilmeniz sayesinde onu
izini surup bulacagimizdan eminim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I'm just glad we've arrived in time. What do
you know about his plans for tonight?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Zamaninda yetistigimize sevindim. Bu geceki
planlari hakkinda ne biliyorsunuz?

original: <T><M3/1/1>Do you know where he's hiding?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Nerede saklandigini biliyor musunuz?

original:
<T><M7/1/1>Hershel, please tell me you've found
something.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Hershel, lutfen bir sey
buldugunu soyle.

original:
<T><M6/2/1>Yes, I believe we have. He planted a series
of clues around the fairground.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Evet, sanirim bulduk. Panayir alanina
bir dizi ipucu birakmis.

original: <T>Really? What sort of clues?
translation: <T>Gercekten mi? Ne tur ipuclari?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>He seems to be leading us to Tingly Tower,
the park's control room.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Bizi Tingly Kulesi'ne, parkin
kontrol odasina goturuyor gibi.

original: <T>Well then, what are we waiting for?
translation: <T>O halde neyi bekliyoruz?

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <T>That's not the way to Tingly Tower!
translation: <T>Tingly Tower'a giden yol bu degil!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Wow! This is Tingly Tower? It looks like an
exotic palace!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Vay! Burasi Tingly Kulesi mi? Egzotik bir
saray gibi gorunuyor!

original:
<T>If I didn't already know it was a control
room, I would have thought it was another
attraction.
translation:
<T>Eger bunun bir kontrol odasi oldugunu zaten
bilmeseydim, baska bir
atraksiyon sanirdim.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>This certainly is a fitting location for the
Masked Gentleman's theatrics. <W>I wonder
what he's planning?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Burasi Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
tiyatrosuna yakisir bir yer. <W>Acaba
ne planliyor?

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original:
<T>A panic in the middle of a crowded
fairground could be catastrophic.
translation:
<T>Kalabalik bir panayirin ortasinda cikacak bir
panik felaket olabilir.

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>We must prevent his next miracle somehow.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Bir sonraki mucizesini bir sekilde engellemeliyiz.

original: <T>Wait! <W><M7/2/3/45>Professor, look up there!
translation: <T>Bekle! <W><M7/2/3/45>Profesor, suraya bakin!

original: 奇跡の紳士
translation: Mucize Beyefendi

original: <T>Aha, I'm delighted to see you've made it!
translation: <T>Aha, geldiginize cok sevindim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Tonight's miracle is for the select few who
were clever enough to find my clues.
<W30>Now...<W>on with the show!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu gecenin mucizesi, ipuclarimi bulacak kadar
zeki olan seckin birkac kisi icin.
<W30>Simdi...<W>gosteri baslasin!

original: <T><M4/1/1>Ah ha ha ha! Catch me if you can!
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Ah ha ha ha! Yakalayabilirsen yakala!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Blast! He's disappeared into the control
tower.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Kahretsin! Kontrol
kulesine kayboldu.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Henry, wait. What exactly is inside the
tower?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Henry, bekle. Kulenin icinde tam olarak ne
var?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Industrial-grade power relays, mostly. All the
electricity for the park is routed through the
tower.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Cogunlukla endustriyel guc roleleri. Parkin
tum elektrigi
kuleden dagitiliyor.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Naturally we keep it locked so that nobody
can-
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Elbette kimse
giremesin diye kilitli tutariz-

original:
<T>Augh!<W><M2/1/1> What if he cuts off the power to the
rides? He could endanger all the visitors!
translation:
<T>Ahh!<W><M2/1/1> Ya oyuncaklarin elektrigini keserse?
Tum ziyaretcileri tehlikeye atabilir!

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>It doesn't quite seem...theatrical enough
for the Masked Gentleman...<W60><M1/2/1/45> Still, we should
follow him inside.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Pek... Maskeli Beyefendi'ye gore yeterince
tiyatrovari gorunmuyor...<W60><M1/2/1/45> Yine de iceri
pesinden girmeliyiz.

original:
<T><M6/2/5>Um, Professor? How are we supposed to
find the Masked Gentleman in the dark?
translation:
<T><M6/2/5>Sey, Profesor? Karanlikta Maskeli
Beyefendi'yi nasil bulacagiz?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Henry, do you know where the light switches
are?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Henry, isik dugmelerinin nerede oldugunu
biliyor musun?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>No, I've never needed to come in here
before. Erm, let's see...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Hayir, daha once buraya girmem gerekmedi.
Sey, bir bakalim...

original:
<T>Ah ha ha ha! Worry not, my esteemed
guests! You have the best seats in the
house - you'll see in just a moment.
translation:
<T>Ah ha ha ha! Endiselenmeyin, degerli
misafirlerim! Evin en iyi
koltuklari sizde - birazdan goreceksiniz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Where are you?! Show yourself, villain. How
dare you threaten my city?!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Neredesin?! Goster kendini, hain. Nasil
sehrimi tehdit edersin?!

original: <T><M1/1/1>YOUR city, hmm? Is that what you think?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>SENIN sehrin, ha? Oyle mi saniyorsun?

original:
<T>Though I suppose... <W><M2/1/1>Yes, this foul pit of
greed and tawdry thrills does reflect its
creator perfectly.
translation:
<T>Gerci sanirim... <W><M2/1/1>Evet, acgozluluk ve
ucuz heyecanla dolu bu igrenc cukur,
yaraticisini kusursuzca yansitiyor.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>You built this city as a monument to your
grotesquely swollen ego. I can't wait to see
your face when it's all gone.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bu sehri siskin egona bir anit olarak
insa ettin. Her sey yok oldugunda
yuzunu gormeyi sabirsizlikla bekliyorum.

original: <T><M2/1/1>How dare you!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Nasil curet edersin!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Now, now, Ledore. I'm actually helping you,
you know. I'm teaching you a valuable
lesson in humility.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Simdi, simdi, Ledore. Aslinda sana yardim
ediyorum, biliyorsun. Sana alcakgonulluluk
konusunda degerli bir ders veriyorum.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>And giving you exclusive entry to the most
miraculous show on earth! Ha ha!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ve seni dunyanin en mucizevi gosterisine
ozel olarak sokuyorum! Ha ha!

original: <T><M5/2/3/20>Professor, he's getting away!
translation: <T><M5/2/3/20>Profesor, kaciyor!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>We must cut off his escape. Hurry,
everyone!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Kacis yolunu kesmeliyiz. Cabuk,
herkes!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M1/1/2>He's gone...

<T>He can't be far. <W><M3/1/1/45>He must have come back
this way, no?
translation:
<T>Cok uzaklasmis olamaz. <W><M3/1/1/45>Bu taraftan
geri donmus olmali, degil mi?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Then the only way to go is back down the
hill.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>O zaman tek yol tepenin
asagisina geri donmek.

original: <T><M5/1/2>Quick, back to the fairground!
translation: <T><M5/1/2>Cabuk, panayir alanina geri!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/1/2>The fairground is empty! Where did
everybody go?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Lunapark bombos! Herkes
nereye gitti?

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <T><M2/1/1>No! We're too late!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Hayir! Cok gec kaldik!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M6/2/4>Did they just...<W>vanish?<M6/2/3>
translation: <T><M6/2/4>Az once...<W>yok mu oldular?<M6/2/3>

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>Impossible. It has to be a trick!
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Imkansiz. Bu bir hile olmali!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: 奇跡の紳士
translation: Mucize Beyefendi

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Ah hah hah! Congratulations! You are now
members of an exclusive club: fairground
visitors who still exist!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ah hah hah! Tebrikler! Artik
seckin bir kulubun uyesisiniz: lunaparkta
hala var olan ziyaretciler!

original: <T><M1/1/1>You monster! <M2/1/1>Why are you doing all this?!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Canavar! <M2/1/1>Bunu neden yapiyorsun?!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Why, Henry, I'm doing it for you. So you
can understand what it means to have
everything you've worked for...vanish.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Henry, neden mi? Senin icin yapiyorum. Boylece
ugruna calistigin her seyin
...yok olmasinin ne demek oldugunu anlarsin.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>After all you've done for me, paying you
back in kind...<W>is the least I could do.
Ah ha ha ha.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Benim icin yaptiklarinin ardindan, sana ayni sekilde
karsilik vermek...<W>yapabilecegimin en azi.
Ah ha ha ha.

original: シャロア
translation: Saroa

original: <T>Eeeek!
translation: <T>Aaa!

original: <T><M2/1/1>Angela!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Angela!

original: <T><SEQ{''}shinshi{''}>Henry! Help me!
translation: <T><SEQ{''}shinshi{''}>Henry! Yardim et!

original: <T><M2/1/1>Wait! No!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Dur! Hayir!

original: <T>Angela! <W30>ANGELA!
translation: <T>Angela! <W30>ANGELA!

original: <T><M5/2/3>Professor, he's taken her!
translation: <T><M5/2/3>Profesor, onu goturdu!

original: <T><M3/2/1>We must act quickly!
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Cabucak harekete gecmeliyiz!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>They're gone. <W><M8/2/1/45>I'm sorry, Henry.
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Gittiler. <W><M8/2/1/45>Uzgunum, Henry.

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <T><M2/1/1>They went this way! We can still catch them!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Bu taraftan gittiler! Hala yakalayabiliriz!

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Calm down, Henry. If the Masked Gentleman
planned to harm Angela, he would have
done so already.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Sakin ol, Henry. Maskeli Beyefendi Angela'ya
zarar vermeyi planlasaydi, bunu coktan
yapmis olurdu.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M5/2/3>Professor, do you hear that? Something is
happening inside the control tower. Maybe
it's Angela!
translation:
<T><M5/2/3>Profesor, duydunuz mu? Kontrol kulesinin
icinde bir sey oluyor. Belki de
Angela'dir!

original: <T><M2/1/1>Angela! I'm coming!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Angela! Geliyorum!

original: <T><M2/2/1/15>Henry, wait!
translation: <T><M2/2/1/15>Henry, dur!

original: <T><M2/1/1>Angela, where are you?!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Angela, neredesin?!

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original: <T><M8/1/1>Henry? <W>It's all right. I'm fine.
translation: <T><M8/1/1>Henry? <W>Her sey yolunda. Iyiyim.

original: 奇跡の紳士
translation: Maskeli Beyefendi

original:
<T><M2/1/1>This was but a small taste of the anguish
I will bring you, Ledore. A little appetiser
before the banquet.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu, sana yasatacagim acinin kucuk bir tadiydi
Ledore. Solen oncesi kucuk bir
aperitif.

original:
<T>...But it will never be enough! Everything
I had, you-
translation:
<T>...Ama asla yetmeyecek! Sahip oldugum her seyi
sen-

original:
<T><M2/1/1>What are you talking about? Who are you?
What have I done to you?!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ne diyorsun? Sen kimsin?
Sana ne yaptim?!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Tsk, tsk, Henry, have you no feel for
drama? We need a good cliffhanger to build
anticipation for the final act!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Tsk, tsk, Henry, dram duygun yok mu?
Final perde icin beklentiyi artiracak iyi bir
askida birakma lazim!
<T><M5/2/1/45>Final perde...?

original: <T><M3/2/3/15>What could he mean by that?
translation: <T><M3/2/3/15>Bununla ne demek istedi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I promise it won't disappoint! Believe me
when I tell you there will be nothing
anticlimactic about this one!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Soz veriyorum hayal kirikligi olmayacak! Sana
soyluyorum, bunda asla siradan bir
son olmayacak!

original:
<T>And don't worry about getting good seats.
You'll be able to see tomorrow's miracle
from anywhere in the city.
translation:
<T>Iyi yer kapma derdine de dusme.
Yarinin mucizesini sehrin her yerinden
gorebileceksin.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It will be the last, and greatest, miracle of
my illustrious career! Ha ha ha!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu, gorkemli kariyerimin son ve en buyuk
mucizesi olacak! Ha ha ha!

original: <T><M2/2/1>No! This ends here!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Hayir! Burada biter!

original: <T><M1/1/1>You seem ill-equipped to stop me, Layton.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Beni durduracak donanima sahip degilsin, Layton.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But if you don't...<W>well, there will be
casualties. <W30>Quite a few of them.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama durdurmazsan...<W>o zaman
kayiplar olacak. <W30>Hem de epey.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>In fact, I imagine there won't be an accurate
body count for quite some time! Aha ha ha!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hatta uzun sure dogru bir
olu sayisi bile cikarilamaz! Aha ha ha!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>And with that, ladies and gentlemen, I bid
you a fond farewell!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ve boylece, bayanlar baylar, size sevgiyle
veda ediyorum!

original: <T><M2/1/1>What is that lunatic planning?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>O deli ne planliyor?

original: <T><M4/1/1>Henry, what are you going to do?
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Henry, ne yapacaksin?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>I don't know...<W> But it's my duty to protect
this city.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Bilmiyorum...<W> Ama bu sehri korumak benim
gorevim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Perhaps if you gave him the Mask of Order
like he asked, he would stop all of this.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Belki de istedigi gibi ona Duzen Maskesi'ni
versen, butun bunlari durdurur.

original:
<T>It must be among the treasure you found in
the ruins, Henry. If you search thoroughly,
I'm sure you'll find it!
translation:
<T>Harabelerde buldugun hazinenin icinde olmali,
Henry. Iyice ararsan, eminim bulursun!

original: <T><M3/1/1>I...can't. <W>That treasure...
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Ben... yapamam. <W>O hazine...

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Henry, you must stop hiding it! Think of the
city!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Henry, onu saklamayi birakmalisin! Sehri
dusun!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Angela, I'm not hiding anything. Why would
you say that?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Angela, hicbir seyi saklamiyorum. Neden
boyle diyorsun?

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>If I might interject...
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Araya girebilir miyim...

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>I don't think it's safe to stay here. We've
yet to find out what happened to the people
who vanished.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Burada kalmak guvenli degil. Kaybolan
insanlara ne oldugunu hala
ogrenemedik.

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>Of-of course...

<T><M3/2/1/45>Well, the Masked Gentleman has escaped
once again.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Maskeli Beyefendi
bir kez daha kacti.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>I don't like what he said about being able to
see the next miracle from anywhere in the
city.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Sehrin her yerinden bir sonraki mucizeyi
gorebilecegimizi soylemesi hic hosuma
gitmedi.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>It is rather troubling indeed. Whatever he's
planning must be enormous in scale.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Gercekten de oldukca endise verici. Ne
planliyorsa olcegi cok buyuk olmali.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Maybe this time everyone in town will
disappear...or turn into statues...or
spontaneously combust.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Belki bu sefer sehirdeki herkes
yok olur... ya da heykellere donusur... ya da
kendiliginden alev alir.

original:
<T>Perhaps, but I fear it may be something far
more real than his tricks so far.
translation:
<T>Belki, ama bunun simdiye kadarki numaralarindan
cok daha gercek bir sey olmasindan korkuyorum.

original:
<T><M3/2/3>What about making everyone in Tingly Town
disappear? Was that a trick?
translation:
<T><M3/2/3>Tingly Town'daki herkesi yok etmesine ne
diyeceksin? O da mi numaraydi?

original:
<T><M5/1/2>We won't know until we find them,
I suppose...
translation:
<T><M5/1/2>Onlari bulana kadar bilemeyiz,
sanirim...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M3/2/1>What on earth?!
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Ne oluyor?!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/1/4>Everyone's back! <W>It all looks just as it did
before. There's no sign of panic. What is
this?!
translation:
<T><M3/1/4>Herkes geri dondu! <W>Her sey tipki
onceki gibi gorunuyor. Panik belirtisi yok. Bu
da ne?!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M1/2/4>But they vanished... <W>We all saw it. What
does it mean, Professor?
translation:
<T><M1/2/4>Ama yok oldular... <W>Hepimiz gorduk. Bu
ne anlama geliyor, Profesor?

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>I wish I knew, Luke.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Keske bilseydim, Luke.

original:
<T>Perhaps this was just another sample of the
horror we can expect tomorrow.
translation:
<T>Belki de bu, yarin
bekleyebilecegimiz dehsetin bir ornegiydi.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/60>But why were the five of us the only
witnesses?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Ama neden sadece besimiz
tanik olduk?

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>He wanted me to see it.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Onu gormemi istedi.

original:
<T>Yes, Henry. I think you need to tell us
everything...anything, that you know.
translation:
<T>Evet, Henry. Bildigin her seyi... her
ne varsa, bize anlatmalisin.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Do you really have no idea who the man
under the mask might be? Is there no one
you've made enemies with?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Gercekten de maskenin altindaki adamin
kim olabilecegine dair hicbir fikrin yok mu?
Dusman edindigin kimse yok mu?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>No, I don't know... I don't know anyone
who could be capable of this. Why has he
gone so far?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hayir, bilmiyorum... Bunu yapabilecek
kimseyi tanimiyorum. Neden bu kadar
ileri gitti?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/60>I'm going home. I need time to think. I need
to construct some sort of plan for that
monster's return tomorrow.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/60>Eve gidiyorum. Dusunmek icin zamana
ihtiyacim var. O canavarin yarinki donusu
icin bir plan kurmaliyim.

original: シャロア
translation: Charoix

original: <T><M7/1/1>I'll come too. I'm exhausted.
translation: <T><M7/1/1>Ben de geliyorum. Cok yoruldum.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Goodnight, both of you. Take care.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Ikinize de iyi geceler. Kendinize dikkat edin.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/60>It's almost as if these fair-goers are unaware
that they disappeared.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Sanki bu panayir ziyaretcileri
yok olduklarinin farkinda degil.

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>Nobody looks panicked...or even confused.
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Kimse paniklememis... hatta sasirmis bile degil.

original: <T><M5/1/1>Professor, here comes Inspector Grosky!
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Profesor, Mufettis Grosky geliyor!

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Layton! I saw Ledore and his wife hurrying
away from here. Did something happen?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Layton! Ledore'u ve karisini buradan
aceleyle uzaklasirken gordum. Bir sey mi oldu?

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Yes. We had another encounter with the
Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Evet. Maskeli Beyefendi'yle
bir kez daha karsilastik.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Impossible! I was on the scene! How could I
have missed that?!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Imkansiz! Olay yerindeydim! Nasil
kacirdim bunu?!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Inspector, you've been here at the
fairground all evening, is that right?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Mufettis, butun aksam buradaki panayir
alanindaydiniz, oyle mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Of course! I've been policing this place
within an inch of its life, looking for that
masked ne'er-do-well!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Elbette! Su maskeli serseriyi ararken burayi
didik didik
denetledim!

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>And there were people around enjoying
themselves the whole time?
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Ve bu sure boyunca etrafta eglenen
insanlar vardi?

original:
<T>Yes...<W> Unless they were only pretending to
enjoy themselves! Is that it?
translation:
<T>Evet...<W> Tabii sadece egleniyormus gibi
yapmiyorlarsa! Oyle mi?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>No, nothing like that. <W>So you didn't notice
anything unusual...
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Hayir, oyle bir sey degil. <W>Yani
olagan disi hicbir sey fark etmediniz...

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Professor, it sounds as though Inspector
Grosky didn't even notice when he and the
others disappeared.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Profesor, anlasilan Mufettis
Grosky, kendisi ve digerleri yok olurken bile
hicbir sey fark etmemis.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>I believe you're right, Luke, and I think
that's a vital clue. But it's getting late now.
Let's go back to the hotel.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Sanirim haklisin, Luke, ve bunun onemli
bir ipucu oldugunu dusunuyorum. Ama artik
gec oldu. Otele donelim.

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Inspector, you should know that the Masked
Gentleman threatened us with a final miracle
tomorrow.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Mufettis, bilmelisiniz ki Maskeli Beyefendi
bizi yarin son bir mucizeyle
tehdit etti.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>He said it will be visible from anywhere in
the city, so we must prepare for a
large-scale event.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Sehrin her yerinden gorulebilecegini soyledi,
bu yuzden
buyuk olcekli bir olay icin hazirlanmaliyiz.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Please report this to the chief inspector.
Ask him to post as many officers as he can
on the streets.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Lutfen bunu basmufettise bildirin.
Sokaklara elinden geldigince
cok polis cikarmasini isteyin.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Of course! Until tomorrow then! <W>FOR THE
YARD!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Elbette! O halde yarin gorusuruz! <W>YARD
ICIN!

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>We'd better get some rest. Let's resume our
investigation in the morning.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Biraz dinlensek iyi olur. Sorusturmamiza
sabah devam edelim.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Something that can be seen from
anywhere... What could the Masked
Gentleman be planning?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Sehrin her yerinden gorulebilecek
bir sey... Maskeli Beyefendi
ne planliyor olabilir?

original:
<T>Well, whatever it is, <M3/1/1>it's going to dwarf
everything we've seen up to now.
translation:
<T>Her neyse, <M3/1/1>simdiye kadar gordugumuz
her seyi golgede birakacak.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Thus far, he's used misdirection and simple
illusions, but such tricks are hard to pull off
on a large scale...
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Simdiye dek saptirma ve basit illuzyonlar
kullandi ama bu tur numaralari
buyuk olcekte yapmak zor...

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Professor, could he use the power of the
mask? Is that what killed Randall?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Profesor, maskenin gucunu kullanabilir mi?
Randall'i olduren de bu muydu?

original:
<T><M3/2/1/60>No... <W65><M8/2/1/60>No, that was my fault.<W60> If I had been
a better friend, Randall would still...
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/60>Hayir... <W65><M8/2/1/60>Hayir, bu benim hatamdi.<W60> Eger
daha iyi bir arkadas olsaydim, Randall hala...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<V0010><T><M4/4/1>Ready to embark upon the first day of the
rest of your life, Hershel?</V>
translation:
<V0010><T><M4/4/1>Hayatinin geri kalaninin ilk gunune
baslamaya hazir misin, Hershel?</V>

original: <V0020><T><M3/1/1>Henry! Is everything all set?</V>
translation: <V0020><T><M3/1/1>Henry! Her sey hazir mi?</V>

original: ヤングヘンリー
translation: Genc Henry

original:
<V0030><T>Yes, Master Randall. <L1.8>The cart is loaded and
should be ready for your departure.</V>
translation:
<V0030><T>Evet, Randall Efendi. <L1.8>At arabasi yuklendi ve
hareketiniz icin hazir olmali.</V>

original: <V0040><T><M4/1/1>Angela! <L1.25>What are you doing here?</V>
translation: <V0040><T><M4/1/1>Angela! <L1.25>Burada ne yapiyorsun?</V>

original: <V0050><T>Henry, is this your doing?</V>
translation: <V0050><T>Henry, bunu sen mi yaptin?</V>

original:
<V0060><T><M1/1/2>...Yes, sir. <L1.45>My apologies. <L2.85>It seemed rather
important.</V>
translation:
<V0060><T><M1/1/2>...Evet, efendim. <L1.45>Ozur dilerim. <L2.85>Oldukca
onemli gorunmustu.</V>

original: ヤングシャロア
translation: Genc Sharoa

original:
<V0070><T><M2/1/1>Henry had nothing to do with it. <L2.05>I wasn't
going to let you go without saying goodbye,
Randall.</V>
translation:
<V0070><T><M2/1/1>Henry'nin bununla ilgisi yok. <L2.05>Sana veda etmeden
gitmene izin vermeyecektim,
Randall.</V>

original:
<V0080><T><M1/1/1>I thought it'd be easier if you didn't see me
go. <L3.15>I was going to have Henry deliver this, <L5.6>
but since you're here...</V>
translation:
<V0080><T><M1/1/1>Beni gormezsen daha kolay olur sanmistim
giderken. <L3.15>Bunu Henry'ye teslim ettirecektim, <L5.6>
ama madem buradasin...</V>

original: <V0090><T>What...<L1.2>what is this? <L3.05>I can't take this.</V>
translation: <V0090><T>Ne...<L1.2>bu da ne? <L3.05>Bunu kabul edemem.</V>

original:
<V0100><T><M4/1/1>Look after it for me. <L1.95>You can give it back
when I return.</V>
translation:
<V0100><T><M4/1/1>Benim icin sakla. <L1.95>Dondugumde
geri verebilirsin.</V>

original: <V0110><T><M1/1/1>Yes. <L0.85>Yes, of course. <L2.85>Thank you, Randall.</V>
translation: <V0110><T><M1/1/1>Evet. <L0.85>Evet, elbette. <L2.85>Tesekkur ederim, Randall.</V>

original: <V0120><T><M2/1/1>I'll see you soon, Angela. <L1.85>I swear.</V>
translation: <V0120><T><M2/1/1>Yakinda gorusuruz, Angela. <L1.85>Soz veriyorum.</V>

original: <V0130><T>You will be careful, won't you?</V>
translation: <V0130><T>Dikkatli olacaksin, degil mi?</V>

original:
<V0140><T><M4/2/1>Naturally. <L1.55>When I get back, we can have
that picnic on the hill. <L4.15>How does that
sound?</V>
translation:
<V0140><T><M4/2/1>Elbette. <L1.55>Dondugumde
tepede o piknigi yapabiliriz. <L4.15>Nasil
olur?</V>

original:
<V0150><T><M4/4/2>Well, we'd better be off before my father
spots us! <L2.9>Next stop: <L3.95>Akbadain!</V>
translation:
<V0150><T><M4/4/2>Babam bizi
fark etmeden gitsek iyi olur! <L2.9>Siradaki durak: <L3.95>Akbadain!</V>

original: <V0160><T>Goodbye...</V>
translation: <V0160><T>Hosca kal...</V>

original:
<V0170><T><M1/2/1>Please don't worry, Miss Angela. <L2.05>Master
Randall has a remarkable mind. <L4.9>He'll find
what he seeks and return soon.</V>
translation:
<V0170><T><M1/2/1>Lutfen endiselenmeyin, Bayan Angela. <L2.05>Randall Efendi
olaganustu bir zekaya sahip. <L4.9>Aradigini
bulacak ve yakinda donecek.</V>

original: <V0180><T><M2/1/1>I hope you're right, Henry...</V>
translation: <V0180><T><M2/1/1>Umarim haklisindir, Henry...</V>

original: <V0190><T><M1/1/2>I'm certain of it.</V>
translation: <V0190><T><M1/1/2>Bundan eminim.</V>

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Do you think she'll be all right, Randall?
translation: <T>Onun iyi olacagini dusunuyor musun, Randall?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Angela? Oh, she'll be fine. She's always
like that.
translation:
<T>Angela mi? Ah, iyi olur. Hep
boyledir zaten.

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>If you say so...
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Oyle diyorsan...

original:
<T>So, where do we go from here? Where is
this Akbadain, exactly?
translation:
<T>Peki, buradan nereye gidiyoruz? Bu
Akbadain tam olarak nerede?

original:
<T><M2/4/3>Oh yeah, I never got round to showing you,
did I?
translation:
<T><M2/4/3>Ah dogru ya, sana gostermeye hic
firsat bulamamistim, degil mi?

original: <T><K>Hm?
translation: <T><K>Hi?

original:
<T><M3/4/3>Look at this. <W>Remember how I explained that
the mask's inscriptions are a sort of treasure
map?
translation:
<T><M3/4/3>Suna bak. <W>Maskenin yazitlarinin bir tur hazine
haritasi oldugunu acikladigimi
hatirliyor musun?

original: <T>I spent a whole three months deciphering it.
translation: <T>Onu cozmek icin tam uc ay harcadim.

original:
<T>But I found out where it leads: Thornley's
Gorge, due south of Stansbury.
translation:
<T>Ama nereye goturdugunu ogrendim: Stansbury'nin
hemen guneyindeki Thornley Bogazi.

original: <T><M1/2/1>What about the crest?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Peki ya arma?

original:
<T><M4/2/3>It's piqued your interest, has it? Well,
I researched that, too.
translation:
<T><M4/2/3>Merakini cekti, degil mi? Eh,
onu da arastirdim.

original:
<T>I searched through numerous academic
works and analysed over 80 ancient
symbols that were similar to the crest.
translation:
<T>Bircok akademik
kaynagi taradim ve armaya benzeyen
80'den fazla kadim sembolu analiz ettim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>My analysis led me to one overwhelming
conclusion: these similar symbols all
originated in the very distant past.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Analizim beni cok acik bir
sonuca goturdu: Bu benzer sembollerin hepsi
cok uzak bir gecmisten geliyor.

original:
<T>The civilisation responsible for them is not
connected to any culture we know from
historical records.
translation:
<T>Onlardan sorumlu uygarlik,
tarihi kayitlardan bildigimiz hicbir kulturle
baglantili degil.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>It's the Azran civilisation, Hershel! The
mysterious Azran, known only from the most
ancient of legends.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bu, Azran uygarligi, Hershel! En
eski efsanelerden baska hicbir yerde adi gecmeyen
esrarengiz Azran.

original: <T><M2/2/1>The Azran civilisation?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Azran uygarligi mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>It's discussed in Rutledge's {''}Ancient
Histories{''} and there are many theories, but
nothing has ever been proven.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Rutledge'in {''}Ancient
Histories{''} adli eserinde geciyor; pek cok teori var ama
hicbiri bugune kadar kanitlanmadi.

original:
<T>Until now, that is! Hershel, I think the Azran
built the Akbadain ruins.
translation:
<T>Ta ki simdiye kadar! Hershel, Akbadain
harabelerini Azranlarin insa ettigini dusunuyorum.

original:
<T>This could be the first solid evidence of their
existence. It'll be the find of the century!
translation:
<T>Bu, varliklarinin ilk saglam kaniti olabilir.
Yuzyilin kesfi olacak!

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>B-but the Azran! You really think...?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>A-ama Azranlar! Gercekten...?

original:
<T><M2/4/3>Enough standing around! Akbadain's
waiting!
translation:
<T><M2/4/3>Daha fazla oyalanmak yok! Akbadain
bizi bekliyor!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>Hey! Where are you going? You can't
change your mind now!
translation:
<T>Hey! Nereye gidiyorsun? Simdi
fikrini degistiremezsin!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Here we are! The Akbadain ruins. The Mask
of Chaos led us here, to unearth the
ancestral treasures hidden within.
translation:
<T>Iste buradayiz! Akbadain harabeleri. Kaos Maskesi
bizi buraya, icindeki
atalardan kalma hazineleri ortaya cikarmaya getirdi.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>This place looks absolutely huge. We never
planned for an expedition of this scale.
translation:
<T>Burasi inanilmaz buyuk gorunuyor. Boyle bir olcekte
bir kesif gezisi planlamamistik.

original: <T>I know. Isn't it brilliant?
translation: <T>Biliyorum. Harika degil mi?

original: <T><M1/1/1>That isn't quite what I was getting at...
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Demek istedigim pek o degildi...

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Come on, we have to work together. Who
knows what traps and pitfalls we might run
into? We need a plan of action!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hadi ama, birlikte calismaliyiz. Kim
bilir ne tur tuzaklar ve tehlikelerle karsilasacagiz?
Bir planimiz olmali!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Good thinking. No doubt you already have
something in mind?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Iyi dusunce. Elbette zaten
aklinda bir sey vardir?

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Naturally! I'll run you through my Ruins
Exploration Strategy!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Elbette! Sana Harabe
Kesif Stratejimi anlatacagim!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Lucky for us, I managed to find a copy of
an ancient manuscript that is believed to be
a map of Akbadain.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Sansimiza, Akbadain'in haritasi olduguna inanilan
kadim bir el yazmasinin bir kopyasini
bulmayi basardim.

original:
<T>Don't worry about getting lost. You can just
touch the map icon in the corner to check
our current location.
translation:
<T>Kaybolmaktan endise etme. Kosedeki harita simgesine
dokunarak
su anki konumumuzu kontrol edebilirsin.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Whenever you want to speak to me, just
touch <CR>Talk</CR>.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Benimle konusmak istediginde, sadece
dokun <CR>Talk</CR>.

original:
<T>You can ask me about anything, from basic
information to advice on getting past traps
and sticky situations.
translation:
<T>Bana en temel
bilgilerden tuzaklari ve zor durumlari asmaya dair
tavsiyelere kadar her seyi sorabilirsin.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>The backpack works the same as the trunk,
so you can just use it as usual. <W>So, next,
how do we move?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Sirt cantasi da sandikla ayni sekilde calisir,
yani her zamanki gibi kullanabilirsin. <W>Peki, sirada,
nasil hareket ediyoruz?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Touch the arrows on the Touch Screen to
move in any direction. Hold the arrow down
to walk along without stopping.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Her yone hareket etmek icin Dokunmatik Ekran'daki
oklara dokun. Oku basili tutarsan
durmadan yurursun.

original:
<T>Ah yes, I almost forgot. You can also use
the <CR>+Control Pad</CR> or the <CR>Circle Pad</CR> to move.
<W>It's entirely up to you.
translation:
<T>Ah evet, az kalsin unutuyordum. Hareket etmek icin
<CR>+Control Pad</CR> ya da <CR>Circle Pad</CR> de kullanabilirsin.
<W>Tamamen sana kalmis.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Have a go at moving now.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Simdi hareket etmeyi dene.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Aha! I've been saving a present for you,
Hersh, and now seems like a good time to
give it to you.
translation:
<T>Aha! Senin icin bir hediye sakliyordum,
Hersh, simdi de onu sana vermek icin iyi bir zaman
gibi gorunuyor.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It's...a large shovel.<W> Er...why are you
giving it to me?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu... buyuk bir kurek.<W> Sey... neden bana
veriyorsun?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Every explorer needs a good shovel! Here,
allow me to explain.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Her kasifin iyi bir kurege ihtiyaci vardir! Bak,
aciklayayim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Touch <CR>Dig Hole</CR> to dig a hole in the ground
directly in front of you.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Topraga bir cukur kazmak icin <CR>Dig Hole</CR>'a dokun;
cukur tam olarak onunde acilir.

original:
<T>And let's see... <W>You can also press the
<CR>A Button</CR> to dig a hole. Whatever's easiest
for you.
translation:
<T>Bir de suna bakalim... <W>Ayrica
<CR>A Button</CR>'a basarak da cukur kazabilirsin. Sana
hangisi kolaysa onu sec.

original:
<T>As you can imagine, you can't dig through
rocks or a solid stone floor, only into soil.
translation:
<T>Tahmin edebilecegin gibi, kayalari ya da
saglam bir tas zemini kazamazsin; yalnizca topragi kazabilirsin.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Aren't you just dying to try it out? Go on,
try digging a hole over there.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Denemek icin can atiyor olmalisin, degil mi? Haydi,
surada bir cukur kazmayi dene.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Have a go at digging a hole there!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Surada bir cukur kazmayi dene!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T><M4/2/1>Excellent! Nicely dug!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Mukemmel! Cok iyi kazdin!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M4/1/1>Hmm, this shovel may come in useful.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Hmm, bu kurek isimize yarayabilir.

original:
<T>Right then! I think we have a plan. We'd
better start exploring, or we'll never be
world-famous archaeologists!
translation:
<T>Peki o zaman! Sanirim bir planimiz var. Hemen
kesfe baslamaliyiz, yoksa asla
dunyaca unlu arkeologlar olamayiz!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>Hey! We haven't finished our little planning
meeting yet. Humour me and try digging in
that spot, would you?
translation:
<T>Hey! Kucuk planlama
toplantimiz daha bitmedi. Beni kirma da
su noktada kazmayi dene, olur mu?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M4/2/1>What on earth?! The ground is glowing!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Ne oluyor boyle?! Zemin parliyor!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/2/1>There must be something buried there! Isn't
it obvious? <W>Quick, dig it up!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Orada gomulu bir sey olmali! Bu
apacik degil mi? <W>Cabuk, kazip cikar!

original:
<T>What's the matter? Aren't you going to try
digging in that nice shiny patch of earth?
translation:
<T>Ne oldu? Denemeyecek misin
su guzel parildayan toprak parcasini kazmayi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Just face the glowing spot and touch
<CR>Dig Hole</CR>. Or you could press the
<CR>A Button</CR>. Either works.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sadece parlayan noktaya don ve dokun
<CR>Dig Hole</CR>. Ya da
<CR>A Button</CR>. Ikisi de olur.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>Where are you going, Hersh? Don't you
want to know what's buried there? Don't
keep me in suspense!
translation:
<T>Nereye gidiyorsun, Hersh? Orada neyin
gomulu oldugunu ogrenmek istemiyor musun? Beni
merakta birakma!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Look, Randall, I've found a hint coin. That's
a nice surprise!
translation:
<T>Bak, Randall, bir ipucu parasi buldum. Bu
ne hos bir surpriz!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>My archaeologist's instinct never fails!
I reckon that glowing patches are likely to
contain something interesting.
translation:
<T>Arkeolog icgudulerim hic sasmaz!
Su parlayan bolgelerin buyuk olasilikla
ilginc bir sey sakladigini dusunuyorum.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Just as long as {''}interesting{''} doesn't turn out
to be snakes or anything...
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Yeter ki {''}ilginc{''} dedigin sey
yilan falan cikmasin...

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Pfft, don't be so negative. Come on, let's
get moving!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Pff, o kadar olumsuz olma. Hadi,
yola koyulalim!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Oof, might be tricky with that hole there.
We'd better fill it back in, Hersh.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Off, suradaki delik varken zor olabilir.
Onu doldursak iyi olur, Hersh.

original:
<T>Just stand in front of the hole and touch
<CR>Fill Hole</CR>.
translation:
<T>Sadece deligin onunde dur ve
<CR>Deligi Doldur</CR> secenegine dokun.

original:
<T>We need to fill in that hole, Hersh. <W>It's easy.
Just stand in front of it and touch <CR>Fill Hole</CR>.
translation:
<T>O deligi doldurmamiz gerekiyor, Hersh. <W>Cok kolay.
Onunde durup <CR>Deligi Doldur</CR> secenegine dokun.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>The door is closed. How are we going to get
past here?
translation:
<T>Kapi kapali. Buradan
nasil gececegiz?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall
