original: <T>Well, we could always try pushing it.
translation: <T>Sey, her zaman itip deneyebiliriz.

original: <T><M4/1/1>Blast! It won't budge.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Kahretsin! Kimildamiyor.

original: <T><M3/2/1>There's no way to pull it open either.
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Cekerek acmanin da bir yolu yok.

original: <T><K>Grr...
translation: <T><K>Grr...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We can't come all the way out here to
Akbadain and then get stuck at the first
door. Dash it all!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bunca yolu gelip
Akbadain'e kadar geldik de ilk
kapida mi takilip kalacagiz? Kahrolasi!

original: <T>Ah, hold on!
translation: <T>Ah, dur bir!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>What's this? I think it's a switch of some
sort.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bu da ne? Sanirim bir tur
anahtar.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Hmm, nothing happened. It must not have
anything to do with the door.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Hmm, hicbir sey olmadi. Demek ki
kapiyla ilgisi yok.

original:
<T>Wait a sec. There's another switch over
there. <M4/2/2>Maybe that's the answer!
translation:
<T>Bir saniye. Surada bir anahtar daha var
orada. <M4/2/2>Belki de cozum budur!

original: <T>Still nothing...
translation: <T>Hala hicbir sey...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Fiddlesticks! These switches can't just be
here for no reason.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Tuh! Bu anahtarlar
bosuna burada olamaz.

original: <T>Think, Hersh! There must be a way...
translation: <T>Dusun, Hersh! Bir yolu olmali...

original: <T><M4/1/1>Oh! I know! Let me just try something...
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Ah! Buldum! Bir sey deneyeyim...

original:
<T>Hey, hey! Where do you think you're going?
I'm not giving up now!
translation:
<T>Hey, hey! Nereye gittigini saniyorsun?
Simdi pes etmiyorum!

original:
<T><M2/2/2>There has to be some trick to opening this
door, and we're going to find out what it is!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Bu kapiyi acmanin bir numarasi olmali,
ve ne oldugunu bulacagiz!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M5/1/1>You have to press both switches at once to
open the door.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Kapiyi acmak icin iki dugmeye de ayni anda
basman gerekiyor.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/4/3>Hersh, you're a genius! Now we can move
on!
translation:
<T><M2/4/3>Hersh, sen bir dahisin! Artik devam
edebiliriz!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hmm. It's hard to believe you didn't work
that out yourself. You knew what to do all
along, didn't you?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Himm. Bunu kendi basina cozememis olmana
inanmak zor. Ne yapman gerektigini en
basindan beri biliyordun, degil mi?

original: <T>Ahem...
translation: <T>Eee...

original:
<T><M1/2/2>You know me too well, Hersh. I can't fool
you, can I?
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Beni fazla iyi taniyorsun, Hersh. Seni
kandiramam, degil mi?

original:
<T>Still, I'd have been stuck on my own. We're
lucky there are two of us! <W><M4/2/2>Maybe this is
a reminder to use teamwork.
translation:
<T>Yine de tek basima olsaydim takilip kalirdim. Biz
iki kisiyiz, sansliyiz! <W><M4/2/2>Belki de bu,
ekip calismasini kullanmamiz gerektigini hatirlatiyordur.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Possibly... In any case, I've come this far,
so I'm going with you to the end!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Olabilir... Her halukarda buraya kadar geldim,
o yuzden seninle sonuna kadar geliyorum!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Look, another door. And another two
switches.
translation:
<T>Bak, bir kapi daha. Bir de iki
anahtar daha.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>I'll take the one on the right. You take the
left.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ben sagdakini alirim. Sen de
soldakini.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M1/2/1>Roger.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Anlasildi.

original: <T><M2/2/1/15>Aaaah!<W> Wha-<W>what are those things?
translation: <T><M2/2/1/15>Aaaah!<W> Ne-<W>o da ne oyle?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>They look like mechanical mummies of some
kind. Perhaps the guardians of the ruins
coming to greet us?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bir tur mekanik mumyaya
benziyorlar. Belki de harabelerin bekcileri
bizi karsilamaya gelmistir?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I'd say I'm not terribly keen on this kind of
greeting.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bu tur bir
karsilamadan pek hoslandigimi soyleyemem.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Come on, this only makes it all the more
exciting! <W>No risk, no glory, remember?
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Hadi ama, bu isi daha da
heyecanli yapiyor! <W>Risk yoksa zafer de yok, unutma.

original:
<T>You have that shovel, don't you? Just dig
some holes for the mummies to fall into.
translation:
<T>Kurek sende, degil mi? Mumyalarin dusecegi
birkac cukur kaz.

original: <T><M1/2/1>What about you, though?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Peki ya sen?

original:
<T><M4/2/1>I'm a champion sprinter, remember? I'll
make a dash for the switch on the right. The
left one's up to you!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Ben sampiyon bir sprinterim, hatirladin mi? Sagdaki anahtara
kosup basacagim. Soldaki
sana kaliyor!

original:
<T>If digging holes doesn't work for you...<W>just
run for it. <W30>Once we've pressed the switches,
the mummies won't matter. <W>I hope.
translation:
<T>Eger cukur kazmak ise yaramazsa...<W>sadece
kac. <W30>Anahtarlara bastiktan sonra,
mumyalar onemli olmayacak. <W>Umarim.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>Once activated, mechanical mummies will
move at the same time as Hershel, matching
him step for step.
translation:
<T>Aktiflestirildiklerinde, mekanik mumyalar
Hershel ile ayni anda hareket eder ve
onu adim adim takip eder.

original:
<T>Additionally, if Hershel stops to dig a hole,
the mummies will move one square.
translation:
<T>Ayrica Hershel bir cukur kazmak icin durursa,
mumyalar bir kare ilerler.

original:
<T>If Hershel runs into a mummy, he'll have to
give up and retreat to safety in the previous
chamber.
translation:
<T>Hershel bir mumyaya carparsa,
pes edip onceki
odaya guvenlige cekilmek zorunda kalir.

original:
<T>To change direction on the spot, touch the
little rotate arrows in the top corners of the
Touch Screen.
translation:
<T>Yerinde yon degistirmek icin,
Dokunmatik Ekran'in ust koselerindeki
kucuk dondurme oklarina dokun.

original:
<T>You can also use the <CR>L Button</CR> and <CR>R Button</CR>
to make Hershel turn round.
translation:
<T><CR>L Button</CR> ve <CR>R Button</CR> tuslarini da kullanarak
Hershel'i dondurebilirsin.

original:
<T>To give up and retreat to the previous
chamber, touch <CR>Run!</CR> on the Touch Screen.
translation:
<T>Vazgecip onceki
odaya geri cekilmek icin Dokunmatik Ekran'da <CR>Run!</CR>'a dokun.

original:
<T>If you're completely at a loss, touch this
icon on the bottom left of the Touch Screen
to activate a very helpful Guide Mode.
translation:
<T>Tamamen tikandiysan,
Dokunmatik Ekran'in sol altindaki bu simgeye dokunarak
cok faydali Rehber Modu'nu etkinlestir.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Hershel, you have the shovel. Try to dig
holes and make those mummies fall into
them.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hershel, kurek sende. Cukur kazmayi dene
ve o mumyalari icine dusur.
Tamam mi?

original:
<T>I'll sprint to the switch on the right. You
make your way to the one on the left, all
right?
translation:
<T>Ben sagdaki anahtara kosacagim. Sen de
soldakine git, tamam
mi?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M2/2/1/15>Aaaah!<W> Wha-<W>what are those things?
translation: <T><M2/2/1/15>Aaaah!<W> Ne-<W>ne o seyler?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M3/1/1>They look like mechanical mummies of some
kind. Perhaps the guardians of the ruins
coming to greet us?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bir tur mekanik mumyaya benziyorlar.
Belki de harabelerin bekcileri,
bizi karsilamaya geliyorlardir?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I'd say I'm not terribly keen on this kind of
greeting.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bu tur bir karsilamaya pek de bayildigimi
soyleyemem.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Hershel, you have that shovel. Try to dig
holes and make those mummies fall into
them.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hershel, o kurek sende. Cukurlar kazmayi dene
ve su mumyalarin onlarin icine
dusmesini sagla.

original: <T>What about you?
translation: <T>Peki ya sen?

original:
<T>Don't worry about me! I'll dash to the switch
on the right, and you make your way to the
one on the left.
translation:
<T>Benim icin endiselenme! Sagdaki dugmeye
kosacagim, sen de
soldakine dogru yol al.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Right! I made it! Hershel, you get to the
other switch.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Tamam! Basardim! Hershel, sen
oteki dugmeye git.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>I know. Give me a moment!
translation: <T>Biliyorum. Bana bir saniye ver!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>We got through in one piece!
translation: <T>Tek parca halinde gectik!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Phew! This place is rather more closely
guarded than I imagined.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Uff! Burasi dusundugumden cok daha siki
korunuyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yes, we'll have to be on our toes from now
on.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet, bundan sonra tetikte olmamiz gerekecek
gorunuyor.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Ack! The way is blocked by a mummy. What
should I do?
translation:
<T>Ah! Yol bir mumya tarafindan kapatilmis. Ne
yapmaliyim?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Hey! Use the shovel to dig a hole. Then try
to lure the mummy into the hole.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Hey! Kurekle bir cukur kaz. Sonra
mumya'yi cukura cekmeye calis.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Hershel, watch out! There's a mummy
closing in on you! Dig a hole in the ground
and make it fall in.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Hershel, dikkat et! Uzerine dogru gelen bir mumya
var! Yere bir cukur kaz
ve icine dusmesini sagla.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>How deep do these ruins go, I wonder?
translation: <T>Bu harabeler ne kadar derine iniyor acaba?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/2/1>They must be vast. Akbadain isn't legendary
for nothing!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Kesinlikle cok genis olmali. Akbadain
bosuna efsane olmadi!

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>What if they go on and on for a hundred
floors or something? What do we do then?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ya yuz kat falan daha asagiya
devam ederse? O zaman ne yapariz?

original:
<T><M1/1/4>Uh...<W> I-I hadn't... <W30><M4/2/2/45>Well, let's worry about
that when we come to it, shall we?
translation:
<T><M1/1/4>Sey...<W> B-Ben... <W30><M4/2/2/45>Neyse, gelince
onu dusunuruz, olur mu?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Hey, Randall, look. There's a boulder in our
path.
translation:
<T>Hey, Randall, bak. Yolumuzda kocaman bir
kaya var.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T><M1/1/1>Oh, blast! What shall we do?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Ah, kahretsin! Ne yapacagiz?

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Hmm, it looks heavy, but on the other hand,
it's round, so...maybe we can push it and
roll it out of the way?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Hmm, agir gorunuyor ama ote yandan
yuvarlak, yani...belki itip
yuvarlayarak yolumuzdan cikarabiliriz?

original:
<T><M4/2/2>Well, it's certainly worth a shot! Let's try it
out.
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Denemeye kesinlikle deger! Hadi
deneyelim.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>When standing in front of a boulder, touch
<CR>Push</CR> on the Touch Screen to push the
boulder away.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bir kayanin onunde dururken, Dokunmatik Ekran'da
<CR>Push</CR> secenegine dokunarak
kayayi uzaga it.

original:
<T>You've probably guessed this already, but
you can also push boulders by pressing the
<CR>A Button</CR>.
translation:
<T>Muhtemelen bunu zaten tahmin ettin ama
<CR>A Button</CR>'a basarak kayalari
itebilirsin.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Come on, try it!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Hadi, dene!

original: <T>Well, are you just going to give up?
translation: <T>E, pes mi edeceksin yani?

original:
<T>Stand in front of the boulder and either
touch <CR>Push</CR> or press the <CR>A Button</CR>.
translation:
<T>Kayanin onune gecip ya
<CR>Push</CR>'a dokun ya da <CR>A Button</CR>'a bas.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T><M2/2/1>Oooh! It worked!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Ooo! Ise yaradi!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M3/1/1>That was easy. Why did we even worry?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Bu cok kolaydi. Neden endiselenmisiz ki?

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Great! From now on, if we find boulders in
our path, we'll just shove them out of the
way.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Harika! Bundan sonra yolumuzda kayalar
bulursak, onlari hic dusunmeden
kenara iteriz.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>You know, Hershel, I have a feeling this
room is going to be rather tricky to get
through.
translation:
<T>Biliyor musun, Hershel, bu odadan gecmek
oldukca zor olacak gibi
hissediyorum.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1>There's a gap in the floor! And it's far too
wide to jump.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Yerde bir bosluk var! Hem de atlamak icin
fazlasiyla genis.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Hang on a sec. Why don't we just use that
boulder to make a path? Another puzzle
solved!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bir saniye dur. Neden su kayayi kullanip
bir yol yapmiyoruz? Bir bulmaca daha
cozuldu!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Ha ha ha. I think you're enjoying this,
Randall. Anyway, I'm game if you are.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ha ha ha. Sanirim bundan zevk aliyorsun,
Randall. Neyse, sen varsan ben de varim.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>You can use boulders as stepping stones to
reach previously inaccessible places.
translation:
<T>Kayalari basamak tasi gibi kullanarak daha once
ulasilamayan yerlere erisebilirsin.

original:
<T>If you find yourself stuck, touch <CR>Restart</CR>
at the bottom right of the Touch Screen to
return everything to its original position.
translation:
<T>Takilirsan, <CR>Yeniden Baslat</CR>
Dokunmatik Ekranin sag alt kosesine dokunarak
her seyi ilk konumuna geri dondurebilirsin.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Brilliant! We can just walk over the boulder
now.
translation:
<T>Harika! Artik kayanin uzerinden yuruyup
gecebiliriz.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M5/1/1>So boulders have their uses too... Let's
keep it in mind.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Demek kayalarin da ise yaradigi oluyor... Bunu
aklimizda tutalim.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Onwards, then!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>O halde devam!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Oh no, the mummies are back! What
a stubborn lot.
translation:
<T>Ah hayir, mumyalar geri dondu! Ne
inatci herifler.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hey, here's a thought. How about pushing
boulders into the mummies? That should
deal with them.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hey, bir fikir: Kayalari
mumyalarin ustune itsek? Bu onlari
halleder.

original:
<T>When a mummy is in your way, just push a
boulder into it or dig a hole for it to fall into.
translation:
<T>Bir mumya yolunu keserse, uzerine bir
kaya it ya da dusecegi bir cukur kaz.

original: <T><M4/1/2>Good luck, Hersh!
translation: <T><M4/1/2>Bol sans, Hersh!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Don't worry about me, Hershel. You focus
on dropping those mummies into holes and
bowling them over.
translation:
<T>Benim icin endiselenme, Hershel. Sen
o mumyalari cukurlara dusurmeye ve
yuvarlayip devirmeye odaklan.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>I'm on it.
translation: <T>Hallederim.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Nicely done, Hersh. Keep this up and we'll
get to the heart of the ruins in no time!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Iyi is, Hersh. Boyle devam edersek
harabelerin kalbine hemen ulasiriz!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Let's not get too cocky. There might be
more nasty surprises ahead.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Cok da havaya girmeyelim. Ileride
baska kotu surprizler olabilir.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>You worry too much. Just like your mother.
Be positive, like me: together, you and I can
do anything!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Cok fazla endiseleniyorsun. Tipki annen gibi.
Benim gibi olumlu ol: sen ve ben birlikte
her seyi yapabiliriz!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>Look, there's a puzzle in here!
translation: <T>Bak, burada bir bulmaca var!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Wow, there are all sorts of things buried in
these ruins.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Vay canina, bu harabelerin altinda ne cok sey
gomulu.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Well, you dug it up, so you have to solve
it!<M1/6/1>
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ee, onu sen cikardin; o zaman cozmek de
senin isin!<M1/6/1>

original: <T><M1/2/1>Wait, what? Are you serious?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Dur, ne? Ciddi misin?

original:
<T>What kind of civilisation buries puzzles?
I'm just going to put it back where I
found it.
translation:
<T>Hangi uygarlik bulmaca gomer ki?
Ben bunu buldugum yere
geri koyacagim.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Maybe I can solve it this time...
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Belki bu sefer cozebilirim...

original:
<T>This is why archaeology is so brilliant. You
never know what you'll find!
translation:
<T>Arkeoloji bu yuzden harika. Ne bulacagini
asla bilemezsin!

original: <T>Yes, well, shall we go on?
translation: <T>Evet, peki, devam edelim mi?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M4/2/2>We're on the third level down now. It's
really starting to feel other-worldly.
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Simdi ucuncu kata indik. Burasi
gercekten de insani baska bir dunyadaymis gibi hissettiriyor.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Have we much further to go, though?
I never told my parents I was going with you.
They're going to get worried...
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Peki daha ne kadar gidecegiz?
Aileme seninle gittigimi hic soylemedim.
Meraklanacaklar...

original:
<T><M1/1/4>Your mother certainly will...<W><M1/2/1>but at least your
father understands the spirit of the explorer!
translation:
<T><M1/1/4>Annen kesinlikle meraklanir...<W><M1/2/1>ama en azindan
baban kasif ruhunu anliyor!

original:
<T><M2/2/4>All my father ever says to me is to stop
wasting time on {''}foolish{''} adventures and
study hard to take over the estate.
translation:
<T><M2/2/4>Babamin bana soyledigi tek sey,
{''}aptalca{''} maceralarla vakit kaybetmeyi birakip
mulku devralmak icin cok calismam.

original:
<T>Now even Angela is turning against me.
Henry is the only one who supports my
archaeological ambitions!
translation:
<T>Simdi Angela bile bana karsi donuyor.
Arkeolojik hedeflerimi destekleyen tek kisi
Henry!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>They're all worried about you, Randall. They
don't want you running off and putting
yourself in danger. <W>Nor do I.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hepsi senin icin endiseleniyor, Randall. Senin
kacip gidip kendini tehlikeye atmani
istemiyorlar. <W>Ben de istemiyorum.

original: <T><M2/1/1>It's a bit late now, of course...<M1/1/1>
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Tabii artik biraz gec...<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M4/4/3>You couldn't have stopped me anyway! This
trip is going to make me famous and launch
my archaeological career!
translation:
<T><M4/4/3>Zaten beni durduramazdin! Bu
yolculuk beni unlu edecek ve
arkeoloji kariyerimi baslatacak!

original:
<T>If you get stuck anywhere, just ask me and
I'll do what I can to help.
translation:
<T>Bir yerde takilirsan, bana sor yeter;
yardim edebildigim kadar ederim.

original: <T><M2/4/3>We can do this, Hersh! Come on!
translation: <T><M2/4/3>Bunu basaririz, Hersh! Hadi!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Look, this whole patch of ground is glowing.
Quick, dig here, Hersh!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bak, su toprak parcasinin tamami parliyor.
Cabuk, burada kaz, Hersh!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M1/2/1>Hang on a moment...<W> Do you...hear that?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Bir dakika...<W> Sunu...duydun mu?

original: <T><M1/1/1>Yes... Wh-what is it?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Evet... Ne-ne... ne bu?

original: <T>Argh!
translation: <T>Aaah!

original: <T>Run! Run!
translation: <T>Kos! Kos!

original: <T>Ph...phew! That was close.
translation: <T>Oh... of! Az kalsin!

original:
<T>Blimey! These ruins are not for the faint of
heart.
translation:
<T>Vay canina! Bu harabeler
odleklere gore degil.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Ha ha! That's why it's an adventure!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Ha ha! Zaten macera da bu yuzden!

original:
<T>Thrilled by a brush with death...<W><M1/1/1> You have
guts, Randall, I'll give you that.
translation:
<T>Olumle burun buruna gelmek seni heyecanlandiriyor...<W><M1/1/1> Cesursun,
Randall, hakkini teslim edeyim.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Heh. It's okay to admit you're having fun,
Hersh.<W> Come on, let's pick up the pace.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Heh. Eglendigini kabul etmekte sorun yok,
Hersh.<W> Hadi, biraz hizlanalim.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>Oh! A puzzle!
translation: <T>Ah! Bir bulmaca!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Gosh. What kind of puzzle is that?
translation: <T>Vay be. Bu ne tur bir bulmaca?

original:
<T>These ancient puzzles are a challenge,
aren't they? Maybe we'd better bury this
one again.
translation:
<T>Bu eski bulmacalar zorlayici,
degil mi? Belki bunu
yeniden gommeliyiz.

original: <T><M4/2/2>Right then, this time I'm going to crack it!
translation: <T><M4/2/2>Pekala, bu sefer cozecegim!

original:
<T>That puzzle was very apropos. The Azran
people must have liked their puzzles.
translation:
<T>Bu bulmaca tam yerindeydi. Azran
insanlari bulmacalari seviyor olmali.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Just like me! Clearly, we were destined for
each other, the Azran civilisation and I.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Tipki benim gibi! Belli ki Azran uygarligiyla
ben birbirimiz icin yaratilmisiz.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>I don't think destiny had anything to do with
it...
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Kaderin bununla pek ilgisi oldugunu
sanmiyorum...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Here we go again! You know, I'm starting to
get fond of these mouldering menaces.
translation:
<T>Yine basliyoruz! Biliyor musun, su curumus
tehditlere isinmaya basladim.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1>There's something different this time,
though.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ama bu sefer farkli bir sey var,
sanki.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>You mean the red one?<W> Hmm, maybe that's
what the myths meant by {''}Crimson Furies{''}...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Kirmizi olani mi diyorsun?<W> Himm, belki de
mitlerin {''}Crimson Furies{''} derken kastettigi buydu...

original: <T><M4/1/2>You'd better be on your guard, Hersh.
translation: <T><M4/1/2>Dikkatli olsan iyi olur, Hersh.

original: <T><M1/1/1>I could say the same to you, you know.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Aynisini sana da soyleyebilirim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>The red mummy is faster than the others,
so keep a close eye on it. <W>Ready?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Kirmizi mumya digerlerinden daha hizli,
o yuzden gozunu ustunden ayirma. <W>Hazir misin?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Hey, Hershel! I'm safe now! Get rid of the
mummies by digging holes and rolling
boulders.
translation:
<T>Hey, Hershel! Artik guvendeyim! Cukurlar
kazarak ve kayalari yuvarlayarak
mumyalari ortadan kaldir.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>I know, I know.
translation: <T>Biliyorum, biliyorum.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M4/2/2>Hah! How exhilarating! This is how every
expedition should be!
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Hah! Ne heyecan verici! Her
sefer boyle olmali!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>It's certainly exciting, but on the whole I
think I prefer somewhat quieter trips, myself.
translation:
<T>Elbette heyecanli, ama genel olarak ben
daha sakin gezileri tercih ederim.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Come now, Hershel, without a bit of danger,
you never really feel alive.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Hadi ama, Hershel, biraz tehlike olmadan
insan gercekten yasadigini hissetmez.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>And I think you're starting to enjoy the
danger, too. You can't fool me.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bence sen de tehlikeden keyif almaya
basliyorsun. Beni kandiramazsin.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>Ah, blocked again.
translation: <T>Ah, yine kapali.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Yes...
translation: <T>Evet...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>There's a switch and...a lever. Strange...<W>
Presumably, we'll need to use both.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bir dugme ve... bir kol var. Tuhaf...<W>
Muhtemelen ikisini de kullanmamiz gerekecek.

original: <T><K>Hmm.</K>
translation: <T><K>Hmm.</K>

original:
<T><M3/1/1>The real problem is, how do we get up
there? Both the switch and the lever seem
to be out of reach.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Asil sorun, oraya nasil cikacagiz?
Dugme de kol da
ulasilamayacak kadar yukarida.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Whoa! A boulder just came crashing down!
Maybe we can use that to get to the lever.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Vay canina! Az once bir kaya gurultuyle dustu!
Belki bunu kola ulasmak icin kullanabiliriz.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/4>What's got into you? Would you stop
uttering monosyllabic grunts and help me
out here?
translation:
<T><M3/1/4>Sana ne oldu? Tek heceli homurtular
cikarmayi birakip bana
burada yardim eder misin?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original: <T><M4/2/2>Brilliant! We can get through now!
translation: <T><M4/2/2>Harika! Artik gecebiliriz!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>We're deep in the bowels of the earth now.
<W>I wish Henry could have come with us. He'd
have loved it down here.
translation:
<T>Simdi yerin derinliklerine indik.
<W>Keske Henry de bizimle gelebilseydi. Buralari
cok severdi.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Henry had to stay behind to perform his
duties and cover our escape - you said so
yourself.
translation:
<T>Henry gorevlerini yerine getirmek ve kacisimizi
ortbas etmek icin geride kalmak zorundaydi; bunu
sen soyledin.

original:
<T><M3/1/4>He used to go everywhere with me, but all
that changed when my father decided to
train him up as a butler...
translation:
<T><M3/1/4>Eskiden benimle her yere gelirdi ama babam onu
bir usak olarak yetistirmeye karar verince
her sey degisti...

original:
<T><M3/2/1>He's so keen. He left school to focus on his
training, didn't he? I've never had much of
a chance to talk to him.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Cok hevesli. Egitimine odaklanmak icin okulu
a birakti, degil mi? Onunla konusma
firsatim pek olmadi.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>My father really took to Henry. He's clever,
hard-working, obedient - all the qualities my
father values.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Babam Henry'yi gercekten benimsedi. Zeki,
caliskan, itaatkar; babamin deger verdigi tum
ozellikler onda var.

original:
<T><M1/1/4>Not like me. My father never valued anything
that I...<W30>that I...
translation:
<T><M1/1/4>Benim gibi degil. Babam hicbir zaman
benim...<W30> benim...

original: <T><M1/2/1>Randall...
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Randall...

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Well, at least you're here, Hersh! And we
can take back the wild tales of our
incredible adventures.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Neyse ki buradasin, Hersh! Ve
inanilmaz maceralarimizin
efsane hikayelerini geri goturebiliriz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Absolutely! We have to find something
amazing, if only for Henry and Angela's
sake.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Kesinlikle! Henry ve Angela'nin
hatiri icin bile olsa, muhtesem bir sey
bulmaliyiz.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Let's press on then, shall we?
translation: <T><M4/2/1>O halde devam edelim, olur mu?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Whoa, the room ahead looks enormous! It
must contain something interesting. <W><M4/2/1>Let's go
and see!
translation:
<T>Vay canina, ilerideki oda devasa gorunuyor! Kesin
ilginc bir sey vardir. <W><M4/2/1>Hadi gidip
bakalim!

original: <T>Huh?
translation: <T>Ha?

original: <T>Come on, let's keep moving.
translation: <T>Hadi, yurumeye devam edelim.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Wow... What's all this? They look like some
kind of crystal.
translation:
<T>Vay... Bunlar da ne? Bir cesit
kristale benziyorlar.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>What, those blue things? <W><M1/3/4>Mmm, I don't think
they're worth much, you know.
translation:
<T>Su mavi seyler mi? <W><M1/3/4>Hmm, sanmiyorum ki
pek bir degeri olsun.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Valuable or not, they're very pretty. <W>But
they're blocking the way. How are we going
to get past?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Degerli olsun olmasin, cok guzeller. <W>Ama
yolu kapatiyorlar. Nasil
gececegiz?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Let's try shattering them with a well-aimed
boulder. It can't be harder than smashing
through those mummies.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Onlari iyi nisanlanmis bir kayayla parcalamayi deneyelim.
Bu, o mumyalari
parcalayip gecmekten daha zor olamaz.

original:
<T><M4/3/4>Blast! This isn't working. I think it needs
a bit of momentum to break through the
crystal.
translation:
<T><M4/3/4>Kahretsin! Bu ise yaramiyor. Sanirim
kristali kirmak icin biraz
ivmeye ihtiyacimiz var.

original:
<T>We need to set the boulder rolling? <W><M5/1/1>Hey,
wait! I think we can do it, Randall.
translation:
<T>Kayayi yuvarlamamiz mi gerekiyor? <W><M5/1/1>Hey,
dur! Sanirim basarabiliriz, Randall.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T><M4/2/1>Hah! Tiresome Crystal, you are defeated!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Hah! Sikici Kristal, yenildin!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>That was...quite effective.
translation: <T>Bu... oldukca etkiliydi.

original: <T><M1/2/1>See, try and you'll be rewarded!
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Gordun mu, denersen karsiligini alirsin!

original:
<T>With the right attitude, you can overcome
anything! And if you ever do get stuck, just
ask me for advice.
translation:
<T>Dogru bir tutumla her seyin ustesinden
gelebilirsin! Takilirsan da
benden tavsiye iste yeter.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>What's this? A suitcase of some sort?
translation: <T>Bu da ne? Bir tur bavul mu?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Hey, something's fallen out of it. Stone
blocks, I think. There's something written
in here too...
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hey, icinden bir sey dusmus. Sanirim tas
bloklar. Icinde yazili bir sey
de var...

original:
<T>Oh, crumbs. We have to close this case, or
who knows what might happen?
translation:
<T>Eyvah. Bu sandigi kapatmaliyiz yoksa
kim bilir neler olur?

original:
<T>So we have to get all the stone blocks back
into the case, am I correct?
translation:
<T>Yani tum tas bloklari tekrar sandiga
koymamiz gerekiyor, dogru mu?

original:
<T>Who would leave something like that buried
here? These ruins hold some nasty
surprises!
translation:
<T>Kim boyle bir seyi buraya gomer?
Bu harabeler gercekten de kotu
surprizlerle dolu!

original:
<T>Definitely! All that talk of a curse - do you
think there's something in it?
translation:
<T>Kesinlikle! Su lanet muhabbeti...
sence bunda bir gercek payi var mi?

original: <T>Hmm... It's probably noth-<W><M1/1/4> Argh!
translation: <T>Hmm... Muhtemelen bir sey degi-<W><M1/1/4> Aaah!

original: <T><M2/2/1>Hey, what's wrong?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Hey, ne oldu?

original:
<T>Look! Blood! I must have cut my finger on
one of the blocks.<M3/1/4> Do you think that was
the curse...?
translation:
<T>Bak! Kan! Parmami
bloklardan birine kesmis olmaliyim.<M3/1/4> Sence bu
lanet miydi...?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Surely not... Still, I suppose it's just as well
we broke it.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sanmam... Yine de, her halukarda
bozmamiz iyi oldu.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>What's going on with this door? There are
about a dozen keys. How do we know
which one to use?
translation:
<T>Bu kapiya ne oluyor? Burada
bir duzine kadar anahtar var. Hangisini
kullanacagimizi nereden bilecegiz?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Nonsense, Randall, there are only five - and
look, this plaque probably shows us which
one to use.
translation:
<T>Sacmalama, Randall, sadece bes tane var - ve
bak, bu plaka muhtemelen hangisini
kullanacagimizi gosteriyor.

original:
<T>Argh. They all look the same to me! Is there
really only one that works?
translation:
<T>Ahh! Bana hepsi ayni gorunuyor! Gercekten
sadece biri mi ise yariyor?

original:
<T>We're not going any further until we find the
right key, so...
translation:
<T>Dogru anahtari bulana kadar ileri
gitmiyoruz, yani...

original: <T><M2/2/1>I have it, Hershel! This is the key!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Buldum, Hershel! Iste anahtar bu!

original:
<T>There we go, one door opened. <W>Well, that
was a bit of an anticlimax. What a faff just
to open a door!
translation:
<T>Iste oldu, bir kapi acildi. <W>Sey, bu da
biraz hayal kirikligiydi. Sirf bir kapiyi
acmak icin ne ugras!

original:
<T>Don't you see? That made a boring door
into a mysterious door!<W><M4/4/3> The Azran had a real
sense of dramatic build-up.
translation:
<T>Gormuyor musun? Sikici bir kapiyi
gizemli bir kapiya donusturdu!<W><M4/4/3> Azranlarin
kademeli dram konusunda ciddi bir zevki varmis.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Look at the mummies over there! We've not
seen any like that before. <W>Hang on, are
those...?
translation:
<T>Suradaki mumyalara bak! Daha once hic
boylesini gormemistik. <W>Bir dakika, onlar
da ne...?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>What? Do you know what they are?
translation: <T>Ne? Ne olduklarini biliyor musun?

original:
<T><M2/1/4>No, but have you seen what they've got on
their backs?<W30> Giant spikes! <W>I wouldn't like to
get too close to them!
translation:
<T><M2/1/4>Hayir ama sirtlarindaki seyi gordun mu?
<W30> Kocaman dikenler! <W>Onlara cok fazla
yaklasmak istemem!

original: <T>Pfff!
translation: <T>Puf!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I get the impression that even if you drop
one of those mummies in a hole, its spikes
are still going to be sticking out...
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sanki o mumyalardan birini bir cukura dusursen bile,
dikenleri yine disarida kalacak gibi
geliyor...

original:
<T><M4/2/1>You mean, wherever I bury a blue mummy,
its spikes will block the path? Hmm...
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Yani mavi bir mumyayi nereye gomersem
dikenleri yolu mu kapatacak? Hmm...

original:
<T>We've established that whenever a blue
mummy falls into a hole, its spikes will
stick out, blocking the way.
translation:
<T>Mavi bir mumya bir cukura dustugunde,
dikenlerinin disari cikip yolu
kapattigini anladik.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>If you can't find a way to bury them, just try
to avoid them. Your main aim is to safely
reach the switch!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Onlari gommek icin bir yol bulamazsan,
ondan kacinmaya calis. Asil amacin guvenle
anahtara ulasmak!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Hersh, I'm there! Watch out for the spiky
fellows and dig wisely, so you don't cut off
the way.
translation:
<T>Hersh, geldim! Dikenli
seylere dikkat et ve akillica kaz, yoksa
yolu kapatirsin.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>All right, Randall. I know what I'm doing.
translation: <T>Tamam, Randall. Ne yaptigimi biliyorum.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Wow, that was a trifle scary. We'd better
keep our wits about us or we'll be worm
food.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Vay, bu biraz urkutucuydu. Aklimizi basimizda
tutalim yoksa solucanlara
yem oluruz.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1>You've only started thinking that now? What
do you think I've been doing all this time?
Staying safe is our top priority.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bunu ancak simdi mi dusunuyorsun? Sence ben
bunca zamandir ne yapiyordum?
Guvende kalmak en buyuk onceligimiz.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Yours, perhaps.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Seninkini, belki.

original:
<T>I don't know what awaits us, but I enjoy the
thrill of it, the mystery! You can't be a real
explorer without that thrill.
translation:
<T>Bizi neyin bekledigini bilmiyorum ama
heyecanini, gizemini seviyorum! O heyecan
olmadan gercek bir kasif olamazsin.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>We're not archaeologists! We're just kids!
Didn't you say this was the last time you'd
go exploring, anyway?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Biz arkeolog degiliz! Sadece cocuguz!
Zaten bunun kesfe ciktigin son sefer oldugunu
soylememis miydin?

original:
<T>So what? It's now that matters. You have to
live in the now! <W><M2/2/2>Come on.
translation:
<T>Eee ne olmus? Onemli olan simdi. Simdide
yasamalisin! <W><M2/2/2>Hadi.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>We're really getting deep down now. What
level is this?
translation:
<T>Epey derinlere indik. Bu
kacinci seviye?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>By my count, we're on the sixth floor down.
translation: <T>Benim saydigima gore, altinci kata indik.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Right, right. <W>We must be getting close to the
Azran ancestral treasure now.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Evet, evet. <W>Azran atalarinin hazinesine
yaklasiyor olmaliyiz.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Do you really think we're going to find it in
a place so huge?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Boylesine buyuk bir yerde gercekten
bulacagimizi mi dusunuyorsun?

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Hey, you're not losing your nerve now, are
you?
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Hey, simdi cesaretini kaybetmiyorsun,
degil mi?

original:
<T>I don't want to stop at the Mask of Chaos.
There's more, much more to be found!
translation:
<T>Kaos Maskesi'yle yetinmek istemiyorum.
Daha fazlasi, cok daha fazlasi var!

original:
<T><M4/2/2>I'm going to find treasure that not even
Rutledge could conceive. I'll be a legend
among archaeologists!
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Rutledge'in bile hayal edemeyecegi hazineleri
bulacagim. Arkeologlar arasinda
bir efsane olacagim!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>That's my dream, my true dream.<W> Don't you
understand?
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Iste benim hayalim, gercek hayalim.<W> Anlamiyor musun?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>I don't know. I keep telling you, I don't even
like archaeology that much...
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bilmiyorum. Sana hep soyluyorum; arkeolojiyi
o kadar da sevmiyorum...

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Listen. This must remain a secret, but...
<W>once I'm a bona fide archaeologist, I intend
to ask Angela to marry me.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Dinle. Bu sir olarak kalmali ama...
<W>Gercek bir arkeolog oldugumda,
Angela'ya evlenme teklif etmeyi dusunuyorum.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>So please, please help me make this
expedition a success.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>O yuzden lutfen, lutfen bu
seferi basariya ulastirmama yardim et.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I suppose I can't argue with that.<W> Well then,
let's go and find treasure!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sanirim buna karsi cikamam.<W> O halde,
hadi gidip hazineyi bulalim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>What's this? The path splits here...
translation: <T>Bu da ne? Yol burada ikiye ayriliyor...

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>I think we should go right.
translation: <T>Bence sagdan gitmeliyiz.

original: <T>Really? I think left would be better.
translation: <T>Gercekten mi? Bence soldan gitmek daha iyi.

original: <T>Randall, watch out!
translation: <T>Randall, dikkat et!

original: <T><M5/1/1>Wh-wh-wh-<W><M1/1/1>what was that?!
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Ne-ne-ne-<W><M1/1/1> neydi o?!

original: <T>Randall? Are you all right?
translation: <T>Randall? Iyi misin?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Y-yes... <W>I'm... <W30>I'm seemingly unscathed.
That was close, though. Are you okay,
Hersh?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>E-evet... <W>Ben... <W30>gorunuse gore yara almadim.
Ama az kalsin oluyordu. Sen iyi misin,
Hersh?

original: <T><M1/1/1>Yes, I'm fine.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Evet, ben iyiyim.

original: <T>Blast! The way's completely blocked now.
translation: <T>Kahretsin! Yol artik tamamen kapandi.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>What shall we do? Do you want me to go
and get help?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ne yapacagiz? Istersen gidip
yardim getireyim mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>No, it's okay. I'll just go down this path. It
should connect with your path at some
point.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hayir, sorun degil. Ben su yoldan gidecegim. Bu yol
bir noktada senin yoluna
baglanmali.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>But Hersh, be careful, won't you? You'd
better be at the other end of this path, you
hear me?
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Ama Hersh, dikkatli ol, olur mu? Bu yolun
obur ucunda olsan iyi olur,
duydun mu?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>All right... <W>It's a deal. I'll see you at the
other end, then.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Peki... <W>Anlastik. O zaman yolun
obur ucunda gorusuruz.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>I should run into Randall somewhere along
this path. I can't go home on my own,
anyway...
translation:
<T>Bu yolun bir yerlerinde Randall'a rastlamaliyim.
Zaten tek basima eve
gidemem...

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>There's no way past these obtrusive
crystals. <W>What to do, what to do...
translation:
<T>Bu inatci kristallerin yanindan gecmenin
hic yolu yok. <W>Ne yapsak, ne yapsak...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>Hey, Hershel!
translation: <T>Hey, Hershel!

original: <T><M1/1/1>Randall? Thank goodness!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Randall? Cok sukur!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Good to see you're in one piece, Hersh.
Stand back! I'm going to use this boulder to
clear away the crystals!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Seni saglam gormek guzel, Hersh.
Geri cekil! Bu kayayi kullanip
kristalleri temizleyecegim!

original:
<T>There you go. You can get through now. Go
on, then - I'll help you from up here.
translation:
<T>Iste boyle. Artik gecebilirsin. Hadi
oyleyse - ben de buradan yardim ederim.

original: <T>Understood!
translation: <T>Anlasildi!

original:
<T>Hershel! I'll deal with these crystals. You
focus on moving forwards!
translation:
<T>Hershel! Ben bu kristallerle ugrasacagim. Sen
ilerlemeye odaklan!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original: <T>Hershel!
translation: <T>Hershel!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I can use this boulder to take out the
mummies! Head for the door and try to get
them lined up in front of me on the way.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu kayayi kullanip
mumyalardan kurtulabilirim! Kapiya dogru git ve
yolda onlari onumde siraya dizmeye calis.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>These lumbering stooges are no match for
a well-aimed boulder.
translation:
<T>Bu hantal budalalar, iyi nisan alinmis bir kayaya
karsi koyamaz.

original: <T><M4/2/2>Hah! Bullseye! Excellent work, partner!
translation: <T><M4/2/2>Hah! Tam isabet! Harika is, dostum!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>Watch out!
translation: <T>Dikkat et!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Phew... <W>That was a nasty surprise. Thank
you, Randall!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Of... <W>Bu kotu bir surprizdi. Tesekkur
ederim, Randall!

original: <T><M1/2/1>Don't mention it! I've always got your back!
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Lafi bile olmaz! Ben her zaman arkandayim!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>However, we're still left with a bit of a
poser. We need two people to press the
two switches at once...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama hala kucuk bir sorun var.
Iki anahtara ayni anda basmak icin iki kisiye
ihtiyacimiz var...

original:
<T>I'd take the second switch if I could get
down there, but this drop is rather
uninviting... <W>What could we do?
translation:
<T>Asagi inebilsem ikinci anahtari ben alirdim ama bu
inis hic de davetkar degil...
<W>Ne yapabiliriz?

original: <T><M3/2/1>Hey, I've got it!
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Hey, buldum!

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Critical thinking is the key to success,
Hersh. We need to make the ruins work for
us!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Basarinin anahtari dogru dusunmektir,
Hersh. Harabeleri kendi lehimize
kullanmaliyiz!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Push the boulder onto one of the switches.
It's at least double my weight, so it can
stand there in my stead.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Kayayi anahtarlardan birinin ustune it.
En az iki katim agirliginda; bu yuzden benim
yerime orada durabilir.

original: <T>Ah, good thinking!
translation: <T>Ah, iyi fikir!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Hersh, you continue in that direction. I'm
going to see what's this way.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Hersh, sen o yonden devam et. Ben de
bu tarafta ne var bakacagim.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Come on, I'll be fine. I'm sure we'll find
each other again further along.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hadi, iyiyim ben. Eminim ileride
yeniden bulusuruz.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmm, you're probably right. Look after
yourself until then, won't you?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmm, muhtemelen haklisin. O zamana kadar
kendine dikkat eder misin?

original: <T><M3/1/1>You worry too much, Hersh. See you later!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Cok endiseleniyorsun, Hersh. Sonra gorusuruz!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Blimey! What's this massive pit doing here?
translation: <T>Vay canina! Bu kocaman cukurun burada ne isi var?

original:
<T><M4/2/1>It's pitch black down there. I don't like the
look of this at all.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Asagisi zifiri karanlik. Bu durumun
hic hosuma gittigi yok.

original: <T>Aahhh!
translation: <T>Aahhh!

original: <T>Well, that was clever. I dropped the shovel.
translation: <T>Eh, akillicaydi. Kuregi dusurdum.

original:
<T>I'll need to be careful not to become these
spiders' dinner.
translation:
<T>Su orumceklerin
aksam yemegi olmamak icin dikkatli olmaliyim.

original:
<T>There must be a safe spot for me to stand
in. Then I just bide my time, and snatch the
shovel at the right moment!
translation:
<T>Durabilecegim guvenli bir yer olmali.
Sonra da zamanimi bekleyip
kuregi dogru anda kaparim!

original:
<T>Phew! I got the shovel back and I'm still
alive!<W> I think I'd better not tempt fate any
more. Bye-bye, poisonous spiders!
translation:
<T>Oh be! Kuregi geri aldim ve hala
hayattayim!<W> Sanirim kaderi daha fazla zorlamasam
iyi. Hosca kalin, zehirli orumcekler!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>Hersheeeeel! Over here!
translation: <T>Hersheeeeel! Buraya!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Randall!
translation: <T>Randall!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Past this chamber, there's a way down to
the next level. Can you get over here?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu odanin otesinde bir sonraki kata inen
bir yol var. Buraya gelebilir misin?

original:
<T>Botheration... How can I get over to
Randall?
translation:
<T>Hay aksi... Randall'in yanina nasil
gidebilirim?

original:
<T>There must be something I can use to make
a path over there.
translation:
<T>Oraya bir yol olusturmak icin
kullanabilecegim bir sey olmali.

original: <T>Randall! Are you all right?
translation: <T>Randall! Iyi misin?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Hah! I'm set to become a famous
archaeologist. It'll take more than a few
traps to throw me! <W>What about you?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hah! Ben unlu bir
arkeolog olacagim. Beni alt etmek icin birkac
tuzak yetmez! <W>Ya sen?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Still standing. Things got a bit hairy on the
way, but I survived.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ayaktayim. Yolda isler biraz
sarpa sardi ama hayatta kaldim.

original:
<T>We both made it out unscathed! I'd call that
a pretty resounding success. <W><M4/2/1>All right! Down
we go...
translation:
<T>Ikimiz de yara almadan ciktik! Buna
oldukca buyuk bir basari derim. <W><M4/2/1>Pekala! Asagi
iniyoruz...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>That's the direction I came from. I can tell
you with certainty there's nothing of any
interest that way.
translation:
<T>Orasi geldigim yon. Kesinlikle soyleyebilirim ki
o tarafta ilgi cekici
hicbir sey yok.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>We're getting close to the Azran ancestral
treasure, Hersh! I can smell it!
translation:
<T>Azran atalarinin hazinesine yaklasiyoruz,
Hersh! Kokusunu aliyorum!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Well, it's lucky one of us has a nose for this
sort of thing. We're already pretty deep.
How much further is it?
translation:
<T>Eh, iyi ki birimizin boyle seylere burnu var.
Zaten epey derindeyiz.
Daha ne kadar var?

original: <T><M1/1/1>Don't tell me you're getting tired!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Sakin yoruldugunu soyleme!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Oh, no, it's not that.<W> It's just...it seems
unlikely that this place was built to live in.
But then what was its purpose?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Yok, yok, o degil.<W> Sadece...burasi
yasamak icin yapilmisa benzemiyor.
Peki o zaman amaci neydi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hmm, good question. A building this well
fortified and full of traps to repel intruders
must be protecting something.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hmm, iyi soru. Bu kadar iyi
tahkim edilmis ve davetsiz misafirleri uzak tutacak
tuzaklarla dolu bir yapi, mutlaka bir seyi koruyordur.

original:
<T>The traps will likely get bigger and nastier
the further we go, so don't hesitate to ask
me for help.
translation:
<T>Ne kadar ilerlersek tuzaklar o kadar
daha buyuk ve daha tehlikeli olacak; bu yuzden
yardima ihtiyacin olursa cekinme.

original:
<T>I won't. Whatever I may say, I do value your
advice, Randall.
translation:
<T>Cekinmem. Ne dersem diyeyim, senin
ogutlerine deger veriyorum, Randall.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>The hidden legacy of the Azran... What
manner of treasure could it be?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Azran'in gizli mirasi...
Nasil bir hazine olabilir ki?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Ack! I think I hit something!
translation: <T>Ah! Sanirim bir seye carptim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/2/1>This looks like an unusual puzzle. It's
almost as if the Azran left it here especially
for us!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bu sira disi bir bulmaca gibi gorunuyor. Sanki
Azranlar bunu ozellikle
bizim icin buraya birakmis!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>You've finally cracked! Leaving puzzles for
you, indeed.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Sonunda cildirdin! Sana bulmaca birakmislar,
oyle mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/2>The Azran thought up some real stumpers,
I must say!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Azranlar gercekten kafa karistiran seyler
dusunmus, dogrusu!

original:
<T>If we're not going to solve it, we should put
it back where we found it.
translation:
<T>Eger cozmeyeceksek, onu buldugumuz
yere geri koymaliyiz.

original:
<T>Right! Watch in awe as I solve the
intractable puzzle left for me by the Azran
people!
translation:
<T>Tamam! Azran
halkinin bana biraktigi bu
cetin bulmacayi cozerken hayranlikla izle!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>These ancient puzzles are fully intact
pieces of the Azran legacy. They must be
carefully documented and preserved!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bu kadim bulmacalar Azran mirasinin
sapasaglam parcalari. Dikkatle
kayit altina alinmali ve korunmali!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Then anybody could have a go at solving
them, couldn't they?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>O zaman herkes onlari cozmeyi deneyebilir,
degil mi?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/4/3>I wonder what the hidden hoard contains...
Mountains of gold and silver? Piles of
precious stones?
translation:
<T><M2/4/3>Gizli hazine acaba neler iceriyor...
Altin ve gumus daglari mi? Yiginla
degerli tas mi?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Well, if even you don't know, how do you
expect me to?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Sen bile bilmiyorsan, benden nasil
bilmemi beklersin?

original:
<T><M3/1/4>Ha ha! Good point. Sorry.<W> I'm just getting
excited as we get closer.
translation:
<T><M3/1/4>Ha ha! Haklisin. Pardon.<W> Yaklastikca
daha da heyecanlaniyorum.

original:
<T>Er, I'm not saying there really are a hundred
floors, but we could be only halfway there.
Doesn't that worry you?
translation:
<T>Yani, gercekten yuz kat var demiyorum ama
belki de daha yolun yarisindayiz.
Bu seni endiselendirmiyor mu?

original:
<T><M2/4/3>Hershel, we're exploring ancient and
mysterious ruins in the middle of the desert.
There's nowhere I'd rather be!
translation:
<T><M2/4/3>Hershel, colun ortasinda kadim ve
gizemli harabeleri kesfediyoruz.
Olmayi daha cok isteyecegim bir yer yok!

original:
<T>It feels as though these ruins have been
waiting for aeons just to be discovered by
me. <W>No, I'm not worried.
translation:
<T>Sanki bu harabeler caglar boyunca
ozellikle benim tarafimdan kesfedilmeyi
beklemis gibi. <W>Hayir, endiseli degilim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Yes, how kind of the Azran to design this
place just for you.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Evet, Azranlarin bu yeri sirf senin icin
tasarlamasi ne kadar nazikce.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>These are some top-notch ruins, really.
They're well stocked with puzzles.
translation:
<T>Bunlar gercekten birinci sinif harabeler.
Bulmacalarla dolu.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>You mean puzzles in ruins are a thing?
translation: <T>Yani harabelerde bulmaca olmasi normal mi?

original: <T>Of course. Now, give me a hand with this!
translation: <T>Elbette. Simdi suna bir el at!

original:
<T>Argh, I must still lack the skills to solve this
one!
translation:
<T>Ahh, demek ki bunu cozmek icin hala
yeterli degilim!

original:
<T>I'm going to solve it this time, Hersh. Just
you wait.
translation:
<T>Bu sefer cozecegim, Hersh. Sen
dur da gor.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>What an atmospheric puzzle! These ruins
are everything I could have wished for, and
more!
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Ne atmosferik bir bulmaca! Bu harabeler
hayal edebilecegim her sey,
hatta daha fazlasi!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Ugh, there are quite a lot of those bandaged
blighters here. <W>That means we're getting
close to our goal!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ugh, su sargili heriflerden burada epey var.
<W>Bu da hedefimize
yaklastigimiz anlamina gelir!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M1/2/1>How do you know that?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Bunu nereden biliyorsun?

original:
<T>It's just common sense, Hersh.<W> The heavier
the defences, the closer you are to the thing
being defended!
translation:
<T>Bu sadece sagduyu, Hersh.<W> Savunma ne kadar
sikiysa, korunan seye o kadar
yakinsindir!

original:
<T><M4/2/2>This isn't the time for questions, anyway.
Unless it's the question of how to get
through this room!
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Her halukarda simdi soru sorma zamani degil.
Soru, bu odadan nasil
gececegimizse baska!

original:
<T><M4/2/2>If you can't find a good spot to bury the
blue mummies, just avoid them as much as
possible.<W> Good luck!
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Mavi mumyalari gommek icin iyi bir yer
bulamazsan, mumkun oldugunca
onlardan kacin.<W> Iyi sanslar!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Hersh, I'm in position! Bury as many
mummies as you can, but watch the spikes!
translation:
<T>Hersh, pozisyondayim! Elinden geldigince cok
mumya gom, ama dikenlere dikkat et!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Don't worry, I know the drill.
translation: <T>Merak etme, ne yapacagimi biliyorum.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Phew! I don't know how, but we did it!
Hershel, you have the makings of a great
archaeologist in you!
translation:
<T>Oh be! Nasil oldu bilmiyorum ama basardik!
Hershel, sende harika bir
arkeolog olma potansiyeli var!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Well, I suppose there is a certain appeal...
But it's not really for me, Randall.
translation:
<T>Evet, cazip bir yani oldugu kesin...
Ama bana gore degil, Randall.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>What are you talking about? If you enjoy it,
that's all that matters. You could be my
partner!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ne diyorsun sen? Eger hosuna gidiyorsa,
onemli olan tek sey budur. Benim
ortagim olabilirsin!

original:
<T>This world contains so many puzzles just
waiting to be solved. We could have so
much fun working together!
translation:
<T>Bu dunyada cozulmeyi bekleyen o kadar cok
bulmaca var ki. Birlikte calisirken
cok eglenebiliriz!

original:
<T><M3/1/3>Ha ha! You make it seem as if anything is
possible. <W>But seriously, this is about as
much excitement as I can handle.
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>Ha ha! Sanki her sey mumkunmus gibi
anlatiyorsun. <W>Ama cidden, benim
kaldirabilecegim heyecan bu kadar.

original:
<T><M4/2/2>Oh, come on! Where's your spirit of
adventure, Hershel? We've survived so far,
haven't we?
translation:
<T><M4/2/2>Ah hadi ama! Macera ruhun nerede,
Hershel? Simdiye kadar hayatta kaldik,
degil mi?

original:
<T>In fact, what are we doing standing around?
Let's go!
translation:
<T>Hem zaten burada dikilip ne yapiyoruz?
Hadi gidelim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original: <T>Hm? The air feels different here...
translation: <T>Hmm? Buradaki hava farkli geliyor...

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Yes, there's a faint breeze, isn't there?
Maybe a nearby tunnel leads outside.
translation:
<T>Evet, hafif bir esinti var, degil mi?
Belki yakindaki bir tunel disari cikiyordur.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Let's find out. Off we go!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Ogrenelim bakalim. Hadi gidelim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original: <T><M4/2/1>Hang on a sec. Is this...?
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Bir saniye. Bu...?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Aaaah!
translation: <T>Aaaah!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original: [Not used]
translation: [Kullanilmiyor]

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>It's here.
translation: <T>Iste burada.

original: <T>The last door...
translation: <T>Son kapi...

original:
<T>Behind this door is the ancestral treasure of
the Azran.
translation:
<T>Bu kapinin arkasinda Azranlarin
atalardan kalma hazinesi var.

original: <T>The treasure Randall gave everything for...
translation: <T>Randall'in her seyini feda ettigi hazine...

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Randall... <W>You gave your life for this.
translation: <T>Randall... <W>Bunun icin hayatini verdin.

original: <T><M8/2/4>And what was it worth? <W30>Trinkets? <W30>Jewellery?
translation: <T><M8/2/4>Peki neye degdi? <W30>Uc bes sus esyasina mi? <W30>Mucevhere mi?

original:
<T>The long lost treasure of the Azran...<W>
It should have been yours.
translation:
<T>Azranlarin yitip gitmis hazinesi...<W>
Aslinda senin olmaliydi.

original: <T>I want no part of it.
translation: <T>Bunun hicbir parcasinda gozum yok.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<V0010><T><M8/2/3>Randall... <L1.75>I'm...<L3.05>I'm leaving Stansbury.
<L5.25>No more Azran. <L7.15>No more masks. <L8.45>It's...<L8.95>too
much for me.</V>
translation:
<V0010><T><M8/2/3>Randall... <L1.75>Ben...<L3.05>Stansbury'den ayriliyorum.
<L5.25>Artik Azran yok. <L7.15>Artik maske yok. <L8.45>Bu...<L8.95>benim icin
fazla.</V>

original:
<V0020><T><M9/2/3/45>I'll never forget you. <L2.3>I just need some...
<L3.95>distance from all this.</V>
translation:
<V0020><T><M9/2/3/45>Seni asla unutmayacagim. <L2.3>Sadece biraz...
<L3.95>bu her seyden uzakliga ihtiyacim var.</V>

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original: <V0030><T>Hershel. <L1.15>Are you ready?</V>
translation: <V0030><T>Hershel. <L1.15>Hazir misin?</V>

original: <V0040><T><M1/2/1>Almost. <L1.4>I <L1.85>just need a minute.</V>
translation: <V0040><T><M1/2/1>Neredeyse. <L1.4>Benim <L1.85>sadece bir dakikaya ihtiyacim var.</V>

original: <V0050><T><M2/1/3>Of course, dear.</V>
translation: <V0050><T><M2/1/3>Elbette, canim.</V>

original: <V0060><T>The carriage is ready when you are.</V>
translation: <V0060><T>Ne zaman hazirsan, fayton hazir.</V>
<V0070><T><M1/2/3>Tesekkur ederim.</V>

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
ランド、君との約束通りナゾは解いたよ。
君はあの宝を発見した者として
有名になりたかったのかい？
translation:
Rand, sana verdigim soz geregi bulmacayi cozdum.
O hazineyi kesfeden kisi olarak
unlu olmak mi istiyordun?

original:
悪いが、僕には興味がないんだ。
あの宝のことは僕と君だけの
秘密にしておこう。永遠にね。
translation:
Uzgunum ama benim ilgimi cekmiyor.
O hazineyi sadece ikimizin
sirri olarak saklayalim. Sonsuza dek.

original:
あれは君が命をかけて挑んだ、
君だけの宝だから…
translation:
O, senin canini ortaya koyarak pesine dustugun,
yalnizca sana ait bir hazineydi...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Every explorer gets lost occasionally. Touch
the map icon in the corner to check our
current location on the map.
translation:
<T>Her kasif ara sira kaybolur. Kosedeki harita simgesine
dokunarak
haritadaki su anki konumumuzu kontrol et.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Touch the arrows on the Touch Screen to
move in any direction. Hold the arrow down
to walk along without stopping.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Her yone hareket etmek icin Dokunmatik Ekran'daki
oklara dokun. Oku basili tutarsan
durmadan yurursun.

original:
<T>Ah yes, I almost forgot. You can also use
the <CR>+Control Pad</CR> or the <CR>Circle Pad</CR> to move.
<W>It's entirely up to you.
translation:
<T>Ah evet, az kalsin unutuyordum. Hareket etmek icin
<CR>+Control Pad</CR> ya da <CR>Circle Pad</CR> de kullanabilirsin.
<W>Tamamen sana kalmis.

original:
<T>Touch <CR>Dig Hole</CR> to dig a hole in front of you
with the shovel. You can only dig into earthy
ground, obviously.
translation:
<T>Onundeki yere kurekle cukur kazmak icin <CR>Dig Hole</CR>'a dokun.
Elbette sadece toprak
zeminde kazabilirsin.

original:
<T>When standing in front of a boulder, touch
<CR>Push</CR> on the Touch Screen to roll it away
from you.
translation:
<T>Bir kayanin onundeyken,
Dokunmatik Ekran'da <CR>Push</CR>'a dokunup onu
kendinden uzaga yuvarla.

original:
<T>You can also dig holes and push boulders
by pressing the <CR>A Button</CR>. <W>Just do what's
easiest for you.
translation:
<T><CR>A Button</CR> tusuna basarak da cukur kazip kayalari itebilirsin.
<W>Senin icin en
kolayi neyse onu yap.

original:
<T>That pretty much covers the basics of
exploring. You can review all this info
whenever you like.
translation:
<T>Kesfin temel
kurallari asagi yukari bu kadar. Bu bilgileri
istedigin zaman tekrar gozden gecirebilirsin.

original:
<T>When contending with mummies, use the
rotate arrows in the top corners of the
Touch Screen to turn on the spot.
translation:
<T>Mumyalarla ugrasirken,
Dokunmatik Ekran'in ust koselerindeki
kucuk dondurme oklarini kullanarak yerinde don.

original:
<T>You can also use the <CR>L Button</CR> and
<CR>R Button</CR> to turn, Hershel.
translation:
<T>Hershel, donmek icin <CR>L Button</CR> ve
<CR>R Button</CR> tuslarini da kullanabilirsin.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>To give up and retreat to the previous
chamber, touch <CR>Run!</CR> on the Touch Screen.
You can then try again.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Vazgecip onceki
odaya geri cekilmek icin Dokunmatik Ekran'da <CR>Run!</CR>'a dokun.
Sonra tekrar deneyebilirsin.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>I need to join up with Randall again as soon
as possible.
translation:
<T>Bir an once Randall'la
yeniden bulusmam gerek.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>We don't know what kind of traps and
perilous devices could be waiting for us.
Isn't it exciting? Let's move!
translation:
<T>Bizi ne tur tuzaklarin ve
tehlikeli duzeneklerin bekledigini bilmiyoruz.
Heyecan verici degil mi? Hadi gidelim!

original:
<T>Glowing patches of earth usually have
something of interest buried there. We
should definitely dig them up and see.
translation:
<T>Parlayan toprak parcalarinin altinda genelde
ilginc bir seyler gomuludur. Onlari
kesin kazip bakalim.

original:
<T>Activate switches on the floor by standing
on them. Simple!
translation:
<T>Yerdeki anahtarlari uzerlerine basarak
etkinlestir. Bu kadar basit!

original:
<T>However, the blue switches only work in
pairs. Both switches must be pressed at
once for them to have any effect.
translation:
<T>Ama mavi anahtarlar sadece
cift olarak calisir. Etki etmeleri icin
ikisine birden ayni anda basilmalidir.

original:
<T>This is a straightforward lever. Stand next to
it and touch <CR>Pull</CR> on the Touch Screen.
translation:
<T>Bu basit bir kaldirac. Yaninda dur
ve Dokunmatik Ekran'da <CR>Pull</CR>'a dokun.

original:
<T>You can also pull a lever by pressing the
<CR>A Button</CR>. <W>As you prefer.
translation:
<T><CR>A Button</CR> tusuna basarak da kaldirac cekebilirsin.
<W>Tercih senin.

original:
<T>These crystals blocking the way are
a nuisance! To clear them, roll a boulder
into them from a little way away.
translation:
<T>Yolu tikayan bu kristaller
tam bir bela! Temizlemek icin bir kayayi
biraz uzaktan uzerlerine dogru yuvarla.

original:
<T>Ah, the irksome mummies! Once activated,
they move when you move, but that also
means that if you do nothing, so will they.
translation:
<T>Ah, o sinir bozucu mumyalar! Bir kez etkinlesince,
sen hareket edince hareket ederler, ama bu ayni zamanda
sen hicbir sey yapmazsan onlarin da duracagi anlamina gelir.

original:
<T>The best way to deal with this foe is to dig
a hole and lure the mummy into it,
effectively burying it.
translation:
<T>Bu dusmanla basa cikmanin en iyi yolu
bir cukur kazip mumyayi icine cekmek,
yani onu fiilen gommektir.

original:
<T>Apart from digging holes to bury mummies,
you can try knocking them over with
boulders, too. Either works!
translation:
<T>Mumyalari gommek icin cukur kazmanin disinda,
onlari kayalarla devirip
firlatmayi da deneyebilirsin. Ikisi de ise yarar!

original:
<T>The red mummies move twice as fast as the
ordinary ones, so watch out. In fact, they
may be as fast as me!
translation:
<T>Kirmizi mumyalar siradan olanlardan iki kat hizli
hareket eder, dikkat et. Hatta
benim kadar hizli olabilirler!

original:
<T>Blue mummies have spikes on their backs,
which stick out of the ground when they're
buried, blocking the way.
translation:
<T>Mavi mumyalarin sirtinda dikenler vardir;
gomulduklerinde bu dikenler yerden
cikar ve yolu kapatir.

original:
<T>And that covers everything we've come
across in the ruins so far. Ask me again
whenever you like!
translation:
<T>Harabelerde simdiye kadar karsilastigimiz
her sey asagi yukari bu kadar. Istedigin zaman
tekrar sorabilirsin!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>I need to join up with Randall again as soon
as possible.
translation:
<T>Bir an once Randall'la
yeniden bulusmam gerek.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>You want my advice? I'm not sure I have
anything useful to say just now...
translation:
<T>Tavsiyemi mi istiyorsun? Su anda
soyleyecek faydali bir seyim oldugundan emin degilim...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Let's get moving, to start with. We can talk
again shortly.
translation:
<T>Once harekete gecelim. Birazdan
yeniden konusuruz.

original:
<T>You need some advice? <W>To dig a hole,
stand facing your chosen spot and touch
<CR>Dig Hole</CR>.
translation:
<T>Bir tavsiyeye mi ihtiyacin var? <W>Bir cukur kazmak icin,
sectigin noktaya donuk dur ve
<CR>Dig Hole</CR> secenegine dokun.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>Oh, I smell buried treasure! Go and face that
glowing patch of earth and touch <CR>Dig Hole</CR>.
translation:
<T>Oh, gomulu hazine kokusu aliyorum! Git ve o
parlayan toprak parcasina bakip <CR>Dig Hole</CR> secenegine dokun.

original:
<T>There's no treasure left here. Let's move
on.
translation:
<T>Burada artik hazine kalmamis. Hadi
devam edelim.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>These blue switches are just begging to be
stood on, but with two of them, it's not that
easy!
translation:
<T>Bu mavi dugmeler ustune basilmayi resmen istiyor,
ama ikisi birden olunca
o kadar da kolay degil!

original:
<T>Both blue switches must be pressed at once
to have any effect. Remember that!
translation:
<T>Bir etkisi olmasi icin iki mavi dugmeye de ayni anda
basilmali. Bunu unutma!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>We have to stand on the blue switches.
<W>There's just the tiny matter of not getting
walloped by a mummy en route!
translation:
<T>Mavi dugmelerin uzerinde durmaliyiz.
<W>Tabii, yolda bir mumya tarafindan
pataklanmamak gibi kucuk bir mesele var!

original:
<T>Were you hoping for some advice? I'm
afraid I can't help much here...
translation:
<T>Bir tavsiye mi istiyordun? Ne yazik ki
burada pek yardimci olamam...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>The Akbadain ruins certainly are a bit of
a gigantic maze! I'm not sure there's much
I can say to help here...
translation:
<T>Akbadain harabeleri gercekten de
kocaman bir labirent gibi! Burada yardim etmek icin
soyleyebilecegim pek bir sey yok...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>Want some advice, Hersh? I'd stand in front
of that boulder and try touching <CR>Push</CR>. See
what happens!
translation:
<T>Biraz tavsiye ister misin, Hersh? Ben o kayanin
onunde durup <CR>Push</CR> secenegine dokunmayi denerdim. Bak
neler olacak!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Hmm. Try pushing the boulder upwards first,
then left and down, I think... It should be
easy after that.
translation:
<T>Hmm. Once kayayi yukari dogru it,
sonra sola ve asagi, sanirim... Bundan sonrasi
kolay olmali.

original:
<T>The Akbadain ruins certainly are a bit of
a gigantic maze! I'm not sure there's much
I can say to help here...
translation:
<T>Akbadain harabeleri gercekten de
kocaman bir labirent! Burada yardimci olacak
pek bir sey soyleyebilecegimden emin degilim...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>You know what to do with these mummy
blighters - bury them in holes or bowl a big
boulder into them!
translation:
<T>Su belali mumyalarla ne yapacagini biliyorsun -
ya cukurlara gom ya da ustlerine koca bir
kaya yuvarla!

original:
<T>Try to lure them towards a spot where you
can bury them, or in the path of a boulder.
Failing that, dodge them!
translation:
<T>Onlari gomebilecegin bir noktaya ya da bir
kayanin yoluna dogru cekmeye calis.
Olmazsa, siyril gec!

original:
<T>The Akbadain ruins certainly are a bit of
a gigantic maze! I'm not sure there's much
I can say to help here...
translation:
<T>Akbadain harabeleri gercekten de kocaman
bir labirent gibi! Burada yardimci olacak
pek bir sey soyleyebilecegimden emin degilim...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>What kind of advice are you looking for?
I can't see any traps or mechanisms around
here...
translation:
<T>Ne tur bir tavsiye ariyorsun?
Etrafta hicbir tuzak ya da mekanizma
goremiyorum...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Need some advice concerning rocks? To
push a boulder away, stand facing it and
touch <CR>Push</CR>.
translation:
<T>Kayalarla ilgili bir tavsiye mi lazim? Bir kayayi
itmek icin ona donuk dur ve
<CR>Push</CR> secenegine dokun.

original:
<T>If you push it into a gap in the floor, it will
form a sort of stepping stone that we can
walk over.
translation:
<T>Onu zemindeki bir bosluga itersen,
uzerinden yuruyebilecegimiz bir tur basamak
tasi olusur.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Start by pushing the boulder on the
right. Then push the top boulder
downwards. Should be simple after that.
translation:
<T>Sagdaki kayayi iterek basla.
Sonra ustteki kayayi
asagi it. Ondan sonrasi kolay olmali.

original:
<T>What kind of advice are you looking for?
I can't see any traps or mechanisms around
here...
translation:
<T>Ne tur bir tavsiye ariyorsun?
Etrafta herhangi bir tuzak ya da mekanizma
goremiyorum...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Try to pick off the mummies one by one,
without being detected by the others. Leave
the red blighter till last.
translation:
<T>Digerlerine fark ettirmeden mumyalari tek tek
indirmeye calis. Kirmiziyi
en sona birak.

original:
<T>The red one moves faster than you, so
you'll have to carefully plan where you can
bury it.
translation:
<T>Kirmizi olan senden hizli hareket ediyor, bu yuzden
onu nereye gomebilecegini dikkatle
planlamalisin.

original:
<T>What kind of advice are you looking for?
I can't see any traps or mechanisms around
here...
translation:
<T>Ne tur bir tavsiye ariyorsun?
Etrafta herhangi bir tuzak ya da mekanizma
goremiyorum...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>So, want some advice, eh? We really
want to get a close look at that switch,
but the problem is how to get to it.
translation:
<T>Oyle mi, biraz tavsiye istiyorsun? Su dugmeye
yakindan bakmak istiyoruz,
ama sorun ona nasil ulasacagimiz.

original:
<T>Maybe we can push the boulder into a
position that helps us reach the switch.
<W>I want to check that lever too!
translation:
<T>Belki kayayi dugmeye ulasmamiza yardim edecek
bir konuma itebiliriz.
<W>Ben de o kolu kontrol etmek istiyorum!

original:
<T>What kind of advice are you looking for?
I can't see any traps or mechanisms
around here...
translation:
<T>Ne tur bir tavsiye ariyorsun?
Etrafta herhangi bir tuzak ya da mekanizma
goremiyorum...

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>Sorry, Hersh, I don't have a single piece of
useful advice to offer here. Or were you just
making small talk?
translation:
<T>Uzgunum, Hersh; burada verebilecegim tek bir
ise yarar tavsiye bile yok. Yoksa sadece
laf mi ediyordun?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>I don't have any advice as such, but I can
tell you that we're getting close to wonderful
archaeological discoveries!
translation:
<T>Ozel bir tavsiyem yok, ama
harika arkeolojik kesiflere yaklastigimizi
soyleyebilirim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>I'm naming these things {''}Tiresome Crystals{''}.
You can clear them with a boulder, but it
needs momentum.
translation:
<T>Ben bu seylere {''}Tiresome Crystals{''} adini veriyorum.
Bir kayayla temizleyebilirsin ama
ivme gerekiyor.

original:
<T>Shattering these crystals into a million
pieces is most satisfying! Let's find some
more to break!
translation:
<T>Bu kristalleri milyon
parcaya ayirip kirmak cok tatmin edici! Hadi
kiracak birkac tane daha bulalim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Clear the crystals on the right with the
left-hand boulder, and clear the crystals on
the left with the right-hand boulder!
translation:
<T>Sagdaki kristalleri soldaki kayayla,
soldaki kristalleri de sagdaki kayayla
temizle!

original:
<T>I don't have any advice as such, but I can
tell you that we're getting close to wonderful
archaeological discoveries!
translation:
<T>Ozel bir tavsiyem yok ama
harika arkeolojik kesiflere yaklastigimizi
soyleyebilirim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Need a hint? <W>Push the boulder in the centre
down, then move the top-right boulder so
it's left of the centre one.
translation:
<T>Bir ipucu mu lazim? <W>Ortadaki kayayi
asagi it, sonra sag ustteki kayayi oyle hareket ettir ki
ortadakinin solunda kalsin.

original:
<T>I don't have any advice as such, but I can
tell you that we're getting close to wonderful
archaeological discoveries!
translation:
<T>Ozel bir tavsiyem yok ama
harika arkeolojik kesiflere yaklastigimizi
soyleyebilirim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>When you bury blue mummies, their spikes
stick out and block the way, so you have to
plan your route carefully.
translation:
<T>Mavi mumyalari gomdugunde dikenleri disari
cikar ve yolu kapatir; bu yuzden
rotani dikkatle planlamalisin.

original:
<T>Start with the mummy closest to the centre
and bury it in the earthy patch on the far
right. You should be okay after that.
translation:
<T>Once merkeze en yakin mumyayla basla
ve onu en sagdaki toprak alana gom.
Ondan sonra isin yoluna girer.

original:
<T>I don't have any advice as such, but I can
tell you that we're getting close to wonderful
archaeological discoveries!
translation:
<T>Ozel bir tavsiyem yok ama
muhtesem arkeolojik kesiflere yaklastigimizi
soyleyebilirim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>The only advice I can give you all the way
down here is to watch out for traps and
proceed with caution.
translation:
<T>Buralara kadar inmisken sana verebilecegim tek
tavsiye, tuzaklara dikkat etmen ve
temkinli ilerlemen.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Hmm, let's see. I would start by pushing the
top-right boulder down, then rolling the
leftmost boulder to the right.
translation:
<T>Hmm, bakalim. Once sag ustteki kayayi asagi
iterdim, sonra en soldaki kayayi
saga dogru yuvarlardim.

original:
<T>The centre boulder can then go in the gap in
the floor. You should be able to work out
the rest for yourself, no?
translation:
<T>Sonra ortadaki kaya zemindeki bosluga
yerlesebilir. Gerisini de kendin
cozebilirsin, degil mi?

original:
<T>The only advice I can give you all the way
down here is to watch out for traps and
proceed with caution.
translation:
<T>Buralara kadar soyleyebilecegim tek tavsiye,
tuzaklara dikkat etmen ve
temkinli ilerlemen.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Hmm, what would Randall say in this
situation? Probably to never give up. I must
go on and find him again!
translation:
<T>Hmm, Randall bu durumda ne derdi?
Muhtemelen asla pes etme derdi. Devam
etmeli ve onu tekrar bulmaliyim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>It seems we've hit a fork in the road. Which
way should we go? <W>I'm thinking left.
translation:
<T>Gorunuse gore yol ikiye ayriliyor. Hangi
yonden gidelim? <W>Ben sola diyorum.

original:
<T>Even I got a bit of a shock when that big
rock came crashing down. What luck that
neither of us was hurt!
translation:
<T>O koca kaya gurultuyle dusunce ben bile
bir an irkildim. Ne sans ki
ikimiz de zarar gormedik!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>If Randall were here, this is what he'd say...
translation: <T>Randall burada olsaydi, muhtemelen soyle derdi...

original:
<T>{''}You need to break all the crystals. Put a
boulder in three of the holes, then give the
last one a good shove upwards.{''}
translation:
<T>{''}You need to break all the crystals. Put a
boulder in three of the holes, then give the
last one a good shove upwards.{''}

original:
<T>There's nothing left for me to do in here.
I should keep going.
translation:
<T>Burada yapacak baska bir seyim kalmadi.
Devam etmeliyim.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Even without me, it seems you solved the
puzzle in this room. Great work, partner!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ben olmasam da bu odadaki
bulmacayi cozmussun. Harika is, ortak!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Okay, I have to try to think like Randall...
translation: <T>Tamam, Randall gibi dusunmeye calismaliyim...

original:
<T>If I move the bottom-right boulder up, left,
and down...then move the top-right boulder
left... <W>I think I see the answer!
translation:
<T>Sag alttaki kayayi yukari, sola,
ve asagi hareket ettirirsem... sonra sag ustteki kayayi
sola... <W>Sanirim cevabi goruyorum!

original:
<T>There's nothing left for me to do in here.
I should keep going.
translation:
<T>Burada yapacak baska bir seyim kalmadi.
Devam etmeliyim.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Even without me, it seems you solved the
puzzle in this room. Great work, partner!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ben olmasam da bu odadaki
bulmacayi cozmussun. Harika is, ortak!
