original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>I'll do what I can to help you from up here,
so don't give up. Watch out for the
mummies and get to the blue switch!
translation:
<T>Buradan sana yardim edebildigim kadar edecegim,
o yuzden pes etme. Mumyalara dikkat et
ve mavi dugmeye ulas!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>There's nothing left for me to do in here.
I should keep going.
translation:
<T>Burada yapacak baska bir seyim kalmadi.
Devam etmeliyim.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Phew, we scraped through this one
by the skin of our teeth, didn't we? Good
thing I was around to save the day!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Oh be, bunu kil payi atlattik,
degil mi? Iyi ki gunu kurtarmak icin
ben vardim!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Hm? What's that there, in the middle of the
room?
translation:
<T>Hmm? Su odanin ortasindaki
sey de ne?

original:
<T>There's nothing left for me to do in here.
I should keep going.
translation:
<T>Burada yapacak bir sey kalmadi.
Yola devam etmeliyim.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Is this where you came across a host of
poisonous spiders? Phew. Glad it wasn't
me! <M1/2/1>Good going, Hersh!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Burasi zehirli orumcek surusuyle
karsilastigin yer mi? Off. Iyi ki ben
degildim! <M1/2/1>Aferin, Hersh!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>The canal water is welling up from deep
underground. I can't see the bottom... I
should take care not to fall in!
translation:
<T>Kanal suyu yerin cok derinlerinden
yukseliyor. Dibini goremiyorum... Icine
dusmemeye dikkat etmeliyim!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Is this water coming from underground?
I can't even see the bottom. We should
take care not to fall in!
translation:
<T>Bu su yeraltindan mi geliyor?
Dibini bile goremiyorum. Icine
dusmemeye dikkat etmeliyiz!

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>Are you wanting some advice? Hmmm...
I can't really think of anything helpful to
say at the moment.
translation:
<T>Tavsiye mi istiyorsun? Hmmm...
Su an gercekten
ise yarar bir sey aklima gelmiyor.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Move the top boulder down, then roll the
bottom-left boulder to the right and up.
Next, push the bottom-right boulder up.
translation:
<T>Ustteki kayayi asagi indir, sonra sol alttaki
kayayi saga ve yukari yuvarla.
Sonra sag alttaki kayayi yukari it.

original:
<T>What next? You want me to solve the whole
thing for you? Come on, Hersh. Exercise
your grey matter!
translation:
<T>Sonra ne mi? Butun isi senin icin benim
cozmemi mi istiyorsun? Hadi ama, Hersh. Biraz
kafana calistir!

original:
<T>Are you wanting some advice? Hmmm...
I can't really think of anything helpful to
say about this area.
translation:
<T>Biraz tavsiye mi istiyorsun? Hmmm...
Bu bolge hakkinda yardimci olacak
bir sey aklima gelmiyor.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Push the top-right boulder left, down and
left again- <W30>Hey, wait. You don't need me
for a puzzle this easy!
translation:
<T>Sag ustteki kayayi sola, asagi ve
tekrar sola it- <W30>Hey, dur. Bu kadar kolay
bir bulmaca icin bana ihtiyacin yok!

original:
<T>Are you wanting some advice? Hmmm...
I can't really think of anything helpful to
say about this area.
translation:
<T>Bir tavsiye mi istiyorsun? Hmmm...
Bu bolge hakkinda yardimci olacak
pek bir sey aklima gelmiyor.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Hmm, this puzzle is a real poser. Try
pushing the top-right and top-left boulders
towards the bottom right of the room.
translation:
<T>Hmm, bu bulmaca gercekten zor. Sag ust ve
sol ust kayalari odanin sag altina
dogru itmeye calis.

original:
<T>It should be quite straightforward after that.
I'm sure you can manage it, Hersh. You're
my friend, after all.
translation:
<T>Ondan sonra epey basit olmali.
Basarabilecegine eminim, Hersh. Sonucta sen
benim arkadasimsin.

original:
<T>Are you wanting some advice? Hmmm...
I can't really think of anything helpful to
say about this area.
translation:
<T>Biraz tavsiye mi istiyorsun? Hmmm...
Bu bolge hakkinda yardimci olacak
bir sey aklima gelmiyor.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>Hmph, these blue ones are a bore. Why
must they block the way when you bury
them?
translation:
<T>Hih, su mavi olanlar can sikici. Neden
gomdugunde yolu
tikiyorlar ki?

original:
<T>Okay, start by luring the lower of the two
mummies on the right-hand side into a hole
in the bottom-right area.
translation:
<T>Tamam, once sag taraftaki iki mumyadan alttakini
sag alt bolgedeki bir cukura
cekerek basla.

original:
<T>Then bury the bottom-left mummy in the
bottom-left corner, but be sure to circle
round before you dig the hole.
translation:
<T>Sonra sol alttaki mumyayi
sol alt koseye gom, ama cukuru kazmadan once
etrafindan dolasmayi unutma.

original:
<T>After that, you only have three mummies to
deal with, so you can probably work it out
for yourself!
translation:
<T>Bundan sonra sadece uc mumya kalir;
dolayisiyla muhtemelen
gerisini kendin cozebilirsin!

original:
<T>Are you wanting some advice? Hmmm...
I can't really think of anything helpful to
say about this area.
translation:
<T>Biraz tavsiye mi istiyorsun? Hmmm...
Acikcasi bu bolum hakkinda
soyleyecek pek faydali bir sey bulamiyorum.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original:
<T>What kind of advice do you expect? All
I'll say is that we must be getting close
now. I can feel it.
translation:
<T>Ne tur bir tavsiye bekliyorsun? Soyleyebilecegim tek
sey, artik iyice yaklastigimiz
olmali. Hissediyorum.

original: ヤングランド
translation: Genc Randall

original:
<T>[思/おも]えば、ここに[来/く]るまでに
[色/いろ]んな[事/こと]があったよなあ。
translation:
<T>Dusununce, buraya gelene kadar
bir suru sey yasadik.

original:
<T>もうすぐアスラントのナゾに
たどり[着/つ]けるのかと[思/おも]うと、
[感慨/かんがい][深/ふか]いものがあるな。
translation:
<T>Yakinda Azran'in gizemine
ulasacagimizi dusununce,
icimi derin bir duygu kapliyor.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>この[遺跡/いせき]の[発見/はっけん]を[世間/せけん]に[知/し]らしめたら、
[君/きみ]が[望/のぞ]んでいたとおり、[考古/こうこ][学者/がくしゃ]としての
[鮮烈/せんれつ]なデビューが[待/ま]ってるんだろうね。
translation:
<T>Bu harabelerin kesfini dunyaya duyurdugumuzda,
senin istedigin gibi bir arkeolog olarak
carpici bir cikis seni bekliyor olacak.

original:
<T>ああ、そうだな。
エルシャール、その[時/とき]はお[前/まえ]も
[俺/おれ]と[一緒/いっしょ]に[考古/こうこ][学者/がくしゃ]になるんだぜ。
translation:
<T>Evet, oyle.
Hershel, o zaman sen de
benimle birlikte arkeolog olacaksin.

original:
<T>そう[言/い]えばそんなこともあったね。
もしかして、あのとき
[既/すで]に[仮面/かめん]を[見/み]つけていたのかい？
translation:
<T>Simdi hatirladim, boyle bir sey de olmustu.
Yoksa o zaman
maskeyi coktan bulmus muydun?

original: <T>あれは[仮面/かめん]を[探/さが]しに[行/い]く[前/まえ]の[話/はなし]だな。
translation: <T>O, maskeyi aramaya gitmeden onceki bir hikayeydi.

original:
<T>あの[時/とき]はこんな[遺跡/いせき]に[来/く]ることに
なるなんて[思/おも]ってなかったな…。
translation:
<T>O zamanlar boyle bir harabeye
gelecegimizi hic dusunmemistim...

original:
<T>お[前/まえ]たちの[協力/きょうりょく]がなかったら、
ここまでこれなかったかもな。
[思/おも]えばあの[日/ひ]が[俺/おれ]にとっての[転機/てんき]だったんだ。
translation:
<T>Sizin yardiminiz olmasaydi,
buraya kadar gelemezdik belki.
Dusununce, o gun benim icin bir donum noktasiydi.

original: [回想/かいそう]へ
translation: [Geri donus]e

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>もうこんな[時間/じかん]か。
[今日/きょう]はランドの[家/いえ]に[行/い]く[約束/やくそく]だったっけ。
translation:
<T>Simdiden bu kadar [zaman/zaman] mi oldu?
[bugun/bugun] Randall'in [ev/ev]ine [git/git]meye [soz/soz] vermistim, degil mi.

original:
<T>ランドを[待/ま]たせる[前/まえ]に
[早/はや]く[行/い]かないと。
translation:
<T>Randall'i [beklet/beklet]meden [once/once]
[cabuk/cabuk] [git/git]mem gerek.

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original:
<T>おや、エルシャール。
[出/で]かけるのかい？
translation:
<T>Oh, Hershel.
Disari mi cikiyorsun?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>うん、ランドと[約束/やくそく]してたんだ。
[夕飯/ゆうはん][前/まえ]には[帰/かえ]るから[心配/しんぱい]しないで。
translation:
<T>Evet, Randall'la sozlesmistim.
Aksam yemeginden once donerim, merak etme.

original:
<T>[今日/きょう]はタマネギのスープにするわ。
[冷/さ]めないうちに[帰/かえ]ってきてね。
それから、[危/あぶ]ない[事/こと]はしちゃダメよ。
translation:
<T>Bugun sogan corbasi yapacagim.
Sogumadan eve don.
Bir de tehlikeli seyler yapma, olur mu?

original:
<T>[大丈夫/だいじょうぶ]だよ。
[母/かあ]さんは[心配性/しんぱいしょう]だなあ。
translation:
<T>Merak etme, iyiyim.
Anne, sen de cok endiseleniyorsun.

original: <T>アフター
translation: <T>Sonra

original: ローラン
translation: Roland

original:
<T>エルシャール、
ランドくんの[家/いえ]に[遊/あそ]びに[行/い]くのか。
その[前/まえ]にナゾでも[解/と]いて[行/い]きなさい。
translation:
<T>Hershel,
Rand'in evine oynamaya mi gidiyorsun?
Gitmeden once bir bilmece coz de oyle git.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: わかったよナゾをとくよ。
translation: Tamam, bilmeceyi cozecegim.

original:
そんなものかエルシャール。
もっと[熱/あつ]くなって[頑張/がんば]ってナゾを[解/と]くんだ。
translation:
O kadar mi, Hershel?
Daha da heveslen, daha cok cabala ve bilmeceyi coz.

original:
よし、[負/ま]けないよ。

nasil yardim edecegini aciklayayim.

original:
<T>Now, you see the arrows on the ground?
Follow those arrows closely to stay safe
and sound.
translation:
<T>Simdi, yerdeki oklari goruyor musun?
Guvende kalmak icin o oklari yakindan
takip et.

original:
<T>A shovel icon indicates an ideal spot to dig
a hole for the nasties to fall into!
translation:
<T>Kurek simgesi, o kotuler dussun diye
cukur kazmak icin en uygun yeri gosterir!

original:
<T>If you see an arrow above a boulder, push
the boulder in the direction shown by the
arrow.
translation:
<T>Bir kayanin uzerinde bir ok gorursen,
kayayi okun gosterdigi yone
it.

original:
<T>When you've had all the help you need,
touch this icon on the bottom left of the
Touch Screen to quit Guide Mode.
translation:
<T>Ihtiyacin olan tum yardimi aldiginda,
Rehber Modu'ndan cikmak icin Dokunmatik Ekran'in sol
altindaki bu simgeye dokun.

original:
<T>So there you have it, nice and simple! Make
use of this mode and we'll get through the
rest of the ruins in the blink of an eye!
translation:
<T>Iste bu kadar, basit ve anlasilir! Bu modu
kullanirsan, harabelerin geri kalanini
goz acip kapayincaya kadar geceriz!

original:
<T>Oh, and one last thing: there is a small
catch.
translation:
<T>Ah, bir sey daha: kucuk bir
puf noktasi var.

original:
<T>To use Guide Mode for any particular room,
it'll cost you one hint coin. Keep an eye on
your hint coin supply so you don't run out!
translation:
<T>Herhangi bir oda icin Rehber Modu'nu kullanmak,
sana bir ipucu parasina mal olur. Ipucu parasi
stokuna dikkat et ki bitmesin!

original:
<T>Hang on a minute, Hersh. You mean you
haven't got a single hint coin on you?<W>
Not one?!
translation:
<T>Bir dakika, Hersh. Yani uzerinde tek bir
ipucu parasi bile yok mu?<W>
Hic mi?!

original:
<T>What is the world coming to? All right then,
I suppose I'll have to give you one of mine.
But it's just this once, understand?
translation:
<T>Dunya ne hale geliyor? Peki o zaman,
sanirim sana benimkilerden birini vermek zorundayim.
Ama sadece bu seferlik, anlastik mi?

original: ヤングランド
translation: Youngland

original: <T>[回想/かいそう][終了/しゅうりょう]。[先/さき]へ[進/すす]もう！
translation: <T>Geri donus sona erdi. Haydi ilerleyelim!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<V0010><T>We made our way to Tingly Town,
where the Masked Gentleman was
set to perform his next miracle.
translation:
<V0010><T>Tingly Kasabasi'na dogru yola ciktik,
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
bir sonraki mucizesini sergileyecegi yere.

original:
<V0020><T>It happened so quickly and right
before our eyes...everyone in
the park had vanished.
translation:
<V0020><T>Her sey o kadar hizli oldu ki, tam
gozlerimizin onunde... parkta
bulunan herkes ortadan kayboldu.

original:
<V0030><T>The Masked Gentleman then announced
that his final miracle would be visible all
over town. And then he disappeared.
translation:
<V0030><T>Maskeli Beyefendi ardindan,
son mucizesinin tum kasabadan
gorulecegini ilan etti. Sonra da kayboldu.

original:
<V0040><T>The stage is set for the
Masked Gentleman to
unveil his final act.
translation:
<V0040><T>Sahne hazir;
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
son gosterisini sergilemesine az kaldi.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M5/1/1>Where should we start today, Professor?
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Bugun nereden baslayalim, Profesor?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I'm not entirely sure, Emmy. Do you think
anyone knows that the Masked Gentleman
appeared last night?<M1/2/1/45>
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Tam emin degilim, Emmy. Sence
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin dun gece
ortaya ciktigini bilen biri var mi?<M1/2/1/45>

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Well, I'd have to say no, considering
nobody at Tingly Town even realised they
disappeared!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Sey, hayir derdim; cunku
Tingly Kasabasi'ndaki kimse
kaybolduklarini bile fark etmedi!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Was that miracle even real? <W>There must
have been some trick to it, right?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>O mucize gercekten gercek miydi? <W>Kesin
bir numarasi vardir, degil mi?

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>I certainly hope so.<W> Let's see if we can find
some evidence to support your theory,
Luke.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Umarim oyledir.<W> Bakalim
teorini destekleyecek bir kanit
bulabilecek miyiz, Luke.

original: バスカル
translation: Baskal

original:
<T>Ah, Professor Layton and company. I trust
you are well rested?
translation:
<T>Ah, Profesor Layton ve ekibi. Umarim
iyice dinlenmissinizdir?

original:
<T>Many of the city's hotels are in fierce
competition with each other, but we prefer
to focus on our guests.
translation:
<T>Sehrin bircok oteli birbirleriyle kiyasiya
rekabet eder, ama biz
misafirlerimize odaklanmayi tercih ederiz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>After all, with Mr Ledore at the helm, we
hardly need to prove ourselves.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sonucta Bay Ledore isin basindayken,
kendimizi kanitlamaya pek de ihtiyacimiz yok.

original:
<T>That said, I admit we do engage in a little
quaint rivalry with Mr Ledore's other hotels.
translation:
<T>Yine de itiraf etmeliyim ki Bay Ledore'un
diger otelleriyle ufak, tatli bir rekabetimiz var.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>The Reunion Inn had stellar year-end results.
To my chagrin, it's now the hotel that
customers measure us against.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Reunion Inn yil sonunu mukemmel sonuclarla kapatti.
Ne yazik ki artik musterilerin bizi
kiyasladigi otel o oldu.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M4/1/1>So, behind these monuments to luxury lies
a heated battle!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Yani bu luks anitlarinin ardinda
hararetli bir mucadele yatiyor!

original:
<T>Goodness, no! Nothing so crude as that!
<W>However, I assure you that the Reunion Inn
will not bea-<W30> overshadow us this year.
translation:
<T>Aman, hayir! Oyle kaba bir sey degil!
<W>Yine de sizi temin ederim ki Reunion Inn
bu yil bizi asla golgede biraka-<W30> mayacak.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/1>It must be a lot of hard work...
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Cok zor bir is olmali...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It certainly can be, but seeing our patrons'
delight is worth every ounce of effort.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Oyle olabiliyor, ama misafirlerimizin
memnuniyetini gormek her seye deger.

original:
<T>But enough about work. Perhaps a puzzle
will lighten the mood.
translation:
<T>Ama is yeter. Belki bir bulmaca
havayi biraz yumusatir.

original:
<T>I was under the mistaken impression
a puzzle could ameliorate any situation.
Forgive me.
translation:
<T>Yanlislikla su izlenime kapilmisim:
Bir bulmaca her durumu iyilestirebilir.
Affedin beni.

original:
<T>Oh, I do apologise. Were you not quite
finished with your puzzle?
translation:
<T>Ah, ozur dilerim. Bulmacanizi
bitirmemis miydiniz?

original:
<T>Well done, young sir! Just what I'd expect
from an acquaintance of Mr Ledore.
translation:
<T>Aferin, genc bey! Bay Ledore'un
bir tanidigindan da bunu beklerdim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It gives me great pride to work for a man of
such qualities.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Boylesi meziyetlere sahip bir adam icin
calismak bana buyuk gurur veriyor.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Henry's employees seem to like him.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Henry'nin calisanlari onu seviyor gibi.

original: <T><M5/2/6>I still prefer the professor.
translation: <T><M5/2/6>Ben yine de profesoru tercih ederim.

original: <T><M3/1/1>But of course!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Elbette!

original:
<T>We still pride ourselves on being one of the
finest hotels Monte d'Or has to offer.
translation:
<T>Hala Monte d'Or'un sundugu
en iyi otellerden biri olmakla gurur duyuyoruz.

original:
<T>Our aim is to give every visitor a true taste
of Monte d'Or's exotic luxury. I like to think
we achieve that.
translation:
<T>Amacimiz her ziyaretciye
Monte d'Or'un egzotik luksunu gercekten tattirmak.
Bunu basardigimiza inaniyorum.

original:
<T>As our honoured guest, Professor, we've
prepared a gift for you. You will find it in
that box on top of the cabinet behind me.
translation:
<T>Seref misafirimiz olarak, Profesor,
sizin icin bir hediye hazirladik. Onu
arkamdaki dolabin uzerindeki kutuda bulacaksiniz.

original:
<T>Please take it with you to remind you of
your stay here at the Camel's Hump.
translation:
<T>Lutfen bunu yaniniza alin; burada,
Camel's Hump'taki konaklamanizi hatirlatsin.

original:
<T>Monte d'Or was created solely for the
pleasure of its visitors, so you may say our
hotels occupy a vital role here.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or yalnizca ziyaretcilerin
keyfi icin yaratildi; bu yuzden
otellerimizin burada hayati bir rolu var diyebilirsiniz.

original:
<T>It appears as if there is some sort of
disturbance outside.
translation:
<T>Disarida bir tur
kargasa var gibi gorunuyor.

original:
<T>But it takes more than a bit of sand and
commotion to topple our pillars. This hotel
is an oasis of tranquility.
translation:
<T>Ama biraz kum ve kargasa
sutunlarimizi devirmeye yetmez. Bu otel
huzurun vahasidir.

original:
<T>Perhaps a souvenir of your time here in
Monte d'Or will give you peace of mind.
translation:
<T>Belki Monte d'Or'daki zamaninizdan
bir hatira size ic huzuru verir.

original:
<T>I have been keeping it in that box on top of
the cabinet behind me for safekeeping.
Please take it with you.
translation:
<T>Onu guvenle saklamak icin arkamdaki
dolabin uzerindeki kutuda muhafaza ediyordum.
Lutfen yaniniza alin.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>All right, well we have to start somewhere.
I doubt the investigation's just going to
come to us.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Peki, bir yerden baslamak zorundayiz.
Sorusturmanin kendi kendine
ayagimiza gelmesini bekleyemeyiz.

original: ゴンゾ
translation: Gonzales

original:
<T>Professor Layton! There you are! I have
been looking...<W>huff...<W>all over...<W>for you!
translation:
<T>Profesor Layton! Iste buradasiniz! Ben sizi
ariyordum...<W>puf...<W>her yerde...<W>aramadigim yer kalmadi!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Gonzales? Whatever is the matter?
translation: <T>Gonzales? Ne oldu boyle?

original: <T><M1/1/1/15>I stand corrected.
translation: <T><M1/1/1/15>Yanilmisim.

original: <T><M3/1/1>You...you have cleared Mr Dalston's name!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Siz... siz Bay Dalston'in adini temize cikardiniz!

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Oh! I take it Dalston has been released?
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Ah! Demek Dalston serbest birakildi?

original:
<T>Yes, he's just returned to the mansion. I
can't thank you enough!
translation:
<T>Evet, az once malikaneye dondu. Size
ne kadar tesekkur etsem az!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>You're very welcome... However, I don't
believe I did anything to merit such thanks.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Rica ederim... Ancak bu kadar
tesekkuru hak edecek bir sey yaptigimi sanmiyorum.

original: <T><M1/1/1>But of course you did!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Elbette yaptiniz!

original:
<T>Even when all the townspeople suspected
Mr Dalston, I hear you continued to pursue
the true culprit.
translation:
<T>Kasabadakilerin hepsi Bay Dalston’dan
suphelenirken bile, gercek suclunun pesini
birakmadiginizi duydum.

original:
<T>And for that, you have earned my undying
gratitude!
translation:
<T>Ve bunun icin, sonsuz
minnettarligimi kazandiniz!

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>It was no trouble, Gonzales. Dalston is an
old friend.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Hic sorun degil, Gonzales. Dalston benim
eski bir dostum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>A proper gentleman. Now please excuse
me - Mr Dalston is waiting for me at the
mansion.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Tam bir beyefendi. Simdi musaade
edin - Bay Dalston beni
malikanede bekliyor.

original: <T>Please do drop by if you have the time!
translation: <T>Vaktiniz olursa mutlaka ugrayin!

original:
<T><M5/2/1>You know, I'm starting to want a butler
myself...
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Biliyor musun, ben de bir usagim olsun
istemeye basladim...

original:
<T><M6/1/1>If Dalston has been released, it must mean
that news of yesterday's miracle has
reached the police.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Dalston serbest birakildiysa, demek ki
dunku mucizenin haberi
polise ulasmis.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>And now we can finally hear Dalston's side
of the story.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ve artik sonunda Dalston’in
hikayenin kendi tarafini dinleyebiliriz.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Indeed. Let's pay him a visit.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Kesinlikle. Gidip onu ziyaret edelim.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Professor, you know that's not the way to
Mr Dalston's house, right?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Profesor, Bay Dalston'in evine giden yol
bu degil, degil mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh yes, my apologies. The heat must be
getting to me.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah evet, kusura bakma. Sicak herhalde
beni etkiliyor.

original: ニルス
translation: ニルス

original:
<T><M3/1/1>So, is it true? The Masked Gentleman was
at Tingly Town yesterday?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yani dogru mu? Maskeli Beyefendi dun
Tingly Town'daymis?

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original: <T>News travels fast, I see.
translation: <T>Demek haber cabuk yayiliyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Went all the way over there hoping to see
something. No luck, though.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bir sey gorurum diye ta oraya kadar gittim.
Ama sans yoktu.

original:
<T>Heard Henry Ledore was involved somehow.
Odd, though. Our Gentleman goes for big
crowds. Why not this time?
translation:
<T>Henry Ledore'un bir sekilde isin icinde oldugunu duydum.
Ama garip. Bizim Beyefendi kalabaliklari sever.
Neden bu sefer degil?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>No grand presentation? No public display of
showmanship?<W> Losing his touch, is he?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Buyuk bir gosteri yok mu? Sovmenlik
gosterisi yok mu?<W> Elinden mi dusuyor acaba?

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Yes, this time around it was intended for
a select few.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Evet, bu seferki gosteri
seckin birkac kisi icindi.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>It does seem as if we were singled out, but
I'm still not sure what that means...
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Gercekten de sanki ozellikle bizi secmis gibi,
ama bunun ne anlama geldiginden hala emin degilim...

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Maybe he's targeting us because he fears
we're close to unmasking him?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Belki de onu maskesiz birakmaya yaklastigimizdan korktugu icin
bizi hedef aliyordur?

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
<T><M3/2/1>But then why would he show us his miracle
in private? That's like leading us right to the
evidence.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Peki o zaman mucizesini neden bize
ozel olarak gostersin? Bu, bizi dogrudan
kanita goturmek gibi.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Hmm, that is a good point.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Hmm, iyi bir nokta.

original: <T>We have many things to consider here...
translation: <T>Dusunecek cok sey var...

original:
<T>Maybe he's out of ideas. Can't be easy
planning enormous spectacles like that.
translation:
<T>Belki de fikirleri tukenmistir. Oyle devasa gosteriler
planlamak kolay olmasa gerek.

original: トリッキー
translation: トリッキー

original:
<T>Phew! Clowning around is no joke. I ain't
getting any younger and hopping around like
a buffoon is starting to take its toll.
translation:
<T>Puf! Palyacoluk hic saka degil. Ben de
genclesmiyorum; soytari gibi hoplayip ziplamak
vucuduma iyice yuk olmaya basladi.

original:
<T>Can't really entertain the kids the way I used
to, neither.
translation:
<T>Ustelik eskisi gibi cocuklari eglendiremiyorum
artik.

original:
<T>I get up on that ball and two days later my
hips are screaming at me! Makes me look
like a right clown.
translation:
<T>O topun ustune cikiyorum, iki gun sonra
kalcalarim bana avaz avaz bagiriyor! Tam
bir palyacoya donuyorum.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Have you ever thought about yoga? A little
of that before bed's supposed to work
wonders for all your aches and pains.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Hic yogayi dusundun mu? Yatmadan once
biraz yapmak, butun agri sizilara
mucizeler gibi iyi gelirmis.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hah, pull the other one! I can't even touch
my toes!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hah, hadi oradan! Ayagimin parmaklarina bile
uzanamiyorum!

original:
<T><M5/2/1>All right, but don't be so close-minded! How
about a jog down the boulevard? That
should loosen you right up!
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Peki ama bu kadar kapali fikirli olma! Bulvarda
bir kosu nasil olur? Seni hemen
gevsetir!

original: <T><M2/1/1>How about giving your noodle a workout?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ya biraz da beynini calistirsan?

original:
<T>Try that balancing on a ball blindfolded and
you'll see how I feel!
translation:
<T>Bir topun ustunde gozlerin bagli denge kurmayi dene de
nasil hissettigimi gor!

original: <T>Nobody likes a good puzzle any more.
translation: <T>Artik kimse iyi bir bulmacadan hoslanmiyor.

original:
<T>Oh, nice one! There aren't many who can
chew through a puzzle like that.
translation:
<T>Oh, iyiymis! Boyle bir bulmacayi
kemire kemire cozen pek azdir.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Well, what did you expect? I am the
professor's assistant.
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Ee, ne bekliyordun? Ben
profesorun asistaniyim.

original: <T>Phew, that got her off the yoga topic...
translation: <T>Oh, iyi ki... Yoga konusunu kapattirabildim...

original: <T><M4/2/7>I'm sorry?
translation: <T><M4/2/7>Affedersiniz?

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Oh, I'm just mumbling about how I can't
wait to climb back on top of that ball over
there...<W> Can't wait...
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Yok, ben sadece surada duran topun
ustune tekrar cikmak icin nasil da
can attigimi mirildaniyordum...<W> Sabirsizlaniyorum...

original: <T>How's your balance?
translation: <T>Dengen nasil?

original:
<T>Have you met Juggles? He's an oddball,
but there's one thing he's good at...<W>and
that's making us smile.
translation:
<T>Juggles'la tanistin mi? Tuhafin teki,
ama iyi oldugu bir sey var...<W>ve o da
bizi guldurmek.

original:
<T>Thought I'd say juggling, didn't you? Hah!
I'd wipe that grin off his face if he didn't
make me laugh every time I tried.
translation:
<T>"Hokkabazlik" diyecegimi sandin, degil mi? Hah!
Her denedigimde beni guldurmese,
yuzundeki o siritisi silerdim.

original:
<T>So there I was on my ball, when the ground
started shaking and I had to roll around just
to stay on my feet!
translation:
<T>Iste topumun ustundeydim; derken yer
titremeye basladi ve ayakta kalmak icin
oraya buraya yuvarlanmak zorunda kaldim!

original:
<T>And you know what? I think it stretched out
my sore hips. Should be all hunky-dory for
tomorrow's performance now!
translation:
<T>Hem biliyor musun? Sanirim o sarsinti
agriyan kalcalarimi acti. Artik yarinki
gosteri icin her sey tikirinda olmali!

original: ダンチョー
translation: Duncho

original:
<T>Before this town was first established, the
whole area was just an empty wasteland.
translation:
<T>Bu kasaba ilk kuruldugunda,
buralarin tamami bombos bir coraklikti.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Back in the day, we used to cut across this
patch of desert all the time. Never thought
you could build a city in it!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Eskiden buradan kestirmeden gecerdik,
su col parcasini hep arsinlardik. Hic
buraya bir sehir kurulacagini dusunmezdim!

original:
<T>You might find a run-down shack or cottage
out on a hillside, but never anything more.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Yamaclarda harap bir kulube ya da baraka
bulabilirdin, ama asla daha fazlasini degil.<M1/1/1>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Were you in the circus back then?
translation: <T>O zamanlar sirkte miydiniz?

original:
<T>Oh yes. I still remember the days we would
just sit round in a circle with the fire
breathers, burning the midnight oil.
translation:
<T>Ah evet. Sabahlara kadar
ates yutanlarla cember yapip
oturdugumuz gunleri hala hatirlarim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>They'd always tell me about their blunders
on stage. Hah!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sahnede yaptiklari gaflari hep anlatirlardi
bana. Hah!

original:
<T>You don't get that sort of thing happening
these days with television. Though they
definitely have their own sorts of problems.<M2/1/2>
translation:
<T>Televizyonla artik boyle seyler olmaz.
Yine de onlarin
kendine gore dertleri kesin var.<M2/1/2>

original:
<T>Talent doesn't grow on trees. It takes hard
work.
translation:
<T>Yetenek agacta yetismez. Cok
calismak gerekir.

original:
<T>Ahhh... What happened to good old live
performances? That's what I want to know.
translation:
<T>Ahhh... O eski canli
gosteriler ne oldu? Ben onu merak ediyorum.

original:
<T>It's amazing how you just remember things
out of the blue.
translation:
<T>Insan bir anda
hic yoktan seyleri hatirlayiveriyor, sasirtici.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah, life's full of ups and downs... But you
must remember the ups. I always start my
day with a hearty bowl of ups!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah, hayat inis cikislarla dolu... Ama
cikislari hatirlamalisin. Ben her zaman
gune koca bir kase mutlulukla baslarim!

original:
<T>You might be different, of course, but that's
the way I choose to live.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Elbette siz farkli olabilirsiniz, ama ben
hayati boyle yasamayi seciyorum.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M3/1/1>The past shapes us all. I wouldn't be who
I am today were it not for the powerful bond
I shared with a friend.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Gecmis hepimizi sekillendirir. Bir dostla
paylastigim o guclu bag olmasaydi bugun
ben ben olmazdim.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Mmm...those memories. Powerful indeed.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Himm... O anilar. Gercekten de cok guclu.

original:
<T>I'm the ringmaster here! That masked villain
won't be ruining my circus!
translation:
<T>Burada sirk muduru benim! O maskeli alcak
sirki mahvedemeyecek!

original:
<T>I'm going to mix things up for tonight's
performance. Taking a page from the
Masked Gentleman's book, if you will.
translation:
<T>Bu aksamki gosteride isleri biraz
karistiracagim. Isterseniz,
Maskeli Bey'den bir sayfa odunc alarak.

original:
<T>I heard Mr Dalston say that all of his
so-called miracles have been nothing but
the simplest of illusions.
translation:
<T>Bay Dalston'in, su sozde
mucizelerinin aslinda sadece
en basit gozbagciliklar oldugunu soyledigini duydum.

original:
<T>Ch{^a}teau Dalston acted like a wall against
the sand, so all our tents managed to
escape harm's way.
translation:
<T>Ch{^a}teau Dalston kuma karsi bir duvar gibi
davrandi, bu yuzden cadirlarimizin hepsi
zarar gormeden kurtuldu.

original:
<T>But I'm not sure if I can say the same for all
our performers. I fear some of them may not
make it here tonight...
translation:
<T>Ama ayni seyi tum
sanatcilarimiz icin soyleyemem. Bazilarinin
bu aksam buraya yetisemeyeceginden korkuyorum...

original: チルチル
translation: Cilcil

original: <T>Grrrawrr, rawrrr...
translation: <T>Grrrawrr, rawrrr...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Uh-huh. I see. Well, Mr Dalston does have
a lot invested in the people here.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hi hi. Anliyorum. Sey, Bay Dalston'in
buradaki insanlara buyuk yatirimi var.

original: <T>Grrraawr, grrr-garr...
translation: <T>Grrraawr, grrr-garr...

original: <T><M1/2/5>Mr Dalston said that?!
translation: <T><M1/2/5>Bay Dalston bunu mu soyledi?!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Anything worthwhile, Luke?
translation: <T>Ise yarar bir sey var mi, Luke?

original:
<T><M4/1/3>He said Mr Dalston thinks you're amazing!
<W>Mr Dalston's a nice person, really, isn't he?<M1/1/3>
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Bay Dalston senin harika oldugunu dusunuyormus!
<W>Bay Dalston gercekten cok iyi biri, degil mi?<M1/1/3>

original: <T>Grrrrowl-gaarrrrowl! Grrrawr.
translation: <T>Grrrrowl-gaarrrrowl! Grrrawr.

original: <T>Rawrr... Grrrowl!
translation: <T>Rawrr... Grrrowl!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Let's hope they do! Though it might take
a lot of work for the professor to get
through to Mr Dalston on that level.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Umarim oyledir! Ama profesorun
Bay Dalston'a o duzeyde ulasmasi icin
cok caba harcamasi gerekebilir.

original: <T><M5/2/1/30>Such a curious ability...
translation: <T><M5/2/1/30>Ne kadar da tuhaf bir yetenek...

original: <T>Grrrawr?
translation: <T>Grrrawr?

original: ゴンゾ
translation: Gonzo

original: <T>Ah, Professor! Please come in.
translation: <T>Ah, Profesor! Lutfen iceri buyurun.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Mr Dalston has been eagerly anticipating
your arrival.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bay Dalston gelisinizi buyuk bir
heyecanla bekliyordu.

original: <T>Make yourselves at home.
translation: <T>Kendinizi evinizde hissedin.

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original:
<T>Gonzales told me about your intervening
with the police to prove my innocence.
translation:
<T>Gonzales, masumiyetimi kanitlamak icin
polise araya girdigini soyledi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But I still haven't forgotten how you
suspected me at first, too.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama en basta benden suphelendigini de
unutmadim.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I do apologise, but you must understand
I had to take every possibility into
consideration.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ozur dilerim, ama anlamalisiniz;
her ihtimali
goz onunde bulundurmam gerekiyordu.

original:
<T>Hmph! Next time, you leave the one that
involves me out of it, all right?
translation:
<T>Hih! Bir dahaki sefere beni
isin disinda birak, tamam mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I rather hope there won't be a next time,
Dalston.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Umarim bir dahaki sefere gerek kalmaz,
Dalston.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>And one more thing, Layton.<W> I...<W30>I want to
thank you.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bir sey daha var, Layton.<W> Ben...<W30> Sana
tesekkur etmek istiyorum.

original: <T>That's very kind, but not at all-
translation: <T>Cok naziksiniz, ama hic de-

original:
<T>Will you just shut your trap for one second
and let me say my piece? <W>I'm in your debt,
Layton. Remember that.
translation:
<T>Bir saniyeligine ceneni kapatip
sozumu soylememe izin verir misin? <W>Sana borcluyum,
Layton. Bunu unutma.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>If I ever have need of something, I'll be sure
to ask. Thank you.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Bir seye ihtiyacim olursa mutlaka
isterim. Tesekkur ederim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>So, uh, where exactly have you got to with
your investigation?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Peki, sey, sorusturmanda
tam olarak nereye geldin?

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>There was another miracle last night, this
time at Tingly Town. We're still unsure as to
how it was done.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Dun gece bir mucize daha oldu, bu sefer
Tingly Town'da. Hala
nasil yapildigindan emin degiliz.

original:
<T>We'll be heading back there to see if we
missed any clues yesterday.
translation:
<T>Dun herhangi bir ipucu kacirdik mi diye
bakmak icin oraya geri gidecegiz.

original:
<T>Right, well, you'd better keep me informed.
I don't want to be left in the dark.
translation:
<T>Iyi, o halde beni haberdar et.
Karanlikta kalmak istemem.

original:
<T>Left in the dark... <W>Of course!<W> <M2/1/1>That may be
precisely how he pulled it off! Thank you,
Dalston!
translation:
<T>Karanlikta kalmak... <W>Tabii ya!<W> <M2/1/1>Belki de
bunu tam olarak boyle basardi! Tesekkurler,
Dalston!

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Hah hah! I'm not sure what you're thanking
me for, but you're welcome!
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Hah hah! Neye tesekkur ettigini
bilmiyorum ama rica ederim!

original:
<T>Let's see if our visit to Tingly Town confirms
my suspicions.
translation:
<T>Tingly Town'a yapacagimiz ziyaret
suphelerimi dogrulayacak mi bakalim.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/1>Okay! Let's go!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Tamam! Hadi gidelim!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/2/1>This is all so exciting! I wish I could get into
your brain and see what you're so sure
about, Professor.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bu cok heyecan verici! Keske
aklinin icine girip neye bu kadar
emin oldugunu gorebilsem, Profesor.

original:
<T>You will keep me informed, won't you? Keep
in mind I have a lot of property in this town.
translation:
<T>Beni haberdar edersin, degil mi? Unutma
bu kasabada epey mulkum var.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>And who knows - if you keep me in the
loop, I might actually be able to help you.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hem kim bilir... Beni bilgilendirirsen
belki gercekten sana yardim edebilirim.

original: <T><M3/1/1>I understand, Dalston.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Anliyorum, Dalston.

original: モミノキー
translation: Mominoki

original:
<T>When Ah was a wee lad, this area was sand.
Sand, sand, sand as far as the eye could
see.
translation:
<T>Ben kucuk bir cocukken buralar kumdu.
Kum, kum, kum... gozun gordugu her yer
kumdu.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M6/2/1>It's hard to believe that this was all one
big desert in the past.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Buranin eskiden kocaman bir
col olduguna inanmak zor.

original:
<T>Well aye, ye wouldnae have even been
born! Ah've seen a fair few pass through oor
Craggy Dale on the way tae the desert.
translation:
<T>He ya, sen daha dogmamis bile olurdun!
Cole giderken bizim Craggy Dale'den epey
insanin gectigini gordum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It was nice when they stayed with us for
a bit. Ah tell ye, some of their puzzles were
real belters.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bir sure bizde kaldiklarinda guzeldi.
Sana soyleyeyim, bazi bulmacalari
gercekten efsaneydi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Mmph, Ah suppose that wasnae so good
after all.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmm, galiba o da pek iyi bir sey
degilmis aslinda.

original:
<T>The explorers were always fair chuffed when
Ah solved one of their puzzles.
translation:
<T>Kesifciler, bulmacalarindan birini cozdugumde
hep pek sevinirlerdi.

original:
<T>Now, tae make it across the desert,
travellers had tae find a water source.
translation:
<T>Simdi, colu gecebilmek icin,
yolcularin bir su kaynagi bulmasi gerekirdi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>And so they'd head here, to the oasis that
is now Monte d'Or! <W>Ye know, the oasis and
the River Craggy share the same source.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sonra da buraya, simdi Monte d'Or olan vahaya
gelirlerdi! <W>Biliyor musun, bu vaha ile
Craggy Nehri ayni kaynaktan beslenir.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>So is there some sort of underground
waterway flowing through the area?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Yani buradan gecen bir cesit yeralti
su yolu mu var?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Aye, that's right. It's all connected. In fact,
everything is connected if ye really think
about it.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Evet, dogru. Hepsi birbirine bagli. Hatta,
dusununce aslinda her sey birbirine bagli
cikiyor.

original: <T><M3/2/1>Thinking about it makes my head spin...
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Dusunmesi bile basimi donduruyor...

original:
<T>Ha<W20> ha...<W>harrumph! <W>This area cannae have
been more than a wee patch of green land
before Monte d'Or!
translation:
<T>Ha<W20> ha...<W>ohom! <W>Monte d'Or'dan once burasi
kucucuk bir yesil yamagindan fazlasi
olamazdi!

original:
<T>Ah'll be heading back tae Craggy Dale
soon, but Ah'm not leaving without knowing
ma wee boy is safe.
translation:
<T>Yakinda Craggy Dale'e donecegim,
ama kucuk oglumun guvende oldugunu
bilmeden gitmem.

original:
<T>I hope the lad wasnae washed away by all
that flowing sand.
translation:
<T>Umarim cocuk, o akan kumlarin arasinda
suruklenip gitmemistir.

original: コッペリア
translation: コッペリア

original:
<T>Oh, hullo! Are you taking the time to enjoy
everything this city has to offer?
translation:
<T>Ah, merhaba! Bu sehrin sundugu her seyin
tadini cikarmaya vakit ayiriyor musunuz?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/1>We'd like to, but right now we've got some
important investigating to do!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Isterdik ama su anda arastirmamiz gereken
onemli isler var!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>What's stopping you from doing both at the
same time, like me? I'm 'oping to fit in a bit
of sightseeing while I promote our troupe.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Benim gibi ikisini birden yapmaniza ne engel?
Ayni anda ekibimizi tanitirken biraz da
gezmeye calisiyorum.

original:
<T>No point bein' down on the main street with
everyone in their full get-up, know what
I mean?
translation:
<T>Herkes tam kostumuyle ana caddede dolanirken
benim de orada olmamin pek anlami yok,
anladiniz ya?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M5/1/1>So, you're like a walking advert!
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Yani yuruyen bir reklam gibisiniz!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>That's right! <W>Oh, you'll never believe what
I picked up earlier. Want to 'ave a look?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Aynen oyle! <W>Az once ne bulduguma inanamazsiniz.
Bir bakmak ister misiniz?

original:
<T>Come back and find me if you fancy another
crack at it.
translation:
<T>Bir kez daha denemek isterseniz geri donup
beni bulun.

original:
<T>This puzzle was just lyin' in the street. Why
can't people tidy up after themselves?
translation:
<T>Bu bulmaca sokakta oylece duruyordu. Insanlar
neden ardini toparlamiyor ki?

original:
<T>Oh, I can't tell you the last time I had a walk
around town without the ringmaster breathing
down me neck!
translation:
<T>Ah, sirk muduru enseme nefesini uflemeden
sehrin icinde dolasmayali ne kadar oldu,
inanin hatirlamiyorum!

original: <T><M2/1/1>I'm delighted for you.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Sizin adiniza sevindim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>And so many people are out and about! Too
bad you can't tell which one of them is the
Masked Gentleman, eh?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bir de ortalik insan kayniyor! Ne yazik ki
hangisinin Maskeli Beyefendi oldugunu
anlayamiyorsunuz, degil mi?

original: <T><M3/2/1>I 'ope they sort this mess out soon.
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Umarim bu karmasayi yakinda cozerler.

original:
<T>There's so much to do here that time seems
to fly by just like that.
translation:
<T>Burada yapilacak o kadar cok sey var ki zaman
goz acip kapayincaya kadar geciyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Back when they built this city, Chance
Avenue weren't even 'ere. It were a right
green place next to the oasis.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu sehir yapilirken Chance Bulvari
bile yoktu. Vahaya yakin, yemyesil
bir yerdi burasi.

original:
<T>It's good how far Monte d'Or has come, in't
it? Whoever thought a little oasis could
become this huge metropolis?
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'un ne kadar gelistigi harika, degil mi?
Kucucuk bir vahanin
boyle dev bir metropole donusecegini kim dusunurdu?

original: <T><M3/1/1>It's almost like it don't even belong 'ere...
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Sanki buraya ait bile degilmis gibi...

original:
<T>A huge wave of sand just went whoosh an'
washed over everything!
translation: <T>Kocaman bir kum dalgasi "fiiis" diye gelip her seyi basti!

original:
<T>Lucky I was able to hide in one of the
buildings or I'd have been in proper trouble!
translation:
<T>Neyse ki binalardan birine saklanabildim,
yoksa basim fena halde belaya girerdi!

original: パンチョン
translation: Panchon

original: <T><M3/1/1>Have you heard of the Reunion Inn?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Reunion Inn'i duydunuz mu?

original: <T>It is the city's finest five-star hotel.
translation: <T>Sehrin en iyi bes yildizli otelidir.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It's just the type of high-class establishment
I prefer. <W>Of course, six stars would be more
to my liking.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Tam da benim sevdigim turden ust duzey bir mekan
iste. <W>Tabii alti yildiz olsa daha
cok hosuma giderdi.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Would you mind telling us where this hotel
is?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu otelin nerede
oldugunu soyler misiniz?

original:
<T>Why, the centre of town! Only the elite can
afford to stay there, but I suppose you might
gawk at the lobby for free.
translation:
<T>Sehrin tam merkezi! Orada yalnizca seckinler
kalabilecek kadar paraya sahiptir ama sanirim
lobiyi bedavaya seyredebilirsiniz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>In fact, you might glimpse its exterior from
the express tram.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hatta dis cephesini hizli tramvaydan
gorebilirsiniz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Perhaps when a suitable time presents itself,
we'll be able to take the tram there from one
of the stations. Thank you, Mr Waltham.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Uygun bir firsat ciktiginda,
istasyonlardan birinden tramvaya binip oraya
gidebiliriz. Tesekkurler, Bay Waltham.

original:
<T>Casinos? Good for throwing away a few
million or so, but the poor are drawn to
them like moths to a flame. Ugh.
translation:
<T>Kumarhaneler mi? Birkac milyonu cope atmak
icin iyi, ama yoksullar
atese ucan guveler gibi onlara cekilir. Iyy.

original: ギラン
translation: ギラン

original: <T>Professor Layton, good to see you!
translation: <T>Profesor Layton, sizi gormek guzel!

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original: <T>Likewise. No more disturbances, I hope?
translation: <T>Ben de oyle. Umarim baska bir olay yoktur?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>None whatsoever, thank you. I was taking
a moment to reflect on the Scorpion
Casino's recent growth.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hic yok efendim, tesekkur ederim. Scorpion
Casino'nun son buyumesini dusunmek icin
bir an durup soluklaniyordum.

original:
<T>When the casino was first built, Monte d'Or
was still just a small town, a delicate desert
rose.
translation:
<T>Kumarhane ilk insa edildiginde Monte d'Or
hala kucuk bir kasabaydi, narin bir col
gulu gibiydi.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Then the casinos and hotels sprouted up
and the city sprawled outwards to become
the perennial paradise you see today.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sonra kumarhaneler ve oteller filizlendi,
sehir de disa dogru yayilip bugun gordugunuz
surekli bir cennete donustu.

original:
<T>Of course, not being of age at the time,
Mr Ledore needed a guarantor to make it all
possible.
translation:
<T>Elbette o zamanlar resit olmadigindan,
Bay Ledore'un bunu mumkun kilacak bir kefile
ihtiyaci vardi.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Somebody co-signed Henry's property
purchases?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Biri Henry'nin mulk satin alimlarina
kefil mi oldu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yes, that's what I've heard. Apparently, she
passed away some time ago.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet, duydugum bu. Gorunuse gore o da
bir sure once vefat etmis.

original: <T>I was not aware of any of this.
translation: <T>Bunlarin hicbirinden haberim yoktu.

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original: <T><M5/1/1>You learn something every day, Professor.
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Insan her gun yeni bir sey ogreniyor, Profesor.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Why would Henry keep this information from
me?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Henry bu bilgiyi neden benden saklasin
ki?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Stop by the casino when you next have
time, Professor. I've tailored a puzzle just
for you.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bir dahaki firsatta kumarhaneye ugrayin,
Profesor. Sizin icin ozel olarak bir bilmece
hazirladim.

original: ギラン
translation: ギラン

original:
<T>Welcome, Professor. I assume you're here
to try the puzzle I've prepared?
translation:
<T>Hos geldiniz, Profesor. Hazirladigim bulmacayi
denemeye geldiniz sanirim?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Ho ho, you assume correctly. I couldn't
possibly resist.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ho ho, dogru tahmin ettiniz. Buna
karsi koymam mumkun degildi.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Excellent. You'll have to tell me whether
it's worth its weight in picarats.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Mukemmel. Picarat degerine
degip degmedigini bana soylemelisiniz.

original: <T>No good?
translation: <T>Begenmediniz mi?

original:
<T>On the contrary, it's excellently constructed.
I'd just like to save it for another time.
translation:
<T>Aksine, harika hazirlanmis.
Sadece baska bir zamana saklamak istiyorum.

original:
<T>As long as you find my puzzle interesting,
that's good enough for me.
translation:
<T>Bulmacami ilginc bulmaniz
benim icin yeter de artar.

original:
<T>I've been working to find other sources of
amusement besides the usual casino games
to keep our guests happy.
translation:
<T>Konuklarimizi mutlu etmek icin
alisildik kumarhane oyunlarinin disinda da
eglence kaynaklari bulmaya calisiyorum.

original: <T><M2/1/1>It's all according to Mr Ledore's guidelines.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Her sey Bay Ledore'un yonergelerine gore.

original:
<T>The day he entrusted me his casino was the
day I realised what an incredible man he is.
translation:
<T>Kumarhanesini bana emanet ettigi gun,
ne kadar inanilmaz bir adam oldugunu anladim.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>You hold this establishment very dear,
don't you?
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Bu mekan sizin icin cok degerli,
oyle degil mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Put it this way: the sound of cards shuffling
brings me out in goose pimples.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Soyle soyleyeyim: kartlarin karistirilma sesi
tuylerimi diken diken eder.

original: <T>Well, you're in the right business, then.
translation: <T>O halde dogru istesiniz.

original: <T><M3/1/1>I'm the luckiest man in the entire casino.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Bu kumarhanedeki en sansli adam benim.

original:
<T>Our location affords us a great deal of
interest, which can make controlling the
flow of people a difficult task at times.
translation:
<T>Konumumuz buyuk ilgi cekiyor; bu da bazen
insan akisini
kontrol etmeyi zorlastirabiliyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We want to make it as easy as possible for
our patrons to enjoy themselves.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Misafirlerimizin keyif almasini
olabildigince kolaylastirmak istiyoruz.

original:
<T>The top floor of the Scorpion Casino hosts
a members lounge for our special guests.
translation:
<T>Akrep Kumarhanesi'nin en ust katinda
ozel konuklarimiz icin bir uye salonu var.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It's an exquisite meeting space for refined
gentlemen such as yourself, but I'm afraid it
requires a membership.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sizin gibi seckin beyefendiler icin harika
bir bulusma alani; ama maalesef
uyelik gerektiriyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Monte d'Or is at her finest when the sun
goes down and the neon lights up.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Monte d'Or, gunes batip neonlar yaninca
en guzel haline burunur.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You'd be surprised how many of our guests
have slipped out for a night on the town
after their children are fast asleep!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Cocuklari derin uykuya daldiktan sonra
gece sehre kacan konuklarimizin
sayisina sasirirsiniz!

original: ポリス
translation: ポリス

original:
<T>Come on, lemon, lemon, lemon! <W20><M3/1/1>Oh! <W20>Ah!
<W20>Er... <W20>Professor Layton!
translation:
<T>Hadi, limon, limon, limon! <W20><M3/1/1>Oh! <W20>Ah!
<W20>Ee... <W20>Profesor Layton!

original:
<T>I was just, uh...<W>testing! <W20>Yes, just testing this
here slot machine! You know, to make sure
it's not cheating people.
translation:
<T>Ben sadece, sey...<W>test ediyordum! <W20>Evet, sadece su
slot makinesini test ediyordum! Hani,
insanlari dolandirmiyor mu diye.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>This is official police business! Very
important, honest.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bu resmi polis isi! Cok
onemli, vallahi.

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original: <T><M3/2/1>I...wasn't going to say anything.
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Ben... bir sey demeyecektim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>All right, fine! I confess. I was slacking! I
got posted just outside and I popped in for
a short break.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Peki, tamam! Itiraf ediyorum. Kaytardim! Disarida
nobetim vardi, ben de
kisa bir mola icin iceri ugradim.

original:
<T>And you know, there was always a chance
that I might spot a shady character
snooping around in here.
translation:
<T>Hem biliyorsunuz, burada
etrafi kolacan eden supheli birini
gorme ihtimalim de vardi.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Look, please don't report me. I just...I
couldn't help it. I broke down and gave in
this one time. I won't do it again!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bakin, lutfen beni sikayet etmeyin. Ben sadece... Ben
dayanamadim. Bir kez olsun pes edip biraktim.
Bir daha yapmayacagim!

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Well, I'm sure it's hard to stay fully
committed to your job in a place with so
many distractions.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Boyle dikkati dagitan seylerle dolu bir yerde
isine yuzde yuz odaklanmak zor olmali,
elbette.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>We'll just have to redouble our efforts so
that you and the other officers can have
a well-deserved rest.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>O halde biz de cabamizi iki katina cikarmaliyiz ki
siz ve diger memurlar
hak ettiginiz bir mola verebilesiniz.

original:
<T>The chief is still dead suspicious of that
Dalston and no one can ever tell what
Detective Bloom's thinking.
translation:
<T>Sef hala su Dalston'dan deli gibi supheleniyor,
Dedektif Bloom'un da ne dusundugunu
kimse anlayamiyor.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>You're our last hope, Professor! If you don't
solve this case, I don't know who will.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Son umudumuz sizsiniz, Profesor! Bu davayi siz
cozmezseniz, kim cozer bilmiyorum.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Was it all just a dream? This place looks
perfectly normal!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hepsi sadece bir ruya miydi? Burasi
kusursuz bicimde normal gorunuyor!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Something must have happened here while
we were at Tingly Tower.
translation:
<T>Biz Tingly Kulesi'ndeyken burada
bir seyler olmus olmali.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Then maybe we should try looking for clues
there.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>O halde belki de ipuclarini
orada aramaliyiz.

original: パック
translation: Puck

original:
<T>Kiddies love carnivals. Carnivals love
kiddies!
translation:
<T>Cocuklar karnavallari sever. Karnavallar da
cocuklari!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M5/2/1>My, so much energy! I remember when I was
a child...
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Aman, ne kadar enerji! Ben de cocukken
boyleydim...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Actually, just between me and you, I'm 20
years old. I'm a full-grown adult!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aslinda aramizda kalsin, ben 20
yasindayim. Artik koca bir yetiskinim!

original: <T><M1/1/4>Wait...what?!

<T>I thought, hey, I've got a baby face, maybe
I'll be really popular if I dress up! But well...
I don't have a lot of fans...<W>yet.
translation:
<T>Soyle dusundum, bebek yuzum var ya,
suslenirsem cok populer olurum! Ama iste...
Pek hayranim yok...<W>simdilik.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/2/5>I thought you were about my age!
translation: <T><M3/2/5>Ben de seninle yasit sanmistim!

original:
<T><M2/3/1>Look, kid. If you're cute and little, you can
always get people to be nice to you.
Remember that.
translation:
<T><M2/3/1>Bak ufaklik. Sevimli ve kucuksen,
insanlari sana karsi hep daha nazik yaparsin.
Bunu unutma.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I wish I could return to my childhood. Then
I could just spend my days solving puzzles
like this.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Keske cocukluguma donebilsem. O zaman
gunlerimi sadece boyle bulmacalar cozerek
gecirebilirdim.

original: <T>Too hard, huh?
translation: <T>Cok mu zor, ha?

original: <T>Not afraid of a challenge, eh? Nice.
translation: <T>Zorluktan korkmuyorsun, oyle mi? Guzel.

original:
<T><M2/3/1>Hey, you're not so bad with puzzles
yourself!
translation:
<T><M2/3/1>Hey, sen de bulmacalarda
pek fena degilsin!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Just remember that all your dreams can
come true in this town! <W>Even if your dream
is to pretend you're still young.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Unutma, bu kasabada tum hayaller
gercek olabilir! <W>Hayalin
hala gencmis gibi yapmak olsa bile.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Once I've got a real following, I'll be able to
spend all my evenings soaking up the
attention of my adoring fans!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Gercek bir hayran kitlem olunca,
tum aksamlarimi bayilan hayranlarimin
ilgisiyle mest olarak gecirecegim!

original:
<T><M4/2/6>Hmm...<W> Luke, do you feel you need more
attention?
translation:
<T><M4/2/6>Hmm...<W> Luke, daha fazla
ilgiye ihtiyacin oldugunu mu dusunuyorsun?

original:
<T><M4/2/3>Please, no! I hate being treated like a child.
I'd much prefer to dress up as an adult.
translation:
<T><M4/2/3>Lutfen, hayir! Cocuk gibi muamele gormekten nefret ederim.
Bir yetiskin gibi giyinmeyi tercih ederim.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Your loss!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Sen bilirsin!

original:
<T>These balloons are part of my childish spirit.
Long as I keep a tight grip, I can see life
through rose-tinted glasses.
translation:
<T>Bu balonlar cocuk ruhumun bir parcasi.
Siki tuttugum surece hayata
pembe gozluklerle bakabilirim.

original:
<T>I wanted to use my adorable act to get
some attention from the tourists, but a
clown showed up and stole my thunder.
translation:
<T>Sevimli numaramla turistlerin
dikkatini cekmek istiyordum ama bir
palyaco cikageldi ve butun sovumu caldi.

original: <T><M3/1/1>I'm not a fan of clowns.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Palyacolardan hoslanmam.

original: <T><M3/1/1>What was all that sand about?!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Bu kum isi de neydi oyle?!

original: セレナ
translation: セレナ

original:
<T>Do you know that absotively gorgeous hotel
in the centre of town? It must cater to
wealthy celeries or something!
translation:
<T>Sehir merkezindeki o absurt derecede muhtesem oteli
biliyor musunuz? Zengin unlulere falan
hitap ediyor olmali!

original:
<T>I hear it's got bristling access to the
racecourse and Tingly Town and their
service is supposed to be top notch!
translation:
<T>Duyduguma gore hipodroma ve Tingly Town'a
piril piril baglantilari varmis ve
hizmetleri de birinci sinifmis!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I wish I could experience what it's like to be
a mollypampered princess.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Keske simartila simartila buyutulmus bir prenses
olmanin nasil bir sey oldugunu yasayabilsem.

original:
<T>I like to imagine myself on a lazy Sunday
morning eating eggs Benevolent in bed while
my servants call me mistremoiselle.
translation:
<T>Tembel bir pazar sabahi, yatakta Eggs Benevolent yerken
hizmetkarlarimin bana mistremoiselle diye seslendigini
hayal etmeyi seviyorum.

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
<T><M5/2/1>That's something you and I have in
common, Serena.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Bu konuda ortak bir yanimiz var,
Serena.

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
<T><M1/2/5>Really?! I have a hard time imagining you
doing that, Emmy.
translation:
<T><M1/2/5>Gercekten mi?! Seni oyle hayal etmekte
eziliyorum, Emmy.

original:
<T><M4/2/6>Of course! After breakfast, I'd go for a jog
around my estate, take some photos in the
city, do some training...
translation:
<T><M4/2/6>Elbette! Kahvaltidan sonra malikanemde
kosuya cikar, sehirde birkac fotograf ceker,
sonra da biraz antrenman yaparim...

original:
<T><M3/1/2>I'm not sure you're dreaming about quite the
same lifestyle...
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Sanirim ikiniz pek de ayni yasam tarzini
hayal etmiyorsunuz...

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Yeah, your fantasy life sounds kind of
exhausticating!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Evet, senin hayal hayatin biraz
yorucuymus gibi!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>The point of being rich is that you can pay
other people to work for you so you can
focus on being lazy and wonderfabulous.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Zengin olmanin olayi, isleri baskalarina yaptirip
senin de tembellik etmeye ve harika-havali olmaya
odaklanabilmendir.

original: <T>Monte d'Or just leaves me breathless!
translation: <T>Monte d'Or nefessiz birakiyor beni!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I'm never going back to a boring life of
miseritude!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bir daha asla sikici bir
sefalet hayatina donmem!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Let's investigate Tingly Tower. We may find
some clues about what happened yesterday.
translation:
<T>Tingly Kulesi'ni arastiralim. Dun olanlarla ilgili
bazi ipuclari bulabiliriz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>We still haven't investigated Tingly Tower.
Let's do that before moving on.
translation:
<T>Hala Tingly Kulesi'ni arastirmadik.
Devam etmeden once bunu yapalim.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Hmm. Everything seems to be the same as it
was last night...
translation:
<T>Hmm. Her sey dun gecekiyle ayni
gibi gorunuyor...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M6/2/1>It's still pitch black! I can't even see my
feet!
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Hala zifiri karanlik! Ayaklarimi bile
goremiyorum!

original:
<T>Yes, the interior seems to block out even
the faintest sliver of light.
translation:
<T>Evet, icerisi en ufak bir isik
kirintisini bile iceri sokmuyor gibi.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T>Professor, what are you doing?
translation: <T>Profesor, ne yapiyorsunuz?

original: <T>Exactly as I thought.
translation: <T>Tam dusundugum gibi.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>The Masked Gentleman isn't afraid of
building elaborate contraptions to support
his illusions.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Maskeli Beyefendi, illuzyonlarini
desteklemek icin karmasik duzenekler
kurmaktan cekinmiyor.

original: <T><M2/2/1>What do you mean by that?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Ne demek istiyorsunuz?

original: <T>Quite clever...
translation: <T>Oldukca zekice...

original:
<T><M6/1/1>While the Masked Gentleman had our
attention, he rotated the floor so that we
went out on the opposite side.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Maskeli Beyefendi dikkatimizi dagitirken,
zemini dondurup bizi
karsi taraftan cikardi.
<T><M1/2/5>Gercekten mi?!

original:
<T>I'll bet my hat there's an exact replica of
Tingly Town on the other side of this door.
translation:
<T>Bahse girerim bu kapinin ote yaninda
Tingly Town'un birebir kopyasi var.

original: <T><M2/1/1>You've got to be kidding me...
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Saka yapiyor olmalisiniz...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>The concept is so simple that it verges on
the absurd. Who would ever suspect a
replica park behind the first?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Fikir o kadar basit ki neredeyse
sacma. Kim ilk parkin arkasinda
bir kopya park olacagini dusunur ki?

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I can see him hiding a rotating floor inside
the tower, but surely this can't have gone
unnoticed!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Kulenin icine doner bir zemin saklamasini
anlarim ama bunun
fark edilmemis olmasi imkansiz!

original: <T><M3/1/1>So this park was empty all along...
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Demek bu park basindan beri bosmus...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That seems to be the case. Come, let's
head back to the real park.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Gorunen o. Hadi, gercek parka
geri donelim.

original: マーフィー
translation: Murphy

original:
<T>Aha! It's you! What a pleasure to see you
again. <W>You must be eager to hear the latest
news from the world of accountancy!
translation:
<T>Aha! Sensin! Seni tekrar gormek ne guzel.
<W>Muhasebe dunyasindan en guncel
haberleri duymak icin sabirsizlaniyor olmalisin!

original: マーフィー
translation: Murphy

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Yes, I knew the opportunity to hear more
of this city's economy would draw you in.
How could it not?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Evet, bu sehrin ekonomisi hakkinda
daha fazlasini dinleme firsatinin sizi cekecegini biliyordum.
Nasil cekmesin ki?

original:
<T><M1/2/2>But, err, I can't just give you something for
nothing. Business principles, you know.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Ama sey, size bedavaya
bir sey veremem. Is prensipleri, bilirsiniz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M1/2/1>Oh, is that so?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Oyle mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Let's see... Yes, an answer to this puzzle
should be sufficient recompense. It'll be
worth it, trust me.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bir bakalim... Evet, bu bulmacanin
cevabi yeterli bir karsilik olur. Buna
degecek, bana guvenin.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You don't know what you're missing, sir. It's
the bargain to end all bargains!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Neleri kacirdiginizi bilmiyorsunuz efendim.
Bu, tum pazarliklarin pazarligi!

original:
<T>That's right. Just think about the choice
information that's waiting for you just round
the corner.
translation:
<T>Aynen oyle. Su kosenin hemen ardinda
sizi bekleyen o degerli
bilgileri bir dusunun.

original:
<T>Splendid, splendid! I simply have no choice
but to tell you every last...<W30>fascinating...
<W30>detail.
translation:
<T>Harika, harika! O halde size
sonuna kadar her...<W30>ilginc...
<W30>detayi anlatmaktan baska carem yok.

original: <T>That was the deal.
translation: <T>Anlastigimiz buydu.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Well! <W>Mr Ledore's fortune has escalated to
truly amazing levels. He's rapidly climbing
the lists of the world's richest.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Vay canina! <W>Bay Ledore'un serveti
gercekten inanilmaz seviyelere ulasti. Dunya
zenginleri listelerinde hizla yukseliyor.

original:
<T>Ever since Mr Dalston was detained by the
police, customers have flocked to
Mr Ledore's establishments.
translation:
<T>Bay Dalston polis tarafindan gozaltina alindigindan beri
musteriler akin akin
Bay Ledore'un isletmelerine yoneliyor.

original:
<T>It's reached the point where you could
reasonably say that Mr Ledore owns this
entire city.
translation:
<T>Oyle bir noktaya geldi ki
Bay Ledore'un bu
tum sehrin sahibi oldugunu rahatca soyleyebilirsiniz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That arrest definitely benefited Mr Ledore.
Why, I'd bet my reputation as an accountant
on it.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>O tutuklama kesinlikle Bay Ledore'a yaradi.
Hatta buna
bir muhasebeci olarak itibarimi ortaya koyarim.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/1/3>Professor, doesn't that put Henry under a lot
of suspicion?! After all, he's the one who
accused Mr Dalston to begin with!
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Profesor, bu Henry'yi
oldukca supheli duruma sokmuyor mu?! Sonucta
Bay Dalston'u ilk suclayan da oydu!

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>I agree with you entirely, Luke. Murphy, do
you happen to know who was behind the
financing of the fairground?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Tamamen katiliyorum, Luke. Murphy,
lunaparkin finansmaninin
arkasinda kimin oldugunu biliyor musun?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Was it the same group responsible for the
construction?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Insaati ustlenen grup
ayni grup muydu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Well, basically. I mean, that's all Mr Ledore.
He issues the permits for every construction
project.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Temelde evet. Yani isin ozu Bay Ledore.
Her insaat projesi icin
izinleri o veriyor.

original:
<T>He's been pouring money into new buildings
like it's cement, lately. But the Masked
Gentleman concerns him.
translation:
<T>Son zamanlarda yeni binalara
cimento doker gibi para akitiyor. Ama Maskeli
Bey onu endiselendiriyor.

original:
<T>With all this expansion, he can't afford
a drop-off in business right now.
translation:
<T>Bu kadar buyume varken
su anda islerinde bir dususe tahammulu yok.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh my, look at the time... I have enough
work for three people. No rest for the
number crunchers! Farewell for now!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aman, saate bakin... Uc kisilik
isim var. Rakamlarla ugrasanlara
dinlenmek yok! Simdilik hosca kalin!

original:
<T><M3/1/2>He talks enough for three people! Doesn't
he realise he's giving away people's
confidential information?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Uc kisi yerine konusuyor! Insanlarin
gizli bilgilerini
ifsa ettiginin farkinda degil mi?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Anyway, does that mean Henry's pouring
lots of money into his facilities?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Yani bu, Henry'nin
tesislerine cok para akittigi anlamina mi geliyor?

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Apparently so. But I would still like to check
with Henry to see how much of this is really
true.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Oyle gorunuyor. Ama bunun ne kadarinin
gercekten dogru oldugunu gormek icin
Henry'yle yine de konusmak istiyorum.

original:
<T><M7/1/3>Good idea, Professor! Let's head to the
Ledores' and ask him about it.
translation:
<T><M7/1/3>Iyi fikir, Profesor! Ledore'lara gidip
ona bunu soralim.

original: マカロン
translation: Macaron

original:
<T>Me mam told me where I should wait for her
if I got lost, so I thought that meant I was
allowed...<W30>to wander off...<W30>a bit.
translation:
<T>Annem kaybolursam nerede beklemem
gerektigini soyledi, ben de bunun
biraz...<W30>uzaklasmama...<W30>izin var demek oldugunu sandim.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M4/2/3>So you're lost again?
translation: <T><M4/2/3>Yine mi kayboldun?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Umm...<W30>aye, but it's...it's not my fault! I was
too distracted by this puzzle - look!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ee...<W30>evet, ama... benim sucum degil! Bu
bulmacaya cok daldim... Bak!

original:
<T>Aaah, it's propah annoyin', like! I'm not
gannin' back to find me mam until I work it
out!
translation:
<T>Ahh, cok sinir bozucu! Ben bunu
cozmeden annemi bulmaya
gitmiyorum!

original:
<T>I just don't get it... As soon as I solve it,
I'll gan look for me mam.
translation:
<T>Hic anlamiyorum... Cozer cozmez
annemi aramaya gidecegim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yay, you did it! I didn't know that was how it
worked!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Yasasin, yaptin! Boyle
calistigini bilmiyordum!

original:
<T>Umm, me mam said if we got separated, I
should wait for her at the Reunion Inn. It's
that huge white hotel.
translation:
<T>Ee, annem ayrilirsak
Reunion Hani'nda onu beklemem gerektigini soyledi. O
kocaman beyaz otel var ya.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/1>What do you think, Emmy? Should we take
her there?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ne dersin Emmy? Onu
oraya goturelim mi?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Of course! Bonnie, would you like to come
with us to the hotel?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Elbette! Bonnie, bizimle
otele gelmek ister misin?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Nae way! I want to stay and watch the
carnival a bit more, like!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yok ya! Biraz daha kalip
karnavali izlemek istiyorum!

original:
<T>It's me mam's fault for not keepin' an eye
on me. I'll find her when I feel like it.
translation:
<T>Suc annemde, beni gozden
kacirdi. Canim isteyince onu bulurum.

original: <T><M5/2/3>Are you sure you'll be all right by yourself?
translation: <T><M5/2/3>Tek basina iyi olacagina emin misin?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Wey aye! Me mam says I have a propah
good sense of direction, even if I do wander
off a lot.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Tabii ki! Annem, cok
geziniyor olsam da yon duygumun
cok iyi oldugunu soyler.

original:
<T>And when I do fancy headin' back, I can just
take the tram from Tingly Town to the
Reunion Inn, nae problem.
translation:
<T>Hem geri donmek istersem,
Tingly Town'dan Reunion Hani'na tramvaya
binerim, sorun yok.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Well, if you're sure...
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Peki, eminsen...

original: <T><M4/1/1>Don't keep your mum waiting too long!
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Anneni fazla bekletme!

original:
<T>I saw a lad with some balloons earlier.
I want some balloons now, like...
translation:
<T>Az once balonlari olan bir cocuk gordum.
Ben de simdi balon istiyorum...

original:
<T>Fuaaah... I'm getting a bit sleepy, like.
Maybe I should gan back to the hotel. D'ya
reckon me mam's there waitin' for me?
translation:
<T>Fuaaah... Biraz uykum geldi.
Belki otele donmeliyim. Sence
annem beni orada bekliyor mudur?

original:
<T>When all the sand went whoosh, the big
muscly toy man ran up and helped me!
translation:
<T>Kumlar birden 'vuuus' deyince o kocaman
kasli oyuncak adam kosup bana yardim etti!

original:
<T>Then he ran off again shoutin' {''}Hemmy!
Hemmy!{''} and somethin' about jewels.
translation:
<T>Sonra da tekrar {''}Hemmy!
Hemmy!{''} diye bagirarak ve mucevherlerden bahsederek uzaklasti.

original: ラプンシュカ
translation: ラプンシュカ

original:
<T>Well, there's one good thing about the
Masked Gentleman coming to town, and
that's more business!
translation:
<T>Sehre Maskeli Beyefendi'nin gelmesinin bir iyi yani var,
ve o da daha cok is demek!
Daha cok musteri yani!

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T>Really? I would have thought the carnival
would cause the greatest influx of tourists.
translation:
<T>Oyle mi? Ben en buyuk turist akininin
karnaval yuzunden olacagini sanirdim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Well, there's that too, but the largest crowds
are gathering where the Masked Gentleman
has appeared.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>O da var tabii, ama en buyuk kalabaliklar
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin gorundugu yerde
toplaniyor.

original:
<T>There's certainly no shortage of hotels in
Monte d'Or, but all the places in the city
centre are completely booked up.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'da otel sikintisi yok elbette,
ama sehir merkezindeki tum yerler
tamamen dolmus.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I'm glad you managed to get into one of the
good ones.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Iyilerden birine yerlesebilmis olmaniza
sevindim.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Yes, thanks to Henry and Angela.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Evet, Henry ve Angela sayesinde.

original:
<T>Of course. <W>Still, considering the Ledores
invited you here, haven't you found them
to be a bit standoffish?
translation:
<T>Elbette. <W>Yine de, Ledore'lar sizi buraya
davet ettigine gore, onlari biraz mesafeli
bulmadiniz mi?

original:
<T>Don't get me wrong, though. I'm not saying
they're involved. In fact, I'm certain Henry
Ledore is innocent of any wrongdoing.
translation:
<T>Beni yanlis anlamayin ama; onlarin isin icinde oldugunu
soylemiyorum. Hatta Henry
Ledore'un hicbir sucu olmadigindan eminim.

original: <T><M4/2/1>What makes you so confident?
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Bu kadar emin olmanizi saglayan ne?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>He's the quiet type. The less one talks
about oneself, the higher the risk of being
misjudged by others.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>O sessiz bir tip. Insan kendinden ne kadar az
bahsederse, baskalari tarafindan
yanlis anlasilma riski o kadar artar.

original:
<T>I'm just saying make sure you don't end up
accusing the wrong person too.
translation:
<T>Sadece, siz de sonunda yanlis kisiyi
suclamadiginizdan emin olun diyorum.

original:
<T>Sometimes it's worth following your gut
feeling instead of cold, hard logic.
Remember that.
translation:
<T>Bazen soguk, kati mantik yerine
icgudunu dinlemeye deger.
Bunu unutmayin.

original: コマーニ無
translation: Comarni

original: <T>Oh, bother! Why is it always me?
translation: <T>Ah, kahretsin! Neden hep ben?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T>What's the matter, Bungle?
translation: <T>Ne oldu, Bungle?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>The ringmaster hates me, I'm sure of it! First
he has me handing out flyers, then putting
up posters...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sirk muduru benden nefret ediyor, eminim! Once
bana brosur dagittiriyor, sonra da
afis astiriyor...

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Well, at least you're better off than when
you were tangled up in those balloons!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>En azindan su balonlara
dolanip kaldigin zamankinden iyisin!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Now don't go dredging up the past! All it
took was a few little slip-ups and now I'm
branded as a bungler!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Simdi gecmisi kurcalayip durma! Sadece birkac
kucuk hataydi ve simdi
beceriksiz diye damgalandim!

original:
<T>I want to pull my weight and do some of the
more important circus...stuff!
translation:
<T>Ben de uzerime duseni yapip sirkle ilgili daha
onemli... seyleri yapmak istiyorum!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M5/2/1>But without you, how would anyone hear
about the show?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Ama sen olmadan, kim gosteriden
haberdar olurdu?

original: <T><M3/1/1>Uh, well... <W>I hadn't thought of that.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Ee, sey... <W>Bunu dusunmemistim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>She's right. If we hadn't run into you, we'd
never have known about the circus.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hakli. Sana rastlamasaydik,
sirki asla duyamazdik.

original:
<T><M2/1/1><K>...<W><K/>Oh goodness, I'm quite responsible really,
aren't I? I can feel the pressure getting to
me already...
translation:
<T><M2/1/1><K>...<W><K/>Aman Tanrim, aslinda oldukca sorumluyum,
degil mi? Baskinin
simdiden uzerime coktugunu hissediyorum...

original:
<T>Someday I'll get up on that stage and show
the world how well I can balance on a ball.
translation:
<T>Bir gun o sahneye cikip dunyaya
top uzerinde ne kadar iyi dengede durabildigimi gosterecegim.

original: オージー
translation: オージー

original:
<T>Mmm, there's really nothing like the taste of
melted mozzarella.
translation:
<T>Mmm, erimis mozzarellanin tadi gibisi
gercekten yok.

original:
<T>Looking at art while you eat pizza makes the
art even better! Look at how this cheese
stretches our conceptions!
translation:
<T>Pizza yerken sanat izlemek, sanati daha da
guzellestirir! Su peynirin
algilarimizi nasil esnettigine bakin!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh, you'll have to excuse me. I get carried
away with my calzones.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah, kusura bakmayin. Calzone'lar
beni fazla costuruyor.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/2/4>You don't touch the art when your hands are
all greasy, do you?
translation:
<T><M4/2/4>Ellerin yag icindeyken sanata dokunmazsin,
degil mi?

original:
<T>My dear boy, art is to be seen. Pizza is to
be eaten.
translation:
<T>Sevgili oglum, sanat seyredilmek icindir.
Pizza ise yenmek icin.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>And what better way to appreciate fine art
than with a nose full of the fragrant aromas
of tomato and cheese?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Domates ve peynirin mis kokusunu
burnunuzun icine cekerken
guzel sanati takdir etmekten daha iyi ne var?
<T><M2/2/1>Anliyorum...

original:
<T>Speaking of pizza, this puzzle has me
stumped. Surely it's not natural for the
slices to do this...
translation:
<T>Pizza demisken, bu bulmaca beni
camura sapladi. Dilimlerin boyle
davranmasi normal olamaz...

original:
<T>What's really puzzling is why I even wasted
my time on a puzzle when I've got pizza and
art to keep me busy.
translation:
<T>Asil sasirtici olan, pizza ve sanat varken
niye vaktimi bir bulmacaya
harcadigim.

original:
<T>I would really like to know the answer before
my pizza gets cold.
translation:
<T>Pizzam sogumadan once
cevabi gercekten ogrenmek isterim.

original: <T>Well, now that IS food for thought!
translation: <T>Iste bu gercekten dusunceye gida!

original: <T><M1/2/2>I wonder why they let him eat that in here?
translation: <T><M1/2/2>Acaba neden burada yemesine izin veriyorlar?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Maybe recent events aren't the only reason
the gallery has been empty.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Belki de galerinin bos olmasinin tek nedeni
son olaylar degildir.

original:
<T>Great art can make our hearts melt like
mozzarella. And melted mozzarella is
great - and delicious - art in itself!
translation:
<T>Buyuk sanat kalplerimizi mozzarella gibi
eritip akitabilir. Erimis mozzarella da
basli basina harika - ve lezzetli - bir sanattir!

original:
<T>I know I just ate, but all this art is making
me want another slice of pizza.
translation:
<T>Az once yemis olsam da bu kadar sanat,
bana bir dilim daha pizza istetiyor.

original:
<T>Monte d'Or is in the middle of a desert, but
the fresh spring water allows farmers to grow
all the ingredients necessary for pizza.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or colun ortasinda, ama taze kaynak
suyu sayesinde ciftciler pizzaya gereken
tum malzemeleri yetistirebiliyor.

original: <T>What is that racket outside?
translation: <T>Disaridaki o gurultu de ne?

original:
<T>Can't that Masked Gentleman stay put?
Does he not appreciate great art? Or -
heaven forbid - great cheese?
translation:
