<T>Su Maskeli Beyefendi yerinde duramaz mi?
Yoksa buyuk sanattan anlamiyor mu? Ya da -
Allah korusun - iyi peynirden?

original: ジャグラー
translation: Juggles

original:
<T>Hullo there! I'm taking over for Pirouette
today just to, you know, get everyone
excited about the big show.
translation:
<T>Selam! Bugunku gosteride Pirouette'in
yerine ben geciyorum; hani, herkes buyuk
sova iyice heyecanlansin diye.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/5>Juggles, you're really good at that!
translation: <T><M3/1/5>Juggles, bunu gercekten cok iyi yapiyorsun!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/1/1>I must admit, I'm very impressed. That must
require an extraordinary level of hand-eye
coordination.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Itiraf etmeliyim, cok etkilendim. Bu,
el-goz koordinasyonunda olaganustu bir
seviyeyi gerektirir.

original:
<T><M7/1/1/40>Aww, don't! You're embarrassing me! <W>Tell
you what. Since you're all so sweet, I'll
share a special puzzle with you.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/40>Ayy, yapmayin! Beni utandiriyorsunuz! <W>Soyle
yapayim. Bu kadar tatli oldugunuza gore,
sizinle ozel bir bulmaca paylasacagim.

original:
<T>Too hard for you? Never mind. Always a
tomorrow. <W>Unless...<W20>well, I suppose you
might not be around tomorrow.
translation:
<T>Sizin icin cok mu zor? Bos verin. Yarin da
var. <W>Tabii...<W20> sey, yarin burada
olmayabilirsiniz gerci.

original:
<T>That's the spirit! Give it a good old bash!
Only, not too hard. We, er,<W20> don't want
it breaking or anything.
translation:
<T>Iste bu! Bir guzel girisin!
Ama cok da sert degil. Biz, ee,<W20> kirilmasini
filan istemeyiz.

original:
<T>Oh bril-<W30> sub-<W30> fantastic. You're so clever,
you are! Look at that! All done like you
weren't even trying!
translation:
<T>Ooo har-<W30>i-<W30>ka! Ne kadar zekisin!
Suna bak! Hic ugrasmamissin gibi
hemen bitirdin!

original:
<T>It's not easy with the Masked Gentleman on
your doorstep, but a little bit of comic
entertainment can go a long way.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi kapinizdayken kolay degil,
ama biraz komik eglence
insanin icini ferahlatir.

original: <T><M3/1/1>You really care about people, don't you?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Insanlari gercekten onemsiyorsun, degil mi?

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Making people smile is what makes me
smile. It's a win-win situation!
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Insanlari gulumsetmek beni de
gulumsetiyor. Herkes kazaniyor!

original:
<T>Now, you come back any time you like. I'll
see if I can juggle something up for you.
translation:
<T>Istediginiz zaman yine gelin. Sizin icin bir
seyler ayarlamaya bakarim.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>We'll make a point to come back when our
work is done.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Isimiz bittiginde tekrar
ugramayi ihmal etmeyecegiz.

original: <T>I love juggling! <W>Just in case you missed that!
translation: <T>Jonglorluge bayilirim! <W>Hani kacirdiysaniz diye soyluyorum!

original:
<T>Aww. How could I not enjoy juggling when I
see how happy it makes people?
translation:
<T>Ayy. Insanlari bu kadar mutlu ettigini
gorunce jonglorlugu sevmemek mumkun mu?

original:
<T>I do my best to put a smile on people's
faces.
translation:
<T>Insanlarin yuzunu guldurmek icin elimden
geleni yaparim.

original:
<T>What's there to be afraid of when you get to
see a show like this?!
translation:
<T>Boyle bir gosteriyi izleyebiliyorken
korkacak ne var ki?!

original: ヤッタイ
translation: Yattai

original:
<T>Oh, Emmy, you are resplendent in loveliness
today! May I get you something?<W> Tea?
<W30>Toys? <W30>The world on a silver platter?
translation:
<T>Ah, Emmy, bugun guzelligin goz kamastiriyor!
Sana bir sey getireyim mi?<W> Cay?
<W30>Oyuncak? <W30>Gumus tepside dunya?

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Well, since you're asking...you don't
happen to know anything about the Masked
Gentleman, do you?
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Madem sordun... Maskeli Beyefendi
hakkinda bir sey biliyor
olmaz misin?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I have sadly never laid eyes on the evildoer.
Oh woe, if I had but caught a glimpse...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ne yazik ki o kotuculu hic gormedim.
Ah, bir kez olsun goz ucuyla gorebilseydim...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Mmm, I suppose you have your stall to
watch over. Well, never mind. Thanks,
though.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmm, tezgahini gozetmen gerek tabii.
Neyse. Yine de
tesekkurler.

original:
<T><M1/3/2>Wait! Don't go!<W> I have something that can
help you! Er... <W30>Here! A puzzle, just for you!
translation:
<T><M1/3/2>Dur! Gitme!<W> Sana yardim edecek bir seyim
var! Ee... <W30>Al! Sadece sana ozel bir bulmaca!

original:
<T>If you can solve it, I believe the answer will
lead you to the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Cozebilirsen, cevabin seni
Maskeli Beyefendi’ye goturecegine inaniyorum.

original: <T><M5/1/4>What? Why didn't you say so before?
translation: <T><M5/1/4>Ne? Bunu neden daha once soylemedin?

original:
<T>Emmy, I implore you, please try to solve this
puzzle before you go anywhere else.
translation:
<T>Emmy, yalvaririm, baska bir yere gitmeden once
bu bulmacayi cozmeye calis.

original: <T>Ah! You have the wisdom of Athena!
translation: <T>Ah! Athena’nin bilgeligi sende var!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>But wait, how will this puzzle help our
investigation?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ama dur, bu bulmaca
sorusturmamiza nasil yardim edecek?

original:
<T><M3/3/1>Ah, aha ha... I thought perhaps there was
a connection, but...clearly I was mistaken.
<W>Oops! Aha ha ha...
translation:
<T><M3/3/1>Ah, aha ha... Belki bir baglanti vardir
diye dusundum ama... belli ki yanilmisim.
<W>Hoppala! Aha ha ha...

original: <T><M5/1/6>Oh, right. <W>Well that's a shame.
translation: <T><M5/1/6>Ha, dogru. <W>Yazik olmus.

original:
<T>I...I could not bear to see you leave and
forged a shameful lie that dirtied my
conscience. <M4/1/1>Can you ever forgive me?
translation:
<T>Ben... seni giderken gormeye dayanamadim ve
vicdanimi kirleten utanc verici bir yalan
uydurdum. <M4/1/1>Beni affedebilir misin?

original:
<T>Oh, Emmy! You are a shooting star that sets
my heart ablaze!
translation:
<T>Ah, Emmy! Sen kalbimi alevlendiren bir
kayan yildizsin!

original: <T>Why must I be prisoner to your beauty?
translation: <T>Neden guzelliginin esiri olmak zorundayim?

original: <T>Emmy! Thank the heavens you are safe!
translation: <T>Emmy! Sukurler olsun guvendesin!

original: タニア
translation: Tania

original:
<T>Eee... Where's that daughtah of mine got to
now? Evah since we got here, she just can't
keep still!
translation:
<T>Ahh... O kizim simdi nereye gitti acaba?
Buraya geleli, bir turlu
yerinde duramiyor!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M4/1/1>There certainly is a lot around here to
distract a child.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Burada bir cocugun dikkatini dagitacak
cok sey var.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>She definitely takes aftah her dad, like. He
propah loves puzzles 'n' all.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Kesin babasina cekmis. O da
bulmacalara filan bayilirdi.

original:
<T>He'd always give her these holiday-themed
puzzles. I bet that's why she's got such
a short attention span now, like!
translation:
<T>Ona hep tatil temali
bulmacalar verirdi. Bahse girerim bu yuzden
simdi dikkat suresi bu kadar kisa!

original:
<T>Eee... I wonder if it's my fault for spoilin'
Bonnie...
translation:
<T>Ahh... Acaba Bonnie'yi simarttigim icin
suc bende mi...

original:
<T>Me husband always used to give Bonnie
puzzles like this.
translation:
<T>Kocam Bonnie’ye hep boyle
bulmacalar verirdi.

original:
<T>I thought bein' in a big place like this might
be scary for the bairn, but she just finds
everythin' around her really excitin'.
translation:
<T>Boyle buyuk bir yerde olmak cocugu
korkutur sanmistim ama etrafindaki her seyi
cok heyecan verici buluyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I told her to wait for me at the Reunion Inn
if we got separated. Eee, I just hope she
was payin' attention.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ayrilirsak Reunion Inn'de beni bekle
dedim. Ahh, umarim
dinlemistir.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M2/2/1>Would you like us to go and look for her?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Isterseniz gidip onu arayalim mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Eee, no, flower. Don't worry about it. She's
got a propah good sense of direction, like.
She can look aftah herself.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ahh, yok canim. Merak etme. Yon duygusu
cok iyidir.
Kendi basinin caresine bakabilir.

original:
<T>Anyway, I've always told her not to talk to
strangers, so I doubt she'll be gettin' herself
into trouble or owt like that.
translation:
<T>Hem ona hep yabancilarla konusma
derdim; o yuzden basini belaya
sokacagini sanmiyorum.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I see. Well, I hope the two of you are
reunited soon.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Anliyorum. Umarim ikiniz
yakinda kavusursunuz.

original:
<T>Eee, that Bonnie! Take your eyes off her for
one second, and poof! She's gone!
translation:
<T>Ahh, su Bonnie! Gozunu bir an
dalinca, puf! Kayboluyor!

original:
<T>I'd be more worried about Bonnie, but I've
seen loads of police around town. She'll
be okay.
translation:
<T>Bonnie icin daha cok endiselenirdim ama
kasabada bir suru polis gordum. Iyi
olacaktir.

original:
<T>Aw, wey aye! Look at all that sand! I hope
Bonnie's al' reet.
translation:
<T>Aman ya! Su kuma bak! Umarim
Bonnie iyidir.

original:
<T>She's got a good heed on her shoulders,
though. I'm sure she found help.
translation:
<T>Ama akli basindadir.
Eminim birinden yardim bulmustur.

original: グロリア
translation: Gloria

original:
<T>So, Hershel, will you be sticking around for
a bit once this whole business is over?
translation:
<T>Peki, Hershel, bu is tamamen bittiginde
bir sure daha buralarda kalacak misin?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Unfortunately, no. I fear my students would
miss me if I didn't turn up to my seminars.
translation:
<T>Ne yazik ki hayir. Derslerime gelmezsem
ogrencilerimin beni ozleyeceginden korkuyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh, that's right, it's Professor Hershel now,
isn't it? Good for you!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ah dogru ya, artik Profesor Hershel oldu,
degil mi? Senin adina sevindim!

original:
<T>After Henry was released from service at
the Ascot house, he spent a lot of time
studying archaeology and Norwell.
translation:
<T>Henry Ascot malikanesindeki gorevinden ayrildiktan sonra
arkeoloji ve Norwell uzerine
uzun sure calisti.

original:
<T>If he hadn't come here and founded Monte
d'Or, he could have had a career in
archaeology.
translation:
<T>Buraya gelip Monte
d'Or'u kurmasaydi, arkeolojide
bir kariyeri olabilirdi.

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Yes, I remember that Henry enjoyed helping
Randall with his research.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Evet, Henry'nin Randall'in arastirmalarina yardim etmekten
keyif aldigini hatirliyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That Masked Gentleman knew about the
mask. He must have a background in
archaeology as well.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>O Maskeli Bey maskeyi biliyordu.
Demek ki onun da
arkeoloji gecmisi olmali.

original:
<T>Add in those investigators from London and
suddenly the whole town's obsessed with
the subject!
translation:
<T>Bir de Londra'dan gelen o arastirmacilari ekleyince
bir anda butun kasaba
bu konuyla kafayi bozdu!

original: <T><M6/1/1>Well, archaeology is an enticing field.
translation: <T><M6/1/1>Dogrusu, arkeoloji cezbedici bir alan.

original:
<T>Even after you've gone off back to London,
you should drop by now and then to say
hello.
translation:
<T>Londra'ya dondukten sonra bile,
arada bir ugrayip
selam ver.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You have my word, Gloria. I look forward to
it.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Soz veriyorum, Gloria. Bunu
sabirsizlikla bekliyorum.

original: ハンナ
translation: Hanna

original:
<T>There's something I've been dying to tell
Grosky, but he's always busy running off
somewhere or another.
translation:
<T>Grosky'ye anlatmaya can atiyorum,
ama o hep bir yerlere kosturup
duruyor, hep mesgul.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M4/1/1>Have you got some new evidence?
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Yeni bir delil mi var?

original:
<T><M2/1/3>Well, it seems the police have been
gossiping about a certain young lady.
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Sey, polisler belli bir genc
hanim hakkinda dedikodu yapiyormus.

original:
<T>They say she's been chasing after the
Masked Gentleman. She was even racing
across rooftops earlier!
translation:
<T>Maskeli Bey'in pesine dusmus diyorlar.
Hatta az once
catilarda kosturuyormus!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Perhaps she is an accomplice of the
Masked Gentleman!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Belki de Maskeli Bey'in
suc ortagidir!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>That's a pretty good theory, but somehow
I doubt it...
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Guzel bir teori, ama nedense
pek inanamiyorum...

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I have a sneaking suspicion this woman is
chasing Inspector Grosky...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Icime bir suphe dustu; bu kadin
Mufettis Grosky'nin pesinde...

original:
<T><M2/1/2>What? A vile, shadowy minx stalking my
beloved?!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Ne? Benim sevgilimi takip eden
igrenc, sinsi bir yosma mi?!

original:
<T>Oh, the smelling salts won't be potent
enough. I need a puzzle to calm myself
down.
translation:
<T>Ah, bayiltma tuzlari
yetmez. Sakinlesmek icin bir bulmacaya
ihtiyacim var.

original:
<T><M1/1/3>I can't concentrate either. Not while this
foul coquette is harassing my Grosky.
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Ben de odaklanamiyorum. Bu
igrenc cilveli kiz benim Grosky'mi rahat birakmiyorken olmaz.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>I can't stop thinking about this mystery
woman chasing Clamp! Please, help me
take my mind off it with a puzzle!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Clamp'in pesindeki bu esrarengiz
kadini dusunmeden edemiyorum! Lutfen,
aklimi dagitmak icin bir bulmacayla bana yardim et!

original: <T>Very good! Thanks for helping me relax.
translation: <T>Cok iyi! Rahatlamama yardim ettigin icin tesekkurler.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I have mixed feelings about this other
Grosky fan. If she dare try to steal him
away...
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bu diger Grosky hayrani hakkinda
karmasik duygularim var. Onu benden
calmaya kalkarsa...

original:
<T><M2/2/1>But if she joins the Clampettes, I might let
her off. She could be my secretary.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ama Clampettes'a katilirsa belki
onu affederim. Sekreterim bile olabilir.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Hee hee. <M2/1/2>Emmy, she doesn't seem to
realise that you were talking about her...
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Hih hi. <M2/1/2>Emmy, senin ondan
bahsettigini fark etmiyor galiba...

original:
<T><M5/2/3>That runaway-train attitude reminds me of
Grosky himself... <W>Maybe they are a good
match.
translation:
<T><M5/2/3>Bu kontrolsuz tren gibi tavri bana
Grosky'nin kendisini hatirlatiyor... <W>Belki de
iyi bir ikili olurlar.

original:
<T>The Clampettes are always looking for new
members. Let's all band together to support
the world's greatest inspector!
translation:
<T>Clampettes her zaman yeni
uyeler arar. Dunyanin en buyuk mufettisini
desteklemek icin hep birlikte birleselim!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>I wonder if the police have found the
Masked Gentleman's hiding place yet?
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Acaba polis
Maskeli Bey'in saklandigi yeri buldu mu?

original:
<T><M1/1/3>A little sand won't bother me! I'm a London
girl! I can handle anything!
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Biraz kum beni korkutmaz! Ben Londrali
bir kizim! Her seyin ustesinden gelirim!

original:
<T><M3/3/4>I'll stay here in Monte d'Or for as long as
Grosky needs me!
translation:
<T><M3/3/4>Grosky bana ihtiyac duydugu surece
Monte d'Or'da kalacagim!

original: ミカ
translation: Mika

original:
<T>Mr Ledore phoned us up this morning saying
that the Masked Gentleman was at the
funfair last night.
translation:
<T>Bay Ledore bu sabah arayip Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
dun gece
lunaparktaymis dedi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>So it's back to being like a zoo here again.
<W>Joy.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Demek ki burasi yine hayvanat bahcesi gibi olacak.
<W>Ne hos.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M4/1/3>You're not a fan of the police, are you?
translation: <T><M4/1/3>Polisi pek sevmiyorsunuz, degil mi?

original:
<T>Oh, I'm their biggest fan!<W> They're the most
adorable lot of sweaty, talentless individuals
I've ever known.
translation:
<T>Ah, ben onlarin en buyuk hayraniyim!<W> Tanidigim
en sevimli terli, yeteneksiz topluluk
onlar.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Well, that one detective isn't so bad. The
one born with the brains and the looks.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Gerci su bir dedektif fena sayilmaz. Hani
zekasi ve yakisikliligiyla dogan.

original:
<T>And he was clever enough to solve this
puzzle in no time.
translation:
<T>Ustelik bu bulmacayi
aninda cozecek kadar da zeki.

original:
<T>Too bad. I guess the detective who solved it
before is a pro, after all.
translation:
<T>Yazik. Demek ki daha once cozen dedektif
sonucta gercekten profesyonelmis.

original:
<T>I don't know... Can you really match up to
the detective and solve this?
translation:
<T>Bilmiyorum... Gercekten o dedektifle
boy olcusup bunu cozebilir misin?

original:
<T>Hmm, okay. You don't look like much, but
you're definitely on the ball.
translation:
<T>Hmm, peki. Pek bir seye benzemiyorsun ama
belli ki isin ehliymissin.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Of course he is! He's the youngest
professor in the history of Gressenheller
University!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Tabii ki oyle! O, Gressenheller
Universitesi tarihinin en genc
profesorudur!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That's great, but don't try to drag me
into his entourage.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Harika, ama beni
onun ekibine katmaya calisma.

original:
<T>At any rate, I'm just glad there's one
competent detective among all the riff-raff.
translation:
<T>Her halukarda, su ayak takiminin arasinda
en azindan bir becerikli dedektif olmasina seviniyorum.

original:
<T><M5/1/1>I'm surprised that Detective Bloom would
take the time to solve a puzzle.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Dedektif Bloom'un bulmaca cozmeye
vakit ayirmasina sasirdim.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M2/1/1>The appeal of puzzles is universal, Emmy!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Bulmacalarin cazibesi evrenseldir, Emmy!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Mayor Williams keeps looking over my
shoulder at every opportunity. Why can't he
just let me get on with it?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Baskan Williams her firsatta omzumun uzerinden
bakip duruyor. Neden
beni isimi yapmaya birakmiyor ki?

original:
<T>Sometimes I wish I had a job that's a little
less stressful.
translation:
<T>Bazen keske
biraz daha az stresli bir isim olsa diyorum.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Maybe a professional sunbather...
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Mesela profesyonel guneslenen biri...

original:
<T><M2/1/2>All that sand completely changed the
geography of the city. <W>So, more work for us,
coordinating repair crews and such.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>O kum sehrin cografyasini tamamen
degistirdi. <W>Yani bize daha cok is cikti,
tamir ekiplerini falan koordine edecegiz.

original:
<T>Ugh! What good is a special task force if
they can't prevent this kind of thing from
happening?!
translation:
<T>Off! Boyle seylerin
olmasini engelleyemiyorlarsa ozel bir
gorev gucunun ne faydasi var?!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>How are you today, Mr Mayor?
translation: <T>Bugun nasilsiniz, Sayin Belediye Baskani?

original: オルトビルセン
translation: Ortbilsen

original:
<T>Grand, grand! Fair dues to you, Layton.
After you cleared up those miracles, we got
quite a bit of work done.
translation:
<T>Harika, harika! Hakkini vermek gerek, Layton.
O mucizeleri cozdukten sonra
epeyce is bitirdik.

original: <T><M4/1/1>I'm glad to hear it.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Bunu duymak guzel.

original:
<T>I was so relieved to hear that no one was
hurt. So very relieved!
translation:
<T>Kimsenin yaralanmadigini duyunca cok rahatladim.
Cok ama cok rahatladim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I'll have to do my part in the restoration
work. Contributions are always welcome!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Onarim calismalarinda ben de uzerime duseni
yapmaliyim. Her turlu katki makbuldur!

original:
<T>Michelle has been giving me strange looks
lately. I fancy she's cross with me.
translation:
<T>Michelle son gunlerde bana tuhaf tuhaf bakiyor.
Sanirim bana kizgin.

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T>How did that blasted Masked Gentleman pull
off the Tingly Town stunt?!
translation:
<T>O lanet Maskeli Bey
Tingly Town numarasini nasil yapti?!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Perhaps I'll be able to explain it to you later,
but for now our time would be better spent
determining his next course of action.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Belki daha sonra size aciklayabilirim,
ama simdilik vaktimizi
onun bir sonraki hamlesini belirlemeye ayirsak daha iyi.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Something that can be seen from anywhere
in town...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Kasabanin her yerinden gorulebilecek
bir sey...

original:
<T><M2/2/1>If he intends to involve the whole city, we
need to stop him before it's too late.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Butun sehri ise karistirmak istiyorsa,
cok gec olmadan onu durdurmaliyiz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I'm going to put this Masked Gentleman
behind bars even if I have to build a cage
round the city to do it!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu Maskeli Bey'i
gerekirse sehrin etrafina bir kafes insa edip
yine de parmakliklarin arkasina tikacagim!

original:
<T><M3/1/2>I suppose that means we'll see you charging
around all over town again later!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Demek ki seni birazdan yine
tum kasabada kostururken gorecegiz!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>The Masked Gentleman's not going to get
away with this! I've got a fistful of justice
with his name on it!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Maskeli Bey bununla
kurtulamayacak! Uzerinde onun adi yazili
bir avuc adaletim var!

original: ブルーマイル
translation: Mavi Mil

original:
<T>Professor Layton, your particular field of
expertise at Gressenheller University is
archaeology, is it not?
translation:
<T>Profesor Layton, Gressenheller Universitesi'ndeki
uzmanlik alaninizin
arkeoloji oldugunu soyluyorlar, degil mi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>We hear great things about you, even at
Scotland Yard.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hakkinizda cok iyi seyler duyuyoruz,
Scotland Yard'da bile.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Well, that's quite kind of you, Detective. It's
nothing, really. I just enjoy my work.
translation:
<T>Ne kadar naziksiniz, Dedektif. Aslinda
bir sey degil. Sadece isimi seviyorum.

original: <T>We've heard you're modest, too.
translation: <T>Mutevazi oldugunuzu da duyduk.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>As it happens, I've also been studying
archaeology as a kind of hobby.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ben de bir hobi olarak
arkeolojiyle ilgileniyorum.

original:
<T>I find it sad that a historical treasure,
chronicled by Donald Rutledge, no less,
could be used so disrespectfully.
translation:
<T>Donald Rutledge tarafindan bile kayda gecirilmis
tarihi bir hazinenin
bu kadar saygisizca kullanilmasina uzuluyorum.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>We can't say what the original sculptors of
the mask had in mind when making it, but I
doubt they envisioned this.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Maskeyi yapan ilk heykeltiraslarin
ne amacladigini bilemeyiz, ama
bunu hayal ettiklerini sanmiyorum.

original: <T><M3/1/1>We think alike, Professor Layton.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Ayni dusunuyoruz, Profesor Layton.

original:
<T>We must stop this masked maestro so
the mask can achieve whatever its
intended purpose might be.
translation:
<T>Bu maskeli ustayi durdurmaliyiz ki
maske, amaci her neyse,
onu gerceklestirebilsin.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I hope we can sit down sometime and
discuss archaeology when this is over.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Her sey bittiginde bir ara oturup
arkeolojiyi konusabilmeyi umarim.

original: <T><M2/1/1>That would be splendid.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Harika olurdu.

original:
<T>This city doesn't leave much to the
imagination. London seems quaint by
comparison.
translation:
<T>Bu sehir hayal gucune pek
yer birakmiyor. Yaninda
Londra bile sevimli kaliyor.

original: シバロフ
translation: Shibarov

original:
<T>How are we supposed to unmask the
Masked Gentleman when the whole town's
wearing masks for the festival?!
translation:
<T>Butun kasaba festival icin
maske takmisken
Maskeli Bey'in maskesini nasil dusurecegiz?!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>And then there's this apparent feud between
Ledore and Dalston. Is that real, or are they
actually the ones behind all this?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bir de Ledore ile Dalston arasindaki
sozde husumet var. Bu gercek mi, yoksa
tum bunlarin arkasinda aslinda onlar mi var?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Chief Inspector, I don't believe there's a
conspiracy here. The Masked Gentleman is
evidently acting of his own accord.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Bas Mufettis, burada bir
komplo olduguna inanmiyorum. Maskeli Bey
belli ki kendi basina hareket ediyor.

original:
<T>Dalston still sets off alarm bells for me. He
could have set everything up just to watch
it all play out.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Dalston hala bende alarm zillerini caldiriyor. O
her seyi sirf
olan biteni izlemek icin ayarlamis olabilir.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M4/2/1>The Masked Gentleman bears a deep hatred
for this town. Dalston does not.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Maskeli Bey bu kasabadan derin bir nefret
besliyor. Dalston degil.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I've been on the force, what, 25 years now,
and never have I seen a case so
convoluted!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Teskilatta ne, 25 yildir varim,
boylesine
karmasik bir dava hic gormedim!

original:
<T>We're continuing our investigation, putting
everything we've got to work, but our sweep
of Tingly Town hasn't given us anything.
translation:
<T>Sorusturmaya devam ediyoruz, elimizde ne varsa
seferber ettik ama
Tingly Town taramasindan hicbir sey cikmadi.

original: ハインリヒ
translation: ハインリヒ

original:
<T>Argh! I'm up to my ears in debt... <W>Up to my
eyeballs, actually. <W>Really, I'm in over my
head here!
translation:
<T>Ahh! Borca batmis durumdayim... <W>Hatta
girtlagima kadar. <W>Gercekten de
boyumu asan bir is bu!

original:
<T>If I could strike lucky, just once, I could pay
back all my debts!
translation:
<T>Bir kez olsun sans yuzume gulse de
tum borclarimi odeyebilsem!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I don't know how these races work, but I
like that horse with the 20 on it. A high
number means it's better, right?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bu yarislar nasil isler bilmiyorum ama
ustunde 20 yazan ati sevdim. Buyuk
sayi daha iyi demek, degil mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>I'd advise you to stop here and cut your
losses, sir.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Burada durup daha fazla zarar etmeden
cekilmenizi tavsiye ederim, efendim.

original:
<T>And what makes you such an expert, eh?
I'm not listening to you unless you can
solve this puzzle!
translation:
<T>Peki seni bu kadar uzman yapan ne, ha?
Bu bulmacayi cozmedikce
seni dinlemem!

original: <T>See? You're not even worth listening to.
translation: <T>Gordun mu? Seni dinlemeye bile degmez.

original:
<T>I might consider taking your advice if you
solve this puzzle...or I might not.
translation:
<T>Bu bulmacayi cozersen belki
tavsiyeni dikkate alirim... belki de almam.

original:
<T>Hang on a sec, mate. Why are you trying to
stop me? What's in it for you? You thinking
of betting on the same horse or something?
translation:
<T>Bir dakika dostum. Niye beni durdurmaya
calisiyorsun? Senin cikarin ne? Ayni ata
bahis oynayip beni saf disi mi birakacaksin?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>No, that's not it at all. I just think it would
be wiser for you to stop.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hayir, hic alakasi yok. Sadece durmanizin
daha akillica olacagini dusunuyorum.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Yeah, I heard that part!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Evet evet, o kismi duydum!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Yes, but I'm not certain that you...<W> <M3/1/1>Wouldn't
you prefer the security of steady income?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Evet ama emin degilim ki siz...<W> <M3/1/1>Daha duzenli
bir gelirin guvenligini tercih etmez misiniz?

original:
<T>Maybe. But now you've made such a big
deal out of it, I have to bet! If I don't, the
horse is sure to win - Murphy's Law.
translation:
<T>Belki. Ama simdi bu kadar buyuttun ya,
bahis oynamak zorundayim! Oynamazsam
at kesin kazanir - Murphy Kanunu.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Very well. Do as you will.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Pekala. Nasil isterseniz.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>All these chumps are picking horses with low
numbers. Hah! I'll bet on number 20 and
strike it rich, rich, rich!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Su enayiler dusuk numarali atlari seciyor.
Sayi 20'ye basacagim ve
koseyi donecegim, donecegim, donecegim!

original:
<T><M2/1/2>That's funny... I bet on the horse with the
highest number, but it came in last.<W> Argh! I
should have reversed it!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Tuhaf... En yuksek numarali ata
bahis oynadim ama sonuncu geldi.<W> Ahh! Ben
tam tersini yapmaliymisim!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>What should I do?! I'm...I'm penniless! I'd
better get out of here before they realise
how much I owe them!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Ne yapacagim?! Ben... ben bes parasizim! Onlar
ne kadar borcum oldugunu fark etmeden
buradan sivissam iyi olacak!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Phew! This sand fiasco will cover my escape
from this city. Cheers, Masked Gentleman!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ohh! Bu kum karmasasi sehirden kacisimi
ortbas edecek. Sag ol, Maskeli Beyefendi!

original: グスタフ
translation: Gustav

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Good day, Professor. In fact, one might
dare to say it is a fine day here at the
racecourse.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Iyi gunler, Profesor. Hatta
buradaki hipodromda
gunun cok guzel oldugunu soylemeye curet edebiliriz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Your investigation must be exhausting. Are
you here for a well-deserved break?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sorusturmaniz yorucu olmali. Hak ettiginiz
bir mola icin mi buradasiniz?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Not this time, I'm afraid. After all, I do have
Luke with me.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ne yazik ki bu sefer degil. Sonucta
yanimda Luke var.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Ah, yes, of course. Never mind.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ah, evet, tabii. Bos verin.

original:
<T>I've heard you are quite the cavalier, in
many senses of the word. Perhaps you'd
care to participate in a race some day?<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Sizin oldukca sovalye ruhlu oldugunuzu
duydum, kelimenin pek cok anlamiyla. Belki
bir gun bir yarisa katilmak istersiniz?<M1/1/1>

original: <T><M1/1/1>Ah... <W>Well, I'll certainly consider it.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Ah... <W>Elbette dusunecegim.

original:
<T>I see horseracing as a refined and dignified
sport.
translation:
<T>At yarisini seckin ve
asil bir spor olarak goruyorum.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>We are proud to boast some of the finest
thoroughbreds in the country.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ulkenin en iyi
safkanlariyla ovunmekten gurur duyariz.

original: シャロア
translation: Angela

original:
<T><M2/1/1>How are you progressing, Hershel? I'm
starting to fear that we'll never catch the
Masked Gentleman...
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Nasil gidiyor, Hershel? Maskeli Beyefendi'yi
asla yakalayamayacagimizdan
korkmaya basladim...

original:
<T><M7/1/1>If only we could find that Mask of Order
that he spoke of, perhaps we could stop
him.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Keske bahsettigi Duzen Maskesi’ni
bulabilsek; belki onu
durdurabiliriz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Do you really think that we can trust
anything the Masked Gentleman says?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Maskeli Beyefendi’nin soyledigi
her seye gercekten guvenebilir miyiz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>But the Mask of Order is a genuine artefact
that was recorded by Rutledge. You must
have read about it too.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Ama Duzen Maskesi, Rutledge’in kayda
girdigi gercek bir eserdir. Sen de
okumus olmalisin.

original:
<T>I have read that the Mask of Chaos and
Mask of Order exist as a pair. It's possible
that one could stop the other...
translation:
<T>Kaos Maskesi ile Duzen Maskesi’nin
bir cift olarak var oldugunu okudum. Belki
biri digerini durdurabilir...

original:
<T><M7/1/1/45>We know the police aren't going to catch
him any time soon. If we want to save the
city, we must find that mask!
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Polisin onu yakin zamanda yakalayamayacagini
biliyoruz. Sehri kurtarmak istiyorsak
o maskeyi bulmaliyiz!

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>I thought Henry must have it among the
things he brought back from the ruins, but
he claims not to...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Henry’nin harabelerden getirdigi
esyalarin arasinda olmali sanmistim ama
kendinde olmadigini soyluyor...

original:
<T>Perhaps Henry is hiding something, even
from you. Hmm...
translation:
<T>Belki Henry senden bile bir seyler sakliyordur.
Hmm...

original: <T><M2/2/1/45>Angela, where is your pendant?
translation: <T><M2/2/1/45>Angela, kolyen nerede?

original:
<T>Pendant? <W><M1/1/1>Oh, that. I lost it. I think the string
must have snapped.
translation:
<T>Kolyem mi? <W><M1/1/1>Ha, o. Kaybettim. Sanirim ipi
kopmus olmali.

original:
<T><M7/1/1/45>It was getting old anyway. I was thinking of
replacing it sometime.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Zaten eskimisti. Bir ara
degistirmeyi dusunuyordum.

original:
<T><M5/2/1/60>I see. Well, I suppose this is a good
opportunity to do so.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Anliyorum. O halde bunu yapmak icin
iyi bir firsat sayilir.

original: <T>I was hoping to speak to Henry. Is he here?
translation: <T>Henry ile konusmak istiyordum. Burada mi?

original: <T><M8/1/1/45>Yes, he's in his study.
translation: <T><M8/1/1/45>Evet, calisma odasinda.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Thank you.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Tesekkur ederim.

original: <T>Henry is in his study. Please go on in.
translation: <T>Henry calisma odasinda. Lutfen iceri buyurun.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Professor, Henry is in his study. Aren't we
going to see him?
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Profesor, Henry calisma odasinda. Onu
ziyaret etmeyecek miyiz?

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <T>Professor Layton. How may I help you?
translation: <T>Profesor Layton. Size nasil yardimci olabilirim?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Henry, I'd like to ask you a few questions
about yesterday's incident.
translation:
<T>Henry, size birkac soru sormak istiyorum
dunku olay hakkinda.

original:
<T>I gave a full report to the police. They're
now investigating what happened.
translation:
<T>Polise ayrintili bir rapor verdim. Onlar da
simdi ne oldugunu arastiriyorlar.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Yes, well, we have been conducting our own
investigation.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Evet, ama biz de kendi
sorusturmamizi yurutuyoruz.

original:
<T>We discovered an exact replica of Tingly
Town...<W>just behind the original one.
translation:
<T>Tingly
Kasabasi'nin birebir bir kopyasini kesfettik...<W>hemen asilinin arkasinda.

original: <T>What?
translation: <T>Ne?

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Tingly Tower has been fitted with a rotating
floor. We were turned around last night
without realising it.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Tingly Kulesi doner bir zeminle donatilmis.
Dun gece farkina varmadan
dondurulmusuz.

original:
<T>A pitch-dark space like that is perfect for
pulling off just such a trick.
translation:
<T>Boylesine zifiri karanlik bir yer, boyle bir numarayi
yapmak icin mukemmel.

original:
<T>We were so intent on pursuing the Masked
Gentleman that we walked straight into his
illusion.<M1/2/1/60>
translation:
<T>Maskeli Bey'i kovalamaya o kadar odaklanmistik ki
dogruca onun
yanilsamasinin icine yuruduk.<M1/2/1/60>

original: <T>That's hard to imagine...
translation: <T>Bunu hayal etmek zor...

original:
<T>Besides, nothing gets built in this town
without my permission.
translation:
<T>Ustelik, bu kasabada benim iznim olmadan
hicbir sey insa edilmez.

original: <T><M2/2/1>That's what I wanted to ask you about.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Aslinda size bunu sormak istiyordum.

original:
<T>We heard that you recently invested a great
deal in various construction projects around
town.
translation:
<T>Son zamanlarda kasaba genelindeki cesitli
insaat projelerine epey
yatirim yaptiginizi duyduk.

original:
<T>It seems an odd decision to promote
expansion in such uncertain times.
translation:
<T>Boylesine belirsiz zamanlarda buyumeyi
desteklemek garip bir karar gibi gorunuyor.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Why not wait until this Masked Gentleman
business is over and Monte d'Or is safe
again?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Bu Maskeli Bey isi bitene ve Monte d'Or
yeniden guvenli olana kadar
neden beklemiyorsunuz?

original:
<T>I've said this before, Layton, and I'll say it
again. I do not need to explain myself to
you.
translation:
<T>Bunu daha once de soyledim, Layton, yine de
soyluyorum. Kendimi size aciklamak zorunda
degilim.

original:
<T>The town of Monte d'Or is under my
supervision, and I will do as I see fit.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or kasabasi benim
gozetimim altinda ve ben uygun gordugum gibi davranirim.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>I understand, Henry. I didn't mean to
question your judgement.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Anliyorum, Henry. Amacim
kararinizi sorgulamak degildi.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>However, in order to conduct my
investigation, I need all the information
available.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ancak, sorusturmami yurutebilmem icin
tum mevcut bilgilere
ihtiyacim var.

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Very well. I won't stand in your way.
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Pekala. Yolunuza cikmayacagim.

original:
<T>Most officials and businesses in town will
cooperate if you give them my name.
translation:
<T>Kasabadaki cogu yetkili ve isletme, adimi
verirseniz sizinle is birligi yapacaktir.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>But I'm afraid that is all I can do for you.
I have my own work to do.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ama korkarim sizin icin yapabilecegim tek sey bu.
Benim de yapmam gereken isler var.

original: <T><M1/2/1/45>Of course. Thank you, Henry.
translation: <T><M1/2/1/45>Elbette. Tesekkur ederim, Henry.

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Now, I must take my leave.
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Simdi musaadenizi isteyecegim.

original: <T>Please feel free to look around my study.
translation: <T>Calisma odami rahatca gezebilirsiniz.

original:
<T>If you find something useful, you may take it
with you.
translation:
<T>Ise yarar bir sey bulursaniz, yaniniza
alabilirsiniz.

original: <T>If you'll excuse me.
translation: <T>Musaadenizle.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M5/1/2>Shall we search the study, then? There may
be information about the park's construction
or notes on the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M5/1/2>O halde calisma odasini arayalim mi? Burada
parkin insasi hakkinda bilgi
ya da Maskeli Bey'le ilgili notlar olabilir.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/2/3>Emmy's right, Professor! We should do
a thorough search of this room.
translation:
<T><M3/2/3>Emmy hakli, Profesor! Bu odada
iyice arama yapmaliyiz.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Wait a moment. I think we've missed an
important point here.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bir dakika. Sanirim burada onemli bir
noktayi gozden kacirdik.

original:
<T>Henry is hiding something from us. <W>All along
I thought it was to do with the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Henry bizden bir sey sakliyor. <W>Bastan beri
bunun Maskeli Bey'le ilgili oldugunu
saniyordum.

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>We may be on the wrong track entirely.
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Tamamen yanlis iz uzerinde olabiliriz.

original: <T><M2/2/1/45>What do you mean, Professor?
translation: <T><M2/2/1/45>Ne demek istiyorsunuz, Profesor?

original: ランドの母
translation: Land'in Annesi

original: <T>Henry, is someone there?
translation: <T>Henry, orada biri var mi?

original:
<T>Oh! Guests!<W> Hmm. You look familiar, but...<W>
I'm sorry. Do I know you, young man?
translation:
<T>Ah! Misafirler!<W> Himm. Tanidik geliyorsunuz ama...<W>
Uzgunum. Seni taniyor muyum, genc adam?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Are you... My goodness! What a surprise!
<W>I must talk to you.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Sen... Aman Tanrim! Ne surpriz!
<W>Seninle konusmam gerek.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Luke, Emmy, I need to ask this lady
a few questions.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Luke, Emmy, bu hanimefendiye
birkac soru sormam gerekiyor.

original: ランドの母
translation: Land'in Annesi

original:
<T>Hershel? Hershel Layton, is that you?<W> What
happened to your hair?
translation:
<T>Hershel? Hershel Layton, sen misin?<W> Ne
oldu sacina?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>Professor?
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Profesor?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Yes, it's me. Emmy, Luke, I'd like you to
meet Mrs Ascot, <M2/1/1>Randall's mother.
translation:
<T>Evet, benim. Emmy, Luke, sizi
Bayan Ascot'la tanistirayim, <M2/1/1>Randall'in annesi.

original: <T><M1/1/4/45>Oh! <W>Er, it's nice to meet you, ma'am.
translation: <T><M1/1/4/45>Ah! <W>Ee, sizinle tanistigima memnun oldum, hanimefendi.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>How are you, Mrs Ascot? It has been a long
time. Are you visiting Henry and Angela?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Nasilsiniz, Bayan Ascot? Uzun zaman oldu.
Henry ve Angela'yi mi ziyaret ediyorsunuz?

original:
<T>Not exactly. It's...<W>a long story. <W>Ah, where
do I start?
translation:
<T>Pek sayilmaz. Bu...<W>uzun bir hikaye. <W>Ah, nereden
baslasam?

original:
<T>After Randall's accident, my husband and I
employed all possible means to find him.
translation:
<T>Randall'in kazasindan sonra, esimle ben onu
bulmak icin mumkun olan her yolu denedik.

original:
<T>We hired rescue teams to search the ruins,
had a new passage dug... <W>We spent our
entire fortune.
translation:
<T>Harabeleri aramalari icin kurtarma ekipleri tuttuk,
yeni bir gecit kazdirdik... <W>Tum
servetimizi harcadik.

original: <T><M4/1/3>And yet, you still didn't find him...
translation: <T><M4/1/3>Ve yine de onu bulamadiniz...

original:
<T>It pained us to be in that big house without
Randall, so we left Stansbury and came here
with Henry.
translation:
<T>Randall olmadan o buyuk evde olmak bizi
cok acitiyordu, bu yuzden Stansbury'den ayrilip buraya
Henry'yle geldik.

original:
<T>When my husband passed away, I had
nowhere to go, no one to turn to. Henry
asked me to stay with him.
translation:
<T>Esim vefat edince gidecek
yerim, basvuracak kimsem kalmadi. Henry
benimle kalmami istedi.

original:
<T>He took me in and settled my debts. He said
he was making everything ready for
Randall's return.
translation:
<T>Beni yanina aldi ve borclarimi kapatti. Dedi ki
Randall'in donusu icin her seyi
hazirliyormus.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Henry never breathed a word about any of
that.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Henry bunlarin hicbirinden hic
bahsetmedi.

original:
<T>Does that surprise you? Henry has always
been like that. He never blows his own
trumpet.
translation:
<T>Bu sana sasirtici mi geliyor? Henry her zaman
boyledir. Kendi kendini
asla ovmez.

original:
<T>If he doesn't feel that something needs to
be said, he keeps it to himself. It's just his
way.
translation:
<T>Bir seyin soylenmesi gerektigini
dusunmuyorsa, icinde tutar. Bu onun
tarzidir.

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>Yes... Yes, you're quite right.
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Evet... Evet, cok haklisiniz.

original:
<T>So, Hershel, just...be kind to him, won't
you?
translation:
<T>O yuzden, Hershel, lutfen... ona nazik olur
musun?

original:
<T>I don't think he's ever fully accepted
Randall's death.
translation:
<T>Sanmiyorum ki Randall'in olumunu hic
tam olarak kabullenebildi.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I see. <W>Then I shall leave Henry out of the
investigation as much as possible.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Anliyorum. <W>O halde Henry'yi
sorusturmadan olabildigince uzak tutacagim.

original:
<T>If this Masked Gentleman knew what Henry
was really like, he would not be doing this.
translation:
<T>Bu Maskeli Bey Henry'nin gercekte nasil biri oldugunu
bilseydi, bunu yapmazdi.

original:
<T>If only Randall were alive... He would help
Henry. They were like brothers growing up,
you know.
translation:
<T>Keske Randall hayatta olsaydi... O, Henry'ye
yardim ederdi. Buyurken kardes gibiydiler,
biliyor musun.

original: <T>This city is Randall's too...
translation: <T>Bu sehir Randall'in da...

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Yes, Randall would have been tireless in
hunting down the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Evet, Randall Maskeli Bey'in izini surmekte
dur durak bilmezdi.

original: シャロア
translation: Saroa

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>Mrs Ascot, is that you?
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Bayan Ascot, siz misiniz?

original: <T>Angela!
translation: <T>Angela!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Oh, I beg your pardon! I didn't mean to
interrupt.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ah, affedersiniz! Sozunuzu
kesmek istemedim.

original: <T>Oh, psh, Angela. Is it lunchtime, then?
translation: <T>Ah, bos ver Angela. Ogle vakti mi, oyleyse?

original:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Yes, I thought I'd call you before the food
got cold. I didn't mean to barge in...
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Evet, yemek sogumadan once sizi
cagirayim dedim. Iceri dalmak istemedim...

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>No, no, that's all right.<W> We were just about
to leave anyway.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Hayir, hayir, sorun degil.<W> Zaten biz de
cikmak uzereydik.

original: <T><M8/1/1/45>Already? I'm sure Henry will be back soon.
translation: <T><M8/1/1/45>Simdiden mi? Eminim Henry yakinda doner.

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Oh, no, my business with Henry is done. We
have other matters to attend to.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Yok, Henry'yle isim bitti. Bizim
ilgilenmemiz gereken baska meseleler var.

original: <T>Very well, Hershel.<W>
translation: <T>Pekala, Hershel.<W>

original:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Good luck! I hope you manage to find the
Mask of Order soon. It's the only way that
Monte d'Or can be saved.
translation:
<T><M7/1/1/45>Bol sans! Duzen Maskesi'ni yakinda bulmayi
basarirsiniz umarim. Monte d'Or'un kurtulmasinin
tek yolu bu.

original: <T><M2/1/1/45>I will do my best.
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Elimden geleni yapacagim.

original:
<T>Good luck, Hershel. I hope you find the
Mask of Order soon. It's the only way that
Monte d'Or can be saved.
translation:
<T>Bol sans, Hershel. Duzen Maskesi'ni yakinda
bulmani umuyorum. Monte d'Or'un kurtulmasinin
tek yolu bu.

original:
<T>Well, well, little Hershel Layton, all grown
up... We're counting on you!
translation:
<T>Vay vay, kucuk Hershel Layton buyumus de
kocaman olmus... Sana guveniyoruz!

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original:
<T>Leaving already? I was just making some
tea.
translation:
<T>Simdiden mi gidiyorsunuz? Daha yeni cay
demliyordum.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Yes, do forgive me. I'm certainly not one to
pass up a cup of tea unless I have to.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Evet, kusura bakmayin. Mecbur kalmadikca
bir fincan cayi asla geri cevirmem.

original:
<T>Well, no matter. We'll have time for tea
when everything is resolved.
translation:
<T>Neyse, sorun degil. Her sey cozuldugunde
cay icmeye vaktimiz olacak.

original:
<T>Please understand that I will assist you
whenever I feel that I can.
translation:
<T>Lutfen anlayin; yapabilecegimi hissettigim
her an size yardim edecegim.

original: <T>Let me know if there's anything I can do.
translation: <T>Yapabilecegim bir sey olursa haber verin.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Professor, what {''}other matters{''} are there
that we have to attend to? Do you have
a new lead?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Profesor, ilgilenmemiz gereken {''}baska meseleler{''} neler
var? Elinizde
yeni bir ipucu mu var?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Perhaps...
translation: <T>Belki...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Did you work out where the Masked
Gentleman will appear next?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Maskeli
Beyefendi'nin bir sonraki kez nerede gorunecegini buldunuz mu?

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>We need to go and talk to Mayor Williams.
There is something I wish to verify.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Belediye Baskani Williams'la gidip konusmaliyiz.
Dogrulamak istedigim bir sey var.

original: <T><M1/2/1>So, back to the city hall?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Yani, belediye binasina geri mi?

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Indeed. Do you recall me saying that we
may be on the wrong track?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Evet. Yanlis bir iz uzerinde olabilecegimizi
soyledigimi hatirliyor musun?

original: <T><M3/1/1>I intend to find out if I was right or not.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Hakli olup olmadigimi ogrenmek istiyorum.

original: オルトビルセン
translation: Orto Bilsen

original:
<T>Hello, Layton! Come to join our little
fact-finding party?
translation:
<T>Merhaba, Layton! Kucuk
arastirma grubumuza katilmaya mi geldin?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Mr Mayor, we need some information.
translation: <T>Sayin Belediye Baskani, biraz bilgiye ihtiyacimiz var.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oooh, information, eh? How can I help
you?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ooo, bilgi ha? Size nasil
yardim edebilirim?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I'd like to see the record detailing all the
land, properties and assets belonging to
Henry Ledore.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Henry Ledore'a ait
tum arazi, mulk ve varliklari
detaylandiran kaydi gormek istiyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hold on, Layton! I can't just give you that!
What's this got to do with the Masked
Gentleman, anyway?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Dur bir dakika, Layton! Bunu oylece veremem!
Bunun Maskeli
Bey'le ne ilgisi var ki?

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Henry has given his permission. <W>This
information might just save the city and
everyone in it.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Henry izin verdi. <W>Bu
bilgi sehri ve
icindeki herkesi kurtarabilir.

original:
<T>Really? <W>Well, if Henry Ledore has allowed it,
who am I to interfere?
translation:
<T>Gercekten mi? <W>Henry Ledore izin verdiyse,
ben kimim ki karisayim?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But first, won't you solve this puzzle for
me? It's been giving me no end of trouble.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama once su bulmacayi
benim icin cozer misiniz? Basimi epey agritti.

original:
<T>I'd be glad to help you, but I really need to
get this puzzle solved first, see.
translation:
<T>Size seve seve yardim ederim ama once
su bulmacayi cozmem gerekiyor, anladiniz ya.

original:
<T>Won't you help me solve this puzzle? I just
want to get it out of the way before going to
look up that info for you.
translation:
<T>Bu bulmacayi cozmeme yardim eder misiniz? Sadece
sizin icin o bilgileri aramadan once
sunu aradan cikarmak istiyorum.

original:
<T>Ah, grand! Well then, I'll get you that
information, as promised.
translation:
<T>Ah, harika! O halde soz verdigim gibi
o bilgileri size getirecegim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Michelle, could you please fetch me the
record of Mr Ledore's property and assets?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Michelle, Bay Ledore'un mulk ve
varlik kayitlarini getirir misin lutfen?

original: ミカ
translation: Mika

original:
<T>I took the liberty of getting it out while you
were busy on that puzzle, Mr Mayor. Here
it is.
translation:
<T>Bulmacayla ugrasirken ben kayitlari cikarmaya
cesaret ettim, Sayin Baskan. Iste
burada.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Ah, how astute of you, Michelle.<W> Now, then.
This is the record detailing all the properties
under Mr Ledore's control.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ne kadar da dusuncelisin, Michelle.<W> Peki.
Bu, Bay Ledore'un kontrolundeki
tum mulkleri ayrintilandiran kayittir.

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>Let's see...<W> Hm...<W> So it is true!
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Bir bakalim...<W> Hm...<W> Demek dogruymus!

original:
<T>I trust you not to go spreading this around,
all right? It's sensitive stuff.
translation:
<T>Bunu ortaliga yaymayacaginiza guveniyorum,
tamam mi? Hassas bir konu.

original:
<T>I can make you a copy if you need one, just
please, please keep all this to yourself.
translation:
<T>Gerekirse size bir kopyasini verebilirim, ama
lutfen, lutfen bunu aranizda tutun.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Thank you, Mr Mayor. This is invaluable
information.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Tesekkur ederim, Sayin Baskan. Bu
paha bicilmez bir bilgi.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original: <T>Ah, just who I was looking for!
translation: <T>Ah, tam aradigim kisi!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Mr Layton, could you meet us in the briefing
room? The chief would like a word.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bay Layton, brifing odasinda
bulusabilir miyiz? Sef sizinle konusmak istiyor.

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>Very well. Thank you.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Pekala. Tesekkur ederim.

original:
<T>Mr Ledore is quite serious about his secrets.
Only a handful of people have seen that
document.
translation:
<T>Bay Ledore sirlarina cok onem veriyor.
O belgeyi
yalnizca birkac kisi gordu.

original:
<T>Mr Ledore seems awfully agitated about the
state of Monte d'Or at the moment. I hope
you can solve this case soon.
translation:
<T>Bay Ledore su siralar Monte d'Or'un
durumu yuzunden cok huzursuz gorunuyor. Umarim
bu vakayi yakinda cozersiniz.

original:
<T>Who could have predicted we'd have an
earthquake here? It's unheard of.
translation:
<T>Burada deprem olacagini kim tahmin edebilirdi?
Duyulmus sey degil.

original:
<T>Or was this also the work of the Masked
Gentleman?
translation:
<T>Yoksa bu da Maskeli
Bey'in isi miydi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Chief Inspector Sheffield asked to see me
back in the briefing room, so we'd better
go there first.
translation:
<T>Basmufettis Sheffield beni brifing odasinda
gormek istedi, o yuzden once
oraya gitsek iyi olur.

original: シバロフ
translation: Shibarov

original:
<T>It seems the Masked Gentleman turned up at
Tingly Town last night. We heard about it
from Mr Ledore.
translation:
<T>Gorunuse gore Maskeli Bey dun gece
Tingly Town'da ortaya cikmis. Bunu
Bay Ledore'dan duyduk.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Yes, Chief Inspector, that's correct. We
haven't seen the end of this case yet.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Evet, Bas Mufettis, dogru. Bu davanin
henuz sonunu gormedik.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>Everyone in the fairground just seemed to
have vanished, all at once!
translation:
<T>Lunaparktaki herkes bir anda
yok olmus gibiydi!

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>As long as the Masked Gentleman is loose,
we can expect more of his tricks.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Maskeli Bey serbest kaldigi surece,
daha cok numarasini bekleyebiliriz.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Hrmph. All right, I believe you, Layton.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Him. Peki, sana inaniyorum, Layton.

original:
<T>This doesn't mean that Dalston is off the
hook, but we need to broaden the search.
translation:
<T>Bu, Dalston'in aklandigi anlamina gelmiyor
ama aramayi genisletmemiz gerekiyor.

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>Have there been any recent developments?
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Son gelismeler var mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Detective Bloom is at the racecourse. He
said he found something there.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Dedektif Bloom hipodromda. Orada
bir sey buldugunu soyledi.

original:
<T>If you head up now, you should be able to
catch him.
translation:
<T>Hemen yola cikarsaniz,
ona yetisebilirsiniz.

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>Thank you. We'll head straight there.
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Tesekkurler. Dogruca oraya gidiyoruz.

original:
<T>We'll get him, Layton. No matter what it
takes.
translation:
<T>Onu yakalayacagiz, Layton. Ne
pahasina olursa olsun.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T>Hey, it's dark already!
translation: <T>Hey, ortalik simdiden karardi!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/1>We'll have to hurry if we want to find out
where the Masked Gentleman will strike
next.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Maskeli Bey'in bir sonraki
saldirisini nerede yapacagini
ogrenmek istiyorsak acele etmeliyiz.

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Layton! Why didn't you tell me that the
Masked Gentleman was at the Reunion
Inn?!<M3/1/1>
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Layton! Maskeli Bey'in
Reunion Inn'de
oldugunu bana neden soylemedin?!<M3/1/1>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Hm? At the Reunion Inn? Well, that's news
to me, Inspector.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Hm? Reunion Inn'de mi? Bu benim icin
haber, Mufettis.

original: <T><M1/1/2/45>Haven't you talked to Bloom yet?
translation: <T><M1/1/2/45>Bloom'la henuz konusmadiniz mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>The Masked Gentleman is hiding in the
biggest hotel in Monte d'Or, the first to be
built here.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Maskeli Bey, Monte d'Or'daki
en buyuk otelde saklaniyor; buraya insa edilen
ilk otel de o.

original:
<T>That's got to be where he'll be doing his
next trick.
translation:
<T>Bir sonraki numarasini
kesin orada yapacaktir.

original:
<T>As it happens, we were just on our way to
talk to Detective Bloom.
translation:
<T>Tesadufe bakin ki, biz de zaten
Dedektif Bloom'la konusmaya gidiyorduk.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Hurry up! And then come and meet me at
the Reunion Inn!<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Cabuk olun! Sonra da Reunion Inn'de
benimle bulusun!<M1/1/1>

original: <T><M3/2/1>FOR THE YARD!<M3/1/1>
<T><M4/2/1/45>The Reunion Inn... Of course.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Reunion Inn... Elbette.

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original:
<T>I'm counting on you, Hershel. I know you
can catch the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Sana guveniyorum, Hershel. Maskeli Bey'i
yakalayabilecegini biliyorum.

original: <T><M4/1/1>I'm sorry I can't do more to help you.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Daha fazla yardimci olamadigim icin uzgunum.

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original:
<T>What stunt will the Masked Gentleman try to
pull tonight? I just have no idea how he
thinks...
translation:
<T>Maskeli Bey bu gece hangi numarayi
deneyecek? Nasil dusundugunu
hic anlayamiyorum...

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original:
<T>Oi, Layton! What news? Any progress on
the case?
translation:
<T>Hey, Layton! Ne haber? Davada bir ilerleme
var mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>It seems the Masked Gentleman has been
hiding out at the Reunion Inn.
translation:
<T>Gorunuse gore Maskeli Bey
Reunion Hani'nda saklaniyormus.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>The Reunion Inn? Well, that's Henry's. First
place he built.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Reunion Hani mi? O Henry'nin. Insa ettigi ilk
yer.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Yes, it is. In fact, it was the first building
in the whole city.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Evet, oyle. Hatta, sehirde insa edilen ilk bina
oydu.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Why would that masked buffoon make that
his base of operations?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>O maskeli budala neden orayi
us olarak secsin?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I don't have much love for Henry, but I
understand how he feels about hotels.
Especially that one, his first.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Henry'yi pek sevmem ama
oteller konusunda ne hissettigini anliyorum.
Ozellikle de ilk yaptigi o oteli.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It's pretty cocky of this lout to make his lair
there.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu herifin inini
oraya kurmasi epey kustahca.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I feel the same way, and I am more
determined than ever to stop him before he
can do any more damage.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ben de oyle dusunuyorum ve onu daha fazla zarar
vermeden durdurmaya
her zamankinden daha kararliyim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Good luck, Layton. I won't get in your way.
<W>Feel free to call on me whenever you have
a moment.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bol sans, Layton. Yoluna cikmayacagim.
<W>Ne zaman bir vaktin olursa
bana ugrayabilirsin.

original:
<T>Layton. Judging from your look, you haven't
found the Masked Gentleman yet.
translation:
<T>Layton. Suratindan anladigim kadariyla
Maskeli Bey'i hala bulamadin.

original: <T><M1/1/1>No, unfortunately not.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Hayir, maalesef.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Have you come to ask my opinion on
something? Not worried that I'll feed you
a red herring or something?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bir sey hakkinda fikrimi mi sormaya geldin?
Seni sahte bir izle
oyalayacagimdan korkmuyor musun?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I'm sorry that I suspected you, Dalston.
I had to be cautious, but Hannibal soon
convinced me of your innocence.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Senden suphelendigim icin ozur dilerim, Dalston.
Dikkatli olmam gerekiyordu ama Hannibal
kisa surede masumiyetine beni ikna etti.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hannibal? <W>Wait, you mean the tiger,
Hannibal?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hannibal mi? <W>Bir dakika, kaplan olan
Hannibal'dan mi bahsediyorsun?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yes. I know that you discussed the case
with him too.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet. Davayi onunla da
konustugunu biliyorum.

original:
<T>That cat and his big mouth. Someone's not
getting any treats tomorrow...
translation:
<T>O kedi ve geveze agzi... Yarin birileri
odul mamasi alamayacak...

original: <T>You've got a lot of free time, eh?
translation: <T>Cok bos vaktin var, ha?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Not exactly. It's just that it's important to
investigate every avenue...
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Pek sayilmaz. Sadece, her ihtimali
arastirmak onemli...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Feeling a bit weary, eh? Why don't you
have a bit of dinner before you head out
again?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Biraz yoruldun galiba, ha? Disari
yeniden cikmadan once
biraz aksam yemegi yesene?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>That's very tempting, but I think we must
decline.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Cok cazip, ama sanirim
reddetmek zorundayiz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>No? Gonzales is a fine cook. You won't get
better food at Henry's, I guarantee!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hayir mi? Gonzales harika yemek yapar. Henry'nin
yerinde daha iyisini bulamazsin, garanti ederim!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I'm sorry, but we can't afford to interrupt our
investigation.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Uzgunum, ama sorusturmamiza
ara vermeyi goze alamayiz.

original:
<T>Once we have the Masked Gentleman in
custody, it would be my pleasure to share
a meal with you, Dalston.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Maskeli Bey'i
gozaltina aldigimizda, seninle
bir yemek paylasmak benim icin zevk olur, Dalston.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmph. I won't hold my breath then...<W>or my
appetite.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hih. O halde nefesimi tutmam...<W>ya da
istahimi.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Dalston, tell me something. Have any of
your hotels been affected by the Masked
Gentleman's ill deeds?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Dalston, bana bir sey soyle. Otellerinden
herhangi biri Maskeli Bey'in
kotu islerinden etkilendi mi?

original:
<T>Why the sudden interrogation, Layton? All
my hotels have been hurt.
translation:
<T>Bu ani sorgu da ne, Layton? Benim
tum otellerim zarar gordu.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>I see. Henry has been investing heavily in
construction efforts to rebuild the town, but
you have not.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Anliyorum. Henry kasabayi yeniden insa etmek icin
insaat calismalarina buyuk yatirimlar yapiyor, ama
sen yapmiyorsun.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Hmph. I'm not throwing money around until
this case is solved and things have settled
down.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Hih. Bu dava cozulup ortalik durulana kadar
para sacmaya
niyetim yok.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Which is another reason I wish you'd get on
with it and catch the villain.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bu da sucluyu yakalamani
neden istedigimin bir baska sebebi.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I can assure you we are doing our utmost to
resolve this case.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sana temin ederim, bu davayi cozmek icin
elimden gelenin fazlasini yapiyoruz.

original:
<T>Oi, Layton. Why are you here having
a chinwag when the Masked Gentleman is
still out there?
translation:
<T>Hey, Layton. Maskeli Bey hala disaridayken
burada sohbet
etmene ne gerek var?

original:
<T>Ascot was the same, always stopping to
babble at me about his business. Couldn't
get enough of me!
translation:
<T>Ascot da ayniydi, hep durup islerinden
gevezelik ederdi. Bana
doyamazdi!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Ha ha. Well, you can't deny it is intriguing
to be reunited with old friends after so many
years.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ha ha. Inkar edemezsin; bunca yil sonra eski
dostlarla yeniden bulusmak
insanin hosuna gidiyor.

original:
<T>But I remember Randall talking to you. You
never seemed interested in joining us... <W>Why
was that?
translation:
<T>Ama Randall'in seninle konustugunu hatirliyorum. Sen
bize katilmaya hic istekli gorunmezdin... <W>Neden
oyleydi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmph. Randall was always surrounded by
friends. He didn't need me.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hih. Randall hep arkadaslarla cevriliydi.
Bana ihtiyaci yoktu.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>After he was gone, Henry followed in his
footsteps and found that treasure, and
Angela snubbed me.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>O gittikten sonra Henry onun izinden gidip o hazineyi buldu,
ve
Angela beni tersledi.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>So I came here to make my fortune. You
went to London and became a respected
scholar.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu yuzden servetimi yapmak icin buraya geldim. Sen
Londra'ya gidip saygin bir
bilgin oldun.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Who knows? If Randall were still alive, we
might both still be living in Stansbury.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Kim bilir? Randall hala hayatta olsaydi, ikimiz de
belki hala Stansbury'de yasiyor olurduk.

original: <T><M8/2/1>Yes...<W> If Randall were still alive.
translation: <T><M8/2/1>Evet...<W> Randall hala hayatta olsaydi.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Anyway, that's enough misty-eyed
reminiscing for me.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Neyse, benim icin bu kadar
duygusal ani yeter.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Yes, well. It was good to talk after all these
years, Dalston.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Evet... Bunca yil sonra konusmak iyi geldi,
Dalston.

original: <T><M3/1/1>You look knackered, Layton.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Bitkin gorunuyorsun, Layton.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>You should have a rest. Even a big brain like
yours needs a break.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Dinlenmelisin. Senin gibi buyuk bir beyin bile
mola ister.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>That would be wonderful, but I'm afraid that
if we don't solve this case soon, more
people will suffer.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Bu harika olurdu ama korkarim ki
bu davayi yakinda cozmezsek, daha fazla
insan aci cekecek.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Wow, Angela really has twisted your arm,
hasn't she? You've got no reason to care
for Monte d'Or otherwise.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Vay canina, Angela kolunu gercekten bukmus,
oyle degil mi? Yoksa Monte d'Or'u
umursaman icin bir sebep yok.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I consider it my duty as a gentleman to
come to the aid of those in need.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bir beyefendi olarak, ihtiyac icindekilere
yardim etmeyi gorev sayarim.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Oh, come off it. If you're so serious about
this, what are you doing here yapping at
me?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Hadi ama, birak bunlari. Eger bu konuda bu kadar
ciddiysen, burada benimle
gevezelik etmene ne gerek var?

original: <T><M3/1/1>Hm, point taken.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Himm, haklisin.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Come on, Layton, I was just joking! Lighten
up a bit!<W> Hang around here as much as you
like.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hadi ama Layton, saka yapiyordum! Biraz
rahatla!<W> Istedigin kadar burada
takil.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Ha ha. Well, perhaps I'll be back sometime,
then.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ha ha. Oyleyse belki bir ara
yeniden gelirim.

original:
<T>Hey, Layton. I'm starting to think you
actually enjoy hanging around here.
translation:
<T>Hey, Layton. Burada takilmaktan gercekten
hoslandigini dusunmeye basladim.

original: <T>Why would I not? It is very pleasant here.
translation: <T>Neden hoslanmayayim ki? Burasi cok keyifli.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Well, if you like it that much, maybe I should
give you a little present.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Madem bu kadar sevdin, belki sana kucuk
bir hediye vermeliyim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>It's just over there. Why don't you have
a look?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hemen surada. Bir
baksana?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>It's a diorama of this house! You may now
gaze upon it whenever you like. It's one of
a kind, so treat it well.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bu evin bir dioramasi! Artik istedigin zaman
ona bakip seyredebilirsin. Tek
ornek, o yuzden iyi bak.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Thank you, Dalston! It's quite charming.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Tesekkur ederim, Dalston! Cok hos.

original: ゴンゾ
translation: Gonzo

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Welcome, sir. May I prepare something for
you to eat?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hos geldiniz efendim. Yemek
icin bir sey hazirlayayim mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Ah, no, thank you. We don't wish to disturb.
translation: <T>Ah, hayir, tesekkurler. Rahatsiz etmek istemeyiz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I see. It's just that I so rarely get the
opportunity to entertain. Most people in
town think Mr Dalston rather strange.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Anliyorum. Sadece misafir agirlama firsatini
cok nadiren buluyorum. Kasabadaki cogu insan
Bay Dalston'i oldukca tuhaf buluyor.

original:
<T>And what few acquaintances he has don't
visit much. I sometimes wonder if he doesn't
get very lonely.
translation:
<T>Zaten az sayida tanidigi da
pek ugramiyor. Bazen
cok yalniz kalip kalmadigini merak ediyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Please stop by whenever there's a lull in
your investigation. I know Mr Dalston would
appreciate it.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sorusturmanizda bir duraklama oldugunda
lutfen ugrayin. Bay Dalston'in
memnun kalacagini biliyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Of course. Dalston is an old friend. I'll
come back when I can.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Elbette. Dalston eski bir dost. Uygun
oldukca geri gelirim.

original:
<T>You have to really know a person to see
through their faults and realise their true
qualities.
translation:
<T>Birinin kusurlarini asarak
gercek niteliklerini fark edebilmek icin
onu gercekten tanimak gerekir.

original:
<T>I wish others would take the time to get to
know Mr Dalston better...
translation:
<T>Keske baskalari da Bay Dalston'i daha iyi
tanimaya vakit ayirsa...

original: パンチョン
translation: パンチョン

original: <T>Ahh...
translation: <T>Ahh...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>Mr Waltham, it's rare to see you looking
down. Did something happen?
translation:
<T>Bay Waltham, sizi boyle basiniz one egik gormek
nadirdir. Bir sey mi oldu?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I was just thinking about the past. It's like
something out of a penny dreadful.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sadece gecmisi dusunuyordum. Sanki
ucuz bir korku romanindan firlamis gibi.

original:
<T>But you're right, it's unbecoming of me to
dwell on just the negative. Let's refresh our
minds with a puzzle!
translation:
<T>Ama haklisin, sadece olumsuz seylere takilip kalmak
bana yakismaz. Haydi, bir bulmacayla
zihnimizi tazeleyelim!

original:
<T>Maybe you're a bit too young for that
puzzle, my boy.
translation:
<T>Belki de o bulmaca icin biraz
kucuksun, evlat.

original: <T>Do you know what ball darts are?
translation: <T>Balon darti nedir biliyor musun?

original:
<T>From where did such sad memories come in
a glittering town such as this?
translation:
<T>Boylesine pariltili bir sehirde
bu kadar huzunlu anilar nereden cikmis?

original: <T><M2/1/2>Was it something to do with money?
translation: <T><M2/1/2>Para ile mi ilgiliydi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Isn't everything? It was about the day my
wife took half my money and ran off with
a poor man. <W>A day much like today.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Her sey oyle degil mi? Karimin
paramin yarisini alip fakir bir adamla kactigi gun.
<W>Tipki bugun gibi bir gun.

original:
<T>I loved my wife dearly, but it turns out she
only loved my fortune. Hah.
translation:
<T>Karimi cok severdim ama meger
sadece servetimi seviyormus. Hah.

original: <T><M1/2/4>Oh... That's terrible.
translation: <T><M1/2/4>Ah... Bu korkunc.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I'm sorry, young man. <W>Remember that the
only thing you can trust in this world is
money. It will never betray you.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Uzgunum, genc adam. <W>Unutma ki bu dunyada
guvenebilecegin tek sey
paradir. O seni asla yari yolda birakmaz.

original:
<T>It's a sad state of affairs, I know. But I'm
better off lonely and rich than loved and
poor.
translation:
<T>Biliyorum, cok aci bir durum. Ama
sevilip fakir olmaktansa yalniz ve
zengin olmayi tercih ederim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Make way for Waltham of Waltham and Co.!
Time is money and you can't afford to make
me wait!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Waltham and Co.'nun Waltham'ina yol verin!
Vakit nakittir ve beni
bekletmeye kalkmayin!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Think what would happen to the city's
economy if I were out of the picture!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ben ortadan kaybolsam sehrin
ekonomisine ne olacagini bir dusunun!

original:
<T>I've been trying to get a meeting with Mr
Ledore for...<W>well, hours now.
translation:
<T>Bay Ledore'la gorusmeye calisiyorum da...<W>sey,
saatlerdir.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>My name is Waltham. I'm stinking rich...<W>and
I very much doubt you are.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Benim adim Waltham. Para icinde yuzuyorum...<W>ve
sizin de oyle oldugunuzu hic sanmiyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>My gold tooth is especially dazzling tonight,
with the neon in full glow.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu gece neonlar isil isilken
altin disim ozellikle goz kamastiriyor.

original:
<T>If I didn't have money, I would just have an
empty gap there.
translation:
<T>Param olmasaydi orada
sadece bombos bir bosluk olurdu.

original: チルチル
translation: Cilcil

original: <T>Growrrr... Grawr...
translation: <T>Growrrr... Grawr...

original: <T><M1/2/1>Grr...rrrrowr...
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Grr...rrrrowr...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/2>That's so sad! We'll have to teach people
not to be afraid of you, then!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Bu cok uzucu! O zaman insanlara
senden korkmamayi ogretmeliyiz!

original: <T>Growrrrrr...
translation: <T>Growrrrrr...

original: <T><M3/1/3>I can help! I'm great with puzzles!
translation: <T><M3/1/3>Ben yardimci olabilirim! Bulmacalarda cok iyiyim!

original: <T>Rawrr?
translation: <T>Rawrr?

original: <T>Grrraarr!
translation: <T>Grrraarr!

original: <T>Grawrr...
translation: <T>Grawrr...

original: <T>Grrrawwrr. Grrrawr-raaawrrr.
translation: <T>Grrrawwrr. Grrrawr-raaawrrr.

original:
<T><M3/2/5/15>Something beneath the town? What do you
mean?
translation:
<T><M3/2/5/15>Kasabanin altinda bir sey mi? Ne
demek istiyorsun?

original: <T>Rawrr. Grrrawr.
translation: <T>Rawrr. Grrrawr.

original: <T>Growrr...
translation: <T>Growrr...

original: <T>Grrr. Grawrr...
translation: <T>Grrr. Grawrr...

original: <T>Grrwawarr?!
translation: <T>Grrwawarr?!

original: マーフィー
translation: Murphy

original:
<T>Ah, good evening! It seems I'm a veritable
handbook of quantitative information this
week! Yes, indeed!
translation:
<T>Ah, iyi aksamlar! Gorunuse gore bu hafta
nicel bilginin adeta
el kitabiyim! Evet, gercekten de!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Hello, Murphy.
translation: <T>Merhaba, Murphy.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yes, yes! I've just been here watching
Mr Ledore's fortune grow.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet, evet! Burada Bay Ledore'un servetinin
buyumesini izliyordum.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Well, that's good news for Henry.
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Bu Henry icin iyi haber.

original:
<T>And since I manage his wealth, I feel
immensely gratified every time it increases!
translation:
<T>Servetini ben yonettigim icin,
her arttiginda buyuk bir memnuniyet duyuyorum!

original: <T><M2/2/1>Then, it is also good news for you.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>O halde senin icin de iyi haber.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Here's an idea. If you would entrust me with
your savings, I could make you rich! <W>How
about it?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bir fikrim var. Birikimlerinizi bana emanet
ederseniz sizi zengin edebilirim! <W>Ne
dersiniz?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Oh, no, thank you. My finances don't really
require much management.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ah, hayir, tesekkurler. Mali durumum
pek yonetim gerektirmiyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>No? Well, it's your loss. Or at least, lack of
gain. Ha ha!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Hayir mi? Eh, kaybeden siz olursunuz. Ya da
en azindan kazanctan mahrum kalirsiniz. Ha ha!

original:
<T>Whenever Mr Ledore needs financial advice,
he comes straight to me.
translation:
<T>Bay Ledore ne zaman mali tavsiyeye ihtiyac duysa,
dogruca bana gelir.

original:
<T>And as the year end results clearly show,
he's now one of the richest men in the
country!
translation:
<T>Yil sonu sonuclarinin da acikca gosterdigi gibi,
artik ulkenin
en zengin adamlarindan biri!

original: セレナ
translation: Serena

original:
<T>I was feeling a hot streak coming on, then
I pulled the lever and got triple sevens!
Wonderfabulant, right?
translation:
<T>Sansimin dondugunu hissediyordum; sonra
kollari cektim ve uc yedi geldi!
Harikamuazzam, degil mi?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M5/2/1>Congratulations!
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Tebrikler!

original:
<T><M3/1/2>But I didn't know when to stop, and before
I knew it, all my winnings were gone. Just
like that! Kerplumph!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Ama ne zaman duracagimi bilemedim; goz
acip kapayincaya kadar tum kazancim gitti.
Iste boyle! Gum!

original:
<T>Is that fair?<W> Maybe you could help me solve
this puzzle to help take my mind off the
whole fiddle...
translation:
<T>Bu adil mi?<W> Belki su bulmacayi cozmeme yardim
edersin de aklim
bu dolaplardan biraz uzaklasir...

original:
<T>You won't do one teensy, miniscopic puzzle
with me?! My luck really has run out...
translation:
<T>Benimle ufacik, minicik bir bulmaca bile
yapmayacak misin?! Sansim gercekten bitmis...

original:
<T>Help illuminate my mood by doing a puzzle
with me. Please?
translation:
<T>Benimle bir bulmaca cozerek
moralimi biraz aydinlat. Lutfen?

original: <T>Do you feel better now?
translation: <T>Simdi daha iyi hissediyor musun?

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Not in the sliverest! I need to get back on
a hot streak. That'll make me feel less like
a damp squid!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Zerre kadar bile! Sansim yeniden donmeli.
O zaman kendimi
islak bir kalamar gibi hissetmem!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Yes, well...sorry we couldn't be more of
a help.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Sey... daha fazla yardimci olamadigimiz icin
uzgunum.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Oh, there's no need to consolidate me!
I think the Masked Dandleman will turn my
fortunes around tonight!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ah, beni teselli etmene gerek yok!
Bence Maskeli Dandleman bu gece
sansimi dondurecek!

original:
<T>I bet he'll put everyone on a hot streak and
we'll all win buckets!
translation:
<T>Eminim herkese sans getirecek ve
hepimiz kovalar dolusu kazanacagiz!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I don't imagine the casino owners will be
pleased if everyone wins.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Herkes kazanirsa kumarhane sahiplerinin
pek memnun olacagini sanmiyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I doubt we need to worry about that
happening.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bunun olmasindan
endise etmemize gerek yok bence.

original:
<T>I can't wait to see what kind of miracle the
Masked Dandleman has on his sleeve
tonight.
translation:
<T>Bu gece Maskeli Dandleman'in
kollarindan nasil bir mucize cikaracagini
gormek icin sabirsizlaniyorum.

original:
<T>Everything here is so spardiant, but it's hard
to get excited about it when you're scrapped
for cash.
translation:
<T>Burasi o kadar piril piril ki, ama
metelige kursun atarken
heyecanlanmak zor.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I hope the Masked Dandleman hurries up
and gets here soon so he can brizzle up my
mood with a great performance.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Umarim Maskeli Dandleman cabuk gelir de
harika bir gosteriyle
moralimi pirildatir.

original:
<T><M3/1/2/15>Wh-<W>wh-<W>what happened? All of a sudden
sand came flowing in from every nook!
I thought that only happened in films!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2/15>Ne-<W>ne-<W>ne oldu? Birdenbire her
