koseden kum akmaya basladi!
Bunun sadece filmlerde oldugunu sanirdim!

original:
<T>No one told me the miracle was going to be
a huge disastrophe! Get me the stage
manager!
translation:
<T>Kimse bana mucizenin koca bir
felaket olacagini soylemedi! Bana sahne
mudurunu getirin!

original: コマーニ有
translation: コマーニ有

original: <T><M5/2/1>Unghh, grgghh... It hurts...
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Unghh, grgghh... Aciyor...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/2/5>Bungle! Did you get tied up again?!
translation: <T><M3/2/5>Bungle! Yine mi baglanip kaldin?!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1>A true gentleman never turns his back on
a clown in need.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Gercek bir beyefendi, yardima muhtac
bir palyacoya sirtini donmez.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>The entanglement looks considerably more
complicated this time. Don't go anywhere.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Bu seferki dolasiklik epey daha
karmasik gorunuyor. Kipirdama.

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>Hold tight. We'll get you out of this.
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Dayan. Seni buradan cikaracagiz.

original: コマーニ無
translation: コマーニ無

original: <T>Phew! Once again, you're a lifesaver!
translation: <T>Ohh! Yine hayatimi kurtardiniz!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Here I was terrified I was going to float
away! Well, I've certainly learnt my lesson,
I can tell you that!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ucup gidecegim diye odum kopmustu!
Ama dersimi aldim,
onu soyleyebilirim!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>What do you mean? Was this some sort of
punishment?
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Ne demek istiyorsun? Bu bir tur
ceza miydi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Well, don't make it common knowledge,
but...<W30>I ate the ringmaster's pudding. I don't
know what came over me!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Pek duyulmasin ama,
sey...<W30>Sirk mudurunun pudingini yedim. Neden
boyle yaptim, bilmiyorum!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Look, promise you won't tell him that you
helped me.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bak, bana yardim ettigini
ona soylemeyecegine soz ver.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>If he hears that I've been telling tales, he
might tie me up with so many balloons that
I actually float off for good!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Dedikodu yaptigimi duyarsa beni o kadar
cok balonla baglar ki
gercekten sonsuza dek ucup giderim!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I've spent so much time tied up in my
balloons that I'm starting to get used to it.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Balonlarima bagli o kadar cok vakit gecirdim ki
artik alismaya basladim.

original:
<T>One of the balloons I was tangled up in flew
away while I was trying to escape.
translation:
<T>Kurtulmaya calisirken dolandigim balonlardan biri
ucup gitti.

original:
<T>I think I saw it floating towards the marquee.
It's not your average balloon...
translation:
<T>Sanki cadira dogru suzulurken gordum.
Oyle siradan bir balon degil...

original:
<T><M3/1/1>All right, I agree that putting up flyers is
important, but I want a chance to get on
stage!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Tamam, afis asmak onemli, kabul. Ama
sahneye cikma
sansim da olsun istiyorum!

original:
<T>Knowing my luck, I'd probably get a bunch
of crazy fans who'd bungle up my career on
a monumental scale!
translation:
<T>Benim sansima, muhtemelen bir suru cilgin
hayran cikar ve kariyerimi
devasa olcekte mahveder!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>One of the balloons I was tangled up in flew
away while I was trying to escape.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Kurtulmaya calisirken dolandigim balonlardan biri
ucup gitti.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Cripes! Someone tell me next time there's
an earthquake!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Vay canina! Bir dahaki depremde
bana haber versin biri!

original: ニルス
translation: Nils

original:
<T>Evening. Got the feeling something's going
to happen tonight.
translation:
<T>Iyi aksamlar. Bu gece bir seyler olacakmis
gibi hissediyorum.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Oh? Why do you say that?
translation: <T>Oyle mi? Neden boyle diyorsun?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Can't quite pin it down. Something smacks
of danger.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Tam aciklayamiyorum. Tehlike kokusu
aliyorum.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Let's hope that's just your mind playing
tricks on you...
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Umarim bu sadece zihninin sana
oyun oynamasidir...

original:
<T>Don't get me wrong, I'm usually the most
level-headed one around here. <W>Just can't
shake the feeling...
translation:
<T>Yanlis anlama, genelde burada en
sogukkanli olan benim. <W>Ama
su hissi bir turlu atamiyorum...

original: ポリス
translation: ポリス

original:
<T>Evening, Professor! Still at the old evidence
collecting, I take it?
translation:
<T>Iyi aksamlar, Profesor! Hala eski usul delil
topluyoruz, oyle mi?

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T>Yes, we are. I take it you are still searching
as well?
translation:
<T>Evet, oyle. Siz de hala ariyorsunuz
diye anliyorum?

original:
<T>That I am. I discovered a key clue to solving
this case: we're going to need more time.
translation:
<T>Elbette. Bu davayi cozmenin kilit ipucunu buldum:
daha fazla zamana ihtiyacimiz var.

original:
<T>Which is to say, I haven't found a blinking
thing!
translation:
<T>Yani, goz kirpacak
bir sey bile bulamadim!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Nevertheless, I commend you on your hard
work thus far.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yine de simdiye kadarki siki
calismaniz icin sizi takdir ediyorum.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Awfully kind of you to say so! If you lot
manage to work anything out, be sure to
report it right away, won't you?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ne kadar naziksiniz! Siz de bir sey
bulursaniz hemen
haber verirsiniz, degil mi?

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Do you think Detective Bloom's already told
the task force that the Masked Gentleman
will be at the Reunion Inn?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Sence Dedektif Bloom gorev gucune
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin Reunion Inn'de
olacagini soylemistir?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/30>It doesn't appear so. He may be worried that
the information will be leaked and reach the
Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/30>Oyle gorunmuyor. Bilginin sizip
Maskeli Beyefendi'ye ulasmasindan
endise ediyor olabilir.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Because rushing in before they were fully
prepared might let him escape?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Cunku tam hazirlanmadan baskin yapmak
kacmasina yol acabilir mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1/30>Yes. Until we know the Masked Gentleman's
identity, we ought to follow Bloom's lead
and keep quiet.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/30>Evet. Maskeli Beyefendi'nin kim oldugunu
ogrenene kadar Bloom'u izleyip
sessiz kalmaliyiz.

original:
<T>So, if we never manage to explain how a
miracle was performed, doesn't that make it
sort of a real miracle?
translation:
<T>Peki, bir mucizenin nasil yapildigini asla
aciklayamazsak, bu da onu
gercek bir mucize yapmis olmaz mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Constable. How goes the investigation?
translation: <T>Memur. Sorusturma nasil gidiyor?

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Well, I hate to say this, but it's not looking
too great.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Sunu soylemek istemem ama pek
iyi gorunmuyor.

original:
<T>That know-it-all Bloom acts like he's got
a lead, but if he has, he's kept us all in the
dark about it.
translation:
<T>Her seyi bildigini sanan Bloom bir iz bulmus gibi
davraniyor ama bulduysa da
hepimizi karanlikta birakiyor.

original: <T>That would prove to be an obstacle.
translation: <T>Bu da engel olur tabii.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Just between you and me, I'm not confident
we could catch our man even if we did have
all the info.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aramizda kalsin, tum bilgi elimizde olsa bile
adami yakalayabilecegimizden
pek emin degilim.

original:
<T>Not that we're incompetent, oh no. It's just
that, well, we were never really prepared to
deal with anything...big.
translation:
<T>Yetersiz oldugumuzdan degil, hayir. Sadece
sey... biz hic
boylesine... buyuk bir seyle basa cikmaya hazirlanmadik.

original:
<T>Maybe when this is over, I can bring the kids
here. They'd love to spend a day at the
funfair! Have you seen the poster?
translation:
<T>Belki bu is bitince cocuklari buraya getiririm.
Bir gun lunaparkta vakit gecirmeye bayilirlar!
Afisi gordunuz mu?

original: <T>Ah, it appears to be ripped here.
translation: <T>Aa, surasi yirtilmis galiba.

original:
<T>Professor, I thought there was no puzzle you
couldn't solve!
translation:
<T>Profesor, cozemeyeceginiz bulmaca
yok sanirdim!

original:
<T>We should probably put up a new poster in
place of the torn one...
translation:
<T>Yirtilanin yerine
yeni bir afis asmaliyiz...

original: <T>Good on you, Professor!
translation: <T>Aferin size, Profesor!

original:
<T>It was nothing. You could have solved it too
with that level of observation.
translation:
<T>Onemli degil. Siz de bu kadar dikkatle
bakinca cozebilirdiniz.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Heh heh, you're too kind! But it comes with
the territory. All part of the job.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Heh heh, cok naziksiniz! Ama isin
dogasi bu. Meslegin bir parcasi.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Maybe I'll take a nice relaxing holiday with
the family when this case is over.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bu dava bitince ailemle
guzel, dinlendirici bir tatile cikarim belki.

original: <T>This place is always buzzing with people!
translation: <T>Burasi her zaman insan kayniyor!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I haven't had much time to spend with the
family in the last month or so. It's starting
to drag me down.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Son bir aydir ailemle pek vakit geciremedim.
Bu durum
beni iyice yipratiyor.

original: <T><M4/2/1>I'm sorry to hear that.
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Bunu duyduguma uzuldum.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I just hope that the next time I come here,
it'll be with my family, not for work.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Umarim buraya bir dahaki gelisim
is icin degil, ailemle olur.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Where'd all that sand come from?! We
managed to get everyone to safety, but only
just in the nick of time...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu kadar kum nereden cikti?! Herkesi guvene
almayi basardik ama
tam zamaninda...

original:
<T>You're not telling me that's another of the
Masked Gentleman's miracles?!
translation:
<T>Bunun da Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
mucizelerinden biri oldugunu soylemeyin?!

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Oh, would you believe...<W20> I can't...I just
can't believe it!
translation:
<T>Inanir misin...<W20> Ben...
inanamiyorum... Hic inanamiyorum!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/2/5>What's wrong, Constable?
translation: <T><M3/2/5>Ne oldu, Memur?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Well, I tried this slot machine just for
a laugh and guess what happened?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sey, su slot makinesini
saka olsun diye denedim, tahmin et ne oldu?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I'm set for life! I could stop working now
and never do another midnight shift directing
traffic in the freezing cold!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Omur boyu rahatim! Artik calismayi birakip
dondurucu sogukta gece yarisi
trafik yonetme vardiyalarina bir daha girmem!

original: <T><M1/1/1>You hit the jackpot?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Jackpot mu vurdun?

original:
<T>Bingo! <W>Come on, join in the celebration!
Free puzzles on the house!
translation:
<T>Bingo! <W>Hadi, kutlamaya katil!
Bulmacalar benden, bedava!

original: <T>Aw, don't be such a stick-in-the-mud.
translation: <T>Ah, bu kadar da surat asma.

original:
<T>I just wanted to share some of my
happiness with you. It's natural, innit?
translation:
<T>Sadece biraz mutlulugumu
seninle paylasmak istedim. Dogal degil mi?

original:
<T>Ouch! My cheeks ache from grinning!
Maybe I could double - no, triple - my
earnings!
translation:
<T>Ah! Siritmaktan yanaklarim agridi!
Belki kazancimi ikiye... yok, uce
katlayabilirim!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Please try to remember that gambling is an
enormous risk. You could lose it all and
end up back at square one.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Lutfen kumarin buyuk bir risk
oldugunu unutma. Her seyini kaybedip
en basa donebilirsin.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Nah, I've got a feeling about this! I can
feel it in my bones!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Yok ya, icimde bir his var! Iliklerime kadar
hissediyorum!

original: <T>I can't possibly lose now!
translation: <T>Artik kaybetmem imkansiz!

original: <T><M1/2/2>Professor, please stop him...
translation: <T><M1/2/2>Profesor, lutfen onu durdurun...

original:
<T><M5/2/1>It's your decision, of course, Constable, but
please remember a true gentleman never
relies on luck.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Elbette karar senin, Memur, ama
gercek bir beyefendinin asla
sansa bel baglamadigini unutma.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You will keep this whole thing secret from
the guv, won't you?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bu isi amirden
gizli tutarsiniz, degil mi?

original:
<T>Guv says I'm to stay here and keep guard.
You never know when trouble might arise
with disappointed gamblers around.
translation:
<T>Amirim burada kalip nobet tutmami soyledi.
Etrafta hayal kirikligina ugramis kumarbaz varken
ne zaman sorun cikacagi belli olmaz.

original:
<T>Oh, and about earlier... Thanks for your
advice. I had a good old think, and I'll be
saving that money I won for my retirement!
translation:
<T>Ha, bir de az onceki... Tavsiyeniz icin
tesekkurler. Iyice dusundum ve
kazandigim parayi emekliligim icin biriktirecegim!

original:
<T>Still here, keeping the peace. So I got a bit
distracted along the way, but now I'm on
top form!
translation:
<T>Hala buradayim, asayisi sagliyorum. Yolda biraz
dikkatim dagildi ama simdi
formum yerinde!

original:
<T>It may look like I'm off in my own world, but
I'm actually focusing all my senses to detect
any signs of criminal activity.
translation:
<T>Kendi dunyama dalmisim gibi gorunebilir ama
aslinda suc faaliyeti belirtisi
yakalamak icin tum duyularimi keskinlestiriyorum.

original: <T>Pretending to be lazy ain't easy, my friend.
translation: <T>Tembelmis gibi yapmak kolay degil, dostum.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>I heard that the Mask of Chaos used to be
on display in Mr Ledore's house.
translation:
<T>Kaos Maskesi'nin eskiden
Bay Ledore'un evinde sergilendigini duydum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I had no idea it was a priceless artefact.
I thought it was just some spooky-looking
carnival mask.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu kadar paha bicilmez bir eser oldugunu
hic bilmiyordum. Sadece urkutucu gorunumlu
bir karnaval maskesi sanmistim.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1>I imagine most people in town feel that way
about it.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Kasabadaki cogu insanin da
boyle dusundugunu saniyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>And then there's its twin mask called the
Mask of Order. So what's your theory, Prof?
Is it actually magic?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bir de ikizi olan Duzen Maskesi var. Peki
sizin teoriniz ne, Profesor?
Gercekten sihir mi?

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Well, the historical records indicate that it
contains some sort of power, but I couldn't
say what kind.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Tarihi kayitlar icinde bir tur guc
barindirdigini gosteriyor, ama
ne tur oldugunu soyleyemem.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Do you think the big M.G. knows about its
power?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sence buyuk M.G. onun
gucunu biliyor mu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I'm not certain, but we're going to ensure
that he never gets his hands on it.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Emin degilim ama onun
asla eline gecirmemesini saglayacagiz.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Well, I have faith in you, Professor.
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Profesor, size guveniyorum.

original:
<T>What's the Masked Gentleman planning for
tonight, I wonder?
translation:
<T>Maskeli Bey bu gece icin
ne planliyor acaba?

original: ブルーマイル
translation: Bloom

original:
<T>Professor, we've determined who took the
chariot.
translation:
<T>Profesor, arabayi kimin
aldigini tespit ettik.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>And did this information lead you to the
Masked Gentleman's identity?
translation:
<T>Peki bu bilgi sizi Maskeli
Bey'in kimligine goturdu mu?

original: <T><M1/1/1>If only it were that simple...
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Keske bu kadar basit olsaydi...

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It seems our man blended in flawlessly with
the chariot inspectors. We're looking at
a master of disguise here.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Adamimiz, araba mufettislerinin arasina
kusursuzca karismis. Karsimizda
kilik degistirme ustasi var.

original:
<T>He and his associates deconstructed the
cart and then told Mr Ledore that it needed
to be repaired.
translation:
<T>O ve ortaklari arabayi parcalara ayirdi,
sonra da Bay Ledore'a
tamir edilmesi gerektigini soylediler.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>And when they were done using it in the
parade, they brought it back here and
reassembled it.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Gecitte kullanmayi bitirince
buraya geri getirip
yeniden birlestirdiler.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>I see. Then what exactly do you believe is
the Masked Gentleman's intention?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Anliyorum. Peki sizce Maskeli
Bey'in amaci tam olarak ne?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>He wants the Mask of Order, so it has to
have some definite significance to him.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Duzen Maskesi'ni istiyor, demek ki
onun icin kesin bir anlami var.

original:
<T>As for what he plans to do with the masks...
Well, I'm at a loss.
translation:
<T>Maskelerle ne yapmayi planladigina gelince...
Dogrusu bilemiyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>All we can say is that his intentions are
undoubtedly malicious.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Tek soyleyebilecegimiz, niyetlerinin
suphesiz kotu oldugu.

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Detective Bloom, do you believe that the
Masked Gentleman is currently at the
Reunion Inn?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Dedektif Bloom, Maskeli Bey'in su anda
Reunion Inn'de
oldugunu dusunuyor musunuz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Most definitely. It's the perfect location for
his purposes. I don't think he'll be leaving
any time soon.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Kesinlikle. Amaclari icin mukemmel bir yer.
Yakinda
ayrilacagini sanmiyorum.

original:
<T>There's a tram stop near here that goes right
by it.
translation:
<T>Buraya yakin, otelin
tam onunden gecen bir tramvay duragi var.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I still have a few leads to check. Would you
mind investigating the Reunion Inn in my
stead?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hala bakmam gereken birkac ipucu var.
Benim yerime Reunion Inn'i
inceleyebilir misiniz?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Not at all. As a matter of fact, we already
intended to do so.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Elbette. Zaten
bunu yapmayi dusunuyorduk.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I appreciate it, Professor. Now please
excuse me, I must be off.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Tesekkur ederim, Profesor. Simdi
musaadenizle, gitmem gerekiyor.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M2/2/1/45>He really is very thorough with his work.
translation: <T><M2/2/1/45>Isinde gercekten cok titiz.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M4/2/1>What other leads do you think he was
talking about?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Sence bahsettigi
baska ipuclari neler olabilir?

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Do you think he's working on something
else?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Baska bir sey
uzerinde mi calisiyor dersin?

original: <T><M1/2/1>I really couldn't say.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Gercekten soyleyemem.

original: <T><M1/2/1/45>So, what now, Professor?
translation: <T><M1/2/1/45>Peki simdi ne yapacagiz, Profesor?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Hmm, based on what we've witnessed so
far, I'd considered Henry the main suspect.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hmm, simdiye kadar gorduklerimize
bakinca Henry'yi
bas supheli olarak gormustum.

original:
<T>But it seems that that's just what the
Masked Gentleman wanted me to do.
translation:
<T>Ama anlasilan Maskeli
Bey'in tam da istedigi buydu.

original:
<T><M6/2/1>All along, he's been trying to incriminate
Henry with a bag of manipulative tricks.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1>Bastan beri turlu manipulatif numaralarla
Henry'yi suclu gostermeye calisiyormus.

original:
<T>He knew that when his miracles were
exposed, all roads would lead to Henry.<M1/2/1/55>
translation:
<T>Mucizeleri ortaya ciktiginda
tum yollarin Henry'ye cikacagini biliyordu.<M1/2/1/55>

original:
<T><M3/1/1>So the Masked Gentleman, whoever he is,
is trying to frame Henry!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Demek Maskeli Bey her kimse,
Henry'ye komplo kurmaya calisiyor!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>But we know it isn't Mr Dalston. Who else
could it be?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ama Bay Dalston olmadigini biliyoruz. Baska
kim olabilir?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I don't know. Not yet anyway. Let's head to
the Reunion Inn.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Bilmiyorum. En azindan simdilik. Hadi
Reunion Inn'e gidelim.

original: グスタフ
translation: Gustave

original:
<T>I can't believe someone made off with one
of the carts without my knowledge.
translation:
<T>Birinin, benim haberim bile olmadan
arabalardan birini alip kacmasina inanamiyorum.

original: <T>This is no petty criminal, is it?
translation: <T>Bu ufak tefek bir suclu degil, oyle mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Indeed it's not. I have the impression our
culprit is rather accustomed to this sort of
work.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Gercekten degil. Suclumuzun bu tur
islere epey aliskin oldugu
izlenimini edindim.

original:
<T>Not only that, but this kind of operation
would require money, time, the help of
others and a familiarity with the town.
translation:
<T>Sadece bu da degil; boyle bir is
para, zaman, baskalarinin yardimi
ve kasabayi tanimayi gerektirir.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I see... Well, I do hope the police bring him
to justice soon.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Anliyorum... Umarim polis onu yakinda
adalete teslim eder.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I don't suppose I could tempt you with
a puzzle before you go, could I?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Gitmeden once sizi bir bulmacayla
cezbedebilir miyim, acaba?

original:
<T>Seating plans do cause headaches, don't
they?
translation:
<T>Oturma duzenleri bas agritir, degil
mi?

original:
<T>Our sponsors gave us this puzzle. It never
occurred to me that they were giving us a
subtle hint...
translation:
<T>Sponsorlarimiz bize bu bulmacayi verdi. Bize
ince bir ipucu verdikleri hic
aklima gelmemisti...

original:
<T>I can't in good conscience keep the
racecourse open with the Masked
Gentleman out there.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi ortalikta dolasirken
vicdanim elvermiyor; hipodromu
acik tutamam.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Do you mean because you might be
inadvertently creating an audience for one
of his miracles?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Yani istemeden, onun mucizelerinden
birine seyirci mi
olusturmus olabilirsiniz diye mi?

original: <T><M2/1/1>Yes, exactly.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Evet, aynen oyle.

original:
<T>Ever since the Masked Gentleman appeared,
we've been overcome with anxiety.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi ortaya ciktigindan beri,
icimizi endise kapladi.

original:
<T>The moment the sun sets, everyone floods
into the casinos. But until then, the grounds
are the most popular place to be.
translation:
<T>Gunes batinca herkes kumarhanelere
dolusuyor. Ama o zamana kadar
burasi en gozde yer.

original:
<T>Our motto is {''}Be a gentleman{''}, but given
recent events, I think it's just doing damage
to our business.
translation:
<T>Sloganimiz {''}Beyefendi ol{''}, ama son
olaylari dusununce bunun isimize
zarar verdigini saniyorum.

original: <T><M4/1/1>Ah well, everything goes in cycles.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Eh, her sey donguler halinde ilerler.

original:
<T>What was that? An earthquake?! <W>Thankfully,
the racecourse is undamaged.
translation:
<T>O da neydi? Deprem mi?! <W>Neyse ki,
hipodrom zarar gormemis.

original:
<T>But you know, I think all that shaking may
have improved the view...
translation:
<T>Ama biliyor musun, bunca sarsinti
manzarayi daha da guzellestirmis olabilir...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>According to Detective Bloom, we should be
able to access the Reunion Inn from this
tram station.
translation:
<T>Dedektif Bloom'a gore, Reunion Inn'e
bu tramvay istasyonundan
ulasabilmemiz gerekiyor.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T>How do we get tickets?
translation: <T>Biletleri nasil alacagiz?

original: <T>I'll explain.
translation: <T>Aciklayayim.

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>We can either touch the icon on the Touch
Screen below or examine the red ticket
machine here.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Ya asagidaki Dokunmatik
Ekran'daki simgeye dokunabiliriz ya da
suradaki kirmizi bilet makinesini inceleyebiliriz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Then it's simply a matter of choosing our
destination on this screen. Quick and
efficient.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Sonra da bu ekrandan
gidecegimiz yeri secmek yeterli. Hizli ve
verimli.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T>Easy-peasy!
translation: <T>Cok kolay!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>So the Reunion Inn is the grandest hotel in
the city? I'm getting excited!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Yani Reunion Inn sehrin en gorkemli
oteli mi? Heyecanlaniyorum!

original: <T><M5/2/1>Let's buy our tickets and get going!
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Biletlerimizi alip yola koyulalim!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
わあ、これがモンテドール最大のホテル
『友を待つ宿』ですか
translation:
Vay canina, demek burasi Monte d'Or'un en buyuk oteli
『Bulusma Hani』 mi?

original:
奇跡の紳士は、本当にこのホテルの
客の中にいるのでしょうか
translation:
Mucize Beyefendi gercekten bu otelin
misafirleri arasinda mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: 私の勘が正しければね
translation: Eger sezgilerim dogruysa, evet.

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T>Friends, roamers, gentlemen, lend me your
ears! You are on an outing to the Reunion
Inn?
translation:
<T>Dostlar, gezginler, beyefendiler, kulak verin!
Reunion Inn'e mi
gidiyorsunuz?

original:
<T>The tiny sparrow tells me that under this
most starry of skies, those that wait here are
reunited with an old friend.
translation:
<T>Kucuk serce bana diyor ki, bu yildizlarla dolu
gogun altinda burada bekleyenler,
eski bir dostla yeniden bulusur.

original: <T><M2/1/1>And now I see the rumours are true!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Demek soylentiler dogruymus!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Well, I suppose you're right, Aldus.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Pekala, galiba haklisin, Aldus.

original:
<T>My good, gracious and genteel man! Please
bear with me, for I must know how many
puzzles you have solved!
translation:
<T>Iyi, zarif ve kibar efendim! Lutfen beni
hos gorun; kac tane
bulmaca cozdugunuzu bilmem gerek!

original:
<T>Do you fulfil the quota that a gentleman
should and could?
translation:
<T>Bir beyefendinin yerine getirmesi gereken
kotayi doldurdunuz mu?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Oh no! This will not do! I cannot let you
set a foot in the inn until you are versed in
at least 75 puzzles!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ah hayir! Bu olmaz! En az 75 bulmacada
ustalasmadan
hanin icine adim atmaniza izin veremem!
<T><M1/2/1/45>Ah... <W>Gercekten mi?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>I am sorry, but true friends must show tough
love from one time to another!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Uzgunum ama gercek dostlar bazen
sert sevgi gostermek zorundadir!

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Very well. We'll just have to come back after
we've solved 75 puzzles, yes?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Pekala. O zaman 75 bulmaca cozdukten
sonra geri gelecegiz, degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Exactly so! I'm sure you will find it no
trouble at all. <W>Then, until we meet again!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aynen oyle! Bunun sizin icin hic
zor olmayacagindan eminim. <W>Oyleyse, yeniden gorusene dek!

original:
<T>Ah, you have returned! How eagerly I have
been anticipating the tallness of your hat!
translation:
<T>Ah, geri donmussunuz! Sapkanizin
ne kadar uzadigini merakla bekliyordum!

original:
<T>How many puzzles is it that you have
solved?
translation:
<T>Kac tane bulmaca
cozdunuz?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Goodness! What is wrong?! Were my words
weightless to you? I said you must solve 75
puzzles at the very least!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Aman Tanrim! Ne oluyor?! Sozlerim size
hic mi agir gelmedi? En az 75
bulmaca cozmelisiniz demistim!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Surely this cannot be a problem for your
expansive brain! I shall wait here for your
return.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu, genis ufuklu beyniniz icin sorun olamaz!
Ben burada, donusunuzu
bekleyecegim.

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>All right. We'll be back shortly, Aldus.
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Peki. Az sonra donecegiz, Aldus.

original: アルダス
translation: アルダス

original:
<T>Friends, roamers, gentlemen, lend me your
ears! You are on an outing to the Reunion
Inn?
translation:
<T>Dostlar, gezginler, beyefendiler, kulak verin!
Reunion Inn'e bir gezintiye mi
gidiyorsunuz?

original:
<T>The tiny sparrow tells me that under this
most starry of skies, those that wait here are
reunited with an old friend.
translation:
<T>Kucuk sercem bana diyor ki; bu
yildizlarla dolu gok altinda, burada bekleyenler
eski bir dostla yeniden bulusacak.

original: <T><M2/1/1>And now I see the rumours are true!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Demek soylentiler dogruymus!

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Well, I suppose you're right, Aldus.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Sanirim haklisin, Aldus.

original:
<T>My good, gracious and genteel man! Please
bear with me, for I must know how many
puzzles you have solved!
translation:
<T>Ah, iyi, zarif ve kibar beyefendi! Lutfen
bana katlanin; kac bilmece cozdugunuzu
bilmem sart!

original:
<T>Do you fulfil the quota that a gentleman
should and could?
translation:
<T>Bir beyefendinin yerine getirmesi gereken
kotaya ulastiniz mi?

original:
<T>Ah, you have returned! How eagerly I have
been anticipating the tallness of your hat!
translation:
<T>Ah, geri dondunuz! Sapkanizin yuksekligini
ne heyecanla bekliyordum!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>How many puzzles is it that you have
solved?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Kac bilmece
cozdunuz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh, salubrious day! A most learned
gentleman you are!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ah, ne kutlu gun! Ne kadar bilgili bir
beyefendisiniz!

original: <T><M2/1/1>You have not betrayed my expectations.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Beklentilerimi bosa cikarmadiniz.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Please, go right on ahead. I shall be
watching over you from below, ever your
good friend!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Lutfen, buyurun ilerleyin. Ben de asagidan,
her daim dostunuz olarak,
sizi gozetecegim!

original:
<T>I deeply understand your desire to stay and
chat, but there must be something more
important to you, more urgent!
translation:
<T>Kalmak ve sohbet etmek isteginizi cok iyi
anliyorum; ama sizin icin daha
onemli, daha acil bir sey olmali!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Do not worry yourselves. I shall protect you
as a shepherd does his woolly lambs!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Endiselenmeyin. Bir cobanin yunlu kuzularini
korudugu gibi sizi de
koruyacagim!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M6/1/1>So this is the Reunion Inn? <W>It's definitely
much bigger than our hotel.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Demek burasi Bulusma Hani? <W>Kesinlikle
bizim otelden cok daha buyuk.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M4/2/1>Now this is somewhere I could get used to!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Iste burasi alisabilecegim bir yer!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Given the name, I gather Henry has some
special feelings for this hotel.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Adindan da anlasildigi gibi, Henry'nin bu
otele karsi ozel duygulari var sanirim.

original: <T><M3/1/4>So this is where it all began?
translation: <T><M3/1/4>Demek her sey burada basladi?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Yes, this hotel was an expansion of the first
building that Henry put up while he searched
for Randall.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Evet, bu otel Henry'nin Randall'i ararken
insa ettigi ilk binanin
bir genislemesiydi.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>He never gave up hope that he'd meet his
friend again one day.
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Bir gun arkadasini yeniden gorecegi umudundan
hic vazgecmedi.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Yes...<W> Henry never gave up.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Evet...<W> Henry hic vazgecmedi.

original: ヌーデン
translation: ヌーデン

original:
<T>Good evening and a most humble welcome
to the Reunion Inn!
translation:
<T>Iyi aksamlar ve Reunion Inn'e en mutevazi
hos geldiniz!

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>Mr Mordaunt?
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Bay Mordaunt?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Quite so! Ah! I've never mentioned it, have
I? <W>Among my many duties to Mr Ledore, I
also happen to be the manager of this hotel.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aynen oyle! Ah! Daha once soylemedim, degil mi
ben? <W>Bay Ledore'a olan bircok gorevimin yaninda ben de
bu otelin muduruyum.

original:
<T>This way, please. We've been expecting
you.
translation:
<T>Bu taraftan lutfen. Sizi bekliyorduk
zaten.

original:
<T>I heard from Mr Ledore that the Masked
Gentleman is believed to be hiding here...
translation:
<T>Bay Ledore'dan Maskeli
Beyefendi'nin burada saklandigina inanildigini duydum...

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>We're not entirely sure yet, but we'd like to
investigate the premises.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Henuz tamamen emin degiliz ama
mekani arastirmak istiyoruz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yes, of course. We'd most appreciate it if
you could find him before he strikes again.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet, elbette. Yeniden vurmasindan once onu
bulabilirseniz cok memnun oluruz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But I do have one condition. I am aware
that Mrs Ledore invited you here.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama bir sartim var. Bayan Ledore'un sizi buraya
davet ettiginin farkindayim.

original:
<T>However, I also understand that you once
suspected Mr Ledore in the recent incidents.
translation:
<T>Ancak son olaylarda bir ara
Bay Ledore'dan suphelendiginizi de biliyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>As we stand, I cannot in good faith
cooperate with you. I am Mr Ledore's
personal assistant, if you remember.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Su haliyle, iyi niyetle
sizinle is birligi yapamam. Hatirlarsaniz, ben Bay Ledore'un
kisisel asistaniyim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But perhaps to convince me your intentions
are true, would you be so inclined as to
solve this puzzle?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama niyetinizin gercekten dogru olduguna
beni ikna etmek icin, su bilmeceyi
cozmek ister misiniz?

original:
<T>My apologies, but unless you can solve this
puzzle, I simply cannot help you...
translation:
<T>Kusura bakmayin ama bu bilmeceyi
cozemezseniz size
yardim edemem...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Mr Mordaunt, I implore you to let us search
this hotel.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bay Mordaunt, bu oteli aramamiza izin
vermenizi rica ediyorum.

original:
<T>Of course. But I must first implore you to
solve this puzzle.
translation:
<T>Elbette. Ama once ben de sizden su bilmeceyi
cozmenizi rica edecegim.

original: ヌーデン
translation: ヌーデン

original:
<T>Simply splendid, Professor. You have fully
convinced me of your intentions to help
Mr Ledore. I shall assist you however I can.
translation:
<T>Harikulade, Profesor. Bay Ledore'a yardim etme
niyetiniz beni tamamen
ikna etti. Elimden gelen her sekilde yardimci olacagim.

original:
<T>As the largest hotel in Monte d'Or, we also
have the most rooms. If you need help
navigating the place, you need only ask.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'un en buyuk oteli oldugumuz icin,
en cok odaya da biz sahibiz. Otelde yon bulmakta
yardima ihtiyaciniz olursa sormaniz yeter.

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original: <T>It's reassuring to have you on our side.
translation: <T>Yanimizda olmaniz icimi rahatlatti.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I've prepared a room guide for you. You'll
find it on the Touch Screen whenever you
are in the hotel.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sizin icin bir oda rehberi hazirladim. Oteldeyken
Touch Screen'de
bulabilirsiniz.

original:
<T>Just indicate the room you wish to search
and I will guide you there.
translation:
<T>Aramak istediginiz odayi secin
yeter; sizi oraya gotururum.

original:
<T>When you wish to leave the Reunion Inn,
touch the door icon in the top-right corner
of the screen.
translation:
<T>Reunion Inn'den ayrilmak istediginizde,
ekranin sag ust kosesindeki kapi simgesine
dokunun.

original: <T><M5/1/1/45>I can't thank you enough.
translation: <T><M5/1/1/45>Ne kadar tesekkur etsem az.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>No trouble at all, Professor. Our motto here
is {''}Arrive a stranger, depart a friend{''}. Let me
know if you need anything else.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hic sorun degil, Profesor. Bizim sloganimiz
{''}Yabanci gel, dost git{''}. Baska bir seye ihtiyaciniz
olursa soyleyin.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I've memorised every inch of this hotel, so
please, don't hesitate to enquire about
anything.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu otelin her kosesini ezbere bilirim, bu yuzden
lutfen hicbir seyi
sormaktan cekinmeyin.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Are there any rooms here that are regularly
used by Mr or Mrs Ledore?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Bay ya da Bayan Ledore'un duzenli olarak
kullandigi odalar var mi?

original: <T><M1/1/1>Yes, I believe I can help you there.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Evet, sanirim bu konuda yardimci olabilirim.

original:
<T>As a matter of fact, I was specifically
intending to ask you to investigate such
a room.
translation:
<T>Aslina bakarsaniz, ozellikle de sizi boyle
bir odayi arastirmaya
rica edecektim.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Well then, I'd like to see it.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Oyleyse, gormek isterim.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Yes. Right this way!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Elbette. Bu taraftan!

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T>Er, Professor? The room I'd like you to
investigate, it's...<W30>not that way.
translation:
<T>Sey, Profesor? Incelemenizi istedigim oda...
<W30>bu tarafta degil.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Would you mind touching the icon on the
Touch Screen below labelled {''}Office{''}?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Alttaki Dokunmatik Ekran'da {''}Ofis{''} yazan
simgeye dokunur musunuz?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>And what is this room, exactly?
translation: <T>Peki bu oda tam olarak nedir?

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T>This is the private office where Mr Ledore
conducts his research.
translation:
<T>Bu, Bay Ledore'un
arastirmalarini yuruttugu ozel ofis.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M5/1/1>This isn't quite as tidy as his study.
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Burasi calisma odasi kadar duzenli degil.

original:
<T>Well, Mr Ledore is a very busy man, and the
cleaning staff are, under no circumstance,
to be allowed in here.
translation:
<T>Bay Ledore cok mesgul bir adam ve
temizlik personelinin hicbir sart altinda
buraya girmesine izin verilmez.

original:
<T>You'll find all the documents related to town
administration and planning archived here.
translation:
<T>Kasabanin yonetimi ve planlamasiyla ilgili
tum belgeleri burada arsivlenmis bulursunuz.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Why did you show us this room,
Mr Mordaunt?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Bize bu odayi neden gosterdiniz,
Bay Mordaunt?

original: <T>Because I want you to know the truth.
translation: <T>Cunku gercegi bilmenizi istiyorum.

original:
<T>This room is filled with the hopes and
dreams of Mr Ledore. Every thought he had
as he built Monte d'Or remains here.
translation:
<T>Bu oda Bay Ledore'un umutlari ve
hayalleriyle dolu. Monte d'Or'u insa ederken
aklindan gecen her dusunce burada duruyor.

original:
<T>I imagine any doubts you might still have
about him can be cleared up here.
translation:
<T>Sanirim onun hakkinda hala
kalan supheleriniz burada giderilebilir.

original:
<T>Please, feel free to investigate this room as
long as you like.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Lutfen, istediginiz kadar
bu odayi arastirmaktan cekinmeyin.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>This wall is the same as the one that was in
Randall's room. <W>And this toy...
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Bu duvar, Randall'in odasindaki
duvarin aynisi. <W>Ve su oyuncak...

original: <T>So after all that, Henry was still...
translation: <T>Demek bunca seye ragmen Henry hala...

original:
<T>Professor, at the back of this office is a
records room where Mr Ledore keeps
various important documents.
translation:
<T>Profesor, bu ofisin arka tarafinda
Bay Ledore'un cesitli onemli belgeleri
sakladigi bir arsiv odasi var.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Since you're already here, would you care
to see it as well? I hope to be thorough in
aiding your investigation.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Zaten buradayken onu da
gormek ister misiniz? Sorusturmaniza
yardim ederken titiz olmak isterim.

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>Yes, of course.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Evet, elbette.

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Emmy, Luke, I'll be away briefly to
investigate the records room.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Emmy, Luke, arsiv odasini
incelemek icin kisa sureligine ayrilacagim.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>Could you two continue investigating this
room while I'm gone?
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Ben yokken siz ikiniz
bu odayi arastirmaya devam eder misiniz?

original: <T><M7/2/1/45>Leave it to us, Professor!
translation: <T><M7/2/1/45>Bize birakin, Profesor!

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>Then, Mr Mordaunt, please lead the way.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>O halde Bay Mordaunt, lutfen onden buyurun.

original: <T><M1/1/1>As you wish.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Emredersiniz.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Come on, Luke. Let's see if we can search
the entire room before the professor gets
back!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Hadi Luke. Profesor geri donmeden once
tum odayi aramayi
basarabilecek miyiz bakalim!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/3>Yeah! But we should still be thorough and
inspect anything that looks suspicious!
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>Evet! Ama yine de titiz olmali ve
supheli gorunen her seyi incelemeliyiz!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T>We should stay and investigate this room
before the professor gets back.
translation:
<T>Profesor geri donmeden once burada kalip bu odayi
incelemeliyiz.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M7/1/3>All right. Let's show him how well we can
manage on our own!
translation:
<T><M7/1/3>Peki. Kendi basimiza ne kadar iyi idare
edebildigimizi ona gosterelim!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/1/1>This picture frame has a photo of some
children in it.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu cercevenin icinde bazi cocuklarin
fotografi var.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M4/2/1>It looks like Henry, but who is that next to
him? Is that the professor?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Henry'ye benziyor, ama yanindaki kim?
O profesor mu?

original: <T><M4/1/1>No, that must be Randall.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Hayir, o Randall olmali.

original: <T><M5/2/1>They look like siblings!
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Kardes gibiler!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>And look, isn't this robot the same one
Henry's holding in the picture?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ve bak, su robot Henry'nin fotografta
tuttuguyla ayni degil mi?

original:
<T>I think you're right. It's rather old, but
someone's been keeping it in really good
shape.
translation:
<T>Sanirim haklisin. Oldukca eski, ama
biri onu gercekten cok iyi
durumda tutmus.

original: <T><M3/1/1>But why would Henry keep it in his office?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Peki Henry onu neden ofisinde tutsun ki?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Maybe as a memento? I don't think it's
going to help us, so let's move on.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Belki bir hatira olarak? Bize yardim edecegini
sanmiyorum, o yuzden devam edelim.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M2/1/1>This wall is covered with writing.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Bu duvar yazilarla kapli.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T>The professor said it looked just like a wall
in Randall's room.
translation:
<T>Profesor, Randall'in odasindaki
duvarlardan birine tipatip benzedigini soyledi.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Wait...you don't think he took the wall from
Randall's house and brought it here, do
you?!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Dur... Randall'in evindeki duvari
sokup buraya getirdigini
dusunmuyorsun, degil mi?!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It's possible. This is the City of Miracles,
after all!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Mumkun. Sonucta burasi
Mucizeler Sehri!

original:
<T>Wow... It must contain some clue about the
ruins, but it's all in code...
translation:
<T>Vay be... Harabelerle ilgili bir ipucu
iceriyor olmali ama hepsi sifre...

original: <T><M1/2/5>Can you read what it says?
translation: <T><M1/2/5>Ne yazdigini okuyabiliyor musun?

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Maybe...<W>if I had a library on hand and a few
years to spare!
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Belki...<W>yanimda bir kutuphane ve
harcayacak birkac yilim olsaydi!

original:
<T><M6/1/1>He must have had some other reason for
bringing it here beyond just trying to
decipher the writing.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Sirf yaziyi cozmekten ote,
buraya getirmesinin
baska bir nedeni olmali.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Right. If that's all he cared about, he could
have just copied it or taken a picture...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Evet. Tek derdi bu olsaydi,
kopyalayabilir ya da fotografini cekebilirdi...

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmm, hotel registers. These list the names
of the guests and their rooms.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmm, otel kayitlari. Misafirlerin adlarini
ve odalarini listeliyorlar.

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
<T><M2/1/2>There probably won't be any clues about the
Masked Gentleman in there.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Orada Maskeli Beyefendi'yle ilgili
pek ipucu olmayabilir.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Mmm, that's true. Even if he is here, we
don't know what name he'd be under.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Mmm, dogru. Buradaysa bile,
hangi adla kayit yaptirdigini bilmiyoruz.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Hey! What about this binder, Emmy?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Hey! Su klasore ne diyorsun, Emmy?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Records of the Masked Gentleman's
appearances, including copies of the
warning letters and announcements.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin ortaya cikis kayitlari;
uyari mektuplarinin ve
duyurularin kopyalari da var.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Henry was trying pretty hard to catch the
Masked Gentleman too.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Henry de Maskeli Beyefendi'yi yakalamak icin
oldukca ugrasmis.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M3/2/1>It must be horrible to see someone trying to
destroy what you've built.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Insa ettigin seyi yok etmeye calisan birini gormek
korkunc olmali.

original: <T><M1/1/2>And to think we suspected him...
translation: <T><M1/1/2>Bir de biz ondan suphe ettik...

original:
<T><M3/1/2>If the professor and Henry had just
cooperated all along, they might have
caught the Masked Gentleman by now...
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Profesor ile Henry bastan beri is birligi yapsaydi,
simdiye coktan
Maskeli Beyefendi'yi yakalamis olabilirlerdi...

original:
<T><M5/1/1>I think Henry felt betrayed when the
professor didn't stay in Stansbury to help
him search for Randall.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Bence Profesor Stansbury'de kalip Randall'i
aramasina yardim etmeyince,
Henry kendini ihanete ugramis hissetti.

original: <T><M5/1/3>They weren't exactly on the best of terms.
translation: <T><M5/1/3>Aralari pek iyi degildi.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Why do adults make these kinds of things so
complicated?
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Yetiskinler neden boyle seyleri bu kadar
karmasik hale getiriyor?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T>This looks like some sort of old journal. The
cover is all faded.
translation:
<T>Bu eski bir gunluk gibi gorunuyor. Kapagi
iyice solmus.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M2/2/1>It says {''}Expedition Log{''}.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Uzerinde {''}Expedition Log{''} yaziyor.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Could this be the journal of one of the
search parties that went out looking for
Randall?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bu, Randall'i aramaya cikan
arama ekiplerinden birinin
gunlugu olabilir mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>There might be more information about the
Mask of Chaos in here!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Burada Kaos Maskesi hakkinda
daha fazla bilgi olabilir!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hm? There are some photos stuck on the
inside.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Himm? Icine yapistirilmis
bazi fotograflar var.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Do you think there's a clue in there?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Sence orada bir ipucu var mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I can't tell whether there's a clue in here or
not...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Burada bir ipucu
var mi yok mu anlayamiyorum...

original:
<T><M3/2/1>There's got to be something important
hidden in these photos!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bu fotograflarda
sakli onemli bir sey olmali!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>The fact that they're in this journal must
mean they were taken during the search.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bu gunlugun icinde olmalari,
arama sirasinda cekildikleri anlamina gelmeli.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>If it's really a record from the search for
Randall, maybe there's something about
the Mask of Chaos in here.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Eger bu gercekten Randall'i aramaya dair bir kayit ise,
belki burada Kaos Maskesiyle ilgili
bir sey vardir.

original: <T><M5/1/1>That could well be, Luke. Let's have a look.
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Olabilir, Luke. Bir bakalim.

original:
<T>Our search of the ruins for the lost boy
continues. We use the inn by the oasis
as our base of operations now.
translation:
<T>Kayip cocugu bulmak icin harabelerdeki arayisimiz
suruyor. Artik vahadaki hani
us olarak kullaniyoruz.

original:
<T>The ruins are a dark and ominous place,
and no one would even dream of going in
there without the enormous sum of money
being offered as a reward.

I've hardly been contributing out of the
kindness of my own heart, either.
translation:
<T>Harabeler karanlik ve ugursuz bir yer,
kimse de buyuk bir meblag
odul olarak teklif edilmeden
oraya girmeyi hayal bile etmez.

Ben de pek kendi iyiligimden
katkida bulunuyor sayilmam.

original:
<T>We were only a handful of men to
begin with, but now we've turned
into a full-blown expedition team.
translation:
<T>Basta sadece bir avuc adamdik
ama simdi
tam tesekkullu bir sefer ekibine donustuk.

original:
<T>Men descend into the narrow pit by the
oasis every day with the prospect of
finding the boy and striking it rich.
translation:
<T>Adamlar her gun vahadaki dar cukura iniyor,
cocugu bulup
zengin olma umuduyla.

original:
<T>We've had no luck so far, but that boy
Henry Ledore certainly has. The word is he
struck gold down here! A pile of treasure
big enough to make your eyes boggle.
translation:
<T>Simdiye kadar hic sansimiz olmadi ama o cocuk
Henry Ledore'un oldugu kesin. Soylentiye gore
burada altin bulmus! Gozleri faltasi gibi actiracak kadar
buyuk bir hazine yigini.

original:
<T>In fact, I've heard that's how he's
been able to offer such an enormous
reward for finding his friend.
translation:
<T>Hatta, duyduguma gore bu sayede
arkadasini bulana boyle
buyuk bir odul koyabilmis.

original:
<T>And so we press on, delving deeper
and deeper into the ruins.

Just recently, we found a strange room
with two mysterious pedestals.
translation:
<T>Ve boylece harabelere daha da
derinlere inerek devam ediyoruz.

Daha yeni, garip bir oda bulduk
icinde iki esrarengiz kaide vardi.

original:
<T>This chamber seems to be the final room
of this underground complex, and we have
created a scaffold to connect it to the
world above, but we can't go any further.
translation:
<T>Bu oda, yeralti kompleksinin son odasi gibi gorunuyor,
ve onu
yukaridaki dunyaya baglamak icin bir iskele kurduk,
ama daha ileri gidemiyoruz.

original:
<T>Unless we've all grossly overlooked
something, our search for Randall Ascot
is coming to an undeniable end.
translation:
<T>Hepimiz cok buyuk bir seyi gozden kacirmadiysak,
Randall Ascot'u arayisimiz
kacinilmaz bir sona yaklasiyor.

original:
<T>After all, it's been over a year now
since the boy went missing. Soon,
this will all be forgotten.
translation:
<T>Ne de olsa cocugun kaybolmasinin uzerinden
bir yildan fazla zaman gecti. Yakinda
butun bunlar unutulacak.

original:
<T>Monte d'Or was built upon forgotten ruins.
And perhaps one day Monte d'Or
will be forgotten too...
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or unutulmus harabelerin uzerine kuruldu.
Belki bir gun Monte d'Or da
unutulur...

original:
<T><M2/1/2>So they never found him... <W>He mentions
being based next to an oasis, so I suppose
Monte d'Or probably wasn't even a city yet.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Demek onu hic bulamamislar... <W>Bir vahanin yaninda
us kurduklarindan bahsediyor, o halde sanirim
Monte d'Or o zamanlar muhtemelen henuz bir sehir bile degildi.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Do you think that Henry ever stopped
looking for Randall?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Sence Henry Randall'i aramayi
hic birakti mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Considering the state of this room?<W> No,
I don't think he ever stopped.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu odanin haline bakilirsa?<W> Hayir,
hic biraktigini sanmiyorum.

original:
<T>Anyway, it looks as if we've just about
exhausted this journal.
translation:
<T>Neyse, gorunen o ki bu gunlugu
iyice incelemisiz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M2/1/1>So, have you two found anything?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Peki, siz ikiniz bir sey bulabildiniz mi?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M1/2/1>Yes, Professor! Look!
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Evet, Profesor! Bakin!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>It's a log from an expedition that was
searching for Randall! We also found
a journal that Henry has been keeping.
translation:
<T>Randall'i arayan bir sefer ekibinin kaydi!
Ayrica Henry'nin tuttugu
bir gunluk de bulduk.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Good work.<W> And I made a discovery of my
own.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Iyi is.<W> Ben de kendi
adima bir kesif yaptim.

original:
<T><M3/1/4>Is that...<W>the Mask of Chaos?! <W>But I thought
someone stole it from Henry's study!
translation:
<T><M3/1/4>Bu...<W>Kaos Maskesi mi?! <W>Ama ben
birinin onu Henry'nin calisma odasindan caldigini saniyordum!

original:
<T><M2/2/5>Does this mean Henry really was the Masked
Gentleman all along?!
translation:
<T><M2/2/5>Bu, Henry'nin basindan beri gercekten
Maskeli Bey oldugu anlamina mi geliyor?!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>So all that about the mask being stolen was
just a lie?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Yani maskenin calindigina dair
her sey yalandan mi ibaretti?

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>Well, not exactly.
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Sey, pek de degil.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>But then why would Henry hide the mask
here?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>O zaman Henry maskeyi
neden buraya saklasin ki?

original: <T><M2/1/1>It wasn't Henry who hid it.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Onu saklayan Henry degildi.

original: <T><M1/2/5>I'm...<W>confused.
translation: <T><M1/2/5>Ben...<W>kafam karisti.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hang on.<W> Is that actually the Mask of Order?
The one that the Masked Gentleman wants?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Dur bir dakika.<W> Bu gercekten Duzen Maskesi mi?
Maskeli Bey'in istedigi o maske?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Not quite.<W> You see, I expected to find
a replica of the Mask of Chaos here.
<W>A fake mask.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Tam olarak degil.<W> Cunku burada
Kaos Maskesi'nin bir kopyasini bulmayi bekliyordum.
<W>Sahte bir maske.

original:
<T>But to my surprise...this turned out to be
the genuine Mask of Chaos.
translation:
<T>Ama beni sasirtan... bunun
Kaos Maskesi'nin gercegi cikmasi oldu.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>It seems that someone placed it here. But
why?<W> And is the Masked Gentleman even
aware of this?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Gorunuse gore biri onu buraya koymus. Ama
neden?<W> Ve Maskeli Bey bundan
haberdar mi acaba?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>The answers are yet unclear, but I know
there is a deep connection between these
questions and the next miracle.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Cevaplar henuz net degil, ama biliyorum ki
bu sorularla
bir sonraki mucize arasinda derin bir bag var.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I also found something else rather
interesting.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ayrica oldukca
ilginc baska bir sey daha buldum.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Where's this supposed to be?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Burasi neresi olmali?

original:
<T><M6/1/1>What does it say in the corner there...<W> Is it
Monte d'Or?
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Su kosede ne yaziyor...<W> Bu
Monte d'Or mu?

original:
<T><M3/2/5>It doesn't look anything like what it does
now.
translation:
<T><M3/2/5>Simdiki haline
hic benzemiyor.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Indeed. This is an old prospective map of
how the town would look as development
progressed.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Evet. Bu, kasabanin gelisim
ilerledikce nasil gorunecegini
gosteren eski bir taslak harita.

original:
<T>It also reveals a rather fascinating secret
about Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T>Ayrica Monte d'Or hakkinda
oldukca ilginc bir sirri da aciga cikariyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Doesn't it seem as if these ruins are laid out
rather deliberately?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu harabeler sanki
bilerek planlanmis gibi gorunmuyor mu?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Now that you mention it, they do seem to
form a pattern.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Simdi soyleyince, gercekten de
bir desen olusturuyorlar gibi.

original:
<T><M5/1/1>I believe this explains why the Masked
Gentleman has been so intent on finding the
Mask of Order.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Bence bu, Maskeli Bey'in neden
Duzen Maskesi'ni bulmaya bu kadar
takintili oldugunu acikliyor.

original: <T><M1/2/5>Really? Why?!
translation: <T><M1/2/5>Gercekten mi? Neden?!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Before I share my thoughts with you, I'd like
to confirm my suspicions by finding some
more evidence.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Dusuncelerimi sizinle paylasmadan once,
suphelerimi dogrulamak icin
biraz daha kanit bulmak istiyorum.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>According to Bloom, the Masked Gentleman
is somewhere in this hotel.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Bloom'a gore Maskeli Bey
bu otelin bir yerinde.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Mr Mordaunt, are there any other rooms you
think may be of interest to us?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bay Mordaunt, bize ilginc gelebilecegini
dusundugunuz baska odalar var mi?

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Actually, Professor, I just remembered that
I have something I was asked to hold on to
for you.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Aslinda, Profesor, az once hatirladim;
sizin icin saklamam istenen
bir sey bende.

original:
<T>Terribly sorry for the trouble, but would you
mind returning to the lobby with me?
translation:
<T>Rahatsizlik icin cok ozur dilerim, ama
benimle lobiye geri doner misiniz?

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>Very well.
ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T>I just remembered that we're holding on to
something for you. Please come back to the
lobby with me.
translation:
<T>Senin icin bir sey sakladigimizi yeni hatirladim.
Lutfen benimle birlikte
lobiye geri gel.

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T>Here we are, Professor. This is the item
we've been keeping for you.
translation:
<T>Iste buradayiz, Profesor. Bu,
sizin icin sakladigimiz esya.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>So someone knew I'd be coming here?
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Demek birileri buraya gelecegimi biliyordu?

original:
<T>I...suppose so, yes. It was found on the
reception desk, addressed to you.
translation:
<T>I...sanirim oyle, evet. Resepsiyon
masasinda, size hitaben bulunmus.
<T><M5/2/1>Anliyorum...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T>Is that a book?
translation: <T>Bu bir kitap mi?
<T><K>Himm...</K>

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I believe the Masked Gentleman has left us
a message. Let's see what he has to say.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sanirim Maskeli Bey bize
bir mesaj birakmis. Bakalim ne diyecek.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>This book...
<T><M2/1/1>He's given us a children's story?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Bize bir cocuk masali mi vermis?

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>A kingdom surrounded by woods...five close
friends, treasure. <W>Luke, do you know this
story?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Ormanlarla cevrili bir krallik...bes yakin
arkadas, hazine. <W>Luke, bu
hikayeyi biliyor musun?

original:
<T><M2/2/2>No... <W>I have a big book of fairy tales at
home, but I don't remember this one.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Hayir... <W>Evde buyuk bir masal kitabim var
ama bunu hatirlamiyorum.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>This story feels unfinished, though. It
doesn't have a proper ending.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Ama bu hikaye yarim kalmis gibi.
Duzgun bir sonu yok.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>It may be an allegory of sorts, perhaps
about the Masked Gentleman himself.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Belki bir tur alegoridir;
muhtemelen Maskeli Bey'in kendisiyle ilgili.

original: <T><M3/2/1>So what's he trying to tell us?
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Peki bize ne anlatmaya calisiyor?

original: <T><M1/1/4>Who turned off the lights?!
translation: <T><M1/1/4>Isiklari kim kapatti?!

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>No doubt this was the Masked Gentleman's
handiwork. He has been waiting for us.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Suphesiz bu Maskeli Bey'in
isi. Bizi bekliyormus.

original:
<T>And this book is an invitation. He wishes us
to go and find him.
translation:
<T>Ve bu kitap bir davet. Onu bulmamizi
istiyor.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Is this all just a game to him?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Bu onun icin sadece bir oyun mu?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Come now, we might still be able to stop
his next miracle if we move quickly.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Hadi, hizli davranirsak
bir sonraki mucizesini hala durdurabiliriz.

original: <T><M1/2/3>Ready when you are, Professor!
translation: <T><M1/2/3>Siz ne zaman hazirsaniz, Profesor!

original:
<T>Hmm, I'm certain that he's in this hotel
somewhere. Perhaps the story contains a
clue as to his whereabouts.
translation:
<T>Hmm, onun bu otelde bir
yerlerde oldugundan eminim. Belki hikayede
nerede olduguna dair bir ipucu vardir.

original:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Let's see...<W> The story ended as the boy
{''}fell asleep in a sunny spot by the window{''}.
translation:
<T><M6/2/1/45>Bir bakalim...<W> Hikaye, cocugun
{''}fell asleep in a sunny spot by the window{''}.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Well, if he fell asleep, there must have been
a place for him to lie down.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Madem uyuyakalmis, uzanabilecegi
bir yer olmali.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Oh! Somewhere with a bed!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Ah! Yatagin oldugu bir yer!

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Yes, we should try searching in the guest
rooms.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Evet, misafir
odalarinda aramayi denemeliyiz.

original:
<T>The one we're looking for should receive
a lot of sun. A room with a large, south-
facing window, perhaps.
translation:
<T>Aradigimiz yer bol gunes almali.
Buyuk, guneye
bakan bir penceresi olan bir oda, belki.

original:
<T>I believe we have some rooms matching that
description on the third floor. Would you
care to see them?
translation:
<T>Sanirim ucuncu katta bu
tarife uyan bazi odalarimiz var. Gormek
ister misiniz?

original:
<T>Once upon a time, in a small kingdom
surrounded by woods, there were five
children who were the best of friends.
translation:
<T>Bir zamanlar, ormanlarla cevrili kucuk bir
krallikta, can ciger
bes cocuk vardi.

original:
<T>They spent their days enjoying their
beautiful land, fishing in streams
and running over the grassy fields.
translation:
<T>Gunlerini guzel
topraklarinin tadini cikararak, derelerde balik
tutarak ve cimenli tarlalarda kosarak gecirirlerdi.

original:
<T>One day, they climbed the tallest hill in
the kingdom. And at the very top of the
hill they found a mound of treasure!
translation:
<T>Bir gun, kralliktaki en yuksek tepeye
tirmandilar. Ve tepenin
tam zirvesinde bir hazine yigini buldular!

original:
<T>Reading the words {''}Brave adventurer, you
may claim me!{''} on a sign nearby, the friends
took the treasure and divided it equally.
translation:
<T>Yakindaki bir tabelada {''}Brave adventurer, you
may claim me!{''} yazdigini okuyunca, arkadaslar
hazineyi aldilar ve esitce paylastilar.

original:
<T>Four of them spent their share on items
they wanted, but the fifth buried his in
a beautiful place surrounded by green.
translation:
<T>Dordu payini istedigi seylere harcadi,
ama besincisi kendi payini
yesilliklerle cevrili guzel bir yere gomdu.

original:
<T>He wanted to be able to relive his
adventure and hunt for treasure with
his friends any time he wanted.

He hoped it would always give the five
friends a reason to be together.
translation:
<T>Macerasini yeniden yasayabilmek icin
istedigi zaman arkadaslariyla
hazine avina cikmak istiyordu.

Bu hazinenin, bes arkadasa
her zaman bir arada olmak icin bir sebep vermesini umuyordu.

original:
<T>This boy knew that people change when
they grow up, but the buried treasure
would always be his link to the past.
translation:
<T>Bu cocuk, insanlar buyudukce degisir diye
biliyordu, ama gomulu hazine
gecmise olan bagini hep koruyacakti.

original:
<T>He returned from burying his treasure
and fell asleep in a sunny spot by
the window, completely content.
translation:
<T>Hazinesini gomdukten sonra geri dondu
ve pencere kenarinda
gunesli bir yerde, tam bir huzurla uykuya daldi.

original: <T>THE END
translation: <T>SON

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Forgive me, but I was under the impression
that you wanted to search the hotel. There
should be no need to take the tram.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Affedersiniz ama oteli aramak istediginizi
saniyordum. Tramvaya binmeye
gerek olmamali.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>The boy in the Masked Gentleman's story
{''}fell asleep in a sunny spot by the window{''}.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Bey'in hikayesindeki cocuk
{''}pencerenin yanindaki gunesli bir yerde uyuyakaldi{''}.

original: <T>Is this the room we're looking for?
translation: <T>Aradigimiz oda bu mu?

original: フランキ
translation: フランキ

original:
<T>So, what's the next scam? Who should we
fleece next?
translation:
<T>Peki, siradaki numara ne? Sonra kimi
yolacagiz?

original: ナルキス
translation: ナルキス

original:
<T>Frankie, my dear, you're almost as brainless
as you are ugly. I'm having doubts about
our partnership.
translation:
<T>Frankie, canim, hem cirkinligin kadar
beyinsizsin neredeyse. Ortakligimizdan
suphe duymaya basladim.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Wh-what? Come on, Narc, don't say that.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>N-ne? Hadi ama, Narc, oyle deme.

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>I set everything up perfectly, but you always
find a way to mess things up. You're about
as much use as a tennis ball made of jelly.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Her seyi kusursuz ayarliyorum ama sen
hep bir sekilde berbat ediyorsun. Joleden bir
tenis topu kadar ise yararsin.

original:
<T>Oi, enough of that. Or were you looking for
a good slap across the rashers?
translation:
<T>Hey, yeter. Yoksa suratina guzel bir
saplak mi istiyorsun?

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T><M9/2/1>Here now, both of you, I doubt that fighting
will help the situation.
translation:
<T><M9/2/1>Hadi ama ikiniz de; kavga etmenin
bir faydasi olacagini sanmiyorum.

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Layton! What a pleasant...aha, intrusion.
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Layton! Ne hos bir... aha, baskin.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Might I ask what you're doing here in my
hotel room? <W><M1/1/1/45>Well?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Benim otel odamda ne yaptiginizi sorabilir miyim?
<W><M1/1/1/45>Ee?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Yeah! Who do you think you are, barging in
on us like this?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Evet! Sen kim oluyorsun da boyle dalip
cikiyorsun?

original:
<T>You're disrupting our business strategy
session. How are we to afford to stay here
with insufficient ill-gotten gains?
translation:
<T>Is stratejisi toplantimizi boluyorsun. Yeterince
haksiz kazancimiz yokken burada kalmayi
nasil karsilayacagiz?

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Er, in that case, my apologies, gentlemen.
By all means, continue.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Ee, o halde kusura bakmayin, beyefendiler.
Buyurun, devam edin.

original:
<T>Hmph. We paid perfectly good dirty money
for this room. You can't just poke around in
here. That's rude!
translation:
<T>Hih. Bu oda icin gayet guzel pis para odedik.
Burada oylece dolanip kurcalayamazsin.
Bu kabalik!

original:
<T>Yeah! You think you can just search where
you like without asking us first? Not likely,
mate.
translation:
<T>Evet! Once bize sormadan istedigin yeri
aralayabilecegini mi saniyorsun? Hadi oradan,
dostum.

original: フランキ
translation: Franky

original:
<T>You're going to keep bothering me then?
What d'you want? Another battle of wits?
translation:
<T>Yani beni rahatsiz etmeye devam mi edeceksin?
Ne istiyorsun? Yine bir zeka duellosu mu?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Perhaps some other time. I simply wish to
search the room. We're investigating the
Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Belki baska zaman. Ben sadece
odayi aramak istiyorum. Maskeli Bey'i
arastiriyoruz.

original: ナルキス
translation: Narcisse

original:
<T>Oh, of course, Layton! I should be delighted
if you would rifle through my possessions.
translation:
<T>Ah, elbette, Layton! Esyalarimi
didik didik etmeniz beni memnun eder.

original:
<T>Hmph...<W> Well, I suppose I could allow it...
but only if you solve this puzzle!
translation:
<T>Hih...<W> Peki, sanirim izin verebilirim...
ama ancak bu bulmacayi cozersen!

original:
<T>I won't budge. You can't search the room
unless you solve our puzzle.
translation:
<T>Kimildamam. Bulmacamizi
cozmeden odayi arayamazsin.

original:
<T>Solve this puzzle and you may search our
room as much as your heart desires.
translation:
<T>Bu bulmacayi coz, sonra istersen
odamizi gonlunce ararsin.

original:
<T>Well, I...<W>I'm impressed! You actually solved
it!
translation:
<T>Sey, ben...<W>Etkilendim! Gercekten
cozdun!

original:
<T>Then I take it you'll have no objection to
our searching this room?
translation:
<T>O zaman bu odayi
aramamiza itiraziniz yok, oyle mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hah! Nice one, Narc. That was one of your
{''}perfect{''} plans, was it?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hah! Guzelmis, Narc. Bu da senin
{''}perfect{''} planlarindan biri miydi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Stick a sock in it, Frankie!<W> Of course you
may search the room, Layton.<W> There's
nothing left in here anyway.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Ceneni kapat, Frankie!<W> Elbette
odayi arayabilirsiniz, Layton.<W> Zaten
burada bir sey kalmadi.

original: <T><M4/2/1/45>Thank you. We won't be long.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Tesekkurler. Uzun surmez.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>Couldn't this room be the {''}beautiful place
surrounded by green{''} from the story?
translation:
<T>Bu oda, hikayedeki {''}beautiful place
surrounded by green{''} olmasin?

original:
<T>You're such a pork chop, Narcisse! You
think you're so smart, but your puzzles are
proper mince.
translation:
<T>Ne aptalsin Narcisse! Sen
kendini cok zeki saniyorsun ama bulmacalarin
tam bir sacmalik.

original:
<T>I don't need this, Frankie! Not today!<W>
Ahem...<W> You may search our room now. You
won't find much, though.
translation:
<T>Buna ihtiyacim yok, Frankie! Bugun degil!<W>
Ohom...<W> Simdi odamizi arayabilirsiniz. Ama
pek bir sey bulamazsiniz.

original:
<T>You know, entering other people's rooms
and poking around is rather unrefined.
translation:
<T>Biliyor musunuz, baskalarinin odasina
girip karistirmak pek de nezih sayilmaz.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But thankfully, I'm refined enough for both
of us. I'm completely at ease with you
poking around in here.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama neyse ki ikimiz adina da
yeterince nezihim. Burayi karistirmaniz beni
hic rahatsiz etmiyor.

original:
<T>Oi, watch where you put them fingers! 'Less
you want me to break 'em.
translation:
<T>Hey, o parmaklarini nereye soktuguna bak! Yoksa
kirarim.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>What kind of yob thinks it's okay to poke
around in people's rooms, anyway?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Insanlarin odalarini karistirmanin
normal oldugunu dusunen ne bicim serseri bu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>What was that?! It was like the earth
just moved.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>O da neydi?! Sanki yer
kipirdadi.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>My, that was one of the finest charlatan
shows I've ever seen. This hotel really does
have five-star service!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Aman, gordugum en iyi
sahtekarlik gosterilerinden biriydi. Bu otel gercekten
bes yildizli hizmet veriyor!

original: ユーミン
translation: ユーミン

original:
<T>Ah, the gentleman and his friends. Nice to
see you all again.
translation:
<T>Ah, beyefendi ve arkadaslari. Hepinizi
yeniden gormek guzel.

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original: <T>Hi, Yuming! What are you doing here?
translation: <T>Merhaba, Yuming! Burada ne yapiyorsun?

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T>Yes, aren't you staying at the Camel's
Hump?
translation:
<T>Evet, sen Camel's
Hump'ta kalmiyor muydun?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yes, I was, but they mixed up a couple of
my dates, so they've had to put me here for
a few days.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet, kaliyordum ama tarihlerimi biraz
karistirmislar. O yuzden beni birkac gunlugune
buraya aldilar.

original:
<T>Oh, I'm sorry. I hope it hasn't ruined your
holiday.
translation:
<T>Uzuldum. Umarim tatilini
mahvetmemistir.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh, no! Not at all! This hotel is far fancier,
and the service is first-rate.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ah, hayir! Hic de degil! Bu otel cok daha sik,
hizmet de birinci sinif.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>So...you're just waltzing into people's
rooms unannounced, then?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Yani... insanlarin odalarina
habersizce pat diye giriyorsun, oyle mi?

original: <T><M3/2/1>Ah... Well, you see-
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Ah... Sey, soyle ki-

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh, don't worry about it. I don't mind!
Please, make yourselves at home. How
about a puzzle?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah, dert etmeyin. Benim icin sorun degil!
Lutfen, rahatiniza bakin. Bir bilmece
ister misiniz?

original:
<T>You're just going to leave this puzzle
unfinished?
translation:
<T>Bu bilmeceyi boyle
yarim mi birakacaksin?

original:
<T>While you're in my room, you're my guest.
It's only fair I offer you a puzzle!
translation:
<T>Odamdayken misafirimsiniz.
Size bir bilmece sunmam cok dogal!

original: <T>Hey, not bad!
translation: <T>Hey, fena degil!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>You know, I like the hotels in this city, but
who comes up with these names?!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Biliyor musunuz, bu sehrin otellerini seviyorum ama
bu isimleri kim buluyor?!

original: <T><M1/1/1>I should ask the owner.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Sahibine sormaliyim.

original:
<T>You can see the entire city from the roof.
It's a spectacular view, to say the least!
translation:
<T>Catidan butun sehri gorebilirsiniz.
En azindan soylemek gerekirse, manzara muhtesem!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M21/1/1>Professor, there was a book hidden behind
the frame!
translation:
<T><M21/1/1>Profesor, cercevenin arkasinda
sakli bir kitap vardi!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Ah, so the {''}beautiful place surrounded by
green{''} was the picture frame in this room.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Ah, demek ki {''}beautiful place surrounded by
green{''} bu odadaki resim cercevesiymis.

original: <T>What a complicated way to give directions!
translation: <T>Yon tarif etmek icin ne kadar karmasik bir yol!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M3/1/1>I want to know what the book says!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Kitapta ne yazdigini ogrenmek istiyorum!

original: <T><M4/1/3>Well, that was a sad story...
translation: <T><M4/1/3>Bu huzunlu bir hikayeydi...

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Yes...<W>clearly another allegory, but I'm not
sure what it means.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Evet...<W>acikca bir baska alegori, ama
ne anlama geldiginden emin degilim.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>So that last part must be designed to lead
us to another room, right?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>O halde son kisim bizi baska bir odaya
yonlendirmek icin tasarlanmis olmali, degil mi?

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Yes, the young man disappears into the
woods at the end.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Evet, genc adam sonunda
ormana dogru kayboluyor.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Mr Mordaunt, are there any rooms here with
a lot of plants or foliage in them?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Bay Mordaunt, burada icinde
cok sayida bitki ya da yaprakli suslemeler olan bir oda var mi?

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Indeed, sir. We have one room that is
absolutely full of plants.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Elbette efendim. Bitkilerle
tamamen dolu bir odamiz var.

original: <T><M3/1/1>That must be it! Let's go!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Iste o olmali! Hadi gidelim!

original:
<T>Once upon a time, there was a
young boy who came across an
injured wild dog and took him in.
translation:
<T>Bir zamanlar,
yarali bir vahsi kopekle karsilasan
genc bir cocuk onu yanina aldi.

original:
<T>As the dog healed, he learnt to trust the
boy and slowly forgot his wild ways.

In the following years, the two grew up
together and never spent a day apart.
translation:
<T>Kopek iyilestikce, cocuga guvenmeyi ogrendi
ve yavas yavas vahsi aliskanliklarini unuttu.

Sonraki yillarda ikisi birlikte buyudu
ve bir gun bile ayri kalmadilar.

original:
<T>But the day came when the boy had to
leave the village to pursue his dream
of becoming a scholar.

The boy entrusted the dog to his family,
knowing he would protect them.
translation:
<T>Ama gun geldi, cocuk
bilgin olma hayalinin pesinden gitmek icin
koyden ayrilmak zorunda kaldi.

Cocuk, onlari koruyacagini bilerek
kopegi ailesine emanet etti.

original:
<T>As the boy departed in his cart, the dog
howled. He was sad to see the boy go.
translation:
<T>Cocuk arabasiyla ayrilirken kopek
uludu. Cocugun gidisine uzulmustu.

original:
<T>The boy grew into a fine young man
and became a famous scholar.
translation:
<T>Cocuk iyi bir delikanliya donustu
ve unlu bir bilgin oldu.

original:
<T>When he finally returned home,
he was eager to show his family
and his dog what he had made
of himself.

But when he arrived, he found
his house empty.
translation:
<T>Nihayet eve dondugunde,
ailesine ve kopegine
kendini ne hale getirdigini,
neler basardigini gostermek icin sabirsizdi.

Ama vardiginda
evini bombos buldu.

original:
<T>The young man, now fully grown, asked
a passer-by what had happened.
translation:
<T>Artik tamamen buyumus olan genc adam,
yoldan gecen birine ne oldugunu sordu.

original:
<T>The helpful stranger told him that the
family who lived in the house had been
chased out years ago by a wild dog.

And that's when the young man realised...
translation:
<T>Yardimsever yabanci ona,
evde yasayan ailenin
yillar once vahsi bir kopek tarafindan kovuldugunu soyledi.

Iste o an genc adam anladi...

original:
<T>He had been betrayed by
the one he trusted most.

He had no home to return to
and his family were gone.
translation:
<T>En cok guvendigi kisi tarafindan
ihanete ugramisti.

Donecek bir evi yoktu
ve ailesi ortadan kaybolmustu.

original:
<T>With grief weighing heavy upon his
heart, the young man disappeared into
the woods, never to be seen again.
translation:
<T>Kederin agirligi
kalbine cokmusken, genc adam
ormana karisti ve bir daha asla gorulmedi.

original: <T>THE END
translation: <T>SON

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>I believe the key word in the Masked
Gentleman's directions was {''}woods{''}.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Bey'in tarifinde anahtar kelimenin
{''}orman{''} oldugunu dusunuyorum.

original: <T>Does this room match that description?
translation: <T>Bu oda o tarife uyuyor mu?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Wow! There certainly are a lot of plants in
here. Some with flowers, some with fruit...
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Vay! Burada gercekten cok
bitki var. Bazilarinda cicek, bazilarinda meyve...

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Indeed, madam. The conservatory is the
pride of the hotel!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Elbette hanimefendi. Seramiz otelin
gurur kaynagidir!

original:
