<T>Careful monitoring and adjustment of the
soil richness and air humidity allows us to
grow plants from any climate in this room.
translation:
<T>Topragin zenginligini ve havanin nemini
dikkatle izleyip ayarlayarak
bu odada her iklimden bitki yetistirebiliyoruz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>That's very impressive.
translation: <T>Bu gercekten etkileyici.

original: <T><M5/1/1/45>Ah, and you keep birds here too?
translation: <T><M5/1/1/45>Ah, burada kus da besliyorsunuz, oyle mi?

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Absolutely not! They might scatter arid
seeds in the temperate region or- <W30>Urk!
<W30>A bird!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Kesinlikle hayir! Kurak bolge tohumlarini
iliman bolgeye sacabilirler ya da- <W30>Aa!
<W30>Bir kus!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Professor, it's holding something in its
claws.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Profesor, pencelerinde
bir sey tutuyor.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>So it is! That must be the book we're
looking for. We might have a hard time
catching the bird, though.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Oyleymis! Bu, aradigimiz
kitap olmali. Ama
kusu yakalamakta zorlanabiliriz.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Leave it to me, Professor! I'll just speak to
the bird and ask her to give it to us!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bana birakin, Profesor! Kusla konusup
onu bize vermesini isteyecegim!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>I've never tried speaking to a bird before!
Here goes!
translation:
<T>Daha once hic bir kusla konusmayi denemedim!
Haydi bakalim!

original:
<T><M3/3/1>Hello? My name's Luke. Is there any
chance we can borrow that book you're
holding?
translation:
<T><M3/3/1>Merhaba? Ben Luke. Elindeki
kitabi bize odunc
verme sansin var mi?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T>Any luck, Luke?
translation: <T>Sansin yaver gitti mi, Luke?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Erm, she understood me, but she's not
giving us anything until she gets her
favourite fruit. <W><M1/1/2>She's not very nice.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Ee, beni anladi ama
en sevdigi meyveyi almadan
bize hicbir sey vermiyor. <W><M1/1/2>Pek de hos biri degil.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>There are many different kinds of fruit in
here. Is it something other than what's
already here?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Burada pek cok cesit meyve var.
Burada olanlardan
farkli bir sey mi istiyor?

original: <T><M2/2/2>I don't know. She wasn't very specific.
translation: <T><M2/2/2>Bilmiyorum. Pek acik soylemedi.

original: <T><M5/1/1>Can you think of anything, Mr Mordaunt?
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Akliniza bir sey geliyor mu, Bay Mordaunt?

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T>Yes, madam, I believe I can. One particular
tree here bears a very special fruit, but only
under certain conditions.
translation:
<T>Evet hanimefendi, sanirim var. Buradaki
agaclardan biri cok ozel bir meyve verir, ama
yalnizca belirli kosullarda.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>If I were a fussy fowl, that's certainly the
fruit I would choose.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ben secici bir kus olsaydim, kesinlikle o
meyveyi secerdim.

original:
<T><M4/1/3>Great. So we have to wait around here until
the conditions are just right for this tree to
bear fruit?!
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Harika. Demek bu agacin
meyve vermesi icin kosullar
tam uygun olana kadar burada bekleyecegiz?!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Actually, though the tree withers easily in
the wrong environment, it will produce fruit
instantly in perfect conditions.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Aslinda agac yanlis ortamda
kolayca solar ama kusursuz kosullarda
aninda meyve verir.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>The environmental controls must be offline
because of the power outage. We'll need to
restore power to the room.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Elektrik kesintisi yuzunden cevre kontrolu
devre disi kalmis olmali. Odaya
elektrigi geri getirmemiz gerek.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh! Of course! I completely forgot, the
conservatory has a backup generator.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ah! Tabii ya! Unuttum, seranin
yedek bir jeneratoru var.

original:
<T><M1/1/4>How could you forget something like that?!
<W>So...where is the switch?
translation:
<T><M1/1/4>Oyle bir seyi nasil unutursun?!
<W>Peki... anahtar nerede?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It's, uh...<W> That is to say... <W><M2/1/1>Hidden
somewhere in this room!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sey...<W> Yani demek istedigim... <W><M2/1/1>Gizli
bu odanin bir yerinde!

original:
<T><M1/1/6/45>You've forgotten where the switch is,
haven't you?
translation:
<T><M1/1/6/45>Anahtarin nerede oldugunu
unuttunuz, degil mi?

original: <T>I'm afraid so.
translation: <T>Korkarim oyle.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>It's quite all right. We don't need any more
information. <W>Emmy, all we have to do is
search the room.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Hic sorun degil. Daha fazla
bilgiye ihtiyacimiz yok. <W>Emmy, yapmamiz
gereken tek sey odayi aramak.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Aha! Nothing can hide from me! The switch
is here, in this strange flower.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Aha! Hicbir sey benden saklanamaz! Anahtar
surada, su tuhaf cicegin icinde.

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original: <T><M3/1/1>Oh, so it is! How silly of me!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Aa, oyleymis! Ne kadar da sakarim!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Um... The petals look like they're covered
in slime, and it really smells! I don't really
want to get that stuff on my clothes.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Sey... Yapraklar sanki sumuksu bir seyle
kapli ve cok kotu kokuyor! Onu
uzerime bulastirmak hic istemem.

original:
<T><M5/2/2>Psh. What are we waiting for? Let's flip the
switch already!
translation:
<T><M5/2/2>Peh. Neyi bekliyoruz? Hadi su anahtari
ceviriverelim!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Look, that empty canal just filled up with
water!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bak, o bos kanal az once suyla
doldu!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M4/2/1>There's a new piece of fruit up there!
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Orada yeni bir meyve var!

original: <T><M3/1/2>Hmm, the bird doesn't seem to be moving.
translation: <T><M3/1/2>Hmm, kus pek hareket ediyor gibi gorunmuyor.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M4/1/1/45>You know, the peel looks rather tough.
Maybe the bird is waiting for the fruit to fall
and break apart.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1/45>Biliyor musun, kabugu oldukca sert gorunuyor.
Belki kus, meyvenin dusup
parcalanmasini bekliyordur.

original: <T><M5/1/3>Mmm, let's knock the fruit down!
translation: <T><M5/1/3>Himm, hadi meyveyi asagi dusurelim!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M7/1/1>We did it, Professor! Now we can get the
book!
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Basardik, Profesor! Simdi kitabi
alabiliriz!

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
<T>Another book left for us by the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin bize biraktigi
bir kitap daha.

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original: <T>I wonder if it's another story.
translation: <T>Acaba yine bir hikaye mi?

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>Let's find out.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Hadi bakalim, gorelim.

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>Well, that story was...
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Eee, o hikaye...

original:
<T><M3/2/3>Horrible! Who would read such a story to
a child?!
translation:
<T><M3/2/3>Korkunctu! Boyle bir hikayeyi
bir cocuga kim okur?!

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
<T>I'm fairly sure the story is only meant for us.
<M3/1/1>What do you suppose the Masked
Gentleman is trying to tell us?
translation:
<T>Hikayenin asil bizim icin yazildigina oldukca eminim.
<M3/1/1>Sence Maskeli Beyefendi bize ne
anlatmaya calisiyor?

original:
<T>A town decaying in the midst of great
prosperity...<W> A man growing ever richer and
forgetting the great debt he owes...
translation:
<T>Buyuk bir refahin ortasinda curuyen bir kasaba...<W> Gittikce zenginlesen ve
borclu oldugu buyuk iyiligi unutan bir adam...

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>What do you think, Professor?
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Ne dusunuyorsunuz, Profesor?

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>A {''}vast and empty chasm{''}...
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Bir {''}ucsuz bucaksiz ve bombos ucurum{''}...

original: <T><M6/1/1/45>Ah, of course.
translation: <T><M6/1/1/45>Ah, elbette.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Mr Mordaunt, does this hotel have
a spacious hall for special occasions?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bay Mordaunt, bu otelde ozel etkinlikler icin
genis bir salon var mi?

original: ヌーデン
translation: ヌーデン

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Indeed it does, sir. We use the Grand Hall
for such events. It's a world-class venue.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Elbette var efendim. Boyle etkinliklerde Grand Hall'u
kullaniriz. Dunya standartlarinda bir mekandir.

original: <T><M3/1/1>We need to go there. Quickly!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Oraya gitmemiz gerek. Cabuk!

original:
<T>Once upon a time, there was a very poor
man who lived in a vibrant, bustling town.

The townspeople were very kind and made
sure that, though the man had nothing to
his name, he never lacked for anything.
translation:
<T>Bir varmis bir yokmus, cok fakir bir
adam, canli ve hareketli bir kasabada yasarmis.

Kasabalilar cok iyi kalpliymis ve
adamin uzerinde adi sani olmasa da
hicbir zaman hicbir seyden mahrum kalmamasini saglarlarmis.

original:
<T>One day, the richest man in town took
pity on him and bought the poor man
a shop so that he could earn a living.
translation:
<T>Bir gun, kasabanin en zengin adami
ona acimis ve zavalli adama
gecimini saglayabilsin diye bir dukkan almis.

original:
<T>The poor man ran a good business,
and his shop quickly flourished.
translation:
<T>Fakir adam isi iyi yurutmus,
dukkani da kisa surede buyuyup gelismis.

original:
<T>Soon it became the most successful
shop in town and attracted customers
from far and wide. Not even the rich
man's shop could compare.

No longer poor, the man bought up all
the food in town, intending to dominate
the market and make a huge profit.
translation:
<T>Cok gecmeden kasabanin en basarili
dukkani olmus ve dort bir yandan
musteri cekmeye baslamis. Zengin
adamin dukkani bile onunla yarisamazmis.

Artik fakir olmayan adam, pazari
ele gecirip buyuk kar etmek icin
kasabadaki tum yiyecekleri toplamis.

original:
<T>He raised the price of food so high
that no one in town could afford it,
but merchants from richer towns were
eager to buy all they could get.

The man had become so blinded by
money that he forgot the debt he
owed to those in his home town.
translation:
<T>Yiyecek fiyatlarini oyle yukseltmis ki
kasabada kimse alamaz olmus,
ama daha zengin kasabalardan gelen tuccarlar
bulabildikleri her seyi almaya hevesliymis.

Adam paranin gozunu oyle kor ettigi
bir hale gelmis ki, memleketindeki
insanlara olan borcunu unutmus.

original:
<T>His neighbours starved, but the
man was only concerned with
watching his fortune grow.
translation:
<T>Komsulari acliktan kirilirken,
adamin tek derdi
servetinin buyumesini izlemekmis.

original:
<T>The greedy man became so rich that
rumours of his wealth spread to even
the most remote corners of the land.

He built himself an opulent palace,
exulting in his fame while the
town decayed around him.
translation:
<T>Acgozlu adam oyle zengin olmus ki,
servetinin dedikodusu en
uzak diyarlara bile yayilmis.

Kendine gorkemli bir saray yaptirmis,
sohretinin keyfini cikarirken
kasaba da etrafinda curuyup gitmis.

original:
<T>The townspeople had no choice but to
leave. In time the man was the only
person left, lord of an empty kingdom.
translation:
<T>Kasabalilarin gitmekten baska caresi kalmamis.
Zamanla adam, bombos bir kralligin
tek efendisi olarak yapayalniz kalmis.

original:
<T>There, his loneliness, a vast and empty
chasm, swallowed him whole.
translation:
<T>Orada, yalnizligi, ucsuz bucaksiz ve bombos bir
ucurum gibi, onu butunuyle yutmus.

original: <T>ALL'S WELL THAT ENDS WELL
translation: <T>SONU IYI BITENIN HER SEYI IYIDIR

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>This doesn't look like the Grand Hall.
translation: <T>Burasi Buyuk Salon'a benzemiyor.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>We're looking for somewhere {''}vast and
empty{''}.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Soyle bir yer ariyoruz: {''}ucsuz bucaksiz ve
bos{''}.

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T>The Grand Hall is as tall as the Reunion Inn
itself.
translation:
<T>Buyuk Salon, Bulusma Hani'nin
kendisi kadar yuksek.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M6/1/5>Gosh! Look how far away the ceiling is.
Imagine if you were up there looking down.
It really would be like a chasm.
translation:
<T><M6/1/5>Vay canina! Tavana bak, ne kadar uzakta.
Dusunsene, yukarida olup asagi baksaydin.
Gercekten de bir ucurum gibi olurdu.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>What's this? The room is immaculate, but
there's something off about that cushion.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Bu da ne? Oda kusursuz, ama
su minderle ilgili tuhaf bir sey var.

original:
<T><M2/1/3>It does look a bit bumpy, doesn't it? Maybe
there's something stuffed inside.
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Biraz kabarik duruyor, degil mi? Belki de
icine bir sey saklamislardir.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Professor, I found another book inside the
cushion. <W>It seems to have a fancier cover
than the others.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Profesor, minderin icinde baska bir kitap buldum.
<W>Digerlerinden daha suslu bir kapagi var
gibi.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M5/2/1/45>I wonder what story this one will hold...
translation: <T><M5/2/1/45>Acaba bunun icinde nasil bir hikaye var...

original:
<T><M1/2/1>There's only one way to find out- <W20><M1/1/4>Huh? <W>It
won't open!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ogrenmenin tek bir yolu var- <W20><M1/1/4>Hi? <W>Kitap
acilmiyor!

original:
<T>It appears this book's elaborate cover is
more than just decoration. This will require
a closer look.
translation:
<T>Gorunuse gore bu kitabin suslu kapagi
sadece sus degil. Daha yakindan
bakmak gerekecek.

original: <T><M4/1/1>How are we supposed to open this?
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Bunu nasil acacagiz?

original:
<T><M1/1/2>We'll definitely manage to get the book
open this time!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Bu sefer kitabi mutlaka
acacagiz!

original: <T>Excellent! Now we can read the book.
translation: <T>Harika! Artik kitabi okuyabiliriz.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/3>Finally!
translation: <T><M3/1/3>Nihayet!

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>The Masked Gentleman must feel betrayed
by someone he trusted, someone who stole
his love.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Maskeli Beyefendi, guvendigi biri tarafindan
ihanete ugramis olmali; sevdigini elinden
alan biri tarafindan.

original: <T>While he was trapped inside a cave...
translation: <T>Bir magaranin icinde hapsolmusken...

original:
<T>I'd be pretty angry too! But what does this
have to do with Monte d'Or?
translation:
<T>Ben de cok kizardim! Ama bunun
Monte d'Or'la ne ilgisi var?

original: <T>Hmm...
translation: <T>Hmm...

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>I think we need to focus on the words {''}the
audience sat with rapt attention{''}...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Bence {''}seyirciler
buyulenmis gibi purdikkat oturuyordu{''} sozlerine odaklanmaliyiz...

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>It brings to mind a theatre. <W>Mr Mordaunt,
is there anything like that here?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Bu bana bir tiyatroyu hatirlatiyor. <W>Bay Mordaunt,
burada buna benzer bir yer var mi?

original: ヌーデン
translation: Mordaunt

original:
<T><M3/1/1>We don't have a theatre per se, but we do
have an auditorium. We screen films there.
Tasteful ones.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Tam anlamiyla bir tiyatromuz yok ama
bir oditoryumumuz var. Orada filmler gosteririz.
Seckin olanlardan.

original: <T><M3/2/1>That sounds like the place. Let's go!
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Aradigimiz yer bu olmali. Hadi gidelim!

original:
<T>Once upon a time, there was a kind
princess who lived in a secluded
kingdom deep within a valley.
translation:
<T>Bir varmis bir yokmus, iyi kalpli bir
prenses, tenha bir
vadinin derinlerindeki bir krallikta yasarmis.

original:
<T>This princess was so beautiful that
suitors camped outside the castle for
months, hoping for a chance to woo her.
translation:
<T>Bu prenses oyle guzelmis ki,
talipleri onu etkileme sansi icin
aylarca kalenin disinda kamp kurarmis.

original:
<T>But not one of the wealthy
and handsome young men
pleased the princess.
translation:
<T>Ama zengin
ve yakisikli genclerin
hicbiri prensesi memnun edememis.

original:
<T>Then one day, as the princess was
gazing from her window, she saw a
young knight riding by.

The princess fell in love with him
instantly and begged her father
to allow him an audience.
translation:
<T>Derken bir gun, prenses
penceresinden bakarken,
yoldan gecen genc bir sovalye gormus.

Prenses ona
ilk goruste asik olmus ve babasina
onu huzuruna kabul etmesi icin yalvarmis.

original:
<T>The king was happy to encourage the
match, and it wasn't long before the
princess married her young knight.
translation:
<T>Kral bu evliligi desteklemekten memnunmus,
ve cok gecmeden
prenses genc sovalyesiyle evlenmis.

original:
<T>Some years later, when the two were
rulers of the land, the young king rode
out to slay a dangerous dragon.
translation:
<T>Yillar sonra, ikisi ulkenin
hukumdari oldugunda, genc kral
tehlikeli bir ejderhayi oldurmeye gitmis.

original:
<T>The queen waited for her king
to return. But he never did.
translation:
<T>Kralice kralinin
donmesini beklemis. Ama kral hic donmemis.

original:
<T>The chancellor did all he could to comfort
the queen in her grief. With time, the
queen's heart betrayed her lost husband and
she began to feel love for the chancellor.

The chancellor's plan had worked. He had
sent the king into a dragon's cave and
then collapsed the entrance.
translation:
<T>Sansolye, kraliceyi acisinda teselli etmek icin
elinden geleni yapmis. Zamanla
kralicenin kalbi kayip kocasina ihanet etmis ve
sansolyeye karsi sevgi duymaya baslamis.

Sansolyenin plani islemis. Krali bir ejderha magarasina
gondermis ve
sonra da girisi cokertmis.

original:
<T>The queen knew none of this. She
only knew that the king was gone
and she loved the chancellor.

The two had a lavish royal wedding, and
the audience sat with rapt attention,
eager to see their new king.
translation:
<T>Kralice bunlarin hicbirini bilmiyormus. O
sadece kralin gittigini
ve sansolyeyi sevdigini biliyormus.

Ikisi gosterisli bir kraliyet dugunu yapmis ve
seyirciler buyulenmis bir dikkatle oturmus,
yeni krallarini gormek icin sabirsizlaniyormus.

original:
<T>It seemed that here, they would bear
witness to the miracle of love.
translation:
<T>Sanki burada, onlar
ask mucizesine taniklik edeceklerdi.

original:
<T>Now the treacherous chancellor had
the queen, the crown and the country.
translation:
<T>Artik hain sansolyenin elinde
kralice, tac ve ulke varmis.

original: <T>BUT...
translation: <T>AMA...

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T>We haven't used the auditorium for some
time. Nowadays, most new films are too
rowdy to be deemed suitable.
translation:
<T>Bir suredir oditoryumu kullanmiyoruz.
Gunumuzde cogu yeni film,
uygun sayilmayacak kadar gurultulu.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Do you really think the Masked Gentleman
is in here?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin gercekten
burada oldugunu mu dusunuyorsunuz?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Yes, I'm quite certain. We should take care
when we investigate.
translation:
<T>Evet, oldukca eminim. Incelerken
dikkatli olmaliyiz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>There's a puzzle hidden here.
translation: <T>Burada gizli bir bulmaca var.

original: <T>Let's worry about this one later.
translation: <T>Bunu sonra dusunelim.

original:
<T>Ah, we still have this puzzle to solve, don't
we?
translation:
<T>Ah, su bulmacayi hala cozmemiz
gerekiyor, degil mi?

original: <T>That was rather difficult.
translation: <T>Bu oldukca zordu.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>There may be something behind this
screen... I wonder...
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Bu perdenin arkasinda bir sey
olabilir... Acaba...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M5/2/5>Professor, look!
translation: <T><M5/2/5>Profesor, bakin!

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <T><M2/1/2>There's a film running!
translation: <T><M2/1/2>Film oynuyor!

original: スクリーン
translation: Screen

original: <T>BUT...
translation: <T>AMA...

original:
<T>The king was not dead. One year
after entering the cave, he awoke
to find himself buried under rubble.
translation:
<T>Kral olmemisti. Magaraya girdikten bir yil
sonra uyandi ve
kendini molozlarin altinda gomulu buldu.

original:
<T>He used every last ounce of strength
to dig his way out through the debris.
translation:
<T>Elindeki son gucu bile
molozlarin arasindan kazip cikmak icin kullandi.

original:
<T>Finally, he made it back out into the
open air. He hurried to the castle,
anxious to relieve his wife's worry...
translation:
<T>Sonunda yeniden acik
havaya cikti. Karisinin endisesini
dindirmek icin kaleye aceleyle kostu...

original:
<T>And there he found his queen
and his chancellor, living happily
as husband and wife.
translation:
<T>Ve orada kralicesini
ve sansolyesini, mutlu bir sekilde
kari koca olarak yasarken buldu.

original: <T>Wait, that's the end of the story?!
translation: <T>Dur, hikaye burada mi bitiyor?!

original: <T>That remains to be seen.
translation: <T>Onu zaman gosterecek.

original:
<T><M1/1/4>How about you, Luke? What do you- <W20>Luke?
<W>Professor, where's Luke?!
translation:
<T><M1/1/4>Peki ya sen, Luke? Sen ne- <W20>Luke?
<W>Profesor, Luke nerede?!

original: 奇跡の紳士
translation: Maskeli Bey

original:
<T>Ladies and gentlemen! <W>Welcome to my
humble theatre of revenge.
translation:
<T>Hanimlar ve beyler! <W>Mutevazi
intikam tiyatroma hos geldiniz.

original: <T><SEQ{''}luke{''}>I believe you've lost something.
translation: <T><SEQ{''}luke{''}>Sanirim bir sey kaybettiniz.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Luke! <W>Unhand him this instant, you villain!
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Luke! <W>Onu hemen birak, seni alcak!

original: <T><SEQ{''}shinshi{''}><M13/2/6>Professor! Help!
translation: <T><SEQ{''}shinshi{''}><M13/2/6>Profesor! Yardim!

original:
<T><M13/1/1>Villain?! For shame, Layton! <W>After all the
effort I've made to keep you thoroughly
entertained.
translation:
<T><M13/1/1>Alcak mi?! Ayip ediyorsun, Layton! <W>Bunca
cabayi seni bastan sona
eglendirmek icin harcadim.

original:
<T><M12/1/1><SEQ{''}luke{''}>I do hope you're looking forward to the final
act.
translation:
<T><M12/1/1><SEQ{''}luke{''}>Umarim final
perdesini sabirsizlikla bekliyorsunuzdur.

original:
<T><M13/1/1>Tonight, my revenge will rise to its dramatic
climax as the curtains fall on Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T><M13/1/1>Bu gece, Monte d'Or'da perde inerken
intikamim dramatik doruguna ulasacak.

original:
<T><M13/1/1>But first, Layton - the man who abandoned
his childhood friend... <W>I have a special show
planned just for you.
translation:
<T><M13/1/1>Ama once, cocukluk arkadasini
terk eden adam Layton... <W>Senin icin ozel
bir gosteri hazirladim.

original:
<T><M12/1/1><SEQ{''}luke{''}>I'm sure your young friend here will play his
role perfectly.
translation:
<T><M12/1/1><SEQ{''}luke{''}>Genc arkadasinin burada rolunu
kusursuz oynayacagindan eminim.

original: <T><M9/2/1>Leave him out of this! <M1/2/1>He's just a boy!
translation: <T><M9/2/1>Onu bunun disinda birak! <M1/2/1>O daha cocuk!

original: <T><SEQ{''}shinshi{''}><M13/2/6>Professor!
translation: <T><SEQ{''}shinshi{''}><M13/2/6>Profesor!

original: <T>Ah aha aha aha!
translation: <T>Ahaha haha haha!

original: <T><M3/1/2>We have to save Luke!
translation: <T><M3/1/2>Luke'u kurtarmaliyiz!

original: <T><M3/2/1>Quickly, Emmy!
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Cabuk, Emmy!

original: スクリーン
translation: Ekran

original: <T>BUT...
translation: <T>AMA...

original:
<T>The king was not dead.

One year after entering the cave,
he awoke to find himself
buried under rubble.
translation:
<T>Kral olmemisti.

Magaraya girdikten bir yil sonra,
uyandiginda kendini
molozlarin altinda gomulu buldu.

original:
<T>He used every last ounce of strength
to dig his way out through the debris.
translation:
<T>Son zerresine kadar gucunu kullanarak
molozlarin arasindan kendine bir cikis yolu kazdi.

original:
<T>Finally, he made it back out into the
open air. He hurried to the castle,
anxious to relieve his wife's worry...
translation:
<T>Sonunda yeniden acik havaya cikti.
Esinin endisesini gidermek icin
aceleyle kaleye kostu...

original:
<T>And there he found his queen
and his chancellor, living happily
as husband and wife.
translation:
<T>Ve orada kralicesini
ve sansolyesini, mutlu bir sekilde
kari koca olarak yasarken buldu.

original: テキスト[不要/ふよう]
translation: Metin[Gereksiz]

original: ランド
translation: Randall

original:
見事だ、レイトン。
友のために命をかけるとは
translation:
Etkileyici, Layton.
Bir dostun icin hayatini ortaya koymak...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
ああ。リスクのない成功なんてないからね。
君がいつも言っていた言葉だ。
translation:
Evet. Risk olmadan basari da olmaz.
Bunu hep sen soylerdin.

original:
ふふっ…やはり、気づいていたんだな。
エルシャール
translation:
Heh heh... Demek ki fark etmissin.
Hershel.

original: …気づいたときには驚いたよ、ランド…
translation: ...Fark ettigimde saskina dondum, Randall...

original: ふふふ…
translation: Hehehe...

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original: ランド！？
translation: Randall!?

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: まさか！！
translation: Olamaz!!

original: ランド
translation: Randall

original: <V0010><T><M1/1/2>Now my revenge is at hand!<M1/2/2></V>
translation: <V0010><T><M1/1/2>Intikamim artik elimde!<M1/2/2></V>

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <V0020><T>Master Randall? <L1.4>Is that really you?!</V>
translation: <V0020><T>Ustat Randall? <L1.4>Gercekten siz misiniz?!</V>

original: <V0030><T><M1/1/1>It is. <L1.05>Unfortunately for you.</V>
translation: <V0030><T><M1/1/1>Evet. <L1.05>Ne yazik ki senin icin.</V>

original:
<V0040><T><M2/2/2>I have returned to take back everything you
stole from me!</V>
translation:
<V0040><T><M2/2/2>Benden caldigin her seyi geri almak icin
geri dondum!</V>

original:
<V0050><T><M3/2/4>The Azran treasure, <L1.65>my family fortune...<L3.4>and
my Angela. <L5.6><M3/2/2>Henry, <L6.6>you will know the pain
I have felt all these years.</V>
translation:
<V0050><T><M3/2/4>Azran hazinesi, <L1.65>aile servetim...<L3.4>ve
Angela'm. <L5.6><M3/2/2>Henry, <L6.6>bunca yildir
cektigim aciyi sen de tadacaksin.</V>

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original: <V0060><T>Randall, no! <L1.05>It's not like that!</V>
translation: <V0060><T>Randall, hayir! <L1.05>Oyle degil!</V>

original:
<V0070><T>Master Randall, please! <L1.65>You've got it all
wrong! <L2.9>Let me explain!</V>
translation:
<V0070><T>Ustat Randall, lutfen! <L1.65>Her seyi
yanlis anladiniz! <L2.9>Aciklamama izin verin!</V>

original:
<V0080><T><M2/2/2>Oh, I would love to, <L1.7>but unfortunately, <L2.75>I'm
not interested in your explanations!</V>
translation:
<V0080><T><M2/2/2>Ah, isterdim, <L1.7>ama ne yazik ki, <L2.75>sizin
"aciklamalariniz" ilgimi cekmiyor!</V>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<V0090><T><M3/2/1>You could at least tell us where you've been
all these years.</V>
translation:
<V0090><T><M3/2/1>Bunca yil nerede oldugunu en azindan
soyleyebilirdin.</V>

original:
<V0100><T><M1/1/2>Well...all right. <L1.75>Why not? <L2.9>What good is an
untold tale?</V>
translation:
<V0100><T><M1/1/2>Peki... olur. <L1.75>Neden olmasin? <L2.9>Anlatilmamis bir
hikaye neye yarar?</V>

original:
<V0110><T>I first explored the ruins of Akbadain nearly
18 years ago.</V>
translation:
<V0110><T>Akbadain harabelerini ilk kez neredeyse
18 yil once arastirdim.</V>

original:
<V0120><T><M3/1/4>I was only a few steps from unlocking its
secrets...<L2.65>before I fell victim to one of its
many cunning traps.</V>
translation:
<V0120><T><M3/1/4>Sirlarini cozmeme yalnizca birkac adim
kalmisti...<L2.65>ta ki kurnaz tuzaklarindan
birine kurban gidene kadar.</V>

original:
<V0130><T>I fell into a deep ravine, <L1.85>where I could
have died. <L3.45>But as fate would have it,
<L4.8>an underground river broke my fall.</V>
translation:
<V0130><T>Derin bir yariga dustum, <L1.85>orada
olebilirdim. <L3.45>Ama kaderin cilvesiyle,
<L4.8>yeralti nehri dususumu yavaslatti.</V>

original:
<V0140><T>The current washed me onto the banks
of a remote village. <L3.35>The villagers nursed
me back to health.</V>
translation:
<V0140><T>Akinti beni uzak bir koyun kiyilarina
surukledi. <L3.35>Koyluler beni
iyilestirdi.</V>

original:
<V0150><T>I made a full recovery, <L1.6>but I could not
tell the villagers anything about myself.
<L4.85>My mind was a blank.</V>
translation:
<V0150><T>Tamamen iyilestim, <L1.6>ama kendim hakkinda
koylulere hicbir sey soyleyemedim.
<L4.85>Zihnim bombostu.</V>

original: <V0160><T>You...<L0.85>you had amnesia?</V>
translation: <V0160><T>Sen...<L0.85>hafizani mi kaybettin?</V>

original:
<V0170><T>I worked in the village while I tried to
recover my memory.</V>
translation:
<V0170><T>Hafizami geri kazanmaya calisirken
koyde calistim.</V>

original:
<V0180><T>Months went by, <L1.6>years went by...<L3.45>and
eventually I gave up on trying to unearth
my old life.</V>
translation:
<V0180><T>Aylar gecti, <L1.6>yillar gecti...<L3.45>ve
sonunda eski hayatimi ortaya cikarmaya
calismaktan vazgectim.</V>

original: <V0190><T>Then one day, <L1.7>I received a letter.</V>
translation: <V0190><T>Sonra bir gun, <L1.7>bir mektup aldim.</V>

original:
<V0200><T>{''}I know all about your past,{''} it read.
<L2.8>{''}I know who took everything from you.
<L5.35>And I know how to get it all back.{''}</V>
translation:
<V0200><T>{''}Gecmisinin her seyini biliyorum,{''} diyordu.
<L2.8>{''}Senden her seyini kimin aldigini biliyorum.
<L5.35>Ve hepsini nasil geri alacagini da biliyorum.{''}</V>

original:
<V0210><T><M1/1/1>The letter recounted my life in great
detail.</V>
translation:
<V0210><T><M1/1/1>Mektup, hayatimi buyuk bir
detayla anlatiyordu.</V>

original:
<V0220><T>And it said that the one who had betrayed
me was a man named...<L4.05>Henry.</V>
translation:
<V0220><T>Ve beni ihanete ugratan kisinin
adinin...<L4.05>Henry oldugunu soyluyordu.</V>

original:
<V0230><T>When I read that name, it was as though
someone had turned a key in my mind.
<L4.45>Everything came flooding back.</V>
translation:
<V0230><T>O adi okuyunca sanki
zihnimde bir anahtar cevrildi.
<L4.45>Her sey birden geri geldi.</V>

original:
<V0240><T><M3/1/1>I remembered all that I had...<L2.6>and all that
had been taken from me.</V>
translation:
<V0240><T><M3/1/1>Sahip oldugum her seyi...<L2.6>ve
benden alinan her seyi hatirladim.</V>

original: <V0250><T>But the letter didn't end there.</V>
translation: <V0250><T>Ama mektup bununla bitmiyordu.</V>

original:
<V0260><T>{''}I have a plan to take revenge on those
who have wronged you.{''}</V>
translation:
<V0260><T>{''}Sana kotuluk edenlerden
intikam almak icin bir planim var.{''}</V>

original:
<V0270><T><M1/1/1>{''}You need only to don the garb of the
Masked Gentleman and they shall cower
before you!{''}</V>
translation:
<V0270><T><M1/1/1>{''}Tek yapman gereken Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
kiligina burunmek; o zaman hepsi
onunde sinip kalacak!{''}</V>

original:
<V0280><T>So it was decided. <L2.2>I would have my
revenge by taking back what was
mine.</V>
translation:
<V0280><T>Boylece karar verildi. <L2.2>Intikamimi,
bana ait olani geri alarak
alacaktim.</V>

original:
<V0290><T>And the letters continued - <L1.95>each one
advising me on how to execute my plan
as the Masked Gentleman.</V>
translation:
<V0290><T>Ve mektuplar devam etti - <L1.95>her biri
Maskeli Beyefendi olarak planimi
nasil uygulayacagimi anlatiyordu.</V>

original:
<V0300><T><M2/1/1>As each phase of my plan fell into place,
<L3.05>I felt myself returning with it. <L5.65>The Masked
Gentleman brought me back.</V>
translation:
<V0300><T><M2/1/1>Planimin her asamasi yerine oturdukca,
<L3.05>ben de onunla birlikte geri dondugumu
hissediyordum. <L5.65>Beni geri getiren Maskeli
Beyefendi oldu.</V>

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <V0310><T><M2/2/5>The letters... <L1.95>Professor, <L2.9>do you think...?</V>
translation: <V0310><T><M2/2/5>Mektuplar... <L1.95>Profesor, <L2.9>sizce...?</V>

original: <V0320><T><M3/2/1>I fear the worst, Luke.</V>
translation: <V0320><T><M3/2/1>En kotusunden korkuyorum, Luke.</V>

original:
<V0330><T><M3/1/2>This closes my tale of woe. <L2.75>However, we
still have a few tears to shed!</V>
translation:
<V0330><T><M3/1/2>Iste aci hikayem burada biter. <L2.75>Ama daha
dokecegimiz birkac gozyasi var!</V>

original:
<V0340><T><M3/2/2>Henry, <L0.9>you shall bear witness as I ruin you,
<L3.8>just as you ruined me.</V>
translation:
<V0340><T><M3/2/2>Henry, <L0.9>bana yaptigin gibi seni mahvedisime
<L3.8>tanik olacaksin.</V>

original: <V0350><T><M2/1/1>Master Randall! <L1.15>Wait!</V>
translation: <V0350><T><M2/1/1>Ustat Randall! <L1.15>Bekleyin!</V>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M1/2/1>Randall's gone. Come, we must follow him!
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Randall gitti. Haydi, onu takip etmeliyiz!

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <T>Master Randall... <W>How could you think...?
translation: <T>Ustat Randall... <W>Bunu nasil dusunebildiniz...?

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original:
<T>This last miracle... I wonder what he's
planning.
translation:
<T>Bu son mucize... Acaba ne
planliyor?

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Mr Ledore, please allow me to accompany
you.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bay Ledore, lutfen size
eslik etmeme izin verin.

original:
<T>Thank you, Mordaunt. We must make Master
Randall see the truth before he does
something terrible.
translation:
<T>Tesekkur ederim, Mordaunt. Ustat
Randall'a, korkunc bir sey yapmadan once
gercegi gostermeliyiz.

original: <T>Quickly, let's go!
translation: <T>Cabuk, gidelim!

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original: <T>Hershel, we need to go after Randall!
translation: <T>Hershel, Randall'in pesinden gitmeliyiz!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M1/2/1>Yes, we must hurry.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Evet, acele etmeliyiz.

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original:
<T>I still find it hard to believe. Is it really
Master Randall?
translation:
<T>Hala inanmakta zorlaniyorum. Gercekten
Ustat Randall mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Indeed it is. We must stop him before
he acts again, or something terrible will
happen!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Aynen oyle. Bir daha harekete gecmeden once
onu durdurmaliyiz, yoksa korkunc bir sey
olacak!

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original: <T>Professor? What would you have me do?
translation: <T>Profesor? Benden ne yapmami istersiniz?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Stay calm and follow us. We must leave
immediately.
translation:
<T>Sakin olun ve bizi takip edin. Hemen
ayrilmaliyiz.

original:
<T>O-of course! Well then, to leave, just touch
the door icon on the top-right of the map
screen.
translation:
<T>E-elbette! Oyleyse cikmak icin, harita ekraninin
sag ustundeki kapi simgesine
dokunmaniz yeterli.

original: ランド
translation: Randall

original: これが[最後/さいご]の[奇跡/きせき]になるだろう…
translation: Bu, [son/son] [mucize/mucize] olacak...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: [not used]
translation: [not used]

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M1/2/1>Randall! Stop this immediately!
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Randall! Bunu hemen durdur!

original: ランド
translation: Randall

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Why, Hershel? You reap what you sow,
don't you?
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Neden, Hershel? Ne ekersen onu bicersin,
degil mi?

original:
<T><M3/2/2/45>Watch closely, Henry! Watch as your
precious city sinks into oblivion!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2/45>Iyi izle, Henry! Degerli sehrinin yok olusunu
izle!

original:
<T>All roads leading out of Monte d'Or have
been blocked. Embrace the final miracle!
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'dan cikan tum yollar
kapatildi. Son mucizeyi kucaklayin!

original:
<T><M2/1/2>You will all share the fate of your beloved
city and return to dust!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Hepiniz sevdiginiz sehrin kaderini
paylasacak, toza donuseceksiniz!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/2/2>It's pouring in so fast!
translation: <T><M3/2/2>Cok hizli doluyor!

original:
<T><M1/1/3/45>There must be some escape route we can
use, mustn't there?
translation:
<T><M1/1/3/45>Kullanabilecegimiz bir kacis yolu
olmali, degil mi?

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original:
<T>This town was built on an oasis, and it lies
in what is basically a big bowl. If there's no
way up, there's no way out.
translation:
<T>Bu kasaba bir vaha uzerine kuruldu ve
aslinda kocaman bir canagin icinde. Eger
yukari cikis yoksa, cikis da yok.

original: <T><M1/2/2>Oh dear, Professor! What can we do?
translation: <T><M1/2/2>Aman Tanrim, Profesor! Ne yapacagiz?

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Let me go after Randall, Professor! I can
take him down!
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Randall'in pesine ben duseyim, Profesor!
Onu durdurabilirim!

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>We must remain calm. Only clear minds will
prevail here. <W>We need to head towards the
monument.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Sakin kalmaliyiz. Burada ancak sogukkanli
zihinler basarili olur. <W>Anita dogru
gitmemiz gerekiyor.

original: <T><M2/2/1/45>Why? What's over there?!
translation: <T><M2/2/1/45>Neden? Orada ne var?!

original:
<T>I'll explain once we're there. Henry, Angela,
come!
translation:
<T>Oraya varinca aciklarim. Henry, Angela,
gelin!

original:
<T>Understood. We'll follow you to the
monument.
translation:
<T>Anlasildi. Sizi anita kadar
takip edecegiz.

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original: <T><M7/1/1/45>Maybe we can take the tram.
translation: <T><M7/1/1/45>Belki tramvayi kullanabiliriz.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Let's hurry to the monument.
translation: <T>Anita acele edelim.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Phew! The tram is still running! The stop
closest to the monument is Tingly Town,
I think.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Oh! Tramvay hala calisiyor! Anita en yakin durak
sanirim Tingly Town,
olmali.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Very well, let's take the tram.
translation: <T>Pekala, tramvaya binelim.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T>It's chaos here too!
translation: <T>Burasi da tam bir kaos!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>If we don't stop it soon, Monte d'Or will be
buried under the sand.
translation:
<T>Bunu yakinda durdurmazsak Monte d'Or
kumun altinda kalacak.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T>What are we going to do, Professor?
translation: <T>Ne yapacagiz, Profesor?

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Oi, Layton! What is this sandstorm? I can't
see a thing!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Hey, Layton! Bu kum firtinasi da ne? Hicbir
sey goremiyorum!

original: <T><M4/2/1>Inspector Grosky? It's-
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Mufettis Grosky? Bu-

original:
<T><M3/1/1/30>It's the Masked Gentleman, isn't it? I should
have known. All right, he's got it coming
this time. FOR THE YARD!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/30>Bu Maskeli Beyefendi, degil mi? Bilmeliydim.
Pekala, bu sefer hak ettigini bulacak.
HUCUM!

original: <T><M1/2/1/45>Inspector, wait! Where-<W> He's gone.
translation: <T><M1/2/1/45>Mufettis, bekleyin! Nereye-<W> Gitti.

original: シバロフ
translation: Sheffield

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Has Grosky gone off again? Should have
had him tied down. Real loose cannon on
deck.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Grosky yine mi ortadan kayboldu? Onu bir yere
baglamak gerekirdi. Tam bir basina buyruk
serseri.

original:
<T>Ah, Chief Inspector Sheffield. I need your
help.
translation:
<T>Ah, Basmufettis Sheffield. Yardiminiza
ihtiyacim var.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I saw someone dressed like the Masked
Gentleman heading for the gallery plaza. Is
that...who I think it is?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Maskeli Beyefendi gibi giyinmis birini
galeri meydanina giderken gordum. O...
benim dusundugum kisi mi?

original: <T><M2/2/1>There's no time to explain.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Aciklamaya zaman yok.

original:
<T>We are heading to the monument at once
to stop this madness.
translation:
<T>Bu cilginligi durdurmak icin hemen
anita gidiyoruz.

original:
<T>Please ensure the townspeople are safe. Get
everyone to the top floors of the tallest
buildings.
translation:
<T>Lutfen kasaba halkini guvende tutun. Herkesi
en yuksek binalarin ust katlarina
cikarin.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmph. All right, Layton. I'll see to the
people's safety.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hih. Pekala, Layton. Halkin guvenligiyle
ben ilgilenecegim.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Is Detective Bloom here?
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Dedektif Bloom burada mi?

original:
<T>He said he was going to investigate the
Reunion Inn. I haven't seen him since!
translation:
<T>Reunion Hani'ni arastiracagini soyledi.
O zamandan beri gormedim!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Probably got scared and turned tail once the
real trouble started.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Asil sorun baslayinca korkup
kuyrugunu kistirmistir.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Don't you worry, we'll sort out the civilians.
I'll be waiting in the gallery plaza afterwards!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sen merak etme, sivilleri biz hallederiz.
Sonrasinda galeri meydaninda bekliyor olacagim!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Professor, do you think Detective Bloom
really ran away?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Profesor, sizce Dedektif Bloom
gercekten kacti mi?

original: <T><M4/1/1>We didn't see him at the Reunion Inn...
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Reunion Hani'nda onu gormedik...

original: <T><M3/2/1>Let's just press on to the monument.
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Hadi anita dogru devam edelim.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>We don't need to use the tram. Let's get to
the monument!
translation:
<T>Tramvayi kullanmamiza gerek yok. Anita
ulasalim!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M2/2/1>We need to hurry to the monument before
the desert swallows the town!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Col kasabayi yutmadan once anita
acele etmeliyiz!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M5/1/1>This is no time for a detour!
translation: <T><M5/1/1>Simdi dolambacli yola sapmanin zamani degil!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M4/1/1>We're here, Professor! Now what?
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Buradayiz, Profesor! Simdi ne yapacagiz?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M4/2/2>The sand is getting higher!
translation: <T><M4/2/2>Kum seviyesi yukseliyor!

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original:
<T>If we only had the Mask of Order, we could
counteract the Mask of Chaos and stop this.
Tell us where it is, Henry!
translation:
<T>Duzen Maskesi elimizde olsaydi, Kaos Maskesi'ni
etkisiz hale getirip bunu durdurabilirdik.
Nerede oldugunu soyle, Henry!

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <T><M3/1/1>What are you talking about, Angela?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Neyden bahsediyorsun, Angela?

original:
<T><M4/1/1>This is no time to play dumb! The city's
being destroyed. Are you just going to let
it happen?!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Simdi aptala yatma zamani degil! Sehir
yok ediliyor. Bunun olmasina
izin mi vereceksin?!

original: <T>Give me the Mask of Order!
translation: <T>Duzen Maskesi'ni bana ver!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I have no idea where it is. You of all people
should know that!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Nerede oldugunu bilmiyorum. Bunu
en iyi sen bilmelisin!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Angela, calm down, please!<W> The Mask of
Order is in a safe place. There's no need to
worry.
translation:
<T>Angela, lutfen sakin ol!<W> Duzen Maskesi
guvenli bir yerde. Endiselenmeye
gerek yok.

original: <T><M1/2/5>How do you know that?
translation: <T><M1/2/5>Bunu nereden biliyorsunuz?

original: <T><M2/1/2>Professor, we're running out of time!
translation: <T><M2/1/2>Profesor, zamanimiz tukeniyor!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>The only thing that can save this town is
a true miracle.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu kasabayi kurtarabilecek tek sey
gercek bir mucize.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Professor, what are you talking about?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Profesor, ne diyorsunuz?

original:
<T><M6/1/1>We will now solve the final puzzle of
Akbadain.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Simdi Akbadain'in son bulmacasini
cozecegiz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>If my theory is correct, we should be able to
save the town.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Teorim dogruysa, kasabayi
kurtarabilmeliyiz.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>The puzzle of Akbadain? But...<W>what's that
got to do with saving the town?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Akbadain bulmacasi mi? Ama...<W>bunun
kasabayi kurtarmakla ne ilgisi var?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>The entrance to the ruins is nowhere near
here, is it, Professor?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Harabelerin girisi buraya
yakin degil, degil mi Profesor?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Correct. <W>But that's just the front door. The
visitors' entrance, so to speak.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Dogru. <W>Ama bu sadece on kapi. Tabiri
caizse ziyaretci girisi.

original: <T><M2/2/4>I don't understand...
translation: <T><M2/2/4>Anlamiyorum...

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I was quite surprised by that old map of
Monte d'Or back at the Reunion Inn.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Reunion Hani'ndaki o eski Monte d'Or haritasi
beni epey sasirtti.

original:
<T>When I explored the ruins of Akbadain 18
years ago, I made my way to the deepest
chambers.
translation:
<T>Akbadain harabelerini 18 yil once
kesfettigimde en derin
odalarina kadar ilerledim.

original:
<T>But the treasure that I found there, though
worth a great deal in gold, was of no great
archaeological value.
translation:
<T>Ama orada buldugum hazine, altin
olarak cok degerli olsa da
tarihi acidan pek bir degeri yoktu.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>That treasure was really just another trap laid
by the Azran to divert thieves from the true
purpose of the ruins.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>O hazine aslinda Azran'in hirsizlari
harabelerin gercek amacindan
saptirmak icin kurdugu bir baska tuzakti.

original:
<T>Anyone satisfied with material riches would
fail to look any further and never discover
what's really hidden there.
translation:
<T>Maddi zenginlikle yetinen biri daha ileri
bakmaz ve orada gercekten sakli olani
asla kesfedemez.

original: <T>And what is that?
translation: <T>Peki o nedir?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Henry, you reached the bottom of the ruins
as well. Do you remember the markings you
saw there?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Henry, sen de harabelerin en altina
ulastin. Orada gordugun isaretleri
hatirliyor musun?

original:
<T>How could I forget? They were like
nothing I'd ever seen before.
translation:
<T>Nasil unuturum? Daha once
hic gormedigim seylerdi.

original: <T>But I didn't know what they meant.
translation: <T>Ama ne anlama geldiklerini bilmiyordum.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Look at this.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Suna bak.

original: <T><M3/1/1>What is it?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Bu nedir?

original:
<T>When the Reunion Inn was first built, this
area was still an oasis in the desert,
surrounded by ancient ruins.
translation:
<T>Reunion Hani ilk insa edildiginde burasi
colde bir vahaydi ve
antik harabelerle cevriliydi.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>This map shows the lie of the land
before the city of Monte d'Or was
established.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Bu harita, Monte d'Or sehri
kurulmadan once arazinin
nasil oldugunu gosteriyor.

original:
<T>Using the oasis as the circle's centre,
do you see how the ruins hint at the
shape of the original structures?<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Vahayi dairenin merkezi kabul edersek,
harabelerin orijinal yapilarin
seklini nasil ima ettigini goruyor musun?<M1/1/1>

original: <T><M1/1/1>It's the same shape as those markings!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>O isaretlerle ayni sekil!

original: <T>But what does it mean, Professor?
translation: <T>Ama bunun anlami ne, Profesor?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It means the ruins of Akbadain extend
for miles underground and end up here,
directly below Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu, Akbadain harabelerinin yer altinda
kilometrelerce uzanip buraya,
Monte d'Or'un tam altina geldigi anlamina geliyor.

original:
<T>And the heart of the ruins, the deepest
chamber that remained hidden for aeons,
lies directly beneath us.
translation:
<T>Ve harabelerin kalbi olan, caglar boyunca
sakli kalan en derin oda,
tam ayaklarimizin altinda.

original:
<T>Henry, based on what we read in the
expedition journal in your office,
I thought you must know.
translation:
<T>Henry, ofisindeki kesif gunlugunde
okuduklarimiza dayanarak
senin bilmen gerektigini dusundum.

original: <T><M3/1/1>I just... <W>I never thought...
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Ben sadece... <W>Hic dusunmemistim...

original: <T><M3/1/1>That's amazing, Professor!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Inanilmaz, Profesor!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>If we solve the puzzle of Akbadain, I believe
that the hidden chambers will be revealed as
they once were.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Akbadain'in bulmacasini cozersek,
gizli odalarin eskiden oldugu gibi
ortaya cikacagina inaniyorum.

original: <T><M4/1/1>As they once were...?
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Eskiden oldugu gibi...?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>However, in order to do this, we need both
masks: the Mask of Chaos and the Mask of
Order.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Ancak bunu yapabilmek icin iki maske de
gerekli: Kaos Maskesi ve Duzen
Maskesi.

original: ダルストン
translation: Dalston

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I thought I might find you in the eye of the
storm. What's going on, Layton?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sizi firtinanin gobeginde bulurum diye
dusunmustum. Neler oluyor, Layton?

original: <T><M3/1/1>Where's all this sand coming from?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Bu kadar kum nereden geliyor?

original:
<T>I'm sorry, there's no time to explain,
Dalston.
translation:
<T>Uzgunum, aciklamaya zaman yok,
Dalston.

original:
<T>But you should know the town is in grave
danger.
translation:
<T>Ama bilmelisin ki kasaba buyuk
tehlikede.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I can see that. Is the Masked Gentleman
at it again?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Goruyorum. Maskeli Beyefendi yine mi
is basinda?

original:
<T><M2/2/2>See what happens, Henry? See what
happens when you try to sic the police on
me for your own gain?
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Gordun mu, Henry? Kendi cikarin icin
polisi uzerime salmaya kalkinca
neler oluyor, gordun mu?

original:
<T>Dalston, listen to me. Randall is the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Dalston, beni dinle. Maskeli Beyefendi
Randall.

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Randall? <W>Seriously? Have you finally lost
it, or is all this sand clouding your brain?
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>Randall? <W>Cidden mi? Aklini sonunda
mi kacirdin, yoksa bu kumlar beynini mi
bulandirdi?

original: <T><M2/1/1>It's true, Dalston! <M3/1/1>Randall is alive!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Dogru, Dalston! <M3/1/1>Randall yasiyor!

original: <T><M1/1/1>Randall, alive? But...<W>how?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Randall, yasiyor mu? Ama...<W>nasil?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>He's heading for the gallery plaza. We have
to stop him!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Galeri meydanina gidiyor. Onu
durdurmaliyiz!

original: <T><M3/1/1>Henry, wait! I'm going with you.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Henry, bekle! Seninle geliyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>But it's just to save the town, got it? I'll
settle matters with you later.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ama sadece kasabayi kurtarmak icin,
anladin mi? Seninle hesabi
sonra gorurum.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Now, let's look for the way into the ruins.
According to the map and the markings, it
should be around here.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Simdi harabelere girisi bulalim.
Haritaya ve isaretlere gore
buralarda olmali.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Right! Let's split up and find it as fast as we
can!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Tamam! Ayrilip olabildigince hizli
bulalim!

original: <T><M8/1/1>Er...<W> All right.
translation: <T><M8/1/1>Ee...<W> Tamam.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>The markings seem to indicate that there is
a way into the ruins around here
somewhere.
translation:
<T>Isaretler, buralarda bir yerde harabelere
giren bir yol oldugunu
gosteriyor gibi.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M3/1/1>We've got to be close!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Yakin olmaliyiz!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M4/2/5>Hey! Over here!
translation: <T><M4/2/5>Hey! Buraya!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Luke, that's just a manhole cover. <W>Oh, wait,
look at this pattern...
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Luke, bu sadece bir rogar kapagi. <W>Ah, dur,
su desene bak...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M3/1/1>Yes. Open it up!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Evet. Ac!

original:
<T>The sand level is rising. We must solve this
puzzle quickly!
translation:
<T>Kum seviyesi yukseliyor. Bu
bulmacayi hizlica cozmeliyiz!

original:
<T>If we can just get this open, we can go
down into the ruins.
translation:
<T>Bunu acabilirsek harabelere
asagi inebiliriz.

original: <T><M3/1/3>It's open! Let's go!
translation: <T><M3/1/3>Acildi! Hadi gidelim!

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original:
<T>Who would have ever guessed there was an
entrance to the ruins hidden here?
translation:
<T>Burada gizli bir harabe girisi oldugunu
kim tahmin edebilirdi ki?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>There's an entrance to the ruins just behind
the monument. We should go down there
now.
translation:
<T>Anitin hemen arkasinda harabelere acilan bir
giris var. Simdi asagiya inmeliyiz
hemen.

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original: <T>Ah. Yes, of course.
translation: <T>Ah. Evet, elbette.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>All right, let's go.
translation: <T>Pekala, gidelim.

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original:
<T><M2/1/1>But what are you planning to do without the
Mask of Chaos, Hershel?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ama Kaos Maskesi olmadan ne yapmayi
planliyorsun, Hershel?

original: <T><M1/1/1>I have it right here.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Tam burada.

original: <T>What? How?
translation: <T>Ne? Nasil?

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I found it at the Reunion Inn, of course. The
true Mask of Chaos, hidden in the archives,
just as you had left it.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Elbette Reunion Hani'nda buldum. Arsivlerde
saklanan gercek Kaos Maskesi,
senin biraktigin gibi.

original: <T><M7/1/1>I...<W>I beg your pardon?
translation: <T><M7/1/1>Ben...<W>Affedersin?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M2/2/5>Angela hid the mask, Professor?
translation: <T><M2/2/5>Angela maskeyi sakladi, Profesor?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I'll explain later. We need to act fast if we
are to save the town.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Sonra aciklarim. Kasabayi kurtarmak
istiyorsak hizli hareket etmeliyiz.

original: <T><M3/1/1>But what are you planning to do?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Peki ne yapmayi planliyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Yes! Even if we have the Mask of Chaos, we
still need the Mask of Order, don't we?
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Evet! Kaos Maskesi bizde olsa bile,
Duzen Maskesi'ne de ihtiyacimiz var,
degil mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Not to worry, Luke. I know exactly where
that is. <W>Come, Angela, I will need your help.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Merak etme, Luke. Onun tam olarak
nerede oldugunu biliyorum. <W>Gel, Angela,
yardimina ihtiyacim olacak.

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original: <T>What is this?
translation: <T>Bu nedir?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>This is the final chamber of Akbadain, the
one that Randall and I never found on our
expedition...
translation:
<T>Burasi Akbadain'in son odasi; Randall'la benim
seferimizde asla bulamadigimiz oda...

original: <T><M7/1/1>So it was here all along.
translation: <T><M7/1/1>Demek basindan beri buradaymis.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>And to solve this room's puzzle, we need
both masks.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ve bu odanin bulmacasini cozmek icin
iki maske de gerekli.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Didn't you say you knew where to find the
Mask of Order?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Duzen Maskesi'nin nerede oldugunu
bildigini soylememis miydin?

original: <T><M3/1/1>Indeed. I will show you.
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Elbette. Sana gosterecegim.

original:
<T>This engraving is the same message that
Randall deciphered on the stone tablet
years ago.
translation:
<T>Bu oyma, Randall'in yillar once tas tabletten
cozdugu mesajin aynisi.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>{''}Only the bearers of Chaos and Order may
reveal our legacy. It is always the two halves
that make the whole.{''}
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>{''}Kaos ve Duzen'i tasiyanlar ancak
mirasimizi ortaya cikarabilir. Butunu olusturan,
her zaman iki yaridir.{''}

original:
<T>You see those pedestals over there? One
mask must be placed on each one to
trigger the mechanism.
translation:
<T>Su kaideleri goruyor musun? Mekanizmayi
calistirmak icin her birine bir
maske yerlestirilmeli.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>With that, we can unlock the secret of
Akbadain and save Monte d'Or!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Boylece Akbadain'in sirrini
aciga cikarip Monte d'Or'u kurtarabiliriz!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hershel, stop speaking in riddles! Where is
the Mask of Order?!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hershel, bilmece konusmayi birak! Duzen
Maskesi nerede?!

original:
<T>Hmm. You assumed that Henry found the
Mask of Order with the treasure and that he
had been hiding it all along.
translation:
<T>Hmm. Henry'nin Duzen Maskesi'ni hazineyle
birlikte buldugunu ve onu basindan beri
sakladigini varsaydin.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Assumptions are dangerous things. Consider
the message again.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Varsayimlar tehlikelidir. Mesaji
yeniden dusun.

original:
<T>{''}It is always the two halves that make the
whole.{''}
translation: <T>{''}Butunu olusturan, her zaman iki yaridir.{''}

original: <T><M1/1/1>{''}Two halves{''}...<W> No! Surely not!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>{''}Iki yari{''}...<W> Hayir! Olamaz!

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
ふたつの[仮面/かめん]はひとつでふたつの[仮面/かめん]
だったんだ。[奇跡/きせき]の[仮面/かめん]…、それこそが
[破邪/はじゃ]の[仮面/かめん]でもあるんだ。
translation:
Iki [maske/maske] aslinda tek bir, ama iki [maske/maske]
ymis. [mucize/mucize]nin [maske/maske]si... iste o da
[kotuluksavar/kotuluksavar]nin [maske/maske]siymis.

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original: <T>It was so simple all along!
translation: <T>Bastan beri bu kadar basitmis!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Now, Angela, I need you to help me solve
the final puzzle of Akbadain and save
Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T>Simdi, Angela, Akbadain'in son bulmacasini
cozmeme yardim etmen ve Monte d'Or'u
kurtarmam gerekiyor.

original: <T>Yes...<W> Of course.
translation: <T>Evet...<W> Elbette.

original: シャロア
translation: Sharoa

original: <T>It was so simple all along!
translation: <T>Bastan beri bu kadar basitmis!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Now, Angela, I need you to help me solve
the final puzzle of Akbadain and save
Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T>Simdi, Angela, Akbadain'in son bulmacasini
cozmeme yardim etmen ve Monte d'Or'u
kurtarmam gerekiyor.

original: <T>Yes, Hershel...<W> Of course.
translation: <T>Evet, Hershel...<W> Elbette.

original: ランド
translation: Randall

original: な…なんということだ…
translation: N... Bu da ne boyle...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
見ろ、ランド。
君が長い間求めてきた…
アスラント文明の遺産だ。
translation:
Bak, Randall.
Uzun zamandir pesinde oldugun...
Azran uygarliginin mirasi.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T>Go on, Professor. You should talk to
Randall!
translation:
<T>Hadi, Profesor. Randall'la
konusmalisiniz!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Of course. I have much to say to him.
translation: <T>Elbette. Ona soyleyecek cok seyim var.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>If I could just have a moment. I must talk to
Randall.
translation:
<T>Sadece bir dakikanizi alacagim. Sununla konusmam gerek:
Randall.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>I have to talk to Randall and tell him the
truth.
translation:
<T>Randall'la konusup ona
gercegi soylemem gerek.

original:
<T>After this point, you'll be
unable to save your game.
Are you ready to continue?
translation:
<T>Bu noktadan sonra,
oyununuzu kaydedemeyeceksiniz.
Devam etmeye hazir misiniz?

original: ランド
translation: Rand

original: <V0010><T><M4/3/3>What was that? <L1.1>What happened?</V>
translation: <V0010><T><M4/3/3>Bu da neydi? <L1.1>Ne oldu?</V>

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <V0020><T>Amazing...</V>
translation: <V0020><T>Inanilmaz...</V>

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <V0030><T>Is everyone okay?</V>
translation: <V0030><T>Herkes iyi mi?</V>

original: <V0040><T>This is the true treasure of the Azran...</V>
translation: <V0040><T>Azran'in gercek hazinesi bu...</V>

original:
<V0050><T><M4/2/1/45>The riddle we could not have solved 18
years ago, Randall.</V>
translation:
<V0050><T><M4/2/1/45>18 yil once cozemedigimiz bilmece
buydu, Randall.</V>

original:
<V0060><T><M6/2/1/45>We were distracted by tales of fortune, <L2.9>while
the most valuable archaeological find lay
elsewhere all along.</V>
translation:
<V0060><T><M6/2/1/45>Servet hikayeleriyle dikkatimizi dagittilar, <L2.9>oysa
en degerli arkeolojik kesif
bastan beri bambaska bir yerdeydi.</V>

original:
<V0070><T><M5/3/1>You did it... <L1.4>You solved the puzzle of
Akbadain. <L4.2>Spectacular. <L6.05>I must hand it to
you, Hershel.</V>
translation:
<V0070><T><M5/3/1>Basardin... <L1.4>Sunun bilmecesini cozdun:
Akbadain. <L4.2>Muhtesem. <L6.05>Hakkini vermeliyim,
sana, Hershel.</V>

original:
<V0080><T><M2/2/1/45>There is no puzzle without a solution. <L2.7>You
taught me that, Randall.</V>
translation:
<V0080><T><M2/2/1/45>Cozumu olmayan bilmece yoktur. <L2.7>Bunu
bana sen ogrettin, Randall.</V>

original:
<V0090><T><M7/3/1/45>Archaeology was nothing more than
a passing fancy for you...<L3.3>and still you
unearthed all of this. <L5.9>Incredible.</V>
translation:
<V0090><T><M7/3/1/45>Arkeoloji senin icin yalnizca
gecici bir hevesti...<L3.3>ama yine de sen
butun bunlari ortaya cikardin. <L5.9>Inanilmaz.</V>

original: <V0100><T><M4/2/1/45>I had some help.</V>
translation: <V0100><T><M4/2/1/45>Biraz yardim aldim.</V>

original:
<V0110><T><M8/4/4>Your skill has magnified my own faults. <L3.1>Even
in revenge...I am a failure.</V>
translation:
<V0110><T><M8/4/4>Becerin, kendi kusurlarimi daha da buyuttu. <L3.1>Intikamda bile
...bir basarisizim.</V>

original:
<V0120><T><M5/2/1/45>Nonsense. <L1.8>The important thing is that you're
with us now.</V>
translation:
<V0120><T><M5/2/1/45>Sacmalik. <L1.8>Onemli olan, artik
bizimle olman.</V>

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <V0130><T><M1/1/2>Master Randall...</V>
translation: <V0130><T><M1/1/2>Ustat Randall...</V>

original:
<V0140><T><M6/2/2>Stay away from me! <L1.45>You stole everything
from me! <L3.4>Everything!</V>
translation:
<V0140><T><M6/2/2>Benden uzak dur! <L1.45>Benden her seyimi
caldin! <L3.4>Her seyimi!</V>

original: <V0150><T><M1/1/1>That's not true!</V>
translation: <V0150><T><M1/1/1>Bu dogru degil!</V>

original:
<V0160><T><M2/2/1/20>You still don't see? <L1.8>Henry took nothing from
you, Randall. <L3.9>You were used.</V>
translation:
<V0160><T><M2/2/1/20>Hala gormuyor musun? <L1.8>Henry senden hicbir sey
almadi, Randall. <L3.9>Seni kullandilar.</V>

original: <V0170><T><M1/3/1>Used? <L1.3>What are you talking about?</V>
translation: <V0170><T><M1/3/1>Kullandilar mi? <L1.3>Ne diyorsun sen?</V>

original:
<V0180><T><M4/2/1/60>Everything you were told in those letters was
a lie.</V>
translation:
<V0180><T><M4/2/1/60>O mektuplarda sana anlatilanlarin hepsi
yalandi.</V>

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <V0010><T><M1/2/3>Descole! <L1.85><M3/2/3>Then where's Angela?</V>
translation: <V0010><T><M1/2/3>Descole! <L1.85><M3/2/3>O halde Angela nerede?</V>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<V0020><T><M2/2/1>I found Angela trapped in a room <M2/1/1>at the
Reunion Inn.</V>
translation:
<V0020><T><M2/2/1>Angela'yi bir odada kapana kisilmis halde buldum <M2/1/1>
Reunion Hani'nda.</V>

original: <V0030><T><M2/2/3>Where is she now?</V>
translation: <V0030><T><M2/2/3>Simdi nerede?</V>

original: ヌーデン
translation: Nuden

original: <V0045><T>Right here.</V>
translation: <V0045><T>Tam burada.</V>

original:
<V0050><T><M4/1/1>I asked her to wear a costume while we
played Descole's little game.</V>
translation:
<V0050><T><M4/1/1>Descole'un kucuk oyununu oynarken
ona bir kostum giymesini soyledim.</V>

original: デスコール
translation: Descole

original:
<V0060><T>I see... <L1.4>You pretended to be taken in by my
Angela disguise until I helped you solve the
riddle of Akbadain.</V>
translation:
<V0060><T>Anliyorum... <L1.4>Benim
Angela kiligima kanmis gibi davrandin; ben de sana
Akbadain bilmecesini cozmende yardim edene dek.</V>

original:
<V0070><T><M2/1/1>You knew that you needed my help if you
were to solve that final puzzle.</V>
translation:
<V0070><T><M2/1/1>Son bulmacayi cozmek icin
yardimima ihtiyacin oldugunu biliyordun.</V>

original: <V0080><T><M1/2/1/45>Very good, Descole.</V>
translation: <V0080><T><M1/2/1/45>Cok iyi, Descole.</V>

original:
<V0090><T><M3/1/1>I knew I never should have used this
has-been bumpkin!</V>
translation:
<V0090><T><M3/1/1>Bu gozden dusmus koyluyu
asla kullanmamaliydim!</V>

original: ランド
translation: Rand

original: <V0100><T><M4/3/2>I can't believe what I've done...</V>
translation: <V0100><T><M4/3/2>Ne yaptigimi inanamiyorum...</V>

original:
<V0110><T><M1/3/1>You're pitiful, Ascot! <L1.9><M1/1/1>I gave you back your
life, and you failed! <L4.85>And Layton, you must
tell me... <L7.9>How did you know?</V>
translation:
<V0110><T><M1/3/1>Acinacak haldesin, Ascot! <L1.9><M1/1/1>Sana geri
hayatini verdim ve yine de basaramadin! <L4.85>Ve Layton, bana
soyle... <L7.9>Nasil anladin?</V>

original:
<V0120><T><M4/2/1/45>When I first arrived here, I spoke to the real
Angela.</V>
translation:
<V0120><T><M4/2/1/45>Buraya ilk geldigimde, gercek
Angela'yla konustum.</V>

original:
<V0130><T><M2/2/1/45>But I definitely sensed a great unease
within her.</V>
translation:
<V0130><T><M2/2/1/45>Ama icinde derin bir huzursuzluk
oldugunu kesinlikle hissettim.</V>

original:
<V0140><T><M5/2/1/45>Angela had suspected Randall of being the
Masked Gentleman all along. <L4.8><M6/2/1>That was why
she wrote me the letter.</V>
translation:
<V0140><T><M5/2/1/45>Angela, basindan beri Randall'in
Maskeli Beyefendi oldugundan supheleniyordu. <L4.8><M6/2/1>Bu yuzden
bana mektup yazdi.</V>

original:
<V0150><T><M2/2/1>She was hoping that I would get to Randall
before the police did.</V>
translation:
<V0150><T><M2/2/1>Polisten once Randall'a ulasmami
umuyordu.</V>

original:
<V0160><T><M5/2/1/45>She thought that if I confronted Randall,
I might be able to get through to him.</V>
translation:
<V0160><T><M5/2/1/45>Randall'la yuzlesirsem,
ona ulasabilecegimi dusunuyordu.</V>

original: <V0170><T>Yes. Go on.</V>
translation: <V0170><T>Evet. Devam et.</V>

original:
<V0180><T><M1/2/1>Despite our history, <L1.6>Angela wasn't sure what
I would do if <M5/2/1/45>I discovered that Randall was
the Masked Gentleman.</V>
translation:
<V0180><T><M1/2/1>Gecmisimize ragmen, Angela
Randall'in
Maskeli Beyefendi oldugunu ogrenirsem ne yapacagimi bilmiyordu.</V>

original:
<V0190><T><M1/2/1/45>But the next time I saw her, there was
something different about her demeanour.
<L5.25>Her unease had disappeared.</V>
translation:
<V0190><T><M1/2/1/45>Ama onu bir sonraki gorusumde, ortada
tavriyla ilgili bir seyler farkliydi.
<L5.25>Huzursuzlugu kaybolmustu.</V>

original:
<V0200><T><M5/2/1/45>And from that moment, <L1.65>I began to suspect
Angela.</V>
translation:
<V0200><T><M5/2/1/45>Ve o andan itibaren, <L1.65>Angela'dan suphelenmeye
basladim.</V>

original: <V0210><T><M2/1/1>Perhaps I was too eager.</V>
translation: <V0210><T><M2/1/1>Belki de fazla aceleciydim.</V>

original:
<V0220><T><M2/2/1/45>You gave yourself away when you asked for
the Mask of Order to solve the riddle of
Akbadain.</V>
translation:
<V0220><T><M2/2/1/45>Akbadain bilmecesini cozmek icin
Duzen Maskesi'ni istediginde
kendini ele verdin.</V>

original:
<V0240><T><M3/1/1>When I heard of Henry's mask, I needed
to find someone to play the Masked
Gentleman. <L4.2>Randall obliged.</V>
translation:
<V0240><T><M3/1/1>Henry'nin maskesini duyunca,
Maskeli Beyefendi rolunu oynayacak birini bulmam
gerekti. <L4.2>Randall da kabul etti.</V>

original:
<V0250><T><M2/1/1>I had to convince Henry of the power of the
Mask of Chaos with our dark miracles.</V>
translation:
<V0250><T><M2/1/1>Karanlik mucizelerimizle Henry'yi
Kaos Maskesi'nin gucune inandirmaliydim.</V>

original:
<V0260><T><M1/1/1>If Henry believed that the Mask of Order
could counteract the powers of the Masked
Gentleman, <L5.1>well then...</V>
translation:
<V0260><T><M1/1/1>Henry, Duzen Maskesi'nin
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin guclerine karsi koyabilecegine
inanirsa, <L5.1>o zaman...</V>

original:
<V0270><T><M2/1/1>Surely he would procure this mask rather
than watch his dear city crumble, yes?</V>
translation:
<V0270><T><M2/1/1>Bu maskeyi elbette temin ederdi,
sevgili sehrinin yikilisini izlemektense, degil mi?</V>

original:
<V0280><T><M1/2/1>But when he did not, you grew tired of
waiting.</V>
translation:
<V0280><T><M1/2/1>Ama yapmayinca,
beklemekten sikildin.</V>

original:
<V0290><T><M2/2/1>You became Angela so that you could get
closer to Henry.</V>
translation:
<V0290><T><M2/2/1>Henry'ye daha cok yaklasabilmek icin
Angela kiligina girdin.</V>

original:
<V0300><T><M4/2/1/60>But Henry still wouldn't reveal the location
of the Mask of Order.</V>
translation:
<V0300><T><M4/2/1/60>Ama Henry hala yerini aciklamiyordu
Duzen Maskesi'nin.</V>

original:
<V0310><T><M6/2/1/45>And he couldn't...<L1.25>because he never had the
Mask of Order in the first place.</V>
translation:
<V0310><T><M6/2/1/45>Ve aciklayamazdi...<L1.25>cunku Duzen Maskesi'ne
hic sahip olmamisti.</V>

original:
<V0320><T>Bravo, Layton. <L2.1>But I'm afraid all of the
deductive reasoning in the world won't
change the fact that I've already won.</V>
translation:
<V0320><T>Bravo, Layton. <L2.1>Ama korkarim dunyadaki butun
akil yurutmeler bile
benim coktan kazandigim gercegini degistiremez.</V>

original: <V0330><T><M3/1/1>You've actually done my work for me.</V>
translation: <V0330><T><M3/1/1>Aslinda benim isimi benim yerime yaptin.</V>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: デスコール
translation: Descole

original:
<V0040><T>Thank you, Layton.
Mwahahahahaha!
Ahahahaha!</V>
translation:
<V0040><T>Tesekkurler, Layton.
Mwahahahahaha!
Ahahahaha!</V>

original: <V0050><T>Until we meet again!</V>
translation: <V0050><T>Tekrar gorusene kadar!</V>

original: ランド
translation: Rand

original: <V0010><T>What does that mean?</V>
translation: <V0010><T>Bu ne demek?</V>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<V0020><T>Randall, you should know the truth about
Monte d'Or.</V>
translation:
<V0020><T>Randall, Monte d'Or hakkinda
gercegi bilmelisin.</V>

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original: <V0030><T>We have something to tell you.</V>
translation: <V0030><T>Sana soylememiz gereken bir sey var.</V>

original: <V0040><T><M5/3/2>Oh, just leave me alone, all of you!</V>
translation: <V0040><T><M5/3/2>Ah, hepiniz beni yalniz birakin!</V>

original:
<V0050><T><M4/2/1>Randall, when you disappeared, we didn't
know if you'd ever return. <L4.15>We were
destroyed. <L5.5>All of us.</V>
translation:
<V0050><T><M4/2/1>Randall, kayboldugunda biz
bir daha donup donmeyecegini bilmiyorduk. <L4.15>Yikildik.
<L5.5>Hepimiz.</V>

original:
<V0060><T><M5/2/1/45>Your parents took it especially hard, of
course. <L3.3>Their businesses failed, <L5.2>and the
Ascot house fell into disrepair.</V>
translation:
<V0060><T><M5/2/1/45>Elbette en cok anne baban
etkilendi. <L3.3>Isleri batti, <L5.2>ve
Ascot malikanesi harabeye dondu.</V>

original:
<V0070><T><M6/2/1>All that time, <L1.3>Henry risked his life as he
searched for you down in those ruins...<L5.3><M5/2/1/45>but
to no avail.</V>
translation:
<V0070><T><M6/2/1>Bunca zaman Henry hayatini riske atip
o korkunc harabelerde seni aradi...<L5.3><M5/2/1/45>ama
nafile.</V>

original:
<V0080><T><M4/2/1/45>In a strange twist of fate, <L1.9>he found the Azran
treasure you were searching for all those
years ago.</V>
translation:
<V0080><T><M4/2/1/45>Kaderin garip bir cilvesiyle, Azran
hazinesini buldu; senin bunca yil once
aradigin hazineyi.</V>

original:
<V0090><T><M1/2/1/45>Henry supported your parents with his
newfound wealth, but he could not truly
replace what they had lost.</V>
translation:
<V0090><T><M1/2/1/45>Henry, yeni buldugu servetiyle
anne babani destekledi ama
kaybettiklerini gercekten geri getiremedi.</V>

original:
<V0100><T><M2/2/1/45>So he did what he could. <L1.7>He worked hard
to build Monte d'Or, <L4.2>and he cared for your
parents as if they were his own.</V>
translation:
<V0100><T><M2/2/1/45>Bu yuzden elinden geleni yapti. <L1.7>Monte d'Or'u kurmak icin cok
calisti, <L4.2>ve anne babana
kendi ailesiymis gibi bakti.</V>

original: <V0110><T><M7/4/3>You... <L1.15>Henry, is this true?</V>
translation: <V0110><T><M7/4/3>Sen... <L1.15>Henry, bu dogru mu?</V>

original: シャロア
translation: Charo

original:
<V0120><T>It is, Randall. <L1.55>Henry never stopped searching
for you. <L3.95>He always believed that you would
return someday.</V>
translation:
<V0120><T>Evet, Randall. <L1.55>Henry seni aramayi
hic birakmadi. <L3.95>Bir gun mutlaka
geri donecegine hep inandi.</V>

original:
<V0130><T><M7/1/1>He spent a fortune sending search parties
down into those awful ruins.</V>
translation:
<V0130><T><M7/1/1>O korkunc harabelere arama ekipleri
gondermek icin servet harcadi.</V>

original:
<V0140><T><M8/1/1>He built the Reunion Inn so that they would
have a base near the ruins.</V>
translation:
<V0140><T><M8/1/1>Harabelerin yaninda bir usleri olsun diye
Reunion Hani'ni insa etti.</V>

original: <V0150><T><M7/4/3>The Reunion Inn?</V>
translation: <V0150><T><M7/4/3>Reunion Hani mi?</V>

original:
<V0160><T><M2/1/1>I believe that was the first building
established here in Monte d'Or.</V>
translation:
<V0160><T><M2/1/1>Sanirim Monte d'Or'da yapilan
ilk bina oydu.</V>

original:
<V0170><T>Out here, in the middle of nowhere, the
Reunion Inn thrived. <L4.55>That was <M4/1/1/45>quite
a miracle, if you ask me.</V>
translation:
<V0170><T>Burada, issizligin ortasinda
Reunion Hani gelisip buyudu. <L4.55>Bu da <M4/1/1/45>gercek
bir mucize, bana sorarsan.</V>

original:
<V0180><T><M6/2/1/45>But not one without a rational explanation
behind it.</V>
translation:
<V0180><T><M6/2/1/45>Ama bunun arkasinda
mantikli bir aciklama da vardi.</V>

original: <V0190><T><M5/3/1>And what was that?</V>
translation: <V0190><T><M5/3/1>Peki neydi o?</V>

original:
<V0200><T><M1/2/1/45>Henry announced several rewards for anyone
who could find the man named Randall.</V>
translation:
<V0200><T><M1/2/1/45>Henry, Randall adindaki adami
bulana cesitli oduller acikladi.</V>

original:
<V0210><T><M2/2/1>These rewards were so large that word
spread quickly, <L3.55>and the Reunion Inn became
a popular haunt.</V>
translation:
<V0210><T><M2/2/1>Oduller o kadar buyuktu ki
haber hizla yayildi, <L3.55>ve Reunion Hani
ugrak bir yer haline geldi.</V>

original:
<V0220><T>From there, the town prospered. <L2.55>Hotels and
shops cropped up everywhere. <L5.3>A thriving city
bloomed here in the desert.</V>
translation:
<V0220><T>Bundan sonra kasaba zenginlesti. <L2.55>Oteller ve
dukkanlar her yerde belirdi. <L5.3>Colun ortasinda
canli bir sehir filizlendi.</V>

original:
<V0230><T><M4/1/1/45>And Monte d'Or became the city we know
today.</V>
translation:
<V0230><T><M4/1/1/45>Ve Monte d'Or, bugun bildigimiz
sehre donustu.</V>

original: <V0240><T><M4/4/3>I...I can't believe it.</V>
translation: <V0240><T><M4/4/3>Ben... inanamiyorum.</V>

original:
<V0250><T>One might say that Monte d'Or is built
around the idea of your return, Randall.</V>
translation:
<V0250><T>Denebilir ki Monte d'Or,
senin donus fikrin etrafinda kuruldu, Randall.</V>
<V0260><T><M7/4/3>Benim donusum...?</V>

original:
<V0270><T><M4/1/1/45>And that is the true miracle behind the city
of Monte d'Or.</V>
translation:
<V0270><T><M4/1/1/45>Ve Monte d'Or sehrinin arkasindaki
asil mucize de budur.</V>

original: <V0280><T><M4/4/3>I...<L1.9>I don't know what to say.</V>
translation: <V0280><T><M4/4/3>Ben...<L1.9>Ne diyecegimi bilmiyorum.</V>

original:
<V0290><T><M5/2/1/45>Randall, it appeared as if Henry had stolen
your family and your fortune. <L4.8>Nothing could
be further from the truth.</V>
translation:
<V0290><T><M5/2/1/45>Randall, Henry aileni ve servetini
calmis gibi gorunuyordu. <L4.8>Bunun
gercekle uzaktan yakindan ilgisi yoktu.</V>

original:
<V0300><T><M1/2/1/45>In fact, he spent his entire life <M1/1/1>preserving all
that was yours.</V>
translation:
<V0300><T><M1/2/1/45>Aslinda, butun omrunu <M1/1/1>senin olan her seyi
korumaya adadi.</V>

original: <V0330><T>Randall, my marriage to Henry wasn't real.</V>
translation: <V0330><T>Randall, Henry'yle evliligim gercek degildi.</V>

original:
<V0350><T><M4/1/1>After I lost you, Randall, I didn't know how
to go on. <L3.9>My parents kept pressing me to
get married.</V>
translation:
<V0350><T><M4/1/1>Seni kaybettikten sonra, Randall,
nasil devam edecegimi bilemedim. <L3.9>Ailem durmadan
evlenmem icin baski yapiyordu.</V>

original:
<V0360><T><M3/1/1>They wanted me to marry the richest man in
town...<L2.85>Alphonse Dalston.</V>
translation:
<V0360><T><M3/1/1>Kasabanin en zengin adamiyla
evlenmemi istiyorlardi...<L2.85>Alphonse Dalston.</V>

original:
<V0370><T><M2/1/1>I had given up so completely by that time
that I probably would have agreed just so
that they would leave me alone.</V>
translation:
<V0370><T><M2/1/1>O zamanlar o kadar pes etmistim ki
sirf beni rahat biraksinlar diye
muhtemelen kabul ederdim.</V>

original:
<V0380><T><M1/1/1>But then Henry asked me. <L1.95>I will never forget
it. <L3.35>He said, <L4.6>{''}Will you wait for Master Randall
with me?{''}</V>
translation:
<V0380><T><M1/1/1>Ama sonra Henry bana sordu. <L1.95>Bunu asla
unutmayacagim. <L3.35>Soyle dedi, <L4.6>{''}Ustat Randall'i
benimle birlikte bekler misin?{''}</V>

original:
<V0390><T>Henry always believed you would come
back. <L3.1><M4/1/1>He helped me believe too.</V>
translation:
<V0390><T>Henry her zaman geri donecegine
<L3.1><M4/1/1>inaniyordu. Bana da inandirdi.</V>

original:
<V0400><T><M3/1/1>So we agreed to pretend to be married...
<L2.65>until the day you returned, Randall.</V>
translation:
<V0400><T><M3/1/1>Bu yuzden evliymis gibi davranmaya karar verdik...
<L2.65>sen geri donene kadar, Randall.</V>

original:
<V0410><T><M2/1/1>Henry vowed that he would protect and
preserve everything of yours.<M1/1/1/45></V>
translation:
<V0410><T><M2/1/1>Henry, senin olan her seyi koruyup
titizlikle saklayacagina yemin etti.<M1/1/1/45></V>

original:
<V0420><T><M4/1/1/45>Henry never took anything from you. <L2.3>He
protected everything for you.</V>
translation:
<V0420><T><M4/1/1/45>Henry senden hicbir sey almadi. <L2.3>O
her seyi senin icin korudu.</V>

original: ランド
translation: Rand

original: [Not used]
translation: [Kullanilmiyor]

original: ランド母
translation: Rand'in annesi

original: ランド
translation: Rand
<V0020><T><M7/4/3>O olabilir mi?</V>

original: ランドの母
translation: Rand'in annesi

original: <V0030><T>Randall!</V>
translation: <V0030><T>Randall!</V>

original:
<V0050><T>Oh, if it wasn't for Henry, I don't know what
would have happened to me. <L4.3>He took such
good care of me, Randall.</V>
translation:
<V0050><T>Ah, Henry olmasaydi bana ne
olurdu bilmiyorum. <L4.3>Benimle o kadar iyi
ilgilenip bakti ki, Randall.</V>

original:
<V0060><T><M7/4/4>I understand. <L2.2>Oh, Mother...<L3.6>I thought I'd
