never see you again!</V>
translation:
<V0060><T><M7/4/4>Anliyorum. <L2.2>Ah, Anne...<L3.6>Bir daha seni
asla goremeyecegimi sanmistim!</V>

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <V0070><T>Randall, I believe this is yours.</V>
translation: <V0070><T>Randall, sanirim bu sana ait.</V>

original:
<V0080><T><M2/2/1>This document is proof of ownership for all
properties attributed to the Ledore family.</V>
translation:
<V0080><T><M2/2/1>Bu belge, Ledore ailesine atfedilen tum
mulklerin sahiplik kanitidir.</V>

original:
<V0090><T><M4/2/1/45>It reveals that the Ledore family fortune is,
in fact, <L3.25>fully owned by a third party.</V>
translation:
<V0090><T><M4/2/1/45>Ledore aile servetinin,
aslinda <L3.25>tamamen ucuncu bir kisiye ait oldugunu gosteriyor.</V>

original: <V0100><T><M7/3/3>Third party?</V>
translation: <V0100><T><M7/3/3>Ucuncu kisi mi?</V>

original:
<V0110><T><M6/2/1/45>All of the land and money attributed to the
Ledores is actually in the name of Randall
Ascot.</V>
translation:
<V0110><T><M6/2/1/45>Ledore'lara atfedilen tum toprak ve para
aslinda Randall
Ascot'un adina kayitli.</V>

original: <V0120><T><M8/4/4>How can this be?</V>
translation: <V0120><T><M8/4/4>Bu nasil olabilir?</V>

original:
<V0130><T>Henry created a replica of the Mask of
Chaos, <L3.25>but not to steal the glory that ought
to have been yours.</V>
translation:
<V0130><T>Henry, Kaos Maskesi'nin
bir kopyasini yapti, <L3.25>ama bu, sana ait olmasi gereken
sani calmak icin degildi.</V>

original:
<V0140><T><M2/2/1>It was the symbol of Monte d'Or, <L2.25>a beacon
that would draw your attention, <L4.6>wherever you
were.</V>
translation:
<V0140><T><M2/2/1>Bu, Monte d'Or'un simgesiydi, <L2.25>bulundugun
yer neresi olursa olsun dikkatini cekecek bir
<L4.6>isaret.</V>

original:
<V0150><T><M1/2/1/45>Henry assumed you would seek out
someone claiming to have the Mask of
Chaos when you came back.</V>
translation:
<V0150><T><M1/2/1/45>Henry, geri dondugunde
Kaos Maskesi'ne sahip oldugunu iddia eden
birini arayacagini varsaydi.</V>

original: <V0160><T><M4/2/1/45>His assumption was correct.</V>
translation: <V0160><T><M4/2/1/45>Varsayimi dogruydu.</V>

original:
<V0170><T><M5/2/1/45>But when the Masked Gentleman appeared,
<M1/2/1/45>it was clear the police would come asking
questions.</V>
translation:
<V0170><T><M5/2/1/45>Ama Maskeli Beyefendi ortaya cikinca,
<M1/2/1/45>polisin gelip soru soracagi
belliydi.</V>

original:
<V0180><T><M6/2/45>Angela acted fast. <L1.7>She knew that if the
police investigated Henry's mask, <L4.8>they
would discover it was a fake.</V>
translation:
<V0180><T><M6/2/45>Angela hizli davrandi. <L1.7>Polis
Henry'nin maskesini incelerse, <L4.8>onun
sahte oldugunu anlayacaklarini biliyordu.</V>

original:
<V0190><T><M1/2/1/45>So she hid the mask and claimed it had
been stolen in order to preserve the symbol
of Monte d'Or's prosperity.</V>
translation:
<V0190><T><M1/2/1/45>Bu yuzden maskeyi sakladi ve onun
calindigini iddia etti; boylece
Monte d'Or'un refah sembolunu korudu.</V>

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original: <V0200><T><M4/1/1>And also to keep Henry's beacon alive.</V>
translation: <V0200><T><M4/1/1>Ve Henry'nin isaretini de canli tutmak icin.</V>

original:
<V0210><T><M2/2/1>Randall, <L1.3>do you still feel that Henry has
taken something from you?</V>
translation:
<V0210><T><M2/2/1>Randall, <L1.3>Henry'nin senden
bir sey aldigini hala dusunuyor musun?</V>

original: <V0220><T><M8/4/4>What have I done...?</V>
translation: <V0220><T><M8/4/4>Ne yaptim ben...?</V>

original: ヘンリー
translation: Henry

original:
<V0230><T>You weren't yourself. <L2.1>And now that you are,
and back here with us...<L5.2>everything is going
to be okay.</V>
translation:
<V0230><T>Kendinde degildin. <L2.1>Ama artik kendinsin,
ve burada bizimlesin...<L5.2>her sey
iyi olacak.</V>

original: <V0250><T><M3/2/1/45>This was the true miracle all along.</V>
translation: <V0250><T><M3/2/1/45>Asil mucize bastan beri buydu.</V>

original: コリー
translation: Collins

original:
<T>Ah, Layton. How are you doing, boy?
Recovering well?
translation:
<T>Ah, Layton. Nasilsin, evlat?
Iyi toparlaniyor musun?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>I suppose so. Thank you, sir.
translation: <T>Sanirim oyle. Tesekkur ederim, efendim.

original:
<T>Layton...<W> I was very sorry to hear about
young Ascot.
translation:
<T>Layton...<W> Genc Ascot'u duyduguma
cok uzuldum.
<T><M1/2/3>...<W>Evet, efendim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Ahem...<W> So you're off to London soon, eh?
We expect great things from you at
university.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ahem...<W> Yakinda Londra'ya gidiyorsun, oyle mi?
Universitede senden buyuk seyler
bekliyoruz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Though I'm a little surprised that you applied
to do archaeology. It never seemed to be
your field of choice.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Yine de arkeoloji okumak icin basvurman
beni biraz sasirtti. Hic
senin tercih ettigin alan gibi gorunmezdi.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I want to see the things Randall had hoped
to see. Perhaps I can tell him about them
one day...
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Randall'in gormeyi umdugu seyleri
gormek istiyorum. Belki bir gun
ona anlatabilirim...

original: <T>I see...<W> Well, you have my full support.
translation: <T>Anliyorum...<W> Pekala, tum destegim seninle.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You'll no doubt meet Dr Schrader at
Gressenheller's Department of Archaeology.
He's an excellent teacher.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Gressenheller'in Arkeoloji Bolumu'nde
Dr. Schrader'la mutlaka tanisirsin.
Harika bir ogretmendir.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>And London is a big place, so you'll meet
plenty of new people. I think you'll enjoy it.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ve Londra buyuk bir yer, bu yuzden
bir suru yeni insanla tanisirsin. Bence hosuna gidecek.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Thank you, Mr Collins.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Tesekkur ederim, Bay Collins.

original:
<T>Good luck in London, Layton. Come back
and visit us when you've become a famous
archaeologist!
translation:
<T>Londra'da bol sans, Layton. Unlu bir
arkeolog oldugunda geri don
ve bizi ziyaret et!

original: グロリア
translation: Gloria

original:
<T>Ah, Hershel, lad. Leaving for London,
I hear!
translation:
<T>Ah, Hershel delikanli. Londra'ya
gidiyormussun, oyle duydum!

original:
<T>It's going to be sad not having you around
here any more.
translation:
<T>Senin artik buralarda
olmayacak olman uzucu olacak.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M1/2/3>Oh, er... Thank you.
translation: <T><M1/2/3>Sey... Tesekkur ederim.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>Why the long face? I doubt Randall would
want to see you like that, you know. {''}Chin
up, Hershel!{''}, he'd say.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Niye suratin asik? Randall'in seni boyle
gormek isteyecegini sanmam, bilirsin. {''}Basini
dik tut, Hershel!{''}, derdi.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Yes, you're right.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Evet, haklisin.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I know Mr Ascot gave you a hard time, but
it's only because he's heartbroken and he's
not thinking straight.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bay Ascot'un sana zorluk cikardigini biliyorum ama
bu sadece yuregi yandigi icin; su an
saglikli dusunemiyor.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You are not to blame, Hershel. You hear
me?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Suclu sen degilsin, Hershel. Duyuyor
musun?

original: <T>I...<W> Thank you, Gloria.
translation: <T>Ben...<W> Tesekkur ederim, Gloria.

original:
<T>Don't forget to write to us from London, will
you?
translation:
<T>Londra'dan bize yazmayi unutma,
tamam mi?

original: ヤングダルストン
translation: Genc Dalston

original:
<T>Oi, Layton. Have you seen Angela lately?<W>
No, me neither. I don't think she's even left
her house since...
translation:
<T>Hey, Layton. Angela'yi son zamanlarda gordun mu?<W>
Hayir, ben de gormedim. Sanirim
o gunden beri evinden bile cikmadi...

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Ascot's dad is on the warpath. He fired
Henry for not stopping that idiot from going
into the ruins.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Ascot'un babasi kuplere binmis. O aptalin
harabelere girmesini durdurmadi diye
Henry'yi kovdu.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M6/2/3>But it's my fault... I'm the one who could
have saved him and didn't.
translation:
<T><M6/2/3>Ama bu benim sucum... Onu
kurtarabilecek olan bendim ve yapmadim.

original:
<T>Come on, Layton. Do you really think you
could've stopped Ascot going into those
ruins once he'd made up his mind?
translation:
<T>Hadi ama, Layton. Gercekten
Ascot harabelere gitmeye karar verdiginde
onu durdurabilecegini mi saniyorsun?

original: <T>No one could. It was just rotten luck.
translation: <T>Kimse durduramazdi. Tamamen sanssizlikti.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>And now you're off to London, right? Don't
blame you. I hear old Ascot's been giving
you a hard time.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Simdi de Londra'ya gidiyorsun, degil mi? Seni
suclamiyorum. Duyduguma gore yasli Ascot
sana epey zorluk cikariyormus.

original:
<T><M1/2/3>My parents just thought it would be too
much for me to stay here what with...
everything.
translation:
<T><M1/2/3>Ailem, burada kalmanin
bunca seyden sonra bana fazla
gelecegini dusundu...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hey, Layton. Do you...<W> Do you think there's
any chance that Ascot is...<W>still alive?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hey, Layton. Sence...<W> Sence
Ascot'un...<W> hala hayatta olma ihtimali var mi?

original:
<T>Dalston, I saw him fall into a ravine so deep
I couldn't even see the bottom.
translation:
<T>Dalston, onu oyle derin bir ucuruma duserken gordum ki
dibini bile goremedim.

original:
<T>And none of the search teams have found
anything. <W><M6/2/3>So I can only conclude...
translation:
<T>Ve arama ekipleri hicbir sey
bulamadi. <W><M6/2/3>Bu yuzden ancak su sonuca varabiliyorum...

original:
<T>Sorry I said anything. I just thought...<W> Well,
I hope things work out for you in London.
translation:
<T>Bir sey dedigim icin kusura bakma. Sadece dusundum...<W> Sey,
Londra'da isler senin icin yoluna girer umarim.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Randall does something stupid and now the
whole town's down in the dumps.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Randall aptalca bir sey yapti ve simdi
tum kasaba moral bozuklugu icinde.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Silly fool. Why'd he have to go off and do
something like that?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Ahmak herif. Neden gidip
boyle bir sey yapmak zorundaydi?

original: ヤングダルストン
translation: Genc Dalston

original:
<T>Layton? What are you doing out here at this
time?
translation:
<T>Layton? Bu saatte burada
ne yapiyorsun?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>I just needed some fresh air.
translation: <T>Biraz temiz hava almam gerekiyordu.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Hey, it was around this time of night when
you came back that time and told us about
Ascot...
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Hey, o gece de bu saatlerde
geri gelip bize
Ascot'tan bahsetmistin...

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Everyone was stunned. Now, come nightfall,
they all just stay home, locked away, as
though they're hiding from something.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Herkes sok olmustu. Simdi gece olunca,
hepsi evine kapanip kilitleniyor,
sanki bir seyden saklanir gibi.

original:
<T><M1/2/3>Well, what do you expect? It's a hard time
for everyone.
translation:
<T><M1/2/3>Ne bekliyorsun ki? Zor bir donem
herkes icin.

original:
<T><M1/1/3>Hmph. Ascot reaped what he sowed. No
matter what they say about Henry plotting
the whole thing, or you encouraging him...
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Hih. Ascot ektigini bicti. Ne
derlerse desinler, Henry'nin her seyi planladigini
ya da senin onu kiskirttigini...

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Ascot was a pig-headed brat, and what
happened to him was his own fault. No one
else's.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ascot inatci bir veletmis; basina gelenler
kendi sucuydu.
Baskasinin degil.

original: <T>He was very strong-willed...
translation: <T>Cok inatciydi...

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Look, I didn't hate him and I feel really
lousy about the whole thing. But it was his
call. You know that.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bak, ondan nefret etmiyordum ve bu isten
gercekten kotu hissediyorum. Ama karar
onundu. Biliyorsun.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Yeah, I know.<W> Thanks, Dalston.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Evet, biliyorum.<W> Tesekkurler, Dalston.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hey. Sorry, I don't know what else to say
about Ascot... I'm not great with words.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hey. Kusura bakma, Ascot hakkinda baska
ne diyecegimi bilmiyorum... Sozcuklerle aram iyi degildir.

original: ダンフィン
translation: Dunfin

original:
<T>Old Ascot's search teams went out again
today.
translation:
<T>Yasli Ascot'un arama ekipleri bugun de
yine yola cikti.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>There seem to be more of them every day.
translation: <T>Her gun daha da cogaliyor gibiler.

original:
<T>He's just going to keep hiring more and
more people until Randall is found. Not
that I can blame him!
translation:
<T>Randall bulunana kadar daha da
fazla insan ise almaya devam edecek. Onu
suclayamam!

original:
<T><M2/1/2>It can't be good for his business, though.
I hope they find the boy before the money
runs out.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Yine de bu isine iyi gelmez.
Umarim para
tukenmeden cocugu bulurlar.

original: <T><M1/1/2>Even if all they find is his body...
translation: <T><M1/1/2>Bulduklari tek sey cesedi olsa bile...

original: <T>Uncle Douglas, please.
translation: <T>Douglas Amca, lutfen.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I'm sorry, Hershel, I'm just talking nonsense.<W>
Let's just hope for the best.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Uzgunum, Hershel, sacmaliyorum.<W>
Hadi en iyisini umalim.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>The town doesn't feel the same any more.<W>
That boy was the life of Stansbury.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Kasaba artik eskisi gibi degil.<W>
O cocuk Stansbury'nin nesesiydi.

original: ライオネル
translation: Lionel

original: <T>'Ullo, lad. Nice weather, isn't it?
translation: <T>Selam, delikanli. Hava guzel, degil mi?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Hello, Lionel.
translation: <T>Merhaba, Lionel.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>The anemones are out in me mum's garden.
Want to come and 'ave a look?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Anemonlar annemin bahcesinde acti.
Gelip bir bakmak ister misin?

original:
<T><M1/2/3>Thank you, maybe I will sometime. I'm not
really in the mood at the moment...
translation:
<T><M1/2/3>Tesekkur ederim, belki bir ara gelirim. Su an
pek havamda degilim...

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Ah well, fair enough. Angela used to love
the anemones, she did...
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Eh, peki. Angela anemon ciceklerini
cok severdi...

original: <T>Sorry. I'm sure they're beautiful.
translation: <T>Uzgunum. Eminim cok guzellerdir.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Eh, no worries. Come whenever you can.
And if you can't, there's always next year!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Eh, sorun degil. Ne zaman gelebilirsen gel.
Gelemezsen de, seneye her zaman var!

original:
<T>Don't forget about us 'ere in Stansbury
while you're off learning things in London,
eh?
translation:
<T>Londra'da bir seyler ogrenirken burada
Stansbury'deki bizi unutma,
tamam mi?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>Ah, Henry...
translation: <T>Ah, Henry...

original: ヤングヘンリー
translation: Genc Henry

original:
<T>Good afternoon. <W>Is it true that you're going
to London?
translation:
<T>Iyi gunler. <W>Londra'ya
gideceginiz dogru mu?

original:
<T>Yes, I'm going to Gressenheller University to
study archaeology.
translation:
<T>Evet, arkeoloji okumak icin
Gressenheller Universitesi'ne gidiyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>But what about Master Randall? What if
he's still alive somewhere in the Akbadain
ruins and needs our help?
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Peki ya Randall Bey? Ya
Akbadain harabelerinde bir yerde hala
hayattaysa ve yardima ihtiyaci varsa?

original:
<T><M2/2/3>Henry, I...<W>I just can't imagine that...<W> It was
such a deep pit. I couldn't even see the
bottom.
translation:
<T><M2/2/3>Henry, ben...<W>Bunu hayal bile edemiyorum...<W> Oyle
derin bir cukurdu ki dibini bile
goremedim.

original:
<T><M6/2/3>I don't see how he could have survived such
a fall.
translation:
<T><M6/2/3>Boylesi bir dususten nasil sag cikabildigini
anlayamiyorum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I see. <W>Well, I'm not giving up. I know we'll
find him.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Anliyorum. <W>Ama vazgecmiyorum. Onu
bulacagiz.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Enjoy your life in London.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Londra'da hayatinin tadini cikar.

original: <T>Um...<W> Thank you.
translation: <T>Sey...<W> Tesekkur ederim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Master Randall is alive, and we're going to
find him. I'm sure of it.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Randall Bey hayatta ve biz onu
bulacagiz. Bundan eminim.

original: ヤングヘンリー
translation: Genc Henry

original:
<T>Master Randall used to sneak out at night,
without his father knowing.
translation:
<T>Randall Bey babasi fark etmeden
geceleri gizlice disari cikardi.

original:
<T><M2/1/2>And when Mrs Ascot found out, she felt
bound to tell Mr Ascot, so I was always
treading on eggshells.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Bayan Ascot ogrenince Bay Ascot'a
soylemek zorunda hissetti, ben de hep
kirilacakmis gibi temkinliydim.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Standing here now, I feel as if Randall could
come back at any moment. He'll just come
over the hill with Angela...
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Simdi burada durunca, Randall her an
geri donecekmis gibi geliyor. Angela'yla
tepenin ardindan cikip gelecek...

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M1/2/3>Henry, Randall is...
translation: <T><M1/2/3>Henry, Randall...

original: <T><M1/1/1>Lost. He is lost. Nothing more.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Kayip. O kayip. Hepsi bu.

original:
<T><M6/2/3>I should have stopped him. But he was so
adamant about exploring those ruins...
translation:
<T><M6/2/3>Onu durdurmaliydim. Ama o harabeleri kesfetme
konusunda cok kararliydi...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I know Master Randall will come back. He'd
never break a promise.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Randall Bey'in geri donecegini biliyorum. O
asla sozunu bozmaz.

original:
<T><M1/1/2>My main concern at present is Mr and
Mrs Ascot. They are taking it all very hard.
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Su an asil endisem Bay ve
Bayan Ascot. Her seyi cok agir yasiyorlar.

original: ローラン
translation: Rolan

original: <T><M3/1/1>Hullo, son. Are you all packed?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Selam, evlat. Her seyi topladin mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Have you got all you need for your first
week of lectures? We can bring some more
things later on.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ilk ders haftan icin gereken her seyin
hazir mi? Sonra biraz daha
esya getirebiliriz.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T>I think so. <W>Thanks, Pa.
translation: <T>Sanirim oyle. <W>Tesekkurler, baba.

original:
<T>Randall would be tickled pink about you
going to Gressenheller, you know. He'd not
want to see you looking so glum!
translation:
<T>Gressenheller'e gidecek olman Randall'i
cok sevindirirdi, bilirsin. Seni
boyle somurturken gormek istemezdi!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Yes, you're right.<W> I just want to fulfil his
dream, Pa. Because he can't... But I want
to do it right.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Evet, haklisin.<W> Ben sadece onun
hayalini gerceklestirmek istiyorum, baba. Cunku
o yapamaz... Ama bunu dogru yapmak istiyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I know, Hershel. You're a good boy. Or
should I say a fine young man? We're very
proud of you, your mother and I.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Biliyorum, Hershel. Iyi bir cocuksun. Ya da
yakisikli bir genc mi demeliyim? Annenle ben
seninle cok gurur duyuyoruz.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Th-thanks, Pa.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Te-tesekkurler, baba.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Just keep looking to the future, son. You
have your whole life ahead of you. Don't
dwell on the past.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sadece gelecege bak, evlat. Onunde koskoca
bir hayat var. Gecmise
takilip kalma.

original: ローラン
translation: Rolan

original:
<T>Can't sleep, Hershel? Why don't you go for
a walk?
translation:
<T>Uyuyamiyor musun, Hershel? Neden
bir yuruyuse cikmiyorsun?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M1/2/3>Mm. I suppose a walk might help...
translation: <T><M1/2/3>Hmm. Sanirim biraz yurumek iyi gelebilir...

original: <T>It's a lovely mild night. It'll do you good.
translation: <T>Ne guzel, ilik bir gece. Sana iyi gelir.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>I'll go with you if you like. We can go up the
hill and look at the stars.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Istersen seninle gelirim. Tepeye cikip
yildizlara bakariz.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>No, thanks, it's okay. It's late, so I think I'll
just go to bed.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Yok, tesekkurler, gerek yok. Gec oldu, ben
yatsam iyi olacak.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>All right, son. But you should go out and
get some fresh air sometime. It's not good
to be cooped up all day and night.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Peki, evlat. Ama ara sira disari cikip
biraz temiz hava almalisin. Gece gunduz
evde tikili kalmak iyi degil.

original: <T><M1/1/1>I know, Pa. I will.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Biliyorum, baba. Yapacagim.

original:
<T>We should all go up on the hill and have
one last picnic together before you go off
to London!
translation:
<T>Londra'ya gitmeden once hepimiz tepeye
cikip birlikte
son bir piknik yapmaliyiz!

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Hershel, I'm making your favourite for
supper tonight - shepherd's pie!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hershel, bu aksam yemege senin favorini
yapiyorum - coban turtasi!

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original: <T><M1/2/3>Oh. Thanks, Ma, but I'm not very hungry.
translation: <T><M1/2/3>Ah. Tesekkurler, anne, ama pek ac degilim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Oh, rhubarb! You have to eat, dear. You
can't just let yourself waste away.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ah, aman! Yemelisin, canim. Kendini
boyle eriyip gitmeye birakamazsin.

original:
<T>Listen, Hershel, I know how awful you must
feel at the moment, but these things take
time.
translation:
<T>Dinle, Hershel, su an ne kadar kotu
hissettigini biliyorum ama boyle seyler
zaman alir.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>You just need to keep putting one foot in
front of the other.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Sadece bir ayagini
otekisinin onune koymaya devam etmen gerek.

original: <T>Yes, Ma, I know.
translation: <T>Evet, anne, biliyorum.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Are you hungry, dear? We need to get your
strength up before your big move to
London.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ac misin, canim? Londra'ya
tasinmandan once gucunu
toplamamiz gerek.

original: ルシール
translation: Lucille

original:
<T>Hmm, so what should I make for dinner
tomorrow? I could do a roast chicken. Or
pork chops, maybe?
translation:
<T>Hmm, yarin aksam yemegine ne yapsam?
Firinda tavuk yapabilirim. Ya da
belki domuz pirzolasi?

original: <T><M2/2/1>Hershel, is there anything you fancy?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Hershel, canin bir sey ister mi?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>Ma, we've just had dinner, and you're
already thinking about what to cook
tomorrow?
translation:
<T>Anne, daha yeni aksam yemegi yedik ve
simdiden yarin ne
pisirecegini mi dusunuyorsun?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Well, it's hard work planning interesting
meals to keep your family happy.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sey, aileni mutlu etmek icin ilginc
yemekler planlamak zor is.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Especially when one of them does nothing
but push his food around his plate.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hele de biri tabagindaki yemegi
sadece itip duruyorsa.

original: <T><M1/2/3>I know. I'm sorry, Ma.
translation: <T><M1/2/3>Biliyorum. Uzgunum, anne.

original:
<T>How's your packing going, Hershel? Have
you sorted out all the books you need for
London?
translation:
<T>Toparlanman nasil gidiyor, Hershel? Londra icin
gereken butun kitaplari
hazirladin mi?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T>The school is closed at this time. Why am
I even trying to go in?
translation:
<T>Okul su anda kapali. Neden
iceri girmeye calisiyorum ki?

original: グロリア
translation: Gloria

original: <T>What on earth is going on?
translation: <T>Ne oluyor boyle?

original:
<T><M2/1/2>First there was sand everywhere, then the
ground started shaking! There I was thinking,
{''}This is it, girl!{''}
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Once her yer kum oldu, sonra
yer sarsilmaya basladi! Icimden,
{''}Iste bu, kizim!{''} diyordum.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Are you all right, Gloria? You're not hurt,
are you?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Iyi misin, Gloria? Yaralanmadin,
degil mi?

original:
<T><M11/1/1>No, no, I'm fine. It's just that after what
happened to Stansbury, I hoped I'd never
see another town fall into ruin...
translation:
<T><M11/1/1>Hayir, hayir, iyiyim. Sadece Stansbury'de
olanlardan sonra bir daha baska bir kasabanin
yikima suruklendigini gormemeyi ummustum...

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I'm not going to last much longer, so I don't
fancy moving again. I'd just as soon stay
here and be buried in the sand!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Daha fazla dayanabilecegimi sanmiyorum, o yuzden
bir daha tasinmak istemiyorum. En iyisi burada
kalip kumlara gomulmek!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Please don't say that, Gloria. You have
many years ahead of you! I'm glad to find
you safe and well.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Lutfen boyle soyleme, Gloria. Onunde
daha uzun yillar var! Seni
sag salim gormek beni sevindirdi.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Hmm. You keep yourself safe too, lad,
you hear me?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Himm. Sen de kendine dikkat et, delikanli,
anladin mi?

original:
<T>I'd never felt an earthquake before. Why,
it's unheard of in this part of the world!
What could have caused it?
translation:
<T>Daha once hic deprem hissetmemistim. Hem de
buralarda gorulmemis bir sey!
Buna ne sebep olmus olabilir?

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>The Masked Gentleman has been our
biggest case ever!
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi simdiye kadarki
en buyuk davamiz oldu!

original:
<T>Monte d'Or grew so quickly that the police
was forced to keep taking on new recruits
all the time.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or o kadar hizli buyudu ki polis
surekli yeni
acemi personel almak zorunda kaldi.

original:
<T>Everyone was new, so none of us really
had a clue what we were doing, to be
honest.
translation:
<T>Herkes yeniydi, dogrusu hicbirimiz
ne yaptigimizi
pek bilmiyorduk.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>That certainly sounds problematic...
translation: <T>Bu gercekten sorunlu gorunuyor...

original:
<T>But it seems Detective Bloom has found
some promising clues, so hopefully this will
all be over soon.
translation:
<T>Ama gorunen o ki Dedektif Bloom
umut verici bazi ipuclari bulmus, umarim
her sey yakinda biter.

original:
<T>Leave security to us!<W> That way, you can
concentrate on looking for clues.
translation:
<T>Guvenligi bize birakin!<W> Boylece siz
ipucu aramaya odaklanabilirsiniz.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Ah, Professor Layton! We're getting the
citizens to safety, so you can catch that
masked rascal.
translation:
<T>Ah, Profesor Layton! Vatandaslari guvene
aliyoruz, siz de o
maskeli serseriyi yakalayin diye!

original:
<T>Who would've thunk it, though? That the
Masked Gentleman would be mixed up with
the Ledores...
translation:
<T>Ama kim dusunurdu? Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
Ledore'larla
isi olacagini...

original:
<T>Surely Mr Ledore can't have been behind
the whole thing, can he?
translation:
<T>Bay Ledore butun bunlarin arkasinda
olamaz, degil mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>No, he's entirely innocent. I believe there
has been a...misunderstanding between him
and the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Hayir, o tamamen masum. Bence onunla
Maskeli Beyefendi arasinda bir... yanlis
anlasilma olmus.

original:
<T>One which I intend to resolve as quickly as
possible. I am grateful for the cooperation
of the Monte d'Or police.
translation:
<T>Bunu mumkun oldugunca cabuk
cozmeye niyetliyim. Monte d'Or polisinin
is birligi icin minnettarim.

original: <T>Just doing our job, Professor!
translation: <T>Sadece isimizi yapiyoruz, Profesor!

original:
<T>We will keep the citizens of Monte d'Or safe
and sound, don't you worry.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or halkini sag salim
koruyacagiz, merak etmeyin.

original:
<T>Leave security to us, Professor!<W> We're
counting on you to catch the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Guvenligi bize birakin, Profesor!<W> Sizin
Maskeli
Beyefendi'yi yakalamaniza guveniyoruz.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original: <T>【[仮/かり]】ジロウテキスト
translation: <T>【[Gecici]】Jiro metni

original: <T>【[仮/かり]】アフター
translation: <T>【[Gecici]】Sonrasi

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>I've been protecting the people of Monte
d'Or alongside Chief Inspector Sheffield ever
since our police force was founded.
translation:
<T>Polis teskilatimiz kuruldugundan beri Monte
d'Or halkini Basmufettis Sheffield'la birlikte
koruyorum.

original:
<T>He's a good man, completely dedicated to
his job, but...<W> Well, let's just say he's
very zealous when pursuing criminals.
translation:
<T>Iyi bir adam, isine tamamen
adanmis ama...<W> Sey, suclularin pesine duserken
fazlasiyla hirslidir diyelim.

original:
<T>With both Sheffield and Grosky charging
around, I wouldn't fancy being in the
Masked Gentleman's shoes right now!
translation:
<T>Sheffield ile Grosky ortaligi birbirine katarken
su an
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin yerinde olmak istemezdim!

original:
<T>By the way, Detective Bloom is nowhere to
be found. Have you seen him lately?
translation:
<T>Bu arada Dedektif Bloom ortalarda
yok. Onu son zamanlarda gordunuz mu?

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T>Chief Inspector Sheffield sent me to the
Ledore house. There was so much sand,
I thought I was done for.
translation:
<T>Basmufettis Sheffield beni
Ledore malikanesine gonderdi. O kadar cok kum vardi ki,
isim bitti sandim.

original:
<T>And I've seen plenty of sand in my time,
living out here in the desert. Imagine how
the tourists must feel...
translation:
<T>Ustelik colde yasadigim icin hayatimda cok kum gordum,
turistlerin nasil hissettigini
dusunsenize...

original:
<T>The chief inspector and Grosky are both out
there, but I don't know if they're any closer
to catching their mark.
translation:
<T>Basmufettis de Grosky de oradalar ama
hedeflerini
yakalamaya yaklastilar mi bilmiyorum.

original:
<T>By the way, Detective Bloom is nowhere to
be found. Have you seen him lately?
translation:
<T>Bu arada Dedektif Bloom ortalarda
yok. Onu son zamanlarda gordunuz mu?

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original:
<T>A paragon day, my friends. Today, it is I
who seeks you! <W>Oh, I am gladdened to find
you safe from the sand!
translation:
<T>Harikulade bir gun, dostlarim. Bugun sizi arayan
benim! <W>Ah, sizi kumlardan
sag salim kurtulmus bulduguma sevindim!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Thank you. It's good to see you safe as
well, Aldus.
translation:
<T>Tesekkurler. Seni de sag salim
gormek guzel, Aldus.

original:
<T>Oh, capital gentleman, your concern for my
well-being is lovingly appreciated! <W>The only
damage was sand in my moustache.
translation:
<T>Ah, mukemmel beyefendi, halim hatirim icin
kayginizi ictenlikle takdir ediyorum! <W>Tek
zararim biyigima kacan kumdu.

original:
<T>I feared the sand would quickly swallow our
precious town up, but no! It rose like a
blooming flower and disaster was averted!
translation:
<T>Kumlarin sevgili kasabamizi hizla yutacagindan
korktum, ama hayir! Bir cicek gibi yukseldi
ve felaket onlendi!

original:
<T>Now tell me my friends - what is this if not
a true miracle?
translation:
<T>Soyleyin dostlarim; bu, gercek bir mucize degilse
nedir?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T>You can say that again...<W> Oh, rats! I didn't
take any pictures!
translation:
<T>Aynen oyle...<W> Ah, tuh! Hic
fotograf cekmemisim!

original:
<T>Should I pose for the young lady? The
ordinary man, survivor of calamities, witness
to miraculous happenings!
translation:
<T>Genc hanimefendi icin poz mu vereyim?
Siradan adam; felaketlerden sag cikan,
mucizelere taniklik eden!

original:
<T>Alas, no, I forget my purpose here. There is
one last titbit of information I must give you.
translation:
<T>Ah, hayir, asil isimi unutuyorum. Size
verecegim son bir bilgi kirintisi var.

original: <T>What is it, Aldus?
translation: <T>Nedir, Aldus?

original: <T>Now, are you giving me your full attention?
translation: <T>Simdi, tum dikkatinizi bana veriyor musunuz?

original:
<T>Touch the writing desk in your hotel room
and you will be transported to Stansbury
of the past. A trip down memory lane!
translation:
<T>Otel odanizdaki yazi masasina dokunun
ve gecmisin Stansbury'sine
goturuleceksiniz. Ani yolculugu!

original:
<T>And to return? Merely touch the desk in
young Hershel's room. You will be whisked
right back to present-day Monte d'Or!
translation:
<T>Geri donmek icin mi? Genc Hershel'in odasindaki
masaya dokunmaniz yeter. Sizi
hemen gunumuz Monte d'Or'una geri goturur!

original:
<T>Oh, and there is one other thing: you may
touch the bed in either room to pass the
time from day to night.
translation:
<T>Ah, bir sey daha var: Iki odadan birindeki
yataga dokunarak zamani
gunduzden geceye cevirebilirsiniz.

original:
<T>I see... So we can go back and check for
anything we might have left undone!
translation:
<T>Anliyorum... Yani geri donup
yarim biraktigimiz bir sey var mi bakabiliriz!

original:
<T>Precisely, my friend! You are truly
a gentleman of great intellect.
translation:
<T>Aynen oyle, dostum! Gercekten
buyuk zekaya sahip bir beyefendisiniz.

original: <T>So long, my friends. Until we meet again!
translation: <T>Hosca kalin, dostlarim. Yeniden gorusene dek!

original:
<T>Let's try that when we get back to the
Camel's Hump.
translation:
<T>Camel's Hump'a dondugumuzde
bunu deneyelim.

original:
<T>My friends! How kind it is of you to enquire
after me again!
translation:
<T>Dostlarim! Halimi hatirimi
yeniden sormaniz ne kadar nazik!

original:
<T>Now then, have you retained my succulent
titbit of wisdom from earlier? No?
translation:
<T>Peki, biraz onceki leziz
bilgelik kirintimi hatirladiniz mi? Hayir mi?

original: <T>I see. Thank you for the explanation.
translation: <T>Anliyorum. Aciklama icin tesekkur ederim.

original:
<T>It is very much the contrary, sir. I should
be thanking you for your most wonderful
friendship!
translation:
<T>Tam tersi, efendim. Asil ben
sizin bu harika
dostlugunuz icin tesekkur etmeliyim!

original: ゴンゾ
translation: Gonzo

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Welcome, sir. May I prepare something for
you to eat?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hos geldiniz, efendim. Size
yiyecek bir sey hazirlayayim mi?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Ah, no, thank you. We don't wish to disturb.
translation: <T>Ah, hayir, tesekkurler. Rahatsiz etmek istemeyiz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I see. It's just that I so rarely get the
opportunity to entertain. Most people in
town think Mr Dalston rather strange.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Anliyorum. Sadece misafir agirlama
firsatim pek olmuyor. Kasabadaki cogu kisi
Bay Dalston'i biraz tuhaf buluyor.

original:
<T>And what few acquaintances he has don't
visit much. I sometimes wonder if he doesn't
get very lonely.
translation:
<T>Zaten sahip oldugu az sayidaki tanidigi da pek
ugramaz. Bazen
cok yalniz kalip kalmadigini merak ediyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Please stop by whenever there's a lull in
your investigation. I know Mr Dalston would
appreciate it.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sorusturmanda bir duraklama olunca
lutfen ugra. Bay Dalston'in bunu cok
takdir edecegini biliyorum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Of course. Dalston is an old friend. I'll
come back when I can.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Elbette. Dalston eski bir dost. Firsat buldukca
geri gelecegim.

original:
<T>You have to really know a person to see
through their faults and realise their true
qualities.
translation:
<T>Birini gercekten tanimalisin ki kusurlarinin
otesini gorup gercek
niteliklerini anlayabilesin.

original:
<T>I wish others would take the time to get to
know Mr Dalston better...
translation:
<T>Keske digerleri Bay Dalston'i
daha iyi tanimak icin zaman ayirsa...

original: ゴンゾ
translation: Gonzo

original:
<T>I saw a wave of sand coming, and then - I
could not believe my eyes - Mr Dalston
dashed out of the house!
translation:
<T>Bir kum dalgasi geldigini gordum, sonra da -
gozlerime inanamadim - Bay Dalston
evden firladi!

original:
<T>What could have caused him to perform
such a reckless act?!
translation:
<T>Onu boyle pervasiz bir sey
yapmaya ne suruklemis olabilir?!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>If you're looking for Dalston, I believe we
last saw him at the gallery plaza.
translation:
<T>Dalston'i ariyorsaniz en son onu
galeri meydaninda gordugumuzu saniyorum.

original:
<T>The plaza? But it offers no protection
against the sand at all. Why would he go
there?
translation:
<T>Meydan mi? Ama kuma karsi hic
koruma saglamaz. Neden
oraya gitsin ki?

original:
<T>An old friend of ours is there. Please don't
worry. Dalston is perfectly safe.
translation:
<T>Orada eski bir dostumuz var. Lutfen
endiselenmeyin. Dalston tamamen guvende.

original: <T>A-an old friend? Well, if you say so, sir.
translation: <T>E-eski bir dost mu? Madem oyle diyorsunuz, efendim.

original:
<T>But please do come and visit us once this is
all over. It would give Mr Dalston such
pleasure.
translation:
<T>Ama lutfen her sey bitince bize
ugrayin. Bu Bay Dalston'i
cok mutlu eder.

original:
<T>This old friend of Mr Dalston's that you
spoke of... What sort of person is he,
I wonder?
translation:
<T>Sozunu ettiginiz Bay Dalston'in su eski
dostu... Nasil biri acaba,
merak ediyorum.

original: マーフィー
translation: Murphy

original:
<T>Ah, good day! It seems I'm a veritable
handbook of quantitative information this
week! Yes, indeed!
translation:
<T>Ah, iyi gunler! Gorunuse gore bu hafta
sayisal bilgilerin adeta yuruyen el kitabiyim!
Evet, kesinlikle!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Hello, Murphy.
translation: <T>Merhaba, Murphy.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yes, yes! I've just been here watching
Mr Ledore's fortune grow.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet, evet! Burada sadece
Bay Ledore'un servetinin buyumesini izliyordum.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Well, that's good news for Henry.
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Bu, Henry icin iyi haber.

original:
<T>And since I manage his wealth, I feel
immensely gratified every time it increases!
translation:
<T>Ve madem servetini ben yonetiyorum,
her arttiginda buyuk bir memnuniyet duyuyorum!

original: <T><M2/2/1>Then, it is also good news for you.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>O zaman bu, senin icin de iyi haber.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Here's an idea. If you would entrust me with
your savings, I could make you rich! <W>How
about it?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bir fikrim var. Birikimlerini bana emanet edersen
seni zengin edebilirim! <W>Ne
dersin?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Oh, no, thank you. My finances don't really
require much management.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ah, hayir, tesekkurler. Mali durumum
pek bir yonetim gerektirmiyor.

original:
<T>No? Well, it's your loss. Or at least, lack of
gain. Heh heh.
translation:
<T>Hayir mi? Peki, bu senin kaybin. Ya da en azindan,
kazancsizlik. Heh heh.

original:
<T>Whenever Mr Ledore needs financial advice,
he comes straight to me.
translation:
<T>Bay Ledore ne zaman finansal tavsiye isterse,
dogruca bana gelir.

original:
<T>And as the year end results clearly show,
he's now one of the richest men in the
country!
translation:
<T>Ve yil sonu sonuclarinin acikca gosterdigi gibi,
artik ulkenin
en zengin adamlarindan biri!

original: マーフィー
translation: Murphy

original:
<T>This is unfortunate indeed! We've destroyed
the image of Monte d'Or as a safe holiday
spot!
translation:
<T>Bu gercekten talihsiz! Monte d'Or'un guvenli bir
tatil yeri imajini
yerle bir ettik!

original:
<T>We don't know how it will affect the next
financial report yet, but I fear business is
going to take a hit.
translation:
<T>Bir sonraki mali raporu nasil etkileyecegini
henuz bilmiyoruz ama islerin
darbe alacagindan korkuyorum.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>I think we avoided the worst, but it may be
some time before this town returns to its
former vibrancy.
translation:
<T>Sanirim en kotusunden kurtulduk ama
bu kasabanin eski canliligina
donmesi zaman alabilir.

original:
<T>Well, nothing is more fun than watching
a graph rise over time!
translation:
<T>Sey, zamanla yukselen bir grafigi izlemekten
daha eglenceli ne var!

original:
<T>Maybe it's time that the Ledore and Dalston
empires stopped fighting and joined for
greater glory!
translation:
<T>Belki de Ledore ve Dalston
imparatorluklarinin kavga etmeyi birakip
daha buyuk bir ihtisam icin birlesme zamani gelmistir!

original:
<T>I confess I've been looking for an
opportunity to propose just such a plan for
the past few calendar months now.
translation:
<T>Itiraf edeyim, boyle bir plani onermek icin
son birkac aydir
bir firsat kolluyordum.

original:
<T>If the two houses were united, Monte d'Or
could develop into a city of dreams that
shines over the whole world!
translation:
<T>Iki hanedan birlesseydi, Monte d'Or
tum dunyaya isik sacan
hayaller sehrine donusebilirdi!

original:
<T>I believe Monte d'Or can be rebuilt into a
real metropolis. And to think, a bit of sand
might have started it all.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'un gercek bir metropole
yeniden insa edilebilecegine inaniyorum. Dusunsene,
her seyi biraz kum baslatmis olabilir.

original: <T>It's a wonderful thing. Yes, sir, it is!
translation: <T>Harika bir sey. Evet efendim, oyle!

original: ニルス
translation: Nils

original:
<T>Hey. Still after that Masked Gentleman,
right?
translation:
<T>Hey. Hala su Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
pesindesin, degil mi?

original:
<T>So many people in Monte d'Or. Must be like
finding a needle in a haystack.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'da o kadar cok insan var ki,
samanlikta igne aramak gibi.

original:
<T>Plenty of people with grudges. Not just
Dalston. The stinking rich attract grudges.
That's how it is.
translation:
<T>Kin tutan cok insan var. Sadece
Dalston degil. Igrenc derecede zenginler kini
uzerine ceker. Iste boyle.

original:
<T>Monte d'Or is a desert town. Sun keeps
people inside most of the day. Comes alive
at night, though!
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or bir col kasabasi. Gunes
insanlari gunun cogunda iceride tutar. Ama
geceleri canlanir!

original: ニルス
translation: Nils

original:
<T>Got sand all over my new outfit. Thanks,
Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Yeni kiyafetim bastan asagi kuma bulandi. Sag ol,
Maskeli Beyefendi.

original:
<T>Heard a loud noise. Looked like the cliffs
were exploding. Not exactly a miracle.
translation:
<T>Yuksek bir gurultu duydum. Ucurumlar
patliyormus gibiydi. Pek mucize sayilmaz.

original:
<T>Hope everyone got indoors. Safe. It'd pretty
much kill the carnival if someone got hurt.
translation:
<T>Umarim herkes iceri girmistir, guvendedir. Biri
yaralansa karnavalin tadi kacar.

original:
<T>That Masked Gentleman. If he thinks those
tricks of his are miracles... <W>He's nutty.
translation:
<T>Su Maskeli Beyefendi. O numaralarinin
mucize oldugunu saniyorsa... <W>catlak bu.

translation: Layton

translation: コマーニ有

original: <T><M5/2/1>Ack! A<W>aa<W>aa<W>aargh!
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Ah! A<W>aa<W>aa<W>aaargh!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Ooh! That looks fun! Is this part of your
incredible escape act?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ooh! Bu eğlenceli görünüyor! Bu, senin
inanılmaz kaçış numaranın bir parçası mı?

original:
<T>It's not<W30> - Ooh! It's pinching! - <W30>not an act.
<W>Ow ow OWWWWW!
translation:
<T>Bu<W30> - Ooh! Sıkıştırıyor! - <W30>bir numara değil.
<W>Ah ah AAAAA!

original: <T><M3/1/1>Careful! You'll lose those balloons!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Dikkat! O balonları kaybedeceksin!

original: ジャグラー
translation: ジャグラー

original:
<T>Hullo! You two look like you're enjoying
yourselves. Mind if I join in?
translation:
<T>Merhaba! Siz ikiniz eğleniyor gibisiniz.
Katılsam sakıncası var mı?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Mister clown here has got all tangled up in
my balloons.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Şu palyaço bey benim balonlarıma
tamamen dolanmış.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh dear. Done it again, have you, Bungle?
What is it with you and balloons?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Aman. Yine mi yaptın, Bungle?
Balonlarla derdin ne senin?

original:
<T><M4/1/1>So, little jester, how about I entertain you
with a bit of fancy juggling while Bungle gets
your balloons sorted out for you?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Öyleyse küçük soytarı, Bungle balonlarını
senin için düzeltirken ben de sana biraz
hünerli jonglörlük gösterip eğlendireyim mi?

original:
<T>Bungle, you get yourself out of that mess
and give this young man back his
possessions, you hear?
translation:
<T>Bungle, o karmaşadan çık
ve bu gence
eşyalarını geri ver, duydun mu?

original:
<T>B<W20>-b<W20>-but wait...I can't! <W30>Ha ha ha, that
tickles!<W30> Wait, are you listening?
translation:
<T>B<W20>-b<W20>-bekle... Yapamıyorum! <W30>Ha ha ha, bu
gıdıklıyor!<W30> Hey, dinliyor musun?

original: <T><M3/2/1>Wow! That's amazing, mister!
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Vay canına! Bu harika, efendim!

original:
<T>Ha ha! Isn't it?<W> Oh, hold on to your
eyeballs. Wait till you see this one!
translation:
<T>Ha ha! Öyle değil mi?<W> Gözlerini dört aç.
Şunu görünce asıl şaşıracaksın!

original:
<T><M3/3/1>Whoaaa! That's so cool! How did you do
that?
translation:
<T><M3/3/1>Vaaay! Çok havalı! Bunu nasıl
yaptın?

original:
<T>Nggghhh... <W>Help! I'm flying away!<W> Hey,
listen! Quickly, get me down, before I-
<W>Help! <W>Heeeeeeeeeeeelp...
translation:
<T>Nggghhh... <W>Yardım! Uçup gidiyorum!<W> Hey,
dinle! Çabuk, beni indir, yoksa ben-
<W>Yardım! <W>Heeeeeeeeeeeelp...

original: ラプンシュカ
translation: ラプンシュカ

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Hello there! What can I do for you today?
We offer all kinds of attire, from fancy dress
to uniforms to national costumes.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Merhaba! Bugün sizin için ne yapabilirim?
Gösterişli elbiselerden
üniformalara ve ulusal kostümlere kadar her türlü kıyafetimiz var.

original: パンチョン
translation: パンチョン

original:
<T><M1/1/1>The name's Waltham. It should come as no
surprise to you that I have rather a lot of
cash at my disposal.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Adım Waltham. Epeyce
şaşırmamanız gerekir; çünkü
emrimde hatırı sayılır miktarda nakit var.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I want something majestic, something which
says power and influence, like, say...gold
cloth trimmed with diamonds!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Görkemli bir şey istiyorum; öyle bir şey ki
güç ve nüfuz desin; mesela... elmaslarla
süslenmiş altın kumaş!

original:
<T><M2/1/3>Gold cloth? Oh no, I'm afraid we don't have
anything quite so garish here. <M2/2/1>May I make
a suggestion?
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Altın kumaş mı? Ah hayır, ne yazık ki burada
bu kadar göz alıcı bir şeyimiz yok. <M2/2/1>Bir
öneride bulunabilir miyim?

original:
<T>Hrmph.<M2/1/1> It's certainly not my habit to allow
others to choose for me, but if you must...
translation:
<T>Hıh.<M2/1/1> Başkalarının benim adıma seçmesine
izin vermek alışkanlığım değildir, ama madem öyle...

original:
<T><M3/1/3>Well, you see, that pudding shape and tacky
gold tooth of yours do cramp your style
somewhat.
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>Şöyle ki, o puding gibi vücudunuz ve o zevksiz
altın dişiniz tarzınızı
biraz kısıtlıyor.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>But we could probably hide a lot of the extra
baggage inside a mascot suit.<W><M3/2/2> How about
this cuddly bear costume?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ama fazladan yükün çoğunu muhtemelen bir maskot
kostümünün içine saklayabiliriz.<W><M3/2/2> Şu sevimli
ayı kostümüne ne dersiniz?

original: <T><M2/2/1>B-baggage?! Are you calling me fat?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Y-yük mü?! Bana şişman mı diyorsunuz?

original:
<T><M2/2/3>I was referring to your overblown ego,
actually. I think a lovable bear costume
would mask it quite nicely.
translation:
<T><M2/2/3>Aslında kastettiğim, şişkin egonuzdu.
Sevimli bir ayı kostümünün
onu oldukça iyi gizleyeceğini düşünüyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/3>I imagine your little boy would've found it
very endearing. But you never did spend
much time with him, did you?
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Küçük oğlunuzun bunu çok seveceğini tahmin ediyorum.
Ama onunla
pek vakit geçirmediniz, değil mi?

original: <T><M2/2/2>Wha-<W20> How do you know that?
translation: <T><M2/2/2>Ne-<W20> Bunu nereden biliyorsunuz?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Heh heh. Very little goes on in this town that
Ludmilla doesn't know about, Mr Waltham.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Heh heh. Bu kasabada Ludmilla'nın bilmediği
çok az şey olur, Bay Waltham.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Now, here is my real suggestion to you:
discard your life of luxury and drop that silly
gold cloth and diamond nonsense.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>İşte size asıl önerim:
Lüks hayatınızı bir kenara bırakın ve şu aptalca
altın kumaşla elmas saçmalığından vazgeçin.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Discard my-?! What would a poor
shopkeeper like you know about my life?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Hayatımı bırakayım mı-?! Senin gibi zavallı bir
esnaf benim hayatım hakkında ne bilebilir ki?

original:
<T><M1/1/3>Money may buy you precious metals for
your fillings, Mr Waltham, but it won't
soothe heartache.
translation:
<T><M1/1/3>Para, Bay Waltham, dolgunuz için değerli metaller
satın aldırabilir, ama
yüreğinizdeki acıyı dindiremez.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>This is your chance to change your life and
go back to your loved ones. We are in the
City of Miracles, after all!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bu, hayatınızı değiştirip
sevdiklerinize geri dönmeniz için bir fırsat. Sonuçta biz
Mucizeler Şehri'ndeyiz!

original: <T><M1/1/2>Why, of all the...
translation: <T><M1/1/2>Yok artık...

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hrmph. <W><M2/1/1>Fine. I'm not wearing that ridiculous
bear costume, though.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hıh. <W><M2/1/1>Pekâlâ. Ama o saçma
ayı kostümünü giymem.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Oh, no, I have something even better in
mind! <M3/2/1>Just leave it to Ludmilla. <M3/2/2>They'll
barely recognise you!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Ah, hayır, aklımda daha da iyisi var!
<M3/2/1>Merak etmeyin, Ludmilla'ya bırakın. <M3/2/2>Sizi
tanımakta zorlanacaklar!

original: ダンチョー
translation: ダンチョー

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hah! We've sold out again tonight! Our little
Stellar Circus is really taking off.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hah! Bu gece yine tüm biletleri tükettik! Küçük
Stellar Sirki'miz gerçekten yükselişte.

original: コッペリア
translation: コッペリア

original:
<T><M1/2/1>We've got our Hannibal to thank for that.
He's the real star of the show. In't that
right, you big softie?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bunu Hannibal'a borçluyuz.
Gösterinin gerçek yıldızı o. Öyle değil mi,
iri yumuşak kalpli?

original: チルチル
translation: チルチル

original: <T><M1/1/1>Grrrrowl.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Grrrrowl.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Putting up those posters was a good idea.
No one could tell from that picture that he's
just a giant teddy bear.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>O afişleri asmak iyi fikirdi.
Kimse o resimden onun
kocaman bir oyuncak ayı olduğunu anlayamadı.

original: <T><M1/2/1>Grrrawr.
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Grrrawr.

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Ey, an' we're almost out of Hannibal soft
toys! Bungle did a dead good job with them
posters, didn't he?
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Hey, Hannibal peluş
oyuncakları da bitmek üzere! Bungle şu
afişlerle müthiş iş çıkardı, değil mi?

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Hah! I wonder. As far as I can tell, all that
twit does is spread ludicrous rumours.<M2/1/2>
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Hah! Bakalım. Benim gördüğüm kadarıyla o
aptalın yaptığı tek şey saçma sapan söylentiler yaymak.<M2/1/2>

original:
<T><M1/1/1>No, our success is due to the prowess of
our troupe and my strict training regime.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hayır, başarımız
ekibimizin ustalığına ve benim sıkı eğitim disiplinime borçlu.

original:
<T><M3/2/3>Though some of our members pull their
weight more than others. Hannibal is worth
a hundred of those ruddy rodents.<M3/1/3>
translation:
<T><M3/2/3>Yine de bazı üyelerimiz diğerlerinden daha çok
yük çekiyor. Hannibal, o lanet olası kemirgenlerin
yüz tanesine bedel.<M3/1/3>

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Now don't be so hard on them bunnies!
They just need a patient an' dedicated
trainer, that's all.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Şu tavşanlara bu kadar yüklenme!
Onların tek ihtiyacı sabırlı ve adanmış bir
antrenör, hepsi bu.

original:
<T>I bet that young lad'll manage to teach his
bunny a whole bag o' new tricks. You'll see!
translation:
<T>Bahse girerim o genç delikanlı
tavşanına bir sürü yeni numara öğretecek. Göreceksin!

original: <T><M2/2/1>Grrrow-ow-owl...
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Grrrow-ow-owl...

original:
<T><M3/2/2/45>Ooh, is it time for your beddy-byes, Hanny?
Off you go, then. We'd better get you rested
before the show.
translation:
<T><M3/2/2/45>Oo, uyku vakti mi geldi, Hanny?
Hadi bakalım, yat o zaman. Gösteriden önce
dinlenmiş olman gerek.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Grrrawr.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Grrrawr.

original: トリッキー
translation: トリッキー

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hey, boss! Did you take your tray of grub?
Because it ain't in the food tent.<M1/1/1/60>
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Hey, patron! Yemeğini aldın mı?
Çünkü yemek çadırında yok.<M1/1/1/60>

original:
<T><M3/1/3>Wh-what?! I knew it! That flaming Bungle's
at it again!
translation:
<T><M3/1/3>N-ne?! Biliyordum! Şu kahrolası Bungle
yine iş başında!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmm... <M2/1/1/>I did see him scoffing a bowl of
pudding a little while back.<M1/1/1/60>
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmm... <M2/1/1/>Az önce onun bir kase
pudingi tıkındığını gördüm.<M1/1/1/60>

original:
<T><M2/1/3>That's it! Next time I see him, that little twit
is going to get what's coming to him!
translation:
<T><M2/1/3>Yeter! Onu bir dahaki görüşümde, o küçük aptal
hak ettiğini bulacak!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Bungle, my friend, I think that might have
been the straw that broke the camel's
back...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bungle, dostum, sanırım bu
devenin belini kıran
son damla oldu...

original: ヤッタイ
translation: ヤッタイ

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Step right up, step right up! Soft toys,
wind-up toys, model toys! Jean-Paul's got
'em all, and they're cheap!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Yaklaşın, yaklaşın! Peluşlar,
kurmalı oyuncaklar, maket oyuncaklar! Jean-Paul'da
hepsi var, hem de ucuz!

original: マカロン
translation: マカロン

original: <T><M1/3/1>Aw, wey aye! <M1/2/1>Look at all the teddies!
translation: <T><M1/3/1>Vay canına! <M1/2/1>Şu peluş ayılara bak!

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Hello, little lady. Are you on your own?
<M1/3/2>Where's your mum and dad?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Merhaba küçük hanım. Yalnız mısın?
<M1/3/2>Annenle baban nerede?

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ah, I think me mam's gone and got lost
again.<M2/1/1> I've been lookin' for her for ages!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ah, galiba annem gidip kayboldu
yine.<M2/1/1> Onu asırlardır arıyorum!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>But me feet are propah killin', so I'm havin'
a break.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ama ayaklarım fena halde ağrıyor, o yüzden
bir mola veriyorum.

original:
<T><M1/3/2>Oh, I see. You've lost your mum. <M1/2/1>Well, not
to worry. Jean-Paul is here to help! Shall we
go and find her?<M2/2/1/45>
translation:
<T><M1/3/2>Anlıyorum. Anneni kaybetmişsin. <M1/2/1>Şey,
dert etme. Jean-Paul yardım etmek için burada! Hadi
gidip onu bulalım mı?<M2/2/1/45>

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh, but me mam said not to gan anywhere
with strangers.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ama annem yabancılarla hiçbir yere gitme
dedi.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>And you're a stranger, mistah! So if I gan
anywhere with ya, me mam'll be cross.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Ve siz de yabancısınız, bayım! O yüzden ben
sizinle bir yere gidersem annem kızar.

original:
<T><M1/3/2>Is that so? Well, in that case, you'd better
stay here until your mum comes back. You
can help me run the stall!
translation:
<T><M1/3/2>Öyle mi? O hâlde, bu durumda en iyisi
annen geri gelene kadar burada kal. Tezgâhı
işletmeme yardım edebilirsin!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Wey aye! I'm class at playin' shop, man.<W>
<M2/2/1>Teddies for sale! Cute teddies, soft teddies,
fuzzy-wuzzy teddies!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Olur ya! Dükkâncılık oynamakta çok iyiyim, valla.<W>
<M2/2/1>Peluşlar satılık! Şirin peluşlar, yumuşacık peluşlar,
pofuduk mufuduk peluşlar!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Ha ha! You do have a knack for this! How
about showing off these robots now?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Ha ha! Bunun için gerçekten yeteneğin var! Şimdi
şu robotları da övsene?

original:
<T><M2/3/1>Teddies for sale, teddies for sale!<W> White
teddies, brown teddies!<W> Pink teddies, blue
teddies!
translation:
<T><M2/3/1>Peluşlar satılık, peluşlar satılık!<W> Beyaz
peluşlar, kahverengi peluşlar!<W> Pembe peluşlar, mavi
peluşlar!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Ha ha... The bears are nice, but what about
the other toys? You have to show those off
too.<M2/2/1/45> How about this bunny?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ha ha... Ayılar güzel ama ya
Diğer oyuncaklar? Onları da öne çıkarmalısın
tabii.<M2/2/1/45> Şu tavşana ne dersin?

original:
<T><M3/3/1>But I like the teddies!<M2/2/1/45><W> Teddies for sale!
Teddies for sale! Fluffy teddies with propah
silky ears!
translation:
<T><M3/3/1>Ama ben peluşları seviyorum!<M2/2/1/45><W> Peluşlar satılık!
Peluşlar satılık! Fena pofuduk peluşlar, hem de
ipeksi kulaklı!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Heh heh! Well, I can't deny you have the
voice for this, little lady. You can have a job
here when you're older, if you like.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Heh heh! Doğrusu, bunun için
sesin çok uygun, küçük hanım. İstersen büyüyünce
burada işe bile girebilirsin.

original: タニア
translation: タニア

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Eee, Bonnie! There ya are! I've been lookin'
al' ower! How many times do I have to tell
ya not to gan off on your own?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aaa, Bonnie! İşte buradasın! Seni
her yerde aradım! Kaç kere sana
tek başına gitme diyeceğim?

original: <T><M1/3/1>Oh, hiya, Mammy!<M1/2/1>
translation: <T><M1/3/1>Aa, merhaba anne!<M1/2/1>

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Eee, pet, I'm really sorry! I hope me little
Bonnie hasn't been botherin' ya.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ay canım, çok özür dilerim! Umarım küçük
Bonnie seni rahatsız etmemiştir.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Hah! No worries. This little lady has been
helping me at the stall!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Hah! Hiç sorun değil. Bu küçük hanım
tezgâhta bana yardım etti!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Aye, that's right! I've been lookin' after all
the teddies!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Evet, doğru! Bütün
peluşlara göz kulak oldum!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>She's been a great help! In fact, please
accept this cute little bear with my thanks.
<M2/2/1/45>Stop by whenever you like!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Çok yardımcı oldu! Hatta, lütfen
teşekkür olarak şu şirin ayıcığı kabul edin.
<M2/2/1/45>Ne zaman isterseniz uğrayın!

original: <T><M3/2/1>Eee, really?! Are ya sure that's al' reet?
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Aaa, gerçekten mi?! Emin misiniz, olur mu öyle?

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Absolutely. Your little daughter was no
trouble at all.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Elbette. Küçük kızınız
hiç sorun olmadı.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Thank you sooo much, that's really kind!
<M1/1/1>Bonnie, say thank you to the nice man.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Çooook teşekkür ederim, çok naziksiniz!
<M1/1/1>Bonnie, kibar amcaya teşekkür et.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Thank yooou! Buh-bye, mistah!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Teşekküüürler! Hoşçaaakal, bayım!

original:
<T>What a spirited little tyke! She's going
places, that one.
translation:
<T>Ne afacan bir velet! Bu kız
ileride çok yol alacak.

original: <T><M2/2/1>Right, back to work, then.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Peki, o zaman işe geri dönelim.

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Step right up, step right up! Jean-Paul has
toys of every kind! Teddies, robots, teddies,
bunnies and more teddies!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Yaklaşın, yaklaşın! Jean-Paul'da
her tür oyuncak var! Peluşlar, robotlar, peluşlar,
tavşanlar ve daha bir sürü peluş!

original: ポリス
translation: ポリス

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Oi, Constable! <W>'Ow's patrol working out for
you?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Hey, Memur! <W>Devriye nasıl gidiyor
senin için?

original: ポリス②
translation: ポリス②

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Constable! Well, here's a turn up for the
books! Nothing to report on my end, I'm
afraid. You?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Memur! Vay canına, bu da nereden çıktı!
Benim tarafta rapor edecek bir şey yok\mmaalesef. Ya sende?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Not a sausage. I've been up and down
this street more times than you can shake
a truncheon at.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Tık yok. Bu caddede aşağı yukarı
o kadar gidip geldim ki,
cop sallayacak yer kalmadı.

original:
<T>And while we're out doing the rounds, the
chief's just having a go at the new blood!
translation:
<T>Biz devriye gezerken de
amir yeni gelenleri azarlayıp duruyor!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I told you! I told you they'd be at each
other's throats again, didn't I? No good will
come of relying on Scotland Yard.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sana demiştim! Yine birbirlerinin
boğazına sarılacaklar demiştim, değil mi? Scotland Yard'a güvenmekten
hayır gelmez.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>'Opeless, the lot of 'em. And that inspector,
the one with the chest 'air? Runs about like
a nutter but never turns up for duty.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Umutsuz, hepsi. Şu müfettiş var ya,
göğsü kıllı olan? Deli gibi
koşturur ama nöbete asla gelmez.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ah, you mean that musclehead Grosky.
Makes you wonder where he's off to in such
a hurry, doesn't it?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Ha, kas yığını Grosky'yi diyorsun.
Bu kadar aceleyle nereye gittiğini düşündürtüyor
insana, değil mi?

original: ポリス③
translation: ポリス③

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I should've known you two slackers would
be here. You're cruising for a bruising from
the guv if he finds out!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>İki kaytarıcının burada olacağını
tahmin etmeliydim. Amir öğrenirse
fena patlarsınız!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Oi, Constable! Oh come on, we ain't got
a choice, do we? There's nothing to do
seeing as we can't find a blinking lead.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Hey, Memur! Hadi ama,
seçeneğimiz yok ki, değil mi? Lanet bir ipucu bulamayınca
yapacak iş de kalmıyor.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I don't think that excuse is going to cut it
with the sarge. <W>Anyway, what are you doin'
here, Constable? Is our shift over already?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bu bahane tutmaz bence
çavuşun yanında. <W>Neyse, burada ne arıyorsun
Memur? Vardiyamız bitti mi yoksa?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Hah, you'll be lucky! Now that we've
finished our search, I've been assigned to
look after you two dunderheads!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Hah, daha neler! Şimdi
aramayı bitirdiğimize göre bana
siz iki budalayla ilgilenme görevi verildi!

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>You've finished the search? You made light
work of that, Constable! Did you find any
clues?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Aramayı bitirdin mi? Ne çabuk hallettin
işi, Memur! Hiç
ipucu buldun mu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Nothing out of the ordinary. And you know
what I think? I think this Masked Gentleman
of ours really did it.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sıradışı bir şey yok. Ama biliyor musun
ne düşünüyorum? Bence bizim şu Maskeli Beyefendi
gerçekten yaptı.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>You know, a bona fide miracle. Maybe that
mask is the real thing, too.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Yani, düpedüz bir mucize. Belki o
maske de gerçektir.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Oh, come off it, Constable! You believe in
that 'ocus-pocus? People don't just vanish
into thin air!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hadi canım, Memur! O
hokkabazlığa mı inanıyorsun? İnsanlar bir anda
buhar olup uçamaz!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Well, we'll find out when we catch him,
won't we?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Yakalayınca öğreneceğiz,
değil mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Did you see that gentleman with the top
hat? They say he'll stop at nothing to solve
this case.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Silindir şapkalı o beyefendiyi gördün mü?
Bu davayı çözmek için
hiçbir şeyden geri durmayacak diyorlar.

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Oh, him? DI Bloom says he's some
professor or other. I'm not convinced,
bringing civilians into police affairs...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Ha, onu mu? Komiser Bloom onun bir
profesör falan olduğunu söylüyor. Pek ikna olmadım,
sivilleri polis işine karıştırmak...

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>I beg your pardon, Constable. I think we
need all the 'elp we can get on this one.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Affedersiniz Memur. Bence bu işte
alabileceğimiz her türlü yardıma ihtiyacımız var.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Shh, shut your gobs! It's DI Bloom!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Şşşt, çenenizi kapatın! Komiser Bloom!

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Oh crumbs, we've been rumbled, ain't we?
Just throw a salute and scarper. Quick, like.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Eyvah, yakalandık değil mi?
Selam çakıp sıvışın. Çabuk, hadi.

original: ブルーマイル
translation: ブルーマイル

original:
<T>I'd say everything is under control...<W>
if I could only tell who was who.
translation:
<T>Her şey kontrol altında derdim...<W>
ama kim kimdi bir anlayabilsem.

original: オルトビルセン
translation: オルトビルセン

original: <T>Michelle, Michelle!
translation: <T>Michelle, Michelle!

original: ミカ
translation: ミカ

original: <T>Right here, Mr Mayor. What's the matter?
translation: <T>Buradayım, Sayın Belediye Başkanı. Ne oldu?

original: <T><M2/1/1>I've just had the most luminous idea!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Az önce dahiyane bir fikir geldi aklıma!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I see. Would you care to...enlighten me as
well, then?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Anlıyorum. O halde beni de...aydınlatmak
ister misiniz?

original:
<T>Ever since that {''}people turning into horses{''}
palaver, we've had citizens asking all sorts
of questions, right?
translation:
<T>Şu {''}people turning into horses{''}
meselesinden beri vatandaşlar türlü türlü
sorular soruyor, değil mi?

original:
<T>Well, no wonder. They all want to know who
this Masked Gentleman character is. If only
we knew!
translation:
<T>Elbette. Hepsi şu Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
kim olduğunu bilmek istiyor. Keşke
biz de bilsek!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Now, I know it's disrupting your work. So
there's me thinking, how about creating a
special task force to deal with him?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Biliyorum işinizi aksatıyor. Ben de düşündüm de,
onunla ilgilenmek için özel bir görev gücü
kursak nasıl olur?

original:
<T>We could give them headquarters here in the
city hall, so they'd be on hand in case
anything else happens.
translation:
<T>Karargâhlarını burada belediye binasında
kurabiliriz; böylece bir şey daha olursa
hemen hazır olurlar.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Hmm... That's not a bad idea, actually.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Hmm... Aslında fena fikir değil.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It's good, isn't it? We could even call up
Scotland Yard and commandeer an
investigation team.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>İyi, değil mi? Hatta Scotland Yard'ı arayıp
bir soruşturma ekibini
görevlendirebiliriz.

original: <T>Wait a minute, sir. We can do that?
translation: <T>Bir dakika, efendim. Bunu yapabilir miyiz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Well, if we can't, they'll just say no, won't
they? And if they say yes, whoop-dee-dah
for us!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Yapamıyorsak da 'hayır' derler, değil mi?
'Evet' derlerse de ne âlâ
bize!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Well, at least you're staying positive,
Mr Mayor...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>En azından iyimserliğinizi koruyorsunuz,
Sayın Belediye Başkanı...

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: ヤングレイトン

original:
<T>Phew, I'm exhausted! I think I'll go to bed
now, Ma!
translation:
<T>Püf, bittim! Sanırım şimdi yatmaya
gideceğim, anne!

original: ルシール
translation: ルシール

original:
<T><M2/1/1>What, at this time? That's unusually sensible
of you.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu saatte mi? Bu, senin için alışılmadık
derecede akıllıca.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It feels as if I've been running around all
day: first I was looking for Pa, then I was
dragged around by Randall!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Sanki bütün gün koşturmuş gibiyim:
ilk önce babayı arıyordum, sonra da Randall
beni oradan oraya sürükledi!

original:
<T>Hmm. Well, try not to fall into bed with all
your clothes on this time, will you?
translation:
<T>Hmm. Peki, bu sefer bütün
giysilerinle yatağa düşmemeye çalış, olur mu?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Yes, Ma, all right. I'm a big boy now. Good
night!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Evet anne, tamam. Artık büyüdüm. İyi
geceler!

original: <T><M1/1/1>Sweet dreams, dear.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Tatlı rüyalar, canım.

original: ローラン
translation: ローラン

original: <T>G'night, son!
translation: <T>İyi geceler, oğlum!

original: <T><M2/1/1>So... What was all that about, then?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ee... Az önceki de neydi öyle?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Don't pretend you don't know what I mean.
Those men in black suits asking after
Hershel - who were they really?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ne demek istediğimi bilmiyormuş gibi yapma.
Siyah takım elbiseli o adamlar Hershel'i soruyordu—
gerçekte kimlerdi?

original: <T><K>Hmph...
translation: <T><K>Hıh...

original:
<T>What's going on, Roland? What were they
doing coming all the way out here to
Stansbury?
translation:
<T>Neler oluyor, Roland? Onlar
buralara kadar gelip
Stansbury'ye neden geldiler?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>They told me they were just a team of
archaeologists who wanted to see Norwell.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sadece Norwell'i görmek isteyen bir arkeolog
ekibi olduklarını söylediler.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh, come off it. Those men haven't been
near a dig site in their lives.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Hadi canım. O adamlar hayatlarında
bir kazı alanının yanına bile yaklaşmamıştır.

original:
<T>Well, that's what they said. I could hardly
accuse them of lying, could I?
translation:
<T>Ne diyeyim, öyle söylediler. Yalan
söylediklerini kolayca suçlayamazdım, değil mi?

original:
<T>And before you ask, I don't know why they
wanted to see Hershel. Or why they gave up
when I told them he was out.
translation:
<T>Soracağını biliyorum: Hershel'i neden görmek
istediklerini de bilmiyorum. Ben onun dışarıda
olduğunu söyleyince niye vazgeçtiklerini de.

original: <T>I don't like this. I don't like it one bit.
translation: <T>Bunu hiç sevmedim. Hiç ama hiç.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Listen to me, Lucille. Hershel is our boy.
He'll be fine.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Beni dinle, Lucille. Hershel bizim oğlumuz.
O iyi olacak.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmm... He is still young, but I suppose he
does have a solid head on his shoulders -
just like his father!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmm... Hâlâ genç, ama sanırım
omuzlarının üzerinde sağlam bir kafa var—
tıpkı babası gibi!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>And his heart is in the right place too,
thanks to his mother. He'll be all right.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Kalbi de doğru yerde; bunu annesine borçlu.
O iyi olacak.

original:
<T>Let's leave it at that. It's nearly bed time,
anyhow. <W>How about a mug of cocoa? With
a little cream on top?
translation:
<T>Bunu burada bırakalım. Zaten yatma vakti
neredeyse geldi. <W>Bir kupa kakao ister misin? Üstüne
biraz krema da koyarız?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Didn't you have two helpings of pudding?<W>
Well, all right. I'll whip the cream if you heat
the milk.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Pudingden iki porsiyon yememiş miydin?<W>
Peki, tamam. Sen sütü ısıtırsan ben de kremayı
çırparım.

original: ダルストン
translation: ダルストン

original: <T>Ringmaster, my good man!
translation: <T>Sirk müdürü, değerli dostum!

original: ダンチョー
translation: ダンチョー

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Why, it's Mr Dalston! Welcome to our
humble circus. Please, come in.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aa, Bay Dalston! Mütevazı sirkimize hoş
geldiniz. Lütfen, buyurun.

original:
<T>I'm afraid the show doesn't start for another
three hours, though.
translation:
<T>Ama korkarım gösterinin başlamasına daha
üç saat var.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>No worries. I just came by to drop off some
goodies for everyone, to get your strength
up before the show.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sorun değil. Sadece herkese biraz
ikram bırakmaya geldim; gösteriden önce
enerjiniz toplansın diye.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Ooh, thank you kindly!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Ooh, çok teşekkür ederiz!

original: <T><M1/1/1>Harrumph. So, is Hannibal around?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Hıh. Peki Hannibal buralarda mı?

original:
<T>Hannibal! How are you, boy? I've brought
some of that lovely fresh meat again. Mmm,
get your chops round this!
translation:
<T>Hannibal! Nasılsın oğlum? Yine o nefis taze
etten getirdim. Mmm,
şundan bir güzel dişle!

original: チルチル
translation: チルチル

original: <T><M1/1/1>Grrrrow-grrrrowl. Grrrowl!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Grrrrow-grrrrowl. Grrrowl!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Har har! I knew you'd like that! Hope you
don't mind the ramblings of a poor rich
bloke like me.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Har har! Beğeneceğini biliyordum! Umarım
benim gibi zavallı zengin bir adamın gevezeliğine
alınganlık etmezsin.

original: <T>Grrrawwr.
translation: <T>Grrrawwr.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>His lordship Henry Le Bore is beating me
again. He's got the same assets but higher
profits. How does he do it?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Lord Henry Le Bore yine beni geçiyor.
Aynı varlıklara sahip ama daha fazla
kâr ediyor. Nasıl yapıyor?

original:
<T>Though, the real thorn in my paw these days
is that crackpot calling himself the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Ama bugünlerde asıl canımı sıkan,
kendine Maskeli Beyefendi diyen o çatlak.

original:
<T>Waltzes into town like he owns the place,
ruins the parade for everyone and expects
us to simply take it?
translation:
<T>Sanki buranın sahibiymiş gibi şehre süzülür,
herkesin geçit törenini mahveder ve
bizim de bunu sineye çekmemizi mi bekler?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Look, I know this city isn't perfect. It's full
of money grabbers and cheaters. But it's my
home, my whole life!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bakın, bu şehrin kusursuz olmadığını biliyorum.
Paragözler ve üçkâğıtçılarla dolu. Ama burası benim
yuvam, tüm hayatım!

original: <T>Grrraw, rawwwr.
translation: <T>Grrraw, rawwwr.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>You know what I mean, don't you, boy?
I know you understand me.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Ne demek istediğimi biliyorsun, değil mi oğlum?
Beni anladığını biliyorum.

original: <T>Grrrowwwl.
translation: <T>Grrrowwwl.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You know what? I think I'll name my next
hotel after you. How about that? It can have
black and white stripes, the works.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Biliyor musun? Bir sonraki otelime senin adını
vereceğim. Ne dersin? Siyah-beyaz çizgiler de olur,
her şeyiyle.

original: <T>Rawwwr!
translation: <T>Rawwwr!

original:
<T>Ha! Then we're agreed. Once someone
cleans up this royal mess, you and me can
say hello to the Hannibal Hotel!
translation:
<T>Ha! O zaman anlaştık. Biri şu kraliyet
rezaletini temizleyince, senle ben de
Hannibal Oteli'ne merhaba deriz!

original: グロスキー
translation: グロスキー

original:
<T>Monte d'Or at last! Now where is this
devious villain that's been menacing the
city, eh?!
translation:
<T>Nihayet Monte d'Or! Peki şehri tehdit eden
bu sinsi kötü adam nerede, ha?!

original: <T><M4/1/1>You there! Stop, in the name of the Yard!
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Sen! Yard adına dur!

original: ヌーデン
translation: ヌーデン

original: <T>Yes? How may I be of assistance, sir?
translation: <T>Evet? Size nasıl yardımcı olabilirim, efendim?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Inspector Clamp Grosky. I was hoping you
could tell me about this Masked Mantelpiece
or what have you.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Müfettiş Clamp Grosky. Şu Maskeli Şömine Süsü
filan hakkında bana
bir şeyler söyleyebileceğinizi umuyordum.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Masked Mantel- <W>Ah! I believe you mean
Gentleman. I am honoured that Scotland
Yard would take an interest.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Maskeli Şömine- <W>Ah! Sanırım Maskeli
Beyefendi demek istiyorsunuz. Scotland
Yard'ın ilgilenmesi benim için bir onur.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Let's cut to the chase. Tell me what's going
on in the city. I'll make short work of this
scumbag!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Lafı uzatmayalım. Şehirde neler oluyor
anlatın. Şu herifi hemen
defterini dürerim!

original:
<T>Well, simply put, a strange man has stolen
the symbol of our city, the Mask of Chaos,
and is using it to commit nefarious deeds.
translation:
<T>Kısaca söylemek gerekirse, tuhaf bir adam
şehrimizin simgesi Kaos Maskesi'ni çaldı
ve onu kötü işler yapmak için kullanıyor.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>He calls himself the Masked Gentleman and
claims his acts are miracles...but I would
sooner call them nightmares.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Kendine Maskeli Beyefendi diyor ve
yaptıklarının mucize olduğunu iddia ediyor...
ama ben onlara daha çok kâbus derim.

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Nightmares, you say? <W>Well, we can't let that
go unchecked, can we? That rascal, toying
with innocent citizens...<M2/1/2>
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Kâbus mu dediniz? <W>Buna göz yumamayız,
değil mi? O serseri, masum
vatandaşlarla oynuyor...<M2/1/2>

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It may interest you to know that a special
task force has been established at the city
hall. Why not contact them?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bilginizi çeker mi bilmem ama belediye
binasında özel bir görev gücü kuruldu.
Onlarla iletişime geçsenize?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Aha! So they're at the city hall, eh?<W> Watch
your step, Masked Gentleman! Justice will
be served piping hot!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Aha! Demek belediye binasındalar, ha?<W> Dikkat
et, Maskeli Beyefendi! Adalet
sıcacık servis edilecek!
<T><M1/1/1>Ah, efendim!

original:
<T>I believe that's the wrong dir-<W20> Oh dear. He's
out of sight already.
translation:
<T>Sanırım o yanlış yön-<W20> Aman. Gözden
kayboldu bile.

original: <T>It was just around the corner, too.
translation: <T>Üstelik tam köşeyi dönmüştü.

original: ギラン
translation: ギラン

original: <T>I can't say I'm happy about this. At all.
translation: <T>Bundan hiç memnun olduğumu söyleyemem. Hiç.

original: バスカル
translation: バスカル

original: <T>No, indeed!
translation: <T>Kesinlikle hayır!

original: グスタフ
translation: グスタフ

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I've had it up to here with Murphy and his
blathering! Yap, yap, yap!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Murphy ve onun
gevezeliğine artık tahammülüm kalmadı! Yap, yap, yap!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>It's no joking matter. All our confidential
information is at risk if he's allowed to go
on.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu şaka değil. Tüm gizli
bilgilerimiz, onun böyle sürmesine izin verirsek
tehlikede.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>I once caught him detailing the hotel's
profits for the last five years to a customer.
Imagine the mortification!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bir keresinde onu, otelin
son beş yıldaki kârını bir müşteriye tek tek anlatırken
yakaladım. Düşünün rezaleti!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>He does my accounts, too. When old
Mordaunt casually quoted my figures back
to me, I knew who to blame!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Benim hesaplarımı da o tutuyor. Yaşlı
Mordaunt rakamlarımı bana rahatça tekrarlayınca
kimi suçlayacağımı anladım!

original:
<T>He's already crossed the line. We ought to
report him to Mr Ledore!
translation:
<T>Çizgiyi çoktan aştı. Onu Bay Ledore'a
şikâyet etmeliyiz!

original: <T>Is that really advisable?
translation: <T>Bu gerçekten akıllıca mı?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>It's my understanding that Murphy was a
great help to Mr Ledore when he first built
the Reunion Inn...
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Anladığım kadarıyla Murphy, Bay Ledore
Reunion Inn'i ilk inşa ederken ona büyük
yardım etmiş...

original:
<T>It's said that without his advice, Monte d'Or
wouldn't be the city it is today.<M1/1/1>
translation:
<T>Denir ki onun öğüdü olmasaydı Monte d'Or
bugün olduğu şehir olmazdı.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Rubbish. We can speculate all we want, but
unless we do something about this, we're all
in deep shtook.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Saçmalık. Ne kadar tahmin yürütürsek yürütelim, ama
buna karşı bir şey yapmazsak hepimiz
fena halde batacağız.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmm, I could believe that, about the city.
He may be loose-lipped, but once he works
for you, he's a very loyal man.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmm, şehir hakkında buna inanabilirim.
Ağzı gevşek olabilir, ama bir kez
