original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>A day after the levitation incident that
occurred in front of the Montsarton Gallery,
Dalston remains in custody.
translation:
<T>Montsarton Galerisi'nin onunde yasanan
havalanma olayindan bir gun sonra
Dalston hala gozaltindadir.

original:
<T>Professor Layton heads to the city hall to
see what news the police have regarding
Dalston's situation.
translation:
<T>Profesor Layton, Dalston'in durumu hakkinda
polisin ne haber getirdigini gormek icin
belediye binasina gider.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>During Dalston's interrogation, our heroes
learn that he owns a chariot similar to the
one used by the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Dalston'in sorgusu sirasinda kahramanlarimiz,
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin kullandigina benzer bir
at arabasina sahip oldugunu ogrenir.

original:
<T>Layton, Emmy and Luke head to the north
end of town to investigate the racecourse.
translation:
<T>Layton, Emmy ve Luke yaris pistini incelemek icin
kentin kuzey ucuna
gider.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>During Dalston's interrogation, our heroes
learn that he owns a chariot similar to the
one used by the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Dalston'in sorgusu sirasinda kahramanlarimiz,
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin kullandigina benzer bir
at arabasina sahip oldugunu ogrenir.

original:
<T>Layton, Emmy and Luke arrive at the
racecourse and begin their investigation.
translation:
<T>Layton, Emmy ve Luke yaris pistine varir
ve sorusturmalarina
baslar.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>At the racecourse, Layton finds that one of
the chariots was absent at the time of the
statue incident.
translation:
<T>Yaris pistinde Layton, heykel olayi sirasinda
arabalardan birinin orada
olmadigini fark eder.

original:
<T>Henry must approve the removal of any
chariots, so Layton returns to the Ledore
estate to ask him in person...
translation:
<T>Herhangi bir arabanin cikarilmasi Henry'nin onayini
gerektirdiginden Layton, ona bizzat sormak icin
Ledore malikanesine geri doner...

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Layton confronts Henry directly with
evidence that connects him to the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Layton, Henry’yi Maskeli
Beyefendi’yle baglantili oldugunu gosteren
kanitlarla dogrudan yuzlestirir.

original:
<T>Henry, however, claims that he is actually
the victim here. Can he be trusted?
translation:
<T>Henry ise aslinda burada kurbanin
kendisi oldugunu iddia eder. Ona guvenilebilir mi?

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Layton, Luke and Emmy are informed by a
policeman that one of his colleagues may
have some information for them.
translation:
<T>Layton, Luke ve Emmy'ye bir polis,
meslektaslarindan birinin onlar icin bazi
bilgilerinin olabilecegini soyler.

original:
<T>The group head to Celebration Boulevard to
find out what he has to say before trying to
find more clues on their own.
translation:
<T>Grup, Celebration Bulvari'na gider
ve onun ne soyleyecegini ogrenir; ardindan
kendi baslarina daha fazla ipucu aramaya calisirlar.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>The policeman waiting for Layton on
Celebration Boulevard offers to provide
some horse riding courses.
translation:
<T>Kutlama Bulvari'nda Layton'i bekleyen polis,
at binme dersleri
vermeyi teklif eder.

original:
<T>Returning to the case, the group head for
the Scorpion Casino to investigate rumours
of a disturbance there.
translation:
<T>Tekrar olaya donen grup, orada bir olay ciktigina dair
soylentileri arastirmak icin Akrep Kumarhanesi'ne
gider.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Layton and his friends put an end to the
disturbance at the Scorpion Casino.
translation:
<T>Layton ve arkadaslari, Scorpion
Kumarhanesi’ndeki kargasaya son verir.

original:
<T>They then proceed north to Tingly Town,
where the next miracle is set to happen.
translation:
<T>Ardindan kuzeye, bir sonraki mucizenin
gerceklesecegi Tingly Town’a dogru ilerlerler.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Layton and friends arrive at Tingly Town to
stop the Masked Gentleman's next miracle.
translation:
<T>Layton ve arkadaslari, Maskeli
Beyefendi’nin bir sonraki mucizesini durdurmak icin Tingly Town’a gelir.

original:
<T>They investigate the fair, looking for clues
left by the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi’nin biraktigi ipuclarini
aramak icin panayiri arastirirlar.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>The clues left behind by the Masked
Gentleman lead Layton and friends to
Tingly Tower.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi’nin biraktigi ipuclari
Layton ve arkadaslarini
Tingly Tower’a goturur.

original:
<T>Will the Masked Gentleman be waiting for
them inside?
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi iceride
onlari bekliyor olacak mi?

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Inside Tingly Tower, Layton and friends are
greeted by the Masked Gentleman, who tells
them of his next miracle.
translation:
<T>Tingly Kulesi'nin icinde Layton ve arkadaslarini
Maskeli Beyefendi karsilar ve onlara
sonraki mucizesini anlatir.

original:
<T>The villain disappears again, but the heroes
stay hot on his trail as they chase him
through the tower.
translation:
<T>Kotu adam yine kaybolur, ancak kahramanlarimiz
izini birakmaz ve onu
kule boyunca kovalar.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Layton and friends chase the Masked
Gentleman back out into Tingly Town to find
it completely deserted.
translation:
<T>Layton ve arkadaslari Maskeli
Beyefendi’yi Tingly Town’a kadar kovalar
ve kasabayi tamamen terk edilmis bulur.

original:
<T>What has the dastardly villain done with all
the people?!
translation:
<T>Alcak kotu adam tum
insanlara ne yapti?!

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Layton is telling Emmy and Luke more about
his past in order to shed some light on the
present.
translation:
<T>Layton, bugune biraz isik tutmak icin
Emmy ve Luke'a gecmisi hakkinda daha
fazla sey anlatiyor.

original:
<T>In the past, Randall convinces Angela to let
him go on his expedition after promising to
return safely.
translation:
<T>Gecmiste Randall, sag salim donecegine soz verip
Angela'yi, onun sefere gitmesine izin vermeye
ikna eder.

original:
<T>Randall and Hershel wake before sunrise to
prepare for their journey to the ruins.
translation:
<T>Randall ve Hershel, harabelere yapacaklari yolculuga
hazirlanmak icin gun dogmadan once uyanir.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Layton is telling Emmy and Luke more about
his past in order to shed some light on the
present.
translation:
<T>Layton, bugune biraz isik tutmak icin
Emmy ve Luke'a gecmisi hakkinda daha
fazla sey anlatiyor.

original:
<T>In the past, Randall and Hershel have set
out for the ruins of Akbadain.
translation:
<T>Gecmiste Randall ve Hershel
Akbadain harabelerine dogru yola cikar.

original:
<T>The mask will lead them straight to the ruins,
but what will they find there?
translation:
<T>Maske onlari dogrudan harabelere goturecek,
peki orada ne bulacaklar?

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Randall and Hershel enter the mysterious
ruins of Akbadain and begin exploring.
translation:
<T>Randall ve Hershel, Akbadain’in gizemli
harabelerine girip kesfe baslar.

original:
<T>What fate awaits them on their quest to
uncover the secrets of the Azran?
translation:
<T>Azran’in sirlarini ortaya cikarma
yolculuklarinda onlari nasil bir kader bekliyor?

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Randall and Hershel are forced to make their
way through a network of ancient and deadly
traps.
translation:
<T>Randall ve Hershel, kadim ve olumcul
tuzaklardan olusan bir agin icinden
ilerlemek zorunda kalir.

original:
<T>The secret of the Azran must be close at
hand...
translation:
<T>Azran’in sirri cok
yakinda olmali...

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Having overcome all the Azran's puzzles and
pitfalls, Randall and Hershel reach the heart
of the Akbadain ruins.
translation:
<T>Azran'in tum bulmacalarini ve tuzaklarini astiktan sonra
Randall ve Hershel, Akbadain harabelerinin
kalbine ulasir.

original:
<T>At the last moment, they are taken by
surprise and Randall falls into a deep ravine,
still holding the Mask of Chaos.
translation:
<T>Son anda gafil avlanirlar
ve Randall, hala Kaos Maskesi'ni tutarken
derin bir yariga duser.

original:
<T>Grief-ridden, Hershel makes his way alone
to the treasure chamber.
translation:
<T>Keder icinde Hershel, tek basina
hazine odasina dogru yol alir.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>After witnessing the disappearance of the
crowds in Tingly Town, Layton and friends
are warned of a final miracle.
translation:
<T>Tingly Kasabasi'ndaki kalabaliklarin kaybolusuna
tanik olan Layton ve arkadaslari,
son bir mucize konusunda uyarilir.

original:
<T>On their fourth day in Monte d'Or, the
heroes are finally closing in on the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'daki dorduncu gunlerinde,
kahramanlarimiz sonunda Maskeli Beyefendi'yi
yakalamaya cok yaklasir.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>After witnessing the disappearance of the
crowds in Tingly Town, Layton and friends
are warned of a final miracle.
translation:
<T>Tingly Kasabasi'ndaki kalabaliklarin kaybolusuna
tanik olan Layton ve arkadaslari,
son bir mucize konusunda uyarilir.

original:
<T>On their fourth day in Monte d'Or, the
heroes are finally closing in on the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'daki dorduncu gunlerinde,
kahramanlarimiz sonunda Maskeli Beyefendi'yi
yakalamaya cok yaklasir.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>As they set out to resume their investigation,
Layton and his friends are approached by
Dalston's butler.
translation:
<T>Sorusturmaya yeniden koyulacaklari sirada,
Layton ve arkadaslarinin yanina
Dalston'in usagi gelir.

original:
<T>Hearing that Dalston has been released,
they decide to pay him a visit to find out
what he knows.
translation:
<T>Dalston'in serbest birakildigini duyunca,
ne bildigini ogrenmek icin ona
bir ziyaret yapmaya karar verirler.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Layton and his friends have a fruitful talk
with Dalston after his release from police
custody.
translation:
<T>Layton ve arkadaslari, polis gozetiminden
ciktiktan sonra Dalston’la verimli bir
konusma yapar.

original:
<T>The group then set off for Tingly Town, the
scene of the previous night's miracle.
translation:
<T>Grup daha sonra, onceki geceki mucizenin
yasandigi yer olan Tingly Town’a dogru yola cikar.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Layton discovers the truth behind the trick at
Tingly Town, but there are still unanswered
questions.
translation:
<T>Layton, Tingly Kasabasi'ndaki numaranin ardindaki
gercegi ortaya cikarir, ancak hala
cevaplanmamis sorular vardir.

original:
<T>After hearing about some of Henry's
investments, Layton goes back to the
Ledore estate to talk to Henry.
translation:
<T>Henry'nin bazi yatirimlarini duyduktan sonra Layton,
Henry'yle konusmak icin
Ledore malikanesine geri doner.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>At the Ledores' house, Layton finds Henry's
attitude as terse as ever, but he also has
a surprise encounter.
translation:
<T>Ledore'larin evinde Layton, Henry'nin
tavrinin her zamanki gibi kisa ve sert oldugunu gorur, ama
ayni zamanda beklenmedik bir karsilasma yasar.

original:
<T>Randall's mother is living with the Ledores.
After talking to her, Layton decides to head
to the city hall.
translation:
<T>Randall'in annesi Ledore'larla birlikte yasamaktadir.
Onunla konustuktan sonra Layton
belediye binasina gitmeye karar verir.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>At the city hall, Layton uncovers one of
Monte d'Or's greatest secrets.
translation:
<T>Belediye binasinda Layton,
Monte d'Or’un en buyuk sirlarindan birini ortaya cikarir.

original:
<T>Accompanied by Emmy and Luke, he returns
to the racecourse to talk to Detective
Bloom.
translation:
<T>Emmy ve Luke’un esliginde, Dedektif
Bloom’la konusmak icin hipodroma
geri doner.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>According to Detective Bloom, the Masked
Gentleman is hiding somewhere in the
Reunion Inn.
translation:
<T>Dedektif Bloom'a gore Maskeli Beyefendi,
Reunion Hani'nin bir yerlerinde
saklaniyor.

original:
<T>Layton and his team head for the Reunion
Inn hoping to finally put an end to the
Masked Gentleman's tricks.
translation:
<T>Layton ve ekibi, Maskeli Beyefendi'nin oyunlarina
son vermeyi umarak Reunion Hani'na
gider.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Layton and friends arrive at the Reunion
Inn, where the Masked Gentleman is
rumoured to be.
translation:
<T>Layton ve arkadaslari, Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
oldugu soylentileri dolasan Reunion Hani'na
varir.

original:
<T>With hotel manager Mordaunt as his guide,
Layton begins his inspection of the hotel
and the puzzles hidden throughout.
translation:
<T>Otel muduru Mordaunt rehberliginde,
Layton oteli ve her yere gizlenmis
bulmacalari incelemeye baslar.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Having learnt a part of Henry's past in the
Reunion Inn, Layton begins searching for
the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
<T>Reunion Hani’nda Henry’nin gecmisinin
bir kismini ogrenen Layton, Maskeli
Beyefendi’yi aramaya baslar.

original:
<T>Layton and friends must follow a trail of
mysterious clues left behind by the villain.
translation:
<T>Layton ve arkadaslari, kotu adamin
geride biraktigi gizemli ipuclarinin izini surmelidir.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Nearing the end of the Masked Gentleman's
fairy tale trail, Layton arrives in the
hotel's auditorium.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi'nin masal izinin sonuna yaklasirken,
Layton otelin
konferans salonuna varir.

original:
<T>Before anyone can react, the Masked
Gentleman kidnaps Luke. Can Layton save
his apprentice before it is too late?
translation:
<T>Kimse tepki veremeden Maskeli Beyefendi
Luke'u kacirir. Layton, cok gec olmadan
cirakini kurtarabilecek mi?

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>The Masked Gentleman reveals himself as
Randall, the friend Layton thought he lost
18 years ago.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Beyefendi’nin aslinda Randall,
Layton’in 18 yil once kaybettigini sandigi
arkadasi oldugu ortaya cikar.

original:
<T>Randall explains his desire to take revenge
on Henry and raises the curtain on his final
act...
translation:
<T>Randall, Henry’den intikam alma istegini
anlatir ve son
perdesini aralar...

original:
<T>For his final miracle, the Masked Gentleman
sets off an avalanche to bury the city under
the desert sands.
translation:
<T>Son mucizesi icin Maskeli Beyefendi,
sehri col kumlarinin altina gommek uzere
bir kum cigi baslatir.

original:
<T>With precious little time left, Layton rushes
to the city monument in the hope of saving
the city...
translation:
<T>Kalan kisitli zamanda Layton,
sehri kurtarma umuduyla sehir anitina
kosar...

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>With Monte d'Or's destruction imminent, the
only hope rests in the Akbadain ruins, which
lie beneath the city.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'un yok olusu an meselesiyken,
tek umut sehrin altinda bulunan
Akbadain harabelerindedir.

original:
<T>Will Layton be able to solve the final puzzle
of Akbadain and save Monte d'Or from the
rising sand?
translation:
<T>Layton, Akbadain'in son bulmacasini cozerek
Monte d'Or'u yukselen kumlardan
kurtarabilecek mi?

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatim devam ediyor

original:
<T>Layton solves the riddle of the Mask of
Chaos, elevating Akbadain to its original
position.
translation:
<T>Layton Kaos Maskesi’nin bilmecesini
cozerek Akbadain’i asil
konumuna yukseltir.

original:
<T>With Monte d'Or saved, Layton and Henry
now stand reunited with Randall after 18
years...
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or kurtarildiktan sonra Layton ve
Henry, 18 yilin ardindan Randall’la yeniden
bir araya gelir...

<T>[奇跡/きせき]lerin [街/まち]i...
