original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>Did you enjoy Professor Layton and the
Miracle Mask?
translation:
<T>Professor Layton and the
Miracle Mask'i begendiniz mi?

original:
<T>You have reached the end of the story, but
the game is far from over!
translation:
<T>Hikayenin sonuna geldiniz, ama
oyun daha bitmedi!

original:
<T>There are exactly 135 puzzles scattered
throughout the story you've just completed.
translation:
<T>Az once bitirdiginiz hikaye boyunca
tam 135 bulmaca yer aliyor.

original:
<T>See if you can complete each and every
one of them!
translation:
<T>Bakalim hepsini birden
tamamlayabilecek misiniz!

original:
<T>You might unlock some new content in the
Bonuses section!
translation:
<T>Bonuslar bolumunde yeni iceriklerin
kilidini acabilirsiniz!

original: <T>There's all sorts of fun awaiting you there!
translation: <T>Orada sizi turlu turlu eglence bekliyor!

original:
<T>See if you have what it takes to conquer
some of the most baffling puzzles in the
game.
translation:
<T>Oyundaki en kafa karistirici
bulmacalardan bazilarinin ustesinden
gelmek size gore mi, gorelim.

original:
<T>Have fun with the rest of Professor Layton
and the Miracle Mask!
translation:
<T>Professor Layton and the
Miracle Mask'in geri kalaninin tadini cikarin!

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>Did you enjoy Professor Layton and the
Miracle Mask?
translation:
<T>Professor Layton and the
Miracle Mask'i begendiniz mi?

original:
<T>You solved all 135 puzzles in the story
mode of this game. Congratulations!<J402>
translation:
<T>Bu oyunun hikaye modundaki 135 bulmacanin
hepsini cozdunuz. Tebrikler!<J402>

original:
<T>That is no small feat! You must have a brain
to rival that of Professor Layton himself.
translation:
<T>Bu hic de kucuk bir basari degil! Profesor Layton'inkine rakip bir
zeka seviyeniz olmali.

original:
<T>There is still more to see in Professor
Layton and the Miracle Mask!
translation:
<T>Professor Layton and the
Miracle Mask'te gorecek daha cok sey var!

original:
<T>For more fun, try a Daily Puzzle or one of
Layton's Challenges in the Bonuses section.
translation:
<T>Daha fazla eglence icin Gunluk Bulmaca'yi ya da Bonuslar bolumundeki
Layton'in Meydan Okumalarindan birini deneyin.

original: <T>Enjoy the rest of what's on offer!
translation: <T>Sunulanlarin geri kalaninin tadini cikarin!

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>Since you've come to the end of the story,
you may now save your game.
translation:
<T>Hikayenin sonuna geldigine gore,
artik oyununu kaydedebilirsin.

original:
<T>When you continue this game, you will
resume play right after saving Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T>Bu oyuna devam ettiginde,
Monte d'Or'u kurtardiktan hemen sonra devam edeceksin.

original:
<T>From there, you can wander around freely,
collecting items and solving puzzles you
might have missed.
translation:
<T>Oradan sonra ozgurce dolasabilir,
esyalari toplayip kacirmis olabilecegin
bulmacalari cozebilirsin.

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>Congratulations! You have solved all 15 of
Layton's Challenges!<J402>
translation:
<T>Tebrikler! Layton'in 15 Meydan Okumasinin
hepsini cozdunuz!<J402>

original:
<T>You have now solved every puzzle in this
game.
translation:
<T>Artik bu oyundaki tum bulmacalari
cozdunuz.

original:
<T>You might even be a match for the great
Professor Layton.
translation:
<T>Belki de buyuk Profesor Layton'a bile
denksiniz.

original: <T>Here is a reward for getting so far!
translation: <T>Buralara kadar geldiginiz icin bir odul!

original:
<T>New pages have been added to the Profiles
and Art sections.
translation:
<T>Profil ve Sanat bolumlerine
yeni sayfalar eklendi.

original: <T>Enjoy those at your leisure!
translation: <T>Dilediginiz zaman goz atin!

original:
<T>There's plenty of other content to keep you
busy, too.
translation:
<T>Sizi mesgul edecek baska pek cok icerik
de var.

original:
<T>Be sure to have a look through the Top
Secret material or try a Daily Puzzle.
translation:
<T>Top
Secret icerigine goz atmayi ya da bir Gunluk Bulmaca denemeyi unutmayin.

original: <T>Enjoy the rest of what's on offer!
translation: <T>Sunulanlarin geri kalaninin tadini cikarin!

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>Congratulations! You have mastered all the
main stages for your toy robot!
translation:
<T>Tebrikler! Oyuncak robotun icin tum
ana asamalari tamamladin!

original:
<T>The Toymaker's House has been added to
Layton's Challenges.<J402>
translation:
<T>Oyuncakci'nin Evi, Layton'in Meydan Okumalari'na
eklendi.<J402>

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>Congratulations! The customers have
scooped up all the stock from every aisle
of the shop!
translation:
<T>Tebrikler! Musteriler
magazanin her reyonundaki tum stoklari
kapis kapis aldi!

original:
<T>The Shopkeeper's House has been added to
Layton's Challenges.<J402>
translation:
<T>Dukkancinin Evi, Layton'in Meydan Okumalari'na
eklendi.<J402>

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>Congratulations! The rabbit performed to the
ringmaster's satisfaction in every play.
translation:
<T>Tebrikler! Tavsan
her oyunda sirk sefinin memnuniyetini kazandi.

original:
<T>The Ringmaster's House has been added to
Layton's Challenges.<J402>
translation:
<T>Sirk Sefinin Evi, Layton'in Meydan Okumalari'na
eklendi.<J402>

original: ナゾーバ
translation: Nazooba

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Ehee hee hee! If it's puzzles you're after,
then look no further!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ehee hee hee! Bulmaca ariyorsaniz,
daha fazla aramaniza gerek yok!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Giving up? Oh, do be a dear and try the
poor thing again. You'll break its little
heart if you don't!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Pes mi ediyorsun? Hadi ama, su zavalliyi
bir daha dene. Yoksa minicik
kalbini kirarsin!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I couldn't have done it better myself! Ehee
hee hee!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ben bile daha iyisini yapamazdim! Ehee
hee hee!

original: Pick a puzzle to solve.
translation: Cozmek icin bir bulmaca sec.

original:
Solve puzzle %s,
{''}%s{''}?
translation:
Bulmaca %s'yi coz,
{''}%s{''}?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T>Now, where shall we go?
translation: <T>Peki, simdi nereye gidecegiz?

original: ナレーション中
translation: Anlatici

original:
<T>What better place to spend an evening than
the racecourse, home of the most
prestigious sport in Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T>Bir aksami gecirmek icin bundan daha iyi yer
olur mu? Monte d'Or'un en prestijli sporunun
yuvasi olan hipodrom!

original:
<T>Fun for all the family! Spooky funfair Tingly
Town is guaranteed to both thrill you and
chill you.
translation:
<T>Tum aile icin eglence! Korkutucu lunapark Tingly
Town, sizi hem heyecanlandirip
hem de urpertecek!

original:
<T>Experience the courtesy, kindness and
camaraderie of the hotel where Monte d'Or
was born: the Reunion Inn.
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or'un dogdugu oteldeki nezaketi,
iyiligi ve sicak dostlugu deneyimleyin:
Reunion Inn.

original: <T>Perhaps later.
translation: <T>Belki sonra.

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Back for more, sir? Now, you can't fool me.
I see that look in your eyes, like a hungry
donkey in search of a thistle.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Yine mi geldiniz efendim? Artik beni kandiramazsiniz.
Gozlerinizde o bakisi goruyorum; sanki ac bir
diken arayan esek gibisiniz.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I was, frankly, moved to tears by your
stunning display of chivalry!<M1/2/1> <W>Tears, literally
<M4/2/1>streaming down my face!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Dogrusu, sergilediginiz o muhtesem sovalyelik
gosterisi beni gozyaslarina bogdu!<M1/2/1> <W>Hem de kelimenin tam anlamiyla,
<M4/2/1>yuzumden suzule suzule!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M1/2/1/45>Oh, I see. Well, er...<W>thank you very much.<M1/1/1>
translation: <T><M1/2/1/45>Anliyorum. Sey, imm...<W>cok tesekkur ederim.<M1/1/1>

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I've been whiling away the hours since that
magical day just hoping for another glimpse
of that incredible poise!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>O buyulu gunden beri saatleri bosa gecirip
o inanilmaz zarafeti bir kez daha gorebilmeyi
umut ediyorum!

original:
<T><M1/2/1/60>The horses are fed and watered, and they're
chomping at the bit! Go on, saddle up! You
know you want to!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/60>Atlar yemini yedi, suyunu icti; sabirsizliktan
dizginleri kemiriyorlar! Haydi, eyerle! Sen de
istiyorsun, biliyorum!

original: <T><M2/2/1>Oh, you're back again, Professor!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Aa, yine geldiniz Profesor!

original:
<T><M1/2/1/60>The horses have all been groomed and
they're raring to go. Ready to take the reins
again?
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/60>Atlarin hepsi timarlanip hazirlandi,
yola cikmak icin can atiyorlar. Dizginleri
yeniden eline almaya hazir misiniz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh, go on. Don't look a gift horse in the
mouth!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Hadi ama. Bedava atin disine bakilmaz!

original: <T><M1/2/1>All galloped out, are we?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Tum dortnal gucunuz tukendi mi yoksa?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Whenever you're whinnying for some action,
just say the word.<W> I'll bring the horses, you
bring the riders!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ne zaman biraz aksiyon icin kisnemeye
baslarsaniz, soylemeniz yeter.<W> Ben atlari getiririm,
sen binicileri getir!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Now then, allow me to explain a bit about
the rules.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Pekala, kurallari biraz aciklayayim.

original:
<T>Head to the goal while collecting as many
flags as you can. Your highest total will be
recorded.
translation:
<T>Mumkun oldugunca cok bayrak toplayarak
hedefe ulasin. En yuksek toplam puaniniz
kaydedilecek.

original:
<T>Slide your stylus on the Touch Screen in
short, quick motions to move the horse left
and right.
translation:
<T>Ati saga sola hareket ettirmek icin kalemi
Dokunmatik Ekran uzerinde kisa ve hizli
hareketlerle kaydirin.

original:
<T>The horse will stumble and slow down if you
hit a barrel, costing you precious points. Try
to avoid them if you can.
translation:
<T>Bir varile carparsaniz at tokezler ve yavaslar;
bu da degerli puanlariniza mal olur. Mumkunse
onlardan kacinmaya calisin.

original:
<T>Picking up an energy carrot will give your
horse a burst of speed, allowing it to smash
through barrels to score extra points!
translation:
<T>Bir enerji havucu almak, atiniza hiz patlamasi
saglar ve varilleri parcalayarak ekstra puan
kazanmaniza olanak tanir!

original:
<T>I'll tell you a secret. It's those energy
carrots that are the key to getting a top
score. Nab as many as you can!
translation:
<T>Size bir sir vereyim. En yuksek skora giden
anahtar o enerji havuclaridir. Elinizden
geldigince cok kapin!

original:
A casual course for the beginner. The
perfect place for practising the basics
of riding.
translation:
Baslangic seviyesi icin rahat bir parkur.
Biniciligin temellerini calismak icin
mukemmel bir yer.

original: Sprinter Course
translation: Sprinter Parkuru

original:
A solid intermediate course. For
competent riders who love the thrill of
cantering and galloping.
translation:
Saglam bir orta seviye parkur. Tiris ve
dortnalin heyecanini seven yetkin
biniciler icin.

original: Miler Course
translation: Miler Parkuru

original:
A densely flagged course tailored to
the advanced rider. For those who
can't resist a challenge.
translation:
Ileri seviye binicilere gore, bayraklarla
dolu bir parkur. Meydan okumaya
dayanamayanlar icin.

original: Stayer Course
translation: Stayer Parkuru

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Go on, then! Pick a course and I'll get you
saddled up!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Haydi oyleyse! Bir parkur secin de sizi
eyerleyeyim!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Now then, let's see. Your current high score
is...0?!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Pekala, bakalim. Su anki en yuksek skorunuz...
0?!

original:
<T>Oh dear. I'm sorry if I wasn't clear enough
before, but you're supposed to be collecting
the flags, not avoiding them!
translation:
<T>Aman da aman. Once yeterince acik olmadiysam
kusura bakmayin ama bayraklari toplamaniz
gerekiyor, onlardan kacinmaniz degil!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Not used to riding yet? Don't fret! No one's
born an expert.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Henuz binicilige alismadiniz mi? Dert etmeyin!
Kimse uzman dogmaz.

original:
<T>You need to slide the stylus in very small,
light movements. Just don't worry too much
and it'll all be hunky-dory.
translation:
<T>Kalemi cok kucuk, hafif hareketlerle kaydirmaniz
lazim. Fazla kafaya takmayin; her sey yoluna
girecek.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Not bad at all. I can tell you've hit your
stride.<W> But don't stop there! You can do
better!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Hic fena degil. Tempoyu yakaladiginiz belli.<W> Ama
orada durmayin! Daha iyisini yapabilirsiniz!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Now that was some fine riding! I think you're
going to become a bit of a celebrity in the
riding community!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Iste bu harika bir surustu! Sanirim binicilik
dunyasinda az biraz unlu olacaksiniz!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Incredible! I don't know how you did it, but
that's a perfect score! You can say goodbye
to the Sprinter Course, then.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Inanilmaz! Nasil yaptiniz bilmiyorum ama bu
mukemmel bir skor! O halde Sprinter Parkuru'na
veda edebilirsiniz.

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>But don't stop there! No, your riding days
are far from over. The sky is the limit!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Ama burada durmayin! Hayir, binicilik gunleriniz
henuz bitmedi. Sinir gokyuzu!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Right. I think you've got enough hands-on
experience to move on to the next course:
the Miler Course!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Pekala. Bir sonraki parkura gecmek icin
yeterince tecrube kazandiniz:
Miler Parkuru!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Now then, let's see. Your current high score
is...0?!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Pekala, bakalim. Su anki en yuksek skorunuz...
0?!

original:
<T>What are you playing at, dodging all the
flags? You are a stubborn mule, aren't you!
translation:
<T>Ne yapiyorsunuz siz, tum bayraklardan
kaciyorsunuz? Inatci bir katirsiniz, degil mi!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>What's wrong? Was your horse a bit antsy?
Never you mind. We all have our bad days.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ne oldu? Atiniz biraz huzursuz muydu?
Bos verin. Hepimizin kotu gunleri olur.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>You went like the wind! Just stay calm and
memorise the positions of those flags and
I think you'll be even faster!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Ruzgar gibi gittiniz! Sakin kalip bayraklarin
yerlerini aklinizda tutun, bence daha da
hizlanirsiniz!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Oh, if I had a penny for every time I
finished just a few short! I feel your pain.
But come on, you're almost there!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ah, her seferinde az farkla kacirdigim icin bir
kurus alsaydim! Acinizi anliyorum.
Ama haydi, neredeyse oldu!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Honest to goodness, I have never seen such
an elegant run. You've brought tears to this
constable's eyes.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Inanin, boylesine zarif bir kosu hic gormedim.
Bu memurun gozlerini yasarttiniz.

original:
<T>Even the Miler Course bows before your
command of the equine spirit.
translation:
<T>Miler Parkuru bile at ruhuna hakimiyetinizin
onunde egiliyor.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Right. I think you've done enough to move
on to the crowd favourite: the Stayer
Course!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Pekala. Sanirim seyircinin favorisine gecmek
icin yeterince yaptiniz: Stayer
Parkuru!

original:
<T>How did you even manage to weave out of
the way of all those flags? You'll have to
tell me your secret!
translation:
<T>Bunca bayragin arasindan nasil olup da
siyrildiniz? Sirrinizi soylemek zorundasiniz!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Hmm. I know you can do better than this.
<M2/2/1>Show us a proper run next time!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Himm. Bunun daha iyisini yapabileceginizi
biliyorum.
<M2/2/1>Bir dahaki sefere duzgun bir kosu gosterin!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Good for you, and nice work handling those
reins! Try to learn the course bit by bit and
you'll soon have it mastered!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Aferin size, dizginleri de guzel kontrol ettiniz!
Parkuru parca parca ogrenmeye calisin;
yakinda ustalasirsiniz!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Ohh, beautiful! It gave me goose pimples
watching you ride like that. Please, do give
up your day job!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Ahh, harika! Boyle surdugunuzu izlerken tuylerim
diken diken oldu. Lutfen, gunduz isinizi birakin da
tamamen buna yonelin!

original:
<T><M4/2/1>P-p-perfect?! I never believed I would see
the birth of a living legend right before my
eyes...<M1/2/1>
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>M-m-mukemmel mi?! Gozlerimin onunde
canli bir efsanenin dogusunu gorecegime
inanmazdim...<M1/2/1>

original:
<T><M4/2/1>You, my friend, are going to take the world
by storm.
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Dostum, dunyayi kasip kavuracaksiniz.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Now that you've come this far, you should
try to sharpen your skills and improve your
high scores.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Madem buraya kadar geldiniz, becerilerinizi
bileyip rekorlarinizi gelistirmeye calisin.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M1/2/6>That wasn't any good, was it?
translation: <T><M1/2/6>Pek iyi olmadi, degil mi?

original: <T><M1/1/1>Let me have another crack at it!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Bir kez daha deneyeyim!

original: <T><M1/2/2>Mm, I can do better than that.
translation: <T><M1/2/2>Himm, bundan daha iyisini yapabilirim.

original: <T><M1/1/1>I'll keep trying!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Denemeye devam edecegim!

original: <T><M2/2/4>I suppose that wasn't too bad.
translation: <T><M2/2/4>Sanirim o kadar da kotu degildi.

original: <T><M1/1/1>But I think I can improve on it!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Ama daha da iyilestirebilirim!

original: <T><M4/1/1>Yeah! I think I did pretty well that time!
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Evet! Bu sefer oldukca iyi yaptim bence!

original: <T><M1/1/1>Maybe I can get it perfect next time!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Belki bir dahaki sefere mukemmel yaparim!

original: <T><M3/1/1>I did it! A perfect run!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Basardim! Mukemmel bir kosu!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Now I know the Sprinter Course like the
back of my hand!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Artik Sprinter Parkuru'nu avucumun ici gibi
biliyorum!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M1/1/3>Erm...let's pretend that never happened.
translation: <T><M1/1/3>Sey...hic olmamis gibi yapalim.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Okay, never mind. I'll break that record in
a flash!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Tamam, bos ver. O rekoru aninda kirarim!

original: <T><M1/2/3>Well, that was annoying.
translation: <T><M1/2/3>Eh, bu sinir bozucuydu.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Don't think I've given up, though!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Ama vazgectigimi sanma!

original: <T><M2/1/1>It was on par, as things go.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Idare ederdi, sayilir.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But with a little more training, I think I could
improve on it!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama biraz daha antrenmanla bunu
daha da gelistirebilirim!

original:
<T><M2/2/2>You clearly don't know who you're dealing
with, flags!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Bayraklar, kiminle ugrastiginizi belli ki
bilmiyorsunuz!

original: <T><M1/1/1>I've got my eye on a perfect run next time!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Bir dahaki sefere hedefim mukemmel kosu!

original: <T><M5/2/1>Miler Course, you're no match for me!
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Miler Parkuru, bana rakip olamazsin!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Did you watch me, Professor? Wasn't I
spectacular?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Beni izlediniz mi Profesor? Muhtesem degil
miydim?

original: <T><M8/2/1>That was a rather poor show.
translation: <T><M8/2/1>Oldukca zayif bir gosteriydi.

original: <T><M1/1/1>I must strive to do better next time.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Bir dahaki sefere daha iyisini yapmaya
cabalamaliyim.

original: <T><M4/2/1>Hm. It's harder than it first appears.
translation: <T><M4/2/1>Himm. Ilk gorundugunden daha zor.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Let's give it another go, shall we?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Bir kez daha deneyelim, olur mu?

original:
<T><M5/1/1>I'd say my performance was not quite
satisfactory.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Performansim pek de tatmin edici degildi
diyebilirim.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Perhaps I should redouble my efforts.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Belki de cabami iki katina cikarmaliyim.

original: <T><M6/1/1>I seem to have finished with a decent result.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Fena sayilmayacak bir sonucla bitirmis
gorunuyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But with persistence and a little perspiration,
perhaps I can achieve a perfect score.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama azim ve biraz da ter dokmekle,
belki mukemmel skora ulasabilirim.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>A true gentleman wouldn't settle for anything
less.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Gercek bir beyefendi daha aziyla yetinmez.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Yes, I think I could get quite used to horse
riding.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Evet, sanirim ata binmeye epey
alisabilirim.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>You could at least have crossed the finish
line...
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Hic olmazsa bitis cizgisini gecebilirdiniz...

original: ポリス
translation: Polis

original: <T><M2/2/1>Aha, back again, Professor?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Aha, yine geldiniz Profesor?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I've got some bad news for you, though. I'm
tied up at the moment. Still on my shift, you
see.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ama size kotu bir haberim var. Su an
mesgulum. Hala vardiyadayim,
anlayacaginiz.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>But I'll tell you what. Come back again after
dark and I'll see if we can sort something
out.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Soyle yapalim. Hava karardiktan sonra
bir daha gelin, bir seyler ayarlayabilir
miyiz bakarim.

original: <T><M3/2/1>I'll bring the horses, you bring the riders!
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Ben atlari getiririm, siz de jokeyleri!

original: ラプンシュカ
translation: Rapunska

original:
<T><M2/2/3>Well, look what we have here! I see
somebody's cleared out all the aisles in my
little shop!
translation:
<T><M2/2/3>Bak sen! Burada kim varmis! Goruyorum ki
birileri benim kucuk dukkanimdaki tum
raflari bosaltmis!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T>That would be me!
translation: <T>O kisi benim!

original:
<T><M3/2/2>You've got a keen business sense, boy!
Now, I have a promise to keep, don't I?
Here's your present.
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Iyi bir ticaret zekan var, evlat!
Simdi, tuttugum bir soz var, degil mi?
Al, hediyen.

original: <T><M3/1/1>Oh! Well, thank you very much, madam!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Ah! Cok tesekkur ederim, hanimefendi!

original:
<T>There, that completes your catalogue. Go
ahead and show it to your friends.<W> It might
get me a few more customers!
translation:
<T>Iste, katalogun tamamlandi. Hadi
gidip arkadaslarina goster.<W> Belki
bana birkac musteri daha getirir!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>18 years ago... I remember as if it were
yesterday.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>18 yil once... Sanki daha
dunmus gibi hatirliyorum.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>It wasn't long after our expedition to the
ruins...
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Harabelere yaptigimiz kesif gezisinden
cok da uzun sure gecmemisti...

original: <T><M8/2/1/45>No, now's not the time to reminisce.
translation: <T><M8/2/1/45>Hayir, simdi anilari yad etme zamani degil.

original:
Recollect your memories and
return to Stansbury?
translation:
Anilarini tazele ve
Stansbury'ye don?

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M5/1/1/45>I should say my goodbyes before I set off
for London.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1/45>Londra'ya yola cikmadan once
veda etmeliyim.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>That's enough of remembering the past for
now.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Simdilik gecmisi hatirlamak
bu kadar yeter.

original:
<T><M1/2/1/45>No, let's look back to those times for
a while longer.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1/45>Hayir, biraz daha o gunlere
donup bakalim.

original:
Finish reminiscing and
return to Monte d'Or?
translation:
Anilari yad etmeyi bitirip
Monte d'Or'a don?

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Stansbury... It was so very long ago, but it's
still an important place to me.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/45>Stansbury... Cok uzun zaman onceydi ama
benim icin hala onemli bir yer.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Hello there. It's Luke! I'm sure by now you
all know me as Professor Layton's
number one apprentice!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Merhaba! Ben Luke! Eminim artik hepiniz beni
Profesor Layton'in
bir numarali ciragi olarak taniyorsunuzdur!

original:
<T>Maybe you don't remember, but we went on
an adventure together through my home, the
misty town of Misthallery.
translation:
<T>Belki hatirlamazsiniz ama memleketim olan
sisli Misthallery kasabasinda birlikte bir
maceraya atilmistik.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I'm really glad we've had a chance to meet
again!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Yeniden gorusme firsati buldugumuz icin
cok mutluyum!

original:
<T><M2/2/3/45>Thanks to the professor, the Misthallery
case made the front page of all the papers
and is famous to this day.
translation:
<T><M2/2/3/45>Profesor sayesinde Misthallery olayi tum
gazetelerin mansetine cikti ve bugun bile
unlu.

original:
<T>But it had a much greater meaning for me.
Do you know why?
translation:
<T>Ama benim icin cok daha buyuk bir anlami
vardi. Nedenini biliyor musunuz?

original:
<T><M4/1/1>Because it was the very first time I got to
work with Professor Layton!
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Cunku Profesor Layton ile ilk kez o zaman
birlikte calismistim!

original:
<T>I met the professor before that, but I was so
little that I don't remember it at all.
translation:
<T>Aslinda profesorle daha once tanismistim ama
cok kucuktum; hic hatirlamiyorum.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>My father talked about him a lot, though.
They'd been friends since university.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Yine de babam ondan cok bahsederdi.
Universiteden beri arkadastilar.

original:
<T>So when Misthallery was in trouble, I just
knew he'd help us.
translation:
<T>Bu yuzden Misthallery basi derde girdiginde,
bize yardim edecegini biliyordum.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Needless to say, we hit it off right from the
start! It was as if we were destined to be
teacher and pupil!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Tahmin edeceginiz gibi daha en bastan
iyi anlastik! Sanki kaderimiz ogretmen ve
ogrenci olmakmis gibiydi!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M2/2/6>Oh, really now?<W> That's not quite the way
I remember it.
translation:
<T><M2/2/6>Oyle mi gercekten?<W> Ben pek oyle
hatirlamiyorum.

original: <T><M1/2/5>E-<W30>Emmy!<W> I didn't see you come in!
translation: <T><M1/2/5>E-<W30>Emmy!<W> Geldigini gormedim!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>When I first met you, you were a very shy
and reclusive little boy.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Seni ilk tanidigimda cok utangac ve icine
kapanik bir cocuktun.

original:
<T><M3/2/3>That's not true! <W><M3/2/2>Well, maybe I was a bit
stand-offish...but I had good reason to be!
translation:
<T><M3/2/3>Bu dogru degil! <W><M3/2/2>Yani, belki biraz
mesafeliydim...ama bunun icin iyi bir nedenim vardi!

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Heh heh. I understand, Luke. I was just
teasing you.
translation: <T><M5/2/1>He he. Anliyorum Luke. Sadece takiliyordum.

original:
<T><M3/2/3>Don't be mean, Emmy! And anyway, can't
you see I'm in the middle of an important
introduction?
translation:
<T><M3/2/3>Kaba olma, Emmy! Hem gormuyor musun,
onemli bir tanitimin ortasindayim?

original: <T>Well, why don't you introduce me, too?
translation: <T>Peki, beni de tanitsana?

original: <T><M3/2/5>Oh, good idea!
translation: <T><M3/2/5>Aa, iyi fikir!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>This is Emmy. She has a funny sounding
surname. Do you know what it is?
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bu Emmy. Soyadi kulaga biraz komik geliyor.
Ne oldugunu biliyor musunuz?

original: 設問
translation: Soru

original: What is Emmy's surname?
translation: Emmy'nin soyadi nedir?

original: 回答
translation: Cevap

original: A. Ottawa
translation: A. Ottawa

original: B. Altava
translation: B. Altava

original: C. Altamira
translation: C. Altamira

original: <T><M3/1/2>Nope, that's a city in Canada!
translation: <T><M3/1/2>Hayir, o Kanada'da bir sehir!

original: <T><M4/1/3>That is correct!
translation: <T><M4/1/3>Dogru cevap!

original:
<T><M3/1/2>No, that's a famous cave in Spain. They
discovered cave paintings dating back to
the Stone Age there.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Hayir, o Ispanya'da unlu bir magara. Orada
Tas Devri'ne kadar uzanan magara resimleri
bulmuslardi.

original: <T><M3/2/5>Wow. You learn something new every day.
translation: <T><M3/2/5>Vay be. Insan her gun yeni bir sey ogreniyor.

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>As an archaeologist's assistant, I have
a duty to keep you on your toes. Ha ha!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Bir arkeolog asistani olarak sizi zinde tutmak
benim gorevim. Ha ha!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Emmy Altava is her full name. She claims to
be the professor's assistant.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Tam adi Emmy Altava. Profesorun asistani
oldugunu soyluyor.

original:
<T><M3/2/2>I don't {''}claim{''} to be, Luke. I was officially
appointed by Dean Delmona!
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Oyle {''}claim{''} etmiyorum Luke. Beni resmen
Dekan Delmona gorevlendirdi!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Dean Delmona? He's the head of
Gressenheller University, isn't he?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Dekan Delmona mi? Gressenheller
Universitesi'nin basi degil mi o?

original: <T><M1/2/4>Exactly! Got a problem with that?
translation: <T><M1/2/4>Aynen oyle! Bir sorun mu var?

original:
<T><M1/2/5>Why are you being so defensive, Emmy?
I didn't say anything.
translation:
<T><M1/2/5>Neden bu kadar savunmaya geciyorsun Emmy?
Ben bir sey demedim ki.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>I'm not!<W> Now, here's another question for
you in the audience. Do you know Luke's
surname?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Gecmiyorum!<W> Simdi, seyirciler icin bir soru
daha. Luke'un soyadini biliyor musunuz?

original: <T><M3/2/3>Of course they do!
translation: <T><M3/2/3>Elbette biliyorlardir!

original: What is Luke's surname?
translation: Luke'un soyadi nedir?

original: A. Elarton
translation: A. Elarton

original: B. Triangle
translation: B. Triangle

original: C. Triton
translation: C. Triton
<T><M2/2/2>Sey, hayir...

original: <T><M1/2/4>Are you joking?!
translation: <T><M1/2/4>Saka mi yapiyorsunuz?!

original: <T><M3/1/1>That's it!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Iste bu!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>I'm Luke Triton, the professor's number one
apprentice!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ben Luke Triton, profesorun bir numarali
ciragiyim!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>He's been helping the professor out ever
since we solved the Misthallery case.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Misthallery olayini cozdugumuzden beri
profesore yardim ediyor.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>If it hadn't been for that, I'd never have met
you or the professor!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>O olmasaydi ne sizi ne de profesoru
asla tanimazdim!

original:
<T><M2/2/3>It was so strange, the things that were
happening in Misthallery. What was the
Misthallery case about?
translation:
<T><M2/2/3>Misthallery'de olan bitenler cok tuhafti. Peki,
Misthallery olayi ne hakkindaydi?

original: What was the Misthallery case about?
translation: Misthallery olayi ne hakkindaydi?

original: A. A bull rampaging in town
translation: A. Kasabada ortaligi dagitan bir boga

original: B. A spectre ruining homes
translation: B. Evleri yerle bir eden bir hayalet

original: C. A raven stealing flutes
translation: C. Flut calan bir karga

original: <T>A bull? I don't recall any bulls.
translation: <T>Bir boga mi? Hic boga hatirlamiyorum.

original: <T><M4/1/3>That's absolutely right!
translation: <T><M4/1/3>Kesinlikle dogru!

original:
<T><M1/1/2>Well, the Black Ravens did know something
about a flute...
translation:
<T><M1/1/2>Gerci Kara Kargalar bir flut hakkinda bir seyler
biliyordu...

original:
<T><M4/1/1>A town cursed by a spectre... I never
expected that something really was
destroying those houses.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bir hayaletin lanetledigi bir kasaba...
Gercekten bir seyin o evleri yiktigini
beklemiyordum.

original:
<T><M1/2/1>I was born in London, but I grew up in
Misthallery.<W60> <M1/2/2>It really upset me that so many
houses were damaged.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Londra'da dogdum ama Misthallery'de buyudum.<W60> <M1/2/2>Bu kadar
cok evin zarar gormesi beni cok uzmustu.

original:
<T><M1/1/3/45>The legend of the spectre was a cunning
front for a terrifying conspiracy and a very
sad tale.
translation:
<T><M1/1/3/45>Hayalet efsanesi, korkunc bir komplonun
kurnazca kilifi ve cok huzunlu bir hikayeydi.

original:
<T><M4/1/1>The professor managed to solve all the
mysteries of that case, too.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Profesor o olayin tum gizemlerini de cozmeyi
basarmisti.

original: <T><M2/1/2/45>But there was one mystery that remained.
translation: <T><M2/1/2/45>Ama geriye kalan tek bir gizem vardi.

original: <T><M4/2/3>There was a mysterious man...
translation: <T><M4/2/3>Gizemli bir adam vardi...

original: ナレーション低
translation: Anlatim (Dusuk)

original: <T>What's this? Me, mysterious?!
translation: <T>Ne oluyor? Ben mi gizemli?!

original: <T><M5/1/7/45>Ack! I'd recognise that voice a mile away.
translation: <T><M5/1/7/45>Ah! O sesi kilometrelerce oteden tanirim.

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original: <T><M3/1/1>Of course you would! It's me!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Elbette tanirsin! Benim!

original:
<T><M1/2/6/45>Inspector Grosky. <W>You're looking lively as
ever.
translation:
<T><M1/2/6/45>Mufettis Grosky. <W>Her zamanki gibi
enerjik gorunuyorsunuz.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Now, on to the topic of Inspector Grosky's
first name. <W>Hey, do you have any idea what
it is?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Simdi de Mufettis Grosky'nin adina gelelim. <W>Hey,
onun ne oldugunu biliyor musunuz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>What? <W>What's this? <W><M4/1/1>I wasn't informed of
a spot check!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ne? <W>Bu da ne? <W><M4/1/1>Boyle bir yoklama yapilacagini
kimse bana soylemedi!

original:
<T><M2/2/7/45>Inspector Grosky's first name? This one's
a toughie.
translation: <T><M2/2/7/45>Mufettis Grosky'nin adi mi? Bu zor soru.

original: What is Inspector Grosky's forename?
translation: Mufettis Grosky'nin adi nedir?

original: A. Grip
translation: A. Grip

original: B. Trunk
translation: B. Trunk

original: C. Clamp
translation: C. Clamp

original:
<T><M2/1/2>It does sound a bit like something with
a good strong hold. <W>But it's not right, I'm
afraid.
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Saglam bir tutusu olan bir seye benziyor.
<W>Ama maalesef dogru degil.

original: <T><M3/2/2>Nope, way off!
translation: <T><M3/2/2>Hayir, cok alakasiz!

original: <T><M4/1/1>That's the one!
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Iste o!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Clamp Grosky, that's who I am! Thank my
parents!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Ben Clamp Grosky'yim! Annem babam sag
olsun!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Inspector Grosky works at Scotland Yard and
he's right on the ball when it comes to
investigations.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Mufettis Grosky Scotland Yard'da calisir ve
sorusturma islerinde oldukca atiktir.

original: <T><M2/1/1>Ha ha ha! Well said!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ha ha ha! Guzel soyledin!

original:
<T><M4/1/6>Except that a remarkable number of the
cases he's been assigned to...<W> Well...Luke?
translation:
<T><M4/1/6>Yalniz kendisine verilen davalarin dikkate
deger bir kismi...<W> Sey...Luke?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>They were all solved by the professor,
weren't they?
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Hepsini profesor cozmustu, degil mi?

original:
<T>Ha ha, now I can't deny that! <W><M3/1/1/45>Well, it's been
fun, but I can't stay to chat. I smell a case
brewing!
translation:
<T>Ha ha, bunu inkar edemem! <W><M3/1/1/45>Eglenceliydi
ama sohbet edecek vaktim yok. Yeni bir
davanin kokusunu aldim!

original: <T><M4/1/1>FOR THE YARD!
translation: <T><M4/1/1>YARD ICIN!

original: <T><M1/2/5/45>Yeugh! He kicked up a dust storm!
translation: <T><M1/2/5/45>Iyy! Ortaligi toz dumana katti!

original:
<T><M2/1/7/45>Hmm. It's easy to get sidetracked with
Inspector Grosky in your life.
translation:
<T><M2/1/7/45>Himm. Mufettis Grosky hayatinizdaysa
konudan sapmak cok kolay.

original: <T><M2/2/1>What was it we were talking about?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Biz ne konusuyorduk?

original:
<T><M3/1/2/45>The mysterious man.<W> That was it. He called
himself Descole.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2/45>Gizemli adam.<W> Evet, oydu. Kendine
Descole diyordu.

original: <T><M3/2/3>What do you think he's after?
translation: <T><M3/2/3>Sence neyin pesinde?

original:
<T><M1/1/2/45>I haven't the foggiest, Luke. <W>All we know is
that he seems to know the professor!
translation:
<T><M1/1/2/45>Hicbir fikrim yok Luke. <W>Tek bildigimiz,
profesoru taniyor gibi gorundugu!

original: <T><M2/2/2>Whatever he's up to, it can't be good...
translation: <T><M2/2/2>Ne planliyorsa, iyi bir sey olamaz...

original:
<T><M3/1/2/45>If he even dares to lay a hand on the
professor, I'll knock him into next Sunday.
translation:
<T><M3/1/2/45>Profesore bir dokunmaya kalksin,
onu haftaya savururum.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M3/2/1/45>Who's going to lay a hand on me?
translation: <T><M3/2/1/45>Bana kim dokunacakmis?

original: <T><M1/1/1>Professor!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Profesor!

original:
<T><M2/2/2/45>I was just saying I'll stand against anyone
who threatens you, Professor!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2/45>Sizi tehdit eden kim olursa olsun karsisinda
duracagimi soyluyordum, Profesor!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>That's very reassuring, Emmy. But I think
I should be able to defend myself.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu cok ic rahatlatici, Emmy. Ama sanirim
kendimi savunabilirim.

original: <T><M1/1/3/45>Well, of course, but...
translation: <T><M1/1/3/45>Elbette ama...

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Professor, do you have any idea what
Descole is trying to do?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Profesor, Descole'un ne yapmaya calistigi
hakkinda bir fikriniz var mi?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>I can't say I do, Luke. But I'm quite certain
we'll be seeing him again.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Maalesef yok Luke. Ama onu yeniden
gorecegimize eminim.

original: <T><M5/1/3/45>That's what I'm worried about...
translation: <T><M5/1/3/45>Ben de ondan endiseleniyorum...

original:
<T><M5/2/1/60>All I can surmise is that he's after something
related to my research.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1/60>Tek cikarimim, arastirmalarimla ilgili bir seyin
pesinde oldugu.

original:
<T><M2/2/3>Your research? He's after something to do
with archaeology?
translation:
<T><M2/2/3>Arastirmalariniz mi? Arkeolojiyle ilgili bir seyin
pesinde mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Well, let's take things as they come. He's
sure to rear his head again soon.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Neyse, akisina birakalim. Yakinda yine ortaya
cikacaktir.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Right! What matters most is the adventure
to come!
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Evet! Onemli olan bizi bekleyen macera!

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>You're looking bright-eyed and bushy-tailed
all of a sudden, Luke.
translation: <T><M4/2/1/45>Birdenbire gozlerin parladi, Luke.

original:
<T><M4/1/3>Of course! I am the professor's number one
apprentice!
translation:
<T><M4/1/3>Elbette! Ben profesorun bir numarali
ciragiyim!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Oh, and before I forget, let's see how our
friend did in the quiz!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Aa, unutmadan, bakalim arkadasimiz
bilgi yarismasinda nasil yapti!

original:
<T><M5/1/5>You got every answer right!<W60> I think you'd be
a match for the professor himself!
translation:
<T><M5/1/5>Tum cevaplar dogru!<W60> Bence profesorun kendisiyle bile
bas edebilirsiniz!

original:
<T><M2/1/2>You got just one answer wrong.<W60> You're on
par with me,<M4/1/1/45> the professor's number one
apprentice!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Sadece bir cevabi yanlis yaptiniz.<W60> Benimle ayni
seviyedesiniz,<M4/1/1/45> profesorun bir numarali
ciragiyla!

original:
<T><M2/1/2>You made two mistakes.<W60> You could team up
with the professor's assistant!
translation:
<T><M2/1/2>Iki hata yaptiniz.<W60> Profesorun asistaniyla
ekip olabilirsiniz!

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Was it a bit tricky for you?<W60> <M3/1/1>Well, don't
worry. You can learn more about us during
our adventure together!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Biraz zor mu geldi?<W60> <M3/1/1>Dert etmeyin.
Birlikte cikacagimiz macera boyunca
hakkimizda daha fazlasini ogrenebilirsiniz!

original:
<T><M2/2/2>Oops, you made too many mistakes. <W60><M1/1/1>Hard
luck. But I'll still keep you company on our
adventure!
translation:
<T><M2/2/2>Hoppala, cok fazla hata yaptiniz. <W60><M1/1/1>Sanssizlik.
Ama yine de macerada size eslik edecegim!

original: <T><M2/1/1>Are you all set, Luke?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Hazir misin, Luke?

original: <T><M1/1/1>Ready when you are, Professor!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Siz ne zaman hazirsaniz ben de hazirim, Profesor!

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Good. Don't forget to lock the door on your
way out.
translation: <T><M2/1/1/45>Guzel. Cikarken kapiyi kilitlemeyi unutmayin.

original: ナレーション低
translation: Anlatim (Dusuk)

original:
<T>The key to our world lies in
the legacies from past ages.
translation:
<T>Dunyamizin anahtari,
gecmis caglardan kalan miraslardadir.

original:
<T>Take the ancient civilisation
of the Azran, for instance...

I have sought their treasures
far and wide.
translation:
<T>Ornegin Azran'in kadim uygarligini ele alalim...

Onlarin hazinelerini
dort bir yanda aradim.

original: [not used]
translation: [Kullanilmiyor]

original: <T>In Misthallery, the village of fog...
translation: <T>Sis koyu Misthallery'de...

original: <T>In the lost kingdom of Ambrosia...
translation: <T>Kayip Ambrosia kralliginda...

original: <T>And in the City of Miracles, Monte d'Or.
translation: <T>Ve Mucizeler Sehri Monte d'Or'da.

original:
<T>But whenever I'm on the cusp of uncovering
their secrets, HE sticks his oar in.<W> Time after
infuriating time!
translation:
<T>Ama ne zaman sirlarini ortaya cikarmanin
esigine gelsem, O araya giriyor.<W> Hem de
defalarca, sinir bozucu bir sekilde!

original: デスコール
translation: Descole

original:
<T>How many more times will you stand in my
way, Hershel Layton?
translation:
<T>Yoluma daha kac kez cikacaksin,
Hershel Layton?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>You act upon your intellect as if it's for the
good of mankind, but you know nothing!
Nothing at all!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aklini insanligin iyiligi icin kullaniyormus gibi
davraniyorsun ama hicbir sey bilmiyorsun!
Hicbir sey!

original:
<T><M1/1/1/60>Hershel Layton. You are oblivious, and yet
you still...<W60>manage...<W>to interfere!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/60>Hershel Layton. Hicbir seyin farkinda degilsin ama
yine de...<W60>bir sekilde...<W>engellemeyi basariyorsun!

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Why must you taunt me so? <W>Has fate played
me a cruel hand?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Neden beni boyle kiskirtiyorsun? <W>Kader bana
acimasiz bir oyun mu oynadi?

original: <T><M3/1/1>Oh? What's this?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Oh? Bu da ne?

original: <T><M3/1/1>Time for a spot of fun?
translation: <T><M3/1/1>Biraz eglence zamani mi?

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M7/2/3>Emmy, look!
translation: <T><M7/2/3>Emmy, bak!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M4/1/2>Watch your step, Luke! I don't want you
falling into that chasm.
translation:
<T><M4/1/2>Dikkatli ol Luke! O yariga
dusmeni istemiyorum.

original:
<T><M5/2/3>We've made it to the lowest level of the
ruins!
translation: <T><M5/2/3>Harabelerin en alt seviyesine ulastik!

original:
<T><M2/1/2/45>So these are the remnants of the Akbadain
ruins...
translation:
<T><M2/1/2/45>Demek Akbadain harabelerinin kalintilari
bunlar...

original:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Did the Azran really have such advanced
technology?
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/45>Azran gercekten bu kadar gelismis bir
teknolojiye mi sahipti?

original:
<T><M3/1/3/45>Well, Donald Rutledge was confident of their
existence, but it's a mystery as to what sort
of civilisation they were.
translation:
<T><M3/1/3/45>Donald Rutledge onlarin varligindan emindi ama
ne tur bir uygarlik olduklari hala bir gizem.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Then that would make this the greatest find
in the history of archaeology!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>O zaman bu, arkeoloji tarihindeki en buyuk
kesif olur!

original:
<T><M5/1/2>That's not all. A culture this advanced...
They'll have to rewrite all the history books!
translation:
<T><M5/1/2>Hepsi bu degil. Bu kadar gelismis bir kultur...
Tum tarih kitaplarini yeniden yazmalari gerekecek!

original:
<T><M2/2/2/45>I suppose even the greatest civilisations can
only last so long.
translation:
<T><M2/2/2/45>Sanirim en buyuk uygarliklar bile ancak
bir yere kadar yasayabiliyor.

original: <T>Ah hah hah...
translation: <T>Ah hah hah...

original: <T><M1/1/2>Who's skulking back there?
translation: <T><M1/1/2>Orada arkada kim sinsice dolasiyor?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Now now, young lady. Where are your
manners?
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Hay hay, genc hanim. Terbiyeniz nerede?

original: <T><M1/2/3>Descole!
translation: <T><M1/2/3>Descole!

original: <T><M2/1/2>We thought you'd fled the city!
translation: <T><M2/1/2>Sehirden kactigini saniyorduk!
<T><M2/2/1>Ben mi? <W30>Kacmak mi?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Don't be absurd. <W>I found what I wanted. The
city simply held no more meaning for me.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sacmalamayin. <W>Istedigimi buldum. Sehrin
benim icin artik hicbir anlami kalmamisti.

original:
<T><M5/2/3>And now you're here. Just what are you
playing at?!
translation: <T><M5/2/3>Simdi de buradasin. Ne oyun ceviriyorsun?!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Perhaps if you asked more politely, I would
deign to answer you.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Belki daha nazik sorsaydiniz, cevap vermeye
tenezzul ederdim.

original:
<T>That professor of yours clearly hasn't taught
you decorum.
translation:
<T>Su profesorunuz belli ki size gorgu kurallarini
ogretememis.

original:
<T><M3/1/2>Gah! Spit it out, Descole! What are you
after?
translation:
<T><M3/1/2>Off! Soyle artik, Descole! Neyin
pesindesin?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>And under what obligation must I answer?
<W60>No matter.<M2/2/1> I do have something interesting
to tell you.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Peki ben hangi zorunlulukla cevap verecekmisim?
<W60>Neyse.<M2/2/1> Size soyleyecek ilginc bir seyim var.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Boy! You implied that the Azran civilisation
crumbled, did you not?
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Boy! Azran uygarliginin coktugunu ima
ettin, degil mi?

original: <T><M3/2/3>I'm not {''}Boy{''} - my name is Luke Triton!
translation: <T><M3/2/3>Ben {''}Boy{''} degilim; adim Luke Triton!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>...As I was saying, the Azran civilisation is
still very much alive.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>...Dedigim gibi, Azran uygarligi
hala dimdik ayakta.

original: <T><M5/1/2/45>That's impossible!
translation: <T><M5/1/2/45>Bu imkansiz!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Do you deny the truth laid out before you?
<W90><M1/1/1/60>You know it's true.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Onunuze serilen gercegi inkar mi ediyorsunuz?
<W90><M1/1/1/60>Dogru oldugunu biliyorsunuz.

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>You're just blinding yourselves to the truth.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Siz sadece gercege gozlerinizi kapatiyorsunuz.

original: <T><M1/1/3/45>And what {''}truth{''} would that be?
translation: <T><M1/1/3/45>Peki bu hangi {''}truth{''} olacak?

original: <T><M2/2/2/45>We're...blinding ourselves?
translation: <T><M2/2/2/45>Biz...gozumuzu mu kapatiyoruz?

original:
<T><M3/1/1>Think back carefully. Back to the time you
met Layton.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Iyice dusunun. Layton ile
tanistiginiz zamana donun.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Descole!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Descole!

original: <T><M5/1/2>Enough riddles! Tell us what you know!
translation: <T><M5/1/2>Yeter bilmece! Bildiklerini soyle!

original: <T><M2/1/1>Oh, I will, Emmy Altava. I will.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Elbette, Emmy Altava. Elbette soyleyecegim.

original: <T><M5/1/4>How do you know my name?!<W90><M5/1/2>
translation: <T><M5/1/4>Adimi nereden biliyorsun?!<W90><M5/1/2>

original:
<T><M3/1/1><K>Hm?</K> <W>Hmph. It seems our little repartee must
end here.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1><K>Hi?</K> <W>Him. Gorunuse gore kucuk atismamiz burada
bitmeli.

original: <T><M1/1/2>Wait! Descole, hold on!
translation: <T><M1/1/2>Dur! Descole, bekle!

original: <T><M2/2/1>Until next time, Miss Altava.
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Bir dahaki sefere kadar, Bayan Altava.

original:
<T>Graaaaaaagh! Get back here, you reprobate
scum!
translation:
<T>Grrraaaaaah! Geri gel buraya, alcak
pislik!

original: グロスキー
translation: Grosky

original: <T><M4/2/2>Where did he go? That villain!<M4/1/2>
translation: <T><M4/2/2>Nereye gitti? Su herif!<M4/1/2>

original: <T><M5/2/3>He was just here! He went that way!<W65><M1/2/3>
translation: <T><M5/2/3>Az once buradaydi! Su tarafa gitti!<W65><M1/2/3>

original: <T><M1/1/2>You've been chasing Descole, Inspector?
translation: <T><M1/1/2>Descole'un pesinden mi kosuyordunuz, Mufettis?

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Of course! He's the one responsible for
putting the city into this fine mess!<M3/1/2>
translation: <T><M3/2/2>Elbette! Sehri bu hale sokan o!<M3/1/2>

original:
<T><M3/2/2>Thinks he can just shirk the law, eh? Well,
he's got another thing coming! See you in
London, Emmy!<M3/1/2>
translation:
<T><M3/2/2>Kanundan pacayi siyiracagini saniyor, oyle mi?
Heh, daha neler! Londra'da gorusuruz,
Emmy!<M3/1/2>

original: <T><M2/2/1/45>What's wrong?

<T><M1/1/1>No, no, it's nothing. I'm just getting a little
tired of Grosky's antics.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Yok, yok, bir sey yok. Sadece Grosky'nin
numaralarindan biraz yoruldum.

original: <T><M2/1/2>He's very energetic.
translation: <T><M2/1/2>Cok enerjik.

original: <T><M2/1/6>Energetic, hah. That's one word for him.
translation: <T><M2/1/6>Enerjik, ha. Ona denebilecek kelimelerden biri.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Well then, shall we wrap things up here and
head back to London?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/45>Pekala, burada toparlayip
Londra'ya donelim mi?

original: <T><M1/2/1>Ah, Professor! We just saw Descole!
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Ah, Profesor! Az once Descole'u gorduk!

original:
<T><M2/2/3>Do you think he's after something in the
ruins?
translation: <T><M2/2/3>Sence harabelerde bir seyin pesinde mi?

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>After something? <W>Say, perhaps, the lost
legacy of the Azran?
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Bir seyin pesinde mi? <W>Mesela...Azran'in
kayip mirasinin mi?

original: <T><M1/1/3>What did you say, Professor?
translation: <T><M1/1/3>Ne dediniz, Profesor?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Oh, don't mind me. <M1/1/1><W>Let's go. I'm hoping to
be back in London for supper.
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Bos verin beni. <M1/1/1><W>Hadi gidelim. Aksam
yemegine Londra'ya donmus olmayi umuyorum.

original: <T><M1/2/5>Oh! <W60><M4/1/5>You heard him, Emmy. Let's go!
translation: <T><M1/2/5>Oh! <W60><M4/1/5>Duydun iste, Emmy. Hadi gidelim!

original:
<T><M4/2/6>You're too predictable, Luke! You little
greedy guts.
translation:
<T><M4/2/6>Cok tahmin edilebilirsin Luke! Acgozlu
yaramaz seni.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I bet you a treacle pudding you can't finish
before me!
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bahse girerim benden once bitiremezsin!
Bir pekmezli pudingine var misin?

original:
<T><M5/2/1>Ooh, you'll regret you ever said that, young
man!
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Ah, bunu dedigine pisman olacaksin, delikanli!

original:
<T><M3/1/1>By the way, Professor. <W>Can we come back
and explore the ruins some other time?
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bu arada, Profesor. <W>Baska bir zaman geri gelip
harabeleri kesfedebilir miyiz?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Yes! That sounds like a good idea. Some
time when we'll be able to have a bit of
peace and quiet.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Evet! Iyi fikir. Biraz
huzur ve sessizlik bulabildigimiz
bir zamanda.

original: <T><M4/1/1>All right. I see no reason why not.
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Peki. Neden olmasin.

original: ブロネフ
translation: Bronev

original: <T><M2/2/2>Jean Descole and Hershel Layton.
translation: <T><M2/2/2>Jean Descole ve Hershel Layton.

original:
<T><M1/4/3/45>Even your great minds cannot grasp the true
importance of the Azran legacy.
translation:
<T><M1/4/3/45>Buyuk zihinleriniz bile Azran mirasinin
gercek onemini kavrayamaz.

original:
<T><M3/1/1/60>But no matter. The two of you will never so
much as lay a finger on the truth.<W> Not while
I'm in control.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1/60>Ama onemi yok. Siz ikiniz gercege bir parmak
bile dokunamayacaksiniz.<W> Ben kontrol bende
oldukca.

original: <T><M2/2/1/45>Ah hah hah hah...
translation: <T><M2/2/1/45>Ah hah hah hah...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M3/1/1/45>Let's stay here until nightfall.
translation: <T><M3/1/1/45>Gece cokene kadar burada kalalim.

original: Explore Monte d'Or at night?
translation: Monte d'Or'u gece kesfet?

original: <T><M5/1/1/45>Let's have a rest until it's daytime.
translation: <T><M5/1/1/45>Gunduz olana kadar biraz dinlenelim.

original: Explore Monte d'Or by day?
translation: Monte d'Or'u gunduz kesfet?

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Then it's settled. We'll rest here a while.
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Oyleyse karar verildi. Bir sure burada dinlenelim.

original: <T><M6/1/1/45>It's time to resume our investigations.
translation: <T><M6/1/1/45>Sorusturmamiza devam etme zamani.

original:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Change of plan. We'll continue as we were
before.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/45>Plan degisti. Daha once
yaptigimiz gibi devam edecegiz.

original: ヤングレイトン
translation: Genc Layton

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>I'm feeling sleepy. Maybe I'll close my eyes
for a little while...
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Uykum geldi. Belki gozlerimi biraz
kaparim...

original: Explore Stansbury at night?
translation: Stansbury'yi gece kesfet?

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>Time for an early bed, I think.
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Sanirim erken yatma zamani.

original: Explore Stansbury by day?
translation: Stansbury'yi gunduz kesfet?

original:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Come on, don't oversleep this time,
Hershel!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1/45>Hadi, bu sefer fazla uyuma,
Hershel!

original: <T><M4/1/1/45>Ahh, a good sleep works wonders!
translation: <T><M4/1/1/45>Ahh, iyi bir uyku mucizeler yaratir!

original:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Actually, no. I've got plenty to be getting on
with right now.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1/45>Aslinda hayir. Su an yapacak
cok isim var.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M7/1/1>Look! The parrot dropped a coin!
translation: <T><M7/1/1>Bak! Papagan bir bozuk para dusurdu!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M5/1/1/45>This looks like a hint coin...<W60><M5/2/1>but it isn't.
translation: <T><M5/1/1/45>Bu bir ipucu parasi gibi gorunuyor...<W60><M5/2/1>ama degil.

original:
<T><M2/2/4>Aw, we can't trade it for a hint? What is it
then?
translation:
<T><M2/2/4>Tuh, bunu bir ipucu icin takas edemiyor muyuz? O
zaman bu ne?

original:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Hmm... <W30>Well, as its use is an enigma to us,
why not call it an enigma coin?
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/45>Hmm... <W30>Kullanimi bize muamma olduguna gore,
neden ona muamma parasi demeyelim?

original: <T><M2/2/2>An enigma coin?
translation: <T><M2/2/2>Muamma parasi mi?

original: <T><M1/1/1/45>Where did that parrot come from, anyway?
translation: <T><M1/1/1/45>Bu papagan nereden cikti acaba?

original:
<T><M2/1/1/45>I don't believe it's anyone's pet. Perhaps it
flew in from somewhere.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1/45>Birinin evcil hayvani oldugunu sanmiyorum. Belki
bir yerlerden ucup gelmistir.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Parrots really have it easy, don't they?
Flying around wherever they please.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Papaganlarin hayati gercekten kolay, degil mi?
Canlari nereye isterse oraya ucuyorlar.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>Monte d'Or really is an amazing place. It's
like one giant funfair!
translation:
<T>Monte d'Or gercekten harika bir yer. Koca bir
lunapark gibi!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>It's spectacular, isn't it? You know, some
people travel half the globe just to witness
the Monte d'Or festivities.
translation:
<T>Muhtesem, degil mi? Biliyor musun, bazi
insanlar Monte d'Or senliklerini gormek icin
dunyanin yarisini dolasiyor.

original:
<T>That's crazy! Still, I can see why. You'd
never see something like this in London!
translation:
<T>Cok cilginca! Yine de nedenini anliyorum.
Londra'da boyle bir sey asla goremezdin!

original:
<T>Hm, Professor? Do you think Emmy will be
here soon? She said for us to meet her at
the monument...
translation:
<T>Himm, Profesor? Emmy sence yakinda gelir mi?
Anitta bulusmamizi soylemisti...

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>I'm back, Professor, Luke! I hope you
weren't waiting long. Now, wait till you hear
this!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Geldim, Profesor, Luke! Umarim cok
beklemediniz. Sunu bir duyun bakalim!

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Your personal enquiries were fruitful, I take
it?
translation: <T><M1/2/1>Kisisel arastirmalariniz verimli gecti, oyle mi?

original:
<T>Yep, ripe and juicy to boot! We have a new,
{''}modern{''} way to investigate! It's different
from what we're used to.
translation:
<T>Evet, hem de tam kivaminda! Arastirmak icin
{''}modern{''} bir yontemimiz var artik! Alistigimizdan
farkli.

original: <T>Okay, listen up.
translation: <T>Tamam, iyi dinleyin.

original:
<T><M6/1/1/30>Touch the magnifying glass in the corner of
the Touch Screen to switch to Investigation
Mode.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1/30>Inceleme Modu'na gecmek icin Dokunmatik
Ekran'in kosesindeki buyutece dokunun.

original:
<T>In this mode, the magnifying glass will
appear on the top screen, like this.
translation:
<T>Bu modda buyutec ust ekranda soyle
gorunecek.

original:
<T><M2/2/1/30>You can move it around by sliding the stylus
on the Touch Screen in the direction you
want.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1/30>Kalemi Dokunmatik Ekran uzerinde istediginiz
yone kaydirarak buyuteci hareket ettirebilirsiniz.

original:
<T>Try moving the magnifying glass around, and
you'll see that it turns orange over certain
areas.
translation:
<T>Buyuteci gezdirmeyi deneyin; bazi bolgelerin
uzerinde turuncuya dondugunu goreceksiniz.

original:
<T>When it turns orange, you can interact with
the environment. Just touch the Touch
Screen to take a closer look!
translation:
<T>Turuncuya dondugunde cevreyle etkilesime
girebilirsiniz. Yakindan bakmak icin
Dokunmatik Ekran'a dokunun!

original:
<T><M4/2/1/30>No need for anything fancy. Give the screen
a quick tap and that'll do it. <W>Everything all
right so far? Good!
translation:
<T><M4/2/1/30>Suslu bir seye gerek yok. Ekrana hizlica bir
dokunus yeter. <W>Simdilik her sey tamam mi?
Guzel!

original:
<T><M2/1/-/30>I think so. Just slide the stylus on the Touch
Screen to look around <M-/1/-/->and give it a quick
tap to investigate?
translation:
<T><M2/1/-/30>Sanirim oyle. Etrafa bakmak icin kalemi
Dokunmatik Ekran'da kaydir <M-/1/-/->ve incelemek icin
hizlica dokun, degil mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Thank you, Emmy. Well then, let's get
a move on. Be sure to check anything that
looks out of the ordinary.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Tesekkurler, Emmy. O halde, yola koyulalim.
Siradisi gorunen her seyi mutlaka kontrol edin.

original: セレナ
translation: Serena

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Wait, don't tell me.<W> You're going to
questerview me, right? Wonderfabulant!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Dur, soyleme.<W> Bana bir
sorguroportaj yapacaksin, degil mi? Harikafantastik!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Er... Well, I don't know about that, but we
were hoping to enquire about the strange
occurrences in Monte d'Or.
translation:
<T>Ee... Yani, tam oyle mi bilmem ama biz
Monte d'Or'da yasanan tuhaf
olaylari sormak istiyorduk.

original:
<T>Oh, I'm all over it! I never miss a dramedy!
<M3/2/1>They're so thrillerating!
translation:
<T>Ah, ben buna bayilirim! Hicbir dramedi kacirmam!
<M3/2/1>O kadar gerilim-eglenceliler ki!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T>So you can tell us about the miracles?!
translation: <T>Yani bize mucizelerden bahsedebilirsin?!

original: <T>Sure!
translation: <T>Tabii!

original:
<T>I'll tell you all I know if you can fulify my
passion for thrillerating fun!
translation:
<T>Eger gerilim-eglenceye olan tutkumu
doyurabilirsen bildigim her seyi anlatirim!

original:
<T>Why stop there? It's no fun if you don't
copartipate!
translation:
<T>Neden orada duralim? Sen de
ortak-katilmazsan hic eglenceli olmaz!

original: <T>Try my puzzle again! It's wonderfabulant!
translation: <T>Bulmacami bir daha dene! Harikafantastik!

original:
<T>Tell me if the Masked Dandleman turns up
again.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Dandleman ortaya cikarsa
bana soyle.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>A dark, mistevious stranger in a suit like
snow? I'm there.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Kar gibi beyaz bir takim elbiseli karanlik,
muzip bir yabanci mi? Ben varim.

original: セレナ
translation: Serena

original:
<T><M4/2/1>Sir, your wit is impressibly razor-quick!
Watch you don't cut yourself.
translation:
<T><M4/2/1>Efendim, zekaniz inanilmaz derecede jilet gibi hizli!
Dikkat edin de kendinizi kesmeyin.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>Are you willing to tell us about the miracles
now?
translation:
<T>Simdi bize mucizeleri
anlatmaya razi misin?

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Ever since the mistevious dandleman in
white appeared on the scene, there's been
one miracle after another!
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Beyazlar icindeki muzip dandleman
ortaya ciktigindan beri,
mucize ustune mucize yasaniyor!

original:
<T><M3/2/1>And I can't get enough of them! He's
leagues above your average magiman. It's
like comparing the moon to a spoon!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ve ben bunlara doyamiyorum! Siradan bir magimanin
cok cok ustunde. Ayla
kasigi kiyaslamak gibi!

original:
<T>{''}Dandleman in white{''}? If we're to presume
you mean gentleman, that would mean...
Well, I'm not quite sure.
translation:
<T>{''}Dandleman in white{''}? Sayet
gentleman demek istedigini varsayarsak, bu su anlama gelir...
Ama... Pek emin degilim.

original:
<T>There's plenty of witnesses to questerview.
Try asking at the hotel reception?
translation:
<T>Sorgugorus yapilacak pek cok tanik var.
Otel resepsiyonuna sormayi dener misin?

original: <T>Thank you. We'll take your advice.
translation: <T>Tesekkur ederim. Tavsiyenizi dikkate alacagiz.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M5/2/1>I suppose we'd better head for the hotel
then, right Professor? Let me explain how
movement works.
translation:
<T><M5/2/1>O zaman otele gitsek iyi olacak,
degil mi Profesor? Hareket etmenin
nasil oldugunu anlatayim.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>See the orange circle on the Touch Screen?
Touch it to move to that location.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Dokunmatik Ekran'daki turuncu daireyi goruyor musun?
Oraya gitmek icin ona dokun.

original: <T>That sounds reasonable. Let's give it a go.
translation: <T>Mantikli gorunuyor. Hadi deneyelim.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
<T>That's the shopping district, Professor. We
want to be going towards the hotel.
translation:
<T>Orasi alisveris bolgesi, Profesor. Biz
otelin oldugu tarafa gitmeliyiz.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T><M6/1/1>Just look at this place!
translation: <T><M6/1/1>Suraya bak!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T><M5/1/1>Roughly half the buildings on this street are
hotels. They wouldn't be able to
accommodate all the tourists otherwise.
translation:
<T><M5/1/1>Bu sokaktaki binalarin yaklasik yarisi
otel. Yoksa bunca turisti
barindiramazlardi.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Oh, I don't know. You could always stuff
them away in shopping bags.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Bilemiyorum. Istersen hepsini
alisveris posetlerine tikistirabilirsin.

original:
<T>Right then. Let's continue our enquiries and
see what we can gather in the vicinity.
translation:
<T>Pekala. Sorusturmaya devam edelim ve
cevrede neler ogrenebilecegimize bakalim.

original:
<T><M7/1/1>Why don't we try asking that boy with the
balloons?
translation:
<T><M7/1/1>Balonlu su cocuga sormayi
denesek ya?

original: パック
translation: Puck

original:
<T>Ahem.<M3/2/1>La la-laa! I love the carnival! It's so
much fun!<W> ...Yippee! <M1/2/1>So exciting!
translation:
<T>Ohom.<M3/2/1>La la-laa! Karnavali seviyorum! Cok
cok eglenceli!<W> ...Yuppi! <M1/2/1>Ne kadar heyecanli!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>I agree. Monte d'Or is quite the colourful
locale. Now more than ever, or so I've
heard.
translation:
<T>Katiliyorum. Monte d'Or oldukca renkli bir
yer. Hem de her zamankinden daha cok, diye
duydum.

original:
<T>Could you perhaps tell us about the
mysterious events that have been happening
in this city?
translation:
<T>Bu sehirde olup biten gizemli olaylar
hakkinda bize biraz anlatir misiniz?

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Oh, you didn't just stop to chat then. Well,
I'll tell you what you want...after you solve
the puzzle I hid.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Demek sadece sohbet etmeye ugramadiniz. Peki,
istediginizi soyleyecegim...sakladigim bulmacayi
cozdukten sonra.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Oooooh! Hide-and-seek with puzzles! <W>An
eensy-weensy clue for you - look up at the
sign and change your view.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Oooooh! Bulmacali saklambac! <W>Size minicik
bir ipucu: Tabelaya bakin ve bakis acinizi
deyistirin.

original:
<T>When the magnifying glass turns blue you
can take a closer look.
translation:
<T>Buyutec maviye dondugunde daha yakindan
bakabilirsiniz.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original: <T><M2/1/1>What's above the sign?
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Tabelanin ustunde ne var?

original:
<T><M1/2/1>That's for you to find out. Just touch the
Touch Screen when the magnifying glass
turns blue. Then, yippeeeee!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Onu sen bulacaksin. Buyutec maviye
dondugunde Dokunmatik Ekran'a dokun.
Sonra, yuppiiiiii!

original: <T>I already told you, look at the sign.
translation: <T>Sana zaten soyledim, tabelaya bak.

original:
<T><M2/2/1>La la-la. Maybe I hid it too well for you. You
need to check the spot where the
magnifying glass turns blue.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>La la-la. Belki de senin icin fazla iyi sakladim.
Buyutecin maviye dondugu noktayi
kontrol etmelisin.

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original: <T>I hadn't expected a puzzle to turn up there!
translation: <T>Orada bir bulmaca cikacagini beklemiyordum!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
<T>This must be what the child meant for us to
find.
translation:
<T>Cocugun bulmamizi istedigi sey
bu olmali.

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M1/2/2>Let me solve this one, Professor! I'll have it
done in a jiffy!
translation:
<T><M1/2/2>Bunu ben cozeyim, Profesor! Hemen
hallederim!

original: <T><M2/1/3>Urgh. I jumped right into that one.
translation: <T><M2/1/3>Off. Ona baliklama atladim.

original:
<T><M1/2/3>Let's put the past behind us and try again.
The professor's assistant never backs down
from a challenge!
translation:
<T><M1/2/3>Gecmisi geride birakip yeniden deneyelim.
Profesorun asistani
bir meydan okumadan asla kacmaz!

original: <T><M1/2/4>Done and dusted!
translation: <T><M1/2/4>Bitti gitti!

original:
<T>I believe you just solved a hidden puzzle,
Emmy. Excellent work!
translation:
<T>Sanirim gizli bir bulmacayi cozdun,
Emmy. Harika is!

original:
<T>Now that we've done as the boy asked,
perhaps he'll prove a little more informative.
translation:
<T>Cocugun dedigini yaptigimiza gore,
belki biraz daha konuskan olur.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>And you remember how to return to normal
view, don't you? Simply touch <CR>Zoom Out</CR>
on the Touch Screen.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Normal gorunume nasil donecegini hatirliyorsun,
degil mi? Dokunmatik Ekran'da <CR>Zoom Out</CR>
secenegine dokunman yeter.

original: パック
translation: Puck

original:
<T><M1/2/1>Wahey! Good on you for solving it! <W>I had
buckets of fun watching!
translation:
<T><M1/2/1>Vay be! Cozdun ya! <W>Izlerken
cok eglendim!

original: レミ
translation: Emmy

original:
<T><M6/2/2>You'll keep your promise I hope? Naughty
boys don't get any presents, you know!
translation:
<T><M6/2/2>Sozunu tutarsin umarim? Yaramaz
cocuklar hediye alamaz, bilirsin!

original:
<T>Of course! <W>Amazing things have been
happening! They say we're under the curse
of the Mask of Chaos.
translation:
<T>Elbette! <W>Inanilmaz seyler
oluyor! Kaos Maskesi'nin
laneti altindaymisiz diyorlar.

original:
<T>It's a scary-looking mask. I'd be hiding
under the covers if the feats weren't so
spectacular!
translation:
<T>Korkunc gorunen bir maske. Bu numaralar
bu kadar muhtesem olmasaydi,
ben coktan yorganin altina saklanmistim!

original:
<T>Who knows what the Masked Gentleman will
do next? It's the talk of the town.
translation:
<T>Maskeli Centilmen bir sonraki sefer
ne yapacak kim bilir? Sehrin dilinde!

original:
<T><M2/2/1>Oh, look, the parade's about to start! I'd
better go! But it's been fun talking to you.
translation:
<T><M2/2/1>Aa, bak, gecit toreni baslamak uzere! Ben
gitsem iyi olur! Ama seninle konusmak guzeldi.

original:
<T>Thanks for playing the demo version of
Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask!
Hope you enjoyed it!
translation:
<T>Demo surumunu oynadiginiz icin tesekkurler:
Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask!
Umarim keyif almissinizdir!

original: <T><M3/3/1>Yip-yip-yippee! Carnival here I come!
translation: <T><M3/3/1>Yasasin yasasin! Karnaval, geliyorum!

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
It makes my eyes go
funny if I stare at it...
translation:
Uzun uzun bakarsam
gozlerim garip oluyor...

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
I'd advise against
staring at it for too
long, Luke.
translation:
Buna cok uzun sure
bakmani onermem,
Luke.

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
Neon lights, glitz and
glamour... I can't say
I'm too taken by it.
translation:
Neon isiklari, ihtisam ve
gosteris... Pek de
hosuma gitmedi.

original:
My poor eyes aren't yet
accustomed to all these
street lights.
translation:
Zavalli gozlerim daha
butun bu sokak
isiklarina alisamadi.

original:
It's bright, so it should
be safe at night, right?
translation:
Aydinlik, yani gece
guvenli olmali,
degil mi?

original:
It's a bit of a shame that
the lights drown out all
the stars...
translation:
Isiklarin tum
yildizlari bastirmasi
biraz yazik...

original:
Wow! It looks as if it's
sparkling!
translation:
Vay canina! Sanki
piril piril
parliyor!

original:
A shower may cleanse
the body, but a fountain
cleanses the soul.
translation:
Dus bedeni temizler,
ama bir fiskiye ruhu
temizler.

original:
My eyes are riveted to
this thing!
translation:
Gozlerim buna
kilitlendi!

original:
The grass is always
greener on the other
side, but not the neon!
translation:
Cimen karsi tarafta
hep daha yesildir, ama
neon icin gecerli degil!

original:
Mmmm, this place smells
really good.
translation:
Mmmm, burasi
gercekten cok
guzel kokuyor.

original:
{''}Miracle Caf{'e}{''}. Very
tempting. I don't see
any free tables, though.
translation:
{''}Miracle Caf{'e}{''}. Cok
cazip. Ama bos
masa goremiyorum.

original:
They've managed to affix
quite a few lamps up
there.
translation:
Oraya epey
lamba yerlestirmeyi
basarmislar.

original:
That's a spiky tower, and
no mistake!
translation:
Bu bayagi sivri bir
kule, kesin!

original:
Ah! The perfect chance
for a little snapshot!
translation:
Ah! Kucuk bir
fotograf icin harika
firsat!

original:
If one of us gets lost,
we should meet under
that marquee!
translation:
Birimiz kaybolursa,
su tentenin altinda
bulusalim!

original:
It's uplifting to see
those flags fluttering
fiercely in the wind.
translation:
Ruzgarda siddetle
dalgalanan o
bayraklar icimi aciyor.

original:
How many people do
you suppose it took
to put it up?!
translation:
Bunu kurmak icin
kac kisi gerekmistir
acaba?!

original:
This looks like a nice
caf{'e}. It seems to have
plenty of customers.
translation:
Guzel bir
caf{'e}ye benziyor.
Musterisi de bol.

original:
This street looks much
better lit up at night than
during the day.
translation:
Bu sokak gece
aydinlatilinca gunduzden
daha guzel gorunuyor.

original:
Solid stone. Do you think
they'll ever turn back to
normal?
translation:
Tas gibi. Sence
bir daha normale
donerler mi?

original:
If I get turned to stone,
don't make me into a
garden gnome, please.
translation:
Eger ben de tasa
donusursem, lutfen beni
bahce cucesi yapma.

original:
It's scientifically
improbable, and yet
here they are...
translation:
Bilimsel olarak
imkansiz, ama
iste buradalar...

original:
It's the curse. The curse
of the mask!
translation:
Bu bir lanet.
Maskenin laneti!

original:
You and your curses,
Luke. You're always
so superstitious!
translation:
Sen ve lanetlerin,
Luke. Hep bu kadar
batil inanclisin!

original:
The masked man's
motives are as of yet
unclear. Hmm...
translation:
Maskeli adamin
niyeti henuz
belli degil. Himm...

original:
They must have been
petrified before they
were...petrified.
translation:
Tas kesilmeden once
cok korkmus olmalilar,
sonra da... tas kesilmisler.

original:
Is it safe to carry on our
investigation?
translation:
Sorusturmaya
devam etmek
guvenli mi?

original:
We have to press on if
we are to uncover the
truth. Let's continue.
translation:
Gercegi ortaya
cikarmak istiyorsak
devam etmeliyiz. Hadi.

original:
Anyone who's not stone
is trembling with fear!
translation:
Tas olmayan herkes
korkudan titriyor!

original:
You'd have to have a
heart of stone not to
be upset by this.
translation:
Buna uzulmemek icin
kalbin tas olmasi
gerekir.

original:
This was by no means a
miracle. The result is far
more like a nightmare.
translation:
Bu kesinlikle bir
mucize degildi. Sonuc,
daha cok bir kabus.

original: コイン
translation: Para

original: You found a hint coin!

original: アイテム

original:
You found a new item for

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
Wow, it's so vast I feel
a little lost.
translation:
Vay canina, o kadar genis ki
biraz kaybolmus gibi hissediyorum.

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
It's certainly well lit in
here. I wonder just how
many bulbs are used.
translation:
Icerisi gercekten iyi
aydinlatilmis. Acaba
kac ampul kullaniyorlar?

original: レミ
translation: Remi

original:
This marquee is huge!
I'd love to climb all
the way up to the top.
translation:
Bu tente kocaman!
En tepesine kadar
tirmanmak isterdim.

original:
The shops in Monte d'Or
stay open unusually late.
translation:
Monte d'Or'daki dukkanlar
alisilmadik derecede gec
kapaniyor.

original:
Everything's so bright! I
guess the shops have to
compete with the parade.
translation:
Her yer cok parlak!
Sanirim dukkanlar gecitle
rekabet etmek zorunda.

original:
I wish they had some
shops that interested me.
translation:
Keske ilgimi ceken
birkac dukkan olsaydi.

original:
There's some horrible
noise coming from this
place.
translation:
Bu yerden korkunc
bir gurultu
geliyor.

original:
Don't be rude, Luke.
Tourists love their
karaoke.
translation:
Kaba olma, Luke.
Turistler
karaokeyi sever.

original:
The partygoers in there
seem blissfully oblivious
to the outside world.
translation:
Iceridekiler dis dunyadan
habersizmis gibi
keyiflerine bakiyor.

original:
Click! An unforgettable
moment, preserved in
history forever.
translation:
Klik! Unutulmaz bir
an, sonsuza dek
tarihe kazindi.

original:
For such a young city,
the variety of architecture
is quite surprising.
translation:
Bu kadar genc bir sehir
olmasina ragmen,
mimari cesitlilik sasirtici.

original:
It's just one long,
straight road! I can
see right to the end!
translation:
Tek bir uzun,
dumduz yol! Ta
sonunu gorebiliyorum!

original:
The scale of this marquee
is really in a whole other
league.
translation:
Bu tentenin olcegi
gercekten bambaska
bir ligde.

original:
The carnival's come to
town and there's no
stopping it!
translation:
Karnaval sehre geldi
ve artik onu durdurmak
mumkun degil!

original:
The main street seems
seldom frequented
during the day.
translation:
Ana cadde gunduzleri
pek sik
ugranmiyor gibi.

original:
It must be a boring
time of day for the
shopkeepers.
translation:
Dukkan sahipleri icin
gunun bu saati
sikici olmali.

original:
You might be right.
That shopkeeper's
having a nap!
translation:
Hakli olabilirsin.
Su dukkan sahibi
uyukluyor!

original: It's not open yet.
translation: Henuz acik degil.

original:
I think they're probably
getting ready for this
evening's business.
translation:
Sanirim bu aksamki
is icin
hazirlaniyorlardir.

original:
I suppose they open their
doors to coincide with
the parade.
translation:
Sanirim kapilarini
gecitle ayni zamana
gore aciyorlar.

original:
It's the curse. The curse
of the mask!
translation:
Bu bir lanet.
Maskenin laneti!

original:
You and your curses,
Luke. You're always
so superstitious!
translation:
Sen ve lanetlerin,
Luke. Hep bu kadar
batil inanclisin!

original:
The Gentleman's motives
are as of yet unclear.
Hmm...
translation:
Centilmenin niyeti henuz
belli degil.
Himm...

translation: Para

original: You found a hint coin!
translation: Bir ipucu parasi buldun!

original: アイテム
translation: Esya

original:
You found a new item for
your collection box!
translation:
Koleksiyon kutun icin yeni bir
esya buldun!

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
An art gallery! I don't
suppose they allow
photography...
translation:
Bir sanat galerisi! Fotograf
cekmeye izin verdiklerini
sanmiyorum...

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
It's a real shame the
gallery's shut.
translation:
Galerinin kapali olmasi
gercekten yazik.

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
I hear tourists come from
far and wide to visit this
gallery.
translation:
Duyduguma gore turistler
bu galeriyi gormek icin
uzaklardan geliyor.

original:
It's got some pretty
unique exhibitions,
I'll give it that!
translation:
Kabul etmeliyim ki
oldukca benzersiz
sergileri var!

original:
I think it's even bigger
than the galleries I
saw in London.
translation:
Bence Londra'da
gordugum galerilerden
bile daha buyuk.

original:
Those beams turn the
night sky into a rainbow!
translation:
Su isinlar gece
gokyuzunu gokkusagina ceviriyor!

original:
Yes, the way the colours
meld into each other is
rather effective.
translation:
Evet, renklerin birbirine
karisma bicimi
oldukca etkileyici.

original:
It's beautiful...and a little
bit eerie.
translation:
Guzel... ama biraz da
urkutucu.

original:
The wind keeps blowing
sand in my mouth! Ptuh!
Ptuh!
translation:
Ruzgar durmadan agzima
kum dolduruyor! Puf!
Puf!

original:
The phantasmagoria of
the night is all but
gone now.
translation:
Gecenin hayal dunyasi
artik neredeyse tamamen
kayboldu.

original:
It's as if the city shares
two completely different
sides.
translation:
Sanki sehrin
iki bambaska
yuzu var.

translation: コイン

translation: Bir ipucu parasi buldun!

original: アイテム

original:
You found a new item for
