translation:
Koleksiyon kutun icin
yeni bir esya buldun!

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
Look at these, Luke!
Aren't they cute?
translation:
Suna bak, Luke!
Ne kadar da tatlilar, degil mi?

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
They're cuddly toys. Of
course they're cute!
translation:
Onlar pelus oyuncak. Tabii
ki tatli olacaklar!

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
Erm, what can I say...
It's a novel design.
translation:
Sey, ne diyeyim...
Oldukca ozgun bir tasarim.

original:
Ah, a toy car. I always
had a fondness for them
as a child.
translation:
Ah, bir oyuncak araba.
Cocukken onlara hep
bir zaafim vardi.

original:
I reckon Luke could fit
in there. What do you
think, Professor?
translation:
Bence Luke oraya sigar.
Ne dersiniz,
Profesor?

original:
Oh, come on, Emmy!
I'm not that small!
translation:
Haydi ama, Emmy!
O kadar da kucuk degilim!

original:
Those veggies are so
bright! Did they put
neon in them, too?
translation:
Su sebzeler ne kadar
parlak! Onlara da neon
mu koymuslar?

original:
The key to a balanced
diet is never far away.
translation:
Dengeli beslenmenin anahtari
hic de uzakta degil.

original:
I'd love to take a big bite
out of one of those juicy
tomatoes.
translation:
Su sulu domateslerden
birinden koca bir isirik
almak isterdim.

original:
Closed. We'll have to
wait till morning for
fresh veg, then.
translation:
Kapali. O zaman taze
sebze icin sabaha kadar
beklemeliyiz.

original:
I suspect the staff want
to take part in the
carnival too.
translation:
Sanirim calisanlar da
karnavala katilmak
istiyor.

original:
It's a shame they don't
let you see inside...
translation:
Iceriyi gormene izin
vermemeleri yazik...

original: コイン
translation: コイン

original: You found a hint coin!
translation: Bir ipucu parasi buldun!

original: アイテム
translation: アイテム

original:
You found a new item for
your collection box!
translation:
Koleksiyon kutun icin
yeni bir esya buldun!

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
Is this a barber's? Crikey,
the prices are pretty
steep!
translation:
Burasi bir berber mi? Vay
canina, fiyatlar epey
yuksek!

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
The sign says they do
a {''}miracle cut{''}. What
kind of style is that?
レミ
translation: レミ

original:
I changed my hairstyle
recently. Did you
notice, Professor?
translation:
Sac stilimi yakinlarda
degistirdim. Fark ettiniz
mi, Profesor?

original:
That's an impressive
array of brightly
coloured clothes.
translation:
Ne kadar etkileyici bir
renkli kiyafet
cesidi.

original:
Hmm. I could do with a
brighter shade of lemon!
translation:
Hmm. Daha parlak bir
limon tonu fena olmazdi!

original:
Ahh! I thought those
mannequins in the back
were alive!
translation:
Aaah! Arkadaki
mankenlerin canli
oldugunu sandim!

original:
Hello, plantsies! What
are you doing in the
middle of the road?
translation:
Merhaba bitkicikler! Ne
isiniz var yolun
ortasinda?

original:
How do the buses get
through here?!
translation:
Otobusler buradan
nasil geciyor?!

original:
The better part of the city
is pedestrianised, you
know.
translation:
Sehrin buyuk kismi
yaya bolgesi zaten,
biliyorsun.

original: コイン
translation: コイン

original: You found a hint coin!
translation: Bir ipucu parasi buldun!

original: アイテム
translation: アイテム

original:
You found a new item for
your collection box!
translation:
Koleksiyon kutun icin
yeni bir esya buldun!

original: ルーク
translation: ルーク

original:
Wow, there are so many!
I wouldn't know which to
pick.
translation:
Vay canina, ne kadar cok!
Hangisini sececegimi
bilemiyorum.

original: レミ
translation: レミ

original:
The people in the parade
were wearing masks too.
translation:
Gecitteki insanlar da
maske takiyordu.

original: レイトン
translation: レイトン

original:
Originally, this carnival
was to honour the Mask
of Chaos.
translation:
Baslangicta bu karnaval,
Kaos Maskesi'ni
onurlandirmak icindi.

original:
You won't see these rare
mask styles anywhere
else.
translation:
Bu nadir maske
tarzlarini baska hicbir
yerde goremezsin.

original:
They are bizarre. But
maybe we should buy
one as a souvenir?
translation:
Tuhaflar. Ama belki de
hatira olarak bir tane
almaliyiz?

original:
No, I don't think any of
them would suit me...
translation:
Hayir, hicbirinin bana
uyacagini sanmiyorum...

original:
Oh, they have dresses
too! I can't say they're
my colour, though.
translation:
Aa, elbiseleri de var!
Ama benim rengim
sayilmazlar.

original:
Emmy, why don't you
try this one on?
translation:
Emmy, sunu bir
denemeye ne dersin?

original:
I think it would suit you,
Emmy. It's a fine dinner
dress.
translation:
Bence sana yakisir,
Emmy. Guzel bir
yemek elbisesi.

original:
I believe the fitting rooms
are behind the curtain.
translation:
Soyunma kabinleri
perdenin arkasinda
olmali.

original:
Professor, you should
try wearing something
else for a change.
translation:
Profesor, degisiklik olsun
diye baska bir sey
giyinmelisiniz.

original:
That curtain could make
for a brilliant cape!
translation:
O perde harika bir
pelerin olabilir!

original: コイン
translation: コイン

original: You found a hint coin!
translation: Bir ipucu parasi buldun!

original: アイテム
translation: アイテム

original:
You found a new item for
your collection box!
translation:
Koleksiyon kutun icin
yeni bir esya buldun!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original:
It's marvellous how the
horizon draws your eyes
to the centre.
translation:
Ufkun gozlerini
merkeze cekmesi
harika.

original:
A letter from an old friend of mine has compelled
me to travel to the city of Monte d'Or, at the heart
of the desert. We'd hardly set foot in town before
Emmy shot off to conduct her own enquiries. In the
meantime, Luke and I are going to see the street
parade. The city traffic is strictly regulated, so I
have had to part with the Laytonmobile for a while,
painful as it is.

For now, I think we are all just waiting to see what
will happen next.
translation:
Eski bir dostumdan aldigim bir mektup beni
colun kalbindeki Monte d'Or sehrine gitmeye mecbur birakti. Kasabaya daha
yeni ayak basmistik ki Emmy kendi arastirmalarini yapmak uzere
kosturup gitti. Bu arada Luke'la ben sokak
gecidini izleyecegiz. Sehir trafigi siki bicimde denetlendigi icin
Laytonmobile'dan bir sureligine ayrilmak zorunda kaldim,
ne kadar aci verici olsa da.

Simdilik, sanirim hepimiz sirada ne
olacagini gormek icin bekliyoruz.

original: A Brilliant Carnival
translation: Goz Kamastirici Bir Karnaval

original:
We have arrived in Monte d'Or in the midst of
some spectacular festivities. The city really is
quite incredible, considering it started its life as
a small hotel and grew to its current size in a mere
18 years. It is baffling to think how many people
must have moved here to create such a large
community.

We plan to watch the parade, which will begin
presently, but not before stepping in to aid a clown
in distress.
translation:
Monte d'Or'a son derece gorkemli
senliklerin tam ortasinda geldik. Sehir gercekten de
hayli inanilmaz; bir zamanlar kucuk bir otelken
yalnizca
18 yilda bugunku buyuklugune ulasmis.
Boylesine buyuk bir
toplulugu olusturmak icin buraya kac insanin
tasinmis olmasi gerektigini dusunmek bile
sasirtici.

Birazdan baslayacak gecidi izlemeyi
planliyoruz, ama once
basina dert acilmis bir palyacoya yardim edecegiz.

original: Petrified Crowd
translation: Tasa Donmus Kalabalik

original:
A single scream at the centre of the carnival threw
the crowd into chaos. The spectators began to flee
all around us and there were shouts about people
being turned to stone. We rushed to the scene and,
sure enough, there lay life-sized stone statues,
looking just like petrified people.

A strange masked character appeared, claiming
responsibility for the deed, which he called
a {''}grand miracle{''}. He took flight, but we have
determined to chase him down.
translation:
Karnavalin tam ortasinda yukselen tek bir ciglik
kalabaligi kaosa surukledi. Seyirciler
her yana kacisti ve
insanlarin tasa donusturuldugune dair bagrismalar vardi.
Olay yerine kostuk ve
gercekten de orada, bire bir insan boyutunda tas heykeller duruyordu;
sanki insanlar tas kesilmis gibiydi.

Tuhaf, maskeli bir kisi ortaya cikti ve
bu isi kendisinin yaptigini, buna da
bir {''}buyuk mucize{''} dedigini soyledi. Ucarak uzaklasti, ama biz
onu yakalamaya kararliyiz.

original: In Pursuit of the Gentleman
translation: Beyefendinin Pesinde

original:
We pursued the Masked Gentleman, as he called
himself, but even on horseback we could not keep
up with a flying quarry.

I am inclined to believe that the strange event we
witnessed was one of the {''}terrifying incidents{''}
that Angela mentioned in her letter. Emmy's
investigations revealed that the Masked Gentleman
has been performing these so-called miracles for
a few weeks now, but we will need to speak to
Angela to get the whole story.
translation:
Kendisine Maskeli Beyefendi
diyen bu adamin pesine dustuk, fakat
at sirtinda bile
ucan bir hedefe yetisemedik.

Gordugumuz bu tuhaf olayin,
Angela'nin mektubunda sozunu ettigi {''}korkunc hadiseler{''}den
biri olduguna
inanmaya meyilliyim. Emmy'nin
arastirmalari, Maskeli Beyefendi'nin bu sozde mucizeleri
birkac haftadir sahneledigini ortaya koydu, ama
tum hikayeyi ogrenmek icin
Angela'yla konusmamiz gerekecek.

original: The Gallery is Off Limits
translation: Galeriye Girilmez

original:
After bumping into an old friend eager as ever to
share advice, we continued to the marquee. Amid
festival debris, we came across a clown balloon in
a very sorry state. It even seemed to be sobbing in
self-pity. The real source of the wailing, however,
was a young lady who had lost her mother in all the
panic and needed our assistance.
Mother and child reunited, we set off for the Ledore
mansion. On the way, we passed an art gallery, but
discovered it to be closed due to a prior incident:
another of the Masked Gentleman's miracles.
translation:
Her zamanki gibi ogut vermeye hevesli
eski bir dostla karsilastiktan sonra
cadira dogru devam ettik. Ortalik
festival artiklarinin icindeydi; cok kotu durumda
bir palyaco balonuna rastladik.
Oyle ki, kendi haline acir gibi
hickira hickira agliyor sanilirdi. Ama asil
aglama sesi, panik sirasinda annesini kaybeden
genc bir kizdan geliyordu ve yardimimiza ihtiyaci vardi.
Anneyle cocuk tekrar kavusunca, Ledore
malikanesine dogru yola ciktik. Yolda bir sanat galerinin onunden gectik, ama
daha onceki bir olay yuzunden kapali oldugunu ogrendik:
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin bir baska mucizesi.

original: Jean-Paul and the Swindlers
translation: Jean-Paul ve Dolandiricilar

original:
On our way to the residential district, we have had
quite our share of adventures. Emmy received a
lovely handcrafted wind-up robot, which should
afford us hours of fun.

Then, as we neared the gates to the Ledore estate,
we were accosted by an unsavoury character in the
street. A second man stepped in to mediate our
dispute, but I strongly suspect that the two were in
league. We shall have to be wary of more than just
the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
Yerlesim bolgesine giderken
basimizdan epey macera gecti. Emmy'ye
sevimli, el yapimi bir kurmali robot hediye edildi; bu bize
saatlerce eglence saglayacaktir.

Sonra, Ledore arazisinin kapilarina yaklasirken
sokakta sevimsiz bir tip tarafindan
durduk yere sikistirildik. Tartismamiza arabuluculuk etmek icin ikinci bir adam araya girdi,
ama ikisinin
isbirligi icinde oldugundan siddetle supheleniyorum. Sadece
Maskeli Beyefendi'ye karsi degil,
baska tehlikelere karsi da temkinli olmaliyiz.

original: Angela at her Wits' End
translation: Angela'nin Sabri Tasti

original:
It has been 18 long years since I last spoke to
Angela. I was sorry to find her nerves so frayed,
though it is understandable in the circumstances.
She explained that Henry, to whom she is married,
found the Mask of Chaos along with mountains of
riches while searching for Randall in the ruins.
Evidently, he has used this wealth to build the city
of Monte d'Or.
Since Henry is out, we plan to retire for the night
and come back tomorrow. I'd just like to return to
the scene of the petrification miracle first.
translation:
Angela'yla en son konusmamin uzerinden
tam 18 uzun yil gecmis. Onu bu kadar yipranmis gormek beni uzdu,
ama icinde bulundugu kosullar goz onune alininca
anlasilir.
Randall'i harabelerde ararken Henry'nin, Kaos Maskesi'ni ve
daglar kadar hazineyi buldugunu anlatti.
Belli ki bu serveti
Monte d'Or sehrini insa etmek icin kullanmis.
Henry disarida oldugundan,
geceyi dinlenerek gecirmeyi ve yarin tekrar gelmeyi planliyoruz. Yalniz,
once taslastirma mucizesinin yasandigi yere
bir kez daha ugramak istiyorum.

original: The Masses Amassed
translation: Kalabalik Toplandi

original:
As we arrived at the scene of the petrification
incident, an officer rushed over to prevent us from
disturbing the evidence. He had found hoofprints
which he believed had been left by the culprit. I
hadn't the heart to tell him those tracks were ours.

It seems few witnesses have come forward, and with
the constant foot traffic, a thorough examination
of the scene will be difficult. We do have one lead,
though: one of the local shopkeepers is apparently
well informed about the town's comings and goings.
translation:
Taslastirma
olayinin yasandigi yere vardigimizda, bir polis
delilleri bozmamamiz icin yanimiza kostu.
Suclunun biraktigini dusundugu
nal izleri bulmustu. O izlerin
bizim izlerimiz oldugunu soyleyecek halim yoktu.

Gorunen o ki cok az tanik ortaya cikmis ve
surekli ayak trafigi yuzunden olay yerini
iyice incelemek zor olacak. Yine de
bir ipucumuz var:
yerel esnaftan biri sehrin olup bitenlerinden
hayli haberdarmis.

original: A New Source
translation: Yeni Bir Kaynak

original:
Whether through insouciance or just determination
to have fun, the tourists are crowding the streets
of Monte d'Or again, enjoying the festivities as
if nothing had happened.
We tracked down the shop we sought, a costume
boutique in the shopping district, and spoke to
the owner, Ludmilla. Though unable to explain the
Masked Gentleman's methods, she seems certain
that his miracles are nothing more than clever
tricks. I think we've gathered enough information
for tonight.
translation:
Ister umursamazliktan, ister
eglenme kararliligindan olsun, turistler yine
Monte d'Or sokaklarini doldurmus;
sanki hicbir sey olmamis gibi
senliklerin tadini cikariyorlar.
Aradigimiz dukkani bulduk: alisveris bolgesindeki
bir kostum butigi. Sahibi Ludmilla'yla konustuk. Maskeli Beyefendi'nin yontemlerini aciklayamasa da,
mucizelerinin aslinda
zekice numaralardan ibaret olduguna kesin gozuyle bakiyor. Bu gece icin
yeterince bilgi topladigimizi dusunuyorum.

original: A Night at the Camel's Hump
translation: Camel's Hump'ta Bir Gece

original:
As we approached the Camel's Hump hotel, we
encountered the ringmaster of the Stellar Circus,
Monte d'Or's circus troupe. After finding ourselves
entrusted with a rabbit who aspires to learn the
dramatic arts, we finally entered the hotel and were
promptly shown to our rooms.
Now that we have time to sit back and think, I have
to wonder how we will find the Masked Gentleman
during a carnival in a city this size. I think I shall
have to tell Emmy and Luke about Randall, for the
sake of the investigation.
translation:
Camel's Hump oteline yaklasirken,
Monte d'Or'un sirk toplulugu Stellar Sirki'nin
sirk muduruyle karsilastik. Sahne sanatlarini ogrenmeyi arzulayan
bir tavsani bize emanet ettikten sonra
nihayet otele girdik ve
hemen odalarimiza goturulduk.
Simdi oturup dusunmeye vakit bulmusken,
boylesine buyuk bir sehirde, bir karnaval sirasinda
Maskeli Beyefendi'yi nasil bulacagimizi merak ediyorum. Sorusturma acisindan,
Randall'dan Emmy'ye ve Luke'a da bahsetmem gerekecek.

original: Good Morning, Monte d'Or
translation: Gunaydin, Monte d'Or

original:
It seemed as though the carnival carried on
throughout the night, for when we awoke, bright
and refreshed, the streets were as busy as ever.

After reviewing yesterday's events, we prepared to
set off once more for the Ledores' mansion to hear
Henry's take on the recent events in Monte d'Or.
Another reunion awaits me, but I fear that this time
we may not receive the warmest of welcomes...
translation:
Karnaval gece boyunca surmus gibi
gorunuyor; cunku uyandigimizda, dinc
ve zinde, sokaklar her zamanki gibi kalabalikti.

Dunku olaylari gozden gecirdikten sonra,
Monte d'Or'daki son olaylar hakkinda
Henry'nin gorusunu dinlemek icin Ledorelarin
malikanesine yeniden gitmeye hazirlandik.
Beni bir baska bulusma daha bekliyor, ama bu kez
en sicak karsilamayi gormeyecegimizden korkuyorum...

original: The Lost Little Girl
translation: Kaybolan Kucuk Kiz

original:
No sooner had we left the hotel than we bumped
into the little girl whom we helped last night.
In an unfortunate turn of events, she seems to
have got lost again!

With her mother no doubt frantic with worry, we
cannot in good faith continue our investigation until
the pair are reunited. I think the most promising
location to look is the place where mother and
daughter got separated, on Celebration Boulevard.
translation:
Otelden cikar cikmaz,
dun gece yardim ettigimiz kucuk kizla karsilastik.
Talihsiz bir gelismeyle,
yine kaybolmus gibi gorunuyor!

Annesi kuskusuz endiseden deliye donmustur;
bu yuzden ikisi yeniden kavusmadan
vicdanen sorusturmamiza devam edemeyiz.
En umut verici yer,
anneyle kizin ayrildigi yer olan
Kutlama Bulvari.

original: Exodus from Stansbury
translation: Stansbury'den Goc

original:
While on the way to Celebration Boulevard to help
little lost Bonnie, I spied a face that hasn't changed
a bit since I was a wide-eyed schoolboy: Gloria! It
appears that sometime after I went to study in
London, Gloria moved to Monte d'Or to start a new
life.

Seeing these familiar faces again takes me back
a long, long way. I wonder if I may not even meet
a few more. Such seems to be the way in the City
of Miracles.
translation:
Kutlama Bulvari'na giderken, kayip kucuk Bonnie'ye yardim etmek icin,
cocuklugumdan beri hic degismemis bir yuz gordum:
Gloria! Gorunuse gore ben Londra'da okumaya gittikten bir sure sonra
Gloria Monte d'Or'a tasinip yeni
bir hayat kurmus.

Bu tanidik yuzleri yeniden gormek beni
cok, cok eskilere goturuyor.
Belki daha fazlasiyla da karsilasirim.
Mucizeler Sehri'nde islerin gidisi
boyle gibi gorunuyor.

original: Mother and Child Reunited
translation: Anne ve Kiz Yeniden Kavustu

original:
Thanks to a tip from the well-to-do Mr Waltham and
further help from Mr Mordaunt, we finally delivered
the child safely to her anxious mother.

With the two happily reunited, we can now return to
our investigation and focus our attention on the
Ledores. I'm sure Henry will have his hands full, so
it's probably best that we keep our visit as short as
possible.
translation:
Zengin Bay Waltham'in verdigi bir ipucu ve
Bay Mordaunt'un ek yardimi sayesinde,
cocugu sonunda kaygili annesine sag salim teslim ettik.

Ikisi de mutlulukla yeniden kavustuguna gore,
artik sorusturmamiza donebilir ve
dikkatimizi Ledorelara verebiliriz. Henry'nin isi basindan askin olacaktir,
bu yuzden ziyaretimizi
mumkun oldugunca kisa tutmak
muhtemelen en iyisi.

original: Absent Henry
translation: Henry Ortalarda Yok

original:
We returned to the Ledore mansion to talk to
Henry, but he was again not present. I'll admit I
was not entirely surprised. Presumably, he's tied up
in meetings concerning last night's events. As the
founder of Monte d'Or, he bears a great deal of
responsibility.

Despite Henry's absence, Angela allowed us to
investigate his study. She was perfectly decorous
throughout, yet I felt there was something rather off
about her. I can't quite put my finger on it.
translation:
Henry'yle konusmak icin
Ledore malikanesine donduk, ama yine
orada degildi. Dogrusu
pek sasirmadim.
Muhtemelen dunku olaylarla ilgili toplantilara yetismeye calisiyordur.
Monte d'Or'un kurucusu olarak,
ustunde buyuk bir sorumluluk var.

Henry'nin yokluguna ragmen Angela,
calisma odasini incelememize izin verdi. Bastan sona kusursuz bir nezaket icindeydi,
ama onda bir tuhaflik sezinledim.
Tam olarak ne oldugunu
bir turlu cikaramiyorum.

original: A Thorough Search of the Study
translation: Calisma Odasinda Titiz Bir Arama

original:
Having performed a thorough search of Henry's
study, we were unable to find anything remotely
connected to the Masked Gentleman. The Mask of
Chaos was stolen from this house, but there are no
signs of a break-in, nor any clues as to who could
be responsible.

When I asked Angela if she knew of anyone who
might bear a grudge against Henry, she could only
think of Alphonse Dalston, another former resident
of Stansbury...
translation:
Henry'nin
calisma odasinda titiz bir arama yapmamiza ragmen, Maskeli Beyefendi'yle
en ufak bir baglanti
bulamadik. Kaos Maskesi
bu evden calinmis, ama
zorla girilme izine rastlamadik; kimin sorumlu olabilecegine dair de hicbir ipucu yok.

Angela'ya, Henry'ye kin besleyebilecek birini
taniyip tanimadigini sordugumda, aklina
yalnizca Stansbury'nin eski sakinlerinden biri olan
Alphonse Dalston geldi...

original: Seeing Dalston Again
translation: Dalston'la Yeniden Karsilasmak

original:
Ch{^a}teau Dalston lies far afield of the Ledore estate,
past the Stellar Circus. We stopped by, hoping to
interview the master of the house, but he was as
uncooperative as ever. Still, it was interesting to
meet Dalston again. It seems he has achieved a
great deal in the past 18 years through hard work
and sheer determination.

Before leaving, we received a highly unsettling
letter. I believe a visit to the city hall is in order
if we are to crack this case.
translation:
Ch{^a}teau Dalston, Ledore malikanesinin epey disinda,
Stellar Sirki'nin ilerisinde kaliyor. Ev sahibini
sorgulamayi umarak ugradik, ama
her zamanki gibi isbirligine yanasmadi. Yine de
Dalston'la tekrar karsilasmak ilgincti. Gorunuse gore son 18 yilda
siki calismasi ve
sarsilmaz azmi sayesinde
cok sey basarmis.

Ayrilmadan once son derece huzursuz edici
bir mektup aldik.
Bu davayi cozmek istiyorsak,
belediyeye ugramamiz gerektigine inaniyorum.

original: The Headquarters at the City Hall
translation: Belediyedeki Karargah

original:
Just as Dalston informed us, the city hall is being
used as headquarters for a special task force. I
hear Monte d'Or has its own police station, but for
a case of this magnitude Mayor Williams decided
to provide a larger base of operations and call in
extra help.

As well as assigning the entire Monte d'Or police
force to the case, the mayor has requisitioned some
high-ranking officers from Scotland Yard. I've yet
to find out who they are.
translation:
Dalston'in soyledigi gibi, belediye
ozel bir gorev gucunun karargahi olarak kullaniliyor.
Monte d'Or'un kendi karakolu varmis, ama
bu kadar buyuk bir dava icin Belediye Baskani Williams daha genis
bir operasyon ussu saglamaya ve
ek destek cagirmaya karar vermis.

Baskan, tum Monte d'Or polis gucunu davaya atamakla kalmamis,
Scotland Yard'dan da
bazi ust duzey memurlari gorevlendirmis. Kim olduklarini
henuz ogrenemedim.

original: Three's a Crowd
translation: Uc Kisi Bir Kalabalik

original:
Inspector Grosky and the esteemed Detective
Bloom have come from Scotland Yard to assist Chief
Inspector Sheffield of the local police force with
the Masked Gentleman case.

The mayor spoke of bad blood between two of the
inspectors, and I must say relations between
Sheffield and Bloom seem tense. Still, I believe if
they can put their differences aside, the task force
should yield some positive results. I am to take part
in their strategy meeting shortly.
translation:
Mufettis Grosky ve
saygin Dedektif Bloom, Maskeli Beyefendi davasinda
yerel polis gucunun Basmufettisi Sheffield'a
yardim etmek uzere Scotland Yard'dan gelmisler.

Belediye baskani iki mufettis arasinda eski bir husumetten soz etmisti,
ve dogrusu Sheffield ile Bloom arasindaki
iliski de gergin gorunuyor. Yine de
aralarindaki sorunlari bir kenara birakabilirlerse,
gorev gucunun olumlu sonuclar verecegine inaniyorum. Birazdan
strateji toplantilarina
katilacagim.

original: On Horses and Miracles
translation: Atlar ve Mucizeler Uzerine

original:
The conference kicked off with Detective Bloom and
his theories on the first incident, in which people
were transformed into horses.

Although he did not witness the incident himself,
his reasoning seems to be sound and I believe his
explanation to be fairly conclusive. The Masked
Gentleman's motive for targeting the parade during
its peak hours was presumably to incite the greatest
amount of fear among the masses.
translation:
Toplanti, Dedektif Bloom'un
ilk olaya dair teorileriyle basladi; o olayda insanlar
ata donusturulmustu.

Olayi kendi gozleriyle gormemis olsa da,
mantigi saglam gorunuyor ve aciklamasini
oldukca ikna edici buluyorum. Maskeli Beyefendi'nin gecidi
en yogun saatinde hedef almasinin nedeni,
muhtemelen kalabaliklar arasinda
azami korkuyu yaymakti.

original: On Paintings and Miracles
translation: Tablolar ve Mucizeler Uzerine

original:
Next, Chief Inspector Sheffield laid out the details of
the second miracle, in which characters seemingly
climbed out from paintings and caused havoc in
town. We concluded the trick had been executed
using a collection of donated paintings which were
to be displayed at a specific time so that the paint
would vanish just after the gallery's closing time.

Few would be able to coordinate such an elaborate
stunt, and a number of accomplices would be
necessary. This is worrying...
translation:
Ardindan Basmufettis Sheffield,
ikinci mucizenin ayrintilarini anlatti; sozde, tablolarin icinden
karakterler cikmis ve sehirde ortaligi karistirmisti.
Numaranin, bagislanan bir tablo koleksiyonunun
belirli bir saatte sergilenmesiyle yapildigi sonucuna vardik; boylece boya
galeri kapandiktan hemen sonra kaybolacakti.

Boylesine karmasik bir gosteriyi
cok az kisi koordine edebilir ve
bir suru suc ortagi gerekirdi.
Bu endise verici...

original: On Flames and Miracles
translation: Alevler ve Mucizeler Uzerine

original:
The third spectacle, a public vanishing act, was
particularly well thought out. The sight of people
disappearing in an inferno would have been
terrifying. The Masked Gentleman must have
prepared his 13 {''}victims{''} well in advance so that
they could reveal nothing that might incriminate him.

There were no casualties, but there is no denying
the pernicious nature of the Gentleman's act. It
is now evident that he bears great animosity
towards Monte d'Or.
translation:
Ucuncu gosteri, halka acik bir yok olus numarasi,
ozellikle ustaca kurgulanmisti. Insanlarin
alevlerin icinde kaybolusunu gormek
dehset verici olurdu. Maskeli Beyefendi,
13 {''}kurbanini{''} onceden iyice hazirlamis olmali ki
kendini ele verecek hicbir sey soylemesinler.

Can kaybi olmadi, ama Beyefendi'nin eyleminin
kotucul dogasi inkar edilemez. Artik
Monte d'Or'a karsi buyuk bir
kin besledigi acik.

original: Meeting Adjourned
translation: Toplanti Sona Erdi

original:
Having elucidated the first three miracles, the only
miracle left to be explained is that of the stone
statues.

This progress has already had a positive effect on
the city; with the case of the living paintings now
cracked, the police have agreed to reopen the art
gallery. We shall pick up our investigation there in
the hopes of finding some new leads on the Masked
Gentleman.
translation:
Ilk uc mucizeyi aydinlattiktan sonra,
aciklanmasi gereken tek mucize
tas heykeller olayi kaldi.

Bu ilerleme sehri simdiden olumlu etkiledi;
canli tablolar olayi cozuldugunden,
polis sanat galerisini yeniden acmayi kabul etti. Maskeli Beyefendi'ye dair yeni ipuclari bulma umuduyla,
sorusturmamiza oradan
devam edecegiz.

original: Hannah and the Cart Tracks
translation: Hannah ve Araba Izleri

original:
As we headed towards the art gallery, we had an
unexpected encounter with Hannah, who had raced
to Monte d'Or on the heels of Inspector Grosky.
She appeared to be gathering information for the
inspector. Her devotion is quite admirable, for a
civilian.

She explained that the police were very interested
in the discovery of some cart tracks near the scene
of the petrification incident. I must say, that
does sound like a promising lead.
translation:
Sanat galerisine dogru giderken,
Mufettis Grosky'nin pesine takilip Monte d'Or'a
kosarak gelen Hannah'yla
beklenmedik bir sekilde karsilastik.
Mufettis icin bilgi topluyor gibiydi.
Bir sivil icin
takdire sayan bir baglilik.

Polisin, taslastirma olay yerinin yakininda bulunan
bazi araba izleriyle
cok ilgilendigini anlatti. Dogrusu,
bu epey umut verici
bir ipucu gibi duruyor.

original: Art Donations
translation: Sanat Bagislari

original:
Montsarton Gallery was a quiet oasis, a reprieve
from the hubbub of the city. One would never know
that anything amiss had happened here. The seized
paintings have been replaced by a selection of
classics that I should love to examine closer - but
art appreciation will have to wait.
According to the curator, Henry contributed several
works of art, most of which have not yet been put
on display and are presently gathering dust in the
warehouse on the top floor. Perhaps Ludmilla from
the costume boutique can tell us more...
translation:
Montsarton Galerisi sakin bir vahaydi;
sehrin hengamesinden bir kacis. Burada
bir seylerin ters gittigini kimse tahmin edemezdi.
El konulan tablolarin yerine, yakindan incelemeyi cok isteyecegim
bir klasik seckisi asilmis - ama
sanat keyfi beklemek zorunda.
Kuratore gore Henry birkac eser bagislamis;
cogu henuz sergilenmemis ve su anda
ust kattaki depoda tozlaniyormus. Belki de
kostum butigindeki Ludmilla bize daha fazlasini anlatabilir...

original: Ludmilla Offers Some Advice
translation: Ludmilla Birkac Oneride Bulunuyor

original:
Ludmilla was generous enough to enlighten us on
the many problems surrounding the continuing
development of Monte d'Or. Notably, she was of
the opinion that the police force is still too small and
too green to handle such a rapidly growing city.

Ludmilla also mentioned that about a month ago,
the circus near Ch{^a}teau Dalston hired a large
quantity of vestments from her boutique. I assume
she was referring to the Stellar Circus, which we
passed earlier on the way to Dalston's estate.
translation:
Ludmilla, Monte d'Or'un suregelen
gelisimini cevreleyen bircok sorun hakkinda
bizi aydinlatacak kadar comertti. Ozellikle,
polis gucunun hala cok kucuk ve
boylesine hizli buyuyen bir sehri idare etmek icin fazla deneyimsiz oldugu gorusundeydi.

Ludmilla ayrica yaklasik bir ay once,
Ch{^a}teau Dalston yakinindaki sirkin,
butiginden buyuk miktarda
kiyafet kiraladigini soyledi. Sanirim, Dalston'in malikanesine giderken
onunden gectigimiz Stellar Sirki'nden
bahsediyordu.

original: Ruling out the Stellar Circus
translation: Stellar Sirki'ni Eleme

original:
Based on our knowledge of events thus far, it's
evident that the Masked Gentleman needs a large
number of helpers in order to perform his stunts.
I surmised that the circus troupe might be involved,
wearing hired clothing to disguise themselves as
ordinary citizens, but after talking to the ringmaster,
I have revised my opinion.

We may yet learn something if, with Luke's help,
we can extract testimony from the circus's white
tiger, whom Dalston frequently visits.
translation:
Su ana kadarki bilgilerimize gore,
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin numaralarini sergilemek icin
cok sayida yardimciya ihtiyaci oldugu acik.
Sirk toplulugunun,
kiraladiklari kiyafetlerle siradan vatandas kiliginda
isin icinde olabilecegini dusundum, ama mudurle konustuktan sonra
fikrimi gozden gecirdim.

Yine de Luke'un yardimiyla,
Dalston'in sik sik ziyaret ettigi
sirkin beyaz kaplanindan bir ifade alabilirsek,
belki bir seyler ogreniriz.

original: The Tiger's Testimony
translation: Kaplanin Ifadesi

original:
We are truly fortunate that Luke is able to speak to
animals, for we might otherwise never have learnt
that the circus was performing as usual on the night
of the petrification miracle, and that Dalston spent
the entire evening there.

If we are to believe Hannibal's testimony, Dalston is
not our culprit. We must hope that the real
mastermind will fall into our hands tonight.
translation:
Luke'un hayvanlarla konusabilmesine gercekten sukretmeliyiz,
aksi takdirde sirkin,
taslastirma mucizesinin yasandigi gece her zamanki gibi gosteri yaptigini ve
Dalston'in tum aksami orada gecirdigini
asla ogrenemezdik.

Hannibal'in ifadesine inanacak olursak,
Dalston suclumuz degil. Gercek
elebasinin bu gece
elimize dusmesini ummaliyiz.

original: Evening Descends
translation: Aksam Cokuyor

original:
We must have lost track of time in the tent, for
when we left, the sun had long since set. If the
letter we received this morning was no hoax, the
next miracle should take place outside Montsarton
Gallery. We can expect it to cause another stir
among the crowds.

Looking around, I see nothing to suggest that the
Stellar Circus performers are heading to the plaza.
I'm fairly certain now that they are not in cahoots
with the Masked Gentleman.
translation:
Cadirda zamanin nasil gectigini fark etmemis olmaliyiz; cunku
ciktigimizda gunes coktan batmisti. Bu sabah aldigimiz mektup bir saka degilse,
bir sonraki mucize Montsarton
Galerisi'nin disinda gerceklesmeli. Bunun,
kalabaliklar arasinda
yeni bir kargasa yaratmasini bekleyebiliriz.

Etrafa baktigimda Stellar Sirki sanatcilarinin meydana yoneldigine dair hicbir isaret yok.
Artik oldukca eminim;
onlar Maskeli Beyefendi'yle
isbirligi icinde degiller.

original: Miracle Hunters
translation: Mucize Avcilari

original:
By the time we arrived at the plaza, the crowds had
already gathered. They looked on with eager eyes,
chattering among themselves - many of them
thrill-seekers, no doubt.

Angela was present, having received a letter similar
to ours. I have a sneaking suspicion that the
Masked Gentleman is targeting the wealthiest
citizens of Monte d'Or, those who have invested
most in its economy. But for what purpose?
translation:
Meydana vardigimizda, kalabalik
coktan toplanmisti. Heyecanli gozlerle
izliyor, aralarinda fisildasiyorlardi -
kuskusuz cogu heyecan arayan kimselerdi.

Angela da oradaydi; o da bizimkine benzer
bir mektup almis. Icimde bir his var:
Maskeli Beyefendi, Monte d'Or'un en zengin
vatandaslarini, ekonomisine en cok yatirim yapanlari hedef aliyor.
Ama hangi amacla?

original: The Levitation Miracle
translation: Havaya Yukselme Mucizesi

original:
Once again, the Masked Gentleman put on an
extravagant show. Moments after he appeared,
onlookers were lifted off the ground and floated up
into the sky, apparently unaffected by gravity.

The villain then announced that his next miracle
would be staged in Tingly Town. He claims that the
city is cursed and that the only way to save it is to
obtain a powerful artefact mentioned in Rutledge's
{''}Ancient Histories{''}: the Mask of Order. Angela
seems to believe him, but I remain dubious...
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi bir kez daha
gosterisli bir sov yapti. Ortaya ciktiktan birkac dakika sonra
seyirciler yerden yukseldi ve
yercekiminden etkilenmiyormuscasina
gokyuzune dogru suzuldu.

Ardindan kotu adam, bir sonraki mucizesinin
Tingly Town'da sahnelenecegini ilan etti. Sehrin lanetli oldugunu ve
onu kurtarmanin tek yolunun Rutledge'in
{''}Eski Tarihler{''}inde adi gecen guclu bir eseri elde etmek oldugunu iddia ediyor:
Duzen Maskesi'ni. Angela ona inaniyor gibi,
ama ben hala kuskucuyum...

original: Dalston Apprehended
translation: Dalston Yakalandi

original:
The moment the Gentleman departed the scene,
Sheffield stormed the plaza with a platoon of men
and, to my great surprise, arrested Dalston. The
chief inspector's accusation was that Dalston has
long harboured feelings for Angela. Now, whether
that claim is true or not, and I have no reason to
believe it to be so, it hardly seems sufficient
grounds for arrest!

The interrogation will be held tomorrow morning.
I hope the police come to their senses by then.
translation:
Beyefendi olay yerinden ayrilir ayrilmaz,
Sheffield bir manga adamla meydana daldi ve
beni cok sasirtarak Dalston'i tutukladi. Basmufettisin suclamasi,
Dalston'in uzun zamandir Angela'ya karsi duygular besledigi yonundeydi.
Simdi, bu iddianin dogru olup olmadigi bir yana,
ben dogru olduguna inanmak icin bir sebep gormuyorum,
bu tutuklama icin yeterli gerekce sayilmaz!

Sorgu yarin sabah yapilacak.
Umarim o zamana kadar polis aklini basina toplar.

original: Quickly, to the City Hall
translation: Cabuk, Belediyeye

original:
After levitating members of the crowd and making
them vanish into the sky last night, the Masked
Gentleman warned us of his next miracle, which is
due to take place tonight in Tingly Town.

In the meantime, we have Dalston's interrogation
to worry about. We must hurry to the city hall if we
are to prove his innocence. It is essential the police
stop wasting resources on Dalston and concentrate
on the real villain, whoever he may be.
translation:
Dun gece kalabaliktan bazilarini havaya kaldirip
gokyuzunde yok ettikten sonra Maskeli Beyefendi,
bu gece Tingly Town'da gerceklesmesi beklenen
bir sonraki mucizesini haber verdi.

Bu arada Dalston'in sorgusu da basimizda.
Masumiyetini kanitlamak istiyorsak belediyeye yetismeliyiz.
Polisin Dalston'la oyalanmayi birakip,
kim olursa olsun gercek kotu adama
odaklanmasi sart.

original: Dalston Under Scrutiny
translation: Dalston Mercek Altinda

original:
The rumours must have spread like wildfire, as
almost everyone in the city seems to know about
last night's events.
Detective Bloom and Chief Inspector Sheffield claim
that the cart tracks seen near the site of the statues
match a chariot owned by Dalston. I had presumed
that a cart was involved in the incident, but this is
an unexpected twist. The only other chariots of this
type are kept at the racecourse, and they have
supposedly been ruled out. Still, I should like to
have a closer look at them.
translation:
Dedikodular yangin gibi yayilmis olmali; cunku
sehirde neredeyse herkes
dun gece olanlari biliyor.

Dedektif Bloom ile Basmufettis Sheffield,
heykellerin bulundugu yerin yakininda gorulen izlerin
Dalston'a ait bir arabaya uydugunu soyluyor. Olayda bir arabanin kullanildigini varsaymistim,
ama bu beklenmedik bir gelisme. Bu tur baska arabalar yalnizca hipodromda bulunuyormus ve
sozde hepsi elenmis. Yine de
onlara daha yakindan bakmak
istiyorum.

original: A Clue at the Racecourse?
translation: Hipodromda Bir Ipucu mu?

original:
The racecourse we came to investigate was bursting
with exultant spectators. I must say I had never
before witnessed a chariot race such as this.
Compared to standard carts, the chariots look quite
robust, making them the ideal choice for handling
high speeds - or indeed, heavy loads - but we
would need to do a closer inspection to be sure.

Perhaps the manager can assist us here. I have
spotted a well-groomed gentleman who may well be
the person we are looking for.
translation:
Incelemek icin geldigimiz hipodrom,
coskulu seyircilerle dolup tasiyordu. Dogrusu boyle bir
araba yarisini daha once hic
gormemistim. Siradan arabalara kiyasla,
bu savas arabalari hayli saglam gorunuyor;
yuksek hizlara - hatta agir yuklere - dayanmak icin ideal olabilirler, ama emin olmak icin
daha yakindan incelemek gerekir.

Belki isletmeci bize burada yardimci olabilir. Bakimli bir beyefendi gozume carpti;
muhtemelen aradigimiz kisi odur.

original: Carte Blanche
translation: Tam Yetki

original:
The racecourse manager, Gustav, was not aware of
any chariots leaving the grounds, but he admitted
they were not all handled under his supervision.
I am confident that examining these chariots will
lead us to a whole new truth.

We have kindly been granted permission to explore
the racecourse grounds as we please, and I intend
to make full use of Gustav's generosity.
translation:
Hipodrom isletmecisi Gustav,
arabalarin araziden ciktigindan haberdar olmadigini soyledi, ama
hepsinin kendi gozetimi altinda kullanilmadigini da kabul etti.
Bu arabalari incelemenin
bizi bambaska bir gercege gotureceginden
eminim.

Gustav'in comertligi sayesinde hipodrom alanini diledigimiz gibi arastirma izni aldik
ve ben de
bu firsati sonuna kadar
kullanacagim.

original: A Cart was Removed?
translation: Bir Araba Kaldirilmis mi?

original:
A full examination revealed the racing chariots to
be sturdily built and able to support substantial
weight. More interesting still was the fact that each
chariot could be deconstructed by removing key
bolts, allowing them to be transported easily.

The racecourse manager's records show that one
chariot was out for maintenance on the day of the
petrification incident. The chariots are ultimately
Henry's responsibility, so I think we'll have to check
the facts with him.
translation:
Ayrintili bir inceleme, yaris arabalarinin
saglam yapildigini ve
ciddi agirlik tasiyabildigini gosterdi. Daha da ilginci,
her araba kilit civatalari sokulerek parcalarina ayrilabiliyor; boylece
kolayca tasinabiliyordu.

Hipodrom kayitlari, taslastirma olayinin yasandigi gun bir arabanin bakim icin
disarida oldugunu gosteriyor. Arabalar nihayetinde
Henry'nin sorumlulugunda, bu yuzden
gercekleri onunla
kontrol etmemiz gerekecek.

original: Henry is Behaving Oddly
translation: Henry Tuhaf Davraniyor

original:
We've come to the conclusion that a chariot was
indeed removed from the racecourse in time for the
petrification incident, and furthermore, that such an
operation could not have been authorised without
Henry's written permission. This in itself is troubling,
but there's more. It was Henry who directed the
police to arrest Dalston, and he has been at the
forefront of every major incident we've witnessed
thus far. I fear that Henry is hiding something...
translation:
Taslastirma olayi icin hipodromdan gercekten bir araba cikarildigi ve
boyle bir islemin Henry'nin yazili izni olmadan
yetkilendirilemeyecegi sonucuna vardik. Bu bile basli basina endise verici,
ama dahasi var. Dalston'i tutuklatmasi icin polise yon veren Henry'ydi ve
su ana dek tanik oldugumuz her buyuk olayin
tam merkezindeydi. Henry'nin bir sey sakladigindan
korkuyorum...

original: Afternoon Tea
translation: Ikindi Cayi

original:
We paid a visit to the Ledores, and over tea I
openly shared my doubts and suspicions with
Henry. Whether he is the mastermind or not, he
seems to have been somehow involved in every
incident to date, so I had hopes that he might
provide some useful information.

Unfortunately, he obstinately refused to tell me
anything. I only hope I can break through his shell
before it's too late.
translation:
Ledorelara ugradik ve cay esliginde
kuskularimi ve suphelerimi
Henry'yle acikca paylastim. Beyin olup olmadigi bir yana,
bugune kadar her olaya bir sekilde karismis gorunuyor;
bu yuzden bize ise yarar bilgiler verebilecegini umuyordum.

Ne yazik ki inatla
hicbir sey soylemeyi reddetti. Tek umudum,
cok gec olmadan
kabuklarini kirabilmem.

original: Police Aid
translation: Polisten Yardim

original:
We had just left the Ledores' and were about to
head to Tingly Town when we were stopped in mid-
stride by an eager-looking constable. He asked if
he could escort us back to Celebration Boulevard,
where another officer wants to talk to us. I agreed
readily. We cannot pass up the opportunity to gain
new information about the Masked Gentleman, no
matter how insignificant it may seem.
translation:
Ledorelarin yanindan yeni ayrilmis, Tingly Town'a gitmek uzereyken
hevesli gorunen bir polis memuru adimlarimizi kesti.
Bizi Kutlama Bulvari'na kadar
eslik edip goturebilecegini soyledi; orada baska bir memur bizimle konusmak istiyormus.
Memnuniyetle kabul ettim.
Maskeli Beyefendi hakkinda
ne kadar onemsiz gorunurse gorunsun,
yeni bir bilgi edinme firsatini
kacirmamaliyiz.

original: Horse Racing Revisited
translation: At Yarisi Yeniden

original:
The officer who wished to speak to us turned out to
have a rather unusual request: he had seen us
chase the Masked Gentleman on horseback and
was hoping for another performance.

Following this, we learnt of what could be a
dangerous situation developing at the Scorpion
Casino. It isn't the location that the Gentleman
expressly mentioned, but we can't afford to treat
any disturbance in Monte d'Or lightly, so we will
make the casino our next destination.
translation:
Bizimle konusmak isteyen memurun
oldukca tuhaf bir istegi vardi:
Bizi Maskeli Beyefendi'yi at ustunde kovalarken gormus ve
bir gosteri daha bekliyormus.

Bunun ardindan, Akrep
Kumarhanesi'nde tehlikeli olabilecek bir durumun gelistigini ogrendik.
Beyefendi'nin ozellikle belirttigi yer orasi degil,
ama Monte d'Or'daki hicbir karisikligi hafife alamayiz;
bu yuzden
bir sonraki duragimiz
kumarhane olacak.

original: Murphy Blocks the Way
translation: Murphy Yolu Kesiyor

original:
On our way to the casino, we found our path
obstructed by a man named Murphy. He poured out
details of the Ledores' and Dalston's financial
affairs and pointed out to us that Dalston's arrest
and the Masked Gentlemen's miracles are actually
profiting Henry. It's concerning news, to say the
least, but we have no time to ponder it now. To
the casino!
translation:
Kumarhaneye giderken yolumuz,
Murphy adinda bir adam tarafindan kesildi. Ledorelar ile Dalston'in mali islerine dair
detaylari doktu ve
Dalston'in tutuklanmasinin ve Maskeli Beyefendi'nin mucizelerinin aslinda
Henry'ye kazandirdigini bize gosterdi.
En azindan endise verici bir haber, ama
su an bunun uzerinde dusunup oyalanacak vaktimiz yok.
Kumarhaneye!

original: Trouble at the Casino
translation: Kumarhanede Sorun

original:
From what we've heard on Chance Avenue, the
mishap in the Scorpion Casino is not linked to the
Masked Gentleman. Though it may no longer seem
like the best use of our time, it goes against my
principles to leave any dilemma unsolved. Once we
resolve the problem, we will go directly to Tingly
Town.
translation:
Sans Bulvari'nda duyduklarimiza gore,
Akrep Kumarhanesi'ndeki talihsizlik Maskeli Beyefendi'yle baglantili degil.
Artik zamanimizi en iyi sekilde kullanmiyor gibi gorunse de,
hicbir ikilemi cozumsuz birakmak
ilkelerime aykiri. Sorunu cozdukten sonra
dogrudan Tingly
Town'a gidecegiz.

original: An Elegant Solution
translation: Zarif Bir Cozum

original:
The ones causing a stir in the casino were none
other than Frankie, the confrontational thug we met
near the Ledores' mansion, and Narcisse, the
mediator who stepped in. The casino's manager,
Mr Drake, treated Frankie so unsympathetically as
to suggest that such disruptions are quite common.
I suspect the situation would have been resolved
without our intervention, but Mr Drake expressed
his gratitude nonetheless. Having such a powerful
acquaintance on our side is guaranteed to be a
great asset.
translation:
Kumarhanede ortaligi karistiranlar,
Ledore malikanesinin yakininda karsilastigimiz
kavgaci serseri Frankie ile
araya giren arabulucu Narcisse'den baskasi degildi.
Kumarhane muduru Bay Drake,
Frankie'ye oyle bir sogukkanlilikla davrandi ki
boyle taskinliklarin oldukca yaygin oldugu anlasiliyordu.
Durum bizim mudahalemiz olmadan da cozulebilirdi diye dusunuyorum,
ama Bay Drake yine de
tesekkurlerini sundu. Boylesine guclu bir tanidigin yanimizda olmasi
kesinlikle
buyuk bir avantaj saglayacak.

original: Into Tingly Town
translation: Tingly Town'a Dogru

original:
Tingly Town, the funfair to the north of Monte d'Or,
remains in keeping with the ostentatious style of the
city. We spoke to Yukkles, the clown we first met by
the stone statues, who was hopeful of our solving
the case. In fact, everyone here appears to be in
high spirits, seemingly oblivious to the fact that the
Gentleman will appear tonight.

The situation is a little worrying, but for now we shall
proceed as planned and conduct an investigation of
the area.
translation:
Monte d'Or'un kuzeyindeki lunapark Tingly Town,
sehrin gosterisli uslubuna uygun
bir yer olarak duruyor. Ilk kez tas heykellerin yaninda tanistigimiz palyaco Yukkles'la konustuk;
davayi cozmemiz konusunda umutluydu. Aslinda buradaki herkesin
keyfi yerinde, sanki Beyefendi'nin bu gece ortaya cikacagi gerceginden habersizmis gibi.

Durum biraz kaygi verici,
ama simdilik planlandigi gibi ilerleyip
bolgeyi sorusturmaya devam edecegiz.

original: The Gentleman's Message
translation: Beyefendinin Mesaji

original:
It is all too easy to be distracted by the
entertainment Tingly Town has to offer, but before
we get sidetracked, it is imperative that we put
a stop to the Masked Gentleman's ungracious acts.

Having faith in our predictions, Inspector Grosky
has arrived to investigate, but we will have to do
without the rest of the police force for now. Still, we
have a lead to go on and are scouring the funfair
for {''}a new spin on the miraculous{''}. I expect the
attractions will be the key to this riddle.
translation:
Tingly Town'un sundugu
eglenceyle dikkatin dagilmasi isten bile degil, ama
yoldan sapmadan once
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin nezaketsiz eylemlerine
bir son vermemiz sart.

Tahminlerimize guvenen Mufettis Grosky
sorusturmak icin buraya gelmis,
ama simdilik polis gucunun geri kalanindan
yoksun olacagiz. Yine de elimizde bir ipucu var:
lunaparki {''}mucizeye yeni bir yorum{''} arayarak
didik didik ediyoruz. Bu bilmeceyi cozecek anahtarin
eglence duzenekleri olduguna inaniyorum.

original: Results of the Scavenger Hunt
translation: Hazine Avinin Sonucu

original:
Concealed within each of the funfair attractions were
parts of a message left by the Masked Gentleman.
Put together, the cards formed a map pointing to
Tingly Tower, the control tower to the north of the
funfair.

The Masked Gentleman's intention may be to show
us a spectacle from the tower's apex, as it
overlooks the entire park. But what exactly does
he have in mind?
translation:
Lunaparktaki her bir eglence duzeneginin icine
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin biraktigi mesajin parcalari saklanmisti.
Kartlar birlestirildiginde,
lunaparkin kuzeyindeki kontrol kulesi olan
Tingly Tower'i isaret eden bir harita olustu.

Maskeli Beyefendi'nin amaci,
butun parki tepeden goren bu kulenin zirvesinden bize bir gosteri sunmak olabilir.
Ama aklinda tam olarak
ne var?

original: Henry Joins the Hunt
translation: Henry Av'a Katiliyor

original:
As we were about to set off for Tingly Tower, Henry
and Angela arrived on the scene offering to aid us
in apprehending the Gentleman. After some
discussion, they decided to accompany us to the
tower. Henry appears genuinely worried about the
Gentleman's actions, but it seems most unlike him
to allow Angela to put herself in danger as well...

In any case, we are out of time. We have to stop
the Gentleman before he is able to shut off the
power to Tingly Town!
translation:
Tingly Tower'a dogru yola cikmak uzereyken,
Henry ve Angela olay yerine gelip
Beyefendi'yi yakalamamiza yardim etmeyi teklif ettiler. Kisa bir tartismadan sonra kuleye bizimle gelmeye karar verdiler.
Henry gercekten de Beyefendi'nin yaptiklarindan endiseli gorunuyor,
ama Angela'nin da kendini tehlikeye atmasina izin vermesi ona hic benzemez...

Her neyse, vaktimiz kalmadi.
Beyefendi Tingly Town'un elektrigini kesmeden once
onu durdurmaliyiz!

original: The Great Disappearance
translation: Buyuk Yok Olus

original:
The inside of Tingly Tower was black as pitch,
forcing us to rely on voice to guide each other.
It is this tower that supplies power to the park,
but how the Masked Gentleman could find his way
in the dark is anybody's guess.

On leaving the tower, we found to our amazement
that the entire park had become deserted. Only
the Gentleman's voice resounded through the still
and sombre park. I cannot conceive how such a
feat could be possible.
translation:
Tingly Tower'in ici zifiri karanlikti;
birbirimizi yonlendirmek icin sesimize guvenmek zorunda kaldik.
Bu kule parka elektrik sagliyor, ama
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin karanlikta yolunu nasil bulabildigi
tam bir muamma.

Kuleyi terk ettigimizde, saskinlik icinde
tum parkin bombos kaldigini gorduk.
Hala ve kasvetli parkta yalnizca
Beyefendi'nin sesi yankilaniyordu.
Boylesi bir seyin
nasil mumkun olabilecegini aklim almiyor.

original: The Great Reappearance
translation: Buyuk Geri Donus

original:
The Masked Gentleman escaped our grasp, leaving
us with the ominous announcement that we would
be able to see his next miracle from anywhere in
the city. The scale must be unprecedented!

We were relieved beyond words when the funfair's
crowds reappeared, completely unaware that they
had only moments ago vanished entirely. Thus far
we have disproved all the Gentleman's miracles as
stunts. But how can we possibly explain this?
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi elimizden kacti, geride de
bir sonraki mucizesini sehrin neresinden olursa olsun
gorebilecegimizi soyleyen ugursuz bir duyuru birakti.
Olcegi benzeri gorulmemis olmali!

Lunapark kalabaliklarinin
yeniden belirmesiyle kelimelerle anlatilamayacak kadar rahatladik;
az once tamamen yok olduklarindan habersizdiler.
Simdiye dek Beyefendi'nin mucizelerinin hepsinin birer numara oldugunu curuttuk.
Peki bunu
nasil aciklayabiliriz?

original: Dawn of the Fourth Day
translation: Dorduncu Gunun Safagi

original:
Last night, the Masked Gentleman appeared before
us and claimed that his final miracle would be seen
throughout the city. All his miracles to date have
involved a large number of people, yet I sense that
when alluding to the scale of his final miracle, the
Gentleman is not talking about the size of the
audience.

I find myself wondering if the crowds at Tingly Town
were even aware that the Gentleman had made his
appearance...
translation:
Dun gece Maskeli Beyefendi karsimiza cikti ve
son mucizesinin tum sehirden gorulecegini iddia etti.
Su ana kadarki mucizelerinin hepsi cok sayida insani iceriyordu,
ama son mucizesinin olceginden soz ederken
Beyefendi'nin kastettigi seyin
seyirci sayisi olmadigini hissediyorum.

Kendi kendime sunu soruyorum:
Tingly Town'daki kalabaliklar
Beyefendi'nin ortaya ciktiginin
farkinda bile miydi...?

original: Back to Ch{^a}teau Dalston
translation: Ch{^a}teau Dalston'a Donus

original:
We had barely begun our fourth day of investigation
when Dalston's butler Gonzales caught us at the
hotel entrance with some interesting news: Dalston
has been released. Presumably, the police have
been informed about our confrontation with the
Masked Gentleman.
It pains me that we were not able to clear Dalston's
name sooner, but it is a great relief that he was
able to leave without incident. With little else to go
on, Dalston may be our only lead. We shall visit
Ch{^a}teau Dalston and hear what he has to say.
translation:
Dorduncu sorusturma gunumuze daha yeni baslamistik ki
Dalston'in usagi Gonzales,
otelin girisinde bizi ilginc bir haberle yakaladi:
Dalston serbest birakilmis. Muhtemelen polis,
Maskeli Beyefendi'yle yuzlesmemizden haberdar olmustur.
Dalston'in adini daha once temize cikaramamis olmamiz canimi yakiyor,
ama sorunsuz bicimde cikabilmis olmasina
cok sevindim. Baska bir izimiz pek yok;
Dalston tek ipucumuz olabilir.
Ch{^a}teau Dalston'a gidip
ne diyecegini dinleyecegiz.

original: Dalston Liberated
translation: Dalston Ozgur

original:
By the time we arrived at Ch{^a}teau Dalston, it was
evident that rumours of the Masked Gentleman's
appearance in Tingly Town had spread thick and
fast. Dalston is not entirely off the hook, but at
least the police will focus their attention on
apprehending the real Masked Gentleman for now.

Dalston was naturally peeved about the whole
affair, but he agreed to support us in any way he
can. We should be very grateful, in fact, for he has
inadvertently aided us in solving last night's miracle.
translation:
Ch{^a}teau Dalston'a vardigimizda,
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin Tingly Town'daki gorunusune dair soylentilerin
hizla yayildigi belliydi.
Dalston tamamen aklanmis degil,
ama en azindan polis simdilik
asil Maskeli Beyefendi'yi yakalamaya
odaklanacak.

Dalston dogal olarak bu ise pek bozulmustu,
ama elinden gelen her sekilde bize destek olmayi kabul etti.
Aslinda ona minnettar olmaliyiz; cunku
dun geceki mucizeyi cozmemize
istemeden de olsa yardim etti.

original: The Mysterious Guarantor
translation: Gizemli Kefil

original:
Mr Drake of the Scorpion Casino has disclosed a
very concerning piece of information to us: Henry
was not of legal age at the time of Monte d'Or's
inception and thus required a guarantor to carry out
his plans. Said guarantor was purportedly a woman,
but I'm unsure as to who she could have been,
given that Henry had no known relatives. Whoever
she was, she must have been deeply involved in
the development of Monte d'Or. Why didn't Henry
tell us about this?
translation:
Akrep Kumarhanesi'nin sahibi Bay Drake,
bizimle son derece kaygi verici bir bilgi paylasti:
Monte d'Or kurulurken Henry resit degilmis
ve planlarini hayata gecirmek icin bir kefile ihtiyac duymus.
Soz konusu kefilin bir kadin oldugu soyleniyor,
ama Henry'nin bilinen bir akrabasi olmadigina gore
kim olabileceginden emin degilim.
Kim olursa olsun,
Monte d'Or'un gelisiminde derinden yer almis olmali.
Henry bunu bize neden soylemedi?

original: The Mystery of Tingly Tower
translation: Tingly Tower'in Sirri

original:
A re-examination of Tingly Tower revealed a back
door which opened upon a perfect duplicate of
Tingly Town. Under the veil of darkness, it was all
too easy for the Gentleman to trick us into thinking
we had exited the tower via the same door as we
had entered through.

What baffles me most is why he would go to such
lengths to show only the five of us his elaborate
trick. The only thing we can be sure of is the
conviction with which he carries out his acts.
translation:
Tingly Tower'i yeniden inceledigimizde,
Tingly Town'un bire bir kopyasina acilan
arka bir kapi bulduk. Karanligin perdesi altinda,
Beyefendi'nin kuleye girdigimiz kapidan cikmisiz gibi
bizi kandirmasi fazlasiyla kolay olmus.

Beni en cok sasirtan sey,
boylesine zahmete girip bu karmasik numarayi
sadece besimize gostermis olmasi.
Kesin bildigimiz tek sey,
eylemlerini ne kadar inancla
surdurdugu.

original: Straight from Murphy's Mouth
translation: Murphy'nin Agzindan

original:
As we left Tingly Tower, we were approached by
Murphy, the financial advisor. He was evidently
itching to tell us something, which turned out to be
very pertinent indeed. It seems that ever since
Dalston's arrest, Henry's businesses have enjoyed
a substantial advantage.

I have to wonder: Henry has recently invested large
sums into city planning. Could he be responsible for
the creation of the second Tingly Town?
translation:
Tingly Tower'dan ayrilirken,
mali danisman Murphy yanimiza geldi.
Belli ki bir seyler soylemek icin yanip tutusuyordu ve
soyledikleri gercekten de cok yerindeydi.
Dalston'in tutuklanmasindan bu yana
Henry'nin isleri ciddi bir avantaj saglamis.

Sunu dusunmeden edemiyorum:
Henry yakin zamanda sehir planlamasina buyuk paralar yatirdi.
Ikinci Tingly Town'un
yaratilmasindan
o mu sorumlu olabilir?

original: Angela's Pendant
translation: Angela'nin Kolyesi

original:
Angela is becoming visibly weary with recent events,
not least last night's miracle. She is convinced that
the town could be spared the Gentleman's tricks if
we only had the Mask of Order, but it seems to me
that she is deluding herself.
I don't quite know why, but Angela has changed. In
a perfectly nonchalant manner, she told me she
had lost her pendant, a pendant that I remember
her treasuring dearly in the past. Either she has
changed dramatically over the past 18 years, or
something is afoot.
translation:
Angela son olaylarla belirgin bicimde yoruluyor;
ozellikle de dun geceki mucizeyle.
Duzen Maskesi elimizde olsaydi
sehrin Beyefendi'nin numaralarindan kurtulacagina inanmis durumda,
ama bana kalirsa kendini kandiriyor.
Neden bilmiyorum, ama Angela degismis.
Son derece umursamaz bir tavirla,
eskiden cok deger verdigini hatirladigim kolyesini
kaybettigini soyledi.
Ya son 18 yilda cok degisti,
ya da ortada
baska bir sey var.

original: Henry Remains Reticent
translation: Henry Hala Ketum

original:
Since last night's miracle, Henry has taken an even
more obstinate stance towards us. We know that
there are only a handful of people capable of
orchestrating such a large-scale stunt. Perhaps he
fears that he has come under suspicion, as the one
who ordered the expansion of the city facilities. He
seems oddly intent on restoring peace to the city
without first closing the case.
translation:
Dun geceki mucizeden sonra Henry bize karsi
daha da inatci bir tavir takindi.
Boylesine buyuk olcekli bir numarayi duzenleyebilecek insan sayisi cok az.
Sehir tesislerinin genisletilmesini emreden kisi olarak
suphe altina girmekten korkuyor olabilir.
Davanin ustunu kapatmadan once,
sehre barisi geri getirmeye
garip bicimde
takmis durumda.

original: Mrs Ascot is Alive!
translation: Bayan Ascot Yasiyor!

original:
We were busy examining Henry's study, when who
should appear but Mrs Ascot, Randall's mother!

She told us of how she invested so much money in
the search for her missing son that the Ascot family
riches dwindled to nothing and the name faded into
obscurity. She would not even have a roof over her
head if not for Henry. Based on this, I am inclined
to believe that the female guarantor Mr Drake
mentioned was, in fact, Mrs Ascot.
translation:
Henry'nin calisma odasini incelerken
karsimiza kim cikti dersiniz: Randall'in annesi Bayan Ascot!

Kayip oglunu aramak icin o kadar cok para yatirdigini,
Ascot ailesinin servetinin sifira indigini ve
adlarinin unutulup gittigini anlatti.
Henry olmasa basini sokacak bir catisi bile olmayacakmis.
Buna bakarak, Bay Drake'in sozunu ettigi kadin kefilin
gercekte Bayan Ascot olduguna
inanmaya meyilliyim.

original: The Ownership of Monte d'Or
translation: Monte d'Or'un Sahipligi

original:
Even with Henry's permission, it troubles my
conscience to pry into his private affairs. However,
the information I've uncovered casts a new light on
Henry's previously inexplicable actions.

The whole time, he has simply tried to protect
Monte d'Or and keep it ready for Randall's return.
As the city's guardian, Henry has been determined
to remove any sign of the havoc caused by the
Masked Gentleman.
translation:
Henry'nin izni olsa bile,
ozel islerine burnumu sokmak vicdanimi rahatsiz ediyor.
Yine de buldugum bilgiler,
Henry'nin simdiye dek aciklanamayan
davranislarina yeni bir isik tutuyor.

Meger o, bastan beri
Monte d'Or'u korumaya ve
Randall'in donusune hazir tutmaya calismis.
Sehrin muhafizi olarak Henry,
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin yarattigi yikimin
her izini
silip supurmeye kararliymis.

original: Lingering Doubts
translation: Suregelen Supheler

original:
Chief Inspector Sheffield still harbours suspicion
towards Dalston - a natural response given the
unlikelihood that somebody else could have
operated unnoticed for so long under the vigilant
eye of the Monte d'Or police force.

The chief inspector informed us that Detective
Bloom has found some crucial evidence at the
racecourse. If we make haste, we may yet find him
there.
translation:
Basmufettis Sheffield hala
Dalston'dan supheleniyor - Monte d'Or polisinin uyanik
gozu altinda bir baskasinin bunca sure fark edilmeden
is gormus olmasi pek olasi degil; bu yuzden bu tepki dogal.

Basmufettis, Dedektif Bloom'un hipodromda
kritik bir kanit buldugunu soyledi.
Acele edersek,
onu hala orada yakalayabiliriz.

original: The Reunion Inn
translation: Reunion Inn

original:
It is now evening, and we can no longer afford to
waste any time if we are to put an end to the
Masked Gentleman's tricks. Inspector Grosky,
determined as ever to make an arrest, claims that
the Gentleman has appeared at a place called the
Reunion Inn.

But let's not get ahead of ourselves. First, we shall
hurry to the racecourse to talk to Detective Bloom.
translation:
Artik aksam oldu ve
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin numaralarina son vermek istiyorsak
daha fazla vakit kaybedemeyiz.
Her zamanki gibi kararli olan Mufettis Grosky,
Beyefendi'nin Reunion Inn denilen bir yerde ortaya ciktigini iddia ediyor.

Ama acele hukum vermeyelim.
Once hipodroma kosup
Dedektif Bloom'la konusacagiz.

original: The Excellent Inspector
translation: Mukemmel Mufettis

original:
Detective Bloom firmly believes that the Masked
Gentleman is after the Mask of Order and that he
is currently hiding out somewhere in the Reunion
Inn. I've come to a similar conclusion.

If the Gentleman's primary objective is to cause
detriment to Henry, then it follows that he bears
some deeply ingrained resentment towards him. In
any case, we must seek out the Gentleman as soon
as we possibly can.
translation:
Dedektif Bloom, Maskeli Beyefendi'nin Duzen Maskesi'nin pesinde olduguna ve
su anda Reunion Inn'in bir yerinde saklandigina
kesinlikle inaniyor.
Ben de benzer bir sonuca vardim.

Eger Beyefendi'nin asil amaci
Henry'ye zarar vermekse,
ona karsi cok derin koklu bir
kin besliyor demektir.
Her halukarda,
Beyefendi'yi
mumkun olan en kisa surede bulmaliyiz.

original: The Heart of Monte d'Or
translation: Monte d'Or'un Kalbi

original:
The city of Monte d'Or grew from a very modest
little inn. Today, the Reunion Inn is a sprawling
hotel complex of such grandeur that it left us
breathless.

Henry gave the hotel its name trusting that he and
Randall would one day meet there, but now a
shadow hangs over this place of hope. The Masked
Gentleman is inside and he is no doubt putting the
last details of his final miracle into place. We must
stop him!
translation:
Monte d'Or sehri,
mutevazi kucuk bir handan buyumus.
Bugun Reunion Inn, nefesimizi kesecek kadar gorkemli
devasa bir otel kompleksi.

Henry, bir gun Randall'la orada bulusacaklarina inanarak otele bu adi vermisti,
ama simdi bu umut yerinin ustune
bir golge cokmus durumda.
Maskeli Beyefendi iceride ve
son mucizesinin son hazirliklarini yaptigina suphe yok.
Onu durdurmaliyiz!

original: Manager of the Reunion Inn
translation: Reunion Inn Muduru

original:
It came as a surprise to all to discover that
Mr Mordaunt, a man often seen hurrying around the
city on various errands, is actually the manager
of the Reunion Inn. Whoever his sources are, he
seems to have remarkably accurate and extensive
knowledge of the case - he even knows of my
doubts regarding Henry. How lucky we are to have
him as a guide!

He wishes to show us a place that may be of
interest to us, and I am inclined to follow.
translation:
Sehirde cesitli isler icin kostururken sikca gordugumuz
Bay Mordaunt'un aslinda
Reunion Inn'in muduru oldugunu ogrenmek hepimizi sasirtti.
Kaynaklari kim olursa olsun,
davaya dair sasirtici derecede dogru ve kapsamli bilgilere sahip;
hatta Henry hakkindaki suphelerimi bile biliyor.
Onun rehberligine sahip oldugumuz icin ne kadar sansliyiz!

Bize ilginc gelebilecek bir yeri gostermek istiyor
ve ben de
onu takip etmeye
meyilliyim.

original: Henry's Secret
translation: Henry'nin Sirri

original:
The place that Mr Mordaunt wished us to see was
Henry's office, located in a secluded section of the
Reunion Inn. One part of the wall was precisely as
it had been in Randall's room 18 years ago. It may
be that even to this day, Henry continues his
search for Randall...

Given their excellent observational skills, I have
left Emmy and Luke to examine the office. In the
meantime, Mr Mordaunt and I will search the
records room.
translation:
Bay Mordaunt'un gostermek istedigi yer,
Reunion Inn'in tenha bir bolumunde bulunan Henry'nin ofisiydi.
Duvarin bir kismi, 18 yil once Randall'in odasindaki haliyle
bire bir ayniydi.
Belki Henry,
bugun bile Randall'i aramayi surduruyordur...

Gozlem yeteneklerine guvendigim icin
Emmy ile Luke'u ofisi incelemeleri icin biraktim.
Bu arada Bay Mordaunt'la ben
kayit odasinda
arastirma yapacagiz.

original: Concealed among the Records
translation: Kayitlarin Arasinda Sakli

original:
I went to search the records room looking for
information, and came across something that defied
all my expectations: the Mask of Chaos itself!
Meanwhile, Emmy and Luke found a log written by
the expedition team that searched for Randall.
Putting two and two together, I have established
one possible theory that connects the mask and the
city plans that I found in the records. I don't
believe the Masked Gentleman was aware of this
room. After coming here, everything has begun to
click into place.
translation:
Bilgi aramak icin kayit odasina girdim ve
tum beklentilerime meydan okuyan bir seyle karsilastim:
Kaos Maskesi'nin ta kendisi!
Bu sirada Emmy ile Luke,
Randall'i arayan kesif ekibinin yazdigi bir kayit defteri buldu.
Ikisini birlestirince,
maskeyle kayitlar odasinda buldugum sehir planlarini
baglayan olasi bir teori kurabildim.
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin bu odadan haberi oldugunu sanmiyorum.
Buraya geldikten sonra,
her sey yavas yavas
yerli yerine oturmaya basladi.

original: An Unexpected Gift
translation: Beklenmedik Bir Hediye

original:
After escorting us back to the lobby, Mr Mordaunt
gave me a cryptic story book that was undoubtedly
left for me by the Masked Gentleman. Clearly, he
has been expecting us and left the book as some
sort of message. No doubt he is also responsible
for the hotel's sudden blackout.
translation:
Bizi tekrar lobiye kadar goturdukten sonra
Bay Mordaunt,
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin suphesiz benim icin biraktigi
gizemli bir hikaye kitabi verdi.
Belli ki bizi bekliyormus ve
kitabi bir tur mesaj olarak birakmis.
Otelin aniden kararmasinin sorumlusu da
kuskusuz o.

original: The Book and the Fairy Tale
translation: Kitap ve Masal

original:
The book that the Masked Gentleman left for us
contained part of what appears to be a fairy tale.
It alludes to something of grave importance, but
what? I follow that the boy in the tale acts as a
mouthpiece for the Masked Gentleman, but exactly
what he is trying to convey remains a mystery.

The text also gives hints indicating another location.
I fear we shall have to participate in the Masked
Gentleman's little game until its conclusion.
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin biraktigi kitap,
bir masalin parcasi gibi gorunen bir metin iceriyordu.
Son derece onemli bir seye gonderme yapiyor, ama
neye?
Masaldaki cocugun Maskeli Beyefendi adina konustugunu anliyorum,
ama tam olarak
neyi iletmeye calistigi hala bir muamma.

Metin ayrica baska bir konuma isaret eden ipuclari veriyor.
Korkarim
Beyefendi'nin kucuk oyununa
sonuna kadar katlanmak zorunda kalacagiz.

original: The Boy and his Dog
translation: Cocuk ve Kopegi

original:
We found a second book in one of the hotel suites,
a tale concerning a boy and his dog. It seems at
first glance to be a perfectly ordinary fairy tale,
but it must hold some deeper meaning for the
Gentleman.

The tone of this story is very different from the
last, leaving me with the impression that our
masked mastermind is afraid of betrayal and
abandonment. Perhaps he has already suffered
these things?
translation:
Otel suitlerinden birinde ikinci bir kitap bulduk;
bir cocukla kopegi hakkinda bir hikaye.
Ilk bakista tamamen siradan bir masal gibi dursa da,
Beyefendi icin daha derin bir anlam tasimali.

Bu hikayenin tonu bir oncekinden cok farkli;
maskeli beynimizin
ihanet ve
terk edilmekten korktugu izlenimini veriyor.
Belki de bunlari
coktan yasamistir?

original: Connecting the Dots
translation: Parcalari Birlestirmek

original:
The vague and fragmented facts are finally slotting
into place in my mind. The jigsaw is almost
complete.
It seems that I was not the only one to wrongly
suspect Henry - but the Masked Gentleman's
bitterness runs far deeper than any of us could
have imagined. Unless we lift the veil of mistrust,
all Henry's devotion will be for naught, and there
will be no way to pick up the broken pieces. I pray
that we have time to convince the Gentleman of his
grave misunderstanding.
translation:
Belirsiz ve parcali gercekler,
nihayet zihnimde yerli yerine oturuyor.
Yapboz neredeyse
tamamlandi.
Gorunen o ki Henry'den yanlis suphelenen
yalnizca ben degilmisim - ama Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
aci ofkesi, hicbirimizin hayal edemeyecegi kadar derin.
Guvensizlik perdesini kaldiramazsak,
Henry'nin tum bagliligi bosa gidecek ve
kirilan parcalari toparlamanin
hicbir yolu kalmayacak.
Umarim Beyefendi'yi
vahim yanilgisindan vazgecirecek kadar
vaktimiz vardir.

original: Declaration of Betrayal
translation: Ihanet Ilani

original:
The elaborately decorated book we discovered in
the Grand Hall told the story of a chancellor who
had committed treason. I am beginning to believe
that the entire tale loosely weaves together key
events in the Masked Gentleman's life. It's essential
that I make him aware of his mistake, but I fear that
will be difficult, when he has deluded himself for so
long.
Still, this is no time to waver. I will go to the
auditorium, as the books indicate, and try to
talk sense into him.
translation:
Buyuk Salon'da buldugumuz
ozenle suslenmis kitap,
ihanet etmis bir sansolyenin hikayesini anlatiyordu.
Artik bu masalin,
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin hayatindaki kilit olaylari
gevsekce birbirine ordugune inanmaya basliyorum.
Onu hatasindan haberdar etmem sart,
ama bunca zamandir kendini kandirirken
bunun zor olmasindan korkuyorum.
Yine de simdi tereddut zamani degil.
Kitaplarin isaret ettigi gibi,
salona gidip
ona aklini basina toplamasini saglamaya calisacagim.

original: Confrontation in the Auditorium
translation: Salondaki Yuzlesme

original:
The Gentleman was lying in wait for us in the
auditorium. He must have been waiting patiently,
biding his time on that forgotten stage, all to show
us - to show someone - his despair.

I feel for him, but he must be truly misguided to act
as he did next, putting an innocent boy in danger.
If Luke had fallen from that rope, I could never
have forgiven myself!
translation:
Beyefendi,
salonda bize pusu kurmustu.
O unutulmus sahnede
sabirla beklemis olmali; zamani gelince
bize - birine -
umutsuzlugunu gostermek icin.

Ona aciyorum, ama
bir sonraki yaptiginda gercekten yolunu kaybetmisti:
masum bir cocugu tehlikeye atmak.
Luke o ipten dusseydi,
kendimi asla affedemezdim!

original: Randall's Return
translation: Randall'in Donusu

original:
As I have suspected for some time, the Masked
Gentleman is Randall. After falling into the depths
of Akbadain, he spent 18 years in forgetfulness
until he received a letter that detailed his past.
This letter told pernicious tales of Stansbury's
decline and Henry's betrayal. It was from this that
Randall's animosity for Henry stemmed.
With each subsequent letter, the thorns of hatred 
grew more tangled, to the point where the downfall
of Monte d'Or seemed to Randall not an atrocity,
but a necessity.
translation:
Uzun zamandir suphelendigim gibi,
Maskeli Beyefendi Randall'dir.
Akbadain'in derinliklerine dustukten sonra
gecmisini anlatan bir mektup alana dek
18 yil boyunca unutkanlik icinde yasamis.
Bu mektup, Stansbury'nin cokusu ve
Henry'nin ihaneti hakkinda kotu niyetli hikayeler anlatiyordu.
Randall'in Henry'ye duydugu dusmanlik
iste buradan dogdu.
Her yeni mektupla,
nefretin dikenleri daha da
sarpa sardi; oyle ki
Monte d'Or'un yikimi Randall'a bir vahset degil,
bir zorunluluk gibi gorunmeye basladi.

original: Avalanche of Sand
translation: Kum Cigi

original:
Randall intends to bury the city in an avalanche of
sand. He has detonated explosives in the rocky
cliffs surrounding the city, causing sand to pour
down. We have precious little time before the city
is engulfed.
Catching Randall must wait - we must first save
Monte d'Or. If we can find a way to raise the city
higher than ground level, we may yet avert disaster.
I have reason to believe this is possible, but if my
prediction is wrong, this place may be buried in
sand forever.
translation:
Randall sehri bir kum cigiyla
gommek istiyor. Sehrin cevresindeki kayalik ucurumlarda patlayicilar patlatti
ve kumun asagi
akmasina neden oldu.
Sehir yutulmadan once
cok az zamanimiz var.
Randall'i yakalamak bekleyebilir - once Monte d'Or'u kurtarmaliyiz.
Sehri yer seviyesinin ustune yukseltmenin bir yolunu bulabilirsek,
felaketi onleyebiliriz.
Bunun mumkun olduguna inanmak icin nedenlerim var, ama
tahminim yanlis cikarsa
burasi sonsuza dek
kumun altinda kalabilir.

original: Detective Bloom Flees
translation: Dedektif Bloom Kaciyor

original:
After a brief encounter with Inspector Grosky, we
spoke to Chief Inspector Sheffield, who agreed that
the police would help escort the people to safety
while we found a way to stop the sand's infiltration.
I believe that both the mask and the blueprints to
the city are the keys to saving Monte d'Or.

On another note, I would never have expected
Detective Bloom to flee during such a crisis. I had
thought him a more responsible individual.
translation:
Mufettis Grosky'yle kisa bir karsilasmanin ardindan,
Basmufettis Sheffield'la konustuk; polis,
insanlari guvenlige ulastirirken
biz de kumun sehre sizmasini durdurmanin bir yolunu arayacaktik.
Maskenin ve sehir planlarinin
Monte d'Or'u kurtarmanin anahtarlari olduguna inaniyorum.

Bir baska not olarak,
boylesi bir krizde Dedektif Bloom'un kacmasini asla beklemezdim.
Onu daha sorumluluk sahibi biri sanirdim.

original: A Way to Save the City
translation: Sehri Kurtarmanin Yolu

original:
The sand has not yet reached the monument, but it
soon will. Angela seemed very worried about where
the Mask of Order might be, but as it happens,
I already know the precise location. It is hidden in
plain view, where none of us would have thought to
look.

The mask can wait for now. We need to find a
passage into the ruins and venture down to solve
the puzzle that awaits us.
translation:
Kum henuz anita ulasmadi, ama
yakinda ulasacak.
Angela, Duzen Maskesi'nin nerede olabilecegi konusunda cok kaygiliydi,
ama tesadufe bakin ki,
ben tam yerini biliyorum.
Kimsenin aklina bakmaya gelmeyecek kadar goz onunde bir yerde sakli.

Maske simdilik bekleyebilir.
Harabelere girecek bir gecit bulmali ve
bizi bekleyen bilmeceyi cozmek icin
asagi inmeli
ve yol almaliyiz.

original: A Gentleman's Agreement
translation: Bir Beyefendi Anlasmasi

original:
Dalston turned up, alarmed at the sand pouring into
the city, but there was no time to explain the
situation in detail.

Henry is in a terrible state now that he has learnt
of the Gentleman's true identity, and even Dalston
seems quite shaken by the news. The two have
temporarily set aside their differences and set off
together to catch Randall.
translation:
Dalston,
sehre dolan kumdan dehsete kapilmis halde cikageldi,
ama durumu ayrintisiyla aciklayacak vakit yoktu.

Beyefendi'nin gercek kimligini ogrendiginden beri Henry perisan bir halde
ve hatta Dalston bile bu haberle sarsilmis gorunuyor.
Ikisi aralarindaki
farkliliklari simdilik bir kenara birakip
Randall'i yakalamak icin
birlikte yola ciktilar.

original: Underground Descent
translation: Yeraltina Inis

original:
Behind the monument lay a manhole, which I
presume leads to the path the expedition team once
used to enter the ruins. If their records and the
city blueprints are anything to go by, Monte d'Or
lies directly over the Azran ruins, and this path will
take us to the heart of those ruins.

If we really have the true Mask of Chaos, I believe
we will finally come to the crux of the mystery
surrounding not just one mask, but both of them.
translation:
Anitin arkasinda bir rogar kapagi vardi;
sanirim kesif ekibinin bir zamanlar harabelere girmek icin kullandigi yola aciliyor.
Kayitlar ve sehir planlari dogruysa,
Monte d'Or dogrudan Azran harabelerinin ustunde duruyor
ve bu yol bizi
o harabelerin kalbine goturecek.

Gercek Kaos Maskesi elimizdeyse,
sanirim nihayet
yalnizca bir maskeyi degil, ikisini de
cevreleyen gizemin
ozune varacagiz.

original: The Two Masks
translation: Iki Maske

original:
In order to solve the final puzzle of the ruins,
two keys are required. Angela believed these were
two individual masks, the Mask of Chaos and the
Mask of Order, but I realise now there's more to it.
The mask Randall found in the ruins was real, but in
