18 years, he never discovered the secret it
concealed. All this time, order and chaos have
been two parts of the one whole.
translation:
Harabelerin son bilmecesini cozmek icin
iki anahtar gerekiyor.
Angela bunlarin iki ayri maske olduguna inaniyordu:
Kaos Maskesi ve Duzen Maskesi.
Ama simdi anliyorum ki mesele bundan ibaret degil.
Randall'in harabelerde buldugu maske gercekteydi, ama
18 yil boyunca icinde sakladigi sirri hic kesfedemedi.
Bunca zamandir,
duzen ve kaos tek bir butunun
iki parcasiymis.

original: Monte d'Or Rises
translation: Monte d'Or Yukseliyor

original:
It seems evident to me now that in their time, the
Azran most probably used the final chamber as a
control mechanism of sorts. Now the ruins are rising
from the earth, back to the position they occupied
many millennia ago. With barely any change to its
topography, the entire city of Monte d'Or now sits
above the sand, raised by the ruins it was built
upon. Whatever riches they may have contained,
the true treasure has always been the ruins
themselves.
translation:
Artik bana acik gorunuyor ki
Azranlar zamaninda son odayi
bir tur kontrol mekanizmasi olarak kullanmis olmali.
Simdi harabeler,
binlerce yil once bulunduklari konuma geri donerek
topraktan yukseliyor.
Arazi yapisinda neredeyse hicbir degisiklik olmadan,
tum Monte d'Or sehri simdi kumun ustunde duruyor;
ustune kuruldugu harabeler tarafindan yukseltildi.
Icinde ne tur hazineler barindirmis olurlarsa olsunlar,
asil hazine
hep harabelerin kendisiymis.

original: Randall Defeated
translation: Randall Yenildi

original:
Randall has changed over the past 18 years. Lost
and vulnerable, he had little choice but to believe
the scathing rumours he was told about Henry and
the fate of Stansbury, and his bitterness is
understandable.

I cannot lightly forgive his actions. However, I do
hope to bring him a little peace. Now that the city is
safe, I shall tell him all I know in the hope that I can
dispel his misconceptions once and for all.
translation:
Randall son 18 yilda degismis.
Kaybolmus ve savunmasiz haldeyken,
Henry ve Stansbury'nin akibeti hakkinda kendisine anlatilan acimasiz soylentilere inanmak disinda pek secenegi yoktu;
bu yuzden
kininin anlasilir tarafi var.

Yaptiklarini kolayca bagislayamam.
Yine de ona biraz olsun huzur getirmeyi umuyorum.
Sehir artik guvende olduguna gore,
bildigim her seyi ona anlatacagim;
umarim boylece
yanilgilarini
bir kez ve sonsuza dek dagitabilirim.

original: Descole's Objective
translation: Descole'un Amaci

original:
There was one key element that allowed me to
distinguish Angela from Descole: when Angela first
summoned me to Monte d'Or, she already had her
suspicions of who the Masked Gentleman really
was. But Descole, overlooking this vital detail,
impersonated an Angela who was intent on finding
the Mask of Order, with no thought of her past love.

It was Descole who orchestrated the whole thing,
manipulating Randall as he pleased to further his
own ends. But what exactly is he after?
translation:
Angela'yi Descole'den ayirmami saglayan tek bir kilit unsur vardi:
Angela beni Monte d'Or'a ilk cagirdiginda,
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin gercekte kim olduguna dair
zaten supheleri vardi.
Ama Descole bu hayati ayrintiyi gozden kacirarak,
gecmisteki askini hic dusunmeden
Duzen Maskesi'ni bulmaya odakli bir Angela kiligina girdi.

Butun duzeni kuran Descole'du;
Randall'i kendi cikarlari icin diledigince yonlendirdi.
Peki ama
tam olarak neyin pesinde?

original: The 18 Year Reunion
translation: 18 Yillik Bulusma

original:
One at a time, I exposed the lies that Randall has
been led to believe. I can only hope that he will
respond to the truth and to Henry, Angela and
Mrs Ascot's heartfelt emotions. To discover his
hometown and legacy abandoned and forgotten
must have been a tremendous shock. Still, recalling
how brave he was in our youth, I'm hopeful he'll be
able to start afresh. Henry never stopped searching
for his lost friend, and with a little luck, his
fondest wish may be granted.
translation:
Randall'a inandirilan yalanlari
teker teker ortaya doktum.
Tek umudum, gercege ve Henry, Angela ile
Bayan Ascot'un icten duygularina
karsilik verebilmesi.
Memleketini ve mirasini terk edilmis, unutulmus halde bulmak
muazzam bir sok olmaliydi.
Yine de gencligimizde ne kadar cesur oldugunu hatirlayinca,
yeniden baslayabilecegine dair umutluyum.
Henry kayip dostunu aramaktan hic vazgecmedi ve biraz sansla,
en buyuk dilegi
gerceklesebilir.

original: Monte d'Or, City of Miracles
translation: Monte d'Or, Mucizeler Sehri

original:
This time, I was able to save Randall. Not only from
the physical crevasse that opened up below us, but
also from the deep, emotional abyss into which he
plunged those 18 years ago. Monte d'Or truly is a
city of miracles, a place where friends are reunited,
no matter how great the gulf. Randall can bury the
years he has lost and begin his life afresh.

Once we're back in London, I look forward to writing
to my old friends in Monte d'Or. I owe them a great
deal, not least for introducing me to archaeology!
translation:
Bu kez Randall'i kurtarmayi basardim.
Sadece altimizda acilan fiziksel yariktan degil,
18 yil once dustugu
derin, duygusal ucurumdan da.
Monte d'Or gercekten bir mucizeler sehri;
dostlarin, aradaki ucurum ne kadar buyuk olursa olsun,
yeniden bulustugu bir yer.
Randall kaybettigi yillari geride birakip hayatina
yeniden baslayabilir.

Londra'ya dondugumuzde,
Monte d'Or'daki eski dostlarima yazmayi sabirsizlikla bekliyorum.
Bana cok sey borcluyum;
en basta da
beni arkeolojiyle tanistirdiklari icin!

original: Randall is a Pighead
translation: Randall Tam Bir Dangalak

original:
Randall bested me at fencing practice today, so it
looks as though I'll be joining him on his
{''}archaeological adventure{''}. I don't even like
archaeology and he knows it! I suppose he's just
so enthusiastic he thinks everyone else will love
archaeology in time, but I wish he'd give it a rest
now and then. Ah well, knowing me, I'll probably
just let myself get swept up in it, as always.
translation:
Bugun kilic antrenmaninda Randall beni yendi, bu yuzden
onun {''}arkeolojik macerasina{''} katilacak gibiyim.
Arkeolojiyi hic sevmiyorum ve o da bunu biliyor!
Sanirim o kadar hevesli ki, zamanla herkesin
arkeolojiyi sevecegini dusunuyor, ama keske ara sira
biraksa. Neyse, beni taniyorsun, her zamanki gibi
muhtemelen kendimi yine ona
kaptiracagim.

original: Class, as Always
translation: Ders, Her Zamanki Gibi

original:
Today's lesson was about the Azran civilisation.
I hadn't heard of it but, of course, Randall had -
I could tell from the smug look on his face! He was
so keyed up, he kept interrupting the class with
his questions. I think old Collins was a bit peeved.

Phew! What a tiring day. Don't I have anything
good to write about?
translation:
Bugunku ders Azran uygarligi hakkindaydi.
Ben hic duymamistim ama elbette Randall duymustu -
yuzundeki o kendini begenmis ifadeden anladim! O kadar
heyecanliydi ki, sorulariyla dersi surekli bolup durdu.
Sanirim ihtiyar Collins biraz sinirlendi.

Off! Ne yorucu bir gun. Yazacak guzel bir seyim
yok mu?

original: Enough with the Questions!
translation: Sorular Yeter!

original:
Mr Collins's lessons are usually quite enjoyable and
he's fairly laid back, for a teacher. So why does
Randall always have to stick his oar in and ask
really complicated questions? The rest of us have
to sit around like lemons and listen to him. I just
wish he'd be a bit less of a blockhead sometimes.

And we'll have to cut practice short this afternoon,
so it'll be next week before I can teach him a
lesson. Maybe I should race him home instead.
translation:
Bay Collins'in dersleri genelde oldukca keyiflidir ve
bir ogretmene gore epey rahattir. Peki neden
Randall hep araya girip
boyle karmasik sorular sormak zorunda? Geri kalanimiz
limon gibi oturup onu dinliyoruz. Keske
bazen biraz daha az budala olsa.

Ustelik bugun ogleden sonra antrenmani kisa kesmemiz gerekecek,
bu yuzden ona dersini vermem gelecek haftayi bulacak.
Belki de onunla eve kadar yarismaliyim.

original: Randall Time Begins at 8
translation: Randall'a Gore Zaman 8'de Baslar

original:
You know, even when Angela is around, Randall
never stops raving about archaeology. You'd think
he'd have other things to talk about with his
girlfriend! She doesn't seem to mind, though, and
I think she's even coming to Randall's {''}archaeology
seminar{''} this evening. To be honest I'd rather read
my book tonight, but since I lost that fencing bout,
I suppose I'm obliged to go. Anyway, I'm sure it
won't be so bad in the end. Right, enough diary for
now! I'd like to read a good chunk before I go to
Randall's.
translation:
Biliyor musun, Angela yanindayken bile Randall
arkeoloji diye sayiklamayi hic birakmiyor. Insan
kiz arkadasiyla konusacak baska seyleri olur sanir!
Ama Angela hic aldirmiyor gibi, hatta galiba bu aksam
Randall'in {''}arkeoloji
seminerine{''} bile gelecek. Acikcasi ben bu gece kitabimi okumayi
tercih ederdim, ama o kilic macini kaybettigim icin
sanirim gitmek zorundayim. Neyse, eminim sonunda
o kadar da kotu olmayacaktir. Tamam, simdilik gunluk
bu kadar! Randall'a gitmeden once
epeyce okumak istiyorum.

original: Ma is Such a Worrier!
translation: Anne Cok Kuruntulu!

original:
When I got home, Ma was in a bit of a tizz.
Apparently Pa went off with some strange men
dressed in black suits and hasn't been seen since.

She's probably making too much of it all, but it's
nearly dinner time, so I'd better go out and find Pa
in any case. If I go up towards Pebble Lane,
there's sure to be someone who's seen him go by.
translation:
Eve geldigimde anne biraz telasliydi.
Meger baba siyah takim elbiseli bazi tuhaf adamlarla
gitmis ve o zamandan beri kimse gormemis.

Muhtemelen fazla buyutuyor, ama neredeyse
aksam yemegi vakti, o yuzden her halukarda cikip
babayi bulsam iyi olacak. Pebble Lane tarafina gidersem,
onu giderken goren biri mutlaka vardir.

original: Pa Located
translation: Baba Bulundu

original:
After asking our neighbours without any real luck, I
finally tracked down Pa on the path to the forest.

He claims those men in black suits were old friends
of his, but it does seem a little odd... Apparently
they came to see Norwell, so he gave them the full
tour.

Anyway, I've been out quite a while now and Ma's
probably fretting, so we'd better hurry home.
translation:
Komsulara sorup da pek bir sey ogrenemeyince,
sonunda babayi ormana giden patikada buldum.

Siyah takim elbiseli adamlarin eski arkadaslari oldugunu
soyluyor ama yine de biraz tuhaf... Meger
Norwell'i gormek icin gelmisler, o da onlara
tam bir tur attirmis.

Her neyse, epey zamandir disaridayim ve anne
muhtemelen kaygilaniyordur, hemen eve donmeliyiz.

original: Off to Randall's House
translation: Randall'in Evine Dogru

original:
What with wandering round for ages looking for Pa,
the evening's just flown by.

Ma made a pretty good stew for dinner, but I didn't
even have time for a second helping since I have
to go to Randall's. I don't feel very comfortable
going to his house this late, especially when his
father's at home, but Randall insists it's fine. I'll
just have to make it quick.

I'd better get going!
translation:
Babayi bulmak icin saatlerce dolastigimdan,
aksam nasil gecti anlamadim.

Anne aksam yemegine cok guzel bir yahni yapti ama
Randall'a gitmem gerektigi icin ikinci porsiyona
vakit bulamadim. Bu saatte onun evine gitmek
pek icime sinmiyor, hele babasi evdeyken, ama
Randall sorun olmadigini soyluyor. Hizlica
gidip gelmem gerekecek.

Hadi cikayim artik!

original: Dalston's Out Late
translation: Dalston Gec Saatte Disarida

original:
I bumped into Dalston on the way to Randall's.
He's always acting too cool for school, but I can
tell he'd like to join our {''}kiddie adventures{''}, as
he calls them.

Apparently, he and Randall used to spend quite a
lot of time together back before I moved here.
Perhaps he's jealous of me or something.

Oh, and I saw Henry out shopping earlier. He has
it pretty hard, having to work all the time like that!
translation:
Randall'a giderken Dalston'la karsilastim.
Hep havali gorunmeye calisiyor ama
bizim {''}cocuk maceralarimiza{''},
kendi deyimiyle, katilmak istedigi belli.

Meger ben buraya tasinmadan once o ve Randall
epey vakit gecirirlermis.
Belki de bana falan kiskanclik yapiyordur.

Ha bir de, az once Henry'yi alisveriste gordum. Surekli
calismak zorunda olmasi onun icin epey zor!

original: Sneaking into Randall's
translation: Randall'in Evine Sizmak

original:
I met Angela on the way over the hill to Randall's
house. We went through our usual secret entrance
so as not to alert Randall's father. The last time we
tried using the front door, Mr Ascot gave Randall
extra study tasks for a week! As if we don't already
get enough homework at school.

Still, Henry always seems to be expecting us when
we arrive, so we're clearly not as cat-like as we'd
like to think.
translation:
Randall'in evine giden yokusta Angela'yla karsilastim.
Randall'in babasini uyarmamak icin her zamanki gizli giristen
gectik. En son on kapiyi kullanmaya kalktigimizda, Bay Ascot
Randall'a bir hafta boyunca ekstra calisma odevleri vermisti!
Sanki okulda zaten
yeterince odev almiyormusuz gibi.

Yine de Henry, vardigimizda bizi hep bekliyor gibi gorunuyor;
demek ki kendimizi sandigimiz kadar
kedi gibi sessiz sanmiyoruz.

original: Scrawl on the Wall
translation: Duvardaki Karalama

original:
The discovery Randall was so excited about turns
out to be the legendary Mask of Chaos, from
Donald Rutledge's {''}Ancient Histories{''}. Hah! So
the only reason he asked Mr Collins all that guff
about whether the mask existed or not was so he
could unveil it to us later! Ah, Randall, always the
show-off. I bet Mr Collins's face will be a picture!
Still, I'm not convinced the mask is even genuine,
though Randall is adamant. To prove his findings,
he unveiled a wall of his room, covered in rows and
rows of cryptic symbols.
translation:
Randall'in bu kadar heyecanlandigi kesif,
Donald Rutledge'in {''}Ancient Histories{''} kitabindaki
efsanevi Kaos Maskesi cikti. Hah! Demek
Bay Collins'e maskenin var olup olmadigiyla ilgili o kadar
sacma soru sormasinin tek sebebi, sonra onu
bize gostermekmis! Ah Randall, her zamanki gibi
gosteris meraklisi. Bahse girerim Bay Collins'in yuzu gorulmeye deger!
Yine de maskenin gercekten
orijinal olduguna pek inanmiyorum; Randall ise emin.
Bulduklarini kanitlamak icin,
odasinin bir duvarini acti; ustu sira sira gizemli sembollerle kapliydi.

original: To Norwell!
translation: Norwell'e!

original:
The rows of symbols that Randall revealed to us so
dramatically are apparently the secret message of
Norwell, which he has decrypted. How on earth did
Randall manage to decipher a text that defeated all
the archaeology experts?!

Anyway, it seems that it was thanks to the message
on the Norwell wall that Randall found the Mask of
Chaos. He says he'll explain more once we're
standing in front of the wall itself.
translation:
Randall'in bize boylesine dramatik bicimde gosterdigi o sembol siralari,
meger Norwell'in gizli mesajiymis; Randall da onu cozmus.
Randall,
butun arkeoloji uzmanlarini bile alt eden bir metni nasil oldu da
desifre edebildi?!

Her neyse, Kaos Maskesi'ni Randall'in Norwell duvarindaki
bu mesaj sayesinde buldugu anlasiliyor. Daha fazlasini,
duvarin tam onune
gelince anlatacagini soyluyor.

original: Norwell at Night
translation: Gece Norwell

original:
Going to Norwell at night is a bigger undertaking
than I thought. Maybe they don't expect visitors to
the wall at this hour, because the gate to the forest
was locked and there was no lighting on the path.
By moonlight, Norwell is quite an eerie place! That
huge wall looming over you, those strange archaic
symbols...

Has Randall really deciphered this message from
the distant past? I wonder what it says...
translation:
Gece Norwell'e gitmek sandigimdan daha buyuk bir ismis.
Bu saatte duvara ziyaretci beklemiyorlar herhalde; cunku ormana
acilan kapi kilitliydi ve patikada hic isik yoktu.
Ay isiginda Norwell gercekten urkutucu bir yer!
Uzerine coken o dev duvar,
o tuhaf, kadim
semboller...

Randall gercekten de uzak gecmisten gelen bu mesaji cozdu mu?
Acaba ne yaziyor...

original: Angela Runs Off
translation: Angela Kacip Gidiyor

original:
When Randall cracked the puzzle of Norwell, he
discovered that the wall is engraved with a set of
directions leading to a certain location. It was there
that he found the Mask of Chaos. He went on to
explain, in typical Randall style, that the mask is
the key to finding the legendary Akbadain ruins.

Apparently that was the last straw for Angela,
though: she snatched the mask from Randall's
hands and stormed off in a huff. I hope we can
find her!
translation:
Randall Norwell'in bilmecesini cozdugunde,
duvarin belli bir yere goturen bir dizi
yonlendirmeyle kazindigini fark etti.
Kaos Maskesi'ni de orada bulmus.
Sonra da, her zamanki Randall tavriyla, maskenin
efsanevi Akbadain harabelerini bulmanin anahtari oldugunu anlatti.

Belli ki Angela icin bu son damlaydi:
maskeyi Randall'in elinden kapip
ofkeyle uzaklasti.
Onu bulabilsek keske!

original: Angela's Tears
translation: Angela'nin Gozyaslari

original:
We found Angela sitting on Memory Knoll, hugging
the mask to her chest and sobbing. Randall's wild
talk about exploring the ruins had reminded her of
her older brother, who went missing on an
archaeological expedition. Still, neither Angela's
tears nor my arguments seem to have any impact
on Randall - he's just as determined as ever to go
exploring. With Henry's help, and a promise not to
do anything dangerous, he eventually convinced
Angela to let him go, but I'm not sure I'm happy
with all this.
translation:
Angela'yi Memory Knoll'da otururken bulduk; maskeyi gogsune
bastirmis, hickira hickira agliyordu. Randall'in
harabeleri kesfetmekle ilgili cilginca konusmalari ona
arkeolojik bir seferde kaybolan agabeyini hatirlatmis.
Yine de ne Angela'nin
gozyaslari ne de benim sozlerim Randall'i etkilemiyor -
kesfe cikmaya her zamanki kadar kararli.
Henry'nin yardimiyla ve tehlikeli bir sey yapmayacagina dair
soz vererek, sonunda Angela'yi
onu birakmaya ikna etti,
ama ben bu durumdan pek memnun degilim.

original: Before Setting Off...
translation: Yola Cikmadan Once...

original:
Now that he has Angela's consent, I don't think
anything is going to stop Randall from following
his foolhardy dreams of archaeological glory, and
I'm the muggins who has to accompany him. Well,
I suppose he needs somebody to be the voice of
reason, and poor Henry is tied up by his duties
at Ascot House.

Speaking of Henry, he made us an amazing cup of
tea when we got back from the Norwell wall. No
wonder Mr Ascot keeps him close!
translation:
Angela'nin iznini aldigina gore, Randall'i
arkeolojik san hayallerinin pesinden kosmaktan
artik hicbir sey durduramaz; yaninda giden de
bana kaldi. Sanirim
aklin sesi olacak birine ihtiyaci var, zavalli Henry ise
Ascot Evi'ndeki gorevleriyle
mesgul.

Madem Henry'den soz ettim, Norwell duvarindan dondugumuzde
bize muthis bir fincan cay yapti.
Bay Ascot'un onu yaninda tutmasina sasmamali!

original: Day of the Journey
translation: Yolculuk Gunu

original:
On the morning of our departure, Randall got Henry
to bring the horse and cart round to the front of the
house. He's making quite a pompous spectacle of
all this, considering we're meant to be sneaking off
in secret! Does he realise how much it cost me to
tiptoe out of the house without even a word to Ma?

Angela turned up unexpectedly just as we were
leaving and gave Randall a bit of a shock, but not
even she could slow him down now.
translation:
Yola cikacagimiz sabah Randall, Henry'ye
ati ve arabayi evin onune getirmesini soyledi.
Gizlice kacmamiz gerekirken
her seyi ne kadar da gorkemli bir gosteriye ceviriyor!
Anneye tek kelime etmeden evden sessizce cikmanin
bana neye mal oldugunu biliyor mu?

Tam ayrilirken Angela beklenmedik bir anda cikageldi ve
Randall'i biraz sasirtti ama
artik onu yavaslatmaya onun bile gucu yetmedi.

original: Finding a Forgotten Civilisation
translation: Unutulmus Bir Uygarligi Bulmak

original:
As Randall steered us relentlessly towards our
destination, it occurred to me that I'd never asked
exactly where the Akbadain ruins were.

Randall explained that his research pointed to a
place called Thornley's Gorge, deep within the
desert. Honestly, it looks like the middle of nowhere
on the map. I hope Randall is right about this!
translation:
Randall bizi amansizca hedefimize dogru surerken,
Akbadain harabelerinin tam olarak nerede oldugunu
hic sormadigimi fark ettim.

Randall, arastirmalarinin colde derinlerde
Thornley's Gorge adli bir yeri isaret ettigini anlatti.
Durust olmak gerekirse, haritada tam bir issizlik gibi gorunuyor.
Umarim Randall bu konuda haklidir!

original: Thornley's Gorge
translation: Thornley Kanyonu

original:
After hours of driving across the desert, we finally
reached Thornley's Gorge, where we hope to find
the Akbadain ruins.

We came to the edge of a gigantic, precipitous
ravine, but Randall was completely unfazed. I hope
he remembers his promise to Angela. That said, I
must admit I've grown rather curious about these
ancient ruins too, and I'd hate to have to turn back
now. Archaeology does have a powerful hold on the
imagination...
translation:
Colde saatlerce yol aldiktan sonra sonunda
Akbadain harabelerini bulmayi umdugumuz
Thornley Kanyonu'na ulastik.

Devasa, dik bir ucurumun kenarina geldik,
ama Randall hic aldirmadi. Umarim
Angela'ya verdigi sozu hatirlar. Yine de
itiraf etmeliyim ki ben de bu
kadim harabeleri oldukca merak etmeye basladim ve
simdi geri donmek zorunda kalmaktan nefret ederdim.
Arkeoloji, hayal gucunu gercekten de guclu bicimde yakaliyor...

original: Into the Akbadain Ruins!
translation: Akbadain Harabelerine!

original:
After a hairy descent into Thornley's Gorge, we
managed to locate the entrance to Akbadain. The
interior of the ruins seems solidly built, so at least
I'm not too worried about getting buried alive!

It's quite an intimidating place, but Randall's
confidence and good humour help to banish all my
worries. I do wonder how he expects us to explore
a structure of this size armed only with one measly
shovel, though.
translation:
Thornley Kanyonu'na zorlu bir inisin ardindan
Akbadain'in girisini bulmayi basardik. Harabelerin
ici saglam gorunuyor; en azindan
diri diri gomulmekten pek korkmuyorum!

Burasi oldukca goz korkutucu, ama Randall'in
kendine guveni ve iyi mizahi tum
endiselerimi dagitiyor. Yine de
yalnizca kucucuk bir kurekle bu kadar buyuk bir yapiyi
nasil kesfedecegimizi dusunuyorum.

original: The Bottomless Ruins
translation: Dipsiz Harabeler

original:
The ruins are full of obstacles and traps to
overcome, not to mention buried treasures. It's
almost as though they were made for Randall's
amusement. He certainly seems to think so!

The floor has given way in places, but so far we've
been able to bridge the gaps using large rocks.

With just the two of us, I always have to be the
responsible one, but in truth I'm rather enjoying
myself. Much as I hate to admit it...
translation:
Harabeler, ustesinden gelmemiz gereken engeller ve tuzaklarla dolu;
ustelik gomulu hazineler de cabasi. Sanki
Randall'i eglendirmek icin yapilmislar.
O da kesinlikle oyle dusunuyor!

Zemin yer yer cokmus, ama simdilik
bosluklari buyuk kayalarla kapatabildik.

Sadece ikimiz olunca hep sorumlu kisi ben olmak zorundayim,
ama aslinda epey egleniyorum.
Itiraf etmekten nefret etsem de...

original: Stout Defences
translation: Saglam Savunmalar

original:
Blimey! At first I was relieved when I saw how solidly
built this place was, but now I'm starting to wish it
were a bit more decayed; Akbadain's ancient
defences still appear to be in perfect working order.
We had a close call when a huge boulder crashed
towards us down a narrow corridor. I thought we
were done for! Randall is seemingly unperturbed.

We've got this far unscathed, but I dread to think
what might be waiting ahead. I'm glad Angela isn't
here to see this...
translation:
Vay canina! Basta buranin ne kadar saglam yapildigini gorunce
rahatlamistim, ama simdi biraz daha
harabeye donmus olmasini diliyorum; Akbadain'in kadim
savunmalari hala kusursuz calisiyor gibi.
Dar bir koridorda koca bir kaya uzerimize dogru yuvarlaninca
kil payi kurtulduk. Isimiz bitti sandim!
Randall ise sanki hic etkilenmedi.

Buraya kadar yara almadan geldik ama
ileride bizi neyin bekledigini dusunmek bile istemiyorum.
Angela'nin burada olmamasina seviniyorum...

original: How Much Further?
translation: Daha Ne Kadar?

original:
Randall and I are pushing on through the ruins,
somehow managing to evade all the pitfalls of this
place. We're four levels below ground now, but the
truth is we don't know how many levels there are.

Up till now, we've been able to use boulders to get
across gaps in the path, but I'm afraid that sooner
or later we'll stumble upon an obstacle we can't
overcome, and oddly enough, I'd be genuinely
disappointed if we had to turn back. I just hope
our luck holds!
translation:
Randall'la harabelerin icinde ilerlemeye devam ediyoruz,
bir sekilde buranin tum tuzaklarindan siyrilmayi basariyoruz.
Su an yerin dort kat altindayiz, ama
kac kat oldugunu aslinda bilmiyoruz.

Simdiye kadar yol uzerindeki bosluklari gecmek icin kayalari kullandik,
ama er ya da gec
asamayacagimiz bir engelle karsilasmaktan korkuyorum ve
isin garibi, geri donmek zorunda kalsak gercekten
hayal kirikligina ugrardim. Tek umudum
sansimizin surmesi!

original: Crystals, Bones... What Next?
translation: Kristaller, Kemikler... Sirada Ne Var?

original:
On the fifth level down, we found clusters of
beautiful crystals everywhere. Randall made me
shatter some of them with a boulder so we could
get by, but it seemed a great shame to destroy
such lovely wonders of nature. Ah well, I suppose
they often say that progress requires sacrifice.
Speaking of which, I think some previous visitors
were a lot less fortunate than us - we came upon
some human bones a little way back. Clearly, we
aren't really the first people to find these ruins.
I just hope we don't end up like them.
translation:
Besinci kata indigimizde, her yerde
guzel kristal kumeleri bulduk. Randall,
gecebilmemiz icin bazilarini bir kayayla
kirmami istedi, ama
doganin bu kadar guzel harikalarini yok etmek yazik gibi geldi.
Neyse, derler ya, ilerleme fedakarlik ister.
Madem oyle, sanirim bizden once gelen bazi ziyaretciler
bizim kadar sansli degildi - az once
biraz geride birkac insan kemigine rastladik.
Belli ki bu harabeleri bulan ilk kisiler biz degiliz.
Umarim onlarin sonuna benzemeyiz.

original: Separated from Randall!
translation: Randall'dan Ayrildim!

original:
We've had incredible luck most of the way, but
I knew it couldn't last forever. Randall and I got
separated. On the bright side, I can hear him
shouting instructions to me, which means he's not
hurt. It seems as if both our paths lead in the same
direction, so we're just hoping they will join up
again further on.

There's no time to go back to Stansbury to get
help. It's going to be harder without Randall, but
I must press on.
translation:
Yolun cogunda inanilmaz sansliydik, ama
bunun sonsuza dek surmeyecegini biliyordum. Randall'la
ayrildik. Iyi tarafindan bakarsak,
bana talimatlar bagirdigini duyabiliyorum; demek ki
yarali degil. Ikimizin yolu da
ayni yone gidiyor gibi,
bu yuzden ileride yeniden birlesmelerini umuyoruz.

Yardim almak icin Stansbury'ye donmeye zaman yok.
Randall olmadan daha zor olacak, ama
ilerlemek zorundayim.

original: Canals in the Depths
translation: Derinlerde Kanallar

original:
After crossing a complex of canals which brought us
back together again, Randall and I made our way
down to the seventh level of the ruins. Why did the
ancients build such a massive structure?
It strikes me that the air doesn't smell as musty as
I'd expect this far below ground, which suggests
there might be a tunnel to the surface near here.
Those giant spiders I ran into earlier must live off
something, I suppose. Maybe this place has a
unique ecosystem of its own? At any rate, we can't
turn back now!
translation:
Bizi yeniden bir araya getiren karmasik bir kanal agini gectikten sonra,
Randall'la harabelerin yedinci katina
indik. Kadimler neden
bu kadar devasa bir yapi insa etti?
Bu kadar yerin altinda olmasina ragmen havanin
bekledigim kadar kuf kokmamasi dikkatimi cekiyor; bu da
buralarda yuzeye cikan bir tunel olabilecegini dusunduruyor.
Az once karsilastigim o dev orumcekler
sonucta bir seylerle besleniyor olmali. Belki buranin
kendine ozgu bir ekosistemi vardir?
Her halukarda, artik geri donemeyiz!

original: Into the Abyss
translation: Ucuruma Dogru

original:
Eight levels underground, we reached the heart of
the ruins and gained a glimpse of the final door
separating us from the legacy of the Azran
civilisation... But we got careless.

Randall is gone. He fell into a bottomless ravine,
still gripping the infernal Mask of Chaos in his hand,
and I couldn't hold him. We were fools to think we
could conquer such ancient and powerful ruins with
nothing but a shovel and our reckless ambition. But
it's too late to realise this now. Far too late...
translation:
Yerin sekiz kat altinda, harabelerin kalbine ulastik ve
bizi Azran uygarliginin mirasindan
ayiran son kapiyi
uzaktan gorduk... Ama dikkatsiz davrandik.

Randall gitti. Kaos Maskesi'ni elinde siki siki tutarken
dipsiz bir ucuruma dustu ve
ben onu tutamadim. Sadece bir kurek ve
pervasiz hirsimizla boyle kadim ve guclu harabeleri
yenebilecegimizi sanmak aptallikti. Ama
bunu simdi anlamanin bir faydasi yok. Cok gec... Cok gec...

original: Last Steps
translation: Son Adimlar

original:
I can't just stand around here forever. I have to go
on, for Randall's sake. I have to finish what he
started, his dream of finding the ancestral treasure
of the Azran and returning victorious to Stansbury.

Victorious? Pah! How can I ever face Angela and
Henry again? And Randall's parents, what do I tell
them? If only I'd made Randall see reason, stopped
him from going on this stupid expedition...
translation:
Burada sonsuza dek oylece duramam. Randall icin
devam etmeliyim. Onun
baslattigi seyi bitirmeliyim; Azran'in ata mirasi hazinesini
bulup Stansbury'ye zaferle donme hayalini.

Zafer mi? Hah! Angela'nin ve
Henry'nin yuzune nasil bakacagim? Ya Randall'in ailesi, onlara
ne diyecegim? Keske Randall'a akliselim gosterip
onu bu aptal seferden vazgecirseydim...

original: Akbadain's Final Chamber
translation: Akbadain'in Son Odasi

original:
What I found in the last chamber of the ruins was a
pile of sparkling treasure, full of gold and gems,
and the peculiar symbol of the Azran that marks this
as their legacy.

I'm sure one could spend the rest of one's life in
idleness and luxury with such a mountain of wealth,
but what is that worth? Was it worth risking our
whole future for? Was it worth dying for?
translation:
Harabelerin son odasinda buldugum sey,
altin ve mucevherlerle dolu, isildayan bir hazine yiginiydi;
ayrica bunun Azran'in mirasi oldugunu gosteren
tuhaf Azran sembolu de vardi.

Bu kadar servetle insan omrunun geri kalanini
tembellik ve luks icinde gecirebilir elbette,
ama bunun degeri ne? Butun gelecegimizi riske atmaya
deger miydi? Bunun icin olmeye deger miydi?

original: After that Day
translation: O Gunden Sonra

original:
After I got back to Stansbury, I couldn't look Angela
or Henry in the eye. Racked with guilt, I holed
myself up at home. Ma and Pa came to meet me
when I arrived, gave me the hardest scolding of my
life, and then the warmest hug. I'm back at school
now, but everything there reminds me of Randall.
I feel as if there's a gaping hole in my chest.

They've sent a search party to look for Randall in
the ruins, but the ravine was so deep... Could
anyone survive a fall like that?
translation:
Stansbury'ye dondukten sonra Angela'nin
ya da Henry'nin gozlerinin icine bakamadim. Suclulukla
kivranarak eve kapandim. Eve vardigimda
anneyle baba beni karsilamaya geldi; hayatimin en sert
azariyla birlikte, ardindan en sicak sarilmayi da verdiler.
Simdi yeniden okuldayim ama oradaki her sey Randall'i hatirlatiyor.
Gogsumde kocaman bir bosluk varmis gibi hissediyorum.

Randall'i harabelerde aramak icin bir ekip gonderdiler, ama ucurum
o kadar derindi ki... Boyle bir dususten
kim sag cikabilir?

original: Leaving for London
translation: Londra'ya Gidis

original:
Everything has changed in Stansbury since that
day. The loss of one boy seems to have sapped
the life of the whole town. It feels empty, drained.
Henry was dismissed from the Ascot household,
and Angela has retreated into herself and never
leaves the house. I finished school and passed
the entrance exam to study archaeology at
Gressenheller. Randall always wanted me to share
his love of archaeology, and somehow it feels a
fitting way to honour him. Now, London awaits.
Goodbye, Stansbury. Goodbye, Randall...
translation:
O gunden beri Stansbury'de her sey degisti.
Tek bir cocugun kaybi sanki
butun kasabanin yasamini cekip almis. Her yer bos, solgun.
Henry Ascot ailesinin yanindan cikarildi,
Angela ise icine kapandi ve
evden hic cikmiyor. Okulu bitirdim ve
Gressenheller'da arkeoloji okumak icin
giris sinavini kazandim. Randall
hep arkeoloji sevgisini paylasmami isterdi ve bir sekilde bu,
onu onurlandirmanin uygun bir yolu gibi geliyor. Simdi Londra beni bekliyor.
Elveda, Stansbury. Elveda, Randall...

original: 説明文 前編
translation: Aciklama (1. Kisim)

original:
The professor's journal is a log of the
events that have transpired during your
investigation. Touch an entry to read it.
translation:
Profesorun gunlugu, sorusturma boyunca
yasanan olaylarin kaydini tutar.
Okumak icin bir kayda dokunun.

original: The Miracle of Monte d'Or
translation: Monte d'Or Mucizesi

original:
Prosperous Monte d'Or is famous for growing
from a single humble inn into a large and wealthy
city in the space of just 18 years. How could such
a city develop so fast?
translation:
Zengin Monte d'Or, buyuyup gelismesiyle unludur
tek bir mutevazi handan buyuk ve varlikli bir
sehre, sadece 18 yil icinde donusmesiyle. Boyle
bir sehir nasil bu kadar hizli gelisebilir?

original:
Some 18 years ago, Henry offered a hefty reward
for Randall's return, attracting entrepreneurs and
fortune-seekers from all parts to the Reunion Inn.
Many stayed and set up businesses, and the little
settlement grew into a full-blown city. Thus, it
could be said that Monte d'Or was built upon
Henry's devotion to his friend.
translation:
Yaklasik 18 yil once Henry, buyuk bir odul koydu
Randall'in geri donmesi icin; girisimcileri ve
sans avcilarini her yerden Reunion Inn'e cekti.
Pek cogu kalip is kurdu ve kucuk
yerlesim zamanla koca bir sehre donustu. Boylece
Monte d'Or'un,
Henry'nin arkadasina bagliligi uzerine kuruldugu soylenebilir.

original:
Monte d'Or is a huge city, which Henry Ledore
built from nothing in a mere 18 years. That's
quite an accomplishment!
translation:
Monte d'Or, Henry Ledore'un
hic yoktan yalnizca 18 yilda kurdugu dev bir sehir. Bu
gercekten buyuk bir basari!

original:
The gallery plaza in the centre of town was
built on top of an oasis. The city no doubt
developed around this water source.
translation:
Sehrin merkezindeki Galeri Meydani
bir vahanin uzerine insa edilmis. Sehir kuskusuz
bu su kaynaginin etrafinda gelisti.

original:
It seems that many of the former inhabitants
of Stansbury have moved to Monte d'Or. That
must also have boosted the population.
translation:
Gorunuse gore Stansbury'nin eski sakinlerinin
bircogu Monte d'Or'a tasinmis. Bu da
nufusu artirmis olmali.

original:
At first glance, the city seems to be thriving,
but some services have not kept up with the
rapid growth. The police force is one of them.
translation:
Ilk bakista sehir cok canli gorunuyor,
ama bazi hizmetler bu
hizli buyumeye ayak uyduramamis. Polis teskilati da bunlardan biri.

original:
Reunion Inn... It appears that the whole city of
Monte d'Or was built around the little inn that
Henry built in the desert.
translation:
Reunion Inn... Gorunuse gore
Monte d'Or'un tamami Henry'nin colde insa ettigi
kucuk hanin etrafinda kurulmus.

original:
The records left by the rescue team who
searched for Randall clearly indicate that
the Reunion Inn was their base of operations.
translation:
Randall'i arayan kurtarma ekibinin biraktigi kayitlar
acikca gosteriyor ki
Reunion Inn onlarin operasyon ussuymus.

original:
It seems that Monte d'Or owes its whole
existence to the prize money Henry offered
to find Randall.
translation:
Gorunuse gore Monte d'Or, varliginin tamamini
Henry'nin Randall'i bulmak icin koydugu odule
borclu.

original: The Petrification Miracle
translation: Tasa Donusme Mucizesi

original:
A number of people were turned to stone during
the parade on Celebration Boulevard. Some
members of the crowd appear to have witnessed
the petrification as it occurred. Was this really
some sort of miraculous act?
translation:
Kutlama Bulvari'ndaki gecit toreni sirasinda bazi insanlar
tasa donustu. Kalabaliktan bazi
kisiler, taslasmayi
oldugu anda gorduklerini soyluyor. Bu gercekten
bir tur mucize miydi?

original:
The petrification miracle was nothing but an
elaborate trick. The perpetrators created a
distraction while they placed stone statues all
around. With a few panicked shouts, they then
convinced the crowd that the statues were real
people turned to stone.
translation:
Tasa donusme mucizesi, yalnizca
ustaca hazirlanmis bir numaraydi. Suclular
tas heykelleri etrafa yerlestirirken
bir dikkat dagitma yaratti. Sonra birkac panik cigligiyla
kalabaligi, heykellerin
tasa donusmus gercek insanlar olduguna inandirdilar.

original:
The crowds deserted Celebration Boulevard,
leaving forlorn stone statues that were
seemingly living people just moments before...
translation:
Kalabalik Kutlama Bulvari'ni terk etti,
geride, az once canli insanlar gibi duran
kederli tas heykeller birakarak...

original:
The stone figures have now been cleared from
the street, but as far as I know, the petrified
victims have yet to be identified.
translation:
Tas figurler artik sokaktan kaldirildi,
ama bildigim kadariyla taslasan
kurbanlarin kimligi hala belirlenmedi.

original:
It seems the police were examining the trail left
by a horse-drawn cart in the street. Was it just
a part of the parade?
translation:
Polis, sokakta bir at arabasinin biraktigi izleri
inceliyor gibiydi. Bu sadece
gecit toreninin bir parcasi miydi?

original:
All the culprits had to do was place statues
then claim they'd watched them turn to stone.
This created panic among the crowd.
translation:
Suclularin tek yaptigi heykelleri yerlestirip
sonra da onlarin tasa donustugunu gorduklerini soylemekti.
Bu da kalabalikta panige yol acti.

original: The Mask of Chaos
translation: Kaos Maskesi

original:
It is said that the Mask of Chaos grants its wearer
tremendous magical power. Could this power be
behind the Masked Gentleman's so-called
miracles?
translation:
Kaos Maskesi'nin, takan kisiye
muazzam bir buyulu guc verdigi soylenir. Bu guc
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin sozde
mucizelerinin ardinda olabilir mi?

original:
Randall used the myth behind the Mask of Chaos
to convince everyone of its magical power. It was
a key part of his plan to take revenge on Henry
by destroying Monte d'Or.
translation:
Randall, Kaos Maskesi'nin ardindaki efsaneyi
herkesi onun buyulu gucune inandirmak icin kullandi. Bu,
Henry'den intikam almak icin planinin
Monte d'Or'u yok etme kisminda kilit bir parcaydi.

original:
It's odd. I always thought the mask's powers
were just part of the legend...
translation:
Tuhaf. Ben hep maskenin guclerinin
yalnizca efsanenin bir parcasi oldugunu sanirdim...

original:
The mask apparently allows the Masked
Gentleman to perform impossible feats. Can
a simple mask possess such a power?
translation:
Gorunuse gore maske, Maskeli
Beyefendi'nin imkansiz seyler yapmasina izin veriyor. Basit bir
maske boyle bir guce sahip olabilir mi?

original:
The Mask of Chaos was first studied by the
historian Donald Rutledge, but its purpose has
never been understood.
translation:
Kaos Maskesi ilk kez tarihci
Donald Rutledge tarafindan incelendi, ama amaci
hicbir zaman anlasilmadi.

original:
Only the Mask of Order can counter the power
of the Mask of Chaos, they say. That sounds
quite fantastical.
translation:
Dediklerine gore Kaos Maskesi'nin gucunu
yalnizca Duzen Maskesi dengeleyebilirmis. Bu
oldukca masalsi geliyor.

original:
When Randall first acquired the mask, he
thought it was the key to finding the ruins.
He believed it to be some sort of map.
translation:
Randall maskeyi ilk ele gecirdiginde
harabeleri bulmanin anahtari oldugunu dusundu.
Onun bir tur harita olduguna inaniyordu.

original:
When Randall fell and disappeared into the
Akbadain ruins, I am certain he was holding
the real mask in his hand.
translation:
Randall Akbadain harabelerine dusup
kayboldugunda, elinde
gercek maskeyi tuttugundan eminim.

original:
The Mask of Chaos, a mysterious and highly
evocative artefact, proved a valuable prop in
Randall's deception.
translation:
Kaos Maskesi, gizemli ve
son derece etkileyici bir eser olarak,
Randall'in aldatmacasinda degerli bir arac oldu.

original: The Masked Gentleman
translation: Maskeli Beyefendi

original:
A mysterious character calling himself the Masked
Gentleman is parading around town performing
ever more dramatic and miraculous feats. He
must have some agenda, but it's not clear what
he wishes to achieve.
translation:
Kendine Maskeli Beyefendi diyen gizemli biri,
sehirde dolasip giderek daha
dramatik ve mucizevi numaralar sergiliyor. Onun
bir amaci olmali, ama neye
ulasmak istedigi belli degil.

original:
The Masked Gentleman was revealed to be the
long-missing Randall. Enraged by his friend
Henry's apparent betrayal, he set about
frightening away the inhabitants of Monte d'Or
with his malevolent {''}miracles{''}.
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
uzun zamandir kayip olan Randall oldugu ortaya cikti. Arkadasi
Henry'nin gorunurdeki ihanetine ofkelenen Randall,
Monte d'Or sakinlerini
kotucul {''}mucizeleri{''} ile korkutup kacirmaya basladi.

original:
The Masked Gentleman appeared around a
month ago and started staging his unsettling
miracles. What is he after?
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi yaklasik
bir ay once ortaya cikti ve rahatsiz edici
mucizelerini sahnelemeye basladi. Ne pesinde?

original:
The Masked Gentleman is likely the one who
stole the Mask of Chaos from the Ledores'
study, but for what purpose?
translation:
Kaos Maskesi'ni Ledorelarin
calisma odasindan calanin Maskeli Beyefendi olmasi muhtemel,
ama hangi amacla?

original:
When the Masked Gentleman's letter of
warning was delivered to Dalston, a similar
letter was handed to me.
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin uyari mektubu
Dalston'a ulastirildiginda, ben de
benzer bir mektup aldim.

original:
The incidents so far indicate that he has a
number of accomplices. He must wield quite
some influence...
translation:
Simdiye kadarki olaylar onun
bircok suc ortagi oldugunu gosteriyor. Oldukca
buyuk bir nufuza sahip olmali...

original:
It seems that the Masked Gentleman harbours
a great deal of resentment towards Henry. But
why would that be?
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin Henry'ye
karsi buyuk bir kin besledigi anlasiliyor. Ama
neden?

original:
Randall assumed the role of a masked villain
and engineered this whole masquerade just to
get back at Henry...
translation:
Randall, maskeli bir kotu adam rolune burunup
bu butun maskeli oyunu
sirf Henry'den oc almak icin kurguladi...

original: Traces of Another Civilisation
translation: Baska Bir Uygarliktan Izler

original:
Although Monte d'Or is a new city, built in the
latest architectural fashion, traces can be found
here and there of a very ancient civilisation.
Where do these come from, and what could it
mean?
translation:
Monte d'Or yeni bir sehir ve en
son mimari tarzla insa edilmis olsa da, burada burada
cok eski bir uygarligin izlerine rastlaniyor.
Bunlar nereden geliyor ve bu
ne anlama gelebilir?

original:
Directly below Monte d'Or lay the heart of the
ancient ruins of Akbadain, a vestige of the once
great Azran civilisation. The remnants found
above ground were just a small part of that
vast structure.
translation:
Monte d'Or'un tam altinda, eski
Akbadain harabelerinin kalbi yatiyor; bunlar bir zamanlarin
buyuk Azran uygarligindan kalma izler. Yeryuzunde bulunan kalintilar,
o dev yapinin
yalnizca kucuk bir parcasiydi.

original:
This area of desert is known to be the site of
various ancient ruins. Monte d'Or must also
have its share of relics.
translation:
Bu col bolgesi, cesitli
antik harabelerin bulundugu yer olarak bilinir. Monte d'Or da
kendi payina dusen kalintilara sahip olmali.

original:
This town first grew around an oasis, but
nowadays, the gallery plaza is considered to
be the centre of Monte d'Or.
translation:
Bu kasaba once bir vahanin etrafinda buyudu, ama
gunumuzde Galeri Meydani
Monte d'Or'un merkezi sayiliyor.

original:
Hannibal seems to believe that there is
something of importance underneath the city.
translation:
Hannibal, sehrin altinda
onemli bir sey olduguna inaniyor.

original:
Among the Reunion Inn's records, we found
the original plans of Monte d'Or. The town
layout was rigidly planned.
translation:
Reunion Inn'in kayitlari arasinda
Monte d'Or'un orijinal planlarini bulduk. Sehir
duzeni kati bir sekilde planlanmis.

original:
There should be an entrance that leads below
ground near the monument. This is surely the
key to the city's very existence.
translation:
Anitin yakininda yer altina
inen bir giris olmali. Bu, kuskusuz
sehrin varliginin anahtari.

original:
Even I had no idea that Monte d'Or was built
over the Akbadain ruins. It was quite an
astounding discovery!
translation:
Monte d'Or'un Akbadain harabelerinin
uzerine kuruldugunu ben bile bilmiyordum. Bu gercekten
sasirtici bir kesifti!

original: The Mask of Order
translation: Duzen Maskesi

original:
Donald Rutledge's {''}Ancient Histories{''} tells of
a Mask of Order, a counterpart to the Mask of
Chaos that can negate its power. This mask could
be the key to stopping the Masked Gentleman,
but how to find it?
translation:
Donald Rutledge'in {''}Antik Tarihler{''} adli eseri,
Kaos Maskesi'nin karsiti olan
ve gucunu etkisiz kilabilen bir Duzen Maskesi'nden bahseder. Bu maske
Maskeli Beyefendi'yi durdurmanin anahtari olabilir,
ama onu nasil bulacagiz?

original:
The Mask of Order and the Mask of Chaos are in
fact two halves of the same artefact, which can
be separated at will. Far from counteracting each
other, they gain power only when used together.
translation:
Duzen Maskesi ile Kaos Maskesi aslinda
ayni eserin iki yarisidir ve
istenildiginde birbirinden ayrilabilir. Birbirlerini etkisiz kilmak bir yana,
yalnizca birlikte kullanildiklarinda guc kazanirlar.

original:
I have my doubts about the Mask of Chaos and
its special powers, so a mask that can counter
it? Dubious...
translation:
Kaos Maskesi ve
ozel gucleri konusunda suphelerim var; onu dengeleyebilen bir maske mi?
Supheli...

original:
Randall said he had failed to find the twin to
the Mask of Chaos. He must have meant the
Mask of Order...
translation:
Randall, Kaos Maskesi'nin ikizini
bulamadigini soylemisti. Demek ki
Duzen Maskesi'ni kastediyordu...

original:
Angela is very concerned with finding this Mask
of Order, but Henry seems to know nothing
about it... Odd.
translation:
Angela bu Duzen Maskesi'ni bulmak konusunda
cok endiseli, ama Henry sanki hicbir sey
bilmiyormus gibi... Tuhaf.

original:
Detective Bloom also believes that this mask
is important to the case. It is certainly an
artefact worthy of attention.
translation:
Dedektif Bloom da bu maskenin
olay icin onemli olduguna inaniyor. Gercekten de
dikkate deger bir eser.

original:
The masks were never two separate entities,
but one and the same. They belonged together
from the start.
The Levitation Miracle
translation: Havalanma Mucizesi

original:
After apparently walking on thin air, the Masked
Gentleman lifted onlookers into the air before
making them vanish altogether. What tricks did he
resort to in order to pull off this {''}miracle{''}?
translation:
Sanki havada yurumus gibi gorunen Maskeli
Beyefendi, izleyicileri havaya kaldirdi ve sonra
onlari tamamen ortadan kaybetti. Bu {''}mucizeyi{''}
yapmak icin hangi hilelere basvurdu?

original:
To create the illusion of walking in mid-air, the
Masked Gentleman used wires strung between
the gallery and the marquee. His {''}victims{''} were
simply accomplices who were lifted up by
balloon-like devices and then cloaked in black
cloth.
translation:
Havada yuruyormus yanilsamasini yaratmak icin
Maskeli Beyefendi, galeri ile cadir arasinda
gerilmis teller kullandi. {''}Kurbanlari{''} ise
aslinda, balon benzeri duzeneklerle
yukari kaldirilan suc ortaklariydi; ardindan siyah
bezle ortulduler.

original:
Those people appeared to be simply swallowed
up into the night sky... There must be some
sort of trick to it.
translation:
O insanlar sanki
gece gokyuzu tarafindan yutulmus gibiydi... Bunun
bir hilesi olmali.

original:
All the incidents so far have involved a fair
number of accomplices. This one is surely no
different.
translation:
Simdiye kadarki tum olaylarda epey
cok suc ortagi vardi. Bu da
farkli degildir.

original:
After the event, it seems some black cloth was
found in the gallery plaza. This must be
significant in some way...
translation:
Olaydan sonra Galeri Meydani'nda
bir miktar siyah bez bulundugu soyleniyor. Bu,
bir sekilde onemli olmali...

original:
This was no miracle - the Masked Gentleman
had his henchmen mingle in with the crowd
and then gave the signal.
translation:
Bu bir mucize degildi - Maskeli Beyefendi
adamlarina kalabaliga karismalarini sagladi
ve sonra isareti verdi.

original: Henry's Suspicious Behaviour
translation: Henry'nin Supheli Davranislari

original:
Henry is clearly hiding something, which he
cannot or will not speak about. What could his
secret be?
translation:
Henry acikca bir sey sakliyor; bunu
anlatamiyor ya da anlatmak istemiyor. Sirri
ne olabilir?

original:
Henry's devotion to maintaining and expanding
his estate in Monte d'Or lay in his desire to have
everything perfect for Randall's eventual return.
translation:
Henry'nin Monte d'Or'daki malikanesini
koruma ve genisletme cabasi, Randall'in bir gun geri donusu icin
her seyin kusursuz olmasini istemesinden kaynaklaniyordu.

original:
Why does Henry continue to pour money into
Monte d'Or, knowing the Masked Gentleman
might strike at any time?
translation:
Henry, Maskeli Beyefendi'nin her an
saldirabilecegini bile bile, neden
Monte d'Or'a para akitmaya devam ediyor?

original:
Despite turning a cold shoulder on us initially,
Henry joined us in Tingly Town and seemed
willing to offer his help.
translation:
Basta bize soguk davransa da,
Henry Tingly Town'da bize katildi ve
yardim etmeye istekli gorunuyordu.

original:
Somewhere behind Tingly Town is a complete
and exact copy of the park. Who could build
such a thing?
translation:
Tingly Town'in arkasinda, parkin
tam ve birebir bir kopyasi var. Bunu
kim insa etmis olabilir?

original:
Ludmilla, from the costume shop, seems to
believe that Henry's secret has nothing to do
with the Masked Gentleman...
translation:
Kostum dukkanindan Ludmilla,
Henry'nin sirrinin Maskeli Beyefendi ile
hic ilgisi olmadigina inaniyor...

original:
In Henry's study, we met Mrs Ascot, whom I
previously believed to be dead. It seems she
lives with the Ledores.
translation:
Henry'nin calisma odasinda, daha once oldugunu sandigim
Bayan Ascot ile karsilastik. Gorunuse gore
Ledorelarla yasiyor.

original:
Henry built the Reunion Inn to welcome Randall
home. He even recreated part of Randall's old
bedroom.
translation:
Henry, Randall'i eve hos geldin diye karsilamak icin
Reunion Inn'i insa etti. Hatta Randall'in eski
yatak odasinin bir kismini bile yeniden yapti.

original:
Henry truly believed that Randall would return
and wanted nothing more than to safeguard
everything that he cared for.
translation:
Henry, Randall'in geri donecegine gercekten inaniyordu
ve en cok da
deger verdigi her seyi korumak istiyordu.

original: Angela's Suspicious Behaviour
translation: Angela'nin Supheli Davranislari

original:
Angela has been acting strangely and she may
be hiding something. Could her odd behaviour
be somehow related to the Masked Gentleman?
translation:
Angela garip davraniyor ve
bir sey sakliyor olabilir. Bu tuhaf davranislari
Maskeli Beyefendi ile bir sekilde baglantili olabilir mi?

original:
At some point, Angela was replaced by Descole
in disguise. Taking over her identity almost
seamlessly, he hoped to manipulate Henry into
revealing the Mask of Order.
translation:
Bir noktada Angela'nin yerine, kilik degistirmis Descole gecti.
Onun kimligini neredeyse kusursuz bir sekilde
ustlenerek Henry'yi
Duzen Maskesi'ni ortaya cikarmaya zorlamayi umdu.

original:
It has certainly been many years since I knew
Angela at school. I confess she seems quite a
changed person.
translation:
Angela'yi okuldan taniyali
uzun yillar oldu. Itiraf etmeliyim, oldukca
degismis gorunuyor.

original:
Angela believes that the Mask of Order could
be used to stop the Masked Gentleman and
has told Henry about it.
translation:
Angela, Duzen Maskesi'nin
Maskeli Beyefendi'yi durdurmak icin kullanilabilecegine inaniyor
ve bunu Henry'ye soyledi.

original:
I noticed that Angela has lost her once
treasured necklace, but she seems oddly
indifferent about it...
translation:
Angela'nin bir zamanlar
cok deger verdigi kolyesini kaybettigini fark ettim, ama garip bir sekilde
umursamaz gorunuyor...

original:
The Mask of Chaos, which Angela claimed was
stolen from her house, has turned up in the
records room at the Reunion Inn...
translation:
Angela'nin evinden calindigini soyledigi
Kaos Maskesi, Reunion Inn'deki
kayit odasinda ortaya cikti...

original:
Angela must have been terrified by the city
sinking into the sand - she seemed desperate
to get Henry to use the Mask of Order.
translation:
Angela, sehrin kumlara gomulmesinden
cok korkmus olmali; Henry'nin
Duzen Maskesi'ni kullanmasini saglamak icin caresiz gorunuyordu.

original:
Descole was clever, but he failed to
understand the real nature of Henry and
Angela's relationship.
translation:
Descole zekiydi, ama
Henry ile Angela'nin iliskisinin gercek
dogasini anlamayi basaramadi.

original: The Vanishing Miracle
translation: Yok Olma Mucizesi

original:
The crowds of visitors in Tingly Town vanished
all of a sudden, then reappeared minutes later,
apparently oblivious to the whole thing. What
could have happened to all those people in
the meantime?
translation:
Tingly Town'daki ziyaretci kalabaligi
bir anda yok oldu, sonra birkac dakika sonra
hicbir sey olmamis gibi geri belirdi. Bu insanlar
bu sirada
nereye gitmis olabilir?

original:
The Masked Gentleman used the darkness in
Tingly Tower and a rotating floor mechanism
to disorientate Layton and the others. He led
them into an exact, but empty, replica of the
funfair to make them think the crowd had
vanished.
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi, Tingly Tower'daki karanligi
ve doner bir zemin mekanizmasini
Layton ile digerlerini sasirtmak icin kullandi. Onlari
eglence parkinin birebir ama bos bir kopyasina
goturerek kalabaligin
yok oldugunu sanmalarini sagladi.

original:
That the bustling crowds at the funfair should
all suddenly leave seems...highly unlikely, to
say the least.
translation:
Lunaparktaki hareketli kalabaligin
hepsinin birden gitmesi... en hafif tabirle
pek olasi gorunmuyor.

original:
When we trailed the Masked Gentleman back
through the tower, the crowds at the funfair
were all back again. But how?
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin pesinden kuleye
geri dondugumuzde, lunaparktaki kalabalik
yeniden oradaydi. Peki nasil?

original:
{''}Left in the dark{''}... That is without doubt
an important clue to uncovering the truth
behind this miracle.
translation:
{''}Karanlikta birakilmak{''}... Bu, kuskusuz
bu mucizenin ardindaki gercegi ortaya cikarmak icin
onemli bir ipucu.

original:
It's interesting to note that Tingly Tower is a
perfectly symmetrical building. It looks exactly
the same from every side.
translation:
Tingly Tower'in
tamamen simetrik bir yapi olmasi ilginc. Her
taraftan tam olarak ayni gorunuyor.

original:
The concept was as simple as the execution
was extravagant. The Masked Gentleman will
go to any lengths!
translation:
Fikir ne kadar basitse uygulamasi da
o kadar gosterisliydi. Maskeli Beyefendi
hedefi icin her seyi yapabilir!

original:
Let's review the major mysteries
in our story.

Touch a mystery for more details.
translation:
Hikayemizdeki baslica gizemleri
gozden gecirelim.

Daha fazla bilgi icin bir gizeme dokunun.

original: Profiles
translation: Profiller

original:
Read about the various characters
you meet in the game. You may even
find exclusive information here...
translation:
Oyunda karsilastigin cesitli karakterler
hakkinda oku. Burada hatta
ozel bilgiler bile bulabilirsin...

original: Layton
translation: Layton

original:
The perfect gentleman,
Hershel Layton's main
passions are solving
puzzles and enjoying
a nice cup of tea. The
daring escapades of his
best friend Randall led
him to become the highly
regarded archaeology
professor he is today.
Though, even he admits
he's a tad disorganised.
translation:
Mukemmel bir beyefendi,
Hershel Layton'in baslica
tutkulari bulmacalar
cozmek ve guzel bir
fincan cayin tadini
cikarmaktir. En yakin
arkadasi Randall'in
cesur maceralari onu
bugun herkesin saygi
duydugu arkeoloji
profesoru yapti. Yine de
biraz daginik oldugunu soyler.

original: Luke
translation: Luke

original:
The professor's self-
proclaimed apprentice,
Luke is a very bright
boy with puzzle-solving
skills that rival an
adult's, and his ability
to talk to animals has
helped others out of a
pinch on numerous
occasions. But with only
11 years behind him, he
still has much to learn.
translation:
Profesorun kendi-
kendine ilan ettigi
ciragi Luke, bulmaca
cozme becerileriyle
bir yetiskine bile
rakip olacak kadar
zeki bir cocuktur.
Hayvanlarla konusmasi
pek cok kez baskalarini
zor durumdan kurtardi.
Ama daha 11 yasinda;
hala ogrenecegi cok sey var.

original: Emmy
translation: Emmy

original:
Layton's assistant Emmy
is a bright and vivacious
girl who boasts excellent
martial arts skills to
complement Layton's
sharp intellect. With her
trusty camera at hand,
she's always prepared to
rush in headfirst, but
despite her tomboyish
nature, she harbours an
unseen delicate side.
translation:
Layton'in asistani Emmy
neseli ve canli
bir genc kizdir; ustun
dovus sanatlariyla
Layton'in keskin
zekasini tamamlar. Guvenilir
fotograf makinesi elinde,
her zaman ilk atilmaya
hazirdir; ama
erkek fatma tavrina
ragmen icinde
gizli, narin bir yani vardir.

original: Descole
translation: Descole

original:
A man who would drag
someone into the heart
of darkness to achieve
his own ends, Descole is
a cold-hearted scientist
who remorselessly
manipulates people like
puppets. He holds a
vested interest in
archaeology and had
Randall perform a myriad
of miracles for him.
translation:
Kendi amaclari icin
birini karanligin
ta icine surukleyebilecek
Descole, kalpsiz
bir bilim insanidir ve
insanlari acimasizca
kukla gibi
kullanir. Arkeolojiye
ozel bir ilgisi vardir ve
Randall'a sayisiz
mucize yaptirip
durmustur.

original: Grosky
translation: Grosky

original:
Scotland Yard's hot-
blooded ace inspector
not only sports bulging
muscles and a dashing
pompadour but also
tackles investigations
with everything he's got,
even if that's often a tad
more than is needed. His
best-kept secret is that
he has a lovely estranged
wife.
translation:
Scotland Yard'in atesli
basmufettisi Grosky,
sadece kabarik
kaslari ve havali
sac modeliyle degil,
sorusturmalara da
tum gucuyle
dalmasiyla unludur-
bazen gereginden
fazla olsa bile. En buyuk
sirri ise, ayri yasadigi
cok sevimli bir esinin olmasidir.

original: Granny Riddleton
translation: Nine Riddleton

original:
A clairvoyant who goes by
the name of Elizabeth, this
mystery lady stores all the
puzzles Layton and his
companions miss on the
way. She bears a striking
resemblance to someone,
but who? Her mask is said
to hide a stunningly
attractive face, but none
can confirm or deny this.
translation:
Elizabeth adiyla anilan
bir kahin olan bu
gizemli hanim, Layton ve
arkadaslarinin yolda
kacirdigi tum
bulmacalari saklar.
Birine cok benzer,
ama kime? Maskesinin
ardinda buyuleyici derecede
guzel bir yuz sakladigi
soylenir, ama kimse emin degildir.

original: Roland
translation: Roland

original:
Layton's father nurtures
a warm, thick beard that
befits his generous
hospitality. This quiet,
discerning gentleman
secretly pines for
adventure and even
solved a couple of cases
of his own back in the
day. He'd have been his
son's age, in fact...
translation:
Layton'in babasi,
comert misafirperverligine
yakisan sicak ve
gur bir sakal tasir.
Sessiz, ince eleyip
sik dokuyan bu beyefendi
icten ice macera
ozlemi ceker ve
vaktiyle kendi basina
birkac olayi bile
cozmustur. Hatta o zamanlar oglunun yasindaydi...

original: Lucille
translation: Lucille

original:
A kind and spritely lady,
Lucille is both a caring
mother to Layton and an
excellent chef, as the
whole village can attest.
She takes pride in keeping
the house neat and tidy,
and is all too used to
collecting books, laundry
and tea cups from under
Hershel's bed.
translation:
Nazik ve dinc bir hanim
olan Lucille, Layton'a
sefkatli bir anne ve
tum koyun onaylayacagi
kadar da iyi bir ascidir.
Evi derli toplu
tutmakla gurur duyar
ve Hershel'in yataginin
altindan kitaplar,
camasirlar ve cay
fincanlari toplamak ona yabanci degildir.

original: Masked Gentleman
translation: Maskeli Beyefendi

original:
The mysterious man who
one day appeared in
Monte d'Or performing all
sorts of miracles. His
feats were so astounding
they beggared belief,
but Layton saw through
the elaborate tricks this
cunning thespian staged.
The real wonder is how he
could bear to wear that
mask for so long!
translation:
Bir gun Monte d'Or'da
ortaya cikip turlu
mucizeler sergileyen
gizemli adam. Yaptiklari
o kadar akil almazdi ki
inanmak zordu,
ama Layton bu kurnaz
oyuncunun kurdugu
karmasik numaralarin
ardini gordu. Asil
mucize, bu maskeyi
bu kadar uzun sure nasil takabildigi!

original: Randall
translation: Randall

original:
The true identity of the
Masked Gentleman was
none other than Layton's
old friend Randall,
mistakenly incensed with
revenge after finding his
legacy and his dearest
stolen away by his best
friend. Despite this, his
lovable character stayed
the same and his friends
never really left his side.
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
gercek kimligi,
Layton'in eski dostu
Randall'dan baskasi
degildi. Mirasinin ve
en sevdiklerinin en iyi
arkadasi tarafindan
elinden alindigini sanip
intikamla yanip tutustu.
Buna ragmen sevecen
kisiligi degismedi ve
dostlari onu hic yalniz birakmadi.

original: Henry
translation: Henry

original:
As the founder of
Monte d'Or, Henry poured
his newly gained fortune
into his city's growth
whilst never forgetting
the kindness Randall
showed him. In fact, he
had faithfully awaited
his friend's return the
whole time. He treasures
the toy robot Randall
gave him to this day.
translation:
Monte d'Or'un kurucusu
Henry, yeni kazandigi
serveti sehrin gelisimine
harcarken Randall'in ona
gosterdigi iyiligi hic
unutmadi. Hatta
basindan beri
dostunun donusunu
sadakatle bekledi.
Randall'in ona verdigi
oyuncak robota bugun bile
goz gibi bakar.

original: Angela
translation: Angela

original:
Angela is Henry's wife in
writing only - the truth
is that she, like Henry,
had also been waiting
for Randall's return,
treasuring the pendant
he gave her all the while.
She had a hunch who the
man behind the mask
really was and sought
help from Layton to
confirm her suspicions.
translation:
Angela kagit ustunde
Henry'nin esidir; aslinda
o da Henry gibi
Randall'in donusunu
beklemistir ve onun
kendisine verdigi kolyeyi
hep saklamistir.
Maskenin ardindaki
adamin kim oldugunu
sezmisti ve suphelerini
dogrulatmak icin Layton'dan
yardim istedi.

original: Dalston
translation: Dalston

original:
A Monte d'Or tycoon,
Dalston is a tender animal
lover at heart, but his
difficulty in expressing
himself openly often has
him unfairly judged as an
unfeeling money grabber.
His dream of having a
hotel of his own fulfilled,
he will be proud of the life
he has lived when he's
old and grey.
translation:
Monte d'Or'un zenginlerinden
Dalston, ozunde
yumusak kalpli bir
hayvanseverdir; ama
duygularini acikca
ifade edememesi yuzunden
cogu kez vicdansiz bir
para avcisi sanilir.
Kendi oteline sahip olma
hayalini gerceklestirdigine
gore, yaslanip
ak sacli oldugunda yasadigi hayata gururla bakacak.

original: Young Layton
translation: Genc Layton

original:
Pampered and adored by
the people of Stansbury,
the earnest 17-year-old
Layton is a bookworm
and a keen fencer. His
archaeological interest
at this stage of his life
is somewhat lacking,
though it's clear that he
doesn't entirely dislike
being dragged from pillar
to post by Randall.
translation:
Stansbury halkinin
simartip sevdigi
samimi 17 yasindaki
Layton tam bir kitap
kurdudur ve iyi bir
eskrimcidir. Bu
donemde arkeolojiye
ilgisi pek guclu degildir,
ama Randall'in onu oradan
oraya suruklemesinden
tamamen hoslanmadigi da
soylenemez.

original: Young Randall
translation: Genc Randall

original:
At 17 years, Randall is
equally ardent in his
passion for his girlfriend
Angela and for exploring
ruins. He'll get almost
everyone wrapped up in
his plans, but most take
this as a sign of his
friendship. Despite his
excellent eyesight, he
wears glasses to mimic
a famous archaeologist.
translation:
17 yasindaki Randall,
hem sevgilisi Angela'ya
hem de harabeleri
kesfetmeye ayni
derecede tutkuludur.
Planlarina neredeyse
herkesi dahil eder, ama
cogu bunu dostlugunun
bir gostergesi sayar.
Gorusu cok iyi olmasina
ragmen, unlu bir
arkeologu taklit etmek icin gozluk takar.

original: Young Henry
translation: Genc Henry

original:
A diligent and dutiful
individual, Henry recently
began special training as
the Ascots' butler. Many
of his tasks are menial,
yet he easily possesses
the mental aptitude to
solve the riddle of Norwell.
He has feelings for
Angela, but values his
friendship with Randall
more.
translation:
Caliskan ve gorev
bilinci yuksek Henry,
yakin zamanda Ascotlarin
usagi olmak icin ozel
egitime basladi. Islerinin
cogu angaryadir,
ama Norwell bilmecesini
cozecek zekaya fazlasiyla
sahiptir. Angela'ya karsi
hisleri vardir, fakat
Randall'la dostlugunu
daha cok onemser.

original: Young Angela
translation: Genc Angela

original:
Angela in her teenage
years is an intelligent
girl who manages to be
bubbly, graceful and
charming all at once. She
lost her brother in a
freak excavation accident,
which is why she's so
opposed to Randall's
spontaneous decisions to
go in search of adventure.
translation:
Genclik yillarindaki
Angela zeki bir
kizdir; ayni anda
neseli, zarif ve
cekici olmayi basarir.
Kardesini talihsiz bir
kazi kazasinda kaybettigi
icin Randall'in
birdenbire macera
pesine dusme
kararlarina siddetle karsi cikar.

original: Young Dalston
translation: Genc Dalston

original:
As the rebel of the pack,
Dalston often speaks his
mind and tends to give
a bad first impression,
but he would never hurt
a fly. Rather than inherit
his father's household,
he aspires to become an
astute businessman with
his own hotel. His stern
and rugged face reflects
his no-nonsense manner.
translation:
Grubun asi cocugu
Dalston cogu zaman
aklindan geceni soyler
ve kotu bir ilk izlenim
birakir, ama sinege bile
zarar vermez. Babasinin
isini devralmak yerine,
kendi oteli olan
kurnaz bir is insani
olmayi ister. Sert
ve koseli yuzu, onun
lafi dolandirmayan tavrini yansitir.

original: Bloom
translation: Bloom

original:
Detective Bloom is a
young prodigy sent by
Scotland Yard. Though
he seemed to be aiding
the investigation, his
true purpose was to have
Layton lead him to the
Mask of Order. He follows
his orders unwaveringly,
no matter the deed.
translation:
Dedektif Bloom,
Scotland Yard tarafindan
gonderilen genc bir
dahidir. Sorusturmaya
yardim ediyor gibi
gorunse de asil amaci
Layton'in onu Duzen
Maskesi'ne goturmesiydi.
Ne olursa olsun,
emirlere asla karsi gelmez.

original: Sheffield
translation: Sheffield

original:
The hard-hitting chief
inspector of Monte d'Or
commands respect with
an iron fist and an
incredibly chiselled jaw.
Sheffield's ready to come
down on crime like a ton
of bricks, and his men
love this belligerence.
Unfortunately, the latest
case has him stumped.
translation:
Monte d'Or'un sert
basmufettisi Sheffield,
demir yumrukla ve
inanilmaz keskin cenesiyle
saygi toplar. Suca
tonlarca tugla gibi
inmeye hazirdir ve
adamlari bu hircinligini
sever. Ne yazik ki
son vaka onu
caresiz birakmistir.

original: Alderman
translation: Belediye Baskani

original:
The nice but dim Mayor
Williams is an endearing
figure to the people of
Monte d'Or. When excited
he gesticulates wildly
and can't help prying into
other people's affairs to
know all the juicy details.
Although he means no
harm by it, he still
manages to rub a few
people up the wrong way.
translation:
Iyi niyetli ama biraz
kafasi kit Belediye Baskani
Williams, Monte d'Or halkinin
sevdigi bir tiptir. Heyecanlaninca
kollarini delice sallar
ve en ufak dedikoduyu
ogrenmek icin baskalarinin
islerine burnunu sokmadan
duramaz. Kotu niyeti
yoktur ama yine de
bazi insanlarin
sinirine dokunmayi basarir.

original: Mrs Ascot
translation: Bayan Ascot

original:
Randall's elusive mother
had been kept well-hidden
by Henry, waiting for the
day her son would return.
Layton deduced that she
was the guarantor who
gave Henry the rights to
the land. Her needlework
is top-notch and both
Henry and Angela's
clothes are her handiwork.
translation:
Randall'in izini kaybettiren
annesi, Henry tarafindan
ozenle saklanmis ve
oglunun donecegi gunu
beklemistir. Layton, onun
Henry'ye arazi haklarini
veren kefil oldugunu
anladi. Igne oyasi
isciligi mukemmeldir;
Henry ile Angela'nin
kiyafetlerinin cogu onun elinden cikmistir.

original: Pascal
translation: Pascal

original:
The hotelier of the
Camel's Hump hotel looks
as ordinary as they come,
but his gracious hospitality
is anything but. He even
attunes the tone of his
voice to fit his guests'
personal needs. It's no
wonder Pascal's service
is so highly acclaimed.
translation:
Camel's Hump Oteli'nin
sahibi Pascal, disaridan
bakinca siradan gorunur,
ama misafirperverligi
hic de oyle degildir.
Hatta konuklarinin
ihtiyaclarina gore ses
tonunu bile ayarlar.
Pascal'in hizmetinin
bu kadar ovulmesine sasmamali.

original: Jean-Paul
translation: Jean-Paul

original:
Burly Jean-Paul runs the
local toy stall in
Knick-Knack Alley, and
he's not in the least bit
shy to tell the world all
about his shop and his
muscles. Around women,
however, his bravado
turns to mush - he tends
to fall for them in a
gushy way that scares
off his customers.
translation:
Iri yari Jean-Paul,
Knick-Knack Sokagi'ndaki
oyuncak tezgahini isletir
ve dukkanini da
kaslarini da herkese
anlatmaktan hic cekinmez.
Ama kadinlarin yaninda
bu kabadayiligi erir-
onlara oyle sulu bir
sekilde tutulur ki
bu hal, musterilerini
korkutup kacirir.

original: Ludmilla
translation: Ludmilla

original:
Ludmilla is the cheery
owner of a vintage
costume shop and she's
very well informed about
the city. She offers
precious snippets of info
to tourists willing to
rent a nice, hand-picked
set of clothing. Rumour
has it she runs another
shop with all sorts of
things...
translation:
Ludmilla, eski
kostumler satan bir
dukkanin neseli
sahibidir ve sehir
hakkinda epey bilgilidir.
Ozenle secilmis guzel
kiyafetler kiralamaya
razi turistlere degerli
bilgi kirintilari verir.
Soylentiye gore
her turlu seyin bulundugu
baska bir dukkani daha var...

original: Gustav
translation: Gustav

original:
Respectable Gustav may
be getting on a bit, but
he still commits himself
to the proud pastime of
horse racing by tending
to the racecourse. If
there's one thing he
wants, it's to have his
sport take the world by
storm. It's just a shame
nobody takes his ideas
seriously...
translation:
Saygin Gustav biraz
yaslanmis olabilir ama
at yarisina duydugu
gururlu tutkuyu
hipodroma bakarak
surdurur. Tek istedigi,
bu sporun dunyayi
kasirga gibi sarmasidir.
Ne yazik ki
kimse onun
fikirlerini
ciddiye almaz...

original: Gonzales
translation: Gonzales

original:
Gonzales was originally
a first-rate chef at the
Reunion Inn, until he had
a row with the owner and
was ushered promptly out.
Fortunately, Dalston took
pity and hired him as his
personal butler. Gonzales
now shares an affinity with
his oddball boss that none
can ever hope to match.
translation:
Gonzales aslinda
Reunion Inn'de birinci
sinif bir asciydi; ta ki
sahibiyle kavga edip
kapi disari edilene kadar.
Neyse ki Dalston aciyip
onu kisisel usagi olarak
ise aldi. Gonzales simdi
acayip patronuyla oyle bir
uyum yakaladi ki
kimse bunun yanina yaklasamaz.

original: Drake
translation: Drake

original:
Inspired by Henry's keen
business skills, Drake
manages the Scorpion
Casino and cherishes it as
if it were his child. Few
can withstand his intense
glare when he lowers his
shades, so the casino
rarely has any rowdy
customers.
translation:
Henry'nin keskin
is zekasindan ilham alan
Drake, Scorpion
Kumarhanesi'ni yonetir ve
onu kendi cocugu gibi
sever. Gozluklerini
indirip sert bakisini
savurdugunda pek azi
dayanir; bu yuzden
kumarhanede nadiren taskin musteri olur.

original: Ringmaster
translation: Sirk Muduru

original:
Once a plain old member
of the Stellar Circus
troupe, this stout man
climbed the ranks in the
hope of commanding more
respect and finally earned
the title of Ringmaster.
His friendly appearance
belies a vicious temper,
but that doesn't stop the
troupe from loving him to
bits.
translation:
Bir zamanlar Stellar
Sirk toplulugunun siradan
bir uyesiyken, bu
tombul adam daha cok
saygi gormek umuduyla
basamaklari tirmandi
ve sonunda Sirk Muduru
unvanini aldi.
Sevimli gorunusu
aslinda sert bir
huy saklar; yine de
topluluk onu cok sever.

original: Aldus
translation: Aldus

original:
Aldus is a mild-mannered
man whose excessively
friendly attitude seems
to draw only suspicion.
He frequently anticipates
Layton's next destination
and pops up to give him
advice, only to run off
again. He's crazy about
wooden boxes and takes
one with him everywhere
he goes...supposedly.
translation:
Aldus, fazlasiyla
samimi tavri yuzunden
cogu kiside suphe uyandiran
uysal bir adamdir.
Sik sik Layton'in bir
sonraki duragini onceden
sezer, ortaya cikip
ogut verir ve yine kaybolur.
Tahta kutulara bayilir
ve nereye gitse
yaninda bir tane tasir...
sozde.

original: Waltham
translation: Waltham

original:
A narrow-minded parvenu
whose life centres on
money, money and more
money, Waltham is so set
on flaunting his wealth
that even his false tooth
had to be made of gold.
He pours his vast income
into gambling and looks
down on the poor, but for
all his prejudices, he will
never be mean to a child.
translation:
Dar kafali bir gorgusuz
zengin olan Waltham'in
hayati para, para ve
daha cok para etrafinda
doner. Servetini oyle
sergilemeye meraklidir ki
takma disini bile altindan
yaptirmistir. Buyuk
gelirini kumara yatirir
ve yoksullari kucumser,
ama tum onyargilarina ragmen
bir cocuga asla kotuluk etmez.

original: Mordaunt
translation: Mordaunt

original:
Manager of the Reunion
Inn, aide to Henry and
overseer to a dozen other
tasks - no matter how
small, Mordaunt does it
all! This man-with-a-plan's
unorthodox hairstyle is
trimmed once a month by
his personal stylist to
keep it in pristine shape.
translation:
Reunion Inn'in muduru,
Henry'nin yardimcisi ve
bir duzine baska isin
sorumlusu-ne kadar kucuk
olursa olsun, Mordaunt
hepsini yapar!
Planli programli bu adamin
tuhaf sac modeli,
mukemmel kalmasi icin
kisisel stilisti tarafindan ayda bir duzeltilir.

original: Hannah
translation: Hannah

original:
Hannah is the number
one (and only) member of
the Clampettes, a Clamp
Grosky fan club.
Rocketing in every
chance she gets, she has
gone down in police
history for always being
the first to arrive at the
scene of a crime, if only
to fawn over her
unsuspecting inspector.
translation:
Hannah, Clamp Grosky
hayran kulubu Clampettes'in
bir numarali (ve tek)
uyesidir.
Firsat buldukca roket
gibi firlar; polis
tarihine, suc mahalline
hep ilk varan kisi olarak
gecmistir-tek amaci
habersiz mufettisine
hayranlikla
yapismak olsa bile.

original: Pirouette
translation: Pirouette

original:
Tightrope walker and face
of the Stellar Circus,
Pirouette takes great
delight in showing off
her flexible body and
performing nail-biting
acrobatic feats that drive
the crowds wild. In her
most popular act, you'll
find her spinning and
twirling around streams of
aerial silk!
translation:
Ip cambazi ve Stellar
Sirk'in yuzu olan
Pirouette, esnek bedenini
sergilemekten ve
kalpleri hoplatan
akrobasi numaralariyla
kalabaligi costurmaktan
buyuk keyif alir. En
populer gosterisinde,
havada asili ipek
seritlerin arasinda
done done suzuldugunu gorursun!

original: Fang
translation: Fang

original:
Allow me to present the
feline star of Stellar
Circus, the ferocious
Hannibal! But he's just
a big baby, really. In fact,
he only goes wild when
it's dinner time! He has
to hear Dalston's gripes
on a daily basis, but he
likes the attention, even
if he finds Dalston's
problems bewildering.
translation:
Karsinizda Stellar
Sirk'in kedi yildizi,
azili Hannibal!
Ama aslinda koca bir
bebek. Hatta yalnizca
aksam yemegi vakti
gelince cilgina doner!
Her gun Dalston'in
sizlanmalarini dinlemek
zorunda, ama ilgiyi
seviyor-Dalston'in
dertlerini anlamasa bile.

original: Juggles
translation: Juggles

original:
Juggles's madcap antics
capture the attention of
passers-by, regardless of
their age, rank or office.
That and his charitable
acts of helping out lost
tourists have gained him
a bit of a celebrity
status around town. And
what's more, he doesn't
even charge a penny!
translation:
Juggles'in cilgin
hareketleri, yasi
mevkii ne olursa olsun
yoldan gecen herkesin
dikkatini ceker.
Kaybolmus turistlere
yardim eden hayirsever
davranislari da ona
sehirde kucuk bir
un kazandirdi. Ustelik
tek kurus bile istemez!

original: Puck
translation: Puck

original:
This balloon-toting little
boy may look sweet, but
behind his jangling jester
costume hides a fully
grown adult. Puck does
what he does to get
attention from tourists,
but he's only succeeded
in being pampered by
eccentric figures like
Juggles and Waltham.
translation:
Elinde balonlarla gezen
bu kucuk cocuk tatli
gorunebilir, ama singir
singir soytari kostumunun
altinda yetiskin bir
adam saklidir. Puck
turistlerin ilgisini
cekmek icin bunu yapar,
ama sonucta sadece
Juggles ve Waltham gibi
tuhaf tipler tarafindan simartilir.

original: Chuckles
translation: Chuckles

original:
His balancing ball act may
be a hit, but old Yukkles
isn't the barrel of laughs
he's cracked up to be.
For all his top-notch
performances in the ring,
he'll moan and whinge
about his bad back and
chronic rheumatism
whenever he gets half a
chance.
translation:
Denge topu gosterisi
cok tutsa da yasli
Yukkles soylendigi kadar
kahkaha dolu biri degildir.
Arenadaki birinci sinif
performanslarina ragmen,
firsat buldugu her an
kotu belinden ve
kronik romatizmasindan
yakinip
durur.

original: Murphy
translation: Murphy

original:
Nobody knows more about
the city's economy and
its residents' assets
than accountant Murphy,
but he's got some real
problems with the notion
of {''}client confidentiality{''}.
Just consider yourself
fortunate if he hasn't
already leaked the state
of your finances to the
entire city.
translation:
Sehrin ekonomisini ve
sakinlerinin varliklarini
muhasebeci Murphy'den
iyi bilen yoktur, ama
