{''}musteri gizliligi{''}
kavramiyla ciddi
problemleri vardir.
Mali durumunu
simdiden
tum sehre
ifsa etmediyse
kendini sansli say!

original: Bonnie
translation: Bonnie

original:
A little girl whose eager
curiosity never dwindles,
Bonnie keeps losing
herself in the throngs of
tourists, which frays her
poor mother's nerves. It's
not that her sense of
direction is bad - rather,
she just isn't bothered
either way. They're going
to meet up again in the
end anyway, right?
translation:
Meraki hic bitmeyen
kucuk Bonnie, turist
kalabaliginda surekli
kaybolur; bu da zavalli
annesinin sinirlerini
yipratir. Yol bulmasi
kotu oldugu icin degil-
sadece pek umursamaz.
Nasil olsa eninde sonunda
yeniden
bulusacaklar,
degil mi?

original: Tanya
translation: Tanya

original:
A single mother with a
penchant for shopping,
Tanya only seems to get
the chance to enjoy the
sights of Monte d'Or
while on the lookout for
her constantly vanishing
daughter. Despite her
extravagant spending,
she's never in the red -
lipstick excepted!
translation:
Alisverise duskun
bekar bir anne olan Tanya,
Monte d'Or'un
guzelliklerinin tadini
ancak surekli kaybolan
kizini ararken cikarir.
Savurgan harcamalarina
ragmen hic
eksiye dusmez-
ruj masrafi
haric!

original: Tannenbaum
translation: Tannenbaum

original:
You wouldn't expect it,
but beneath placid
Mr Tannenbaum's reams
of hair lies a rather stern
and frightening face.
He spends most of his
days leading a peaceful,
ascetic life in the village
of Craggy Dale. But if he
decided to one day take
on Lady Luck, he'd do so
with bags of money.
translation:
Inanmazsin ama,
sakin gorunen
Bay Tannenbaum'un
gur saclarinin altinda
oldukca sert ve
korkutucu bir yuz yatar.
Gunlerinin cogunu
Craggy Dale koyunde
huzurlu, sade bir yasam
surerek gecirir. Ama bir
gun Sans Tanricasi'yla
kapisacak olsa, cuvalla parayla yapar.

original: Serena
translation: Serena

original:
With an ardent passion
for danger, Serena is a
thrill seeker who can't
resist the air of mystery
surrounding the
{''}wonderfabulant{''} marvels
she loves so much. She
shares her thoughts and
opinions loudly and
indiscriminately with
anyone who shows the
slightest interest.
translation:
Tehlikeye buyuk bir
tutkuyla bagli olan
Serena, cok sevdigi
{''}wonderfabulant{''} harikalari
saran gizem havasina
dayanamayan bir
heyecan avcisidir.
Dusunce ve fikirlerini
yuksek sesle ve
hic ayirt etmeden,
en ufak ilgi gosteren
herkesle paylasir.

original: Bumble
translation: Bumble

original:
After eating all the
Ringmaster's favourite
snacks, poor old Bungle
has been relegated to
dishing out pamphlets
and putting up posters.
He's a master of his
craft, which is, namely,
making a bumbling idiot
of himself wherever
possible.
translation:
Sirk Muduru'nun en sevdigi
atistirmaliklarin hepsini
yiyince zavalli Bungle,
brosur dagitmaya ve
afis asmaya
mahkum edildi.
Ustaligi sudur:
mumkun olan her yerde
kendini sakar bir
budala durumuna
dusurmek.

original: Beaufort
translation: Beaufort

original:
Montsarton Gallery's
curator has almost as
much love for pizza as
he does for fine art. In
fact, Beaufort's so fond
of his formaggios that he
insists on eating while
patrolling the halls.
The gallery's visitors
appreciate the art, but
they aren't so fond of the
aroma!
translation:
Montsarton Galerisi'nin
kuratoru Beaufort, guzel
sanati sevdigi kadar
pizzayi da sever.
Hatta peynirli
pizzalarina oyle duskundur
ki salonlarda devriye
gezerken bile yemekte
israr eder.
Ziyaretciler sanati takdir
eder ama kokusunu
pek sevmez!

original: Michelle
translation: Michelle

original:
A fussy and disgruntled
receptionist at the city
hall, Michelle is really a
very talented individual,
but she rarely makes an
effort to show it. It's
rumoured she can speak
four languages fluently,
but she never has cause
to speak anything but
English.
translation:
Belediye binasindaki
huysuz ve sikayetci
resepsiyonist Michelle,
aslinda cok yetenekli
biridir; ama bunu
gostermek icin nadiren
caba harcar.
Dort dili akici
konustugu soylenir,
ama Ingilizce disinda
konusmasina pek gerek kalmaz.

original: Nils
translation: Nils

original:
A logical mind is often
accompanied by a lack of
imagination, and Nils fits
this image to a tee. He's
a sceptic through and
through, with such a
worldly air about him
that it's hard to believe
he's just a teenager
recently arrived from the
countryside.
translation:
Mantikli bir zihin cogu
zaman hayal gucu
eksikligiyle gelir ve
Nils buna tam uyar.
Bastan sona bir
suphecidir; oyle
dunya gormus bir havasi
vardir ki kirsaldan yeni
gelmis siradan bir
ergen olduguna
inanmak zordur.

original: Frankie
translation: Frankie

original:
On the one hand, Frankie
is a rowdy troublemaker
who roughs up tourists
for their money. On the
other, he is a romantic
who holds the purest
love for Angela. He
always ends up involved
in Narcisse's cunning
schemes, wholly oblivious
to the fact he's being
used.
translation:
Bir yandan Frankie,
turistleri paralari icin
hirpalayan, gurultucu
bir beladir.
Ote yandan, Angela'ya
karsi tertemiz bir
sevgi besleyen bir
romantiktir.
Her seferinde Narcisse'in
kurnaz planlarina bulasir
ve kullanildiginin
farkina bile varmaz.

original: Narcisse
translation: Narcisse

original:
As a man who thinks of
himself as the epitome
of beauty, Narcisse is
big-headed in more ways
than one. He and Frankie
work together to extort
cash from unsuspecting
tourists, but Narcisse
is the brains of the
operation and would
never dream of lowering
himself to Frankie's level.
translation:
Kendini guzelligin
zirvesi sanan Narcisse,
birden fazla anlamda
kibirli biridir.
Frankie ile birlikte
habersiz turistlerden
para sizdirirlar, ama
isin beyni Narcisse'tir
ve asla
Frankie'nin seviyesine
inmeyi aklindan
bile gecirmez.

original: Humbert
translation: Humbert

original:
Despite his age, it's
difficult to call Humbert
a grown-up, given that
he's shirked all the
responsibilities of
adulthood, choosing to
spend every bit of his
time and money on
gambling. Slot machines,
horse races, the lot. He's
even considered betting
his own mother!
translation:
Yasina ragmen Humbert'e
yetiskin demek zor,
cunku yetiskinligin tum
sorumluluklarindan kacip
zamanini ve parasini
tamamen kumara
harcamayi secmis.
Slot makineleri,
at yarislari, ne ararsan.
Hatta kendi annesini
bile bahis konusu
etmeyi dusunmus!

original: Policeman
translation: Polis

original:
Sheffield's hard-working
police force are up all
hours of the day trying to
apprehend the mysterious
Masked Gentleman. But
with so many falling prey
to the allure of casinos,
street performances and
the like, bringing the
criminal to justice often
falls to second place on
the list.
translation:
Sheffield'in caliskan
polisleri, gizemli
Maskeli Beyefendi'yi
yakalamak icin gunun
her saati ayaktadir.
Ama pek cogu kumarhane
cazibesine, sokak
gosterilerine ve benzer
seylere kapildigindan,
sucluyu adalete
teslim etmek cogu zaman
listenin ikinci sirasina duser.

original: Yuming
translation: Yuming

original:
A music artist from the
Far East who came to
Monte d'Or to take a
break from her hectic life,
Yuming is a very amiable
woman who's unafraid to
speak her mind. She
currently stays at the
Reunion Inn, where the
view of the night sky is
her latest inspiration.
translation:
Uzak Dogu'dan gelen
muzik sanatcisi Yuming,
yogun hayatina ara
vermek icin Monte d'Or'a
gelmistir. Dusundugunu
soylemekten cekinmeyen
cok sevimli bir kadindir.
Su anda Reunion Inn'de
kalir; gece gogunun
manzarasi onun
en yeni ilham kaynagidir.

original: Gloria
translation: Gloria

original:
A former resident of
Stansbury, Gloria is
still the same spritely
old woman that Layton
remembers from his
youth, though she may
be a little nosier. Her
glasses were a present
from her eldest son, and
she holds them very dear.
translation:
Stansbury'nin eski
sakinlerinden Gloria,
Layton'in gencliginden
hatirladigi ayni
dinc yasli kadindir,
yalniz biraz daha
merakli olabilir.
Gozlugu buyuk oglunun
hediyesidir ve
ona cok deger verir.

original: Lionel
translation: Lionel

original:
Short in stature but large
of heart, Lionel's favourite
hobby is to stroll around
Stansbury. In fact, he
doesn't do much else!
Day or night, he'll be
traipsing about the
neighbourhood, always
dying to share a story or
two about his youth but
too shy to muster up the
courage!
translation:
Boyu kisa ama
yuregi kocaman Lionel'in
en sevdigi hobi
Stansbury'de dolasmaktir.
Aslinda baska pek
bir sey yapmaz!
Gece gunduz mahallede
turlayip durur,
gencliginden bir iki
hikaye anlatmak icin
can atar ama
cekingenliginden cesaret edemez!

original: Dougal
translation: Dougal

original:
Kindly Douglas is a former
resident of Stansbury who
loved a spot of fishing and
could frequently be seen 
sitting at the riverbank
with Layton's father. He
and his wife never could
agree on the proper way
to cook a good Sunday
fry-up.
translation:
Nazik Douglas, bir zamanlar
Stansbury'de yasayan ve
balik tutmayi cok seven
biriydi; onu sik sik
Layton'in babasiyla
nehir kiyisinda otururken
gorebilirdin. Kendisiyle
esi, iyi bir pazar
kahvaltisini nasil
pisirecekleri konusunda hic anlasamazdi.

original: Mr Collins
translation: Bay Collins

original:
Mr Collins may have a
near encyclopaedic
knowledge of ancient
history backed up by a
series of expeditions
in his youth, but his
students tend to consider
him unbearably dull.
Though somewhat
grumpy, he really does
care for his pupils.
translation:
Bay Collins, gencliginde
yaptigi seferlerle
destekledigi neredeyse
ansiklopedik bir
antik tarih bilgisine
sahiptir; ama ogrencileri
onu dayanilmaz derecede
sikici bulur.
Biraz aksi olsa da,
ogrencilerini
gercekten onemser.

original: Bronev
translation: Bronev

original:
A man whose identity is
shrouded in mystery.
Detective Bloom is his
subordinate, and he
appears to have some
sort of connection with
Descole, but even this
fact is, at present,
unclear. He seems to be
looking for something
related to the Azran
civilisation...but what?
translation:
Kimligi gizemle
ortulu bir adam.
Dedektif Bloom onun
emrindedir ve
Descole ile bir tur
baglantisi var gibi
gorunur; ama su an
bunun bile
kesinligi yoktur.
Azran uygarligiyla
ilgili bir sey
ariyor gibi...ama ne?

original: Layton's Horse
translation: Layton'in Ati

original:
A stately black mare who
runs like the wind once
Layton takes hold of the
reins. She sails over
hurdles effortlessly and
with such nobility that
she surely belongs to a
royal breed. Highly fitting
of the professor's stature.
translation:
Layton dizginleri eline
aldiginda ruzgar gibi
kosan heybetli siyah
bir kisrak.
Engelleri zahmetsizce
asar; oyle asil durur ki
sanki kraliyet soyundan
geliyor.
Profesorun durusuna cok yakisir.

original: Emmy's Horse
translation: Emmy'nin Ati

original:
A princely white steed
whose graceful form stops
passers-by in their tracks.
His nimble hooves can
move swiftly and elegantly
out of the way of
oncoming barrels, sharing
Emmy's tenacity and
eagerness to tackle any
challenge that lies ahead.
translation:
Zarif gorunusuyle
yoldan gecenleri bile
yerinde donduran
asil bir beyaz at.
Cevik toynaklari,
ustune gelen varillerden
hizla ve sikca siyrilir;
Emmy'nin azmi ve
onundeki her zorluga
atilma istegini paylasir.

original: Luke's Horse
translation: Luke'un Esegi

original:
Luke's little donkey may
not seem like a very apt
choice of steed, but once
his little hooves start
clopping hurriedly along
the cobbles, it's clear
there is no better choice.
What he lacks in speed,
he makes up for in pure
determination.
translation:
Luke'un kucuk esegi
pek iyi bir binek gibi
gorunmeyebilir; ama
kucuk toynaklari
kaldirimlarda hizli hizli
takirdamaya baslayinca,
daha iyi bir secim
olmadigi anlasilir.
Hizda eksigi olabilir,
ama saf kararliligiyla bunu telafi eder.

original: Voice
translation: Ses

original:
Listen to sound clips of
characters from the game.
translation:
Oyundaki karakterlerin
ses kayitlarini dinleyin.

original:
Yes, it is. Some people even call it the
City of Miracles.
translation:
Evet, oyle. Hatta bazilari buraya
Mucizeler Sehri bile diyor.

original:
Ah, I intended no offence, Angela. All will
become clear in time. We will soon get to
the bottom of things.
translation:
Ah, niyetim seni kirmak degildi, Angela. Her sey
zamanla acikliga kavusacak. Yakinda isin
aslini ortaya cikaracagiz.

original: This was the true miracle all along.
translation: Asil mucize basindan beri buydu.

original:
Randall, I told you. I'm not interested in
archaeology.
translation:
Randall, sana soyledim. Arkeolojiyle
ilgilenmiyorum.

original:
I told no one of it. It shall forever remain
our secret. Here is what you sacrificed
your life for.
translation:
Bunu kimseye soylemedim. Sonsuza dek
aramizda kalacak. Iste hayatini feda ettigin
sey.

original: I'm the professor's apprentice!
translation: Ben profesorun ciragiyim!

original:
This is fantastic! Everyone is having such
a good time!
translation:
Bu harika! Herkes ne kadar da
egleniyor!

original:
Little chap? I'm not a child! I'm Luke
Triton, apprentice to Professor Layton!
translation:
Kucuk cocuk mu? Ben cocuk degilim! Ben Luke
Triton, Profesor Layton'in ciragiyim!

original: Descole! Then where's Angela?
translation: Descole! O zaman Angela nerede?

original:
But I still have lots of questions about
the Azran civilisation, Professor.
translation:
Ama Azran uygarligi hakkinda hala bir suru
sorum var, Profesor.

original: That was no match for my wits!
translation: Zekamin karsisinda sansi yoktu!

original:
What is your relationship with Angela,
Professor? Is she one of Professor
Layton's lost loves?
translation:
Angela'yla iliskiniz nedir,
Profesor? O, Profesor
Layton'in kayip asklarindan biri mi?

original:
We made the trip to Monte d'Or to
investigate the Mask of Chaos.
translation:
Kargasa Maskesi'ni arastirmak icin Monte d'Or'a
geldik.

original:
How did you get in here with all the
competent police officers?
translation:
Bunca yetenekli polis varken buraya
nasil girdiniz?

original:
What other city can claim that it was built
on a foundation of loyalty and friendship?
translation:
Baska hangi sehir, sadakat ve dostluk
temeli uzerine kuruldugunu soyleyebilir?

original:
Monte d'Or is not long for this world.
Those who prosper by the mask must also
wither by it.
translation:
Monte d'Or'un bu dunyada fazla zamani kalmadi.
Maskeyle yukselenler, onunla da
solup gidecek.

original:
This closes my tale of woe. However, we
still have a few tears to shed!
translation:
Boylece kederli hikayem sona eriyor. Ama biz
hala dokecek birkac gozyasina sahibiz!

original: Henry, Angela... I'm home.
translation: Henry, Angela... Eve geldim.

original:
I can't just live in my father's shadow
my entire life. I need this, and I need
your help to do it.
translation:
Hayatim boyunca babamin golgesinde
yasayamam. Buna ihtiyacim var ve bunu
yapmak icin yardimina ihtiyacim var.

original:
Take the mask. It's yours. You must solve
the last puzzle, Hershel.
translation:
Maskeyi al. Artik senin. Son bilmeciyi
cozmelisin, Hershel.

original: I hope to see you soon.
translation: Seni yakinda gormeyi umuyorum.

original:
Is it some sort of complement to the
Mask of Chaos?
translation: Kargasa Maskesi'nin bir tur tamamlayicisi mi?

original:
Randall, my marriage to Henry wasn't
real.
translation:
Randall, Henry'yle evliligim
gercek degildi.

original:
You'll always look out for him, won't
you, Hershel? Promise me.
translation:
Ona hep goz kulak olacaksin, degil
mi Hershel? Bana soz ver.

original:
Hershel! Where is he? Tell me what
happened out there! Why aren't you
with Randall? Why?!
translation:
Hershel! Nerede o? Bana orada ne
oldugunu soyle! Neden Randall'la
birlikte degilsin? Neden?!

original: Perhaps I was too eager.
translation: Belki de fazla aceleciydim.

original:
This has been a pleasure.
Many thanks, Layton!
translation:
Bu benim icin bir zevkti.
Cok tesekkurler, Layton!

original:
So then, it has come to pass. And we
shall see if the Azran were worth my
trouble. I have sacrificed everything
for this moment.
translation:
Demek sonunda oldu. Simdi Azranlarin
zahmetime degip degmedigini
gorecegiz. Bu an icin her seyimi
feda ettim.

original:
The Garden of Healing. The City of
Harmony. We have two of the three.
Which is just another way of saying
we have nothing, isn't it?
translation:
Sifa Bahcesi. Uyum Sehri. Ucunden
ikisine sahibiz. Bu da aslinda
hicbir seye sahip olmadigimizi
soylemenin baska bir yolu, degil mi?

original:
Trespassers! This site is now controlled
by Targent! And we can't have you two
blabbing about what you've seen.
translation:
Izinsiz girenler! Burasi artik
Targent'in kontrolunde! Ve ikinizin
gorduklerinizi ortaliga sacmasina izin veremeyiz.

original:
There's nothing more to say, Master
Randall. We all knew you would return.
We just didn't think you'd take so long.
translation:
Soyleyecek bir sey kalmadi, Usta
Randall. Hepimiz donecegini biliyorduk.
Sadece bu kadar uzun surecegini dusunmemistik.

original:
Henry, I knew it was you! You set me
up with this stupid letter just to get me
out here, because you're not man
enough to face me yourself! Coward!
translation:
Henry, sen oldugunu biliyordum! Beni
buraya getirmek icin su aptal mektupla
tuzak kurdun, cunku benimle yuzlesecek
kadar cesur degilsin! Korkak!

original:
Guess I'll have to turn to my arrest
record at Scotland Yard to cheer me up!
Ah ha ha ha!
translation:
Neselenmek icin Scotland Yard'daki
sabikama bakmam gerekecek galiba!
Ah ha ha ha!

original:
Detective Inspector Leonard Bloom.
Senior detective at Scotland Yard.
translation:
Dedektif Mufettis Leonard Bloom.
Scotland Yard'da kidemli dedektif.

original:
All right then. Just make sure he
doesn't get in the way.
translation:
Peki o zaman. Sadece araya
girmemesine dikkat et.

original: Music
translation: Muzik

original:
Listen to background
music from the game.
translation:
Oyundaki arka plan
muziklerini dinleyin.

original: Professor Layton's Theme
translation: Professor Layton's Theme

original: Miracle Mask Theme
translation: Miracle Mask Theme

original: Puzzles Abound
translation: Puzzles Abound

original: Monte d'Or: Carnival Night
translation: Monte d'Or: Carnival Night

original: Misgivings
translation: Misgivings

original: Dangerous Pranks
translation: Dangerous Pranks

original: The Gentleman's Theme
translation: The Gentleman's Theme

original: Fierce Chase
translation: Fierce Chase

original: Expectation
translation: Expectation

original: Illusion
translation: Illusion

original: Monte d'Or: City of Miracles
translation: Monte d'Or: City of Miracles

original: A Moment of Calm
translation: A Moment of Calm

original: Inside the Circus Tent
translation: Inside the Circus Tent

original: Puzzles
translation: Puzzles

original: Searching for Clues
translation: Searching for Clues

original: The Scorpion Casino
translation: The Scorpion Casino

original: The Racecourse
translation: The Racecourse

original: Stansbury: Halcyon Days
translation: Stansbury: Halcyon Days

original: Stansbury: Moonlit Knoll
translation: Stansbury: Moonlit Knoll

original: Norwell
translation: Norwell

original: Akbadain Ruins
translation: Akbadain Ruins

original: Akbadain Breakthrough
translation: Akbadain Breakthrough

original: Time for Action!
translation: Time for Action!

original: Grief
translation: Grief

original: Treasured Memories
translation: Treasured Memories

original: Tingly Town
translation: Tingly Town

original: Reunion Inn
translation: Reunion Inn

original: Descole's Theme
translation: Descole's Theme

original: A Treasure that Lasts
translation: A Treasure that Lasts

original: Targent's Theme
translation: Targent's Theme

original: The Toy Robot
translation: The Toy Robot

original: Robot Showdown
translation: Robot Showdown

original: The One-Stop Shop
translation: The One-Stop Shop

original: The Rabbit Show
translation: The Rabbit Show

original: Rabbit on Stage
translation: Rabbit on Stage

original: Mysterious Flower
translation: Mysterious Flower

original: Celebration Boulevard
translation: Kutlama Bulvari

original:
This quintessential tourist spot is
lined with caf{'e}s and restaurants.
The fountain is a popular
meeting place.
translation:
Bu klasik turistik nokta
caf{'e}ler ve restoranlarla cevrilidir.
Cesme, populer bir
bulusma yeridir.

original: Montsarton Gallery
translation: Montsarton Galerisi

original:
Housing countless classic and
contemporary pieces, the gallery
is itself a work of art when lit up
for the carnival.
translation:
Sayisiz klasik ve
cagdas esere ev sahipligi yapan galeri,
karnaval icin isiklandirildiginda
basli basina bir sanat eseridir.

original: Ledore Mansion
translation: Ledore Malikanesi

original:
Exuding opulence, the manor
and its pristine garden are kept
in perfect shape by none other
than Mr Ledore himself.
translation:
Gorkemiyle goz kamastiran malikane
ve kusursuz bahcesi,
baska hic kimse degil
bizzat Bay Ledore tarafindan mukemmel durumda tutulur.

original: Monument
translation: Anit

original:
Hopefuls heading for Chance
Avenue are sure to spot this
monument that chronicles the
glorious history of Monte d'Or.
translation:
Sans Caddesi'ne gidenler
Monte d'Or'un gorkemli tarihini
anlatan bu
aniti mutlaka fark eder.

original: The Camel's Hump
translation: Devenin Horgucu

original:
Pascal's Persian-themed hotel
receives such high praise from
visitors that it's always fully
booked.
translation:
Pascal'in Pers temali oteli
ziyaretcilerden o kadar ovgu alir ki
her zaman tamamen
dolu olur.

original: Ch{^a}teau Dalston
translation: Ch{^a}teau Dalston

original:
Unconventional Dalston owns
this rather grim-looking mansion
near the desert. It doesn't get
many visitors.
translation:
Sira disi Dalston,
cole yakin bu oldukca kasvetli
malikanenin sahibidir. Pek
ziyaretcisi yoktur.

original: Police HQ
translation: Polis Karargahi

original:
The city hall currently hosts a
temporary police HQ. During
briefings, the combined might
of the team is quite tangible.
translation:
Belediye binasi su anda
gecici bir polis karargahina ev sahipligi yapiyor. Brifinglerde,
ekibin birlesik gucu
adeta hissediliyor.

original: Chance Avenue
translation: Sans Caddesi

original:
Bright lights and neon signs
illuminate the enticing Chance
Avenue. Night-time is when it
really comes alive.
translation:
Parlak isiklar ve neon tabelalar
cazip Sans Caddesi'ni
aydinlatir. Asil gece olunca
canlanir.

original: Racecourse
translation: Hipodrom

original:
As the venue for a favourite local
pastime, the racecourse is kept
looking spic and span. The same
can't be said for the sheds!
translation:
Yerel halkin gozde eglencesine ev sahipligi yaptigi icin
hipodrom tertemiz tutulur. Ama ayni
seyi kulubeler icin
soylemek zor!

original: Reunion Inn
translation: Reunion Hani

original:
The Reunion Inn is where it all
began and, thanks to its regal
architecture, the most visited
hotel in Monte d'Or.
translation:
Her seyin basladigi yer olan
Reunion Hani, gorkemli
mimarisi sayesinde
Monte d'Or'un en cok ziyaret edilen otelidir.

original: Henry's Office
translation: Henry'nin Ofisi

original:
In a far corner of the Reunion
Inn lies Henry's office, forever
a reminder to the city's past and
to Randall's expedition.
translation:
Reunion Hani'nin uzak bir kosesinde
Henry'nin ofisi bulunur; sehrin gecmisini ve
Randall'in kesif seferini
daima hatirlatir.

original: Grand Hall
translation: Buyuk Salon

original:
Hotel guests gather in the Grand
Hall. The atrium rises all the
way to the top, which only adds
to the majesty.
translation:
Otel misafirleri Buyuk
Salon'da toplanir. Atriyum
ta tavana kadar yukselir; bu da
ihtisama ihtisam katar.

original: Depths of Akbadain
translation: Akbadain'in Derinlikleri

original:
The ruins contain a secret
mechanism, hidden by Azran
arts. Both the Mask of Chaos
and the Mask of Order are
required to operate it.
translation:
Harabeler, Azran sanatlariyla
gizlenmis bir gizli
mekanizma barindirir. Onu calistirmak icin
hem Kargasa Maskesi
hem de Duzen Maskesi gerekir.

original: St Vernon's
translation: St Vernon's

original:
St Vernon's is unique in that it
offers archaeology studies at
A-Level. The quality of teaching
is exceptional.
translation:
St Vernon's, A-Level duzeyinde
arkeoloji egitimi vermesiyle
benzersizdir. Ogretim
kalitesi olaganustudur.

original: Riverside Cottage
translation: Nehir Kenari Kulubesi

original:
The old brick cottage is home to
two of the nicest parents in
Stansbury. They're known to
chortle the night away.
translation:
Eski tugla kulubede
Stansbury'nin en iyi anne babalarindan
ikisi yasar. Geceleri
gece boyu gulusmeleriyle unludurler.

original: Hershel's Room
translation: Hershel'in Odasi

original:
17-year-old Hershel's room is
frequently tidied by his mother,
despite his pleas to leave
everything as it is.
translation:
17 yasindaki Hershel'in odasi,
her seyi oldugu gibi birakmasi icin yalvarmasina ragmen,
annesi tarafindan sik sik
toplanir.

original: Memory Knoll
translation: Ani Tepesi

original:
This romantic little hill is great
for picnics and even better for
stargazing. A great spot for a
few fireworks, too.
translation:
Bu romantik kucuk tepe
piknik icin harika, yildiz
seyri icin daha da guzel. Birkac
havai fisek icin de sahane bir yerdir.

original: Ascot House
translation: Ascot Evi

original:
The richest house in the village
abides by strict rules, many
of which Randall breaks on a
regular basis.
translation:
Koyun en zengin evi
kati kurallara uyar; Randall da
bunlarin cogunu
duzenli olarak cigner.

original: Randall's Room
translation: Randall'in Odasi

original:
Randall's room reflects his
childish and disorganised state
of mind. Even the wall is spared
no mercy.
translation:
Randall'in odasi, onun
cocuksu ve daginik
zihnini yansitir. Duvarlar bile
merhamet gormemistir.

original: Norwell
translation: Norwell

original:
The stone wall excavated at
Stansbury is thought to be part
of the ancient Azran civilisation.
translation:
Stansbury'de kazilan tas duvarin,
kadim Azran uygarliginin
bir parcasi oldugu dusunuluyor.

original: Transmogrification
translation: Sekil Degistirme

original:
The Gentleman's miraculous
debut. Horses appeared where
tourists once stood, throwing
the crowds into panic.
translation:
Beyefendi'nin mucizevi
ilk gosterisi. Bir zamanlar turistlerin
durdugu yerde atlar belirdi ve
kalabaligi panige surukledi.

original: Paintings Alive
translation: Canlanan Tablolar

original:
A miracle in which people leapt
from paintings and rioted in
the streets. The city centre
descended into chaos.
translation:
Insanlarin tablolardan atlayip
sokaklarda isyan ettigi bir mucize.
Sehir merkezi
kargasaya suruklendi.

original: Miracle on Stage
translation: Sahnede Mucize

original:
As the flames erupted, the 13
people that stood on the dais
vanished, baffling the onlookers
at the gallery plaza.
translation:
Alevler yukselirken, kursude duran
13 kisi ortadan kayboldu; galeri
meydanindaki seyircileri
saskina cevirdi.

original: By the Oasis
translation: Vahanin Yaninda

original:
The Reunion Inn started life as
a modest little building by an
oasis. The shaft nearby was dug
by a party searching for Randall
to give easy access to the ruins.
translation:
Reunion Hani, bir vahanin yaninda
mutevazi kucuk bir bina olarak basladi.
Yakindaki kuyu, Randall'i arayan bir ekip tarafindan
harabelere kolay erisim saglamak icin
kazildi.

original: The Traitorous Regent
translation: Hain Naip

original:
A once loyal chancellor deceived
his king to take the country for
his own. It's a tale that carries a
powerful message.
translation:
Bir zamanlar sadik olan bir sansolye,
ulkeyi ele gecirmek icin kralini aldatti.
Guclu bir mesaj tasiyan
bir hikaye.

original: Rural Harmony
translation: Kirsal Uyum

original:
Idyllic Craggy Dale is far
removed from the hectic bustle
of Monte d'Or, and can calm
the fieriest of hearts.
translation:
Huzurlu Craggy Dale,
Monte d'Or'un telasli kalabaligindan
cok uzaktadir ve
en atesli kalpleri bile sakinlestirebilir.

original: Life in Craggy Dale
translation: Craggy Dale'de Yasam

original:
The residents of Craggy Dale
live off the land. Their skin turns
a healthy brown from working
out in the sun all day.
translation:
Craggy Dale sakinleri
topraktan gecinir. Gun boyu guneste
calistiklari icin tenleri
saglikli bir bronza doner.

original: Best of Friends
translation: Can Dostlar

original:
An old photo of Randall and
Henry. The robot is a symbol
of the strong, brotherly bond
between them.
translation:
Randall ve Henry'nin eski bir fotografi.
Robot, aralarindaki guclu
kardesce bagin
bir simgesidir.

original: The Stansbury Four
translation: Stansbury Dortlusu

original:
A fond memory of old friends
who, with Randall as their
leader, went out on all sorts
of exciting misadventures.
translation:
Randall'in liderliginde
her turlu heyecanli maceraya
dalan eski arkadaslarin
tatli bir hatirasi.

original: Commemorative Photo
translation: Hatira Fotografi

original:
This photo is a true miracle,
commemorating the revival of
a precious friendship after
18 long years.
translation:
Bu fotograf gercek bir mucizedir;
18 uzun yilin ardindan
degerli bir dostlugun
yeniden canlanisini olumsuzlestirir.

original: Layton's Challenges
translation: Layton'in Meydan Okumalari

original:
Test your wits against the hardest
puzzles the professor has to offer.
Do you have what it takes?
translation:
Zekanizi profesorun sundugu en zor
bulmacalara karsi sinayin.
Bunu basarabilir misiniz?

original: The Toymaker's House
translation: Oyuncakcinin Evi

original: The Shopkeeper's House
translation: Dukkancinin Evi

original: The Ringmaster's House
translation: Sirk Yoneticisinin Evi

original: The Old Friends' House
translation: Eski Dostlarin Evi

original: The Puzzle Queen's House
translation: Bulmaca Kralicesinin Evi

original: Puzzle %03d: %s
translation: Bulmaca %03d: %s

original: Bonuses
translation: Ekstralar

original:
Unlock bonus features by solving
mysteries and puzzles as you
progress through the game.
The range of features on each
save file will vary.
translation:
Gizemleri ve bulmacalari cozerek
oyun boyunca ilerledikce yeni
ekstra ozelliklerin kilidini acin.
Her kayit dosyasindaki ozellikler
farklilik gosterebilir.

original:
Would you like to receive
notifications from Level-5
about Daily Puzzles?
If no extra data for this game is
present on the SD Card, new
extra data will be created.
translation:
Level-5'ten Gunluk Bulmacalar
hakkinda bildirim almak ister misiniz?
Bu oyun icin SD Kartta ek veri yoksa,
SD Kartta yeni
ek veri olusturulacaktir.

original:
You are currently receiving
notifications for this game.

Would you like to turn
notifications off?
translation:
Su anda bu oyun icin
bildirim aliyorsunuz.

Bildirimleri kapatmak
ister misiniz?

original: Turning notifications on...
translation: Bildirimler aciliyor...

original: Turning notifications off...
translation: Bildirimler kapatiliyor...

original: Notifications are now turned on.
translation: Bildirimler artik acik.

original: Notifications are now turned off.
translation: Bildirimler artik kapali.

original: Checking the SD Card...
translation: SD Kart kontrol ediliyor...

original:
Creating new extra data
on SD Card...
translation:
SD Kartta yeni ek veri
olusturuluyor...

original:
You can activate SpotPass to receive
notifications about Daily Puzzles
available for download.
To use this feature, you must agree
to the Nintendo 3DS Service User
Agreement and Privacy Policy.
translation:
SpotPass'i etkinlestirerek indirilebilir
Gunluk Bulmacalar hakkinda bildirim
alabilirsiniz.
Bu ozelligi kullanmak icin Nintendo 3DS
Hizmet Kullanici Sozlesmesi ve Gizlilik
Politikasi'ni kabul etmelisiniz.

original: Cancelling...
translation: Iptal ediliyor...

original: Cancelled.
translation: Iptal edildi.

original:
No SD Card is inserted.
SpotPass cannot be used.
translation:
SD Kart takili degil.
SpotPass kullanilamaz.

original: An error has occurred.
translation: Bir hata olustu.

original: Top Secret
translation: Cok Gizli

original:
Access exclusive material
here. Unlock more features
by collecting picarats.
translation:
Buradan ozel iceriklere
erisin. Pikarats toplayarak
daha fazla ozelligin kilidini acin.

original: The Hidden Door of Monte d'Or
translation: Monte d'Or'un Gizli Kapisi

original:
Use the passwords found in other Professor
Layton games to access special bonus
material. For more details, refer to the
instruction manual.
translation:
Diger Profesor Layton oyunlarinda bulunan
sifreleri kullanarak ozel bonus iceriklere
erisin. Daha fazla bilgi icin
kullanim kilavuzuna bakin.

original: パスワード
translation: Sifre

original: Password for the Hidden Door of Misthallery
translation: Misthallery'nin Gizli Kapisi icin sifre

original: Movies
translation: Videolar

original:
Relive the adventure! You can watch
cutscenes from the game here.
translation:
Macerayi yeniden yasa! Oyundaki
ara sahneleri buradan izleyebilirsin.

original: Emmy's Enquiries
translation: Emmy'nin Sorusturmalari

original:
To prove her initiative as an
assistant, Emmy patrols the
neighbourhood alone, gathering
intel on the Masked Gentleman
and his previous deeds.
translation:
Asistan olarak giriskenligini
kanitlamak icin Emmy,
mahalleyi tek basina devriye gezip
Maskeli Beyefendi ve
onceki yaptiklari hakkinda bilgi toplar.

original: Ballooning Out of Proportion
translation: Balonlar Cigirindan Cikiyor

original:
Dunderhead Bungle has found
himself tied up in knots yet again,
no thanks to Puck's balloons!
Juggles steps in to help, but is
he too late?
translation:
Aptal Bungle yine kendini
dugumler icinde buldu; Puck'in balonlari
sag olsun!
Juggles yardima kosuyor ama
cok mu gec kaldi?

original: Ludmilla Knows Best
translation: Ludmilla En Iyisini Bilir

original:
Boutique owner Ludmilla likes
to think she cares about her
customers. And when one fellow
decides to saunter in, he's
guaranteed to leave a new man.
translation:
Butik sahibi Ludmilla,
musterilerini onemsedigini
sanmayi sever. Ve biri iceri soyle
suzulup girdi mi,
yeni bir adam olarak cikmasi garanti.

original: Shimmering Stellar Circus
translation: Parildayan Stellar Sirki

original:
The Stellar Circus is all the rage
in Monte d'Or these days. Tonight,
we present you with an exclusive
behind-the-scenes glimpse of the
carefree troupe.
translation:
Stellar Sirki bu aralar
Monte d'Or'da cok moda. Bu gece,
kayitsiz sartsiz neseli toplulugun
perde arkasina
a ozel bakis sunuyoruz.

original: Stray Child, Stray Heart
translation: Kayip Cocuk, Kayip Yurek

original:
An inquisitive little face peeks out
between Jean-Paul's stacks of toys
one day. Maybe he can help
Bonnie look for her mummy!
translation:
Bir gun merakli kucuk bir yuz,
Jean-Paul'un oyuncak yiginlarinin
arasindan bakiverir. Belki de
Bonnie'nin annesini aramasina yardim eder!

original: Plods in a Pod
translation: Kapsulde Polisler

original:
The police under CI Sheffield
pour blood and sweat into their
investigation. But what does
Detective Bloom have to say
about their identical faces?
translation:
Basmufettis Sheffield'in polisleri
sorusturmaya kan ter icinde calisiyor.
Ama Dedektif Bloom,
ayni yuzlere sahip olmalari hakkinda
ne diyor?

original: Behind the Bureaucracy
translation: Burokrasinin Ardinda

original:
Following the Masked Gentleman's
first malicious deed, the city hall
admin are rushed off their feet.
That is, until the mayor thinks up
a brilliant way to save the city.
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
ilk kotu eyleminden sonra belediye
memurlari kosturup durur.
Ta ki belediye baskani sehri kurtarmak icin
parlak bir fikir bulana kadar.

original: The Laytons' Secret
translation: Laytonlarin Sirri

original:
Riverside Cottage is always full of
good cheer. However much the
Laytons bicker during the day,
they resolve any tensions with
a little chat before bed.
translation:
Nehir Kenari Kulubesi her zaman
neseyle doludur. Laytonlar gun icinde
ne kadar didisse de,
yatmadan once kucuk bir sohbetle
gerilimi cozerler.

original: Hannibal the Ferocious
translation: Vahsi Hannibal

original:
The Stellar Circus's ferocious
tiger, Hannibal, and Dalston are
the best of friends. Today, Dalston
pays a visit with the usual
delicacies in hand.
translation:
Stellar Sirki'nin vahsi kaplani
Hannibal ile Dalston can dosttur. Bugun Dalston,
yine her zamanki
leziz ikramlariyla
ziyarete gelir.

original: Grosky Runs Rampant
translation: Grosky Ortaligi Kasip Kavuruyor

original:
Do unflinching determination and
a vast mound of chest hair amount
to the sum of their parts? With
Grosky on the beat, it's hard to
tell.
translation:
Sarsilmaz kararlilik ve
kocaman bir gogus kili yigini,
bir araya gelince gercekten bir sey eder mi?
Devriyede Grosky varken
anlamak zor.

original: Confidentiality Compromised
translation: Gizlilik Tehlikede

original:
The respective managers of
Henry's establishments gather to
discuss a certain individual and
his continuous tendency to blab
confidential information...
translation:
Henry'nin isletmelerinin
yoneticileri, belli bir kisiyi ve
surekli gizli bilgileri
agzindan kacirma huyunu
konusmak icin toplanir...

original: Moonlit Rendezvous
translation: Ay Isiginda Bulusma

original:
Two young lovers meet under the
beautiful starlit sky. A snapshot in
time of a bittersweet adolescence.
translation:
Iki genc asik, yildizlarla dolu
guzel gokyuzunun altinda bulusur.
Tatli-aci bir ergenligin zamandan bir kesiti.

original: Tannenbaum's Trek
translation: Tannenbaum'un Yolculugu

original:
While scouring the streets for his
foster son, Mr Tannenbaum bumps
into a woman who, like him, shares
a rural background.
translation:
Evlatlik oglunu bulmak icin
sokaklari arayan Bay Tannenbaum,
kendisi gibi kirsal kokleri olan
bir kadinla karsilasir.

original: The Lady Spy
translation: Kadin Casus

original:
The moment this woman arrived on
the scene, she became a legend.
Who is she? And where did she
come from?
translation:
Bu kadin sahneye adim atar atmaz
bir efsaneye donustu.
O kim? Ve nereden
geldi?

original: A Difficult Letter
translation: Zor Bir Mektup

original:
Angela, having an inkling of the
Masked Gentleman's true identity,
resolves to write a letter to Layton
before anyone else can suspect.
translation:
Angela, Maskeli Beyefendi'nin
gercek kimligine dair bir sezgiyle,
baska kimse suphelenmeden once
Layton'a bir mektup yazmaya karar verir.

original: Bloom's Subterfuge
translation: Bloom'un Oyunu

original:
The highly reputed inspector
from Scotland Yard appears at
first glance to be working on
the Gentleman case, but his
true loyalties lie elsewhere.
translation:
Scotland Yard'in cok saygin
mufettisi ilk bakista
Beyefendi vakasi uzerinde calisiyor
gibi gorunur, ama
asil sadakati baska yerdedir.

original: Sheffield Steels Himself
translation: Sheffield Celik Gibi

original:
Sheffield may be hard as granite,
but even while his city's
destruction is imminent, he
single-mindedly fights to protect
the peace.
translation:
Sheffield granit kadar sert olabilir,
ama sehrinin yok olusu yaklassa bile,
tek bir hedefle
barisi korumak icin
savasir.

original: The Seeds of Revenge
translation: Intikamin Tohumlari

original:
Betrayed by his own friend, his
hometown a desolate landscape,
Randall vows for revenge, while 
a caped figure deceptively urges
him on.
translation:
Kendi dostu tarafindan ihanete ugrayan, onun
memleketi harabeye donen
Randall intikam yemini ederken, 
pelerinli bir figur onu
aldatici bir sekilde kiskirtir.

original: An Unusual Proposal
translation: Sira Disi Bir Teklif

original:
A young man, fervently loyal and
resolute, takes it upon himself to
watch over and protect everything
that was once important to his
best friend.
translation:
Genc bir adam, atesli bir sadakatle
kararli bir sekilde, en iyi dostu icin
bir zamanlar onemli olan her seyi
gozetip korumayi
kendine gorev edinir.

original: Beneath the Hat
translation: Sapkanin Altinda

original:
The professor divulges a little
known fact about his hat and the
hairstyle he wore in his youth.
translation:
Profesor, sapkasi ve
gencliginde kullandigi
sac modeli hakkinda pek bilinmeyen bir gercegi aciklar.

original: 説明文 前編
translation: Aciklama (1. Kisim)

original:
Peek into the lives of those you have
met during your investigation.

Touch an episode to view it.
translation:
Sorusturman sirasinda tanistigin
kisilerin hayatlarina goz at.

Goruntulemek icin bir bolume dokun.

original: Stylish Clay Pot
translation: Sik Kil Comlek

original:
It's no doubt an antique pot, but the
design appeals to modern sensibility.
translation:
Suphesiz antika bir comlek, ama
tasarimi modern zevke hitap ediyor.

original: Knobbly Cane
translation: Puruzlu Baston

original:
All gnarled and with a rugged handle,
this walking stick has no charm at all.
translation:
Tamamen budakli ve kaba bir sapli
bu bastonun hic cekiciligi yok.

original: Warped Mirror
translation: Egri Bugru Ayna

original:
This broken mirror twists and warps
your reflection. Amusing, isn't it?
translation:
Bu kirik ayna yansimani egip buker.
Eglenceli, degil mi?

original: Intricate Fish Hook
translation: Ince Iscilikli Balik Kancasi

original:
{''}You can't be too careful.{''} Definitely
the motto for this finicky fish hook.
translation:
{''}Ne kadar dikkatli olsan az.{''} Kesinlikle
bu nazli balik kancasinin mottosu.

original: Useless Paint
translation: Ise Yaramaz Boya

original:
Faulty paint that changes colour with
temperature. Why not remarket it?
translation:
Sicaklikla renk degistiren arizali boya.
Neden yeniden pazarlamayasin?

original: Muffled Record
translation: Boguk Kayit

original:
The recording is so quiet, it seems to fade
away as you listen...
translation:
Kayit o kadar kisik ki, dinledikce
kayboluyor gibi...

original: Captured Queen
translation: Yakalanmis Vezir

original:
The keystone chess piece, captured by an
opposing bishop after a blunder.
translation:
En kilit satranc tasi, bir hata sonrasi
rakip fil tarafindan ele gecirilmis.

original: Tiny Fountain Pen
translation: Minik Dolma Kalem

original:
A miniature fountain pen crafted in minute
detail. Difficult to use, though.
translation:
En ince detaylariyla yapilmis minyatur bir
dolma kalem. Ama kullanmasi zor.

original: Crayon Drawing
translation: Mum Boya Resmi

original:
A crayon sketch of my parents from my
youth. Never could throw it away.
translation:
Cocuklugumdan kalma, ailemin mum boyayla
cizilmis bir eskizi. Hic atamadim.

original: Fluorescent Honey
translation: Floresan Bal

original:
Its vivid colours look suspect, but it is
in fact delicious and highly nutritious.
translation:
Canli renkleri supheli duruyor ama aslinda
cok lezzetli ve oldukca besleyici.

original: Triumphant Emblem
translation: Zafer Amblemi

original:
Precious few could wear this emblem with
the pride and dignity it merits.
translation:
Bu amblemi hak ettigi gurur ve
asaletle tasiyabilecek kisi cok azdir.

original: Feeble Lamp
translation: Zayif Lamba

original:
Giving off no more light than a match,
this lantern provides little comfort.
translation:
Bir kibritten fazla isik vermeyen
bu fener pek teselli etmez.

original: Alarming Clock
translation: Urkutucu Saat

original:
Its violent alarm leaves none in doubt
whether they're awake or in dreamland.
translation:
Siddetli alarmi, uyanik misin ruyada mi
hic suphe birakmaz.

original: Weighted Scales
translation: Agirlikli Terazi

original:
These scales can't make any useful
judgements with those uneven arms.
translation:
Bu terazinin kollari dengesiz; dogru durust
olcum yapamaz.

original: Glossy Scarf
translation: Parlak Atki

original:
A beautiful scarf for a special day.
Who knows when that might be?
translation:
Ozel bir gun icin guzel bir atki.
O gun ne zaman olur, kim bilir?

original: Beloved Diary
translation: Sevgili Gunluk

original:
It's filled with somebody's memories.
Some of the anecdotes are...colourful.
translation:
Birinin anilariyla dolu.
Bazi anekdotlar... renkli.

original: Ferocious Beast
translation: Vahsi Canavar

original:
A stuffed tiger toy sold at the circus.
It might pounce at any moment!
translation:
Sirkten alinmis pelus bir kaplan.
Her an uzerine atlayabilir!

original: Shimmer Lens
translation: Isiltili Mercek

original:
This unusual lens makes unremarkable
scenes wave and shimmer like magic.
translation:
Bu tuhaf mercek siradan manzaralari
sihir gibi dalgalandirip parildatir.

original: Tinned Lunch
translation: Konserve Ogle Yemegi

original:
The latest fast food innovation: lunch
in a tin! The menu changes daily, too.
translation:
Fast food'un son icadi: tenekede
ogle yemegi! Menu de her gun degisir.

original: Booby Prize
translation: Teselli Odulu

original:
Why are prizes only for winners? This
facetious trophy upends convention.
translation:
Oduller neden sadece kazananlara? Bu
alayci kupa gelenegi tersyuz eder.

original: Generous Slot Machine
translation: Comert Slot Makinesi

original:
You'll hit the jackpot every time.
But it won't make you any richer.
translation:
Her seferinde buyuk ikramiyeyi vurursun.
Ama seni daha zengin yapmaz.

original: Ghost Husk
translation: Hayalet Kabugu

original:
A skin shed by a ghost?! Its existence
is baffling, but it has a certain appeal.
translation:
Bir hayaletin doktugu deri mi?! Varligi
akil almaz ama bir cekiciligi var.

original: Lucky Ticket
translation: Sansli Bilet

original:
A winning ticket for a raffle with rich
sponsors. Sadly, it's long out of date.
translation:
Zengin sponsorlu bir cekilisin kazanan bileti.
Ne yazik ki suresi coktan gecmis.

original: Tumbler Clown
translation: Devrilen Palyaco

original:
A toy clown with unusual charm. Knock it
over and back up it bounces!
translation:
Tuhaf bir cekiciligi olan oyuncak palyaco. Devir
ve tekrar ziplayip ayaga kalksin!

original: Calligraphed Hieroglyphics
translation: Hatla Yazilmis Hiyeroglifler

original:
This script fragment must be millennia old,
but the penmanship's still legible.
translation:
Bu yazi parcasi binlerce yillik olmali,
ama yazisi hala okunakli.

original: Whispering Seashell
translation: Fisildayan Deniz Kabugu

original:
Close your eyes and hold it up to your ear
to hear the whispering of the sea.
translation:
Gozlerini kapatip kulagina gotur,
denizin fisiltisini duy.

original: Lustrous Crystals
translation: Parlak Kristaller

original:
This simple crystal cluster contains a
phantasmic world of light and colour.
translation:
Bu basit kristal kumesi,
isik ve renkten hayalimsi bir dunya barindirir.

original: Dobey-Dobey Doll
translation: Dobey-Dobey Bebegi

original:
A fairly coarse doll made of clay. The
name is just something I thought up.
translation:
Kilden yapilmis oldukca kaba bir bebek. Ismini
oylesine uydurdum.

original: Mineral Nugget
translation: Mineral Parcasi

original:
A nugget packed with minerals. It has no
great value, but it's still beautiful.
translation:
Minerallerle dolu bir parca. Pek
degeri yok ama yine de guzel.

original: Paradox Cufflink
translation: Paradoks Kol Dugmesi

original:
An artistic piece expressing the ironies
and anguish of the modern era.
translation:
Modern cagin ironilerini ve
acilarini anlatan sanatsal bir parca.

original: Wooden Chap
translation: Ahsap Adamcik

original:
What are the origins of this sculpture?
Who made it, and why? No one knows.
translation:
Bu heykelin kokeni nedir?
Kim yapti, neden yapti? Kimse bilmiyor.

original: Teardrop Bud
translation: Gozyasi Tomurcugu

original:
The leaves of this droopy plant resemble
teardrops on the verge of falling.
translation:
Bu sarkik bitkinin yapraklari,
dusmek uzere olan gozyaslarina benzer.

original: Noon Glory
translation: Ogle Isiltisi

original:
A fruit that can only be gathered by day.
Juicy sweet with a floral bouquet.
translation:
Sadece gunduz toplanabilen bir meyve.
Sulu, tatli; ciceksi bir aromasi var.

original: Dusk Star
translation: Alacakaranlik Yildizi

original:
Found only in the deep dark of night.
Handle with care, as it hates sunlight.
translation:
Sadece gecenin zifiri karanliginda bulunur.
Gunes isigindan nefret eder; dikkatle tasi.

original: Stealth Balloon
translation: Gizli Balon

original:
Its surface was designed to reflect light.
Remarkably hard to see by day.
translation:
Yuzeyi isigi yansitacak sekilde tasarlanmis.
Gunduz fark etmek sasirtici derecede zor.

original: Desert Footprint
translation: Col Ayak Izi

original:
This camel's foot ornament highlights the
padded underside. A perfect souvenir.
translation:
Bu deve ayagi susu, yastikli alt
kismi vurgular. Mukemmel bir hatira.

original: Grandiose Diorama
translation: Gorkemli Diorama

original:
A scale model of Ch{^a}teau Dalston. Its
stone castle design suits him to a T.
translation:
Ch{^a}teau Dalston'un olcekli bir maketi. Tas sato
tasarimi ona cuk oturuyor.

original: Borrowed Shovel
translation: Odunc Kurek

original:
My best friend gave me this shovel. It
reminds me of the trials we overcame.
translation:
En iyi arkadasim bu kuregi bana verdi. Birlikte
atlattigimiz sinavlari hatirlatiyor.

original: Enigma Coin
translation: Muamma Parasi

original:
It looks a bit like a hint coin but it's a
fake. And what does {''}R{''} stand for?
translation:
Biraz ipucu parasina benziyor ama
sahte. Peki {''}R{''} neyin kisaltmasi?

original: Last Jigsaw Piece
translation: Son Yapboz Parcasi

original:
A lone jigsaw piece. You never realise
a piece is missing until the end.
translation:
Tek basina bir yapboz parcasi. Bir parcanin
eksik oldugunu ancak en sonda anlarsin.

original:
These scales can't make any useful
judgements with those uneven pans.
translation:
Bu terazinin kefeleri dengesiz; dogru durust
olcum yapamaz.

original:
Found in the Akbadain ruins. The
penmanship is impressive.
translation:
Akbadain harabelerinde bulundu. Yazisi
etkileyici.

original:
Found in the Akbadain ruins. Hold it to
your ear to hear the whispering sea.
translation:
Akbadain harabelerinde bulundu. Kulagina
gotur, denizin fisiltisini duy.

original:
Found in the Akbadain ruins. Filled with
a whole world of light and colour.
translation:
Akbadain harabelerinde bulundu. Isik ve renkten
olusan koca bir dunya dolu.

original:
Found in the Akbadain ruins. A crude clay
doll with a charmingly cheerful face.
translation:
Akbadain harabelerinde bulundu. Neseli yuzlu,
kaba bir kil bebek.

original:
Found in the Akbadain ruins. It's a nugget
made up of various minerals.
translation:
Akbadain harabelerinde bulundu. Cesitli
minerallerden olusan bir parca.

original:
This droopy plant resembles a teardrop
on the verge of falling.
translation:
Bu sarkik bitki, dusmek uzere olan bir
gozyasina benzer.

original:
Found only in the dark deep of night.
Handle with care, as it hates sunlight.
translation:
Sadece gecenin zifiri karanliginda bulunur.
Gunes isigindan nefret eder; dikkatle tasi.

original: Desert Hoofprint
translation: Col Toynak Izi

original:
This ornament represents a camel's
hoofprint. The perfect souvenir.
translation:
Bu sus, bir devenin
toynak izini temsil eder. Mukemmel bir hatira.

original: The Collection Box Explained
translation: Koleksiyon Kutusu Aciklamasi

original:
Here are the rare and interesting
items obtained on your adventure!
Touch for details.
translation:
Macera boyunca elde ettigin nadir ve ilginc
esyalar burada!
Ayrintilar icin dokun.

original: 名前登録メニュー
translation: Isim Kayit Menusu

original: You can't use that name.
translation: Bu adi kullanamazsin.

original: パスワード入力
translation: Sifre Girisi

original:
Incorrect password. You
may have made a mistake
in entering the password.
translation:
Sifre hatali.
Sifreyi girerken
hata yapmis olabilirsin.

original: 名前入力説明文
translation: Isim Girisi Aciklamasi

original: Please enter your name.
translation: Lutfen adini gir.

original: UGC対応説明文
translation: Kullanici Icerigi Aciklamasi

original: 説明文（ペット）
translation: Aciklama (Evcil Hayvan)

original: Give your new rabbit a name.
translation: Yeni tavsanina bir ad ver.

original: Memories of Misthallery
translation: Misthallery Anilari

original:
Enter the password from Professor
Layton and the Spectre's Call.
For more information, please refer to
the instruction booklet.
translation:
Professor Layton and the Spectre's Call
oyunundaki sifreyi gir.
Daha fazla bilgi icin
kullanim kilavuzuna bak.

original: The Hidden Door of Monte d'Or
translation: Monte d'Or'un Gizli Kapisi

original:
Enter the password from the sixth
game of the series.
For more information, please refer
to the instruction booklet.
translation:
Serinin altinci oyunundaki
sifreyi gir.
Daha fazla bilgi icin
kullanim kilavuzuna bak.

original: Layton
translation: Layton

original: Luke
translation: Luke

original: Emmy
translation: Emmy

original: 日刊ナゾ通信(説明文)
translation: Gunluk Bulmaca Haberleri (Aciklama)

original: The Alchemist's Lair
translation: Simyacilarin Siginagi

original:
In a dank, abandoned basement, a group of
alchemists study to this day, experimenting
with chemicals of multitudinous colours,
all in the hope of turning lead to gold.
translation:
Nemli, terk edilmis bir bodrumda bir grup
simyaci bugun bile calisiyor, turlu
renkte kimyasallarla deneyler yapiyor,
tek amaclari kursunu altina cevirmek.

original: Tetraton
translation: Tetraton

original:
Lunch. Holidays. Shopping. The mind is
always filled with thoughts. But by
combining four different thoughts together,
you can wash your worries away and live
a stress-free life.
translation:
Ogle yemegi. Tatil. Alisveris. Zihin
hep dusuncelerle doludur. Ama dort
farkli dusunceyi birlestirirsen,
derdin tasan silinir ve
stresten uzak bir hayat yasarsin.

original: Ghouls and Guards
translation: Hortlaklar ve Muhafizlar

original:
This gloomy castle has been besieged by
uninvited ghosts! Use the magical mirrors
to vanquish them with the light of justice!
How does it work, you ask? Well...might is
right!
translation:
Bu kasvetli kale davetsiz
hayaletlerce kusatildi! Sihirli aynalari
kullanip onlari adaletin isigiyla yok et!
Nasil mi calisiyor diyorsun? Ee... guc
haklidir!

original: Big Block Box
translation: Koca Blok Kutusu

original:
Playtime's over and everyone had a lot of
fun, but now it's time to tidy up. Putting
away all the blocks may seem like a chore
at first, but it's very satisfying to fit them
all into place.
translation:
Oyun bitti, herkes cok eglendi,
ama simdi toparlanma zamani. Bloklari
toplamak once angarya gibi
gelebilir, ama hepsini yerine
oturtmak cok tatmin edici.

original: Pen Pals
translation: Mektup Arkadaslari

original:
In a sunny place far, far away, the animals
are looking for a new place to stay! Give
them a nice, safe pen to live in!
translation:
Gunesli, cok uzak bir yerde hayvanlar
yeni bir yuva ariyor! Onlara
yasayacaklari guvenli bir agil yap!

original: Food Chain
translation: Besin Zinciri

original:
Mmm, aren't these carrots delicious! And
they stretch as far as the eye can see!
If I eat all these, I'll be bouncing off the
burrows! Who's afraid of a big bad wolf,
anyway?
translation:
Mmm, bu havuclar nefis degil mi! Hem
goz alabildigine uzaniyor!
Hepsini yersem inlerden sekerek
firlarim! Hem koca kotu kurttan
kim korkar ki?

original: Bewitching Night
translation: Buyuleyici Gece

original:
As the neighbourhood witch, I take my
duties seriously. It's up to me to keep
the streets nice and bright, without
breaking the bank.
translation:
Mahallenin cadisi olarak gorevlerimi
ciddiye alirim. Sokaklari
parlak ve guzel tutmak bana duser,
ama butceyi de delmeden.

original: Tomb of the Ancients
translation: Kadimlerin Mezari

original:
Here we are at last - the tomb entrance!
If we can just connect up all the ancient
hieroglyphs, we'll be as rich as kings!
I don't care how many doors we have to
go through!
translation:
Iste sonunda geldik - mezarin girisi!
Tum kadim hiyeroglifleri
baglayabilirsek krallar kadar zengin oluruz!
Kac kapidan gecmemiz gerektigi
umurumda degil!

original: Feuding Fiefdoms
translation: Kavgaci Beylikler

original:
Beneath the fa{,c}ade of peace, a vicious
struggle for power threatens the very
foundation of our country. I beseech you,
aid us by dividing our fiefs into their
respective areas!
translation:
Baris goruntusunun altinda amansiz
bir iktidar kavgasi, ulkemizin
temelini tehdit ediyor. Yalvaririm,
timarlarimizi
bolgelerine ayirarak bize yardim et!

original: Perilous Voyage
translation: Tehlikeli Yolculuk

original:
Calm waters, blue sky... Yet the perils
of the ocean are many. We must map out
a safe path lest ships who follow in our
stead should be dashed upon the rocks!
All hands on deck!
translation:
Sakin sular, mavi gokyuzu... Ama
okyanusun tehlikesi cok. Ardimizdan
gelen gemiler kayalara carpmasin diye
guvenli bir rota cizmeliyiz!
Herkes guverteye!

original: Whose Tile Is It Anyway?
translation: Bu Kare Kimin?

original:
Ladies and gentlemen, we are proud to
present to you the greatest show in history!
Please, move the tiles before you into the
frame, and watch the show unfold before
you!
translation:
Hanimefendiler, beyefendiler; tarihin
en buyuk gosterisini sunmaktan gurur duyariz!
Lutfen onunuzdeki karolari
cerceveye yerlestirin ve
gosteriyi izleyin!

original: Sweet Truth
translation: Tatli Gercek

original:
Oh no, this just won't do! Have you ever
seen sweets arranged in such a dreadfully
haphazard way? Oh, my poor babies. Well?
Don't just stand there! Sort it out!
translation:
Aman hayir, boyle olmaz! Hic
bu kadar berbat bir daginiklikla
dizilmis tatli gordun mu? Ah, zavalli bebeklerim. Eee?
Oylece durma! Duzenle sunlari!

original: A Dish Too Far
translation: Bir Tabak Fazla

original:
Good evening! Table for 13? Right this
way. Ah, table for 24, madam? No, no,
that's absolutely fine. We have the
country's finest chefs. I guarantee that
all your food will be served piping hot!
translation:
Iyi aksamlar! 13 kisilik masa mi? Hemen
buyurun. 24 kisilik masa mi, hanimefendi? Hayir hayir,
hic sorun degil. Ulkenin
en iyi sefleri bizde. Tum yemeklerinizin
dumani ustunde servis edilecegine garanti veririm!

original: Little Lost Ducklings
translation: Kayip Yavru Ordekler

original:
The tranquillity of the duck pond has been
shattered by the quacking of lost ducklings.
Reunite them with their mothers to stop
their tears, but be careful. They're still wild.
translation:
Ordek goletinin huzuru
kayip yavru ordeklerin vakvaklariyla bozuldu.
Gozyaslari dinsin diye onlari anneleriyle
bulustur, ama dikkatli ol. Daha evcillesmediler.

original: St Bronto's
translation: St Bronto's

original:
The Archaeopteryx crowing signals the end
of school for these knowledge-hungry
dinosaurs. Each one makes its way home,
avoiding confrontation. Better safe than
saut{'e}ed.
translation:
Archaeopteryx'in otusu
bu bilgiye ac dinozorlar icin
dersin bittigini haber verir. Her biri
catismadan kacinarak evine gider. Kizarmaktansa
temkinli olmak iyidir.

original: Flight Path
translation: Ucus Rotasi

original:
Look, I said I want you to map me out
a flight path! What? No, I don't care how
you do it, as long as it gets me where
I want to go. Yes, it can overlap. But no
T-junctions, understand?
translation:
Bak, sana bana bir ucus rotasi
ciz dedim! Ne? Nasil yaptigin umurumda degil,
yeter ki beni istedigim yere gotursun.
Evet, yollar ust uste binebilir. Ama
T-kavsagi yok, anlasildi mi?

original: Trains and Trainspotters
translation: Trenler ve Tren Meraklilari

original:
Rule no. 1 of the trainspotter's handbook:
Make stops on all bridges! Rule no. 2 of
the trainspotter's handbook: Never pass
under any bridges! ...Ah, here it comes!
Get in position!
translation:
Tren meraklisi el kitabi kural 1:
Tum koprulerde dur! Kural 2:
Hicbir koprunun altindan gecme!
... Ah, iste geliyor!
Pozisyon al!

original: Sun, Sand and Tortoises
translation: Gunes, Kum ve Kaplumbagalar

original:
The desert weren't so bad, really. They 'ad
these oases and whatnot. Always a pair o'
tortoises around them oases too. Beautiful
place, but by 'eck were it scorching!
translation:
Col aslinda o kadar da kotu degildi. Soyle
vaha falan vardi. O vahalarin yaninda hep bir
cift kaplumbaga da olurdu. Guzel
yerdi ama aman Allah'im, ne sicakti!

original: The Barking Beat
translation: Havlayan Devriye

original:
This is an urgent safety awoofment.
Criminal riff-raff have escaped from Her
Majesty's woofest and they're hiding out in
Bonesbury Woofs! There's no time to woof.
Arrest those ruffians!
translation:
Bu acil bir guvenlik havurusu.
Suclu ayak takimi Majestelerinin
en havlamali hapishanesinden kacti ve
Bonesbury Woofs'ta saklaniyor! Havlamaya vakit yok.
O serserileri yakalayin!

original: Pipework Patch-up
translation: Boru Tesisati Tamiri

original:
The park's ruddy pipework has gone to pot
and no one is amused! Get a move on with
those repairs, will you?! The park needs its
water supply!
translation:
Parkin lanet boru tesisati bozuldu,
kimse de eglenmiyor! Su onarimlara
bir an once girissenize?! Parkin
suya ihtiyaci var!

original: ナゾーバ
translation: Nazoba

original:
<T><M1/1/1>It is I, the beautiful and clairvoyant...
Elizabeth!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Benim, guzel ve durugorulu...
Elizabeth!

original:
<T>I can't help but notice you've solved one of
my darlings!
translation:
<T>Gormeden edemiyorum, canimlarimdan birini
cozmussun!

original: <T><M3/2/1>Not bad. Not bad at all.
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Fena degil. Hic fena degil.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Allow me to bestow upon you one fine item
of furniture!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Sana seckin bir mobilya parcasi
armagan etmeme izin ver!

original:
<T>Well it's a start, but you're going to need
a bit of d{'e}cor! A lot, in fact!
translation:
<T>Iyi, baslangic sayilir ama biraz dekora
ihtiyacin var! Hatta cok!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But don't think you can just swap furniture
in and out willy-nilly! Do you know how
much work that takes?
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama mobilyayi kafana gore cikarip
takabilecegini sanma! Bunun ne kadar
is oldugunu biliyor musun?

original: <T>At least give it some thought first!
translation: <T>En azindan once biraz dusun!

original: <T><M3/2/1>Ehee hee hee!
translation: <T><M3/2/1>Ehee hee hee!

original:
<T>The furniture you ordered should turn up
right at your doorstep.
translation:
<T>Siparis ettigin mobilya yakinda
kapina dayanir.

original:
<T><M1/1/1>We shall give you another royal reward after
you've solved a few more puzzles!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Birkac bulmaca daha cozdukten sonra
sana bir kraliyet odulu daha verecegiz!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>My, look at the time. My poor dears will be
starving! Toodle-oo!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Aa, saate bak! Zavalli canlarim
acliktan bayilacak! Hosca kal!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>We are proud to present another reward of
the highest calibre! Ehee hee hee!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>En ust kalitede bir odul daha sunmaktan
gurur duyuyoruz! Ehee hee hee!

original: <T>You may pick one item and one item only!
translation: <T>Yalnizca bir esya secebilirsin, sadece bir tane!

original: <T><M2/1/1>But don't take all day!
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Ama butun gununu de alma!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>You, connoisseur of rare and delectable
puzzles - you have been granted your wish!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sen, nadir ve leziz bulmacalarin
ustasi... Dilegin kabul edildi!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>In the name of the beautiful and clairvoyant
Elizabeth, look no further.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Guzel ve durugorulu Elizabeth adina,
daha fazla arama.

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Within these sacrosanct halls are the very
rarest of puzzles, puzzles I've traversed the
world to collect.
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Bu kutsal salonlarda en nadir bulmacalar,
toplamak icin dunyayi dolastigim
bulmacalar sakli.

original:
<T>What's more, I have one for every day of
the year! That's a whole 365 puzzles!
translation:
<T>Ustelik yilin her gunu icin bir tane var!
Toplam tam 365 bulmaca!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>But if you want to get your eager little hands
on them, you'll have to do as I say!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ama hepsine hevesli ellerinle ulasmak
istiyorsan, dedigimi yapmalisin!

original:
<T>Touch the <CR>Download</CR> icon on the Touch
Screen.
translation:
<T>Dokunmatik Ekran'daki <CR>Indir</CR> simgesine
dokun.

original: <T><M1/1/1>Go on, do it now! Touch <CR>Download</CR>!
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Hadi, hemen yap! <CR>Indir</CR>'e dokun!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Ooh, I've been waiting for this! You'd better
roll up your sleeves, because it's time to get
remodelling!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Oooh, bunu bekliyordum! Kollari sivasan iyi olur,
cunku tadilat zamani geldi!
Basliyoruz!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>It's your big chance to fill your room with
the fittings and fixtures you've being fawning
over!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Odani, hayran hayran baktigin
donanim ve mobilyalarla doldurmak icin
kocaman bir firsat!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>Ehee hee hee! Now pick a piece of
furniture, and we can get cracking!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ehee hee hee! Simdi bir mobilya sec,
ve ise koyulalim!

original: レイトン
translation: Layton

original: <T><M2/1/1>Remarkable.
translation: <T><M2/1/1>Olaganustu.

original:
<T>It appears you've managed to solve all
{''}%s{''} puzzles.
translation:
<T>Gorunuse gore tum
{''}%s{''} bulmacayi cozmeyi basarmissin.

original:
<T><M3/1/1>I've had my eye on a delightful piece on
display in Covent Garden for a while now.
translation:
<T><M3/1/1>Bir suredir Covent Garden'da sergilenen
harika bir parcaya goz koymustum.

original:
<T><M6/1/1>But I think you deserve it more than I. In
fact, it's on the way to your house as we
speak.
translation:
<T><M6/1/1>Ama bence onu benden daha cok sen hak ediyorsun. Hatta
su anda
evine dogru yola cikti.

original: <T><M5/2/1>What's this?
translation: <T><M5/2/1>Bu da ne?

original: <T>Visitors? I can't say I expected this.
translation: <T>Ziyaretciler mi? Bunu beklemiyordum dogrusu.

original: アルダス
translation: Aldus

original: <T><M2/2/1>Marvellous, absolutely marvellous!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Muhtesem, gercekten muhtesem!

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Ehee hee hee! You took the words right out
of my mouth.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ehee hee hee! Tam agzimdan aldin!
Diyecegimi soyledin.

original:
<T>To think that anyone could have the tenacity
and wit to solve <CR>all 365 of my precious
puzzles</CR>!
translation:
<T>Birinin bu kadar azimli ve zeki olup
<CR>degerli 365 bulmacamin hepsini
cozebilecegini</CR> dusunmek bile!

original: <T><M2/2/1>Now this is a cause for celebration!
translation: <T><M2/2/1>Iste bu kutlama sebebi!

original: <T><M4/1/1>Oh, I am beyond words, my friends!
translation: <T><M4/1/1>Ah, kelimeler kifayetsiz dostlarim!

original: <T><M1/1/1>See, this is why I brought Peachy along.
translation: <T><M1/1/1>Gordun mu, Peachy'i yanimda getirmemin sebebi buydu.

original: <T>You brought it with you, I hope?
translation: <T>Yaninda getirdin, degil mi?

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Ha ha ha ha! There is no need for doubt. Be
the nights hot or cold, I will be there still to
warm your hearts!
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Ha ha ha ha! Supheye gerek yok. Geceler
ister sicak ister soguk olsun, ben yine orada olur,
kalplerinizi isitirim!

original:
<T>I have been permitted so humbly by this
pinnacle of the sublime, the gorgeous
Elizabeth, to gift you with a present.
translation:
<T>Yuceligin zirvesi olan o muhtesem
Elizabeth tarafindan nacizane izin verildi;
sana bir hediye sunacagim.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Gorgeous and clairvoyant! How many times
do I have to tell you?
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Muhtesem ve durugorulu! Kac kere
soyleyecegim sana?

original:
<T><M3/2/1>But it breaks my weeping heart to tell you
that the present...<W>it is not here.
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Ama soylemek zorundayim; aglayan kalbimi
paramparca ediyor: hediye...<W> burada degil.

original:
<T><M3/2/1>Where is the present, you ask?<W> For you, my
beloved friend, we have gone one step
more. It has already been sent!
translation:
<T><M3/2/1>Hediye nerede mi diyorsun?<W> Senin icin,
sevgili dostum, bir adim daha oteye gittik.
Hediye coktan gonderildi!

original:
<T><M4/1/1>I have spent the long nights toiling and
broiling over this special gift. Please, it is
a token of my warmth.
translation:
<T><M4/1/1>Bu ozel hediye icin uzun geceler calisip
didinip durdum. Lutfen kabul et;
bu, icten sicakligimin bir isareti.

original: <T>And now, good day to you all!
translation: <T>Simdi hepinize iyi gunler!
<T>Sey<K>...

original:
<T><M1/1/1>Well...<W> Aldus aside, your present should be
winging its way to you this very moment.
translation:
<T><M1/1/1>Sey...<W> Aldus bir yana, hediyen su anda bile
sana dogru ucuyor olmali.

original:
<T>It's something a bit more special than what
we're used to giving you. Now you can't say
we don't care!
translation:
<T>Bu, sana vermeye alistiklarimizdan biraz daha ozel bir sey.
Artik
umursamadigimizi soyleyemezsin!

original:
<T><M2/1/1>A heartfelt congratulations to you for your
diligent effort!
translation:
<T><M2/1/1>Ozverili caban icin seni
yurekten tebrik ederim!

original: Download puzzles?
translation: Bulmacalar indirilsin mi?

original:
Daily Puzzle data transfer.

If no extra data for this game is
present on the SD Card, new extra
data will be created.
translation:
Gunluk Bulmaca veri aktarimi.

Bu oyun icin ek veri SD Kartta
yoksa, yeni ek veri
olusturulacaktir.

original:
To use this feature, you
must accept the terms of the
Nintendo 3DS Service User
Agreement.
translation:
Bu ozelligi kullanmak icin,
Nintendo 3DS Hizmet Kullanici
Sozlesmesi'nin
sartlarini kabul etmelisin.

original: Checking the SD Card...
translation: SD Kart kontrol ediliyor...

original: Checking save data...
translation: Kayit verisi kontrol ediliyor...

original: Creating data on the SD Card...
translation: SD Kartta veri olusturuluyor...

original: Connecting to the internet...
translation: Internete baglaniliyor...

original: Downloading...
translation: Indiriliyor...

original: Checking downloaded data...
translation: Indirilen veri kontrol ediliyor...

original:
Download complete. Number of
new puzzles downloaded: %d
translation:
Indirme tamamlandi. Indirilen
yeni bulmaca sayisi: %d

original:
Download complete. Your puzzle
list is already up to date.
translation:
Indirme tamamlandi. Bulmaca
listen zaten guncel.

original:
Download failed.
Please try again later.
translation:
Indirme basarisiz.
Lutfen daha sonra tekrar dene.

original: Cancelling download...
translation: Indirme iptal ediliyor...

original: Download cancelled.
translation: Indirme iptal edildi.

original: No SD Card present.
translation: SD Kart takili degil.

original: An error has occurred.
translation: Bir hata olustu.

original: Saving...
translation: Kaydediliyor...

original: Now saving...
translation: Kaydediliyor...

original: Puzzle %03d: %s
translation: Bulmaca %03d: %s

original: Puzzle D%02d: %s
translation: Gunluk Bulmaca D%02d: %s

original:
You solved the puzzle
{''}%s{''}!
translation:
Bulmacayi cozdun
{''}%s{''}!

original:
You solved that puzzle without looking
at a single hint! Great job!
translation:
O bulmacayi tek bir ipucuna bile bakmadan
cozdun! Harika is!

original:
You viewed %d hint while solving this
puzzle.
translation:
Bu bulmacayi cozerken %d ipucu
gordun.

original:
You viewed %d hints while solving
this puzzle.
translation:
Bu bulmacayi cozerken %d ipucu
gordun.

original:
There are currently no puzzles
for you to solve here.
translation:
Su anda burada cozebilecegin
hic bulmaca yok.

original:
Solve puzzle %03d,
{''}%s{''}?
translation:
Bulmaca %03d,
{''}%s{''} cozulsun mu?

original: Puzzle D%02d: {''}%s{''}
translation: Gunluk Bulmaca D%02d: {''}%s{''}

original: Elizabeth's Shack
translation: Elizabeth'in Kulubesi

original: Retry the puzzle?
translation: Bulmaca yeniden denensin mi?

original:
Save data has been corrupted
and will be erased.
translation:
Kayit verisi bozuldu
ve silinecek.

original:
The data could not be written.
Turn off the power and reinsert
the Nintendo 3DS Card.

Kaydi acik olan StreetPass'in
kayitli oldugu oyun karti bu degil.

Sorun devam ederse, Sistem Ayarlari'ndan

original:

when locked. Turn off the power and
unlock the SD Card.

SD Kart yazmaya karsi korumali.

Kart kilitliyken SD Karta veri
yazilamaz. Gucu kapatin ve
SD Kartin kilidini acin.

original:

Please turn off the power and make
sure the SD Card is properly inserted
into the Nintendo 3DS system.

SD Kart takili degil.

Lutfen gucu kapatin ve SD Kartin
Nintendo 3DS sistemine dogru sekilde
takili oldugundan emin olun.

original:

in the SD Card slot.

and check the SD Card.
translation:
SD Kart yuvasina taninmayan
bir kart takilmis.

Lutfen gucu kapatin
ve SD Karti kontrol edin.

original:
There is not enough space on the
SD Card to create extra data.

on the SD Card.
translation:
SD Kartta ek veri olusturmak icin
yeterli bos alan yok.

Lutfen SD Karttaki kullanilmayan
verileri silin.

original:

Please try again later.

SpotPass etkinlestirilemedi.

Indirme baslatilamadi.
Lutfen daha sonra tekrar deneyin.

original:
Could not access the extra data. Hold
down the POWER Button to turn off
the power and reinsert the SD Card.

If the problem persists, please delete
the extra data in the System Settings.

If the extra data cannot be deleted,
the SD Card may need to be
formatted.

Ek verilere erisilemedi. Gucu kapatmak icin
POWER dugmesini basili tutun ve
SD Karti cikarip yeniden takin.

Sorun devam ederse, Sistem Ayarlari'ndan
ek verileri silin.

Ek veriler silinemiyorsa, SD Kartin
bicimlendirilmesi gerekebilir.

original: Assemble the robot!
translation: Robotu birlestir!

original:
This robot comes in four parts: head, body,
arms and legs. To put the parts together, all
you have to do is put each part into one of
the four yellow boxes, then flip the switch.
The only problem is you're not sure what
order they'll be assembled in or which way
up they'll be!

Can you put the robot back together
correctly? You can rotate the parts as well
as move them. When all the parts are in
place, touch <CR>Submit</CR> to start the assembly
machinery.
translation:
Bu robot dort parcadan olusuyor: bas, govde,
kollar ve bacaklar. Parcalari birlestirmek icin tek
yapman gereken, her parcayi dort sari kutudan
birine koymak ve sonra dugmeyi cevirmek.
Tek sorun, hangi sirayla birlestirileceklerini ya da
hangi yonde duracaklarini
bilmiyor olman!

Robotu tekrar bir araya
dogru sekilde getirebilir misin? Parcalari dondurebilir
ve yerlerini de degistirebilirsin. Tum parcalar
yerine oturdugunda, montaj
makinesini baslatmak icin <CR>Submit</CR> secenegine
dokun.

original:
Correct!

Now the toy robot is fully assembled and
ready to be played with.
translation:
Dogru!

Artik oyuncak robot tamamen monte edildi ve
oynamaya hazir.

original:
Too bad.

Try to take it step by step.
translation:
Maalesef.

Adim adim dene.

original:
You don't have to think too hard here. You
can just work by trial and error.

To start with, put each part in any box and
start the machinery. Then watch them fall
one at a time and try to work out how the
boxes' contents are handled during the
assembly process. In what order are they
put together, and how are they each
rotated?
translation:
Burada cok fazla zorlamana gerek yok. Sadece
 deneme-yanilma ile ilerleyebilirsin.

Once her parcayi herhangi bir kutuya koyup
makineyi calistir. Sonra parcalarin birer birer
dususunu izle ve kutularin icindekilerin
montaj sirasinda nasil islendigini anlamaya
calis. Hangi sirayla birlestiriliyorlar ve her biri
nasil donduruluyor?

original:
If you followed Hint 1, you've probably
worked out the order in which the boxes'
contents are put together.

Now place the parts in the boxes so that
the robot is built from its legs first, then
body, then arms, then head. You can think
about the rotation later.
translation:
1. ipucunu takip ettiysen, muhtemelen
kutularin icindekilerin hangi sirayla
birlestirildigini anlamissindir.

Simdi parcalari kutulara, robot once bacaklardan,
sonra govdeden, sonra kollardan, sonra bastan
olusacak sekilde yerlestir. Dondurmeyi sonra
dusunebilirsin.

original:
Here's part of the solution: place the body
in the rightmost box and rotate it so it's
upside down.
translation:
Cozumun bir kismi: Govdeyi
en sagdaki kutuya koy ve ters olacak sekilde
dondur.

original:
Put the parts in the boxes in the following
order, from left to right: arms, legs, head,
body.

There's no need to rotate the legs - they
can go in the right way up. Now just work
out how the arms and head need to be
rotated and the robot is complete!
translation:
Parcalari kutulara soldan saga su sirayla koy:
kollar, bacaklar, bas,
govde.

Bacaklari dondurmene gerek yok - dogru yonde
koyabilirsin. Simdi sadece
kollarin ve basin nasil dondurulmesi gerektigini bul
ve robot tamam!

original: Find the little girl's mum!
translation: Kucuk kizin annesini bul!

original:
You've got it in the bag!

The correct answer is B. Thank goodness
the little girl found her mum!
translation:
Iste dogru canta!

Dogru cevap B. Neyse ki
kucuk kiz annesini buldu!

original:
Too bad.

Quick, find the girl's mum for her!
translation:
Ne yazik.

Cabuk, kiz icin annesini bul!

original:
Pay close attention to what the little girl said.

One detail is that her mum has red hair. That
means it can't be A.

C might have red hair, but he's definitely not
the girl's mum.
translation:
Kucuk kizin soylediklerine dikkatlice bak.

Bir ayrinti, annesinin kizil sacli olmasi. Bu da
A olamayacagi anlamina gelir.

C'nin saclari kizil olabilir ama kesinlikle
kizin annesi degil.

original:
The remaining candidates are B, D and E.

Of these, only D has a handbag that fits the
description of {''}pink with a bear on it{''}.
However, judging by what D says, it's not
actually her handbag. These three women's
handbags were all mixed up somehow.
translation:
Geriye kalan adaylar B, D ve E.

Bunlardan sadece D'nin el cantasi
{''}uzerinde ayi olan pembe{''} tarifine uyuyor.
Ancak D'nin soylediklerine bakilirsa bu
aslinda onun cantasi degil. Bu uc kadinin
cantalari bir sekilde karismis.

original:
E says that the handbag she's holding has
the wrong pattern. The only other pattern on
these women's handbags is the star on the
bag B is holding.

Furthermore, D says that her handbag is
blue. This must be the bear-patterned blue
handbag that E is holding.
translation:
E, elindeki cantanin deseninin
yanlis oldugunu soyluyor. Bu kadinlarin
cantalarindaki tek diger desen, B'nin
tuttugu cantadaki yildiz.

Ayrica D, cantasinin
mavi oldugunu soyluyor. Bu, E'nin elindeki
ayi desenli mavi canta olmali.

original:
E's original handbag is the blue one with the
star pattern.

D's original handbag is the blue one with the
bear pattern.

Whoever is left must be the owner of the pink
bag with the bear pattern - and hence the
little girl's mum.
translation:
E'nin asil cantasi yildiz desenli
mavi olan.

D'nin asil cantasi ayi desenli
mavi olan.

Geriye kalan kisi, ayi desenli pembe
cantanin sahibi olmali - yani
kucuk kizin annesi.

original: [Moved to ID 166]
translation: [ID 166'ya tasindi]

original: [Not used]
translation: [Kullanilmiyor]

original: Untangle the strings!
translation: Ipleri coz!

original:
This clumsy clown has got caught up in his
balloon strings. Give Luke and Layton a
hand in untangling the strings.

Touch any of the orange points on the
Touch Screen to swap around the strings to
the left and right of that point. Keep at it until
you can free the poor clown!

It's possible to untangle all four strings in as
few as three moves.
translation:
Bu sakar palyaco balon
iplerine dolanmis. Luke ve Layton'a
ipleri cozmekte yardim et.

Dokunmatik Ekran'daki turuncu
noktalardan herhangi birine dokunup
o noktanin solundaki ve sagindaki ipleri
yer degistir. Zavalli palyacoyu kurtar!

Dort ipin tamamini yalnizca
uc hamlede cozmek mumkun.

original:
Correct!

Thank goodness you got him down quickly.
Now the balloons are free to float gently
in the breeze.
translation:
Dogru!

Neyse ki onu cabucak indirdin.
Artik balonlar ruzgarda
usulca suzulebilir.

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
When you switch the strings around, they
move in a very particular way. Try touching
