everywhere and just seeing what happens
until you get the hang of it.

Don't worry if the strings get tangled up
beyond all recognition. You can touch
<CR>Restart</CR> as many times as you like.
translation:
Ipleri yer degistirince,
cok belirli bir sekilde hareket ederler. Dokunup
her yerde ne olduguna bakmayi dene,
alisana kadar devam et.

Ipler iyice karissa bile
endiselenme. Istedigin kadar
<CR>Yeniden Baslat</CR>'a dokunabilirsin.

original:
When you touch an orange point to switch
the strings around, pay attention to the
green points near it.

The green points to the top left and bottom
left of the orange point swap with those on
the top right and bottom right.

This also indicates how the strings move.
Look carefully.
translation:
Ipleri yer degistirmek icin turuncu bir
noktaya dokundugunda,
yakinindaki yesil noktalara dikkat et.

Turuncu noktanin sol ust ve sol altindaki
yesil noktalar, sag ust ve sag altindakilerle
yer degistirir.

Bu, iplerin nasil hareket ettigini de gosterir.
Dikkatlice bak.

original:
Here's some more specific advice to get you
started.

First, touch the orange point in the top-right
corner. This will untangle one of the strings.

That leaves only three.
translation:
Baslamana yardimci olacak daha
spesifik bir tavsiye:

Once sag ust kosedeki turuncu
noktaya dokun. Bu, iplerden birini cozecek.

Geriye sadece uc tane kalacak.

original:
Following on from Hint 3, the next orange
point to touch is the one in the centre.

Now just touch one more point and the
strings will be completely untangled.
translation:
Ipucu 3'un devaminda, siradaki turuncu
dokunacagin nokta ortadaki.

Simdi bir noktaya daha dokun ve
ipler tamamen cozulsun.

original: Predict the next number!
translation: Siradaki sayiyi tahmin et!

original:
The numbers on this giant slot machine
aren't random. In fact, there's a rule that
determines the sequence of numbers that
appears every time you activate it. Your task
is to work out the rule and predict what
four-digit number will appear next. Be
warned, though - you only have five
chances.

Touch the numbers on the Touch Screen to
make your prediction. When you're ready,
touch the orange button to activate the slot
machine.
translation:
Bu dev slot makinesindeki sayilar
rastgele degil. Aslinda, onu her calistirdiginda
gorunen sayi dizisini belirleyen
bir kural var. Gorevin,
kurali bulup sirada hangi
dort basamakli sayinin cikacagini tahmin etmek.
Ama dikkat - yalnizca bes
hakkin var.

Tahminini yapmak icin Dokunmatik Ekrandaki
sayilara dokun. Hazir olunca,
slot makinesini calistirmak icin turuncu dugmeye
dokun.

original:
Correct!

Every four-digit number corresponds to a
date - specifically, the last day of a month.
The next number in the sequence is the last
day of the next month. You just have to
watch out for February, which only has
28 days.

Good thing it doesn't deal with leap years!
translation:
Dogru!

Her dort basamakli sayi bir
tarihe karsilik gelir - ozellikle bir ayin son gunune.
Dizideki sonraki sayi, bir sonraki ayin
son gunudur. Sadece
yalnizca 28 gunu olan Subat'a
dikkat etmelisin.

Neyse ki artik yillarla ugrasmiyor!

original:
Too bad.

Better luck next time!
translation:
Olmadi.

Bir dahaki sefere daha sansli ol!

original:
Pay attention to the pair of numbers in the
two rightmost slots.

It appears this is a two-digit number that
goes up by one each time. Well, almost each
time.
translation:
En sagdaki iki yuvadaki
sayi ciftine dikkat et.

Gorunuse gore bu, her seferinde
bir artan iki basamakli bir sayi. Yani, neredeyse her
seferinde.

original:
The two leftmost slots don't change very
much. They seem to almost always display
either 30 or 31. What could be the
significance of that?
translation:
En soldaki iki yuva cok
degismiyor. Neredeyse her zaman
30 ya da 31 gosteriyor. Bunun
anlami ne olabilir?

original:
The pair of numbers on the left and the pair
of numbers on the right go together and form
a set.

Furthermore, the two rightmost slots just
cycle through the numbers 01 to 12. What
could this mean?
translation:
Soldaki sayi cifti ile sagdaki sayi cifti
birlikte gider ve bir
takim olusturur.

Ayrica, en sagdaki iki yuva sadece
01'den 12'ye kadar sayilar arasinda
dongu yapiyor. Bu ne
anlama gelebilir?

original:
It turns out that the numbers in the slot
machine are dates. Each time, it shows you
the last day of a month and the month itself.
That should make it fairly simple to work out
the next number.

You don't have to worry about leap years.
translation:
Meger slot
makinesindeki sayilar tarihlermis. Her seferinde sana
bir ayin son gununu ve ayin kendisini gosteriyor.
Bu da
sonraki sayiyi bulmayi oldukca kolaylastirmali.

Artik yillari dusunmene gerek yok.

original: Repaint one house!
translation: Bir evi yeniden boya!

original:
Correct!

Repainting the rightmost house in yellow
satisfies all the tenants' conditions.

Never mind the cost of materials and labour,
the landlord ought to charge all four of them
for the time it took to work out which house
to paint!
translation:
Dogru!

En sagdaki evi sariya
boyamak, tum kiracilarin
sartlarini karsilar.

Malzeme ve iscilik masraflarini
bos ver; ev sahibi, hangi evi
boyayacagini bulmak icin
harcadiklari zamanin bedelini
dordunden de almali!

original:
Too bad.

Take another look at the tenants' conditions
and see whose house colour and position
you can work out for certain.
translation:
Olmadi.

Kiracilarin sartlarina bir daha
goz at ve kimin ev rengini ve
konumunu kesin olarak
cikarabildigini gor.

original:
You can reduce the complexity of this
puzzle by thinking about how the tenants'
requirements limit the houses they can
move into. For example, ② doesn't want
to be on the ends of the row, so they can
only be in house B or C.

Now take a look at ②'s other requirement
and see which of those two houses you
could put them in.
translation:
Bu bulmacayi, kiracilarin
isteklerinin onlari hangi
evlere gidebilecekleri konusunda
nasil kisitladigini dusunerek
basitlestirebilirsin. Ornegin, ②
siranin uclarinda olmak istemiyor,
bu yuzden sadece B ya da C
evinde olabilir.

Simdi ②'nin diger sartina bak ve
bu iki evden hangisine
yerlestirebilecegini dusun.

original:
Let's suppose ② moves into house B. That
would require house C to be repainted.

If you paint C red, that leaves A as the only
house that ④ could move into (neither red
nor blue). ③ then has to move into either
house C or house D, but neither satisfies
their requirements. So house C can't be
painted red.
translation:
Diyelim ki ② B evine tasindi. Bu
durumda C evinin yeniden
boyanmasi gerekir.

C'yi kirmiziya boyarsan, ④'un
tasinabilecegi tek ev A kalir
(ne kirmizi ne mavi). ③ ise
C ya da D evine tasinmak
zorunda kalir, ama ikisi de
sartlarini karsilamaz. Demek ki
C evi kirmizi olamaz.

original:
Continuing the line of thought from Hint 2,
let's say ② still moves into house B, but this
time you paint house C yellow. That means
that ① and ③ can take house A or C, leaving
house D for ④. However, house D doesn't
satisfy ④'s requirements.

So out of the two houses, B and C, that ②
could move into, there is no way to repaint
C and make everyone happy. Thus ② has to
take house C.
translation:
Ipucu 2'deki dusunceyi surdurup
②'nin yine B evine tasindigini
varsayalim, ama bu kez C evini
sariya boyayalim. O zaman ① ve
③ A ya da C evini alabilir, D evi
ise ④'e kalir. Ancak D evi ④'un
sartlarini karsilamaz.

Yani ②'nin gidebilecegi iki evden
(B ve C), C'yi boyayip herkesi
memnun etmenin bir yolu yok.
Bu yuzden ② C evini almak zorunda.

original:
From the previous hints, you know that ②
moves into house C. This leaves no house
that ③ can move into, unless one of either
B or D is painted yellow.

Painting B yellow would let ③ move into
house D, but then there would be no red
house for ① to live next door to.

Only one possibility remains.
translation:
Onceki ipuclarindan, ②'nin
C evine tasindigini biliyorsun.
Bu durumda ③'un gidebilecegi
hicbir ev kalmaz; ancak B ya da D
sariya boyanirsa olur.

B'yi sariya boyamak ③'un D evine
tasinmasini saglar, ama o zaman ①'in
yaninda yasayacagi kirmizi bir ev
kalmaz.

Geriye tek bir olasilik kaliyor.

original: How many boxes will fit?
translation: Kac kutu sigar?

original:
You have two wooden crates without lids.
All the inside dimensions of both crates
(length, width, height) are 30 cm.

You also have numerous boxes with a length
and width of 20 cm and a height of 10 cm.
You want to pack as many of these into the
crates at once as possible.

If you use both crates, what's the maximum
number of boxes that you can fit at once?
There mustn't be any part of the boxes
sticking out of the crates.
translation:
Kapagi olmayan iki ahsap sandigin var.
Her iki sandigin ic olculeri
(uzunluk, genislik, yukseklik) 30 cm.

Ayrica uzunlugu ve genisligi 20 cm,
yuksekligi 10 cm olan cok sayida kutun var.
Bunlardan mumkun oldugunca cogunu ayni anda
sandiklara yerlestirmek istiyorsun.

Iki sandigi da kullanirsan, ayni anda
en fazla kac kutu sigdirabilirsin?
Kutularin hicbir kismi sandiklarin disina
tasmamali.

original:
You pack some brainpower!

12 boxes will fit. The trick is to put the two
crates together with the open sides facing
each other. Then you can carry more boxes
without any of them sticking out.
translation:
Aklini kullanmissin!

12 kutu sigar. Puf noktasi iki
sandigi acik yuzleri birbirine bakacak
sekilde birlestirmek. Boylece daha fazla
kutu, hicbiri disari tasmadan sigar.

original:
Too bad.

There's a trick to this. Try to think outside
the box, so to speak.
translation:
Olmadi.

Bunun bir puf noktasi var. Tabiri caizse
kutunun disini dusunmeye calis.

original:
Let's establish this straight off: if you use
the crates in the normal way, you can only
fit five boxes in each one.
translation:
Once sunu netlestirelim: sandiklari
normal sekilde kullanirsan, her birine
sadece bes kutu sigdirabilirsin.

original:
If you can fit five boxes in each crate, the
maximum number of boxes should be ten.

There's more to it than that, however. Try to
think of other ways you can use the crates.
You should find a way to fit more boxes
inside.
translation:
Her sandiga bes kutu sigdirabiliyorsan,
maksimum kutu sayisi on olmali.

Ama is bununla bitmiyor. Sandiklari
kullanmanin baska yollarini dusun.
Icine daha fazla kutu sigdirmanin bir
yolunu bulmalisin.

original:
When you fill up one of these crates, there
is always some space left over. Is there
some way you could use this space
effectively?
translation:
Bu sandiklardan birini doldurdugunda,
her zaman biraz bosluk kalir. Bu boslugu
etkili bicimde kullanmanin bir yolu
olabilir mi?

original:
When filling the crates separately, you can
only fit five boxes in each. However, if you
put the two crates together, with the open
sides facing each other, there is space for
an extra two boxes.

How many does that add up to?
translation:
Sandiklari ayri ayri doldurursan, her birine
sadece bes kutu sigar. Ancak iki sandigi,
acik yuzleri birbirine bakacak sekilde
birlestirirsen, fazladan iki kutuluk
yer olusur.

Bu toplamda kac eder?

original: Who ate which slice?
translation: Hangi dilimi kim yedi?

original:
A, B and C each ate one of three differently
sized slices of strawberry gateau.

A: {''}C ate the medium slice, and B had the
large one.{''}
B: {''}A had the large slice, and I had the
medium one.{''}

A and B have each made one statement that
is true and one that is false. Can you work
out who ate which slice? Move the slices
onto the plates to answer.
translation:
A, B ve C, cilekli pastanin uc farkli
buyuklukteki diliminden birer tane yedi.

A: {''}C orta dilimi yedi, B de
buyuk olani yedi.{''}
B: {''}A buyuk dilimi yedi, ben de
orta olani yedim.{''}

A ve B ikiser ifade soyledi; birisi
dogru, birisi yanlis. Hangi dilimi kimin
yedigini bulabilir misin? Cevap icin dilimleri
tabaklarin uzerine tasi.

original:
Correct!

The small slice was eaten by B, the medium
slice by C and the large slice by A.

A must have wanted to cover up her greed,
but why did B bother to lie?
translation:
Dogru!

Kucuk dilimi B, orta
dilimi C, buyuk dilimi de A yedi.

A, acgozlulugunu gizlemek istemis olmali,
peki B neden yalan soyledi?

original:
Too bad.

Have another look at the statements and
consider them one at a time.
translation:
Olmadi.

Ifadeleri bir kez daha incele ve
tek tek dusun.

original:
A and B each stated two things, one of which
is true and one false. Start with one of A's
statements, assume it's a lie and see how
that affects the rest of the statements.
translation:
A ve B ikiser sey soyledi; bunlardan biri
dogru, digeri yanlis. A'nin ifadelerinden
biriyle basla, onun yalan oldugunu varsay
ve bunun diger ifadeleri nasil etkiledigine bak.

original:
Let's assume that A's statement that {''}C ate
the medium slice{''} is false. That would mean
that the statement {''}B had the large one{''}
must be true.

If that were true, however, both of B's
statements would be false. You know for sure
that one of B's statements is true, so the
original assumption is faulty.
translation:
A'nin {''}C orta dilimi yedi{''} sozunun
yanlis oldugunu varsayalim. Bu durumda
{''}B buyuk olani yedi{''} sozu dogru
olmak zorunda kalir.

Ama bu dogru olsaydi, B'nin
iki ifadesi de yanlis olurdu. B'nin
ifadelerinden birinin kesinlikle dogru
oldugunu biliyorsun, yani
baslangic varsayimi hatali.

original:
Since the assumption in Hint 2 was proven
faulty, A's statement that {''}C ate the medium
slice{''} must be true.

This should tell you which of B's statements
is false. Look at each in turn.
translation:
2. Ipucu'ndaki varsayim hatali ciktigina gore,
A'nin {''}C orta dilimi yedi{''} sozu
dogru olmali.

Bu da B'nin hangi sozunun
yanlis oldugunu gosterir. Ikisini de
sirayla kontrol et.

original:
The previous hints have shown that C ate
the medium slice, so B's statement {''}I had
the medium one{''} is false. That must mean
that B's other statement {''}A had the large
slice{''} is true. The rest is easy!
translation:
Onceki ipuclari C'nin
orta dilimi yedigini gosterdi; o halde
B'nin {''}Ben orta olani yedim{''} sozu
yanlistir. Bu da B'nin diger sozu olan
{''}A buyuk dilimi yedi{''} ifadesinin
dogru oldugu anlamina gelir. Gerisi kolay!

original: Flip the pizza face up!
translation: Pizzayi yuzu yukari cevir!

original:
A renowned but clumsy chef prepared this
mouth-watering margherita pizza and cut it
into eight slices. Unfortunately, he somehow
managed to flip all but one of them over in
the process.

He's tried his best to flip the slices back up,
but the cheese is spread so thickly that
every time he flips one, the adjacent slices
turn over with it.

Can you find a way to flip the slices so they
all face the right way up?
translation:
Unlu ama sakar bir sef bu
istah acici margarita pizzayi hazirlayip
sekiz dilime boldu. Ne yazik ki, bir sekilde
surecte bir tanesi haric hepsini
ters cevirmeyi basardi.

Dilimleri yeniden duz cevirmeye calisti,
ama peynir o kadar kalin surulmus ki
her seferinde birini cevirince, yanindaki dilimler de
onunla birlikte ters donuyor.

Tum dilimleri
dogru tarafa bakacak sekilde cevirebilir misin?

original:
Magnifico!

You can flip the entire pizza face up in just
three moves. How did you get on?
translation:
Mukemmel!

Tum pizzayi sadece
uc hamlede yuzu yukari cevirebilirsin. Nasil gittin?

original:
Too bad.

Try not to flip it over too many times or you'll
just end up in a sticky mess.
translation:
Olmadi.

Cok fazla cevirmemeye calis, yoksa
sadece yapis yapis bir karmasaya donusur.

original:
Seven of the eight slices are facing down, so
flipping three of them up seems like a good
idea to start with. But even if you get six
of them the right way up, one will still be
face down.

The more difficult-seeming method may in
fact be the simplest.
translation:
Sekiz dilimin yedisi ters duruyor, bu yuzden
uc tanesini duz cevirmek iyi bir
baslangic gibi gorunuyor. Ama alti tanesini
dogru tarafa cevirsen bile, biri hala
ters kalacak.

Daha zor gorunen yontem
aslinda en basiti olabilir.

original:
You should be able to solve it straight away
once you know which slice to flip first.
There's only one slice that's face up, and
this slice must be one of the three that are
flipped in the first move.
translation:
Hangi dilimi once cevirecegini bilirsen
bunu hemen cozebilmelisin.
Yuzu yukari bakan yalnizca bir dilim var ve
bu dilim, ilk hamlede cevrilen uc dilimden
biri olmali.

original:
Try flipping over either slice next to the one
facing up. Now look how the face-down
slices are arranged. It should be easy to flip
the whole pizza over in just two more moves.
translation:
Yuzu yukari olan dilimin yanindaki dilimlerden
birini cevirmeyi dene. Simdi ters duran
dilimlerin nasil dizildigine bak. Sadece iki hamlede
tum pizzayi cevirmek kolay olmali.

original:
Assuming you start by flipping the slice to the
right of the one facing up, that leaves the
whole top-right quarter facing up. Now you
just need to flip the remaining slices up in
sets of three and you're done!
translation:
Yuzu yukari olan dilimin sagindaki dilimi
cevirerek basladigini varsayarsak, bu
sag ust ceyregin tamamini yuzu yukari birakir. Simdi
kalan dilimleri uclu
gruplar halinde cevirmen yeter, bitti!

original: How many litres per bottle?
translation: Sise basina kac litre?

original:
The owner of a juice factory wanted to send
a gift to three important customers. To make
sure no one was offended, they were all
given 18 litres of juice, but there weren't
enough of each bottle size to make the
shipments identical. Still, the owner was able
to make up three shipments of 18 litres
using different sets of small, medium and
large bottles.

Can you work out how many litres of juice
each size of bottle holds? All the sizes are
whole numbers, by the way.
translation:
Bir meyve suyu fabrikasinin sahibi
uc onemli musterisine bir hediye
gondermek istedi. Kimse kirilmasin
diye hepsine 18 litre meyve suyu
verdi, ancak her boy siseden yeterince
olmadigindan gonderiler ayni olamadi.
Yine de sahibi, 18 litrelik uc paketi
kucuk, orta ve buyuk siselerin farkli
kombinasyonlariyla hazirlayabildi.

Her boy sisenin kac litre aldigini
bulabilir misin? Bu arada hepsi
tam sayidir.

original:
That's right!

The large bottle holds six litres, the medium
holds three, and the small holds one.

That's a lot of juice!
translation:
Dogru!

Buyuk sise alti litre, orta sise
uc litre, kucuk sise ise bir litre alir.

Bu da bayagi meyve suyu!

original:
Try again.

Each combination of bottles adds up to
18 litres. Bear that in mind.
translation:
Tekrar dene.

Sise kombinasyonlarinin her biri
18 litre eder. Bunu unutma.

original:
B and C each received six small bottles.
Remove those from the equation and the
remainder of their shipments will tell you
that one large bottle is equal to two medium
ones.
translation:
B ve C'nin her biri alti kucuk sise aldi.
Bunlari denklemden cikarirsan,
kalan kisim sana
bir buyuk sisenin iki orta
siseye esit oldugunu gosterir.

original:
Hint 1 demonstrated that one large bottle
equals two medium bottles. You can thus
replace the large bottle in A's shipment with
two medium ones, giving a total of five
medium bottles.

A has five medium and three small bottles.
C has four medium and six small bottles.

So you know that one medium bottle is
equivalent to three small bottles.
translation:
Ipucu 1, bir buyuk sisenin
iki orta siseye esit oldugunu gosterdi. Bu yuzden
A'nin paketindeki buyuk siseyi
iki orta siseyle degistirebilirsin; boylece toplam
bes orta sise elde edersin.

A'nin bes orta ve uc kucuk sisesi var.
C'nin dort orta ve alti kucuk sisesi var.

Boylece bir orta sisenin
uc kucuk siseye denk oldugunu bilirsin.

original:
You already replaced the large bottle in A's
shipment with two medium ones in the last
hint. Now take it one step further: replace
each medium bottle with three small ones.
A now has 18 small bottles.

Since the total shipment size is 18 litres, you
know that each small bottle must contain one
litre of juice.
translation:
Son ipucunda A'nin paketindeki buyuk siseyi
iki orta siseyle zaten degistirdin.
Simdi bir adim daha ilerle: her orta siseyi
uc kucuk siseyle degistir.
Artik A'nin 18 kucuk sisesi var.

Toplam miktar 18 litre olduguna gore,
her kucuk sisenin
bir litre meyve suyu icerdigini bilirsin.

original:
Let's summarise what you've worked out
from the previous hints.

1 large bottle = 2 medium bottles
1 medium bottle = 3 small bottles
1 small bottle = 1 litre of juice

With this information, it shouldn't take you
long to work out how many litres the medium
and large bottles hold.
translation:
Onceki ipuclarindan
cikarip bulduklarini ozetleyelim.

1 buyuk sise = 2 orta sise
1 orta sise = 3 kucuk sise
1 kucuk sise = 1 litre meyve suyu

Bu bilgilerle,
orta ve buyuk siselerin
kac litre aldigini bulman uzun surmez.

original: Who's Mr Blue?
translation: Bay Mavi kim?

original:
Well played!

The lying Mr Brown is C. Since his statement
is false, D must be Mr Blue.
translation:
Iyi oynadin!

Yalan soyleyen Bay Kahverengi C'dir. Soyledigi
yanlis olduguna gore D Bay Mavi olmali.

original:
Too bad.

Pay attention to the fact that you already
know the name of the person who lied.
translation:
Maalesef.

Yalan soyleyen kisinin adini zaten
bildigine dikkat et.

original:
Only Mr Brown is lying. Since he is one of
the three people the caddy spoke to, you
can start by supposing one of A, B or C is
Mr Brown. Then look at how that works with
the others' statements, and how that
statement being false affects everything else.
translation:
Yalnizca Bay Kahverengi yalan soyluyor.
Caddie'nin konustugu uc kisiden biri oldugu icin,
once A, B veya C'den birinin
Bay Kahverengi oldugunu varsayabilirsin. Sonra
bu varsayimin digerlerinin ifadeleriyle
nasil uyustuguna ve
o ifadenin yanlis olmasinin her seyi nasil etkiledigine bak.

original:
Let's say that A is Mr Brown. That would
make his statement false, and B's statement
true, so B is neither Mr Black nor Mr Blue.
C's statement must also be true, meaning
that D is Mr White.

However, that leaves Mr Brown as the only
possibility for B's identity, and you already
started on the assumption that A was
Mr Brown, so this scenario is impossible.
translation:
Diyelim ki A, Bay Kahverengi olsun. Bu,
ifadesini yanlis yapar ve B'nin ifadesini dogru,
yani B ne Bay Siyah ne de Bay Mavi olur.
C'nin ifadesi de dogru olmali; bu da
D'nin Bay Beyaz oldugu anlamina gelir.

Ancak bu durumda B'nin kimligi icin tek olasilik
Bay Kahverengi kalir. Oysa en basta A'nin
Bay Kahverengi oldugunu varsaymistik,
yani bu senaryo imkansizdir.

original:
Let's move on to B and assume he is
Mr Brown. It doesn't take long to see that
this isn't possible, as B's statement {''}I'm not
Mr Blue!{''} cannot be a lie if he is really
Mr Brown.

So now you know who must be lying.
translation:
Simdi B'ye gecelim ve onun
Bay Kahverengi oldugunu varsayalim. Bunun
mumkun olmadigini hemen gorursun; cunku
B'nin {''}Ben Bay Mavi degilim!{''} ifadesi,
eger gercekten Bay Kahverengi ise
yalan olamaz.

Artik kimin yalan soylemesi gerektigini biliyorsun.

original:
We know now that C must be Mr Brown,
whose statement is a lie. A must then be
telling the truth when he says that B is
Mr Black. This doesn't contradict B's own
statement, either.

So D must be either Mr Blue or Mr White.
Since C's statement is a lie, that means D
can only be...?
translation:
Artik C'nin, yalan soyleyen
Bay Kahverengi olmasi gerektigini biliyoruz. Bu durumda A,
B'nin Bay Siyah oldugunu soylerken
dogruyu soylemis olmali. Bu, B'nin kendi
ifadesiyle de celismez.

O halde D ya Bay Mavi ya da Bay Beyazdir.
C'nin ifadesi yalan olduguna gore D ancak...?

original: Enter the row and seat.
translation: Sira ve koltuk numarasini gir.

original:
Correct!

Ms A was in row 6, seat 4.

Right at the back! Oh dear... At first she
seemed very fussy, but anyone would
complain about that seat.
translation:
Dogru!

Bayan A 6. sirada, 4. koltuktaydi.

En arkada! Ah canim... Basta cok huysuz
gibi gorunuyordu ama herkes o koltuga
sikayet ederdi.

original:
Too bad.

Read each of Ms A's statements carefully
and narrow down the possibilities.
translation:
Olmadi.

Bayan A'nin her cumlesini dikkatle oku
ve olasiliklari daralt.

original:
Let's narrow down the options a little. We
can deduce from ① that Ms A had at least
two seats on either side of her.

That should be enough to get you started.
translation:
Hadi secenekleri biraz daraltalim. ①'den,
Bayan A'nin iki yaninda en az ikiser koltuk
oldugunu cikarabiliriz.

Baslamak icin bu yeter.

original:
② tells us that Ms A must have had at least
one row of seats in front of her.
translation:
② bize Bayan A'nin onunde en az
bir sira daha oldugunu soyluyor.

original:
③ is quite specific, and lets us narrow it
down further to:
seat 3 or 10 in row 3 or 4, or
seat 4 or 12 in row 5 or 6
translation:
③ oldukca net ve bizi su olasiliklara
indiriyor:
3. ya da 4. sirada 3 veya 10. koltuk, ya da
5. ya da 6. sirada 4 veya 12. koltuk

original:
Take the list of possible seats in the previous
hint and find one where the difference
between the row number and seat number
is 2.

That's where Ms A was sitting.
translation:
Bir onceki ipucundaki olasi koltuk listesinden,
sira numarasi ile koltuk numarasinin
farkinin 2 oldugu birini bul.

Bayan A'nin oturdugu yer orasi.

original: What's the correct time?
translation: Dogru saat kac?

original:
Correct!

It's 1:25 in the morning! It was a nice
evening, but it's time to go home to bed.
translation:
Dogru!

Sabah 1:25! Guzel bir aksamdi,
ama artik eve gidip yatma zamani.

original:
Too bad.

Compare the times on the top screen with
the statement made by each person.
translation:
Olmadi.

Ust ekrandaki saatleri
her kisinin soyledigiyle karsilastir.

original:
Start off by ordering the different watch times
shown from the latest time to the earliest.

Now, how does that relate to the four
people's statements?
translation:
Once ust ekranda gorunen farkli saatleri
gec olandan erken olana dogru sirala.

Simdi bunun dort
kisinin sozleriyle nasil iliskili olduguna bak.

original:
The fastest watch reads 1:35, and the
slowest one reads 1:05.

The person with the slowest watch is A,
and the one with the fastest watch is D.
translation:
En hizli saat 1:35'i, en
yavas olan ise 1:05'i gosteriyor.

En yavas saate sahip kisi A,
en hizli saate sahip kisi de D.

original:
As long as you start with either the slowest
or fastest watch, the answer should be clear.

A has the slowest watch, and it says 1:05.
translation:
En yavas ya da en hizli
ten baslayinca cevap netlesir.

A'nin saati en yavastir ve 1:05'i gosterir.

original:
A's watch is 20 minutes slow.

A's watch reads 1:05.

So what's the correct time?
translation:
A'nin saati 20 dakika geri.

A'nin saati 1:05 gosteriyor.

Oyleyse dogru saat kac?

original: Which segments are lit?
translation: Hangi parcalar yaniyor?

original:
The sign for this shop has the logo in the
middle, surrounded by eight orange neon
lights. Each light consists of a circle
divided into 16 segments, some of which
glow blue according to a certain pattern.

Can you work out which segments should be
lit in the top circle, marked with a question
mark? Touch a segment to light it blue or
turn it off.
translation:
Bu dukkanin tabelasinda logo ortada,
etrafinda sekiz turuncu neon
isik var. Her isik, 16 parcaya
bolunmus bir daireden olusuyor ve bazi parcalar
belirli bir duzene gore mavi yaniyor.

Soru isaretiyle isaretlenmis ust dairede
hangi parcalarin
yanmasi gerektigini bulabilir misin? Bir parcaya dokun
mavi yak ya da kapat.

original:
Correct!

If you compare the circles going clockwise
around the sign, one of the lit segments
moves four places anticlockwise and the
other moves two places clockwise in each
subsequent circle. So in the top circle, the
two lit segments overlap and only one is lit.
translation:
Dogru!

Tabelanin etrafindaki daireleri saat yonunde
karsilastirirsan, yanan parcalardan biri
her sonraki dairede saat yonunun tersine dort
adim, digeri ise saat yonunde iki adim ilerler.
Bu yuzden ust dairede
iki yanan parca ust uste gelir ve yalnizca biri yanar.

original:
Too bad.

Have a good look at the lit segments on
each circle in turn.
translation:
Olmadi.

Her bir dairede yanan parcalara
sirayla iyice bak.

original:
Each circle has two lit segments. They may
not look like it at first, but they do follow a
pattern.

Compare neighbouring circles and see if you
can work out the pattern.
translation:
Her dairede iki yanan parca var. Ilk bakista
oyle gorunmeyebilir ama bir
duzene uyuyorlar.

Komsu daireleri karsilastir ve
duzeni bulup bulamayacagina bak.

original:
The two lit segments in each circle move
according to two different rules.

Count how many spaces each lit segment
moves between circles.
translation:
Her dairedeki iki yanan parca
iki farkli kurala gore hareket ediyor.

Her yanan parcanin
daireler arasinda kac bosluk ilerledigini say.

original:
If you start with one circle and move
clockwise around the sign, you'll notice
that one of the lit segments is moving
two spaces clockwise within the circle
each time.

What about the other one?
translation:
Bir daireden baslayip tabelanin etrafinda
saat yonunde ilerlersen,
yanan parcalardan birinin
dairenin icinde her seferinde saat yonunde
iki bosluk ilerledigini fark edeceksin.

Peki ya digeri?

original:
Moving clockwise around the sign, the
other lit segment is moving four spaces
anticlockwise within the circle each time.

There's no easy way to tell which segment
is which, so you'll just have to compare the
circles and work out where the lit segments
go in the top circle.
translation:
Tabelanin etrafinda saat yonunde ilerlerken,
diger yanan parca her seferinde
daire icinde saat yonunun tersine dort bosluk ilerliyor.

Hangi parcanin hangisi oldugunu anlamanin kolay bir yolu yok,
bu yuzden daireleri karsilastirip
yanan parcalarin ust dairede
nereye gittigini bulmalisin.

original: Divide the board!
translation: Tahtayi bol!

original:
You want to cut this unusual 6 x 6
chessboard into four pieces that are the
same shape, have an equal area and each
contain one white pawn and one black pawn.

Can you work out how to do it?

Draw lines on the board to show where to
cut it. Keep in mind that solutions may be
rotated, but cannot be mirrored.
translation:
Bu siradisi 6 x 6
satranc tahtasini dort parcaya kesmek
istiyorsun; parcalar ayni sekle sahip,
alanlari esit olacak ve her biri
bir beyaz piyon ile bir siyah piyon icerecek.

Bunu nasil yapacagini bulabilir misin?

Nereden kesecegini gostermek icin tahtaya
cizgiler ciz. Cozumler dondurulebilir,
ancak ayna goruntusu olamaz.

original:
Correct!

That was nicely cut!
translation:
Dogru!

Guzel kestin!

original:
Try again.

Start from somewhere you know will have to
be cut.
translation:
Tekrar dene.

Kesilmesi gerektigini bildigin bir yerden
basla.

original:
Look at the four white pawns in the centre of
the board. One of these will have to go into
each of the four separate pieces, so you can
draw a cross to cut between them.

Extend that cross so that the whole board is
divided into quarters. You'll see that the
top-left section doesn't have a black pawn
in it. What can you do to fix that?
translation:
Tahtanin ortasindaki dort beyaz piyona bak.
Bunlarin her biri, dort ayri parcadan birine
gitmek zorunda. Bu yuzden aralarindan
gececek sekilde bir arti isareti cizebilirsin.

Bu artiyi uzatip tum tahtayi dorde bol.
Sol ust bolumde siyah piyon olmadigini
goreceksin. Bunu duzeltmek icin
ne yapabilirsin?

original:
Continuing from Hint 1, let's try to make
the top-left section include a black pawn.

Draw lines so that the top-left quarter
includes the squares A4, A5 and B5.

Now that section has a black pawn, but
the shapes are off...
translation:
1. Ipucundan devam edelim; sol ust bolumun
bir siyah piyon icermesini saglayalim.

Sol ust ceyrek, A4, A5 ve B5 karelerini
icerecek sekilde cizgiler ciz.

Artik o bolumde siyah piyon var, ama
sekiller uyusmuyor...

original:
Now try to change the shape of the other
sections to match that of the section you
adjusted in Hint 2. Draw lines so that the
bottom-left quarter includes the squares
D6, E6 and E5.

The shapes still aren't identical, but they're
getting closer...
translation:
Simdi diger bolumlerin seklini, 2. Ipucunda
ayarladigin bolumle ayni olacak sekilde
degistirmeye calis. Sol alt ceyrek,
D6, E6 ve E5 karelerini
icerecek sekilde cizgiler ciz.

Sekiller hala birebir degil, ama
yaklasiyorsun...

original:
Draw lines so that the bottom-right section
includes the squares F3, F2 and E2.

Next, draw so that the top-right section
includes the squares C1, B1 and B2.

How does that look?
translation:
Sag alt bolum, F3, F2 ve E2
karelerini icerecek sekilde cizgiler ciz.

Sonra sag ust bolum, C1, B1 ve B2
karelerini icerecek sekilde ciz.

Nasil gorunuyor?

original: Predict the next number!
translation: Bir sonraki sayiyi tahmin et!

original:
Here is an unusual slot machine: the
numbers that appear when it is activated
aren't random, but obey some sort of rule.
Your task is to work out the rule and predict
what four-digit number will appear next.
However, you only have five chances to get
it right, so think carefully!

Touch the numbers on the Touch Screen to
make your prediction. When you're ready,
touch the orange button to activate the slot
machine.
translation:
Iste sira disi bir slot makinesi: calistirildiginda
cikan sayilar rastgele degil, bir kurala uyuyor.
Gorevin, bu kurali bulup bir sonraki
dort basamakli sayinin ne olacagini
tahmin etmek. Ancak dogru bilmek icin
sadece bes hakkin var, o yuzden dikkatli dusun!

Dokunmatik Ekran'daki sayilara dokunarak
tahminini gir. Hazir oldugunda,
turuncu dugmeye dokunup slot
makinesini calistir.

original:
Correct!

From left to right, the digits increase by the
following amount each time: 4, 3, 2, 1.

How many spins did it take you to get it?
translation:
Dogru!

Soldan saga, rakamlar her seferinde
su kadar artiyor: 4, 3, 2, 1.

Kac cevirmede bildin?

original:
Too bad.

Remember, there's a rule that determines
the next number. There's no use in just
guessing at random numbers!
translation:
Olmadi.

Unutma, bir sonraki sayiyi belirleyen
bir kural var. Rastgele sayi tutturmanin
bir faydasi yok!

original:
Since there's a rule that determines the next
number, the only way you can start working
it out is by activating the slot machine and
comparing the new number that appears to
the first one.

It gets easier the more numbers you have to
compare. Don't be shy - you can spin the
reels up to four times before you even need
to give an answer. Just don't forget to write
down the numbers as you go along!
translation:
Sonraki sayiyi belirleyen bir kural
olduguna gore, ise baslamanin tek yolu
slot makinesini calistirip cikan yeni sayiyi
ilk sayiyla karsilastirmaktir.

Karsilastiracak sayin arttikca is kolaylasir.
Cekinme-cevap vermen gerekmadan once
makineyi dort kez cevirebilirsin.
Yeter ki her seferinde cikan sayilari
yazmayi unutma!

original:
So, following on from Hint 1, what numbers
have come up so far? Compare them and
see if you notice anything. It may look like
completely unrelated sets of numbers, but
there must be some kind of rule determining
what will appear next.

Have you considered looking at each reel on
its own?
translation:
Oyleyse, Ipucu 1'in devami olarak,
simdiye kadar hangi sayilar cikti?
Onlari karsilastir ve bir sey fark edip
etmedigine bak. Tamamen alakasiz
gorunebilirler, ama bir sonraki sayiyi
belirleyen mutlaka bir kural vardir.

Her makarayi tek tek incelemeyi
dusundun mu?

original:
Activate the slot machine four times and
write down all the numbers one above the
other.

Next, look at the rightmost column of
numbers. Do you notice anything about
them? This digit seems to change by the
same amount every time.

Now compare the others to see if there's a
similar pattern!
translation:
Slot makinesini dort kez calistir ve
cikan tum sayilari alt alta yaz.

Sonra en sagdaki rakam sutununa bak.
Onlarla ilgili bir sey fark ediyor musun?
Bu rakam her seferinde ayni miktarda
degisiyor gibi.

Simdi digerlerini karsilastir-benzer
bir desen var mi?

original:
Based on Hint 3, you've probably realised
that the rightmost digit increases by one
each time. 9 changes to 0, but remember
that 0 can also be taken as the rightmost
digit of the number 10!

The other digits also increase by a fixed
amount each time. If you can work out how
much each one goes up by, predicting the
next number should be a walk in the park.
translation:
Ipucu 3'e gore muhtemelen en sagdaki
rakamin her seferinde bir arttigini
fark ettin. 9, 0'a doner ama unutma
0 ayni zamanda 10 sayisinin en sag
basamagi olarak da dusunulebilir!

Diger rakamlar da her seferinde sabit
bir miktarda artiyor. Her birinin ne
kadar yukseldigini bulabilirsen, bir
sonraki sayiyi tahmin etmek cocuk oyuncagi.

original: Flip the pizza face up!
translation: Pizzayi ustu yukari cevir!

original:
Another pizza gone wrong for our
ham-handed chef! This time, he managed
to flip exactly half the pizza upside down.

He tried to flip it back up, but the cheese
is spread just as thickly as the last pizza,
and every time he tries to flip a slice, the
adjacent slices turn over with it.

Can you find a way to get the whole pizza
back the right way up, toppings and all?
translation:
Bizim sakar sef yine bir pizzayi mahvetti!
Bu sefer pizzanin tam yarisini ters cevirmeyi
basardi.

Tekrar duzeltmeye calisti ama peynir gecen
pizzadaki kadar kalin yayilmis; bir dilimi
cevirmeye kalkinca, yanindaki dilimler de
onunla birlikte donuyor.

Tum pizzayi, malzemeleriyle birlikte,
yeniden dogru yone cevirebilir misin?

original:
Correct!

You can flip the whole pizza back up in just
four moves, you know.
translation:
Dogru!

Tum pizzayi sadece
dort hamlede duzeltebilirsin.

original:
Too bad.

You really don't need to flip it over that
many times.
translation:
Olmadi.

Onu o kadar cok cevirmene gerek yok.

original:
You may be tempted to go ahead and flip
over three slices on the right side of the
pizza, but don't be hasty.

That said, the first slice you need to flip is
on the right.
translation:
Sag taraftaki uc dilimi birden cevirmek
isteyebilirsin ama acele etme.

Yine de ilk cevirecegin dilim
sag tarafta.

original:
With your first move, you should flip two
slices up and one down. There are two
possible slices you can flip to achieve this,
but don't worry - you can finish in the
minimum number of moves either way.
translation:
Ilk hamlede iki dilimi yukari, bir dilimi asagi
getirmelisin. Bunu saglamak icin cevirebilecegin
iki olasi dilim var; ama endiselenme, hangisini
secersen sec en az hamleyle bitirebilirsin.

original:
Remember the two possible slices mentioned
in Hint 2? Your next move is to flip the
second one, the one you didn't pick last
time.

You should now have a similar pattern on the
opposite side.
translation:
Ipucu 2'de bahsedilen iki olasi dilimi hatirla.
Bir sonraki hamlende digerini cevir; yani
az once secmedigin dilimi.

Simdi karsi tarafta benzer bir desen
olusmali.

original:
Now it's time to flip a slice on the left side.
Resist the urge to pick a face-down slice and
flip one facing up. The puzzle is as good as
solved!
translation:
Simdi sol taraftan bir dilim cevirme zamani.
Ters duran bir dilimi secip cevirmek istegine
diren; yukari bakan birini cevir. Bulmaca
neredeyse cozuldu!

original: Which cabin is cheapest?
translation: Hangi kulube en ucuz?

original:
A family of five is visiting some hillside
cabins. There are four cabins available
and the prices vary: cabin A costs {po}200,
cabin B costs {po}400, cabin C costs {po}300
and cabin D costs {po}600. The cost is fixed
regardless of the number of residents, so
they are restricted only by space.

Which is the cheapest cabin that the whole
family can stay in? Give your answer by
positioning their sleeping bags inside a cabin
so that they all fit. The sleeping bags may
not overlap.
translation:
Bes kisilik bir aile, yamactaki
kulubeleri ziyaret ediyor. Dort kulube var
ve fiyatlar degisiyor: A kulubesi {po}200,
B kulubesi {po}400, C kulubesi {po}300
ve D kulubesi {po}600. Ucret, kisi sayisindan
bagimsiz sabit; yani onlari sinirlayan tek sey
alan.

Tum ailenin kalabilecegi en ucuz kulube
hangisi? Cevabini, uyku tulumlarini bir
kulubenin icine hepsi sigacak sekilde
yerlestirerek ver. Uyku tulumlari
ust uste gelemez.

original:
Correct!

The answer was cabin B. The only cabins
that the whole family can fit in are cabins
B and D, and B is the cheaper of the two.

If only they could sleep standing up, they'd
be able to stay in a much cheaper one!
translation:
Dogru!

Cevap B kulubesiydi. Tum ailenin
sigabildigi tek kulubeler B ve D,
ve bu ikisi icinde daha ucuz olan B.

Bir de ayakta uyuyabilselerdi,
cok daha ucuz birinde kalabilirlerdi!

original:
Too bad.

Perhaps you could try reading the question
again, in case you missed something.
translation:
Olmadi.

Belki bir seyi kacirmissindir.
Soruyu tekrar okumayi dene.

original:
Rotate the sleeping bags, move them around
and try as many different combinations as
you can. The key is to start with the nooks
and corners.
translation:
Uyku tulumlarini dondur, yerlerini degistir
ve olabildigince cok farkli kombinasyon dene.
Isin anahtari, once girinti ve koselerden
baslamak.

original:
Try as you like, you'll be able to fit only four
family members into the cabins that cost
{po}200 and {po}300. It's a shame, since they're
so cheap!
translation:
Ne kadar denersen dene, {po}200 ve {po}300
olan kulubelere ancak dort
aile bireyini sigdirabilirsin. Yazik, cunku
cok ucuzlar!

original:
Did you manage to fit the whole family
snugly into cabin D?

Well done if you did, but remember that
using all the space available isn't the aim
here!
translation:
Tum aileyi D kulubesine
sikica sigdirmayi basardin mi?

Basardiysan aferin, ama unutma:
burada amac tum alani doldurmak degil!

original:
You can fit the whole family into both cabins
B and D, so both are correct!

Or so you might think, but remember the
main goal. You're looking for the cheapest
cabin that they can sleep in.
translation:
Tum aile hem B hem de D kulubesine sigar,
yani ikisi de dogru!

Ama oyle sanma; asil amaci hatirla.
Aradigin, uyuyabilecekleri en ucuz
kulube.

original: Who's the sore loser?
translation: Kim yenilgiyi hazmedemedi?

original:
The cards in this tournament beat each
other as follows: fire > wood > water > fire.
Four players each draw four cards, which
they have to play in order going from top to
bottom. Both players in a match play one
card. Whoever wins moves on to the final,
but if it's a draw, the next cards are played.
Used cards are discarded.

At the end of the tournament, one player
announces {''}I'd have won if I'd been allowed
to swap wood for water and water for wood!{''}
Who said this?
translation:
Bu turnuvada kartlar birbirini
su sekilde yener: ates > odun > su > ates.
Dort oyuncunun her biri dort kart ceker,
ve bunlari yukaridan asagiya sirayla
oynamak zorundadir. Bir eslesmede iki oyuncu
birer kart oynar. Kazanan finale cikar,
ama beraberlik olursa sonraki kartlar oynanir.
Kullanilan kartlar atilir.

Turnuva sonunda bir oyuncu
{''}Odunu suyla ve suyu odunla
degistirebilseydim kazanirdim!{''}
Bunu kim soyledi?

original:
Correct!

It was C who was lamenting his bad luck.
If he'd had a few more draws, he would
have won!
translation:
Dogru!

Kotu sansindan yakinan C'ydi.
Birkac beraberlik daha ciksaydi,
kazanacakti!

original:
Too bad.

You know from the diagram that in the first
round A plays B and C plays D.
translation:
Olmadi.

Semadan, ilk turda
A'nin B'yle, C'nin de D'yle oynadigini biliyorsun.

original:
There's only one player who would have no
reason whatsoever to be unhappy with the
cards they drew: the winner.

If you work out who the winner was, you can
rule them out right away.
translation:
Cektigi kartlardan hic ama hic
memnuniyetsiz olmasina gerek olmayan tek
bir oyuncu vardir: kazanan.

Kazananin kim oldugunu bulursan,
onu hemen eleyebilirsin.

original:
Here's how you work out the actual winner:
A versus B
- A (water), B (water) = draw
- A (wood), B (fire) = B wins
C versus D
- C (wood), D (water) = C wins
B versus C (final)
- B (water), C (water) = draw
- B (fire), C (wood) = B wins
B is the winner overall.
translation:
Gercek kazanani soyle bulursun:
A - B
- A (su), B (su) = beraberlik
- A (odun), B (ates) = B kazanir
C - D
- C (odun), D (su) = C kazanir
B - C (final)
- B (su), C (su) = beraberlik
- B (ates), C (odun) = B kazanir
B genel kazanan olur.

original:
B is the winner, so the one complaining is
A, C or D. What if A had been allowed to
swap wood for water and water for wood?
A versus B
- A (wood), B (water) = A wins
A versus C (final)
- A (water), C (water) = draw
- A (wood), C (wood) = draw
- A (fire), C (water) = C wins
A would have lost even if he had swapped
his cards, so A isn't the sore loser.
translation:
B kazandi, yani sikayet eden
A, C ya da D'dir. Peki A'nin
odunu suyla ve suyu odunla
degistirmesine izin verilseydi?
A - B
- A (odun), B (su) = A kazanir
A - C (final)
- A (su), C (su) = beraberlik
- A (odun), C (odun) = beraberlik
- A (ates), C (su) = C kazanir
A kartlarini degistirse bile
kaybederdi; yani A sikayet eden degildir.

original:
The one who complained must be either C or
D. What if C had been allowed to swap his
cards?
C versus D
- C (water), D (water) = draw
- C (wood), D (wood) = draw
- C (water), D (fire) = C wins
B versus C (final)
- B (water), C (wood) = C wins
In this scenario, C wins. Hold on, didn't B
beat C in the actual game?
translation:
Sikayet eden ya C ya da
D olmali. Peki C'nin
kartlarini degistirmesine
izin verilseydi?
C - D
- C (su), D (su) = beraberlik
- C (odun), D (odun) = beraberlik
- C (su), D (ates) = C kazanir
B - C (final)
- B (su), C (odun) = C kazanir
Bu senaryoda C kazaniyor. Dur bir dakika,
gercek oyunda C'yi yenen B degil miydi?

original: Avoid the spiders!
translation: Orumceklerden kacin!

original:
The shovel's fallen in a pit! Hershel needs
to retrieve it, but there are poisonous
spiders coming up the poles. The spiders
change direction any chance they get
while still moving upwards. They somehow
manage to never bump into each other,
but if they bump into Hershel, he'll be in
trouble!

Which of the marked spots is the only safe
place for Hershel to avoid the spiders as
they climb out of the hole?
translation:
Kurek bir cukura dustu! Hershel onu
geri almak zorunda, ama zehirli
orumcekler direklerden yukari tirmaniyor. Orumcekler
firsat buldukca yon degistiriyor
ama yine de yukari dogru ilerliyorlar. Bir sekilde
birbirlerine hic carpmiyorlar,
fakat Hershel'e carparlarsa basi
belaya girer!

Isaretli noktalardan hangisi, orumcekler
delikten cikarken Hershel'in onlardan
kacinabilecegi tek guvenli yerdir?

original:
The answer is A!

Phew. Looks as though Hershel is safe!
He'd better get out of that hole before those
creepy-crawlies come back!
translation:
Cevap A!

Oh be! Gorunuse gore Hershel guvende!
O urkutucu surungenler geri gelmeden
o cukurdan ciksa iyi olur!

original:
Too bad.

One of these spots is definitely safe.
Stay calm and find the right one!
translation:
Olmadi.

Bu noktalardan biri kesinlikle guvenli.
Sakin ol ve dogru olani bul!

original:
Take one spider at a time and trace the
route it will take out of the hole.
translation:
Her seferinde bir orumcege odaklanip
cukurdan cikarken izleyecegi yolu takip et.

original:
If you're finding it tricky, try using the Memo
Function. Use a different colour to trace
each spider's route and the answer should
become clear.
translation:
Zorlaniyorsan Not
Fonksiyonu'nu kullan. Her orumcegin yolunu
farkli bir renkle cizersen cevap
netlesecektir.

original:
If you follow the routes the spiders on the
right will take, you'll see that the options on
the right-hand side aren't very safe at all.
It looks like Hershel will need to find safety
somewhere on the left.
translation:
Sagdaki orumceklerin izleyecegi
yollari takip edersen, sag taraftaki
seceneklerin hic de guvenli olmadigini gorursun.
Gorunuse gore Hershel guvenligi
solda bir yerde bulmali.

original:
If you trace all the ropes that a spider will
cross on its way out of the hole, you'll be
left with the only safe rope to stand on.
translation:
Bir orumcegin cukurdan cikarken
kesecegi tum ipleri izlersen,
ustunde durulabilecek tek guvenli ip kalir.

original: Find each section's value!
translation: Her bolgenin degerini bul!

original:
Three darts players have just finished a
game, with the results as shown. Can you
work out how many points each different
colour section of the dartboard is worth?

No two sections have the same value, and
their values increase the closer they are to
the centre. Each is worth a single-digit value
of at least one point.
translation:
Uc dart oyuncusu az once
resimdeki sonuclarla bir oyunu bitirdi. Dart tahtasindaki
her farkli renkli bolumun kac puan ettigini
bulabilir misin?

Hicbir iki bolumun degeri ayni degil ve
merkeze yaklastikca degerleri artiyor. Her biri
en az 1 puan olan, tek haneli bir
degere sahip.

original:
Correct!

A = 9, B = 7, C = 5 and D = 4.

As long as you remember that the only
possible values are from one to nine, this
is just simple calculation.
translation:
Dogru!

A = 9, B = 7, C = 5 ve D = 4.

Olasi degerlerin yalnizca 1'den 9'a kadar
oldugunu hatirlarsan,
bu sadece basit bir hesap.

original:
Too bad.

One of the three players' results should be
easier to analyse than the others'.
translation:
Maalesef.

Uc oyuncudan birinin sonucu
digerlerine gore daha kolay analiz edilmeli.

original:
The middle player's dartboard has two darts
each in section A and section D, for a total
of 26 points. So section A and D must add
up to half of 26, or 13.

What does that mean?
translation:
Ortadaki oyuncunun tahtasinda
A bolumunde iki, D bolumunde iki dart var ve toplam
26 puan ediyor. Demek ki A ile D'nin toplami
26'nin yarisi, yani 13.

Bu ne anlama geliyor?

original:
The left player's dartboard has one dart in
each section from A to D, for a total of
25 points.

From Hint 1, you know that A + D = 13,
so subtracting that from the total tells you
that B + C = 12.
translation:
Soldaki oyuncunun tahtasinda A'dan D'ye kadar
her bolumde birer dart var ve toplam
25 puan.

1. ipucundan A + D = 13 oldugunu biliyorsun,
bunu toplamdan cikarinca
B + C = 12 kalir.

original:
The right player's dartboard has one dart
in section B and three in segment C. You
already know that B + C = 12, so subtract
that from the total and you have 10 points
left for the other two darts in segment C.
That means segment C is worth 5 points.

Now you just need to substitute that value in
the other equations you've worked out using
the previous hints.
translation:
Sagdaki oyuncunun tahtasinda B bolumunde bir dart,
C bolumunde uc dart var. B + C = 12 oldugunu
zaten biliyorsun, bunu toplamdan cikarinca
C bolumundeki diger iki dart icin 10 puan kalir.
Bu da C bolumunun 5 puan ettigini gosterir.

Simdi bu degeri, onceki ipuclariyla buldugun
diger denklemlerde yerine koyman yeterli.

original:
The previous hints have shown that C = 5
and B + C = 12. Thus, B = 7.

The puzzle description tells you that A must
be higher than B, but still a single digit, so
it has to be either 8 or 9.

D cannot equal 0 and must be lower than C,
so it has to be 1, 2, 3 or 4. And you already
know that A + D = 13...
translation:
Onceki ipuclari C = 5 oldugunu ve
B + C = 12 oldugunu gosteriyor. O halde B = 7.

Bulmaca aciklamasina gore A, B'den buyuk olmali
ama yine de tek haneli olmali; yani
8 ya da 9.

D, 0 olamaz ve C'den kucuk olmali,
yani 1, 2, 3 ya da 4. Ayrica
A + D = 13 oldugunu biliyorsun...

original: Divide up the luggage!
translation: Bagaji bolusturun!

original:
Two porters have to carry six pieces of
luggage of unknown weight. Each piece
weighs a different amount, and they are
labelled in order of weight from A to F,
with A being the lightest and F the heaviest.
Each piece weighs up to 10 kg and the total
weight is 40 kg or less.

Each porter can carry up to 20 kg at once,
and between them they want to carry it all
in one go. How should they divide up the
luggage between them? Pile it all up in their
hands and then ring the bell.
translation:
Iki hamal, agirliklari bilinmeyen alti parcalik
bagaji tasimak zorunda. Her parca
farkli agirlikta ve A'dan F'ye,
A en hafif ve F en agir olacak sekilde
etiketlenmis. Her bir parca en fazla 10 kg,
toplam agirlik ise 40 kg ya da daha az.

Her hamal tek seferde en fazla 20 kg
tasiyabiliyor ve aralarinda hepsini
tek seferde tasimak istiyorlar. Bagaji
aralarinda nasil bolusturmeliler? Parcalari
ellerine yerlestirip sonra zili cal.

original:
Correct!

A luggage crisis has been averted.
translation:
Dogru!

Bir bagaj krizi daha atlatildi.

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
There are six pieces of luggage, so your first
assumption might be that each porter should
carry three pieces. However, it's possible
that one of them could take four pieces if
they're light enough.

Test this out by putting pieces A to D in one
of the porters' hands. If they can't carry the
four lightest pieces, then the only option is
for the porters to take three pieces each.
translation:
Alti parca bagaj var; bu yuzden ilk
varsayimin her hamalin uc parca
tasimasi olmasi normal. Ancak yeterince
hafiflerse, birinin dort parca tasimasi da
mumkun.

Bunu denemek icin A'dan D'ye kadar olan
parcalari hamallardan birinin eline koy.
Eger dort en hafif parcayi tasiyamiyorsa,
o zaman tek secenek her hamalin uc parca
almasidir.

original:
Based on Hint 1, it should be clear that
each porter can only carry three pieces of
luggage. The challenge, then, is to divide
them up in a way that balances.

First, try giving one porter the heaviest piece
of luggage, F, and the other porter the
second heaviest, E.
translation:
Ipucu 1'e gore, her hamal sadece uc parca
bagaj tasiyabilir. O halde amac, bunlari
dengeli bicimde bolusturmektir.

Once bir hamala en agir parca
F'i, diger hamala ise
ikinci en agir parca E'yi ver.

original:
Following on from Hint 2, the porter carrying
piece F should also take the lightest piece of
luggage, A.

Meanwhile, the other porter should take B,
the second lightest piece.

Now it's just a matter of where to put the last
two!
translation:
Ipucu 2'yi takip edersen, F parcasini tasiyan
hamal ayrica en hafif parca
bagaji, A'yi da almali.

Bu sirada diger hamal B'yi,
ikinci en hafif parcayi almali.

Simdi geriye kalan iki parcayi nereye
koyacagina karar vermek kaldi!

original:
If you followed Hints 2 and 3, you should
have just two pieces of luggage left.

Thankfully, it doesn't matter if you get it
wrong and make the porters buckle under
the strain. They aim to please no matter
the task, so you have ample opportunity to
swap around pieces C and D and try again.
This time it should be correct.
translation:
Ipucu 2 ve 3'u izlediysen, geriye sadece iki
bagaj parcasi kalmis olmali.

Neyse ki yanlis yapip hamallarin yuk altinda
bukulmesine sebep olsan da sorun degil.
Her isi memnuniyetle yaparlar; bu yuzden
C ve D parcalarini yer degistirip yeniden
denemek icin bolca firsatin var.
Bu sefer dogru olmali.

original: Circle the correct dodgem!
translation: Dogru carpisan arabayi isaretle!

original:
The photograph shown above was taken
while a group of friends were driving
dodgems.

The person who took the photo was driving a
white dodgem and she was facing forwards.

Where was she sitting when she took the
photo? Circle the correct white dodgem.
translation:
Yukarida gosterilen fotograf,
bir grup arkadas carpisan arabalara
binerken cekildi.

Fotografi ceken kisi beyaz bir arabayi
suruyordu ve ileriye dogru bakiyordu.

Fotografi cekerken nerede oturuyordu?
Dogru beyaz arabayi daire icine al.

original:
Correct!

It was the dodgem circled above.

Not a bad photo, eh? Now to decide where
it goes on the mantelpiece.
translation:
Dogru!

Daire icine alinan araba oydu.

Fena fotograf degil, degil mi? Simdi onu
somine rafina nereye koyacagina karar ver.

original:
Too bad.

Start off by looking for a situation in the
dodgem arena that matches the one shown
in the photo.
translation:
Olmadi.

Once carpisan araba alaninda,
fotograftakine uyan bir durumu
bulmaya calis.

original:
There are six white dodgems in all.

The photo taker's friends are driving a red
dodgem and a green dodgem. First, look for
white dodgems that don't have a red one
and a green one in front of them. These
dodgems can be ruled out.
translation:
Toplam alti beyaz araba var.

Fotografcinin arkadaslari kirmizi bir araba
ve yesil bir araba suruyor. Once onunde
bir kirmizi ve bir yesil araba olmayan
beyaz arabalari bul. Bu
arabalar elenebilir.

original:
If you look closely at the photo, you might
notice that a yellow dodgem is bumping into
the green one.

Is this happening anywhere in the dodgem
arena?
translation:
Fotografa dikkatlice bakarsan,
sari bir arabanin yesil olana
carptigini fark edebilirsin.

Bu durum carpisan araba alaninda
baska nerede oluyor?

original:
There are several places in the dodgem
arena where the situation looks very much
like the one shown in the photo.

However, it's not enough to simply match up
what you're seeing in the photo. You have to
consider what position the photo was taken
from as well.
translation:
Carpisan araba alaninda
fotograftakine cok benzeyen
birkac durum var.

Ama sadece fotograftaki goruntuyu
eslestirmek yetmez. Fotografin
hangi konumdan cekildigini de
dusunmelisin.

original:
The photo was taken from a white dodgem
which has a green dodgem, a red one and
a yellow one directly in front of it.

You might want to take a closer look at the
white dodgem just below the middle and the
one in the top-right corner.
translation:
Fotograf, onunde dogrudan
bir yesil, bir kirmizi ve
bir sari araba olan beyaz bir arabadan cekildi.

Ortadakinin hemen altindaki beyaz arabaya
ve sag ust kosedekine
daha yakindan bakmak isteyebilirsin.

original: Select the right key!
translation: Dogru anahtari sec!

original:
In front of the door are five stone snakes,
each coiled around a key.

There's also a plaque depicting a key. Only
one snake's key matches the one on the
plaque, and that key will open the door.

Which snake holds the correct key?
Select from A, B, C, D or E.
translation:
Kapinin onunde bes tas yilan var,
her biri bir anahtarin etrafina dolanmis.

Ayrica bir anahtar resmi olan bir plaka var. Sadece
bir yilanin anahtari plakadakiyle
aynidir ve o anahtar kapiyi acar.

Dogru anahtari hangi yilan tutuyor?
A, B, C, D veya E'yi sec.

original:
Fantasssstic!

It's snake C that has the correct key.
The next question is...how on earth are
they planning to get it out?
translation:
Muhtesesssssem!

Dogru anahtar yilan C'de.
Siradaki soru... bunu
nasil cikaracaklar acaba?

original:
Too bad.

Examine each part of the key individually
and compare the options closely.
translation:
Olmadi.

Anahtarin her parcasini ayri ayri incele
ve secenekleri dikkatlice karsilastir.

original:
Look at the grip on each key.

The one on the plaque has a triangular grip.
Snake B's key has a square grip, so you can
exclude B as a possibility.
translation:
Her anahtarin tutma kismina bak.

Plakadaki anahtarin tutma kismi ucgen.
Yilan B'nin anahtarinin tutma kismi kare, bu yuzden
B'yi eleyebilirsin.

original:
Following on from Hint 1, next have a look
at the keys' teeth.

It's hard to tell because the keys are all
facing different directions, but if you compare
them closely, the key depicted on the plaque
has indentations on two sides: the side at
the end and the side facing outwards.

Which other keys fit this description?
translation:
1. Ipucunun devami olarak simdi de
anahtarlarin dislerine bak.

Anahtarlarin hepsi farkli yonlere baktigi icin
anlamak zor, ama dikkatle karsilastirirsan
plakadaki anahtarin
iki yuzunde girinti oldugunu gorursun: uc tarafta
ve disa bakan tarafta.

Hangi diger anahtarlar bu tarife uyuyor?

original:
Based on the second hint, it can't be A or D,
because these have different indentations on
the teeth.

This leaves only C and E. What other
differences could there be between the
keys?

In particular, think about the parts that are
almost covered up by the snakes.
translation:
Ikinci ipucuna gore A ya da D olamaz,
cunku bunlarin dislerindeki girintiler
farkli.

Geriye sadece C ve E kaliyor. Anahtarlar arasinda
baska ne
farklar olabilir?

Ozellikle yilanlarin neredeyse
tamamen kapattigi kisimlari dusun.

original:
Near the base of the grip of each key is a
rectangular plate which can face one of two
directions.

Snakes C and E both cover up most of this
plate, but if you look closely, you can see
which direction each one faces.

Which one faces the same direction as on
the plaque?
translation:
Her anahtarin tutma kisminin dibine yakin yerde,
iki yonden birine bakabilen
dikdortgen bir plaka var.

Yilan C ve E bu plakanin cogunu
kapatiyor, ama dikkatle bakarsan
her birinin hangi yone baktigini gorebilirsin.

Hangisi plakadakiyle
ayni yone bakiyor?

original: Fix the sign!
translation: Isareti duzelt!

original:
All the tiles on this signpost fell off, and
Hershel and his friends won't continue
without fixing it.

Help them out by moving and rotating the
tiles to fix the sign.
translation:
Bu yon tabelasindaki tum taslar dustu ve
Hershel ile arkadaslari onu duzeltmeden
devam etmeyecek.

Taslari hareket ettirip dondurerek
tabelayi duzeltmelerine yardim et.

original:
Give yourself a big hand!

So left is the right way to go. Right?
translation:
Kendini alkisla!

Demek ki sola gitmek dogru yol. Oyle degil mi?

original:
Too bad.

It's supposed to be a signpost, but for now
it's just a post.
translation:
Maalesef.

Bir yon tabelasi olmasi gerekiyor ama simdilik
sadece bir direk.

original:
First, try to think about what the sign might
be depicting.

You usually see signs like these at forks in
roads, so it's likely to indicate {''}left{''} or
{''}right{''} somehow.

However, it doesn't look as if it could be an
arrow...
translation:
Once tabelanin neyi
anlatiyor olabilecegini dusun.

Bu tur tabelalari genelde yol ayrimlarinda gorursun,
yani muhtemelen {''}sol{''} ya da
{''}sag{''} yonunu bir sekilde gosteriyor.

Ama ok gibi
gorunmuyor...

original:
Have you worked out what shape is depicted
on the sign? Either way, here's a clue about
how to move the tiles.

One tile is almost completely white. Put this
in the bottom left-hand corner.

There's also a tile mostly taken up by a
square. Put this in the bottom-right corner
and rotate it so that the white area is on
the bottom right.
translation:
Tabeladaki seklin ne oldugunu
cozebildin mi? Her halukarda, iste taslari nasil
hareket ettirecegine dair bir ipucu.

Bir tas neredeyse tamamen beyaz. Bunu
sol alt koseye koy.

Bir de buyuk kismi kareyle dolu bir tas var.
Bunu sag alt koseye koy ve beyaz bolge
sag altta kalacak sekilde dondur.

original:
This next hint should be very handy: the
picture on the sign is actually a hand
pointing in the direction you should walk.

When you point with your hand, what does
your hand look like? Try it and see, then
see if you can rearrange the remaining
tiles to match.

By now, it shouldn't be too hard to work
out which direction the hand is pointing.
translation:
Siradaki ipucu cok ise yarayacak: Tabeladaki
resim aslinda gitmen gereken yonu gosteren
bir el.

Elinle isaret ettiginde elin nasil gorunur?
Deneyip gor, sonra kalan taslari buna
uyacak sekilde yeniden duzenlemeye calis.

Artik elin hangi yonu gosterdigini
bulmak cok zor olmamali.

original:
Normally you would point with your index
finger. When you do that, what positions
would your other fingers be in?

Chances are, your thumb will be sticking
straight up. Could that be the tile with the
L shape? The remaining three fingers will
be closed tightly. That must be the tile with
the four rectangles.

The right direction should be clear now!
translation:
Normalde isaret parmaginla gosterirsin.
Bunu yaptiginda diger parmaklarin
hangi pozisyonda olur?

Muhtemelen basparmagin yukari dogru dikilir.
Bu L seklindeki tas olabilir mi? Kalan uc parmak
sikica kapali olur. Bu da dort dikdortgenli
tas olmali.

Dogru yon artik belli olmali!

original: Solve the {''}simple{''} problem!
translation: {''}Basit{''} problemi coz!

original:
Dalston has posed Hershel a maths
problem. It's written on a homework sheet,
but it's torn in several places, making it very
difficult to read.

Dalston smirks as he watches Hershel
examine the puzzle. With an air of self-
satisfaction, he says: {''}Still struggling? But
this is the simplest maths problem ever!{''}

Can you help Hershel work out the answer
to the problem? Write down the number.
translation:
Dalston, Hershel'e bir matematik
problemi sordu. Odev kagidina yazilmis,
ama birkac yerinden yirtilmis, bu da onu
okumayi cok zorlastiriyor.

Dalston, Hershel'in
bulmacayi inceledigini izlerken siritir. Kendinden
memnun bir edayla soyle der: {''}Hala ugrasiyor musun? Ama
bu simdiye kadarki en basit matematik problemi!{''}

Hershel'in problemin cevabini bulmasina yardim eder misin
peki? Sayiyi yaz.

original:
Correct! Hope you didn't tear your hair out.

From where Dalston is standing, the torn
parts of the page appear to form a much
simpler maths problem: 17 - 2. The answer,
of course, is 15.
translation:
Dogru! Sacini basini yolmamissindir umarim.

Dalston'in durdugu yerden bakinca, sayfanin yirtik
kisimlari cok daha
basit bir matematik islemi olusturuyor: 17 - 2. Cevap,
tabii ki 15.

original:
Too bad.

Dalston says it's a simple problem. That
can't be right...or can it?
translation:
Olmadi.

Dalston bunun basit bir problem oldugunu soyluyor. Bu
dogru olamaz... ya da olabilir mi?

original:
Just smoothing out the creases won't help.
There are some necessary parts of the
equations missing that make it impossible
to solve.

However, Dalston seems convinced that it's
a simple problem. Surely he wouldn't say
that about multiple-variable equations!
What's going on?
translation:
Sadece kirisikliklari duzeltmek ise yaramaz.
Denklemlerin bazi gerekli kisimlari
eksik; bu da cozmeyi imkansiz
kiliyor.

Yine de Dalston bunun
basit bir problem olduguna ikna olmus gorunuyor. Herhalde
cok degiskenli denklemler icin boyle demez!
Ne oluyor boyle?

original:
Why does Dalston, who's standing right in
front of Hershel, find it so much easier to
solve?

He's looking at the homework sheet upside
down. Shouldn't that just make it harder
to read?

Try looking at it upside down yourself and
see if it helps at all.
translation:
Hershel'in tam
onunde duran Dalston bunu neden bu kadar daha kolay
cozebiliyor?

Odev kagidina ters
bakiyor. Bu, okumayi daha da zorlastirmaz mi
ki?

Sen de kagida ters bakmayi dene ve
hic ise yariyor mu gor.

original:
When you looked at the sheet upside down,
did you notice anything?

Maybe Dalston isn't looking at those
equations at all.

Incidentally, those rips in the paper are
shaped quite strangely. Is there some kind
of special meaning to them?
translation:
Kagida ters baktiginda,
bir sey fark ettin mi?

Belki de Dalston o
denklemlere hic bakmiyordur.

Bu arada, kagittaki yirtiklar
epey tuhaf sekilli. Acaba
bunlarin ozel bir anlami mi var?

original:
Look at the sheet upside down and focus
only on the ripped parts. It looks as if they
form a maths problem of their own.

It appears to read {''}17 - 2{''}.

A far simpler problem!
translation:
Kagida ters bak ve
yalnizca yirtik kisimlara odaklan. Sanki onlar
kendi baslarina bir matematik islemi olusturuyor.

Soyle okunuyor gibi: {''}17 - 2{''}.

Cok daha basit bir problem!

original: Which poster is identical?
translation: Hangi afis ayni?

original:
Bungle is cheerily putting up posters in the
plaza one evening, when all of a sudden, he
gets a terrible fright and bungles up which
poster is which.

Can you help him find the poster that
matches the one on the pole on the top
screen?

Touch posters on the Touch Screen to have
a closer look. You can rotate the poster on
the pole by sliding the hand left and right.
translation:
Bungle bir aksam meydanda neseyle afis
asarken, birden korkunc bir seyden urker
ve hangi afisin hangisi oldugunu karistirir.

Ust ekrandaki direkte duran afisle
ayni olan afisi bulmasina yardim eder misin?

Daha yakindan bakmak icin Dokunmatik Ekran'daki
afislere dokun. Direkteki afisi, eli saga sola
kaydirarak dondurebilirsin.

original:
The correct answer is poster B!

In A, the tail of the large clown balloon is
different, and in C the trumpeter's hat is
a different shape.

But really, with differences that small, would
anyone even notice if Bungle made a
mistake?
translation:
Dogru cevap B afisi!

A'da buyuk palyaco balonunun kuyrugu
farkli, C'de ise trompetcinin sapkasi
farkli bir sekle sahip.

Ama gercekten, bu kadar kucuk farklarla,
Bungle hata yapsa kim fark eder ki?

original:
Too bad.

Compare each of the posters very closely.
translation:
Olmadi.

Afislerin her birini cok dikkatli karsilastir.

original:
Rather than looking for the one identical
picture among three different posters, it's
easier to try and eliminate the ones that are
different from the one on the pole.

Once you find the two posters that are
different, you know the last one must be
what you're looking for.
translation:
Uc farkli afisin arasinda ayni olani aramak
yerine, direktekinden farkli olanlari elemek
daha kolaydir.

Iki farkli afisi buldugunda,
geriye kalan son afis aradigin olacaktir.

original:
Look closely and compare the balloons in
poster A. There really are all kinds - small
ones, big ones...
translation:
Afis A'daki balonlara dikkatlice bak.
Gercekten her turlusu var - kucukler,
buyukler...

original:
Now draw your attention to the people in
poster C. Look out for even the most subtle
of things, such as the way they're facing,
their clothes and so on.
translation:
Simdi dikkatini afis C'deki insanlara ver.
Hangi yone baktiklari, kiyafetleri ve benzeri
en ince ayrintilara bile dikkat et.

original:
A part of the large clown balloon is different
from the model on poster A, and the trumpet
player in the middle of poster C also has
something different about him.

That leaves only one poster. Look again and
see for yourself!
translation:
Buyuk palyaco balonunun bir kismi, A afisindeki
modelden farkli ve C afisinin ortasindaki trompetci
de onunla ilgili bir seyde farkli.

Geriye yalnizca bir afis kaliyor. Bir daha bak ve
kendi gozlerinle gor!

original: Leave Lucky in the centre!
translation: Lucky'yi ortada birak!

original:
Lucky the black cat and her eight white
kittens are sitting on a 5 x 5 board. Both
Lucky and the kittens can jump over any
kitten that is on a horizontally, vertically or
diagonally adjacent square. Jumping over
a kitten removes that kitten from the grid.
Lucky is safe, though, as the little kittens
can't jump over her.

Can you jump and bounce the cats around
so that only Lucky is left, sitting alone in the
centre?
translation:
Siyah kedi Lucky ve sekiz beyaz
yavrusu 5 x 5'lik bir tahtanin uzerinde oturuyor. Hem
Lucky hem de yavrular, yatay, dikey ya da
capraz komsu karede bulunan herhangi bir
yavrunun uzerinden atlayabilir. Bir yavrunun uzerinden
atlamak, o yavruyu tahtadan cikarir.
Ama Lucky guvende; cunku kucuk yavrular
onun uzerinden atlayamaz.

Kedileri ziplatip oraya buraya
hareket ettirerek yalnizca Lucky'nin, tek basina
ortada kalmasini saglayabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

You managed to get all the kittens off the
board and leave only Lucky in the middle!
Do you think she's glad to get some peace
and quiet?
translation:
Dogru!

Tum yavrulari
tahtadan cikarmayi basardin ve ortada yalnizca Lucky kaldi!
Sence biraz huzur
ve sessizlik bulduguna seviniyor mu?

original: Miaoh well.
translation: Miyav, neyse.

original:
It's important to consider the first move.

You may feel safer leaving Lucky in the
middle, but you're going to have to move her
to solve this. In fact, the first step is to make
her jump four times in a row.
translation:
Ilk hamleyi dusunmek onemlidir.

Lucky'yi
ortada birakmak daha guvenli gelebilir, ama bunu cozmek icin
onu hareket ettirmen gerekecek. Hatta ilk adim, onu
ard arda dort kez ziplatmaktir.

original:
Let's say you chose to move Lucky down on
the first move, and down is south.

Keep going and jump Lucky north-west,
north-east, then south-east. She should
now be sitting in the middle of the rightmost
column.

Now try to make one of the kittens jump so
that it lands a bit closer to Lucky.
translation:
Diyelim ki ilk hamlede Lucky'yi asagi
hareket ettirmeyi sectin ve asagi guney olsun.

Devam et ve Lucky'yi kuzeybatiya,
kuzeydoguya, sonra da guneydoguya ziplat. O
simdi en sagdaki
sutunun ortasinda oturuyor olmali.

Simdi yavrulardan birini ziplatip
Lucky'ye biraz daha yakin bir yere inmesini sagla.

original:
Let's pick up from Lucky getting to her last
position in Hint 2. The kitten you want to
move next is the one that is furthest left.
There's only one square it can go to.

After that, another kitten has to move, but
there's only one way to avoid getting stuck.
After this jump, you should be almost there!
translation:
Ipucu 2'de Lucky'nin ulastigi son
konumdan devam edelim. Simdi hareket ettirmek istedigin yavru
en soldaki.
Gidebilecegi tek bir kare var.

Bundan sonra baska bir yavru hareket etmeli, ama
kilitlenmemek icin tek bir yol var.
Bu ziplamadan sonra neredeyse bitirmis olmalisin!

original:
The second kitten that has to move in Hint 3
is the bottom one. Make it jump upwards so
that you end up with two kittens lined up
together at the top.

There's now just one way left for a kitten to
jump, so go for it. After that, just jump Lucky
into the middle!
translation:
Ipucu 3'te hareket etmesi gereken ikinci yavru
en alttaki. Onu yukari ziplat ki
ust tarafta yan yana
iki yavru kalsin.

Artik bir yavrunun ziplayabilecegi tek bir yol kaldi;
onu da yap. Sonra, Lucky'yi
ortaya ziplatman yeter!

original: Who pays for lunch today?
translation: Bugun ogle yemegini kim odeyecek?

original:
Every day, colleagues A, B and C spin a
wheel to determine who will pay for lunch.
The wheel is divided into three segments,
worth the number of points indicated in the
picture, and the colleagues spin the wheel
six times. Each time, all three of them
receive points according to which segment
lands on them. Whoever has the fewest total
points at the end has to pick up the bill.

Today, A has ended up with 13 points.
If no two people finished with the same
score, who had to pay for lunch?
translation:
Her gun, A, B ve C adli is arkadaslari
ogle yemegini kimin odeyecegini belirlemek icin
bir cark cevirir.
Cark uc dilime ayrilmistir,
ve her dilim resimdeki puan degerine sahiptir.
Ucu de carki
alti kez cevirir. Her seferinde ucunun de
hangi dilime geldigine gore puan alirlar.
En sonunda toplam puani en az olan
hesabi oder.

Bugun A'nin puani 13 oldu.
Kimse ayni puanda bitirmediyse,
ogle yemegini kim odemek zorunda kaldi?

original:
Correct!

B lost out and had to pay for everyone.

Spin, spin, spin! Don't you find yourself
wanting to spin the Lazy Susan when you
get one at the restaurant?
translation:
Dogru!

B kaybetti ve herkesin
hesabini o odedi.

Cevir, cevir, cevir! Restoranda
donen tepsi gelince onu da
cevirmek istemiyor musun?

original:
Too bad.

You should be able to work out everyone's
score based on A's.
translation:
Olmadi.

A'nin puanindan yola cikarak
herkesin puanini bulabilmelisin.

original:
The only score you know is A's: 13 points.
To get this many points after six spins of the
wheel, she could have got two points on five
occasions and three points once, for
example.

What other combinations of points would give
A a score of 13?
translation:
Bildigin tek puan A'ninki: 13.
Carki alti kez cevirdikten sonra
bu puana ulasmak icin ornegin
bes kez 2 puan, bir kez de 3 puan
almis olabilir.

A'yi 13 puana goturen
baska hangi puan kombinasyonlari var?

original:
There are only three ways for A to have
received 13 points after six spins.

1 x 3 pts, 5 x 2 pts = 13 pts
2 x 3 pts, 3 x 2 pts, 1 x 1 pt = 13 pts
3 x 3 pts, 1 x 2 pts, 2 x 1 pt = 13 pts

Now you can look at the wheel and work out
how many points B and C would have
received in each of these cases.
translation:
A'nin alti donuste
13 puan almasinin yalnizca uc yolu var.

1 x 3 puan, 5 x 2 puan = 13 puan
2 x 3 puan, 3 x 2 puan, 1 x 1 puan = 13 puan
3 x 3 puan, 1 x 2 puan, 2 x 1 puan = 13 puan

Simdi carka bakip,
bu durumlarin her birinde B ile C'nin
kac puan aldigini bulabilirsin.

original:
Did you work out B and C's scores in each
of the cases outlined in Hint 2?

When A gets 1, B gets 3. When A gets 2,
B gets 1. When A gets 3, B gets 2. C gets
the remaining points in each case.

Oh, and don't forget that no two people got
the same number of points, so you can rule
out any combination that gives B or C the
same score of 13 that A has.
translation:
Ipucu 2'deki her durumda
B ve C'nin puanlarini buldun mu?

A 1 alirsa B 3 alir. A 2 alirsa,
B 1 alir. A 3 alirsa B 2 alir. C ise
her seferinde kalan puani alir.

Ayrica kimsenin ayni puanda bitirmedigini
unutma; bu yuzden B'nin ya da C'nin
A gibi 13 puan aldigi tum kombinasyonlari
elemelisin.

original:
There are three ways for A to receive 13
points, and you can exclude any case in
which B or C also gets 13 points.

There's only one way left, and that leaves A
with 13 points, B with 7 and C with 16.

The one with the fewest points pays for
lunch.
translation:
A'nin 13 puan almasinin uc yolu var;
B ya da C'nin de 13 puan aldigi
tum durumlari eleyebilirsin.

Geriye tek bir olasilik kalir: A 13,
B 7 ve C 16 puanda biter.

En az puani olan
ogle yemegini oder.

original: Who lost to E?
translation: E'ye kim yenildi?

original:
Six ladies have just finished playing a tennis
tournament round-robin style (each one
played all the others once).

The results are still in the process of being
drawn up on the board shown here, but you
know that only two of the matches ran out of
time and ended in draws.

Much to her surprise, E managed to win a
match despite being a tennis rookie. Can
you work out who she defeated?
translation:
Alti hanim az once lig usulu
(birbirleriyle birer kez oynayarak) bir tenis
turvasini bitirdi.

Sonuclar yukaridaki tabloda hala yaziliyor,
amma sadece iki macin sure doldugu ve
berabere bittigini biliyorsun.

Teniste acemi olmasina ragmen E,
bir maci kazanmayi basardi. Sence
kimi yendi?

original:
Correct!

F was the one who lost to E.

The completed scoreboard tells the whole
story: poor F lost all her matches! Don't let
it get you down, F! Onwards and upwards!
translation:
Dogru!

E'ye yenilen kisi F idi.

Tamamlanan tablo her seyi anlatiyor:
zavalli F tum maclarini kaybetmis!
Moralini bozma, F! Devam!

original:
Too bad!

You won't get anywhere just staring at
the numbers on the scoreboard!
translation:
Maalesef!

Sadece tabloya bakip
duranarak bir yere varamazsin!

original:
You can tell from the scoreboard that B
didn't lose a single match, so it can't be her.
But even if you knew everyone's win and
loss totals, it wouldn't tell you who won and
lost to whom.

Is there anything else this scoreboard can
tell you?
translation:
Tablodan B'nin
tek bir mac bile kaybetmedigini anlayabilirsin,
yani o olamaz. Ama herkesin kac galibiyet
kac maglubiyet aldigini bilsen bile,
kimin kimi yendigini soylemez.

Bu tablo baska ne anlatabilir?

original:
Each of the six ladies played each of the
others once, so you can work out how many
matches were played in total.

Two of the matches ended in draws, so you
should be able to work out how many
matches each player won.
translation:
Alti hanimin her biri digerleriyle
birer kez oynadigina gore, toplam kac
mac yapildigini hesaplayabilirsin.

Iki mac berabere bittigine gore,
her oyuncunun kac mac kazandigini
bulabilmelisin.

original:
Out of 15 matches, two were draws. That
leaves 13 wins between all the players.
Have a good look at the scoreboard. There
are already 13 wins listed between players
A, B, C, D and E. That must mean that F
