didn't win any matches at all.

Which means...
translation:
15 macin ikisi berabere bitti.
Bu da tum oyuncular arasinda toplam 13 galibiyet
oldugu anlamina gelir.
Tabloya dikkatle bak. A, B, C, D ve E arasinda
zaten 13 galibiyet yazili. Demek ki
F hic mac kazanmamis.

Yani...

original:
F didn't win any matches at all, and she
didn't play in either of the matches that
ended in draws. In other words, she lost
against every other player.

So the only person who lost against E
must be...
translation:
F hic mac kazanmadi ve
berabere biten iki macin hicbirinde oynamadi.
Baska bir deyisle, diger herkesle oynadigi
maclarin hepsini kaybetti.

O halde E'ye yenilen tek kisi
mutlaka...

original: How far did he walk?
translation: Ne kadar yurudu?

original:
{''}I went to visit my partner in hospital earlier.
I got 500 m from my front door, and then I
remembered that I wanted to buy him some
flowers. So I went back to the flower shop,
got the flowers, and then continued towards
the hospital. The flower shop is on a straight
line between my house and the hospital,
800 m away from the hospital. Afterwards,
I walked straight home on the same road.{''}

How many metres did the policeman walk in
total between leaving home and returning?
translation:
{''}Az once hastanede yatan esimi ziyarete gidiyordum.
On kapimdan 500 m uzaklasinca ona
cicek almak istedigimi hatirladim. Bu yuzden
cicekciye geri dondum, cicekleri aldim ve
hastaneye dogru yoluma devam ettim. Cicekci,
evimle hastane arasindaki duz cizgi uzerindedir ve
hastaneden 800 m uzaktadir. Daha sonra da
ayni yoldan dumduz eve yurudum.{''}

Polis memuru evden cikip geri donene
kadar toplam kac metre yurumustur?

original:
Correct!

The red line is the first 500 m the policeman
walked from home. The blue line is the
return journey from the flower shop to
the hospital, 2 x 800 = 1600 metres.
The dotted lines show the original journey
to the shop and the journey from the shop
back home, which in total must be the same
distance as the first 500 m. So the total is
2600 metres.
translation:
Dogru!

Kirmizi cizgi, polis memurunun evden
yurudugu ilk 500 m'yi gosterir. Mavi cizgi,
cicekciden hastaneye gidis yoludur:
2 x 800 = 1600 metre.
Noktali cizgiler, dukkana gidisin ilk kismini
ve dukkandan eve donusu gosterir; bunlarin
toplami, ilk 500 m ile ayni mesafe olmalidir.
Bu yuzden toplam 2600 metredir.

original:
Too bad!

Try drawing a diagram of the entire route to
the hospital via the shop, and back home.
translation:
Olmadi!

Dukkan uzerinden hastaneye gidis ve
eve donus guzergahinin tamaminin
bir semasini cizmeyi dene.

original:
Let's call the point where the policeman
realises he needs to buy flowers X. The
outgoing and return journeys can then be
shown as:
home → X → flower shop → hospital
hospital→ home

Try drawing this route, taking care with the
position of the flower shop.
translation:
Polis memurunun cicek almasi gerektigini
fark ettigi noktaya X diyelim. O zaman gidis
ve donus yollari soyle gosterilebilir:
ev → X → cicekci → hastane
hastane→ ev

Cicekcinin konumuna dikkat ederek bu
guzergahi cizmeyi dene.

original:
First, the policeman walks 500 m from home
to point X. Next, he returns to the shop. Call
this distance Y. Then he walks 800 m from
the shop to the hospital. That's the total
outgoing journey.

On the return journey, he walks 800 m from
the hospital to the shop, and then walks from
the shop to his home. Call this last distance
Z, and the total is:
500 + Y + 800 + 800 + Z
translation:
Once polis memuru evden
X noktasina 500 m yurur. Sonra
dukkana geri doner. Bu mesafeye Y diyelim.
Ardindan dukkandan hastaneye 800 m yurur.
Bu, gidis yolunun toplamidir.

Donuste, hastaneden dukkana 800 m yurur,
sonra dukkandan evine yurur. Bu son mesafeye
Z diyelim ve toplam:
500 + Y + 800 + 800 + Z

original:
There are two distances you don't know:
Y, from point X to the flower shop, and
Z, from the flower shop to the policeman's
home.

The shop is somewhere on the straight line
between home and point X, and the distance
from X to home is 500 m. So the distance
from X to shop (Y) plus that from shop to
home (Z) must total...
translation:
Bilmedigin iki mesafe var:
X noktasindan cicekciye Y,
cicekciden polis memurunun evine Z.

Dukkan, ev ile X noktasi arasindaki duz cizgi
uzerinde bir yerdedir ve X'ten eve uzaklik 500 m'dir.
O halde X'ten dukkana (Y) ve dukkandan eve (Z)
mesafelerinin toplami...

original:
As mentioned in Hint 2, the total distance
is 500 + Y + 800 + 800 + Z.

From Hint 3, you can work out that
Y + Z = 500.

The rest is just addition!
translation:
Ipucu 2'de belirtildigi gibi toplam mesafe
500 + Y + 800 + 800 + Z'dir.

Ipucu 3'ten sunu cikarabilirsin:
Y + Z = 500.

Gerisi sadece toplama!

original: Find the Ace of Diamonds!
translation: Karo Asi'ni bul!

original:
Of the three famous swords shown here,
one is the legendary Ace of Diamonds.
Those who have faced it in battle all call
it so.

Can you work out which one it is?
translation:
Burada gosterilen uc unlu kilictan
biri efsanevi Karo Asi'dir.
Onunla savasta karsilasan herkes
ona boyle der.

Hangisi oldugunu bulabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

Sword A is the Ace of Diamonds. Anyone
who's ever seen it from the pointy end
knows why!
translation:
Dogru!

A kilici Karo Asi'dir. Ucundan onu
goren herkes
nedenini bilir!

original:
Too bad.

That one doesn't have the necessary
quality that would lend it the name
Ace of Diamonds...
translation:
Olmadi.

Sectigin kilic, ona
Karo Asi adini verecek
ozellige sahip degil...

original:
The name Ace of Diamonds isn't based on
the sword's history or legends. It's purely
about the shape of the weapon.
translation:
Karo Asi adi kilicin
tarihi ya da efsanelerinden gelmez. Tamamen
silahin sekliyle ilgilidir.

original:
Compare the swords carefully.

A's grip is the same red colour as the
diamond on an ace of diamonds card.
B has a diamond-shaped decoration on
the cross-guard at the base of the blade,
and a diamond pattern on the handle.
C has an actual diamond in the handle.

But are any of these features enough to
call the sword the Ace of Diamonds?
translation:
Kiliclari dikkatlice karsilastir.

A'nin kabzasi, bir karo asi kartindaki
karonun kirmizisiyla ayni renkte.
B'nin kilicin dibindeki capraz korumasinda
karo seklinde bir sus var,
ve sapinda da karo desenleri bulunuyor.
C'nin sapinda ise gercek bir elmas var.

Ama bu ozelliklerden herhangi biri
ona Karo Asi demeye yeter mi?

original:
All the swords are hung up on display and
out of use now, but at the time the Ace of
Diamonds earned its moniker, it would have
been used as a weapon.

Perhaps its opponents called it so based on
the shape it had from their point of view?
In other words, from the end of the blade?
translation:
Tum kiliclar simdi sergileniyor ve
kullanilmiyor, ama Karo Asi
lakabini kazandigi zaman
bir silah olarak kullaniliyordu.

Belki de rakipleri, kendi bakis acisindan
gordukleri sekle gore ona boyle dedi?
Yani, kilicin ucundan bakinca?

original:
Look carefully at the shape of each of the
blades as seen from the end of the blade,
including the cross-guard. One of them must
have a shape befitting the name Ace of
Diamonds.

The ace of diamonds is a playing card.
What shape are playing cards?
translation:
Kilic uclarindan bakinca gorunen
bicak sekillerine dikkatlice bak,
capraz korumayi da dahil et. Iclerinden biri
Karo Asi adina yakisan bir sekle
sahip olmali.

Karo asi bir iskambil kartidir.
Iskambil kartlari ne sekildedir?

original: Make the hat!
translation: Sapkayi yap!

original:
You have a stack of thin tiles which are
3 x 3 small squares in size. There are three
colours and each tile is all one colour. You
want to use the limited tiles available and
stack them on top of each other to construct
a top hat like the one above.

How should you layer them? Take the tiles
from the right and place them inside the
border on the left.
translation:
Elinde 3 x 3 kucuk kareden olusan ince
karolardan bir yigin var. Uc renk var ve her
karo tek bir renkten olusuyor. Sagdaki sinirli
karolari kullanarak, soldaki cercevenin icine
ust uste dizip yukaridaki silindir sapkayi
yapmak istiyorsun.

Karolari nasil ust uste koymalisin? Sagdan
karolari alip soldaki cercevenin icine yerlestir.

original:
You did it!

That's some expert tile laying right there!
translation:
Basardin!

Iste bu, tam bir karo doseme ustaligi!

original: That's a shame.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
Each tile has a size of 3 x 3 and you can
place tiles anywhere, but they have to run
all the way around the edge.

Start by placing the eight white tiles so they
run around the edges.
translation:
Her karo 3 x 3 boyutunda ve istedigin yere
koyabilirsin, ama karolar kenarin etrafini
tamamen dolasmali.

Once sekiz beyaz karoyu kenarlari
dolasacak sekilde yerlestir.

original:
Place the black tiles along the brim of the hat
so that you end up with a 3 x 5 rectangle.
Now we have the problem of how to make
the sides of the brim look right.

Although Hint 1 told you to place all the
white tiles first, try bringing two of them to
the front and see what you can do.
translation:
Siyah karolari sapkanin kenarligi boyunca
yerlestirerek 3 x 5'lik bir dikdortgen elde et.
Simdi sorun, kenarligin yanlarini dogru
gostermek.

Ipucu 1 tum beyazlari once koy demisti ama
ikisinin yerini one alip neler yapabilecegine
bak.

original:
Do you now have a black upside-down T
shape? Look at the model to see how to
proceed from here.

There's a fully visible 3 x 3 black tile
positioned at the top of the hat. That has
to be the last tile you place.
translation:
Simdi siyah ters bir T seklin var mi?
Modelden buradan nasil ilerleyecegine bak.

Sapkanin tepesinde tamamen gorunen 3 x 3
siyah bir karo var. Bu, yerlestirecegin son
karo olmali.

original:
If the last tile to place is a black one, then
the tile for the red of the hatband must come
before it. Position it exactly in the centre and
then place the last black tile. You know
where it goes.
translation:
Son koyacagin karo siyahsa, sapka bandinin
kirmizisi olan karo ondan once gelmeli.
Onu tam ortaya yerlestir ve sonra son siyah
karoyu koy. Nereye gittigini biliyorsun.

original: Which bear fits?
translation: Hangi ayi uyar?

original:
Here's a 3 x 3 grid of some very dapper
teddy bears from Bungle's sticker collection.

It looks as if they're arranged in some kind
of pattern, but one of the stickers has fallen
off.

Which bear sticker fits into the empty
square: A, B, C or D?
translation:
Iste Bungle'in cikartma koleksiyonundan
cok sik oyuncak ayilarin 3 x 3'luk bir izgarasi.

Sanki bir tur duzene gore dizilmisler,
ama cikartmalardan biri dusmus.

Bos kareye hangi ayi cikartmasi
uyar: A, B, C mi yoksa D mi?

original:
Beary good!

The answer is teddy bear D.

Those crafty dandies have been arranged
so that no two bears in the same row or
column are wearing the same hat, glasses
or ribbon.
translation:
Ayi gibi iyi!

Cevap D oyuncak ayisi.

Bu kurnaz sik beyler oyle bir dizilmis ki
ayni satirda ya da sutunda iki ayi
ayni sapka, gozluk
ya da kurdeleyi takmiyor.

original:
Too bad.

It doesn't seem as if they follow any kind of
pattern, does it? No, there must be some
method to the madness here.
translation:
Olmadi.

Hicbir duzene uymuyor gibi gorunuyor,
oyle degil mi? Hayir, burada bir
mantik olmali.

original:
Why are they all so fancily dressed?
There must be a reason for it.

A teddy bear dinner party, perhaps?
translation:
Neden hepsi bu kadar suslu giyinmis?
Bunun bir nedeni olmali.

Belki de bir oyuncak ayi aksam yemegi?

original:
The bears are wearing hats, glasses and
ribbons.

There must be some kind of pattern based
on these flashy accessories.
translation:
Ayilar sapka, gozluk ve
kurdele takiyor.

Bu gosterisli aksesuarlar uzerinden
bir duzen olmali.

original:
Here's a little tip: you can ignore the
diagonal.
translation:
Kucuk bir ipucu: caprazi
goz ardi edebilirsin.

original:
Pay close attention to the hats.

Look along the top row and you'll see that
the bears are wearing a beret, a bowler and
a top hat in order from left to right. If you
look down the first column, they're wearing
a beret, top hat and bowler.

None of the bears are wearing the same kind
of hat. The bears' ribbons and glasses
follow the same pattern.
translation:
Sapkalara dikkat et.

Ust siraya bak ve goreceksin ki
ayilar bere, melon sapka ve
silindir sapkayi soldan saga sirayla takiyor. Ilk sutuna
asagi dogru bakarsan, takilanlar
bere, silindir sapka ve melon sapka.

Hicbir ayi ayni tur
sapka takmiyor. Kurdeleler ve gozlukler de
ayni duzeni izliyor.

original: What do A, B, C, D & E do?
translation: A, B, C, D ve E ne is yapiyor?

original:
Correct!

A runs the caf{'e}, B the grocer's, C the
bookshop, D the patisserie and E the
baker's. By paying close attention, you can
rule out which jobs they don't do.
translation:
Dogru!

A caf{'e}'yi, B bakkali, C
kitapciyi, D pastaneyi ve E
firini isletiyor. Dikkatli davranirsan,
hangi isleri yapmadiklarini eleyebilirsin.

original:
Too bad.

Try taking notes for each person.
translation:
Olmadi.

Her kisi icin not almayi dene.

original:
Read carefully and you'll work out which
jobs A through E don't do.

For example, according to A, neither A nor C
run the baker's or patisserie. Try narrowing
it down for each person in the same way.
translation:
Dikkatle oku; A'dan E'ye kadar herkesin
hangi isi yapmadigini cikaracaksin.

Ornegin A'ya gore ne A ne de C
firini ya da pastaneyi isletiyor. Ayni sekilde
her kisi icin olasiliklari daralt.

original:
C comes up quite a lot, doesn't she? Let's
start with C, then.

Summing up what A, B, C and E said, we can
work out that C doesn't work at the baker's,
patisserie, caf{'e} or the grocer's.

That just leaves the bookshop, and so the
answer for C is clear.
translation:
C adi epey geciyor, degil mi? O halde
C'den baslayalim.

A, B, C ve E'nin soylediklerini
toplarsak C'nin firini,
pastaneyi, caf{'e}'yi ya da bakkali
isletmedigini anlariz.

Geriye sadece kitapci kalir; yani C icin
cevap bellidir.

original:
Let's narrow down D's job next. According
to C and D, D isn't the baker, caf{'e} owner or
grocer. We know that C runs the bookshop
already, so that means that D must run the
patisserie.

And what about E? According to D, he
doesn't run the caf{'e}, nor is he the grocer.
What does that leave?
translation:
Simdi D'nin isini daraltalim. C ve D'ye
gore D firinci degil, caf{'e} sahibi degil,
bakkal da degil. C'nin zaten kitapciyi
islettigini biliyoruz; o halde D
pastaneyi isletir.

Peki ya E? D'ye gore o
caf{'e}'yi isletmez, bakkal da degildir.
Geriye ne kaliyor?

original:
E isn't the caf{'e} owner or the grocer, and
he doesn't run the bookshop or patisserie
either. That means he has to be the baker,
which just leaves A and B. How can you tell
which one runs the caf{'e} and which one is the
grocer?

Oh, didn't B say that she hasn't been to the
caf{'e} in ages? She can't be the one running
the caf{'e} then! The solution should be clear
now.
translation:
E caf{'e} sahibi degil, bakkal degil;
kitapciyi ya da pastaneyi de isletmiyor.
Demek ki firinci olmak zorunda; geriye
A ve B kaliyor. Hangisinin caf{'e}'yi,
hangisinin bakkali islettigini nasil anlarsin?

B, uzun zamandir caf{'e}'ye ugramadigini
soylememis miydi? O halde caf{'e}'yi
isletiyor olamaz! Cozum artik acik.

original: Who's in the yellow area?
translation: Sari bolgede kim var?

original:
Hurray, the races are on! Three groups of
tradespeople have been invited to watch:
tailors, winemakers and upholsterers.

The seating areas for each group have been
arranged so that the sponsors can tell at a
glance which is which.

Can you tell which group of tradespeople are
sitting in the yellow area?
translation:
Yasasin, yarislar basladi! Uc meslek
grubu izlemeye davet edildi:
terziler, sarap ureticileri ve dosemeciler.

Her grubun oturma bolgesi oyle bir sekilde
ayarlanmis ki sponsorlar hangisinin hangisi
oldugunu bir bakista anlayabiliyor.

Sari bolgede hangi meslek grubunun
oturdugunu bulabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

The red seating area is shaped like a chair
so that's where the upholsterers will sit.
The blue seating area is in the shape of a
bottle, so the winemakers will be sitting
there. And finally, the yellow seating area is
shaped like a shirt: just right for the tailors.
translation:
Dogru!

Kirmizi oturma alani sandalye seklinde,
yani dosemeciler orada oturacak.
Mavi alan sise seklinde, bu yuzden
sarap ureticileri orada oturur. Son olarak,
sari alan gomlek seklinde: terziler icin
tam bicilmis kaftan.

original:
Too bad.

You can tell just by looking, remember.
translation:
Maalesef.

Sadece bakarak anlayabilirsin, unutma.

original:
The seats are divided up in quite an intricate
way, aren't they? Perhaps the number of
seats has something to do with it?

No, that can't be it. You can tell just by
looking, so there's no need for maths or
chair-counting.
translation:
Koltuklar oldukca karmasik
bir sekilde ayrilmis, degil mi? Belki de
koltuk sayisiyla ilgilidir?

Hayir, oyle olamaz. Sadece bakarak
anlasilabiliyor, yani matematige ya da
koltuk saymaya gerek yok.

original:
It really is quite a peculiar way of dividing up
the seats. Why not try looking at it from a
different angle?

Oh, and you'll find some clues on the Touch
Screen, too.
translation:
Koltuklarin bolunme sekli gercekten de
tuhaf. Neden farkli bir acidan bakmayi
denemiyorsun?

Ha, bir de Dokunmatik
Ekran'da bazi ipuclari bulacaksin.

original:
This just in!

Apparently, the sponsors' seats are off to
the right of the area shown on the top
screen. If you look at the image from the
angle of the sponsors, you'll be able to tell
which group's sitting where at a glance.
translation:
Son dakika!

Meger sponsorlarin koltuklari, ust ekranda
gorulen alanin sag tarafindaymis. Resme
sponsorlarin acisindan bakarsan,
hangi grubun nerede oturdugunu
bir bakista anlayabilirsin.

original:
Turn the Nintendo 3DS system so that the
right-hand side is on the bottom. Doesn't
the red seating area look a bit like a chair?
The blue area looks like a bottle, and the
yellow area looks like a shirt as well.

A shirt? Well then, that should tie up the
loose ends of the puzzle!
translation:
Nintendo 3DS sistemini, sag tarafi
altta kalacak sekilde cevir. Kirmizi oturma alani
sanki bir sandalyeye benzemiyor mu?
Mavi alan bir sise gibi, sari alan da
bir gomlek gibi gorunuyor.

Gomlek mi? O halde bulmacanin
son parcalari da yerine oturdu!

original: Which arrow is missing?
translation: Hangi ok eksik?

original:
Below the roller coaster lies a stack of
see-through panels with red arrows.

Originally there were four panels, but
someone's gone and taken one. Given that
each arrow points in a different direction,
can you tell which panel is missing?
Choose from A to D.
translation:
Hiz treninin altinda kirmizi oklardan olusan
seffaf panellerden bir yigin var.

Basta dort panel vardi ama biri alinmis.
Her ok farkli bir yone baktigina gore,
hangi panelin eksik oldugunu soyleyebilir misin?
A'dan D'ye sec.

original:
Correct!

The arrow facing downwards is missing.

Because the panels are transparent, the
arrows get darker as more are placed on
top of each other.
translation:
Dogru!

Asagi bakan ok eksik.

Paneller seffaf oldugu icin ust uste geldikce
oklar daha koyu gorunur.

original:
Too bad.

What does it look like when you place
transparent pictures on top of each other?
translation:
Olmadi.

Seffaf resimleri ust uste koyunca
nasil gorunur?

original:
It might be a bit tricky to work this out in your
head, so try drawing it using the Memo
Function.

If you draw each arrow a different colour, it
should be easier to work out.
translation:
Bunu kafanda canlandirmak zor olabilir,
Memo ozelligini kullanarak ciz.

Her oku farkli renkte cizersen
cikarma yapmak daha kolay olur.

original:
The panels may be transparent, but each
time they overlap, it becomes harder for light
to pass through them.

One area of the arrows is noticeably darker
than the rest. What can you conclude from
this?
translation:
Paneller seffaf olsa da ust uste geldikce
isigin gecmesi zorlasir.

Oklarin bir bolgesi digerlerinden belirgin
sekilde daha koyu. Buradan ne cikarirsin?

original:
The dark red area can only be created if
there are three overlapping arrows, so the
panel with the arrow pointing upwards must
be one of the three on the stack.

Try and picture what shape would be left if
you removed the up arrow.
translation:
Koyu kirmizi alan ancak uc okun ust uste
gelmesiyle olusur; demek ki yukari bakan
oklu panel yigindaki uc panelden biri.

Yukari oku cikarirsan geriye hangi seklin
kalacagini hayal et.

original:
In addition to the panel with an up arrow,
the panel with an arrow pointing right is also
lying on the stack.

See if you can work out the final panel to
rule out.
translation:
Yukari oklu panelin yani sira saga bakan
oklu panel de yiginin uzerinde.

Son olarak hangi paneli elemen gerektigini
bul.

original: Find the sender & recipient!
translation: Gondereni ve aliciyi bul!

original:
Someone sent a letter and a set of photos to
a friend of theirs.

{''}Here are the photos we all took when we
went on holiday. There should be nine in
total - I hope I sent them all! Sadly, it looks
like neither of us had a photo taken with
each person in the group. I think we
snapped more of me than you. I'll stop
hogging the limelight next time!{''}

Who sent this letter, and who received it?
translation:
Birisi, bir arkadasina bir mektup ve
bir dizi fotograf gondermis.

{''}Tatilimizde hep birlikte cekildigimiz
fotograflar burada. Toplam dokuz tane
olmali - umarim hepsini gondermisimdir!
Ne yazik ki ikimiz de gruptaki herkesle
birlikte fotograf cektirememisiz. Sanirim
benim fotografim seninkinden daha cok.
Bir dahaki sefere sahneyi kaplamayacagim!{''}

Bu mektubu kim gonderdi ve kim aldi?

original:
Correct!

The letter was from B to C.
translation:
Dogru!

Mektup B'den C'ye gonderilmisti.

original:
Too bad.

Try to work out which people appear in
which photos.
translation:
Olmadi.

Hangi fotografta hangi kisilerin
gorundugunu bulmaya calis.

original:
Try making a note of who's in which photo
for each photo. Then work out how many
photos A through D appear in respectively.
translation:
Her fotograf icin kimlerin oldugunu
not al. Sonra A'dan D'ye kadar
her birinin kac fotografta ciktigini bul.

original:
A is in six photos, B five, C four and D five
again. According to the letter, the sender is
in more photos than the recipient.

Take each of A, B, C and D in turn, and
check whether or not they appear in photos
with every other person.
translation:
A alti fotografta, B bes, C dort ve D de
yine bes fotografta. Mektuba gore gonderen,
alicidan daha fazla fotografta yer aliyor.

A, B, C ve D'yi sirayla ele al
ve diger herkesle birlikte fotografta
gorunup gorunmediklerini kontrol et.

original:
B and C didn't get to have their photo taken
with every other person. That means they
must be the two people described in the
letter.

The letter said that the sender appeared
in more photos than the recipient. Try
comparing the number of photos B and C
appear in.
translation:
B ve C, gruptaki herkesle
fotograf cektirememis. Bu da onlarin
mektupta bahsedilen iki kisi
olmasi gerektigi anlamina geliyor.

Mektup, gonderenin
alicidan daha fazla fotografta gorundugunu soyluyor.
B ve C'nin gorundugu
fotograf sayisini karsilastir.

original:
Out of B and C, the one who appears in
more photos has to be the sender. If you
followed Hint 2, you should already have
counted the number of photos each person
appears in.

So who appears in the most photos, B or C?
translation:
B ile C'den hangisi
daha cok fotografta gorunuyorsa, gonderen odur.
Ipucu 2'yi takip ettiysen,
herkesin kac fotografta
gorundugunu zaten saymis olmalisin.

Peki en cok fotografta kim var: B mi, C mi?

original: Can you work out the order?
translation: Sirayi cikarabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

C came in first, A second, B third and D
came last. D didn't sound very happy about
the result, did he?
translation:
Dogru!

C birinci, A ikinci, B ucuncu ve D
sonuncu oldu. D sonuctan pek memnun
gorunmuyor, degil mi?

original:
Too bad.

Try and narrow down who participated in
which race.
translation:
Olmadi.

Kimin hangi yarisa katildigini daraltmaya calis.

original:
B didn't make it to the final. In other words,
she lost the first race, so she's one of the
two people competing for third.
translation:
B finale cikamadi. Baska bir deyisle,
ilk yarisi kaybetti; yani ucunculuk icin
yarisan iki kisiden biri.

original:
It seems D lost the race with B. From Hint 1,
you know that B lost the first race and was
competing in the third-place run-off.

In other words, the race in which B beat D
had to have been the run-off.
translation:
D'nin B ile yaptigi yarisi kaybettigi anlasiliyor.
1. Ipucundan, B'nin ilk yarisi kaybettigini ve
ucunculuk icin yaristigini biliyorsun.

Yani B'nin D'yi yendigi yaris,
ucunculuk yarisi olmali.

original:
A won one race and lost another, and C
says she beat A. So that means A's one loss
was in the race against C.

You know from Hint 2 that B and D were
competing in the third place run-off, so that
means A and C had to have been competing
in the final. So who beat who?
translation:
A bir yarisi kazanip birini kaybetmis ve C de
A'yi yendigini soyluyor. Demek ki A'nin
tek yenilgisi C'ye karsi.

2. Ipucundan B ile D'nin ucunculuk icin
yaristigini biliyorsun; o halde finalde
A ile C yarismis olmali. Peki kim kimi yendi?

original:
You know from Hint 2 that B won in the third
place run-off against D. So B came in third,
and D came in fourth. Furthermore, you
know from Hint 3 that the final was between
A and C, and that C won in the end.

So who took first place and who came in
second?
translation:
2. Ipucundan B'nin, D'ye karsi ucunculuk
yarisini kazandigini biliyorsun. Bu durumda
B ucuncu, D dorduncu. Ayrica 3. Ipucundan
finalin A ile C arasinda oldugunu ve sonunda
C'nin kazandigini biliyorsun.

Oyleyse birinci kim, ikinci kim?

original: Complete the cubic maze!
translation: Kup labirenti tamamla!

original:
A young boy wants to stick these six maze
panels together to form a cube, creating a
path from the car to the flag.

Can you create an example without moving
the panels with the car and the flag on
them?

Oh, and make sure that all paths connect up
to the main path between the car and the
flag, leaving no dead ends!
translation:
Genc bir cocuk bu alti labirent
panelini yapistirip bir kup olusturmak, boylece
arabadan bayraga giden bir yol yapmak istiyor.

Araba ve bayrak olan panelleri
yerinden oynatmadan bir
ornek olusturabilir misin?

Ayrica, tum yollarin
araba ile bayrak arasindaki ana yola baglandigindan
emin ol; cikmaz sokak kalmasin!

original:
Correct!

Now he can make a beautiful cubic maze
using your example!
translation:
Dogru!

Artik senin ornegini kullanarak
harika bir kup labirent yapabilir!

original:
Too bad.

Are there any unconnected paths lurking
somewhere?
translation:
Olmadi.

Bir yerlerde baglantisiz
yollar kalmis olabilir mi?

original:
You can start by looking for the panel that
connects the paths coming from the top of
the panel with the flag, but you'll find
yourself with two possibilities.

Think about the other sides and how they'll
connect up. Is there anywhere that can help
you narrow it down to one panel?
translation:
Bayrakli panelin ustunden cikan
yollari baglayan paneli
arayarak baslayabilirsin, ama
iki olasilik bulacaksin.

Diger yuzleri ve nasil
baglanacaklarini dusun. Seni
tek bir panele indirmeye yardim edecek bir sey var mi?

original:
Out of the two possible panels that you
identified in Hint 1, only one fits the paths
coming from the top of the panel with the
car on it.

Think about how your example cubic maze
would look when completed. Which parts
connect where?
translation:
1. ipucunda belirledigin iki olasi panelden
yalnizca biri, arabali panelin ustunden gelen
yollarla
uyumludur.

Ornek kup labirentin tamamlandiginda
nasil gorunecegini dusun. Hangi parcalar
nereye baglaniyor?

original:
See the space immediately above the flag
panel? The paths on the left side of the
panel you place there should connect with
the top of the car panel.

There are two paths running from the top of
the car panel, one on the left and one in the
middle.
translation:
Bayrakli panelin hemen ustundeki boslugu goruyor musun?
Oraya koyacagin panelin sol tarafindaki
yollar, arabali panelin ustuyle
baglanmali.

Arabali panelin ustunden cikan iki yol var:
biri solda, biri de
ortada.

original:
The panel initially placed at the top right is
the one that you should place above the flag
panel. Once you put that into place, the rest
is simple.

Look carefully at the parts that are directly
connected, and arrange the panels so that
the paths line up.
translation:
Basta sag ustte duran panel,
bayrakli panelin ustune koyman gereken paneldir.
Onu yerine koyunca, gerisi
kolay.

Dogrudan baglanan kisimlara dikkatle bak
ve panelleri
yollar hizalanacak sekilde yerlestir.

original: Match up the horses!
translation: Atlari eslestir!

original:
These cheerful tiles can be put together so
they form horse shapes of four different
colours. With these nine tiles, you can make
a total of 12 complete, uniformly coloured
horses within the frame, but at the moment
the colours are all mixed up!

Can you rotate the nine tiles so as to match
up all the colours and make 12 horses?
translation:
Bu neseli karolar birlestirildiginde
dort farkli renkte at sekilleri olusturuyor.
Bu dokuz karo ile cerceve icinde
toplam 12 tane, tek renkten olusan
tam at yapabilirsin, ama su anda
renkler birbirine karismis!

Dokuz karoyu dondurerek
tum renkleri eslestirip 12 at yapabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

The pattern looks so neat and tidy now that
it's all lined up right!
translation:
Dogru!

Hepsi dogru hizalaninca desen
ne kadar duzenli gorunuyor!

original:
Too bad.

You must have missed a tile somewhere
along the line.
translation:
Olmadi.

Bir yerde bir karoyu
kacirmis olmalisin.

original:
Actually, if you know the correct rotation of
just one tile, all the rest should fall into
place.

The problem is how to work out if a tile is
correct. Try to rotate them around a bit and
see for yourself!
translation:
Aslinda tek bir karonun dogru yonunu
bilirsen, geri kalanlarin
hepsi yerine oturur.

Asil sorun, bir karonun dogru olup olmadigini
nasil anlayacagin. Biraz cevirip
kendin gormeyi dene!

original:
Of the nine tiles, there are two you don't
need to rotate.

You can work out which these are by just
taking each tile in turn and rotating
everything around it to see if it all matches
up.
translation:
Dokuz karonun icinde, dondurmene gerek
olmayan iki tane var.

Hangileri oldugunu anlamak icin
her karoyu sirayla secip
cevresindekileri dondurerek
uyup uymadigina bak.

original:
The three tiles in the central column must all
be rotated, so you'll have to try the tiles on
the left or right to use as a focal point.
translation:
Orta sutundaki uc karo mutlaka
dondurulmeli, bu yuzden odak noktasi olarak
soldaki ya da sagdaki karolardan birini denemelisin.

original:
The tiles in the left-hand column must all be
rotated as well. This means that two of the
three tiles on the right-hand side are fine as
they are.

With this info, you should have it worked out
in no time!
translation:
Soldaki sutundaki karolar da
dondurulmeli. Bu da sag taraftaki
uc karodan ikisinin
oldugu gibi dogru oldugunu gosterir.

Bu bilgiyle cozumu
cok kisa surede bulursun!

original: Who was the winner?
translation: Kazanan kimdi?

original:
A and B are confronting each other in a
ten-round card game. The rules of this game
are simple: fire beats wood, wood beats
water and water beats fire.

The details aren't clear, but it seems that A
drew fire three times, wood five times and
water twice, while B drew fire twice, wood
five times and water three times. None of
the rounds were drawn.

Can you work out who won this match?
translation:
A ve B, on tur suren
bir kart oyununda karsi karsiya geliyor. Oyunun
kurallari basit: ates odunu yener,
odun suyu yener ve su atesi yener.

Detaylar net degil, ama gorunen o ki A
a?tesi uc kez, odunu bes kez ve
suyu iki kez cekmis; B ise atesi iki kez,
odunu bes kez ve suyu uc kez cekmis.
Turlarin hicbiri berabere bitmemis.

Bu maci kimin kazandigini bulabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

If A won 3 - 2 when A drew wood, and A
also won 3 - 2 when B drew wood, A must
be the overall winner.
translation:
Dogru!

A, odun cektiginde 3 - 2 kazandiysa ve B
odun cektiginde de A 3 - 2 kazandiysa,
genel kazanan A olmali.

original:
Too bad.

You had a 50/50 chance of guessing
correctly, but you should really think
about the answer!
translation:
Maalesef.

Dogru tahmin etme sansin %50 idi,
ama gercekten dusunmeliydin!

original:
The fact that there were no draws is
important. It means that for every card that
A drew, B drew a different card.
translation:
Beraberlik olmamasi
cok onemli. Bu, A hangi karti cektiyse
B'nin mutlaka farkli bir kart cektigi anlamina gelir.

original:
For instance, if A drew fire, B must have
drawn wood or water. If you know how many
of each type of card each player got, you
should be able to calculate the win/loss ratio.

Basically, if you match up the number of one
type of card that A drew with the total of the
other two types that B drew, that's half the
battle.
translation:
Ornegin A ates cektiyse, B ya
odun ya da su cekmis olmali. Her oyuncunun
her tur karttan kac tane aldigini biliyorsan,
galibiyet/maglubiyet oranini hesaplayabilirsin.

Temel olarak, A'nin cektigi bir tur kartin sayisini
B'nin cektigi diger iki turun toplamiyla
eslestirirsen, isin yarisi tamamdir.

original:
A drew wood five times. In those five rounds,
B drew fire twice and water three times. From
this, we can gather that A must have beaten
B three times and lost twice.

You can use similar logic to determine the
results of the five bouts when B drew wood.
Then it's just a question of adding all the
results up and working out who had the most
wins.
translation:
A odunu bes kez cekti. Bu bes turda
B iki kez ates, uc kez su cekti. Buradan,
A'nin B'yi uc kez yendigini ve iki kez kaybettigini
anlariz.

Benzer mantikla B'nin odun cektigi bes turun
sonucunu da bulabilirsin.
Sonra tum sonuclari toplayip
kimin daha cok galibiyet aldigini gorursun.

original:
The five times that A drew wood, B drew fire
twice and water three times, so A won 3 - 2.

The five times that B drew wood, A drew fire
three times and water twice, meaning A won
3 - 2 again.

Now add them up. Who wins?
translation:
A'nin odun cektigi bes seferde B
iki kez ates, uc kez su cekti; yani A 3 - 2 kazandi.

B'nin odun cektigi bes seferde ise A
uc kez ates, iki kez su cekti; bu da A'nin
yine 3 - 2 kazandigi anlamina gelir.

Simdi topla. Kim kazaniyor?

original: Enthrone the emperor!
translation: Imparatoru tahta cikar!

original:
Six penguins are standing on an iceberg,
five small ones and their rather portly
emperor. All penguins can move either
horizontally or vertically, but once in motion
they won't stop until they hit another
penguin - if there's nothing in the way,
they'll plunge straight into the sea.

Can you help the emperor penguin get back
to his rightful place in the centre of the
iceberg?
translation:
Alti penguen bir buzdaginin uzerinde duruyor;
besi kucuk, biri ise biraz tombul
imparatorlari. Tum penguenler yatay ya da
dikey hareket edebilir, fakat bir kez hareket edince
baska bir penguene carpana kadar durmazlar.
Onlerinde bir engel yoksa,
dosdogru denize duserler.

Imparator penguenin buzdaginin
ortasindaki hak ettigi yerine donmesine
yardim edebilir misin?

original:
Correct!

Were you able to guide the emperor to the
centre without losing a single penguin to the
sea?

You can solve this puzzle in only five moves.
Have another shot if you used more than
that!
translation:
Dogru!

Hicbir pengueni denize dusurmeden
imparatoru merkeze goturebildin mi?

Bu bulmacayi sadece bes hamlede cozebilirsin.
Daha fazla hamle yaptiysan bir daha dene!

original:
Too bad.

Try to move the emperor by bumping him
around against the other penguins so that
he never falls off the iceberg.
translation:
Maalesef.

Imparatoru, diger penguenlere carptirarak
hareket ettirmeye calis; boylece
buzdagindan hic dusmez.

original:
If you move the emperor first, he'll fall into
the sea before he reaches the centre.

First, consider which penguins the emperor
will need to bump into to stay on the ice.
The first step will be to move the penguin
to the far right of the emperor.
translation:
Imparatoru once hareket ettirirsen,
merkeze ulasmadan denize duser.

Once imparatorun buzda kalmak icin
hangi penguenlere carpmasi gerektigini dusun.
Ilk adim, imparatorun en sagindaki
pengueni hareket ettirmek olmali.

original:
Did you slide that far-right penguin into
the emperor?

Now move the emperor penguin three times,
making sure he doesn't fall into the water.
He should stop one square to the left of the
centre square.
translation:
En sagdaki pengueni
imparatora kaydirdin mi?

Simdi imparatoru uc kez hareket ettir,
ama suya dusmemesine dikkat et.
Merkez karenin bir solundaki karede
durmali.

original:
Slide the emperor to the right until he collides
with the penguin on the right side, then move
him down into another.

He should now be only inches away from the
goal!
translation:
Imparatoru saga kaydirip
sag taraftaki penguene carpana kadar ilerlet,
sonra asagi indirip bir baskasina carptir.

Artik hedefe sadece
birkac adim kaldi!

original:
Let's start again from the beginning and
make sure not to let any penguin fall off
the iceberg. Start by moving the penguin
to the far right of the emperor leftwards.
Then move the emperor up, right, down,
right, down, left and finally up!

Voil{`a}! The emperor arrives at his iceberg
throne!
translation:
En bastan baslayalim ve
hicbir penguenin buzdagindan dusmesine
izin vermeyelim. Imparatorun en sagindaki
pengueni sola kaydirarak basla.
Sonra imparatoru sirasiyla yukari, saga, asagi,
saga, asagi, sola ve son olarak yukari hareket ettir!

Voil{`a}! Imparator buzdagi
tahtina ulasti!

original: Turn all the rabbits brown!
translation: Butun tavsanlari kahverengiye cevir!

original:
Here are some rather unusual rabbit toys.

There are three rules:
1. The rabbits can only move by jumping
horizontally, diagonally or vertically over
other rabbits.
2. They can jump over any number of
rabbits at once.
3. A white rabbit will turn brown when
jumped over, and vice versa.

Can you make all the rabbits here turn
brown, following the rules given above?
translation:
Iste biraz tuhaf tavsan oyuncaklari.

Uc kural var:
1. Tavsanlar yalnizca diger tavsanlarin uzerinden
yatay, capraz ya da dikey atlayarak hareket eder.
2. Ayni anda istenen sayida tavsanin uzerinden
atlayabilirler.
3. Uzerinden atlaninca beyaz tavsan kahverengiye,
kahverengi tavsan da beyaza doner.

Yukaridaki kurallara uyarak buradaki tum
tavsanlari kahverengi yapabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

And all it took was a few big leaps from our
brave bouncing bunnies! It just goes to show
what a little courage can do!
translation:
Dogru!

Cesur ziplayan tavsanlarimizin birkac buyuk
hamlesi yetti! Azicik cesaret neler yapar!

original:
Too bad.

You can change a lot of the rabbits' colours
by making good use of the corner tiles.
translation:
Olmadi.

Kose karelerini iyi kullanirsan bircok tavsanin
rengini degistirebilirsin.

original:
Start by having the rabbit in the top right
jump down. That should turn one rabbit
brown and open up the top-right corner.
translation:
Once sag ustteki tavsani asagi ziplat.
Bu, bir tavsani kahverengiye cevirir ve
sag ust koseyi acar.

original:
Next, move the bottom-left white rabbit into
the top-right corner and then into the top-left
corner.
translation:
Sonra sol alttaki beyaz tavsani sag ust
koseye, ardindan sol ust koseye tasi.

original:
Make the white rabbit you moved in Hint 2
jump down to the bottom-right corner,
followed by the bottom-left corner.

The solution should be becoming clearer
now.
translation:
Ipucu 2'de hareket ettirdigin beyaz tavsani
sag alta, ardindan sol alta ziplat.

Cozum artik daha net olmali.

original:
After following the hints up to Hint 3, you
should now have a white rabbit in the
bottom-left corner. Move him upwards. That
leaves you with one white rabbit on each
side of the puzzle.

Now then, what should you do to make them
turn brown?
translation:
Ipucu 3'e kadar olanlari yaptiktan sonra,
sol alt kosede beyaz bir tavsan kalmali.
Onu yukari tasi. Boylece bulmacanin her
kenarinda birer beyaz tavsan kalir.

Peki onlari kahverengiye cevirmek icin
ne yapmalisin?

original: Put the lights in order!
translation: Isiklari siraya diz!

original:
The ringmaster's having a word with the man
in charge of lighting - an angry word.

{''}Hey! What do you call this mess?! Put
those lights in order, on the double!
Leave the top-left and bottom-right ones,
they're all right. You need to move and
rotate the rest! Remember, they need to
be in order from top left to bottom right!{''}
translation:
Sirk sefi, isiklardan sorumlu adamla
konusuyor - hem de ofkeyle.

{''}Hey! Bu da ne boyle?! Su isiklari hemen
duzene sok, cabuk!
Sol ust ve sag alttakileri birak,
onlar dogru yerde. Digerlerini tasimak ve
dondurmek zorundasin! Unutma, sol ustten
sag alta dogru sirali olmalilar!{''}

original:
Correct!

So the lights were supposed to be in the
shape of the numbers 1 to 8! The show
must go on!
translation:
Dogru!

Demek ki isiklar 1'den 8'e kadar
sayilarin seklinde olmaliymis! Gosteri
devam etmeli!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
The ringmaster said to put the lights in order.
What did he mean?

Do you notice anything about the lights in
the top left and bottom right? Those ones
are placed correctly, remember.
translation:
Sirk sefi isiklari siraya diz dedi.
Ne demek istedi?

Sol ustteki ve sag alttaki isiklarda
bir sey fark ediyor musun? Unutma,
onlar dogru yerlestirilmisti.

original:
Have you worked out what the ringmaster
meant when he said the top-left and bottom-
right lights were all right? Try holding your
Nintendo 3DS at a distance and looking at
the Touch Screen.

They look like numbers, don't they?
translation:
Sirk sefinin sol ust ve sag alt
isiklarin dogru oldugunu soylerken
ne demek istedigini cozdun mu? Nintendo 3DS'ini
biraz uzakta tutup
Dokunmatik Ekran'a bakmayi dene.

Sayiya benziyorlar, degil mi?

original:
The lights at the top left and bottom right
represent numbers. The top-left lights
represent 1, and the bottom-right ones 8.
Oh, and it seems that there are eight places
to place the lights, as well.

The order in which to place the lights should
now be as clear as day.
translation:
Sol ustteki ve sag alttaki isiklar
sayilari temsil ediyor. Sol usttekiler
1'i, sag alttakiler ise 8'i gosteriyor.
Ayrica isiklari yerlestirecek
sekiz yer oldugu da anlasiliyor.

Simdi isiklari hangi sirayla koyman
gerektigi gun gibi ortada.

original:
Place the lights so that they represent the
numbers 1, 2, 3 and so on in order.

Oh, and one more thing. In order of colour,
the lights should be: white, red, blue, yellow,
yellow, blue, red and then white.
translation:
Isiklari, 1, 2, 3 ve devami
sirasiyla sayilari gosterecek sekilde yerlestir.

Bir sey daha var. Renk sirasina gore
isiklar soyle olmali: beyaz, kirmizi, mavi, sari,
sari, mavi, kirmizi ve son olarak beyaz.

original: Who's in the tent?
translation: Cadirda kim var?

original:
After finishing work for the day and changing
back into their normal clothes, the members
of a circus troupe gather in the big tent to
celebrate another successful performance.
It's a bit nippy in there at night, so they're
warming up with a few rounds of hot
chocolate.

It's hard to tell just by looking at the
silhouettes, but there's at least one member
of the troupe missing. Who is in the tent?
Select each person who is present.
translation:
Gunun isini bitirip kiyafetlerini degistirerek
yeniden normal kiyafetlerini giyen
sirk toplulugunun uyeleri buyuk cadirda
bir baska basarili gosteriyi kutlamak icin
toplanir. Geceleri icerisi biraz serin oldugundan,
birkac tur sicak
cikolata icerek isiniyorlar.

Sadece siluetlere bakarak
anlamak zor, ama toplulugun en az bir
uyesi eksik. Cadirda kim var?
Orada bulunan herkesi sec.

original:
Correct!

All members aside from the chap second
from the right are present and accounted
for.

Let's hope they don't stay up too late.
They've got another busy day ahead of
them.
translation:
Dogru!

Sagdan ikinci
adam haric tum uyeler burada
ve yerli yerinde.

Umarim cok gece kalmazlar.
Onlerinde yine yogun bir gun
var.

original:
Too bad.

Take a deep breath and try again.
translation:
Olmadi.

Derin bir nefes alip yeniden dene.

original:
There are three mugs raised, which means
there must be three people raising a toast.

If you have a look at the hairstyles of the
people involved in the toast, you can make
out the man on the left side of the Touch
Screen, the lady second from the left, and,
if you look closely, the gentleman fourth
from the left.
translation:
Uc kupa havaya kaldirilmis; bu da
kadeh kaldiran uc kisi olmasi gerektigi anlamina gelir.

Kadeh kaldiranlarin
sac modellerine bakarsan,
Dokunmatik Ekran'in sol tarafindaki erkegi,
soldan ikinci kadini ve,
dikkatle bakarsan soldan dorduncu
beyefendiyi secebilirsin.

original:
Pay close attention to the far ends of the
tent. There's a silhouette that looks like a
vase of flowers on the far right. But what
about the silhouette on the far left? Is that a
vase of flowers too?
translation:
Cadirin en uc
kisimlarina dikkat et. En sagda cicek vazosuna
benzeyen bir siluet var. Peki
en soldaki siluet ne? O da
bir cicek vazosu mu?

original:
What's that odd shape you can see below
the two mugs in the middle? It seems too
lumpy to be a table. And too uneven to be
a sofa. Why, it looks more like the silhouette
of someone lying down!
translation:
Ortadaki iki kupanin altinda gordugun
tuhaf sekil de ne? Bir masa olmak icin fazla
yumrulu. Bir kanepe olmak icin de fazla
engebeli. Daha cok birinin uzanmis
siluetine benziyor!

original:
Have a look again at the silhouette on the
far left that looks like a vase of flowers.
Can you see the legs? It looks as if that
must be the lady third from the left.

That leaves just one person: the lazybones
having a lie-down in the middle of the tent.
Who's that?
translation:
En soldaki, cicek vazosuna benzeyen
siluete tekrar bak.
Bacaklari gorebiliyor musun? Bu, sanki
soldan ucuncu kadin olmali.

Geriye tek kisi kaliyor: cadirin ortasinda
uzanip yatan
tembel. O kim?

original: How many people crossed?
translation: Kac kisi gecti?

original:
Here's a bridge at the side of a river. The
ground's all muddy, so you can see the
footprints left by all the people who've been
here recently. None of them seem to have
had the same footwear.

So, can you tell how many people crossed
the bridge?
translation:
Iste nehrin kenarinda bir kopru. Zemin
tamamen camurlu, bu yuzden
buradan yakin zamanda gecen herkesin
ayak izlerini gorebiliyorsun. Hicbiri
ayni ayakkabiyi giymis gibi gorunmuyor.

Peki, kopruden kac kisinin gectigini
soyleyebilir misin?

original:
Correct!

Only two people crossed the bridge. There
might be a lot of footprints in front of the
bridge, but there are only footprints for two
on the bridge itself.
translation:
Dogru!

Kopruden yalnizca iki kisi gecti. Koprunun
onunde cok ayak izi olabilir, ama koprunun
uzerinde sadece iki kisiye ait
ayak izi var.

original:
Too bad.

Take a deep breath, and have another think
about it.
translation:
Olmadi.

Derin bir nefes al ve
bir daha dusun.

original:
This is a bit of a trick question, so take care
not to get caught out.
translation:
Bu biraz yaniltmacali bir soru, dikkat et de
kandirilma.

original:
You might get the impression that a lot of
people crossed the bridge, but are you
positive about that?
translation:
Bir suru kisinin
kopruden gectigini dusunebilirsin, ama
bundan emin misin?

original:
Read the question carefully.

Sure, there are plenty of footprints in front
of the bridge, but can you tell out of those
how many crossed the bridge?
translation:
Soruyu dikkatle oku.

Evet, koprunun onunde
bir suru ayak izi var, ama bunlardan
kacinin kopruden gectigini
soyleyebilir misin?

original:
The puzzle is asking you to look only for
the number of people who actually crossed
the bridge.

You don't need to bother counting the
footprints in front of the bridge. You just
need to focus on the ones that appear on
the bridge. Count those and the answer
should be clear.
translation:
Bulmaca senden yalnizca gercekten
kopruden gecen kisi sayisina bakmani istiyor.

Koprunun onundeki
izleri saymana gerek yok. Sadece
koprunun uzerinde gorunenlere odaklan.
Onlari say ve cevap
netlesecektir.

original: Which umbrella matches?
translation: Hangi semsiye ayni?

original:
A friend of yours is having a bit of trouble
in a shop.

{''}A sudden gust of wind has broken my
brolly! It was my favourite, too.

I was hoping to buy a new one with the
exact same design, but all the umbrellas
here look pretty similar and I don't know
which one to get.{''}

Which umbrella should he pick?
translation:
Bir arkadasin bir dukkanda biraz zor
durumda.

{''}Ani bir ruzgar esintisi semsiyemi kirdi!
Ustelik en sevdigimdi.

Ayni desende yenisini almak istiyordum ama
buradaki semsiyelerin hepsi birbirine cok
benziyor; hangisini alacagimi bilmiyorum.{''}

Sence hangi semsiyeyi secmeli?

original:
Correct!

The answer is brolly B.

A's handle is different, C's handle has no
decoration, D has more spokes and E has a
design on the inside as well as the outside.
translation:
Dogru!

Cevap semsiye B.

A'nin sapi farkli, C'nin sapinda sus yok,
D'nin telleri daha fazla ve E'nin deseni
disinin yani sira icinde de var.

original:
Too bad.

Look carefully, and you'll spot the parts
which are clearly different.
translation:
Olmadi.

Dikkatle bakarsan, acikca farkli olan
kisimlari fark edeceksin.

original:
Let's start by comparing the handles. They
all seem to have a J shape, although A has
a more angular design. We can rule out A,
then.

Now then, what other differences can you
find? How about the part directly above the
bit we were just looking at?
translation:
Once saplari karsilastiralim. Hepsi J
seklinde gibi gorunuyor ama A'nin tasarimi
daha koseli. O halde A'yi eleyebiliriz.

Peki baska ne fark bulabilirsin? Az once
baktigimiz kismin hemen ustundeki bolgeye
ne dersin?

original:
Next, compare the decorations on the handle
guard, just above the handle on each
umbrella. C doesn't have any decoration and
you can't see D's. Is it hidden? You won't
be able to know for sure, then.

Hang on - which parts of your friend's
umbrella were the most badly broken?
Try counting those.
translation:
Sonra, her semsiyede sapin hemen ustunde
yer alan korumali kisimdaki susleri karsilastir.
C'de hic sus yok ve D'ninki gorunmuyor.
Gizli mi? O zaman emin olamazsin.

Dur bir dakika-arkadasinin
semsiyesinde en kotu kirilan kisimlar
hangileriydi? Onlari saymayi dene.

original:
Umbrella D has quite a lot of spokes. A lot
more than the broken umbrella, that's for
sure. That just leaves B and E.

You can just make out a white polka-dot
pattern on the broken umbrella, so does that
mean you can rule out B, which has different
colours? No, it doesn't. It's possible that the
whole pattern on the broken umbrella is
hidden from view.
translation:
Semsiye D'nin oldukca fazla teli var.
Kirik semsiyeden cok daha fazla, kesin.
Geriye B ve E kaliyor.

Kirik semsiyede beyaz puantiye
desenini az da olsa gorebiliyorsun; bu
B'yi (renkleri farkli) eleyebilecegin
anlamina mi geliyor? Hayir. Kirik semsiyenin
deseninin buyuk kismi gozden sakli olabilir.

original:
Have another look at the broken umbrella.
Which part is the most visible? The inside.

Looking at the inside of the umbrella, you'd
be forgiven for thinking the whole thing is
patternless.

Now, have another look at B and E. Doesn't
one umbrella look completely different on the
inside?
translation:
Kirik semsiyeye bir kez daha bak.
En cok hangi kismi gorunuyor? Ici.

Icine bakinca, sanki hic desen yokmus gibi
dusunebilirsin.

Simdi B ve E'ye tekrar bak. Ic yuzu tamamen
farkli gorunen bir tanesi yok mu?

original: How many bulls are there?
translation: Kac boga var?

original:
Deep inside this cave is what appears to be
a cave painting from many thousands of
years ago. The cave is dark, so it's difficult
to make out the entire painting.

Your lamp can only illuminate one part at a
time, but can you count how many bulls are
depicted here?
translation:
Bu magaranin derinlerinde, binlerce
yil oncesinden kalma bir magara resmi
oldugu anlasilan bir resim var. Magara karanlik,
bu yuzden tum resmi secmek zor.

Fenerin ayni anda sadece bir bolgeyi
aydinlatabiliyor, peki burada kac boga
resmedildigini sayabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

There are nine small bulls and one large
one.
translation:
Dogru!

Dokuz kucuk boga ve bir buyuk
boga var.

original:
Too bad.

Use your lamp to light up every corner of
the painting.
translation:
Olmadi.

Resmin her kosesini
fenerinle aydinlat.

original:
Start from the edge of the painting, move the
lamp along and count the bulls as you go.
Some of them are fairly small, so look
closely!
translation:
Resmin kenarindan basla, feneri
boyunca gezdirerek bogalari say.
Bazilari oldukca kucuk, o yuzden
dikkatle bak!

original:
Did you count all the bulls you could see,
but still got the answer wrong?

Those were definitely bulls, so you didn't
count something that wasn't a bull. But
maybe you missed one? Do another pass
over the painting with your lamp.
translation:
Gorebildigin tum bogalari saydin ama
yine de yanlis mi cikti?

Onlar kesinlikle bogaydi, yani boga olmayan
bir seyi saymadin. Ama
birini kacirmis olabilirsin. Fenerinle
resmin uzerinden bir kez daha gec.

original:
You've probably found nine bulls in the
painting. That's not all of them. However,
you're not going to find any more by
concentrating on just one spot. Perhaps
you're missing the wood for the trees?
translation:
Muhtemelen resimde dokuz boga
buldun. Hepsi bu degil. Ancak,
tek bir noktaya takilirsan daha fazlasini
bulamazsin. Belki de butunu
gormeyi kaciriyorsun?

original:
There are nine smaller bulls and one giant
bull. You should see it if you cast your eyes
over the entire painting.
translation:
Dokuz kucuk boga ve bir dev
boga var. Gozlerini
tum resmin uzerinde gezdirirsen onu
gormelisin.

original: Arrange the totem blocks!
translation: Totem bloklarini duzenle!

original:
Who's responsible for this mess?! Each of
these columns should be three blocks high
and have a totem head on top! The heads
were arranged from left to right in this order:
yellow, blue, green, red.

Can you use the mallet to shunt the blocks
around and restore the columns to their
original grandeur?

Be careful, though: <CR>you can never hit the
top block in a column</C>. Think carefully about
which order to hit the blocks in.
translation:
Bu daginikligin sorumlusu kim?! Her bir
sutun uc blok yuksekliginde olmali ve
en ustunde bir totem kafasi olmali! Kafalar
soldan saga su sirayla dizilmisti:
sari, mavi, yesil, kirmizi.

Tokmagi kullanarak bloklari
saga sola itip sutunlari
eski ihtisamina kavusturabilir misin?

Ama dikkat: <CR>asla bir
sutunun en ust bloguna vuramazsin</C>. Hangi
bloklara hangi sirayla vuracagini iyi dusun.

original:
Well done!

Even the totem heads themselves seem
happy to be back in their places...
Or do they?
translation:
Aferin!

Totem kafalarinin kendisi bile
yerlerine dondukleri icin mutlu gorunuyor...
Yoksa degil mi?

original:
Too bad.

Watch where you swing that mallet!
translation:
Olmadi.

Tokmagi salladigin yere dikkat et!

original:
You'll want to start by shunting blocks into
the second column, which is currently empty.
Make sure the totem heads never fall below
their final position, fourth from the bottom.
translation:
Baslamak icin bloklari
su anda bos olan ikinci sutuna
itmek isteyeceksin.
Totem kafalarinin, son konumlarinin
altina - yani alttan dorduncu siranin altina -
asla dusmemesine dikkat et.

original:
If you hit any block in the leftmost column,
the blue totem head will fall below its final
position, so leave that column alone for
now.

Wielding the mallet from the right-hand side,
shunt three blocks into the empty second
column.
translation:
En soldaki sutunda
hangi bir bloga vurursan,
mavi totem kafasi son konumunun
altina duser; bu yuzden
simdilik o sutuna dokunma.

Tokmagi sag taraftan kullanarak
uc blogu bos ikinci
sutuna it.

original:
There are various ways to solve this puzzle.
One is to keep hitting wherever the bottom,
rightmost arrow points. After three hits, you
should have two blocks in the fourth column.
Shunt the plain block under the red totem
head to the right, and then all you need to
do is get the heads in the right place.
translation:
Bu bulmacayi cozmenin cesitli yolu var.
Bunlardan biri, altta en sagdaki okun
gosterdigi yere vurmaya devam etmek.
Uc vurustan sonra,
dorduncu sutunda iki blok olmali.
Kirmizi totem kafasinin altindaki
duz blogu saga it, sonra
geriye sadece kafalari dogru yere
getirmek kalir.

original:
Continuing from Hint 3, you should have the
yellow and blue heads in the first column and
the red and green ones in the third column,
right?

Now hit the green head from the right and
the rest should be easy!
translation:
3. Ipucu'ndan devam edersen,
sari ve mavi kafalar birinci sutunda,
kirmizi ve yesil olanlar ucuncu sutunda,
degil mi?

Simdi yesil kafaya sagdan vur
ve gerisi kolay olmali!

original: Guide the ladybird!
translation: Ugur bocegini yonlendir!

original:
Two ladybird friends, one red and one blue,
have lost each other on this corncob.
Wherever they go, the corn kernels seem
to get between them!

Can you guide the red ladybird around the
corncob to meet its blue friend?
translation:
Bir kirmizi, bir mavi iki ugur bocegi
bu misir kocaninda birbirini kaybetmis.
Nereye gitseler, misir taneleri
aralarina giriyor!

Kirmizi ugur bocegini kocanin uzerinde
yonlendirip mavi arkadasiyla
bulusturabilir misin?

original:
Well done!

From a ladybird's point of view, a corncob
must seem like an impenetrable maze.
translation:
Tebrikler!

Bir ugur boceginin gozunden bakinca,
bir misir kocani gecilmez bir labirent gibi
gorunuyordur.

original:
Too bad.

Have a good think and you should be able
to find a path.
translation:
Olmadi.

Iyice dusunursen bir yol
bulabilirsin.

original:
Stay calm and take your time, and you'll get
there eventually! If you get completely lost,
you can always start again from the
beginning.

For now, head upwards!
translation:
Sakin ol ve acele etme, sonunda
basaracaksin! Tamamen kaybolursan,
her zaman bastan
baslayabilirsin.

Simdilik yukari dogru ilerle!

original:
Where are you getting lost?

All right, start over from the beginning and
head upwards from there. You'll soon find
yourself at a fork with three possible paths.

Take the middle route and head for that
green corn kernel you can see on the
horizon.
translation:
Nerede kayboluyorsun?

Tamam, bastan basla ve
oradan yukari dogru ilerle. Yakinda uc olasi
yolun ayrildigi bir catala varacaksin.

Ortadaki yolu sec ve
ufukta gorebildigin o
yesil misir tanesine dogru git.

original:
Have you reached the green kernel
mentioned in Hint 2? Next, take the path
right of the green kernel.

You're well on your way now!
translation:
Ipucu 2'de bahsedilen yesil taneye
ulastin mi? Simdi yesil tanenin
sagindaki yolu sec.

Artik dogru yoldasin!

original:
Continuing from Hint 3, once you're on the
path to the right of the green kernel, stick to
the left wall. Just keep left and go on until
you spot the little blue ladybird!
translation:
Ipucu 3'ten devam ederek, yesil tanenin sagindaki
yola girdikten sonra sol duvara
yaslan. Surekli soldan git ve
en sonunda kucuk mavi ugur bocegini
gordugunde dur!

original: Reconstruct the fossil!
translation: Fosili yeniden birlestir!

original:
This splendid fossil is broken into nine
pieces. It was actually restored once before,
but, well, let's just say one of the research
assistants is a bit of a butterfingers.

It used to be a 3 x 3 square. Think you
can get it back to normal?

Since it's quite fragile and broken enough
as it is, you can only move three pieces at
a time horizontally or vertically. Put it back
together in the centre of the grid.
translation:
Bu harika fosil dokuz parcaya
ayrilmis. Aslinda bir kez daha once
onarilmisti ama, sey... Diyelim ki
arastirma asistanlarindan biri biraz sakar.

Eskiden 3 x 3 bir kareydi. Sence
onu eski haline getirebilir misin?

Zaten epey kirilgan ve yeterince parcalanmis
oldugu icin, ayni anda sadece uc parcayi
yatay ya da dikey olarak hareket ettirebilirsin.
Ortadaki izgarada yeniden birlestir.

original:
Correct!

So it was an ammonite fossil.

You can solve this puzzle in just four moves.
Who'd have thought it was so simple?
translation:
Dogru!

Demek ki bu bir ammonit fosiliymis.

Bu bulmacayi sadece dort hamlede
cozebilirsin. Bu kadar basit olacagini
kim dusunurdu?

original:
Too bad.

We won't find out what kind of fossil it is at
this rate!
translation:
Olmadi.

Bu gidisle fosilin ne oldugunu
asla ogrenemeyecegiz!

original:
You can put this fossil back together in just
four moves. If you get it wrong, it'll make
things harder for you, so be careful when
moving the pieces.
translation:
Bu fosili sadece dort hamlede yeniden
birlestirebilirsin. Yanlis yaparsan
isini zorlastirirsin, bu yuzden parcalari
tasirken dikkatli ol.

original:
You can only move three pieces at a time.
This is actually to your advantage, as it
reduces the number of possible parts you
can move.

Remember, you want to move the pieces in
order to have the complete fossil in the
middle nine squares of the grid.
translation:
Ayni anda sadece uc parcayi hareket
ettirebilirsin. Bu aslinda avantajin;
cunku hareket ettirebilecegin olasi
parca gruplarini azaltiyor.

Unutma, amacin fosilin tamamini
izgaranin ortasindaki dokuz karede
toplamak.

original:
Here's some more hands-on advice: first,
move the three pieces in the second column
from the left down one row.

What should your next move be? Remember,
you want the result to be in the middle nine
squares.
translation:
Daha somut bir ipucu: once,
soldan ikinci sutundaki uc parcayi
bir satir asagi indir.

Siradaki hamlen ne olmali? Unutma,
sonuc ortadaki dokuz karede olmali.

original:
Continuing on from Hint 3, move the three
pieces in the centre column up one row.
Next, move the three pieces in the second
row from the bottom over to the right one
column.

Can you work out the last move?
translation:
3. Ipucundan devam ederek, orta sutundaki
uc parcayi bir satir yukari tasi. Sonra,
alttan ikinci satirdaki uc parcayi saga
bir sutun kaydir.

Son hamleyi cikarabilir misin?

original: Ring the bell!
translation: Zili caldir!

original:
Ring the bell and send the signal to Randall!

Set the order in which the four slingshots are
shot. The shots will only bounce off the first
thing they come into contact with, and any
obstructions they hit will break and
disappear.

Get it right and the bell will ring!
translation:
Zili caldir ve Randall'a sinyal gonder!

Dort sapanin hangi sirayla
ateslenecegini ayarla. Atislar yalnizca ilk
temas ettikleri seye carpip seker ve
vurduklari tum
engeller kirilip
yok olur.

Dogru yaparsan zil calar!

original:
Well done!

The bell rang. Hopefully Randall heard it!
translation:
Tebrikler!

Zil caldi. Umarim Randall duymustur!

original: Try again.
translation: Tekrar dene.

original:
You need to think about how to get rid of
the cat ornament, flowerpot and brick.

Don't aim for the bell right away. Deal with
those obstructions first.
translation:
Kedi susunu, saksiyi ve tuglayi
nasil ortadan kaldiracagini dusun.

Hemen zili hedefleme. Once
bu engellerle ugras.

original:
There is more than one way to solve this
puzzle.

For example, try setting the rightmost
slingshot to fire first, which gets rid of the
cat. Now, in which order would you need to
fire the others to ring the bell?
translation:
Bu bulmacayi cozmenin birden fazla yolu var.

Ornegin, en sagdaki
sapani once atesleyip kediyi yok etmeyi dene.
Simdi, digerlerini hangi sirayla
ateslersen zil calar?

original:
Here's an example of how to get rid of the
obstructions.

You should tackle the cat first, then the
brick, then the flowerpot. You'll then be able
to ring the bell.

The key is in how you break the brick.
translation:
Engelleri yok etmenin bir ornegi:

Once kediyi, sonra
tuglayi, sonra da saksiyi halletmelisin. Boylece
zili calabilirsin.

Asil kilit, tuglayi nasil kiracaginda.

original:
You remembered to get rid of the cat with
the rightmost slingshot first, right?

Next, use the leftmost slingshot to break
the brick.

You should be able to work out the order
of the last two for yourself.
translation:
En sagdaki sapanla once kediyi yok etmeyi
unutmadin, degil mi?

Sonra, en soldaki sapani kullanip
tuglayi kir.

Son iki atisin sirasini
artik kendin bulabilmelisin.

original: Carry the luggage!
translation: Bagaji tasiyin!

original:
Two porters have to carry two pieces of
luggage of unknown weight. Each piece
weighs a different amount and they both
weigh at least 10 kg. Their total weight is
40 kg or less.

Each porter can carry up to 20 kg at once,
and they want to carry both pieces of
luggage in one go.

How should they carry the luggage? Put
the luggage in their hands and then ring
the bell.
translation:
Iki hamal, agirligi bilinmeyen iki parca
bagaj tasimak zorunda. Her parca
farkli agirlikta ve ikisi de
en az 10 kg. Toplam agirliklari
40 kg ya da daha az.

Her hamal bir seferde en fazla 20 kg
tasiyabiliyor ve iki parcayi da
tek seferde tasimak istiyorlar.

Bagaji nasil tasimalilar? Bagajlari
ellerine yerlestir ve sonra
zili cal.

original:
Correct!

The solution is for them to share the load.
Teamwork is everything!
translation:
Dogru!

Cozum yuku paylasmalari.
Takim calismasi her seydir!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
Start by having them hold the luggage in as
many ways as you can think of. Perhaps
you'll come across the solution.
translation:
Once aklina gelen olabildigince cok sekilde
bagaji tutmalarini dene. Belki
cozume rastlarsin.

original:
It appears that even if the porters take one
piece of luggage each, they won't be able
to carry both pieces. What to do, then?

One fact you should bear in mind is that in
total, the two pieces of luggage weigh 40 kg
or less.
translation:
Gorunuse gore hamallar birer parca
bagaj alsa bile ikisini de
tasiyamiyorlar. O halde ne yapmali?

Unutmaman gereken bir sey var:
Iki bagajin toplam agirligi
40 kg ya da daha az.

original:
One of the pieces of luggage must weigh
more than 20 kg. That's why it's impossible
for the porters to take one piece each.

Is there some way the porters could work
together to carry the luggage?
translation:
Bagajlardan biri 20 kg'dan
daha agir olmali. Bu yuzden
hamallarin birer parca almasi imkansiz.

Hamallarin bagaji tasimak icin
birlikte calisabilecegi bir yol var mi?

original:
Why not try placing both pieces of luggage
right in the middle, between the two porters,
then ringing the bell.

What do you suppose will happen?
translation:
Neden iki bagaji da
iki hamalin tam ortasina, aralarina koyup
sonra zili calmiyorsun?

Sence ne olacak?

original: Form a card suit!
translation: Bir iskambil sembolu olustur!

original:
Four large painted crates are standing here.
When stacked in a certain way, these crates
combine to create one of the four symbols of
a card suit: either spade, heart, diamond
or club.

Use the crane to move the four crates and
place them on the dais on the right so that
they form this card suit symbol. You can
rotate the crates horizontally in mid-air.
translation:
Burada boyali dort buyuk sandik duruyor.
Belirli bir sekilde ust uste konduklarinda,
bu sandiklar iskambil destesindeki dort
sembolden birini olusturur: maca, kupa, karo
ya da sinek.

Vincle dort sandigi tasi ve
sagdaki platforma yerlestirerek
bu sembolu olustur. Sandiklari
havadayken yatay olarak dondurebilirsin.

original:
Well done!

So the crates were meant to form a suit of
clubs!
translation:
Aferin!

Sandiklar
sinek sembolunu olusturmak icinmis!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
Have a close look at the pattern painted on
the sides of each crate.

Start with the crate on the top left. It has on
its four sides what seems to be the top-left
corners of a diamond and of a club, and the
top-right corners of a diamond and of a
heart. Clearly, this must be one of the two
top crates! This also shows that you can rule
out the spade altogether.
translation:
Her sandigin yanlarina boyanan desene
dikkatlice bak.

Sol ustteki sandikla basla. Dort yuzunde,
karonun ve sinegin sol ust
koseleriyle karonun sag ust kosesi ve
kupasinin sag ust kosesi gibi parcalar var.
Bu acikca iki ust sandiktan biri olmali!
Bu ayrica maca sembolunu
tamamen eleyebilecegini de gosterir.

original:
Next, let's take the top-right crate. One of its
sides has the top-right corner of a spade,
but you already know you can't make a
spade, so you can discount that. All three
other sides have a bottom corner.

Now picture what each quarter of a card suit
symbol would look like. Some parts might be
the same for spades and clubs, or for hearts
and diamonds.
translation:
Simdi sag ustteki sandiga bakalim. Yuzlerinden birinde
maca sembolunun sag ust kosesi var,
ama artik maca yapamayacagini bildigine gore
bunu goz ardi edebilirsin. Diger uc yuzde ise
alt kose parcalari bulunuyor.

Simdi bir sembolun her ceyregi
nasil gorunur diye dusun. Bazi parcalar
maca ile sinekte, ya da kupa ile karoda
ayni olabilir.

original:
Now take the bottom-left crate. It has the
bottom-left of a black suit, the top-right of
a club, the top-left of a spade and the
bottom-left of a red suit.

The bottom-right crate has the top-left of a
heart, the bottom-right of two red suits and
the bottom-right of a black suit.

The lack of usable diamond top corners
narrows it down to either a heart or a club.
translation:
Simdi sol alttaki sandigi al. Uzerinde
siyah bir sembolun sol alti, sinegin sag ustu,
macanin sol ustu ve
kirmizi bir sembolun sol alti var.

Sag alttaki sandikta bir
kupanin sol ustu, iki kirmizi sembolun sag alti ve
siyah bir sembolun sag alti bulunuyor.

Kullanilabilir karo ust koseleri olmayinca,
geriye ya kupa ya da sinek kaliyor.

original:
You know that the only suit symbol you can
make is either a heart or a club.

Can we assume it's a heart? Well, you've
got the top-left part on that last crate
mentioned in Hint 3, but none of the other
crates have the bottom-right corner of a red
suit.

So the symbol must be a club! The only thing
left is to put it together.
translation:
Yapabilecegin sembolun ya
kupa ya da sinek oldugunu biliyorsun.

Peki bunun kupa oldugunu varsayabilir miyiz? Ipucu 3'te
bahsi gecen son sandikta sol ust parca var,
ama diger sandiklarin hicbirinde
kirmizi bir sembolun sag alt kosesi yok.

O halde sembol sinek olmali! Geriye kalan
tek sey onu birlestirmek.

original: Make a total of 22!
translation: Toplam 22 yap!

original:
You're looking to use a crane to shift four
giant dice. It seems like a fairly easy task,
but there's a catch: you need to arrange the
dice in a square so that the four numbers on
the front add up to 22.

Use the crane to move the dice over to the
dais on the right. You can rotate the dice
horizontally in mid-air.
translation:
Dort dev zari tasimak icin bir vinc kullanacaksin.
Bu oldukca kolay gorunuyor,
ama bir sart var: zarlari bir kare seklinde
dizip ondeki dort sayinin
toplamini 22 yapmalisin.

Vinci kullanarak zarlari sagdaki
platforma tasi. Havada
yatay olarak dondurebilirsin.

original:
Well done!

To make four dice add up to 22, you have
to have two 5s and two 6s!
translation:
Aferin!

Dort zarin toplamini 22 yapmak icin
iki tane 5 ve iki tane 6 olmali!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
To begin with, you need to find out what
numbers you have to work with. Lift each die
in turn with the crane and take note of the
numbers on their visible sides.

For instance, the top-left die has 1, 4, 6 and
3 showing.
translation:
Once hangi sayilara sahip oldugunu
bulmalisin. Vinci kullanip her zari
sirayla kaldir ve gorunen yuzlerdeki
sayilari not et.

Ornegin, sol ustteki zarda 1, 4, 6 ve
3 gorunuyor.

original:
The top-right die has 2, 1, 5 and 6 showing
on its visible sides, so those numbers are
available for you to use.

Check all the dice in the same manner until
you've worked out a solution!
translation:
Sag ustteki zarda 2, 1, 5 ve 6
gorunuyor; yani kullanabilecegin sayilar
bunlar.

Tum zarlari ayni sekilde kontrol edip
cozumu bulana kadar devam et!

original:
If you rotate the bottom-left die, you can see
2, 4, 5 and 3.

You have to make 22 with only four dice,
so you're going to need the higher numbers.
translation:
Sol alttaki zari dondurursen
2, 4, 5 ve 3'u gorursun.

Sadece dort zarla 22 yapmalisin,
bu yuzden daha buyuk sayilara ihtiyacin var.

original:
The bottom-right die has 2, 4, 5 and 3.

Now you know what numbers are at your
disposal on each die, you just need to
calculate which add up to make 22!
translation:
Sag alttaki zarda 2, 4, 5 ve 3 var.

Artik her zarda hangi sayilara
erisebilecegini biliyorsun; simdi
22 edenleri hesapla!

original: Find the repeating pattern!
translation: Tekrarlanan deseni bul!

original:
Colourful flags have been strung up all over
town for the carnival.

There are only seven different designs of
flag, but they're displayed in a variety of
combinations.

One such combination is the pattern shown
in the top-right corner. How many times
does this pattern feature in the strings of
flags shown above? Look carefully and write
down the number.
translation:
Karnaval icin kasabanin her yerine
rengarenk bayraklar asilmis.

Sadece yedi farkli bayrak deseni var,
ama pek cok farkli
kombinasyonla dizilmisler.

Bu kombinasyonlardan biri sag ust kosede
gosterilen desen. Bu desen yukaridaki
bayrak dizilerinde kac kez
gorunuyor? Dikkatlice bak ve
sayisini yaz.

original:
Correct!

The pattern appears twice in total: once
when you look at the flags from the front
and once when you look from the back.
translation:
Dogru!

Desen toplamda iki kez gorunuyor: bir kez
bayraklara onden baktiginda
ve bir kez de arkadan baktiginda.

original:
Too bad.

Maybe you're looking at this from the wrong
perspective?
translation:
Olmadi.

Belki de buna yanlis
acidan bakiyorsundur?

original:
Look very carefully at the flags decorating
the town.

The easiest way to start is by first locating
any one of the three flags.

For example, you could look for the white
and purple flag. Then you could check the
flags to the left and right of it and see
whether they match the pattern.
translation:
Kasabayi susleyen bayraklara
cok dikkatli bak.

Baslamanin en kolay yolu,
uc bayraktan herhangi birini once bulmak.

Ornegin beyaz ve mor bayragi
arayabilirsin. Sonra onun solundaki ve
sagindaki bayraklara bakip
desenle uyusup uyusmadiklarini
kontrol edebilirsin.

original:
Did you spot the pattern near the top-left
corner? It won't be as easy to find other
instances, though. There are a lot of flag
combinations that look similar at first glance
but are actually different.

Speaking of which, did you notice that the
flags are double-sided? The flags you see
with their designs reversed are hanging the
other way around. Does that help?
translation:
Sol ust koseye yakin yerde
deseni gordun mu? Ama diger
ornekleri bulmak o kadar kolay olmayacak.
Ilk bakista benzer gorunen bircok
bayrak dizilimi var ama aslinda farklilar.

Bu arada, bayraklarin cift tarafli
oldugunu fark ettin mi? Deseni ters
gorduklerin diger yonde asili.
Bu isine yaradi mi?

original:
Since the flags are double-sided, you'll need
to consider what this scene looks like from
the other side. In other words, you should
look for places where these same three flags
appear, but with the order reversed.

All three of these flags are symmetrical, so
you don't have to worry about the pattern
changing when you look from the other side.
That's a relief!
translation:
Bayraklar cift tarafli oldugundan,
bu sahnenin obur taraftan nasil
gorundugunu de dusunmelisin.
Yani ayni uc bayragin
bu kez ters sirayla
gorundugu yerleri aramalisin.

Bu uc bayragin da deseni simetrik,
bu yuzden obur taraftan bakinca
desenin degismesinden endiselenmene gerek yok.
Iyi ki!

original:
How many times does the pattern appear if
you include the times it can be seen when
looking at the scene from the other side?

It appears once on the string of flags at the
back. Did you spot it?

Now add this to the one mentioned in Hint 2,
and you should have your answer.
translation:
Deseni, sahneye obur taraftan
bakinca gorunenleri de sayarsan
kac kez gorursun?

Arkadaki bayrak dizisinde bir kez
gorunuyor. Fark ettin mi?

Simdi bunu Ipucu 2'deki sayiya ekle,
cevabin cikacaktir.

original: Circle one coloured pencil!
translation: Bir renkli kalemi daire icine al!

original:
This little purple ant wants to cross a sea
of pencils to join its red friend. It always
walks on top of the pencils, and can only
go along each pencil once. It's too small
to climb up from one pencil onto another.

As the situation is now, the ant will not be
able to get from its starting point at the
blue arrow to its goal at the red arrow.
However, by moving just one coloured
pencil, you can help it reach the goal.
Which coloured pencil should you move?
Circle your answer.
translation:
Bu kucuk mor karinca bir
kirmizi arkadasina ulasmak icin bir kalem
denizini gecmek istiyor. Her zaman
kalemlerin ustunde yurur ve her kalem boyunca
yalnizca bir kez ilerleyebilir. Bir kalemden
digerine tirmanamayacak kadar kucuk.

Su anki durumda karinca,
mavi okla gosterilen baslangic noktasindan
kirmizi okla gosterilen hedefine
ulasamaz.
Ancak sadece bir renkli
kalemi hareket ettirerek hedefine ulasmasina yardim edebilirsin.
Hangi renkli kalemi hareket ettirmelisin? Cevabini daire icine al.

original:
You're sharp!

It's the pink pencil the ant is standing on.
If you move it to the bottom-right corner,
the ant can walk straight to the goal and be
reunited with its friend. So much for that sea
of pencils!
translation:
Keskin gozlusun!

Karincanin uzerinde durdugu pembe kalem.
Onu sag alt koseye tasirsan,
karinca dogrudan hedefine yuruyebilir ve
arkadasiyla yeniden bulusur. Kalem denizi de
neymis!

original:
Well, that was an anty climax.

Are you wondering if you can move the
ordinary pencils as well? Sadly, you can't!
translation:
Eh, pek de karincali bir final olmadi.

Siradan kalemleri de hareket ettirebilir misin diye
merak ediyorsun belki. Maalesef edemezsin!

original:
The layout of the pencils is complicated,
to say the least.

Don't just think about which coloured pencil
you could move. Also consider where you
would move it to.
translation:
Kalemlerin dizilimi,
en hafif tabirle karmasik.

Sadece hangi renkli kalemi
hareket ettirecegini dusunme. Onu nereye
tasiyacagini da dusun.

original:
You can't move any of the plain pencils that
make up the sea of green, but you are
allowed to move any of the coloured pencils.

Look very carefully and consider your
options.
translation:
Yesil denizi olusturan siradan kalemlerin hicbirini
hareket ettiremezsin, ama
renkli kalemlerin herhangi birini oynatabilirsin.

Dikkatlice bak ve
seceneklerini degerlendir.

original:
You can pick any coloured pencil at all and
move it wherever you like. No one can raise
any objections, because the puzzle doesn't
specify any coloured pencils you can't move
or any places you can't put them.
translation:
Istedigin herhangi bir renkli kalemi secip
istedigin yere tasiyabilirsin. Kimse itiraz edemez,
cunku bulmaca,
hareket ettiremeyecegin renkli kalemleri
ya da koyamayacagin yerleri belirtmiyor.

original:
If you can move whichever coloured pencil
