you like, then you should be able to move
the one with the ant on top straight into the
bottom-right corner. The ant can then just
saunter along to the goal without any hassle.

Which coloured pencil should you move if
you want to carry the ant along with it?
translation:
Istedigin renkli kalemi
hareket ettirebiliyorsan, ustunde karinca olani dogrudan
sag alt koseye
tasiyabilmelisin. Boylece karinca hicbir zorlanma olmadan
hedefine dogru salina salina yurur.

Karincayi da
yaninda goturmek istiyorsan hangi renkli kalemi hareket ettirmelisin?

original: Which way to go?
translation: Hangi yoldan gitmeli?

original:
A young explorer wants to go from point 1
to point 5. To do so, he must pass through
the correct four caves in the cave complex
shown. The wrong caves are filled with
horrible traps.

He has with him four photos, A to D, taken
by an explorer who made it through
successfully. Work out the correct route
using the photographs. However, keep in
mind that you don't know which photo was
taken where.
translation:
Genc bir kasif 1 noktasindan
5 noktasina gitmek istiyor. Bunun icin,
gosterilen magara kompleksinde dogru
dort magaradan gecmesi gerekiyor.
Yanlis magaralar korkunc tuzaklarla dolu.

Yaninda, basariyla gecmeyi basaran bir
kasifin cektigi A'dan D'ye dort fotograf var.
Fotograflari kullanarak dogru rotayi bul.
Ancak hangi fotografin nerede cekildigini
bilmedigini unutma.

original:
Correct!

If you have a good look at the scenery in
the distance of each photo, you can tell
where they were taken.

The light will be on the left-hand side of a
cave that bends right, and vice versa. With
this in mind, you can work out the correct
route.
translation:
Dogru!

Her fotografta uzakta gorunen manzaraya
dikkatle bakarsan, nerede cekildiklerini
anlayabilirsin.

Saga kivrilan bir magarada isik sol tarafta,
sola kivrilanda ise sag tarafta olur.
Bunu aklinda tutarak dogru rotayi
cikarabilirsin.

original:
Too bad.

Try again before he runs into one of those
horrible traps!
translation:
Olmadi.

O korkunc tuzaklardan birine
dusmeden once tekrar dene!

original:
Compare the area just beyond the exits of
each cave in the photos to work out where
they were taken.

In B, you can see some flowers past the
exit. That's also the only one where you
don't see any rocks in the background.
Where does that fit in?
translation:
Fotograflarda her magaranin cikisinin
hemen otesindeki bolgeyi karsilastirarak
nerede cekildiklerini bul.

B'de cikisin otesinde cicekler gorunuyor.
Ayrica arka planda hic kaya gormedigin
tek fotograf da o. Bu nereye uyuyor?

original:
You can see sand just past the exit in A.
It follows that this must be between areas
3 and 4.

C and D look similar, but in C you can only
see a wall of rock and no cave entrances.
That should narrow it down.
translation:
A'da cikisin hemen otesinde kum gorunuyor.
Bu, bunun 3 ile 4 bolgeleri arasinda
olmasi gerektigi anlamina gelir.

C ve D birbirine benziyor, ama C'de sadece
bir kaya duvari gorunuyor ve hicbir magara
girisi yok. Bu, secenekleri epey azaltmali.

original:
You can work out the correct caves to go
through by looking at what you can see of
the exits.

If you take a photo of the exit in a cave that
bends right, the wall on the right will get in
the way, obscuring the right-hand side of the
exit. That means B must have been taken in
a cave that bends right, so you can tell it's
the one marked by a red line.
translation:
Dogru magaralari, cikislardan
gorebildiklerine bakarak bulabilirsin.

Saga kivrilan bir magaranin cikisini
fotograflarsan, sagdaki duvar araya girip
cikisin sag tarafini kapatir. Bu da B'nin
saga kivrilan bir magarada cekildigini
gosterir; yani kirmizi cizgiyle isaretli olan.

original:
In Hints 1 and 2, we determined that A
was taken between areas 3 and 4, and B
between 4 and 5. You can only see a wall
beyond the exit in C, so that must have been
taken between 1 and 2. That leaves D,
taken between 2 and 3.

We determined in Hint 3 that B is from a
red line cave. D is clearly from a straight
cave, so it must be the yellow line. What
about A and C?
translation:
Ipucu 1 ve 2'de, A'nin 3 ile 4 arasinda,
B'nin ise 4 ile 5 arasinda cekildigini bulduk.
C'de cikisin otesinde sadece bir duvar
gorunuyor; o halde bu 1 ile 2 arasinda
cekilmis olmali. Geriye D kaliyor:
2 ile 3 arasinda cekilmis.

Ipucu 3'te B'nin kirmizi cizgili magaradan
oldugunu bulduk. D acikca duz bir magaradan,
yani sari cizgiden. Peki A ve C hangisi?

original: Which is the 4?
translation: Hangisi 4?

original:
The numbers for the door of room 2134 in
this hotel have mysteriously gone missing.
In their place, the management are using
long, rectangular plates.

If the 2, 1 and 3 are represented by the
plates shown, then which of plates A to D
should be used in place of the 4?
translation:
Bu otelde 2134 numarali
odanin kapi numaralari gizemli bir sekilde kaybolmus.
Yerlerine yonetim,
uzun, dikdortgen plakalar kullaniyor.

2, 1 ve 3, gosterilen
plakalarla temsil ediliyorsa, 4'un yerine A'dan D'ye
hangi plaka kullanilmali?

original:
Correct!

The answer is D.

Once the plates are affixed within each
square, the uncovered space in the square
forms the number. That's a handy way of
saving on materials!
translation:
Dogru!

Cevap D.

Plakalar her
karenin icine yerlestirildiginde, karenin acikta kalan kismi
rakami olusturur. Bu, malzemeden tasarruf etmenin
pratik bir yolu!

original:
Too bad.

There must be a particular way to affix those
plates to the door.
translation:
Olmadi.

O plakalari kapiya
yapistirmanin belirli bir yolu olmali.

original:
The 2, 1 and 3 are each represented by two
brown plates.

The plates for the 2 and 3 look the same,
and neither of them look like numbers.

Maybe they're being affixed to the door in
some special way?
translation:
2, 1 ve 3'un her
biri iki kahverengi plakayla temsil ediliyor.

2 ve 3 icin kullanilan plakalar ayni gorunuyor
ve hicbiri rakama benzemiyor.

Belki de kapiya
ozel bir sekilde yerlestiriliyorlardir?

original:
Did you notice that only the plates to be
affixed for the 1 are the same width as the
available space?

What would it look like if you put the plates
in as they are? A minus sign?

You need to turn them first. That's how you
get a 1 out of these plates.
translation:
1 icin
yerlestirilecek plakalarin, ayrilan boslukla ayni genislikte
olan tek plakalar oldugunu fark ettin mi?

Plakalari oldugu gibi
koyarsan neye benzer? Bir eksi isareti mi?

Once onlari
cevirmen gerekir. Bu plakalarla 1'i boyle elde edersin.

original:
If you affix the plates for the 1 as described
in Hint 2, the remaining uncovered space in
the square forms the number 1. How could
you use the plates for the 2 and 3 to form
those numbers in the same way?

And which plates could you use for the
number 4?
translation:
Ipucu 2'de
anlatildigi gibi 1'in plakalarini yerlestirirsen, karenin
acikta kalan kismi 1'i olusturur. 2 ve 3'un plakalarini
ayni yontemle
o sayilari olusturacak sekilde nasil kullanabilirsin?

Peki 4
rakami icin hangi plakalari kullanabilirsin?

original:
Form the 2 by putting one of the plates on
the left of the square, slightly down from the
top, and the other in the diagonally opposite
spot. For the 3, place both plates a little
apart from each other on the left.

How many plates do you need for the 4?
The digit is a cross shape with a diagonal
bar, but remember there are two ways of
writing it. In any case, you'd probably need
more than just one or two plates.
translation:
2'yi olusturmak
icin plakalardan birini karenin soluna, ustten biraz asagiya
koy, digerini de capraz
karsi koseye yerlestir. 3 icinse iki plakayi solda, birbirinden biraz
ayri olacak sekilde yerlestir.

4 icin kac plaka
gerekiyor?
Rakam, capraz bir cizgisi olan bir arti
sekli; ama yazmanin iki yolu oldugunu
unutma. Her durumda muhtemelen bir ya da iki plakadan fazlasi gerekir.

original: Which room?
translation: Hangi oda?

original:
This hotel has a suite with many rooms in it.
Cleaning such a large suite is quite the task,
so the hotel staff like to take an efficient
route that allows them to cover the whole
suite without doubling back through any of
the rooms.

They take a different route every day, but
no matter which order they clean in, there's
always one room that they pass through at
the same point in the route.

Can you work out which one?
translation:
Bu otelin icinde pek cok oda bulunan bir suiti var.
Bu kadar buyuk bir suiti temizlemek epey is,
bu yuzden personel verimli bir
rota izleyip tum suiti
hicbir odadan geri donmeden
dolasmak ister.

Her gun farkli bir rota izlerler, ama
hangi sirayla temizlerlerse temizlesinler,
rotada hep ayni noktada gectikleri
tek bir oda vardir.

Hangisi oldugunu bulabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

The large central room on the left-hand side
is the only room that stays in the same
position no matter the route.

Use the wall between the two central rooms
to divide the suite into two halves. There are
several routes, but no matter whether you
start on the left or the right, this room
will always be the seventh room you pass
through.
translation:
Dogru!

Sol taraftaki buyuk orta oda,
hangi rota secilirse secilsin
hep ayni konumda kalan tek odadir.

Iki orta oda arasindaki duvari
suiti ikiye bolmek icin kullan. Birkac rota var,
ama soldan da baslasan sagdan da baslasan,
bu oda her zaman gectigin
yedinci oda olacaktir.

original:
Too bad.

Have you considered all the possible
routes?
translation:
Olmadi.

Ihtimal olan tum
rotalari dusundun mu?

original:
You want to find a route through the suite
without passing through the same room
twice.

Why not start off working out some routes
and see where they take you?
translation:
Suitten gecerken bir rota bulmalisin,
ayni odaya
iki kez ugramadan.

Once birkac rota cikarmayi dene
ve nereye goturduklerine bak.

original:
No matter which route you take through the
rooms, there is one room that you will always
pass through at the same point in the route.

To make it clearer, try starting from the
top-left and top-right rooms, and count the
rooms as you pass through them. Was there
a room that was the same number in both
routes?
translation:
Odalarda hangi rotayi izlersen izle,
rotada hep ayni sirada
gectigin bir oda vardir.

Daha net olmasi icin,
sol ust ve sag ust odalardan baslamayi dene,
gectikce odalari say. Iki rotada da
ayni sira numarasina denk gelen
bir oda var mi?

original:
Actually, you don't even need to trace out
any routes to work out this puzzle.

Since there are 13 rooms in total, you have
to pass through the same room at the
seventh room. The two rooms in the middle
of the suite are connected by only one door,
so one of these rooms must be the central
seventh room in any route.
translation:
Aslinda bu bulmacayi cozmek icin
rotalari tek tek cizmen bile gerekmiyor.

Toplam 13 oda olduguna gore,
her rotada yedinci sirada
ayni odadan gecmek zorundasin. Suitin ortasindaki
iki oda sadece tek bir kapiyla baglidir,
bu yuzden bu odalardan biri her rotanin
ortasindaki yedinci oda olmali.

original:
Considering the layout of the suite, we can
suppose that one of the two large central
rooms is the seventh one, which comes up
in the middle of any route through the 13
rooms. That room would have to have six
rooms on either side of it, wouldn't it?

Which room is that?
translation:
Suitin planina bakinca,
iki buyuk orta odadan birinin,
13 odalik herhangi bir rotanin ortasinda cikan
yedinci oda oldugunu varsayabiliriz.
Bu odanin iki yaninda da
altisar oda olmali, degil mi?

Bu oda hangisi?

original: Place the slabs!
translation: Levhalari yerlestir!

original:
Each of these stone slabs has two arrows on
it. To open the manhole, you must fill the
board with slabs so that all four rows, all
four columns and both diagonals contain one
of each direction of arrow. Some of the slabs
are already firmly fixed in place, but you
can freely rotate the rest.

Are you up to the task?
translation:
Bu tas levhalarin uzerinde ikiser ok var.
Rogar kapagini acmak icin tahtayi levhalarla
doldurmalisin; oyle ki dort satirin, dort
sutunun ve iki kosegenin her birinde her ok
yonunden birer tane bulunsun. Bazi levhalar
yerine sabitlenmis durumda, ama kalanlari
ozgurce cevirebilirsin.

Bu isin ustesinden gelebilir misin?

original:
Correct!

Now, let's see what's beneath that manhole!
translation:
Dogru!

Simdi bakalim su rogar kapaginin altinda ne var!

original:
Too bad.

There must have been a row, column or
diagonal with two of the same arrow in it.
Look carefully!
translation:
Olmadi.

Bir satir, sutun ya da kosegende ayni yonde
iki ok olmali. Dikkatle bak!

original:
Start by placing panels next to the ones
already fixed in place.

The bottom-right corner of the board is a
good place to start, as there's only one
orientation of panel that can fit there.
Check the rows and column for this space
and choose a panel that will fill the space
without duplicating the existing arrows.
translation:
Once, sabitlenmis olanlarin yanina
paneller yerlestirmeye basla.

Sag alt kose iyi bir baslangictir; cunku oraya
sigabilecek panelin sadece tek bir yonu vardir.
Bu boslugun satir ve sutununu kontrol et
ve mevcut oklari tekrar etmeyecek
bir panel sec.

original:
The space on the bottom right of the board
needs a piece with a left and right arrow on
it. The left arrow should be on top, as
there's already a right arrow in the third
row down.

Next, let's look at the space at the top of
the second column from the right. After the
bottom-right panel is in position, it should
be easy to work out which one goes here.
translation:
Tahtanin sag altindaki boslukta uzerinde
sol ve sag ok bulunan bir parca olmali.
Ustte sol ok olmali; cunku ucuncu satirda
zaten bir sag ok var.

Simdi, sagdan ikinci sutunun en ustundeki
bosluga bakalim. Sag alt panel yerlesince,
buraya hangisinin gelecegini cikarmak kolay.

original:
With the first two hints, you should have
already filled in the right half of the board.

Now let's see which panel fits in the centre
of the leftmost column. You'll be completing
two rows with this piece, so there's only one
panel that could go here.
translation:
Ilk iki ipucuyla tahtanin sag yarisini
doldurmus olmalisin.

Simdi en soldaki sutunun ortasindaki bosluga
hangi panelin uyduguna bakalim. Bu parcayla
iki satiri tamamlayacaksin, bu yuzden buraya
gelebilecek sadece bir panel var.

original:
You should have gathered from Hint 3 that
the panel with a right and down arrow goes
in the centre of the leftmost column on the
board.

That leaves only two spaces left to fill.
Don't forget that you need to pay attention
to the diagonals, or else you won't know
which panel goes where.
translation:
Ipucu 3'ten, sag ve asagi ok iceren panelin
tahtanin en sol sutununun ortasina
gelecegini anlamis olmalisin.

Geriye doldurulacak sadece iki bosluk kalir.
Kosegenlere de dikkat etmeyi unutma;
yoksa hangi panelin nereye gidecegini
bilemezsin.

original: Where should they sit?
translation: Nereye oturmalilar?

original:
Five police officers have been tasked with
the security of a 64-seat theatre. Each
officer can see all the seats directly in front
of him, behind him, to his left and right,
and at 45-degree diagonals.

The seating arrangement shown above
would let the five officers cover the whole
theatre. However, all but the fourth row of
seats have already been booked. With one
officer already sitting in seat 4-A, where
should the others sit to cover the whole
theatre?
translation:
Bes polis memuru,
64 koltuklu bir tiyatronun guvenligiyle gorevlendirildi. Her
memur, dogrudan onundeki
arkasindaki, solundaki ve sagindaki tum koltuklari
ayrica 45 derecelik caprazlari da gorebilir.

Yukarida gosterilen oturma duzeni
bes memurun tum tiyatroyu
kapsamasini saglar. Ancak dorduncu sira disindaki tum
koltuklar coktan rezerve edilmis. 4-A koltugunda
bir memur zaten otururken,
digerleri tum tiyatroyu kapsamak icin nereye
oturmali?

original:
Correct!

This arrangement will cover the whole
theatre. Now the show can go on in safety!
translation:
Dogru!

Bu duzen tum
tiyatroyu kapsar. Artik gosteri guvenle devam edebilir!

original:
Too bad.

Don't just guess; try to find the answer
through logic.
translation:
Olmadi.

Sadece tahmin etme; cevabi
mantikla bulmaya calis.

original:
Using the Memo Function, place an officer in
any free seat in the fourth row and work out
which seats are covered and which aren't.
translation:
Not Defteri islevini kullanarak, dorduncu siradaki
bos bir koltuga bir memur yerlestir ve
hangi koltuklarin kapsandigini, hangilerinin kapsanmadigini bul.

original:
Using the Memo Function, draw lines
extending horizontally, vertically and
diagonally from seat 4-A. Now decide where
to place the next officer so that as many of
the remaining seats as possible are covered.

How about 4-F, for example?
translation:
Not Defteri islevini kullanarak cizgiler ciz:
4-A koltugundan yatay, dikey ve
capraz olarak uzat. Simdi, kalan koltuklarin mumkun oldugunca
cogunu kapsayacak sekilde bir sonraki memuru nereye
koyacagina karar ver.

Mesela 4-F nasil?

original:
Did you place an officer in 4-F? Make sure
to mark all the seats covered from there.

Now, how about 4-E? It's right next to 4-F,
but it covers a lot of the remaining seats.
translation:
4-F'ye bir memur koydun mu? Oradan
kapsanan tum koltuklari isaretlediginden emin ol.

Peki ya 4-E? 4-F'nin hemen yaninda,
ama kalan koltuklarin cogunu kapsiyor.

original:
We've got a lot of the theatre covered, so
now let's find the two remaining seats that
will cover the whole place.

Try 4-G. Draw the lines as before and you
should find that there are only six seats not
covered by any officer.

Where should the last officer go to cover
these seats? Easy!
translation:
Tiyatronun buyuk kismini kapsadik, simdi
tum yeri kapsayacak kalan iki koltugu
bulalim.

4-G'yi dene. Daha onceki gibi cizgileri ciz ve
herhangi bir memur tarafindan kapsanmayan yalnizca alti
koltuk kaldigini bulmalisin.

Son memur bu koltuklari kapsamak icin nereye oturmali?
Cok kolay!

original: Divide the board!
translation: Tahtayi bol!

original:
You're trying to cut this 6 x 6 chessboard
into four sections that are the same shape,
are of equal area and each contain three
pawns. To complicate matters, you want at
least one white and one black pawn in every
section.

Can you find a way to do it?

Draw lines on the board to show where to
cut it. Keep in mind that solutions may be
rotated, but cannot be mirrored.
translation:
Bu 6 x 6 satranc tahtasini,
ayni sekle sahip, esit alanda olan
ve her biri uc piyon iceren
dort bolume kesmeye calisiyorsun.
Isi zorlastirmak icin,
her bolumde en az bir beyaz
ve bir siyah piyon olmasini da istiyorsun.

Bunu yapmanin bir yolunu bulabilir misin?

Nereden kesecegini gostermek icin
tahtaya cizgiler ciz.
Cozumler dondurulebilir,
ama aynalanamaz.

original:
Good job!

Now we have four sections of equal size and
shape!
translation:
Iyi is!

Artik esit boyut ve
sekle sahip dort bolumumuz var!

original:
Never mind.

There are a number of ways to split the area
into four - you just need to find the right
one.
translation:
Bos ver.

Alani dorde bolmenin bircok yolu var -
sadece dogru olani bulman gerekiyor.

original:
The pawns are concentrated on one part of
the board, so first consider how you could
divide the chessboard into two. Then you
can think about how to separate the pawns
into equal numbers.
translation:
Piyonlar tahtanin bir tarafinda yogunlasiyor,
bu yuzden once satranc tahtasini ikiye
nasil bolebilecegini dusun.
Sonra piyonlari esit sayilara
ayirmanin yolunu arayabilirsin.

original:
To divide the board into four sections as
described in the puzzle, you'll need to have
two sections with one white and two black
pawns, and two sections with one black and
two white pawns.
translation:
Bulmacada tarif edildigi gibi
tahtayi dort bolume ayirmak icin,
iki bolumde bir beyaz ve iki siyah piyon,
iki bolumde de bir siyah ve iki beyaz piyon
olmasi gerekir.

original:
First, you'll have to divide the board cleanly
into two halves.

Considering the distribution of the pawns,
a horizontal line through the middle should
do the trick. Now have a think about how
you might divide up the top and bottom
halves.
translation:
Once tahtayi
temiz bir sekilde iki yariya bolmelisin.

Piyonlarin dagilimini dusununce,
ortadan gecen yatay bir cizgi
isini gorur. Simdi ust ve alt
yarilari nasil bolebilecegini dusun.

original:
Try drawing a shape that looks a bit like the
number 3 on its side. Within just the top half
of the board, you can make two 3s slotted
into each other.

Once you get the shape right, you'll have
the pawns divvied up perfectly, and you'll
just need to do the same on the bottom.
translation:
Yan yatmis bir 3 sayisina
benzeyen bir sekil cizmeyi dene.
Sadece tahtanin ust yarisinda,
birbirinin icine gecmis iki tane 3
sekli yapabilirsin.

Sekli dogru oturtunca,
piyonlar kusursuz sekilde bolunecek
ve ayni seyi altta da yapman gerekecek.

original: Rough Text
translation: Taslak Metin

original: Divide the board!
translation: Tahtayi bol!

original:
You want to cut this 6 x 6 chessboard into
four sections that are the same shape, have
an equal area and each contain four pawns.
This time round, you want two white pawns
and two black pawns in each section.

Can you work out how to do it?

Draw lines on the board to show where to
cut it. Keep in mind that solutions may be
rotated, but cannot be mirrored.
translation:
Bu 6 x 6 satranc tahtasini, ayni sekle sahip,
alanlari esit ve her biri dort piyon iceren
dort parcaya ayirmak istiyorsun.
Bu sefer her parcada iki beyaz ve iki siyah
piyon olmali.

Bunu nasil yaparsin?

Tahtanin uzerinde kesilecegi yerleri ciz.
Cozumler dondurulebilir ama aynalanamaz.

original:
Correct!

Your clean divide is proof of a job well done!
translation:
Dogru!

Tertemiz bolmen, isi ne kadar iyi yaptigini
gosteriyor!

original:
Too bad.

Are you sure you had two black and two
white pawns in each section?
translation:
Olmadi.

Her bolumde iki siyah ve iki beyaz
piyon olduguna emin misin?

original:
The pawns seem to be a bit more evenly
distributed this time.

Start by considering where you can cut to
split the board in two with an equal number
of black and white pawns in each half.
translation:
Bu sefer piyonlar daha dengeli dagilmis
gorunuyor.

Once tahtayi ikiye bolecek ve her yarida
esit sayida siyah ve beyaz piyon birakacak
bir kesim dusun.

original:
From the way the pawns are positioned,
a straight, vertical line down the middle
seems like a safe bet.

Now try dividing the board into quarters.
translation:
Piyonlarin konumuna bakinca, ortadan
duz bir dikey cizgi guvenli gorunuyor.

Simdi tahtayi dort ceyrege ayirmayi dene.

original:
You can include all the pawns in the leftmost
column, two black and one white, within the
same section.

You still need one more pawn in that section,
though. How can you manage that?
translation:
En soldaki sutundaki tum piyonlari-iki siyah
ve bir beyazi-ayni bolume alabilirsin.

Ama o bolumde bir piyon daha olmali.
Bunu nasil saglarsin?

original:
In addition to the one white and two black
pawns in the leftmost column, you'll want to
include the white pawn in B3. Then you need
to make the two sections in the left half of
the board the same size and shape.

Once you've managed that, simply draw the
same set of lines on the right and you'll have
the answer before you.
translation:
En soldaki sutundaki bir beyaz ve iki siyah
piyonun yani sira B3'teki beyaz piyonu da
bu bolume katmalisin. Sonra tahtanin sol
yarisindaki iki bolumun ayni boyut ve sekle
sahip olmasini saglamalisin.

Bunu basardiktan sonra sag tarafa da ayni
cizgileri kopyala; cevap gozunun onunde
olacak.

original: Place the red squares!
translation: Kirmizi kareleri yerlestir!

original:
{''}I've been embroidering this cushion in
green and yellow, but it's not lively enough.
I want to add two red squares to each of the
four yellow areas.

Oh, but I don't want more than one red
square in any given row, column or
diagonal. Trust me, it'll look nicer!

I've stitched two already. Can you help me
work out where the other six should go?{''}
translation:
{''}Bu yastigi bos vaktimde
yesil ve sari iplikle isliyordum ama yeterince canli degil.
Dort sari bolgenin her birine iki kirmizi kare
eklemek istiyorum.

Ama hicbir satirda, sutunda ya da
caprazda birden fazla kirmizi kare olmasini
istemiyorum. Inan, daha guzel gorunecek!

Ikisini zaten isledim. Kalan altisini
nereye koymam gerektigini bulmama yardim eder misin?{''}

original:
Correct!

Now you've got a balanced embroidery
pattern. From a certain point of view...
translation:
Dogru!

Artik dengeli bir nakis
deseni elde ettin. Bir acidan bakinca...

original:
Too bad.

You must have placed two red squares in
the same row, column or diagonal.
translation:
Maalesef.

Ayni satirda, sutunda ya da caprazda
iki kirmizi kare yerlestirmis olmalisin.

original:
The Memo Function is the easiest way to
solve this puzzle.

Start with the two red squares that have
already been stitched and mark off the
squares in the same rows, columns and
diagonals so you know not to place any
more red squares there.
translation:
Bu bulmacayi cozmenin en kolay yolu
Not Alma (Memo) islevini kullanmak.

Daha once islenmis iki kirmizi kareden basla ve
ayni satir, sutun ve caprazdaki kareleri isaretle.
Boylece oralara baska kirmizi kare
koymaman gerektigini bilirsin.

original:
If you mark the unusable spaces as shown
in the previous hint, you should find that
there's only one place for you to put the
second red square in the right-hand yellow
area.

Now place that square and mark off the
spaces that it makes unusable.
translation:
Onceki ipucunda gosterildigi gibi
kullanilamayan yerleri isaretlersen,
sagdaki sari alandaki ikinci kirmizi kare icin
sadece tek bir yer kaldigini goreceksin.

Simdi o kareyi yerlestir ve
kullanilamaz hale gelen yerleri isaretle.

original:
Continuing from Hint 2, there are now only
three usable spaces in the top yellow area.

Since two of them are in the same column,
it's impossible to use them both. So you
know for sure that you need to use the
remaining third space.
translation:
2. ipucundan devam edersen,
ustteki sari alanda artik sadece
uc kullanilabilir yer kaldigini gorursun.

Ikisi ayni sutunda oldugundan,
ikisini birden kullanmak imkansiz. Bu yuzden
kesin olarak kalan ucuncu yeri
kullanman gerektigini bilirsin.

original:
Mark off the spaces in the same row, column
and diagonal as the red square you placed
in Hint 3 and you'll see where to place the
second red square in the top yellow area.

In turn, this will tell you where to place the
other red square in the left-hand yellow
area. The rest should be easy.
translation:
3. ipucunda yerlestirdigin kirmizi kareyle
ayni satir, sutun ve caprazdaki kareleri isaretle;
ustteki sari alandaki ikinci kirmizi kareyi
nereye koyacagini gorursun.

Bu da sirayla, soldaki sari alandaki
diger kirmizi kareyi nereye koyacagini
gosterir. Gerisi kolay.

original: Where did each shot hit?
translation: Her atis nereye isabet etti?

original:
A police officer was doing some target
practice one day. The target was divided
into sections worth 5, 35, 40, 75 and 100
points. After five shots, his score totalled
100 points.

How many times did he manage to shoot
each point section?
translation:
Bir polis memuru bir gun hedef talimi yapiyordu.
Hedef 5, 35, 40, 75 ve 100 puanlik
bolumlere ayrilmisti.
Bes atistan sonra toplam puani
100 puan oldu.

Her puanlik bolumu
kac kez vurdu?

original:
Bullseye!

He hit the 100-point section once.
He's either a hotshot...or a notshot.
translation:
Tam isabet!

100 puanlik bolumu bir kez vurdu.
Ya usta bir nisanci... ya da sansi yaver gitti.

original:
Too bad.

Are you perhaps off the mark a little?
translation:
Olmadi.

Acaba biraz hedefi mi sasirdin?

original:
100 points in five shots.

Let's imagine he hit the 75-point section
once. That leaves 25 points to make up.
He could get 25 points if he hit the 5-point
section five times, but that would be a total
of six shots, so that's not the answer.

Try some other combinations of shots.
translation:
Bes atista 100 puan.

Diyelim ki 75 puanlik bolumu
bir kez vurdu. Geriye 25 puan kalir.
5 puanlik bolumu bes kez vurursa 25 puan eder,
ama bu toplam
alti atis yapar; yani cevap bu degil.

Baska atis kombinasyonlari dene.

original:
You've probably realised that it takes more
than five shots at the target to reach a
combined score of 100 points.

Hmm... Is there a way to score a number of
points other than by hitting the target?
translation:
Muhtemelen 100 puana ulasmak icin
hedefe besten fazla isabet
gerektigini fark ettin.

Hmm... Hedefi vurmadan da
puan almak mumkun mu?

original:
Just because the officer fired five shots
doesn't mean they all hit the target.

In other words, it's possible for him to score
0 points with any given shot.

Do you see the answer now?
translation:
Memurun bes kez ates etmis olmasi,
hepsinin hedefi vurdugu anlamina gelmez.

Yani, herhangi bir atisla
0 puan almasi mumkun.

Simdi cevabi goruyor musun?

original:
If a shot were to miss the target, the officer
would score 0 points.

Can you use that to make a total of 100
points out of five shots?

Maybe the officer is just a lucky shot!
translation:
Bir atis hedefi iskalarsa,
memur 0 puan alir.

Bunu kullanarak bes atista
toplam 100 puan yapabilir misin?

Belki de memurun sadece sansi yaver gitmistir!

original: Leave Lucky in the centre!
translation: Lucky'yi ortada birak!

original:
This time, Lucky has nine white kittens
crowding around her on the 5 x 5 board!
Both Lucky and the kittens can jump over
any kitten that is on a horizontally, vertically
or diagonally adjacent square. Jumping over
a kitten removes that kitten from the grid,
but Lucky can't be jumped over.

Once again, you want to leave only Lucky in
the centre of the board. Now, get pouncing
with those kitties!
translation:
Bu sefer Lucky, 5 x 5'lik tahtada
etrafini saran dokuz beyaz yavru kediyle
kalabaligin ortasinda!
Hem Lucky hem de yavru kediler,
yatay, dikey ya da capraz olarak bitisik
bir karede duran herhangi bir kedinin
ustunden atlayabilir. Bir kedinin uzerinden
atlamak, o kediyi tahtadan kaldirir,
ama Lucky'nin uzerinden atlanamaz.

Yine amac, tahtanin ortasinda
sadece Lucky'yi birakmak.
Haydi, kediciklerle atla zipla!

original:
Correct!

It's actually possible to use only Lucky to
complete this puzzle. If you haven't tried it,
think about how you could do it. It takes
nine moves.
translation:
Dogru!

Aslinda bu bulmacayi
sadece Lucky'yi kullanarak
bitirmek de mumkun. Denemediysen,
nasil yapabilecegini dusun.
Dokuz hamle surer.

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
Let's concentrate on just one of the several
possible ways to solve this puzzle.

See how the cats are clustered at the
bottom? The two kittens at the top are the
problem here. Think about how to jump over
those two. Lucky doesn't make the first move
here.
translation:
Bu bulmacayi cozmenin
birkac yolundan sadece birine odaklanalim.

Kedilerin altta kumelendigini goruyor musun?
Ustteki iki yavru kedi sorun yaratiyor.
O ikisinin uzerinden nasil atlayacagini dusun.
Ilk hamleyi Lucky yapmiyor.

original:
First make the kitten below the centre square
jump diagonally upwards - either way will do.
Keep jumping it until it has moved around the
board and returned to its original position.
This should leave five kittens in the bottom
two rows of the board.
translation:
Once orta karenin altindaki yavru kediyi,
capraz yukari ziplat - hangi tarafa olursa.
Onu ziplata ziplata tahtanin etrafinda
dolastirip tekrar baslangic yerine
dondur. Bu, tahtanin en alt iki sirasinda
bes yavru kedi birakmali.

original:
It's about time Lucky did some work now.
Maybe you can finish the puzzle with her?

You don't start with a diagonal jump, if that's
what you're thinking.
translation:
Artik Lucky'nin biraz calismasinin zamani.
Belki bulmacayi onunla bitirebilirsin?

Dusundugun gibi capraz bir ziplayisla
baslamiyorsun.

original:
From the position with five kittens left at the
end of Hint 2, move Lucky either vertically
or horizontally.

For example, if you move her up, she has
to jump diagonally down and then sideways
twice. The last move should bring her to
the centre!
translation:
2. Ipucu'nun sonunda kalan
bes yavru kediyle olusan konumdan,
Lucky'yi ya dikey
ya da yatay hareket ettir.

Ornegin onu yukari goturursen,
capraz asagi ziplamasi, ardindan
iki kez yana ziplamasi gerekir.
Son hamle onu ortaya getirmeli!

original: Solve the code!
translation: Kodu coz!

original:
The final door of the ruins has five slots on
it, each marked with a different symbol, and
nine stone blocks which fit into those slots.

Help Hershel place five blocks in the slots
in the correct order to open the door.
translation:
Harabelerin son kapisinda bes yuva var;
her biri farkli bir sembolle isaretli ve
bu yuvalara uyan dokuz tas blok var.

Kapiyi acmak icin Hershel'in
bes blogu yuvalara dogru sirayla yerlestirmesine yardim et.

original:
Correct.

The symbols show you which block to use in
each slot based on the way each block is
framed by the others.
translation:
Dogru.

Semboller, her blogun digerleri tarafindan
nasil cevrelendigine gore hangi yuvada
hangi blogun kullanilacagini gosterir.

original:
Too bad.

Clear your mind and try again.
translation:
Olmadi.

Zihnini bosalt ve tekrar dene.

original:
The nine blocks each have some kind of
ancient glyph on them, but there doesn't
appear to be any direct correlation between
the glyphs and the symbols in the slots.

If the glyphs on the blocks don't mean
anything, then what could the code on the
door represent?
translation:
Dokuz blogun her birinde bir tur
antik isaret var, ama
bu isaretler ile yuvalardaki semboller
arasinda dogrudan bir iliski yok gibi.

Bloklarin uzerindeki isaretler
bir sey ifade etmiyorsa, kapidaki
kod neyi temsil ediyor olabilir?

original:
You can place the block in the centre of the
door into the middle slot.

Do you understand why this block goes into
that slot?
translation:
Kapinin ortasindaki blogu
orta yuvaya yerlestirebilirsin.

Bu blogun neden o yuvaya
girdigini anliyor musun?

original:
The bottom-right block goes into the leftmost
slot.

The symbol in that slot bears a kind of
resemblance to where you got the block
from, doesn't it?
translation:
Sag alttaki blok en soldaki
yuvaya gider.

O yuvadaki sembol, blogu
aldigin konuma
biraz benzemiyor mu?

original:
Each symbol represents how each block is
framed by the surrounding blocks.

The blocks surrounding the top-left block
form the symbol in the rightmost slot. Those
surrounding the top-right block make the
symbol in the second slot from the right.

Now which block does the remaining symbol
indicate?
translation:
Her sembol, her blogun
cevresindeki bloklarla nasil cercevelendigini temsil eder.

Sol ustteki blogu cevreleyen bloklar
en sagdaki yuvadaki sembolu olusturur. Sol ust sagdaki
Sag ustteki blogu cevreleyenler ise
sagdan ikinci yuvadaki sembolu yapar.

Simdi kalan sembol
hangi blogu gosteriyor?

original: Piece the map together!
translation: Haritayi birlestir!

original:
Whenever new tourists arrive in town, they
are given a map to help them with their
sightseeing. Unfortunately, the maps have a
tendency to fall apart along the fold lines,
making it impossible to work out how to get
to where they want to go.

Can you restore the map to its original
condition?
translation:
Sehre yeni turistler geldiginde, gezmelerine
yardimci olsun diye onlara bir harita verilir. Ne yazik ki,
haritalar kat yerlerinden dagilma egiliminde,
bu da gitmek istedikleri yere
nasil ulasacaklarini anlamayi imkansiz kilar.

Haritayi eski haline
getirebilir misin?

original:
Well done!

That should make things a bit easier now.
translation:
Tebrikler!

Simdi isler biraz daha kolay olmali.

original:
Too bad.

It's not too far to go, but the map needs
to be fixed completely before it can be
used properly.
translation:
Olmadi.

Gidilecek yer cok uzak degil, ama haritanin
dogru kullanilabilmesi icin tamamen
duzeltilmesi gerekiyor.

original:
Find the biggest feature on the map and
start from there.

How about that park with a pond?
translation:
Haritadaki en buyuk ayrintiyi bulup
oradan basla.

Mesela icinde golet olan o park?

original:
There's a yellow symbol that's been split in
two. Reassemble it and you're well on your
way to restoring the whole map.
translation:
Ikiye bolunmus sari bir sembol var.
Onu birlestirirsen butun haritayi
tamamlamaya epey yaklasmis olursun.

original:
The towers are actually very close to each
other on the finished map. As symbols of
the town, they lie at its centre.
translation:
Kuleler tamamlanmis haritada aslinda
birbirine cok yakin. Sehrin simgeleri olarak
merkezde yer aliyorlar.

original:
The Ferris wheel is at the leftmost edge of
the map and the burger shop is at the
rightmost edge.

Now just pay attention to the different road
colours and you'll have it.
translation:
Donme dolap haritanin en sol kenarinda,
hamburger dukkani ise
en sag kenarinda.

Simdi sadece farkli yol
renklerine dikkat et, tamamdir.

original: Which direction?
translation: Hangi yone?

original:
Four aged photos have been stuck inside an
old journal. They're faded and hard to make
out, but they all show the same place and
seem to have been taken within a short
space of time. In photo A, you can see a
horse-drawn carriage travelling across the
frame.

Can you tell in which direction the carriage
was headed?
translation:
Dort eski fotograf, eski bir gunlugun icine
yapistirilmis. Soluk ve secilmeleri zor, ama
hepsi ayni yeri gosteriyor ve kisa bir zaman
araliginda cekilmis gibi gorunuyor. A
fotografinda, kadrajin icinden gecen
at arabasini gorebilirsin.

Arabanin hangi yone gittigini
soyleyebilir misin?

original:
Correct!

It was heading south.

A leaf has fallen from the left-hand tree
between the times photo A and photo B were
taken, so we can assume that the sun was
setting. Since the sun sets in the west, the
viewer must be east of the carriage, and the
carriage is therefore travelling south.
translation:
Dogru!

Guneye gidiyordu.

A ve B fotograflarinin cekildigi zamanlar
arasinda soldaki agactan bir yaprak dusmus,
bu yuzden gunesin batmakta oldugunu
varsayabiliriz. Gunes batida battigina gore,
bakan kisi arabanin dogusundadir; dolayisiyla
araba guneye dogru gidiyordur.

original:
Too bad.

What are you basing your answer on?
translation:
Olmadi.

Cevabini neye dayandirdin?

original:
First, have a close look at the carriage.
The horse is facing to the left, so it must be
travelling from right to left through the
picture.

That's not enough information to work out
the cardinal direction in which it's travelling,
though. Is there anything else in the photo
that could help you with that? Something
people would have used in olden times to
work out their directions?
translation:
Once arabaya dikkatle bak.
At sola bakiyor, yani resimde sagdan sola
dogru gidiyor olmali.

Ama bu, hangi ana yone gittigini bulmak icin
yeterli bilgi degil. Fotografta sana yardimci
olabilecek baska bir sey var mi? Eski
zamanlarda insanlarin yon bulmak icin
kullandigi bir sey?

original:
The sun is a useful guide when trying to
determine compass points. It rises in the
east and sets in the west, without fail.

The sun is just above the horizon in these
photos... But wait! Don't answer yet. Is it
rising or setting? Compare the photos and
see if you can work it out.
translation:
Gunes, yonleri belirlemekte cok ise yarar.
Hatasiz bir sekilde dogudan dogar ve batidan batar.

Bu fotograflarda gunes ufkun hemen ustunde...
Ama dur! Hemen cevap verme. Doguyor mu,
batiyor mu? Fotograflari karsilastir ve
bunu anlayip anlayamadigina bak.

original:
There is something else in the photos that
will allow you to work out the passage of time
between them. The number of leaves on the
tree on the left should tell you something.

Use this information combined with the
position of the sun and you'll be able to
work out which direction lies roughly straight
ahead as you look at the photo.
translation:
Fotograflarda, aralarindaki zamanin
gecisini anlamani saglayacak bir baska
ipucu daha var. Soldaki agactaki yaprak
sayisi sana bir sey soylemeli.

Bu bilgiyi gunesin konumuyla birlestirirsen,
fotografa bakarken karsinda yaklasik olarak
hangi yonun oldugunu bulabilirsin.

original:
Compare photos A and D, where the sun is
higher, with photo B, where it's lower.
One of the leaves is missing from the tree
in photo B. Therefore, B must have been
taken later than A and D, and the sun must
be getting lower in the sky because it's
setting.

Picture yourself at the scene. If the sun is
setting behind the hills in the west, which
direction is the carriage travelling?
translation:
Gunesin daha yuksekte oldugu A ve D
fotograflarini, daha alcakta oldugu B ile
karsilastir. B fotografinda agactaki yapraklardan
biri eksik. Demek ki B, A ve D'den daha
sonra cekilmis ve gunes gokyuzunde
alcaliyor; cunku batiyor.

Kendini o yerde hayal et. Gunes batida,
tepelerin ardinda batiyorsa, araba hangi
yone gidiyor?

original: Locate the artefacts!
translation: Eserleri bul!

original:
An archaeologist uncovered six artefacts at
this dig site, at the points marked A to F.

Unfortunately, in the heat of discovery, he
completely forgot to make a note of where
each artefact was found. On the plus side,
he did at least have a record of the order in
which they were found: jug, necklace, dish,
axe, sword and woodblock.

Can you work out where each one was
found?
translation:
Bir arkeolog bu kazi alaninda,
A'dan F'ye isaretli noktalarda alti eser
buldu.

Ne yazik ki kesif heyecaniyla, her eserin
tam olarak nereden ciktigini not etmeyi
unutmus. Neyse ki en azindan
bulunus sirasini kaydetmis: testi, kolye,
tabak, balta, kilic ve tahta blok.

Her birinin nerede bulundugunu
bulabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

You can trace the footprints to work out the
order: B, D, C, A, F and E.

Careful note-taking is essential on digs like
this!
translation:
Dogru!

Sirayi ayak izlerini takip ederek
bulabilirsin: B, D, C, A, F ve E.

Boyle kazilarda dikkatli not tutmak
cok onemlidir!

original:
Too bad.

Take another good look over the dig site.
translation:
Olmadi.

Kazi alanina bir kez daha dikkatlice bak.

original:
There are a lot of footprints around the site.
Compare the footprints found around points
A to F. You should be able to tell which
footprints arrive at each point and which
ones leave.
translation:
Alanda cok fazla ayak izi var.
A'dan F'ye kadar noktalarin cevresindeki
izleri karsilastir. Hangi izlerin her noktaya
geldigini ve hangilerinin ayrildigini
anlayabilmelisin.

original:
Try to find the place where the first artefact
was discovered. That should be the only
place where there is a set of footprints
leaving and none arriving.

Perhaps the ground was dry until the
archaeologist found the first artefact,
and then it started to rain...
translation:
Ilk eserin bulundugu yeri bulmaya calis.
Orasi, ayak izlerinin yalnizca ciktigi ve
hicbir izinin gelmedigi tek yer olmali.

Belki arkeolog ilk eseri bulana kadar
zemin kuruydu da, sonra yagmur basladi...

original:
B is the only place without footprints leading
to it. You can follow the prints that leave B
to find the rest in order.

It's a little hard to follow, but there is
definitely a trail. It seems to lead to D
first...
translation:
B, kendisine dogru giden ayak izi olmayan
tek yer. B'den cikan izleri takip ederek
digerlerini sirayla bulabilirsin.

Takip etmesi biraz zor, ama kesinlikle
bir iz yolu var. Ilk olarak D'ye gidiyor gibi...

original:
B is the first place, and D the second. Keep
following the trail of footprints to find the next
one.

There are only four footprints between D and
the next artefact in the trail.
translation:
B ilk yer, D ise ikinci. Sonraki eseri bulmak
icin ayak izi izini takip etmeye devam et.

D ile izdeki bir sonraki eser arasinda
sadece dort ayak izi var.

original: Where should the photo go?
translation: Fotograf nereye asilmali?

original:
The owner of a caf{'e} took a photo of a
visiting celebrity couple. Pleased as punch,
the owner said he'd put it up somewhere in
the caf{'e}, but the resulting photo ended up
looking a bit, well...miserable.

Where's the best place to put it up without
harming the cheerful ambiance of the caf{'e}?

Oh, and this is a special photo, so you can't
cut it up.
translation:
Bir caf{'e} sahibi, ziyarete gelen unlu bir cifti
fotografladi. Cok memnun olan sahibi,
onu caf{'e}de bir yere asacagini soyledi,
ama ortaya cikan fotograf biraz... sey,
mutsuz gorunuyor.

Caf{'e}nin neseli havasini bozmadan
bu fotografi asmak icin en iyi yer neresi?

Bir de bu ozel bir fotograf, yani
kesip bicemezsin.

original:
Correct!

Well, would you look at that! By wrapping it
around the column, the photo is transformed
into one depicting an amicable toast!
translation:
Dogru!

Bak sen! Fotografi
sutunun etrafina sarinca, samimi bir kadeh
kaldirisi gosteren bir goruntuye donusuyor!

original:
Too bad.

It looks as if this calls for a rather unusual
way of putting the photo up.
translation:
Olmadi.

Gorunuse gore bu fotografi asmak icin
biraz sira disi bir yontem gerekiyor.

original:
What a photo! He's managed to get it so
that the couple are right on the far edges
from each other. They've even got their
backs turned.

Maybe the photo would be a bit more cheery
if they were each facing someone.
translation:
Ne fotograf ama! Cifti oyle bir yakalamis ki
birbirlerinden en uzak koselere dusmusler.
Ustelik
sirtlarini bile donmusler.

Belki de her biri birine bakiyor olsaydi,
fotograf daha neseli gorunurdu.

original:
Is there any way to get the couple to face
each other without cutting the photo?

You could put them together by rolling up
the photo, couldn't you?
translation:
Fotografi kesmeden cifti
birbirine baktirmanin bir yolu var mi?

Fotografi rulo yaparak
onlari yan yana getirebilirsin, degil mi?

original:
You'll need to make the photo cylindrical so
that you can get the couple to face each
other.

Where can you put the photo up so that it's
cylindrical? Is there anything that you can
wrap it around?
translation:
Cifti birbirine baktirmak icin
fotografi silindir sekline getirmen
gerekecek.

Fotografi silindir olacak sekilde
nereye asabilirsin? Etrafina
sarabilecegin bir sey var mi?

original:
Is there anything in the caf{'e} that you can
wrap the photo around in order to put it on
display?

Oh, what about that? That right there! The
thing standing right between those two
chairs, there!
translation:
Caf{'e}de fotografi sergilemek icin
etrafina sarabilecegin
bir sey var mi?

Ya suna ne dersin? Iste orada! Su
iki sandalyenin tam arasinda duran
sey!

original: Who's the host telling off?
translation: Sunucu kimi azarliyor?

original:
Host: {''}Get ready for the time of your lives 
on our spectacular stage! Pay attention to 
the cameras placed on the corners of the 
stars. Their viewing angle is only as wide 
as the edges of each star point. Keep free 
of the centre and make sure you're not 
caught on more than one camera!{''} 

Hey! Haven't you been listening? You're 
on more than one camera!{''} 

Who's the host telling off?
translation:
Sunucu: {''}Hayatinizin en guzel anlarina hazir olun
muhtesem sahnemizde! Yildizlarin koselerine
yerlestirilen kameralara dikkat edin.
Gorus acilari, her yildiz ucunun kenarlari
kadar genis. Merkezden uzak durun ve
birden fazla kameraya yakalanmayin!{''}

Hey! Dinlemiyor musun? Birden fazla
kamerada gorunuyorsun!{''}

Sunucu kimi azarliyor?

original:
Correct!

The answer is A, C, D, F and G. It looks as
if quite a lot of people got a ticking off from
the host!
translation:
Dogru!

Cevap A, C, D, F ve G. Gorunuse gore epey
kisi sunucudan azar isitti!

original:
Too bad.

It's all in how you count it.
translation:
Olmadi.

Her sey nasil saydigina bagli.

original:
It might be easier to think about who each
camera captures, rather than how
many cameras each person appears on.
translation:
Her kisinin kac kamerada gorundugunu
saymaktan ziyade, her kameranin kimi
yakaladigini dusunmek daha kolay olabilir.

original:
Make a note of who appears on each
camera. On the right star:

Camera 10: G
Camera 9: A, I
Camera 8: C
Camera 7: D
Camera 6: F

How about the ones on the left?
translation:
Her kamerada kim gorunuyor not al.
Sag yildizda:

Kamera 10: G
Kamera 9: A, I
Kamera 8: C
Kamera 7: D
Kamera 6: F

Soldakiler peki?

original:
On the left star:

Camera 1: H
Camera 2: D, E, F, G
Camera 3: B, C
Camera 4: A
Camera 5: No one

Now just take Hint 2 into consideration and
think it through a bit more.
translation:
Sol yildizda:

Kamera 1: H
Kamera 2: D, E, F, G
Kamera 3: B, C
Kamera 4: A
Kamera 5: Kimse

Simdi Ipucu 2'yi de goz onunde bulundur ve
biraz daha dusun.

original:
Simply add up how many cameras each
person has been caught on using the
information from Hints 2 and 3.

A is on two cameras, B on one, C on two,
D on two, E on one, F on two, G on two,
H on one and I on one.

So, who shows up on more than one
camera?
translation:
Ipucu 2 ve 3'teki bilgileri kullanarak her
kisinin kac kameraya yakalandigini topla.

A iki kamerada, B bir, C iki,
D iki, E bir, F iki, G iki,
H bir ve I bir.

Oyleyse kim birden fazla
kamerada gorunuyor?

original: Make the fish a triangle!
translation: Baligi ucgen yap!

original:
Here's a little paper goldfish.

You can make the goldfish into a triangle by
cutting carefully along the dots to make two
pieces, then rotating the resulting pieces to
put them together.

Where should you cut it? Draw lines with the
stylus, taking care to mark only the places
where you should cut.
translation:
Iste kucuk bir kagit japon baligi.

Japon baligini bir ucgene cevirmek icin,
noktali cizgiler boyunca dikkatlice kesip
iki parca elde etmen, sonra parcalari dondurup
birlestirmen gerekiyor.

Nereden kesmelisin? Kalemle cizgiler ciz,
ama sadece kesmen gereken yerleri isaretle.

original:
Gold on you!

If all goldfish could turn into triangles, they'd
have far fewer natural predators!
translation:
Aferin sana!

Eger tum japon baliklari ucgene donusebilseydi,
dogal dusmanlari cok daha az olurdu!

original:
Too bad.

You only need to cut it into two pieces,
remember.
translation:
Olmadi.

Unutma, sadece iki parcaya kesmen gerekiyor.

original:
Are there any parts that'll help you get
started?

There's a triangular indentation in the tail
fin of the goldfish. What does that tell you?

If only you could cut the goldfish into three -
then you could simply cut straight through
the fins.
translation:
Baslamana yardim edecek bir sey var mi?

Baligin kuyruk yuzgecinde ucgen bir oyuk var.
Bu sana ne soyluyor?

Keske baligi uc parcaya kesebilseydin -
o zaman yuzgeclerin icinden dumduz keserdin.

original:
If you cut through the fins, you'll end up
with three pieces, so that's a non-starter.

You've got to deal with the indentation in the
tail fin, though. Try cutting out the shape of
the indentation somewhere else, then using
that shape to fill in the gap.
translation:
Yuzgeclerin icinden kesersen,
uc parca elde edersin; bu olmaz.

Ama kuyruktaki oyugu hesaba katmalisin.
Oyugun seklini baska bir yerden kesip cikar,
sonra o parcayi boslugu doldurmak icin kullanmayi dene.

original:
Did you work out where you need to cut in
order to create a shape that'll fill in the gap?

Find the dot second from the right, third from
the top, then make a small cut going
upwards and to the left.

When this cut is paired with the fish's side,
it makes a triangular point which can fit
nicely into the gap in the tail.
translation:
Boslugu dolduracak sekli
olusturmak icin nereden kesmen gerektigini
bulabildin mi?

Sagdan ikinci noktayi, yukaridan ucuncu noktayi
bul, sonra sola ve yukari dogru giden kucuk
bir kesik at.

Bu kesik, baligin yan kenariyla
eslesince ucgen bir uc olusturur ve
kuyruktaki bosluga guzelce oturur.

original:
After cutting the fish as described in
Hint 3, make another small cut going
downwards and to the left.

Can you see where you're going with this?

Next, you just need to cut downwards and
to the right!
translation:
3. Ipucu'ndaki gibi kestikten sonra,
sola ve asagi dogru giden bir kucuk
kesik daha at.

Nereye varacagini gorebiliyor musun?

Simdi tek yapman gereken asagi
ve saga dogru kesmek!

original: Who hit the bullseye?
translation: Tam ortaya kim vurdu?

original:
A, B and C are playing a game of ball darts.
After throwing four balls each, all three
people each scored 62 points.

A scored 27 points with his first two balls
and B scored five points with her last ball.
The picture above shows where each ball
hit the target.

Who threw the ball that hit the bullseye and
scored 50 points?
translation:
A, B ve C bir
toplu dart oyunu oynuyor.
Her biri dort top attiktan sonra
ucu de 62 puan yapti.

A ilk iki topuyla 27 puan
aldi ve B son topuyla 5 puan aldi.
Yukaridaki resim her topun
hedefe nereden isabet ettigini gosteriyor.

Tam ortaya isabet edip
50 puan getiren topu kim atti?

original:
Correct!

We know that A had to have scored a 30, a
25, a 5 and a 2. Additionally, by looking at
all possible three-ball, 12-point combinations
that take the score from 50 to 62, and by
excluding A's 2 from these combinations,
the one who hit the bullseye must have
scored a 5.

Two balls hit the 5-point area, one of which
was A's, so only B could have got the
50-point score.
translation:
Dogru!

A'nin 30,
25, 5 ve 2 puan almis olmasi gerektigini biliyoruz. Ayrica,
50'den 62'ye cikan toplami saglayan, uc topluk tum 12 puan
kombinasyonlarina bakip
A'nin 2'sini bu kombinasyonlardan cikarinca,
tam ortaya vuran kisinin
5 puan almis olmasi gerektigi ortaya cikar.

Iki top 5 puanlik
alana isabet etti; bunlardan biri A'nindi, bu yuzden 50 puani
yalnizca B almis
olabilir.

original:
Too bad.

Use what you know to narrow down which
balls could belong to each player.
translation:
Olmadi.

Bildiklerini kullanarak
hangi toplarin hangi oyuncuya ait olabilecegini daralt.

original:
First, you'll need to work out the combination
of points needed for the three balls that
didn't hit 50.

There should be four possible patterns.
translation:
Once, 50'ye
isabet etmeyen uc top icin gereken
puan kombinasyonunu bulmalisin.

Dort olasi
dizilim olmali.

original:
Given that someone scored a 50, there are
four possible combinations that can get them
up to 62 points:

1. 50, 6, 5, 1
2. 50, 6, 4, 2
3. 50, 5, 5, 2
4. 50, 5, 4, 3

Using these as reference, can you determine
who scored the 50?
translation:
Birinin 50
aldigini bildigimize gore, onu 62 puana
cikarabilecek dort olasi kombinasyon var:

1. 50, 6, 5, 1
2. 50, 6, 4, 2
3. 50, 5, 5, 2
4. 50, 5, 4, 3

Bu olasiliklari temel alarak, 50 puani
kim aldi bulabilir misin?

original:
Think about A's score. He scored 27 with
his first two balls, so that means he must
have scored a 25 and a 2. That leaves 35
points, so he can only have scored a 30 and
a 5 after that. That rules out A.
translation:
A'nin puanini dusun.
Ilk iki topuyla 27 aldi; bu da 25 ve 2
aldigi anlamina gelir. Geriye 35
puan kalir, yani kalan iki topta sadece 30 ve
5 almis olabilir. Bu da A'yi eler.

original:
Following on from Hint 3, we now know that
A's combination was 30, 25, 5, 2.

Observe the four patterns in Hint 2 again.
We can rule out patterns two and three
because we know that A scored the only 2.
Which leaves the following:
1. 50, 6, 5, 1
4. 50, 5, 4, 3

Didn't B score a 5 with her last ball?
translation:
Ipucu 3'ten devamla, artik
A'nin kombinasyonunun 30, 25, 5, 2 oldugunu biliyoruz.

Ipucu 2'deki dort dizilime tekrar bak.
A'nin tek 2'yi
aldigini bildigimiz icin ikinci ve ucuncu dizilimi eleyebiliriz.
Geriye sunlar kalir:
1. 50, 6, 5, 1
4. 50, 5, 4, 3

B son topuyla 5
almamis miydi?

original: How will the design look?
translation: Desen nasil gorunur?

original:
This stamp is adorned with a blazing sun
motif.

Can you picture how the design will look
after you plonk the stamp down onto a piece
of paper?

Choose from A, B, C or D.
translation:
Bu damga, alev alev bir gunes
motifiyle suslu.

Damgayi bir kagida bastiginda
desenin nasil gorunecegini
zihninde canlandirabilir misin?

A, B, C veya D'yi sec.

original:
Correct!

You'll get D. The spiral in the middle and the
rays around the outside will all be mirrored
when you press the stamp.
translation:
Dogru!

D olur. Ortadaki spiral ve
distaki isinlarin hepsi, damgayi bastiginda
ayna goruntusu olur.

original:
Too bad.

Don't rush. Relax and carefully compare
each of the options.
translation:
Olmadi.

Acele etme. Rahatla ve her secenegi
dikkatle karsilastir.

original:
The design will be mirrored when you stamp
it.

The design might look a bit confusing at
first, so check very, very carefully.
translation:
Damgayi bastiginda desen
ayna goruntusu olur.

Desen ilk bakista biraz
kafa karistirici gorunebilir, o yuzden cok ama cok
dikkatli kontrol et.

original:
Look at picture A. The sun's rays are
mirrored, but the spiral in the middle is not.

You can rule out picture A, then.
translation:
A resmine bak. Gunesin isinlari
ayna goruntusu olmus, ama ortadaki spiral olmamis.

O halde A'yi eleyebilirsin.

original:
Now for picture B. The design is exactly the
same as it looks on the stamp.

The design should be mirrored when you
stamp it, so that's B out.
translation:
Simdi B resmine. Desen damganin uzerindekiyle
birebir ayni.

Bastiginda desen aynalanmali, yani B de
olamaz.

original:
Have a look at picture C. It might be hard
to tell because it's been rotated, but it's
actually the same as B. You can exclude C
as well.

That just leaves D. Have a close look just
in case, though.
translation:
C resmine bak. Dondurulmus oldugu icin
anlamak zor olabilir, ama aslinda
B ile ayni. C'yi de eleyebilirsin.

Geriye D kaliyor. Yine de emin olmak icin
yakindan bak.

original: How many coloured sheets?
translation: Kac renkli kagit?

original:
This artistic young boy wants to make a
stained-glass picture based on the legend
of King Arthur by sticking bits of coloured
sheets to the atrium window.

The sheets used for the sword are going to
be yellow, but he wants to design the rest
so that none of the other parts are the same
colour as any adjacent part.

What is the minimum number of different
coloured sheets he will need, including the
yellow sheet for the sword parts?
translation:
Bu sanatci cocuk, Kral Arthur efsanesine
dayanan bir vitray resmi yapmak istiyor;
renkli kagit parcalarini atriyum penceresine
yapistiracak.

Kilic icin kullanilacak parcalar sari olacak,
ama geri kalanini oyle tasarlamak istiyor ki
bitisik olan hicbir parca ayni renkte olmasin.

Kilicin sari parcalari da dahil olmak uzere,
en az kac farkli renkli kagida ihtiyaci var?

original:
Correct!

While you need four colours to avoid having
any parts with the same colour adjacent to
each other, you only need to use three
different coloured sheets and have the bare
parts of the window be the fourth colour.
translation:
Dogru!

Yan yana ayni renk olmasin diye dort renge
ihtiyacin var; ama aslinda uc farkli renkli
kagit yeter. Pencerenin bos (seffaf) kismini
dorduncu renk gibi kullanabilirsin.

original:
Too bad.

Don't be dazzled by the magnificence of that
sword!
translation:
Olmadi.

O muhtesem kilicin ihtisamina kapilip
yanilma!

original:
Use the Memo Function to try filling in the
colours yourself. Use as few colours as you
can.
translation:
Renkleri kendin doldurmak icin Memo
ozelligini kullan. Mumkun oldugunca az
renk kullan.

original:
The answer is four colours!

Except, that's not quite right. There's a way
to go even lower than that.
translation:
Cevap dort renk!

Ama aslinda tam olarak degil. Daha da
azaltmanin bir yolu var.

original:
The puzzle only said you can't have the
same colours adjacent to each other.

It didn't say that you have to completely
cover the window with coloured sheets.
translation:
Bulmaca yalnizca yan yana ayni rengin
olamayacagini soyledi.

Pencerenin tamamini renkli kagitla
kaplaman gerektigini soylemedi.

original:
You can make good use of the bare glass.

By including the transparent glass as one of
your colours, you can reduce the number of
different coloured sheets you'll need by one.
translation:
Bos cami iyi kullanabilirsin.

Seffaf cami renklerinden biri sayarsan,
ihtiyac duyacagin farkli renkli kagit
sayisini bir azaltirsin.

original: Which way will she face?
translation: Hangi yone bakacak?

original:
A girl has a go on a spinning teacup ride,
beloved at amusement parks across the
world.

There are four saucers on the ride's base
and four cups on each saucer. The base,
saucers and cups each take 20 seconds to
make one complete clockwise rotation.

If the girl in the picture is facing east now,
which way will she be facing after the cup
has spun for 15 seconds?
translation:
Bir kiz donen bir cay fincani oyuncagina biner,
dunyanin dort bir yanindaki lunaparklarin
gozdesidir.

Oyuncagin tabaninda dort tabak
ve her tabagin uzerinde dort fincan vardir. Taban,
tabaklar ve fincanlarin her biri
saat yonunde bir tam turu 20 saniyede tamamlar.

Resimdeki kiz su an doguya bakiyorsa,
fincan 15 saniye dondukten sonra
hangi yone bakiyor olur?

original:
Correct!

She'd be facing south. You can work this out
by calculating the total rotation of the base,
saucer and cup:

270{o } times 3 equals 810{o }, which makes
two complete rotations plus 90{o }.
translation:
Dogru!

Guneye bakiyor olurdu. Bunu,
tabanin, tabagin ve fincanin toplam donusunu hesaplayarak
bulabilirsin:

270{o } carpi 3, 810{o } eder; bu da
iki tam tur arti 90{o } demektir.

original:
Too bad.

Are you thinking too hard about this?
translation:
Olmadi.

Bunu fazla mi kurcaliyorsun?

original:
You know it takes 20 seconds to complete
one rotation. That means in 15 seconds,
you'll get a three-quarter rotation. So,
three-quarter rotations each for the base,
saucer and cup gives you...

That's a bit confusing, isn't it? Isn't there
an easier way?
translation:
Bir turu tamamlamanin 20 saniye
surdugunu biliyorsun. Bu da 15 saniyede
uc ceyrek tur
olacagi anlamina gelir. O halde, taban,
tabak ve fincanin her biri icin uc ceyrek tur...

Biraz kafa karistirici,
degil mi? Daha kolay bir yolu yok mu?

original:
The girl is sitting in the cup, so you'll need
to add up all the rotations of the base,
saucer and cup. In that case, you can
express the problem in simple maths.

Each makes one three-quarter rotation and
one rotation is 360{o }, so it's 270{o } each.
translation:
Kiz fincanin icinde
oturuyor, bu yuzden tabanin,
tabagin ve fincanin tum donuslerini toplamalisin. Bu durumda,
problemi basit bir matematikle ifade edebilirsin.

Her biri uc ceyrek tur atar ve
bir tur 360{o } olduguna gore, her biri 270{o } eder.

original:
Calculate the total rotations of the base, cup
and saucer. That's 270{o } times 3, which
gives you 810{o }.

One full rotation is 360{o }, so you've two full
rotations in 720{o } and an additional 90{o }.

Where would that leave the girl facing?
translation:
Tabanin, fincanin
ve tabagin toplam donusunu hesapla. Bu 270{o } carpi 3'tur ve
810{o } eder.

Bir tam tur 360{o } olduguna gore, 720{o } icinde iki tam tur ve ayrica 90{o } vardir.

Bu durumda kiz hangi yone bakar?

original:
You'll end up with two full rotations and a
90{o } rotation. That means you only need
to think about the 90{o } rotation.

In other words: the direction she'll be facing
is just a one-quarter rotation from her
starting position. Where is that?
translation:
Sonuc iki tam tur
ve 90{o }'lik bir donus olur. Bu da yalnizca
90{o }'lik donusu dusunmen gerektigi anlamina gelir.

Baska bir deyisle: bakacagi yon,
baslangic konumundan sadece ceyrek tur
otedir. Bu hangi yondur?

original: Get the statue out!
translation: Heykeli cikar!

original:
The museum has received a letter from
a mysterious art thief. It reads:
{''}Your precious queen is all mine.{''}

The curator, awash with panic, has rushed
off to see whether his prize statue really has
been stolen. Since he keeps it well hidden
right at the back of the warehouse, however,
it is rather difficult to check.

Move the crates around so as to open up
a path and get the statue from the far left
to the exit on the right.
translation:
Muze, gizemli bir sanat hirsizindan bir mektup
aldi. Mektupta soyle yaziyor:
{''}Degerli kralicen artik benim.{''}

Kurator, panige kapilip, odul heykelinin gercekten
calinip calinmadigini kontrol etmeye kostu.
Ancak onu deponun en arkasinda iyi sakladigi
icin kontrol etmek epey zor.

Kasalari hareket ettirerek bir yol ac ve
en soldaki heykeli sagdaki cikisa ulastir.

original:
Correct!

It takes a minimum of 26 moves to get the
statue out. What a relief that it is safe and
sound!

But wait! Who is that lurking in the shadows?
Could it be...the dastardly thief herself?!
translation:
Dogru!

Heykeli cikarmak icin en az 26 hamle gerekir.
Ne rahatlama; heykel saglam ve yerinde!

Ama dur! Golgelerde kim pusuya yatmis?
Yoksa... o alcak hirsizin kendisi mi?!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
The key to this puzzle is working out how to
get the two crates with protruding parts into
the top area.

Start off by sliding the far-right crate into
the exit, then move the small rectangular
crate next to it into the gap in the top-right
corner. What now?
translation:
Bu bulmacanin puf noktasi, cikintili iki
kasayi ust bolgeye nasil cikaracagini
bulmaktir.

Once en sagdaki kasayi cikisa kaydir,
sonra yanindaki kucuk dikdortgen
kasayi sag ust kosedeki bosluga sur.
Simdi ne yapacaksin?

original:
Continuing from Hint 1, you should now aim
to get the other two small rectangular crates
lined up beneath the first one.

Shove the bottom-right crate out the way and
try to get all three rectangular crates in a
vertical line.
translation:
Ipucu 1'den devamla, simdi diger iki kucuk
dikdortgen kasayi birincisinin altina
hizalamayi hedefle.

Sag alttaki kasayi itip yolundan cikar ve
uc dikdortgen kasayi dikey bir cizgide
toplamaya calis.

original:
The next step is to move the crate beside
the statue to the right, then move the top-
left square crate down. This lets you move
the top crate with a protrusion to the left.

You can use the newly created open space
to line up the three square crates vertically.
translation:
Sonraki adim, heykelin yanindaki kasayi
saga kaydirmak, ardindan sol ustteki kare
kasayi asagi indirmektir. Boylece ustteki
cikintili kasayi sola hareket ettirebilirsin.

Acilan boslugu kullanarak uc kare kasayi
dikey olarak hizalayabilirsin.

original:
Once the three square crates are lined up
vertically on the right, move the bottom-left
crate with a protrusion up. The open space
below can be filled with the square crates,
which makes space at the top.

You'll find that the two crates with protrusions
fit together nicely. Now it's simply a case of
shuffling the other crates around until you
get the statue out!
translation:
Sag tarafta uc kare kasa dikey olarak
hizalaninca, sol alttaki cikintili kasayi
yukari cikar. Alttaki bosluk kare kasalarla
doldurulabilir; bu da ustte yer acar.

Iki cikintili kasanin birbirine guzelce
oturdugunu goreceksin. Artik tek yapman
gereken, diger kasalari evirip cevirerek
heykeli cikarmak!

original: Fill in the details!
translation: Detaylari doldur!

original:
A, B, C and D each found a unique object
at a different depth in the ruins. Based on
the following statements, fill in the missing
information about each artefact, its material
and its depth.
① The doll is made of wood.
② B dug 100 cm deeper than D and found
something at 150 cm deep.
③ An item made of blue-tinged metal was
found deeper down than the wooden one.
④ The pot is made of sandy clay.
⑤ The coin was found in a shallower place
than the sword.
translation:
A, B, C ve D harabelerde
farkli derinliklerde, birbirinden farkli birer nesne buldu.
Asagidaki ifadelere gore, her eserin
ne oldugunu, hangi maddeden yapildigini
ve derinligini doldur.
① Bebek ahsaptandir.
② B, D'den 100 cm daha derine kazdi ve
150 cm derinde bir sey buldu.
③ Mavi tonlu metalden yapilmis bir esya,
ahsap olandan daha derinde bulundu.
④ Comlek kumlu kilden yapilmistir.
⑤ Madeni para, kilictan daha sig bir yerde bulundu.

original:
Correct!

A found a metal blade 200 cm underground.
B dug 150 cm to find a wooden doll.
C found a clay pot at a depth of 100 cm.
D discovered a stone coin 50 cm down.

Quite a successful expedition!
translation:
Dogru!

A, 200 cm derinde metal bir kilic buldu.
B, 150 cm kazip ahsap bir bebek buldu.
C, 100 cm derinde kil bir comlek buldu.
D, 50 cm asagida tas bir madeni para kesfetti.

Ne basarili bir kesif!

original:
Too bad.

Read over the statements carefully and
make sure everything fits.
translation:
Olmadi.

Ifadeleri dikkatlice yeniden oku ve
her seyin uydugundan emin ol.

original:
The following details have already been filled
in: B found a doll, D found a stone artefact,
and A found something at a depth of
200 cm.

Based on the first statement in the puzzle,
you can enter the fact that B's doll was
made of wood.
translation:
Su bilgiler zaten doldurulmus:
B bir bebek buldu, D tas bir eser buldu,
ve A 200 cm
derinde bir sey buldu.

Bulmacadaki ilk ifadeye gore,
B'nin bebeginin
ahsaptan yapildigini yazabilirsin.

original:
The second statement tells you that B dug
150 cm down, which was 100 cm deeper
than D. D thus dug 50 cm into the earth.

The third statement compares the depths at
which the metal and wooden artefacts were
found. You already know the material of B
and D's artefacts, so use those to work out
A and C's.
translation:
Ikinci ifade, B'nin
150 cm kazdigini, bunun da D'den
100 cm daha derin oldugunu soyler.
O halde D 50 cm kazmistir.

Ucuncu ifade, metal ve ahsap eserlerin
bulundugu derinlikleri karsilastirir.
B ve D'nin bulduklarinin malzemesini zaten biliyorsun,
bunlari kullanarak A ile C'ninkini bul.

original:
From the previous two hints, you should
have all the materials and depths filled in.
Now to work out who found which artefact
based on the remaining clues...

From the fourth statement, you can now
deduce that C found a clay pot. As for A and
D, look at the fifth statement and compare
the depths at which the coin and sword were
found. You already know the depths for each
person.
translation:
Onceki iki ipucundan sonra,
tum malzemeler ve derinlikler dolmus olmali.
Simdi kalan ipuclarina gore
kimin hangi eseri buldugunu cikaralim...

Dorduncu ifadeden, C'nin
kil bir comlek buldugunu cikarabilirsin. A ve
D icinse besinci ifadeye bak ve madeni para ile
kilicin bulundugu derinlikleri
karsilastir. Her kisinin derinligini
zaten biliyorsun.

original:
The fifth statement tells you that the coin was
found at a shallower level than the sword.

A's discovery was much deeper than D's.
So did A find the coin or the sword?
translation:
Besinci ifade, madeni paranin
kilictan daha sig bir yerde
bulundugunu soyler.

A'nin buldugu sey D'ninkinden cok daha derindeydi.
Oyleyse A madeni parayi mi buldu, yoksa kilici mi?

original: Where was the boy?
translation: Cocuk neredeydi?

original:
A little boy who was walking around town
stopped in a certain place and stood
watching people for a while. They were
moving around in three distinct patterns,
as shown.

Where was he? Circle your answer on the
map.

By the way, the patterns are shown as seen
from the side.
translation:
Kasabada dolasan kucuk bir cocuk
belli bir yerde durup
bir sure insanlari izledi. Insanlar
sekilde gosterildigi gibi uc farkli duzende
hareket ediyorlardi.

O neredeydi? Haritada
cevabini daire icine al.

Bu arada, desenler
yandan gorunuse gore cizilmistir.

original:
Correct!

He was at the park.

A shows someone swinging on a swing.
B shows two people on a see-saw.
C shows someone sliding down a slide and
running back to the ladder to go again.

What fun!
translation:
Dogru!

Parktaydi.

A, salincakta sallanan birini gosteriyor.
B, tahterevallide iki kisiyi gosteriyor.
C, kaydiraktan kayan birini ve
yeniden cikmak icin merdivene kosmasini gosteriyor.

Ne eglence!

original:
Too bad!

Remember, all these movement patterns are
happening in the same location.
translation:
Olmadi!

Unutma, bu hareketlerin hepsi
ayni yerde gerceklesiyor.

original:
None of the movement patterns look much
like those of people at first glance.

People wouldn't be moving like that on their
own...
translation:
Bu hareketlerin hicbiri ilk bakista
insanlarin hareketine pek benzemiyor.

Insanlar tek baslarina
oyle hareket etmez...

original:
The people in patterns A and B appear to be
using something that's causing them to move
like that.

They have a pretty regular rhythm going
too.
translation:
A ve B desenindeki insanlar,
onlari oyle hareket ettiren bir sey
kullaniyor gibi gorunuyor.

Ayrica oldukca duzenli
bir ritimleri var.

original:
The three movement patterns are all of
people on some kind of apparatus. All three
can, of course, be found at the same place
Maybe if you went to that place, you wouldn't
be sure which apparatus you wanted to play
on first?
translation:
Uc hareket deseni de
bir tur oyuncak/duzenek uzerindeki insanlara ait. Ucu de elbette
ayni yerde bulunabilir.
Belki o yere gitsen,
hangi oyuncaga once binecegine
karar veremezdin?

original:
The three kinds of apparatus are all things
people get on for fun. The little boy was just
watching, but maybe he wanted to join in
too?
translation:
Uc duzenek de
insanlarin eglenmek icin bindigi seyler. Kucuk cocuk sadece
izliyordu, ama belki o da
katilmak istiyordu?

original: Replace the tiles!
translation: Karolari degistir!

original:
The tiles on this street are rather faded.
Can you help out and replace them with
some fresh tiles? The tiles are already
stuck together into several larger pieces.

The pattern is the same as the old one, but
it doesn't have to be oriented the same way.
Oh, and you can rotate each section!
translation:
Bu sokaktaki karolar epey solmus.
Yardim edip onlari
yeni karolarla degistirebilir misin? Karolar zaten
birkac buyuk parca halinde birbirine yapistirilmis.

Desen eskisiyle ayni, ama
ayni yonde durmak zorunda degil.
Ayrica her parcayi dondurebilirsin!

original:
Well done!

That looks much better!
translation:
Aferin!

Boyle cok daha iyi gorunuyor!

original: Try again.
translation: Tekrar dene.

original:
The finished mosaic is 12 x 12, while each
piece is roughly 3 x 6, plus or minus a few
tiles.

The pieces will end up laid out in quite a
neat pattern.
translation:
Tamamlanmis mozaik 12 x 12'dir; her
parca ise kabaca 3 x 6, birkac
karo eksik ya da fazla.

Parcalar sonunda oldukca
duzenli bir desene yerlesir.

original:
Let's get you started on your way.

See that three-pronged piece in the middle
of the right-hand side? Rotate it 180
degrees and place it in the bottom left.

Now take the piece in the bottom-right
corner, rotate it 90 degrees and place it
next to the previous one to complete the
bottom edge of the mosaic.
translation:
Hadi seni yola koyup baslatalim.

Sag kenarin ortasindaki uc cikintili parcayi goruyor musun?
Onu 180 derece
dondur ve sol alt koseye yerlestir.

Simdi sag alt
kosedeki parcayi al, 90 derece dondur ve
mozaigin alt kenarini tamamlamak icin
bir oncekinin yanina koy.

original:
After you place the tiles as described in
Hint 2, you'll see four gaps between the
{''}teeth{''} along their top edge. Look for a
piece with tiles sticking out that would fill
two of those gaps and rotate it so those
tiles are facing downwards.

You should then be able to see most of
the pattern's middle section.
translation:
2. ipucunda anlatildigi gibi karolari yerlestirdikten sonra,
ust kenarlari boyunca {''}disler{''} arasinda dort bosluk
goreceksin. Bu bosluklardan
ikisini dolduracak sekilde cikintili karolari olan bir
parca bul ve onu
bu karolar asagi bakacak sekilde dondur.

Boylece desenin
orta bolumunun cogunu gorebilmelisin.

original:
With the tiles arranged as per the previous
hints, you should be able to complete the
pattern in the centre. You're looking for a
long piece with one tile sticking out.

Once you put that piece in place, it should
be obvious which piece goes on the
left-hand side if you pay attention to both
the shape and the pattern.

The remaining three pieces are up to you.
translation:
Onceki ipuclarina gore karolari yerlestirince,
ortadaki deseni
tamamlayabilmelisin. Aradigin sey,
bir karosu disari tasan uzun bir parca.

O parcayi yerine koyunca,
hem sekle hem de desene dikkat edersen
sol tarafta hangi parcanin
duracagi belli olacaktir.

Kalan uc parca ise sana kalmis.

original: Which fish was it?
translation: Hangi balikti?

original:
This fossil was found on a riverbed. Close
examination revealed tooth marks,
suggesting that it was formed when some
kind of ancient fish bit into something tasty.

Can you tell which one of the fish pictured
in the book made these tooth marks?
translation:
Bu fosil bir nehir yataginda bulundu. Yakindan
inceleyince dis izleri
goruldu; bu da bir zamanlar
bir tur eski baligin lezzetli bir seye isirmasiyla olustugunu gosteriyor.

Kitaptaki resimlerdeki baliklardan
hangisinin bu dis izlerini biraktigini
soyleyebilir misin?

original:
Correct!

The answer is A.

The shape of the teeth is irrelevant. Looking
at the bite mark as a whole, you can see
that only three pairs of front teeth made an
impression, so only a fish without any back
teeth could have made these marks.
translation:
Dogru!

Cevap A.

Dislerin sekli onemli degil. Isirik izine
bir butun olarak bakinca,
yalnizca on dislerin uc ciftinin iz biraktigini
gorebilirsin; bu yuzden ancak arka disleri olmayan bir balik
bu izleri birakmis olabilir.

original:
Too bad.

Don't worry too much about the shape of
each fish's teeth.
translation:
Olmadi.

Her baligin dislerinin sekline
fazla takilma.

original:
The first thing to notice is the number of
tooth marks. There are six, three on each
side. That must mean the fish that made this
bite mark has three pairs of teeth.
translation:
Ilk dikkat edecegin sey dis izlerinin
sayisi. Alti tane var; her
yanda uc. Bu da bu
isirigi yapan baligin uc cift disi oldugunu gosterir.

original:
Compare the three fish. Each of them has
three pairs of teeth on either the upper jaw
or the lower jaw.

C has rounded teeth, but that doesn't
necessarily mean it couldn't make this bite
mark.

Is there anything else about the fish that
sets them apart? Maybe the position of the
teeth?
translation:
Uc baligi karsilastir. Her birinin
ya ust cenede
ya da alt cenede uc cift disi var.

C'nin disleri yuvarlak, ama bu
mutlaka bu isirigi yapamayacagi
anlamina gelmez.

Baliklari ayiran baska bir sey var mi?
Belki dislerin
konumu?

original:
Have another look at the fossil. If the fish
had this object in its mouth and bit into it,
wouldn't it have made more tooth marks
towards the edge?

Unless it had teeth arranged so that there
wouldn't be tooth marks on the edge of the
fossil...
translation:
Fosile bir kez daha bak. Balik
bu nesneyi agzinda tutup isirdiysa,
kenarlara dogru daha fazla dis izi
birakmaz miydi?

Tabii disleri oyle dizilmemisse ki
fosilin kenarinda
dis izi olusmasin...

original:
If the fish had a mouth full of teeth, there
wouldn't be such a gap between the tooth
marks and the edge of the object after it
was bitten.

This fish must not have had any back teeth.
translation:
Baligin agzi dislerle dolu olsaydi,
isirildiktan sonra dis izleriyle
nesnenin kenari arasinda boyle bir bosluk
olmazdi.

Bu baligin arka disleri olmamali.

original: Arrange the boxes!
translation: Kutulari diz!

original:
When this magic box contraption is turned
on, a ball drops into the box on the left,
then emerges above one of the other boxes
and falls into that. Where the ball will
emerge next is somehow linked to the
number on the box it last fell through.

Can you arrange the boxes so that the ball
will pass through each box once before
finishing in the clown box on the far right?
translation:
Bu sihirli kutu duzenegi calistirildiginda
bir top soldaki kutuya duser,
sonra diger kutulardan birinin ustunde belirir
ve icine duser. Topun bir sonraki
