nerede belirecegi, son gectigi
kutunun uzerindeki sayiyla baglantilidir.

Kutulari oyle dizebilir misin ki top,
palyaco kutusuna (en sagdaki) gitmeden once
her kutudan bir kez gecsin?

original:
Magic!

From left to right, the order is:

◆2, ◆3, ●1, ●3

Circles make the ball move to the left, and
diamonds to the right, by the number of
spaces indicated on the box.
translation:
Sihir!

Soldan saga siralama:

◆2, ◆3, ●1, ●3

Daireler topu sola,
elmaslar ise saga,
kutuda yazan sayi kadar kare ilerletir.

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
To get started, just put the boxes anywhere
you like and touch <CR>Submit</C> to see what
happens. Pay close attention to what the ball
does!
translation:
Baslamak icin kutulari istedigin gibi yerlestir
ve ne olacagini gormek icin <CR>Submit</C>'e dokun.
Topun ne yaptigina
dikkat et!

original:
You've probably noticed that when the ball
drops into a numbered box, it moves along
that number of spaces.

Now if only there was a way to tell whether
it would move to the left or right...
translation:
Muhtemelen top numarali bir kutuya
dusunce, o sayi kadar
kare ilerledigini fark ettin.

Keske bunun
sola mi saga mi olacagini da anlayabilsek...

original:
The boxes have shapes on them too - some
have diamonds and some have circles.

What's the difference?
translation:
Kutularin uzerinde sekiller de var -
bazilarinda elmas, bazilarinda daire var.

Farklari ne?

original:
Boxes with circles will move the ball to the
left, and boxes with diamonds will move it
to the right.

Now all you have to do is look at the
numbers and arrange the boxes to get that
ball into the clown box.
translation:
Daireli kutular topu
sola, elmasli kutular ise
saga goturur.

Simdi yapman gereken tek sey
sayilari dikkate alip kutulari
topu palyaco kutusuna ulastiracak sekilde dizmek.

original: Close the cursed case!
translation: Lanetli kutuyu kapat!

original:
{''}Adventurers beware - this case is cursed!
Should you have unwittingly opened this
case, a terrible fate is soon to befall you!{''}

Oh no! Help Hershel and Randall avert the
curse by packing the stone blocks back into
the case! You'll have to pack every block
neatly into the case to close it tight. To
complicate matters, the blocks are dotted
with holes and protruding studs, so you'll
need to make sure the studs on one side
slot into the holes on the other side, or you
won't be able to close the case. Good luck!
translation:
{''}Maceracilar dikkat - bu kutu lanetli!
Farkinda olmadan bu kutuyu actiysan,
yakinda basina korkunc bir sey gelecek!{''}

Oh hayir! Hershel ve Randall'a yardim et,
laneti onlemek icin tas bloklari tekrar
kutunun icine yerlestir!
Kutuyu sikica kapatmak icin her blogu
duzenli bir sekilde kutunun icine koymalisin.
Isi zorlastiran sey, bloklarin uzerinde delikler ve
cikintili pimler olmasi; bu yuzden bir taraftaki
pimlerin diger taraftaki deliklere oturdugundan
emin olmalisin, yoksa kutuyu kapatamazsin.
Bol sans!

original:
Well done!

It looks as if you've saved the day!
For now, at least.
translation:
Aferin!

Gorunuse gore gunu kurtardin!
Simdilik, en azindan.

original:
Too bad.

Remember that fitting every block into the
case isn't enough - you also need to be
able to close it, so the studs and holes must
line up properly.

Quick, try again before it's too late!
translation:
Olmadi.

Her blogu kutuya sigdirmak yetmez;
onu kapatabilmelisin de, yani pimler ve delikler
dogru hizalanmali.

Cabuk, cok gec olmadan tekrar dene!

original:
Trying to think about the studs and holes as
well as the shape of the blocks is enough to
make anyone's head hurt!

But here's some good news: the blocks can
be both moved and rotated, but the truth is
you don't need to rotate them. Try restarting
the puzzle and simply moving the blocks as
they are.
translation:
Pimler ve deliklerin yani sira
bloklarin seklini de dusunmek
insanin basini agritmaya yeter!

Ama iyi bir haber var: bloklar hem tasinabilir
hem de dondurulebilir; ama aslinda
onlari dondurmene gerek yok. Bulmacayi yeniden baslatip
bloklari olduklari gibi hareket ettirmeyi dene.

original:
Let's reveal part of the solution. See the
long, straight block? Put it in the far right
of the right-hand side of the case.

That limits your options a bit. Did that help?
translation:
Cozumun bir kismini acalim. Su
uzun, duz blogu goruyor musun? Onu
kutunun sag tarafinda en saga koy.

Bu seceneklerini biraz kisitlar. Isine yaradi mi?

original:
See the block that looks like a very wide U
with a stud in each corner? That goes in the
left-hand side of the case, at the very
bottom.

Now think about where you need to place
holes on the other side so that the studs slot
into them.
translation:
Her kosesinde birer pim olan genis bir U
seklindeki blogu goruyor musun? O, kutunun
sol tarafina, en
alta gider.

Simdi diger tarafta delikleri nereye koyman
gerektigini dusun ki pimler
onlara otursun.

original:
If you've placed only the two blocks
mentioned in Hints 2 and 3 and not moved
any of the others, you should now have two
blocks sitting to the right, outside the case.
Place both of these in the right-hand side of
the case.

Now you've got this far, you should be able
to work out the rest!
translation:
Yalnizca Ipucu 2 ve 3'te bahsi gecen iki blogu
yerlestirip digerlerini hic oynatmadiysan,
simdi kutunun saginda, disarida duran iki
blok kalmis olmali.
Bu ikisini de kutunun sag tarafina
yerlestir.

Buraya kadar geldiysen,
gerisini de cozebilmelisin!

original: Which plug goes where?
translation: Hangi fis nereye?

original:
You have four cables plugged into four
sockets, but as they run through pipes,
you have no idea which cable connects to
which socket. You only know part of where
cables B and C run through, shown above.

The length of cable inside the pipe is 6 m
for each cable and each section of pipe is
1 m long. However, while the vertical pipes
can hold as many cables as needed, the
horizontal pipes can hold only one cable.
Can you work out which cable is connected
to which socket?
translation:
Dort kablo dort sokete takili, ama borularin
icinden gectikleri icin hangi kablonun hangi
sokete gittigini bilmiyorsun. Sadece B ve C
kablolarinin gectigi yolun bir kismini,
yukarida gosterildigi gibi biliyorsun.

Borunun icindeki kablo uzunlugu, her kablo
icin 6 m ve her boru bolumu 1 m uzunlugunda.
Ancak dikey borular gerektigi kadar kablo
tasiyabilirken, yatay borular sadece tek bir
kablo tasiyabilir. Hangi kablonun hangi
sokete bagli oldugunu bulabilir misin?

original:
Well done!

Cable A goes into socket 3, cable B into
socket 4, cable C into socket 1 and cable D
into socket 2. Whichever path the cables
take within the pipes, the solution is the
same.
translation:
Aferin!

A kablosu 3. sokete, B kablosu 4. sokete,
C kablosu 1. sokete ve D kablosu 2. sokete
gidiyor. Kablolar borularin icinde hangi yolu
izlerse izlesin, sonuc aynidir.

original:
Too bad.

All you need to work out is which cable is
plugged into which socket.
translation:
Olmadi.

Tek yapman gereken, hangi kablonun
hangi sokete takili oldugunu bulmak.

original:
You know that the {''}length of cable inside
the pipe is 6 m for each cable{''}.

Start with cable B and try to work out where
it's going. From its starting point to the end
of the exposed section of cable, it runs
through 4 m of piping. It should be clear
where the last 2 m of cable goes.
translation:
{''}Borunun icindeki kablo uzunlugunun
her kablo icin 6 m oldugunu{''} biliyorsun.

B kablosuyla basla ve nereye gittigini bulmaya
calis. Baslangic noktasindan acikta gorunen
kismin sonuna kadar 4 m'lik borudan geciyor.
Son 2 m'nin nereye gittigi acik olmali.

original:
Next, let's look at cable C. Unlike cable B,
it could take various routes to get to the
exposed part, but there's only one place
where it can end up!
translation:
Simdi de C kablosuna bakalim. B'nin aksine,
acikta gorunen kisma ulasmak icin cesitli
yollardan gidebilir, ama sonlanabilecegi
tek bir yer var!

original:
After following the first two hints, there are
two cables left to place. You only have 6 m
of cable for each, and they all have to run
along 4 m worth of horizontal pipe. That
means the remaining 2 m of cable runs
through vertical pipes.

Once you know that each cable must travel
2 m vertically, the rest should be easy!
translation:
Ilk iki ipucunu uyguladiktan sonra, yerlestirilecek
iki kablo kalir. Her biri icin sadece 6 m kablo var
ve hepsi yatayda toplam 4 m'lik borudan gecmek
zorunda. Bu da kalan 2 m'nin dikey borulardan
gectigi anlamina gelir.

Her kablonun dikeyde 2 m gitmesi gerektigini
anlayinca, gerisi kolay!

original:
Bearing in mind that the {''}length of cable
inside the pipe is 6 m for each cable{''}, you
can work out that B is plugged into socket 4
and C is plugged into socket 1.

The other two must plug into sockets 2 and
3. Since they travel 2 m vertically, cable A
must end up in socket 3. All the cables apart
from B can take various routes, but it won't
change the socket that each ultimately
connects to.
translation:
{''}Borunun icindeki kablo uzunlugunun
her kablo icin 6 m oldugunu{''} aklinda tutarak,
B'nin 4. sokete ve C'nin 1. sokete takili oldugunu
cikarabilirsin.

Diger ikisi 2 ve 3. soketlere gitmeli. Dikeyde 2 m
gittikleri icin A kablosu 3. sokette bitmek zorunda.
B disindaki tum kablolar cesitli yollardan gidebilir,
ama bu, sonunda baglandiklari soketi degistirmez.

original: Enter the door code!
translation: Kapi sifresini gir!

original:
A glass water tank is next to a locked door.
On the floor by the door are some metal
balls and wooden balls, each of which has a
numbered panel attached by a cord. Place
the correct panels into the gaps to enter the
code to unlock the door.

You have only one clue to guide you:
{''}Those who seek passage need only ask
the water.{''}

What is the code to open the door?
translation:
Kilitli bir kapinin yaninda cam bir su tanki var.
Kapinin onundeki zeminde metal ve ahsap
toplar bulunuyor; her birinin uzerinde, bir iple bagli
numarali bir plaka var. Kapinin kilidini acmak icin
dogru plakalari bosluklara yerlestirip
sifreyi gir.

Sana yol gosterecek tek bir ipucu var:
{''}Gecmek isteyenlerin tek yapmasi gereken
suya sormaktir.{''}

Kapiyi acan sifre nedir?

original:
Correct! The door is open!

The code was 9594. If you drop the balls
into the water tank, the wooden balls and
their attached panels will just float on the
top, while the metal balls will sink to the
bottom, leaving the important panels floating
in the middle.

The lengths of the cords tell you the order of
the numbers, so you have to enter them
from top to bottom, the same way you would
see the panels floating in the tank.
translation:
Dogru! Kapi acildi!

Sifre 9594'tu. Toplari
su tankina birakirsan, ahsap toplar ve
onlara bagli plakalar suyun
ustunde yuzerken metal toplar
dipte kalir; onemli plakalar ise
ortada yuzer.

Iplerin uzunlugu sayilarin sirasini gosterir;
bu yuzden onlari yukaridan asagiya,
tipki tankta yuzen plakalari gorecegin gibi,
girmelisin.

original:
Too bad.

Think about the clue some more. What could
{''}ask the water{''} mean?

The clue is the key to this puzzle.

Remember, there's a large glass water tank
next to the door. How might that help you?
translation:
Ipucu bu bulmacanin anahtari.

Unutma, kapinin yaninda buyuk bir cam su tanki var.
Bu sana nasil yardimci olabilir?

original:
Let's take a look at the balls with the panels
attached that are lying on the floor. The
cords connecting the panels to the balls are
all different lengths. Additionally, the balls
are made of two different materials: wood
and metal.

How do these details fit in?
translation:
Yerde yatan, plakalari bagli toplara
bir bakalim. Plakalari toplara baglayan
iplerin hepsi farkli uzunlukta. Ayrica toplar
iki farkli malzemeden yapilmis:
ahsap ve metal.

Bu ayrintilar neyi anlatiyor?

original:
Have you worked out what {''}ask the water{''}
means yet?

Putting all the balls lying on the floor into the
tank will cast some light on the situation.
translation:
{''}suya sor{''} ifadesinin ne anlama geldigini
cozdun mu?

Yerdeki tum toplari tanka koymak
durumu biraz aydinlatacak.

original:
Imagine putting the balls into the water tank
and viewing them through the glass. The
wooden balls and the panels attached to
them will float at the top, so you won't see
the numbers. The metal balls will sink, so
you'll be able to read the panels attached
to those balls.

The lengths of the cords differ, so imagine
the order of the panels from top to bottom.
Might this be the code you're looking for?
translation:
Toplari su tankina koydugunu
ve camin ardindan baktigini hayal et. Ahsap toplar
ve onlara bagli plakalar ustte yuzecegi icin
sayilari goremezsin. Metal toplar batar, bu yuzden
onlara bagli plakalari okuyabilirsin.

Iplerin uzunlugu farkli oldugundan,
plakalarin yukaridan asagiya sirasini dusun.
Aradigin sifre bu olabilir mi?

original: Arrange the totem blocks!
translation: Totem bloklarini diz!

original:
What's this? It looks as if some pranksters
have rearranged the totem blocks. There
should be four columns, arranged like a
staircase, as shown in the picture in the
top right. Each column should have a totem
head on top in the order: yellow, blue,
green, red.

Can you help restore these magnificent
columns?

Note that <CR>you can never hit the top block
in a column</C>.
translation:
Bu da ne? Sanki bazi sakacilar
totem bloklarini karistirmis. Sag ustteki
resimde gosterildigi gibi, merdiven seklinde
dizilmis dort sutun olmali. Her sutunun ustunde
asagidaki sirayla bir totem basi olmali: sari, mavi,
yesil, kirmizi.

Bu gorkemli
sutunlari eski haline getirmeye yardim eder misin?

Unutma: <CR>bir sutundaki en ust bloga
asla vuramazsin</C>.

original:
Well done!

It would be nice if people would leave these
columns alone, wouldn't it?
translation:
Tebrikler!

Keske insanlar bu sutunlari
rahat biraksalar, degil mi?

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
Start from the fourth, rightmost column to
put the columns back in order. It should be
possible to fix everything in only four hits!
translation:
Sutunlari duzene sokmak icin
en sagdaki dorduncu sutundan
basla. Her seyi sadece dort vurusta
duzeltmek mumkun olmali!

original:
First, hit the block beneath the red,
cross-looking totem head from the left.
Can you see what to do next?
translation:
Once, kirmizi, hac gibi gorunen
totem basinin altindaki bloga soldan
vur.
Simdi ne yapman gerektigini
gorebiliyor musun?

original:
Next, hit the red totem head into place in
the fourth column. Then strike one more time
to complete the third column.
translation:
Sonra kirmizi totem basini yerine
oturtarak dorduncu sutuna getir.
Ardindan ucuncu sutunu tamamlamak icin
bir kez daha vur.

original:
To complete the third column, hit the block
under the gawping green totem head from
the right. You only need one more hit now
and it'll be done!
translation:
Ucuncu sutunu tamamlamak icin,
agzi acik yesil totem basinin altindaki bloga
sagdan vur. Artik sadece bir vurus kaldi
ve is bitecek!

original: Match the apron's pattern!
translation: Onlugun desenini eslestir!

original:
{''}I wonder if you can solve this riddle.

I've folded up my dear old apron in three
different ways. It makes the flower pattern
look different each time, see?

All you have to do is tell me what the pattern
will look like when I unfold the apron!{''}

Look at images A, B and C above and put
the flowers on the apron.
translation:
{''}Bakalim bu bilmeceyi cozebilecek misin?

Eski sevgili onlugumu uc farkli sekilde
katladim. Goruyorsun ya, cicek deseni her
seferinde farkli gorunuyor.

Tek yapman gereken, onlugu actigimda desenin
nasil gorunecegini soylemek!{''}

Yukaridaki A, B ve C resimlerine bak ve
cicekleri onluge yerlestir.

original:
{''}Right you are!

This is what the pattern looks like. When the
apron's folded up, you can tell which part
you're looking at by where the apron straps
are and the direction they point.

I do like the haphazard way the flowers are
arranged!{''}
translation:
{''}Aynen oyle!

Iste desen boyle gorunuyor. Onluk katliyken,
hangi kismi gordugunu; askilarin nerede
oldugundan ve hangi yone baktigindan
anlayabilirsin.

Ciceklerin gelisiguzel dizilisine bayildim!{''}

original:
Too bad.

There must be something that can help you
to identify each part of the apron...
translation:
Olmadi.

Onlugun her bolumunu ayirt etmene yardim edecek
bir sey olmali...

original:
Pay close attention to the position of the
apron straps and the way they're facing.

If you're wondering why some of the apron
straps look darker, it's because you're
looking at the back of them.
translation:
Onluk askilarinin konumuna ve baktiklari
yone dikkat et.

Bazi askilar neden daha koyu gorunuyor diye
merak ediyorsan, sebebi arka yuzlerine
bakiyor olman.

original:
The part of the apron shown in A overlaps
with the part shown in B.

B is larger, so first consider which part of
the apron this might depict.

With any luck, you should be able to work
out which part of the apron A depicts without
much trouble!
translation:
A'da gosterilen kisim, B'de gosterilen
kisimla ortusuyor.

B daha buyuk, bu yuzden once bunun onlugun
hangi bolumunu gosterdigini dusun.

Biraz sansla, A'nin onlugun hangi bolumunu
gosterdigini fazla zorlanmadan cikarirsin!

original:
Look carefully at B. If you think about the
apron straps as described in Hint 1, it should
become clear that the top half of the apron is
folded underneath.

What you can see here is the bottom half of
the apron, which means you now have half
of the pattern.
translation:
B'ye dikkatle bak. Ipucu 1'de anlatildigi
gibi askilari dusunursen, onlugun ust
yarisinin altina katlandigi anlasilir.

Burada gordugun sey onlugun alt yarisi;
yani desenin yarisi artik elinde.

original:
You can find out the rest of the flower
pattern by looking at C.

C shows what the apron would look like if you
folded it along the diagonal line that runs
from the top right to the bottom left and
tucked the bottom-right half under.

It's still facing the same way, so you can add
this to the details you got from B to form a
complete picture of the pattern.
translation:
Cicek deseninin kalanini C'ye bakarak
bulabilirsin.

C, onlugu sag ustten sol alta giden capraz
cizgi boyunca katlayip sag alt yarisini
altina soktugunda nasil gorunecegini
gosteriyor.

Hala ayni yone bakiyor; bu yuzden bunu B'den
aldigin detaylara ekleyip deseni
tamamlayabilirsin.

original: Arrange the days off!
translation: Izin gunlerini ayarla!

original:
Mr B: {''}Now then. As you know, we're all
going to close our shops for one day a
week, but we all have to pick a different
day. The other shopkeepers already circled
the days they'd be happy with, so it's just
you two left.{''}
Mr A: {''}I'm happy to close on any day, me.
Long as it's not Sunday.{''}
Ms C: {''}Oh, I'll just close a day before Mr A
then. That's okay, right?{''}

In the end, which day did each of the seven
shopkeepers have as their day off?
translation:
Bay B: {''}Simdi bakin. Bildiginiz gibi, hepimiz
dukkanlarimizi haftada bir gun kapatacagiz,
ama herkes farkli bir gun secmek zorunda.
Diger esnaflar memnun olduklari gunlerin
etrafini zaten cizdi; geriye sadece siz ikiniz
kaldiniz.{''}
Bay A: {''}Ben her gune raziyim.
Yeter ki Pazar olmasin.{''}
Bayan C: {''}Oh, ben de o zaman Bay A'dan bir gun
once kapatirim. Uyar, degil mi?{''}

Sonunda yedi esnafin her biri
hangi gunu tatil yapti?

original:
Correct!

They arranged their days off as follows:

Mr A on Saturday, Mr B on Tuesday,
Ms C on Friday, Mr D on Monday,
Ms E on Thursday, Dr F on Wednesday
and Mr G on Sunday.

Once you realise that Mr A's day off must be
Saturday, the rest just slot into place one
by one!
translation:
Dogru!

Izin gunlerini soyle ayarladilar:

Bay A Cumartesi, Bay B Sali,
Bayan C Cuma, Bay D Pazartesi,
Bayan E Persembe, Dr F Carsamba
ve Bay G Pazar.

Bay A'nin tatilinin Cumartesi olmasi
gerektigini fark edince, gerisi tek tek
yerine oturuyor!

original:
Too bad.

If your plans go awry, the shopkeepers
won't be able to have the days off that
they want!
translation:
Olmadi.

Planlarin sarpa sararsa, esnaflar
istedikleri izin gunlerine
sahip olamayacak!

original:
First, think about who can choose Saturday
as their day off.

According to the chart, the only possibilities
are Mr A or Ms C. For now, let's put Ms C
down for Saturday.

But wait! Ms C's day off has to be the day
before Mr A's, which means Mr A's day off
would have to be Sunday. As a result, the
only one who can choose Saturday is Mr A.
translation:
Once kimin Cumartesi gununu
tatil gunu olarak secebilecegini dusun.

Tabloya gore tek olasiliklar
Bay A ya da Bayan C. Simdilik,
Bayan C'yi Cumartesiye yazalim.

Ama dur! Bayan C'nin tatili Bay A'ninkinden
bir gun once olmali; bu da Bay A'nin tatilinin
Pazar olmasi demek. Sonuc olarak,
Cumartesiyi secebilecek tek kisi Bay A'dir.

original:
The first hint established that Mr A has to
take Saturday off.

Ms C wants her day off to be the one before
Mr A's. That means her day off will have to
be Friday.

In a similar fashion, you should be able to
start eliminating certain possibilities one by
one for the remaining five shopkeepers.
translation:
Ilk ipucu, Bay A'nin tatilinin
Cumartesi olmasi gerektigini gosterdi.

Bayan C, tatilinin Bay A'ninkinden bir gun
once olmasini istiyor. Bu da onun tatilinin
Cuma olmasi demek.

Benzer sekilde, kalan bes esnaf icin de
olasiliklari tek tek eleyerek ilerleyebilmelisin.

original:
Mr A has to take Saturday as his day off,
which means Ms C must take Friday.

Mr B wants to take either Tuesday or Friday.
But since Friday is already taken, it has to
be Tuesday. That means Mr G has to take
Sunday, since his only other option is
Tuesday.

Can you rule out any other possibilities in
this same way?
translation:
Bay A'nin tatili Cumartesi olmali,
bu da Bayan C'nin Cuma olmasi demek.

Bay B ya Sali ya da Cuma gununu istiyor.
Ama Cuma dolu olduguna gore Sali olmali.
Bu da Bay G'nin Pazar olmasi gerektigi
anlamina gelir; cunku diger tek secenegi
Saliydi.

Ayni sekilde baska olasiliklari da
eleyebilir misin?

original:
As of Hint 3, we know the following: Mr A
takes Saturday off, Mr B takes Tuesday,
Ms C takes Friday and Mr G takes Sunday.
The next one we can determine is Mr D.
He's happy with Monday, Friday or Sunday,
but of those, only Monday will work.

Next up, Dr F picked Monday, Wednesday
or Friday. The only remaining choice is
Wednesday. Now just finish off this process
of elimination and you're done!
translation:
Ipucu 3'e gore sunlari biliyoruz: Bay A
Cumartesi, Bay B Sali, Bayan C Cuma
ve Bay G Pazar gunu tatil yapiyor.
Siradaki belirleyebilecegimiz kisi Bay D.
O, Pazartesi, Cuma ya da Pazar gunlerine razi,
ama bunlardan sadece Pazartesi kaliyor.

Sirada Dr F var: Pazartesi, Carsamba
ya da Cuma demis. Geriye sadece
Carsamba kaliyor. Simdi bu eleme
isini tamamla ve bitti!

original: Where's the message?
translation: Mesaj nerede?

original:
{''}My girlfriend says she's hidden a message
for me somewhere in our hotel room, and I'll
have to touch two things in order to find it.
Apparently, there's no way to find it by
touching only one thing.

Can you help me find it?{''}
translation:
{''}Kiz arkadasim, otel odamizin bir yerinde
benim icin bir mesaj sakladigini soyledi ve onu
bulmak icin iki seye dokunmam gerekiyormus.
Gorunuse gore tek bir seye dokunarak
bulmanin hicbir yolu yokmus.

Bulmama yardim eder misin?{''}

original:
That's right!

Turn off the light, turn on the lamp and
illuminate a message of true love!
translation:
Dogru!

Isigi kapat, lambayi ac ve
gercek bir ask mesajini ortaya cikar!

original:
Too bad.

Where on earth could the message be?
translation:
Olmadi.

Mesaj acaba nerede olabilir?

original:
First, try touching everything you can in the
room and see what happens.
translation:
Once odada dokunabildigin her seye
dokun ve ne olduguna bak.

original:
You need to touch two things in order to see
the message. Try different combinations of
things.
translation:
Mesaji gorebilmek icin iki seye dokunmalisin.
Farkli esya kombinasyonlarini dene.

original:
Did you try turning off the room light?
The switch is by the door.
translation:
Odanin isigini kapatmayi denedin mi?
Anahtar kapinin yaninda.

original:
There's something odd about the desk lamp.
You'd be able to find out what if the room
wasn't so bright...
translation:
Masa lambasinda tuhaf bir sey var.
Oda bu kadar aydinlik olmasaydi
ne oldugunu anlayabilirdin...

original: Which link needs removing?
translation: Hangi halkayi cikarmalisin?

original:
This toy chain is made up of many smaller
links. When one of the links is removed, the
chain forms one complete ring.

Circle the letter of the link that should be
removed.
translation:
Bu oyuncak zincir bircok kucuk halkadan olusuyor.
Halkalardan biri cikarilinca
zincir tek bir kapali halka olusturuyor.

Cikarilmasi gereken halkanin
harfini daire icine al.

original:
Correct!

It's H. To form a ring, each link should have
two others connected to it. Both G and K
have three links connected to them, and
both are connected to H, so removing that
one is the key.
translation:
Dogru!

Cevap H. Bir halka olusturmak icin her halkanin
ona bagli iki halkasi olmali. G ve K'nin
ucer baglantisi var ve
ikisi de H'ye bagli; bu yuzden
H'yi cikarmak anahtar.

original:
Too bad.

Think about what the chain would look like
if it were a ring.
translation:
Olmadi.

Zincir bir halka olsaydi
nasil gorunurdu, dusun.

original:
Look closely at which links are connected
to which. Some may look as if they're
connected, but they're actually just lying
on top of each other.
translation:
Hangi halkalarin hangilerine bagli olduguna
dikkatle bak. Bazilari bagliymis
gibi gorunebilir, ama aslinda
sadece ust uste duruyorlardir.

original:
Each of the links that form a ring has
something in common with the others. You
need to find any links that don't fit that
pattern.

Try drawing a ring of links with the Memo
Function. You may notice what the links have
in common with each other.
translation:
Bir halka olusturan her halkanin
digerleriyle ortak bir ozelligi vardir. Bu duzene uymayan
halkayi
bulmalisin.

Not Fonksiyonu ile bir halka zincir
cizmeyi dene. Halkalarin ortak
ozelligini fark edebilirsin.

original:
To make a ring out of links, each link should
be connected to two others, one on either
side.

Look for any links in the chain that don't
have two others connected to them.
translation:
Halkalardan bir halka yapmak icin her halka,
iki yanindaki
iki halkaya bagli olmali.

Zincirde iki baglantisi
olmayan halkalari ara.

original:
If you look carefully, you'll find a blue link
and a yellow link that are both connected to
three other links.

All you need to do is remove the common
link connected to both of these links.
translation:
Dikkatle bakarsan,
uc farkli halkaya bagli bir mavi halka
ve bir sari halka bulacaksin.

Yapman gereken tek sey, bu ikisinin
ikisine de ortak bagli olan halkayi cikarmak.

original: Make the scores the same!
translation: Puanlari esitle!

original:
A dealer at the casino places ten cards on
the table in front of you and says,

{''}The total value of all the numbers I can
read from here is 45. The total of the
numbers you can read from there is 31.
I win!{''}

Can you rotate as few cards as possible so
that you and the dealer both have the same
score?
translation:
Kumarhanede bir krupiye masaya onune on kart koyar
ve soyle der,

{''}Buradan okuyabildigim tum sayilarin
toplam degeri 45. Senin oradan
okuyabildigin sayilarin toplami 31.
Ben kazandim!{''}

En az sayida karti cevirerek
seninle krupiyenin
puanini esitleyebilir misin?

original:
That's right!

1, 2, 5, 8 and 0 are worth the same either
way. Out of the remaining cards, which are
3, 4, 6, 7 and 9, you just need to rotate
the 7 to give yourself seven more points and
take seven away from the dealer, making it
a draw.
translation:
Dogru!

1, 2, 5, 8 ve 0, hangi yonden bakarsan bak ayni
degerdedir. Geri kalan kartlar
3, 4, 6, 7 ve 9'dur; bunlardan sadece
7'yi cevirmen yeterli. Boylece senin puanin
7 artar, krupiyenin puani 7 azalir
ve sonuc berabere olur.

original:
Too bad.

There's no need for any tricky calculations
here.
translation:
Olmadi.

Burada karmasik hesaplara
gerek yok.

original:
You can start by eliminating any cards with
values that don't change when rotated.
There are a few of those.
translation:
Once dondurunce degeri degismeyen
kartlari ele.
Bunlardan birkac tane var.

original:
The cards whose values don't change when
they're rotated are 1, 2, 5, 8 and 0.

You should be focusing on the remaining
cards: 3, 4, 6, 7 and 9.
translation:
Dondurulunce degeri degismeyen kartlar
1, 2, 5, 8 ve 0'dir.

Geri kalan kartlara
odaklanmalisin: 3, 4, 6, 7 ve 9.

original:
You only need to rotate one card.

Which could it be?
translation:
Sadece bir karti dondurmen gerekiyor.

Hangisi olabilir?

original:
The dealer's current total score is 45. Yours
is 31. The number in the middle of those
scores is 38. Is there a card you can rotate
to make both your scores equal 38?

What do you need to add to 31 to get 38?
translation:
Krupiyenin su anki toplam puani 45. Seninki
31. Bu iki puanin ortasi
38'dir. Ikinizin de puanini 38 yapacak
bir karti dondurebilir misin?

31'i 38 yapmak icin kac eklemek gerekir?

original: How many bricks?
translation: Kac tugla?

original:
Lionel is contemplating a row of nine bricks
for his mother's garden wall. Apparently, two
adjacent bricks in the row are much heavier
than the rest, but he can't remember which.
He's decided the only way to identify them
is to lift the bricks one by one, but to save
time, he's going about it in the most efficient
way possible.

Can you work out the maximum number of
bricks he might need to lift in order to find
the two heavy ones?
translation:
Lionel, annesinin bahce duvari icin
dokuz tugladan olusan bir siraya bakiyor.
Sirada yan yana duran iki tuglanin
digerlerinden cok daha agir oldugu soyleniyor,
ama hangileri oldugunu hatirlayamiyor.
Onlari bulmanin tek yolunun tuglalari tek tek
kaldirmak olduguna karar verdi, ama zaman
kazanmak icin bunu mumkun olan en
verimli sekilde yapacak.

Iki agir tuglayi bulmak icin en fazla
kac tugla kaldirmasi gerekebilir?

original:
Correct! It's four!

For example, he might start by lifting bricks
2, 4 and 6. If one of them is heavier, he
can then lift a neighbouring brick. If that
brick isn't also heavy, then he knows the
one on the other side is.

If none of the bricks out of 2, 4 and 6 are
heavier than the rest, he can simply lift 9.
If 9 is heavier, then 8 must be the other
heavy brick. If 9 isn't heavier, then it has
to be 7 and 8.
translation:
Dogru! Dort!

Ornegin 2, 4 ve 6. tuglalari kaldirarak
baslayabilir. Eger bunlardan biri daha agirsa,
komsu bir tuglayi daha kaldirir. O tugla da
agir degilse, diger taraftaki tuglanin agir
oldugunu anlar.

2, 4 ve 6'dan hicbiri daha agir degilse,
9'u kaldirmasi yeter. 9 agirsa, diger agir tugla
8 olmak zorundadir. 9 agir degilse, o zaman
agir olanlar 7 ve 8'dir.

original:
Too bad.

Remember that Lionel wants to lift the
bricks in the most efficient way possible.
translation:
Olmadi.

Lionel'in tuglalari mumkun olan
en verimli sekilde kaldirmak
istedigini unutma.

original:
The key here is the fact that the two heavy
bricks are next to each other.

For example, say Lionel lifted bricks 2 and
4. If they both weighed the same, then
which bricks could he rule out?
translation:
Buradaki ana nokta, iki agir tuglanin
yan yana olmasidir.

Ornegin Lionel 2 ve 4. tuglalari kaldirsin.
Ikisi de ayni agirliktaysa, hangi tuglalari
elemis olur?

original:
Let's say Lionel lifted 2 and 4, and 4 was
heavier. The adjacent heavy brick would be
3 or 5, and he could find out which by
lifting just one of them up.

If 2 and 4 both weighed the same, then he
could rule out bricks 1 to 4.
translation:
Diyelim Lionel 2 ve 4'u kaldirdi ve
4 daha agir cikti. Yanindaki agir tugla
3 ya da 5'tir; hangisi oldugunu, ikisinden
sadece birini kaldirarak bulabilir.

2 ve 4 ayni agirliktaysa, 1'den 4'e kadar
olan tuglalari eleyebilir.

original:
Let's carry on from Hint 2. If bricks 2 and 4
weighed the same, then Lionel could try
lifting 6. If that one were heavier, then the
other heavy brick would have to be 5 or 7.
He could determine which by lifting either
brick, for a total of four lifts.

So what would he do if 6 weren't a heavy
brick?
translation:
Ipucu 2'den devam edelim. 2 ve 4 ayni
agirliktaysa, Lionel 6'yi kaldirmayi deneyebilir.
O daha agirsa, diger agir tugla 5 ya da 7 olmak
zorundadir. Hangisi oldugunu bu iki tugladan
birini kaldirarak belirleyebilir; toplamda dort
kaldirma yapmis olur.

Peki 6 agir degilse ne yapar?

original:
Carrying on from Hint 3, if 6 were a normal
brick as well, then Lionel would lift 9. If 9
was heavier, then he'd know that 8 and 9
were the heavy bricks.

If 9 was not heavier, that would leave only
7 and 8 as the possible heavy bricks - he
wouldn't even need to lift them to know!

That's all the possibilities covered. At most,
he'd only have to lift 2, 4, 6 and 9.
translation:
Ipucu 3'ten devam edersek, 6 da normal
bir tuglaysa, Lionel 9'u kaldirir. 9 agirsa,
8 ve 9'un agir tuglalar oldugunu anlar.

9 agir degilse, geriye agir olabilecek tek
olasilik 7 ve 8 kalir-hatta bunu bilmek icin
onlari kaldirmasina bile gerek yok!

Tum olasiliklari gorduk. En fazla,
2, 4, 6 ve 9'u kaldirmasi yeter.

original: What's the correct order?
translation: Dogru sira hangisi?

original:
Oh dear! It seems you've accidentally
broken a window while playing near a grand
manor. The lady of the house didn't lose her
cool, but just told you this:
{''}I'd like you to use these six coloured
pieces of tape to mend the window exactly
as shown in this drawing. The tape should
go on the inside of the window, of course.{''}

The drawing shows the window as she'd like
it to look from the outside. Now, can you
apply the tape to the window so that she's
satisfied?
translation:
Eyvah! Gorunuse gore buyuk bir malikanenin
yakininda oynarken yanlislikla bir pencereyi
kirmissin. Evin hanimi sogukkanliligini
kaybetmedi ama sana sunu soyledi:
{''}Bu cizimde gosterildigi gibi pencereyi
tam olarak onarmak icin bu alti renkli
bant parcasini kullanmani istiyorum. Bantlar
elbette pencerenin ic tarafina yapistirilmali.{''}

Cizim, onun disaridan gormek istedigi hali
gosteriyor. Simdi, bantlari ona memnun
kalacagi sekilde yapistirabilir misin?

original:
Splendid!

Since you're working from the inside, you
need to start with the tape at the very front
of the design and work towards the back.
And, of course, you need to remember that
the whole design will be mirrored, too.

Hopefully the lady of the manor will be happy
with this solution...
translation:
Harika!

Iceriden calistigin icin, tasarimin en onunde
olan banttan baslayip arkaya dogru gitmelisin.
Ve tabii ki tum desenin aynalanacagini da
unutma.

Umarim malikanenin hanimi bu cozumden
memnun kalir...

original:
Too bad.

The result won't match the sketch. Better
have another look before she gets really
angry!
translation:
Olmadi.

Sonuc cizimle uyusmayacak. O iyice
sinirlenmeden once bir kez daha bak!

original:
Don't forget that the sketch shows the result
as seen from outside the house. How would
the frontmost piece of tape as seen from
the outside look when viewing the window
from the inside?
translation:
Cizimin evin disindan gorunen sonucu
gosterdigini unutma. Disaridan bakildiginda
en onde gorunen bant parcasi, pencereye
iceriden baktiginda nasil gorunur?

original:
The first piece of tape that you stick on
the inside of the window will become the
frontmost piece of tape when viewing the
window from outside.

Which means you need to start with the
blue diamond tape.
translation:
Pencerenin icine yapistirdigin ilk bant,
disaridan bakildiginda en onde gorunen bant
olacaktir.

Yani mavi elmas desenli bantla baslamalisin.

original:
When viewed from outside, the red striped
tape comes after the blue tape.

Which colour comes next?
translation:
Disaridan bakildiginda, kirmizi cizgili
bant mavi banttan sonra gelir.

Sirada hangi renk var?

original:
Here's the order of the tape as viewed from
outside. First, the blue diamond tape, then
the striped red tape, the orange tape with
diagonal stripes, the striped green tape,
the pink tape with squares and finally the
plain yellow tape.

Oh, and don't forget that since the picture
shows the view from outside rather than
inside, you'll need to mirror the layout.
translation:
Disaridan gorunen bantlarin sirasi soyle:
Once mavi elmas desenli bant, sonra kirmizi
cizgili bant, capraz cizgili turuncu bant,
cizgili yesil bant, kareli pembe bant ve en
sonda duz sari bant.

Ayrica, resim disaridan bakisi gosterdigi icin
yerlesimi aynalamayi unutma.

original: Reconnect the wiring!
translation: Kablolari yeniden bagla!

original:
Oh no! The radio has broken, and right
when these kids were going to listen to
some music, too!

You'll have to help repair the radio. Adjust
the wiring so that every section of wire is
connected up, and make sure the cross and
square terminals in the centre connect to
the matching cross and square terminals on
either side.

Use the stylus to rotate the pieces of wiring
and connect everything up!
translation:
Hay aksi! Radyo bozuldu, hem de bu cocuklar
muzik dinleyecekken!

Radyoyu tamir etmene yardim etmelisin. Tum
kablo parcalari birbirine baglanacak sekilde
kablolari ayarla ve ortadaki carpi ve kare uclarin
her iki yandaki ayni carpi ve kare uclarla
baglandigindan emin ol.

Parcalari dondurmek ve her seyi baglamak icin
kalemi kullan!

original:
Correct!

The radio's fixed! Nothing like a good tune
to liven up the atmosphere.
translation:
Dogru!

Radyo duzeldi! Ortami canlandirmak icin iyi
bir melodiden iyisi yok.

original:
Too bad.

Have you got your wires crossed?
Remember, you want to connect square to
square, and cross to cross.
translation:
Olmadi.

Kablolari karistirdin mi?
Unutma, kare kareyle,
carpi da carpiyla baglanmali.

original:
Try choosing a specific point to start from.

You might find it easier if you start working
from the cross terminal on the left side.
translation:
Belirli bir noktadan baslamayi dene.

Soldaki carpi ucundan baslarsan daha
kolay olabilir.

original:
Rotate the bottom-left piece with the round
dot so that the wire points upwards and the
dot is on the bottom.

Do the opposite with the similar piece in the
top left.

Have the top-right piece with a dot point left,
so that the dot is on the right. The piece
immediately below it should point downwards.

Is the answer starting to become clear?
translation:
Sag ustteki noktali parca sola baksin;
okta sagda kalsin. Hemen altindaki parca
ise asagi baksin.

Cevap yavas yavas ortaya cikiyor mu?

original:
Here's the last hint. This time, you want to
look at the piece with the square and cross
terminals in the middle.

Rotate it so that the wire from the cross
terminal points downwards, and the wire
from the square terminal points upwards.
translation:
Son ipucu: Ortadaki kare ve carpi uclu
parcaya bak.

Onu dondur; carpi ucundan cikan kablo
asagi baksin, kare ucundan cikan kablo
yukari baksin.

original: Cordon off the holes!
translation: Cukurlari citle cevir!

original:
There are six huge holes at this dig site!
It's a bit dangerous for people to be working
with these big holes around, so you want to
use a single length of rope to cordon off all
the holes, from A to F.

Stakes have been placed across the site.
Tie the rope around the stakes so that it
runs from the starting stake to the finishing
stake and encloses each hole, while using
as little rope as possible. Oh, and no
diagonals or doubling back between stakes.
translation:
Bu kazi alaninda alti dev cukur var!
Bu buyuk cukurlar varken calismak biraz tehlikeli,
bu yuzden A'dan F'ye kadar tum cukurlari
tek bir ip parcasiyla cevirmek istiyorsun.

Alana kaziklar yerlestirilmis.
Ipi kaziklara baglayarak baslangic kazigindan bitis kazigina giden
ve her cukuru icine alan bir hat olustur,
bunu yaparken mumkun olan en az ipi kullan.
Ayrica kaziklar arasinda capraz gitmek
ya da geri donup ayni yolu iki kez kullanmak yok.

original:
Correct!

One possible solution is shown above.
Now they can work in safety!
translation:
Dogru!

Olasi cozumlerden biri yukarida gosteriliyor.
Artik guvenle calisabilirler!

original:
Too bad.

Remember, you need to cordon off each
hole using the shortest length of rope
possible.
translation:
Olmadi.

Unutma, her cukuru
mumkun olan en kisa ip uzunluguyla
cevirmelisin.

original:
Start by cordoning off hole A. Which hole
should you deal with next?
translation:
Once A cukurunu citle cevir. Sonra
hangi cukurla ilgilenmelisin?

original:
Once you've done A, you should run the
rope down and along the bottom of E, then
run it up and circle C.

What's the most efficient hole to do next?
translation:
A'yi yaptiktan sonra ipi asagi indirip
E'nin altindan gecir, sonra yukari cikarip C'nin etrafini don.

Sirada en verimli cukur hangisi?

original:
Once you've done C, you should completely
cordon off D and E. You can handle both of
those at the same time quite easily.
translation:
C'yi yaptiktan sonra D ve E'yi
tamamen cevirmelisin. Ikisini
ayni anda yapmak oldukca kolay.

original:
Once you've cordoned off A, C, D and E,
you should deal with F next. Keeping your
final destination in mind, you'll want to start
with the stake at the top left of the hole.

That just leaves B. Go straight up from F,
circle B and you're home!
translation:
A, C, D ve E'yi cevirdikten sonra
sirada F var. Son hedefini aklinda tutarak
cukurun sol ustundeki kaziktan
baslamak isteyeceksin.

Geriye sadece B kalir. F'den dumduz yukari cik,
B'nin etrafini don ve bitise ulasirsin!

original: Whose chips are these?
translation: Bu fisler kimin?

original:
Correct!

Stack 4 belongs to A, stack 3 to B, stack 5
to C, stack 2 to D, stack 6 to E and stack 1
to F. D and E's comments are the key to
solving this puzzle.
translation:
Dogru!

4 numarali yigin A'ya, 3 numara B'ye, 5 numara
C'ye, 2 numara D'ye, 6 numara E'ye ve 1 numara
F'ye ait. Bu bulmacayi cozmenin anahtari
D ile E'nin soyledikleri.

original:
Too bad.

You could probably say that for the people
at the casino too...
translation:
Maalesef.

Bunu kumarhanedekiler icin de
soyleyebilirsin...

original:
Let's start with what we know for sure.

You can tell straight away which stack of
chips is D's.
translation:
Once kesin bildiklerimizle baslayalim.

D'nin fis yigininin hangisi oldugunu
hemen anlayabilirsin.

original:
E says he and B started with the same
number of chips. That means their stacks
must have been the same size. But at the
moment, E has more chips left, so...
translation:
E, baslangicta B ile ayni
sayida fise sahip olduklarini soyluyor. Bu da
yiginlarinin baslangicta ayni buyuklukte
oldugu anlamina gelir. Ancak su anda
E'nin elinde daha cok fis kaldigina gore...

original:
You should be able to work out which stacks
of chips D, B and E have just based on what
D and E said.

Now, let's look at what C said. The number
of chips C started with is equal to the amount
B and F lost. You already know how many
chips B lost, and there are three possibilities
for the amount F lost. However, once you do
the sums, you should be able to narrow this
down to a single possibility.
translation:
D ve E'nin soylediklerinden
D, B ve E'nin hangi fis yiginlarina sahip oldugunu
bulabilmelisin.

Simdi C'nin soyledigine bakalim. C'nin baslangicta
sahip oldugu fis sayisi, B ile F'nin kaybettigi
miktara esit. B'nin kac fis kaybettigini zaten
biliyorsun ve F'nin kaybettigi miktar icin uc
olasilik var. Ama hesaplayinca
bunu tek bir olasiliga indirebilmelisin.

original:
From the previous hints, you should have
worked out that D has stack 2, B has 3,
E has 6 and F has 1. That leaves A and C,
and stacks 4 and 5.

A says he only has a quarter of his starting
amount left. Which stack is A's?
translation:
Onceki ipuclarindan
D'nin 2 numarali, B'nin 3 numarali,
E'nin 6 numarali ve F'nin 1 numarali yigini
aldigini bulmus olmalisin. Geriye A ve C ile
4 ve 5 numarali yiginlar kalir.

A, baslangictaki miktarinin sadece
dortte birinin kaldigini soyluyor.
A'nin yigini hangisi?

original: Touch the right square!
translation: Dogru kareye dokun!

original:
This classroom is equipped with a fancy
black and white puzzle board. When you
touch any square section on the board, its
colour changes between black and white. At
the moment, there's more white than black,
but you can change that by touching the
board just once.

Which square section should you touch?
Touch it with the stylus.
translation:
Bu sinifta sik bir siyah-beyaz bulmaca
tahtasi var. Tahtadaki herhangi bir kareye
dokundugunda rengi siyah ile beyaz arasinda
degisir. Su anda beyazlar siyahlardan fazla,
ama tahtaya sadece bir kez dokunarak bunu
degistirebilirsin.

Hangi kare bolume dokunmalisin?
Kalemle dokun.

original:
Correct!

The large square that makes up the border
is a {''}square{''} section of the board as well.
translation:
Dogru!

Kenarligi olusturan buyuk kare de tahta uzerindeki
bir {''}kare{''} bolumdur.

original:
Too bad.

Are you sure you've made the board more
black than white by only touching one
square? Have a closer look.
translation:
Olmadi.

Sadece bir kareye dokunarak tahtayi daha
siyah yaptigindan emin misin? Daha yakindan bak.

original:
Let's take this slow and steady. Start
by counting the number of white squares
and black squares. Then you should think
about which section to touch.
translation:
Sakin sakin gidelim. Once beyaz ve siyah
karelerin sayisini say. Sonra hangi bolume
dokunman gerektigini dusun.

original:
You might be thinking that you'll wind up
with the same amounts of white and black
no matter which white section you touch.
If that's the case, then you're overlooking
something big.

Read the puzzle again and don't let your
first impression blind you.
translation:
Hangi beyaz bolume dokunursan dokun,
sonucta siyah ve beyaz sayisi esit olur
saniyor olabilirsin. Oyleyse buyuk bir seyi
gozden kaciriyorsun.

Bulmacayi tekrar oku; ilk izlenimin seni
kor etmesine izin verme.

original:
The puzzle tells you that the square
sections of the board change colour when
you touch them. Is there a square section
that you're overlooking?
translation:
Bulmaca, tahtanin kare
bolumlerinin dokununca renk degistirdigini soyluyor.
Gozden kacirdigin bir kare bolum var mi?

original:
There are 16 small squares on the board
split up into black and white. Did you
notice the big square shape that frames
all the little ones? Try touching that!
translation:
Tahtada siyah ve beyazdan olusan 16 kucuk
kare var. Hepsini cerceveleyen buyuk kare
sekli fark ettin mi? Ona dokun!

original: Which doughnuts are hers?
translation: Hangi donutlar onun?

original:
A family of three run a mobile doughnut
shop. Their most popular item is the
celebrated Four-Colour Doughnut. There
are 12 doughnuts on display now, three of
which were made by the mother of the
family. Apparently, you can tell which
three those are just by looking at them!

Can you find the mother's doughnuts?

The glaze on the doughnuts is the same on
both sides, by the way.
translation:
Uc kisilik bir aile seyyar bir donut dukkani
isletiyor. En populer urunleri unlu
Dort Renkli Donut. Su anda vitrinde 12 donut
var ve bunlarin ucu ailenin annesi tarafindan
yapilmis. Gorunuse gore sadece bakarak
hangilerinin ona ait oldugunu anlayabiliyorsun!

Annenin donutlarini bulabilir misin?

Bu arada donutlarin uzerindeki glazurun
iki yuzu de ayni.

original:
Correct!

The mother of the family made the second
doughnut from the left in the top row, and
the far-left and far-right ones on the
bottom row.

If you look carefully, you'll notice the
doughnuts are glazed in slightly different
ways. Then it's just a case of finding a
group of three doughnuts that match in
some way and are different from the rest.
translation:
Dogru!

Annenin yaptigi donutlar ust sirada soldan
ikinci olan, alt sirada ise en soldaki ve en
sagdaki donutlardir.

Dikkatle bakarsan glazurlerin cok az da olsa
farkli uygulandigini gorursun. Sonra da,
bir sekilde birbiriyle eslesen ve digerlerinden
ayrilan uclu grubu bulmak kalir.

original:
Too bad.

They all look equally delicious, whoever they
were made by!
translation:
Olmadi.

Kim yapmis olursa olsun, hepsi ayni derecede
istah acici gorunuyor!

original:
The size and shape of all 12 doughnuts is
the same, but there is a way of telling the
difference between them. Can you identify
what it is?
translation:
On iki donutun boyutu ve sekli ayni,
ama aralarinda farki anlamanin bir yolu var.
Sence nedir?

original:
The size and shape is the same for all
doughnuts, so you can only distinguish them
by looking at the glaze.

Try looking for three doughnuts with the
same glaze pattern.
translation:
Tum donutlarin boyutu ve sekli ayni;
bu yuzden farki sadece glazure bakarak
anlayabilirsin.

Ayni glazur duzenine sahip uc donut bulmaya
calis.

original:
If you turn over the doughnuts, the order of
the glazes will change too.

For example, a doughnut where the glazes
are brown, white, orange and pink going
clockwise will be the same as one that's
brown, pink, orange and white going
clockwise when you flip it over.

Keep this in mind when looking for the group
of three.
translation:
Donutlari ters cevirirsen glazurlerin sirasi
da degisir.

Ornegin, saat yonunde kahverengi, beyaz,
turuncu ve pembe olan bir donut; ters
cevrildiginde saat yonunde kahverengi,
pembe, turuncu ve beyaz olan donutla
aynidir.

Uclu grubu ararken bunu aklinda tut.

original:
Look at the first row. The order of the glazes
is the same for three of them, but different
for the second doughnut from the left. That
one was made by the mother of the family.

Now, you just need to look for the two
doughnuts that match it.
translation:
Ilk siraya bak. Ucunun glazur sirasi ayni,
ama soldan ikinci donutunki farkli.
Onu ailenin annesi yapmis.

Simdi sadece onunla eslesen diger iki donuti
bulman gerekiyor.

original: Get Hershel to Randall!
translation: Hershel'i Randall'a ulastir!

original:
Just when Hershel and Randall think they're
reunited, they find themselves separated by
an underground canal system! Fortunately,
you can make a safe path across for
Hershel by using the walkways and floating
stepping stones.

Tilt your Nintendo 3DS system backwards,
forwards, left or right to make the stepping
stones slide in that direction. Watch out for
the dark holes, though - if you slide a
stepping stone over one, it will plug the hole
and stay stuck there.
translation:
Hershel ile Randall yeniden bulustuklarini
sanirken, kendilerini yer alti kanal sistemiyle
ayrilmis halde buluyorlar! Neyse ki,
yuruyus yollarini ve yuzen basamak taslarini
kullanarak Hershel icin guvenli bir yol
olusturabilirsin.

Basamak taslarini o yone kaydirmak icin
Nintendo 3DS'ini geriye, ileriye,
sola ya da saga eg.
Ama karanlik deliklere dikkat et -
bir tasi onlarin uzerinden kaydirirsan,
deligi tikar ve orada sikisip kalir.

original:
Phew!

Hershel and Randall are finally reunited.
Now they can continue their exploration!
translation:
Oh be!

Hershel ve Randall sonunda yeniden bulustu.
Simdi kesiflerine devam edebilirler!

original: Too bad...
translation: Olmadi...

original:
To begin with, you need to move a stepping
stone to get Hershel onto the first walkway.

It seems simple enough, but watch out for
the stone in the bottom right. If that gets
stuck in a hole, you'll never be able to
reach Randall.
translation:
Once Hershel'i ilk yuruyus yoluna
cikarabilmek icin bir basamak tasini
hareket ettirmelisin.

Basit gorunuyor ama sag alttaki tasa dikkat.
Eger o tas bir delige takilirsa,
Randall'a asla ulasamazsin.

original:
Let's run through the first step.

First, tilt your Nintendo 3DS backwards. That
should create a path to the walkway in the
top-centre of the screen. Move Hershel onto
that walkway.
translation:
Ilk adimi birlikte yapalim.

Once Nintendo 3DS'ini geriye eg. Bu,
ekranin ust-orta kismindaki yuruyus yoluna
giden bir yol olusturmali. Hershel'i
o yuruyus yoluna cikar.

original:
Continuing from Hint 2, the next step is to
bring the stepping stone in the bottom-left
corner up next to the fixed stepping stone
in the top-right corner.

It's quite a long way, so be careful not to
get it trapped in a hole on the way.
translation:
2. Ipucu'ndan devam edersek, siradaki adim
sol alt kosedeki basamak tasini,
sag ustteki sabit basamak tasinin yanina
getirmek.

Yol uzun, bu yuzden tasin
yolda bir delige sikismamasina dikkat et.

original:
For those who are struggling with this, here's
the secret formula from start to finish:

↑H↓←↓↑→↓→↑→↑→↑H

Starting with Hershel in his initial position,
tilt your Nintendo 3DS in the direction of
each arrow in turn. Where it says H, you'll
need to move Hershel.
translation:
Zorlananlar icin, baslangictan sona gizli
formul burada:

↑H↓←↓↑→↓→↑→↑→↑H

Hershel'in ilk konumundan baslayarak,
Nintendo 3DS'ini sirayla
her okun gosterdigi yone eg.
H yazan yerlerde Hershel'i hareket ettirmelisin.

original: Circle the lone item!
translation: Yalniz esyayi daire icine al!

original:
Oh no! Yukkles is supposed to be on in a
few minutes, but he's just tripped and now
there's juggling equipment all over the floor!

Everything should be in pairs of two
identically shaped and coloured items, but
there's one object here whose twin seems
to have gone missing.

Which item's twin is missing?
translation:
Eyvah! Yukkles birkac dakika icinde sahneye cikacak,
ama az once tokezledi ve simdi
jonglorluk ekipmanlari her yere sacildi!

Her sey ayni sekil ve renkte
ikiser cift olmali, ama
burada ikizi kaybolmus
bir nesne var.

Hangi esyanin ikizi eksik?

original:
Correct!

The box Yukkles is holding is part of his
juggling act too. Where could its twin have
got to?
translation:
Dogru!

Yukkles'in tuttugu kutu da
jonglorluk numarasinin bir parcasi. Ikizi nereye
gitmis olabilir?

original:
Too bad.

That piece of equipment's twin must be
there too.
translation:
Olmadi.

O ekipmanin ikizi de
orada olmali.

original:
The twins of every object on the floor are
all present. Great!

Wait... Is there something you've missed?
translation:
Yerdeki her nesnenin ikizi
mevcut. Harika!

Dur... Bir seyi gozden kacirmis olabilir misin?

original:
All this equipment is used in Yukkles'
juggling act. You know what juggling is -
it's when you throw and catch balls without
ever letting them fall to the ground.

Skilled practitioners often use objects other
than balls, though.
translation:
Bu ekipmanlarin hepsi Yukkles'in
jonglorluk numarasinda kullaniliyor. Jonglorlugu bilirsin -
toplari atip yakalarsin ve
hic yere dusurmezsin.

Ustalar cogu zaman
toplardan baska nesneler de kullanir.

original:
Are you sure you aren't making any incorrect
assumptions?

An object you use to keep your equipment
in can also be considered a piece of
equipment.
translation:
Yanlis bir varsayim
yapmadigindan emin misin?

Ekipmanini icinde tuttugun
bir nesne de
ekipman sayilabilir.

original:
You can juggle using anything, even boxes
that you keep other things in.

That's right - {''}there's juggling equipment all
over the floor{''}, but that's not to say Yukkles
isn't still holding one piece of his equipment.

What is he holding?
translation:
Her seyle jonglorluk yapabilirsin; hatta
baska seyleri icinde tuttugun kutularla bile.

Evet - {''}yerde her yerde jonglorluk ekipmani var{''},
ama bu, Yukkles'in
hala elinde bir ekipman tutmadigi anlamina gelmez.

Elinde ne tutuyor?

original: Where is the ball?
translation: Top nerede?

original:
Three clowns are chatting about their three
standard pieces of equipment.
① {''}I keep my hat in the black box, and
everything else in the yellow box.
② {''}I keep my drum in the red box, my ball
in the green, and my hat in the black.{''}
③ {''}I keep my drum in the green box, and
everything else in the white box.{''}
The clowns have started tidying up for the
night, and each of them has put one of their
things away into its box. No two clowns put
away the same thing. The black and green
boxes are empty. Which box contains a ball?
translation:
Uc palyaco, uc standart esyalari hakkinda
sohbet ediyor.
① {''}Sapkami siyah kutuda tutarim,
diger her seyi sari kutuya koyarim.{''}
② {''}Davulumu kirmizi kutuya, topumu
yesil kutuya, sapkami da siyah kutuya
koyarim.{''}
③ {''}Davulumu yesil kutuya koyarim,
diger her seyi beyaz kutuda tutarim.{''}
Palyacolar gece icin ortaligi topluyor ve
her biri esyalarindan birini kutusuna koymus.
Hicbir iki palyaco ayni esyayi kaldirmadi.
Siyah ve yesil kutular bos. Hangi kutuda bir top var?

original:
Correct!

It's the yellow box. Since the black box is
empty, neither ① nor ② put their hats into
it, which means ③ must have put away his
hat in the white box. The green box is also
empty, meaning that ② can't have put his
ball in it, so he must have put his drum in
the red box. That leaves ①, who put her ball
in the yellow box.
translation:
Dogru!

Top sari kutuda. Siyah kutu bos olduguna
gore ① de ② de sapkalarini oraya koymamis
olmali; bu da ③'un sapkasini beyaz kutuya
koydugu anlamina gelir. Yesil kutu da bos,
dolayisiyla ② topunu oraya koymus olamaz;
o halde davulunu kirmizi kutuya koymustur.
Geriye ① kalir; o da topunu
sari kutuya koymustur.

original:
Too bad.

Which one could it have been?
translation:
Olmadi.

Hangisi olabilirdi?

original:
The empty black and green boxes are the
keys to solving this puzzle.

You need to work out which clown put their
ball into one of the remaining boxes.
translation:
Bos olan siyah ve yesil kutular, bu
bulmacayi cozmenin anahtari.

Kalan kutulardan hangisine bir palyaconun
topunu koydugunu bulmalisin.

original:
Both ① and ② said they would normally put
their hat into the black box, but the black
box is empty.

We know that one of each item was put away
into its box, so one clown put away their hat.
If it wasn't ① or ②, it must have been ③.
Where would ③ have put his hat?
translation:
Hem ① hem de ② normalde sapkalarini siyah
kutuda tutacaklarini soylediler, ama siyah
kutu bos.

Her esyadan birer tane kutuya kondugunu
biliyoruz; yani bir palyaco sapkasini
kaldirdi. Eger bu ① ya da ② degilse, ③
olmali. ③ sapkasini nereye koyardi?

original:
From Hint 2, you can work out that ③ put
his hat into the white box.

Now look at what ① and ② said. Supposing
② had put his ball away, which box would it
be in?
translation:
Ipucu 2'den, ③'un sapkasini beyaz kutuya
koydugunu cikarabilirsin.

Simdi ① ve ②'nin soylediklerine bak. Diyelim
② topunu kaldirmis olsaydi, hangi kutuda
olurdu?

original:
If ② had put his ball away, it would be in
the green box. However, you know that the
green box is empty.

So who put their ball away, and into which
box?
translation:
Eger ② topunu kaldirmis olsaydi, yesil
kutuda olurdu. Ama yesil kutunun bos
oldugunu biliyorsun.

O zaman topunu kim kaldirdi ve hangi
kutunun icine koydu?

original: How many people?
translation: Kac kisi var?

original:
This delicatessen is quite the fashionable
place to shop for groceries this season!
You can always look through the shop
window and see the queue of people waiting
at the till.

The window is largely covered in posters,
but can you count how many people are in
the queue today?
translation:
Bu sarkuteri bu sezon oldukca moda bir
alisveris yeri! Her zaman vitrine bakip kasada
bekleyen insanlarin kuyrugunu gorebilirsin.

Vitrinin buyuk kismi posterlerle kapli,
ama bugun kuyrukta kac kisi oldugunu
sayabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

There are eight people in the queue,
including a little girl being given a piggyback.
translation:
Dogru!

Kuyrukta sekiz kisi var; bir kucuk kiz da
sirtinda tasiniyor.

original:
Too bad.

Make sure you haven't overlooked anyone.
translation:
Olmadi.

Kimseyi gozden kacirmadigindan emin ol.

original:
Most of the faces are hidden by the posters
in the window, and some people are so short
that you can't even see the top of their
heads.

So there's no way to count everyone just
based on faces and heads.
translation:
Cogu yuz posterlerin arkasinda gizli ve bazi
insanlar o kadar kisa ki baslarinin tepesi bile
gorunmuyor.

Yani sadece yuz ve baslara bakarak saymak
mumkun degil.

original:
No one has their feet covered up by posters.
Count all the feet you can find, taking care
in places where there are several pairs of
feet and where their colour blends in with
the wall.

Yes, look very carefully for the feet.
translation:
Kimsenin ayaklari posterlerle kapanmiyor.
Gordugun tum ayaklari say; ozellikle bircok
cift ayagin oldugu ve rengi duvarla karistigi
yerlerde dikkatli ol.

Evet, ayaklara cok dikkatli bak.

original:
Have you missed something? Not all the
people in the queue have their feet on the
floor. Have a look at the whole scene and
count all the feet you can see.
translation:
Bir seyi mi kacirdin? Kuyruktaki herkesin
ayagi yerde degil. Tum sahneye bak ve
gordugun tum ayaklari say.

original:
No one in the scene has both their feet
covered by a poster, though that doesn't
necessarily mean you'll see their feet below
the posters.

One person in the queue doesn't have their
feet on the floor. One rather young person.
translation:
Sahnede kimsenin iki ayagi birden posterin
arkasinda degil; ama bu, mutlaka ayaklarini
posterlerin altinda gorecegin anlamina gelmez.

Kuyruktaki bir kisinin ayagi yerde degil.
Hem de oldukca kucuk biri.

original: Divide it equally!
translation: Esit sekilde bol!

original:
These four siblings have a big piece of
chocolate to share between them. They want
to divide it up so that each of them gets a
chunk of identical shape and size containing
an almond.

How can they divide the chocolate fairly?
Draw lines to show where the chocolate
should be divided.
translation:
Bu dort kardes, aralarinda paylasacak buyuk
bir cikolata parcasina sahip. Her birinin icinde
bir badem bulunan, sekli ve boyutu ayni
parcalardan alacak sekilde bolmek istiyorlar.

Cikolatayi adilce nasil bolebilirler?
Cizgiler cizerek cikolatanin nereden
bolunecegini goster.

original:
Correct!

Dividing the chocolate as shown will ensure
that each sibling gets their fair share of this
tasty treat.
translation:
Dogru!

Cikolatayi gosterildigi gibi bolmek, her
kardesin bu lezzetli ikramdan hakkini
almasini saglar.

original:
Too bad.

We don't want any sibling rivalry here. Try
to divide it up equally.
translation:
Olmadi.

Kardes kavgasi istemiyoruz. Esitce bolmeyi dene.

original:
Start off by counting how many individual
squares of chocolate there are, then work
out how many each sibling should get.
translation:
Once toplam kac kare cikolata oldugunu say,
sonra her kardesin kac tane almasi gerektigini
hesapla.

original:
Each sibling should receive a chunk of
chocolate consisting of five squares.
They also need one almond each.
translation:
Her kardes bes kareden olusan bir parca
almali. Ayrica her birine bir badem gerekiyor.

original:
Draw a line so that the top two rows are
separated from the rest of the chocolate.
That's one sibling's portion.

Now find a way to divide the rest of the
chocolate so that the others get a piece of
the same size and shape as this one.
translation:
Ustteki iki sirayi cikolatanin geri kalanindan
ayiracak bir cizgi ciz. Bu, bir kardesin payi.

Simdi kalan cikolatayi da, digerlerinin ayni
sekil ve boyutta bir parca alacagi sekilde bol.

original:
Once you've separated the top two rows,
do the same for the bottom two. Now you've
made two identical pieces.

Next, start from the almond on the third row,
count four squares along and draw a line
down between the fourth and fifth square on
that row. Continue that line back two squares
to the left and then round the top-left corner
of the almond on the fourth row. That should
do it!
translation:
Ustteki iki sirayi ayirdiktan sonra ayni seyi
alttaki iki sira icin de yap. Boylece iki ayni parca
elde edersin.

Sonra ucuncu siradaki bademden baslayip dort
kare say ve o siradaki dorduncu ve besinci kare
arasina asagi dogru bir cizgi ciz. Bu cizgiyi iki kare
sola dogru geri gotur ve dorduncu siradaki bademin
sol ust kosesinin etrafindan dolastir. Iste bu!

original: Which plate?
translation: Hangi tabak?

original:
Drat! This pesky feline has knocked three
plates off the dresser!

The cat made off with one of the pieces.
Can you tell which plate it's from? Choose
between A, B or C.
translation:
Kahretsin! Bu yaramaz kedi sifonyerin ustundeki
uc tabagi yere dusurdu!

Kedi parcalardan birini alip kacti.
Hangi tabaga ait oldugunu soyleyebilir misin?
A, B ya da C'yi sec.

original:
Correct!

It's C. Get after that cat!
translation:
Dogru!

C. Hadi su kedinin pesine dus!

original:
Too bad.

That plate has all its pieces accounted for.
translation:
Olmadi.

O tabagin tum parcalari zaten burada.

original:
Inspect each piece in turn. There's
something about them that will help you
determine which belongs to which plate.
translation:
Her bir parcayi tek tek incele.
Uzerlerinde, hangi parcanin hangi tabaga
a ait oldugunu anlamani saglayacak bir ipucu var.

original:
Notice the flower pattern on the plates.
The pieces may be in confusing shapes, but
the pattern is a big help in working out which
piece came from which plate.
translation:
Tabaklarin uzerindeki cicek desenine dikkat et.
Parcalarin sekilleri kafa karistirici olabilir ama
desen, hangi parcanin hangi tabaktan geldigini
anlamanda cok yardimci olur.

original:
Here's a huge hint!

All of the pieces of plate B are here.
translation:
Iste buyuk bir ipucu!

B tabaginin tum parcalari burada.

original:
Here's a massive hint!

All of the pieces of plate A are also here.

That leaves you with only one plate!
translation:
Iste kocaman bir ipucu!

A tabaginin tum parcalari da burada.

Geriye sadece tek bir tabak kaliyor!

original: Which way up is it?
translation: Hangi tarafi yukari?

original:
The bartender places five bottle caps on
the bar, with the star logos facing up.
She closes her eyes and starts turning caps
over at random, counting every turn.

Once she reaches 25, she suddenly slams
her hand onto the bar, covers up one of the
caps, and asks you: {''}Is the logo on this cap
facing up or down?{''}

With the situation shown in the diagram
above, can you answer her question?
translation:
Barmen, bes sise
kapagini bara, yildiz logolari yukari bakacak sekilde koyar.
Gozlerini kapatir ve kapaklari
rastgele cevirip her cevirmeyi saymaya baslar.

25'e ulastiginda,
birden elini bara vurur, kapaklardan birini
ortup sana sorar: {''}Bu kapagin uzerindeki logo
yukari mi bakiyor, asagi mi?{''}

Yukaridaki diyagramda gosterilen
durumda, sorusunu cevaplayabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

The cap is facing down.

Flip the caps an odd number of times and
the number of caps facing up will be even,
and vice versa.

Since 25 is an odd number, there can only
be two caps facing up, so the covered one
must be facing down.
translation:
Dogru!

Kapak asagi
bakiyor.

Kapaklari tek sayida cevirirsen,
yukari bakan kapaklarin sayisi cift olur,
ve tersi de gecerlidir.

25 tek sayi olduguna gore,
yalnizca iki kapak yukari bakabilir; bu yuzden
ortulen kapak asagi bakiyor olmali.

original:
Too bad.

Do you notice anything as you keep flipping
caps over and over?
translation:
Olmadi.

Kapaklari tekrar tekrar cevirdikce bir sey fark ediyor musun?

original:
The best way to solve this puzzle is to
try it out. Find something nearby that
can stand for the caps and give it a
go.

Once you realise a particular rule, you
won't need to flip the caps over 25 times
to work out the answer.
translation:
Bu bulmacayi cozmenin en iyi yolu
denemektir. Yakinda
kapaklari temsil edebilecek bir sey bul ve
deneyip gor.

Belirli bir kurali
fark ettiginde, cevabi bulmak icin kapaklari
25 kez cevirmene gerek kalmayacak.

original:
All the caps started facing up. If you flip
one over, then four are facing up and one
is facing down, right?

Now flip another over and you'll have three
facing up and two facing down.

Flip another and it's two facing up and three
facing down.

Notice any pattern here?
translation:
Tum kapaklar baslangicta yukari bakiyordu. Birini
cevirirsen dort tanesi yukari, bir
tanesi asagi bakar, degil mi?

Simdi bir
tanesini daha cevir ve ucu yukari, ikisi asagi baksin.

Bir tane daha cevirirsen ikisi yukari, ucu
asagi bakar.

Bir oruntu fark ettin mi?

original:
Think carefully about the relationship
between the number of times a cap has
been flipped and the number of caps still
facing up.

When the number of flips is even, the
number of caps facing up is odd. Keep
this in mind and you won't need to flip
them 25 times to solve the puzzle.
translation:
Bir kapagin kac
kez cevrildigi
ile hala yukari bakan
kapaklarin sayisi arasindaki iliskiyi iyi dusun.

Cevirme sayisi ciftse,
yukari bakan kapak sayisi tektir. Bunu
aklinda tutarsan bulmacayi cozmek icin
onlari 25 kez cevirmene gerek kalmaz.

original:
When the number of flips is odd, the number
of caps facing up must be even.

25 flips is an odd number, and two of the
visible caps are facing up, which can only
mean one thing.
translation:
Cevirme sayisi tekse, yukari
bakan kapak sayisi cift olmak zorundadir.

25 cevirmesi tek
sayidir ve gorunen kapaklarin ikisi yukari bakiyor; bu da
yalnizca tek bir anlama gelir.

original: How many pages?
translation: Kac sayfa?

original:
A famous writer has written an adventure
novel with no page numbers. Apparently,
the fold-out island map contains a code that
allows readers to work out how many pages
are in the book.

Can you crack the code?
translation:
Unlu bir yazar, sayfa numarasi olmayan
bir macera romani yazmis. Soylentiye gore,
acilir ada haritasi, okurlarin kitapta
kac sayfa oldugunu bulmasini saglayan
bir kod iceriyormus.

Kodu cozebilir misin?

original:
Correct!

There are 735 pages in the novel. The key
is to fold the map along the fold lines and
combine it with the front cover. How novel!
translation:
Dogru!

Romanda 735 sayfa var. Anahtar,
haritanin kat yerlerinden katlayip
on kapakla birlestirmek. Ne kadar da yaratici!

original:
Too bad.

You're looking for a number. What looks like
a number on that map?
translation:
Olmadi.

Bir sayi ariyorsun. Haritada
sayiya benzeyen ne var?

original:
Those symbols on the map must somehow
tell you the number of pages.

It's a three-digit number, by the way.
translation:
Haritadaki o semboller bir sekilde
sayfa sayisini soyluyor olmali.

Bu arada uc basamakli
bir sayi.

original:
How would the fold-out island map look if you
folded it along the folds?
translation:
Acilir ada haritasi
kat yerlerinden katlarsan nasil gorunur?

original:
Fold the map up and you'll see something
that looks more like numbers at some point.
Maybe you should try rotating the book?
translation:
Haritayi katladiginda bir noktada
sayilara daha cok benzeyen bir sey goreceksin.
Belki kitabi cevirmeyi denemelisin?

original:
You need to look at more than just the map.
Numbers will become apparent when you put
the folded map together with the cover of
the book.

From the left, it should read 7, 3 and...
translation:
Sadece haritaya bakman yetmez.
Katlanmis haritayi kitabin kapagiyla
birlestirince sayilar ortaya cikar.

Soldan saga 7, 3 ve...

original: How many blocks?
translation: Kac blok?

original:
A carpenter has received a shipment of ten
large blocks. He knows there's a mixture of
two kinds of blocks, light and heavy.
Unfortunately, he doesn't know how many
there are of each, and he can't tell which
are light and which are heavy without lifting
them up one by one and comparing them.

For his current project, the carpenter is only
looking for one light block. What is the
maximum number of blocks he might need to
lift until he finds a light one?
translation:
Bir marangoz, on
buyuk bloktan olusan bir sevkiyat aldi. Bunlarin
iki turden olustugunu biliyor: hafif ve agir.
Ne yazik ki her birinden kac tane oldugunu bilmiyor
ve hangisinin hafif hangisinin agir oldugunu
tek tek kaldirip karsilastirmadan
ayirt edemiyor.

Marangozun simdiki isi icin
sadece bir hafif blok bulmasi yeterli.
Bir hafif blok bulana kadar
en fazla kac blogu kaldirmasi gerekebilir?

original:
That's right!

If he's unlucky, he'll need to lift all ten
blocks. If the first nine blocks he picks up
are the same weight, he won't know if the
last block is light or heavy without lifting it
up as well.
translation:
Dogru!

Sanssizsa, on blogun
hepsini kaldirmasi gerekir. Kaldirdigi ilk dokuz blok
ayni agirliktaysa, son blogun
hafif mi agir mi oldugunu
onu da kaldirmadan bilemez.

original:
Too bad.

Think carefully and make sure you haven't
overlooked anything.
translation:
Olmadi.

Dikkatlice dusun ve
hicbir seyi gozden kacirmadigindan emin ol.

original:
This puzzle doesn't require any tricky
calculations, but that's not to say there
isn't a trick to it.

Consider which of the conditions in the
puzzle are concrete and which are vague.
translation:
Bu bulmaca zor
hesaplar gerektirmiyor, ama bu
icinde bir puf noktasi olmadigi anlamina gelmez.

Bulmacadaki kosullardan
hangilerinin kesin, hangilerinin belirsiz olduguna bak.

original:
From the puzzle description, all you know
for sure is that there are ten blocks,
and a mixture of two different kinds: light
and heavy.

If that's the case, what's the maximum
number of light blocks that there could be,
and what's the minimum number?

Thinking about the maximum and minimum
should lead you to the solution.
translation:
Bulmaca aciklamasindan kesin olarak bildigin tek sey,
on blok oldugudur
ve iki turun karisimi oldugudur: hafif
ve agir.

Oyleyse en fazla
kac hafif blok olabilir,
en az kac tane olabilir?

Maksimum ve minimumu dusunmek
seni cozume goturmeli.

original:
There is at least one light block here. In the
worst case scenario, the carpenter might
have to lift nine heavy blocks and then he'd
know the final block was a light one.

Or would he? What if in fact the first nine
blocks he'd lifted were light?
translation:
Burada en az bir hafif blok var. En kotu ihtimalde
marangoz dokuz agir blogu kaldirmak zorunda kalir
ve sonra son blogun hafif oldugunu
anlar.

Ya oyle degilse? Ya aslinda ilk dokuz
blok hafifse?

original:
If the carpenter were to lift nine blocks and
find them all the same weight, he would know
the tenth one was different, but he wouldn't
know for sure whether it was lighter or
heavier than the nine others.

So how many blocks would he have to lift in
total to find out if those first nine were light
or heavy?
translation:
Marangoz dokuz blogu kaldirip
hepsinin ayni agirlikta oldugunu gorse,
onuncunun farkli oldugunu bilir, ama
diger dokuzundan daha hafif mi
daha agir mi oldugunu kesin olarak bilemez.

Oyleyse ilk dokuzunun hafif mi
agir mi oldugunu anlamak icin
toplamda kac blogu kaldirmasi gerekir?

original: Save Luke!
translation: Luke'u kurtar!

original:
While gliding down to the bottom of the
Grand Hall, the Masked Gentleman has left
Luke hanging from a rope in mid-air! Help
Layton slide his way down the ropes drawn
across the hall and save Luke!

There are only a few places where he can
drop from one rope to another. Use the
panel on the right of the Touch Screen to
view the whole hall and hurry to Luke's
rescue!
translation:
Maskeli Beyefendi, Buyuk Salon'un altina
suzulurken Luke'u havada bir ipten sallanir
halde birakti! Layton'in salondan gecen ipler
uzerinden kayarak asagi inmesine ve Luke'u
kurtarmasina yardim et!

Sadece birkac noktada bir ipten digerine
birakabilir. Sagdaki dokunmatik ekran panelini
kullanarak tum salonu gor ve Luke'un
yardimina kos!

original:
Correct!

Thank goodness Luke is safe.
translation:
Dogru!

Sukurler olsun, Luke guvende.

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
There are several routes he can take to
save Luke. There's just one key hint to
keep in mind: there are points where he
must not drop down.

Point N is one of these. If he drops down
here, he'll just wind up flat on his face.
translation:
Luke'u kurtarmak icin birkac farkli rota var.
Ama aklinda tutman gereken tek bir onemli
ipucu var: bazi noktalardan asla asagi
birakmamali.

N noktasi bunlardan biri. Buradan birakirsa
yuzustu yere kapaklanir.

original:
Here's another place where Layton can't
drop down: K.

Luke seems to be directly below this point,
so you might be tempted to make him drop
down here, but if you do, Layton will miss
him.
translation:
Layton'in asagi inemeyecegi bir baska yer: K.

Luke sanki tam bu noktanin altinda, bu yuzden
buradan birakmak isteyebilirsin; ama yaparsan
Layton onu iskalar.

original:
Next in our series of places where he can't
drop down is F.

It's a fair way down, and you might think
that the rope below it will take Layton
close enough to Luke to grab him.

But it won't.
translation:
Asagi inemeyecegi siradaki nokta F.

Oldukca asagida ve altindaki ipin Layton'i
Luke'a yeterince yaklastiracagini
dusunebilirsin.

Ama olmaz.

original:
Here's the final place where he can't drop
down: I.

It's very easy to think that he'll have a
straight run towards Luke if you make him
drop down here, but it's actually a one-way
ticket to utter mortification and despair as
his dashing rescue attempt ends in abject
failure.
translation:
Son yasak nokta: I.

Buradan birakirsan Luke'a dumduz gidecek
sanmak cok kolay; ama aslinda kahramanca
kurtarma girisiminin utanc verici bir
basarisizlikla bittigi, umutsuzluga giden
tek yonlu bir bilet.

original: Make a coffee cup!
translation: Bir kahve fincani yap!

original:
This two-colour mosaic of a coffee cup was
made using red and white tiles. You want to
make an identical picture but you only have
a set of large tiles that are each
3 x 3 squares.

Can you recreate the picture by layering
the tiles you have available? The tiles can
overlap as many times as you want.
translation:
Bu iki renkli kahve fincani mozaigi,
kirmizi ve beyaz taslarla yapilmis. Aynisini
yapmak istiyorsun ama elinde sadece
her biri
3 x 3 kare olan buyuk taslar var.

Elindeki taslari ust uste koyarak
bu resmi yeniden olusturabilir misin? Taslar
istedigin kadar ust uste gelebilir.

original:
Correct!

Give yourself a pat on the back and a nice
cup of coffee.
translation:
Dogru!

Kendini tebrik et ve guzel
bir fincan kahve ic.

original:
Too bad.

You need to find a way to make the handle
using your limited supply of tiles. Once you
clinch that part, the rest is easy.
translation:
Olmadi.

Sinirli taslarinla kulpu yapmanin
bir yolunu bulmalisin. O kismi halledince,
gerisi kolay.

original:
First stick a red tile in the bottom-right
corner and then start making the cup.
translation:
Once sag alt koseye kirmizi bir tasi
yerlestir, sonra fincani yapmaya basla.

original:
Continuing from Hint 1, place a white tile on
the right edge, just above the red one, but
not overlapping with it.

Now place another white tile one square
down and to the left of the previous one.
These two tiles will form the bottom part
of the cup handle.
translation:
Ipucu 1'in devami olarak, sag kenara
kirmizinin hemen ustune beyaz bir tas koy,
ama onunla ust uste gelmesin.

Simdi bir beyaz tasi daha, bir oncekinin
bir kare altina ve soluna yerlestir.
Bu iki tas, fincan kulpunun alt
kismini olusturacak.

original:
Place a red tile two squares from the top
and one from the right, then place another
red tile one square left and down from
that.

The shape of the handle should be starting
to emerge now.
translation:
Ustten iki kare asagiya ve sagdan bir kare
iceriye kirmizi bir tas koy, sonra
onun bir kare soluna ve altina
bir kirmizi tas daha yerlestir.

Kulp sekli artik
belirmeye baslamali.

original:
Next, you'll want to place a white tile one
square from the top and one from the right.
Now cover the top third of the whole area
with three red tiles. Place the last two
red tiles in the bottom-left corner and
immediately to the right of that.

Finish the cup off by making a large square
with the remaining four white tiles!
translation:
Sonra ustten bir kare ve sagdan bir kare
iceriye beyaz bir tas yerlestir.
Simdi tum alanin ust ucte birini
