uc kirmizi tasla kapla. Son iki
kirmizi tasi sol alt koseye ve
hemen sagina yerlestir.

Kalan dort beyaz tasla buyuk bir kare
yaparak fincani tamamla!

original: Make a duck!
translation: Bir ordek yap!

original:
A child made a picture of an adorable little
duckling using three colours of small tiles.
You want to recreate the picture but you
only have a set of large tiles that are each
3 x 3 squares.

Can you make the same duck out of the tiles
you have at your disposal? You may overlap
your tiles as many times as you like.
translation:
Bir cocuk, kucuk karolardan uc renk kullanarak
sevimli bir ordek yavrusu resmi yapti.
Sen de resmi yeniden yapmak istiyorsun ama
elinde her biri
3 x 3 kareden olusan buyuk karolar var.

Elindeki karolarla ayni ordegi
yapabilir misin? Karolari istedigin
kadar ust uste koyabilirsin.

original:
Quacking job!

You can actually complete the picture with
one yellow tile left over. If you feel up to it,
have another quack at it!
translation:
Vak vak harika!

Aslinda resmi
bir sari karo artacak sekilde tamamlayabilirsin. Istersen
bir kez daha dene!

original:
Too bad.

It's hard, but don't give up yet!
translation:
Olmadi.

Zor, ama pes etme!

original:
This puzzle is particularly tricky. These hints
will give you a rough guide as to how to
solve it, but you'll have to work out the rest
for yourself.

Start off by making the beak and the foot.
There's a long way to go.
translation:
Bu bulmaca ozellikle zor. Bu ipuclari
nasil cozecegine dair kabaca bir yol gosterecek,
ama gerisini
kendin cozmelisin.

Once gagayi ve ayagi yap.
Daha cok yol var.

original:
Next, build up the head, the base for the
eye, then the front half of the body.

While you place tiles to form the neck, you
will be forming the small square for the eye
at the same time.
translation:
Sonra basi, gozun
tabanini ve govdenin on yarisini olustur.

Boynu olusturmak icin karolari yerlestirirken,
ayni anda goz icin kucuk
kareyi de olusturacaksin.

original:
Continuing from Hint 2, place tiles to form
the duckling's tail and back. The line that
runs from the back of its head to its tail
can be made with a single blue tile at the
end.
translation:
2. ipucundan devam ederek karolari yerlestirip
ordek yavrusunun kuyrugunu ve sirtini yap. Basindan kuyruguna
uzanan cizginin sonunda
tek bir mavi karo
yeterli olacaktir.

original:
Lastly, finish off the duckling's wing and
thigh with yellow tiles and you're done!
translation:
Son olarak sari karolarla
kanadi ve butu tamamla, iste bitti!

original: Ring the bell!
translation: Zili cal!

original:
Ring the bell and call out the people from
the room.

You have six slingshots and five shots. The
shots will only bounce off the first thing they
come into contact with, and any obstructions
they hit will break and disappear.

Get it right and the bell will ring!
translation:
Zili cal ve odadaki insanlari
disari cagir.

Alti sapanin ve bes atisin var. Atislar
yalnizca ilk temas ettikleri seyden sekerek,
carpilan engelleri
kirip yok eder.

Dogru yaparsan zil calar!

original:
Well done!

Randall and Henry were playing together
in the room. How nice!
translation:
Aferin!

Randall ve Henry odada birlikte oynuyorlarmis.
Ne guzel!

original: Try again.
translation: Tekrar dene.

original:
There are six obstructions, and you'll have
to get rid of five of them if you want to ring
the bell.

You need one shot to ring the bell, so two of
the obstructions will have to be taken out
with one shot.
translation:
Alti engel var ve zili calmak icin
bunlarin besini kaldirman gerekiyor.

Zili calmak icin bir atis gerekiyor; demek ki
engellerden ikisi
tek bir atisla yok edilmeli.

original:
Set the rightmost slingshot to fire first,
getting rid of the lower cat ornament.

The fifth shot will bounce off a wall and
hit the bell, so you need to use one of
the second, third or fourth shots to take
out two obstructions in one go.
translation:
En sagdaki sapani ilk ates edecek sekilde ayarla,
alttaki kedi susunu yok etsin.

Besinci atis bir duvardan sekip
zile vuracak; bu yuzden
ikinci, ucuncu ya da dorduncu atislardan biriyle
iki engeli birden yok etmelisin.

original:
You don't need to use the third slingshot
from the right.

Set the five shots in the other slingshots.
translation:
Sagdan ucuncu sapani
kullanman gerekmiyor.

Diger sapanlara bes atisi yerlestir.

original:
Your second shot should be set in the third
slingshot from the left, which will break
the right-hand brick.

Your third shot goes in the second slingshot
from the left. This will take out the lower
flowerpot.

Shots four and five are up to you!
translation:
Ikinci atisini soldan ucuncu
sapanla ayarla; bu, sagdaki tuglayi
kiracak.

Ucuncu atisin soldan ikinci sapanda olmali.
Bu, alttaki saksiyi
yok eder.

Dorduncu ve besinci atis sana kalmis!

original: What comes next?
translation: Sirada ne var?

original:
This roulette wheel isn't behaving as it
should! Instead of stopping at random, the
ball seems to land on numbers according
to some unknown rule.

On successive spins, the ball lands on
10, 9, 8, 5 then 3.

Where will the ball land next?
translation:
Bu rulet carki olmasi gerektigi gibi calismiyor!
Rastgele durmak yerine,
top sanki bilinmeyen bir kurala gore
sayilara geliyor.

Arka arkaya donuslerde top
10, 9, 8, 5 ve sonra 3'e geliyor.

Bir sonraki duracagi sayi ne?

original:
Correct!

When the ball lands on a number, the next
number will be that many spaces away in
an anticlockwise direction.

The number 12 is missing from the wheel.
If 12 was there, landing on a 12 would
make the next number 12, and the next,
and the next...
translation:
Dogru!

Top bir sayiya geldiginde, bir sonraki sayi
o sayi kadar mesafe
saat yonunun tersine gider.

Carkta 12 sayisi eksik.
Eger 12 olsaydi, 12'ye gelmek bir sonraki sayiyi
12 yapar, sonra yine,
ve yine...

original:
Too bad.

These numbers aren't random. There's
definitely some kind of rule.
translation:
Olmadi.

Bu sayilar rastgele degil.
Kesinlikle bir kural var.

original:
The rule for this sequence of numbers is
only possible on a spinning wheel.

What could it be?
translation:
Bu sayi dizisinin kurali
ancak donen bir carkta mumkun.

Ne olabilir?

original:
Take a look at all the numbers on the wheel
in order. Do you notice anything strange?

Is there one missing?
translation:
Carktaki tum sayilara sirayla
bak. Garip bir sey fark ediyor musun?

Bir tanesi eksik mi?

original:
The ball landed on 10, 9, 8, then 5. Starting
on 10, count how many spaces there are
around the wheel until you reach the 9, then
from the 9 to the 8, and from the 8 to the 5.
You should see a pattern start to emerge.
translation:
Top 10'a, 9'a, 8'e ve sonra 5'e geldi. 10'dan baslayarak
9'a kadar kac bosluk oldugunu say,
sonra 9'dan 8'e,
ve 8'den 5'e.
Bir duzen ortaya cikmali.

original:
Did you count the spaces from the 10 to
the 9?

If you need a bit more help, make sure
you're counting anticlockwise and everything
should become clear.
translation:
10'dan 9'a kadar
bosluklari saydin mi?

Biraz daha yardima ihtiyacin varsa,
saat yonunun tersine saydigina
emin ol; o zaman her sey netlesir.

original: Guide the ladybird!
translation: Ugur bocegini yonlendir!

original:
The red and blue ladybird friends seem to
have lost sight of each other on another
corncob! This time they not only have
kernels blocking their way, but they must
also find their way through tiny tunnels
that go right through the cob and come
out the other side.

Can you once again guide the red ladybird
to the blue one?
translation:
Kirmizi ve mavi ugur bocegi arkadaslar
bir baska misir kocaninda yine birbirini
kaybetmis gibi gorunuyor! Bu kez yalnizca
yolu tikayan taneler degil, ayni zamanda kocanin
icinden gecen kucuk tunelleri de bulmalari gerekiyor;
bu tuneller kocanin obur
tarafindan cikiyor.

Kirmizi ugur bocegini bir kez daha
mavi olana goturebilir misin?

original:
Well done!

Let's hope they stay close in future.
translation:
Tebrikler!

Umarim bundan sonra yakin
dururlar.

original:
Too bad.

There should be a tunnel that leads straight
to the blue ladybird somewhere...
translation:
Olmadi.

Bir yerlerde mavi ugur bocegine
dogrudan giden bir tunel olmali...

original:
See that hole that's slightly below and to
the left of your starting point? You'll want
to start there. Go on, take the plunge!
translation:
Baslangic noktanin biraz altinda ve
asagida solunda olan o deligi goruyor musun? Oradan
baslamak isteyeceksin. Hadi, dal!

original:
If you took the tunnel in Hint 1, you know
that the area on the other end turned out
to be a dead end.

But worry not! Just take the tunnel back
again and then move to the left of the
exit hole. You had to take the tunnel both
ways just to be able to go left!
translation:
Ipucu 1'deki tunele girdiysen,
obur uctaki bolgenin cikmaz
oldugunu biliyorsun.

Ama dert etme! Tunelden geri cik
ve sonra cikis deliginin soluna
dogru ilerle. Sola gidebilmek icin tuneli
iki yonde de kullanman gerekiyordu!

original:
Now you should have a choice between two
tunnel holes. Take the lower one.

It's not far now!
translation:
Simdi iki tunel deligi arasinda
secimin olmali. Alttaki olani sec.

Artik cok az kaldi!

original:
Continuing from Hint 3, when you emerge
from the tunnel, aim for the hole that's
diagonally left and down from you.

You can't go wrong after that!
translation:
Ipucu 3'ten devam ederek, tunelden ciktiginda
senden capraz olarak sola ve asagida olan
delige yonel.

Bundan sonra yanlis yapamazsin!

original: Leave Lucky in the middle!
translation: Lucky'yi ortada birak!

original:
Lucky the black cat is back, but this time she
only has seven white kittens with her on the
5 x 5 board. Both Lucky and the kittens can
jump over any kitten that is in a horizontally,
vertically or diagonally adjacent square.
Jumping over a kitten removes that kitten
from the grid, but Lucky cannot be jumped
over.

Can you make the cats jump around the
board so that Lucky is once again left alone
on the board, sitting in the centre?
translation:
Siyah kedi Lucky geri dondu, ama bu sefer yaninda
5 x 5 tahtada sadece yedi beyaz yavru kedi var.
Hem Lucky hem de yavrular, yatay,
dikey ya da capraz bitisik karedeki
herhangi bir yavrunun uzerinden atlayabilir.
Bir yavrunun uzerinden atlamak o yavruyu
tahtadan kaldirir, ama Lucky'nin uzerinden
atilamaz.

Kedileri ziplatarak, Lucky'nin
bir kez daha tahtada yalniz kalmasini
ve ortada oturmasini saglayabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

Now where have those kittens got to?
translation:
Dogru!

Peki o yavrular nereye gitti?

original:
Too bad.

Try to plan your jumps before you start
moving the cats around.
translation:
Olmadi.

Kedileri hareket ettirmeye baslamadan
once atlayislarini planla.

original:
In this puzzle, Lucky shouldn't jump until
the very end. Start with the kittens and try
to remove as many as you can.
translation:
Bu bulmacada Lucky en sona kadar
ziplamamali. Once yavrularla basla ve
olabildigince cogunu kaldirmaya calis.

original:
First, you need to move the top kitten down.
If you think of down as south, then the next
step is to move the kitten nearest Lucky
towards the north-west.

This will leave you with five kittens and
Lucky.
translation:
Once en ustteki yavruyu asagi indirmen gerekiyor.
Asagiyi guney olarak dusunursen, bir sonraki
adim Lucky'ye en yakin yavruyu
kuzeybatiya dogru hareket ettirmek.

Boylece bes yavru ve
Lucky kalir.

original:
Continuing from Hint 2, move the bottom-left
kitten to the north-east, and then the top-left
kitten straight south.

That now leaves you with three kittens and
Lucky.
translation:
2. ipucundan devam ederek sol alttaki
yavruyu kuzeydoguya, sonra sol ustteki
yavruyu dumduz guneye hareket ettir.

Boylece uc yavru ve
Lucky kalir.

original:
You're almost there. Make the bottom-left
kitten jump twice: first north-east, then
south.

The last move is to jump Lucky into the
centre and that's it!
translation:
Neredeyse bitti. Sol alttaki
yavruyu iki kez ziplat: once kuzeydoguya, sonra
guneye.

Son hamle Lucky'yi
ortaya ziplatmak; iste bu!

original: Enthrone the emperor!
translation: Imparatoru tahta oturt!

original:
Atop an iceberg stand five familiar-looking
penguins and their large emperor. All
penguins can move either horizontally or
vertically, but once in motion they won't stop
until they hit another penguin - if there's
nothing in the way, they'll plunge straight
into the sea.

Can you work out a way to get the emperor
penguin to the very centre of the iceberg?
translation:
Bir buzdaginin ustunde tanidik bes penguen
ve buyuk imparatorlari duruyor. Tum penguenler
yatay ya da dikey hareket edebilir, fakat
hareket ettiklerinde baska bir penguene carpana
kadar durmazlar; onlerinde hicbir sey yoksa
dogruca denize
duserler.

Imparator pengueni
buzdaginin tam ortasina getirebilir misin?

original:
Correct!

The emperor looks quite chuffed with his little
spot on the ice!

You can actually complete this puzzle in nine
moves. How many did it take you?
translation:
Dogru!

Imparator, buz uzerindeki kucuk
yerinden oldukca memnun gorunuyor!

Aslinda bu bulmacayi dokuz
hamlede bitirebilirsin. Sen kac hamlede yaptin?

original:
Too bad.

The penguins will have to put their heads
together if they want to make this work!
translation:
Olmadi.

Penguenler bunu basarmak icin
kafa kafaya vermek zorunda!

original:
You need only move two penguins. Which
ones look right to you?
translation:
Sadece iki pengueni hareket ettirmen gerekiyor. Sence
hangileri dogru?

original:
Move the penguin in the top-left corner first.
Send it sliding right, down, then right again.

If all goes to plan, that puts it on the square
three from the top and two from the right.
translation:
Once sol ust kosedeki pengueni hareket ettir.
Saga kaydir, sonra asagi, sonra tekrar saga.

Her sey yolunda giderse, onu
ustten ucuncu, sagdan ikinci kareye getirir.

original:
Now we want to keep moving the penguin
from Hint 2. Move it down, left, then up.
If it ends up two squares to the right of
the emperor penguin, then you're right on
track.
translation:
Simdi 2. ipucundaki pengueni
hareket ettirmeye devam et. Asagi, sola, sonra yukari kaydir.
Eger imparator penguenin saginda iki kare
kaliyorsa, dogru
yoldasin.

original:
It's finally time for the emperor to move!
Slide him right, down, right, down and left.

You're only one step away from the goal
now!
translation:
Sonunda imparatorun hareket etme zamani!
Onu saga, asagi, saga, asagi ve sola kaydir.

Artik hedefe sadece
bir adim kaldi!

original: Turn all the rabbits brown!
translation: Butun tavsanlari kahverengiye cevir!

original:
Those rabbit toys are raring to go again!

There are three rules:
1. The rabbits can only move by jumping
horizontally, diagonally or vertically over
other rabbits.
2. They can jump over any number of
rabbits at once.
3. A white rabbit will turn brown when
jumped over, and vice versa.

Can you make all the rabbits here turn
brown, following the rules given above?
translation:
Bu tavsan oyuncaklari yine cosmus!

Uc kural var:
1. Tavsanlar yalnizca diger tavsanlarin uzerinden
yatay, capraz ya da dikey atlayarak hareket eder.
2. Ayni anda istenen sayida tavsanin uzerinden
atlayabilirler.
3. Uzerinden atlaninca beyaz tavsan kahverengiye,
kahverengi tavsan da beyaza doner.

Yukaridaki kurallara uyarak buradaki tum
tavsanlari kahverengi yapabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

You can solve this puzzle in 6 moves. How
many moves did you use?
translation:
Dogru!

Bu bulmacayi 6 hamlede cozebilirsin. Sen kac
hamlede cozdun?

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
Try to avoid jumping over rabbits that are
already brown unless you absolutely have to.
translation:
Mecbur kalmadikca, zaten kahverengi olan
tavsanlarin uzerinden atlamamaya calis.

original:
Here's one way to get started on turning all
the rabbits brown:

First, move the rabbit in the top-left corner
to the right. Next, move the same rabbit
down. After that, you'll want to move the
rabbit in the bottom right.
translation:
Iste tum tavsanlari kahverengi yapmaya
baslamak icin bir yol:

Once sol ust kosedeki tavsani saga tasi.
Sonra ayni tavsani asagi indir. Ardindan
sag alttaki tavsani hareket ettirmek isteyeceksin.

original:
Having trouble with the bottom-right rabbit?
After moving the top-left rabbit as described
in Hint 2, you should move the bottom-right
rabbit up, left, down, right and, finally,
diagonally up and to the left.

That should leave you with five brown
rabbits.
translation:
Sag alttaki tavsanda zorlandin mi?
Ipucu 2'de anlatildigi gibi sol ust tavsani
hareket ettirdikten sonra, sag alttaki tavsani
yukari, sola, asagi, saga ve son olarak
capraz yukari-sola ziplat.

Boylece bes kahverengi
tavsan kalmali.

original:
You're nearly there. Next, you'll need to
move the rabbit in the third row from the top,
two columns from the right.

Have him jump up, diagonally down and to
the left, and then up again.

Now all the rabbits should be brown.
translation:
Neredeyse bitti. Simdi ustten ucuncu sirada,
sagdan ikinci sutundaki tavsani
hareket ettirmelisin.

Onu yukari, capraz asagi-sola ve sonra tekrar
yukari ziplat.

Simdi tum tavsanlar kahverengi olmali.

original: How many deer are there?
translation: Kac tane geyik var?

original:
Ah, a cave painting! A magnificent find!

It's a shame the cave is so dark, though. It
makes it all but impossible to make out the
entire painting.

You can use your lamp to study the painting,
but the lamp only illuminates a small area.
Can you count how many deer are depicted
here?
translation:
Ah, bir magara resmi! Muhtesem bir kesif!

Ama magaranin bu kadar karanlik olmasi yazik. Bu,
resmin tamamini secmeyi neredeyse imkansiz kiliyor.

Resmi incelemek icin lambani kullanabilirsin,
ancak lamba yalnizca kucuk bir alani aydinlatir.
Burada tasvir edilen geyiklerin sayisini
sayabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

There are nine small deer and two large
ones overlapping in the background.
translation:
Dogru!

Onde dokuz kucuk geyik ve arkada ust uste
binen iki buyuk geyik var.

original:
Oh deer.

Use your lamp to light up every corner of
the painting.
translation:
Aman geyik...

Resmin her kosesini aydinlatmak icin
lambani kullan.

original:
There are a lot of deer, so use the Memo
Function to keep track as you count them.
translation:
Geyik cok, o yuzden sayarken takip etmek icin
Not (Memo) ozelligini kullan.

original:
There are at least ten deer here. Have you
missed some?
translation:
Burada en az on geyik var. Acaba bazilarini
atladin mi?

original:
The small deer aren't the only ones in the
painting.
translation:
Resimde yalnizca kucuk geyikler
bulunmuyor.

original:
There are two large deer painted behind
the small ones. Add them to the total.
translation:
Kucuklerin arkasinda iki buyuk geyik daha
cizilmis. Onlari da toplama ekle.

original: Move and flip the panels!
translation: Panelleri hareket ettir ve cevir!

original:
The gate is secured by a sturdy padlock
with an unusual code. To open the lock,
Layton and Randall need to rearrange the
nine panels so that every vertical, horizontal
and diagonal set of three numbers adds up
to the same sum.

It might look impossible, but there are more
numbers on the back of the panels. Move
and flip the panels to enter the code and
help our heroes unlock the padlock!
translation:
Kapi, tuhaf bir koda sahip saglam bir
asma kilitle kilitlenmis. Kilidi acmak icin
Layton ve Randall dokuz paneli yeniden
duzenlemeli; oyle ki her dikey, yatay ve
capraz uclu sayi grubunun toplami ayni olsun.

Imkansiz gibi gorunebilir ama panellerin arka
yuzunde daha fazla sayi var. Panelleri
hareket ettirip cevirerek kodu gir ve
kahramanlarimizin kilidi acmasina yardim et!

original:
Correct!

There are actually a few valid solutions, but
here's one example:

2 1 3
3 2 1
1 3 2

Every line of three digits adds up to six. As
each panel has only two possible digits, you
don't have many three-digit totals to
consider.
translation:
Dogru!

Aslinda birkac gecerli cozum var; iste bir ornek:

2 1 3
3 2 1
1 3 2

Her uclu satir 6 eder. Her panelde yalnizca iki
olasi rakam oldugu icin, dusunmen gereken
uclu toplam sayisi cok fazla degil.

original:
Too bad.

There are more numbers on the backs of
the panels. Which numbers do you have to
choose from?
translation:
Olmadi.

Panellerin arkasinda daha fazla sayi var.
Hangi sayilar arasindan secim yapabiliyorsun?

original:
First, start by flipping all the panels to see
which numbers there are.

Surprisingly, there are only a few different
numbers you can use.
translation:
Once tum panelleri cevirip hangi sayilar
olduguna bak.

Sasirtici sekilde kullanabilecegin farkli sayi
cok az.

original:
There are only three different numbers:
1, 2 and 3.

What do these numbers add up to?
translation:
Sadece uc farkli sayi var:
1, 2 ve 3.

Bu sayilar kac eder?

original:
Adding 1, 2 and 3 gives you 6.

With a bit of trial and error, you should
be able to arrange the panels so that the
lines add up to 6 vertically, horizontally
and diagonally.
translation:
1, 2 ve 3'u toplarsan 6 eder.

Biraz deneme-yanilmayla panelleri oyle
yerlestirebilirsin ki cizgiler dikey, yatay ve
caprazda 6'ya tamamlanir.

original:
Here are the diagonal combinations.

One is 2, 2, 2.

The other is 3, 2, 1 from top to bottom.

The remaining four panels are up to you
to work out.
translation:
Capraz kombinasyonlar soyle.

Biri 2, 2, 2.

Digeri yukaridan asagi 3, 2, 1.

Kalan dort paneli de sen bulmalisin.

original: Beat the mummies!
translation: Mumyalari yen!

original:
These two mechanical mummies are moving
in to attack Hershel!

Luckily, he has spotted that the mummies
can only move along the grooves in the tiled
floor. Take full advantage of this and help
Hershel get rid of the mummies by leading
them into the pit!

You'll need to get them to fall into the pit
from the tile immediately above it.
translation:
Bu iki mekanik mumya Hershel'e saldirmak
uzere geliyor!

Neyse ki Hershel, mumyalarin sadece
zemindeki oluklar boyunca
hareket edebildigini fark etti. Bunu sonuna
kadar kullan ve onlari cukura yonlendirerek
Hershel'in mumyalardan kurtulmasina yardim et!

Onlari cukura, hemen ustundeki kareden
dusurmen gerekiyor.

original:
Correct!

Congratulations, you've defeated those
mechanical menaces!
translation:
Dogru!

Tebrikler, bu mekanik belalari yendin!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
First, go right from the start point to get
to a safe place where the mummies can't
get you.

From there, you can watch their movements
and examine the panels, allowing you to
work out how to create a path that will drop
them in the pit.
translation:
Once baslangic noktasindan saga giderek,
mumyalarin ulasamayacagi guvenli bir yere
gec.

Oradan hareketlerini izleyip panelleri
inceleyebilir, onlari cukura dusurecek yolu
nasil olusturacagini bulabilirsin.

original:
There's no single solution for this puzzle.
You just need to get used to the unusual
control method and master how to move
the tiles around.
translation:
Bu bulmacanin tek bir cozumu yok.
Sadece alisilmadik kontrol yontemine
alisip karolari nasil hareket ettirecegini
ustaca ogrenmen gerekiyor.

original:
Here's an example. From the start point,
go right, down, right, up, left, down, right,
down and then wait. The bottom mummy will
fall into the pit.

Just be careful the other fiend doesn't
get you.
translation:
Iste bir ornek. Baslangictan saga, asagi,
saga, yukari, sola, asagi, saga, asagi git
ve sonra bekle. Alttaki mumya cukura
dusecek.

Sadece digerinin seni yakalamasina
dikkat et.

original:
Once you've dispatched the first mummy by
following Hint 3, move in the following way:
left, up, left, up three times, right, down,
down, left, up, right, down and then right.

Just keep an eye on the mummy as you
move. Otherwise, you might have trouble
getting it to fall into the pit.
translation:
Ipucu 3'u uygulayip ilk mumyayi
gonderdikten sonra soyle ilerle:
sola, yukari, sola, uc kez yukari, saga, asagi,
asagi, sola, yukari, saga, asagi ve sonra saga.

Hareket ederken gozunu mumyadan ayirma.
Yoksa onu cukura dusurmekte zorlanabilirsin.

original: Arrange the totem blocks!
translation: Totem bloklarini diz!

original:
The totem pranksters have piled up these
blocks in a cave. There should be four
columns here, arranged like a staircase, as
shown in the picture in the top right.

Can you put the columns back in order
again?

There is, however, one crucial condition:
<CR>you may only use the mallet once</C>. Take
your time and make one well-placed hit!
translation:
Totem sakacilari bu
bloklari bir magarada yigmis. Sag ustteki
resimde gosterildigi gibi, burada merdiven
seklinde dizilmis dort sutun olmali.

Sutunlari tekrar duzene sokabilir misin?

Ama cok onemli bir sart var:
<CR>tokmagi sadece bir kez kullanabilirsin</C>. Acele etme ve tek,
iyi hedeflenmis bir vurus yap!

original:
Well done!

You got the idea. The only way to do it in
one hit was to lean the whole base to one
side. Sometimes it's good to think outside
the box!
translation:
Tebrikler!

Fikri kaptin. Bunu tek vurusta yapmanin
tek yolu butun tabani bir tarafa
yatirmakti. Bazen kalibin disina
cikmak iyidir!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
You can only make one hit with the mallet.
If you're finding yourself at a loss, just
have a go at hitting somewhere and see
what happens.
translation:
Tokmakla yalnizca bir vurus yapabilirsin.
Tikandiysan, bir yere vurmayi deneyip
ne olacagina bak.

original:
Whatever you try, it doesn't look as if you'll
be able to get all the blocks in the right
place with just one hit. So what can the
solution be here?
translation:
Ne yaparsan yap, tek vurusla
butun bloklari dogru
yere getirebilecekmissin gibi gorunmuyor.
Oyleyse cozum ne olabilir?

original:
Look carefully over the whole scene on the
top screen. Is there anywhere that looks
as if it might break?
translation:
Ust ekrandaki tum sahneyi dikkatle incele.
Kirilabilecek gibi gorunen bir yer var mi?

original:
The blocks are all standing on a stone base.
If you look at the left end of that base, you'll
notice a little crack. Try giving that a whack!
translation:
Bloklarin hepsi tas bir tabanin uzerinde duruyor.
O tabanin sol ucuna bakarsan
kucuk bir catlak gorursun. Ona bir vurmayi dene!

original: What's missing?
translation: Ne eksik?

original:
An elite archaeological team unearthed a
stone tablet in the remains of an ancient
settlement. According to one excited
researcher, it's a near perfect specimen of
arithmetic homework from the era.

The strange letters represent numbers,
while the operators +, - and = are the same
as the ones we use today!

Sadly, the bottom-right corner of the tablet
is broken. What should the missing section
say?
translation:
Seckin bir arkeoloji ekibi, antik bir
yerlesimin kalintilarinda bir tas tablet
buldu. Heyecanli bir arastirmaciya gore,
bu tablet donemin aritmetik odevi
neredeyse kusursuz bir ornegi.

Tuhaf harfler sayilari temsil ediyor,
+, - ve = islecleri ise bugun kullandiklarimizla
ayni!

Ne yazik ki tabletin sag alt kosesi kirik.
Eksik bolumde ne yazmali?

original:
Correct!

The answer looks a bit like CB and stands
for 87, as shown above.

The number each character represents is
actually the number of sides that it has!
translation:
Dogru!

Cevap biraz CB'ye benziyor ve
yukarida gosterildigi gibi 87'yi ifade ediyor.

Her karakterin temsil ettigi sayi,
aslinda sahip oldugu kenar sayisi!

original:
Too bad.

The people of the ancient civilisation didn't
just create the characters at random.
There's a logical connection between each
character and the number it represents.
translation:
Olmadi.

Antik uygarligin insanlari bu karakterleri
rastgele uydurmadi.
Her karakter ile temsil ettigi sayi arasinda
mantikli bir baglanti var.

original:
The character that looks a bit like a C
represents the number 8.

With this in mind, can you work out the
pattern?
translation:
C'ye benzeyen karakter
8 sayisini temsil ediyor.

Bunu aklinda tutarak, deseni
bulabilir misin?

original:
The character that looks a bit like a B
represents the number 7.

By the way, there's no relationship between
the alphabet and the numbers. It's just a
coincidence that these characters look like
letters of the alphabet.
translation:
B'ye benzeyen karakter
7 sayisini temsil ediyor.

Bu arada, alfabe ile sayilar arasinda
bir iliski yok. Bu karakterlerin harflere
benzemesi sadece bir tesaduf.

original:
The ▲ character represents the number 3.

Look closely at the shapes used to represent
3, 7 and 8. If you spot the pattern, it will be
easy to work out what the other characters
are.
translation:
▲ karakteri 3 sayisini temsil ediyor.

3, 7 ve 8'i temsil eden sekillere dikkatlice bak.
Deseni fark edersen, diger karakterlerin
ne oldugunu bulmak kolay olacaktir.

original:
The number of sides a character has tells
you what number it represents.

Now, the puzzle is just a question of
arithmetic.
translation:
Bir karakterin kac kenari oldugu,
hangi sayiyi temsil ettigini soyler.

Artik bulmaca sadece
aritmetik meselesi.

original: Put the statue back.
translation: Heykeli yerine koy.

original:
The museum curator is talking to the other
staff:
{''}The mysterious thief has brought back our
museum's precious statue. I'm trying to put
it back in the deepest part of the warehouse
so it can never be stolen again, but with so
much other stuff in the way, it's proving
rather difficult. Can anyone give me
a hand?{''}

Shift the crates around the warehouse and
get the statue back into the far-left alcove.
translation:
Muze kuratoru diger
personele sesleniyor:
{''}Gizemli hirsiz, muzemizin degerli
heykelini geri getirdi. Bir daha asla
calinamasin diye onu deponun en
derin yerine koymaya calisiyorum, ama
arada bu kadar cok esya olunca is
epey zorlasiyor. Bana yardim edebilecek
kimse var mi?{''}

Kasalari depoda kaydirip yerlerini degistirerek
heykeli en soldaki oyuk alana geri koy.

original:
Correct!

{''}Phew, that was a real challenge! Great
work from the security guards, there.
Thanks!

Hang on a minute... Oh no! While we've
been focusing on putting this statue away,
there's been no one left to guard the
museum!{''}
translation:
Dogru!

{''}Oh be, bu gercekten zorlu bir isti!
Guvenlik gorevlileri harika is cikardi.
Tesekkurler!

Bir dakika... Aman hayir! Heykeli yerine
koymaya odaklanmisken, muzeyi koruyacak
kimse kalmadi!{''}

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
This taxing puzzle takes no fewer than
101 moves to complete, but don't despair!

Your first step is to move the two little vertical
rectangular crates into the alcove on the far
left. Eventually, you'll want to put a square
crate in that alcove, though, so start working
towards that goal.
translation:
Bu yorucu bulmacayi tamamlamak icin
tam 101 hamle gerekir, ama umudunu kesme!

Ilk adimin, iki kucuk dikey dikdortgen kasayi
en soldaki oyuga tasimak. Sonunda o oyuga
kare bir kasa koymak isteyeceksin; simdiden
o hedefe dogru ilerlemeye basla.

original:
Have you got a square crate into the alcove
on the left?

Your next goal is to shift the two large,
rectangular crates to the left side. Keep
pushing and shoving with that aim in mind.
translation:
Soldaki oyuk alana bir kare kasa
yerlestirebildin mi?

Siradaki hedefin iki buyuk dikdortgen kasayi
sol tarafa kaydirmak. Bu amacla itip kakmaya
devam et.

original:
Once you've shifted the large, rectangular
crates so that they both stand on the left,
it's nearly time to start moving the statue.

It'll want to slide out, and then work its
way left via the top. In the meantime, you
can fit the two small vertical rectangular
crates into the exit space on the far right.
translation:
Buyuk dikdortgen kasalari ikisi de solda
duracak sekilde kaydirdiginda, heykeli
tasimaya baslama zamani yaklasiyor.

Heykel once disari kayacak, sonra ustten
sola dogru ilerleyecek. Bu sirada iki kucuk
dikey dikdortgen kasayi en sagdaki cikis
bosluguna sigdirabilirsin.

original:
When you finally move the statue into its
place, the crates are positioned thus:
The two short, vertical crates are on the far
right. Both long, narrow crates are in the top
right, and below them is a large, rectangular
crate. One square crate is to the left of the
long, narrow ones and below it lies the other
big, rectangular crate. Under that is one little
horizontal crate. The other horizontal crate is
in the top left and in the bottom left is a
square one.
translation:
Sonunda heykeli yerine koydugunda,
kasalar su sekilde konumlanir:
Iki kisa, dikey kasa en sagdadir. Iki uzun,
dar kasa sag usttedir ve onlarin altinda
buyuk bir dikdortgen kasa vardir. Bir kare
kasa uzun, dar kasalarin solundadir ve onun
altinda diger buyuk dikdortgen kasa durur.
Onun altinda kucuk yatay bir kasa vardir.
Diger yatay kasa sol usttedir ve sol altta
bir kare kasa bulunur.

original: Which should you rotate?
translation: Hangisini dondurmelisin?

original:
This book is locked up tight by some
mysterious contrivance.

The trick to opening it lies in the ten
arrow-shaped jewels adorning the cover.
These jewels are arranged in a particular
pattern, and rotating just one arrow will
release the lock.

Which jewel should you rotate in order to
open the book?
translation:
Bu kitap gizemli bir mekanizma tarafindan
sikica kilitlenmis.

Onu acmanin sirri,
kapagi susleyen ok seklindeki on mucevherde.
Bu mucevherler belirli bir duzenle dizilmis
ve sadece bir oku dondurmek
kilidi acacak.

Kitabi acmak icin
hangi mucevheri dondurmelisin?

original:
Correct!

You need to rotate the top-left arrow so that
it's pointing to the right.

Each jewel is placed so that the arrow is
pointing to one other jewel.

If you trace a route from one arrow, you'll
eventually end up back where you started.
translation:
Dogru!

Sol ustteki oku, saga
bakacak sekilde dondurmelisin.

Her mucevher, uzerindeki okun
baska bir mucevheri isaret edecegi sekilde yerlestirilmis.

Bir oktan baslayip guzergahi izlersen,
en sonunda basladigin yere geri donersin.

original:
Too bad.

Pay attention to the shape of the jewels.
translation:
Olmadi.

Mucevherlerin sekline dikkat et.

original:
Someone's moved one of the ten jewels to
put it out of step with the rest.

See if you can find something that most of
the jewels have in common.
translation:
Biri on mucevherden birini
digerlerinin duzeninden cikarmis.

Mucevherlerin cogunun
ortak bir ozelligini bulmaya calis.

original:
The jewels look like arrows, right?

The direction those arrows are pointing is the
key. Where do they point?
translation:
Mucevherler ok gibi gorunuyor, degil mi?

Bu oklarin baktigi yon
anahtar. Neyi isaret ediyorlar?

original:
Trace a line from each arrow and see if you
can find the odd one out.
translation:
Her okun cizgisini takip et ve
farkli olani bulabilir misin?

original:
Aside from the jewel that someone has
moved, each jewel's arrow points at another
jewel.

Can you find the jewel that doesn't point at
any other one? That's the jewel you're
looking for!
translation:
Birinin yerini degistirdigi mucevher disinda,
her mucevherin oku baska bir mucevheri gosterir.

Hicbirini isaret etmeyen
mucevheri bulabilir misin? Aradigin mucevher
iste o!

original: Make each line weigh 34 g.
translation: Her satir 34 g olsun.

original:
These colourful marbles are all the same
size, but each one has a different weight.
The number on each marble tells you its
weight in grams.

Your challenge is to arrange the marbles
in the grid so that each line of four weighs
34 grams in total.

Some of the marbles are already in place.
Can you work out where the rest of them
need to go?
translation:
Bu renkli misketlerin hepsi ayni boyda,
ama her birinin agirligi farkli. Her misketin
uzerindeki sayi, gram cinsinden agirligini
gosterir.

Gorevin, misketleri izgaraya oyle yerlestirmek
ki dortlu her satirin toplami 34 gram olsun.

Bazi misketler zaten yerinde. Kalanlarin
nereye gitmesi gerektigini bulabilir misin?

original:
Correct!

Each line weighs 34 grams!
translation:
Dogru!

Her satir 34 gram!

original:
Too bad.

Something doesn't add up.
translation:
Olmadi.

Bir seyler tutmuyor.

original:
The simplest place to start is the line in the
top left.
translation: Baslamak icin en kolay yer, sol ustteki satir.

original:
Have a look at the line with 11 and 8, and
the line with 6 and 3.

These two lines share a space. Try working
out which marble goes here.
translation:
11 ve 8'in oldugu satira ve
6 ve 3'un oldugu satira bak.

Bu iki satir bir kareyi paylasiyor. Buraya
hangi misketin gelmesi gerektigini bul.

original:
The line with 11 and 8 needs another
15 grams. The line with 6 and 3 needs
25 grams. You can fill these lines with the
marbles weighing 5, 10 and 15 grams.

The marble that goes in the shared space
weighs 10 grams.

Now try working through the other lines in a
similar way.
translation:
11 ve 8'in oldugu satirin 15 grama daha
ihtiyaci var. 6 ve 3'un oldugu satirin ise
25 grama. Bu satirlari 5, 10 ve 15 gramlik
misketlerle tamamlayabilirsin.

Ortak kareye gelecek misket 10 gramdir.

Simdi diger satirlarda da benzer sekilde
ilerle.

original:
After following Hint 3, you should have a line
containing 14 and 5. This shares a space
with the line containing 7 and 16.

The line with 14 and 5 needs another
15 grams, while the line with 7 and 16 is
11 grams shy of 34. Fill these lines with
the 2-, 9- and 13-gram marbles.

After that, you just have to plug in any
remaining marbles and you're done!
translation:
Ipucu 3'u uyguladiktan sonra 14 ve 5
iceren bir satirin olmali. Bu satir, 7 ve 16
iceren satirla bir kareyi paylasir.

14 ve 5'in oldugu satirin 15 grama daha,
7 ve 16'nin oldugu satirin ise 34'e ulasmak icin
11 grama ihtiyaci var. Bu satirlari 2, 9 ve 13
gramlik misketlerle doldur.

Sonra kalan misketleri yerlestirmen yeter;
bitti!

original: Find the odd one out.
translation: Farkli olani bul.

original:
Here's a popular ride found at fairgrounds
everywhere - the spinning teacups! Well...
something like that, at least. Aren't those
pumpkins?!

Anyway, of these five spinning cups, one
is not like all the others. Can you find the
odd one out?
translation:
Iste lunaparklarda
her yerde gordugun populer bir oyuncak - donen cay
fincanlari! Gerci...
pek oyle sayilmaz. Onlar
balkabagi degil mi?!

Her neyse, bu bes donen fincandan biri
otekilere benzemiyor. Farkli olani
bulabilir misin?

original:
Fair play!

The seats are split into coloured segments,
and every pumpkin except B has the same
order of colours.

It's hard to tell with all that spinning, though!
translation:
Bravo!

Koltuklar renkli dilimlere ayrilmis ve B
haric her balkabaginda renk sirasi ayni.

Ama bu kadar donunce
anlamak zor tabii!

original:
Too bad.

It'd be so much easier if they weren't all
spinning!
translation:
Olmadi.

Hepsi donmeseydi
cok daha kolay olurdu!

original:
The creepy faces on the outside of the cups
don't have anything in common.

You'll have to look elsewhere to find the
difference.
translation:
Dis yuzeydeki urkutucu yuzlerin
ortak bir yani yok.

Farki bulmak icin
baska yere bakmalisin.

original:
There are orange, blue and white cups, so
there's no real pattern there.

Try looking for something that most of the
cups have in common.
translation:
Turuncu, mavi ve beyaz fincanlar var,
yani orada gercek bir desen yok.

Cogu fincanda ortak olan
bir seye bakmayi dene.

original:
Did you notice that the seats inside the cups
are different colours?

With a closer look at this, you might even
find the odd one out.
translation:
Fincanlarin icindeki koltuklarin
farkli renklerde oldugunu fark ettin mi?

Buna yakindan bakarsan,
farkli olani bile bulabilirsin.

original:
Is the spinning a bit too much for you?

Well, here's a little tip: use the Memo
Function to freeze time itself!
translation:
Donme isi biraz fazla mi geldi?

O halde kucuk bir ipucu: Zamani
dondurmak icin Memo
islevini kullan!

original: Arrange the jewels!
translation: Mucevherleri diz!

original:
There's a special way to arrange these
jewels. Can you work it out?

① Viewed from the north, the diamond is
right of the ruby and the emerald is left of
the sapphire.
② From the east, the emerald is right of the
diamond.
③ From the south, the ruby is left of the
sapphire.
④ From the west, the sapphire is on the far
right, the ruby is on the far left and two
jewels lie between them.
translation:
Bu mucevherleri dizmenin ozel bir yolu var.
Bunu bulabilir misin?

① Kuzeyden bakinca, elmas
yakutun saginda; zumrut ise
safirin solunda.
② Dogudan bakinca, zumrut
elmasin saginda.
③ Guneyden bakinca, yakut
safirin solunda.
④ Batidan bakinca, safir en
sagda, yakut en
solda ve aralarinda iki
mucevher var.

original:
Correct!

You need to arrange the jewels as shown.

Clues ① and ③ tell you the order of the
gems from west to east.

Clues ② and ④ tell you the order going from
north to south.
translation:
Dogru!

Mucevherleri gosterildigi gibi dizmelisin.

Ipuclari ① ve ③, taslarin batidan doguya
sirasini verir.

Ipuclari ② ve ④ ise kuzeyden guneye
sirasini verir.

original:
Too bad.

There's something amiss about that
arrangement. Have another look at the
clues and try again.
translation:
Olmadi.

Bu dizilimde bir terslik var.
Ipuclarina tekrar bakip yeniden dene.

original:
The cardinal directions north, south, east
and west correspond to the top, bottom, right
and left of the board respectively.

You'll have a hard time if you just look from
one direction at a time. Try combining two
points of view at the same time when working
this one out.
translation:
Kuzey, guney, dogu ve bati yonleri sirasiyla
tahtanin ust, alt, sag ve sol taraflarina
karsilik gelir.

Sadece tek bir yonden bakarak cozmeye
calisirsan zorlanirsin. Iki bakis acisini ayni
anda birlestirerek dusun.

original:
Try starting with clues ① and ③, which
describe the view from the north and south.

Don't forget that when you're looking from
the north, the right-hand side will be west,
not east.
translation:
Once kuzey ve guneyden gorunumu anlatan
① ve ③ numarali ipuclariyla baslamayi dene.

Kuzeyden bakarken sag tarafin dogu degil,
bati olacagini unutma.

original:
According to clue ①, the diamond is west of
the ruby, and the emerald is east of the
sapphire. Clue ③ tells you that the ruby is to
the west of the sapphire.

By combining these two clues, you can work
out the order of jewels from west to east:
diamond, ruby, sapphire, emerald.
translation:
①'e gore elmas, yakutun batisinda; zumrut
ise safirin dogusunda. ③ ise yakutun
safirin batisinda oldugunu soyler.

Bu iki ipucunu birlestirince batidan doguya
sira soyle olur: elmas, yakut, safir, zumrut.

original:
Clue ② tells you that the emerald is to the
north of the diamond. Clue ④ tells you that
the sapphire is the furthest to the south, and
the ruby is the furthest to the north.

Based on this, you can work the order from
north to south: ruby, emerald, diamond,
sapphire.
translation:
②, zumrudun elmasin kuzeyinde oldugunu
soyler. ④ ise safirin en guneyde, yakutun
ise en kuzeyde oldugunu belirtir.

Buna gore kuzeyden guneye sira: yakut,
zumrut, elmas, safir.

original: Connect the cable!
translation: Kabloyu bagla!

original:
Oh no! A cable section in this circuit has
come loose and now the Ferris wheel's
controls don't work! You have to repair the
yellow cable quickly!

Fix the circuit by moving the long yellow
section down into the gap at the bottom of
the grid.
translation:
Hayir! Bu devredeki bir kablo parcasi
yerinden cikti ve donme dolabin kontrolleri
calismiyor! Sari kabloyu cabucak
tamir etmelisin!

Izgaranin altindaki bosluga uzun sari
parcayi asagi kaydirarak devreyi duzelt.

original:
Well done!

If you solved the puzzle in 18 moves, give
yourself a round of applause!

Now the Ferris wheel should be back under
control!
translation:
Aferin!

Bulmacayi 18 hamlede cozduysen kendini
alkisla!

Simdi donme dolap yeniden kontrol altinda
olmali!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
You can solve this puzzle in 18 moves.

First, slide the yellow section, ⑩, to the top
right, and slot ⑪ and ⑫ into the resulting
gap.

The next piece to move is ⑬, the clock.
translation:
Bu bulmacayi 18 hamlede cozebilirsin.

Once sari parca ⑩'u sag uste kaydir ve olusan
bosluga ⑪ ve ⑫'yi yerlestir.

Siradaki hareket ettirilecek parca ⑬, saat.

original:
Continuing from Hint 1, make sure ⑬ is
against the left edge, then slide ⑭ up next
to ⑬.

Looks a bit tidier now, doesn't it? The next
few moves are tricky, though.
translation:
Ipucu 1'den devam: ⑬'un sol kenara
dayandigindan emin ol, sonra ⑭'u ⑬'un
yanina yukari kaydir.

Biraz daha duzenli gorundu, degil mi?
Ama sonraki birkac hamle zor.

original:
Continuing from Hint 2:
1. Move ⑮ to the far right of the second row
from the bottom.
2. Move ⑩ above ⑮, then slide ⑪ and ⑫
into the now vacant top-right space.
3. Move ⑬ into the top-left corner and slot
⑭ between ⑬ and ⑫.
4. Move ⑩ to the left edge of the third row
from the bottom.

You're nearly there!
translation:
Ipucu 2'den devam:
1. ⑮'i alttan ikinci siranin en sagina tasi.
2. ⑩'u ⑮'in ustune getir, sonra ⑪ ve ⑫'yi
bosalan sag ust alana kaydir.
3. ⑬'u sol ust koseye al ve ⑭'u ⑬ ile ⑫'nin
arasina yerlestir.
4. ⑩'u alttan ucuncu siranin sol kenarina tasi.

Neredeyse bitti!

original:
Continuing from Hint 3:
1. Move ⑭ down one row.
2. Move ⑫ one column left.
3. Move ⑮ into the small gap created by
moving ⑫.
4. Move ⑩ all the way to the right.

Now if you move ⑯ out of the way, you can
slot the yellow section into place.
translation:
Ipucu 3'ten devam:
1. ⑭'u bir sira asagi indir.
2. ⑫'yi bir sutun sola kaydir.
3. ⑫'yi hareket ettirince olusan kucuk bosluga
⑮'i yerlestir.
4. ⑩'u en saga kadar kaydir.

Simdi ⑯'yi kenara cekersen, uzun sari parcayi
yerine oturtabilirsin.

original: Untangle the strings!
translation: Ipleri coz!

original:
Our loveable clown is once again all strung
up with nowhere to go. Give him a hand by
untangling the strings.

Touch any of the orange points on the
Touch Screen to swap around the strings
to the left and right of that point. Keep
swapping them around until you can pull
him free!

It's possible to untangle all five strings in
as few as six moves.
translation:
Sevimli palyacomuz bir kez daha
iplerle baglanmis, kimildayamiyor. Ona yardim et ve
ipleri coz.

Dokunmatik Ekrandaki turuncu noktalardan
herhangi birine dokunarak, o noktanin solundaki ve sagindaki
ipleri yer degistir. Cekip
onu ozgur birakana kadar
degistirmeye devam et!

Bes ipin tamamini
sadece alti hamlede cozmek mumkun.

original:
Correct!

Now let's hope the poor fellow doesn't
get himself tied in knots yet again.
translation:
Dogru!

Simdi umalim da zavalli
bir daha kendini dugumlemesin.

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
There are five strings this time, so the puzzle
is more complicated. Don't just swap the
strings around willy-nilly or you may tangle
up the strings even more.

It's best to start by untangling the string on
the far right.
translation:
Bu sefer bes ip var, yani bulmaca
daha karmasik. Ipleri gelisi guzel
yer degistirirsen,
daha da cok dolastirabilirsin.

En iyisi en sagdaki ipi
cozerek baslamak.

original:
Touch the orange point in the bottom-right
corner followed by the one just above it.
That should get the string on the far right
out of the picture.

Next, try to untangle the string on the far
left.
translation:
Sag alt kosedeki turuncu noktaya,
ardindan hemen ustundekine dokun.
Bu, en sagdaki ipi
devre disi birakmali.

Sonra en soldaki ipi
cozmeyi dene.

original:
After Hint 2, the string on the far right should
be untangled.

Now touch the orange point second from the
left on the bottom row, followed by the point
furthest to the left on the row above.

This will untangle the string on the far left.
translation:
2. ipucundan sonra en sagdaki ip
cozulmus olmali.

Simdi alt sirada soldan ikinci turuncu noktaya,
ardindan ust sirada en soldaki
noktaya dokun.

Bu, en soldaki ipi cozer.

original:
Once you've untangled the strings on the far
left and right, touch the orange point second
from the left and second from the top. Then
touch the point directly below that.

Next, touch the orange point second from
the right and second from the top. This will
untangle the second string from the right.
The rest is up to you!
translation:
En soldaki ve en sagdaki ipleri cozdukten sonra,
soldan ikinci ve yukaridan ikinci turuncu noktaya
dokun. Sonra
onun hemen altindaki noktaya dokun.

Ardindan sagdan ikinci ve yukaridan ikinci
turuncu noktaya dokun. Bu,
sagdan ikinci ipi
cozer. Gerisi sana kalmis!

original: Make a layered mosaic!
translation: Katmanli mozaik yap!

original:
Three colours of small tiles were put up on
a wall to make a fancy mosaic mural. You'd
like to make something similar, but you only
have large tiles that are 2 x 2 squares each.

Can you make the same design as on the
mural using the large tiles you have? You
may overlap them as much as you want.
translation:
Uc renkte kucuk karolar, gosterisli bir
mozaik duvar resmi olusturmak icin bir
duvara yerlestirildi. Buna benzer bir sey
yapmak istiyorsun, ama elinde sadece
her biri 2 x 2 kare olan buyuk karolar var.

Elindeki buyuk karolarla duvardaki desenin
aynisini yapabilir misin? Istedigin kadar
ust uste bindirebilirsin.

original:
That's right!

You did a great job of recreating this snazzy
mosaic!
translation:
Iste bu!

Bu sik mozaigi yeniden olusturmakta
harika is cikardin!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
It seems hard because there aren't really
any distinctive parts, but once you've worked
out the pattern it's a cinch.

Just keep the four white tiles in reserve for
last.
translation:
Belirgin bir parca olmadigi icin zor gorunuyor,
ama deseni bir kez cozdugunde cocuk oyuncagi.

En son icin dort beyaz karoyu ayir.

original:
There are a few ways to complete the
pattern, but the easiest way is to form the
orange and green squares in the corners
one by one.

Start with the orange and green square in
the top-left corner.
translation:
Deseni tamamlamanin birkac yolu var,
ama en kolayi koselerdeki turuncu ve
yesil kareleri tek tek olusturmaktir.

Sol ust kosedeki turuncu-yesil kareyle basla.

original:
Here's a more detailed explanation:

Start with an orange tile in the top left. Place
two green tiles, one overlapping the right half
of the orange, and then another overlapping
the bottom half of the orange.

Now stick an orange tile one square down
and to the right of the corner to finish the
square. Use the same method for the
bottom-right corner.
translation:
Daha ayrintili bir aciklama:

Sol ustte bir turuncu karo ile basla. Iki yesil
karo yerlestir: biri turuncunun sag yarisinin,
digeri turuncunun alt yarisinin uzerine gelecek.

Sonra koseden bir kare asagi ve bir kare saga
bir turuncu karo koyarak kareyi tamamla.
Ayni yontemi sag alt kose icin de kullan.

original:
Use the method explained in Hint 3 to
handle all four corners. You'll have to invert
the colours when dealing with the top-right
and bottom-left corners.

The centre should have turned orange and
green in the process, so now just finish up
by placing the last four white tiles!
translation:
3. Ipucunda anlatilan yontemi dort kose icin
kullan. Sag ust ve sol alt koselerde calisirken
renkleri tersine cevirmen gerekecek.

Bu sirada orta kisim turuncu ve yesil olmus
olmali; simdi de son dort beyaz karoyu koyup
bitir!

original: Rearrange the inscription!
translation: Yaziyi yeniden duzenle!

original:
Here's a copy of the characters inscribed on
the wall, torn up into 16 squares and
arranged in the same way.

Move the pieces of paper so that they form
a 4 x 4 square. However, you can only
move the pieces horizontally and vertically
in sets of four.

Rearrange the pieces of paper to put the
diagram on the wall back in order.
translation:
Iste duvara kazinmis karakterlerin
16 kareye bolunmus ve
ayni sekilde dizilmis bir kopyasi.

Kagit parcalarini hareket ettirerek
4 x 4 bir kare olustur. Ancak
parcalari yalnizca yatay ve dikey
olarak dorderli gruplar halinde oynatabilirsin.

Kagitlari yeniden duzenleyerek
duvardaki semayi tekrar dogru hale getir.

original:
Correct!

The lines of the ancient inscription seem to
create some kind of map. Superimposed on
the map is a diagram in the shape of the
Plough, the seven brightest stars of Ursa
Major.

The Plough is commonly used to find Polaris,
the North Star... Does the Plough in this
map also point to something?
translation:
Dogru!

Kadim yazitin cizgileri bir tur
harita olusturuyor gibi. Haritanin uzerine
Buyuk Kepce seklinde bir cizim
bindirilmis; Buyuk Ayi takimyildizinin
en parlak yedi yildizi.

Buyuk Kepce genelde Polaris'i,
Kutupyildizi'ni bulmak icin kullanilir...
Peki bu haritadaki Kepce de bir seyi mi gosteriyor?

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
You can solve this puzzle in three moves.

The puzzle will just get harder if you make
mistakes, so it's best to simply restart if you
come a cropper.
translation:
Bu bulmacayi uc hamlede cozebilirsin.

Hata yaparsan bulmaca sadece zorlasir,
bu yuzden isleri batirirsan en iyisi
yeniden baslatmaktir.

original:
The ancient script here must make it quite
hard to work out how you're supposed to
rearrange the pieces.

Pay close attention to the red lines. It's not
clear what they're supposed to represent,
but it looks as if connecting the lines is
the key.
translation:
Buradaki eski yazi, parcalari nasil
yeniden duzenlemen gerektigini
anlamani zorlastiriyor olmali.

Kirmizi cizgilere cok dikkat et. Ne
temsil ettikleri belli degil,
ama cizgileri birlestirmek
anahtar gibi gorunuyor.

original:
For your first move, shift the four pieces in
the third column from the left up one row.

That should help you start connecting the
red lines. Any idea what they mean?
translation:
Ilk hamle olarak, soldan ucuncu sutundaki
dort parcayi bir satir yukari kaydir.

Bu, kirmizi cizgileri birlestirmeye baslamana
yardim eder. Ne anlama geldiklerini dusunuyor musun?

original:
Continuing from Hint 3, move the four pieces
in the second column from the right down
a row.

Can you work out the last move you need to
make to solve the puzzle?
translation:
Ipucu 3'un devaminda, sagdan ikinci
sutundaki dort parcayi
bir satir asagi indir.

Bulmacayi cozmek icin gereken son hamleyi
bulabilir misin?

original: Point to the centre!
translation: Merkeze isaret et!

original:
Four mysterious pillars have risen up! The
ruins' mechanism will activate when the
arrows on each pillar point to the centre.

However, the pillars will only turn if Layton
and Angela step on opposing buttons at the
same time. When you have Layton press a
button, Angela will press the one opposite.
Also, keep in mind that they won't be able to
press the same buttons twice in a row.

Work together to save the city!
translation:
Dort gizemli sutun yukseldi! Harabelerin
mekanizmasi, her sutundaki oklar
merkeze baktiginda etkinlesecek.

Ancak sutunlar yalnizca Layton ile Angela
ayni anda karsilikli dugmelere basarsa doner.
Layton bir dugmeye bastiginda,
Angela da tam karsisindakine basar.
Ayrica, art arda iki kez
ayni dugmelere basamayacaklarini unutma.

Sehri kurtarmak icin birlikte calis!

original:
Correct!

You've solved the riddle at the heart of
Akbadain. But will it be enough to save
the city?
translation:
Dogru!

Akbadain'in kalbindeki bilmeceyi cozdun.
Peki bu sehri kurtarmaya yetecek mi?

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
First, have Layton and Angela step on some
buttons and see what happens.

By the way, you can solve this puzzle with
just four sets of button-presses.
translation:
Once Layton ile Angela'ya birkac dugmeye
bastir ve ne olduguna bak.

Bu arada, bu bulmacayi
sadece dort dugme basisi setiyle
cozebilirsin.

original:
There are a total of eight buttons, but since
Angela will always press the button opposite
the one you choose for Layton, there are
only four possible ways to make changes on
the top screen.

Learn how to move the pillars, then think
carefully about which buttons to press in
order to move the arrows.
translation:
Toplam sekiz dugme var; ama Angela
her zaman Layton icin sectigin dugmenin
tam karsisindakine basacagi icin,
ust ekranda degisiklik yapmanin
sadece dort olasi yolu var.

Sutunlarin nasil hareket ettigini ogren,
sonra oklari hizalamak icin
hangi dugmelere basman gerektigini
dikkatle planla.

original:
You might want to avoid having Layton and
Angela press the buttons in the top right and
bottom left.

It's possible to use them to move the arrows
into position, but you'll really have to work
for it. You're better off having the pair use
the other buttons.
translation:
Layton ile Angela'nin
sag ust ve sol alt dugmelere basmasindan
kacinmak isteyebilirsin.

Oklari yerine getirmek icin onlari kullanmak
mumkun, ama cok ugrastirir.
Ikisini diger dugmeleri kullanmaya
yonlendirmen daha iyi.

original:
Have Layton press the top button once and
the top-left button twice. The fourth and final
button press should get the arrows to line
up.

The order in which the buttons are pressed
doesn't matter, but remember that they can't
press the same buttons twice in a row.
translation:
Layton'a ust dugmeye bir kez,
sol ust dugmeye de iki kez bastir.
Dorduncu ve son basis,
oklarin hizalanmasini saglamali.

Dugmelere basma sirasi onemli degil,
ama art arda iki kez
ayni dugmelere basamayacaklarini unutma.

original: Arrange the totem blocks!
translation: Totem bloklarini diz!

original:
The totem pranksters are up to their usual
tricks!

There should be five columns, arranged like
a podium, as shown in the picture in the
top right. Each column should have a totem
head on top in the order: yellow, blue,
purple, green, red. Can you help recreate
this ancient monument?

Note that <CR>you can never hit the top block
in a column</C> so you'll have to think about
which order to hit the blocks in.
translation:
Totem sakacilari yine her zamanki
numaralarinda!

Sag ustteki resimde gosterildigi gibi podyum seklinde
dizilmis bes sutun olmali. Her sutunun ustunde
asagidaki sirayla bir totem basi olmali: sari, mavi,
mor, yesil, kirmizi. Bu kadim aniti
yeniden olusturabilir misin?

Unutma: <CR>bir sutundaki en ust bloga
asla vuramazsin</C> bu yuzden
bloklara hangi sirayla vuracagini
iyi dusunmen gerekecek.

original:
Well done!

If the totems stay this happy even after such
an elaborate prank, there shouldn't be
anything to worry about!
translation:
Tebrikler!

Totemler boyle ayrintili bir sakadan sonra bile
mutlu kalabiliyorsa, endiselenecek
bir sey yok demektir!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
Begin with the leftmost column and hit the
second and third blocks down. That should
get you started!
translation:
En soldaki sutundan basla ve
en ustten ikinci ve ucuncu
bloklara vur. Bu seni baslatir!

original:
Next, hit the very bottom row of blocks from
the left.

Doesn't that make things look a bit easier?
translation:
Sonra, en alttaki blok sirasina
soldan vur.

Bu isleri biraz daha
kolaylastirmiyor mu?

original:
Continuing from Hint 2, hit the sad-looking
blue totem head from the right.

How is it looking now?
translation:
Ipucu 2'den devam ederek,
mutsuz gorunen mavi totem basina
sagdan vur.

Simdi nasil gorunuyor?

original:
Next, hit the green head from the left.

Hmm? Looks as though there's only one
place left to hit now. Give it your all!
translation:
Sonra yesil basa soldan
vur.

Hmm? Artik vuracak
sadece bir yer kalmis gibi. Tum gucunle vur!

original: Enthrone the emperor!
translation: Imparatoru tahta cikar!

original:
Our six local penguins have turned up on
another iceberg and the big emperor is once
again trying to nab the middle spot. All
penguins can move either horizontally or
vertically, but once in motion they won't stop
until they hit another penguin - if there's
nothing in the way, they'll plunge straight
into the sea.

Can you help the emperor find his way into
the middle?
translation:
Alti yerel penguenimiz
baska bir buzdaginda ortaya cikti ve buyuk
imparator yine orta noktayi
kapmaya calisiyor. Tum penguenler yatay ya da
dikey hareket edebilir, ama bir kez harekete gecince
baska bir penguene carpana kadar
durmazlar - onlerinde hicbir sey yoksa
dogruca denize
duserler.

Imparatorun orta kareye ulasmasina
yardim eder misin?

original:
Correct!

Did you know you can solve this puzzle in
six moves? Have another crack at it if you
haven't managed that yet!
translation:
Dogru!

Bu bulmacayi alti hamlede
cozebilecegini biliyor muydun? Bunu
basaramadiysan bir daha dene!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
This time round, you'll have to move three
penguins, including the emperor, to succeed.

Any ideas?
translation:
Bu kez, basarili olmak icin
imparator dahil uc
pengueni oynatman gerekecek.

Bir fikrin var mi?

original:
The first penguin is on the far left, third
square from the top.

Have a think about where you'll need to
move it.
translation:
Ilk penguen en solda,
ustten ucuncu
karede.

Onu nereye
tasiman gerektigini dusun.

original:
Here's how to move the penguin mentioned
in Hint 2:
Slide it right, down, left, then up. Be careful
not to slide another penguin by accident in
the process!
translation:
Ipucu 2'de bahsi gecen pengueni
soyle hareket ettir:
Saga, asagi, sola, sonra yukari kaydir. Bu sirada
yanlislikla baska bir pengueni de
kaydirmamaya dikkat et!

original:
The next penguin is on the top row, two
squares from the left. Move it right, down,
left, up and lastly, right.

All that's left is to move the emperor to the
centre square. Now you've come this far,
you should be able to work it out!
translation:
Siradaki penguen en ust sirada, soldan
iki kare iceride. Onu saga, asagi,
sola, yukari ve son olarak saga
kaydir.

Geriye sadece imparatoru
orta kareye tasimak kaliyor. Buraya kadar
geldigine gore gerisini
cozebilmelisin!

original: Turn all the rabbits brown!
translation: Tum tavsanlari kahverengi yap!

original:
Those odd rabbit toys keep hopping back!

There are three rules:
1. The rabbits can only move by jumping
horizontally, diagonally or vertically over
other rabbits.
2. They can jump over any number of
rabbits at once.
3. A white rabbit will turn brown when
jumped over, and vice versa.

Can you make all the rabbits here turn
brown, following the rules given above?
translation:
O tuhaf tavsan oyuncaklari yine ziplayip geri geliyor!

Uc kural var:
1. Tavsanlar yalnizca diger tavsanlarin uzerinden
yatay, capraz veya dikey
atlarak hareket edebilir.
2. Bir kerede istedigi kadar
tavsanin uzerinden atlayabilirler.
3. Uzerinden atlanan beyaz tavsan
kahverengiye doner, kahverengi
tavsan da beyaza.

Yukaridaki kurallara uyarak
buradaki tum tavsanlari
kahverengiye cevirebilir misin?

original:
Correct!

The rabbits have all changed colour
marvellously. And what an elegant solution!
translation:
Dogru!

Tavsanlarin hepsi harika
sekilde renk degistirdi. Ne kadar da
zarif bir cozum!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
You can do this in only 8 moves.

Think you're up to the challenge?
translation:
Bunu sadece 8 hamlede
yapabilirsin.

Meydan okumaya hazir misin?

original:
Start by moving the rabbits in each corner. It
doesn't matter where you start.
translation:
Koselerdeki tavsanlari oynatarak basla. 
Nereden basladigin
onemli degil.

original:
Have you moved the rabbits in each corner?

You're doing well as long as you avoid
turning any of the brown rabbits white.
translation:
Koselerdeki tavsanlari oynattin mi?

Kahverengi tavsanlarin
hicbirini beyaza cevirmedigin surece
iyi gidiyorsun.

original:
You should now have moved the white
rabbits in each corner and had them jump
over the rabbits next to them.

Next, use your new brown rabbits to jump
over the remaining white rabbits one by one.

That should do it!
translation:
Artik her kosedeki beyaz
tavsani oynatip yanindaki tavsanlarin
uzerinden atlatmis olmalisin.

Simdi yeni kahverengi tavsanlarini kullanarak
kalan beyaz tavsanlarin uzerinden
tek tek atla.

Bu is biter!

original: Flip the pizza face up!
translation: Pizzayi ustu yukari cevir!

original:
Our maladroit chef has mangled another
pizza and this one's a real cheesy mess...

He's trying to get it all face up again, but
this cheese topping is especially sticky and
every time he flips a slice, the adjacent
slices turn over with it.

Can you help flip the slices so that the whole
pizza faces up again and it is restored to its
mouth-watering glory?
translation:
Beceriksiz sefimiz yine bir
pizzayi mahvetmis ve bu sefer tam bir
peynir faciasi...

Hepsini tekrar ustu yukari getirmeye calisiyor,
ama bu peynirli ust ozellikle yapiskan ve
her seferinde bir dilimi cevirdiginde,
yanindaki dilimler de onunla birlikte
donuyor.

Dilimleri cevirip tum
pizzayi tekrar ustu yukari bakar hale
getirmesine ve istah kabartan haline
kavusmasina yardim eder misin?

original:
Correct!

One scrumptious pepperoni pizza coming up!

This pizza puzzle can be solved in just a few
moves. How many did it take you?
translation:
Dogru!

Bir nefis pepperoni pizza geliyor!

Bu pizza bulmacasi sadece birkac
hamlede cozulebilir. Sen kac
hamlede yaptin?

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
You can flip the entire pizza face up in just
four moves. See if you can work out how.
Good luck!
translation:
Tum pizzayi sadece
dort hamlede ustu yukari
dondurebilirsin. Nasil oldugunu
bulmaya calis.
Iyi sanslar!

original:
There are several methods of doing this, but
here's the quickest: start by flipping the slice
closest to the top on the left-hand side. What
comes next?
translation:
Bunu yapmanin birkac yontemi var, ama
en hizlisi su: Once sol tarafta en ustte
en yakin dilimi
cevir. Sonra ne gelir?

original:
The next slice to flip is the one closest to the
bottom on the left-hand side.

You can flip all the slices up in two more
moves. Have you worked it out yet?
translation:
Siradaki cevrilecek dilim, sol tarafta en altta
en yakin
dilim.

Tum dilimleri iki hamlede daha
ustu yukari cevirebilirsin. Hala
bulamadin mi?

original:
Following the previous hint, flip the second
slice down on the left-hand side. Do you see
what the last move should be now?
translation:
Onceki ipucuna gore, sol tarafta
ustten ikinci
dilimi cevir. Son hamlenin
ne olmasi gerektigini simdi
goruyor musun?

original: Get the girl to her friend!
translation: Kizi arkadasina ulastir!

original:
One day, a girl went off exploring an
abandoned canal system with her friend.
Before she knew it, she was stranded on the
other side of the room. But fret not! You
should be able to make a path to help her to
the other side using the walkways and crates
floating in the water.

Tilt your Nintendo 3DS system backwards,
forwards, left or right to make the crates
slide in that direction. Watch out for the dark
holes, though - if a crate floats over one, it
will stay stuck there.
translation:
Bir gun bir kiz,
arkadasiyla terk edilmis bir kanal sistemini kesfe cikar.
Ne oldugunu anlamadan odanin
oteki tarafinda mahsur kalir. Ama endiselenme! Ona
yuruyus yollarini ve
suda yuzen sandiklari kullanarak ote tarafa ulasacagi bir yol yapabilmelisin.

Sandiklarin o yone
kaymasi icin Nintendo 3DS cihazini arkaya,
one, sola ya da saga eg.
Ama karanlik deliklere dikkat et-bir sandik
ustlerinden gecerse oraya takili kalir.

original:
Hurray!

She made it back to her friend safely! But
really, it's not a good idea for them to be
exploring such a dangerous place...
translation:
Yasasin!

Kiz guvenle arkadasina kavustu! Ama
dogrusu, boylesine tehlikeli bir yeri
kesfetmeleri iyi bir fikir degil...

original: Too bad...
translation: Olmadi...

original:
First, you need to use two crates to form a
path to the central walkway.

Just make sure that the crate directly to the
right of the starting position doesn't get
sucked in by a hole.
translation:
Once, iki
sandigi kullanarak orta yuruyus yoluna bir yol olusturmalisin.

Sadece baslangic konumunun
hemen sagindaki sandigin
bir delige kapilip gitmemesine dikkat et.

original:
Let's start from the beginning. Tilt your
Nintendo 3DS system in the following ways to
form a path: down, left, then down again.

You should now have a path to the central
walkway!
translation:
Bastan baslayalim. Nintendo 3DS cihazini
su sekilde egerek
bir yol olustur: asagi, sol, sonra tekrar asagi.

Artik orta
yuruyus yoluna giden bir yolun olmali!

original:
Have you moved the girl onto the central
walkway? Now tilt the Nintendo 3DS in such
a way as to put the top-right crate into the
hole.

With that crate fixed in position, you should
be able to use the other crates to lead the
girl to her friend.
translation:
Kizi orta
yuruyus yoluna cikardin mi? Simdi Nintendo 3DS'i
sag ustteki sandigi
delige sokacak sekilde eg.

O sandik
orada sabitlenince, diger sandiklari kullanarak
kizi arkadasina goturebilmelisin.

original:
Once you've got the top-right crate into the
hole, move another into the hole next to the
central walkway. You can use one of the two
crates in the top left.

Lastly, move the crate in the bottom half of
the screen towards the top right so that it's
positioned next to the crate you just fixed in
place. The two crates should make a path
across to the last walkway, bridging the gap
between the girl and her friend!
translation:
Sag ustteki
sandigi delige soktugunda,
orta yuruyus yolunun yanindaki delige bir
sandik daha koy. Sol ustteki iki sandiktan birini kullanabilirsin.

Son olarak, ekranin
alt yarisindaki sandigi sag uste dogru kaydir ki
az once sabitledigin sandigin
yanina yerlessin. Iki sandik,
son yuruyus yoluna dogru bir gecit olusturup
kizla arkadasi arasindaki boslugu kapatmali!

original: Guide the ladybird!
translation: Ugur bocegini yonlendir!

original:
Our ladybird friends have lost each other yet
again!

Between the corn kernels in their way and
the tunnels that run right through the
corncob, the obstacles are many. Can you
help the red ladybird find its friend again?
translation:
Ugur bocegi arkadaslarimiz
yine birbirini kaybetti!

Yollarini tikayan misir taneleriyle
misir kocaninin icinden gecen tuneller
arasinda, engeller cok. Kirmizi ugur boceginin
arkadasini yeniden bulmasina
yardim eder misin?

original:
Well done!

Our ladybirds look happy! But hold on... If
they can fly, why couldn't they find each
other that way?!
translation:
Tebrikler!

Ugur boceklerimiz mutlu gorunuyor! Ama dur... Eger
ucabiliyorlarsa, neden boyle
bulmadilar ki?!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
This corncob has a total of ten tunnels!
You'll need to go through at least five of
those to find the blue ladybird.
translation:
Bu misir kocaninda toplam on tunel var!
Mavi ugur bocegini bulmak icin bunlarin en az besinden
gecmen gerekecek.

original:
First, take the tunnel that's down and to the
left of your starting area. So, which way
next?
translation:
Once baslangic alaninin
asagisinda ve solunda olan tunelden
gec. Peki, sonra
hangi yone?

original:
After emerging from the tunnel mentioned in
Hint 2, head to the right. If you go left, you'll
only end up going in circles!

So make sure you go right and then head
down to the tunnel hole below.
translation:
Ipucu 2'deki tunelden ciktiktan sonra
saga dogru ilerle. Sola gidersen
sadece dolasip durursun!

Bu yuzden saga git ve sonra
asagidaki tunel
deligine in.

original:
When you get out of the tunnel mentioned in
Hint 3, you'll find yourself in an area with
two other tunnels. Take the one on the
bottom right.

Beyond here, there's only one route that
goes straight to the blue ladybird. Get to it,
then!
translation:
Ipucu 3'teki tunelden ciktiginda
kendini iki baska tunelin
oldugu bir bolgede bulacaksin. Sag alttaki
olani sec.

Bundan sonrasi, dogrudan mavi ugur bocegine
giden tek bir yol. Hadi, ona ulas!

original: Put the fossil together!
translation: Fosili birlestir!

original:
Here's a fossil that's been broken up into
bits. It had been fully reconstructed, but
sadly, it was broken in an accident.

The fossil was originally a 5 x 5 square. Can
you put it back together?

It's extremely fragile, so in order to prevent
it breaking even more, you're only permitted
to move lines of five pieces horizontally or
vertically.

Good luck!
translation:
Iste parcalara ayrilmis bir fosil.
Aslinda tamamen yeniden birlestirilmisti,
ama ne yazik ki bir kazada kirildi.

Fosil aslinda 5 x 5'lik bir kareydi. Onu
yeniden birlestirebilir misin?

Cok kirilgan, bu yuzden daha fazla
kirilmasini onlemek icin
yalnizca bes parcalik siralari yatay
ya da dikey olarak hareket ettirebilirsin.

Iyi sanslar!

original:
Correct!

Excellent work. You've managed to put this
rather complex fossil back together again.

That's one for the pre-history books!
translation:
Dogru!

Harika is. Bu oldukca karmasik
fosili tekrar bir araya getirmeyi basardin.

Tarih oncesi kitaplarina girecek bir basari!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
Getting back on track after making a mistake
will be quite hard in this puzzle. Make good
use of Undo.

You'll want to start off by moving a column
up.
translation:
Bir hata yaptiktan sonra toparlamak
bu bulmacada oldukca zor. Geri Al'i
iyi kullan.

Baslangicta bir sutunu
yukari tasimak isteyeceksin.

original:
Continuing from Hint 1, move a row from the
right to the left.
translation:
1. ipucundan devam ederek, sagdaki bir satiri
sola kaydir.

original:
Continuing from Hint 2, move one column
down. Next, move one row left. Now you just
need one more move to solve it.
translation:
2. ipucundan devam ederek bir sutunu
asagi indir. Sonra bir satiri sola kaydir. Simdi
cozmek icin sadece bir hamle kaldi.

original:
Here's a more specific explanation.
1. Move the second column from the right
one row upwards.
2. Move the third row from the bottom one
column left.
3. Move the middle column one row
downwards.
4. Move the third row from the top one
column left.

Think you can work out the last move now?
translation:
Daha ayrintili bir aciklama:
1. Sagdan ikinci sutunu
bir kare yukari tasi.
2. Alttan ucuncu satiri
bir sutun sola kaydir.
3. Orta sutunu
bir kare asagi indir.
4. Ustten ucuncu satiri
bir sutun sola kaydir.

Son hamleyi artik cikarabilir misin?

original: Divide the board!
translation: Tahtayi bol!

original:
In this final chessboard puzzle, you must
split the 6 x 6 board into four sections that
have the same shape, are of equal area
and each contain four white pawns and four
black pawns.

Can you do it?

Draw lines to divide the chessboard as
described and checkmate this challenge
once and for all! And keep in mind that
solutions may be rotated, but cannot be
mirrored.
translation:
Bu son satranc tahtasi bulmacasinda,
6 x 6'lik tahtayi dort bolume
ayirmalisin; bolumler ayni sekle sahip ve
ayni alanda olmali; her biri dort beyaz piyon
ve dort siyah piyon icermeli.

Yapabilir misin?

Satranc tahtasini tarif edildigi gibi
bolmek icin cizgiler ciz ve bu meydan okumayi
bir kez ve sonsuza dek mat et! Ayrica unutma,
cozumler dondurulebilir,
ama ayna goruntusu olamaz.

original:
Bravo!

You did a splendid job of dividing up the
board!
translation:
Bravo!

Tahtayi bolmekte harika bir is
cikardin!

original:
Oh well.

Are you positive that each section was the
exact same shape and had four white and
four black pawns?
translation:
Eh.

Her bolumun tam olarak ayni sekle
sahip oldugundan ve dort beyaz
dort siyah piyon icerdiginden emin misin?

original:
It may be a little daunting to see the board
covered in so many pawns, but don't be
discouraged.

First, try to divide the board in two, making
sure there is an equal number of black and
white pawns on either side.
translation:
Tahtanin bu kadar cok piyonla
kapli olmasi goz korkutabilir, ama
cesaretini kirma.

Once tahtayi ikiye bolmeyi dene,
iki tarafta da esit sayida siyah ve
beyaz piyon oldugundan emin ol.

original:
It's difficult to get a good grasp of the pawn
distribution at first glance, so you could try
counting them.

A clean cut down the middle leaves you with
eight black pawns and eight white pawns on
either side. Give it a go.
translation:
Ilk bakista piyonlarin dagilimini
kavramak zor, bu yuzden
saymayi deneyebilirsin.

Ortadan duz bir kesik yaparsan,
her iki tarafta da sekiz siyah ve sekiz beyaz
piyon kalir. Bir dene.

original:
Now consider how to split the two halves
you've made with the vertical line.

It may help you to know that the pawns in
A6, B6 and C6 should all lie within the same
section.
translation:
Simdi dikey cizgiyle olusturdugun
iki yarimi nasil bolecegini dusun.

Sunu bilmek isine yarayabilir:
A6, B6 ve C6'daki piyonlarin hepsi
ayni bolumun icinde olmali.

original:
In the bottom-left section, you'll need the
three pawns on the bottom row mentioned in
Hint 3 and the pawns in C2, C3 and C5.
Draw lines so as to include all of those.

Now just add two more black pawns and
you're set!
translation:
Sol alt bolumde, Ipucu 3'te bahsedilen
alt siradaki uc piyona
ve C2, C3 ve C5'teki piyonlara ihtiyacin var.
Hepsini icerecek sekilde cizgiler ciz.

Simdi iki siyah piyon daha ekle
ve tamamdir!

original: Which poster is identical?
translation: Hangi poster ayni?

original:
What a bungled job! The bottom half of this
poster has become completely detached
from the top. Luckily, the scatterbrain who
put it up left behind a box of spares, so
Layton and the policeman should be able to
replace it.

There's a complication, though: all the spare
posters are a little different. Can you find the
one that exactly matches the original? Touch
the posters on the Touch Screen to enlarge
them and slide the hand left and right to
examine the torn original.
translation:
Ne berbat bir is! Bu posterin alt yarisi ustten
tamamen kopmus. Neyse ki, bunu asan
dalgin kisi bir kutu yedek birakmis; Layton ve
polis memuru yenisiyle degistirebilir.

Ama bir sorun var: yedek posterlerin hepsi
biraz farkli. Orijinalin aynisi olani bulabilir
misin? Dokunmatik Ekran'daki posterleri
dokunarak buyut ve kopuk orijinali incelemek
icin eli sola-saga kaydir.

original:
Nicely spotted!

In poster A, the direction the little boy is
facing is wrong. In poster B, there are fewer
people riding the Pumpkin Spinners. It can
only be C!
translation:
Iyi yakaladin!

A posterinde kucuk cocugun baktigi yon
yanlis. B posterinde Pumpkin Spinners'a binen
kisi sayisi daha az. O halde sadece C olabilir!

original:
Too bad.

Examine all the posters carefully! You must
have overlooked something.
translation:
Olmadi.

Tum posterleri dikkatle incele! Bir seyi
gozden kacirmis olmalisin.

original:
It's much harder comparing things when you
can't see the whole picture at once, isn't it?
Try to work out where the edges of the flat
posters correspond to on the pole.
translation:
Her seyi ayni anda goremeyince
karsilastirmak cok daha zor, degil mi?
Duz posterlerin kenarlarinin diregin uzerinde
nereye denk geldigini anlamaya calis.

original:
It's quite a strange poster to begin with.
The section with the Ferris wheel draws the
eye, doesn't it?
translation:
Basli basina tuhaf bir poster zaten.
Donme dolabin oldugu bolum hemen goze
carpiyor, degil mi?

original:
Have you noticed anything around the
spooky pumpkin ride at the withered tree?
translation:
Solmus agacin yanindaki urkutucu kabak
oyuncaginin cevresinde bir sey fark ettin mi?

original:
There's definitely something odd about the
boy near the Ferris wheel and the children
in the pumpkin ride. Have a closer look at
those two places.
translation:
Donme dolabin yanindaki cocukta ve kabak
oyuncagindaki cocuklarda kesinlikle garip bir
sey var. O iki bolgeye daha yakindan bak.

original: Close the cursed case!
translation: Lanetli kutuyu kapat!

original:
Oh no! You've stumbled across a cursed
case! It's up to you to get all the cursed
stone blocks back into the case and close it
tight if you don't want to unleash terrible
things upon the world!

To be safe, you'll have to pack every block
neatly into the case. To complicate matters,
the blocks are dotted with holes and
protruding studs, so you'll need to make
sure the studs on one side slot into the
holes on the other side, or you won't be
able to close the case. Good luck!
translation:
Ah hayir! Lanetli bir kutuya rastladin!
