Dunyaya korkunc seyler salmak istemiyorsan,
lanetli tas bloklarin hepsini tekrar kutuya
yerlestirip sikica kapatmak sana dusuyor!

Guvende olmak icin her blogu kutuya
duzenli bir sekilde yerlestirmelisin. Ustelik,
bloklarin uzerinde delikler ve cikintili pimler var;
bir taraftaki pimlerin diger taraftaki deliklere
oturdugundan emin olmalisin, yoksa kutuyu
kapatamazsin. Bol sans!

original:
Well done!

You've saved the day!

You're probably wondering what kind
of {''}terrible things{''} would have been
{''}unleashed{''} if you'd left the case
alone, though...
translation:
Aferin!

Gunu kurtardin!

Yine de muhtemelen kutuyu kendi haline
biraksaydin ne tur {''}korkunc seylerin{''}
{''}salinacagini{''} merak ediyorsundur...

original:
Too bad.

The blocks may all be in the case, but are
the studs and holes aligned properly?

You have to close that case before it's too
late!
translation:
Olmadi.

Tum bloklar kutuda olabilir, ama
pimler ve delikler dogru hizalanmis mi?

Cok gec olmadan o kutuyu kapatmalisin!

original:
Having trouble fitting shapes, holes and
studs together nicely?

Of all the cursed cases that are rumoured to
exist, this has got to be one of the nastier
ones. You can't just move blocks as they
are - you'll have to rotate them too if you
want to fit them all into the case.
translation:
Sekilleri, delikleri ve pimleri
uygun sekilde oturtmakta zorlaniyor musun?

Var oldugu soylenen tum lanetli kutular arasinda,
bu kesinlikle en ugursuz olanlardan biri.
Bloklari oldugu gibi hareket ettiremezsin-
hepsini kutuya sigdirmak icin dondurmen de
gerekecek.

original:
Let's get started then. See the block that's
shaped like a letter T? That goes in the
top-right corner of the right half of the case.
You don't need to rotate it, mind. It'll remain
a perfect T until it's shut up in the case.
translation:
O zaman baslayalim. T harfi seklindeki
blogu goruyor musun? O, kutunun sag
yarisinin sag ust kosesine gider. Dondurmene
gerek yok. Kutu kapandiginda da tam bir
T olarak kalacak.

original:
Can you see an L-shaped block that has two
holes and one stud? Now look for another
block that's exactly the same shape, but
only has a stud.

These two L-shaped blocks can be put
together to form a rectangle, which will fit into
the bottom in the right-hand side of the
case. You'll have to decide which way round
to put them by looking at the position of the
studs and holes.
translation:
Iki deligi ve bir pimi olan L seklinde bir blok
goruyor musun? Simdi de ayni sekle sahip,
ama sadece pimi olan diger blogu bul.

Bu iki L blogunu birlestirince bir dikdortgen
olusur ve bu da kutunun sag tarafinin alt
bolumune sigar. Pim ve deliklerin konumuna
bakarak hangi yonde yerlestirecegine karar
vermen gerekecek.

original:
Next, look for a block shaped like a letter
U on its side. Move that block, without
rotating it, into the bottom-right corner of
the left-hand side of the case. You should
now know which way round to put those two
L-shaped blocks from Hint 3.

You can work out the rest using the positions
of the holes and studs in the right half!
translation:
Simdi de yan yatmis U harfi seklindeki
blogu bul. Onu dondurmeden, kutunun sol
tarafinin sag alt kosesine yerlestir. Artik,
Ipucu 3'teki iki L blogunu hangi yonde
koyman gerektigini anlamis olmalisin.

Geri kalanini da sag yaridaki delik ve pimlerin
konumlarini kullanarak cikarabilirsin!

original: Match up the horses!
translation: Atlari eslestir!

original:
These cheerful tiles can be put together so
they form horse shapes of six different
colours. With these nine tiles, you can make
a total of 12 complete, uniformly coloured
horses within the frame, but at the moment
the colours are all mixed up!

Can you match up all the colours and
complete the pattern? This time, you can
both rotate and move the tiles.
translation:
Bu neseli karolari birlestirerek alti farkli
renkte at sekilleri olusturabilirsin. Bu dokuz
karo ile cercevenin icinde tek renkli toplam
12 tam at yapabilirsin, ama su an renkler
tamamen karismis durumda!

Tum renkleri eslestirip deseni tamamlayabilir
misin? Bu sefer karolari hem dondurebilir hem
de yerlerini degistirebilirsin.

original:
You're a neightural!

This pattern works as it is, or rotated 90,
180 or 270 degrees!

With all six colours matching, it looks very
pleasing to the eye, don't you think?
translation:
Kisne-tralsin!

Bu desen boyle de calisir; ayrica 90,
180 veya 270 derece dondurulmus haliyle de!

Alti rengin hepsi eslesince goze cok hos
geliyor, degil mi?

original:
Too bad.

There must be a poor little horsey whose
behind isn't the same colour as the rest of
it...
translation:
Olmadi.

Zavalli bir atin arka tarafi,
geri kalaniyla ayni renkte degil galiba...

original:
The only way to solve this one is by trial and
error. Start with the colour of horse with the
least number. There aren't so many pink,
green or tan ones, if you look.
translation:
Bu bulmacanin tek yolu deneme-yanilma.
Once sayisi en az olan at renginden basla.
Dikkat edersen pembe, yesil veya bej olanlar
o kadar da fazla degil.

original:
The fact that every panel can be rotated
means you can complete this puzzle no
matter which direction the pattern faces.
Does that help a little?
translation:
Her panelin dondurulebilmesi, bu bulmacayi
desen hangi yone bakarsa baksin cozebilecegin
anlamina geliyor.
Bu biraz yardimci oldu mu?

original:
Once you work out the correct position of
one tile, the rest should all fall into place,
so here's a clue:
Can you see the tile with both the front and
back of a green horse on it? Put that in the
bottom-right corner. But the way it faces?
Now that would be telling...
translation:
Bir karonun dogru yerini buldugunda, digerleri
zaten yerine oturacaktir, o yuzden bir ipucu:
Uzerinde hem yesil bir atin onu hem de arkasi
olan karoyu goruyor musun? Onu sag alt koseye
koy. Ama hangi yone bakacak?
Onu da soylemek olurdu...

original:
The tile mentioned in Hint 3 should be
placed with pink on the bottom and white on
the top.

Now the pieces should all come together
without much difficulty. You can work the rest
out by process of elimination.
translation:
3. Ipucunda bahsedilen karo,
altta pembe ve ustte beyaz olacak sekilde
yerlestirilmeli.

Simdi parcalar fazla zorlanmadan
bir araya gelmeli. Kalanini eleme
yontemiyle bulabilirsin.

original: Replace the tiles!
translation: Karolari degistir!

original:
This mosaic has become worn and faded, so
the locals have decided to replace it. The
new tiles have arrived in larger pieces that
need arranging. Although the pattern is the
same as the old one, it doesn't have to be
oriented the same way.

You can move and rotate the pieces, so see
if you can give a helping hand and fit them
all into the square nicely.
translation:
Bu mozaik asinip solmus, bu yuzden
yerliler onu yenilemeye karar vermis.
Yeni karolar daha buyuk parcalar halinde geldi
ve yerlestirilmeleri gerekiyor. Desen eskisiyle
ayni olsa da, ayni yonde durmak zorunda degil.

Parcalari hareket ettirip dondurebilirsin;
bakalim hepsini kareye
duzgunce sigdirarak yardimci olabilecek misin?

original:
Well done!

The flowery footpath is back to being
vibrantly coloured! Look how pretty it is
now!
translation:
Aferin!

Cicekli yol yeniden
capcanli renklere kavustu!
Simdi ne kadar guzel gorunuyor!

original: Try again.
translation: Tekrar dene.

original:
It's very hard to tell which piece of the
pattern goes where.

Why don't you start off by working out which
of the pieces fit in the corners and work
outwards from there?
translation:
Desenin hangi parcasinin nereye
gidecegini anlamak cok zor.

Once koselere hangi parcalarin
uydugunu bulup, oradan disari dogru
ilerlemeye ne dersin?

original:
There's a section shaped like a fat letter
{''}T{''}. Rotate it so that the {''}T{''} stands
upright - albeit looking top heavy - then
place it in the top-left corner.
translation:
Kalin bir {''}T{''} harfi seklinde bir bolum var.
{''}T{''}yi dik duracak sekilde dondur -
biraz tepesi agir gorunse de -
sonra onu sol ust koseye yerlestir.

original:
Look for a rectangular piece with a single tile
sticking out on one side. It looks like a boot
if you rotate it the correct way. Place it so
the sole of the boot sits in the bottom-left
corner.

There's only one piece that will fit between
this one and the one you placed in Hint 2.
Find it and the left-hand side of the mosaic is
complete.
translation:
Bir kenarindan tek bir karo
cikan dikdortgen bir parca ara.
Dogru yonde cevirince biraz bot gibi gorunur.
Botun tabani sol alt koseye gelecek sekilde
yerlestir.

Bu parca ile 2. Ipucu'nda koydugun parca
arasina sigacak sadece bir parca var.
Onu bulursan mozaigin sol tarafi tamam!

original:
See the rectangular piece with two tiles
sticking out on the same edge? It should
look vaguely like a power socket. Rotate it so
that those tiles face to the left and place it in
the top-right corner.

Now look for the piece shaped like the letter
{''}E{''}. Rotate it so the flat edge is on the
bottom and put it in the bottom-right corner.
The rest is up to you!
translation:
Ayni kenarinda iki karo
cikan dikdortgen parcayi goruyor musun?
Biraz priz benzeri bir seye benzemeli.
O iki karo sola bakacak sekilde dondur
ve sag ust koseye yerlestir.

Simdi {''}E{''} harfi seklindeki parcayi bul.
Duz kenari altta kalacak sekilde dondurup
sag alt koseye koy. Gerisi sana kalmis!

original: Save the girl!
translation: Kizi kurtar!

original:
A girl's been left hanging in the Grand Hall!
Is this the work of the Masked Gentleman?
Slide your way down the ropes drawn across
the hall and save her!

There are only a few places where you can
drop from one rope to another. Use the
panel on the right of the Touch Screen to
view the whole hall, and hurry to the girl's
rescue!
translation:
Buyuk Salon'da bir kiz asili kalmis!
Bu Maskeli Beyefendi'nin isi mi?
Salona gerilmis iplerden kayarak asagi in
ve onu kurtar!

Bir ipten digerine
dusebilecegin yalnizca birkac yer var. Tum
salonu gormek icin Dokunmatik Ekran'in sagindaki
paneli kullan ve kizin
imdadina yetis!

original:
Correct!

Congratulations, you've saved the day! Why,
she seems quite charmed by her dashing
rescuer.
translation:
Dogru!

Tebrikler, gunu kurtardin! Bak,
gozu pek kurtaricisindan oldukca
etkilenmis gibi gorunuyor.

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
You mustn't drop down at point A, the first
drop point. If you drop down here, you'll
never reach the girl.
translation:
Ilk dusus noktasi olan A'da asagi inmemelisin.
Buradan dusersen kiza
asla ulasamazsin.

original:
Drop down from the second drop point: B.

There's still a long way to go. Make sure to
scan the whole hall using the panel on the
Touch Screen in order to work out the route
you'll need to take.
translation:
Ikinci dusus noktasi olan B'den
asagi in.

Gidecek daha cok yol var. Dokunmatik Ekran'daki
paneli kullanarak tum salonu tarayip
izlemen gereken yolu
belirlediginden emin ol.

original:
Once you've dropped down from point B,
you'll need to drop down at point F. Now
you should only need to make a few more
decisions, even though you're barely halfway
through the trap.

As far as solving the puzzle goes, though,
you're nearly there. Good luck!
translation:
B noktasindan asagi indikten sonra
F noktasinda da asagi inmen gerekecek. Simdi
tuzagin daha yarisina bile gelmemis olsan da
sadece birkac kararin kalmis olmali.

Bulmacayi cozmek acisindan ise,
neredeyse geldin. Iyi sanslar!

original:
After dropping down at F, you'll want to drop
from I.

Victory is not far off now. The rest is all up
to you!
translation:
F'den asagi indikten sonra
I'den dusmek isteyeceksin.

Zafer artik uzak degil. Gerisi
tamamen sana kalmis!

original: Beat the mummies!
translation: Mumyalari yen!

original:
Here come some more mechanical
mummies! This time, there are three of them
on the rampage!

The mummies are moving in to attack
Hershel, travelling along the grooves in the
floor tiles. Get rid of them by leading them
into the pit!

You'll need to get them to fall into the pit
from the tile immediately above it.
translation:
Daha fazla mekanik mumya geliyor! Bu sefer
ucu birden ortaligi kasip kavuruyor!

Mumyalar, dosemedeki oluklar boyunca
ilerleyerek Hershel'e saldiriyor. Onlari cukura
yonlendirerek yok et!

Onlari cukura, hemen ustundeki kareden
dusurmen gerekiyor.

original:
Correct!

Now you have nothing to worry about, no
matter how many mummies might appear!
translation:
Dogru!

Artik kac mumya ortaya cikarsa ciksin,
endiselenecek bir seyin yok!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
There may be three of them this time, but
you mustn't lose your cool. Find a safe spot,
then work out your strategy.
translation:
Bu sefer uc tane olabilir, ama sogukkanliligini
kaybetme. Guvenli bir nokta bul, sonra
stratejini kur.

original:
It's relatively easy to get all three on the
same path, but when you get them all
together, their movements can become
difficult to predict.

Split them off into different paths and deal
with them one by one.
translation:
Hepsini ayni yola sokmak nispeten kolay,
ama hepsi bir araya gelince hareketlerini
tahmin etmek zorlasabilir.

Onlari farkli yollara ayir ve teker teker
hallet.

original:
There isn't much else to add. There are
several different ways of getting the
mummies to fall into the pit. You just need
to play it by ear and move the tiles as
required in order to deal with them!

If you read the next hint, you might get some
more information. Maybe.
translation:
Baska pek bir sey yok. Mumyalari cukura
dusurmenin birkac yolu var. Duruma gore
hareket et ve gerektiginde karolari oynatarak
islerini bitir!

Bir sonraki ipucunu okursan belki biraz daha
bilgi edinirsin. Belki.

original:
Mummification is a special way of preserving
the bodies of the dead so that, according to
ancient beliefs, they can go to the afterlife
looking the same as they did when they were
alive.

But then why would you make a mechanical
mummy?
translation:
Mumyalama, olulerin bedenlerini, eski
inanislara gore oteki dunyaya giderken
hayattaykenki gibi gorunsun diye korumanin
ozel bir yoludur.

Ama o zaman neden mekanik bir mumya
yaparsin?

original: Point to the centre!
translation: Ortayi goster!

original:
The mystery pillars return! The mechanism
will activate when the arrows on each pillar
point to the centre.

However, the pillars will only turn if Layton
and Angela step on opposing buttons at the
same time. When you have Layton press a
button, Angela will press the one opposite.
Also, keep in mind that they won't be able to
press the same buttons twice in a row.

Work together to solve the puzzle!
translation:
Gizemli sutunlar geri dondu! Mekanizma
her sutundaki oklar
merkeze baktiginda calisacak.

Ancak sutunlar yalnizca
Layton ve Angela ayni anda karsilikli dugmelere basarsa doner.
Layton'a bir dugmeye bastirdiginda,
Angela karsisindakine basar.
Ayrica, ayni dugmelere
art arda iki kez basamayacaklarini unutma.

Bulmacayi cozmek icin birlikte calisin!

original:
Magnificent!

If you can solve this puzzle, then there isn't
an ancient riddle around that stands a
chance against your powers of problem
solving!
translation:
Muhtesem!

Bu bulmacayi
cozebiliyorsan, problem cozme gucunun karsisinda
durabilecek
kadim bir bilmece yok demektir!

original: Too bad.
translation: Olmadi.

original:
The way the buttons cause the pillars to
rotate has changed for this puzzle. Try
experimenting and see what happens.

By the way, you can solve this puzzle with
just six sets of button presses.
translation:
Bu bulmacada dugmelerin
sutunlari dondurme sekli degisti. Biraz
deneyip ne oldugunu gor.

Bu arada, bu
bulmacayi sadece alti dugme basma setiyle cozebilirsin.

original:
There are a total of eight buttons, but
since Angela will always press the button
opposite the one you choose for Layton,
there are only four possible ways to make
changes on the top screen.

Learn how to move the pillars, then think
carefully about which buttons to press in
order to move the arrows. It will take you
more moves than last time, so you won't
find the answer through sheer luck.
translation:
Toplam sekiz
dugme var, ama Angela her zaman
Layton icin sectiginin karsisindaki dugmeye basacagi icin,
ust ekranda degisiklik
yapmanin sadece dort olasi yolu vardir.

Sutunlari nasil
hareket ettirecegini ogren, sonra oklari hareket ettirmek icin
hangi dugmelere
basman gerektigini dikkatlice dusun. Gecen seferkinden
daha fazla hamle
gerekecek; yani cevabi sadece sansla bulamazsin.

original:
There are several ways to solve the puzzle.

Here's a tip, though: if Layton and Angela
press the top-left and bottom-right
buttons, they shouldn't press the top-right
and bottom-left buttons. The reverse
applies as well.
translation:
Bulmacayi cozmenin
birkac yolu var.

Ama bir ipucu: Layton ve Angela
sol ust ve sag alt dugmelere basarsa,
sag ust ve sol alt dugmelere basmamalilar.
Tersi
de gecerlidir.

original:
Have Layton press the top button twice, and
the far-right button three times. Then there's
only one other pair of buttons that needs to
be pressed to finish the job.

The order in which the buttons are pressed
doesn't matter, but remember that they can't
press the same buttons twice in a row.
translation:
Layton'a ust
dugmeye iki kez ve
en sagdaki dugmeye uc kez bastir. Sonra isi bitirmek icin
basilmasi gereken sadece bir dugme cifti kalir.

Dugmelere basilma
sirasi onemli degil, ama ayni dugmelere
art arda iki kez basamayacaklarini unutma.

original: パネルの[絵/え]を[元/もと]の[形/かたち]に[戻/もど]そう！
translation: Paneldeki resmi eski haline dondur!

original:
[不思議/ふしぎ]なマジックショーの[始/はじ]まりだ。
バラバラになったパネルを[元/もと]の[形/かたち]に
[戻/もど]すと、そこに[描/えが]かれた[動物/どうぶつ]が[現/あらわ]れる
らしい。マジシャンがパネルとパネル
の[間/あいだ]に[魔法/まほう]をかけるとそこを[中心/ちゅうしん]に
[二/ふた]つのパネルが[入/い]れ[替/か]わるんだ。
さあ、[魔法/まほう]をかけて[元/もと]の[場所/ばしょ]に[戻/もど]した
パネルにはどんな[動物/どうぶつ]が[描/えが]かれて
いるんだろう？
translation:
Tuhaf bir sihir gosterisi basliyor.
Dagilmis panelleri eski sekline
geri getirince, uzerinde cizili olan hayvanin
ortaya cikacagi soyleniyor. Sihirbaz panellerin
arasina buyu yapinca, orayi merkez alarak
iki panel yer degistiriyor.
Haydi, buyu yapip eski yerine dondurdugun
panelde hangi hayvanin
cizili oldugunu bulalim!

original:
[正解/せいかい]！

パネルには[象/ぞう]が[描/えが]かれていたんだ。
ほら、パネルの[後/うし]ろから[象/ぞう]が…
[現/あらわ]れたよ、…ね。
translation:
Dogru!

Panelde bir fil ciziliymis.
Bak, panelin arkasindan fil...
ortaya cikti, gordun mu?

original: [残念/ざんねん]。
translation: Maalesef.

original:
まず、どんな[動物/どうぶつ]が[描/えが]かれている
か[当/あ]ててみよう！
ヒントは[耳/みみ]が[大/おお]きい[動物/どうぶつ]だよ。
translation:
Once, hangi hayvanin cizili oldugunu
tahmin etmeye calis!
Ipucu: Kulaklari buyuk bir hayvan.

original:
[描/えが]かれている[動物/どうぶつ]はわかったかな？
そう、[正解/せいかい]は[象/ぞう]だ。
[絵/え]は、[象/ぞう]を[横/よこ]から[見/み]て[描/えが]いたもので
[左側/ひだりがわ]が[鼻/はな]、[右側/みぎがわ]に[尻尾/しっぽ]がくるよ。
translation:
Hangi hayvanin cizili oldugunu anladin mi?
Evet, dogru cevap fil.
Resim, fili yandan gorup cizilmis;
sol tarafta hortum, sag tarafta kuyruk var.

original: テキスト
translation: Metin

original: パネルの[絵/え]を[元/もと]の[形/かたち]に[戻/もど]そう！
translation: Paneldeki resmi orijinal haline dondur!

original:
[再/ふたた]びマジックショー。[今度/こんど]はパネル
の[数/かず]がちょっと[多/おお]いから[大変/たいへん]だ。
バラバラになったパネルを[魔法/まほう]をかけ
て[元/もと]の[形/かたち]に[戻/もど]そう。パネルとパネル
の[間/あいだ]に[魔法/まほう]をかけるとそこを[中心/ちゅうしん]に
[二/ふた]つのパネルが[入/い]れ[替/か]わる。
さあ、[今度/こんど]はパネルにどんな[動物/どうぶつ]が
[描/えが]かれているんだろう？
translation:
Yine bir sihir gosterisi. Bu sefer panel
sayisi biraz fazla, o yuzden zor.
Dagilan panellere buyu yapip
orijinal haline dondurelim. Iki panelin
arasina buyu yapinca, o nokta merkez olur ve
iki panel yer degistirir.
Peki bu sefer panellerde hangi hayvan
cizili acaba?

original:
[正解/せいかい]！

パネルにはライオンが[描/えが]かれて
いたんだ。
さあ、[凶暴/きょうぼう]なライオンの[登場/とうじょう]…
だよ。
translation:
Dogru!

Panellerde bir aslan cizilmisti.
Haydi, vahsi aslan sahnede...

original: [残念/ざんねん]。
translation: Maalesef.

original: テキスト
translation: Metin

original:
[最後/さいご]のマジックショー。[今度/こんど]は
[魔法/まほう]の[回数/かいすう]が[制限/せいげん]されているぞ！
バラバラになったパネルを[魔法/まほう]をかけ
て[元/もと]の[形/かたち]に[戻/もど]そう。パネルとパネル
の[間/あいだ]に[魔法/まほう]をかけるとそこを[中心/ちゅうしん]に
[二/ふた]つのパネルが[入/い]れ[替/か]わるんだ。
さあ、パネルにはどんな[動物/どうぶつ]が
[描/えが]かれているんだろう？
translation:
Son sihir gosterisi. Bu sefer
buyu yapma sayisi sinirli!

translation:
Bu sira disi donme dolap,
ortasinda ve her kabininde
alfabenin bir harfini tasiyor.
Ortadaki harf [S] ve kabinler,
saat yonunde okundugunda soyle:
[J], [M], [E], [V], [M], [N], [U] ve [?]

Lunaparktaki bir gorevliye gore,
[?] yerine eskiden bir harf varmis
ama hangisi oldugunu hatirlamiyor.
Sadece, harflerin bir kurala uydugunu
biliyor. [?] kabininde eskiden hangi
harf oldugunu bulabilir misin?

original:
Cosmic!

The cabin marked [?] represents Saturn, so
it would have been marked with [S] in the
past. The letters on the Ferris wheel
represent the planets orbiting the Sun.
translation:
Harika!

[?] ile isaretli kabin Saturn'u temsil ediyor;
bu yuzden eskiden uzerinde [S] yaziyordu.
Donme dolaptaki harfler,
Gunes'in etrafinda donen gezegenleri temsil eder.

original:
Too bad.

Have another look at the sequence of
letters. Do they not remind you of
something?
translation:
Olmadi.

Harf dizisine bir daha bak.
Sana bir seyi hatirlatmiyor mu?

original:
Pay attention to the [S] in the centre. The
movement of the wheel is also a clue.

[S] is in the middle and the cabins all go
around it. Does it bring anything to mind?
translation:
Ortadaki [S]'ye dikkat et.
Tekerlegin hareketi de bir ipucu.

[S] ortada, kabinler de onun etrafinda donuyor.
Sana bir sey cagristiriyor mu?

original:
The letters are each the first letter of a word.
The most familiar one to us is [E], without a
doubt.
translation:
Harflerin her biri bir kelimenin
ilk harfi. Bizim icin en tanidik olani
suphesiz [E].

original:
Are you having trouble working out what the
words are from single letters? How about if
we re-order the cabins a bit:
M V E M J ? U N

Still not ringing any bells? By the way, this
ride is nicknamed the Solar Wheel.
translation:
Tek harften kelimeleri cikaramiyor musun?
Kabinleri biraz yeniden siralayalim:
M V E M J ? U N

Hala bir sey cagristirmadi mi?
Bu arada, bu oyuncagin lakabi
Gunes Carki.

original:
Isn't the sequence M V E M J ? U N familiar?
It's the order of the planets orbiting the Sun,
going from the closest to the most distant!

The cabins are marked with the first letter of
each planet in our solar system. So which
planet comes between [J] and [U], and what
is its first letter?
translation:
M V E M J ? U N dizisi tanidik degil mi?
Gunes'in etrafinda donen gezegenlerin,
Gunes'e en yakin olandan en uzaga dogru sirasi!

Kabinlerin uzerinde, gunes sistemimizdeki
her gezegenin ilk harfi var. O halde [J] ile [U]
arasinda hangi gezegen var ve ilk harfi nedir?

original: Make the missing pattern!
translation: Eksik deseni yap!

original:
A schoolteacher called a bright pupil up to
the front of the class and asked him this:

{''}Do you see these five patterns? Each one
is made using two paper L-shapes. None
are rotations or mirrored versions of any
other, yet they all have something in
common. Using these two L-shapes, can
you make another pattern that shares the
common feature of the other five?{''}

Move and rotate the pieces to form a sixth
pattern that shares the common feature.
translation:
Bir ogretmen zeki bir ogrenciyi
sinifin onune cagirip sunu sordu:

{''}Bu bes deseni goruyor musun? Her biri
iki L seklindeki kagit parcasiyla yapilmis. Hicbiri
digerinin dondurulmus ya da ayna goruntusu
degil; yine de hepsinin
ortak bir ozelligi var. Bu iki L parcasini kullanarak,
diger besinin ortak ozelligini paylasan
baska bir desen yapabilir misin?{''}

Parcalari hareket ettirip dondurerek,
ortak ozelligi paylasan altinci bir desen olustur.

original:
Excellent!

They're all fine examples of an unfolded
cube! That's why this pattern would work
even if it was mirrored.
translation:
Harika!

Hepsi acilmis bir
kupun iyi birer ornegi! Bu yuzden bu desen,
ayna goruntusu olsa bile ise yarardi.

original:
Too bad.

Each pattern has a different shape, but they
all form something similar. Have another
think about it.
translation:
Olmadi.

Her desenin sekli farkli, ama hepsi
benzer bir seyi olusturuyor. Bir de
tekrar dusun.

original:
At first glance, the five patterns don't seem
to have any relation to each other
whatsoever. Try to ignore the fact that they
are made of L-shaped pieces and consider
each pattern as a whole.
translation:
Ilk bakista bu bes desenin birbirleriyle
hicbir ilgisi yokmus gibi gorunuyor.
L seklindeki parcalarla yapilmis olmalarini
bir kenara birak ve
her deseni bir butun olarak dusun.

original:
Each pattern looks very flat but, like origami,
they should be properly expressed on a
three-dimensional plane.

What would you get if you put the two
L-shapes together and folded along each
square segment?
translation:
Her desen cok duz gorunuyor ama, origami gibi,
aslinda
uc boyutlu bir duzlemde dusunulmeli.

Iki L parcasini
birlestirip her kare parca boyunca
katlarsan ne elde edersin?

original:
Each of these patterns is a net that can be
used to make a six-sided cube.

Excluding mirrored or rotated patterns, there
are only six possible ways of forming a cube
using the two L-shapes. You've already seen
five, so this last one is up to you.
translation:
Bu desenlerin her biri, alti yuzlu bir kup yapmak icin
kullanilabilecek bir acinimdir.

Ayna goruntusu ya da dondurulmus olanlari saymazsak,
iki L parcasiyla bir kup olusturmanin sadece alti yolu vardir.
Besini zaten gordun,
sonuncusu ise sana kalmis.

original:
Here's your final hint:

Arrange the L-shapes to make a staircase
pattern that has two squares of paper in
each row. How does that look?
translation:
Son ipucun:

L parcalarini merdiven
seklinde, her sirada iki kare kagit olacak bicimde
duzenle. Nasil gorunuyor?

original: ゴーカート
translation: ゴーカート

original:
Use the stylus to circle
the answer on the
Touch Screen. If done
correctly, a finger icon
will appear within the
circle, pointing at your
answer. If it doesn't,
try again.
translation:
Use the stylus to circle
the answer on the
Touch Screen. If done
correctly, a finger icon
will appear within the
circle, pointing at your
answer. If it doesn't,
try again.

original: ホールのナゾ
translation: Hol Bulmacasi

original:
Move the magnifying
glass icon up and
down on the Touch
Screen to look at the
whole hall, from top to
bottom.

Touch <CR>Rescue Luke!</C>
to start Layton's
descent.
translation:
Dokunmatik Ekran'da
buyutec simgesini
yukari asagi hareket
ettirerek holun
tamamini, yukaridan
asagiya incele.

Layton'in inisini
baslatmak icin <CR>Luke'u Kurtar!</C>
secenegine dokun.

original:
When passing any
point from A to P,
touch <CR>Drop down!</C>
to make Layton drop
from the rope he's on
to the one below.
translation:
A'dan P'ye kadar
herhangi bir noktadan
gecerken, Layton'in
bulundugu ipten alttaki
ipe dusmesi icin
<CR>Asagi In!</C>'e dokun.

original: ３色タイル
translation: ３色タイル

original:
Take the tiles from the
right of the Touch
Screen and place them
within the border on
the left so that they
match the model
design. The tiles may
overlap.
translation:
Take the tiles from the
right of the Touch
Screen and place them
within the border on
the left so that they
match the model
design. The tiles may
overlap.

original: 道つなぎ迷路
translation: Yol Birlestirme Labirenti

original:
<CR>This puzzle requires
you to move the
Nintendo 3DS system.</CR>

Tilt the system to make
the stepping stones
slide up, down, left
and right along the
canals.
translation:
<CR>Bu bulmacayi cozmek icin
Nintendo 3DS sistemini
hareket ettirmen gerekiyor.</CR>

Sistemi egerek
basamak taslarinin
kanallar boyunca
yukari, asagi, sola
ve saga kaymasini sagla.

original:
To move Hershel,
touch the arrows on
the Touch Screen.

Move the stepping
stones to allow
Hershel to cross the
canals, and lead him
to Randall!
translation:
Hershel'i hareket
ettirmek icin
Dokunmatik Ekran'daki
oklara dokun.

Basamak taslarini
hareket ettirerek
Hershel'in kanallari
gecmesini sagla ve
onu Randall'a gotur!

original: つみ木
translation: Tahta bloklar

original:
Use the wooden blocks on the right of the
Touch Screen to fill the frame on the left.
You may need to rotate some blocks.
translation:
Dokunmatik ekranin sagindaki tahta bloklari
kullanarak soldaki cerceveyi doldur.
Bazi bloklari dondurmen gerekebilir.

original:
The parts of the frame containing a coloured
symbol can only be filled with blocks of that
colour.
translation:
Cercevenin renkli bir sembol iceren
kisimlari yalnizca o renkteki
bloklarla doldurulabilir.

original:
Watch out, though, as you can't place
matching blocks next to each other. Arrange
all the blocks in the frame while meeting the
two conditions.
translation:
Ama dikkat: Ayni renkli bloklari
yan yana yerlestiremezsin.
Iki kosulu da saglayarak
tum bloklari cerceveye yerlestir.

original:
Place the robot parts
on the Touch Screen
in the yellow boxes.

Rotate parts by
touching the edge and
sliding the stylus
round.
translation:
Robot parcalarini
Dokunmatik Ekran'daki
sari kutulara yerlestir.

Parcalari dondurmek icin
kenarina dokunup
kalemi cevresinde
kaydir.

original:
Once all the parts have
been placed in the
boxes, touch <CR>Submit</C>.
The parts will drop
down in a certain
pattern to assemble
a robot.

Work out the pattern
and assemble the
robot properly.
translation:
Tum parcalar kutulara
yerlestirildikten sonra
<CR>Gonder</C>'e dokun.
Parcalar belli bir
duzenle asagi duserek
bir robot olusturacak.

Duzeni coz ve
robotu dogru sekilde
topla.

original: 柵
translation: Cit

original:
These square patches of turf contain small
sections of fence. Touch a patch to rotate
it 90{o } clockwise, fence and all.
translation:
Bu kare cim parcalarinda kucuk cit bolumleri var.
Bir parcaya dokunarak onu
citiyle birlikte saat yonunde 90{o } dondur.

original:
Rotate the panels to connect sections of
fence. Solve the puzzle <CR>by joining all the
sections into a single secure enclosure</CR>!
translation:
Cit bolumlerini birlestirmek icin panelleri dondur.
Bulmacayi <CR>tum bolumleri tek bir guvenli
citin icine birlestirerek</CR> coz

original: テトラトン
translation: Tetraton

original:
On the Touch Screen, touch a block to
select it and touch again to deselect.
translation:
Dokunmatik ekranda bir bloga dokunarak
sec, secimi kaldirmak icin tekrar dokun.

original:
Look for sets of adjacent blocks that each
have a different picture. Select all four
blocks to remove the set.
translation:
Her biri farkli bir resme sahip bitisik
bloklardan olusan setler ara. Dort blogun
hepsini secerek seti kaldir.

original:
Any blocks above the ones you remove will
fall down.
translation:
Kaldirdigin bloklarin uzerindekiler asagi
duser.

original: Clear all the blocks to win the game.
translation: Oyunu kazanmak icin tum bloklari temizle.

original: ミイラマシンのナゾ
translation: Mumya makinesinin sirri

original:
To move Hershel, slide
the stylus on the
Touch Screen as
shown.

The tile in the space
Hershel moves to
will slip to his
previous position.
translation:
Hershel'i hareket ettirmek icin,
gosterildigi gibi
Dokunmatik ekranda
kalemi kaydir.

Hershel'in gittigi
karedeki tas,
onun bir onceki
yerine kayar.

original:
Move the tiles to
create a path for the
mummies and lead
them into the hole in
the bottom right.

<CR>They must fall in from
the tile that is directly
above the hole.</CR>
translation:
Taslari hareket ettirerek
mumyalara bir yol
olustur ve onlari
sag alttaki delige
dusur.

<CR>Deligin hemen ustundeki
kareden iceri
dusmeliler.</CR>

original: うさぎ
translation: Tavsan

original:
Touch a carrot to choose where the rabbit
starts. Carrots in the same horizontal or
vertical line will be highlighted.
translation:
Bir havuca dokunarak tavsanin nereden
baslayacagini sec. Ayni yatay veya
dikey cizgideki havuclar vurgulanir.

original:
Touch any highlighted carrot, and the rabbit
will move to it, eating any other carrots he
passes on the way.
translation:
Vurgulanan herhangi bir havuca dokun; tavsan
ona giderken yol uzerindeki diger
havuclari da yer.

original:
After your first move, a wolf will appear
behind the rabbit and follow him. The rabbit
is blocked from going backwards now!
translation:
Ilk hamlenden sonra tavsanin arkasinda bir
kurt belirecek ve onu takip edecek.
Artik tavsan geri gidemez!

original:
Lead the rabbit around the field so that he
can munch all the carrots without getting
eaten up himself!
translation:
Tavsani tarlada dolastir ki
kendisi yenmeden butun havuclari
guzelce kemirebilsin!

original: 壁画
translation: Duvar resmi

original:
The tomb entrance is opened using a
strange device inscribed with letters from
an ancient script. Connect pairs of letters
to undo the locks.
translation:
Mezarin girisi, eski bir yazidan harflerle
kazinmis tuhaf bir cihazla aciliyor.
Kilitleri cozmek icin
harf ciftlerini bagla.

original:
Draw lines by sliding the stylus from letter to
letter. Trace over a line to erase it.
translation:
Kalemi bir harften digerine kaydirarak cizgiler ciz.
Bir cizginin uzerinden gecerek onu silebilirsin.

original:
Watch out: you can't draw a line across an
existing connection.
translation:
Dikkat: Var olan bir baglantinin uzerinden
cizgi cekemezsin.

original:
Connect all the matching letters and claim
the treasure!
translation:
Eslesen tum harfleri bagla ve
hazineyi kap!

original: 領地
translation: Toprak

original:
Several wealthy lords share an area of land.
The numbers on the castles indicate how
many squares of territory each lord owns.
translation:
Bir bolgeyi birkac zengin lord paylasir.
Kalelerin uzerindeki sayilar, her lordun
kac karelik topraga sahip oldugunu gosterir.

original:
Slide the stylus on the board to create a
rectangular frame. Use this frame to build
fences around each castle and its territory.
translation:
Tahtada kalemi kaydirarak dikdortgen bir
cerceve olustur. Bu cerceveyi kullanarak
her kalenin ve topraginin etrafina cit cek.

original:
If the amount of territory contained in the
frame matches the number on the castle,
the frame will turn blue. Too many squares,
and the frame will turn red.
translation:
Cercevenin icindeki toprak miktari,
kalede yazan sayi ile eslesirse cerceve
mavi olur. Kareler fazlaysa,
cerceve kirmizi olur.

original:
Territory cannot belong to more than one
castle. Draw frames to divide up all the
land so every lord has the correct amount.
translation:
Toprak birden fazla kaleye ait olamaz.
Tum araziyi bolmek icin cerceveler ciz ve
her lordun dogru miktarda topragi olsun.

original: ヤジリン
translation: Yajilin

original:
Start by working out where the hidden rocks
are. Touch a space to mark it with a rock.
Arrows tell you how many rocks lie in that
direction.
translation:
Once gizli kayalarin nerede oldugunu bul.
Bir kareye dokunarak onu kaya ile isaretle.
Oklar, o yonde kac kaya oldugunu
soyler.

original:
Rocks may also be hiding in places where no
arrow points, but no rocks are directly
adjacent to one another.
translation:
Ok olmayan yerlerde de kayalar sakli olabilir,
ama hicbir kaya digerine dogrudan
bitisik degildir.

original:
Once you have an idea of where the rocks
are, draw lines on the board to chart a
course for the boat, starting and ending at
the flag.
translation:
Kayalarin nerede olduguna dair bir fikrin
olunca, tahtada cizgiler cizerek teknenin
bayraktan baslayip bayrakta bitecek
rotasini belirle.

original:
The course must be a continuous line without
any branches or overlaps.
translation:
Rota, dallanmayan ve ust uste binmeyen
kesintisiz bir cizgi olmalidir.

original:
The boat must travel through all squares
except for those with rocks or arrows.
The journey can't be safely completed until
every blank square has been filled.
translation:
Tekne, kayali veya oklu kareler disindaki
tum karelerden gecmelidir.
Her bos kare doldurulmadan yolculuk
guvenle tamamlanamaz.

original: カラースケルトン
translation: Renkli Iskelet

original:
Fill the empty spaces of the board with all the
tiles from the right-hand side of the Touch
Screen.
translation:
Tahtadaki bos alanlari, Dokunmatik
ekranin sagindaki tum parcalarla
doldur.

original:
Slide the tiles onto the board. Once you've
moved a tile, you can rotate it by sliding the
stylus over the edges.
translation:
Parcalari tahtaya kaydir.
Bir parcayi hareket ettirdikten sonra, kalemi
kenarlari boyunca kaydirarak onu dondurebilirsin.

original:
Both ends of a tile must touch either a grey
square or the edge of the board.
translation:
Bir parcanin iki ucu da ya gri bir kareye
ya da tahtanin kenarina degmelidir.

original:
Tile squares of the same colour and pattern
can be placed on top of each other. You'll
have to do this to complete the puzzle.
translation:
Ayni renkte ve desende olan parca kareleri
ust uste yerlestirilebilir. Bulmacayi tamamlamak icin
bunu yapman gerekecek.

original: 猫のソリティア
translation: 猫のソリティア

original:
Touch and hold any
cat on the Touch
Screen to highlight all
the squares it can
jump to. Jump over the
white kittens one by
one to make them all
vanish, and make sure
the black cat ends up
in the centre.
translation:
Touch and hold any
cat on the Touch
Screen to highlight all
the squares it can
jump to. Jump over the
white kittens one by
one to make them all
vanish, and make sure
the black cat ends up
in the centre.

original: 皿
translation: Tabak

original:
A chef uses colour-coded plates when
serving up dishes. The number on each
type of plate shows how many plates are
in the stack.
translation:
Bir asci, yemek servis ederken renk kodlu
(tabak) kullanir. Her tabak turunun
uzerindeki sayi, destede kac tabak
oldugunu gosterir.

original:
Slide plates from the stacks to the surface
one at a time. When a stack is numbered 2
or higher, you still have to lay out more
plates.
translation:
Tabaklari destelerden tezgaha
birer birer kaydir. Bir destede sayi 2
veya daha yuksekse, hala
daha fazla tabak yerlestirmen gerekir.

original:
To avoid mixing up dishes, each plate must
be placed next to another of the same type
and may not touch any other type of plate.
translation:
Yemekler karismasin diye her tabak
ayni turden baska bir tabagin yanina konulmali
ve baska tur bir tabaga dokunmamalidir.

original:
You can place a tick in an empty space by
touching it. This is handy for marking spaces
that you can't move plates into.
translation:
Bos bir yere dokunarak bir tik isareti
koyabilirsin. Bu, tabak koyamayacagin
kareleri isaretlemek icin kullanislidir.

original: かるがも
translation: Ordek Ailesi

original:
Reunite all the lost ducks with their families!
A family of ducks consists of one mother
duck and four ducklings. Ducklings stand
behind their mother in order.
translation:
Kaybolan tum ordekleri aileleriyle yeniden bulustur!
Bir ordek ailesi bir anne
ordek ve dort yavrudan olusur. Yavrular
annelerinin arkasinda sirayla durur.

original:
Touch a square to place a mother duck.
Slide the stylus from that point to place
ducklings behind her and to gather up
stranded ducklings.
translation:
Bir kareye dokunarak bir anne ordek yerlestir.
O noktadan kalemi kaydirarak
arkasina yavrulari yerlestir ve
dagilmis yavrulari topla.

original:
You can't move the ducks that are there
from the start. Duck heads represent mother
ducks, and ducklings are numbered with their
position in the chain.
translation:
Baslangicta duran ordekleri
hareket ettiremezsin. Ordek baslari anne
ordekleri gosterir; yavrular ise
zincirdeki konumlarina gore numaralanmistir.

original:
Ducks from different families will fight when
they are adjacent. You'll see this on the top
screen.
translation:
Farkli ailelerden ordekler yan yana gelince
kavga eder. Bunu ust ekranda
gorebilirsin.

original:
Pay attention to the direction the mother
duck faces. If any other family is in view,
she'll start a fight. You can't finish the
puzzle if the ducks are fighting.
translation:
Anne ordegin baktigi yone dikkat et.
Gorus alaninda baska bir aile varsa,
kavgaya baslar. Ordekler kavga ederken
bulmacayi bitiremezsin.

original: 恐竜
translation: Dinozor

original:
Lead the baby dinosaurs home. Touching
a baby dinosaur highlights its mother's
territory.
translation:
Bebek dinozorlari eve gotur. Bir bebek
dinozora dokunmak, annesinin
bolgesini vurgular.

original:
Slide the stylus from a baby dinosaur to an
empty square to draw its route.
translation:
Bir bebek dinozordan bos bir kareye kalemi
kaydirarak rotasini ciz.

original:
None of the baby dinosaur's routes can
cross.
translation:
Hicbir bebek dinozorun rotasi
birbirini kesemez.

original:
Some of the baby dinosaurs have brothers
and sisters. You'll have to guide all the
siblings home.
translation:
Bazi bebek dinozorlarin erkek ve kiz
kardesleri var. Tum
kardesleri eve goturmen gerekecek.

original: 橋
translation: Kopru

original:
Touch a flask and slide to another flask in a
direct horizontal or vertical line to connect
the two flasks with a glass tube.
translation:
Bir siseye dokun ve yatay ya da dikey duz
bir cizgiyle baska bir siseye kaydirarak
ikisini bir cam tuple bagla.

original:
You can use up to two tubes to connect a
pair of flasks. No tubes can cross each
other. Touch a tube to remove it.
translation:
Bir sise ciftini baglamak icin en fazla iki
tup kullanabilirsin. Tupler birbirini
kesemez. Bir tupe dokunarak kaldir.

original:
Each flask is numbered to show how many
tubes it needs. Once you have enough, the
number and flask will turn blue. Too many,
and they will turn red.
translation:
Her sise, kac tupe ihtiyac duydugunu
gosteren bir sayiyla numaralidir.
Yeterli olunca sayi ve sise mavi olur.
Fazlaysa kirmizi olur.

original:
The alchemy experiment will succeed <CR>when
all the flasks turn blue</CR> and are <CR>connected</CR>
by glass tubes.
translation:
Simya deneyi, <CR>tum siseler mavi oldugunda</CR>
ve cam tuplerle <CR>baglandiginda</CR>
basarili olur.

original:
Touch the Touch
Screen to change the
direction the ladybird
is facing.

Hold the stylus down
to have the ladybird
walk in that direction.
translation:
Touch the Touch
Screen to change the
direction the ladybird
is facing.

Hold the stylus down
to have the ladybird
walk in that direction.

original:
Slide the stylus on the
Touch Screen to move
the mallet around on
the top screen.
translation:
Slide the stylus on the
Touch Screen to move
the mallet around on
the top screen.

original:
Move the mallet over
an arrow next to a
block to highlight the
arrow, then tap the
Touch Screen to hit
the block and shunt it
in that direction.

Can you hit all the
blocks into place?
translation:
Move the mallet over
an arrow next to a
block to highlight the
arrow, then tap the
Touch Screen to hit
the block and shunt it
in that direction.

Can you hit all the
blocks into place?

original: 天空の広場の猫
translation: Gokyuzu Meydani Kedisi

original:
Touch and hold a
penguin, then slide the
stylus on the Touch
Screen in the direction
you want the penguin
to go.
translation:
Bir penguene dokunup
basili tut, sonra
kalemi Dokunmatik
Ekran uzerinde penguenin
gitmesini istedigin
yone kaydir.

original:
The penguin will keep
sliding until it bumps
into another penguin.

Be careful: if the
penguin doesn't stop,
it'll fall right into the
sea.
translation:
Penguen, baska bir
penguene carpana kadar
kaymaya devam eder.

Dikkat: Penguen
durmazsa, dogruca
denize duser.

original: 白黒ウサギ
translation: Siyah Beyaz Tavsanlar

original:
Touch and hold a
rabbit on the Touch
Screen to highlight all
the squares it can
hop to.

To move the rabbit,
slide it to a green
square.
translation:
Dokunmatik Ekran'da
bir tavsana dokunup
basili tut; boylece
ziplayabilecegi tum
kareler vurgulanir.

Tavsani hareket
ettirmek icin onu yesil
bir kareye kaydir.

original:
Any white rabbits it
crosses over will turn
brown, and vice versa.

Move the rabbits so
that all the rabbits turn
brown.
translation:
Uzerinden gectigi tum
beyaz tavsanlar kahverengi
olur; kahverengiler de
beyaza doner.

Tum tavsanlar
kahverengi olana kadar
tavsanlari hareket ettir.

original: キンコンカン
translation: Kinkonkan

original:
Place mirrors to reflect the light beams and
help the knights banish the ghosts.
translation:
Isik isinlarini yansitmak icin aynalar yerlestir
ve sovalyelerin hayaletleri kovmasina yardim et.

original:
You can only banish a ghost using a beam of
the same colour.
translation:
Bir hayaleti yalnizca ayni renkteki bir isinla
kovabilirsin.

original:
The number on each ghost tells you exactly
how many times you need to reflect the
corresponding beam.
translation:
Her hayaletin uzerindeki sayi, ilgili isini
tam olarak kac kez yansitman gerektigini
soyler.

original:
You can't place more than one mirror per
section, and every section must contain
a mirror.
translation:
Her bolume birden fazla ayna koyamazsin
ve her bolum mutlaka
bir ayna icermelidir.

original:
Touch mirrors to rotate or remove them.
Position the mirrors carefully and banish all
the ghosts!
translation:
Aynalara dokunarak dondur veya kaldir.
Aynalari dikkatle yerlestir ve tum
hayaletleri kov!

original: 魔女
translation: Cadi

original:
Help the neighbourhood witch illuminate the
town. The street lights are firmly planted
and moving them is beyond her power!
translation:
Mahalle cadisinin kasabayi aydinlatmasina
yardim et. Sokak lambalari saglamca
dikili ve onlari tasimak gucunu asar!

original:
Touch a light to flick it on. The illumination
will fall in straight horizontal and vertical
lines until blocked by an obstacle.
translation:
Bir lambaya dokunarak onu yak.
Isik, bir engelle kesilene kadar yatay ve dikey
dogrultuda duz cizgiler halinde yayilir.

original:
After choosing which lights to turn on, touch
<CR>Submit</CR> to see if your solution works. Look
out for anything that you need to fix.
translation:
Hangi lambalari yakacagina karar verdikten sonra
<CR>Gonder</CR>'e dokun ve cozumunun ise yarayip
yaramadigini gor. Duzeltmen gereken seylere dikkat et.

original:
There are a couple of rules you need to
follow. Street lights must not shine on any
light that's already lit. Affected lights will
overheat and turn orange.
translation:
Uyman gereken birkac kural var.
Sokak lambalari, zaten yanan hicbir lambayi
aydinlatmamali. Etkilenen lambalar asiri isinir
ve turuncuya doner.

original:
Additionally, the budget is very tight, so
make sure you use as few lights as possible.
translation:
Ayrica butce cok kisitli, bu yuzden
mumkun oldugunca az lamba kullan.

original: 飛行機
translation: Ucak

original:
Draw lines using the stylus to create <CR>a
flight path that goes through every space</CR>
on the chart.
translation:
Kalemle cizgiler cizerek <CR>tablodaki
her kareden gecen bir ucus rotasi</CR>
olustur.

original:
When drawing your path, make sure you
include all the points already marked on the
chart.
translation:
Rotani cizerken mutlaka
tabloda zaten isaretli olan tum noktalari
dahil ettiginden emin ol.

original:
The plane must travel in a continuous line
and never retrace part of its route. As
a result, the flight path can contain four-way
crossings but no T-junctions.
translation:
Ucak kesintisiz bir cizgi boyunca ilerlemeli
ve rotasinin hicbir kismini tekrar izlememeli.
Bu nedenle rota dort yonlu
kesismeler icerebilir, ama T-kavsaklar olamaz.

original:
Additionally, the plane <CR>can't turn at a
four-way crossing</CR> - it can only go straight
on. Bear that in mind when creating your
path.
translation:
Ayrica ucak <CR>dort yonlu bir kesisimde
donemez</CR> - sadece dumduz
gecebilir. Rotani olustururken bunu
aklinda tut.

original:
If your solution doesn't work, make sure it
doesn't include <CR>T-junctions or turns at
four-way crossings</CR>.
translation:
Cozumun calismiyorsa, icinde <CR>T-kavsaklar
veya dort yonlu kesisimlerde donusler</CR>
olmadigindan emin ol.

original: 鉄道
translation: Demiryolu

original:
Create circular routes for the trains and the
camera-toting trainspotters. The circuits must
pass through all train and camera tiles
respectively.
translation:
Trenler ve kameralariyla tren meraklilari icin
dairesel rotalar olustur. Devreler,
sirasiyla tum tren ve kamera karelerinden
gecmelidir.

original:
Draw lines on the board to create the routes.
Routes cannot pass through trees and
cannot turn on bridges.
translation:
Tahtada cizgiler cizerek rotalari olustur.
Rotalar agaclardan gecemez ve
koprulerin uzerinde donemez.

original:
The trainspotters must pass over all the
bridges to take their photos. They cannot go
under bridges.
translation:
Tren meraklilari fotograflarini cekmek icin
tum koprulerin uzerinden gecmelidir.
Koprulerin altindan gecemezler.

original:
The trains can go under bridges but don't
need to go under all of them. They can't
travel over bridges.
translation:
Trenler koprulerin altindan gecebilir ama
tumunun altindan gecmeleri gerekmez.
Koprulerin ustunden gidemezler.

original:
The trainspotter and train routes can only
cross safely at bridges. <CR>Use the bridges to
create a safe circular route for both trains
and trainspotters!</CR>
translation:
Tren meraklisi ve tren rotalari yalnizca
koprulerde guvenle kesisebilir. <CR>Kopruleri
kullanarak hem trenler hem de meraklilar icin
guvenli bir dairesel rota olustur!</CR>

original: オアシス
translation: Vaha

original:
Slide tortoises from the right of the screen
to place them on the board. Use the shovel
to dig oases. Fill all the empty squares with
a tortoise or an oasis.
translation:
Ekranin sagindan kaplumbagalari surukleyip
tahtaya yerlestir. Kurekle vahalar kaz.
Tum bos kareleri bir kaplumbaga veya
bir vaha ile doldur.

original:
The tortoises must face each other in pairs.
The colours don't need to match.
translation:
Kaplumbagalar ikili halde birbirine bakmalidir.
Renklerin ayni olmasi gerekmez.

original:
At least one oasis must be placed between
each pair of tortoises. No cacti or other
tortoises can be positioned between a pair
of tortoises.
translation:
Her kaplumbaga ciftinin arasina en az bir
vaha yerlestirilmelidir. Bir cift kaplumbaganin
arasina kaktus veya baska kaplumbaga
konamaz.

original:
Finally, all oases must lie between a pair of
tortoises. Now, bring some life to this dry,
dusty desert!
translation:
Son olarak, tum vahalar bir kaplumbaga
ciftinin arasinda olmalidir. Haydi, bu kuru,
toztoprak cole biraz hayat getir!

original: つぼ
translation: Kavanoz

original:
Lead the police dog to the cheeky animal
pranksters and arrest those ruffians!
translation:
Polis kopegini haylaz hayvan sakacilarina
gotur ve o serserileri tutukla!

original:
Move the police dog by drawing lines with
the stylus. He will start moving when you
lift the stylus.
translation:
Polis kopegini kalemle cizgiler cizerek
hareket ettir. Kalemi kaldirdiginda
hareket etmeye baslar.

original:
When the police dog is next to one of the
pranksters, touch it to arrest it. The police
dog will push the mischief-maker backwards
into a cage.
translation:
Polis kopegi sakacilardan birinin yanindayken,
onu tutuklamak icin ona dokun. Polis kopegi
yaramazi geriye dogru iterek
bir kafese sokar.

original:
The police dog can't go through squares with
cages in them. Pay attention to the order in
which you make your arrests!
translation:
Polis kopegi icinde kafes olan karelerden
gocemez. Tutuklamalari hangi sirayla
yaptigina dikkat et!

original: ふん水
translation: Fiskiye

original:
The park's water supply is broken. Connect
the pipe sections on the board and rehydrate
the thirsty park.
translation:
Parkin su sistemi bozulmus. Tahtadaki
boru parcalarini baglayip
susuz kalan parka yeniden su ver.

original:
You can use whichever additional sections
you need. Slide them from the right-hand
side onto the board. Yellow connectors will
appear to link adjacent pipe sections.
translation:
Ihtiyacin olan ek parcalari kullanabilirsin.
Sag taraftan surukleyip tahtaya birak.
Bitisik boru parcalarini baglamak icin
sari baglantilar belirecek.

original:
The numbers on the pipe sections tell you
how many connections you need to make.
Get it right and the number turns blue. Go
over and it turns red.
translation:
Boru parcalarindaki sayilar, kac baglanti
yapman gerektigini gosterir.
Dogru olursa sayi mavi olur.
Asarsan kirmiziya doner.

original:
Numbers also turn red if you put sections
with the same number next to each other.
<CR>Turn all the numbers blue while connecting
all the pipe sections!</CR>
translation:
Ayni sayiya sahip parcalari yan yana
koyarsan sayilar da kirmizi olur.
<CR>Tum boru parcalarini baglarken
butun sayilari mavi yap!</CR>

original:
Touch a blank space once to put down a
placeholder, and twice to put down a cross.
Use these as a guide.
translation:
Bos bir yere bir kez dokunarak bir
isaret koy, iki kez dokunarak bir carpi koy.
Bunlari rehber olarak kullan.

original: ひとりにしてくれ
translation: Beni yalniz birak

original:
Touch sweets to remove them from the box.
The resultant layout should follow two very
specific rules.
translation:
Kutudan cikarmak icin sekerlemelere dokun.
Ortaya cikan duzen iki cok
belirgin kurala uymalidir.

original:
Firstly, you can't have more than one of the
same sweet in any row or column. Once a
sweet is the only one of its kind in its row
and column, it will sparkle on the top screen.
translation:
Ilk olarak, herhangi bir satir veya sutunda
ayni sekerlemeden birden fazla olamaz.
Bir sekerleme satirinda ve sutununda
tek kaldiginda, ust ekranda parildar.

original:
Secondly, you can't have two or more
consecutive blank spaces. Obey these two
rules as you remove sweets from the box
and you'll end up with the perfect layout!
translation:
Ikinci olarak, art arda iki veya daha fazla
bos kare olamaz. Sekerlemeleri kutudan
cikarirken bu iki kurala uyarsan,
sonunda mukemmel duzeni elde edersin!

original: 凸凹ピザ
translation: Engebeli Pizza

original:
Touch and rotate the
spatula on the Touch
Screen.

Move the spatula
beneath the slice you
want to flip.
translation:
Dokunmatik Ekran'da
spatulaya dokunup
dondur.

Spatulayi cevirmek
istedigin dilimin
altina getir.

original:
To flip a slice, touch
the Touch Screen.
The slices on either
side of that slice will
flip as well.

Flip the slices so that
all the slices are the
right way up.
translation:
Bir dilimi cevirmek icin
Dokunmatik Ekran'a
dokun. O dilimin
iki yanindaki dilimler
de birlikte cevrilir.

Tum dilimler dogru
yone bakana kadar
dilimleri cevir.

original: 洞窟の壁面
translation: 洞窟の壁面

original:
Slide the stylus on the
Touch Screen to move
the lit-up area on the
top screen.

Move the lamp and
count the number of
animals on the mural.
translation:
Slide the stylus on the
Touch Screen to move
the lit-up area on the
top screen.

Move the lamp and
count the number of
animals on the mural.

original: 風船のナゾ
translation: Balon Bulmacasi

original:
On the Touch Screen,
touch an orange point
between two panels to
swap those panels.
translation:
Dokunmatik Ekran'da,
iki panelin arasindaki
turuncu noktaya dokunarak
o panelleri yer degistir.

original:
As you swap panels,
the strings will
gradually untangle...
or become even more
tangled! Your goal is
to straighten out all
four strings.
translation:
Panelleri degistirirken
ipler yavas yavas
cozulur...
ya da daha da
dolanir! Amacin
dort ipin hepsini
dumduz yapmak.

original: 無限回廊のナゾ
translation: 無限回廊のナゾ

original:
[Temporary text]

[The graphic's temporary too.]
translation:
[Temporary text]

[The graphic's temporary too.]

original: ママを捜して
translation: ママを捜して

original:
Slide the stylus on the
Touch Screen to move
the finger icon on the
top screen.
translation:
Slide the stylus on the
Touch Screen to move
the finger icon on the
top screen.

original:
When the icon turns
orange, you can touch
the Touch Screen to
mark that choice as
your answer.
translation:
When the icon turns
orange, you can touch
the Touch Screen to
mark that choice as
your answer.

original: ポスターをはろう
translation: ポスターをはろう

original:
Rotate the poster on
the top screen by
sliding the hand across
the scroll bar on the
Touch Screen.

The further you move
the hand from the
centre, the faster
the poster will move.
translation:
Rotate the poster on
the top screen by
sliding the hand across
the scroll bar on the
Touch Screen.

The further you move
the hand from the
centre, the faster
the poster will move.

original: ２人のポーター
translation: ２人のポーター

original:
Slide the pieces of
luggage from the left
side of the Touch
Screen into the
porters' hands, then
touch the bell.

Watch the top screen
to see how the porters
react to the weight.
translation:
Slide the pieces of
luggage from the left
side of the Touch
Screen into the
porters' hands, then
touch the bell.

Watch the top screen
to see how the porters
react to the weight.

original: 心太パズル
translation: 心太パズル

original:
Slide the pieces
horizontally and
vertically. You can
only move them in
lines of three.

Paying attention to the
pattern on the pieces,
arrange them into a
3 x 3 square in the
centre.
translation:
Slide the pieces
horizontally and
vertically. You can
only move them in
lines of three.

Paying attention to the
pattern on the pieces,
arrange them into a
3 x 3 square in the
centre.

original: がらくた連鎖
translation: Hurdalik Zinciri

original:
Slide the numbered
shots into the
slingshots.
translation:
Numarali
atislari
sapanlara kaydir.

original:
Once the slingshots
are loaded, touch
<CR>Submit</C> to fire all the
shots in order.

The goal is to make
one of the shots ring
the bell.
translation:
Sapanlar dolunca,
tum atislari sirayla
firlatmak icin
<CR>Gonder</C>'e dokun.

Amac, atislardan
birinin zili
caldirmasidir.

original: チェスのナゾ
translation: Satranc Bulmacasi

original:
Slide the stylus across
the board to draw
lines. Trace over a
line to erase it.
translation:
Cizgi cizmek icin
kalemi tahta uzerinde
kaydir. Bir cizginin
uzerinden gecerek sil.

original:
Divide the board to
create pieces of the
same shape and area
according to the
conditions in the
puzzle.

Be careful not to
include mirror images
in your solution.
translation:
Bulmacadaki
kosullara gore
tahtayi bolup
ayni sekil ve
alana sahip
parcalar olustur.

Cozumunde ayna
goruntulerini
kullanmamaya dikkat et.

original: トランクの中身
translation: トランクの中身

original:
Touch blocks in the
centre to move them
and on the edges to
rotate them.

Arrange the white
studs, ○, and black
holes, ●, so they fit
together when the
trunk is closed.
translation:
Touch blocks in the
centre to move them
and on the edges to
rotate them.

Arrange the white
studs, ○, and black
holes, ●, so they fit
together when the
trunk is closed.

original:
Control a wind-up toy robot that
moves three steps at a time and
help him land exactly on the goal.
translation:
Ucer adim yuruyen kurmali bir
oyuncak robotu yonet ve
onu hedefe tam isabetle ulastir.

original: Hidden Maze
translation: Gizli Labirent

original:
A dark underground
labyrinth shrouded
in mystery. Enter if
you dare!
translation:
Karanlik bir yeralti
labirenti; sirlarla
ortulu. Cesaretin
varsa iceri gir!

original: Abandoned Lab
translation: Terk Edilmis Laboratuvar

original:
A forgotten lab full
of weird devices
covered by thick
layers of dust.
translation:
Garip aygitlarla dolu
unutulmus bir laboratuvar;
her yeri kalin bir
toz tabakasi kaplamis.

original: Rediscovered Ruin
translation: Yeniden Kesfedilen Harabe

original:
An ancient ruin left
by a lost culture.
Small but perfectly
formidable.
translation:
Kayip bir uygarligin
geride biraktigi eski
bir harabe. Kucuk ama
tam anlamiyla zorlu.

original: Colossal Coliseum
translation: Dev Kolezyum

original:
A grand stadium
built to pit man
against man in a
test of strength.
translation:
Insani insana karsi
guc sinavina sokmak
icin yapilmis gorkemli
bir stadyum.

original: Inviting Oasis
translation: Cazip Vaha

original:
A cool spring that
grants relief to
those trekking over
the arid sands.
translation:
Serin bir pinar;
kurak kumlari asanlara
rahatlama saglar,
yorgunlugu alir.

original: Perilous Pyramid
translation: Tehlikeli Piramit

original:
An eerie place said
to curse all who
enter. But it can't
be true...can it?
translation:
Iceri giren herkesi
lanetledigi soylenen
urkutucu bir yer. Ama
dogru olamaz... degil mi?

original: Weird Wilds
translation: Tuhaf Yabanlar

original:
A remote jungle
filled with plants
that don't even
have names yet.
translation:
Henuz adi bile olmayan
bitkilerle dolu,
uzak bir orman.
Kesfedilmeyi bekliyor.

original: Sturdy Ship
translation: Saglam Gemi

original:
Ruthless pirates
once sailed the
seven seas aboard
this ship.
translation:
Acimasiz korsanlar
bir zamanlar bu gemiyle
yedi denizi
arsinlamis.

original: Teensy Town
translation: Minik Kasaba

original:
The houses may be
miniature, but you
can still expect
a big challenge!
translation:
Evler minicik olabilir,
ama seni
kocaman bir
gorev bekliyor!

original: Floating Castle
translation: Ucan Kale

original:
Look up at the sky
after a storm clears
and you just might
catch a glimpse.
translation:
Firtina dindikten sonra
gokyuzune bak;
belki de
kisacik gorursun.

original: Eastern Palace
translation: Dogu Sarayi

original:
Use the power of
the golden keys to
defeat the dreaded
mechamutt!
translation:
Altin anahtarlarin
gucunu kullanip
korkunc
Mechamutt'u yen!

original:
Few dare to enter this hidden
underground maze. The stages
here will really test your skill.
translation:
Bu gizli yeralti labirentine
az kisi girmeye cesaret eder.
Buradaki bolumler becerini gercekten sinar.

original: A Grand Entrance
translation: Gorkemli Giris

original:
The maze begins!
It looks complex,
but is all this stuff
actually helpful?
translation:
Labirent basliyor!
Karmasik gorunuyor,
ama tum bunlar
gercekten ise yariyor mu?

original: An Ambush or Seven
translation: Yedi Pusu Birden

original:
Six mousebots and
one autocat... It's
a tight spot, all
right! Be careful!
translation:
Alti farebot ve
bir otokedik... Tam bir
sikisik durum!
Dikkatli ol!

original: Barmy Belts
translation: Cilgin Bantlar

original:
You might be going
round in circles,
but at least there
are no enemies!
translation:
Donup duruyor
olabilirsin,
ama en azindan
hic dusman yok!

original: Circles of Trust
translation: Guven Cemberleri

original:
You can get past
those mousebots if
you blend in. Follow
their route, maybe?
translation:
Farebotlarla kaynasirsan
onlarin yanindan
gecebilirsin. Belki de
rotalarini takip et?

original: Tempting Trinkets
translation: Cazip Nimetler

original:
Those golden keys
may be inviting, but
you can't just grab
them willy-nilly!
translation:
O altin anahtarlar
cazip gorunebilir ama
oyle kafana gore
hemen kapamazsin!

original: So Near, Yet So Far
translation: Bu Kadar Yakin, Yine de Uzak

original:
Sometimes, the
shortest possible
route still feels like
the long way round.
translation:
Bazen mumkun olan
en kisa rota bile
insana sanki
cok uzunmus gibi gelir.

original: Close Encounters
translation: Yakin Temaslar

original:
If you watch the
enemies carefully,
you can avoid them
by a hair's breadth.
translation:
Dusmanlari dikkatle
izlersen,
onlardan kil payi
kacinabilirsin.

original: Mousebot Mambo
translation: Farebot Mambo

original:
Try not to disturb
the mousebots and
their endless,
elegant dance!
translation:
Farebotlari ve onlarin
bitmek bilmeyen,
nazik dansini
rahatsiz etmemeye calis!

original: Alleyway Escape
translation: Arka Sokak Kacisi

original:
Mousebot chasing
you down a tight
alley? Relax! You'll
be fine...probably!
translation:
Farebot dar bir
sokakta pesine mi dustu?
Sakin ol! Iyi olacaksin...
muhtemelen!

original: Sneaking Skills
translation: Sizma Becerisi

original:
Going near the
enemy on purpose
is risky, but
when needs must...
translation:
Dusmana bilerek
yaklasmak riskli,
ama bazen
mecbur kalirsin...

original: Crossing Paths
translation: Yollar Kesisirken

original:
Always have your
next move in mind,
or you'll be tripping
over mousebots!
translation:
Bir sonraki hamleni
aklinda tut,
yoksa farebotlara
takilip durursun!

original: Crazy Conveyors
translation: Cilgin Konveyorler

original:
Conveyor belts, as
far as the eye can
see. Just don't get
carried away!
translation:
Goz alabildigine
konveyor bantlari.
Ama kendini fazla
kaptirma!

original: Pick a Goal
translation: Hedef Sec

original:
It doesn't matter
which goal you aim
for, as long as you
can get to it!
translation:
Hangi hedefi sectigin
onemli degil;
yeter ki
ona ulasabilesin!

original: Decision of Destiny
translation: Kaderin Karari

original:
The very first step
you take here will
decide your fate.
Choose carefully.
translation:
Burada atacagin ilk
adim kaderini
belirleyecek.
Dikkatle sec.

original: Journey's End
translation: Yolculugun Sonu

original:
The deepest floor
of the maze. None
who have entered
have ever returned.
translation:
Labirentin en derin
kati. Iceri girenlerden
hicbiri
geri donmedi.

original:
<T>Guide your wind-up robot around the
hazardous course to reach his goal.
translation:
<T>Kurmali robotunu tehlikeli parkurda
yonlendir ve hedefe ulastir.

original:
<T>Touch the yellow arrows to make the robot
move up, down, left or right.
translation:
<T>Robotu yukari, asagi, sola ya da saga
hareket ettirmek icin sari oklara dokun.

original:
<T>The robot walks three steps at a time. You
can't stop him once he gets going!
translation:
<T>Robot her seferinde uc adim yurur. Hareket
edince onu durduramazsin!

original:
<T>There's also no way to make this dogged
adventurer turn around mid-walk.
translation:
<T>Ustelik bu inatci maceraciyi yururken
geri dondurmenin bir yolu yok.

original:
<T>However, if the robot bumps into a wall or
block, he'll be stopped in his tracks.
translation:
<T>Ama robot bir duvara ya da bloga carparsa
oldugu yerde durur.

original: <T>Some stages include conveyor belts.
translation: <T>Bazi bolumlerde konveyor bantlari vardir.

original:
<T>Most of the time they're completely still, but
if the robot stops on one...
translation:
<T>Cogu zaman kipirdamazlar, ama robot
uzerlerinde durursa...

original:
<T>Wheeee! The conveyor belt is activated, and
the robot gets carried along.
translation:
<T>Vuuuu! Konveyor bant calisir ve
robotu surukler.

original:
<T>This is an enemy mousebot. This deadly foe
only moves when your robot does.
translation:
<T>Bu bir dusman farebot. Bu olumcul rakip,
robotun hareket ettiginde hareket eder.

original:
<T>Be careful not to let the robot bump into
one! If he does, it's an instant knockout.
translation:
<T>Robotunun ona carpmamasina dikkat et!
Carparsa aninda yenilirsin.

original: <T>Oh no! The robot's trapped! <W>...Or is he?
translation: <T>Hayir! Robot tuzaga dustu! <W>...Yoksa dusmedi mi?

original:
<T>The robot and the mousebots move at
exactly the same time, so he should be able
to slip past.
translation:
<T>Robot ve farebotlar tam ayni anda hareket
eder, bu yuzden onlarin yanindan
siyrilabilir.

original:
<T>Now, have a look at the gauge on the
right-hand side of the Touch Screen.
translation:
<T>Simdi Dokunmatik Ekran'in sagindaki
gostergesine bak.

original:
<T>This decreases every time the robot moves.
He can move up to 30 times.
translation:
<T>Robot her hareket ettiginde bu azalir.
En fazla 30 kez hareket edebilir.

original:
<T>Collect a golden key to power up! Let's try
it and see...
translation:
<T>Guclenmek icin altin anahtar topla! Haydi
deneyip gorelim...

original:
<T>Now your robot will smash anything in his
path! <W>Well, anything except a wall or a metal
block.
translation:
<T>Artik robotun yolundaki her seyi parcalar!
<W>Yani, bir duvar ya da metal bir blok haric
her seyi.

original: <T>The red panel is the goal.
translation: <T>Kirmizi panel hedeftir.

original:
<T>Whoops! He walked right past it. To win, he
must land exactly on the goal panel.
translation:
<T>Hoppala! Tam yanindan gecti. Kazanmak icin
hedef panelinin ustune tam isabetle inmeli.

original:
<T>Can you see a way to make the robot move
the right number of steps?
translation:
<T>Robotun dogru sayida adim atmasini saglayacak
bir yol bulabilir misin?

original:
<T>Yes! It was a perilous journey, but he got
there in the end.
translation:
<T>Evet! Tehlikeli bir yolculuktu ama sonunda
basardi.

original:
<T>You will collect more stages for your robot
as you play through the main game.
translation:
<T>Ana oyunda ilerledikce robotun icin daha
fazla bolum toplayacaksin.

original:
<T>If you clear every stage, there's a surprise to
look forward to!
translation:
<T>Tum bolumleri tamamlarsan seni bekleyen bir
surpriz var!

original: Reset the stage?
translation: Bolum sifirlansin mi?

original: Return to the world map?
translation: Dunya haritasina donulsun mu?

original:
You completed
{''}%s{''}!
translation:
Tamamladin
{''}%s{''}!

original:
You unlocked the final stage:
{''}%s{''}!
translation:
Son bolumu actin:
{''}%s{''}!

original:
Now brave the hidden maze and its
challenging extra stages!
translation:
Simdi Gizli Labirent'e gir ve
zorlu ek bolumlere meydan oku!

original:
<T>Select Hidden Maze to enter
a special mode with extra stages.
translation:
<T>Ek bolumlerin oldugu ozel bir moda
girmek icin Gizli Labirent'i sec.

original:
<T>The extra stages do not affect
completion of the main game.
translation:
<T>Ek bolumler ana oyunun
bitirme yuzdesini etkilemez.

original:
Line up products on the shelves,
linking one to the next by colour or
by type, and aim to clear out your
entire stock!
translation:
Urunleri raflara diz,
renk ya da turlerine gore
birbirine bagla ve
tum stogunu tuketmeyi hedefle!

original: Fresh Fruits
translation: Taze Meyveler

original:
The smallest aisle in the shop is also the
most fragrant. It's chock full of our freshest
apples, bananas and pineapples.
translation:
Dukkanin en kucuk reyonu ayni zamanda en
mis kokulu olani. En taze elmalarimiz,
bananalarimiz ve ananaslarimizla dolup tasiyor.

original: Crockery
translation: Porselen Esyalar

original:
Our delightful porcelain tea sets are arranged
here for your pleasure, including teapots,
cups and saucers.
translation:
Keyfiniz icin hazirladigimiz zarif porselen cay
takimlarimiz burada: demlikler, fincanlar ve
tabaklar.

original: Orienteering
translation: Kesif Ekipmanlari

original:
This pyramid aisle houses accessories fit for
even the most seasoned adventurers:
compasses, lanterns, cameras...the lot!
translation:
Bu piramit reyonunda en tecrubeli maceracilara
bile yakisacak aksesuarlar var:
pusulalar, fenerler, kameralar... hepsi burada!

original: Instruments
translation: Enstrumanlar

original:
Whether you're starting off or well-versed in
your harmonic minors, you'll find high quality
ocarinas, drums and violins here.
translation:
Ister yeni basliyor olun ister armonik minorlerde
usta, burada kaliteli okarineler, davullar ve
kemanlar bulacaksiniz.

original: Baked Goods
translation: Firin Urunleri

original:
The tantalising smell of treats baking in the
oven wafts down an aisle filled with fresh
loaves, cakes and doughnuts.
Flora
translation: Bitkiler

original:
Rare leafy plants, cacti and flowers from
around the world are gathered here on one
aisle and pruned daily.
translation:
Dunyanin dort bir yanindan nadir yaprakli
bitkiler, kaktusler ve cicekler bu reyonda
toplanir ve her gun budanir.

original: Apparel
translation: Giyim

original:
All our premium hats, ties and shoes are
tailored specifically to suit the needs of
refined ladies and gentlemen.
translation:
Tum kaliteli sapkalarimiz, kravatlarimiz ve
ayakkabilarimiz; zarif hanimefendi ve
beyefendilerin ihtiyaclarina gore hazirlanir.

original: Soft Toys
translation: Pelus Oyuncaklar

original:
Children adore our cute and cuddly collection
of stuffed toys, particularly our teddies, kitties
and bunnies.
translation:
Cocuklar sevimli ve yumusacik pelus
koleksiyonumuza bayilir; ozellikle ayiciklar,
minik kedicikler ve tavsanciklarimiza.

original: Hobby
translation: Hobi

original:
Model enthusiasts and collectors can't resist
our range of remote-controlled land, air and
sea miniatures.
translation:
Model meraklilari ve koleksiyoncular, uzaktan
kumandali kara, hava ve deniz minyaturlerimize
karsi koyamaz.

original: Antiques
translation: Antikalar

original:
Our largest aisle is home to a pristine
selection of antiques, ranging from fine china
and paintings to books and clocks.
translation:
En buyuk reyonumuzda, ince porselenlerden ve
tablolardan kitaplara ve saatlere uzanan, seckin
antikalar bulunur.

original:
Hello! I was wondering, do
you happen to have any
<CR>Misthallery Pippins</CR>?
translation:
Merhaba! Acaba sizde
<CR>Misthallery Pippins</CR>
var mi diye soracaktim.

original:
Oh, you do! I'd recognise
that shine anywhere. One
of those, please!
translation:
Aa, varmis! O pariltiyi
her yerde tanirim. Bir
tanesinden alayim lutfen!

original:
Wait! Isn't that a <CR>Granny
Jones</CR>? I've never tried one
before. I'll take it!
translation:
Dur! Bu bir <CR>Granny
Jones</CR> degil mi? Hic
denemedim. Aliyorum!

original:
A <CR>Stately Pineapple</CR>? Are
they as grand as they
sound? I'll take one!
translation:
<CR>Stately Pineapple</CR> mi? Adi
kadar gorkemli mi acaba?
Bir tane alayim!

original:
Oh, a <CR>Paradise Pineapple</CR>!
I've heard they're sweet and
juicy! I'll buy one!
translation:
Oo, <CR>Paradise Pineapple</CR>!
Tatli ve sulu olur derler.
Bir tane aliyorum!

original:
That's a <CR>King Cavendish</CR>,
isn't it? Oh, roll out the red
carpet - I'll buy it!
translation:
Bu bir <CR>King Cavendish</CR>,
degil mi? Kirmizi haliyi
serin-bunu aliyorum!

original:
The <CR>Queen Plantain</CR> would
be delicious fried! Give me
that, too!
translation:
<CR>Queen Plantain</CR> kizartilinca
cok guzel olur! Onu da
verin!

original: Umm...
translation: Hmm...

original: [not used]
translation: [kullanilmiyor]

original:
Ooh, another <CR>green</CR> one.
A good, healthy colour!
translation:
Ooo, bir <CR>green</CR> daha.
Guzel, saglikli bir renk!

original:
This must be your <CR>yellow</CR>
select range!
translation:
Bu da sizin seckin <CR>yellow</CR>
seriniz olmali!

original:
Ooh, that's a juicy-looking
<CR>apple</CR> there, too!
translation:
Ooo, surada sulu gorunen
bir <CR>apple</CR> da var!

original:
That <CR>pineapple</CR> looks pretty
appetising as well.
translation:
Su <CR>pineapple</CR> da epey
istah acici gorunuyor.

original:
Oh, I see you have another
<CR>banana</CR>!
translation: Aa, bir <CR>banana</CR> daha varmis!

original:
The shelves are bare now...
I've bought everything,
haven't I?
translation:
Raflar bosaldi...
Hepsini satin aldim,
degil mi?

original:
Well! You do know how to
win over your customers,
don't you?
translation:
Vay! Musterilerinizi nasil
kendinize cektiginizi
biliyorsunuz, ha?

original:
I'll be sure to stop by in
future!
translation: Ileride mutlaka yine ugrarim!

original:
Hmm... Well, that should be
enough for now.
translation:
Hmm... Simdilik bu kadari
yeter.

original: Goodbye! Take care!
translation: Hosca kal! Kendine iyi bak!

original: Hmmmm...
translation: Hmmm...

original:
That looks appealing... But
then again, so does that
one...
translation:
Bu cekici gorunuyor...
Ama su da oyle...

original:
No no, I think I've bought
everything I came for.
translation:
Yok yok, sanirim almaya
geldigim her seyi aldim.

original:
There's no need to spend
any more on groceries.
translation:
Markete daha fazla para
harcamama gerek yok.

original:
Morning, dear! I don't
suppose you have a <CR>Moon
Mug</CR> in stock, do you?
translation:
Gunaydin canim! Acaba
stokta bir <CR>Moon
Mug</CR> var midir?

original:
Oh my! That's just what I
was looking for! May I have
it wrapped?
translation:
Aman! Tam da aradigim
sey! Paketleyebilir misiniz?

original:
What's this? A <CR>Gulp Cup</CR>?
What a cute little piece of
crockery! I'll take it!
translation:
Bu da ne? <CR>Gulp Cup</CR> mu?
Ne sirin bir parca! Aliyorum!

original:
Goodness, this <CR>Chirpy Pot</CR>'s
a clever bit of science, isn't
it? I can't resist!
translation:
Vay canina, su <CR>Chirpy Pot</CR>
ne kadar zekice, degil mi?
Dayanamam, aliyorum!

original:
Agnes just loves novelty
pots like this <CR>Wobbly Pot</CR>!
I'll have to get it for her.
translation:
Agnes, su <CR>Wobbly Pot</CR> gibi
acayip demliklere bayilir!
Onu ona almaliyim.

original:
A <CR>Slippery Saucer</CR>? Why
not? Makes it easier to
scoot cups up the table.
translation:
<CR>Slippery Saucer</CR> mi? Neden
olmasin? Fincanlari masada
kaydirmak kolaylasir.

original:
Hot sauce? Oh, sorry, it's
my eyesight. <CR>Hot Saucer</CR>.
Sounds useful. I'll take it!
translation:
Aci sos mu? Ah, kusura
bakmayin, gozlerim... <CR>Hot Saucer</CR>.
Ise yarar gibi. Aliyorum!

original: Hmm.
translation: Hmm.

original:
Ooh, more <CR>yellow</CR>! Like
a ray of sunshine.
translation:
Ooo, daha cok <CR>yellow</CR>!
Gunes isigi gibi.

original:
Aha! You can never have
too much <CR>red</CR> crockery.
translation:
Aha! <CR>red</CR> mutfak esyasi
asla fazla olmaz.

original:
Ah! Like they say, two <CR>cups</CR>
are better than one!
translation:
Ah! Derler ya, birden iki <CR>cups</CR>
daha iyidir!

original:
This <CR>teapot</CR> looks a treat,
too!
translation:
Su <CR>teapot</CR> da pek hos
gorunuyor!

original: What's this other <CR>saucer</CR>?
translation: Su diger <CR>saucer</CR> da ne?

original:
Oh, goodness! My dear, I've
done it again. Me and my
compulsive buying!
translation:
Aman Allah'im! Canim,
yine yaptim. Benim su
alisveris tutkum yok mu!

original:
Why did you have to go and
put them in such tantalising
spots, hmm?
translation:
Neden onlari boyle
cazip yerlere koydunuz ki,
hmm?

original:
Still, it's my pension and my
responsibility. I'm happy.
Ta-ta!
translation:
Neyse, maas benim,
sorumluluk da benim.
Ben mutluyum. Ta-ta!

original:
Aha! Caught myself in the
act there. Right, I'm going
to stick with what I have.
translation:
Aha! Kendimi tam zamaninda
durdurdum. Tamam, elimdekilerle
yetinem.

original:
Have a lovely day, dear!
Ta-ta!
translation:
Iyi gunler canim!
Ta-ta!

original:
So many delightful little
trinkets, but my pension
only goes so far.
translation:
Ne kadar hos ufak tefek sey var,
ama emekli maasimin da bir
siniri var.

original:
Never mind. I'll make do
with what I have here.
translation:
Neyse. Buradakilerle
idare ederim.

original:
Look after the pennies, and
the pounds look after
themselves!
translation:
Kuruslara dikkat edersen,
liralar kendiliginden
duzene girer!

original:
Erm... I'm looking for one
of them <CR>Anti-Compasses</CR>.
Got any?
translation:
Sey... Su <CR>Anti-Compasses</CR>'lardan
ariyorum. Var mi sizde?

original:
Oh, ain't that it? Yeah,
that's the one. You gonna
give that to me?
translation:
O bu mu? Heh, evet,
aynisi. Bunu bana
verecek misin?

original:
So...what is it, a <CR>Whirly
Compass</CR>? Yeah, go on. I'll
'ave it.
translation:
Yani... bu bir <CR>Whirly
Compass</CR> mi? Tamam,
ver gitsin, aliyorum.

original:
<CR>Cool Glow</CR>, this one says.
Cool. Good stuff! Shove
it in the bag, would you?
translation:
Bunda <CR>Cool Glow</CR> yaziyor.
Havali. Guzelmis! Cantaya
at gitsin, olur mu?

original:
<CR>Extreme Blaze</CR>... Yeah!
Sounds like my kind of
thing. Give it here!
translation:
<CR>Extreme Blaze</CR>... Heh!
Tam benlik. Ver onu
buraya!

original:
What's this <CR>Ocean Camera</CR>
all about, then? Hmm, I'll
just buy it!
translation:
Su <CR>Ocean Camera</CR> da neyin
nesi? Hmm, neyse,
alayim bari!

original:
<CR>Five-Star Camera</CR>? That's
like them hotels, innit?
Yeah, go on. Into the bag.
translation:
<CR>Five-Star Camera</CR> mi? Oteller
gibi yani, ha? Tamam,
canta da gitsin.

original: Hold on a sec...
translation: Dur bir saniye...

original:
What's this other <CR>blue</CR>
thing?
translation:
Su diger <CR>blue</CR>
sey ne?

original:
You've got more <CR>red</CR> stuff on
sale, then?
translation:
Demek daha cok <CR>red</CR>
sey var, ha?

original: [not used]
translation: [kullanilmiyor]

original:
You've got another <CR>compass</CR>
there.
translation:
Surada bir <CR>compass</CR>
daha var.

original:
This <CR>lantern</CR> ain't too bad
either...
translation:
Su <CR>lantern</CR> da fena
sayilmaz...

original:
I like the look of this <CR>camera</CR>
too.
translation:
Su <CR>camera</CR>'nin da
havasini sevdim.

original:
Crikey. That's me all out of
money. Narc'll have a right
nark at me!
translation:
Vay be. Param bitti.
Narc beni fena
darlayacak!

original:
This is mental. How'd you
manage to squeeze all that
out of me, eh?
translation:
Bu delilik. Bunca parayi
