benden nasil soktun,
ha?

original:
Well, what's done is done,
yeah? Laters.
translation:
Neyse, olan oldu.
Gorusuruz.

original:
Right, that's enough! I've
already parted with enough
hard-earned cash!
translation:
Tamam, yeter! Zaten
alin teri paramdan
yeterince verdim!

original:
Thanks a bunch, love. Be
seeing you!
translation:
Sag olasin, canim.
Gorusuruz!

original:
Aha! I see your little ploy.
You want me to buy both of
these, yeah?
translation:
Aha! Kucuk numarani
anladim. Ikisini de almami
istiyorsun, ha?

original:
Well it ain't going to work,
love. I've seen it all in my
line of work.
translation:
Yemez, canim. Ben isim
geregi her numarayi
gordum.

original: Right. I'm off!
translation: Tamam. Ben kactim!

original:
As for coming back? I'll
think about it.
translation:
Bir daha gelir miyim?
Bakariz.

original:
Morning! Lovely day! I'm
looking for a <CR>Witch's Song</CR>.
Do you have one?
translation:
Gunaydin! Ne guzel gun!
Bir <CR>Witch's Song</CR> ariyorum.
Var mi sizde?

original:
Oh, wonderful! I've been
looking everywhere for one
of these!
translation:
Ah, harika! Her yerde
aramistim bunu!

original:
You have the beautifully
melodic <CR>Fairy's Breath</CR>,
too! I have no choice!
translation:
Buyuleyici melodisiyle
<CR>Fairy's Breath</CR> de var!
Baska carem yok, aliyorum!

original:
Ah, the <CR>Goblin's Bellow</CR>
resonates with a deep
rumble. I'm sold!
translation:
Ah, <CR>Goblin's Bellow</CR>
derinden bir gurultuyle
yankilaniyor. Satin aldim!

original:
Hey, diddle diddle, I see a
<CR>Magic Fiddle</CR>! And it's going
on my {''}to buy{''} list!
translation:
Hey, diddle diddle, bir
<CR>Magic Fiddle</CR> goruyorum!
Hemen {''}alinacaklar{''} listeme!

original:
An <CR>Electric Canary</CR>. The
colour, the sound...
I absolutely must have it!
translation:
Bir <CR>Electric Canary</CR>. Rengi,
sesi...
Mutlaka sahip olmaliyim!

original:
The <CR>Dusky Stradivarius</CR> is
what I need for my tragic
ballad! A must-buy!
translation:
Trajik baladim icin gereken
sey <CR>Dusky Stradivarius</CR>!
Mutlaka almaliyim!

original:
This <CR>Booming Snare</CR> would
do just fine for the march
piece I'm writing!
translation:
Yazdigim mars parcasi icin
su <CR>Booming Snare</CR> harika
olur!

original: Oh! What's this?
translation: Aa! Bu da ne?

original:
More <CR>purple</CR>! What
a splendid shade!
translation:
Daha cok <CR>purple</CR>! Ne
muhtesem bir ton!

original:
Yes, <CR>yellow</CR> instruments
certainly lift the mood.
translation:
Evet, <CR>yellow</CR> enstrumanlar
insanin icini acar.

original:
You can't beat that classic,
rich <CR>red</CR>.
translation:
O klasik, zengin <CR>red</CR>
renge rakip yok.

original:
Another <CR>ocarina</CR> that speaks
to me in volumes!
translation:
Bana sayfalarca sey
anlatan bir <CR>ocarina</CR> daha!

original:
While I'm here, I may as well
snap up this other <CR>violin</CR>.
translation:
Buradayken su diger <CR>violin</CR>'i
de kapayim bari.

original: [not used]
translation: [kullanilmiyor]

original:
Gosh, I've cleared the
shelves, haven't I?
translation:
Aman! Raflari bosalttim
degil mi?

original:
It's just I was so thrilled at
the thought of playing all
these instruments...
translation:
Sadece... bunca enstrumani
calma dusuncesi beni cok
heyecanlandirdi...

original:
This is so embarrassing! But
thank you very much,
regardless.
translation:
Cok utandim! Ama yine de
cok tesekkur ederim.

original:
Phew! If I buy any more, I
won't be able to carry these
all home!
translation:
Uf! Daha fazlasini alirsam
hepsini eve tasiyamam!

original:
I was very impressed with
your selection. Thank you
very much!
translation:
Seciminiz beni cok etkiledi.
Cok tesekkur ederim!

original:
Both of these are indeed
splendid instruments!
translation:
Ikisi de gercekten harika
enstrumanlar!

original:
But no. I've bought what
I wanted. To buy more
would be extravagant.
translation:
Ama hayir. Istedigimi aldim.
Daha fazlasi savurganlik olur.

original:
Yes, I think I've done quite
nicely with my shopping
today.
translation:
Evet, bugun alisverisimi
gayet iyi yaptim sanirim.

original:
Thank you very much, and
goodbye!
translation:
Cok tesekkur ederim,
hosca kalin!

original:
I'm absolutely famished!
Where's my favourite
<CR>Cinocoberry Ring</CR>?
translation:
Acliktan oluyorum!
Benim favori
<CR>Cinocoberry Ring</CR> nerede?

original:
Ah, there it is! Just one whiff
drives my salivary glands
wild! Ho ho!
translation:
Ah, iste burada! Bir kokusu
bile agzimin suyunu
astiriyor! Ho ho!

original:
I see a delectable <CR>Lime
Glaze</CR> on display! Don't
mind if I do!
translation:
Vitrinde nefis bir <CR>Lime
Glaze</CR> goruyorum! Aliyorum!

original:
A <CR>Fiery Baguette</CR>? Oh yes!
That should put hairs on my
husband's chest!
translation:
<CR>Fiery Baguette</CR> mi? Oh evet!
Kocamin gogsune tuy
bitirir bu!

original:
Ahh, the <CR>Tasty Bloomer</CR> will
make the perfect hors
d'oeuvres for dinner!
translation:
Ahh, <CR>Tasty Bloomer</CR> aksam
yemegi icin mukemmel
aperatif olur!

original:
<CR>Floured Farmhouse</CR>? Very
rustic. Perhaps it goes well
with a bowl of soup?
translation:
<CR>Floured Farmhouse</CR>? Ne
kadar koy isi. Bir kase
corbayla iyi gider belki?

original:
The mere idea of a <CR>Pistachio
Baguette</CR> is genius! I shall
take it!
translation:
<CR>Pistachio
Baguette</CR> fikri bile dahice!
Aliyorum!

original:
What a scrumptious-looking
<CR>Citrus Sponge</CR>! Add that to
my list!
translation:
Ne kadar nefis gorunuyor,
<CR>Citrus Sponge</CR>! Listeye ekle!

original:
That <CR>Snowball Sponge</CR> looks
good, but it would look
better in my tummy!
translation:
<CR>Snowball Sponge</CR> guzel
gorunuyor, ama en cok
karnimda guzel durur!

original: Goodness gracious!
translation: Aman Allah'im!

original:
How marvellous! A <CR>red</CR>
bread!
translation:
Ne harika! <CR>red</CR>
bir ekmek!

original:
More <CR>green</CR>? A unique
flavour, no doubt!
translation:
Daha cok <CR>green</CR>? Kesin
benzersiz bir lezzet!

original:
And what is this <CR>yellow</CR>
delight in front of me?
translation:
Peki su onumdeki <CR>yellow</CR>
nimet de ne?

original:
Oh! This is also wonderfully
<CR>white</CR>.
translation:
Aa! Bu da harika bir
<CR>white</CR>.

original:
Aha, another <CR>doughnut</CR>!
Well, delicious is as
delicious does!
translation:
Aha, bir <CR>doughnut</CR> daha!
Lezzet lezzettir!

original:
Mmm, I can smell another
fresh <CR>loaf</CR>!
translation:
Mmm, taptaze bir <CR>loaf</CR>
daha kokusu geliyor!

original:
More <CR>cake</CR>? How could one
possibly resist?
translation:
Daha fazla <CR>cake</CR>? Buna
kim dayanabilir ki?

original:
That should keep the pantry
full until Monday!
translation:
Bu, kilerimi Pazartesiye
kadar doldurur!

original:
Hmm, perhaps I bought
a tad too many? You, my
dear, are too persuasive!
translation:
Hmm, biraz fazla mi aldim
acaba? Siz, canim, cok
ikna edicisiniz!

original:
Well, can't stay and chat.
I've got a palette to satiate!
Toodle-pip!
translation:
Neyse, sohbet edecek
vaktim yok. Tadina bakacak
cok seyim var! Hosca kal!

original:
That ought to fill the old
second stomach!
translation:
Bu, ikinci midemi de
 doldurur!

original: Why, the injustice!
translation: Bu da haksizlik!

original:
Both look so tantalisingly
delicious, but I simply can't
decide!
translation:
Ikisi de o kadar istah acici ki,
ama bir turlu karar
veremiyorum!

original:
Hmm. Maybe I should watch
the old waistline.
translation:
Hmm. Belki de bel olcume
dikkat etmeliyim.

original:
It pains me to admit it, but
perhaps that's best.
translation:
Soylemesi zor ama
belki de en iyisi bu.

original:
Thank you graciously for
this delicious experience.
Toodle-pip!
translation:
Bu leziz deneyim icin
cok tesekkur ederim.
Hosca kalin!

original:
Good morning! I'm after a
<CR>Whistling Dracaena</CR>. Don't
suppose you have any in?
translation:
Gunaydin! Bir
<CR>Whistling Dracaena</CR>
ariyorum. Sizde var mi acaba?

original:
Ah, is that one? So that's
what it looks like... I like it!
I'll have that, please.
translation:
Ah, bu mu? Demek boyle
gorunuyor... Begendim!
Bunu alayim lutfen.

original:
What is it? A <CR>Flaming
Philodendron</CR>? I do like that
bright red. I'll buy it!
translation:
Bu nedir? <CR>Flaming
Philodendron</CR> mu? O parlak
kirmiziyi sevdim. Aliyorum!

original:
That's a <CR>Starry Schefflera</CR>,
isn't it? I really like those!
Can I have that, too?
translation:
Bu bir <CR>Starry Schefflera</CR>,
degil mi? Onlari cok severim!
Bunu da alabilir miyim?

original:
A <CR>Superspineous</CR>! Those are
indestructible. Maybe I'll
take one for the office.
translation:
<CR>Superspineous</CR>! Bunlar
yikilmaz. Ofise bir tane
alabilirim.

original:
<CR>Floraspineous</CR> flowers are so
sweet! I think I'll put that in
my basket, too.
translation:
<CR>Floraspineous</CR> cicekleri cok
hos! Bunu da sepetime
atayim.

original:
<CR>Rodeospineous</CR> cacti look
like they come out of an old
film. Hmm, why not?
translation:
<CR>Rodeospineous</CR> kaktusler
eski bir filmden cikmis
gibi. Hmm, neden olmasin?

original:
A <CR>Heartfelt Bouquet</CR> of
red roses, hm? Maybe I can
give it to...erm...a friend.
translation:
Kirmizi gullerden bir
<CR>Heartfelt Bouquet</CR>, ha?
Belki... sey... bir arkadasima
veririm.

original:
A <CR>Celebration Bouquet</CR>?
I should take that for my
sister. She's 18 today!
translation:
<CR>Celebration Bouquet</CR> mu?
Bunu kiz kardesime almaliyim.
Bugun 18'ine giriyor!

original: Mm?
translation: Ha?

original:
Hey, this one is a nice
refreshing <CR>green</CR>, too.
translation:
Hey, bunun <CR>green</CR> tonu da
ferahlaticiymis.

original:
Wow. That's a pretty lush
shade of <CR>red</CR>.
translation:
Vay. Ne kadar canli bir
<CR>red</CR> tonu.

original:
Hey, look at that! It's such
a lively <CR>yellow</CR>.
translation:
Hey, suna bak! Ne kadar
canli bir <CR>yellow</CR>.

original:
Ooh, this shade of <CR>purple</CR> is
really enticing.
translation:
Ooo, bu <CR>purple</CR> tonu
gercekten cezbedici.

original:
Aha. There's another
<CR>leafy plant</CR>.
translation:
Aha. Bir <CR>leafy plant</CR>
daha var.

original:
Look at the spines on this
other <CR>cactus</CR>!
translation:
Su diger <CR>cactus</CR>'un
dikenlerine bak!

original:
Hm, the <CR>flowers</CR> in that
bouquet look nice, too.
translation:
Hmm, o buketteki <CR>flowers</CR>
de guzel gorunuyor.

original:
Wow... Looks like I bought
everything up without
noticing.
translation:
Vay... Fark etmeden
hepsini satin almisim.

original:
Well, that wasn't planned,
but this is actually a pretty
nifty shop.
translation:
Bu planli degildi ama
burasi gercekten guzel bir
magazaymis.

original:
My flat is going to feel nice
and refreshing with all this
greenery. Thanks!
translation:
Bu kadar yesillikle evim
ferahlayacak. Tesekkurler!

original:
Hmm, I think that'll do. This
should be enough to liven
things up.
translation:
Hmm, sanirim yeter. Ortami
canlandirmaya bu kadari
yeter.

original: Thanks a lot. Ciao!
translation: Cok tesekkurler. Ciao!

original:
Look at all these lovely
plants. They're so bright and
vibrant!
translation:
Su guzel bitkilere bak.
Ne kadar parlak ve canlilar!

original:
I really can't decide which
to get...
translation:
Hangisini alacagima bir turlu
karar veremiyorum...

original:
Maybe I should stop now or
my flat will look like
a jungle!
translation:
Belki durmaliyim yoksa
evim ormana donecek!

original:
Good afternoon! Splendid
weather, eh? May I see
your range of headwear?
translation:
Iyi gunler! Ne guzel
hava, degil mi? Sapka
seceneklerinizi gorebilir miyim?

original:
Aha! That <CR>Trendy Cap</CR> will
do nicely for my Saturday
morning fishing.
translation:
Aha! Su <CR>Trendy Cap</CR>
Cumartesi sabahi balik
tutmaya cok yakisir.

original:
What an elegant <CR>Top Hat</CR>!
I could do with some new
evening wear. I'll take it.
translation:
Ne kadar zarif bir <CR>Top Hat</CR>!
Yeni bir gece kiyafeti iyi
olur. Aliyorum.

original:
What's this thing, then?
A <CR>Ladies' Bowler</CR>? How
droll! My wife will like it.
translation:
Bu nedir bakalim?
<CR>Ladies' Bowler</CR> mi? Ne
hos! Esim bayilacak.

original:
Look at this <CR>Retro Tie</CR>. Ahh,
it reminds me of my school
days! I'll have it!
translation:
Su <CR>Retro Tie</CR>'a bakin. Ahh,
okul gunlerimi hatirlatti!
Aliyorum!

original:
Now this <CR>Sleek Tie</CR> is
elegance itself - ideal for
our more formal events.
translation:
Su <CR>Sleek Tie</CR> tam bir
zarafet ornegi-daha resmi
etkinlikler icin ideal.

original:
Is this a <CR>Crisp Cravat</CR>? Quite
a vivid hue, but it'll do
nicely for the races.
translation:
Bu bir <CR>Crisp Cravat</CR> mi?
Rengi epey canli ama
at yarislari icin iyi gider.

original:
<CR>Smart Boots</CR>, eh? They'll go
perfectly with my new cap!
Don't mind if I do!
translation:
<CR>Smart Boots</CR>, ha? Yeni
sapkamla mukemmel gider!
Aliyorum!

original:
Ah, a nice pair of <CR>Classic
Shoes</CR>. You can never have
too many of those!
translation:
Ah, guzel bir <CR>Classic
Shoes</CR> cifti. Onlardan
asla fazla olmaz!

original:
I say! These <CR>Fashionista
Boots</CR> are a step in a new
direction! Well, why not?
translation:
Vay canina! Bu <CR>Fashionista
Boots</CR> yepyeni bir tarz!
Peki, neden olmasin?

original: Hmm...
translation: Hmm...

original:
I say! This <CR>blue</CR> matches
perfectly.
translation:
Bakin! Su <CR>blue</CR> mukemmel
eslesiyor.

original:
<CR>Black</CR> again? That's always
in fashion.
translation:
<CR>Black</CR> yine mi? O her zaman
modadir.

original:
Another item in this new
<CR>green</CR> range, hm?
translation:
Bu yeni <CR>green</CR> seriden bir
urun daha, ha?

original:
Oho! A different style of <CR>hat</CR>
there, I see.
translation:
Oho! Farkli bir <CR>hat</CR> tarzi
goruyorum.

original: Another <CR>tie</CR>?
translation: Bir <CR>tie</CR> daha mi?

original:
I'm always looking for
decent <CR>shoes</CR>...
translation:
Her zaman duzgun bir <CR>shoes</CR>
ariyorum...

original:
I say! I seem to have bought
the whole lot in my fervour!
translation:
Bakin! Heyecana kapilip
hepsini satin almisim!

original:
Well, no harm in that! One
always needs new clothes.
translation:
Neyse, bunun zarari yok!
Insanin yeni kiyafete ihtiyaci
olur.

original:
And these stylish items will
fit nicely with my wardrobe.
translation:
Ustelik bu sik parcalar
dolabima cok yakisacak.

original:
I shall be on my way, then.
Thank you kindly, madam.
translation:
O halde ben gideyim.
Nezaketiniz icin tesekkurler,
hanimefendi.

original:
Well, I think that will be
satisfactory for today.
translation:
Sanirim bugunluk bu kadari
yeterli.

original:
My thanks, and a good day
to you, madam.
translation:
Tesekkur eder, iyi gunler
dilerim hanimefendi.

original:
Everything here is so very
elegant!
translation:
Buradaki her sey ne kadar
zarif!

original:
My eye is drawn to each
and every item.
translation:
Gozum her bir urune
kaydi.

original:
But let us not get carried
away. I have purchased
what I came for.
translation:
Ama kendimizi kaptirmayalim.
Geldigim seyi satin aldim.

original:
Um, hiya, miss. How are
ya? Do you have any
little bunnies with-
translation:
Sey, selam abla. Nasilsin?
Hani kucuk tavsanlar var ya-
Onlardan var mi-

original:
Ooh! I see ya, bunnies!
You there...<CR>Podgikins</CR>?
You're just what I wanted!
translation:
Ooo! Tavsanlari gordum!
Sen...<CR>Podgikins</CR> misin?
Tam istedigim gibisin!

original:
Hee hee! And what's your
name? <CR>Mr B</CR>? I love your
glasses. I'll take you 'n' all!
translation:
Hihi! Peki senin adin ne?
<CR>Mr B</CR> mi? Gozlugune
bayildim. Seni aliyorum!

original:
So you're <CR>Nibbles</CR>? Come
home with me and ya can
nibble all my veggies!
translation:
Demek sen <CR>Nibbles</CR>'sin?
Benimle eve gel de
sebzelerimi kemir!

original:
Hello, <CR>Gruffer</CR>. Don't look so
grumpy, like! I'm goin' to
give ya loads of hugs.
translation:
Merhaba, <CR>Gruffer</CR>. Oyle
somurtma! Sana bir suru
sarilacagim.

original:
Are you <CR>Fluffy</CR>? Hee hee,
you're propah soft and
cuddly! I can't resist ya!
translation:
<CR>Fluffy</CR> sen misin? Hihi,
cok yumusak ve sarilasi!
Sana dayanamam!

original:
Your name is <CR>Snowflake</CR>,
eh? You're so lovely and
white. You can come 'n' all!
translation:
Adin <CR>Snowflake</CR> mi?
Ne kadar guzel ve bembeyaz.
Sen de benimlesin!

original:
Aw, wey aye! Are you <CR>Skitty
Cat</CR>? Don't be scared! I'll
look after ya.
translation:
Aaa! <CR>Skitty
Cat</CR> sen misin? Korkma!
Sana ben bakarim.

original:
Hey, <CR>Sleepy Whiskers</CR>, are
you awake? You can nap
on me pillow if ya like.
translation:
Hey, <CR>Sleepy Whiskers</CR>,
uyanik misin? Istersen
yastigimda uyuyabilirsin.

original:
So you're <CR>Dandelion</CR>?
You're so white and puffy...
Awww, I love ya already!
translation:
Demek sen <CR>Dandelion</CR>'sun?
Bembeyaz ve pofuduksun...
Aaa, simdiden seni sevdim!

original: Awww!
translation: Aaa!

original: Look! This one's <CR>red</CR> 'n' all!
translation: Bak! Bu hem de <CR>red</CR>!

original: Here's another <CR>yellow</CR> one!
translation: Bir <CR>yellow</CR> daha!

original:
Yay! More <CR>white</CR> ones!
I love them!
translation:
Yasasin! Daha cok <CR>white</CR>!
Bayiliyorum!

original:
Look at you now! You're
best <CR>bunny</CR> friends.
translation:
Suna bak! Artik en iyi
<CR>bunny</CR> arkadassiniz.

original:
I like <CR>teddies</CR> best of all, and
here's another one!
translation:
Ben en cok <CR>teddies</CR>'leri
seviyorum, bir tane daha var!

original:
It's another <CR>kitty</CR>! Kitty, kitty,
kitty?
translation:
Bir <CR>kitty</CR> daha! Kedi, kedi,
kedi?

original:
Oops! Look, I've bought
everythin'!
translation:
Ups! Bak, hepsini
almisim!

original:
Hee hee! What will me mam
say?
translation:
Hihi! Annem ne
diyecek acaba?

original:
Ta very much, miss shop
lady! Buh-bye!
translation:
Cok tesekkurler abla!
Bay bay!

original:
Okay then. I got what
I wanted and me mam's
waitin' for me.
translation:
Tamam o zaman. Istedigimi
aldim, annem beni
bekliyor.

original:
Cheers, miss shop lady!
Buh-bye!
translation:
Sag ol abla!
Bay bay!

original:
They're all too cute! First
I saw that one, but now
I want this one 'n' all...
translation:
Hepsi cok tatli! Once onu
gordum ama simdi bunu da
istiyorum...

original:
It makes me want them all!
But me mam said I had to
choose carefully...
translation:
Hepsini istiyorum!
Ama annem dikkatli sec
dedi...

original:
Maybe I can come back
again some other day.
translation:
Belki baska bir gun
tekrar gelirim.

original:
Um, excuse me, miss. Do
you have a <CR>teddy</CR> called
<CR>Fluffy</CR> here?
translation:
Sey, affedersin abla. Burada
<CR>Fluffy</CR> adli bir <CR>teddy</CR>
var mi?

original:
Hello there! Rumour has it
you've got a certain model
car I'm on the lookout for...
translation:
Merhaba! Duyduguma gore
aradigim belli bir model
araba sizde varmis...

original:
And as if by magic, there it
is! The <CR>Safari 4x4</CR> in all
its exotic glory. Brilliant!
translation:
Sanki sihirle oldu da
iste burada! Tum egzotik
ihtisamiyla <CR>Safari 4x4</CR>. Harika!

original:
A <CR>Safety 4x4</CR>, eh? Surely
that defeats the point? I like
it, though. I'll have it!
translation:
<CR>Safety 4x4</CR>, ha? Bu biraz
ters dusmuyor mu? Ama
begendim. Aliyorum!

original:
Ooh, a <CR>Cherished Classic</CR>!
Well you can't go wrong
with a classic, can you?
translation:
Ooo, bir <CR>Cherished Classic</CR>!
Klasikle asla hata
yapilmaz, degil mi?

original:
This <CR>Skiddy Banger</CR>'s seen
better days. Feel a bit sorry
for it, to be honest.
translation:
Su <CR>Skiddy Banger</CR> daha iyi
gunler gormus. Dogrusu
biraz acidim.

original:
Hey, that's a collector's
<CR>Shining Hornet</CR>! Smashing!
That'll make me a busy bee!
translation:
Hey, bu koleksiyonluk bir
<CR>Shining Hornet</CR>! Muhtesem!
Beni ari gibi mesgul edecek!

original:
A shiny blue <CR>Kingfisher</CR>! Oh,
love the colour. I think I can
dip into my wallet for this!
translation:
Parlak mavi bir <CR>Kingfisher</CR>!
Rengine bayildim. Sanirim
cuzdani biraz acabilirim!

original:
Aha, a <CR>Soaring Falcon</CR>! It's
got to be better than our old
nesting pigeon at any rate.
translation:
Aha, bir <CR>Soaring Falcon</CR>!
En azindan bizim eski
yuvali guvercinden iyidir.

original:
I don't know this model...
<CR>Elite Chopper</CR>, hm? Alas,
not life-size. But snazzy!
translation:
Bu modeli tanimiyorum...
<CR>Elite Chopper</CR>, ha? Ne yazik
ki gercek boyutta degil.
Ama cok havali!

original:
A big, blue <CR>Sightseeing
Yacht</CR>. Oh, this would look
great in my trailer...
translation:
Buyuk, mavi bir <CR>Sightseeing
Yacht</CR>. Ah, karavanimda
harika durur...

original:
A <CR>Pirate Brig</CR>?! Arr, me
hearties! I'll be takin' ye,
too. Shiver me timbers!
translation:
Bir <CR>Pirate Brig</CR> mi?! Arr,
tayfam! Seni de aliyorum.
Kerestelerim titresin!

original: Hum tee tum...
translation: Him ti tim...

original:
Whew, another <CR>yellow</CR>
model? Those are pretty
hard to come by!
translation:
Vay, bir <CR>yellow</CR>
model daha mi? Onlar
bulunmasi bayagi zor!

original:
All right, I thought that was
a good <CR>blue</CR>, but wow,
would you look at this!
translation:
Tamam, o <CR>blue</CR> iyiydi diye
dusunmustum ama vay be,
suna bir bak!

original:
<CR>Red</CR> again? No no, I'm
not complaining at all!
translation:
<CR>Red</CR> yine mi? Hayir hayir,
hic sikayet etmiyorum!

original:
Fantastic, more <CR>white</CR>
models! Now that's a bit
of style.
translation:
Muhtesem, daha cok <CR>white</CR>
model! Iste buna tarz denir.

original:
There's another <CR>car</CR>. You
can never have too many
of those.
translation:
Bir <CR>car</CR> daha var. Onlardan
asla fazla olmaz.

original:
It's another of those fancy
<CR>helicopters</CR>. You can't
beat a good chopper!
translation:
Su havali <CR>helicopters</CR>'lardan
bir tane daha. Iyi bir
helikopterin yerini tutan yok!

original:
Hey, that's a different kind
of <CR>ship</CR>!
translation: Hey, bu farkli bir <CR>ship</CR> turu!

original:
Hum tee tum tee... Huh?
Did I just take everything?
translation:
Him ti tim ti... Ha?
Az once hepsini mi aldim?

original:
Whoa, my trailer's already
chock full! Where am I
going to put all these?
translation:
Vay canina, karavanim
zaten tika basa dolu!
Bunlari nereye koyacagim?

original:
Not to worry, models are my
favourite thing ever! Well,
next to juggling, naturally.
translation:
Dert degil, modeller en sevdigim
sey! Tabii hokkabazliktan
sonra, dogal olarak.

original:
All right, then. I'm off.
Cheers for that!
translation:
Peki o zaman, ben kaciyorum.
Tesekkurler!

original:
Well, that just about covers
it, eh? Pretty good haul.
Pret-ty good indeed.
translation:
Eh, bu kadar yeter sanirim?
Guzel bir ganimet.
Ger-cekten cok guzel.

original:
I'd best be off, then.
Cheers for that!
translation:
En iyisi ben gideyim.
Tesekkurler!

original:
Tum, tee tiddly tum, tee
too... You know, I can't
decide for the life of me.
translation:
Tim tidi tim tim...
Biliyor musun, ne yapsam
karar veremiyorum.

original:
So much choice! And the
detail on all these models?
Just superb.
translation:
Ne cok secenek var! Hem de
bu modellerin detaylari...
Muhtesem.

original:
I'll have to go home and
think about which best fits
my collection...
translation:

the shelves in such a way that the customer
is certain to buy everything on display.
translation:

kesinlikle satin alsin.

and outlines it in red.
translation:
<T>Ludmilla ilk esyanin nereye konacagina karar verir
ve onu kirmiziyla cerceveler.

<T>She's the boss and her decision is final, so
there's no moving this item.
translation:
<T>Patron odur ve karari kesindir; bu esyayi
yerinden oynatamazsin.

of the screen and place them on the
shelves.

<T>Ekranin ust kismindan urunleri kalemle secip

tell you about its colour and type.

the aisle's items are on display.

magazayi acamazsin.

how she goes about her shopping.

adjacent item of the same type.
translation:
<T>Ornegin, ayni turden bitisik bir urune
karsi koyamazlar.

original:
<T>See? The customer's attention has just
shifted to the <CR>white teddy</CR> to the right.
translation:
<T>Gordun mu? Musterinin dikkati, sagdaki
<CR>white teddy</CR>'ye kaydi.

original:
<T>You can also encourage a shopping spree by
connecting items with matching colours.
translation:
<T>Ayni renkteki urunleri birbirine baglayarak da
alisveris cilginligini tesvik edebilirsin.

original:
<T>In this case, the customer's attention moves
up to the <CR>white bunny</CR>.
translation:
<T>Bu durumda musterinin dikkati, yukaridaki
<CR>white bunny</CR>'ye cikar.

original:
<T>Encourage the customer's impulse buying,
and the whole aisle will soon be sold out.
translation:
<T>Musterinin durtusel alisverisini destekle;
boylece tum reyon kisa surede tukenir.

original:
<T>Avoid situations that could confuse the
customer, though.
translation:
<T>Yine de musteriyi sasirtabilecek durumlardan
kacin.

original:
<T>If they have two choices, they'll have to think
about which one they'd prefer.
translation:
<T>Iki secenekleri olursa, hangisini tercih edeceklerini
dusunmek zorunda kalirlar.

original:
<T>That's a sure-fire way to end their shopping
spree and fail your objective.
translation:
<T>Bu, alisveris serisini kesin olarak bitirir ve
hedefini kacirmana yol acar.

original:
<T>So make sure you arrange items to create
a clear path from the first item to the last.
translation:
<T>Bu yuzden urunleri, ilk urunden son urune
kadar net bir yol olusturacak sekilde yerlestir.

original:
<T>If a customer buys all the items from an aisle,
you'll clear the stage!
translation:
<T>Bir musteri reyondaki tum urunleri satin alirsa,
bolumu gecersin!

original:
<T>As you play through the main game, you'll
find new aisles to challenge you.
translation:
<T>Ana oyunda ilerledikce, seni zorlayacak yeni
reyonlar bulacaksin.

original:
<T>Sell out every aisle in the shop to get a nice
reward!
translation:
<T>Dukkandaki her reyonu tamamen tuket ve
guzel bir odul kazan!

original:
Hiya! I'd like to buy <CR>Fluffy</CR>
the teddy. Aww! Nae way!
You've actually got him!
translation:
Selam! <CR>Fluffy</CR> adli ayicigi almak
istiyorum. Aaa! Yok artik!
Gercekten var mi?!

original: Sunflowers in the Storm
translation: Firtinadaki Aycicekleri

original:
Bunny is enjoying a pleasant
walk in the woods one day, when
things take an unexpected turn!
translation:
Tavsan bir gun ormanda keyifli
bir yuruyus yaparken, isler
beklenmedik bir hal alir!

original:
This script is going to require
six different actions, got it?
translation:
Bu senaryo
alti farkli hareket gerektirecek, anladin mi?

original:
It was a hot, sunny day, and Bunny set
out happily for a stroll in the woods.
translation:
Sicak ve gunesli bir gundu; Tavsan
ormanda gezintiye neseyle cikti.

original:
He'd only gone a little way, though,
when black clouds filled the sky. Soon,
he heard the deep rumble of thunder.
translation:
Daha biraz yol almisti ki,
gokyuzunu kara bulutlar kapladi. Ardindan,
gok gurultusunun derin ugultusunu duydu.

original:
Bunny dashed towards the woods
for cover, when lightning struck
nearby and felled a great tree!
translation:
Tavsan siginmak icin ormana
dogru firladi ama o sirada
yakina yildirim dustu ve koca bir agaci devirdi!

original:
Poor, startled Bunny turned tail and
ran away from the woods as fast as
his legs would carry him.
translation:
Zavalli, urken Tavsan arkasina bile bakmadan
bacaklari ne kadar hizli kosabiliyorsa
ormandan o kadar hizli uzaklasti.

original:
Bunny ran and ran, until he realised
the rain had stopped and he was
standing in a field of tall sunflowers.
translation:
Tavsan kostu da kostu; sonunda yagmurun
dindigini ve uzun aycicekleriyle dolu
bir tarlada durdugunu fark etti.

original:
Though he'd had a bit of a fright, Bunny
was now glad of the storm: he'd found
lots of delicious sunflower seeds!
translation:
Biraz korkmus olsa da Tavsan artik
firtinaya sevindi: cunku bir suru
leziz aycicegi cekirdegi bulmustu!

original: The End
translation: Son

original:
Oho! Starting strong,
I see!
translation:
Oho! Guclu bir
baslangic yapiyorsun!

original: Hmph, not bad!
translation: Hih, fena degil!

original: Hah! Excellent, excellent!
translation: Hah! Mukemmel, mukemmel!

original:
Hmph. That's actually not
bad at all.
translation:
Hih. Aslinda hic
fena degil.

original:
Good, good. That's more
or less what I was after.
translation:
Iyi, iyi. Asagi yukari
istedigim buydu.

original:
Heh heh, you're a cute
little fellow when you
want to be!
translation:
Heh heh, isteyince ne
kadar sevimli bir
kucuk sey oluyorsun!

original:
Hmph. Didn't I ask for
{''}happy{''} here?
translation:
Hih. Burada
{''}mutlu{''} ol demedim mi?

original:
Eh? What was that
supposed to be?
translation:
Eh? Bu da neyin
nesiydi simdi?

original:
That didn't really convey
a {''}startled{''} feeling.
translation:
Bu pek de
{''}urkmus{''} hissi vermedi.

original: No... Not really, no.
translation: Hayir... Pek sayilmaz, hayir.

original:
I was hoping for a more...
stunned look.
translation:
Daha...
dona kalmis bir ifade bekliyordum.

original: Wrong, wrong, all wrong!
translation: Yanlis, yanlis, hepsi yanlis!

original: Hmm...
translation: Himm...

original: That'll do, bunny.
translation: Bu kadari yeter, tavsancik.

original: Well, that seems fine.
translation: Himm, bu iyi gorunuyor.

original: Hmph. Yes, okay.
translation: Hih. Evet, tamam.

original:
I'll let you improvise on
this one.
translation:
Bunda
dogaclama yapmana izin verecegim.

original:
This play should be a
snap. Don't mess it up!
translation:
Bu oyun cocuk oyuncagi olmali.
Sakin batirma!

original:
Hmph! All right, you pass.
But anyone could have
done that!
translation:
Hih! Peki, gectin.
Ama bunu herkes
yapardi!

original:
You're not going on stage
with that acting!
translation:
Bu oyunculukla
sahneye cikamazsin!

original: Keep going...
translation: Devam et...

original: Postman Bun
translation: Postaci Corek

original:
Bunny the postman's work is
never done, delivering letters to
all the denizens of the forest.
translation:
Postaci Tavsan'in isi
hic bitmez; ormanin tum
sakinlerine mektup dagitir.

original:
This script is going to require
six different actions, got it?
translation:
Bu senaryo
alti farkli hareket gerektirecek, anladin mi?

original:
Bunny is the local postman in the
woods.
translation:
Tavsan ormanin
yerel postacisidir.

original:
He loves delivering the post because he
gets to see his friends every day.
translation:
Posta dagitmayi sever cunku
her gun arkadaslarini gorur.

original:
The only part he doesn't like is getting
up early. Bunny is not a morning rabbit
and is in the habit of oversleeping...
translation:
Sevmedigi tek sey erken
kalkmaktir. Tavsan sabah insani degildir
ve sik sik uyuyakalir...

original:
But even on those days, he always
finishes his round in good time.
translation:
Yine de o gunlerde bile
dagitimini her zaman zamaninda bitirir.

original: It's a teensy bit dangerous...
translation: Birazcik tehlikeli...

original:
But luckily, he has a secret
shortcut that leads him just
about anywhere in the woods!
translation:
Ama sansina, onu ormanda
hemen hemen her yere goturen gizli
bir kestirme yolu vardir!

original:
Today's postbag is bulging with letters
and parcels, so he'd better get going!
translation:
Bugunku posta cantasi mektup
ve paketlerle tika basa dolu; o halde
hemen yola koyulsa iyi olur!

original: The End
translation: Son

original:
Excellent! Keep that silly
grin!
translation:
Mukemmel! O aptalca
siritisi koru!

original:
Hmph, good. Better than
your average rabbit's
look of surprise.
translation:
Hih, iyi. Ortalama bir
tavsanin saskin
bakisindan daha iyi.

original:
You really turned on your
small, fuzzy charm, there,
didn't you?
translation:
Kucuk, pofuduk cazibeni
cidden devreye soktun,\deh?

original:
All right. That looked
suitably nervous...
translation:
Peki. Yeterince
gergin gorunuyordu...

original:
What's that?! I told you
to look happy!
translation:
O da ne?! Sana mutlu
gorun dedim!

original:
Bah. How could you get
that wrong?
translation:
Bah. Bunu nasil
yanlis yaparsin?

original:
Come on, turn on the
charm. Waggle your tail
or something!
translation:
Haydi, cazibeni
goster. Kuyrugunu salla
ya da ne bileyim!

original:
Hmph, disappointing.
I want to see the look of
fear in your eyes!
translation:
Hih, hayal kirikligi.
Gozlerinde korkuyu
gormek istiyorum!

original: Hmm...
translation: Himm...

original: That could work...
translation: Bu ise yarayabilir...

original: Well, why not?
translation: Neden olmasin?

original: Fine, go on.
translation: Peki, devam.

original:
You can do more or less
whatever comes to mind
here, anyway.
translation:
Burada zaten aklina ne
gelirse asagi yukari
onu yapabilirsin.

original:
I'm going to be watching
you carefully, got it?
translation:
Seni dikkatle
izleyecegim, anladin mi?

original:
Hmph. That seemed
acceptable. I just hope
you can keep it up.
translation:
Hih. Fena degildi,
kabul edilebilir. Umarim
bunu surdurebilirsin.

original:
I'll never let you back
into our troupe if you
act like that.
translation:
Boyle oynarsan seni
asla tekrar grubumuza
almam!

original: Keep going...
translation: Devam et...

original: Little Lost Squirrel
translation: Kaybolan Kucuk Sincap

original:
A cheery Bunny runs into a baby
squirrel who has got lost. Can
he help her find her way home?
translation:
Neseli Tavsan, kaybolmus
bir yavru sincapla karsilasir. Ona
evinin yolunu bulmasinda yardimci olabilir mi?

original:
This script is going to require
nine different actions, got it?
translation:
Bu senaryo
dokuz farkli hareket gerektirecek, anladin mi?

original: One fine day, Bunny was in high spirits.
translation: Guzel bir gun, Tavsan'in keyfi yerindeydi.

original:
And no wonder: the baker had given
him a freshly baked sesame bun
for being such a good friend.
translation:
Sasilacak sey degil: firinci,
iyi bir arkadas oldugu icin ona
taptaze pismis bir susamli corek vermisti.

original:
But as he skipped along happily, he
suddenly found himself nose-to-nose
with a baby squirrel.
translation:
Neseyle seke seke giderken,
birden kendini yavru bir sincapla
burun buruna buldu.

original:
Where had the little thing come from?
Bunny tried to talk to her, but the
squirrel just cried and cried.
translation:
Bu kucuk sey nereden cikmisti?
Tavsan onunla konusmaya calisti ama
sincap sadece agladi da agladi.

original:
Bunny thought a few playful tricks
might catch her attention and make
her laugh.
translation:
Tavsan, birkac oyunbaz numaranin
dikkatini cekip onu
guldurebilecegini dusundu.

original:
But it was no good. The only way he
could comfort the little creature was
to give her his delicious sesame bun.
translation:
Ama nafileydi. Kucuk yaratigi
teselli etmenin tek yolu,
leziz susamli coregini ona vermekti.

original:
Once she had calmed down, the baby
squirrel told Bunny where she lived,
and he took her home to her mother.

But poor Bunny was now
bunless. His ears drooping
sadly, he started home...
translation:
Ama zavalli Tavsan artik
coreksizdi. Kulaklari uzgunce
dusmus halde, eve dogru yola cikti...

original:
But then the little squirrel's mother
dashed out and placed a big parcel in
his paws. It was a gigantic carrot cake!
translation:
Derken yavru sincabin annesi
disari firlayip patilerine buyuk bir paket
koydu. Icinden devasa bir havuclu kek cikti!

original: All's well that ends well.
translation: Sonu iyi biten her sey iyidir.

original:
Hah! Nice blush you have
going there.
translation:
Hah! Guzel bir
kizarma oldu!

original:
Heh heh. That's what I'm
looking for!
translation:
Heh heh. Aradigim sey
tam da buydu!

original:
Nice paw action there.
Excellent!
translation:
Pati hareketlerin
guzel. Mukemmel!

original:
No, no, no! Bashful!
You know, embarrassed?
translation:
Hayir, hayir, hayir! Utangac!
Hani, utanmis gibi?

original:
Bah. At least try something
appropriate!
translation:
Bah. Bari
uygun bir sey dene!

original:
Mmm, no. Put your back
into it more!
translation:
Mmm, hayir. Biraz daha
caba goster!

original: Hmm...
translation: Himm...

original: All right, yes.
translation: Peki, evet.

original: I suppose that works.
translation: Sanirim bu olur.

original:
I didn't think of that,
but...fine.
translation:
Bunu dusunmemistim,
ama...peki.

original:
Feel free to do as you
like on this one.
translation:
Bunda
istedigini yapabilirsin.

original:
Let's see how well you've
rehearsed this!
translation:
Bunu ne kadar iyi
calistigini gorelim!

original:
Well, how about that?
Not bad for an amateur!
translation:
Bak sen!
Bir amator icin fena degil!

original:
You'll have to get your act
together if you really want
to join us!
translation:
Gercekten bize
katilmak istiyorsan kendine
ceki duzen vermelisin!

original: Keep going...
translation: Devam et...

original: Eve of the Carnival
translation: Karnaval Arifesi

original:
On the eve of the carnival, Bunny
makes merry with his friends, but
doesn't get much sleep...
translation:
Karnaval arifesinde Tavsan,
dostlariyla eglenir ama
pek uyuyamaz...

original:
This script is going to require
ten different actions, got it?
translation:
Bu senaryo
on farkli hareket gerektirecek, anladin mi?

original:
It was the eve of the carnival,
when all the animals of the
forest gather to celebrate.

Bunny was so excited, he could
barely keep still!
translation:
Tavsan o kadar heyecanliydi ki,
yerinde duramiyordu!

original:
He hopped back and forth until
he could stand it no longer, and
decided to visit his friend Squirrel.
translation:
Dayanamayip ileri geri zipladi,
sonunda arkadasi Sincap'i
ziyaret etmeye karar verdi.

original:
After gleefully planning with Squirrel
all the fun they were going to have,
Bunny went over to see Beaver.
translation:
Sincap'la birlikte yapacaklari
butun eglenceleri neseyle planladiktan sonra,
Tavsan bu kez Kunduz'a ugradi.

original:
The two friends had a great time, and
it was dusk before Bunny set off home.
On the way, he bumped into Owl.
translation:
Iki arkadas harika vakit gecirdi ve
Tavsan eve donmek uzereyken alacakaranlik cokmustu.
Yolda Baykus'la karsilasti.

original:
Owl was just as excited as Bunny was,
and she babbled on happily about the
carnival until late into the night.
translation:
Baykus da Tavsan kadar heyecanliydi,
ve gece gec saatlere kadar karnaval hakkinda
neseyle durmadan konustu.

original:
It was well past midnight by the
time Bunny finally got to bed.
translation:
Tavsan nihayet yataga girdiginde
gece yarisini coktan gecmisti.

original:
He sank into a deep slumber and
had blissful dreams about the
carnival and all his friends.
translation:
Derin bir uykuya daldi ve
karnavali ve tum arkadaslarini
dusledigi huzurlu ruyalar gordu.

original:
But Bunny was exhausted from
all the excitement and he slept
tight and long...
translation:
Ama Tavsan tum bu heyecandan
bitap dusmustu; siki siki ve
uzun uzun uyudu...

original:
The next morning, the sun was shining
and the birds were chirping.
translation:
Ertesi sabah gunes parliyor
ve kuslar civildiyordu.

original:
Bunny woke with a start,
his fur standing on end.
translation:
Tavsan irkilerek uyandi,
tuyleri diken diken olmustu.

original:
It was late! He'd overslept!
What about the carnival?!
translation:
Gec kalmisti! Uyuyakalmisti!
Ya karnaval?!

original:
Bunny rushed out to join in the
fun, but by the time he arrived,
the party was all but over.
translation:
Tavsan eglenceye katilmak icin
kosarak cikti ama vardiginda
parti neredeyse bitmisti.

original:
Bunny felt very silly indeed. He'd
been so excited about the carnival
that he'd overslept and missed it!
translation:
Tavsan kendini gercekten cok aptal hissetti.
Karnaval icin o kadar heyecanlanmisti ki
uyuyakalmis ve hepsini kacirmisti!

original:
And this is why, unlike dogs, you should
never let sleeping rabbits lie!
translation:
Iste bu yuzden, kopeklerin aksine,
uyuyan tavsanlari asla kendi haline birakmamalisin!

original: The End
translation: Son

original:
Hah! Some good rotation
there!
translation:
Hah! Guzel bir
donus oldu!

original:
That's pretty much it! Just
don't snore.
translation:
Aynen oyle! Sadece
horlama yeter.

original: Yes, that works nicely.
translation: Evet, bu gayet iyi.

original:
Ho ho ho! A display of
frustration if ever I saw
one!
translation:
Ho ho ho! Bundan daha iyi
bir hayal kirikligi
gosterisi olamaz!

original:
Hmph, I'm not seeing any
twirling or spinning!
translation:
Hih, burada hic
donup durma goremiyorum!

original:
How can you get this part
wrong? It's obvious!
translation:
Bu kismi nasil
yanlis yaparsin? Cok acik!

original:
Mmm, no, something's off.
Look anxious, I said.
translation:
Mmm, hayir, bir seyler ters.
Endiseli gorun dedim.

original:
I'm sure you can squirm
better than that!
translation:
Eminim bundan daha iyi
kivranabilirsin!

original: Hmm...
translation: Himm...

original:
Right, I see where you're
going with that.
translation:
Peki, ne demek
istedigini anladim.

original: Okay.
translation: Tamam.

original:
Well, that should work fine
too...
translation:
Himm, bu da is
gorebilir...

original: You can ad-lib here.
translation: Burada dogaclama yapabilirsin.

original:
Well then, let's see what
you can do in this one!
translation:
Pekala, bakalim bu sefer
neler yapabileceksin!

original:
Ho ho! That's a pass, I
believe. Good work!
translation:
Ho ho! Sanirim gectin.
Aferin!

original:
Sorry, that's not good
enough for my circus.
translation:
Uzgunum, bu benim
sirkim icin yeterli degil.

original: Keep going...
translation: Devam et...

original: Home Sweet Home
translation: Yuvam Guzel Yuvam

original:
After visiting his cousin's house,
Bunny feels a bit jealous and
decides he wants to move.
translation:
Kuzeninin evini ziyaret ettikten sonra,
Bunny biraz kiskanir ve
tasinmak istedigine karar verir.

original:
This script is going to require
11 different actions, got it?
translation:
Bu senaryo
11 farkli hareket gerektirecek, tamam mi?

original:
It was just another ordinary
day in the woods.
translation:
Ormanda siradan bir
gundu yine.

original:
Bunny was invited to visit his
second cousin Fluffy, who had
just moved into a new home.
translation:
Bunny, yeni evine
yeni tasinmis olan
ikinci kuzeni Fluffy'yi ziyarete cagrildi.

original:
When Bunny saw Fluffy's sparkling
new house he grew rather envious.
He wanted a new home as well!
translation:
Bunny, Fluffy'nin piril piril
yeni evini gorunce kiskandi.
O da yeni bir ev istiyordu!

original:
He went round to look at all his
friends' houses in order to
decide what would suit him best.
translation:
Kendisine en uygun olani
secebilmek icin
dostlarinin evlerini tek tek gezdi.

original:
{''}A house near the river like Beaver's
would be nice,{''} thought Bunny.
translation:
{''}Beaver'inki gibi nehre yakin bir ev
guzel olurdu,{''} diye dusundu Bunny.

{''}Ama Squirrel'inki gibi, gunesin
yapraklarin arasindan suzuldugu
agac tepesindeki evi de isterdim,{''} diye dusundu.

original:
Bunny pondered all this as he
wandered through the woods.
translation:
Bunny ormanda dolasirken
bunlari dusunup durdu.

original:
He was still deep in thought when he
bumped into his neighbour, Owl.
translation:
Hala dusuncelere dalmisken
komsusu Owl ile carpisti.

original:
Owl listened to Bunny's dilemma, and at
the end she shook her feathered head.
translation:
Owl, Bunny'nin derdini dinledi ve
sonunda tuylu basini salladi.

original:
Bunny thought about what Owl had said,
and suddenly the answer came to him!
translation:
Bunny, Owl'un soylediklerini dusundu ve
bir anda cevabi buldu!

original:
All this time, he had been envious of
his friends, but he had forgotten how
lovely and cosy his own house was.
translation:
Bu sure boyunca dostlarini kiskanmisti,
ama kendi evinin ne kadar
sevimli ve sicak oldugunu unutmustu.

original:
He understood that every creature
lives best in its own home.
translation:
Her canlinin
kendi evinde en iyi yasadigini anladi.

original:
Suddenly eager to be back home in
his cosy rabbit hole, Bunny dashed off,
carrying with him a valuable lesson.
translation:
Sicak tavsan yuvasina donmeyi
iyice isteyen Bunny, degerli bir dersle
hizla evine kostu.

original: The End
translation: Son

original:
Ho ho ho! Quite the
temper you have there!
translation:
Ho ho ho! Ne
huyun varmis oyle!

original:
That's it! The main thing
here is to look happy.
translation:
Iste bu! Burada onemli olan
mutlu gorunmek.

original:
Hah! I wasn't expecting
that, but excellent!
translation:
Hah! Bunu beklemiyordum
ama mukemmel!

original:
Bravo! You look happy
as a clam!
translation:
Bravo! Agzin
kulaklarinda!

original: Hah! I like it.
translation: Hah! Hosuma gitti.

original:
No, no, no! What do you
do when you're cross?
translation:
Hayir, hayir, hayir! Kizinca
ne yaparsin?

original:
Hmph. I don't see what's
blissful about that.
translation:
Hih. Bunun nesi
mutluluk verici?

original:
Not really what I had in
mind. I said be playful!
translation:
Aklimdaki bu degildi.
Sirin ol dedim!

original:
What was that? I wanted
you to look happy!
translation:
O neydi? Mutlu
gorunmeni istemistim!

original:
Not that! It's a very
specific action I'm
looking for here!
translation:
O degil! Burada
aradigim cok
belirli bir hareket var!

original: Hmm...
translation: Himm...

original: Well...all right, then.
translation: Peki... Oyle olsun.

original: Yes, that should do it.
translation: Evet, bu is gorur.

original: Not a bad choice there.
translation: Fena bir secim degil.

original:
I'll let you make your own
interpretation here.
translation:
Burada kendi
yorumunu katmana izin verecegim.

original:
So, you've shown you're
not devoid of talent. But
this one won't be easy!
translation:
Demek yetenegin
hic de yok degilmis. Ama
bu hic kolay olmayacak!

original:
Well, well. The little
fluffball comes through.
translation:
Vay vay. Kucuk
tuylu top, isi kotardi.

original:
Hmph. You weren't up to
scratch after all.
translation:
Hih. Demek ki
o kadar da iyi degilmissin.

original: Keep going...
translation: Devam et...

original: The Naughty Wolf
translation: Yaramaz Kurt

original:
Bunny teaches a naughty
wolf a lesson.
translation:
Bunny yaramaz bir
kurda ders verir.

original:
This script is going to require
13 different actions, got it?
translation:
Bu senaryo
13 farkli hareket gerektirecek, tamam mi?

original:
Once upon a time, there lived
in the forest a naughty
wolf called Wolfie.
translation:
Bir varmis bir yokmus, ormanda
yaramaz bir
kurt yasarmis; adi Wolfie'ymis.

original:
Whenever the forest animals were
having fun together, Wolfie would
play mischievous tricks on them.
translation:
Orman hayvanlari ne zaman birlikte
eglense, Wolfie de
onlara muzip sakalar yaparmis.

original:
One day, Bunny decided
to teach him a lesson.
translation:
Bir gun, Bunny ona
bir ders vermeye karar verdi.

original:
Bunny thought up a plan and
secretly dug a big hole.
translation:
Bunny bir plan yapti ve
gizlice buyuk bir cukur kazdi.

original: The next morning...
translation: Ertesi sabah...

original:
Bunny crept up behind Wolfie
while he was drinking
from the river.
translation:
Wolfie nehirden su icerken,
Bunny sessizce arkasina
sokuldu.

original: And he kicked him into the water!
translation: Ve onu suya tekmeledi!

original:
Wolfie wasn't too chuffed about
getting all wet and he certainly
didn't like being made fun of.
translation:
Wolfie sirilsiklam olmaktan
hic hoslanmadi; hele
kendisiyle alay edilmesini hic sevmedi.

original:
The bedraggled Wolfie became very
angry and chased right after Bunny.
translation:
Sirilsiklam Wolfie cok
sinirlendi ve Bunny'nin pesine dustu.

original:
With Wolfie hot on his heels,
Bunny ran straight for a certain
spot in the forest.
translation:
Wolfie ensesindeyken,
Bunny dogruca ormandaki belli bir
noktaya kostu.

original:
Bunny took a long run-up and hopped
into the middle of a grassy patch.
translation:
Bunny hizlanip uzun bir kosu aldi ve
cimenlik bir alanin tam ortasina atladi.

original:
Wolfie, following closely behind,
ran head first into the grass...
translation:
Wolfie, hemen arkasindan gelirken,
kafasiyla cimlerin icine daldi...

original:
and landed smack in the middle of
the trap that Bunny had made!
translation:
ve Bunny'nin kurdugu
tuzagin tam ortasina pat diye dustu!

original:
Wolfie fell right into the hole
just as Bunny had planned.
translation:
Wolfie, Bunny'nin planladigi gibi
dogruca cukura dustu.

original:
Try as he might, the hole was
too deep for Wolfie to escape.
translation:
Ne kadar ugrassa da, cukur
Wolfie'nin kacamayacagi kadar derindi.

original:
Bunny looked down to see Wolfie
howling at the bottom of the trap.
translation:
Bunny asagi baktiginda,
Wolfie'nin tuzagin dibinde uludugunu gordu.

original:
Wolfie realised how mean he had been
to the other animals and apologised
for his bad behaviour.
translation:
Wolfie, diger hayvanlara ne kadar
kotu davrandigini fark etti ve
davranisi icin ozur diledi.

original:
He promised to be a good wolf
and change his naughty ways.
translation:
Iyi bir kurt olacagina ve
yaramazliklarini birakacagina soz verdi.

original:
The forest animals all enjoyed
playing together with Wolfie
from that day onwards.
translation:
O gunden sonra orman hayvanlari
Wolfie ile birlikte oynamaktan
yeniden keyif aldi.

original:
Which goes to show it's better
to be kind to others, because
then they'll be kind to you!
translation:
Bu da gosteriyor ki baskalarina
nazik olmak daha iyidir; cunku o zaman
onlar da sana nazik olur!

original:
Very surprising to see.
Very surprising!
translation:
Gormek cok sasirtici.
Cok sasirtici!

original:
Yes! That packed quite
a wallop!
translation:
Evet! Tam
yerinde bir darbe oldu!

original:
Ah, taunting him with a
tail waggle! Brilliant!
translation:
Ah, kuyrugunu sallayip
onu kizdirmak! Harika!

original:
Ho ho ho! That was some
move!
translation:
Ho ho ho! Ne
hareket ama!

original:
Good! I can really feel the
rage from you!
translation:
Guzel! Ofkeni gercekten
hissedebiliyorum!

original:
Every happy ending needs
a happy dance!
translation:
Her mutlu sonun
mutlu bir dansa ihtiyaci var!

original:
What are you doing?
That doesn't look
surprised at all!
translation:
Ne yapiyorsun?
Bu hic de
sasirmis gibi degil!

original:
That was as strong as
a limp lettuce!
translation:
Bu, porsumus bir marul
kadar gucsuzdu!

original:
If you're mocking
somebody, you waggle
your tail, no?
translation:
Birisiyle alay ediyorsan,
kuyrugunu sallarsin,
degil mi?

original:
That wasn't exactly what
I had in mind...
translation:
Aklimdaki tam olarak
bu degildi...

original:
Really focus your anger
next time! I want to see
you fuming!
translation:
Bir dahaki sefere ofkeni
iyice odakla! Seni
kuplere binmis gormek istiyorum!

original:
Hmph... Is that the best
you can do?
translation:
Hih... Yapabildigin
en iyisi bu mu?

original: Hmm...
translation: Himm...

original: That'll do.
translation: Bu olur.

original: Well, that seems fine.
translation: Eh, fena degil.

original: Hmph. Yes, okay.
translation: Hih. Tamam, peki.

original:
I'll let you improvise on
this one.
translation:
Bunda
dogaclama yapmana izin verecegim.

original:
I'm starting to like you,
rabbit. I hope you'll meet
my expectations!
translation:
Seni sevmeye basladim,
tavsan. Umarim
beklentilerimi karsilarsin!

original:
Good job! You're coming
along in leaps and
bounds, aren't you?
translation:
Iyi is! Buyuk
adimlarla ilerliyorsun,
degil mi?

original:
We're going to have to
look for another member
for our troupe.
translation:
Toplulugumuz icin
baska bir uye
bulmamiz gerekecek.

original: Keep going...
translation: Devam et...

original: A Spot of Courage
translation: Bir Parca Cesaret

original:
One day, a hunter enters the
forest. Bunny is in a pinch!
translation:
Bir gun bir avci
ormana girer. Bunny koseye sikisir!

original:
This script is going to require
13 different actions, got it?
translation:
Bu senaryo
13 farkli hareket gerektirecek, tamam mi?

original: One day in the forest...
translation: Ormanda bir gun...

original:
Bunny was hopping through the
trees when he bumped into Bear,
who looked awfully poorly.
translation:
Bunny agaclarin arasinda ziplarken,
pek hasta gorunen Bear ile
burun buruna geldi.

original:
Bunny was afraid of Bear, but
this time he plucked up the
courage to talk to her.
translation:
Bunny Bear'dan korkuyordu ama
bu kez cesaretini toplayip
onunla konustu.

original:
Bear said she had hurt her paw by
stepping on a nasty man's trap.
translation:
Bear, kotu bir adamin tuzagina basip
patisini incittigini soyledi.

original:
Bunny wanted to help and went
to talk to Owl, the wisest of all
his friends in the forest.
translation:
Bunny yardim etmek istedi ve
ormandaki en bilge dostu Owl'un
yanina gitti.

original:
Owl told Bunny where to
get some medicinal herbs
that would heal Bear.
translation:
Owl, Bunny'ye Bear'i iyilestirecek
sifali otlari
nereden bulacagini soyledi.

original:
Bunny hurried to fetch the
herbs and took them to Bear.
translation:
Bunny otlari almak icin acele etti
ve onlari Bear'a goturdu.

original:
They made Bear feel a lot
better. Bear said thank you
and made her way home.
translation:
Otlar Bear'i cok daha
iyi hissettirdi. Bear tesekkur etti
ve evine gitti.

original: Then, some days later...
translation: Aradan birkac gun gecince...

original:
Bunny was merrily hopping through
the forest when all of a sudden
he was spotted by a hunter!
translation:
Bunny neseyle ormanda ziplarken,
birdenbire
bir avci onu fark etti!

original:
Bunny hopped away as fast as
he could, but the hunter chased
him all the way to the river.
translation:
Bunny olabildigince hizli kacti,
ama avci onu
nehre kadar kovaladi.

original:
Bunny couldn't swim. He
thought he was done for!
translation:
Bunny yuzme bilmezdi. O,
isinin bittigini sandi!

original:
When, out of nowhere, a bear appeared!
It knocked Bunny out of harm's way,
then roared, scaring off the hunter.
translation:
Derken, bir anda Bear ortaya cikti!
Bunny'yi tehlikeden uzaklastirdi,
sonra kukreyip avciyi kacirdi.

original:
It was the same bear
that Bunny had helped!
translation:
Bu, Bunny'nin yardim ettigi
ayni Bear'di!

original:
Bear had come to pay Bunny back for
the courage and kindness that he
had shown her in her time of need.
translation:
Bear, zor zamaninda gosterdigi
cesaret ve iyiligin karsiligini
odemek icin gelmisti.

original:
Bunny and Bear have been friends
ever since!
translation:
Bunny ve Bear, o gunden beri
dost kaldilar!

original: And they all lived happily ever after.
translation: Ve sonsuza dek mutlu yasadilar.

original:
Whew! That was positively
seething!
translation:
Vay be! Resmen
kuplere binmissin!

original:
Good! You've shown that
time is of the essence!
translation:
Guzel! Zamanin ne kadar
onemli oldugunu gosterdin!

original:
That's it! You shocked me
too!
translation:
Iste bu! Beni de
sasirttin!

original:
Ahh...I see. You really
thought about that one.
translation:
Ahh... Anladim. Bunu
gercekten dusunmussun.

original:
A happy end deserves a
happy dance!
translation:
Mutlu bir son
mutlu bir dansi hak eder!

original:
I'm not convinced. Really
explode with anger!
translation:
Ikna olmadim. Ofkeni
patlat, goster!

original:
I'd expect a bit more
effort than that!
translation:
Bundan biraz daha
caba beklerdim!

original:
There's only one kind of
surprise I'm looking for
here!
translation:
Burada aradigim
tek bir tur
saskinlik var!

original:
Make it more amusing.
How about rolling?
translation:
Daha eglenceli yap.
Yuvarlanmaya ne dersin?

original:
It's meant to be a happy
ending! I want buckets
of joy!
translation:
Bu mutlu bir son olmali!
Bol bol
sevinc istiyorum!

original: Hmm...
translation: Himm...

original: That could work...
translation: Bu ise yarayabilir...

original: Well, why not?
translation: Ee, neden olmasin?

original: Fine, go on.
translation: Peki, devam et.

original:
You can do more or less
whatever comes to mind
here, anyway.
translation:
Burada zaten
aklina gelen hemen her seyi
yapabilirsin.

original:
You've come a long way!
As have the demands of
the scripts!
translation:
Epey yol katettin!
Senaryolarin beklentileri de
artti!

original:
Your performance was
hare-raising!
translation:
Performansin
tuyler urperticiydi!

original:
Hmph. That wasn't the
kind of performance we're
after.
translation:
Hih. Aradigimiz
performans
bu degildi.

original: Keep going...
translation: Devam et...

original: Fuzzy Dance-Off
translation: Pofuduk Dans Kapismasi

original:
Don't question whether animals
can dance. What matters is if
they can do it with style!
translation:
Hayvanlarin dans edip edemeyecegini
sorgulama. Onemli olan,
bunu havali yapabilmeleri!

original:
This script is going to require
14 different actions, got it?
translation:
Bu senaryo
14 farkli hareket gerektirecek, tamam mi?

original:
The animals all lived happily
together in their tiny forest.
translation:
Hayvanlar, minicik ormanlarinda
hep birlikte mutlu mesut yasiyordu.

original:
Bunny was no exception. He
loved living in the forest too.
translation:
Bunny de bir istisna degildi. O
ormanda yasamayi o da seviyordu.

original:
The animals are good friends, but
they enjoy a bit of competition
every now and then.
translation:
Hayvanlar iyi dosttu, ama
arada bir kucuk bir rekabetin
tadini cikarmayi da severlerdi.

original:
One day, a dance contest was
announced to decide the best
dancer in the forest.
translation:
Bir gun, ormanin en iyi danscisini
secmek icin bir dans yarismasi
duyuruldu.

original:
This was Bunny's big chance
to impress Nutmeg, the rabbit
of his dreams!
translation:
Bu, Bunny'nin hayallerindeki tavsan
Nutmeg'i etkilemek icin
buyuk firsatiydi!

original:
Bunny hurried home and practised
his best moves all night long.
translation:
Bunny eve kostu ve en iyi
hareketlerini butun gece calisti.

original: The next day...
translation: Ertesi gun...

original:
The forest animals were all showing off
their moves in front of a big crowd.
translation:
Orman hayvanlari buyuk bir kalabaligin
onunde hareketlerini sergiliyordu.

original:
Bunny scanned the crowd and
saw that Nutmeg was there too.
translation:
Bunny kalabaliga bakti ve
Nutmeg'in de orada oldugunu gordu.

original:
It was finally Bunny's turn, but
he was a fluffy bag of nerves.
translation:
Sonunda sira Bunny'ye geldi, ama
o, tuylu bir sinir yumagiydi.

original:
Bunny decided to give it everything
he had and dance with all his might.
translation:
Bunny elinden geleni yapmaya karar verdi
ve tum gucuyle dans etti.

original:
The whole crowd focused
on Bunny's every move.
translation:
Tum kalabalik
Bunny'nin her hareketine odaklandi.

original:
Waggle, waggle! Bunny's hip shaking
put everybody in a trance.
translation:
Salla, salla! Bunny'nin kalca kivirtmasi
herkesi buyuledi.

original:
Then he walked around on just his front
paws! A great display of strength, though
his nerves made him a little unsteady.

Wow! Some gasps rose from the
crowd as Bunny really got going!
translation:
Vay! Bunny iyice cosunca,
kalabaliktan hayret nidalari yukseldi!

original:
Next came some acrobatics! It wasn't
perfect, but the crowd didn't mind.
translation:
Sirada akrobatik hareketler vardi! Kusursuz
degildi ama kalabalik aldirmadi.

original:
And for the big finale, an old-skool
breakdancing move!
translation:
Ve buyuk final icin, eski usul
bir breakdans hareketi!

original:
The crowd gave a huge cheer after
seeing Bunny's amazing footwork!
translation:
Kalabalik, Bunny'nin inanilmaz ayak
hareketlerini gorunce buyuk bir tezahurat yapti!

original:
And the victorious Bunny even stole
the heart of his bunny sweetheart too!
translation:
Ve zafer kazanan Bunny,
tavsan sevgilisinin kalbini de caldi!

original:
But that, friends, is another story.
The End
translation:
Ama o, dostlar, baska bir hikaye.
Son

original:
Ho ho! Even heroes can
be shy sometimes.
translation:
Ho ho! Kahramanlar bile
bazen utangac olabilir.

original:
There, there! Everything
will be just fine.
translation:
Hadi, hadi! Her sey
yoluna girecek.

original:
That's the spirit! Go and
show them what you're
made of!
translation:
Iste ruh bu! Git ve
neler yapabildigini
onlara goster!

original:
Good! Get the crowd into
the rhythm!
translation:
Guzel! Kalabaligi
tempoya sok!

original:
Never mind wobbling.
You're doing just fine!
translation:
Sallanmayi bos ver.
Gayet iyi gidiyorsun!

original:
What energy! I honestly
wasn't expecting that!
translation:
Ne enerji! Acikcasi
bunu beklemiyordum!

original:
Interpretive dance, eh?
I like it!
translation:
Cagrisimli dans, ha?
Hosuma gitti!

original:
Oh, good show! You nailed
the ending!
translation:
Oh, harika gosteri! Sonu
tam isabet yaptin!

original:
You'll need to look a bit
more flushed than that!
translation:
Bundan biraz daha
kizarmis gorunmelisin!

original:
That's not it. It has to
make me feel nervous!
translation:
Bu degil. Beni
gercekten geriyor olmali!

original:
Not really my style.
A good kick is the way
to relieve tension!
translation:
Benim tarzim degil.
Guzel bir tekme,
gerginligi atmanin yoludur!

original:
You need a move to get
the crowd behind you.
translation:
Kalabaligi arkana alacak
bir harekete ihtiyacin var.

original:
Let me see... How about
walking on your front
paws?
translation:
Dur bakayim... Ya
on patilerinle
yurumeye ne dersin?

original:
You need to mix your joy
with a dance-style move.
translation:
Sevincini dans tarzi
bir hareketle birlestirmelisin.

original:
Don't you have a silly
jump? Maybe something
that's slightly awkward?
translation:
Komik bir
ziplayisin yok mu? Belki
garipce bir sey?

original:
No, no, no! This has to
be the pinnacle of your
performance.
translation:
Hayir, hayir, hayir! Bu,
performansinin
dorugu olmali.

original: Hmm...
translation: Himm...

original: That'll do.
translation: Bu olur.

original: Well, that seems fine.
translation: Eh, fena degil.

original: Hmph. Yes, okay.
translation: Hih. Tamam, peki.

original:
I'll let you improvise on
this one.
translation:
Bunda
dogaclama yapmana izin verecegim.

original:
You've come a long way.
Your stage awaits!
translation:
Epey yol katettin.
Sahne seni bekliyor!

original:
Well, how about that?
Maybe I'll hire you as
a professional dancer!
translation:
Bak sen! Belki seni
profesyonel bir dansci olarak
ise alirim!

original:
A circus rabbit should at
least know the basics of
dancing...
translation:
Bir sirk tavsani en azindan
dansin temelini
bilmelidir...

original: Keep going...
translation: Devam et...

original: The Snow Bunny
translation: Kar Tavsani

original:
Bunny ventures deep into the forest
to seek a miraculous flower.
translation:
Bunny, mucizevi bir cicek aramak icin
ormanin derinliklerine dogru yola cikar.

original:
This script is going to require
16 different actions, got it?
translation:
Bu senaryo icin
16 farkli hareket gerekecek, anladin mi?

original:
Once upon a time, there was
a young boy who was very ill.
translation:
Bir zamanlar,
agir hasta bir kucuk cocuk vardi.

original:
The boy spent his days inside
his bedroom, staring sadly
out of the window.
translation:
Cocuk gunlerini
odasinin icinde gecirir,
pencereden huzunle disari bakardi.

original:
Then one day, he looked out to
find Bunny staring back at him.
translation:
Derken bir gun disari baktiginda,
Bunny'nin ona baktigini gordu.

original:
Bunny was very timid, but he always
had a smile on his whiskers.
translation:
Bunny cok urkekti ama hep
biyiklarinin ucunda bir tebessum vardi.

original:
The two bonded right away, and
Bunny visited the boy every day.
translation:
Ikisi hemen kaynasti ve
Bunny her gun cocugu ziyaret etti.

original: Then winter came...
translation: Sonra kis geldi...

original:
The boy's illness grew worse,
until he couldn't even go to
the window to see Bunny.

But Bunny had heard of a
rare and miraculous flower,
said to cure any disease.
translation:
Ama Bunny, her hastaligi iyilestirdigi soylenen
nadir ve mucizevi bir cicegin
varligini duymustu.

original: He had to get it!
translation: Onu bulmaliydi!

original:
That was easier said than done.
The only place the flower grew
was deep in a dangerous forest.
translation:
Soylemesi kolaydi, yapmasi zordu.
Cicek yalnizca
tehlikeli bir ormanin derinliklerinde yetisirdi.

original:
Bunny plucked up his courage
and headed into the woods.
translation:
Bunny cesaretini topladi
ve ormana dogru yola koyuldu.

original:
He scoured high and low, searching
the whole forest for the flower.
translation:
Yuksek alcak demeden,
cicegi bulmak icin tum ormani didik didik aradi.

original:
Just when he was about to give
up, he spotted a lone flower!
But time was running out.
translation:
Tam vazgecmek uzereyken,
tek basina bir cicek gordu!
Ama zaman tukeniyordu.

original:
Bunny hopped back as fast as he
could along the treacherous path.
translation:
Bunny tehlikeli patikadan
elinden geldigince hizlica geri sekerek dondu.

original:
In his haste, he slipped on some ice
and tumbled down the rocky slope.
translation:
Aceleyle giderken buzda kaydi
ve tasli yamactan asagi yuvarlandi.

original:
But Bunny couldn't let his bruises slow him
down. He struggled on through the snow.
He had to get the flower to the boy.
translation:
Ama Bunny, yaralarinin onu yavaslatmasina izin veremezdi.
Karin icinde guclukle ilerledi.
Cicegi mutlaka cocuga goturmeliydi.

original:
Later that night, the boy woke to
the sound of tapping at his window.
translation:
O gece ilerleyen saatlerde cocuk,
penceresine vuran tikirtiyla uyandi.

original:
The boy dragged himself to the window
hoping to see his friend, but there on the
window sill he found only a single flower.
translation:
Cocuk kendini zorlayip pencereye surundu,
arkadasini gormeyi umdu ama
pencere pervazinda yalnizca tek bir cicek buldu.

original:
The boy reached out and picked up the
flower. He was immediately surrounded
by a mysterious glow.
translation:
Cocuk uzanip
cicegi eline aldi. Bir anda
gizemli bir pariltiyla cevrelendi.

original:
He didn't know what was happening but
he could feel himself getting better.
translation:
Neler oldugunu bilmiyordu ama
kendini iyilesiyor gibi hissediyordu.

original:
The next day, the boy entered the
forest to thank Bunny for curing him.
translation:
Ertesi gun cocuk, Bunny'ye
onu iyilestirdigi icin tesekkur etmek uzere ormana girdi.

original:
He had only gone a little way when
he found Bunny lying in the snow,
too exhausted to move or speak.

The boy picked up his poor friend
and cried as his cold body became
still. But Bunny looked content.
translation:
Cocuk zavalli arkadasini kucagina aldi
ve soguk bedeni hareketsizlesirken
agladi. Ama Bunny huzurlu gorunuyordu.

original:
The boy dug a grave for Bunny
and planted a flower in the soil.
translation:
Cocuk Bunny icin bir mezar kazdi
ve topraga bir cicek dikti.

original:
It was the same flower that
had cured him of his illness.
translation:
Bu, hastaligini
iyilestiren cicegin aynisiydi.

original:
As he finished, a snowflake settled
on the palm of the boy's hand.
translation:
Isini bitirirken bir kar tanesi,
cocugun avucuna kondu.

original:
{''}I'm glad that you got better,{''}
a voice on the wind whispered.
translation:
{''}Iyilesmene sevindim,{''}
ruzgarin icindeki bir ses fisildadi.

original:
{''}Let's play together the
next time it snows.{''}
translation:
{''}Bir dahaki kar yagdiginda
birlikte oynayalim.{''}

original:
The boy never forgot him. On the first day
of snow each year, he thinks of Bunny,
his true friend, and the joy they shared.
translation:
Cocuk onu hic unutmadi. Her yil
karin ilk yagdigi gun Bunny'yi,
gercek dostunu ve paylastiklari neseyi dusunur.

original: The End
translation: Son

original:
Ho ho! There's nothing
cuter than a waggle!
translation:
Ho ho! Bir kimildamadan
daha sevimlisi yok!

original:
That's the way to show
some fearless courage!
translation:
Iste korkusuz cesaret
boyle gosterilir!

original:
Good! That's a tumble if
ever there was one!
translation:
Guzel! Iste buna
yuvarlanma denir!

original:
Sniff... It really looks
as though you're on your
last legs!
translation:
Hick... Gercekten de
sanki ayakta
zor duruyorsun!

original:
Right. That perfectly
conveys how drained
Bunny must be.
translation:
Evet. Bu, Bunny'nin
ne kadar bitkin
oldugunu tam anlatiyor.

original:
That's it! That's it! Just
what I wanted!
translation:
Iste bu! Iste bu! Tam
istedigim gibi!

original: Oh! The perfect ending!
translation: Ah! Mukemmel bir son!

original:
I said something silly, not
ridiculous!
translation:
Sacma degil, sadece
aptalca bir sey soyledim!

original:
It needs to be a little more
aggressive, no?
translation:
Biraz daha
sert olmali, degil mi?

original:
Imagine how you'd look
rolling down a slope.
translation:
Bir yamactan asagi
yuvarlanirken nasil gorunecegini dusun.

original:
Hmph, no. You need to be
stumbling forwards, weak
and wobbly!
translation:
Hih, hayir. One dogru
sendeliyor gibi olmalisin,
zayif ve titrek!

original:
How could you mess this
one up?!
translation:
Bunu nasil
berbat edersin?!

original:
Mm... You should show
more modesty here.
translation:
Himm... Burada biraz
daha mutevazi olmalisin.

original:
No! The bittersweet
ending has to end on
a happy note!
translation:
Hayir! Aci tatli
son, mutlaka
neseli bir notayla bitmeli!

original: Hmm...
translation: Himm...

original: All right, yes.
translation: Pekala, evet.

original: I suppose that works.
translation: Sanirim olur.

original:
I didn't think of that,
but...fine.
translation:
Bunu dusunmemistim,
ama...peki.

original:
Feel free to do as you
like on this one.
translation:
Bu konuda diledigin
gibi yapabilirsin.

original:
Oh! Think you're ready for
this one? I'm looking
forward to it!
translation:
Ah! Buna hazir oldugunu
mu saniyorsun? Sabirsizlikla
bekliyorum!

original:
That was...tear-jerkingly
magnificent!
translation:
Bu...goz yasartacak
kadar muhtesemdi!

original:
Look, our troupe prides
itself on expressing
the CORRECT emotions!
translation:
Bak, ekibimiz
DOGRU duygulari
ifade etmekle gurur duyar!

original: Keep going...
translation: Devam et...

original: The Greatest Treasure
translation: En Buyuk Hazine

original:
Bunny is hard at work preparing
for a harsh winter, but Fox is just
playing. How will it all end?
translation:
Bunny sert bir kisa hazirlanmak icin
haril haril calisiyor, ama Fox sadece
oynuyor. Sonu nasil bitecek?

original:
This script is going to require
15 different actions, got it?
translation:
Bu senaryo
15 farkli hareket gerektirecek, tamam mi?

original:
The forest braced itself
for a bitter winter.
translation:
Orman
cetin bir kisa hazirlanmisti.

original:
Bunny was hard at work getting
ready for the coming weather.
translation:
Bunny yaklasan havaya hazirlanmak icin
canla basla calisiyordu.

original:
One day, he helped Squirrel
to collect nuts.
translation:
Bir gun Squirrel'a
findik toplamaya yardim etti.

original:
Another day, Bunny helped
Bear collect wild strawberries.
translation:
Baska bir gun Bunny,
Bear'a yabani cilek toplamaya yardim etti.

original:
Bunny was busy every day. He even
dried grass for bedding while the
weather was still warm.
translation:
Bunny her gun mesguldu. Hatta
hava hala sicakken yatak yapmak icin
ot kuruttu.

original:
Fox, on the other hand, never
helped out and just made fun of
all the hard-working animals.
translation:
Fox ise hicbir zaman
yardim etmedi; sadece
caliskan hayvanlarla alay etti.

original:
Then winter came. This year,
it spared the forest no mercy.
translation:
Sonra kis geldi. Bu yil,
ormani hic esirgemedi.

original:
Fortunately, Bunny's hard work paid off
and he waited for the return of spring,
snug and warm in his cosy home.
translation:
Neyse ki Bunny'nin emegi karsiligini verdi
ve sicacik, rahat yuvasinda
baharin donusunu bekledi.

original:
One chilly winter's day, Bunny
went to the river to find Fox
looking quite forlorn.
translation:
Soguk bir kis gununde Bunny
nehre gitti ve Fox'u
oldukca kederli buldu.

original:
Bunny felt sorry for Fox and
asked what was wrong.
translation:
Bunny Fox'a acidi ve
ne oldugunu sordu.

original:
{''}Oh, Bunny,{''} replied Fox, {''}I'm
so hungry I can barely move!{''}
translation:
{''}Ah, Bunny,{''} diye cevap verdi Fox, {''}O kadar
aciktim ki kipirdayamiyorum!{''}

original:
{''}I asked Squirrel and Bear for help,
but they ignored me. They just left
me here in the cold,{''} he cried.
translation:
{''}Squirrel ve Bear'dan yardim istedim,
ama beni gormezden geldiler. Beni
burada, sogukta birakip gittiler,{''} diye agladi.

original: That night...
translation: O gece...

original:
Bunny was still worried about
Fox, so he went back to the
river to check up on him.
translation:
Bunny hala Fox icin endiseliydi,
bu yuzden onu kontrol etmek icin
nehre geri dondu.

original:
Fox was lying in the same
spot, sobbing to himself.
translation:
Fox ayni
yerde yatiyor, hickira hickira agliyordu.

original:
Bunny felt so sorry for Fox that
he invited him back to his house.
translation:
Bunny Fox'a o kadar acidi ki
onu evine davet etti.

original:
He decided to share with Fox the
nuts and strawberries that he had
worked so hard to collect.
translation:
Fox'la, toplamak icin cok calistigi
findiklari ve cilekleri
paylasmaya karar verdi.

original: Then, there was a knock at the door!
translation: Tam o sirada kapi caldi!

original:
Bunny opened the door to find both
Squirrel and Bear standing outside.
translation:
Bunny kapiyi acti; karsisinda
Squirrel ve Bear'i disarida buldu.

original:
They had brought their own supplies
of food to share with Fox too!
translation:
Onlar da Fox'la paylasmak icin
kendi yiyeceklerini getirmislerdi!

original:
Fox was so overwhelmed by their
kindness that he promised to
work hard from then on.
translation:
Gosterdikleri iyilik Fox'u oyle etkiledi ki
bundan sonra
cok calisacagina soz verdi.

original:
Bunny looked at his furry chums
and thought to himself...
translation:
Bunny tuylu dostlarina bakti
icinden soyle dusundu...

original:
{''}The most important thing in life is not
delicious food or a large house...{''}
translation:
{''}Hayattaki en onemli sey
lezzetli yemekler ya da buyuk bir ev degil...{''}

original:
{''}The most important thing
in life is friendship!{''}
translation:
{''}Hayattaki en onemli sey
arkadasliktir!{''}

original: The End
translation: Son

original: That's the way to do it!
translation: Iste boyle yapmali!

original:
Good! Rabbits can't bottle
up their feelings forever!
translation:
Guzel! Tavsanlar duygularini
sonsuzca icine atamaz!

original:
Beautiful! Anyone would be
able to feel your concern
for Fox.
translation:
Harika! Herkes Fox icin
duydugun endiseyi
hissedebilir.

original:
That's the one! That's the
look I wanted!
translation:
Iste bu! Istedigim
bakis buydu!

original:
Hah! I wasn't expecting
that, but well done!
translation:
Hah! Bunu beklemiyordum
ama aferin!

original:
Just the right amount of
modesty. Grand!
translation:
Tam kivaminda
tevazu. Muhtesem!

original:
Exactly as I envisioned it.
Bravo, oh bravo!
translation:
Aynen hayal ettigim gibi.
Bravo, bravo!

original:
No, no! You should be
hard at work!
translation:
Hayir, hayir! Sen
canla basla calismalisin!

original:
Bah. How could you get
that wrong?
translation:
Tuh. Bunu nasil
yanlis yaparsin?

original:
You really need to evoke
more sympathy here.
translation:
Burada daha cok
acima duygusu uyandirmalisin.

original:
I'd prefer it if you look
utterly flabbergasted!
translation:
Soyle tam anlamiyla
afallamis gorunmeni isterim!

original:
Just make it look as if
you're happy.
translation:
Sadece mutluymus
gibi gorun.

original:
Not what I wanted. Show
how shy you are!
translation:
Istedigim bu degil. Ne kadar
utangac oldugunu goster!

original:
It's supposed to be a
happy ending. Get the
emotion right!
translation:
Bu mutlu bir son olmali.
Duyguyu
dogru ver!

original: Hmm...
translation: Himm...

original: Well... All right, then.
translation: Peki... Oyle olsun.

original: Yes, that should do it.
translation: Evet, bu is gorur.

original: Not a bad choice there.
translation: Fena bir secim degil.

original:
I'll let you make your own
interpretation here.
translation:
Burada kendi
yorumunu katmana izin verecegim.

original:
You'll like this one, but
I think I'll enjoy seeing
you act even more!
translation:
Bunu seveceksin, ama
sanirim seni oynarken izlemek
daha da hosuma gidecek!

original:
Absolutely outstanding.
I think you might just
have what it takes!
translation:
Kesinlikle muthis.
Sanirim sende
bu is var!

original:
You can't fall at the last
hurdle. Pick yourself up
and do that again!
translation:
Son engelde dusemezsin.
Kendini toparla
ve tekrar yap!

original: Keep going...
translation: Devam et...

original: ルーク
translation: Luke

original:
<T>Hello! What are you up to,
<N1>?
translation:
<T>Merhaba! Ne yapiyorsun,
<N1>?

original: ウサギ
translation: Tavsan

original: <T>Oh! I was just, well...just wondering.
translation: <T>Ah! Sey... Sadece merak ediyordum.

original: <T>Wondering? What about?
translation: <T>Merak mi ediyordun? Neyi?

original:
<T>About the actions I've learnt. I really
want to do well and make the
ringmaster proud!
translation:
<T>Ogrendigim hareketleri. Gercekten
iyi olmak ve sirk sefini
gururlandirmak istiyorum!

original:
<T>Don't worry your fluffy head. I'll
do whatever I can to help!
translation:
<T>Pofuduk kafani uzme. Yardim etmek icin
elimden geleni yaparim!

original: <T>You will?! Oh, thank you so much!
translation: <T>Gercekten mi?! Ah, cok tesekkur ederim!

original:
<T>Mmm, it's so soft and fuzzy! Warm
and cosy too!
translation:
<T>Mmm, cok yumusak ve pofuduk! Sicacik
ve rahat da!

original:
<T>It's places like this...<W15>that make me...<W15>
sleepy... <W30>Zzzzzzz... <W30>Zzzzzzzzz...
translation:
<T>Boyle yerler...<W15> beni...<W15>
uykucu yapiyor... <W30>Zzzzzzz... <W30>Zzzzzzzzz...

original:
<T>Oh, there, there, bunny. Tell me
what's wrong.
translation:
<T>Ah, tamam, tamam tavsancik. Soyle bakalim,
neyin var?

original:
<T>Well...Emmy gave me a carrot, you
see, but now it's gone! I've looked
everywhere!
translation:
<T>Sey... Emmy bana bir havuc vermisti ya,
ama simdi kayboldu! Her yere
baktim!

original:
<T>Could you have put it away
somewhere for safekeeping?
translation:
<T>Guvende olsun diye bir yere koymus
olabilir misin?

original: <T>Umm...well...
translation: <T>Iii... sey...

original:
<T>Snuff, snuff... You know, I can't
remember!
translation:
<T>Snif snif... Biliyor musun, hic
hatirlamiyorum!

original:
<T>Oh well, don't fret, little bunny,
I'll bring another one for you
next time!
translation:
<T>Neyse, endiselenme kucuk tavsancik,
bir dahaki sefere sana bir tane daha
getiririm!

original:
<T>Y-you will?! Oh, wow! A whole new
carrot for me!
translation:
<T>G-gercekten mi?! Vay canina! Bana yepyeni
bir havuc!

original:
<T>Is something the matter,
<N1>?
translation:
<T>Bir sorun mu var,
<N1>?

original: <T>Oh, Luke!
translation: <T>Ah, Luke!

original: <T>Well, umm...<W>the truth is...<W30> I...<W15>I...
translation: <T>Sey, iii...<W> aslinda...<W30> ben...<W15> ben...

original:
<T>I really want to go whoosh down that
slide, but I can't find an easy way up!
translation:
<T>O kaydiraktan suuup asagi kaymak
istiyorum ama yukari cikmanin kolay bir yolunu bulamiyorum!

original:
<T>Can't you use the box in the
corner as a stepping stone?
translation:
<T>Kosedeki kutuyu basamak gibi
kullanamaz misin?

original:
<T>I suppose...but that way's not fast
enough! I want the whoosh without the
work!
translation:
<T>Sanirim... ama o yol yeterince hizli
degil! Ben, ugrasmadan suuup kaymak
istiyorum!

original:
<T>Hmm, that's tricky. We'll have
to find a quicker way for you
to get up.
translation:
<T>Himm, bu zor. Yukari cikman icin
daha hizli bir yol bulmamiz
gerekecek.

original: <T>'Kay! I'm all ears!
translation: <T>Tamam! Kulak kesildim!

original: <T>Umm...<W>I think...
translation: <T>Iii...<W> sanirim...

original:
<T>I might have got better at dealing with
high places since I started climbing.
translation:
<T>Tirmanmaya basladigimdan beri
yuksek yerlerle basa cikmada daha iyi oldum galiba.

original:
<T>Oh, that's brilliant! Good for
you, <N1>!
translation:
<T>Ah, harika! Aferin sana,
<N1>!

original: <T>Hee hee, thanks!
