translation: <T>Hihi, tesekkurler!

original:
<T>You seem pleased with yourself
today, bunbun! Did something
happen?
translation:
<T>Bugun keyfin yerinde gibi
tavso! Bir sey mi
oldu?

original: <T>Oh, nothing much!
translation: <T>Ah, pek bir sey yok!

original:
<T>I'm just so happy you gave me such
a lovely room! It's so spacious and
warm!
translation:
<T>Bana boyle guzel bir oda verdigin icin
cok mutluyum! Hem genis hem de
sicacik!

original: <T>Ha ha! I'm glad you like it!
translation: <T>Ha ha! Begenmene sevindim!

original: <T>Snuff, snuff!
translation: <T>Snif snif!

original:
<T>Hello bunnykins! What are you
up to now?
translation:
<T>Merhaba tavsancik! Simdi ne
yapiyorsun?

original: <T>Mmm, it's tricky.
translation: <T>Mmm, zor is.

original:
<T>Sometimes I slip down here when I'm
playing on the boxes up above...
translation:
<T>Bazen yukaridaki kutularin uzerinde
oynarken buraya kayip dusuyorum...

original:
<T>Oh no! You're not hurt, are
you?
translation:
<T>Hayir! Yaralanmadin ya
degil mi?

original: <T>Nope, not a whisker out of place!
translation: <T>Yok, bir biyigim bile kipirdamadi!

original:
<T>See how fluffy I am? It protects me if
I have a tumble!
translation:
<T>Ne kadar pofuduk oldugumu goruyor musun?
Dusersem beni koruyor!

original:
<T>Still, try and be a bit more
careful!
translation:
<T>Yine de biraz daha
dikkatli ol!

original: <T>All right, Luke, I will!
translation: <T>Tamam Luke, olacagim!

original: <T>Luke! Did you watch me?!
translation: <T>Luke! Beni izledin mi?!

original: <T>Hm? What did you do?
translation: <T>Hm? Ne yaptin?

original:
<T>I went to the top of the slide, counted
to three, and then...gerrronimooo!
translation:
<T>Kaydiragin tepesine ciktim, uce kadar saydim
ve sonra... gerrronimooo!

original:
<T>Ha ha, bunny, that sounds like
fun! And that slide's just like the
ones I go on in playgrounds!
translation:
<T>Ha ha, tavsan, kulaga eglenceli geliyor!
Hem o kaydirak, parklardakilere
cok benziyor!

original: <T>Wheeeee! I could do this all day!
translation: <T>Viiuuuu! Bunu butun gun yapabilirim!

original:
<T>Can you do it again quickly so
I can see? Just climb up that
block next to the slide there.
translation:
<T>Gorebileyim diye hizlica bir daha
yapar misin? Suradaki kaydiragin
yanindaki bloga tirman yeter.

original: <T>Oh, umm...I can't do that yet.
translation: <T>Ah, iii... daha onu yapamiyorum.

original: <T>I just lose my grip and fall down...
translation: <T>Tutunamayip asagi dusuyorum...

original:
<T>Aww! That sounds so cute. I
want to see you try!
translation:
<T>Aaa! Ne tatli. Denemeni
gormek istiyorum!

original: <T>H-hey! Luke, you're a meanie!
translation: <T>H-hey! Luke, sen cok gaddarsin!

original: <T>What's going on, bunbun?
translation: <T>Ne oluyor, tavso?

original:
<T>Phew! I climbed...<W30>all the way...<W30>up
here! Did you see?
translation:
<T>Of! Tirmandim...<W30> taaa...<W30> buraya
kadar! Gordun mu?

original:
<T>I did! You look a bit tired
now, though!
translation:
<T>Gordum! Ama biraz yorgun
gorunuyorsun!

original:
<T>No, no, I'm...<W15>fine! <W30>But maybe I...<W15>need
to...<W30>catch my breath...
translation:
<T>Hayir, hayir, ben...<W15> iyiyim! <W30>Ama galiba...<W15>
biraz...<W30> nefeslenmem gerekiyor...

original: <T>Gulp...
translation: <T>Yutkun...

original:
<T>Luke! Do you think I can make it down
here?
translation:
<T>Luke! Sence buraya asagi atlayabilir
miyim?

original:
<T>It doesn't look so far to me.
Does it feel high to you?
translation:
<T>Bana cok uzak gorunmedi.
Sana yuksek mi geliyor?

original:
<T>Hmmm, it's not too bad! I was a little
scared before, but not now you're
here!
translation:
<T>Himmm, o kadar da kotu degil! Onceden biraz
korkmustum ama sen buradayken
korkmuyorum!

original:
<T>Aww, what's wrong,
<N1>?
translation:
<T>Aaa, ne oldu,
<N1>?

original:
<T>Help! There's something stuck to my
back and I can't get it off!
translation:
<T>Yardim! Sirtima bir sey yapismis,
cikaramiyorum!

original:
<T>Okay, calm down! I can't do
anything while you're wriggling
around like that!
translation:
<T>Tamam, sakin ol! Boyle kipirdanip
dururken
hicbir sey yapamam!

original: <T>I can't help it. My back feels so itchy!
translation: <T>Elimde degil. Sirtim cok kasiniyor!

original: <T>Hold still. I think I see a leaf.
translation: <T>Kipirdama. Sanirim bir yaprak goruyorum.

original:
<T>On second thoughts...you're
just too adorable like this.
translation:
<T>Bir de dusununce...
bu halinle cok sevimlisin.

original: <T>Hmm...
translation: <T>Himm...

original:
<T>That's an unusual spot for you,
<N1>!
translation:
<T>Senin icin alisilmadik bir yer,
<N1>!

original:
<T>Mmm, it's because I want to hop, hop,
hop across to the other side!
translation:
<T>Mmm, cunku obur tarafa hop hop
ziplayarak gecmek istiyorum!

original:
<T>Wow! Are you sure you can
make it without falling? I
don't want you getting hurt!
translation:
<T>Vay! Dusmeden basarabileceginden
emin misin? Yaralanmani
istemem!

original:
<T>It's fine. I can do it! I've got this in the
burrow!
translation:
<T>Sorun yok. Yapabilirim! Bunu
yuva gibi bilirim!

original:
<T>'Kay, so maybe I did fall two or three
times before... Five times, you could
say.
translation:
<T>Tamam, belki daha once iki-uc kere
dustum... Hatta bes kere
diyebilirsin.

original:
<T>Aww, it's so sweet seeing you
try so hard!
translation:
<T>Aaa, bu kadar ugrasmani
izlemek cok tatli!

original:
<T>The fun part's getting to the slide and
going wheeeee all the way down!
translation:
<T>Eglenceli olan kisim kaydiraga ulasip
viiuuuu diye taa asagi kaymak!

original:
<T>Hello! How did you manage to
end up over here?
translation:
<T>Merhaba! Buraya nasil gelebildin
boyle?

original: <T>Umm...<W>well, I...
translation: <T>Iii...<W> sey, ben...

original:
<T>I just hop, hop, hopped as far as my
legs could carry me and ended up
here!
translation:
<T>Bacaklarimin goturebildigi kadar hop hop
ziplaya ziplaya geldim ve kendimi burada
buldum!

original:
<T>Good job! It looks pretty high
up there.
translation:
<T>Aferin! Orasi epey yuksek
gorunuyor.

original:
<T>Snuff, snuff... But I can't slide down
unless I go up first!
translation:
<T>Snif snif... Ama once yukari cikmadan
kayamaz kiim!

original: <T>Aha ha ha!
translation: <T>Ahahaha!

original:
<T>Aren't you afraid of heights?
If I were a delicate little
rabbit, I know I would be.
translation:
<T>Yukseklikten korkmuyor musun?
Ben narin bir kucuk
tavsan olsaydim, kesin korkardim.

original:
<T>Nope, I don't get ver...<W>verti.<W10>.<W10>.<W> Em,
I don't know how to say fancy words.
translation:
<T>Yok, ben ver...<W> verti.<W10>.<W10>.<W> ii,
sik kelimeleri soylemeyi bilmiyorum.

original:
<T>Well, anyway, I'm not scared, because
I get to slide down at the end.
Wheeee!
translation:
<T>Neyse, korkmuyorum cunku sonunda
kaydiraktan kayacagim.
Viiuuuu!

original: <T>Ha ha, that's the spirit!
translation: <T>Ha ha, iste bu!

original: <T>I feel so...<W30>so very sleepy...
translation: <T>Cok...<W30> cok uykum var...

original:
<T>I need something to do... <W>Can we...
<W30>make a carrot cake?
translation:
<T>Yapacak bir sey lazim... <W>Acaba...
<W30>havuclu kek yapabilir miyiz?

original: <T>Umm... What should I do?
translation: <T>Iii... Ne yapmaliyim?

original: <T>Yaaaaaaaaaaawn.
translation: <T>Eeeeeesneme.

original:
<T>What are we going to do today? Is it
exciting?!
translation:
<T>Bugun ne yapacagiz? Heyecanli
bir sey mi?!

original: <T>La la la!
translation: <T>La la la!

original: <T>La dee da, dee doo dee da!
translation: <T>La di da, di du di da!

original: <T>Um, I forgot. What were we doing?
translation: <T>Sey, unuttum. Ne yapiyorduk?

original: <T>What shall I do today?
translation: <T>Bugun ne yapayim?

original: <T>I think I can hear my belly rumbling...
translation: <T>Sanirim karnimin guruldadigini duyuyorum...

original:
<T>Anything over here? Nope. Anything
over there? I have no idea, but let's
find out!
translation:
<T>Burada bir sey var mi? Yok. Surada var mi?
Bilmiyorum ama hadi
bakalim!

original:
<T>Today's going to be the best day ever!
A bunny never lies!
translation:
<T>Bugun simdiye kadarki en iyi gun olacak!
Bir tavsan asla yalan soylemez!

original:
<T>You know what, Luke? Going for
a slippy slip down the slide is just
about my favourite thing!
translation:
<T>Biliyor musun Luke? Kaydiraktan sip sip
kaymak, en sevdigim seylerden
biri!

original:
<T>Mmmmm, itchy nose. It's not fair. Why
do you get to have all the opposable
thumbs?
translation:
<T>Mmmmm, burnum kasiniyor. Hic adil degil.
Neden butun karsit
basparmaklar sizde?

original:
<T>I wonder how everyone's getting on in
the troupe... I miss them all so much.
translation:
<T>Topluluktaki herkes nasil acaba...
Hepsini cok ozledim.

original:
<T>I think I'll offer you a nibble of my
carrot next time, Luke!
translation:
<T>Bir dahaki sefere havucumdan sana bir
isirik verecegim, Luke!

original:
<T>Emmy gave me such a yummy treat!
I hope she visits me again.
translation:
<T>Emmy bana cok lezzetli bir ikram verdi!
Umarim yine gelir.

original:
<T>The top-hat man hasn't visited in
a while. I suppose he's too busy for
fluffballs.
translation:
<T>Silindir sapkali adam bir suredir gelmedi.
Sanirim pofuduklarla ilgilenecek kadar
mesgul.

original:
<T>Hey, I saw a flying rabbit outside the
window!
translation:
<T>Hey, camin disinda ucan bir tavsan
gordum!

original:
<T>It was huuuge. And all white and puffy!
Do you think I could fly like that too?
translation:
<T>Coooook buyuktu. Bembeyaz ve pofuduk!
Sence ben de oyle ucabilir miyim?

original:
<T>Do you think the top-hat man would
mind if I used his hat for a bed?
translation:
<T>Silindir sapkali adam sapkasini yatak olarak
kullansam kizar mi dersin?

original:
<T>My nose is sharper than ever today!
I can smell a carrot a mile off!
translation:
<T>Bugun burnum her zamankinden daha keskin!
Bir havucu kilometrelerce oteden koklayabilirim!

original:
<T>Hey, do you smell that? I smell a treat
coming!
translation:
<T>Hey, kokuyu aliyor musun? Bir ikramin
yaklastigini kokluyorum!

original:
<T>I think I can jump higher than before!
Is this what they call a {''}spring in your
step{''}?
translation:
<T>Sanirim eskisinden daha yuksege ziplayabiliyorum!
Buna {''}adimlarinda yaylanma{''}
mi diyorlar?

original:
<T>I knew it! These carrots are grown in
Norfolk!
translation:
<T>Biliyordum! Bu havuclar
Norfolk'ta yetismis!

original:
<T>I know from the texture: firm and
crunchy, deliciously juicy, light dusting
of peat.
translation:
<T>Dokudan anlarim: sert ve
kitir kitir, nefis sulu, ustunde
hafif torf tozu.

original:
<T>I need something to gnaw on.
My teeth feel so achy!
translation:
<T>Bir sey kemirmem lazim.
Dislerim cok sizliyor!

original:
<T>Maybe I'm growing wisdom teeth like
a human. Will that make me clever?
translation:
<T>Belki de insanlar gibi yirmilik dis cikariyorum.
Bu beni daha zeki yapar mi?

original:
<T>Mmm, my fur's not so glossy today.
I predict rain.
translation:
<T>Mmm, kurkum bugun pek parlak degil.
Yagmur geliyor bence.

original:
<T>I haven't seen many butterflies lately.
Do they melt in the rain?
translation:
<T>Son zamanlarda pek kelebek gormedim.
Yagmurda eriyorlar mi?

original:
<T>How does my fur feel? It's not matted
or anything, is it?
translation:
<T>Kurkum nasil? Kecelesmis falan degildir
degil mi?

original:
<T>There are parts of me I can't see.
What if someone steals my tuftie?!
I'd never know!
translation:
<T>Gormedigim yerlerim var.
Ya biri ponponumu calarsa?!
Asla fark etmem!

original:
<T>I woke up reeeeally early today! Even
earlier than noisy Mr Cockerel!
translation:
<T>Bugun cooooook erken uyandim! Gurultucu
Horoz Bey'den bile erken!

original:
<T>I like that cap of yours, Luke! It looks
comfortable and...round.
translation:
<T>Sapkani sevdim Luke! Rahat ve...
yuvarlak gorunuyor.

original:
<T>I think I'd look quite swish in a hat.
You'd have to cut holes for my ears,
though.
translation:
<T>Sanirim sapkayla cok havali olurum.
Ama kulaklarim icin delik acman
gerekir.

original:
<T>I think I might start doing some kind of
exercise regime.
translation:
<T>Sanirim bir tur egzersiz duzenine
baslayacagim.

original:
<T>If I train hard, I might be able to rotate
my ears like propellers and fly!
translation:
<T>Siki calisirsam kulaklarimi pervane gibi
dondurup ucabilirim!

original:
<T>The slide is the best thing ever, Luke!
You go {''}whoosh{''}, but you think
{''}eeek{''}!
translation:
<T>Kaydirak dunyadaki en iyi sey, Luke!
Sen {''}suuup{''} gidersin ama icinden
{''}iiiy{''} dersin!

original: <T>Of course, that's all part of the fun!
translation: <T>Tabii, eglencesi de burada!

original:
<T>Maybe when I've learnt how to act
properly, I'll be able to climb straight
up the slide!
translation:
<T>Belki duzgun oyunculuk ogrenince
kaydiraga dosdogru
tirmanabilirim!

original:
<T>Where's Emmy? She was waving a
carrot about, but she forgot to give it
to me!
translation:
<T>Emmy nerede? Bir havucu sallayip duruyordu ama
bana vermeyi
unuttu!

original:
<T>Or maybe it was that I got too excited
and accidentally bit her...
translation:
<T>Ya da belki de fazla heyecanlanip
yanlislikla onu isirmisimdir...

original:
<T>My friend Hannibal has perfect pitch.
Could you say hello to him for me if
you see him?
translation:
<T>Arkadasim Hannibal'in mutlak kulagi var.
Onu gorursen benim icin
selam soyler misin?

original:
<T>See that orange slide? Don't you think
it looks a bit like a carrot?
translation:
<T>Su turuncu kaydiragi goruyor musun?
Biraz havuca benzemiyor mu sence?

original:
<T>I tried gnawing it a few times when
I was hungry...
translation:
<T>Acken birkac kez
kemirmeyi denedim...

original:
<T>I'd love a good chew on the rim of
that top hat. Do you think the man
would let me?
translation:
<T>Su silindir sapkanin kenarini
guzelce kemirmek isterdim. Sence adam
izin verir mi?

original:
<T>Thank you so much for helping me
back there!
translation:
<T>Az once bana yardim ettigin icin
cok tesekkur ederim!

original:
<T>I'm <N1>.
It's nice to meet you!
translation:
<T>Ben <N1>.
Tanistigima memnun oldum!

original: <T>Umm...do you have a name?
translation: <T>Iii... senin bir adin var mi?

original:
<T>Ha ha, yes, I've got a name!
I'm Luke!
translation:
<T>Ha ha, evet, adim var!
Ben Luke!

original:
<T>And I also happen to be
Professor Layton's number
one apprentice!
translation:
<T>Hem ben ayni zamanda
Profesor Layton'in bir
numarali ciragiyim!

original:
<T>We'll have to work hard to
get you back into the troupe,
<N1>!
translation:
<T>Seni yeniden topluluga
dondurmek icin cok calismaliyiz,
<N1>!

original:
<T>I know, I know! I admit I haven't been
doing well enough.
translation:
<T>Biliyorum, biliyorum! Yeterince iyi olmadigimi
kabul ediyorum.

original: <T>But I'll try my best. Really, I will!
translation: <T>Ama elimden gelenin en iyisini yapacagim. Gercekten!

original:
<T>Oh, and by the way...the ringmaster
never understood a word I was saying.
translation:
<T>Bu arada... sirk sefi soylediklerimden
tek kelime bile anlamazdi.

original:
<T>But you can actually talk to me! Did
you study a lot of Laprese at school?
translation:
<T>Ama sen benimle gercekten konusabiliyorsun!
Okulda cok Laprese mi okudun?

original:
<T>Ah, no. I'm not quite sure how
I'm able to speak to you,
actually.
translation:
<T>Ah, hayir. Aslinda seninle nasil
konusabildigimden ben de
pek emin degilim.

original:
<T>I sort of just sense animals'
emotions and the language
comes naturally.
translation:
<T>Sanirim hayvanlarin duygularini
hissediyorum ve dili
kendiliginden anliyorum.

original: <T>That's amazing! Are you a...genius?
translation: <T>Inanilmaz! Sen... bir dahi misin?

original:
<T>Aha ha, not quite. It's just a
skill I have. I think I inherited
it from my father.
translation:
<T>Aha ha, pek sayilmaz. Bu sadece
benim bir yetenegim. Sanirim
babamdan miras aldim.

original:
<T>People give me funny looks
sometimes, but I'd never give it
up for anything!
translation:
<T>Bazen insanlar bana tuhaf bakiyor
ama bunun icin asla
vazgecmem!

original:
<T>After all, we'd never have
become friends if we couldn't
speak to each other!
translation:
<T>Sonucta birbirimizle konusamasaydik
asla arkadas
olamazdik!

original: <T>Friends... Are we really friends?
translation: <T>Arkadas... Gercekten arkadas miyiz?

original:
<T>That's right! And we're going to
get you back into that circus
whatever it takes!
translation:
<T>Aynen oyle! Ne pahasina olursa olsun
seni yeniden o sirke
dondurecegiz!

original:
<T>Then you can see all your
friends there, too!
translation:
<T>O zaman oradaki butun
arkadaslarini da gorebilirsin!

original:
<T>Wheeee! I can't wait to see them
again! Thanks a whole bunch of
carrots!
translation:
<T>Viiuuuu! Onlari tekrar gormek icin
sabirsizlaniyorum! Bir sepet havuc
kadar tesekkurler!

original:
<T>Hey, I've got a great idea,
<N1>!
translation:
<T>Hey, harika bir fikrim var,
<N1>!

original: <T>Mmmm? What's that?
translation: <T>Mmmm? Ne fikri?

original:
<T>Well, seeing as the ringmaster
gave us some scripts to look
at...
translation:
<T>Sey, sirk sefi bize bakmamiz icin
bazi metinler verdi
ya...

original:
<T>I was wondering if you'd like
to learn some choreography
to accompany them!
translation:
<T>Onlara eslik edecek biraz
koreografi ogrenmek
ister misin diye dusundum!

original: <T>Corry-og-riffy? What's that?
translation: <T>Ko-re-o-gra-fi? O da ne?

original:
<T>It's sort of like actions that
you've got planned out. We
can make them really cute!
translation:
<T>Planladigin hareketler gibi bir sey.
Onlari gercekten sevimli
yapabiliriz!

original: <T>Snuff, snuff...
translation: <T>Snif snif...

original:
<T>S-<W30>sorry. I don't think I could do any of
that. Maybe I'm just not cut out for
acting.
translation:
<T>O-<W30>ozur. Bunlarin hicbirini yapabilecegimi
sanmiyorum. Belki de ben
oyunculuga uygun degilim.

original:
<T>Don't give up before you've
even tried! I'm sure you can
do it!
translation:
<T>Daha denemeden pes etme!
Eminim
yapabilirsin!

original: <T>Practice makes perfect!
translation: <T>Calismak mukemmellestirir!

original:
<T>You really think so? <W>'Kay, I'll give it
a go. But don't expect miracles!
translation:
<T>Gercekten oyle mi dusunuyorsun? <W>Tamam, denerim.
Ama mucize bekleme!

original:
<T>What is it you do best,
<N1>?
translation:
<T>En iyi neyi yaparsin,
<N1>?

original: <T>Best? Mmmm, I don't know...
translation: <T>En iyi mi? Mmmm, bilmiyorum...

original:
<T>I suppose I can jump into the air and
<CR>cheer</C>? Oh, and I can maybe <CR>shiver</C> on
the spot?
translation:
<T>Sanirim havaya ziplayip
<CR>Tezahurat</C> yapabilirim? Bir de belki <CR>Titreme</C> yapip
oldugum yerde durabilirim?

original:
<T>Right, let me jot that down.
Cheering and shivering, you
say?
translation:
<T>Peki, not alayim.
Tezahurat ve titreme,
oyle mi?

original: <T>Mm hmm! Cheering and shivering!
translation: <T>Hi hi! Tezahurat ve titreme!

original: <T>Well, it's a start.
translation: <T>Evet, baslangic icin iyi.

original:
<T>We can do this bit by bit so
we don't overload your little
head with too many actions.
translation:
<T>Bunu parca parca yapalim ki
minik kafani cok fazla
hareketle doldurmayalim.

original:
<T>Let's start with cheering.
Can you tell me a bit more
about that?
translation:
<T>Tezahuratla baslayalim.
Bana biraz daha
anlatir misin?

original: <T>Let me think... <W>This is hard.
translation: <T>Dusuneyim... <W> Bu zor.

original:
<T>Oh, I know! I cheer when I'm happy.
I just jump up into the air and go
{''}yippee{''}!
translation:
<T>Ah, biliyorum! Mutlu olunca tezahurat yaparim.
Havaya ziplar ve
{''}yasasin{''} derim!

original:
<T>Okay, so <CR>Cheer</C> is a happy
action!
translation:
<T>Tamam, demek ki <CR>Tezahurat</C> mutlu bir
hareket!

original: <T>Yep, I'm happy when I'm cheery!
translation: <T>Evet, tezahurat yapinca mutlu olurum!

original:
<T>I'm guessing you <CR>shiver</C> when
you're frightened?
translation:
<T>Sanirim korkunca <CR>Titreme</C>
yapiyorsun?

original: <T>Snuff, snuff... <W30>Yes.
translation: <T>Snif snif... <W30>Evet.

original:
<T>I don't like scary things. They make
me feel all tingly.
translation:
<T>Korkunc seyleri sevmem. Icimi
titretir.

original:
<T>There, there, bunny.<W> All right,
I think we might be able to use
this!
translation:
<T>Tamam, tamam tavsancik.<W> Pekala,
bence bunu
kullanabiliriz!

original:
<T>Just make sure you practise
often!
translation:
<T>Sadece sik sik
pratik yap!

original:
<T>Now, here's an idea. Can you
waggle your tail and try to look
silly?
translation:
<T>Simdi bir fikrim var. Kuyrugunu
sallayip biraz
komik gorunmeyi deneyebilir misin?

original:
<T>Tail? Oh, my tuftie? Okay!<W> I can try to
<CR>waggle</C> my tuftie!
translation:
<T>Kuyruk mu? Ah, ponponum mu? Tamam!<W> Ponponumu
<CR>sallamayi</C> deneyebilirim!

original:
<T>You call your tail {''}tuftie{''}... Is
everything you do going to be
this cute?
translation:
<T>Kuyruguna {''}ponpon{''} diyorsun...
Yaptigin her sey boyle
sevimli mi olacak?

original:
<T>Hey, <N1>!
I've just read the first play and
I've got good news!
translation:
<T>Hey, <N1>!
Az once ilk oyunu okudum ve
iyi haberlerim var!

original:
<T>I think we can already have a
crack at it with what you've
learnt so far!
translation:
<T>Simdiye kadar ogrendiklerinle
bence simdiden
deneyebiliriz!

original:
<T>It's only the first of many, but
you've got to start somewhere!
translation:
<T>Bu daha bircogunun ilki, ama
bir yerden baslamak lazim!

original: <T>R-<W30>really? We're starting so soon?
translation: <T>G-<W30>gercekten mi? Bu kadar cabuk mu basliyoruz?

original:
<T>C-<W30>can I have a bit more time, please?
My fur's out of place and my nose is
itchy and-
translation:
<T>B-<W30>bana biraz daha zaman verir misin lutfen?
Kurkum daginik, burnum
kasiniyor ve-

original:
<T>No excuses! You'll never
manage if you don't try!
translation:
<T>Mazeret yok! Denemezsen
asla basaramazsin!

original:
<T>I'm not very confident about my skills,
though...
translation:
<T>Ama yeteneklerime pek
guvenemiyorum...

original: <T>I told you, it'll be fine!
translation: <T>Sana soyledim, her sey yoluna girecek!

original:
<T>Even if you make a mistake,
there's always a tomorrow!
translation:
<T>Hata yapsan bile,
her zaman yarin vardir!

original: <T>I suppose so...<W> 'Kay! I'll try my best!
translation: <T>Sanirim oyle...<W> Tamam! Elimden geleni yapacagim!

original:
<T>See? Didn't I tell you you'd
do just fine?
translation:
<T>Gordun mu? Sana gayet iyi
olacagini soylememis miydim?

original:
<T>I don't think it'll be long
before you nail the next one
too!
translation:
<T>Bir sonraki oyunda da
ustalasman uzun surmez
bence!

original: <T>Right!
translation: <T>Tamam!

original:
<T>Em, actually, I might have thought up
another action...
translation:
<T>Sey, aslinda bir
hareket daha dusundum...

original: <T>Oh! What is it?
translation: <T>Ah! Nedir o?

original:
<T>Well...maybe it could be an action for
gossiping and hearing exciting news.
translation:
<T>Sey... dedikodu yapmak ve heyecanli bir haber
duymak icin bir hareket olabilir.

original:
<T>And, and also...I have one for when
I'm reeling with exhaustion.
translation:
<T>Ve, ve ayrica... bitkinlikten sendeledigim
zamanlar icin de bir tane var.

original:
<T>Perfect! The wider the variety
of moves you learn, the better!
Keep it up!
translation:
<T>Mukemmel! Ne kadar farkli hareket
ogrenirsen o kadar iyi!
Devam et!

original: <T>'Kay!
translation: <T>Tamam!

original:
<T>Right, <N1>.
I'm going to jot down those
moves in the Bunny Journal.
translation:
<T>Peki, <N1>.
Bu hareketleri Tavsan Gunlugu'ne
not edecegim.

original:
<T>Thank you! I wish I could understand
those scribbles, though.
translation:
<T>Tesekkurler! Keske su karalamalari
anlayabilsem.

original: <T>Okay, so here's the plan.
translation: <T>Tamam, plan soyle.

original:
<T>I think we're going to need to
think of even more moves to
use in the next few plays.
translation:
<T>Bence sonraki birkac oyunda
kullanmak icin daha da fazla
hareket dusunmemiz gerekecek.

original:
<T>Let's see... Maybe you could
act as if you're looking around
nervously.
translation:
<T>Bakalim... Belki de etrafina
telasla bakiyormussun
gibi davranabilirsin.

original:
<T>You might also need to look
a bit sheepish at one point.
translation:
<T>Bir yerde de biraz mahcup
gorunmen gerekebilir.

original:
<T>Mmm, I don't know if I can look like
a sheep...but I'm sure I'll learn!
translation:
<T>Mmm, koyun gibi bakabilir miyim
bilmiyorum... ama ogrenirim!

original:
<T>You won't find it too tricky,
then?
translation:
<T>O kadar zor gelmeyecek
yani?

original:
<T>Nope! Not if you're teaching me,
Luke! But don't forget to write them
down!
translation:
<T>Yok! Sen ogretiyorsan,
Luke! Ama yazmayi
unutma!

original:
<T>Don't worry. I know how
important this is for you.
How could I forget?
translation:
<T>Merak etme. Bunun senin icin
ne kadar onemli oldugunu biliyorum.
Nasil unuturum?

original:
<T>Oh, and there's one more
action that might come in
handy.
translation:
<T>Aa, bir de ise yarayabilecek
bir hareket daha var.

original:
<T>Just try to act like you're
working really, really hard at
something. Can you do that?
translation:
<T>Bir seye gercekten, hem de cok
calisiyormus gibi yap.
Yapabilir misin?

original: <T>Really, really hard?
translation: <T>Gercekten, cok mu?

original: <T>Mmm, that sounds really, really hard...
translation: <T>Mmm, kulaga gercekten cok zor geliyor...

original:
<T>I always find it really, really hard to
dig into the ground when I'm making
a home... But I find it satisfying, too.
translation:
<T>Bir yuva yaparken topragi
kazmak bana her zaman cok,
cok zor gelir... Ama bir yandan da keyifli.

original:
<T>That sounds just like what
we need! Working hard to
achieve something positive.
translation:
<T>Iste tam da ihtiyacimiz olan bu!
Olumlu bir sey basarmak icin
cok calismak.

original:
<T>Just paw at the ground with
everything you've got and
this should be a doddle!
translation:
<T>Tum gucunle patilerinle
topragi esele;
bu cocuk oyuncagi olur!

original:
<T>I'll put that one in the Bunny
Journal as <CR>Dig</C>!
translation:
<T>Bunu Tavsan Gunlugu'ne
<CR>Kaz</C> diye yaziyorum!

original:
<T>Give it a go when you've got
time!
translation: <T>Vaktin olunca dene!

original: <T>'Kaaaay!
translation: <T>Tamaaaam!

original:
<T>What are you up to now,
<N1>?
translation:
<T>Simdi ne yapiyorsun,
<N1>?

original:
<T>Mmm, today, I will be mostly trying to
<CR>roll</C> around on the ground!
translation:
<T>Mmm, bugun cogunlukla yerde
<CR>Yuvarlan</C>mayi deneyecegim!

original:
<T>Roll? As in, tumble forwards,
head over tails?
translation:
<T>Yuvarlanmak mi? Yani one dogru
taklalar atmak gibi mi?

original:
<T>A ball of fluff rolling around...
I can't take it - I want to give
you a cuddle!
translation:
<T>Yuvarlanan bir pofuduk top...
Dayanamiyorum; sarilmak
istiyorum!

original:
<T>Ahem. I'll give you a little hand
with that rolling of yours, if you
don't mind.
translation:
<T>Ohom. Istersen, senin su
yuvarlanma isine biraz yardim
edeyim.

original: <T>Snuff, snuff...<W> Tumbles away!
translation: <T>Snif snif...<W> Yuvarlanip gider!

original:
<T>I'd say you've got quite the
repertoire now, bunbun! How
does that make you feel?
translation:
<T>Bence artik epey
repertuvarin var, tavso! Bu
sana nasil hissettiriyor?

original:
<T>I feel warm and fuzzy inside whenever
you're teaching me, Luke!
translation:
<T>Sen bana bir sey ogrettiginde icim
sicacik oluyor, Luke!

original:
<T>That's a lovely compliment! You
know, you're warm and fuzzy on
the outside, too!
translation:
<T>Ne guzel iltifat! Hem biliyor musun,
disi da sicacik ve pofuduksun!

original: <T>Tee hee hee!
translation: <T>Hihi hihi!

original: <T>Oh!
translation: <T>Aa!

original: <T>That reminds me of an action!
translation: <T>Bu bana bir hareketi hatirlatti!

original:
<T>Okay, let's hear it! Lights,
camera...
translation:
<T>Tamam, dinleyelim! Isiklar,
kamera...

original:
<T>Action! <W>It's an action for when
I think of a new action!
translation:
<T>Motor! <W>Yeni bir hareket aklima
geldiginde yaptigim bir hareket!

original: <T>I beg your pardon?
translation: <T>Pardon?

original:
<T>You know! I think humans have
something similar. What was it again?
Oh, I remember - <CR>eureka</C>!
translation:
<T>Hani! Sanirim insanlarin da
benzeri bir seyi var. Neydi o?
Aa, hatirladim - <CR>Evrika</C>!

original: <T>Ahh! Eureka!
translation: <T>Ahh! Evrika!

original:
<T>I'll scribble that brilliant idea
down in the Bunny Journal
before I forget.
translation:
<T>Unutmadan once bu parlak fikri
Tavsan Gunlugu'ne
karalayacagim.

original: <T>Sounds good to me!
translation: <T>Bana uyar!

original:
<T>I haven't been idle either.
I thought of something for
you during that last play.
translation:
<T>Ben de bos durmadim.
Son oyunda senin icin
bir sey dusundum.

original:
<T>It'd be great if you could
pretend to keel over, as if all
the energy drained from you.
translation:
<T>Sanki tum enerjin cekilmis gibi
bayilip dusuyormus gibi yapabilsen
harika olur.

original:
<T>Also, we might need one for
wriggling around on the floor.
Can you manage those?
translation:
<T>Bir de yerde kivranip
durmak icin bir tane lazim.
Bunlari yapabilir misin?

original:
<T>They sound easy enough... I'll see
what I can do!
translation:
<T>Kulaga yeterince kolay geliyor...
Elimden geleni yaparim!

original:
<T>Good! I'll call the exhausted
one <CR>Slump</C>...
translation:
<T>Guzel! Bitkin olana
<CR>Yigil</C> diyecegim...

original:
<T>And the wriggling one <CR>Tantrum</C>.
Straightforward, right?
translation:
<T>Ve yerde kivranana <CR>Tepin</C>.
Basit, degil mi?

original:
<T><CR>Slump</C> and <CR>Tantrum</C>! I'll get to work on
those right now!
translation:
<T><CR>Yigil</C> ve <CR>Tepin</C>! Hemen
calismaya basliyorum!

original:
<T>Good stuff! I'll make a memo
of those two actions in the
Bunny Journal.
translation:
<T>Harika! Bu iki hareketi
Tavsan Gunlugu'ne
not ediyorum.

original: <T>Righty hop!
translation: <T>Hadi hop!

original:
<T>What's on your mind,
<N1>?
translation:
<T>Aklinda ne var,
<N1>?
<T>Iii...

original:
<T>Well, I once saw a clown from the
troupe spinning round and round and
round.
translation:
<T>Sey... Bir keresinde gosteri
ekibinden bir palyaconun donup
durup durdugunu gordum.

original:
<T>I thought I might be able to do it too,
but I just fall over every time I try!
translation:
<T>Ben de yapabilirim sanmistim,
ama her denedigimde dusuyorum!

original:
<T>If you want to spin like a ballet
dancer, you're doing it the
wrong way, silly bunbun!
translation:
<T>Bale danscisi gibi donmek
istiyorsan, yanlis yapiyorsun,
sapsal tavso!

original:
<T>You have to spin sideways, not
forwards!
translation:
<T>One dogru degil, yana dogru
donmelisin!

original:
<T>Oh! I knew I was doing something
wrong!
translation:
<T>Aa! Bir seyi yanlis yaptigimi
biliyordum!

original: <T>If Hannibal can do it, so can I!
translation:
<T>Hannibal yapabiliyorsa, ben de
yaparim!

original:
<T>I'll show them a spin-a-majig to be
proud of!
translation:
<T>Onlara gurur duyacaklari bir
donus-monus gosterecegim!

original:
<T>That's it! It's great to get
inspiration from others!
translation:
<T>Iste bu! Baskalarindan
ilham almak harika!

original:
<T>All right, let's make sure to
practise that one later.
translation:
<T>Peki, onu sonra
mutlaka calisalim.

original:
<T>Oh, yes please, Luke! Teach me how
to <CR>spin</C>!
translation:
<T>Ah, evet lutfen, Luke! Bana
<CR>Don</C>meyi ogret!

original:
<T>I think you're starting to get
the hang of this acting thing.
Look how far you've come!
translation:
<T>Bence bu oyunculuk isine
alismaya basladin.
Ne kadar ilerledin bir bak!

original: <T>It's all thanks to you, Luke!
translation: <T>Hepsi senin sayende, Luke!

original:
<T>Don't be silly. You did all the
hard work!
translation: <T>Sacmalama. Asil isi sen yaptin!

original:
<T>I'm not the one who has to
go on stage and impress the
ringmaster!
translation:
<T>Sahneye cikip sirk sefini
etkilemesi gereken
ben degilim!

original: <T>You really think so?
translation: <T>Gercekten oyle mi dusunuyorsun?

original:
<T>I know so! Now let's celebrate
and try some dance moves!
translation:
<T>Kesinlikle! Haydi kutlayalim
da birkac dans hareketi deneyelim!

original: <T>Some what?
translation: <T>Ne hareketi?

original: <T>What's a dance? Is it like a prance?
translation: <T>Dans da ne? Sekmek gibi mi?

original:
<T>Almost, yes! I suppose your
kind of dance would be hops
and jumps in a circle.
translation:
<T>Neredeyse! Sanirim sizin tur
dansiniz, bir daire icinde hoplayip
ziplamak olur.

original:
<T>There are loads of different
dancing styles, though!
translation:
<T>Ama bir suru farkli
dans tarzi var!

original:
<T>That sounds amazing! I want to try.
Show me!
translation:
<T>Kulaga harika geliyor! Denemek
istiyorum. Goster!

original:
<T>Wow, you're getting right into
this! Don't worry about the
steps. Do what feels natural.
translation:
<T>Vay, hemen kaptirdin kendini!
Adimlari dert etme.
Icinden geldigi gibi yap.

original:
<T>Work on that till the next play
and we'll be sailing!
translation:
<T>Bir sonraki oyuna kadar buna
calis, gerisi su gibi gelir!

original:
<T>I'll put it in the Bunny Journal
as <CR>Jig</C>. Now strut your fluff!
translation:
<T>Bunu Tavsan Gunlugu'ne
<CR>Kipirda</C> diye yaziyorum. Haydi pofudugunu goster!

original: <T>Yes, sir!
translation: <T>Emredersiniz!

original:
<T><N1>? Can I ask
you something?
translation:
<T><N1>? Sana bir
sey sorabilir miyim?

original: <T>Of course! Fire away, Luke!
translation: <T>Tabii! Sor gitsin, Luke!

original:
<T>What would you do if you
were attacked by a baddie?
translation:
<T>Bir kotu adam sana
saldirsa ne yapardin?

original:
<T>Mmmm, that doesn't sound like fun at
all. I'd be really frightened.
translation:
<T>Mmmm, hic eglenceli gelmedi.
Cok korkardim.

original:
<T>But if someone tried to be mean to
me, I might wallop them with a
bunnykick!
translation:
<T>Ama biri bana kotuluk etmeye
kalkarsa, onu bir
tavsan tekmesiyle devirebilirim!

original: <T>A bunnykick, you say?
translation: <T>Tavsan tekmesi mi dedin?

original:
<T>Yep! I'd just push out with one hind
leg and they'd go flying!
translation:
<T>Evet! Arka bacagimla bir iterim,
ucup giderler!

original:
<T>But why would you ask that? Did
something scary happen to you?
translation:
<T>Ama neden soruyorsun? Basina
korkunc bir sey mi geldi?

original:
<T>No, no, not at all. Though
the prospect of a bunnykick
sounds scary enough...
translation:
<T>Hayir, hayir, hic oyle degil.
Ama tavsan tekmesinin fikri
bile yeterince korkutucu...

original:
<T>I just thought it might be a good
action to add to our growing
list.
translation:
<T>Sadece, buyuyen listemize
eklemek icin iyi bir hareket
olur diye dusundum.

original:
<T>It sounds even better than
what I'd expected, actually!
translation:
<T>Hatta bekledigimden bile iyi
kulaga geliyor!

original:
<T>Really?! Then I'll have to try to perfect
it!
translation:
<T>Gercekten mi?! O zaman onu
mukemmellestirmeye calismaliyim!

original:
<T>The whole circus is going to see me
kick an acorn for ten yards with the
<CR>bunnykick</C>!
translation:
<T>Butun sirk, <CR>Tavsan Tekmesi</C>yle
bir palamudu on yarda
oteye tekmeledigimi gorecek!

original:
<T>That far? Then it's a must for
the Bunny Journal.
translation:
<T>O kadar mi? O zaman Tavsan
Gunlugu'ne sart.

original:
<T>I bet the ringmaster is already
impressed with your progress.
translation:
<T>Eminim sirk sefi simdiden
ilerlemeden etkilenmistir.

original:
<T>You've been working really
hard and it's paid off!
translation:
<T>Cok siki calistin
ve karsiligini aldin!

original: <T>Y-you're right!
translation: <T>H-haklisin!

original: <T>Luke?
translation: <T>Luke?

original:
<T>Can you help me with an action? I'm
having a little trouble with it.
translation:
<T>Bir hareketle bana yardim eder misin?
Biraz zorlaniyorum.

original: <T>Sure! What's the problem?
translation: <T>Tabii! Sorun ne?

original:
<T>More importantly, what's the
action?
translation:
<T>Daha onemlisi, hareket
ne?

original:
<T>Actually, I've been trying to do two of
them.
translation:
<T>Aslinda ikisini birden
calisiyorum.

original:
<T>The first one is a <CR>leap</C> through the air!
I have to flip right over and land on my
feet.
translation:
<T>Ilki havada bir <CR>Sicra</C>!
Takla atip ayaklarimin uzerine
inmem gerekiyor.

original: <T>As for the other one, it's a bit strange.
translation: <T>Digeri ise biraz tuhaf.

original:
<T>If I get really frightened and don't know
what to do, I start to <CR>panic</C>!
translation:
<T>Cok korkup ne yapacagimi
bilemezsem <CR>Panikle</C>meye baslarim!

original:
<T>Right, so you want me to teach
you actions for <CR>leaping</C> and
<CR>panicking</C>.
translation:
<T>Peki, yani sana <CR>Sicra</C> ve
<CR>Panikle</C> hareketlerini
ogretmemi istiyorsun.

original:
<T>I'm not sure how I can help
you with those, but I'll try...
translation:
<T>Bunlarda nasil yardimci olacagim
bilmiyorum ama deneyecegim...

original:
<T>I'll write them down anyway
and we can practise them
later.
translation:
<T>Yine de not edeyim;
sonra birlikte
calisiriz.

original:
<T>Are you trying to come up
with another action,
<N1>?
translation:
<T>Yine yeni bir hareket mi
bulmaya calisiyorsun,
<N1>?

original:
<T>Well, I noticed you say a lot of my
actions are cute. All of them, in fact!
translation:
<T>Sey, sen benim hareketlerimin
coguna 'sevimli' diyorsun fark ettim.
Hatta hepsine!

original:
<T>So I was thinking that maybe I should
branch out more, reinvent myself!
translation:
<T>O yuzden belki biraz cesitlenmeli,
kendimi yeniden kesfetmeliyim diye
dusundum!

original:
<T>But I'm not really coming up with any
good ideas... I've hit a brick wall.
translation:
<T>Ama pek iyi bir fikir bulamiyorum...
Tikandim kaldim.

original:
<T>Oh dear. You can't stop being
cute!
translation:
<T>Aman. Sevimli olmayi
birakamazsin!

original:
<T>But I'm sure you can come
up with something if you
think outside the box.
translation:
<T>Ama kaliplarin disinda dusunursen
mutlaka bir sey bulursun.

original: <T>That's the hard part!
translation: <T>Zor olan da o zaten!

original:
<T>Hey! I've got an idea! It's a
long shot, but...
translation:
<T>Hey! Bir fikrim var! Uzak ihtimal
ama...

original:
<T>There's a dance style I read
about called breakdancing.
It looks really {''}hip{''}!
translation:
<T>Breakdance diye okudugum
bir dans tarzi var.
Bayagi {''}havali{''} gorunuyor!

original: <T>Brick-down-sing? Hip?
translation: <T>Brek-dans mi? Havali?

original:
<T>Well, that's what the book
said! You could even be a...<W>
a <CR>b-bunny</C>!
translation:
<T>Kitap oyle diyordu! Hatta bir...<W>
bir <CR>b-tavsan</C> bile olabilirsin!

original: <T>See if it suits you!
translation: <T>Sana yakisiyor mu bir dene!

original:
<T>I don't really know what it all means,
but all right!
translation:
<T>Ne anlama geldigini pek bilmiyorum
ama peki!

original: <T>I trust you, Luke!
translation: <T>Sana guveniyorum, Luke!

original:
<T>Great! I've made a note in
the Bunny Journal!
translation:
<T>Harika! Tavsan Gunlugu'ne
not ettim!

original:
<T>Your <CR>B-Bunny</C> action is going
to make the crowds go wild!
translation:
<T>Senin <CR>B-Tavsan</C> hareketin
kalabaligi costuracak!

original:
<T>I get to be a bunny doing <CR>B-Bunny</C>?
Are you being funny?
translation:
<T><CR>B-Tavsan</C> yapan bir tavsan mi olacagim?
Dalga mi geciyorsun?

original:
<T>Another perfect play! You're on
fire, <N1>!
translation:
<T>Bir kusursuz oyun daha! Harikasin,
<N1>!

original: <T>...Not literally, though. Ha ha!
translation: <T>...Tabii kelimenin tam anlamiyla degil. Ha ha!

original: <T>Really? Oh, phew!
translation: <T>Gercekten mi? Oh, iyi!

original:
<T>You're really getting there! Just
think - you'll be a fully fledged
actor soon.
translation:
<T>Gercekten cok ilerledin! Dusunsene,
yakinda tam anlamiyla bir
oyuncu olacaksin.

original: <T>I know! I can't wait!
translation: <T>Biliyorum! Sabirsizlaniyorum!

original:
<T>Oh, wow! You performed that
last play brilliantly!
translation:
<T>Vay canina! Son oyunu
muhtesem oynadin!

original:
<T>Maybe we can get you back
into the circus faster than
I thought!
translation:
<T>Belki seni sirke dusundugumden
daha cabuk geri
dondurebiliriz!

original: <T>I'm really enjoying myself!
translation: <T>Cok egleniyorum!

original:
<T>Mr Ringmaster's very critical of my
mistakes, but that's character building,
right?
translation:
<T>Sirk sefi hatalarimi cok elestiriyor
ama bu insani gelistirir,
degil mi?

original:
<T>True, he can be demanding
sometimes, but it'll be good
for you in the long run.
translation:
<T>Dogru, bazen zorlayici olabiliyor
ama uzun vadede
sana iyi gelecek.

original:
<T>Shouting's his way of getting
you to improve.
translation:
<T>Bagirmak onun seni
gelistirme yontemi.

original:
<T>So...does that mean he should shout
at me more?
translation:
<T>Yani... o zaman bana daha mi cok
bagirmali?

original:
<T>That doesn't make sense to me. But if
he's happy, I'm happy!
translation:
<T>Bu bana pek mantikli gelmedi.
Ama o mutluysa ben de mutluyum!

original:
<T>Umm, maybe you can forget
what I just said. Just do your
best!
translation:
<T>Iii, belki az once dedigimi
unut. Sen sadece
elinden geleni yap!

original: <T>Come on, chin up!
translation: <T>Hadi, kafani kaldir!

original: <T>That was fantastic!
translation: <T>Bu harikaydi!

original:
<T>I think even professional
breakdancers would be envious
of that performance!
translation:
<T>Bence profesyonel breakdanscilar
bile o performansi kiskanir!

original: <T>Really? You're not just saying that?
translation: <T>Gercekten mi? Oylesine demiyorsun ya?

original:
<T>Cross my heart! With that
level of technique, everyone
will be gobsmacked.
translation:
<T>Kalbim ustune! O teknikle herkes
agzi acik kalacak.

original: <T>Eee! You flatter me...
translation: <T>Eee! Beni utandiriyorsun...

original:
<T>Another magnificent
performance from the one,
the only...<N1>!
translation:
<T>Bir muhtesem performans daha,
tek ve biricik...
<N1>!

original:
<T>I could tell the ringmaster was
impressed with that one.
translation:
<T>Sirk sefinin bundan etkilendigini
anlayabiliyordum.

original: <T>He was?!
translation: <T>Etkilendi mi?!

original:
<T>Yep. You're really close. It
won't be long before he lets
you rejoin the circus!
translation:
<T>Evet. Cok yaklastin. Yakinda seni
sirke geri donmene
izin verecek!

original:
<T>Aren't you itching to see all
your friends again? I know I
would be!
translation:
<T>Tum arkadaslarini yeniden
gormek icin can atmiyor musun?
Ben olsam atardim!

original:
<T>I am, I am! I feel like I can take on
the world now! Come on, raise the
curtains!
translation:
<T>Atmiyor muyum! Simdi dunyayi bile
fethedebilirmisim gibi hissediyorum!
Haydi, perdeleri acin!

original: <T>You did it, <N1>!
translation: <T>Basardin, <N1>!

original:
<T>I'm sure the ringmaster will
take you back after that
stunning performance!
translation:
<T>Eminim sirk sefi o muhtesem
performanstan sonra
seni geri alacak!

original: <T>Don't! Y-you're making me blush!
translation: <T>Yapma! B-beni utandiriyorsun!

original:
<T>I can't wait to get back to the circus.
It's been so long!
translation:
<T>Sirke geri donmek icin sabirsizlaniyorum.
Cok uzun zaman oldu!

original:
<T>I bet everyone misses you.
It'll be great to be back!
translation:
<T>Eminim herkes seni ozledi.
Geri donmek harika olacak!

original: <T>Yep!
translation: <T>Evet!

original: <T>Mmmm, Luke?
translation: <T>Mmmm, Luke?

original:
<T>What is it,
<N1>?
translation:
<T>Ne oldu,
<N1>?

original:
<T>How would you rate my performance
on a scale of one to ten?
translation:
<T>Performansimi birden ona kadar
nasil degerlendirirsin?

original:
<T>Oh. Well, I'd have to give you
one...
translation:
<T>Ah. Sey, sana bir...
vermem gerek...

original:
<T>One huge hug for getting
a perfect ten!
translation:
<T>Mukemmel on aldigin icin
kocaman bir sarilma!

original: <T>I-I don't believe you...
translation: <T>I-inanmiyorum...

original:
<T>You're the best bunny in the
whole wide world! How could
I ever give you less?
translation:
<T>Sen koca dunyadaki en iyi
tavsansin! Sana nasil daha
az verebilirim?

original: <T>You worked so hard for this!
translation: <T>Bunun icin cok calistin!

original: <T>Eee! Snuff snuff.
translation: <T>Eee! Snif snif.

original:
<T>I suppose it's...time to say
goodbye then.<W> But I'll come
and see you all the time!
translation:
<T>Sanirim... o zaman veda
zamani.<W> Ama sik sik
gelip seni gorecegim!

original:
<T>So make sure you work hard
and give that audience a show
to remember!
translation:
<T>O yuzden siki calis
ve seyirciye unutamayacaklari
bir gosteri sun!

original:
<T>I will! Thank you sooooo much, Luke.
I'll never forget this!
translation:
<T>Yapacagim! Cok ama cooook tesekkurler, Luke.
Bunu asla unutmayacagim!

original:
<T>That's just what we're looking
for! Perfect!
translation:
<T>Iste aradigimiz tam da bu!
Mukemmel!

original:
<T>Keep doing that and you'll
look as focused as a husky!
translation:
<T>Boyle devam edersen
husky kadar odaklanmis gorunursun!

original: <T>You think so?
translation: <T>Sence oyle mi?

original:
<T>I'm updating my Bunny Journal
right this moment, all right?
translation:
<T>Tavsan Gunlugu'nu
hemen simdi guncelliyorum, tamam mi?

original:
<T>You can bring out this action
when you want to look really
determined.
translation:
<T>Gercekten kararli gorunmek
istediginde bu hareketi
kullan.

original: <T>'Kay, I understand!
translation: <T>Tamam, anladim!

original: <T>Urgh, I feel a little bit sick...
translation: <T>Of, biraz midem bulandi...

original: <T>Careful! Don't overdo it!
translation: <T>Dikkat! Abartma!

original:
<T>I'm fine. The room's almost stopped
spinning now. Hee hee.
translation:
<T>Iyiyim. Oda neredeyse artik
donmeyi birakti. Hihi.

original:
<T>You kept it up for a long
time, though! Like a bunny
ballet dancer!
translation:
<T>Ama uzun sure dayandin! Tam bir
tavsan bale danscisi
gibi!

original: <T>W-why, thank you.
translation: <T>S-sey, tesekkurler.

original:
<T>I'll update my notes in the
Bunny Journal.
translation:
<T>Notlarimi Tavsan Gunlugu'nde
guncelliyorum.

original:
<T>If something comes up where
you need to dance, this is
the move to use, all right?
translation:
<T>Dans etmen gereken bir durum
olursa, kullanacagin hareket
bu, tamam mi?

original:
<T>It has another use too: it
can show the audience how
happy you are!
translation:
<T>Bir ise daha yarar: seyirciye
ne kadar mutlu oldugunu
gosterir!

original: <T>Got it!
translation: <T>Anladim!

original:
<T>Wow! When did you learn to
dance like that?
translation:
<T>Vay! Boyle dans etmeyi
ne zaman ogrendin?

original:
<T>I don't think the ringmaster
will be able to ignore this.
translation:
<T>Sirk sefinin bunu gormezden
gelmesi mumkun degil.

original: <T>Mmmm, I'm not so sure...
translation: <T>Mmmm, emin degilim...

original:
<T>But you were the one that helped me
with it, Luke, so maybe he won't!
translation:
<T>Ama buna sen yardim ettin, Luke,
belki de gormezden gelmez!

original:
<T>I only guided you. You're
the one who stuck at it!
translation:
<T>Ben sadece yonlendirdim. Asil
pes etmeyen sendin!

original:
<T>And you worked your
little paws off!
translation:
<T>Hem de kucuk patilerini
yorana kadar calistin!

original:
<T>You look really happy when
doing it, too. The audience
are in for a surprise!
translation:
<T>Yaparken cok mutlu gorunuyorsun.
Seyirciyi bir surpriz
bekliyor!

original:
<T>Okay, this one's getting an
update in the Bunny Journal.
translation:
<T>Tamam, bunun icin Tavsan
Gunlugu'nde bir guncelleme yapiyorum.

original:
<T>Use it for happy moments
and you can't go wrong.
translation: <T>Mutlu anlarda kullan; sasmazsin.

original: <T>Happy times, whee!
translation: <T>Mutlu gunler, yasasin!

original: <T>Waggle, waggle! Look, Luke, I did it!
translation: <T>Salla salla! Bak Luke, yaptim!

original: <T>That's a really cute pose!
translation: <T>Bu cok sevimli bir poz!

original: <T>Really? Hee hee.
translation: <T>Gercekten mi? Hihi.

original:
<T>In fact, it's so adorable I'm
updating the Bunny Journal
right this second.
translation:
<T>Hatta o kadar tatli ki
Tavsan Gunlugu'nu
hemen simdi guncelliyorum.

original:
<T>Try using it in a scene where
you're supposed to be really
excited!
translation:
<T>Cok heyecanli olman gereken
bir sahnede bunu
kullanmayi dene!

original: <T>Will do!
translation: <T>Tamamdir!

original:
<T>You landed that perfectly,
<N1>!
translation:
<T>Harika indin,
<N1>!

original:
<T>I can tell you've been working
hard at that one.
translation:
<T>Belli ki buna cok
calismissin.

original:
<T>Snuff, snuff... I'm pretty good at
jumping, aren't I?
translation:
<T>Snif snif... Ziplamakta
iyiyim, degil mi?

original:
<T>I'm updating the Bunny Journal
right now!
translation:
<T>Tavsan Gunlugu'nu
hemen simdi guncelliyorum!

original:
<T>I probably don't need to tell
you, but use it when you
need to take a leap.
translation:
<T>Muhtemelen soylememe gerek
yok ama, bir atilim yapman
gerektiginde bunu kullan.

original:
<T>It can be a physical leap
or even a mental one. Say,
overcoming a difficult task!
translation:
<T>Bu fiziksel bir sicrayis
olabilecegi gibi zihinsel de. Mesela,
zor bir gorevi basarmak!

original: <T>I think I get it!
translation: <T>Sanirim anladim!

original:
<T>I rarely ever use the bunnykick unless
I feel threatened.
translation:
<T>Kendimi tehdit altinda hissetmedikce
nadiren tavsan tekmesini kullanirim.

original:
<T>Do you think I turned it into an art
form this time?
translation:
<T>Sence bu sefer onu bir sanat
dali haline getirdim mi?

original:
<T>Oh, yes! You could even
call it the mighty art of
bunnykick-boxing!
translation:
<T>Ah, evet! Hatta buna
'Tavsan Tekmesi-Boksu'nun
muthis sanati' bile denir!

original:
<T>And I bet you'd beat all the
baddies with a slap and a
bang!
translation:
<T>Bahse girerim tum kotulerini
bir saplakla ve bir
pat diye yenersin!

original: <T>Just like in kung fu films!
translation: <T>Tipki kung fu filmlerindeki gibi!

original: <T>Whack! Pow! Heeee-yah!
translation: <T>Slak! Pow! Hiiiyaaa!

original:
<T>That's the spirit! I'll update
this secret technique of
yours in the Bunny Journal.
translation:
<T>Iste bu! Bu gizli teknigini
Tavsan Gunlugu'nde
guncelleyecegim.

original: <T>Careful not to smudge it!
translation: <T>Sakin bulastirip lekeleme!

original: <T>That's what you call a roll, isn't it?
translation: <T>Buna takla diyorsun, degil mi?

original:
<T>We call it a somersault in PE,
but yes. And I have to say, it's
much cuter when you do it!
translation:
<T>Beden dersinde 'takla' deriz,
ama evet. Ve soylemeliyim ki,
sen yapinca cok daha sevimli!

original: <T>Mmmm, I feel a tad dizzy, though.
translation: <T>Mmmm, ama birazcik basim donuyor.

original:
<T>But you did it, and that's
what counts! I'll update the
Bunny Journal now.
translation:
<T>Ama basardin, onemli olan
bu! Tavsan Gunlugu'nu
simdi guncelliyorum.

original:
<T>Use it when you want to make
people laugh!
translation:
<T>Insanlari guldurmek istediginde
bunu kullan!

original:
<T>'Kay... But I'll probably be dizzy again
afterwards.
translation:
<T>Tamam... Ama sonra yine
basim donecek gibi.

original:
<T>Look, you did it! That was
amazing!
translation:
<T>Bak, basardin! Bu
inanilmazdi!

original: <T>Do you really think so?!
translation: <T>Gercekten oyle mi diyorsun?!

original:
<T>Any time you need a funky
dance move in a play, you
know what to do!
translation:
<T>Bir oyunda havali bir
dans hareketi gerektiginde
ne yapacagini biliyorsun!

original: <T>Snuff, snuff... Funky!
translation: <T>Pof pof... Funky!

original:
<T>I'll add some notes to the
Bunny Journal, all right?
translation:
<T>Tavsan Gunlugu'ne biraz not
ekleyeyim, olur mu?

original: <T>No objections here!
translation: <T>Benden itiraz yok!

original: <T>Was that good as a slump?
translation: <T>Bu, iyi bir cokus muydu?

original:
<T>Ha ha, that was great! I don't
think I could pull it off even
half so well!
translation:
<T>Ha ha, harikaydi! Ben
bunun yarisi kadar bile
iyi yapamazdim!

original:
<T>You looked completely petered
out. Great! I'll update the Bunny
Journal.
translation:
<T>Tamamen bitkin gorunuyordun.
Harika! Tavsan Gunlugu'nu
guncelleyecegim.

original:
<T>Maybe I could try falling asleep like
that...
translation:
<T>Belki ben de oyle
uyuyakalmayi deneyebilirim...

original:
<T>Luke, stop- Ah ha ha ha! Stop, that
tickles!
translation:
<T>Luke, dur- Ah ha ha ha! Dur, bu
gidikliyor!

original:
<T>Aw, I'm sorry! Just think of it
as part of the training!
translation:
<T>Ah, ozur dilerim! Bunu
antrenmanin bir parcasi say!

original:
<T>I think it looks even cuter
when you're pretending to be
angry!
translation:
<T>Kizmis gibi yapinca
bence daha da sevimli
oluyorsun!

original:
<T>I can do a good impression because
the tickling annoys me so much!
translation:
<T>Iyi taklit ediyorum cunku
gidiklanmak beni cok sinirlendiriyor!

original:
<T>Umm, wait a moment. Is it going to be
tickly every time I do this?
translation:
<T>Sey, bir dakika. Bunu her yaptigimda
hep gidiklayacak mi?

original: <T>Well, um...probably.
translation: <T>Sey, um... muhtemelen.

original:
<T>I'll have to build up a tickling
tolerance... Again from the top, Luke!
translation:
<T>Gidiklanmaya dayaniklilik
kazanmam gerekecek... Bastan al, Luke!

original: <T>Eek! That gave me quite a fright!
translation: <T>Ay! Bu beni epey korkuttu!

original: <T>Sorry about that!
translation: <T>Bunun icin ozur dilerim!

original:
<T>But look, now you can make
a really funny pose!
translation:
<T>Ama bak, simdi gercekten
komik bir poz verebilirsin!

original: <T>That wasn't worth it!
translation: <T>Degdigine hic degmedi!

original:
<T>It will be, I promise! I'll add
the details to the Bunny
Journal.
translation:
<T>Degecek, soz! Ayrintilari
Tavsan Gunlugu'ne
ekleyecegim.

original:
<T>You can definitely use that
action to make people crack
up in hysterics!
translation:
<T>Insanlari kahkahaya bogmak
icin o hareketi kesinlikle
kullanabilirsin!

original:
<T>Mmmm, do we have to practise it
again, though?
translation:
<T>Mmmm, ama onu tekrar
calismak zorunda miyiz?

original:
<T>Well, we'll just have to see,
won't we?
translation:
<T>Eh, gorecegiz,
degil mi?

original: <T>Meanie! Luke's a meanie!
translation: <T>Kotusun! Luke kotusun!

original:
<T>Were you looking, Luke? Did you see
how I balanced on two feet like you?
translation:
<T>Bakiyor muydun, Luke? Tipki senin gibi
iki ayagimin ustunde nasil dengede durdum?

original: <T>Yep! You made it look easy!
translation: <T>Evet! Cok kolaymis gibi yaptin!

original: <T>Whoa, I felt a bit wobbly there...
translation: <T>Vay, biraz sallandim sanki...

original:
<T>You'll soon get the hang of it,
don't worry!
translation:
<T>Yakinda alisirsin,
merak etme!

original:
<T>Now I should be able to practise
%s.
translation:
<T>Simdi sunu calisabilmeliyim:
%s.

original:
<T>Hey, Luke! Watch me
practise this move!
translation:
<T>Hey, Luke! Beni izle,
su hareketi calisiyorum!

original: <T>I want to climb up high!
translation: <T>Yuksege tirmanmak istiyorum!

original:
<T>I'm going to jump across!
Are you watching?
translation:
<T>Atlayip karsiya gececegim!
Bakiyor musun?

original:
<T>Look! I'm going to
play on the slide!
translation:
<T>Bak! Kaydirakta
oynayacagim!

original: <T>I'm getting a bit sleepy...
translation: <T>Biraz uykum geliyor...

original: Cheer
translation: Neselen

original: A little hop of happiness.
translation: Mutluluktan kucuk bir ziplayis.

original:
Do you ever feel so happy that you
just want to spring into the air? Use
this for joy!
translation:
Hic oyle mutlu olur musun ki
kendini havaya atmak istersin? Nese icin
bunu kullan!

original: Jaunt
translation: Gezinti

original: Walk along at a merry pace.
translation: Sen bir tempoyla yuru.

original:
It's natural to bounce along
when you're in a cheery
mood. Use this for joy!
translation:
Neseli bir ruh halindeyken
seke seke yurumek dogaldir. Nese icin
bunu kullan!

original: Prance
translation: Sekme

original: Bound forwards with delight.
translation: Sevincle ileri dogru sicra.

original:
It's that feeling you get when
you see someone you care
about. Use this for joy!
translation:
Sevdigin birini gorunce
hissettigin o duygu var ya... Nese icin
bunu kullan!

original: Blush
translation: Kizar

original: A little bit embarrassed.
translation: Biraz utanmis.

original:
This is like getting a compliment -
you feel a bit embarrassed, but
kind of pleased too!
translation:
Bu, iltifat almak gibi—
biraz utanirsin ama
bir yandan da hosuna gider!

original: Dig
translation: Kaz

original: Work hard at digging.
translation: Kazmak icin canla basla calis.

original:
Bunnies look determined when they're
digging. I could try tapping the
ground around his feet...
translation:
Tavsanlar kazarken
kararli gorunur. Ayaklarinin
cevresindeki yere dokunmayi deneyebilirim...

original:
Intently pawing at the ground
everywhere looks like hard work.
Use this to show determination!
translation:
Her yeri dikkatle eselemek
epey yorucu gorunuyor.
Kararliligi gostermek icin bunu kullan!

original: Spin
translation: Don

original: Twirl on the spot.
translation: Oldugun yerde don.

original:
I need to get him on his hind legs and
make him spin. Maybe if I rub his
chest from side to side...
translation:
Onu arka ayaklari uzerine
kaldirip dondurmem gerek.
Belki gogsunu saga sola oksarsam...

original:
Have you seen figure skaters
spinning? They're really
something. Use this for joy!
translation:
Artistik patencilerin
donuslerini gordun mu? Gercekten
harikalar. Nese icin bunu kullan!

original: Jig
translation: Jig

original: A gleeful, lively dance.
translation: Neseli, hareketli bir dans.

original:
I want a spin, then backflip. It might
work if he stands up and I rub him
from head to tummy.
translation:
Once donsun, sonra takla atsin istiyorum.
Ayaga kalkarsa, basindan karnina kadar
oksamak ise yarayabilir.

original:
With these moves, you could easily
be a street performer! Use this for
overwhelming joy!
translation:
Bu hareketlerle rahatca
sokak sanatcisi olursun! Coskun nese icin
bunu kullan!

original: Waggle
translation: Kipirdat

original: A cheeky tail waggle.
translation: Yaramaz bir kuyruk kipirdatisi.

original:
He called his tail {''}tuftie{''}! Maybe if
I try pulling it from side to side...
translation:
Kuyruguna {''}tuftie{''} demis!
Belki saga sola cekmeyi denersem...

original:
There's nothing cuter than a little
fuzzy rabbit wiggling its bottom!
Use this for playfulness!
translation:
Pofuduk bir tavsanin
poposunu kipirdatmasindan daha sevimlisi yok!
Senlik icin bunu kullan!

original: Handwalk
translation: Elde Yuru

original: A wobbly walk on front legs.
translation: On ayaklari uzerinde sendeleyerek yuru.

original:
It's nerve-wracking to watch,
but very entertaining. Use
this for playfulness!
translation:
Izlemesi insani geriyor
ama cok eglenceli. Senlik icin
bunu kullan!

original: Leap
translation: Sicra

original: Do a great leap in the air.
translation: Havaya kocaman bir sicrayis yap.

original:
A big leap, hmm? I could make him
face the other way and then try
tapping him on his back...
translation:
Kocaman bir sicrayis, ha?
Onu diger yone cevirip
sirtina dokunmayi deneyebilirim...

original:
I think the funniest bit is the way
he has to get ready. Use this for
playfulness!
translation:
En komigi, hazirlanis sekli bence.
Senlik icin
bunu kullan!

original: Spy
translation: Gozetle

original: Look around furtively.
translation: Gizlice etrafa bak.

original:
All that glancing around can make
you look suspicious... Use this when
searching for something!
translation:
Oyle etrafa bakinmak
insani supheli gosterebilir...
Bir sey ararken bunu kullan!

original: Bunnykick
translation: Tavsan Tekmesi

original: A fierce kick only for rabbits.
translation: Sadece tavsanlara ozgu acimasiz bir tekme.

original:
To kick, he would have to stand up.
Then a quick double-tap to his left or
right might bring out his inner fighter.
translation:
Tekme atmasi icin ayaga kalkmali.
Sonra soluna ya da sagina hizlica iki kez dokunmak
icindeki dovuscuyu ortaya cikarabilir.

original:
I see it now: bunnykick-boxing, the
world-class martial art! Use this at
dramatic moments!
translation:
Gozumde canlandi: tavsan-tekme boksu,
dunya capinda bir dovus sanati! Bunu
dramatik anlarda kullan!

original: Roll
translation: Yuvarlan

original: An adorable forward roll.
translation: Sevimli bir one takla.

original:
If it's anything like a forward roll,
he might do it if I rub his back...
translation:
One takla gibi bir seyse,
sirtini oksarsam yapabilir...

original:
He's so cute when he rolls up into
a ball. Use this for playfulness!
translation:
Top gibi yuvarlandiginda
cok sevimli oluyor. Senlik icin
bunu kullan!

original: B-Bunny
translation: B-Tavsan

original: Perform some hip hops!
translation: Biraz hip hop hareketi yap!

original:
Apparently, he'll have to start with
a handstand. Then I can try rocking
him from side to side.
translation:
Gorunuse gore once amuda kalkmali.
Sonra onu saga sola sallamayi deneyebilirim.

original:
Breakdancing is hard, but it'll score
you major points for style! Use this
for dancing scenes!
translation:
Breakdans zor ama
tarz puanini ucurur! Dans sahneleri icin
bunu kullan!

original: Shiver
translation: Titreme

original: Tremble with fear.
translation: Korkudan titriyor.

original:
A shudder of genuine terror. You
should use this when you want to
look really scared!
translation:
Gercek bir dehset titremesi.
Gercekten korkmus gorunmek istediginde
bunu kullan!

original: Sulk
translation: Somurt

original: Shuffle along miserably.
translation: Surune surune, mutsuzca yuru.

original:
This is sure to make you look down
in the dumps. Use it to express
disappointment!
translation:
Bu hareket seni kesinlikle
suratsiz gosterir. Hayal kirikligini
anlatmak icin kullan!

original: Flee
translation: Kac

original: Run away in terror!
translation: Dehset icinde kac!

original:
This really captures the essence
of fear. Use it when you want to
make a quick escape!
translation:
Korkunun ozunu yakaliyor.
Hizlica sivismak istediginde
bunu kullan!

original: Stamp
translation: Tepin

original: Stamp your feet in a huff.
translation: Sinirle ayaklarini yere vur.

original:
Use this action when you're
so frustrated that you just
can't help yourself.
translation:
Oyle sinirlenirsin ki
kendini tutamazsin ya...
Iste o anlarda bunu kullan.

original: Slump
translation: Yigil

original: Collapse with exhaustion.
translation: Yorgunluktan yigil.

original:
He has to be splayed out for this
to work. Hmm... I could try pulling
his tummy to the floor?
translation:
Bunun olmasi icin
bacaklarini iki yana acip yayilmali. Himm...
karnini yere dogru cekmeyi deneyebilirim?

original:
Falling flat is a great form of
expression! Try it when you need
to look either injured or tired.
translation:
Yere kapanmak harika bir ifade bicimi!
Yarali ya da yorgun gorunmen gerektiginde
bunu dene.

original: Stagger
translation: Sendel

original: Wobble on the verge of falling.
translation: Dusecek gibi sendele.

original:
Have you ever been so exhausted
your legs could hardly hold you?
Use this to look tired or ill.
translation:
Hic o kadar yoruldun mu ki
bacaklarin seni zor tasidi? Yorgun ya da hasta
gorunmek icin bunu kullan.

original: Tantrum
translation: Ofke Nobeti

original: Squirm with frustration!
translation: Sinirle kivran!

original:
I used to roll over and writhe as
a baby. I think tickling his chest
might provoke a similar reaction!
translation:
Bebekken doner doner kivranirdim.
Gogsunu gidiklamak benzer bir tepki
dogurabilir bence!

original:
He's just so cute when he's
wriggling! I think we can use
this to show exasperation.
translation:
Kivranirken cok sevimli!
Bunu bezginligi
gostermek icin kullanabiliriz.

original: Shock
translation: Sok

original: Fall over with surprise.
translation: Saskinliktan yere kapaklan.

original:
So overcome with shock that
you fall on your backside!
Use this for surprise.
translation:
Oyle sasirirsin ki
poponun ustune dusersin!
Surpriz icin bunu kullan.

original: Awe
translation: Hayranlik

original: Look from side to side in awe.
translation: Hayranlikla saga sola bak.

original:
This action makes it look as if there
are incredible things all around!
Use it for amazement!
translation:
Bu hareket, her yanda
inanilmaz seyler varmis gibi gosterir!
Saskinlik icin bunu kullan!

original: Slink
translation: Suzul

original: Sneak with intent.
translation: Niyetli bir sekilde sinsice ilerle.

original:
Slowly does it...and don't make
a sound. Use this action in
moments of suspense!
translation:
Yavasca... ve ses cikarma.
Gerilim anlarinda
bunu kullan!

original: Worry
translation: Endise

original: A gush of concern.
translation: Bir anda yukselen endise.

original:
Don't worry about how to use it!
Just use it to express worry!
translation:
Nasil kullanilacagini dert etme!
Endiseni gostermek icin
kullan yeter!

original: Eureka
translation: Buldum!

original: What a brilliant idea!
translation: Ne parlak bir fikir!

original:
When you think and think, scratch
your head and finally, you get it!
That's when to use this action.
translation:
Dusunur dusunur, kafani kasir
ve sonunda anlarsin ya! Iste o zaman
bu hareketi kullan.

original: Chatter
translation: Sohbet

original: Chat away enthusiastically.
translation: Hevesle sohbet et.

original:
Talk for a bit, listen for a bit,
smile and nod, as if you were
having a conversation!
translation:
Biraz konus, biraz dinle,
gulumse ve basini salla; sanki
sohbet ediyormussun gibi!

original: Panic
translation: Panik

original: Jump and flail hysterically.
translation: Histerikce zipla ve cirpin.

original:
It's a little bit mean, but I'll
have to get him on his hind
legs and poke his tummy.
translation:
Biraz acimasizca ama
onu arka ayaklari uzerine kaldirip
karnini durtmem gerekecek.

original:
I think you could almost interpret it as
a dance! He even clicks his heels...
translation:
Neredeyse dans gibi bile sayilabilir!
Hatta topuklarini bile tiklatiyor...

original:
You'll want to amble along in a
joyful way here. Look happy!
translation:
Burada neseyle
salina salina yuru. Mutlu gorun!

original:
Look frightened.
Maybe shake a little.
translation:
Korkmus gorun.
Belki biraz titre.

original:
This one should be easy!
Just look surprised.
translation:
Bu kolay olmali!
Sadece sasirmis gorun.

original:
Hah. I don't think you need my
help for this.
translation:
Hah. Sanirim bunun icin
benim yardimima ihtiyacin yok.

original:
Look around at your surroundings
in amazement.
translation:
Etrafina hayretle
bak.

original:
This one's easy. I want to
see you bursting with joy!
translation:
Bu da kolay. Neseden
uctugunu gormek istiyorum!

original:
Ready to give it your all?
First, I want a gleeful look.
translation:
Elinden geleni yapmaya hazir misin?
Once, yuzunde neseli bir ifade istiyorum.

original:
What would you do if you were
startled awake? Do that.
translation:
Korkuyla uyansaydin ne yapardin?
Aynisini yap.

original:
This is the key part, you hear?
Look playful, act the fool!
translation:
Burasi kilit kisim, duydun mu?
Sakaci gorun, maskaralik yap!

original:
It's dangerous, so you're
scared. Got it?
translation:
Tehlikeli, bu yuzden
korkuyorsun. Anladin mi?

original:
Hmm... I think a slightly bashful
look would work best here.
translation:
Himm... Bence burada biraz utangac
bir ifade en iyisi olur.

original:
I want you looking concerned, as
if you don't know what to do.
translation:
Ne yapacagini bilmiyormus gibi,
endiseli gorunmeni istiyorum.

original:
You're working hard, doing the
best you can for your little friend.
translation:
Kucuk arkadasin icin elinden gelenin
en iyisini yaparak cok calisiyorsun.

original:
Hmm... You want to look excited. So
excited that you're whirling around!
translation:
Himm... Heyecanli gorunmelisin. Oyle
heyecanli ki kendi etrafinda donuyorsun!

original:
Come on! I hardly need
to tell you this one.
translation:
Hadi ama! Bunu sana
anlatmama bile gerek yok.

original:
You've just woken up and
you're late, so look anxious!
translation:
Yeni uyandin ve gec kaldin;
bu yuzden endiseli gorun!

original:
Hmph. I reckon you'd be so annoyed
that you just wriggle about here.
translation:
Hih. O kadar sinirlenmis olmalisin ki
burada kipir kipir duruyorsun.

original:
I want you looking quite
green with envy, vexed.
translation:
Burada kiskancliktan catlayan,
cani sikkin gorunmeni istiyorum.

original:
You're the picture of bliss here,
as you dream of your new house.
translation:
Burada mutluluktan ucuyorsun,
yeni evinin hayalini kurarken.

original:
Make it a bit more excited now.
Maybe even a little playful!
translation:
Simdi biraz daha heyecanli yap.
Hatta biraz sakaci bile ol!

original:
You're very pleased with your
idea, so we want to capture joy.
translation:
Fikrinden cok memnunsun,
bu yuzden neseni yansitalim.

original:
It just dawned on you, so act
as if you've had a great idea!
translation:
Aklina yeni geldi; sanki
harika bir fikir bulmussun gibi davran!

original:
I want you to look surprised at
the naughty wolf's behaviour.
translation:
Yaramaz kurdun davranisina
sasirmis gorunmeni istiyorum.

original:
You should smack that naughty
wolf! Show him who's boss!
translation:
O yaramaz kurda bir tokat at!
Patronun kim oldugunu goster!

original: Really make fun of the wolf here.
translation: Burada kurtla iyice dalga gec.

original:
This is the play's high point!
Launch yourself through the air!
translation:
Oyunun doruk noktasi burasi!
Kendini havaya firlat!

original:
Show me how angry you are
with the wolf down the hole!
translation:
Asagidaki delikteki kurda
ne kadar kizgin oldugunu goster!

original:
It's a happy ending, so you're
dancing and bouncing around!
translation:
Mutlu son, bu yuzden
ziplayip oynuyorsun!

original:
Get across how angry you are
that a hunter would lay a trap.
translation:
Bir avcinin tuzak kurmasina
ne kadar kizdigini belli et.

original:
You're searching hard for herbs
to help the poor bear!
translation:
Zavalli ayiya yardim etmek icin
sifali otlari haril haril ariyorsun!

original:
You've just seen a hunter!
How surprised do you feel?
translation:
Az once bir avci gordun!
Ne kadar sasirdin?

original:
How did Bear move you? Make
the audience laugh here.
translation:
Ayi seni nasil etkiledi? Burada
izleyiciyi guldur.

original:
Let your happiness really show
for the final happy ending!
translation:
Son mutlu bitiste mutlulugunu
iyice goster!

original: Imagine how shy you'll be!
translation: Ne kadar utangac olacagini hayal et!

original:
Everybody gets a little nervous
before going on stage.
translation:
Sahneye cikmadan once
herkes biraz gerilir.

original:
Dash it all! Shatter that wall
of worry with a single blow!
translation:
Kahretsin! Endise duvarini
tek bir darbeyle paramparca et!

original:
Before you really start to dance,
get your hips warmed up!
translation:
Dans etmeye baslamadan once,
kalcani biraz isit!

original:
You can walk on your front paws,
right? Show them how it's done!
translation:
On patilerin uzerinde yuruyebiliyorsun,
degil mi? Onlara nasil oldugunu goster!

original:
You're gambolling with glee!
Show the crowd how you feel.
translation:
Sevincle hoplayip zipliyorsun!
Kalabaliga nasil hissettigini goster.

original:
This one needs to look a little odd.
Try a clumsy jump with a heel click.
translation:
Bu biraz tuhaf gorunmeli.
Topugunu saklatarak beceriksizce zipla.

original:
Now break off your dance
with a grand finish!
translation:
Simdi dansini
muhtesem bir finalle bitir!

original:
A cheeky little gesture works
here. Show off that cuteness.
translation:
Burada muzir kucuk bir hareket ise yarar.
O sevimliligini goster.

original:
To save the boy, you're going
to have to kick off your fears.
translation:
Cocugu kurtarmak icin
korkularini tekmelemen gerekecek.

original: Just a simple tumble should do.
translation: Basit bir takla yeter.

original:
You're tired and sore, but you'd
still do anything to save the boy!
translation:
Yorgun ve agrilisin ama
cocugu kurtarmak icin her seyi yaparsin!

original:
You're on your way out.
The choice is obvious.
translation:
Yola cikiyorsun.
Secim cok acik.

original:
In this moving scene, you
should appear modest.
translation:
Bu dokunakli sahnede,
mutevazi gorunmelisin.

original:
You're happy that the boy is well.
Show him you're over the moon!
translation:
Cocugun iyi olmasina sevindin.
Ona havalara uctugunu goster!

original:
At the start, you need
to look hard at work.
translation:
Baslangicta, ise
tam odaklanmis gorunmelisin.

original:
How would you feel if Fox was
making fun of you? Angry!
translation:
Tilki seninle
alay etse ne hissederdin? Ofkeli!

original: Give it your best look of concern.
translation: En iyi endiseli bakisini takin.

original:
I want you to look surprised
when you open that door!
translation:
O kapiyi actiginda
sasirmis gorunmeni istiyorum!

original: Show how happy you are!
translation: Ne kadar mutlu oldugunu goster!

original:
Sometimes, saying your feelings
can be embarrassing. Show it!
translation:
Bazen duygularini soylemek
utandirici olabilir. Goster bunu!

original:
It's a happy ending, so
make it feel like one!
translation:
Bu mutlu bir son, oyleyse
oyle hissettir!

original:
<T>In the <CR>Rabbit Show</C> minigame, your aim is to
help your rabbit become a worthy member of
the Stellar Circus.
translation:
<T><CR>Tavsan Gosterisi</C> mini oyununda amacin,
tavsaninin Yildiz Sirki'nin
layik bir uyesi olmasina yardimci olmak.

original:
<T>You must help the rabbit perform to the
ringmaster's satisfaction in every <CR>play</C>
of the circus's <CR>rabbit show</C>.
translation:
<T>Sirk yoneticisini memnun etmek icin
sirk <CR>tavsan gosterisi</C>ndeki her <CR>oyun</C>da
tavsanin performansina yardimci olmalisin.

original:
<T>To perform in the rabbit show, your rabbit will
have to learn some <CR>actions</C>.
translation:
<T>Tavsan gosterisinde yer almak icin tavsanin
bazi <CR>hareketler</C> ogrenmesi gerekecek.

original:
<T>To teach the rabbit actions, try having a little
<CR>chat</C> with it.
translation:
<T>Tavsana hareket ogretmek icin onunla biraz
<CR>sohbet</C> etmeyi dene.

original:
<T>You can also <CR>train</C> the rabbit to help it learn
lots of different actions.
translation:
<T>Ayrica tavsani <CR>egit</C>erek
bircok farkli hareket ogrenmesine yardimci olabilirsin.

original:
<T>Every action that your rabbit learns is
recorded in the <CR>Bunny Journal</C> as a
<CR>mastered action</C>.
translation:
<T>Tavsanin ogrendigi her hareket
<CR>Tavsan Gunlugu</C>'ne
<CR>ustalasilan hareket</C> olarak kaydedilir.

original:
<T>Touch <CR>Bunny Journal</C> on the bottom of the
Touch Screen to check the list of your
rabbit's actions.
translation:
<T>Tavsaninin hareket listesini gormek icin
Dokunmatik Ekran'in altindaki <CR>Tavsan Gunlugu</C>'ne dokun
ve listeyi kontrol et.

original:
<T>Sometimes the <CR>Bunny Journal</C> contains hints
on how to teach your rabbit an action that it
doesn't know yet.
translation:
<T>Bazen <CR>Tavsan Gunlugu</C>, tavsanina henuz
bilmedigi bir hareketi nasil ogretecegine dair
ipuclari icerir.

original:
<T>Make sure you check the journal every now
and then.
translation:
<T>Gunlugu ara sira
kontrol etmeyi unutma.

original:
<T>When you're not in the mood for circus
training, try touching the different <CR>rabbit
icons</C>.
translation:
<T>Sirk egitimi yapmak istemediginde, farkli <CR>tavsan
simgelerine</C> dokunmayi dene.

original:
<T>You can just watch as your rabbit hops
around and plays in its hutch.
translation:
<T>Tavsanin kulubesinde ziplayip oynayisini
istersen sadece izleyebilirsin.

original:
<T>Try to get to know your rabbit and teach it
a variety of amusing <CR>actions</C> to perform in
the rabbit show <CR>plays</C>!
translation:
<T>Tavsanini tanimaya calis ve ona
tavsan gosterisi <CR>oyun</C>larinda sergilemesi icin
cesitli eglenceli <CR>hareketler</C> ogret!

original:
<T>Touch <CR>Chat</C> to see if your rabbit has anything
on its mind. It might have something
important to discuss with you!
translation:
<T>Tavsaninin aklinda bir sey var mi gormek icin <CR>Sohbet</C>'e dokun.
Seninle konusmak istedigi
onemli bir sey olabilir!

original:
<T>From time to time it will have an idea for
a new <CR>action</C>, which will be recorded in
your <CR>Bunny Journal</C> after the chat.
translation:
<T>Zaman zaman yeni bir <CR>hareket</C> fikri olur;
sohbetten sonra bu,
<CR>Tavsan Gunlugu</C>'ne kaydedilir.

original:
<T>You can also teach your rabbit new <CR>actions</C>
by <CR>training</C> it.
translation:
<T>Tavsanina yeni <CR>hareketler</C> ogretmeyi
onu <CR>egiterek</C> de deneyebilirsin.

original:
<T>Make sure you check the <CR>Bunny Journal</C>
often, to see what new actions your
rabbit can learn and how to teach them.
translation:
<T>Hangi yeni hareketleri ogrenebilecegini
ve nasil ogretecegini gormek icin <CR>Tavsan Gunlugu</C>'nu
sik sik kontrol etmeyi unutma.

original:
<T>When you touch <CR>Train</C>, the rabbit will hop
up close so you can touch it with the stylus.
translation:
<T><CR>Egit</C>'e dokundugunda tavsan
yaklasir; boylece kalemle ona dokunabilirsin.

original:
<T>Once it comes up to you, follow the hints
in the <CR>Bunny Journal</C> to teach your rabbit
new <CR>actions</C>.
translation:
<T>Yanina gelince, tavsanina yeni <CR>hareketler</C> ogretmek icin
<CR>Tavsan Gunlugu</C>'ndeki ipuclarini
takip et.

original: <T>Let's start with some basic interactions.
translation: <T>Once temel etkilesimlerle baslayalim.

original:
<T>Touch the arrows on either side of the Touch
Screen to make your rabbit turn around on
the spot.
translation:
<T>Tavsaninin yerinde donmesini saglamak icin
Dokunmatik Ekran'in iki yanindaki oklarina dokun
ve onu cevirmeyi dene.

original:
<T>The rabbit already knows some basic moves:
it can <CR>stand on its hind legs</C> and <CR>do a
handstand</C>. Let's try those.
translation:
<T>Tavsan zaten bazi temel hareketleri biliyor:
<CR>arka ayaklarinin uzerinde durabilir</C> ve <CR>ters
durabilir</C>. Haydi deneyelim.

original:
<T>To get your rabbit to stand up, <CR>touch and
hold its chest, then slide the stylus straight
up in a slow and steady motion</C>.
translation:
<T>Tavsanini kaldirmak icin, <CR>gogsune dokunup
basili tut, sonra kalemi yavas ve sabit bir hareketle
dumduz yukari dogru kaydir</C>.

original: <T>Your rabbit will stand up on its hind legs!
translation: <T>Tavsanin arka ayaklarinin uzerinde duracak!

original:
<T>When your rabbit's stood up for as long as
you want, <CR>rub its head</C> gently with the stylus
and it will return to all fours.
translation:
<T>Tavsanin yeterince ayakta kaldiginda,
kalemle <CR>basini oksa</C> ve
yeniden dort ayagi uzerine insin.

original:
<T>Why don't you try it out? Use the stylus to
get your rabbit to stand up on its hind legs.
translation:
<T>Hadi sen de dene! Kalemi kullanarak
tavsanini arka ayaklarinin uzerinde durdur.

original: <T>Now let's try a handstand.
translation: <T>Simdi amuda kalkmayi deneyelim.

original:
<T>To get your rabbit to do a handstand,
<CR>touch and hold its head, then slide the stylus
straight down in one slow motion</C>.
translation:
<T>Tavsanina amuda kalktirmak icin,
<CR>basina dokunup basili tut, sonra kalemi
tek yavas hareketle dumduz asagi kaydir</C>.

original:
<T>When your rabbit's done a handstand for as
long as you want, <CR>rub its head</C> gently with
the stylus and it will stop.
translation:
<T>Tavsanin istedigin kadar amutda kaldiktan sonra,
<CR>kalemle basini nazikce ovustur</C> ve duracaktir.

original:
<T>Go on, give it a try! Use the stylus to get
your rabbit to do a handstand.
translation:
<T>Hadi, dene bakalim! Kalemi kullanarak
tavsanini amuda kaldir.

original:
<T>Now then, let's try to teach your rabbit the
action <CR>Waggle</C>.
translation:
<T>Simdi, tavsanina
<CR>Waggle</C> hareketini ogretmeyi deneyelim.
