original:
<T>First, get your rabbit to turn around until
it has its back to you.
translation:
<T>Once, tavsanin sana arkasini donene kadar
donmesini sagla.

original:
<T>Then <CR>touch the rabbit's back and slide the
stylus in wide motions back and forth from
left to right</C>.
translation:
<T>Sonra <CR>tavsanin sirtina dokun ve kalemi
soldan saga dogru genis hareketlerle
ileri geri kaydir</C>.

original:
<T>If you do it right, your rabbit will wiggle
its bottom from side to side. That's all it
takes to learn <CR>Waggle</C>.
translation:
<T>Dogru yaparsan tavsanin kalcasini saga sola
kipirdatir. <CR>Waggle</C> ogrenmek icin gereken
tek sey bu.

original:
<T>Now your rabbit knows a few actions, how
about trying out the rabbit show?
translation:
<T>Artik tavsanin birkac hareket biliyor. Peki,
tavsan gosterisini denemeye ne dersin?

original:
<T>You obtain new play scripts for the rabbit
show by solving puzzles in the main game.
translation:
<T>Ana oyunda bulmacalari cozerek tavsan
gosterisi icin yeni oyun metinleri kazanirsin.

original:
<T>There are ten scripts in total. Each of them
tells a different story using its own set of
<CR>actions</C>.
translation:
<T>Toplam on metin var. Her biri kendi
<CR>hareketler</C> setini kullanarak farkli bir hikaye
anlatir.

original:
<T>Once you choose a play, touch <CR>Rehearse!</C>
on the Touch Screen to prepare the
performance.
translation:
<T>Bir oyun secince, gosteriyi hazirlamak icin
Dokunmatik Ekran'da <CR>Rehearse!</C> secenegine
dokun.

original:
<T>In the rabbit show, the rabbit must perform
<CR>actions</C> to accompany a story.
translation:
<T>Tavsan gosterisinde tavsan, bir hikayeye eslik etmek icin
<CR>hareketler</C> sergilemelidir.

original:
<T>You need to select appropriate actions to
<CR>illustrate key parts of the script</C>.
translation:
<T>Uygun hareketleri secerek
<CR>senaryonun kilit bolumlerini canlandirmalisin</C>.

original:
<T>The ringmaster will watch the rabbit's
performance and decide whether it is
satisfactory or not.
translation:
<T>Sirk yoneticisi tavsanin
performansini izleyecek ve
yeterli olup olmadigina karar verecek.

original:
<T>Touch the arrows on either side of the
Touch Screen to scroll through the script
and select an action for each plot point.
translation:
<T>Senaryoda ilerlemek icin Dokunmatik Ekran'in
iki yanindaki oklarina dokun ve
her olay noktasi icin bir hareket sec.

original:
<T>Once you've chosen an appropriate action,
touch <CR>Select</C> to set it.
translation:
<T>Uygun bir hareket secince,
onu belirlemek icin <CR>Sec</C>'e dokun.

original:
<T>Every part of the story that has a blank space
requires an <CR>action</C>. You can't leave any gaps
in the performance!
translation:
<T>Bosluk olan her hikaye kismi
bir <CR>hareket</C> gerektirir. Performansta hic bosluk
birakamazsin!

original:
<T>The ringmaster will give you <CR>hints</C> for certain
key lines in the script. Pay attention to him!
translation:
<T>Sirk yoneticisi senaryodaki bazi
kilit satirlar icin <CR>ipucu</C> verir. Ona dikkat et!

original:
<T>If you don't satisfy his expectations for those
actions, he will fail the rabbit on that play.
translation:
<T>O hareketlerde beklentilerini karsilayamazsan,
o oyunda tavsani basarisiz sayar.

original:
<T>Once you are ready to perform, touch
<CR>Curtain Up!</C> to start the show.
translation:
<T>Hazir oldugunda,
gosteriyi baslatmak icin <CR>Perde Ac!</C>'a dokun.

original:
<T>You will obtain new play scripts to try out
as you play through the main game.
translation:
<T>Ana oyunda ilerledikce denemek icin
yeni oyun senaryolari kazanacaksin.

original:
<T>If you can successfully perform every play,
you may get a reward of some kind!
translation:
<T>Tum oyunlari basariyla sergilersen,
bir cesit odul kazanabilirsin!

original:
{''}%s{''}
complete!
translation:
{''}%s{''}
tamamlandi!

original:
You failed... Better
luck next time!
translation:
Basarisiz oldun...
Bir dahaki sefere daha iyi sanslar!

original: Are you sure you want to quit?
translation: Cikmak istedigine emin misin?

original:
{''}%s{''} has been added
to the Bunny Journal!
translation:
{''}%s{''} Tavsan Gunlugu'ne
eklendi!

<N1> ogrendi
{''}%s{''}!

original:
More info has been added
for {''}%s{''}!
translation:
{''}%s{''} icin daha fazla bilgi
eklendi!

original:
The Bunny Journal details
all your rabbit's actions.
Check your actions below!
translation:
Tavsan Gunlugu, tavsaninin
tum hareketlerini gosterir.
Asagidan hareketlerini kontrol et!

original:
Select the right actions to
go with the script and
make the show a success!
translation:
Metne uyan dogru hareketleri
sec ve
gosteriyi basariya ulastir!
